Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer Hashed Table von `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit einer Hashed Table für die Zwischenergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_passenger_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ts_passenger_count.
    TYPES: tt_passenger_count_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ts_passenger_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS get_total_passengers_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_passenger_counts) TYPE tt_passenger_count_hashed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_passengers_by_carrier.
    rt_passenger_counts = REDUCE tt_passenger_count_hashed(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_passenger_count_hashed( )
      FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights
      LET lv_index = sy-tabix IN
      NEXT result = COND tt_passenger_count_hashed(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL OR NOT line_exists( result[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] )
          THEN VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_passengers = ls_flight-seatsocc ) )
        ELSE
          VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_passengers = result[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ]-total_passengers + ls_flight-seatsocc ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_passenger_counts FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_passenger_counts.
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_reduce=>tt_sflight_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_reduce( lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lt_passenger_counts) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_passenger_counts ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_passenger_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-total_passengers exp = 150 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_passenger_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-total_passengers exp = 150 ).

    DATA(ls_ua_count) = lt_passenger_counts[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_count-total_passengers exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_empty_table.
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_reduce=>tt_sflight_hashed( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_reduce( lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lt_passenger_counts) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_passenger_counts ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um die Passagierzahlen pro Fluggesellschaft zu summieren. Die Verwendung einer Hashed Table als `result` in `REDUCE` ermöglicht effiziente Lookups und Updates während der Aggregation. `COND` und `VALUE #( BASE ... )` sind moderne Syntaxelemente für konditionale Zuweisungen und die Erweiterung von internen Tabellen.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, COND, VALUE

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `JOIN`-ähnliche Operation zwischen einer Hashed Table von Flügen und einer Hashed Table von Fluggesellschaften durch, um Fluggesellschaftsnamen hinzuzufügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` mit `CORRESPONDING` oder manueller Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ts_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ts_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_with_name,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ts_flight_with_name.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_with_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS join_flights_with_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier_hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_flight_with_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_flights_with_carriers.
    rt_joined_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                               LET ls_carrier = it_carriers[ OPTIONAL carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] IN
                               ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                 connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                 fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                 carrname = ls_carrier-carrname ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_join_data_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_data.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_join=>tt_sflight_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250102' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_join=>tt_carrier_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_join( ).
    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->join_flights_with_carriers( it_flights = lt_flights it_carriers = lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[ 1 ]-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[ 2 ]-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_join_data_no_match.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_join=>tt_sflight_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '999' fldate = '20250103' ) " No matching carrier
    ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_join=>tt_carrier_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_join( ).
    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->join_flights_with_carriers( it_flights = lt_flights it_carriers = lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[ 1 ]-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_joined[ 2 ]-carrname ). " No carrier name for XX
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR ... IN ... LET ... IN` Syntax in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente 'Join'-Operation zwischen internen Tabellen. Durch die Verwendung von `OPTIONAL` beim Zugriff auf die Hashed Table der Fluggesellschaften wird sichergestellt, dass der Vorgang auch dann funktioniert, wenn keine passende Fluggesellschaft gefunden wird, ohne einen Dump zu verursachen. Dies ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Art, Daten aus mehreren Quellen zu kombinieren.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, VALUE, LET, OPTIONAL, Internal Tables, Join

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum ein Feiertag in einem bestimmten Feiertagskalender ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `IS_HOLIDAY` der Klasse `cl_hrpad_date_computations`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_is_holiday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_if_holiday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
        iv_holiday_calendar_id TYPE t001w-feika
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_holiday) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_is_holiday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_if_holiday.
    DATA(lo_date_computations) = cl_hrpad_date_computations=>get_instance( ).
    TRY.
        rv_is_holiday = lo_date_computations->is_holiday(
          iv_date                = iv_date
          iv_holiday_calendar_id = iv_holiday_calendar_id
        ).
      CATCH cx_hrpad_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid calendar ID
        rv_is_holiday = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist entscheidend für Anwendungen, die arbeitsfreie Tage berücksichtigen müssen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist eine moderne Praxis.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table von Flügen und verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu zählen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_count_by_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ts_flight_count_by_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count_by_carrier TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ts_flight_count_by_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_by_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_group=>tt_sflight_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( it_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-flight_count exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 1 ).

    DATA(ls_ua_count) = lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_count-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_empty_table.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_group=>tt_sflight_hashed( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( it_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flight_counts ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax ist eine sehr moderne und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Sie ermöglicht es, komplexe Gruppierungslogik direkt in einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Ausdruck zu implementieren, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt. `GROUP SIZE` liefert dabei direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der jeweiligen Gruppe.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Aggregation, Internal Tables, VALUE

hint: Nutzen Sie die `get_container` Methode des Splitters, um einen Bereich als Parent für den nächsten Splitter zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_nested_splitter
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_main_splitter) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_splitter_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_nested_splitter.
    ro_main_splitter = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = iv_parent_container
      rows    = 1
      columns = 2
    ).

    DATA(lo_sub_container) = ro_main_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).

    DATA(lo_nested_splitter) = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      parent  = lo_sub_container
      rows    = 2
      columns = 1

    lo_nested_splitter->set_sash_position( row = 1 column = 1 pos = 50 ).

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_nested_splitter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_nested_splitter.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    lo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_splitter_nested( ).
    DATA(lo_main_splitter) = lo_cut->create_nested_splitter( lo_custom_container ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_main_splitter msg = 'Haupt-Splitter sollte instanziiert sein.' ).

    DATA(lo_sub_container) = lo_main_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_sub_container msg = 'Sub-Container sollte existieren.' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen dem größten und dem kleinsten Wert einer internen Tabelle von Zahlen unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um den Minimal- und Maximalwert zu finden, und subtrahieren Sie diese dann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_range_difference
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_difference) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_range_difference.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_difference = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max) = REDUCE i(
      INIT max_val = it_numbers[ 1 ]
      FOR <fs_num> IN it_numbers
      NEXT max_val = COND i( WHEN <fs_num> > max_val THEN <fs_num> ELSE max_val )
    ).

    DATA(lv_min) = REDUCE i(
      INIT min_val = it_numbers[ 1 ]
      FOR <fs_num> IN it_numbers
      NEXT min_val = COND i( WHEN <fs_num> < min_val THEN <fs_num> ELSE min_val )
    ).

    rv_difference = lv_max - lv_min.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Differenzen zwischen aufeinanderfolgenden Elementen in einer internen Tabelle von Zahlen. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Gruppieren Sie die Tabelle, um Paare zu bilden, und verwenden Sie dann `REDUCE` zur Summation der Differenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_group_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_differences
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_diff) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_group_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_differences.
    IF lines( it_numbers ) < 2.
      rv_sum_diff = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Hier wird eine 'künstliche' Gruppierung verwendet, um Paare zu bilden.
    " Eine direktere Methode für aufeinanderfolgende Elemente ist oft ein LOOP AT.
    " Für die Demonstration von GROUP BY und REDUCE:
    " Wir können die Tabelle nicht direkt in Paare gruppieren mit GROUP BY.
    " Stattdessen iterieren wir und bilden die Differenzen.
    " Die Anweisung ist etwas irreführend für GROUP BY, da es hier nicht direkt passt.
    " Eine bessere moderne Lösung wäre ein einfacher LOOP oder REDUCE mit Index.

    rv_sum_diff = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_diff = 0
           prev_num = it_numbers[ 1 ]
      FOR i = 2 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lines( it_numbers )
      NEXT sum_diff = sum_diff + ( it_numbers[ i ] - prev_num )
           prev_num = it_numbers[ i ]
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie den Wert eines Feldes von einem anderen Feld in einer internen Tabelle, aber nur für Zeilen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und `FOR`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` um die relevanten Zeilen zu selektieren und `FOR` um die Subtraktion durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_filter_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_remaining_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_filter_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_seats.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                           ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) EXCEPT seatsocc seatsmax
                             seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc
                             seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_subtract.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_filter_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_math_filter_subtract=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 20 seatsmax = 80 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_math_filter_subtract=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 80 )
    ).
    lt_expected[ 1 ]-seatsocc = 50. " 100 - 50 = 50
    lt_expected[ 2 ]-seatsocc = 60. " 80 - 20 = 60

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Zeilen zurückgegeben werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-seatsocc exp = 50 msg = 'Sitze für LH 0400 falsch berechnet.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-seatsocc exp = 60 msg = 'Sitze für LH 0401 falsch berechnet.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_filter_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_math_filter_subtract=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Tabelle sollte leer sein, da keine passende Airline.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_filter_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_math_filter_subtract=>tt_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte leere Tabelle ergeben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR` zur selektiven Verarbeitung von internen Tabellen. Zuerst werden mit `FILTER` nur die relevanten Flüge (nach Fluggesellschaft) ausgewählt. Dann wird mit `FOR` über diese gefilterten Zeilen iteriert und die Subtraktion (`seatsmax - seatsocc`) durchgeführt, um die verbleibenden Sitze zu berechnen. `CORRESPONDING` wird verwendet, um die Felder der Struktur effizient zu kopieren und nur die benötigten Felder zu überschreiben.
keywords: SUBTRACT, FILTER, FOR, Internal Tables, CORRESPONDING, SFLIGHTS

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS display.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mv_refresh_clicked TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA mv_exit_clicked TYPE abap_bool.

      IMPORTING fcode.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " In a real scenario, iv_container_name would refer to a custom control area on a screen.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error appropriately in a productive system
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error appropriately in a productive system
    ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'REFRESH'
      icon  = icon_refresh
      text  = 'Refresh'
      quickinfo = 'Daten aktualisieren' ).

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'EXIT'
      icon  = icon_exit
      text  = 'Exit'
      quickinfo = 'Anwendung beenden' ).

    mo_toolbar->set_button_state( fcode = 'REFRESH' pressed = abap_false ).
    mo_toolbar->set_button_state( fcode = 'EXIT' pressed = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display.
    " In a real scenario, this would typically be called during PBO of the screen
    " where the container is embedded, to ensure the toolbar is rendered.
    mo_toolbar->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'REFRESH'.
        mv_refresh_clicked = abap_true.
        " Add refresh logic here
      WHEN 'EXIT'.
        mv_exit_clicked = abap_true.
        " Add exit logic here (e.g., LEAVE PROGRAM)
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine SORTED TABLE vom Typ SFLIGHT mit Schlüsselfeldern 'CARRID' und 'CONNID'. Füllen Sie die Tabelle mit Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT und demonstrieren Sie die effiziente Datenbeschaffung per Schlüssel.
hint: Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator zur Initialisierung und den LINE_EXISTS-Operator zum Prüfen der Existenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.

PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-DATA gt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @gt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    READ TABLE gt_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid INTO rs_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existing_flight1 FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_read( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'CONNID should be 0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_non_existing_flight1.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_read( ).
    lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Should have raised cx_abap_not_found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Deklaration als SORTED TABLE mit UNIQUE KEY ist der Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen per Schlüssel ('READ TABLE WITH KEY') extrem performant, da die innere Tabelle bereits nach den Schlüsselfeldern sortiert ist. Der 'VALUE'-Operator wird hier nicht direkt zur Füllung verwendet, da dies über einen SELECT-Befehl geschieht. LINE_EXISTS wäre eine Alternative zur Prüfung der Existenz ohne Zeilenzuweisung.
keywords: Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, VALUE, LINE_EXISTS, READ TABLE, SFLIGHT, Performance

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine SORTED TABLE von SFLIGHT-Daten, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluglinie und mit einem Preis über einem Schwellenwert zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie hierfür einen 'FILTER'-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'FILTER'-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-DATA gt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @gt_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( gt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                  WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_existing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_results FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_existing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = '200' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = COND #( WHEN lines( lt_result ) = 0 THEN 'X' ELSE '' ) msg = 'Should find some flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID must be LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = <fs_flight>-price > 200 msg = 'Price must be greater than 200' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_results.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_price = '99999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Should find no flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator ist eine moderne und sehr lesbare Art, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. Er erzeugt eine neue Tabelle mit den übereinstimmenden Zeilen, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren. Der 'USING KEY primary_key' ist hier besonders effizient für SORTED TABLES.
keywords: Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, FILTER, SFLIGHT, Data Filtering

Instructions: Reduzieren Sie eine SORTED TABLE von SFLIGHT-Flügen, um die Summe der Preise für eine bestimmte Fluglinie zu berechnen. Nutzen Sie hierfür einen 'REDUCE'-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'REDUCE'-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-DATA gt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @gt_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN gt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_existing_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_non_existing_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_existing_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = COND #( WHEN lv_total_price > 0 THEN '' ELSE 'X' ) msg = 'Total price should be greater than 0' ).
    " Due to variability in SFLIGHT data, a fixed assertion might fail.
    " Asserting against a known sum or a range is better for productive code.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_non_existing_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 0 msg = 'Total price for non-existing carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Transformation und Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen in einer sehr kompakten und ausdrucksstarken Weise. Hier wird die Summe der Preise für eine bestimmte Fluglinie in einem einzigen Statement berechnet, was zu weniger Code und besserer Lesbarkeit führt.
keywords: Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, REDUCE, SFLIGHT, Aggregation

Instructions: Löschen Sie redundante Einträge in einer SORTED TABLE, die auf SFLIGHT basiert, unter Verwendung von 'DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES'. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Tabelle vor dem Löschen sortiert ist, um die Korrektheit der Operation zu gewährleisten.
hint: Die SORTED TABLE ist bereits sortiert. Nutzen Sie DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_delete_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_dup,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_dup.
    TYPES: tt_flight_dup_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_dup WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS delete_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_dup_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_flight_dup_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_delete_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_duplicates.
    " For a SORTED TABLE, the primary key ensures uniqueness based on 'CARRID' and 'CONNID'.
    " If 'fldate' is also part of the 'redundancy' logic, we might need a different key or post-processing.
    " Here, we assume duplicates based on primary key for simplicity, which isn't strictly how DAD works.
    " To make DAD meaningful for a SORTED TABLE, we need a NON-UNIQUE KEY, and then DAD on selected fields.
    DATA(lt_temp_flights) = it_flights.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_temp_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
    rt_unique_flights = lt_temp_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_some_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_no_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_some_duplicates.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_dup,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_dup.
    TYPES: tt_flight_dup_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_dup WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    DATA(lt_flights_with_duplicates) = VALUE tt_flight_dup_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) " Duplicate for carrid/connid
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' ) " Not a duplicate for carrid/connid
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250105' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_delete_dup( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_flights) = lo_cut->delete_duplicates( lt_flights_with_duplicates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 unique entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique_flights[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique_flights[1]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique_flights[1]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique_flights[2]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique_flights[2]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique_flights[2]-fldate exp = '20250102' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_no_duplicates.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_dup,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_dup.
    TYPES: tt_flight_dup_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_dup WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    DATA(lt_flights_no_duplicates) = VALUE tt_flight_dup_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_delete_dup( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_flights) = lo_cut->delete_duplicates( lt_flights_no_duplicates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 unique entries' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl SORTED TABLEs ihre Zeilen nach dem Schlüssel sortiert halten, ist DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES dennoch nützlich, um Duplikate basierend auf *anderen* als den Schlüsselfeldern oder bei NON-UNIQUE KEYs zu entfernen. Die Effizienz kommt daher, dass die Tabelle für diesen Vorgang bereits sortiert ist. Der COMPARING-Zusatz gibt an, welche Felder für die Duplikatsprüfung maßgeblich sind.
keywords: Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Data Cleansing

Instructions: Mit einer SORTED TABLE, die Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) enthält, erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, in der die Flugpreise verdoppelt werden. Nutzen Sie den 'FOR'-Operator in Verbindung mit 'VALUE', um diese Transformation durchzuführen.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'FOR ... IN ...' und 'VALUE'-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_prices.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_transformed(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        price    = ls_flight-price * 2
        currency = ls_flight-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_price_doubling FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_doubling.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    DATA(lt_original_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = 250 currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed_flights) = lo_cut->transform_prices( lt_original_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 transformed entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed_flights[1]-price exp = 200 msg = 'First flight price should be 200' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed_flights[2]-price exp = 500 msg = 'Second flight price should be 500' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'FOR'-Operator in Verbindung mit 'VALUE' ermöglicht die kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Transformation von internen Tabellen. Hier wird jede Zeile der Quelltabelle iteriert und in eine neue Zeile für die Zieltabelle umgewandelt, wobei der Preis verdoppelt wird. Dies ist eine funktionale Programmierung, die den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht als traditionelle LOOP-Anweisungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, FOR, VALUE, Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen externen String, der in UTF-8 kodiert ist, in das interne ABAP-Systemformat. Der String enthält möglicherweise Sonderzeichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_abap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_system
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_abap_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_abap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_system.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
    ).
    lo_conv->reset( ).
    lo_conv->write( iv_utf8_string ).
    lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_abap_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion_with_special_chars FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
    METHODS test_conversion_with_normal_chars FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_with_special_chars.
    " 'äöüßé' in UTF-8
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = 'C3A4C3B6C3BCC39FC3A9'F.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_utf8_to_abap( ).
    DATA(lv_abap_string) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_system( lv_utf8_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_abap_string exp = 'äöüßé' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_with_normal_chars.
    " 'Hello World' in UTF-8
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = '48656C6C6F20576F726C64'F.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_utf8_to_abap( ).
    DATA(lv_abap_string) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_system( lv_utf8_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_abap_string exp = 'Hello World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE ist der Standardweg, um Daten von einem externen Format (spezifische Codepage und Endianess) in das interne ABAP-Format zu konvertieren. Die Methode CREATE erzeugt eine Instanz des Konverters, WRITE schreibt die zu konvertierenden Binärdaten und READ liest die konvertierten Daten als ABAP-String. Dies ist essenziell für die korrekte Verarbeitung von multi-byte Zeichen aus externen Quellen.
keywords: Codepage Conversion, UTF-8, CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE, String Processing, xstring

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen internen ABAP-String, der Sonderzeichen enthält, in einen UTF-16 Little Endian formatierten 'XSTRING' für die Ausgabe in ein externes System.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_abap_to_utf16 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS convert_abap_to_utf16le
      IMPORTING
        iv_abap_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_utf16_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_abap_to_utf16 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_abap_to_utf16le.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-16LE'
      endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
    ).
    lo_conv->reset( ).
    lo_conv->write( iv_abap_string ).
    lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rx_utf16_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Konvertierung von numerischen Werten, die als 'RAW'-Daten empfangen wurden (z.B. von einem Big Endian System), in die interne ABAP-Darstellung mittels 'CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE'.
hint: Die Konvertierung von numerischen RAW-Daten erfordert die richtige Endian-Einstellung und dann eine Zuweisung in den entsprechenden numerischen Typ.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_raw_endian DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS convert_big_endian_int
      IMPORTING
        ix_big_endian_raw TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_number) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_raw_endian IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_big_endian_int.
    DATA: lv_little_endian_raw TYPE xstring.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = '1103' " Binary conversion, specific internal codepage for raw
      endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big
    ).

    lo_conv->reset( ).
    lo_conv->write( ix_big_endian_raw ).
    lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = lv_little_endian_raw ).

    " Now assign the little-endian raw data to the ABAP integer
    rv_number = lv_little_endian_raw.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_number) = lo_cut->convert_big_endian_int( lx_big_endian ).

    " Example: Big Endian for 1 (0x00000001)

explanation: Die Konvertierung von binären numerischen Daten von einem Endian-Format in ein anderes ist entscheidend für die Interoperabilität mit Systemen, die unterschiedliche Byte-Reihenfolgen verwenden. CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE kann auch dafür verwendet werden, indem ein spezielles Encoding (hier '1103' für binäre Konvertierung, oft auch 'UTF-8' wenn der Binärinhalt UTF-8 repräsentiert) und die entsprechende Endianess angegeben werden. Nach der Konvertierung in ABAP-native Endian-Reihenfolge kann der XSTRING direkt einem numerischen Feld zugewiesen werden.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen XSTRING ein, der potenziell ungültige Zeichen für die Ziel-Codepage enthält, und konvertieren Sie ihn in einen ABAP-String. Implementieren Sie dabei eine Fehlerbehandlung, um solche Zeichen zu ignorieren oder zu ersetzen, anstatt eine Ausnahme auszulösen.
hint: Beachten Sie die Parameter `IGNORE_CERR` oder `REPLACEMENT` in `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE=>CREATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        ix_source_data TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding    TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.

    METHODS convert_with_replacement
      IMPORTING
        ix_source_data TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding    TYPE abap_encoding
        iv_replacement TYPE cl_abap_conv_ce=>replacement_type DEFAULT cl_abap_conv_ce=>replacement_char_hash
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_encoding
      ignore_cerr = abap_true
    ).
    lo_conv->reset( ).
    lo_conv->write( ix_source_data ).
    lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_result_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_with_replacement.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_encoding
      replacement = iv_replacement
    ).
    lo_conv->reset( ).
    lo_conv->write( ix_source_data ).
    lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_result_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_ignore_invalid_chars FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
    METHODS test_replace_invalid_chars FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ignore_invalid_chars.
    " Simulate an XSTRING with an invalid byte sequence for ASCII (e.g., 'C3' is start of UTF-8 multi-byte char)
    DATA(lx_source_data) = '414243C34445'F. " ABC<invalid>DE
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling(
                         ix_source_data = lx_source_data
                         iv_encoding    = 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABCDE' msg = 'Invalid char should be ignored' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_invalid_chars.
    " Simulate an XSTRING with an invalid byte sequence for ASCII (e.g., 'C3' is start of UTF-8 multi-byte char)
    DATA(lx_source_data) = '414243C34445'F. " ABC<invalid>DE
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_with_replacement(
                         ix_source_data = lx_source_data
                         iv_encoding    = 'ISO-8859-1'
                         iv_replacement = cl_abap_conv_ce=>replacement_char_hash ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABC#DE' msg = 'Invalid char should be replaced by #' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei der Codepage-Konvertierung können Fehler auftreten, wenn die Quelldaten Zeichen enthalten, die in der Ziel-Codepage nicht darstellbar sind. `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` bietet mit den Parametern `IGNORE_CERR` und `REPLACEMENT` flexible Möglichkeiten zur Fehlerbehandlung. Statt einer Ausnahme zu folgen, können ungültige Zeichen entweder ignoriert (entfernt) oder durch ein Ersatzzeichen (z.B. '#') ersetzt werden, was robuste Dateiverarbeitung ermöglicht.
keywords: Error Handling, Codepage Conversion, CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE, IGNORE_CERR, REPLACEMENT, xstring

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Daten aus einer SORTED TABLE (SFLIGHT) mit einer weiteren internen Tabelle, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur Flüge über einer bestimmten Kapazität und mit einem bestimmten Datum enthält. Verwenden Sie den 'FOR'-Operator in Verbindung mit 'COND' und 'VALUE'.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit einer INTO-Komponente und einem WHERE-Zusatz, sowie COND für bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: tt_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_capacity_date
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
        iv_date         TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_capacity_date.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_flight_capacity(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
        WHERE ( seatsmax > iv_min_capacity AND fldate = iv_date )
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax
        price    = ls_flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_matching_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 150 price = 300 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 200 price = 400 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251202' seatsmax = 180 price = 350 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 100 price = 250 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_capacity_date(
                         it_flights      = lt_all_flights
                         iv_min_capacity = 170
                         iv_date         = '20251201' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 matching flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_matching_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 150 price = 300 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_capacity_date(
                         it_flights      = lt_all_flights
                         iv_min_capacity = 200
                         iv_date         = '20251201' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Expected no matching flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der Kombination von 'FOR' mit 'WHERE' innerhalb eines 'VALUE'-Operators. Es erlaubt eine deklarative Transformation und Filterung von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in einem einzigen, ausdrucksstarken Statement. Die Effizienz einer SORTED TABLE kommt in dieser Iteration zum Tragen, obwohl der 'WHERE'-Zusatz bei komplexeren Vergleichen eventuell eine lineare Suche erfordert, ist die Initial-Sortierung vorteilhaft.
keywords: Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, FOR, VALUE, COND, Data Filtering, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere für jeden Flug in einer SORTED TABLE von SFLIGHT. Aggregieren Sie die Daten nach 'CARRID' und 'CONNID' und verwenden Sie den 'GROUP BY'-Operator in einer Tabelleausdrucks-Variante.
hint: Nutzen Sie den GROUP BY-Operator für internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_p,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_p.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_p WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_total_seats,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_total_seats.
    TYPES: tt_total_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_total_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_total_seats) TYPE tt_total_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    rt_total_seats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid connid = ls_group-connid ) 
                                 ( carrid    = ls_group-carrid
                                   connid    = ls_group-connid
                                   total_occ = REDUCE sflight-seatsocc( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_by_empty_table FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_sum.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_p,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_p.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_p WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 ) " This entry would normally be a duplicate for unique key, but let's assume it's valid if key definition changes
      " For a UNIQUE KEY SORTED TABLE, direct entry of duplicate primary key values will cause a dump if VALUE for type, so I am simulating data that would be already unique per flight.
      " A better example would be a NON-UNIQUE SORTED TABLE, or a standard table for true GROUP BY. For unique key, each entry is unique anyway, sum becomes just the entry value.
      " Re-thinking example for a unique key sorted table, a sum grouped by carrid and connid from such a table just means taking the unique entry's seatsocc.
      " Let's adjust to non-unique key to make GROUP BY more meaningful here.
      ) TYPE HARMLESS.

    TYPES: tt_sflight_non_unique_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_p WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    DATA(lt_flights_non_unique) = VALUE tt_sflight_non_unique_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 80 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsocc = 120 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_group( ).
    DATA(lt_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( lt_flights_non_unique ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_total_seats ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 grouped entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_total_seats[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_total_seats[1]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_total_seats[1]-total_occ exp = 150 msg = 'LH 0400 sum should be 150' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_total_seats[2]-connid exp = '0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_total_seats[2]-total_occ exp = 80 msg = 'LH 0401 sum should be 80' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_empty_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_p,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_p.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_non_unique_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_p WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    
    DATA(lt_flights_empty) = VALUE tt_sflight_non_unique_sorted( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_group( ).
    DATA(lt_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( lt_flights_empty ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_total_seats msg = 'Expected empty result for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'GROUP BY'-Operator in Kombination mit 'FOR' und 'REDUCE' ist eine sehr mächtige moderne ABAP-Funktion zur Datenaggregation. Er ermöglicht es, Daten in internen Tabellen nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und dann Aggregationen (wie Summen, Minima, Maxima) für jede Gruppe zu berechnen. Dies ist eine deklarative und effiziente Methode, die komplexe LOOP- und AT END OF-Konstrukte ablöst. Da eine SORTED TABLE mit NON-UNIQUE KEYs hier am besten passt, wurde der Typ entsprechend angepasst.
keywords: Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere Strings, die aus verschiedenen Codepages stammen könnten, in einen finalen String. Verwenden Sie 'CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE' und 'CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE' für die sichere Konvertierung und zur Demonstrierung des Szenarios.
hint: Konvertieren Sie jeden String einzeln in/aus XSTRING und dann verketten Sie.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_concat_multi_cp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS concatenate_strings_with_conversion
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1    TYPE string
        iv_encoding1  TYPE abap_encoding
        iv_string2    TYPE string
        iv_encoding2  TYPE abap_encoding
        iv_target_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_concat_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_concat_multi_cp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings_with_conversion.
    DATA: lx_string1_target TYPE xstring,
          lx_string2_target TYPE xstring.

    " Convert string1 to target encoding xstring
    DATA(lo_conv_out1) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_target_encoding ).
    lo_conv_out1->reset( ).
    lo_conv_out1->write( iv_string1 ).
    lo_conv_out1->read( IMPORTING data = lx_string1_target ).

    " Convert string2 to target encoding xstring
    DATA(lo_conv_out2) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(

    lo_conv_out2->write( iv_string2 ).
    lo_conv_out2->read( IMPORTING data = lx_string2_target ).

    " Concatenate xstrings
    rx_concat_xstring = lx_string1_target && lx_string2_target.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für eine SORTED TABLE von SFLIGHT-Daten den maximalen Preis und die Anzahl der Flüge mit diesem Maximalpreis. Nutzen Sie moderne Tabellen-Ausdrücke.
hint: Kombinieren Sie 'REDUCE' für den Maximalwert und 'COUNT' mit 'WHERE'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_info,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_max_price_info.

    METHODS get_max_price_info
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_max_price_info) TYPE ty_max_price_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_info.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_max_price_info-max_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT max_val = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT max_val = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > max_val THEN ls_flight-price ELSE max_val ) ).

    rs_max_price_info-count = COUNT(#( it_flights WHERE price = rs_max_price_info-max_price )).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die prüft, ob ein übergebener XSTRING vollständig in eine bestimmte Codepage konvertierbar ist, ohne Datenverlust oder ungültige Zeichen. Nutzen Sie 'CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE' mit erweiterter Fehlerprüfung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` und prüfen Sie die Rückgabewerte (READ_STATE).
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_validate_encoding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS is_convertible_without_loss
      IMPORTING
        ix_source_data TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding    TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_validate_encoding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_convertible_without_loss.
    DATA: lv_result_string TYPE string,
          lv_read_state    TYPE cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>read_state_flag.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding      = iv_encoding
          replacement   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>replacement_char_error " Force error if replacement needed
          ignore_cerr   = abap_false ).

        lo_conv->reset( ).
        lo_conv->write( ix_source_data ).
        lo_conv->read(
          IMPORTING
            data       = lv_result_string
            read_state = lv_read_state ).

        IF lv_read_state = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>read_state_ok.
          rb_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rb_is_valid = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
        rb_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_valid_conversion.
    " 'Hallo Welt' in UTF-8
    DATA(lx_source_data) = '48616C6C6F2057656C74'F.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_validate_encoding( ).
    DATA(lb_is_valid) = lo_cut->is_convertible_without_loss(
                           ix_source_data = lx_source_data

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_conversion.
    " Invalid UTF-8 sequence: e.g., 'C3' followed by non-valid continuation byte
    DATA(lx_source_data) = '414243C3204445'F. " ABC<invalid_utf8>DE
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_validate_encoding( ).
    DATA(lb_is_valid) = lo_cut->is_convertible_without_loss(
                           ix_source_data = lx_source_data
                           iv_encoding    = 'UTF-8' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lb_is_valid msg = 'Should be invalid UTF-8 conversion' ).

explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert, wie die Methode `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE=>READ` zusammen mit dem Parameter `READ_STATE` und der bewussten Handhabung von `REPLACEMENT` und `IGNORE_CERR` verwendet werden kann, um die Gültigkeit von Codepage-Konvertierungen zu überprüfen. Indem `REPLACEMENT` auf `replacement_char_error` gesetzt und `IGNORE_CERR` auf `abap_false` belassen wird, wird jede auch nur geringfügige Konvertierungsunfähigkeit als Fehler erkannt, entweder durch eine Ausnahme oder durch einen nicht-`read_state_ok`-Wert. Dies ist entscheidend für die Datenintegrität bei der Verarbeitung externer Daten.
keywords: Codepage Validation, CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE, Error Checking, xstring, Data Integrity

Instructions: Führen Sie ein Left Outer Join zwischen einer SORTED TABLE von SFLIGHT-Daten und einer 'virtuellen' Tabelle (ebenfalls eine interne Tabelle), die zusätzliche Informationen zu Fluggästen enthält, durch. Ignorieren Sie Flüge ohne Passagierdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'FOR ... IN ...' für den Join und den 'COND'-Operator für die Bedingung und das Handling von NULL-Werten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_join_pass DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_base,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_base.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_base_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_base WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             passenger TYPE string,
           END OF ty_passenger_data.
    TYPES: tt_passenger_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             passenger TYPE string,
           END OF ty_joined_flight.
    TYPES: tt_joined_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_joined_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS perform_left_outer_join
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight_base_sorted
        it_passengers   TYPE tt_passenger_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_flights) TYPE tt_joined_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_sflight_join_pass IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_left_outer_join.

    " Convert passenger data to a HASHED TABLE for efficient lookup in the join
    DATA(lt_passengers_hashed) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF ty_passenger_data
      FROM it_passengers
      ( KEY carrid connid ).

    rt_joined_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  LET ls_passenger = lt_passengers_hashed[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ]
                                  IN COND #( WHEN line_exists( ls_passenger ) " Only include if passenger data exists (effectively inner join based on prompt "ignorieren Sie Flüge ohne Passagierdaten.")
                                             THEN (   carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
                                                      connid    = ls_flight-connid
                                                      passenger = ls_passenger-passenger ) )
                                  WHERE ( line_exists( ls_passenger ) ) ). " Redundant check for clarity based on prompt

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_left_outer_join_with_matches FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_left_outer_join_no_matches FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_outer_join_with_matches.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_base,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_base.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_base_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_base WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             passenger TYPE string,
           END OF ty_passenger_data.
    TYPES: tt_passenger_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_base_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_passengers) = VALUE tt_passenger_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' passenger = 'John Doe' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' passenger = 'Jane Smith' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_join_pass( ).
    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->perform_left_outer_join( it_flights = lt_flights
                                                      it_passengers = lt_passengers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 joined entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[1]-passenger exp = 'John Doe' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[2]-passenger exp = 'Jane Smith' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_left_outer_join_no_matches.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_base,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_base.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_base_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_base WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             passenger TYPE string,
           END OF ty_passenger_data.
    TYPES: tt_passenger_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_base_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_passengers) = VALUE tt_passenger_data(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' passenger = 'No Match' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_sflight_join_pass( ).
    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->perform_left_outer_join( it_flights = lt_flights
                                                      it_passengers = lt_passengers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_joined msg = 'Expected no joined entries' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für Joins über interne Tabellen ist die Kombination von `FOR ... IN ...`, `LET` und `COND` zusammen mit `LINE_EXISTS` eine moderne und leistungsstarke Methode. Hier wird die 'virtuelle' Passagiertabelle zur effizienten Suche in eine HASHED TABLE umgewandelt. Der `LET`-Operator ermöglicht die temporäre Speicherung des Ergebnisses der Tabellensuche, und `COND` wird verwendet, um nur Zeilen in die Ergebnistabelle aufzunehmen, für die ein übereinstimmender Passagier gefunden wurde, was einem LEFT OUTER JOIN mit einer impliziten WHERE-Klausel entspricht.
keywords: Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, HASHED TABLE, FOR, LET, COND, LINE_EXISTS, Join

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 Zufallszahlen vom Typ Float, die jeweils in einem bestimmten Bereich (z.B. zwischen 10.0 und 20.0) liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und die Methode `get_next( )` in Kombination mit einer Skalierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_float_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_random_floats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_random_floats_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_val TYPE f DEFAULT 10.0
        iv_max_val TYPE f DEFAULT 20.0
        iv_count   TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_floats) TYPE tt_random_floats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_float_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_floats_in_range.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_range) = iv_max_val - iv_min_val.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_0_1) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_scaled_random) = iv_min_val + ( lv_random_0_1 * lv_range ).
      APPEND lv_scaled_random TO rt_random_floats.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 values' act = lines( lt_random_values ) exp = 3 ).

    LOOP AT lt_random_values INTO DATA(lv_value).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Value out of max range' cond = ( lv_value < 15.0 ) ).

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Würfelwurf (Ergebnis 1 bis 6) unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_float`.
hint: Skalieren Sie die Zufallszahl und runden Sie sie auf eine ganze Zahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dice_roller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS roll_dice RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_roller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD roll_dice.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    " Generate a float between 0 (inclusive) and 6 (exclusive)
    DATA(lv_random_0_6) = lo_random->get_next( ) * 6.
    " Add 1 and floor to get an integer between 1 and 6
    rv_result = trunc( lv_random_0_6 ) + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dice_roller( ).
    DATA(lv_roll) = lo_cut->roll_dice( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Dice roll should be >= 1' cond = ( lv_roll >= 1 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Dice roll should be <= 6' cond = ( lv_roll <= 6 ) ).

    DO 100 TIMES.
      lv_roll = lo_cut->roll_dice( ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Dice roll out of range in loop' cond = ( lv_roll >= 1 AND lv_roll <= 6 ) ).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die von `get_next()` gelieferte Zufallszahl wird mit der Anzahl der Seiten des Würfels (6) multipliziert, um einen Bereich von [0, 6) zu erhalten. `trunc()` schneidet die Nachkommastellen ab, und das Hinzufügen von 1 verschiebt den Bereich auf [1, 6].

CLASS zcl_random_data_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_random_data_gen IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_max_value) = 100.0.

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                       ( id = i
                         value = lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_max_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig eine bestimmte Anzahl von Einträgen aus einer gegebenen internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und generieren Sie zufällige Indizes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_picker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS pick_random_entries
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_string
        iv_count        TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_picked_entries) TYPE tt_string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_picker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD pick_random_entries.
    IF it_source_table IS INITIAL OR iv_count <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_source_table ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index_float) = lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_table_size.
      DATA(lv_index) = trunc( lv_random_index_float ) + 1. " 1-based index

      IF lv_index > lv_table_size.
        lv_index = lv_table_size.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND it_source_table[ lv_index ] TO rt_picked_entries.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
