Es ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen, ohne dass explizite Schleifen und temporäre Tabellen erforderlich sind. Dies ist besonders nützlich für komplexe Berichts- und Analyseaufgaben.
keywords: NESTING, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck, um einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zuzuweisen, anstatt eine `IF`-Anweisung mit `sy-subrc` zu verwenden.
hint: Der `COND`-Ausdruck kann direkt einen Wert zurückgeben, basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_message
      IMPORTING iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_message.
    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 0 THEN 'Success'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 4 THEN 'Warning'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 8 THEN 'Error'
      ELSE 'Unknown Status'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_message( 0 ) exp = 'Success' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_message( 4 ) exp = 'Warning' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_message( 8 ) exp = 'Error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_message( 99 ) exp = 'Unknown Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne Alternative zu `IF`-`ELSE IF`-`ELSE`-Konstrukten, wenn es darum geht, einen Wert basierend auf Bedingungen zuzuweisen. Er ist kompakter, lesbarer und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit, `sy-subrc` oder andere temporäre Variablen zu verwenden, um den Status zu verfolgen.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen Eintrag in eine interne Tabelle ein und prüfen Sie den Erfolg mit `sy-subrc` im Vergleich zur modernen Methode, die `INSERT` mit `LINE_EXISTS` kombiniert oder Ausnahmen verwendet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` oder nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` bei Tabellen mit eindeutigem Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS insert_entry_old
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data
      IMPORTING is_new_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS insert_entry_new
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data
      IMPORTING is_new_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_entry_old.
    INSERT is_new_data INTO TABLE ct_data.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD insert_entry_new.
    TRY.
        INSERT is_new_data INTO TABLE ct_data.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_entry_old FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_entry_new FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Zahlen, indem Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und dann eine Division verwenden. Demonstrieren Sie die geschachtelte Verwendung von Ausdrücken.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Elemente, alles in einem Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR n IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + n ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_average_empty FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_average( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      10 20 30 40 50
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '30.0' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die geschachtelte Verwendung von Ausdrücken, indem zuerst `REDUCE` verwendet wird, um die Summe zu berechnen, und dann `lines()` für die Anzahl der Elemente. Obwohl die Division in einem separaten Schritt erfolgt, zeigt es, wie funktionale Ausdrücke wie `REDUCE` in komplexere Berechnungen integriert werden können, um den Code prägnanter zu gestalten.
keywords: NESTING, REDUCE, Math, Expressions, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, wobei Sie moderne Syntax und geschachtelte Ausdrücke verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und `FOR` oder `VALUE` für die Befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_row,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_row.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_itab
      IMPORTING iv_num_rows TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_itab.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr(
      name = 'COL1' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) TO lt_components.
    APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr(
      name = 'COL2' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) ) TO lt_components.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lr_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique = abap_false
    ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_table> = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > iv_num_rows
                            ( col1 = |Row { i }| col2 = i * 10 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_itab FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_dynamic_itab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_itab_create( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_itab( 3 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 3 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row> TYPE zcl_dyn_itab_create=>ty_dynamic_row.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_row>-col1 exp = 'Row 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_row>-col2 exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert dynamische Programmierung (`CREATE DATA` mit RTTI-Klassen) mit modernen Tabellen-Ausdrücken (`VALUE #( FOR ... )`) zur Befüllung. Die dynamische Erstellung der Tabellenstruktur und die anschließende Befüllung mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Konstruktors demonstrieren eine leistungsstarke und flexible Art der Datenverarbeitung in modernem ABAP.
keywords: NESTING, Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, RTTI, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 einzigartigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 20.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine `LOOP` mit `INSERT` in eine Tabelle mit `EMPTY KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = iv_min max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DO iv_count * 2 TIMES. " Try more times than needed to ensure uniqueness
      DATA(lv_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_number INTO TABLE lt_temp_numbers.
      IF lines( lt_temp_numbers ) = iv_count.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rt_unique_numbers = lt_temp_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_random_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_list.
    DATA(lo_gen) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_gen->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_numbers )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Should generate 5 unique numbers'
    ).

    " Check for uniqueness
    DATA(lv_unique_lines) = lines( VALUE HASHED TABLE OF i FROM lt_numbers WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_unique_lines
      exp = 5
      msg = 'All generated numbers should be unique'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_int` in Kombination mit internen Tabellen, um eine bestimmte Anzahl einzigartiger Zufallszahlen zu generieren. Die `INSERT` Anweisung in eine interne Tabelle mit `EMPTY KEY` verhindert Duplikate.
keywords: RANDOM, UNIQUE, INTERNAL TABLES, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_year_carriers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).

    SELECT carrid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( fldate(4) = lv_current_year )
      ( ls_flight-carrid )
    ).
    " Remove duplicates if any
    SORT rt_carriers ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT lv_sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT lv_sum = lv_sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_seats_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight_data BY flight-carrid
                          ( carrid      = flight-carrid
                            total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                    FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                    NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie basierend auf der Auslastung eines Fluges (SEATSOCC / SEATSMAX) den Status des Fluges ('Leer', 'Normal', 'Voll'). Geben Sie diesen Status zurück. Verwenden Sie eine `SWITCH`-Expression.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
                iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_percent) = COND f( WHEN iv_seatsmax = 0 THEN 0
                                         ELSE ( iv_seatsocc * 100 ) / iv_seatsmax ).

    rv_status = SWITCH string(
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percent < 50 THEN 'Leer'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percent >= 90 THEN 'Voll'
      ELSE 'Normal'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_date
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_fldate) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_date.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.

    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_raw_flights ( flight ) ).

    TRY.
        rv_fldate = lt_all_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-fldate.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_fldate = '00000000'. " Return initial date if not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Assuming a flight 'AA' '0017' exists in SFLIGHT with a date like '20250101'
    DATA(lv_fldate) = lo_cut->get_flight_date( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_fldate IS NOT INITIAL ) msg = 'Expected a flight date' ).

    " Test for a non-existent flight

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_fldate_not_found msg = 'Expected initial date for non-existent flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Sie kann auch in Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH` verwendet werden, um das Fehlen einer Zeile abzufangen. `PRIVATE SECTION` wird in der Testklasse verwendet.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Geben Sie den Durchschnittspreis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und anschließend `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_carrier.
    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lines( lt_prices ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                                  FOR price_val IN lt_prices
                                                  NEXT sum = sum + price_val-price ).
      rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_prices ).
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_days_left IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_until_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE fldate FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_fldate)

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS read_sflights_in_chunks RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_sflights_chunk TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights_chunk PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_sflights_chunk TO rt_sflights.
      CLEAR lt_sflights_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung beim Öffnen eines Cursors, z.B. wenn die Tabelle nicht existiert (simuliert).
hint: Überprüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach `OPEN CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS open_cursor_with_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD open_cursor_with_error.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string. " Dummy table for fetch

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name).

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          MESSAGE 'Error opening cursor' TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_open_sql_error.
        ENDIF.

        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_data PACKAGE SIZE 1. " Dummy fetch
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_dyn_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` in Chunks und verarbeiten Sie jeden Chunk mit einer modernen `FOR`-Schleife, um nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 1000 zu extrahieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife für die Nachbearbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS read_and_filter_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_high_price_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_filter_sflights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_sflights_chunk TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights_chunk PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      rt_high_price_flights = VALUE #( BASE rt_high_price_flights
                                       FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_chunk
                                       WHERE ( price > 1000 )
                                       ( ls_sflight ) ).
      CLEAR lt_sflights_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_attribute,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string,
        kind TYPE string, "Instance or Static
      END OF ty_attribute,
      tt_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_attributes IMPORTING iv_class_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attributes.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

        rt_attributes = VALUE #( FOR <attr> IN lt_attributes ( 
          name = <attr>-name
          type = <attr>-type_descr_ref->get_name( )
          kind = COND string( WHEN <attr>-is_static = abap_true THEN 'Static' ELSE 'Instance' )
        ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., class not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage (Montag bis Freitag) zwischen zwei Daten, unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden.
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Tage und verwenden Sie `cl_hrpad_date_computations=>is_weekend` und `add_days_to_date`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_working_days IMPORTING iv_date_from TYPE dats iv_date_to TYPE dats RETURNING VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_working_days.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_date_from.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_date_to.
      IF cl_hrpad_date_computations=>is_weekend( lv_current_date ) = abap_false.
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = cl_hrpad_date_computations=>add_days_to_date( iv_date = lv_current_date iv_days = 1 ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_working_days FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_working_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_working_days( ).

    " Mon 20230102 to Fri 20230106 (5 working days)
    DATA(lv_working_days) = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_date_from = '20230102' iv_date_to = '20230106' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_working_days exp = 5 ).

    " Mon 20230102 to Sun 20230108 (5 working days)
    lv_working_days = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_date_from = '20230102' iv_date_to = '20230108' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_working_days exp = 5 ).

    " Sat 20230107 to Sun 20230108 (0 working days)
    lv_working_days = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_date_from = '20230107' iv_date_to = '20230108' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_working_days exp = 0 ).

    " Mon 20230102 to Mon 20230102 (1 working day)
    lv_working_days = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_date_from = '20230102' iv_date_to = '20230102' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_working_days exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Kombination von `cl_hrpad_date_computations` Methoden (`is_weekend`, `add_days_to_date`) in einer Schleife, um komplexe Datumsberechnungen wie die Ermittlung von Arbeitstagen durchzuführen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit alle Methoden (Instanz- und statische Methoden) einer gegebenen Klasse, einschließlich ihrer Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und `get_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_parameter,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string,
        kind TYPE string, "Importing, Exporting, Changing, Returning
      END OF ty_parameter,
      tt_parameters TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_method,
        name TYPE string,
        kind TYPE string, "Instance or Static
        parameters TYPE tt_parameters,
      END OF ty_method,
      tt_methods TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_methods IMPORTING iv_class_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_methods.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_methods.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

        rt_methods = VALUE #( FOR <method> IN lt_methods ( 
          name = <method>-name
          kind = COND string( WHEN <method>-is_static = abap_true THEN 'Static' ELSE 'Instance' )
          parameters = VALUE #( FOR <param> IN <method>-parameters ( 
            name = <param>-name
            type = <param>-type_descr_ref->get_name( )
            kind = COND string( WHEN <param>-is_importing = abap_true THEN 'Importing'
                               WHEN <param>-is_exporting = abap_true THEN 'Exporting'
                               WHEN <param>-is_changing  = abap_true THEN 'Changing'
                               WHEN <param>-is_returning = abap_true THEN 'Returning'
                               ELSE 'Unknown' )
          ) )
        ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_class_methods FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_class_methods.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_class_methods( ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_cut->get_class_methods( 'ZCL_RTTI_CLASS_METHODS' ). "Test with its own class

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_methods ).
    DATA(lv_found_get_methods) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method) WHERE name = 'GET_CLASS_METHODS'.
      lv_found_get_methods = abap_true.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_method-kind exp = 'Instance' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_method-parameters ) exp = 2 ). "iv_class_name, rt_methods
      DATA(lv_found_param) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT ls_method-parameters INTO DATA(ls_param) WHERE name = 'IV_CLASS_NAME'.
        lv_found_param = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_param-type exp = '\TYPE=STRING' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_param-kind exp = 'Importing' ).
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_param ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_get_methods ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die RTTI-Klasse `cl_abap_classdescr` bietet umfassende Möglichkeiten zur Introspektion von Klassen, einschließlich der Auflistung von Methoden und deren Parametern. Dies ist entscheidend für Metaprogrammierung und Framework-Entwicklung. Die verschachtelte `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Syntax ist ein Beispiel für moderne, kompakte ABAP-Programmierung.

Instructions: Wählen Sie spezifische Felder aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus, transformieren Sie diese mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck in eine neue interne Tabelle und serialisieren Sie das Ergebnis in JSON.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT`, `FOR` und `cl_fdt_json`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             flight_key TYPE string,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price_eur  TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_json.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    DATA(lt_flight_summary) = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
      ( flight_key  = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }|
        flight_date = ls_sflight-fldate
        price_eur   = COND p DECIMALS 2( WHEN ls_sflight-currency = 'USD' THEN ls_sflight-price * '0.90' ELSE ls_sflight-price ) )
    ).

    IF lt_flight_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_json_string = cl_fdt_json=>json_serialize( data = lt_flight_summary ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_transformed_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_transformed_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->get_transformed_json( iv_max_rows = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be initial' act = lv_json exp = '' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain flight_key' substring = 'flight_key' text = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain price_eur' substring = 'price_eur' text = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen numerischen Wert in einen String und umgekehrt, wobei die Konvertierung explizit und typsicher erfolgt.

CLASS zcl_number_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS number_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE p DECIMALS 3
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_number_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD number_to_string.
    rv_string = |{ iv_number }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD string_to_number.
    TRY.
        rv_number = CONV p DECIMALS 3( iv_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        " Handle conversion error, e.g., set default or raise exception
        rv_number = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Für die umgekehrte Konvertierung von String zu Zahl ist der `CONV`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `TRY...CATCH`-Block für die Fehlerbehandlung die typsichere und robuste Methode, um Konvertierungsfehler abzufangen.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen fehlerhaften JSON-String und fangen Sie die auftretende Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json=>json_deserialize` innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH`-Blocks für `cx_fdt_json_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_error_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    CLEAR ev_error_message.
    TRY.
        cl_fdt_json=>json_deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string IMPORTING data = rs_data ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        ev_error_message = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
        CLEAR rs_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).

    DATA(lv_error_msg) = ``.
    DATA(ls_data) = lo_cut->deserialize_with_error_handling( EXPORTING iv_json_string = lv_json IMPORTING ev_error_message = lv_error_msg ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No error expected for valid JSON' act = lv_error_msg ).

  METHOD test_deserialize_invalid_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_json) = `{"field1":"Test","field2":abc}`. " Invalid JSON
    DATA(lv_error_msg) = ``.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Error message expected for invalid JSON' act = lv_error_msg exp = '' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` aus, filtern Sie diese nach Kriterien und serialisieren Sie nur die gefilterten Daten in JSON.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT`, `FILTER` und `cl_fdt_json`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_json.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_sflight_filtered(
      lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE price >= iv_min_price
    ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_json_string = cl_fdt_json=>json_serialize( data = lt_filtered_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights_json.
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge von 'LH' mit Preisen >= 100
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_filter_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights_json( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = '100.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be initial' act = lv_json exp = '' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain carrid LH' substring = '"carrid":"LH"' text = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain price' substring = '"price":' text = lv_json ).

    " Test mit Kriterien, die keine Ergebnisse liefern sollten
    lv_json = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights_json( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_price = '9999.99' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'JSON string should be initial for no results' act = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von Open SQL mit dem modernen `FILTER`-Ausdruck für interne Tabellen. Zuerst werden Daten aus der Datenbank ausgewählt, dann mit `FILTER` basierend auf zusätzlichen Kriterien gefiltert und schließlich die gefilterten Ergebnisse mit `cl_fdt_json` in JSON serialisiert. `FILTER` ist eine sehr effiziente Methode zur Manipulation interner Tabellen in modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Anwendungsprotokoll mit einem Kopf und zwei Informationsmeldungen. Das Protokoll soll anschließend gespeichert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOGOBJ` zur Instanziierung, `ADD_MSG` zum Hinzufügen von Nachrichten und `SAVE` zum Speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_simple_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_save_log
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_simple_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_save_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).

    " Set log header data (optional, but good practice)
    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      aldate = sy-datum
      altime = sy-uzeit
      aluser = sy-uname
      alprog = sy-repid
      almode = 'A' " A = Application Log
      altcode = sy-tcode
    ).
    lo_log->set_log_header( EXPORTING i_s_log_header = ls_log_header ).

    " Add messages
    lo_log->add_msg(
      i_msgty = 'I' " Information
      i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' " Example message class
      i_msgno = '001' " Example message number
      i_msgv1 = 'Log created successfully'
    ).
    lo_log->add_msg(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      i_msgno = '002'
      i_msgv1 = 'Second message added'
    ).

    " Save the log
    lo_log->save( ).

    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll und verknüpfen Sie es mit einem spezifischen Geschäftsobjekt (z.B. einer Flugbuchung). Fügen Sie dann Nachrichten hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `BAL_S_LOG_OBJ` und `SET_LOG_OBJECTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_obj_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS create_log_for_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_obj_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_log_for_flight.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).

    " Define the application log object
    DATA(ls_log_object) = VALUE bal_s_log_obj(
      object = 'ZFLIGHT' " Custom object type
      extnum = |{ is_flight_key-carrid }-{ is_flight_key-connid }-{ is_flight_key-fldate }|
      log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( )
    ).
    lo_log->set_log_objects( EXPORTING i_t_log_objects = VALUE bal_t_log_obj( ( ls_log_object ) ) ).

    " Add messages related to the flight
    lo_log->add_msg(
      i_msgty = 'S' " Success
      i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      i_msgno = '003'
      i_msgv1 = |Flight { is_flight_key-carrid } { is_flight_key-connid } processed.|
    ).
    lo_log->add_msg(
      i_msgty = 'W' " Warning
      i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      i_msgno = '004'
      i_msgv1 = 'Check passenger list.'
    ).

    lo_log->save( ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie ein zuvor erstelltes Anwendungsprotokoll anhand seines Handles und geben Sie die enthaltenen Nachrichten aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_DB_LOAD` zum Laden und `GET_MESSAGES` zum Abrufen der Nachrichten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_read_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_message,
        msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
        msgid TYPE bal_msgid,
        msgno TYPE bal_msgno,
        msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv,
        msgv2 TYPE bal_msgv,
        msgv3 TYPE bal_msgv,
        msgv4 TYPE bal_msgv,
      END OF ty_message,
      tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_log_messages
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_handle TYPE balloghndl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_log_messages.
    DATA(lo_log_load) = NEW cl_bal_db_load( ).
    DATA(lt_log_handles) = VALUE bal_t_logh( ( iv_log_handle ) ).

    TRY.
        lo_log_load->load_logs( EXPORTING i_t_log_handles = lt_log_handles ).
        DATA(lo_loaded_log) = lo_log_load->get_log_object( iv_log_handle ).

        IF lo_loaded_log IS BOUND.
          DATA(lt_bal_messages) = lo_loaded_log->get_messages( ).
          rt_messages = VALUE #( FOR ls_bal_msg IN lt_bal_messages
                                 ( msgty = ls_bal_msg-msgty
                                   msgid = ls_bal_msg-msgid
                                   msgno = ls_bal_msg-msgno
                                   msgv1 = ls_bal_msg-msgv1
                                   msgv2 = ls_bal_msg-msgv2
                                   msgv3 = ls_bal_msg-msgv3
                                   msgv4 = ls_bal_msg-msgv4 ) ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_bal_error INTO DATA(lx_bal_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a new exception
        " For this example, we'll just return an empty table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_existing_log FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing_log FOR TESTING.
    DATA mv_test_log_handle TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Create a log to be read by the test methods
    DATA(lo_log_creator) = NEW zcl_bal_simple_log( ). " Re-use previous example's class
    mv_test_log_handle = lo_log_creator->create_and_save_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_existing_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_read_log( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->read_log_messages( iv_log_handle = mv_test_log_handle ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_messages )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 messages from the loaded log'
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_msg) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_msg-msgty
      exp = 'I'
      msg = 'Message type of first message incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing_log.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie die Details der Ausnahme als Fehlermeldung im Anwendungsprotokoll.

solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_exc_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data_with_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_exc_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_with_error.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).
    lo_log->set_log_header( EXPORTING i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_log( aluser = sy-uname alprog = sy-repid ) ).

    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
        ENDIF.
        lo_log->add_msg(
          i_msgty = 'S'
          i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          i_msgno = '005'
          i_msgv1 = |Value { iv_value } processed successfully.|
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        lo_log->add_msg(
          i_msgty = 'E' " Error
          i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          i_msgno = '006'
          i_msgv1 = 'Arithmetic error occurred.'
        ).
        " Add exception details to the log
        lo_log->add_msg_from_exception(
          i_exception = lx_arith_error
          i_msgty   = 'E'
        ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_log->save( ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und extrahieren Sie die darin enthaltenen Nachrichten, um sie mit `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` zu sammeln.

CLASS zcl_msg_exc_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_message_data,
        msgty TYPE symsgty,
        msgid TYPE symsgid,
        msgno TYPE symsgno,
        msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
        msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
        msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
        msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
      END OF ty_message_data,
      tt_message_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_collect_errors
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_message_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_exc_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_collect_errors.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    TRY.
        IF iv_input = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
        ELSEIF iv_input < 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        lo_msg_helper->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'S'
          i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          i_msgno = '004'
          i_msgv1 = |Input { iv_input } processed successfully.|
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        lo_msg_helper->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          i_msgno = '005'
          i_msgv1 = 'An arithmetic error occurred.'
        ).
        lo_msg_helper->add_message_from_exception( i_exception = lx_arith_error ).
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lt_raw_messages) = lo_msg_helper->get_messages( ).
    rt_messages = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw_msg IN lt_raw_messages
                             ( msgty = ls_raw_msg-msgty
                               msgid = ls_raw_msg-msgid
                               msgno = ls_raw_msg-msgno
                               msgv1 = ls_raw_msg-msgv1
                               msgv2 = ls_raw_msg-msgv2
                               msgv3 = ls_raw_msg-msgv3
                               msgv4 = ls_raw_msg-msgv4 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

hint: Verwenden Sie beide Klassen in Kombination, um Nachrichten zu sammeln und bei Bedarf direkt ins Log zu schreiben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mix_log_and_msg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data_with_logging
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_log_and_msg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_with_logging.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).
    lo_log->set_log_header( EXPORTING i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_log( aluser = sy-uname alprog = sy-repid ) ).

    lo_msg_helper->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      i_msgno = '001'
      i_msgv1 = 'Processing started'
    ).

    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
        ENDIF.
        lo_msg_helper->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'S'
          i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          i_msgno = '004'
          i_msgv1 = |Value { iv_value } processed successfully.|
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        lo_msg_helper->add_message(
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          i_msgno = '005'
          i_msgv1 = 'An arithmetic error occurred in processing.'
        ).
        " Immediately log the exception to BAL
        lo_log->add_msg_from_exception( i_exception = lx_arith_error i_msgty = 'E' ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_msg_helper->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      i_msgno = '006'
      i_msgv1 = 'Processing finished'
    ).

    " Transfer all collected messages from helper to log at the end
    lo_log->add_msg_from_message_helper( i_message_helper = lo_msg_helper ).

    lo_log->save( ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Nachrichten (z.B. aus einem `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER`) filtert und nur bestimmte Typen in ein `CL_BAL_LOGOBJ` überträgt, während andere ignoriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` zum Sammeln, `FILTER` für die Nachrichten und `CL_BAL_LOGOBJ` zum Hinzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mix_filter_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transfer_filtered_messages
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_type TYPE symsgty
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_filter_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_filtered_messages.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    lo_msg_helper->add_message( i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '001' i_msgv1 = 'Info 1' ).
    lo_msg_helper->add_message( i_msgty = 'W' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '002' i_msgv1 = 'Warning 1' ).
    lo_msg_helper->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '003' i_msgv1 = 'Error 1' ).
    lo_msg_helper->add_message( i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '004' i_msgv1 = 'Info 2' ).

    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).
    lo_log->set_log_header( EXPORTING i_s_log_header = VALUE bal_s_log( aluser = sy-uname alprog = sy-repid ) ).

    DATA(lt_all_messages) = lo_msg_helper->get_messages( ).

    " Filter messages using a modern ABAP filter expression
    DATA(lt_filtered_messages) = FILTER #( lt_all_messages USING KEY primary_key WHERE msgty = iv_filter_type ).

    " Add filtered messages to the application log
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_messages INTO DATA(ls_msg).
      lo_log->add_msg(
        i_msgty = ls_msg-msgty
        i_msgid = ls_msg-msgid
        i_msgno = ls_msg-msgno
        i_msgv1 = ls_msg-msgv1
        i_msgv2 = ls_msg-msgv2
        i_msgv3 = ls_msg-msgv3
        i_msgv4 = ls_msg-msgv4
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_log->save( ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer internen Tabelle, die Flugdaten enthält (z.B. `sflights`), einen Teilstring in einem Feld (z.B. `CARRID`) für alle Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` und der funktionalen `REPLACE`-Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_replace_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mod,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_mod.
    TYPES tt_sflight_mod TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mod WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_carrid_in_table
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_old_carrid_part TYPE string
        iv_new_carrid_part TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_mod.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_replace_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_carrid_in_table.
    rt_modified_sflights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( 
        carrid   = REPLACE( val = ls_sflight-carrid old = iv_old_carrid_part new = iv_new_carrid_part occ = 0 ) " occ = 0 for all occurrences
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_in_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_in_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH '.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-price = '100.00'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA '.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0017'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-price = '200.00'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_replace_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_carrid_in_table(
      it_sflights        = lt_sflights
      iv_old_carrid_part = ' '
      iv_new_carrid_part = '-'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_result_1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result_1-carrid
      exp = 'LH-'
      msg = 'Failed to replace in first entry.'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_result_2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result_2-carrid
      exp = 'AA-'
      msg = 'Failed to replace in second entry.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `FOR` in einem `VALUE`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit der funktionalen `REPLACE`-Funktion ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Transformation interner Tabellen, ohne explizite Schleifen und `APPEND`s.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Datenzugriff, der je nach eingestellter Data Aging Temperatur unterschiedliche Nachrichten generiert. Verwenden Sie `REPLACE`, um die Nachricht anzupassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature` und `REPLACE` in einem `CASE`-Ausdruck oder `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_da_cond_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_access_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_cond_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_access_message.
    DATA(lv_current_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ).
    DATA(lv_base_message) = 'Datenzugriff für [TEMPERATUR] Daten. Performance ist [STATUS].'.

    CASE lv_current_temp.
      WHEN '1'. " Hot
        rv_message = REPLACE( val = lv_base_message old = '[TEMPERATUR]' new = 'heiße' occ = 0 ).
        rv_message = REPLACE( val = rv_message old = '[STATUS]' new = 'optimal' occ = 0 ).
      WHEN '2'. " Warm
        rv_message = REPLACE( val = lv_base_message old = '[TEMPERATUR]' new = 'warme' occ = 0 ).
        rv_message = REPLACE( val = rv_message old = '[STATUS]' new = 'gut' occ = 0 ).
      WHEN '3'. " Cold
        rv_message = REPLACE( val = lv_base_message old = '[TEMPERATUR]' new = 'reduzierte' occ = 0 ).
        rv_message = REPLACE( val = rv_message old = '[STATUS]' new = 'eingeschränkt' occ = 0 ).
      WHEN OTHERS. " Not set or invalid
        rv_message = REPLACE( val = lv_base_message old = '[TEMPERATUR]' new = 'unbekannte' occ = 0 ).
        rv_message = REPLACE( val = rv_message old = '[STATUS]' new = 'unbekannt' occ = 0 ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_access_hot FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_access_warm FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_access_cold FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_access_unset FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_access_hot.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_da_cond_access( ).
    DATA(lv_original_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( '1' ). " Set to hot
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_data_access_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message
      exp = 'Datenzugriff für heiße Daten. Performance ist optimal.'
      msg = 'Message for hot data incorrect.'
    ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( lv_original_temp ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_access_warm.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_da_cond_access( ).
    DATA(lv_original_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( '2' ). " Set to warm
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_data_access_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message
      exp = 'Datenzugriff für warme Daten. Performance ist gut.'
      msg = 'Message for warm data incorrect.'
    ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( lv_original_temp ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_access_cold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_da_cond_access( ).
    DATA(lv_original_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( '3' ). " Set to cold
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_data_access_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message
      exp = 'Datenzugriff für reduzierte Daten. Performance ist eingeschränkt.'
      msg = 'Message for cold data incorrect.'
    ).
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( lv_original_temp ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_access_unset.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_da_cond_access( ).
    DATA(lv_original_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ).
    TRY.
        cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( '' ). " Attempt to simulate unset
      CATCH cx_abap_session_temperature.
        " Handle exception if setting to initial is not allowed
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_data_access_message( ).
    IF cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ) IS INITIAL OR
       ( cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ) <> '1' AND
         cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ) <> '2' AND
         cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ) <> '3' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lv_message
        exp = 'Datenzugriff für unbekannte Daten. Performance ist unbekannt.'
        msg = 'Message for unset/invalid temperature incorrect.'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
        act = lv_message
        exp = 'Datenzugriff für unbekannte Daten. Performance ist unbekannt.'
        msg = 'Message for unset/invalid temperature incorrect (should not be unset if originally set to valid value).' 
      ).
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( lv_original_temp ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Data Aging Temperatur als Kriterium für die Anpassung des Anwendungsverhaltens genutzt werden kann. Die `REPLACE`-Anweisung wird hier verwendet, um dynamisch Textbausteine in einer Nachricht auszutauschen, basierend auf der ermittelten Temperatur.
keywords: Data Aging, Session Temperature, Conditional Logic, REPLACE, String Templates

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Flüge und summiere deren Preise für jede eindeutige Kombination aus Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT` und `SUM` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_flight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    METHODS get_flight_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_flight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid       = <fs_group>-carrid
        connid       = <fs_group>-connid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_price  = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP <fs_group> NEXT sum = sum + member-price )
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_flight_summary( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summary ). " Should not be initial if sflights has data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summary ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ). " Example: Assuming 2 unique groups for test data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax, die eine effiziente Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen ermöglicht. Anstatt manueller Schleifen und Hashes wird die Gruppierung direkt im `LOOP` Statement vorgenommen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe, und der `REDUCE` Operator aggregiert den Gesamtpreis auf funktionale Weise, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP AT, REDUCE

CLASS zcl_grp_connections_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_grp_connections_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_connections(
        carrid      = <fs_group>-carrid

CLASS zcl_grp_expensive_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,

        carrid       = <fs_group>-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_price  = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP <fs_group> NEXT sum = sum + member-price )

Instructions: Ermittle den Start- und Endtermin für eine gegebene Geschäftsjahresvariante, Geschäftsjahr und Periode unter Verwendung von `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS`.
hint: Verwende die Methode `GET_PERIOD_DATES` der Klasse `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_per_get_period_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_range,
             date_from TYPE d,
             date_to   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_period_range.
    METHODS get_period_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_bukrs TYPE bukrs
        iv_gjahr TYPE gjahr
        iv_perio TYPE perio
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_period_range) TYPE ty_period_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_per_get_period_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_period_range.
    DATA(lo_period_tool) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).

    TRY.
        lo_period_tool->get_period_dates(
          EXPORTING
            i_bukrs     = iv_bukrs
            i_gjahr     = iv_gjahr
            i_perio     = iv_perio
          IMPORTING
            e_date_from = rs_period_range-date_from
            e_date_to   = rs_period_range-date_to

Instructions: Gruppiere Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Geschäftsjahr und Periode. Füge dazu die Geschäftsjahres- und Periodeninformationen zu den Flugdaten hinzu, bevor du die Gruppierung vornimmst.
hint: Zuerst das Flugdatum in Geschäftsjahr/Periode umwandeln (mit `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS`), dann `GROUP BY` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_flights_by_period DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_period,
             INCLUDE TYPE sflights,
             gjahr TYPE gjahr,
             perio TYPE perio,
           END OF ty_flight_with_period.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_flight_summary,
             gjahr        TYPE gjahr,
             perio        TYPE perio,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_period_flight_summary.
    METHODS group_flights_by_period RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_flights_by_period IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_period.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_period_tool) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    DATA lt_flights_with_period TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_period.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA ls_flight_with_period LIKE LINE OF lt_flights_with_period.
      ls_flight_with_period = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ).
      TRY.
          lo_period_tool->get_period_from_date(
            EXPORTING
              i_bukrs = ls_flight-mandt " Annahme: Mandant als Buchungskreis
              i_date  = ls_flight-fldate
            IMPORTING
              e_gjahr = ls_flight_with_period-gjahr
              e_perio = ls_flight_with_period-perio
          ).
        CATCH cx_bs_period_toolset.
          " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Periode auf '000' setzen
          ls_flight_with_period-gjahr = '0000'.
          ls_flight_with_period-perio = '000'.
      ENDTRY.
      APPEND ls_flight_with_period TO lt_flights_with_period.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_flights_with_period INTO DATA(ls_flight_period) GROUP BY ( gjahr = ls_flight_period-gjahr, perio = ls_flight_period-perio ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      APPEND VALUE ty_period_flight_summary(
        gjahr        = <fs_group>-gjahr
        perio        = <fs_group>-perio
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_price  = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP <fs_group> NEXT sum = sum + member-price )
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators innerhalb der Gruppierung.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation des Durchschnitts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_avg_price_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_price_summary.
    METHODS get_avg_price_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_avg_price_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      DATA(lv_avg_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum_price = 0
             count      = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP <fs_group>
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price
             count      = count + 1
        RESULT COND #( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum_price / count ELSE 0 )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_avg_price_summary(
        carrid        = <fs_group>-carrid
        average_price = lv_avg_price
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_per_next_periods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period,
             gjahr TYPE gjahr,
             perio TYPE perio,
           END OF ty_period.
    METHODS get_next_12_periods
      IMPORTING
        iv_bukrs TYPE bukrs
        iv_start_gjahr TYPE gjahr
        iv_start_perio TYPE perio
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_periods) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_per_next_periods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_12_periods.
    DATA(lo_period_tool) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_current_gjahr) = iv_start_gjahr.
    DATA(lv_current_perio) = iv_start_perio.

    LOOP AT cl_abap_int_tools=>get_sequence( from = 0 to = 11 ) INTO DATA(lv_offset).
      TRY.
          lo_period_tool->calculate_period(
            EXPORTING
              i_bukrs  = iv_bukrs
              i_gjahr  = lv_current_gjahr
              i_perio  = lv_current_perio
              i_offset = lv_offset
            IMPORTING
              e_gjahr  = DATA(lv_calculated_gjahr)
              e_perio  = DATA(lv_calculated_perio)
          ).
          APPEND VALUE ty_period( gjahr = lv_calculated_gjahr perio = lv_calculated_perio ) TO rt_periods.
        CATCH cx_bs_period_toolset.
          " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Schleife abbrechen oder leere Periode hinzufügen
          EXIT.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rng_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei `RANGES`-Tabellen für Fluggesellschaften zu einer einzigen, die alle Einträge beider Tabellen enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit `BASE` und `FOR` um die Tabellen zu mergen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS combine_carrid_ranges
      IMPORTING
        it_range1 TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
        it_range2 TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_carrid_ranges.
    rt_combined_range = VALUE #( BASE it_range1
                                 FOR entry IN it_range2 ( entry ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_ranges FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_ranges.
    DATA: lr_range1 TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid,
          lr_range2 TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' ) TO lr_range1.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) TO lr_range1.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ) TO lr_range2.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'SQ' ) TO lr_range2.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_combine( ).
    DATA(lr_combined) = lo_cut->combine_carrid_ranges( it_range1 = lr_range1 it_range2 = lr_range2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lr_combined ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_combined[ 1 ]-low exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_combined[ 4 ]-low exp = 'SQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator mit der `BASE`-Klausel ermöglicht das Hinzufügen von Einträgen zu einer bereits existierenden internen Tabelle (hier `it_range1`), während der `FOR`-Operator die Einträge aus einer anderen Tabelle (`it_range2`) iteriert. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Tabellen zu mergen.
keywords: RANGES, VALUE, BASE, FOR, Internal Tables, Merge

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie funktionale Methodenaufrufe und Methodenverkettung, um eine Zeichenkette zu verarbeiten.

CLASS zcl_mth_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS to_upper IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS add_prefix IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string iv_prefix TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS process_string IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mth_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_upper.
    rv_text = to_upper( iv_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_prefix.
    rv_text = iv_prefix && iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_string.
    rv_result = NEW zcl_mth_chaining( )->to_upper( iv_text )->add_prefix( iv_prefix = 'PROCESSED: ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (price) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen (sflights) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators innerhalb einer Methode.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mth_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mth_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                               FOR flight IN it_flights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_mth_reduce=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '002'. <fs_flight>-price = '250.50'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '003'. <fs_flight>-price = '50.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mth_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_mth_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mth_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_sflight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Weise. Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen, was den Code kürzer und fehlerresistenter macht.
keywords: METHOD, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail an einen Empfänger mit einem Betreff und einem Textkörper unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_BCS_MESSAGE` und moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_BCS_MESSAGE` und ihre Methoden wie `CREATE_INSTANCE`, `SET_SENDER`, `ADD_RECIPIENT`, `SET_SUBJECT`, `SET_TEXT` und `SEND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_send_simple_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_send_simple_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_instance( ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_message=>string_to_soli_tab( iv_body )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).
        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_sender) = cl_sapuser_bcs=>create_instance_from_current_user( ).
        lo_bcs->set_sender( lo_sender ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen des Fehlers
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_send_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_send_simple_email( ).
    " In einem echten Test würde man hier einen Mock für CL_BCS_MESSAGE verwenden.
    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir den Aufruf.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->send_email( iv_recipient_email = 'test@example.com'
                                          iv_subject         = 'Test E-Mail'
                                          iv_body            = 'Dies ist ein Test.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_bcs)`) und Methodenketten, um den Code kompakter und lesbarer zu machen. Die Klasse `CL_BCS_MESSAGE` ist der Standardweg, um Nachrichten in ABAP zu versenden, und die Verwendung von `cl_bcs_message=>string_to_soli_tab` ist eine moderne Art, String-Inhalte für Dokumente vorzubereiten.
keywords: CL_BCS_MESSAGE, E-Mail, Object Orientation, Inline Declaration, Method Chaining

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von 'Freunden' (simuliert durch `SFLIGHTS`-Daten) nach einem bestimmten Kriterium (z.B. alle Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft) unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_friends DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_friend_data,
             friend_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             friend_name TYPE s_carrname,
             status      TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_friend_data.
    TYPES tt_friend_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_friend_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_friends_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_id     TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_friends) TYPE tt_friend_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_friends IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_friends_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " Simulate friend data from sflights
    DATA(lt_all_friends) = VALUE tt_friend_data(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( friend_id = flight-carrid,
        friend_name = |Carrier { flight-carrid }|,
        status = COND char10( WHEN flight-seatsocc < flight-seatsmax THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' ) )
    ).

    rt_friends = FILTER #( lt_all_friends WHERE friend_id = iv_carrier_id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_friends FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_friends.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_friends( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_friends) = lo_cut->get_friends_by_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No friends found for AA' act = lt_filtered_friends ).
    " Da SFLIGHTS variieren kann, prüfen wir nur, ob die Tabelle nicht leer ist und die Filterung korrekt ist.
    IF lines( lt_filtered_friends ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_filtered_friends INTO DATA(ls_friend).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_friend-friend_id exp = 'AA' ).
      END LOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht das einfache und deklarative Filtern von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingung zu schreiben, kann man die Filterlogik direkt im Ausdruck angeben, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. `VALUE #(...)` wird hier verwendet, um die simulierte Freundesliste zu initialisieren.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Data Processing, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine personalisierte Begrüßungsnachricht für eine Liste von 'Freunden' unter Verwendung von String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates mit `|...|` und eingebetteten Ausdrücken `{...}`.

CLASS zcl_personal_greeting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Variablen und Ausdrücke können direkt in den String eingebettet werden, was die Lesbarkeit gegenüber der Verkettung mit `&&` oder `CONCATENATE` erheblich verbessert. Die `FOR`-Expression in `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht die kompakte Erstellung der Ergebnisliste.
