Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der 'Freunde' pro Status (z.B. 'Active', 'Pending', 'Blocked') aus einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine Map (Hash-Tabelle) zu erstellen, die die Zählungen speichert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_friends_by_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_friend,
             id     TYPE s_carr_id,
             status TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_friend.
    TYPES tt_friends TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_friend WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_status_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS count_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_friends        TYPE tt_friends
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status_counts) TYPE ty_status_count_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_friends_by_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_by_status.
    rt_status_counts = REDUCE ty_status_count_map(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_status_count_map( )
      FOR ls_friend IN it_friends
      NEXT
        counts = VALUE ty_status_count_map(
          counts
          ( key = ls_friend-status value = counts[ ls_friend-status ] + 1 )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_by_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_by_status.
    DATA(lt_friends) = VALUE zcl_count_friends_by_status=>tt_friends(
      ( id = 'F01' status = 'Active' )
      ( id = 'F02' status = 'Pending' )
      ( id = 'F03' status = 'Active' )
      ( id = 'F04' status = 'Blocked' )
      ( id = 'F05' status = 'Active' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_friends_by_status( ).
    DATA(lt_status_counts) = lo_cut->count_by_status( lt_friends ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status_counts[ 'Active' ] exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status_counts[ 'Pending' ] exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status_counts[ 'Blocked' ] exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_status_counts ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator (ABAP 7.50+) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation und Transformation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um eine Hash-Tabelle zu erstellen, die die Häufigkeit jedes Freundesstatus zählt. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen und `COLLECT`-Anweisungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, Hash Table

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch den Textkörper einer E-Mail für `CL_BCS_MESSAGE` basierend auf einer Liste von 'Freunden' und deren Status.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates und `FOR`-Ausdrücke, um den E-Mail-Text dynamisch zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_email_body DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_friend,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_friend.
    TYPES tt_friends TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_friend WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_body
      IMPORTING
        it_friends        TYPE tt_friends
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_email_body) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_email_body IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_body.
    rv_email_body = |Liebes Team,\n\n|
                  && |Hier ist ein Update zu unseren Freunden:\n|
                  && REDUCE string(
                       INIT s = ''
                       FOR ls_friend IN it_friends
                       NEXT s = s && | - { ls_friend-name }: { ls_friend-status }\n|
                     )
                  && |\nMit freundlichen Grüßen,
Ihr System|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_body FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_body.
    DATA(lt_friends) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_email_body=>tt_friends(
      ( name = 'Alice' status = 'Active' )
      ( name = 'Bob'   status = 'Pending' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_email_body( ).
    DATA(lv_body) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_body( lt_friends ).

    DATA(lv_expected_body) = |Liebes Team,\n\n|
                           && |Hier ist ein Update zu unseren Freunden:\n|
                           && | - Alice: Active\n|
                           && | - Bob: Pending\n|
                           && |\nMit freundlichen Grüßen,\nIhr System|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_body exp = lv_expected_body ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert String-Templates mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator, um einen komplexen E-Mail-Text dynamisch zu generieren. Die Verwendung von `\n` für Zeilenumbrüche innerhalb von String-Templates ist eine moderne und lesbare Methode. Der `REDUCE`-Operator iteriert über die Freundesliste und baut den mittleren Teil des E-Mail-Textes effizient auf.
keywords: String Templates, REDUCE, Dynamic Programming, CL_BCS_MESSAGE, Email Body

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie eine Begrüßung für einen 'Freund' basierend auf seinem Status ('Active', 'Pending', 'Blocked') unter Verwendung des `COND`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck mit `WHEN`- und `THEN`-Klauseln, um bedingte Zuweisungen zu machen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_friend_greeting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_friend_status TYPE char10.

    METHODS get_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_friend_name TYPE string
        iv_status      TYPE ty_friend_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_greeting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_greeting = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status = 'Active'  THEN |Hallo { iv_friend_name }, schön dich zu sehen!|
      WHEN iv_status = 'Pending' THEN |Hallo { iv_friend_name }, deine Anfrage wird bearbeitet.|
      WHEN iv_status = 'Blocked' THEN |Hallo { iv_friend_name }, du bist blockiert.|
      ELSE                             |Hallo { iv_friend_name }.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_greeting FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_greeting.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_friend_greeting( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_greeting( 'Anna' 'Active' ) exp = 'Hallo Anna, schön dich zu sehen!' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_greeting( 'Ben' 'Pending' ) exp = 'Hallo Ben, deine Anfrage wird bearbeitet.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_greeting( 'Chris' 'Blocked' ) exp = 'Hallo Chris, du bist blockiert.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_greeting( 'David' 'Unknown' ) exp = 'Hallo David.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.40+) ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen oder `CASE`-Anweisungen für die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er macht den Code kompakter und funktionaler, da der Ausdruck direkt einen Wert zurückgibt. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, Functional Programming, String Templates

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Rohdaten (simuliert durch `SFLIGHTS`) in eine strukturierte Tabelle von 'Freundesprofilen' unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Ausdrucks mit `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...)` in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die Transformation zeilenweise durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_transform_friend_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_raw_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_raw_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_friend_profile,
             friend_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             last_contact TYPE s_date,
             status      TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_friend_profile.
    TYPES tt_friend_profiles TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_friend_profile WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_data
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_data         TYPE tt_raw_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_profiles) TYPE tt_friend_profiles.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transform_friend_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data.
    rt_profiles = VALUE tt_friend_profiles(
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_data
      ( friend_id    = ls_raw-carrid,
        last_contact = ls_raw-fldate,
        status       = COND char10( WHEN ls_raw-fldate > sy-datum - 30 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_data.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = VALUE zcl_transform_friend_data=>tt_raw_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum - 60 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_transform_friend_data( ).
    DATA(lt_profiles) = lo_cut->transform_data( lt_raw_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_profiles ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_profiles[ 1 ]-friend_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_profiles[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Active' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_profiles[ 2 ]-friend_id exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_profiles[ 2 ]-status exp = 'Inactive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife zu schreiben und jede Zeile manuell zu füllen, kann die Transformation in einem einzigen Ausdruck definiert werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für das Mapping von Datenstrukturen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Data Transformation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Senden Sie eine Fehlerbenachrichtigungs-E-Mail mit `CL_BCS_MESSAGE`, wenn eine simulierte Operation fehlschlägt, und demonstrieren Sie dabei die Ausnahmebehandlung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Ausnahmebehandlung und `CL_BCS_MESSAGE` zum Versenden der E-Mail im `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_notifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_should_fail TYPE abap_bool
        iv_admin_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS send_error_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_message TYPE string
        iv_admin_email   TYPE ad_smtpadr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_notifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    TRY.
        IF iv_should_fail = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.
        " Simulierte erfolgreiche Operation
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        DATA(lv_error_msg) = |Operation fehlgeschlagen: { lx_static_check->get_text( ) }|.
        send_error_email( iv_error_message = lv_error_msg iv_admin_email = iv_admin_email ).
        rv_success = abap_false.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Fehler beim Senden der E-Mail selbst
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD send_error_email.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_instance( ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_message=>string_to_soli_tab( iv_error_message )
          i_subject = 'Fehlerbenachrichtigung: Operation fehlgeschlagen'
        ).
        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_sender) = cl_sapuser_bcs=>create_instance_from_current_user( ).
        lo_bcs->set_sender( lo_sender ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_admin_email ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit mehreren Empfängern (TO, CC, BCC) und einem Anhang unter Verwendung von `CL_BCS_MESSAGE` und moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ADD_RECIPIENT` mit verschiedenen Empfängertypen und `ADD_ATTACHMENT` für Anhänge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_send_multi_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_multi_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_to_email        TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_cc_email        TYPE ad_smtpadr OPTIONAL
        iv_bcc_email       TYPE ad_smtpadr OPTIONAL
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE string
        iv_attachment_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_attachment_data TYPE xstring OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_send_multi_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_multi_email.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_instance( ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_message=>string_to_soli_tab( iv_body )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).
        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_sender) = cl_sapuser_bcs=>create_instance_from_current_user( ).
        lo_bcs->set_sender( lo_sender ).

        " TO-Empfänger
        DATA(lo_to_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_to_email ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_to_recipient i_express = abap_true ).

        " CC-Empfänger
        IF iv_cc_email IS NOT INITIAL.
          DATA(lo_cc_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_cc_email ).
          lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_cc_recipient i_express = abap_true i_copy = abap_true ).
        ENDIF.

        " BCC-Empfänger
        IF iv_bcc_email IS NOT INITIAL.
          DATA(lo_bcc_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_bcc_email ).
          lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_bcc_recipient i_express = abap_true i_blind_copy = abap_true ).
        ENDIF.

        " Anhang hinzufügen
        IF iv_attachment_name IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_attachment_data IS NOT INITIAL.
          DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
            i_type    = 'BIN'
            i_hex     = cl_bcs_message=>xstring_to_solix_tab( iv_attachment_data )
            i_length  = xstrlen( iv_attachment_data )
            i_subject = iv_attachment_name
          ).
          lo_bcs->add_attachment( i_document = lo_attachment i_attachment_type = 'BIN' i_attachment_size = xstrlen( iv_attachment_data ) i_attachment_filename = iv_attachment_name ).
        ENDIF.

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von 'Freunden' (simuliert durch `SFLIGHTS`-Daten) nach einem bestimmten Kriterium (z.B. Fluggesellschaft) und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppen unter Verwendung des `GROUP BY`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` und `GROUP BY` in einem `VALUE`-Ausdruck, um Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_friends DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_friend_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_friend_flight.
    TYPES tt_friend_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_friend_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_friends,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             first_flight_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_grouped_friends.
    TYPES tt_grouped_friends TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_friends WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights          TYPE tt_friend_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped) TYPE tt_grouped_friends.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_friends IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_grouped = VALUE tt_grouped_friends(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrier_id = ls_flight-carrid )
      ( carrier_id        = ls_flight-carrid,
        num_flights       = GROUP SIZE,
        first_flight_date = REDUCE s_date(
                               INIT min_date = sy-datum
                               FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                               NEXT min_date = COND s_date( WHEN member-fldate < min_date THEN member-fldate ELSE min_date ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_friends=>tt_friend_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250106' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_friends( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrier_id = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-num_flights exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-first_flight_date exp = '20250101' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_group) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrier_id = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-num_flights exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-first_flight_date exp = '20250105' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `GROUP BY`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ...` (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe können Aggregationen wie `GROUP SIZE` oder weitere `REDUCE`-Ausdrücke verwendet werden, um zusammenfassende Informationen zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode zur Datenanalyse.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_generic_email_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_generic_email_sender IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_sort_friends DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      FROM sflights

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_friends( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_friend_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights retrieved' act = lt_sorted_flights ).

    IF lines( lt_sorted_flights ) > 1.
      " Prüfen, ob die Sortierung korrekt ist
      LOOP AT lt_sorted_flights INTO DATA(ls_current_flight).
        DATA(lv_index) = sy-tabix.
        IF lv_index > 1.
          DATA(ls_previous_flight) = lt_sorted_flights[ lv_index - 1 ].
          IF ls_current_flight-carrid < ls_previous_flight-carrid.
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Incorrect sorting by carrid' ).
          ELSEIF ls_current_flight-carrid = ls_previous_flight-carrid.
            IF ls_current_flight-fldate > ls_previous_flight-fldate.
              cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Incorrect sorting by fldate' ).
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` für Flüge von 'LH' mit einer Flugnummer größer als '0400'.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR` Ausdruck mit `WHERE` Klausel und `VALUE #( SORTED TABLE OF ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS get_filtered_sorted_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sorted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data
                          WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid
                          FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND connid > '0400' )
                          ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                            connid = ls_sflight-connid
                            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                            price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_for( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] OPTIONAL
      msg = 'Flight LH 0400 should not be present' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ] OPTIONAL
      msg = 'Flight LH 0401 should be present' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 0
      msg = 'Expected at least one flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Expected first entry to be LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `VALUE #` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Initialisierung und Filterung von internen Tabellen, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht. Die `SORTED TABLE` sorgt für automatische Sortierung und Schlüsselprüfung.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, VALUE, WHERE, Internal Tables, sflights, ASSERT

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Flugdatensatz aus einer sortierten internen Tabelle mit `BINARY SEARCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ... BINARY SEARCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ) INTO TABLE mt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' ) INTO TABLE mt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0050' fldate = '20251203' ) INTO TABLE mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    READ TABLE mt_flights INTO rs_flight WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_flight. " Ensure empty structure if not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: `BINARY SEARCH` ist die effizienteste Methode, um Einträge in einer sortierten Tabelle zu finden, da sie die Anzahl der Vergleiche logarithmisch reduziert. Dies ist besonders vorteilhaft bei großen Tabellen.

Instructions: Ändern Sie das Flugdatum eines spezifischen Eintrags in einer sortierten internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE` mit dem Schlüssel oder `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS modify_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_new_date TYPE s_date
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_date.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE ty_flight.
    ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid.
    ls_flight-connid = iv_connid.
    ls_flight-fldate = iv_new_date.

    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM ls_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_existing_flight.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_modify=>tt_flights_sorted.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).
    lo_cut->modify_flight_date(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid   = 'LH'
        iv_connid   = '0400'
        iv_new_date = '20260101'
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  = lt_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ]-fldate
      exp = '20260101' msg = 'Expected flight date to be updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'Expected table to remain sorted (AA first)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_non_existing_flight.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_modify=>tt_flights_sorted.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).
    lo_cut->modify_flight_date(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid   = 'XX'
        iv_connid   = '9999'
        iv_new_date = '20260101'
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  = lt_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1
      msg = 'Expected no new entry for non-existing flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20251201'
      msg = 'Expected original flight date to remain unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `MODIFY TABLE` Statement aktualisiert einen Eintrag basierend auf dem Tabellenschlüssel. Bei `SORTED TABLE`s bleibt die Sortierreihenfolge automatisch erhalten, auch wenn ein Schlüsselfeld geändert würde (was bei `UNIQUE KEY` zu einem Fehler führen würde, wenn der neue Schlüssel bereits existiert).
keywords: SORTED TABLE, MODIFY TABLE, Internal Tables, ASSERT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hilfsklasse mit einer Methode, die prüft, ob eine interne Tabelle nicht leer ist und mindestens eine bestimmte Anzahl von Zeilen enthält.
hint: Kapseln Sie `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial` und `assert_true` in einer eigenen Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_custom_assertions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS assert_table_not_empty_and_min_lines
      IMPORTING
        it_table      TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_min_lines  TYPE i
        iv_message    TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_assertions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assert_table_not_empty_and_min_lines.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = it_table
      msg = |{ iv_message } - Table is initial but should not be.| ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( it_table ) >= iv_min_lines )
      msg = |{ iv_message } - Expected at least { iv_min_lines } lines, but found { lines( it_table ) }.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table EXPECTING FAILURES.
    METHODS test_too_few_lines EXPECTING FAILURES.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_table.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
    APPEND 1 TO lt_data.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_data.
    APPEND 3 TO lt_data.

    zcl_custom_assertions=>assert_table_not_empty_and_min_lines(
      it_table     = lt_data
      iv_min_lines = 2
      iv_message   = 'Test with valid table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
    zcl_custom_assertions=>assert_table_not_empty_and_min_lines(
      it_table     = lt_data
      iv_min_lines = 1
      iv_message   = 'Test with empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_too_few_lines.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
    APPEND 1 TO lt_data.
    zcl_custom_assertions=>assert_table_not_empty_and_min_lines(
      it_table     = lt_data
      iv_min_lines = 2
      iv_message   = 'Test with too few lines' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eigene Assertions-Methoden verbessern die Lesbarkeit und Wiederverwendbarkeit von Unit Tests, indem sie komplexe Prüfungen in einer einzigen, aussagekräftigen Methode zusammenfassen. `EXPECTING FAILURES` wird verwendet, um zu testen, ob die Assertion bei ungültigen Eingaben korrekt fehlschlägt.
keywords: ABAP Unit, ASSERT, Custom Assertion, Testability

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Zahl schrittweise modifiziert (addieren, multiplizieren) und Methoden-Chaining ermöglicht. Testen Sie die Zwischen- und Endergebnisse.
hint: Methoden, die Chaining ermöglichen, geben `ME` zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_calculator.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_calculator.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_initial_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( 5 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 )->get_result( ). " (5+3)*2 = 16

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16
      msg = 'Expected result 16 after chaining operations' ).

    DATA(lo_calc2) = NEW zcl_calculator( 10 ).
    lo_calc2->multiply( 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calc2->get_result( ) exp = 30
      msg = 'Expected result 30 after single operation' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_value.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( ). " Default initial value 0
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->add( 10 )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10
      msg = 'Expected result 10 with default initial value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methoden-Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung verkettet werden können. Jede Methode gibt dabei eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurück.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, ABAP Unit, ASSERT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Sitze (SEATSMAX) aller Flüge in `sflights` mit dem `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem initialen Wert und einer Schleife über die Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Daten in SFLIGHTS und die Summe ist > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_seats > 0 )
      msg = 'Expected total seats to be greater than 0' ).

    " Optional: Manuelle Berechnung für eine kleine Stichprobe zur Verifizierung
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsmax ) FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS INTO lv_expected_sum.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_actual_sum_for_sample) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                FOR ls_flight IN ( SELECT FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS FIELDS seatsmax ) 
                                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum_for_sample exp = lv_expected_sum
        msg = 'Sample sum calculation mismatch' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Schleifen für Summierungen oder andere Reduktionsoperationen zu ersetzen.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, sflights, ASSERT

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden und deren maximale Sitzplatzkapazität größer als 200 ist. Überprüfen Sie die Anzahl der Ergebnisse.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_flights_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND seatsmax > 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_filtered_flights ) > 0 )
      msg = 'Expected at least one filtered flight' ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax > 200 )
        msg = 'Seatsmax should be greater than 200' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen, ohne explizite Schleifen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen.
keywords: FILTER, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, sflights, ASSERT

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine Variable inline für das Ergebnis einer Multiplikation und überprüfen Sie den Wert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lv_variable) = ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_declaration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declaration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    DATA(lv_intermediate_result) = iv_num1 * iv_num2.
    rv_product = lv_intermediate_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_product FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_product FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_product.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_declaration( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_product( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 50
      msg = 'Expected product of 5 and 10 to be 50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_product.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_declaration( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten aus `sflights` und gruppieren Sie diese nach `CARRID` und `CONNID`. Für jede Gruppe soll die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität ermittelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             max_seats TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_results TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS get_max_seats_by_flight RETURNING VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_flight_group_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seats_by_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ls_flight-connid.
      DATA(lv_max_seats) = REDUCE s_seatsmax( INIT mx = 0
                                             FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                             NEXT mx = nmax( mx, <fs_group_member>-seatsmax ) ).
      INSERT VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      connid = ls_flight-connid
                      max_seats = lv_max_seats ) INTO TABLE rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_max_seats_by_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_seats_by_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_max_seats_by_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_results ) > 0 )
      msg = 'Expected at least one grouped result' ).

    " Beispielprüfung für einen bekannten Flug (falls vorhanden)
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_result_lh_0400) = lt_results[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_result_lh_0400-max_seats > 0 )
          msg = 'Expected max seats for LH 0400 to be greater than 0' ).
    CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
      " OK, if LH 0400 is not in SFLIGHTS
    ENDTRY.

    " Überprüfen, ob die Tabelle sortiert ist (implizit durch SORTED TABLE)
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) = ''.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) = ''.
    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
      IF ls_result-carrid < lv_prev_carrid OR ( ls_result-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_result-connid < lv_prev_connid ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Table is not sorted correctly' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_result-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_result-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und dem `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Datenaggregation. Die Ergebnisse werden direkt in eine `SORTED TABLE` eingefügt, was die Sortierung und Eindeutigkeit der Gruppen sicherstellt.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, sflights, ASSERT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die `CARRID` und `CONNID` von Flügen aus `sflights` enthält, deren `PRICE` über 500 liegt, und sortieren Sie diese nach `CARRID` absteigend und `CONNID` aufsteigend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( ... FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ORDER BY ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_for_order DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_ordered_flight_keys RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_for_order IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ordered_flight_keys.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                              WHERE ( price > 500 )
                              ORDER BY carrid DESCENDING connid ASCENDING
                              ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_ordered_flight_keys FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_ordered_flight_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_for_order( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->get_ordered_flight_keys( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_flight_keys ) > 0 )
      msg = 'Expected at least one flight key' ).

    " Überprüfen der Sortierung
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) = 'ZZ'. " Start mit einem Wert, der größer ist als jeder mögliche CARRID
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) = ''.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_key-carrid <= lv_prev_carrid )
        msg = 'Carrier ID not sorted descending' ).
      IF ls_key-carrid = lv_prev_carrid.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_key-connid >= lv_prev_connid )
          msg = 'Connection ID not sorted ascending within same carrier' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_key-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_key-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE #` Konstruktion mit `FOR`, `WHERE` und `ORDER BY` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Transformation und Sortierung von internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen und `SORT` Statements.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, ORDER BY, Internal Tables, sflights, ASSERT

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Überprüfen Sie den gelesenen Wert.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'FIELD_NOT_FOUND'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TO <FS>` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programmieraufgaben, bei denen Feldnamen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Feldsymbole ermöglichen den typgerechten Zugriff auf die zugewiesene Komponente.

Instructions: Serialisiere eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in ein XSTRING, komprimiere das XSTRING mittels GZIP und dekomprimiere es anschließend wieder, um die ursprüngliche Tabelle zu rekonstruieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` für die Serialisierung/Deserialisierung und `cl_abap_gzip` für die Kompression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_table_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             maxf     TYPE sflight-maxf,
             occperc  TYPE sflight-occperc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_and_decompress_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_decompressed_table) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_table_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_table.
    DATA: lv_xstring_original TYPE xstring,
          lv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring,
          lv_xstring_decompressed TYPE xstring.

    " Tabelle in XSTRING serialisieren
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE original_table = it_original_table
      RESULT XML lv_xstring_original.

    " XSTRING komprimieren
    lv_compressed_xstring = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_original ).

    " XSTRING dekomprimieren
    lv_xstring_decompressed = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    " Dekomprimiertes XSTRING in Tabelle deserialisieren
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE XML lv_xstring_decompressed
      RESULT original_table = rt_decompressed_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_table_compression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_compression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_table_compress( ).
    DATA: lt_original_sflights TYPE zcl_gzip_table_compress=>tt_sflight,
          lt_decompressed_sflights TYPE zcl_gzip_table_compress=>tt_sflight.

    " Testdaten
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, maxf, occperc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_original_sflights
      UP TO 2 ROWS.

    lt_decompressed_sflights = lo_cut->compress_and_decompress_table( lt_original_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_decompressed_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte gleich sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decompressed_sflights exp = lt_original_sflights msg = 'Dekomprimierte Tabelle sollte dem Original entsprechen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kompression und Dekompression einer internen Tabelle. Zuerst wird die Tabelle mittels `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` in ein XSTRING serialisiert, dann mit `cl_abap_gzip` komprimiert und dekomprimiert, und schließlich wieder deserialisiert. Dies ist nützlich für die effiziente Speicherung oder Übertragung strukturierter Daten.
keywords: GZIP, XSTRING, Serialize, Deserialize, Internal Table, CALL TRANSFORMATION, cl_abap_gzip

Instructions: Löschen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle, die nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer sortiert ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        io_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    ro_unique_flights = io_flights.
    SORT ro_unique_flights BY carrid ASCENDING connid ASCENDING fldate ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ro_unique_flights COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_duplicates=>tt_sflight_key.

    " Testdaten mit Duplikaten
    lt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ) " Duplicate
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230103' ) " Not adjacent duplicate
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230102' ) ). " Duplicate, but not adjacent after sort

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_adjacent_duplicates( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 eindeutige Zeilen übrig bleiben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Erster Eintrag ist AA.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Zweiter Eintrag ist LH.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-fldate exp = '20230103' msg = 'Dritter Eintrag ist LH mit anderem Datum.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` entfernt aufeinanderfolgende, identische Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Feldern zu sortieren, um alle Duplikate zu erfassen. `COMPARING ALL FIELDS` stellt sicher, dass alle Felder für den Vergleich herangezogen werden.
keywords: DELETE, Duplicates, Internal Table, SORT, COMPARING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugdaten aus `sflights` enthält, bei denen die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist und die Flugzeit (`FLTIME`) größer als 100 Minuten ist. Verwenden Sie dabei den `FILTER` Operator.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle in einen JSON-String, komprimieren Sie diesen String mit GZIP und dekomprimieren Sie ihn anschließend wieder, um den ursprünglichen JSON-String zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_cl_sjson_writer` oder `CALL TRANSFORMATION` für JSON und `cl_abap_gzip` für GZIP.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_json_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_and_decompress_json
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decompressed_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_json_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_json.
    DATA: lv_json_string TYPE string,
          lv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring,
          lv_decompressed_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Tabelle in JSON-String konvertieren
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( EXPORTING data = it_original_table PRETTY_PRINT = abap_false
                             RECEIVING r_json = lv_json_string ).

    " JSON-String komprimieren (als XSTRING)
    lv_compressed_xstring = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text( lv_json_string ).

    " Komprimiertes XSTRING dekomprimieren
    rv_decompressed_json = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_text( lv_compressed_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( EXPORTING data = lt_original_data PRETTY_PRINT = abap_false

Eine interne Tabelle wird in einen JSON-String umgewandelt, dieser wird mit `cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text` komprimiert und anschließend wieder dekomprimiert. Dies ist eine gängige Methode, um JSON-Payloads für APIs oder die Speicherung zu optimieren.

CLASS zcl_delete_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, ein ungültiges XSTRING mit `cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring` zu dekomprimieren und fangen Sie die erwartete Ausnahme `cx_sy_compression_error` ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um die Ausnahme zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_invalid_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_invalid_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_invalid_xstring.
    DATA: lv_decompressed_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lv_decompressed_xstring = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( iv_invalid_xstring ).
        rv_error_message = 'Dekomprimierung erfolgreich (unerwartet).'.
      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error INTO DATA(lx_compression_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_compression_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_invalid_compression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) = '414243'X. " Ein ungültiges GZIP-Format

    DATA(lv_error_message) = lo_cut->decompress_invalid_xstring( lv_invalid_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_error_message CS 'Dekomprimierung erfolgreich' msg = 'Sollte keine erfolgreiche Dekomprimierung melden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_error_message msg = 'Fehlermeldung sollte nicht leer sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_error_message exp = 'Fehler bei der Dekomprimierung' msg = 'Fehlermeldung sollte auf Kompressionsfehler hinweisen.' ).

explanation: Beim Umgang mit externen Daten oder potenziell korrupten komprimierten Daten ist eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung unerlässlich. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die spezifische Ausnahme `cx_sy_compression_error` abfängt, die von `cl_abap_gzip` ausgelöst wird, wenn die Dekomprimierung fehlschlägt. Dies verhindert Programmabbrüche und ermöglicht eine kontrollierte Reaktion.
keywords: GZIP, Exception, Error Handling, TRY CATCH, cx_sy_compression_error, cl_abap_gzip

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der gebuchten Sitze für alle Flüge in `sflights` und die durchschnittliche Auslastung (gebuchte Sitze / maximale Sitze) als Dezimalzahl.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             total_booked_seats TYPE i,
             average_occupancy  TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rs_summary-total_booked_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                            FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                            NEXT sum = sum + flight-booked ).

    DATA(total_max_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                     NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).

    IF total_max_seats > 0.
      rs_summary-average_occupancy = rs_summary-total_booked_seats / total_max_seats.
    ELSE.
      rs_summary-average_occupancy = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Total booked seats should not be initial' act = ls_result-total_booked_seats IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Average occupancy should not be initial' act = ls_result-average_occupancy IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total booked seats should be positive' act = ls_result-total_booked_seats > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average occupancy should be between 0 and 1' act = ls_result-average_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_result-average_occupancy <= 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einem funktionalen Stil. Er ist ideal, um Summen, Minima, Maxima oder andere aggregierte Werte zu berechnen, ohne explizite Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen deklarieren zu müssen.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, REDUCE, Aggregation, Sum, Average

hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT(*) IN GROUP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                            ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
                                            flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen aus `sflights`, die in den nächsten 7 Tagen abfliegen. Für jeden dieser Flüge soll das Abflugdatum im Format 'DD.MM.YYYY' formatiert werden. Die resultierende Tabelle soll Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das formatierte Datum enthalten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `xco_cp_time` für Datumsvergleiche und `FOR`/`VALUE` für die Transformation und Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mix_itab_time DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_upcoming_flight,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate_formatted TYPE string,
           END OF ty_upcoming_flight.
    TYPES tt_upcoming_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_upcoming_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_upcoming_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_upcoming_flights) TYPE tt_upcoming_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_itab_time IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_upcoming_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_today) = xco_cp_time=>now()->set_to_date_start( ).
    DATA(lo_seven_days_later) = lo_today->add_days( 7 ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE fldate >= lo_today->get_date( ) AND fldate <= lo_seven_days_later->get_date( ) ).

    rt_upcoming_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                   LET lo_flight_date = xco_cp_time=>from_date( flight-fldate )
                                       lv_formatted_date = lo_flight_date->format( xco_cp_time_format=>dd_mm_yyyy )->value( ) IN
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                     connid = flight-connid
                                     fldate_formatted = lv_formatted_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_upcoming_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).

    DATA(lo_today) = xco_cp_time=>now()->set_to_date_start( ).
    DATA(lo_seven_days_later) = lo_today->add_days( 7 ).

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      DATA(lv_fldate_raw) = xco_cp_time=>from_string( <fs_flight>-fldate_formatted )->get_date( ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date should be today or later' act = lv_fldate_raw >= lo_today->get_date( ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date should be within next 7 days' act = lv_fldate_raw <= lo_seven_days_later->get_date( ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( msg = 'Date format should be DD.MM.YYYY' act = <fs_flight>-fldate_formatted exp = '\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4}' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Zeitpunkte: den aktuellen Zeitpunkt und einen Zeitpunkt vor 24 Stunden. Geben Sie 'TRUE' zurück, wenn der aktuelle Zeitpunkt später ist, ansonsten 'FALSE'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xco_cp_time=>now()` und `subtract_hours()` sowie die Vergleichsoperatoren.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_times
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_later) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_times.
    DATA(lo_now) = xco_cp_time=>now().
    DATA(lo_24_hours_ago) = lo_now->subtract_hours( 24 ).

    IF lo_now->is_after( lo_24_hours_ago ) = abap_true.
      rv_is_later = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_later = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation auf der Tabelle `sflights` durch: Für jeden Flug soll ein neues Feld `flight_status` hinzugefügt werden. Der Status soll 'Delayed' sein, wenn `fldate` in der Vergangenheit liegt und `seatsocc` unter 50% liegt, ansonsten 'On Time'. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung des Status.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_transform_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             sflights,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.
    TYPES tt_flights_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights_with_status) TYPE tt_flights_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_transform_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_flights_with_status = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                      ( flight = flight
                                        flight_status = COND string( WHEN flight-fldate < lv_today AND
                                                                          ( flight-booked / flight-seatsmax ) < 0.5
                                                                    THEN 'Delayed'
                                                                    ELSE 'On Time' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_transform_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_status>).
      IF <fs_flight_status>-flight-fldate < lv_today AND
         ( <fs_flight_status>-flight-booked / <fs_flight_status>-flight-seatsmax ) < 0.5.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be Delayed' act = <fs_flight_status>-flight_status exp = 'Delayed' ).
      ELSE.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten (z.B. '20230101' und '20230131'), unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden. Verwenden Sie die XCO Time API.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xco_cp_time=>from_date()` und iterieren Sie, um Wochentage zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_time_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workdays_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_end_date   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workdays_between.
    DATA(lo_current_date) = xco_cp_time=>from_date( iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lo_end_date) = xco_cp_time=>from_date( iv_end_date ).

    WHILE lo_current_date->is_before_or_equal( lo_end_date ) = abap_true.
      DATA(lv_day_of_week) = lo_current_date->get_day_of_week( )->value( ).
      IF lv_day_of_week <> xco_cp_time_day_of_week=>saturday AND
         lv_day_of_week <> xco_cp_time_day_of_week=>sunday.
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lo_current_date = lo_current_date->add_days( 1 ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Fluggesellschaften und die Summe der gebuchten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` enthält. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_booked_seats,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_booked TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_booked_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_booked_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_booked_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_booked_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_booked_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_booked_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_booked_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_booked_seats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
                                       ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                         total_booked = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                                 FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                                 NEXT sum = sum + member-booked ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).

    DATA(lv_total_booked_sflights) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_summary>).

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request auf eine externe URL (z.B. 'https://www.example.com') durch und geben Sie den Antworttext zurück. Behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler bei der Kommunikation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT=>CREATE_BY_URL`, `SEND`, `RECEIVE` und `GET_CDATA` des Response-Objekts. Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_HTTP_DEST_ERROR` und `CX_HTTP_IO_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_url_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_url_content.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).

        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
          rv_content = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        ELSE.
          " Optional: Log error status and reason
          " DATA(lv_reason) = lo_http_client->response->get_reason( ).
          " MESSAGE e001(zmsg) WITH lv_status_code lv_reason INTO DATA(lv_dummy).
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        " Handle HTTP communication errors
        rv_content = |Error: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_word_count IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle gültigen IP-Adressen (IPv4) aus einem gegebenen Log-String.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem passenden regulären Ausdruck für IPv4-Adressen und extrahieren Sie die gefundenen Substrings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_extract_ip_addresses DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_ipv4_addresses
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_ip_addresses) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_extract_ip_addresses IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_ipv4_addresses.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = '\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b'. " Regex for IPv4 addresses
    DATA: lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_log_string
      RESULTS lt_matches.

    rt_ip_addresses = VALUE #( FOR match IN lt_matches
                                 ( substring( val = iv_log_string off = match-offset len = match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,

         cityto TYPE s_to_city,

    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,

  METHOD test_json_parsing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_json_parser( ).
    " Mock-URL, die eine JSON-Antwort liefert. In einem echten Szenario
    " würde man hier einen Mock-Server oder eine bekannte API verwenden.
    " Für diesen Test simulieren wir eine JSON-Antwort.
    DATA(lv_mock_json_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1'. " Beispiel-API

    " Da wir keine Kontrolle über die externe API haben, können wir nur prüfen,
    " ob die Deserialisierung erfolgreich ist und Daten zurückgegeben werden.
    " Für einen präzisen Test müsste der HTTP-Client gemockt werden.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_and_parse_json( lv_mock_json_url ).

    " Die Struktur ty_flight_data passt nicht zur jsonplaceholder-Antwort.
    " Für einen korrekten Test müsste die ABAP-Struktur an die JSON-Antwort angepasst werden.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob die Deserialisierung keine Exception wirft und die Tabelle nicht leer ist.
    " (Dies ist ein vereinfachter Test, da die JSON-Struktur der URL nicht zu ty_flight_data passt)
    " Realistisch wäre:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post,
             userId TYPE i,
             id TYPE i,
             title TYPE string,
             body TYPE string,
           END OF ty_post.
    DATA(ls_post) TYPE ty_post.
    DATA(lv_json_response) = '{"userId": 1, "id": 1, "title": "sunt aut facere repellat provident occaecati excepturi optio reprehenderit", "body": "quia et suscipit\nsuscipit recusandae consequuntur expedita et cum\nreprehenderit molestiae ut ut quas totam\nnostrum rerum est autem sunt rem eveniet architecto"}'.

    cl_abap_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json = lv_json_response
      CHANGING
        data = ls_post
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_post-id exp = 1 msg = 'ID sollte 1 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_post-userId exp = 1 msg = 'UserID sollte 1 sein.' ).

Dies ist wesentlich effizienter und typsicherer als die manuelle String-Verarbeitung. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_ABAP_JSON_PARSER_ERROR` ist entscheidend für eine robuste Anwendung.

Instructions: Zählen Sie in einer internen Tabelle von Strings, wie viele Einträge ein bestimmtes Substring enthalten, unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und der `CONTAINS` Funktion (oder `FIND` mit `sy-subrc`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_find_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_substring_with_reduce
      IMPORTING
        it_texts    TYPE string_table
        iv_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_find_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_substring_with_reduce.
    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                         FOR text IN it_texts
                         WHERE ( text CP '*' && iv_substring && '*' ) " Using CP for simple pattern match
                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
    " Alternative mit FIND:
    " rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
    "                      FOR text IN it_texts
    "                      LET lv_found = xsdbool( find( val = text sub = iv_substring ) IS NOT INITIAL ) IN
    "                      NEXT count = count + COND i( WHEN lv_found THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request auf eine Webseite durch und extrahieren Sie den Inhalt des HTML-`<title>`-Tags aus dem Antworttext mittels regulärem Ausdruck.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` für den Request und `FIND REGEX` mit einem passenden Muster für das `<title>`-Tag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_web_scraper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_page_title
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_title) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_web_scraper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_page_title.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_html_content TYPE string,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).

        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
          lv_html_content = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

          DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = '<title>(.*?)</title>'.
          DATA: lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.

          FIND REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN lv_html_content
            RESULTS lt_matches
            SUBMATCHES 1.

          IF lines( lt_matches ) > 0.
            rv_title = substring( val = lv_html_content off = lt_matches[ 1 ]-submatches[ 1 ]-offset len = lt_matches[ 1 ]-submatches[ 1 ]-length ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_title = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_no_title) = lo_cut->get_page_title( 'https://www.google.com/404' ). " Eine Seite, die wahrscheinlich keinen Titel liefert
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_no_title msg = 'Sollte keinen Titel finden.' ).

Nach dem Abrufen des HTML-Inhalts einer Webseite mittels `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` wird `FIND REGEX` verwendet, um spezifische Daten (hier der Inhalt des `<title>`-Tags) zu extrahieren. Die `SUBMATCHES`-Option ist entscheidend, um den Inhalt innerhalb der Klammern des regulären Ausdrucks zu erfassen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine URL mit mehreren Query-Parametern aus einer Map von Schlüssel-Wert-Paaren. Die Parameter sollen korrekt URL-kodiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>IF_HTTP_UTILITY~URL_ENCODE` für jeden Parameter und String-Templates zum Zusammenfügen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_url_param,
         name  TYPE string,
         value TYPE string,
       END OF ty_url_param.
TYPES: tt_url_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_url_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_url_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_url_with_params
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_url TYPE string
        it_params   TYPE tt_url_params
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_full_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_url_with_params.
    DATA(lv_query_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR param IN it_params
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL
                 THEN |{ cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~url_encode( param-name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~url_encode( param-value ) }|
                 ELSE |{ s }&{ cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~url_encode( param-name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~url_encode( param-value ) }|
               )
    ).

    IF lv_query_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_full_url = |{ iv_base_url }?{ lv_query_string }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_full_url = iv_base_url.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_url_builder FOR TESTING.
