CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_url_builder.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_url_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_base_url) = 'https://api.example.com/data'.

    DATA(lt_params) = VALUE tt_url_params(
      ( name = 'query' value = 'ABAP Entwicklung' )
      ( name = 'limit' value = '10' )
      ( name = 'filter' value = 'special chars & more' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_full_url) = lo_cut->build_url_with_params( iv_base_url = lv_base_url it_params = lt_params ).
    DATA(lv_expected_url) = 'https://api.example.com/data?query=ABAP%20Entwicklung&limit=10&filter=special%20chars%20%26%20more'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_full_url exp = lv_expected_url msg = 'Die generierte URL ist falsch.' ).

    " Testfall ohne Parameter
    DATA(lv_url_no_params) = lo_cut->build_url_with_params( iv_base_url = lv_base_url it_params = VALUE tt_url_params( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_url_no_params exp = lv_base_url msg = 'URL ohne Parameter sollte unverändert sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um dynamisch eine Query-String aus einer internen Tabelle von Parametern zu erstellen. Jeder Parametername und -wert wird mit `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>IF_HTTP_UTILITY~URL_ENCODE` korrekt kodiert, um Probleme mit Sonderzeichen in URLs zu vermeiden. String-Templates (`|...|`) und der `COND`-Operator sorgen für eine kompakte und lesbare Konstruktion des Query-Strings. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Muster für die URL-Generierung.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Text mindestens zwei von einer Liste von Schlüsselwörtern enthält. Die Suche soll case-insensitive sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife über die Schlüsselwörter und `FIND` (oder `CONTAINS`) mit `IGNORING CASE`. Zählen Sie die Treffer.
solution:
CLASS zcl_check_keywords DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_at_least_two_keywords
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        it_keywords TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_keywords IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_at_least_two_keywords.
    DATA(lv_found_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_keywords INTO DATA(lv_keyword).
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_keyword IN iv_text
        IGNORING CASE.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_found_count = lv_found_count + 1.
        IF lv_found_count >= 2.
          rv_result = abap_true.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_keyword_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_check_keywords( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Dies ist ein Test mit ABAP und SAP Keywords.'.
    DATA(lt_keywords) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'ABAP' )
      ( 'SAP' )
      ( 'HANA' )
      ( 'Cloud' )
    ).

    " Testfall 1: Zwei Keywords gefunden
    DATA(lb_result1) = lo_cut->contains_at_least_two_keywords( iv_text = lv_text it_keywords = lt_keywords ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lb_result1 exp = abap_true msg = 'Sollte TRUE sein (ABAP, SAP).' ).

    " Testfall 2: Nur ein Keyword gefunden
    DATA(lv_text2) = 'Nur ABAP hier.'.
    DATA(lb_result2) = lo_cut->contains_at_least_two_keywords( iv_text = lv_text2 it_keywords = lt_keywords ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lb_result2 exp = abap_false msg = 'Sollte FALSE sein (nur ABAP).' ).

    " Testfall 3: Keine Keywords gefunden
    DATA(lv_text3) = 'Nichts relevantes.'.
    DATA(lb_result3) = lo_cut->contains_at_least_two_keywords( iv_text = lv_text3 it_keywords = lt_keywords ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lb_result3 exp = abap_false msg = 'Sollte FALSE sein (keine Keywords).' ).

    " Testfall 4: Case-insensitive
    DATA(lv_text4) = 'abap und sap'.
    DATA(lb_result4) = lo_cut->contains_at_least_two_keywords( iv_text = lv_text4 it_keywords = lt_keywords ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lb_result4 exp = abap_true msg = 'Sollte TRUE sein (case-insensitive).' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine einfache `LOOP AT` Schleife über eine Liste von Schlüsselwörtern und die `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF ... IGNORING CASE` Anweisung, um das Vorkommen jedes Schlüsselworts im Text zu prüfen. `sy-subrc = 0` zeigt einen Treffer an. Die Zählung der Treffer und das frühzeitige Beenden (`RETURN`) bei Erreichen von zwei Treffern optimieren die Performance. `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen ist ein Merkmal von modernem ABAP.
keywords: FIND, String, Keywords, Conditional Logic, Loop, Ignoring Case

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines regulären Ausdrucks in einem String durch einen anderen String. Zum Beispiel, ersetzen Sie alle Datumsformate (YYYY-MM-DD) durch 'DATUM_ERSETZT'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_regex_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_string TYPE string
        iv_regex_pattern   TYPE string
        iv_replacement     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_regex_pattern.
    rv_result_string = iv_original_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX iv_regex_pattern IN rv_result_string WITH iv_replacement.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_regex_replace FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_regex_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_replace( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Heute ist der 2023-12-03. Morgen ist der 2023-12-04. Und gestern war der 2023-12-02.'.
    DATA(lv_regex) = '\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'. " Regex for YYYY-MM-DD
    DATA(lv_replacement) = 'DATUM_ERSETZT'.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_regex_pattern(
      iv_original_string = lv_text
      iv_regex_pattern   = lv_regex

    " Testfall mit keinem Treffer

    DATA(lv_no_match_result) = lo_cut->replace_regex_pattern(
      iv_original_string = lv_no_match_text

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_no_match_result exp = lv_no_match_text msg = 'Text sollte unverändert bleiben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

WITH ...` ist die direkte und effizienteste Methode, um Muster, die durch reguläre Ausdrücke definiert sind, in einem String zu ersetzen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für komplexe Ersetzungsaufgaben, die über einfache Substring-Ersetzungen hinausgehen. Die moderne ABAP-Syntax ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte Implementierung.
keywords: REGEX, REPLACE, String, Pattern Matching, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine externe URL durch und geben Sie den Antworttext zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT`, setzen Sie den Request-Body mit `SET_CDATA` und den Content-Type-Header auf 'application/json'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS post_json_to_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url       TYPE string
        iv_json_payload TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_to_url.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( iv_json_payload ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).

        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
          rv_response_content = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
        ELSE.
          rv_response_content = |Error: { lv_status_code } - { lo_http_client->response->get_reason( ) }|.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_response_content = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen Sie dynamisch in einer internen Tabelle nach Zeilen, die ein bestimmtes Muster in einem beliebigen String-Feld enthalten. Die Feldnamen sind zur Laufzeit bekannt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` mit dynamischen Bedingungen oder `FILTER` mit einer dynamisch erstellten Bedingung. `FIND` kann innerhalb der Bedingung verwendet werden.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
         carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
         fldate   TYPE s_date,
         cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
         cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
       END OF ty_sflight.
TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_in_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        it_data      TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_pattern   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_found_data) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_in_dynamic_field.
    DATA(lv_pattern_with_wildcard) = |*{ iv_pattern }*|.

    rt_found_data = FILTER #( it_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE ( ( iv_field_name ) CP lv_pattern_with_wildcard ) ).

    " Alternative mit dynamischem FIND in LOOP (weniger performant für große Tabellen):
    " LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
    "   ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_data TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
    "   IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
    "     IF <fs_field> CP lv_pattern_with_wildcard.
    "       APPEND ls_data TO rt_found_data.
    "     ENDIF.
    "   ENDIF.
    " ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String einem bestimmten regulären Ausdruck entspricht (vollständiger Match).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` und die Länge des Treffers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_match DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS matches_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_string      TYPE string
        iv_regex_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_match) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_match IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD matches_regex.
    DATA: ls_match TYPE match_result.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX iv_regex_pattern IN iv_string
      RESULTS ls_match.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_match-offset = 0 AND ls_match-length = strlen( iv_string ).
      rv_is_match = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_match = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_regex_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_regex_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_match( ).

    " Testfall 1: Vollständiger Match
    DATA(lv_email) = 'test@example.com'.
    DATA(lv_email_regex) = '^\S+@\S+\.\S+$'. " Einfacher Regex für E-Mail
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->matches_regex( lv_email lv_email_regex ) exp = abap_true msg = 'E-Mail sollte matchen.' ).

    " Testfall 2: Kein vollständiger Match (Teilstring)
    DATA(lv_partial_email) = 'Hallo test@example.com Welt'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->matches_regex( lv_partial_email lv_email_regex ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Teilstring sollte nicht matchen.' ).

    " Testfall 3: Kein Match
    DATA(lv_invalid_email) = 'invalid-email'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->matches_regex( lv_invalid_email lv_email_regex ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Ungültige E-Mail sollte nicht matchen.' ).

    " Testfall 4: Numerischer String
    DATA(lv_number) = '12345'.
    DATA(lv_number_regex) = '^\d+$'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->matches_regex( lv_number lv_number_regex ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Numerischer String sollte matchen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um einen vollständigen Match eines Strings gegen einen regulären Ausdruck zu prüfen, reicht es nicht aus, nur `sy-subrc = 0` nach `FIND REGEX` zu prüfen. Man muss zusätzlich sicherstellen, dass der gefundene Treffer am Anfang des Strings beginnt (`offset = 0`) und die gleiche Länge wie der gesamte String hat (`length = strlen( iv_string )`). Dies ist eine präzise Methode zur Validierung von Strings mittels Regex in modernem ABAP.
keywords: REGEX, FIND, String, Validation, Pattern Matching, Full Match

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und prüfen Sie, ob der Antwort-Content-Type einem bestimmten Wert entspricht (z.B. 'application/json').
hint: Nach dem `RECEIVE` des `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` greifen Sie auf das `RESPONSE`-Objekt zu und verwenden Sie dessen Methode `GET_CONTENT_TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_content_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_content_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_url          TYPE string
        iv_expected_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_match) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_content_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_content_type.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i,
          lv_actual_type TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).

        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
          lv_actual_type = lo_http_client->response->get_content_type( ).
          IF lv_actual_type CP iv_expected_type. " Using CP for potential charset in content type
            rv_is_match = abap_true.
          ELSE.
            rv_is_match = abap_false.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_match = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_is_match = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Die Verwendung von `CP` für den Vergleich ist flexibel, da Content-Types oft zusätzliche Parameter wie `charset` enthalten können. Die Fehlerbehandlung ist Standard für HTTP-Kommunikation.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Wörter aus einem Satz, die mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnen, unter Verwendung von `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES` und `substring`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit einem Muster, das das Präfix und Wildcards (`*`) enthält, und extrahieren Sie dann die Substrings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_extract_words_prefix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_words_with_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
        iv_prefix   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_extract_words_prefix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_words_with_prefix.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = |{ iv_prefix }*|.
    DATA: lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_pattern IN iv_sentence
      IGNORING CASE
      RESULTS lt_matches.

    rt_words = VALUE #( FOR match IN lt_matches
                         ( substring( val = iv_sentence off = match-offset len = match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_prefix_words FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_prefix_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_extract_words_prefix( ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = 'ABAP ist eine Programmiersprache für SAP-Systeme. Modernes ABAP ist sehr leistungsfähig.'.

    " Testfall 1: Wörter mit Präfix 'ABAP'
    DATA(lt_result1) = lo_cut->extract_words_with_prefix( iv_sentence = lv_sentence iv_prefix = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result1 ) exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 Wörter mit Präfix "ABAP" finden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result1[ 1 ] exp = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result1[ 2 ] exp = 'ABAP' ).

    " Testfall 2: Wörter mit Präfix 'SAP'
    DATA(lt_result2) = lo_cut->extract_words_with_prefix( iv_sentence = lv_sentence iv_prefix = 'SAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result2 ) exp = 1 msg = 'Sollte 1 Wort mit Präfix "SAP" finden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result2[ 1 ] exp = 'SAP-Systeme' ).

    " Testfall 3: Kein Treffer
    DATA(lt_result3) = lo_cut->extract_words_with_prefix( iv_sentence = lv_sentence iv_prefix = 'XYZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result3 msg = 'Sollte keine Wörter finden.' ).

    " Testfall 4: Case-insensitive
    DATA(lt_result4) = lo_cut->extract_words_with_prefix( iv_sentence = 'abap ist modern' iv_prefix = 'abap' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result4 ) exp = 1 msg = 'Sollte 1 Wort (case-insensitive) finden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit einem Muster, das das gewünschte Präfix und einen Wildcard (`*`) enthält, um alle passenden Wörter zu finden. Die `IGNORING CASE` Option sorgt für eine flexible Suche. Der `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Konstruktor-Ausdruck wird verwendet, um die gefundenen Substrings effizient in eine interne Tabelle zu sammeln. Dies ist eine moderne und prägnante Art der String-Verarbeitung.

CLASS zcl_http_read_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_http_read_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_response_headers.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_status_code TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).

        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
          lo_http_client->response->get_header_fields( CHANGING fields = rt_headers ).
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimme den Status eines Fluges basierend auf der Auslastung. Wenn die Auslastung >= 90% ist, ist der Status 'Full', zwischen 50% und 89% ist er 'Normal', ansonsten 'Low'.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_by_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_occupancy_rate TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status)  TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_by_occupancy.
    rv_status = CASE  iv_occupancy_rate
                  WHEN  ( >= 90 )
                    THEN  'Full'
                  WHEN  ( BETWEEN 50 AND 89 )
                    THEN  'Normal'
                  ELSE  'Low'
                END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle, die Flugnummern und einen kategorisierten Status (basierend auf der Auslastung: 'Full', 'Normal', 'Low') für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' enthält. Nutze dabei `FOR` und `CASE`.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR` mit `CASE` innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Ausdrucks für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flight_statuses
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flight_statuses.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                     connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                                     status = CASE  ( ls_sflight-seatsocc / ls_sflight-seatsmax * 100 ) AS occupancy_rate
                                                WHEN  ( >= 90 ) THEN 'Full'
                                                WHEN  ( BETWEEN 50 AND 89 ) THEN 'Normal'
                                                ELSE  'Low'
                                              END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_table( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_statuses) = lo_cut->get_lh_flight_statuses( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flight_statuses ). " sflight might be empty or not contain LH data in test system

    " To make this test more robust, we would need to insert test data into sflight.
    " For demonstration, we assume some data might exist or the table is empty.

      " Example check if any 'Full' status exists (requires test data)
      DATA(lv_has_full) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_flight_statuses INTO DATA(ls_flight_status) WHERE status = 'Full'.
        lv_has_full = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDLOOP.
      " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_has_full msg = 'Expected at least one ''Full'' flight' ).
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die eine bestimmte Aktion basierend auf der aktuellen Daten-Temperatur der ABAP-Session ausführt. Die Aktion soll als String zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature` und eine `CASE`-Expression, um auf die Temperatur zu reagieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_action_by_temperature
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_action_by_temperature.
    DATA(lv_temperature) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ).

    rv_action_description = CASE lv_temperature
                              WHEN if_abap_session_temperature=>c_hot

CLASS zcl_reduce_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid         TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_reduce_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_departure_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_departure_city.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    TRY.
        rv_city = lt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-cityfrom.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_city = 'NOT FOUND'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere die Tabelle `sflight`, um alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' zu erhalten, die nach dem 1. Januar 2025 stattfinden und eine Auslastung von mindestens 70% haben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = 'LH'
                                    AND fldate > '20250101'
                                    AND ( seatsocc / seatsmax * 100 ) >= 70 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " For a real test, insert specific data into sflight
    " Example: INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250601' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 100 ).
    "          INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20241231' seatsocc = 90 seatsmax = 100 ).
    "          INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250601' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 100 ).

      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Klasse, die eine Kette von Operationen auf einem internen Wert ermöglicht (Fluent Interface). Die Klasse soll Methoden zum Hinzufügen, Multiplizieren und Zurücksetzen des Wertes bereitstellen.
hint: Gib `ME` aus den Methoden zurück, um Methodenaufrufe zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.
    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.
    METHODS reset
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.
    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reset.
    mv_current_value = 0.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->add( 5 )->multiply( 2 )->add( 3 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 13 ). " (0 + 5) * 2 + 3 = 13
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies wird durch das Zurückgeben einer Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) in jeder Methode erreicht.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp und einer Liste von Feldnamen füllt. Die Werte sollen dabei aus einer statischen Quelle (z.B. `sflight`) stammen.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff. Dies ist ein komplexeres Szenario, das die Grenzen von 'modern' in Bezug auf 'dynamisch' aufzeigt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE tabname
        it_field_names     TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data)     TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field_value>   TYPE ANY.

    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lr_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        lr_struct_descr ?= lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        DATA lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
        SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflight_data.

        LOOP AT lt_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
          CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
          LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
            READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = lv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_field_value>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field_value>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_runtime_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid type name or field name
        CLEAR rr_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_fill FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_type FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_fill.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_fill( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ).
    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->fill_dynamic_table( iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHT_T' it_field_names = lt_fields ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_data ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_result> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_result> TYPE ANY.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_result>.

    LOOP AT <lt_result> ASSIGNING <ls_result>.

Hier wird gezeigt, wie man zur Laufzeit eine Tabelle basierend auf einem Typnamen erstellt und deren Felder dynamisch füllt, was für generische Schnittstellen oder Tools nützlich ist.

CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_occupancy,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_carr_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupancy_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_carr_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid AS car
                            ( carrid = car
                              total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                      FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                        NEXT sum = sum + ls_group_flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von REDUCE.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um eine Schleife über die interne Tabelle zu iterieren und die Flugpreise zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE s_price = 0
                               FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Städtenamen aus einer Liste von Flugzielen zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, unter Verwendung von REDUCE.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_city_list
      IMPORTING
        it_cities TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_city_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_list.
    rv_city_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                    FOR city IN it_cities
                                    NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN city ELSE s && ', ' && city ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie, wie die ABAP-Sitzungstemperatur für Data Aging gesetzt und anschließend ausgelesen wird. Erläutern Sie die Auswirkungen auf den Datenzugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_SESSION_TEMPERATURE` und ihre Methoden `SET_TEMPERATURE` und `GET_TEMPERATURE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_temp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_aged,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_aged.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_aged TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_aged WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_and_read_temperature
      IMPORTING
        iv_temperature TYPE cl_abap_session_temperature=>ty_temperature
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_current_temperature
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE cl_abap_session_temperature=>ty_temperature.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_temp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_and_read_temperature.
    DATA(lo_session_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( ).
    lo_session_temp->set_temperature( iv_temperature ).

    DATA(lv_current_temp) = lo_session_temp->get_temperature( ).
    rs_result = |Sessionstemperatur gesetzt auf: { lv_current_temp }|.

    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_aged.
    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @lt_flights
          UP TO 10 ROWS.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rs_result = rs_result && | Datenzugriff erfolgreich. { lines( lt_flights ) } Zeilen gelesen.|.
        ELSE.
          rs_result = rs_result && | Datenzugriff ergab keine Zeilen.|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rs_result = rs_result && | Fehler beim Datenzugriff: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_temperature.
    DATA(lo_session_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( ).
    rv_temperature = lo_session_temp->get_temperature( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_and_get_temp FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_and_get_temp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aging_temp( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_temp) = lo_cut->get_current_temperature( ).

    DATA(lv_result_hot) = lo_cut->set_and_read_temperature( cl_abap_session_temperature=>co_hot ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'HOT' act = lv_result_hot ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_current_temperature( ) exp = cl_abap_session_temperature=>co_hot ).

    DATA(lv_result_warm) = lo_cut->set_and_read_temperature( cl_abap_session_temperature=>co_warm ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'WARM' act = lv_result_warm ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_current_temperature( ) exp = cl_abap_session_temperature=>co_warm ).

    DATA(lv_result_cold) = lo_cut->set_and_read_temperature( cl_abap_session_temperature=>co_cold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'COLD' act = lv_result_cold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_current_temperature( ) exp = cl_abap_session_temperature=>co_cold ).

    cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( )->set_temperature( lv_initial_temp ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_SESSION_TEMPERATURE` ermöglicht die Steuerung der Data-Aging-Temperatur auf Session-Ebene. Dies ist entscheidend für Anwendungen, die gezielt auf 'heiße', 'warme' oder 'kalte' Daten zugreifen müssen, um Performance zu optimieren oder Archivierungsstrategien zu unterstützen. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die dynamische Nachrichtenerstellung verwendet.
keywords: Data Aging, CL_ABAP_SESSION_TEMPERATURE, Session Management, Performance, String Templates

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden und deren Abflugdatum in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator mit einer WHERE-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum ) ).

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere oder von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur gleichnamige Felder berücksichtigt werden, unter Verwendung von CORRESPONDING.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_x TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES: tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.

    METHODS map_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
    rs_target-field_x = 'X'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis, unter Verwendung von REDUCE und GROUP BY.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE in Kombination mit einer GROUP BY-Klausel für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
      INIT l_summaries = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        avg_price    = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                       FOR member IN GROUP
                                       NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price ) / GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Datenzugriff auf eine Data-Aging-fähige Tabelle (hier SFLIGHTS als Beispiel) und zeigen Sie, wie die Session-Temperatur den Zugriff auf 'kalte' Daten beeinflussen kann, indem Sie versuchen, Daten mit einer 'heißen' und dann 'kalten' Session-Temperatur zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_SESSION_TEMPERATURE` und beobachten Sie das Verhalten beim SELECT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_flights_with_temp
      IMPORTING
        iv_temperature TYPE cl_abap_session_temperature=>ty_temperature
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flights_with_temp.
    DATA(lo_session_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( ).
    lo_session_temp->set_temperature( iv_temperature ).

    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @rt_flights
          UP TO 5 ROWS.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " In einer echten Data-Aging-Umgebung könnte hier ein Fehler auftreten,
        " wenn versucht wird, kalte Daten mit einer heißen Temperatur zu lesen.
        " Für SFLIGHTS ohne Data-Aging-Konfiguration wird dies keinen Fehler werfen.
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_aging_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aging_access( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( )->get_temperature( ).

    " Test with HOT temperature
    DATA(lt_flights_hot) = lo_cut->read_flights_with_temp( cl_abap_session_temperature=>co_hot ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_hot ). " Should read some data

    " Test with COLD temperature
    DATA(lt_flights_cold) = lo_cut->read_flights_with_temp( cl_abap_session_temperature=>co_cold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_cold ). " Should still read data if SFLIGHTS is not aged

    " Restore initial temperature
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_instance( )->set_temperature( lv_initial_temp ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Session-Temperatur über `CL_ABAP_SESSION_TEMPERATURE` gesetzt wird, was in einer Data-Aging-fähigen Umgebung den Zugriff auf Daten beeinflusst. Obwohl SFLIGHTS standardmäßig nicht Data-Aging-fähig ist, demonstriert es den Mechanismus. In realen Szenarien würde der Zugriff auf 'kalte' Daten mit einer 'heißen' Temperatur zu Fehlern oder leeren Ergebnissen führen.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem gegebenen String und geben Sie diese als Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX und die Methode FIND_ALL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = `\d+` ). " Matches one or more digits
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    LOOP AT lt_matches ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_match>).
      APPEND <fs_match>-submatch TO rt_numbers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_extract_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `Order 123 has 45 items and costs 678.90 EUR.`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( `123` ) ( `45` ) ( `678` ) ( `90` ) ). " Regex \d+ doesn't handle decimal point
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_numbers( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result
                                      exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'All numbers should be extracted' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `No numbers here.`.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_numbers( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result
                                      exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'No numbers should result in empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_salv_column_color IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_color.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Add a color field to the structure for dynamic coloring
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_colored,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             color    TYPE lvc_t_scol, " Table for cell colors
           END OF ty_sflight_colored.

    DATA lt_sflights_colored TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_colored WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lt_sflights_colored = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                   ( <fs_sflight>
                                     color = COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-price > 500
                                                     THEN VALUE lvc_t_scol( ( fname = 'PRICE' color = '1' ) ) " Color '1' is red
                                                     ELSE VALUE lvc_t_scol( ) ) ) ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights_colored
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_color_column( 'COLOR' ). " Assign the color column

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem Text alle Wörter, die mit 'ABAP' beginnen, und geben Sie diese in Großbuchstaben als sortierte Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX, CL_ABAP_MATCHER und eine FOR-Expression mit LOOP AT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_for_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_abap_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_abap_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_for_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_abap_words.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = `\bABAP\w*\b` ). " Matches words starting with ABAP
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    rt_abap_words = VALUE #( FOR <fs_match> IN lo_matcher->find_all( )
                             ( CONV string( to_upper( <fs_match>-submatch ) ) ) ).
    SORT rt_abap_words ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_abap_words FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_abap_words FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_abap_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_for_extract( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `This is an ABAP program, with ABAPer and abap_dev.`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( `ABAP` ) ( `ABAPER` ) ( `ABAP_DEV` ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_abap_words( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result
                                      exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'All ABAP words should be extracted and capitalized' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_abap_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_for_extract( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `No relevant words here.`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_abap_words( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result
                                      exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'No ABAP words should result in empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit einer `FOR`-Expression ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Extraktion und Transformation von Daten. Die `FOR`-Expression iteriert über die Ergebnisse des Matchers und erstellt direkt die Zieltabelle, während `CONV` und `TO_UPPER` die Transformation übernehmen.

Instructions: Validieren Sie eine Eingabezeichenfolge. Wenn sie nur alphanumerische Zeichen enthält, geben Sie 'Valid' zurück, sonst 'Invalid'. Verwenden Sie eine COND-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX und eine COND-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_cond_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_alphanumeric
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_cond_validate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_alphanumeric.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = `^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$` ). " Matches only alphanumeric characters
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_input ).

    rv_status = COND string(
                  WHEN lo_matcher->match( )
                  THEN 'Valid'
                  ELSE 'Invalid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis in einem ALV an. Verwenden Sie eine REDUCE-Expression für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE für die Aggregation und CL_SALV_TABLE für die Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_reduce_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_aggregated_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_reduce_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_aggregated_flight.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE ty_aggregated_flight_tab(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_aggregated_flight_tab( )
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(group_key)
      ( carrid = group_key
        total_price = REDUCE s_price(
          INIT sum_price = 0
          FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP group_key
          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_group_member>-price ) ) ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_aggregated_data
        ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_urls DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_urls
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_urls) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_urls IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_urls.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = `https?://[a-zA-Z0-9./\-]+` ). " Matches http/https URLs
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    rt_urls = VALUE #( FOR <fs_match> IN lo_matcher->find_all( )
                             ( <fs_match>-submatch ) ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS an und heben Sie Zeilen hervor, die Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') enthalten, indem Sie die gesamte Zeile farblich markieren.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_salv_row_color IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_row_color.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_row_colored,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             row_color TYPE lvc_s_colo, " Structure for row color
           END OF ty_sflight_row_colored.

    DATA lt_sflights_row_colored TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_row_colored WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lt_sflights_row_colored = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                       ( <fs_sflight>
                                         row_color = COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'
                                                             THEN VALUE lvc_s_colo( col = '3' int = '0' inv = '0' ) " Color '3' is yellow
                                                             ELSE VALUE lvc_s_colo( ) ) ) ).

          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights_row_colored
        ).

        DATA(lo_display_settings) = lo_salv_table->get_display_settings( ).
        lo_display_settings->set_row_color_fieldname( 'ROW_COLOR' ). " Assign the row color column

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der durch Kommas getrennte Schlüssel-Wert-Paare enthält (z.B. 'key1:value1,key2:value2'), in eine Hash-Tabelle (MAP).
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX, FIND_ALL und eine FOR-Expression, um die Paare zu extrahieren und in eine MAP zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_string_to_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_map
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_map) TYPE string_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_string_to_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_map.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = `([^,:]+):([^,]+)` ). " Matches key:value pairs
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_input ).

    rt_map = VALUE string_map(
      FOR <fs_match> IN lo_matcher->find_all( )
      ( key = <fs_match>-submatch_tab[1]-submatch
        value = <fs_match>-submatch_tab[2]-submatch ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_to_map FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_malformed_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_to_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_string_to_map( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `key1:value1,key2:value2,key3:value3`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_map(
      ( key = 'key1' value = 'value1' )
      ( key = 'key2' value = 'value2' )
      ( key = 'key3' value = 'value3' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_map( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result
                                      exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'String should be converted to map correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_string_to_map( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = ``.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_map( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result
                                      exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'Empty string should result in empty map' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_malformed_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_string_to_map( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `key1:value1,key2`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_map(
      ( key = 'key1' value = 'value1' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_map( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result
                                      exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'Malformed pairs should be ignored or partially processed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit der `FOR`-Expression, um komplexe String-Transformationen in eine Hash-Tabelle (MAP) durchzuführen. Die Verwendung von Submatch-Gruppen (`submatch_tab[1]`, `submatch_tab[2]`) innerhalb der `FOR`-Expression ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster für die Datenextraktion und -strukturierung.
keywords: REGEX, MAP, String Processing, Data Transformation, CL_ABAP_MATCHER, FOR, Submatches

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` und einen `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` instanziiert. Laden Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und zeigen Sie diese in einem einfachen Spaltenbaum an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW` für die Instanziierung der GUI-Objekte und `SET_TABLE_FOR_FIRST_DISPLAY` zur Datenanzeige.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             planetype  TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsocc   TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
        METHODS display_sflight_tree.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        DATA mo_container   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
        DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
        DATA mt_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_node.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = iv_container_name.

        CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_container.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD display_sflight_tree.
        " Prepare data from SFLIGHT
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
          UP TO 10 ROWS.

        " Map raw data to tree node structure
        mt_sflight_data = VALUE #( FOR sflight_line IN lt_sflight_raw
                                   INDEX INTO idx
                                   ( node_key = |{ idx }|,
                                     text = |{ sflight_line-carrid } - { sflight_line-connid }|,
                                     carrid = sflight_line-carrid,
                                     connid = sflight_line-connid,
                                     fldate = sflight_line-fldate,
                                     planetype = sflight_line-planetype,
                                     seatsocc = sflight_line-seatsocc ) ).

        " Define column properties
        DATA(lt_column_properties) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
          ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Airline' )
          ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Flight No.' )
          ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flight Date' )
          ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' coltext = 'Aircraft Type' )
          ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' coltext = 'Occupied Seats' )
        ).

        " Display the tree
        mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE' " Structure of the internal table
            is_variant       = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid )
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = mt_sflight_data
            it_fieldcatalog  = lt_column_properties
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS test_tree_creation FOR TESTING.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_tree_creation.
        DATA(lv_container_name) = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_tree_basic( lv_container_name ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->mo_container ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->mo_column_tree ).

        lo_cut->display_sflight_tree( ).

Instructions: Erweitern Sie die Klasse, um die Spalten des `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` dynamisch basierend auf der Struktur einer internen Tabelle zu definieren, anstatt sie hart zu kodieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `GET_COMPONENTS` zur Laufzeit-Typanalyse.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             planetype  TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsocc   TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_dyn_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
        METHODS display_sflight_tree_dynamic.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        DATA mo_container   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
        DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
        DATA mt_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_node.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_dyn_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = iv_container_name.

        CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_container.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD display_sflight_tree_dynamic.
        " Prepare data from SFLIGHT
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
          UP TO 10 ROWS.

        mt_sflight_data = VALUE #( FOR sflight_line IN lt_sflight_raw
                                   INDEX INTO idx
                                   ( node_key = |{ idx }|,
                                     text = |{ sflight_line-carrid } - { sflight_line-connid }|,
                                     carrid = sflight_line-carrid,
                                     connid = sflight_line-connid,
                                     fldate = sflight_line-fldate,
                                     planetype = sflight_line-planetype,
                                     seatsocc = sflight_line-seatsocc ) ).

        " Dynamically define column properties using RTTI
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( mt_sflight_data ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        DATA(lt_column_properties) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
          FOR comp IN lt_components
          WHERE ( comp-name <> 'NODE_KEY' AND comp-name <> 'RELATKEY' AND comp-name <> 'TEXT' )
          ( fieldname = comp-name coltext = comp-name ) " Simple coltext for demo
        ).

        mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
            is_variant        = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid )
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = mt_sflight_data
            it_fieldcatalog  = lt_column_properties
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

      METHOD test_dynamic_columns.
        DATA(lv_container_name) = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_tree_dyn_cols( lv_container_name ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->mo_container ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE`, der hierarchische Daten aus `SFLIGHT` anzeigt. Gruppieren Sie die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und zeigen Sie die einzelnen Flüge als Unterknoten an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` für die Datenaggregation und `ADD_NODE` zum Aufbau der Hierarchie.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey   TYPE lvc_nkey,

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
        METHODS display_hierarchical_tree.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        DATA mo_container   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
        DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
        DATA mt_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_node.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = iv_container_name.

        CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_container.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD display_hierarchical_tree.
        " Prepare data from SFLIGHT, grouped by CARRID
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
          UP TO 20 ROWS.

        " Define column properties
        DATA(lt_column_properties) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
          ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Airline' )
          ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Flight No.' )
          ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flight Date' )
          ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' coltext = 'Aircraft Type' )
          ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' coltext = 'Occupied Seats' )
        ).

        mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
            is_variant       = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid )
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = mt_sflight_data " Initial empty table
            it_fieldcatalog  = lt_column_properties
        ).

        " Build hierarchy
        DATA(lv_node_key_counter) = 0.
        LOOP AT lt_sflight_raw INTO DATA(ls_sflight_raw) GROUP BY ls_sflight_raw-carrid.
          lv_node_key_counter = lv_node_key_counter + 1.
          DATA(lv_parent_key) = |CARR_{ lv_node_key_counter }|.

          " Add parent node (Airline)
          mo_column_tree->add_node(
            i_node_key = lv_parent_key
            i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_node_root
            is_outtab_line = VALUE ty_sflight_node( carrid = ls_sflight_raw-carrid text = ls_sflight_raw-carrid )
          ).

          " Add child nodes (Flights)
          LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight_raw INTO DATA(ls_flight).
            lv_node_key_counter = lv_node_key_counter + 1.
            mo_column_tree->add_node(
              i_node_key = |FLIGHT_{ lv_node_key_counter }|
              i_relat_node_key = lv_parent_key
              i_relationship = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
              is_outtab_line = VALUE ty_sflight_node(
                                 carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                 connid = ls_flight-connid
                                 fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                 planetype = ls_flight-planetype
                                 seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc
                                 text = |{ ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-fldate }|
                               )
            ).
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDLOOP.

        mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ). " Expand all nodes for better visibility
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc

        DATA(lt_column_properties) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(

          ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Flight No.' )

                               fldate = ls_sflight_raw-fldate

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_events IMPLEMENTATION.

        CREATE OBJECT mo_container
          EXPORTING

          EXPORTING

        SET HANDLER me->handle_node_double_click FOR mo_column_tree.

      METHOD display_tree_with_events.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)

        mt_sflight_data = VALUE #( FOR sflight_line IN lt_sflight_raw
                                   INDEX INTO idx
                                   ( node_key = |{ idx }|,
                                     text = |{ sflight_line-carrid } - { sflight_line-connid }|,
                                     carrid = sflight_line-carrid,
                                     connid = sflight_line-connid,
                                     fldate = sflight_line-fldate,
                                     planetype = sflight_line-planetype,
                                     seatsocc = sflight_line-seatsocc ) ).

          ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Flight No.' )
          ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flight Date' )
          ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' coltext = 'Aircraft Type' )
          ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' coltext = 'Occupied Seats' )

        " In a real scenario, this would trigger a PAI or display a popup.
        " For unit testing, we can't simulate user interaction or screen output.
        " We just verify the handler is set.
        MESSAGE |Node '{ node_key }' double-clicked!| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
        METHODS display_filterable_tree.
        METHODS filter_tree_by_carrid IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.

      PROTECTED SECTION.
        DATA mo_container   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
        DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
        DATA mt_all_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_node.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = iv_container_name.

        CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_container.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD display_filterable_tree.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
          UP TO 20 ROWS.

        mt_all_sflight_data = VALUE #( FOR sflight_line IN lt_sflight_raw
                                   INDEX INTO idx
                                   ( node_key = |{ idx }|,
                                     text = |{ sflight_line-carrid } - { sflight_line-connid }|,
                                     carrid = sflight_line-carrid,
                                     connid = sflight_line-connid,
                                     fldate = sflight_line-fldate,
                                     planetype = sflight_line-planetype,
                                     seatsocc = sflight_line-seatsocc ) ).

        DATA(lt_column_properties) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
          ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Airline' )
          ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Flight No.' )
          ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flight Date' )
          ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' coltext = 'Aircraft Type' )
          ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' coltext = 'Occupied Seats' )
        ).

        mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
            is_variant       = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid )
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = mt_all_sflight_data
            it_fieldcatalog  = lt_column_properties
        ).
        mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD filter_tree_by_carrid.
        " Clear existing nodes
        mo_column_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).

        " Filter data using FILTER expression
        DATA(lt_filtered_data) = FILTER tt_sflight_node(
          mt_all_sflight_data WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        ).

        " Re-add filtered nodes
        LOOP AT lt_filtered_data INTO DATA(ls_node).
          mo_column_tree->add_node(
            i_node_key = ls_node-node_key
            i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_node_root
            is_outtab_line = ls_node
          ).
        ENDLOOP.
        mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

        DATA(lv_found_node_key) = ''.

      ENDMETHOD.

      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD restore_tree_state.
        mo_column_tree->set_expanded_nodes(
          EXPORTING
            it_expanded_nodes = it_expanded_nodes
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
