Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` und implementieren Sie eine Funktion, um die Daten im Baum asynchron zu laden, um die Benutzeroberfläche reaktionsfähig zu halten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_ASYNC_PROC` oder simulieren Sie asynchrones Verhalten mit einem Delay und einer Aktualisierungsmethode.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             planetype  TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsocc   TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_async DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
        METHODS display_async_tree.
        METHODS load_data_async.

      PROTECTED SECTION.
        DATA mo_container   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
        DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
        DATA mt_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_node.

        METHODS handle_data_loaded FOR EVENT finished OF cl_abap_async_proc.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_async IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = iv_container_name.

        CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_container.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD display_async_tree.
        DATA(lt_column_properties) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
          ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Airline' )
          ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Flight No.' )
          ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flight Date' )
          ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' coltext = 'Aircraft Type' )
          ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' coltext = 'Occupied Seats' )
        ).

        mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
            is_variant       = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid )
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = mt_sflight_data " Initially empty
            it_fieldcatalog  = lt_column_properties
        ).
        MESSAGE 'Loading data asynchronously...' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD load_data_async.
        " In a real scenario, this would trigger a background task or a separate process.
        " For demonstration, we simulate a delay and then update.
        WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.

        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
          UP TO 20 ROWS.

        mt_sflight_data = VALUE #( FOR sflight_line IN lt_sflight_raw
                                   INDEX INTO idx
                                   ( node_key = |{ idx }|,
                                     text = |{ sflight_line-carrid } - { sflight_line-connid }|,
                                     carrid = sflight_line-carrid,
                                     connid = sflight_line-connid,
                                     fldate = sflight_line-fldate,
                                     planetype = sflight_line-planetype,
                                     seatsocc = sflight_line-seatsocc ) ).

        " Update the tree with loaded data
        mo_column_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
        LOOP AT mt_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_node).
          mo_column_tree->add_node(
            i_node_key = ls_node-node_key
            i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_node_root
            is_outtab_line = ls_node
          ).
        ENDLOOP.
        mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).
        MESSAGE 'Data loaded and tree updated!' TYPE 'S'.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD handle_data_loaded.
        " This method would be called if using CL_ABAP_ASYNC_PROC
        " For this example, load_data_async is called directly.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS test_async_data_loading FOR TESTING.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_async_data_loading.
        DATA(lv_container_name) = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_tree_async( lv_container_name ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->mo_container ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->mo_column_tree ).

        lo_cut->display_async_tree( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_cut->mt_sflight_data ). " Initially empty

        lo_cut->load_data_async( ). " Simulate async load
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->mt_sflight_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lines( lo_cut->mt_sflight_data ) > 0 ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Konzept des asynchronen Ladens von Daten für einen `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE`. Während eine echte asynchrone Verarbeitung komplexer ist (z.B. mit `CL_ABAP_ASYNC_PROC`), simuliert diese Lösung das Laden im Hintergrund und aktualisiert den Baum anschließend. Dies verhindert, dass die Benutzeroberfläche während des Datenabrufs blockiert wird, was für eine moderne UX entscheidend ist.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, um den `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` zu aktualisieren, wenn sich die zugrunde liegenden Daten ändern, ohne den gesamten Baum neu aufzubauen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE_ITEM` oder `UPDATE_NODES` für gezielte Aktualisierungen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             planetype  TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsocc   TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
        METHODS display_updatable_tree.
        METHODS update_node_seatsocc IMPORTING iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey iv_new_seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc.

      PROTECTED SECTION.
        DATA mo_container   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
        DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
        DATA mt_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_node.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_gui_tree_update IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = iv_container_name.

        CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_container.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD display_updatable_tree.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
          UP TO 10 ROWS.

        mt_sflight_data = VALUE #( FOR sflight_line IN lt_sflight_raw
                                   INDEX INTO idx
                                   ( node_key = |{ idx }|,
                                     text = |{ sflight_line-carrid } - { sflight_line-connid }|,
                                     carrid = sflight_line-carrid,
                                     connid = sflight_line-connid,
                                     fldate = sflight_line-fldate,
                                     planetype = sflight_line-planetype,
                                     seatsocc = sflight_line-seatsocc ) ).

        DATA(lt_column_properties) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
          ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   coltext = 'Airline' )
          ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   coltext = 'Flight No.' )
          ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   coltext = 'Flight Date' )
          ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' coltext = 'Aircraft Type' )
          ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' coltext = 'Occupied Seats' )
        ).

        mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
            is_variant       = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid )
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = mt_sflight_data
            it_fieldcatalog  = lt_column_properties
        ).
        mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD update_node_seatsocc.
        " Update internal data table
        READ TABLE mt_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_node) WITH KEY node_key = iv_node_key.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ls_node-seatsocc = iv_new_seatsocc.
          MODIFY mt_sflight_data FROM ls_node INDEX sy-tabix.

          " Update the tree control
          mo_column_tree->update_item(
            i_node_key = iv_node_key
            it_item_data = VALUE lvc_t_item(
              ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' value = |{ iv_new_seatsocc }| )
            )
          ).
          mo_column_tree->flush( ). " Ensure changes are sent to frontend
          MESSAGE |Node '{ iv_node_key }' updated with new seats occupied: { iv_new_seatsocc }| TYPE 'S'.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE |Node '{ iv_node_key }' not found for update.| TYPE 'W'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS test_tree_node_update FOR TESTING.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_tree_node_update.
        DATA(lv_container_name) = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_tree_update( lv_container_name ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->mo_container ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->mo_column_tree ).

        lo_cut->display_updatable_tree( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lines( lo_cut->mt_sflight_data ) > 0 ).

        " Get a node key to update
        DATA(lv_node_key_to_update) = lo_cut->mt_sflight_data[ 1 ]-node_key.
        DATA(lv_old_seatsocc) = lo_cut->mt_sflight_data[ 1 ]-seatsocc.
        DATA(lv_new_seatsocc) = lv_old_seatsocc + 10.

        lo_cut->update_node_seatsocc( iv_node_key = lv_node_key_to_update iv_new_seatsocc = lv_new_seatsocc ).

        " Assert that internal data was updated
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mt_sflight_data[ 1 ]-seatsocc exp = lv_new_seatsocc ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man einzelne Knoten in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` aktualisiert, ohne den gesamten Baum neu aufzubauen. Nach der Aktualisierung der zugrunde liegenden internen Tabelle wird `UPDATE_ITEM` verwendet, um die Änderungen gezielt an das Frontend zu senden. `FLUSH` stellt sicher, dass die Änderungen sofort sichtbar werden.
keywords: CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE, UPDATE_ITEM, FLUSH, Dynamic Update, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` instanziiert und sicherstellt, dass der Container beim Beenden der Anwendung ordnungsgemäß freigegeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FREE` für die Freigabe des Containers und `CL_GUI_CFW=>FLUSH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_container_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
        METHODS create_container.
        METHODS free_container.

      PROTECTED SECTION.
        DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_gui_container_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        " Constructor can be empty or used for initial setup
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD create_container.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = iv_container_name.
        MESSAGE 'Container created.' TYPE 'S'.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD free_container.
        IF mo_container IS BOUND.
          CALL METHOD mo_container->free.
          FREE mo_container.
          cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Ensure frontend is updated
          MESSAGE 'Container freed.' TYPE 'S'.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE 'Container not bound, no need to free.' TYPE 'I'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS test_container_lifecycle FOR TESTING.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD test_container_lifecycle.
        DATA(lv_container_name) = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
        DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_container_cleanup( lv_container_name ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_cut->mo_container ).

        lo_cut->create_container( lv_container_name ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->mo_container ).

        lo_cut->free_container( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_cut->mo_container ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den korrekten Lebenszyklus eines `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER`. Nach der Erstellung mit `CREATE OBJECT` ist es wichtig, den Container bei Nichtgebrauch oder Programmende explizit mit `CALL METHOD mo_container->free` und `FREE mo_container` freizugeben. `CL_GUI_CFW=>FLUSH` stellt sicher, dass die Freigabe auch im Frontend wirksam wird, um Ressourcenlecks zu vermeiden.
keywords: CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER, FREE, FLUSH, Resource Management, Cleanup

Instructions: Führen Sie einen INNER JOIN zwischen den Tabellen SFLIGHT und SPFLI durch, um Flugdaten mit den entsprechenden Fluggesellschaftsinformationen zu verknüpfen. Wählen Sie dabei spezifische Felder aus und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer internen Tabelle.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen LEFT OUTER JOIN zwischen SFLIGHT und SPFLI durch, um alle Flüge anzuzeigen, auch wenn keine passenden Fluggesellschaftsinformationen in SPFLI gefunden werden. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse zusätzlich nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel mit Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_left_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE spfli-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_left_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, c~cityfrom, c~cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN spfli AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid AND s~connid = c~connid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_left_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find flights for AA' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry should be AA' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_left_join_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_left_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier( 'XX' ). "Assuming 'XX' does not exist

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Should find no flights for XX' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` stellt sicher, dass alle Zeilen aus der linken Tabelle (SFLIGHT) im Ergebnis enthalten sind, auch wenn keine passenden Einträge in der rechten Tabelle (SPFLI) gefunden werden. In solchen Fällen sind die Felder der rechten Tabelle initial. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Ergebnisse effizient auf Datenbankebene.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, Open SQL, SFLIGHT, SPFLI, WHERE, Database Access

Instructions: Führen Sie einen JOIN über drei Tabellen (SFLIGHT, SPFLI, SBOOK) durch, um Flugbuchungsdetails zusammen mit Flug- und Fluggesellschaftsinformationen abzurufen. Verwenden Sie dabei `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel mit mehreren Bedingungen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN` mehrfach und nutzen Sie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` für die automatische Feldzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_triple_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             customid TYPE sbook-customid,
             custtype TYPE sbook-custtype,
             passname TYPE sbook-passname,
             carrname TYPE spfli-carrname,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_booking_detail.
    TYPES tt_booking_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_booking_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_booking_details) TYPE tt_booking_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_triple_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_booking_details.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid, b~customid, b~custtype, b~passname,
           p~carrname, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      INNER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid AND s~connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_booking_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_triple_join FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_triple_join_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_triple_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_triple_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_booking_details( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find booking details' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry should be LH' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_triple_join_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_triple_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_booking_details( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_join_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_description,
             flight_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_description.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_descriptions) TYPE tt_flight_description.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    rt_descriptions = VALUE #( FOR sflight_entry IN
      ( SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
          FROM sflight AS s
          INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
          WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
          ORDER BY s~fldate )
      ( flight_info = |Flug { sflight_entry-carrid } { sflight_entry-connid } von { sflight_entry-cityfrom } nach { sflight_entry-cityto } am { sflight_entry-fldate DATE = USER }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von `cl_appointment`-Objekten und filtern Sie diese Liste anschließend, um nur Termine zu erhalten, die an einem bestimmten Wochentag stattfinden.

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_sample_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_appointments) TYPE tt_appointments.

    METHODS filter_appointments_by_weekday
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
        iv_weekday      TYPE i " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_appointments) TYPE tt_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sample_appointments.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DO 7 TIMES.
      DATA(lo_start_dt) = cl_abap_date_time=>create_from_timestamp(
        timestamp = cl_abap_tims=>create_timestamp(
          date = lv_date
          time = '090000'
        )->get_timestamp( )
      ).
      APPEND NEW cl_appointment( i_start_date_time = lo_start_dt i_duration_minutes = 60 ) TO rt_appointments.
      lv_date = lv_date + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_appointments_by_weekday.
    rt_filtered_appointments = FILTER #( it_appointments USING KEY default
      WHERE start_date_time->get_weekday( ) = iv_weekday ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_value_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_appointments_with_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_appointments) TYPE tt_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_value_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_appointments_with_value.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    rt_appointments = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i <= 3
                                LET lv_date = lv_current_date + ( i - 1 ) IN
                                ( NEW cl_appointment(
                                    i_start_date_time = cl_abap_date_time=>create_from_timestamp(
                                                          timestamp = cl_abap_tims=>create_timestamp(
                                                                        date = lv_date
                                                                        time = '090000'
                                                                      )->get_timestamp( )
                                                        )
                                    i_duration_minutes = 90
                                  ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen, indem Sie die Ergebnisse eines `INNER JOIN` zwischen SFLIGHT und SBOOK aggregieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT` mit `REDUCE` und `INNER JOIN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_join_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_join_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight_booking IN
                                      ( SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~passengers
                                          FROM sflight AS s
                                          INNER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
                                          WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid )
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight_booking-passengers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen SFLIGHT und SPFLI durch und verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` Klauseln, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Abflugort zu ermitteln, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in der neuen Open SQL Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_group_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_counts.
    SELECT s~carrid, p~cityfrom, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, p~cityfrom
      HAVING COUNT( * ) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Formatiere ein gegebenes Datum (z.B. '20251203') basierend auf einer übergebenen Sprache (z.B. 'EN', 'DE') in ein lesbares Format. Das Ergebnis soll in einer Struktur zurückgegeben werden, die das Originaldatum, die Sprache und das formatierte Datum enthält.

CLASS zcl_i18n_date_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_formatted_date,
             original_date TYPE d,
             language      TYPE sy-langu,
             formatted_date TYPE string,
           END OF ty_formatted_date.

    METHODS format_date_by_lang
      IMPORTING
        iv_date    TYPE d
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_formatted_date.

CLASS zcl_i18n_date_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_date_by_lang.
    DATA(lv_locale) = cl_i18n_utilities=>get_locale_from_language( iv_language ).

    rs_result = VALUE #( original_date = iv_date
                         language      = iv_language
                         formatted_date = lo_formatter->date_format(
                                             iv_date = iv_date
                                             iv_date_format = cl_abap_format=>date_format_long )
                       ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechne den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle (definiert mit `BEGIN OF`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators. Berücksichtige nur Flüge in EUR.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_eur_price
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_eur_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE s_price( 0 ) )
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                WHERE ( currency = 'EUR' )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_mixed_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input_data,
             date_val    TYPE d,
             amount_val  TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
             currency_val TYPE waers,
             language_val TYPE sy-langu,
           END OF ty_input_data.
    TYPES tt_input_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_formatted_output,
             language        TYPE sy-langu,
             original_date   TYPE d,
             formatted_date  TYPE string,
             original_amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
             currency_code   TYPE waers,
             formatted_amount TYPE string,
           END OF ty_formatted_output.
    TYPES tt_formatted_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_formatted_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_mixed_data
      IMPORTING
        it_input_data TYPE tt_input_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_data) TYPE tt_formatted_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_mixed_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_mixed_data.
    rt_formatted_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_input IN it_input_data
                                 LET lv_locale = cl_i18n_utilities=>get_locale_from_language( ls_input-language_val )
                                     lo_formatter = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( iv_locale = lv_locale )
                                 IN
                                 ( language        = ls_input-language_val
                                   original_date   = ls_input-date_val
                                   formatted_date  = lo_formatter->date_format(
                                                         iv_date = ls_input-date_val
                                                         iv_date_format = cl_abap_format=>date_format_long )
                                   original_amount = ls_input-amount_val
                                   currency_code   = ls_input-currency_val
                                   formatted_amount = lo_formatter->currency_format(
                                                          iv_amount = ls_input-amount_val
                                                          iv_currency = ls_input-currency_val )
                                 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mixed_format FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mixed_format.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_i18n_mixed_formatter=>tt_input_data(
      ( date_val = '20251203' amount_val = '100.50' currency_val = 'EUR' language_val = 'DE' )
      ( date_val = '20251203' amount_val = '200.75' currency_val = 'USD' language_val = 'EN' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_mixed_formatter( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_cut->format_mixed_data( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of output entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 1 ]-formatted_date exp = '3. Dezember 2025' msg = 'DE date format incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 1 ]-formatted_amount exp = '100,50 €' msg = 'DE EUR format incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 2 ]-formatted_date exp = 'December 3, 2025' msg = 'EN date format incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 2 ]-formatted_amount exp = '$200.75' msg = 'EN USD format incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR` Schleifen mit dem `VALUE` Operator und `LET` Ausdrücken (ab ABAP 7.50) zur Transformation von Daten. CLASS zcl_email_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_email_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

                        LET lv_email_part = replace( val = to_lower( lv_name ) old = ' ' new = '.' )
                        IN
                        ( name = lv_name
                          email = |{ lv_email_part }@example.com|

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Funktion, die einen Text und eine Sprache empfängt. Wenn die Sprache 'DE' ist, soll der Text in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt werden, ansonsten in Kleinbuchstaben. Nutze hierfür den `COND` Operator und `CL_I18N_UTILITIES` zur Sprachprüfung.

CLASS zcl_i18n_text_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_text_by_lang
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_transformed_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_text_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_text_by_lang.
    " CL_I18N_UTILITIES is used conceptually here for language-aware logic.
    " The actual check is direct for simplicity in this example.
    rv_transformed_text = COND string(
                            WHEN iv_language = 'DE' THEN to_upper( iv_text )
                            ELSE to_lower( iv_text ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit einer Struktur, die dynamisch zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen generiert wird. Befülle diese Tabelle mit Beispieldaten. Nutze `BEGIN OF` für die Definition der Feldliste.
hint: Verwende `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` zur dynamischen Typgenerierung. Definiere die Feldliste mit `BEGIN OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
        WHEN 'INT'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_int4( ).
        WHEN 'DATE'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_date( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Default to string or handle error
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    " Example: Fill with some data (simplified, real dynamic filling is more complex)
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      " This part would be dynamic based on field names
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = 'Value A'. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = 100. ENDIF.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = 'Value B'. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_field> = 200. ENDIF.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

Mit `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` können Strukturen und Tabellentypen basierend auf Metadaten erstellt werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Schnittstellen oder Tools. Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Fehler-, Warn- und Erfolgsmeldungen in einer gesammelten Nachrichtenliste mithilfe des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife über die Nachrichtenliste und `COND` für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_count_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_counts,
             errors   TYPE i,
             warnings TYPE i,
             success  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_message_counts.

    METHODS count_messages_by_type
      IMPORTING it_messages TYPE cl_reca_message_list=>tt_message
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_counts) TYPE ty_message_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_count_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_messages_by_type.
    rs_counts = REDUCE ty_message_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_message_counts( )
      FOR message IN it_messages
      NEXT
        counts-errors   = counts-errors   + COND i( WHEN message-msgty = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 ),
        counts-warnings = counts-warnings + COND i( WHEN message-msgty = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 0 ),
        counts-success  = counts-success  + COND i( WHEN message-msgty = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_msg_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '002' ).
    lo_msg_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '003' ).

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `COND` ermöglicht er eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Zählung von Elementen basierend auf Bedingungen, ohne explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen.

CLASS zcl_chained_msg_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_has_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_has_errors) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_chained_msg_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_and_check_errors.
    DATA(lo_msg_list) = NEW cl_reca_message_list( ).

    lo_msg_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Info' )
             ->add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = 'Warnung' ).

    IF iv_has_error = abap_true.
      lo_msg_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler' ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_has_errors = lo_msg_list->has_errors( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den maximalen Flugpreis für jede Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife, die `GROUP BY` verwendet, um die maximale `PRICE` pro `CARRID` zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_per_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_max_price,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_max_price.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_max_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_max_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_prices_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_max_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_max_prices = REDUCE tt_carrier_max_price(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_max_price( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET max_price_for_carrier = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                    INIT current_max = 0
                                    FOR current_flight IN GROUP flight
                                    NEXT current_max = nmax( current_max, current_flight-price ) )
      IN
        result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid max_price = max_price_for_carrier ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Ausnahme und fangen Sie diese ab. Fügen Sie die Details der Ausnahme als Fehlermeldung zum Nachrichtensammler hinzu.

CLASS zcl_exception_to_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_with_error
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_reca_message_list=>tt_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_to_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_with_error.
    DATA(lo_msg_list) = NEW cl_reca_message_list( ).

    TRY.
        " Simulieren einer Ausnahme
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        DATA(lv_error_text) = |Ausnahme aufgetreten: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
        lo_msg_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgv1 = lv_error_text ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        DATA(lv_generic_error_text) = |Allgemeine Ausnahme: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
        lo_msg_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '004' iv_msgv1 = lv_generic_error_text ).
    ENDTRY.

    rt_messages = lo_msg_list->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für die Anzeige in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` vor. Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit hierarchischen Daten (Fluggesellschaft -> Flüge) unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` Schleifen und den `VALUE` Operator, um die hierarchische Datenstruktur zu füllen. Definieren Sie eine Struktur, die die Baumknoten-Attribute enthält.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
         node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
         parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
         text     TYPE string,
         level    TYPE i,
         is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
         carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
       END OF ty_tree_node.
TYPES: tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_preparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_preparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_tree_data.
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE scarr_tab( FOR <fs_scarr> IN SELECT * FROM scarr UP TO 3 ROWS ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS ).

    rt_tree_data = VALUE tt_tree_nodes(
      FOR <fs_scarr> IN lt_carriers
        LET lv_carr_key = |CARR_{ <fs_scarr>-carrid }|
        IN
          ( node_key = lv_carr_key
            parent_key = ''
            text = <fs_scarr>-carrname
            level = 0
            is_folder = abap_true
            carrid = <fs_scarr>-carrid )
          ( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_flights WHERE ( carrid = <fs_scarr>-carrid )
              ( node_key = |FLT_{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }_{ <fs_sflight>-connid }|
                parent_key = lv_carr_key
                text = |Flight { <fs_sflight>-connid } from { <fs_sflight>-cityfrom } to { <fs_sflight>-cityto }|
                level = 1
                is_folder = abap_false
                carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                connid = <fs_sflight>-connid ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_tree_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_data_preparer( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_data) = lo_cut->get_flight_tree_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_tree_data msg = 'Tree data should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = lines( lt_tree_data ) exp = 0 msg = 'At least one node expected' ).

    " Check for hierarchical structure (simple check for parent_key)
    DATA(lv_root_nodes) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_tree_data INTO DATA(ls_node).
      IF ls_node-parent_key IS INITIAL.
        lv_root_nodes = lv_root_nodes + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = lv_root_nodes exp = 0 msg = 'At least one root node expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und bereiten Sie diese Daten für eine mögliche Anzeige in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` vor. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine interne Tabelle zu füllen, die die Fluggesellschaft und die aggregierte Fluganzahl enthält.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
         carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
         carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
         flight_count TYPE i,
       END OF ty_flight_count.
TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs_sflight> IN SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS ).
    DATA(lt_scarr) = VALUE scarr_tab( FOR <fs_scarr> IN SELECT * FROM scarr ).

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_flight_counts( )
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid INTO DATA(group_carrid)
      LET lv_carrname = VALUE scarr-carrname( lt_scarr[ carrid = group_carrid ]-carrname OPTIONAL )
      IN
        counts = VALUE tt_flight_counts(
          BASE counts
          ( carrid = group_carrid
            carrname = lv_carrname
            flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_counts msg = 'Flight counts should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 0 msg = 'At least one carrier expected' ).

    " Simple check: all flight counts should be positive
    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = ls_count-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'Flight count must be positive' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `GROUP BY` ermöglicht er eine sehr kompakte und performante Art, zusammenfassende Daten zu erstellen, die dann in UI-Elementen wie `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` dargestellt werden können.

CLASS zcl_status_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung eines `TRY...CATCH` Blocks, um eine Ausnahme abzufangen und eine spezifische Fehlermeldung zu protokollieren, bevor die Ausnahme erneut ausgelöst wird (`RAISE RESUME` oder `RAISE EXCEPTION`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `RAISE EXCEPTION` (oder `RAISE RESUME` für resumable exceptions) um die Ausnahme zu behandeln und weiterzugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcx_processing_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_processing_error IMPLEMENTATION. ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_propagator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_item
      IMPORTING
        iv_item TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_processing_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS internal_process
      IMPORTING
        iv_item TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_processing_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_propagator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_item.
    TRY.
        internal_process( iv_item ).
      CATCH zcx_processing_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Hier könnte eine Protokollierung erfolgen
        " z.B. cl_abap_sys_log=>add_message( ... )
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD internal_process.
    IF iv_item = 'ERROR'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_processing_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_processing_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Normale Verarbeitung
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_config,
         fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,
         text      TYPE lvc_col_text,
         width     TYPE lvc_s_col-int_width,
       END OF ty_column_config.

CLASS zcl_tree_column_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_column_config
      IMPORTING
        it_column_configs TYPE tt_column_configs
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_column_config.

    METHODS get_default_columns
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_column_configs) TYPE tt_column_configs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_column_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_column_config.
    LOOP AT it_column_configs INTO DATA(ls_config).
      IF ls_config-fieldname IS INITIAL OR ls_config-text IS INITIAL.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_column_config
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_invalid_column_config=>default_text.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_config-width <= 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_column_config
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_invalid_column_config=>default_text.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_default_columns.
    rt_column_configs = VALUE tt_column_configs(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline ID' width = 10 )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flight No.' width = 10 )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' width = 12 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft betreffen, an eine neue interne Tabelle an. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.

solution:
CLASS zcl_append_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    APPEND LINES OF lt_sflights
      FILTER ( WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ) TO rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_modify_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.

    METHODS increase_prices
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flight_price
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_fs_modify_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight_price.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie aggregierte Flugdaten (Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft) aus SFLIGHTS an eine Zieltabelle an, indem Sie `GROUP BY` verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `APPEND LINES OF` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck, der `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    APPEND LINES OF
      VALUE tt_flight_summary(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ( count = count + 1 ) ) )
      ) TO rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Summary should not be initial' act = lt_summary ).
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH count should not be initial' act = lv_lh_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Count should be positive' act = xsdbool( lv_lh_count > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `APPEND LINES OF` mit einem `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck und `REDUCE`. Dies ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Aggregation von Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle, ohne manuelle Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen.
keywords: APPEND LINES OF, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

CLASS zcl_fs_read_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS update_flight_status
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_status TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_read_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight_status.
    READ TABLE ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-status = iv_new_status.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, wobei Sie Feldsymbole für den Zugriff auf die Tabelle und ihre Zeilen verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).
      CATCH cx_sy_type_descr_error.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
      DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
      DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
      DATA(lv_price) = '100.00'.

      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ANY.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE ANY.

      CREATE DATA REF TO (iv_table_type_name) INTO DATA(lr_line).
      ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.

      IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_component> = lv_carrid. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_component> = lv_connid. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_component> = lv_fldate. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_component> = lv_price. ENDIF.

        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lr_data ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit (`CREATE DATA`) und den dynamischen Zugriff auf deren Komponenten mittels Feldsymbolen (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`). Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept der dynamischen Programmierung, das Flexibilität bei der Verarbeitung unbekannter Datenstrukturen bietet.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei interne Tabellen mit Flugdaten und verarbeiten Sie die kombinierte Tabelle anschließend mit Feldsymbolen, um eine Eigenschaft zu ändern.

CLASS zcl_append_fs_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS combine_and_update_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights1 TYPE tt_flight_data
        it_flights2 TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_new_status TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_fs_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_and_update_flights.
    APPEND LINES OF it_flights1 TO rt_combined_flights.
    APPEND LINES OF it_flights2 TO rt_combined_flights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight_data.
    LOOP AT rt_combined_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      <fs_flight>-status = iv_new_status.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_conditional_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             status TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_fs_conditional_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_product_status.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_product> TYPE ty_product.

      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs akzeptiert und den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes in jeder Zeile auf einen neuen Wert setzt, wobei Feldsymbole verwendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS <FS> TYPE ANY TABLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <FS_LINE> TO <FS_COMPONENT>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_generic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_field_in_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table        TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_new_value    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_generic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_in_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_reduce_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_value.
    TYPES tt_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_max_value
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE tt_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_reduce_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_value.
    rv_max = REDUCE i(
      INIT max_val = 0
      FOR <fs_value> IN it_values
      NEXT max_val = COND i( WHEN <fs_value>-value > max_val THEN <fs_value>-value ELSE max_val ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_group_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrid_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrid_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrid_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrid_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_group_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE tt_carrid_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN it_flights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
      ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ( count = count + 1 ) )
        total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum_price = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ( sum_price = sum_price + <fs_group_member>-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle an eine Zieltabelle an, wobei Duplikate basierend auf einem Schlüsselfeld entfernt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `APPEND LINES OF` in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und `DISTINCT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_unique_item,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_unique_item.
    TYPES tt_unique_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_unique_item WITH UNIQUE KEY id.
    METHODS append_distinct_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_unique_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_items) TYPE tt_unique_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_distinct_items.
    APPEND LINES OF
      VALUE tt_unique_item(
        FOR DISTINCT ls_item IN it_source_items
        ( ls_item ) )
      TO rt_target_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für die Anzeige in einem ALV-Grid vor, indem Sie nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Währung und einer berechneten Auslastung auswählen. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne Tabellen-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE` und `COND` für die Transformation und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_display,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2, " Auslastung in Prozent
           END OF ty_flight_display.
    TYPES tt_flight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE s_currcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
                          ( carrid   = <fs_flight>-carrid
                            connid   = <fs_flight>-connid
                            fldate   = <fs_flight>-fldate
                            price    = <fs_flight>-price
                            currency = <fs_flight>-currency
                            occupancy = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-seatsmax > 0
                                                THEN ( <fs_flight>-seatsocc * 100 ) / <fs_flight>-seatsmax
                                                ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_prep) = NEW zcl_sflights_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_eur) = lo_prep->get_filtered_flights( 'EUR' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_eur ).
    " Check if all entries have the correct currency
    LOOP AT lt_flights_eur INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-currency exp = 'EUR' ).
      " Check occupancy calculation (simple check, more robust would be specific values)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_flight-occupancy ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with a currency that might not exist or has no data
    DATA(lt_flights_xyz) = lo_prep->get_filtered_flights( 'XYZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights_xyz ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR` Operator in Verbindung mit `VALUE` und `COND` um Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` zu filtern und zu transformieren. Die Auslastung wird dynamisch berechnet, was die Effizienz moderner Tabellen-Ausdrücke demonstriert.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, COND, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Data Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze und den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, um diese als Zusammenfassung in einer Liste anzuzeigen. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summen zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             total_seats_occupied TYPE i,
             total_price          TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, price FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rs_summary = REDUCE ty_flight_summary(
                       INIT sum_seats = 0 TYPE i
                            sum_price = 0 TYPE s_price
                       FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_flights
                       NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + <fs_flight>-seatsocc
                            sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben, und sortieren Sie das Ergebnis. Nutzen Sie moderne Tabellen-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `SORT` für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_flight_info(
                                   lt_all_flights USING
                                   WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc >= iv_min_free_seats ) ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid
                            connid = flight-connid
                            fldate = flight-fldate
                            seatsocc = flight-seatsocc
                            seatsmax = flight-seatsmax
                            seatsfree = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) ).

    SORT rt_flights BY seatsfree DESCENDING fldate ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_available_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_available_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_available_flights.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_demo->get_available_flights( 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-seatsfree >= 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check sorting (first entry should have highest free seats)
    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_second_flight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lines( lt_flights ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_flight-seatsfree >= ls_second_flight-seatsfree ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_available_flights_empty.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_demo->get_available_flights( 9999 ). " Unlikely to have so many free seats
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `FILTER` Operators (ABAP 7.50) zur effizienten Filterung interner Tabellen und die anschließende Transformation und Sortierung. Dies ist eine sehr lesbare und performante Methode zur Datenmanipulation.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, SORT, SFLIGHTS, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die optional einen Parent-Container für einen `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` akzeptiert. Nutzen Sie den `OPTIONAL` Parameter.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Importparameter als `OPTIONAL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_optional_parent DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_container_with_parent
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name
        io_parent         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

CLASS zcl_gui_optional_parent IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_container_with_parent.
    IF io_parent IS BOUND.
      ro_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(   container_name = iv_container_name
                                                    parent         = io_parent ).
    ELSE.
      ro_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_container_name ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Nutzen Sie moderne Gruppierungs-Ausdrücke, um diese Daten für eine Listenanzeige vorzubereiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_carrids).

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights_carrids
                                GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                ( carrid       = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                  flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts_order FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_sflights_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_demo->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_grouped ).
    " Check if grouping works (e.g., LH should have a count)
    READ TABLE lt_grouped WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_group-flight_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_group-flight_count > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_order.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_sflights_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_demo->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    " Check if the result is sorted by carrid (ASCENDING as specified)
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id VALUE ''.
    LOOP AT lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_group).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_group-carrid GE lv_prev_carrid ).
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_group-carrid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck innerhalb eines `FOR`-Konstruktors (ABAP 7.50), um Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaften zu gruppieren und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe zu ermitteln. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Methode zur Datenaggregation.
keywords: GROUP BY, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Data Grouping, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Formatieren Sie ein Datum aus `SFLIGHTS` in ein benutzerfreundliches Format für die Anzeige in einer Liste. Nutzen Sie String-Templates mit Datum-Formatierungsoptionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit der `DATE` Option.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_flight_date FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_format_flight_date_initial FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flight_date.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_date_format_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_demo->format_flight_date( lv_date ).

    " Der genaue Output hängt von den Benutzereinstellungen ab, daher prüfen wir nur das Format.
    " Beispiel: 'Flugdatum: 03.12.2025' für de-DE
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches(   act = lv_formatted

    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_date_format_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_demo->format_flight_date( '00000000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches(   act = lv_formatted
                                            exp = |Flugdatum: \s*| ). " Initial date might be empty or spaces
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Datum-Formatierung direkt in String-Templates mit der `DATE = USER` Option. Dies ermöglicht eine einfache und lokalisierte Darstellung von Datumsangaben, ohne explizite Konvertierungsfunktionen aufrufen zu müssen.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, die kompatible Felder mit gleichen Namen hat, unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING` Zusatzes mit `CONV`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONV type( CORRESPONDING #( source_struct ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_struct_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS convert IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert.
    rs_target = CONV ty_target( CORRESPONDING #( is_source ) ).
    rs_target-field3 = 'Additional Value'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_struct_corr( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_conv_struct_corr=>ty_source( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 100 ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_converter->convert( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field1 exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field2 exp = 100 ).
