Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle, wobei Sie die Fluggesellschafts-ID (`CARRID`) von `C(3)` in `STRING` umwandeln und nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 filtern. Nutzen Sie `FOR`, `VALUE` und `CONV`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( CONV ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_for_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid_str TYPE string,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_for_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( price > 500 )
      (
        carrid_str = CONV string( ls_flight-carrid ),
        connid     = ls_flight-connid,
        price      = ls_flight-price
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_filtered_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_conversion.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_conv_for_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->get_filtered_flights( ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_entry-carrid_str ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_entry-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = ls_first_entry-price exp = 500 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Assert initial if no data matches filter
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `FOR`-Operator für die Iteration, `WHERE` für die Filterung und den `CONV`-Operator innerhalb des `VALUE`-Konstruktors, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit transformierten Daten zu erstellen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und kompakte Art der Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: CONV, Internal Table, FOR, VALUE, WHERE, SFLIGHT, Type Conversion

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie die Klasse `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` in einem benutzerdefinierten Container. Da dies ein CLI-Agent ist, wird die tatsächliche GUI-Anzeige simuliert.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Flüge und, falls vorhanden, die Anzahl der Buchungen für jeden Flug. Flüge ohne Buchungen sollen ebenfalls angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHTS` und `SBOOK` und `COUNT(*)` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_bookings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking_count,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             booking_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_booking_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_booking_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_booking_count
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_booking_data) TYPE tt_flight_booking_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_bookings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_booking_count.
    SELECT s~carrid,
           s~connid,
           s~fldate,
           COUNT( b~bookid ) AS booking_count
      FROM sflights AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND
                                     s~connid = b~connid AND
                                     s~fldate = b~fldate
      GROUP BY s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_booking_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_booking FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_booking.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_bookings( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_booking_count( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Expected some flight data, but table is empty.'
      fail_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_fail_level_error
    ).

    " Check if any flight has a booking count (example check)
    DATA(lv_found_booking) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-booking_count > 0.
        lv_found_booking = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_found_booking
      msg = 'Expected at least one flight with bookings.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN`, um alle Flüge anzuzeigen, auch wenn keine Buchungen in der Tabelle `SBOOK` vorhanden sind. Die Funktion `COUNT( b~bookid )` zählt die Buchungen pro Flug, wobei `NULL`-Werte (für Flüge ohne Buchungen) ignoriert werden, was zu einer Zählung von 0 führt. `GROUP BY` ist notwendig für die Aggregation.
keywords: JOINS, LEFT OUTER JOIN, ABAP SQL, SFLIGHTS, SBOOK, Aggregation, COUNT, GROUP BY

Instructions: Listen Sie Fluggesellschaften und die Gesamtzahl der von ihnen durchgeführten Flüge auf, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften mit mehr als 5 Flügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN`, `GROUP BY`, `COUNT(*)` und `HAVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_carrier_flight_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname    TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_active_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_flight_stats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_active_carriers.
    SELECT c~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           COUNT( s~connid ) AS flight_count
      FROM scarr AS c
      INNER JOIN sflights AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
      HAVING COUNT( s~connid ) > 5
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrier_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_active_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_active_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_carrier_flight_stats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_active_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Expected some carrier data, but table is empty.'
      fail_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_fail_level_error
    ).

    " Check if all returned carriers have more than 5 flights
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_entry-flight_count > 5 )
        msg = 'Flight count should be greater than 5.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `INNER JOIN` mit Aggregationsfunktionen (`COUNT`) und den Klauseln `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`. `GROUP BY` fasst die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft zusammen, während `HAVING` die Gruppen filtert, die die Bedingung (mehr als 5 Flüge) erfüllen. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Methode zur Datenanalyse direkt in der Datenbank.
keywords: JOINS, INNER JOIN, ABAP SQL, SFLIGHTS, SCARR, Aggregation, COUNT, GROUP BY, HAVING

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie eine Liste von Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) mit Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines), einschließlich der Namen der Fluggesellschaften. Verwenden Sie `UNION ALL`.
hint: Verwenden Sie zwei `SELECT` Anweisungen, jede mit einem `INNER JOIN` zu `SCARR`, und verbinden Sie diese mit `UNION ALL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_union,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_union.
    TYPES tt_flight_union TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_union WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_flight_union.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           s~connid,
           s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           s~connid,
           s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_combined_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_combined_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Expected some flight data, but table is empty.'
      fail_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_fail_level_error
    ).

    " Check if both carriers are present
    DATA(lv_found_lh) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_found_aa) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_found_lh = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_entry-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_found_aa = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_found_lh
      msg = 'Expected flights for carrier LH.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_found_aa
      msg = 'Expected flights for carrier AA.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `UNION ALL` in ABAP SQL (verfügbar ab 7.50), um die Ergebnisse von zwei separaten `SELECT`-Anweisungen zu kombinieren. Jede `SELECT`-Anweisung verwendet einen `INNER JOIN`, um Flugdaten mit den Namen der Fluggesellschaften zu verknüpfen. `UNION ALL` fügt alle Zeilen beider Abfragen zusammen, ohne Duplikate zu entfernen, was effizienter ist, wenn Duplikate akzeptabel sind.
keywords: JOINS, UNION ALL, ABAP SQL, SFLIGHTS, SCARR, Combine Results

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Fluggesellschaften, die keine Flüge in der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und filtern Sie nach `NULL`-Werten in der rechten Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_carriers_without_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_no_flights,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_no_flights.
    TYPES tt_carrier_no_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_no_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_without_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_no_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carriers_without_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_without_flights.
    SELECT c~carrid,
           c~carrname
      FROM scarr AS c
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sflights AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid IS NULL
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " This test assumes there might be carriers without flights in SFLIGHTS.
    " If not, you might need to insert dummy data or adjust the assertion.

    " Example: Check if a specific carrier (e.g., 'XX') is listed if it has no flights

    "   act = lv_found_xx
    "   msg = 'Expected carrier XX to be listed as having no flights.'

Die `WHERE s~carrid IS NULL`-Klausel filtert dann die Ergebnisse, um nur die Fluggesellschaften zu erhalten, für die keine entsprechenden Flüge in `SFLIGHTS` gefunden wurden, was auf das Fehlen von Flügen hinweist.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die durchschnittliche Flugdauer (in Minuten) pro Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN`, `GROUP BY` und die Aggregationsfunktion `AVG` für die Flugdauer. Beachten Sie, dass `FLTIME` in Minuten ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_duration,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             avg_fltime TYPE sflights-fltime,
           END OF ty_avg_duration.
    TYPES tt_avg_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_flight_duration
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_durations) TYPE tt_avg_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_flight_duration.
    SELECT s~carrid,
           s~connid,
           AVG( s~fltime ) AS avg_fltime
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid " Join for completeness, though not strictly needed for AVG(fltime)
      GROUP BY s~carrid, s~connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_durations.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_average_flight_duration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_duration( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_average_flight_duration( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Expected some average duration data, but table is empty.'

    " Check if average flight time is positive for at least one entry
    DATA(lv_found_positive_avg) = abap_false.

    ).

Der `INNER JOIN` zu `SCARR` ist hier optional, zeigt aber die Möglichkeit, Aggregationen mit Joins zu kombinieren. `GROUP BY` ist entscheidend für die korrekte Berechnung der Durchschnitte pro Gruppe.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen HTTP-Statuscode basierend auf einer benutzerdefinierten Logik zurückgibt, und verwenden Sie dabei `CL_REST_STATUS_CODE` für die Standardcodes.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung oder `IF`-Bedingungen, um den Statuscode zu bestimmen, und greifen Sie auf die Konstanten von `CL_REST_STATUS_CODE` zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_custom_status_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_request_type TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_request_type,
                 create TYPE ty_request_type VALUE 'C',
                 read   TYPE ty_request_type VALUE 'R',
                 update TYPE ty_request_type VALUE 'U',
                 delete TYPE ty_request_type VALUE 'D',
               END OF gc_request_type.

    METHODS get_http_status_for_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_request_type TYPE ty_request_type
        iv_resource_exists TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_http_status) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_status_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_http_status_for_request.
    CASE iv_request_type.
      WHEN gc_request_type-create.
        rv_http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_created.
      WHEN gc_request_type-read.
        IF iv_resource_exists = abap_true.
          rv_http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_ok.
        ELSE.
          rv_http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_not_found.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN gc_request_type-update.
        IF iv_resource_exists = abap_true.
          rv_http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_ok.
        ELSE.
          rv_http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_not_found.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN gc_request_type-delete.
        IF iv_resource_exists = abap_true.
          rv_http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_no_content.
        ELSE.
          rv_http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_not_found.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_http_status = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_internal_error.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit `IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN`, die die ersten 5 Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` liest und deren Flugnummern und Fluggesellschaften unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression auf der Konsole ausgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UP TO 5 ROWS` und eine `REDUCE`-Expression für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_classrun DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_classrun IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE TABLE OF ty_flight.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_output) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT s = s && |Carrier: { flight-carrid }, Connection: { flight-connid }\n|
    ).
    out->write( lv_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights.
    DATA(lo_classrun) = NEW zcl_sflights_classrun( ).
    " Mock the output to capture it for assertion
    DATA(lo_output_mock) = NEW cl_abap_unit_test_output( ).
    lo_classrun->if_oo_adt_classrun~main( out = lo_output_mock ).
    " In a real scenario, you'd check lo_output_mock->get_output()
    " For simplicity, we just check if it ran without dump and if sflights has data.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_classrun ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_count ). " Ensure sflight has data
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN`, um Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` zu filtern, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben, und geben Sie die gefilterten Ergebnisse auf der Konsole aus. Nutzen Sie eine `FILTER`-Expression.
hint: Die `FILTER`-Expression ist ideal für die Selektion von Zeilen aus internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_classrun DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_classrun IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE TABLE OF ty_flight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lv_target_carrid) = 'LH'. " Example carrier

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = lv_target_carrid ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      out->write( |Filtered flights for { lv_target_carrid }:\n| ).
      LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        out->write( |  Carrier: { ls_flight-carrid }, Connection: { ls_flight-connid }, Date: { ls_flight-fldate }\n| ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      out->write( |No flights found for { lv_target_carrid }.\n| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in einen JSON-String, aber mit einer benutzerdefinierten Struktur, die nur bestimmte Felder enthält und diese umbenennt. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `CL_FDT_JSON`.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine temporäre Struktur mit den gewünschten Feldern und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` zur Transformation, bevor Sie `CL_FDT_JSON` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_reduce_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE TABLE OF ty_flight_raw.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_custom,
             airline_code TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_number TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_custom.
    TYPES tt_flight_custom TYPE TABLE OF ty_flight_custom.

    METHODS serialize_custom_flights RETURNING VALUE(rv_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_reduce_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_custom_flights.
    DATA lt_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 3 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_raw_flights.

    DATA(lt_custom_flights) = REDUCE tt_flight_custom(
      INIT custom_table = VALUE tt_flight_custom( )
      FOR raw_flight IN lt_raw_flights
      NEXT custom_table = VALUE tt_flight_custom(
        BASE custom_table
        ( airline_code = raw_flight-carrid
          flight_number = raw_flight-connid )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_json) = cl_fdt_json=>create( ).
    lo_json->serialize( EXPORTING data = lt_custom_flights IMPORTING json = rv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_serialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_serialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_reduce_serialize( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_custom_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json ).
    " Check for custom field names
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN lv_json CS 'AIRLINE_CODE' AND lv_json CS 'FLIGHT_NUMBER' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( COND #( WHEN lv_json CS 'CARRID' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE`-Expression zur Transformation von Datenstrukturen und `CL_FDT_JSON` zur Serialisierung. Dies ermöglicht die Erstellung von JSON-Payloads, die exakt den Anforderungen externer Systeme entsprechen, ohne manuelle Feldzuordnungen.

      ELSE |Number { lv_another_number } is not greater than 5.|

CLASS zcl_group_by_classrun DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_group_by_classrun IMPLEMENTATION.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    DATA lt_flight_counts TYPE TABLE OF ty_flight_count.

    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen ungültigen JSON-String und fangen Sie die erwartete Ausnahme mit `TRY...CATCH` ab. Geben Sie die Fehlermeldung über `IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_fdt_json_parse_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    DATA ls_data TYPE ty_data.
    DATA(lv_invalid_json) = '{"FIELD":"Value"'. " Missing closing brace

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_json) = cl_fdt_json=>create( ).
        lo_json->deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_invalid_json IMPORTING data = ls_data ).
        out->write( 'JSON deserialized successfully (unexpected!).' ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        out->write( |JSON parse error caught: { lx_parse_error->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        out->write( |General JSON error caught: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_classrun) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit `IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN`, die dynamisch eine Methode einer anderen Klasse aufruft und das Ergebnis ausgibt. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `cl_abap_methdescr` für RTTI und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_method_name) = 'GET_MESSAGE'.
    DATA(lv_result) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_instance->(lv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_message = lv_result.
        out->write( |Dynamically called method '{ lv_method_name }' returned: { lv_result }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        out->write( |Error calling method dynamically: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message.
    rv_message = 'Hello from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_classrun) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lo_output_mock) = NEW cl_abap_unit_test_output( ).
    lo_classrun->if_oo_adt_classrun~main( out = lo_output_mock ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_output_mock->get_output( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_output ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN lv_output CS 'Hello from dynamic method!' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung und RTTI sind fortgeschrittene Konzepte in ABAP, die Flexibilität bei der Laufzeit ermöglichen. Dieses Beispiel zeigt den dynamischen Aufruf einer Methode, was in Szenarien wie generischen Frameworks oder Plugin-Architekturen nützlich sein kann. `IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN` dient hier als einfacher Ausführungskontext.
keywords: IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CALL METHOD, Object Orientation

Instructions: Simulieren Sie Flugverspätungen für Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Fügen Sie jedem Flug eine zufällige Verspätung zwischen 0 und 120 Minuten hinzu und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und den `FOR` Operator mit `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_delay_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_delay,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             currency   TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype  TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc   TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             delay_minutes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_delay.
    TYPES: tt_flight_delays TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_delay WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS simulate_delays
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_delayed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_delays.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_delay_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_delays.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    rt_delayed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                  LET lv_delay = CONV i( lo_random->get_next( p_from = 0.0 p_to = 120.0 ) ) IN
                                  ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight MAPPING delay_minutes = lv_delay ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_delays FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_delays.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_delay_sim( ).
    DATA(lt_delayed_flights) = lo_cut->simulate_delays( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_delayed_flights IS NOT INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT lt_delayed_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-delay_minutes >= 0 AND ls_flight-delay_minutes <= 120 ) msg = 'Delay not in range' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR` Operator, `LET` Ausdruck und `CORRESPONDING` ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und performante Transformation von Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle, wobei neue Felder dynamisch berechnet werden können. `cl_abap_random_float` liefert die Zufallszahlen für die Simulation. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit `APPEND` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
keywords: FOR, LET, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, sflight, Random, Simulation, cl_abap_random_float, MOVE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Plätzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_flights UP TO 20 ROWS. " Get some data

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND
                                          ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_free_seats = 50 ).

    " Assert that all filtered flights meet the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc >= 50 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance, da der Filter direkt auf die Tabelle angewendet wird und eine neue, gefilterte Tabelle zurückgibt. Dies ist eine moderne Art der Datenübertragung und -selektion.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, sflight, Conditional Logic, MOVE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_seats FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    " Manually calculate for comparison (or use a known value from test data)
    DATA lv_expected_sum TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_sum WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats_lh exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Expression. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen (`LOOP ... ENDLOOP` mit `sum = sum + ...`). Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Strukturdefinition zur Laufzeit und befüllen Sie diese mit Daten, die auch eine zufällige Float-Zahl enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` für die dynamische Typisierung und `cl_abap_random_float` für die Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_float DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE f,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_rows TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_float IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          ls_component    TYPE abap_componentdescr.

    " Define components for the dynamic structure
    ls_component-name = 'ID'. ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ). APPEND ls_component TO DATA(lt_components).
    ls_component-name = 'VALUE'. ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_f( ). APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ls_component-name = 'TEXT'. ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    " Create dynamic structure and table type
    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    " Fill dynamic table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lo_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lo_line->* TO <ls_line>.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_id>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_id> = sy-index. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'VALUE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_value>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_value> = lo_random->get_next( p_from = 0.0 p_to = 100.0 ). ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TEXT' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_text>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_text> = |Entry { sy-index }|. ENDIF.

      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten einer Klasse erstellt und deren Attribute mit zufälligen Float-Werten initialisiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und den `FOR` Operator zur Objekterstellung und Attributzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_object_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS zcl_data_object DEFINITION FOR TESTING.
    CLASS zcl_data_object IMPLEMENTATION.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_object,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE f,
           END OF ty_data_object.
    TYPES: tt_data_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_data_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_objects_with_random_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_objects) TYPE tt_data_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_object_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  CLASS zcl_data_object DEFINITION.
    PUBLIC SECTION.
      DATA: mv_id    TYPE i.
      DATA: mv_value TYPE f.
      METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i iv_value TYPE f.
  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS zcl_data_object IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD constructor.
      mv_id = iv_id.
      mv_value = iv_value.
    ENDMETHOD.
  ENDCLASS.

  METHOD create_objects_with_random_values.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    rt_objects = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
                          ( NEW zcl_data_object( iv_id = i, iv_value = lo_random->get_next( p_from = 0.0 p_to = 100.0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anstatt Objekte in einer Schleife zu erstellen und Attribute einzeln zuzuweisen (`MOVE`), wird dies deklarativ und kompakt mit `NEW` innerhalb der `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Expression erreicht. `cl_abap_random_float` wird verwendet, um die Attributwerte mit Zufallszahlen zu befüllen.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen einfachen XML-String, der Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_empty_document`, `create_element` und `set_text`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_create_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_sflight_xml IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_empty_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flights' ).
    lo_xml_document->set_root_element( lo_root ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_root->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

      DATA(lo_carrid) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'CarrierID' ).
      lo_carrid->set_text( ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_carrid ).

      DATA(lo_connid) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'ConnectionID' ).
      lo_connid->set_text( CONV string( ls_sflight-connid ) ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_connid ).

      DATA(lo_fldate) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'FlightDate' ).
      lo_fldate->set_text( CONV string( ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_fldate ).

      DATA(lo_price) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Price' ).
      lo_price->set_text( CONV string( ls_sflight-price ) ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_price ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xml_string = lo_xml_document->render_2_string( pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xml ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob die Addition zweier `INT1`-Werte zu einem Überlauf führen würde, bevor die Addition durchgeführt wird. Geben Sie `abap_true` zurück, wenn ein Überlauf droht, sonst `abap_false`.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die Summe mit `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_value( )` des Zieltyps.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_overflow_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_int1_overflow IMPORTING iv_val1 TYPE int1
                                              iv_val2 TYPE int1
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rb_overflow) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_overflow_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_int1_overflow.
    DATA(lv_max_int1) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_value( cl_abap_int1=>get_type_descr( ) ).
    DATA(lv_min_int1) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_value( cl_abap_int1=>get_type_descr( ) ).

    " Check for positive overflow
    IF iv_val1 > 0 AND iv_val2 > 0.
      IF lv_max_int1 - iv_val1 < iv_val2.
        rb_overflow = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " Check for negative overflow (underflow)
    IF iv_val1 < 0 AND iv_val2 < 0.
      IF lv_min_int1 - iv_val1 > iv_val2.
        rb_overflow = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rb_overflow = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_overflow_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_overflow_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_overflow_check( ).

    " No overflow
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->check_int1_overflow( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 20 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->check_int1_overflow( iv_val1 = -10 iv_val2 = -20 ) ).

    " Positive overflow (max INT1 is 127)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->check_int1_overflow( iv_val1 = 100 iv_val2 = 30 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->check_int1_overflow( iv_val1 = 127 iv_val2 = 1 ) ).

    " Negative overflow (min INT1 is -128)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->check_int1_overflow( iv_val1 = -100 iv_val2 = -30 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->check_int1_overflow( iv_val1 = -128 iv_val2 = -1 ) ).

    " Mixed signs, no overflow
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->check_int1_overflow( iv_val1 = 100 iv_val2 = -30 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->check_int1_overflow( iv_val1 = -100 iv_val2 = 30 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert eine präventive Überlaufprüfung für `INT1`-Werte. Durch den Vergleich mit den typspezifischen Maximal- und Minimalwerten, die von `cl_abap_exceptional_values` bereitgestellt werden, kann ein Überlauf vor der eigentlichen Berechnung erkannt und vermieden werden. Dies erhöht die Robustheit der Anwendung.
keywords: Overflow, Underflow, `INT1`, `cl_abap_exceptional_values`, Error Handling, Type Safety

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den minimalen und maximalen Wert für einen Dezimaltyp (`DECFLOAT34`) und geben Sie diese in einer Struktur zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_value` und `max_value` mit `cl_abap_decfloat34=>get_type_descr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_decfloat_limits DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_decfloat_limits,
             min_value TYPE decfloat34,
             max_value TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_decfloat_limits.

    METHODS get_decfloat34_limits RETURNING VALUE(rs_limits) TYPE ty_decfloat_limits.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_decfloat_limits IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_decfloat34_limits.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_decfloat34=>get_type_descr( ).
    rs_limits-min_value = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_value( lo_type_descr ).
    rs_limits-max_value = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_value( lo_type_descr ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_decfloat_limits FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_decfloat_limits.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_decfloat_limits( ).
    DATA(ls_limits) = lo_cut->get_decfloat34_limits( ).

    " DECFLOAT34 min value is -9.999999999999999999999999999999999E+384
    " DECFLOAT34 max value is +9.999999999999999999999999999999999E+384
    " Due to precision, comparing directly might be tricky, check if not initial and reasonable range.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_limits-min_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_limits-max_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_limits-min_value < 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_limits-min_value < -1E+300 ). " Check for a very large negative number
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `cl_abap_exceptional_values` verwendet werden kann, um die Grenzen von Dezimalfließkommazahlen (`DECFLOAT34`) zu ermitteln. Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener `DATE`-Wert ein gültiges Datum darstellt, indem Sie ihn mit dem minimalen und maximalen Datumswert vergleichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_value` und `max_value` für den Typ `d`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_date_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_date IMPORTING iv_date TYPE d
                            RETURNING VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_date_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_date.
    DATA(lv_min_date) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_value( cl_abap_date=>get_type_descr( ) ).
    DATA(lv_max_date) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_value( cl_abap_date=>get_type_descr( ) ).

    rb_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_date >= lv_min_date AND iv_date <= lv_max_date THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_validation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_date_validation( ).

    " Valid dates
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_date( '20231203' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_valid_date( '00010101' ) ). " Min date

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), wobei jedes Flugsegment als Knoten mit Attributen für `carrid` und `connid` sowie Kindknoten für `fldate` und `price` dargestellt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_attribute` und `set_attribute` für Attribute und `create_element` für Kindknoten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_sflight_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_sflight_xml_attrs IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_sflight_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_xml_attrs.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_empty_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flights' ).
    lo_xml_document->set_root_element( lo_root ).

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_flight_node->set_attribute( name = 'carrid' value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_flight_node->set_attribute( name = 'connid' value = CONV string( ls_sflight-connid ) ).
      lo_root->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

      DATA(lo_fldate) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'FlightDate' ).
      lo_fldate->set_text( CONV string( ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_fldate ).

      DATA(lo_price) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Price' ).
      lo_price->set_text( CONV string( ls_sflight-price ) ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_price ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xml_string = lo_xml_document->render_2_string( pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_xml_attrs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_xml_attrs.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_sflight_attrs( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_xml_sflight_attrs=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231201' price = '123.45' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20231202' price = '234.56' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_sflight_xml_attrs( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flight carrid="LH" connid="0400">' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<FlightDate>20231201</FlightDate>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Price>123.45</Price>' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die XML-Generierung, indem es zeigt, wie Attribute zu XML-Knoten hinzugefügt werden können. Die Methode `set_attribute` des Elementobjekts ermöglicht das einfache Hinzufügen von Attributen. Dies ist eine gängige Praxis, um Metadaten oder Identifikatoren direkt an ein Element zu binden, was zu kompakteren und semantisch reicheren XML-Strukturen führt.
keywords: XML, Attributes, Generation, `cl_xml_document`, `set_attribute`, `sflight`

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der eine Zahl darstellt, in einen `DECFLOAT16`-Typ. Fangen Sie dabei mögliche Überläufe oder ungültige Formate ab und geben Sie einen Initialwert zurück, falls die Konvertierung fehlschlägt oder zu einem Überlauf führt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values` für die Grenzen und `TRY...CATCH` für Konvertierungsfehler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_str_to_decfloat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_decfloat16
      IMPORTING iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_decfloat) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_str_to_decfloat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_decfloat16.
    DATA(lv_min_df16) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_value( cl_abap_decfloat16=>get_type_descr( ) ).
    DATA(lv_max_df16) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_value( cl_abap_decfloat16=>get_type_descr( ) ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_temp_df) = CONV decfloat16( iv_string ).
        IF lv_temp_df < lv_min_df16 OR lv_temp_df > lv_max_df16.
          rv_decfloat = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>initial_value( cl_abap_decfloat16=>get_type_descr( ) ).
        ELSE.
          rv_decfloat = lv_temp_df.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_decfloat = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>initial_value( cl_abap_decfloat16=>get_type_descr( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_str_to_decfloat( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_df16) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>initial_value( cl_abap_decfloat16=>get_type_descr( ) ).

    " Valid conversion
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_string_to_decfloat16( '123.45' ) exp = '123.45' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_string_to_decfloat16( '-500' ) exp = '-500' ).

    " Invalid format
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_string_to_decfloat16( 'abc' ) exp = lv_initial_df16 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_string_to_decfloat16( '' ) exp = lv_initial_df16 ).

    " Overflow (DECFLOAT16 max is ~9.9E+38)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_string_to_decfloat16( '1E+40' ) exp = lv_initial_df16 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_string_to_decfloat16( '-1E+40' ) exp = lv_initial_df16 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Verwendung von `cl_abap_exceptional_values` zur Bestimmung von Typgrenzen mit der modernen `CONV`-Syntax und `TRY...CATCH` zur robusten Typkonvertierung. Es zeigt, wie man Strings sicher in numerische Typen umwandelt, indem man sowohl Formatfehler als auch Wertebereichsüberschreitungen abfängt und einen definierten Initialwert zurückgibt, anstatt einen Laufzeitfehler zu verursachen.
keywords: Type Conversion, `DECFLOAT16`, `cl_abap_exceptional_values`, `TRY...CATCH`, Error Handling, `CONV`

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String, suchen Sie alle Knoten mit dem Tag `<Item>` und aktualisieren Sie deren Textinhalt mit einem Präfix. Geben Sie den modifizierten XML-String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_elements_by_tag_name` und `set_text` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_update_nodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_item_nodes IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string
                                           iv_prefix     TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_updated_xml) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_xml_update_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_item_nodes.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->get_root_element( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_root->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Item' ).

    LOOP AT lt_items INTO DATA(lo_item_node).
      DATA(lv_current_text) = lo_item_node->get_text( ).
      lo_item_node->set_text( |{ iv_prefix }{ lv_current_text }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_updated_xml = lo_xml_document->render_2_string( pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_initial_xml) = `<Data><Item>Value1</Item><Item>Value2</Item></Data>`.n    DATA(lv_updated_xml) = lo_cut->update_item_nodes( iv_xml_string = lv_initial_xml

Mit `get_text` und `set_text` kann der Textinhalt jedes Knotens einfach modifiziert werden. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die effiziente String-Verkettung verwendet.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_PROCESSOR` mit einer Methode `PROCESS`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen, `CL_ADD_PROCESSOR` und `CL_MULTIPLY_PROCESSOR`, die jeweils eine Addition bzw. Multiplikation durchführen. Demonstrieren Sie die polymorphe Verwendung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACES` in der Klassendefinition und `NEW` zur Instanziierung.
solution:
INTERFACE if_processor.
  METHODS process IMPORTING iv_val1 TYPE i iv_val2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_add_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_processor~process.
    rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_processor~process.
    rv_result = iv_val1 * iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphic_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run IMPORTING io_processor TYPE REF TO if_processor
                 EXPORTING ev_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphic_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run.
    ev_result = io_processor->process( iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_processor FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiply_processor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_processor.
    DATA(lo_add_proc) = NEW zcl_add_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_polymorphic_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = 0.
    lo_demo->run( EXPORTING io_processor = lo_add_proc IMPORTING ev_result = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 msg = 'Addition failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiply_processor.
    DATA(lo_mult_proc) = NEW zcl_multiply_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_polymorphic_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = 0.
    lo_demo->run( EXPORTING io_processor = lo_mult_proc IMPORTING ev_result = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 15 msg = 'Multiplication failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interfaces ermöglichen die Definition eines gemeinsamen Verhaltens, das von verschiedenen Klassen implementiert werden kann. Dies fördert Polymorphie und lose Kopplung, da der aufrufende Code nur das Interface kennen muss, nicht die konkrete Implementierung.
keywords: INTERFACE, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, CLASS, METHODS

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf Komponenten einer Struktur zu, deren Namen zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_s_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_component_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_component_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_component_access=>ty_s_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.
    ls_data-field3 = 'World'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_component_access( ).
    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field1 value incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' msg = 'Field2 value incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_component_not_found.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_component_access=>ty_s_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Test'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_component_access( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Component not found' msg = 'Non-existent field handling failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen oder wenn die Struktur dynamisch aufgebaut wird.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, STRUCTURE, COMPONENT

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Standardimplementierung für eine Methode. Implementieren Sie das Interface in einer Klasse und überschreiben Sie die Standardmethode optional.
hint: Verwenden Sie `METHODS ... DEFAULT ...` in der Interface-Definition.
solution:
INTERFACE if_logger.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
  METHODS get_prefix RETURNING VALUE(rv_prefix) TYPE string DEFAULT 'LOG'. " Default method
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_logger~log_message.
    DATA(lv_prefix) = if_logger~get_prefix( ). " Call default method
    WRITE: / lv_prefix, ':', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_logger~log_message.
    DATA(lv_prefix) = if_logger~get_prefix( ).
    WRITE: / 'CUSTOM', lv_prefix, ':', iv_message. " Custom logging
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_logger~get_prefix. " Overriding default method
    rv_prefix = 'CUSTOM_PREFIX'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und greifen Sie dynamisch auf jede Zeile zu, um einen Wert zu ändern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES: ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE ty_t_flights
        iv_factor     TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE ty_t_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices.
    rt_updated_flights = it_flights. " Copy table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_s_flight.
    LOOP AT rt_updated_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * iv_factor.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_access=>ty_t_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = 100.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = 200.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_access( ).
    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_cut->update_prices( it_flights = lt_flights iv_factor = 1.5 ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = 150 msg = 'First flight price incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = 300 msg = 'Second flight price incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` ist die effizienteste Methode, um interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen und deren Zeilen direkt zu modifizieren. Der Field-Symbol verweist direkt auf die Tabellenzeile, wodurch keine unnötigen Datenkopien entstehen.
keywords: ASSIGNING, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, LOOP, sflights

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF OBJECT lo_object`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS method_a IMPORTING iv_input TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i.
    METHODS method_b IMPORTING iv_input TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_output = iv_input * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_output = iv_input + 10.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_self TYPE REF TO zcl_dynamic_method_caller.
    lo_self = me. " Reference to self for dynamic call

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE any.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_input INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_OUTPUT'.
    CREATE DATA: lr_result TYPE i.
    GET REFERENCE OF lr_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF OBJECT lo_self
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
        ASSIGN lr_result->* TO <fs_result>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_result = <fs_result>.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = -1. " Error indicator
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'METHOD_A' iv_input = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10 msg = 'Dynamic call to METHOD_A failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_b.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'METHOD_B' iv_input = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 15 msg = 'Dynamic call to METHOD_B failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' iv_input = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -1 msg = 'Invalid method call not handled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF OBJECT` erlaubt es, den Namen der aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Frameworks oder Plugin-Architekturen, erfordert aber sorgfältige Fehlerbehandlung. Die Parameterübergabe erfolgt über `PARAMETER-TABLE` mit Referenzen.
keywords: CALL METHOD, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, PARAMETER-TABLE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur oder internen Tabelle (Zeile) auf einen neuen Wert setzt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target> TYPE ANY` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_data_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any structure or table row
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_data_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid data reference'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Field not found in structure'.
    ENDIF.

    " Assign the new value, handling type conversion implicitly
    <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_test,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_test.
    METHODS test_set_field_value_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_field_value_table_row FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_field_not_found EXPECTING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_field_value_structure.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_s_test.
    ls_data-id = 1.
    ls_data-name = 'Old Name'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_data_setter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_field_value(
          ir_data       = REF TO ls_data
          iv_field_name = 'NAME'
          iv_new_value  = 'New Name'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-name exp = 'New Name' msg = 'Field value not updated in structure' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_assign_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_assign_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_field_value_table_row.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_test WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_row>).
    <fs_row>-id = 2.
    <fs_row>-name = 'Initial'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_data_setter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->set_field_value(
          ir_data       = REF TO <fs_row> " Pass reference to field symbol (table row)
          iv_field_name = 'NAME'
          iv_new_value  = 'Updated'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_row>-name exp = 'Updated' msg = 'Field value not updated in table row' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_assign_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_assign_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_s_test.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_data_setter( ).
    lo_cut->set_field_value(
      ir_data       = REF TO ls_data
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT'
      iv_new_value  = 'Value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung von `TYPE REF TO DATA` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS TYPE ANY` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` kann eine Methode generisch auf beliebige Datenstrukturen zugreifen und deren Felder dynamisch manipulieren. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der generischen Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, TYPE REF TO DATA, TYPE ANY

Instructions: Verwenden Sie ein Interface, um eine Factory-Methode zu implementieren, die verschiedene Objekttypen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` in Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen (`FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`) für eine kompaktere Syntax beim Zugriff auf Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_name>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_assign_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_assign_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rt_processed_data = it_data.
    LOOP AT rt_processed_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
      IF <fs_row>-id MOD 2 = 0.
        <fs_row>-text = |{ <fs_row>-text } (Even ID)|.
      ELSE.
        <fs_row>-text = |{ <fs_row>-text } (Odd ID)|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_data.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_inline_assign_demo=>ty_t_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Item 1' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Item 2' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 text = 'Item 3' ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_assign_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_data( lt_input ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_res>) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_res>-text exp = 'Item 1 (Odd ID)' msg = 'First item incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_res> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_res>-text exp = 'Item 2 (Even ID)' msg = 'Second item incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_res> INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_res>-text exp = 'Item 3 (Odd ID)' msg = 'Third item incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen für Field-Symbols (`FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_name>)`) ab ABAP 7.50 machen den Code kompakter und lesbarer, insbesondere in Schleifen oder bei direkten Zuweisungen. Sie reduzieren die Notwendigkeit separater Deklarationszeilen.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Inline Declaration, ABAP 7.50, LOOP

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, deren Index zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und ändern Sie einen Feldwert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN TABLE FIELD(...) TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` oder `ASSIGN (lv_table_name)[lv_index]-field TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_row_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES: ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_index      TYPE i
        iv_new_price  TYPE s_price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    TYPE ty_t_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_row_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight_row> TYPE ty_s_flight.
    ASSIGN ct_flights[ iv_index ] TO <fs_flight_row>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight_row>-price = iv_new_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES: ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_update_flight_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE ty_t_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_row_access( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_index = 1 iv_new_price = 120 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = 120 msg = 'Price of first flight not updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = 200 msg = 'Price of second flight changed unexpectedly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_index.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE ty_t_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_row_access( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_index = 99 iv_new_price = 500 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = 100 msg = 'Price should not change for invalid index' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der direkte Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen über den Index mit `itab[index]` und die Zuweisung an ein Field-Symbol (`ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`) ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um spezifische Zeilen einer internen Tabelle dynamisch zu lesen oder zu ändern. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn der Index zur Laufzeit berechnet wird.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für eine einfache Datenquelle und implementieren Sie es in einer Klasse, die Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` liefert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` und `APPEND` in der Implementierung der Interface-Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE if_flight_data_source.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_data,
           carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
           connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           fldate   TYPE s_date,
           price    TYPE s_price,
         END OF ty_s_flight_data.
  TYPES: ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_flights
    IMPORTING
      iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflights_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_flight_data_source.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_flight_data_source~get_flights.
    IF iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED AND iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_flights.
    DATA(lo_provider) = NEW zcl_sflights_data_provider( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_provider->if_flight_data_source~get_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No flights returned' ).

  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No LH flights returned' ).

    ENDLOOP.

Hier wird eine Klasse gezeigt, die das Interface implementiert und Daten aus der Standardtabelle `SFLIGHTS` abruft, was die Trennung von Datenzugriff und Geschäftslogik fördert.
