Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur oder internen Tabelle (Zeile) auf einen neuen Wert setzt, wobei der Feldname und der Wert dynamisch übergeben werden und die Methode eine Referenz auf das geänderte Feld zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `GET REFERENCE OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_field_ref_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_and_get_ref
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any structure or table row
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_field_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_field_ref_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_and_get_ref.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid data reference'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Field not found in structure'.
    ENDIF.

    <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
    GET REFERENCE OF <fs_field> INTO rr_field_ref.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_test,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_test.
    METHODS test_set_field_and_get_ref FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_field_not_found EXPECTING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_field_and_get_ref.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_s_test.
    ls_data-id = 1.
    ls_data-name = 'Old Name'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_field_ref_setter( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lr_field_ref) = lo_cut->set_field_and_get_ref(
          ir_data       = REF TO ls_data
          iv_field_name = 'NAME'
          iv_new_value  = 'New Name'
        ).
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_name> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN lr_field_ref->* TO <fs_name>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_name> exp = 'New Name' msg = 'Field value via reference incorrect' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-name exp = 'New Name' msg = 'Original structure not updated' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_assign_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_assign_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_s_test.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_field_ref_setter( ).
    lo_cut->set_field_and_get_ref(
      ir_data       = REF TO ls_data
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT'
      iv_new_value  = 'Value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode kombiniert dynamischen Feldzugriff (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`) mit der Rückgabe einer Referenz auf das geänderte Feld (`GET REFERENCE OF`). Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen der Aufrufer nach der dynamischen Änderung weiterhin mit einer typsicheren Referenz auf das spezifische Feld arbeiten möchte, ohne die gesamte Struktur erneut durchsuchen zu müssen.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, REF TO DATA, GET REFERENCE OF

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle als Parameter akzeptiert. Implementieren Sie das Interface in einer Klasse, die die Tabelle filtert und die gefilterten Daten zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` oder `FILTER` für die Tabellenverarbeitung.
solution:
INTERFACE if_table_filter.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
           id    TYPE i,
           value TYPE string,
         END OF ty_s_item.
  TYPES: ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS filter_items
    IMPORTING
      it_items TYPE ty_t_items
      iv_id_threshold TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_filtered_items) TYPE ty_t_items.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_id_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_table_filter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_id_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_table_filter~filter_items.
    rt_filtered_items = FILTER #( it_items WHERE id > iv_id_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_item.
    TYPES: ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_filter_items FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_items.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE ty_t_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'A' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 5 value = 'B' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 10 value = 'C' ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_id_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->if_table_filter~filter_items( it_items = lt_input iv_id_threshold = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered items' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_item>) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_item>-id exp = 5 msg = 'First filtered item ID incorrect' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_item> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_item>-id exp = 10 msg = 'Second filtered item ID incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE ty_t_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'A' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 'B' ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_id_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->if_table_filter~filter_items( it_items = lt_input iv_id_threshold = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result should be initial if no match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interfaces ermöglichen die Definition von generischen Datenverarbeitungsdiensten. Hier wird das `FILTER` Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) verwendet, um eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung effizient zu filtern. Dies ist eine moderne und prägnante Art der Tabellenmanipulation.
keywords: INTERFACE, Internal Tables, FILTER, ABAP 7.50, Object Orientation

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für die Anzeige in einem ALV-Grid vor. Filtern Sie dabei Flüge mit einer maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität von über 200 und mappen Sie die Felder auf eine neue Struktur unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration und `FOR`-Ausdrücke zur Datenmanipulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_flight_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_display.
    TYPES tt_flight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_flight_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE seatsmax <= 200
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                             connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                             fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                             seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax,
                             price    = ls_sflight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_flight_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Seatsmax should be <= 200' act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax <= 200 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax wie Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) und `FOR`-Ausdrücke (`VALUE #( FOR ... )`) um Daten aus der Datenbank zu lesen, zu filtern und in eine neue Struktur zu mappen. Dies führt zu kompakterem und lesbarerem Code im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP`-Anweisungen.
keywords: ALV, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, SELECT, sflights, Data Transformation

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine einfache interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten in einem `cl_gui_alv_grid` an. Die Tabelle soll die Felder Fluggesellschaft (carrid), Flugnummer (connid) und Flugdatum (fldate) aus SFLIGHTS enthalten.

CLASS zcl_alv_simple_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_alv_simple_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'. " Assumes a screen with a custom container named ALV_CONTAINER

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_flights.

    " To make ALV visible, typically PBO of a screen would be used.
    " For a unit test, we just ensure the call doesn't dump.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_alv_simple_display=>tt_flight_data.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und die durchschnittliche Sitzplatzkapazität pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck und zeigen Sie die Ergebnisse in einem ALV-Grid an.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_agg,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_seats   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_agg.
    TYPES tt_carrier_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_carrier_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flights.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_aggregated_data = REDUCE tt_carrier_agg(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_agg(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
      LET flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR m IN GROUP ( c = c + 1 ) )
          total_seats  = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR m IN GROUP ( s = s + m-seatsmax ) )
      IN
        ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid,
          flight_count = flight_count,
          avg_seats    = COND decfloat16( WHEN flight_count > 0 THEN CONV decfloat16( total_seats ) / flight_count ELSE 0 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_aggregated_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_aggregated_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_reduce_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Aggregated data should not be empty' act = lt_aggregated ).

    DATA(ls_agg_lh) = VALUE #( lt_aggregated[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_agg_lh IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count for LH should be positive' act = ( ls_agg_lh-flight_count > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average seats for LH should be positive' act = ( ls_agg_lh-avg_seats > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_agg_aa) = VALUE #( lt_aggregated[ carrid = 'AA' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_agg_aa IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count for AA should be positive' act = ( ls_agg_aa-flight_count > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Innerhalb des `GROUP BY` können weitere `REDUCE`-Ausdrücke verwendet werden, um gruppenspezifische Berechnungen durchzuführen, was zu extrem kompaktem und leistungsstarkem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, ALV, sflights, Aggregation, GROUP BY, VALUE

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach bestimmten Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern. Zeigen Sie die gefilterten Daten in einem ALV-Grid an. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Filterkriterien zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_filter_keys TYPE tt_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_full.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid IN it_filter_keys
                                    AND connid IN it_filter_keys ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Generieren Sie dynamisch einen ALV-Feldkatalog (`LVC_T_FCAT`) für eine beliebige interne Tabelle unter Verwendung von RTTI. Zeigen Sie anschließend eine Beispiel-Tabelle mit diesem Feldkatalog in einem ALV-Grid an.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_salv_table=>factory` oder `cl_gui_alv_grid`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_rtti_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.
    TYPES tt_sflight_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_subset WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_fcat
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    METHODS display_dynamic_alv
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_rtti_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_fcat.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          ls_fcat         TYPE lvc_s_fcat,
          lv_col_pos      TYPE i VALUE 1.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data_ref ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      CLEAR ls_fcat.
      ls_fcat-fieldname = ls_component-name.
      ls_fcat-coltext   = ls_component-name.
      ls_fcat-col_pos   = lv_col_pos.
      APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fcat.
      lv_col_pos = lv_col_pos + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_dynamic_alv.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lt_fcat      TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    lt_fcat = get_dynamic_fcat( ir_data_ref ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'. " Assumes a screen with a custom container named ALV_CONTAINER

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = ir_data_ref.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_fcat FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_fcat.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_rtti_fcat( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_alv_rtti_fcat=>tt_sflight_subset.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight UP TO 3 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    DATA(lr_flights) = REF TO lt_flights.
    DATA(lt_fcat) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_fcat( lr_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field catalog should have 3 entries' act = lines( lt_fcat ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First field should be CARRID' act = lt_fcat[ 1 ]-fieldname exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second field should be CONNID' act = lt_fcat[ 2 ]-fieldname exp = 'CONNID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Third field should be FLDATE' act = lt_fcat[ 3 ]-fieldname exp = 'FLDATE' ).

    " Test display method (cannot fully test GUI, just execution)
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_dynamic_alv( lr_flights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Dynamic ALV display executed without dump' act = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Dynamic ALV display caused a dump' ).

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, die Struktur von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit zu analysieren. Hier wird `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` verwendet, um die Komponenten einer internen Tabelle zu ermitteln und daraus dynamisch einen Feldkatalog für das ALV zu erstellen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische ALV-Anzeigen, bei denen die Struktur der anzuzeigenden Daten nicht zur Entwicklungszeit bekannt ist.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Flugnummer validiert. Wenn die Flugnummer ungültig ist (z.B. leer oder nicht numerisch), soll ein `ASSERT` ausgelöst werden. Zeigen Sie eine Liste von Flügen in einem ALV an, die diese Validierung durchlaufen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSERT ID` für interne Konsistenzprüfungen und `cl_abap_unit_assert` im Unit-Test.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             valid  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_flight_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_validated_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_id.
    " ASSERT ID is typically used for internal consistency checks, not input validation for end-users.
    " For end-user validation, exceptions are preferred.
    " Here, for demonstration of ASSERT, we use it for a 'critical' internal check.
    ASSERT ID z_flight_checks FIELDS iv_connid
           CONDITION iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_connid CO '0123456789'.

    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_connid CO '0123456789' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_validated_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                             connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                             valid  = validate_flight_id( ls_sflight-connid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_validate_flight_id FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_get_validated_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validate_flight_id.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).

    " Test valid ID
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Valid ID should return true' act = lo_cut->validate_flight_id( '0400' ) ).

    " Test invalid ID (empty)
    TRY.
        lo_cut->validate_flight_id( '' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Empty ID should trigger ASSERT' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assert.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Empty ID correctly triggered ASSERT' act = abap_true ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Test invalid ID (non-numeric)
    TRY.
        lo_cut->validate_flight_id( 'ABC' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Non-numeric ID should trigger ASSERT' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assert.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Non-numeric ID correctly triggered ASSERT' act = abap_true ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_validated_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).
    DATA(lt_validated_flights) = lo_cut->get_validated_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Validated flights should not be empty' act = lt_validated_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_validated_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'All retrieved flights should be valid' act = ls_flight-valid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSERT` wird für interne Konsistenzprüfungen verwendet, um sicherzustellen, dass bestimmte Bedingungen zur Laufzeit erfüllt sind. Wenn eine `ASSERT`-Bedingung fehlschlägt, wird ein Laufzeitfehler ausgelöst. Im Unit-Test kann dies abgefangen werden, um das erwartete Verhalten zu überprüfen. Für die Validierung von Benutzereingaben sind Ausnahmen (`RAISE EXCEPTION`) in der Regel die bessere Wahl.
keywords: ASSERT, Unit Testing, Error Handling, Conditional Logic, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer von Flügen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in Minuten. Zeigen Sie die Flugdaten zusammen mit der berechneten Dauer in einem ALV-Grid an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` für Zeitstempelberechnungen oder direkte Arithmetik mit `TIMS` und `DATS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             duration TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.
    TYPES tt_flight_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_duration
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_duration.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, arrtime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           LET lv_dep_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_time_to_tstmp(
                                                  iv_date = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                                  iv_time = ls_sflight-deptime )
                               lv_arr_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_time_to_tstmp(
                                                  iv_date = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                                  iv_time = ls_sflight-arrtime )
                           IN
                           ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                             connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                             fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                             deptime  = ls_sflight-deptime,
                             arrtime  = ls_sflight-arrtime,
                             duration = COND i( WHEN lv_arr_tstmp > lv_dep_tstmp
                                                THEN cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract_tstmp(
                                                         iv_tstmp1 = lv_arr_tstmp,
                                                         iv_tstmp2 = lv_dep_tstmp ) / 60
                                                ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_duration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_duration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_flight_duration( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_duration( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights with duration should not be empty' act = lt_flights ).

    DATA(ls_flight_example) = VALUE #( lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_flight_example IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Duration should be positive for LH 0400' act = ( ls_flight_example-duration > 0 ) ).
      " Example: if deptime = '100000' and arrtime = '120000', duration should be 120
      IF ls_flight_example-deptime = '100000' AND ls_flight_example-arrtime = '120000'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Duration calculation for 2 hours' act = ls_flight_example-duration exp = 120 ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` bietet robuste Methoden zur Manipulation und Berechnung mit Zeitstempeln, was die Handhabung von Datum und Uhrzeit in ABAP erheblich vereinfacht und Fehlerquellen reduziert. Der `VALUE #( FOR ... LET ... IN ... )`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Berechnung der Dauer direkt während der Iteration über die Flugdaten, was den Code sehr kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: Date/Time, ALV, sflights, cl_abap_tstmp, Time Calculation, VALUE, LET

Instructions: Generieren Sie dynamisch einen `SLIS` Feldkatalog (`SLIS_T_FIELDCAT_ALV`) für eine gegebene interne Tabelle unter Verwendung von RTTI und modernen ABAP-Features. Zeigen Sie anschließend eine Beispiel-Tabelle mit diesem Feldkatalog in einem ALV-Grid an (wobei der `SLIS` Feldkatalog in das `LVC_T_FCAT` Format für `cl_gui_alv_grid` konvertiert wird).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und mappen Sie die RTTI-Informationen auf `SLIS_S_FIELDCAT_ALV` und dann auf `LVC_S_FCAT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_slis_fcat_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_slis_fcat_from_rtti
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_slis_fcat) TYPE slis_t_fieldcat_alv.

    METHODS convert_slis_to_lvc_fcat
      IMPORTING
        it_slis_fcat TYPE slis_t_fieldcat_alv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lvc_fcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    METHODS display_alv_with_slis_fcat
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_slis_fcat_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_slis_fcat_from_rtti.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          ls_slis_fcat    TYPE slis_s_fieldcat_alv,
          lv_col_pos      TYPE i VALUE 1.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data_ref ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      CLEAR ls_slis_fcat.
      ls_slis_fcat-fieldname = ls_component-name.
      ls_slis_fcat-seltext_l = ls_component-name.
      ls_slis_fcat-col_pos   = lv_col_pos.
      " Add basic type info, though SLIS often needs more detail
      CASE ls_component-type_descr->type_kind.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
          ls_slis_fcat-datatype = 'CHAR'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_numc.
          ls_slis_fcat-datatype = 'NUMC'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int1 OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int2 OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int8.
          ls_slis_fcat-datatype = 'INT4'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
          ls_slis_fcat-datatype = 'P'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat.
          ls_slis_fcat-datatype = 'DECFLOAT'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
          ls_slis_fcat-datatype = 'DATS'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time.
          ls_slis_fcat-datatype = 'TIMS'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          ls_slis_fcat-datatype = 'CHAR'. " Default
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_slis_fcat TO rt_slis_fcat.
      lv_col_pos = lv_col_pos + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_slis_to_lvc_fcat.
    rt_lvc_fcat = VALUE #( FOR ls_slis IN it_slis_fcat
                           ( fieldname = ls_slis-fieldname,
                             coltext   = ls_slis-seltext_l,
                             col_pos   = ls_slis-col_pos,
                             datatype  = ls_slis-datatype ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv_with_slis_fcat.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lt_slis_fcat TYPE slis_t_fieldcat_alv,
          lt_lvc_fcat  TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    lt_slis_fcat = get_slis_fcat_from_rtti( ir_data_ref ).
    lt_lvc_fcat  = convert_slis_to_lvc_fcat( lt_slis_fcat ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'. " Assumes a screen with a custom container named ALV_CONTAINER

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_lvc_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = ir_data_ref.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_slis_fcat_generation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_slis_to_lvc_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_display_alv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_slis_fcat_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_slis_fcat_gen( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_alv_slis_fcat_gen=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights.
    DATA(lr_flights) = REF TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_slis_fcat) = lo_cut->get_slis_fcat_from_rtti( lr_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'SLIS field catalog should have 4 entries' act = lines( lt_slis_fcat ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First field should be CARRID' act = lt_slis_fcat[ 1 ]-fieldname exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last field should be PRICE' act = lt_slis_fcat[ 4 ]-fieldname exp = 'PRICE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_slis_to_lvc_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_slis_fcat_gen( ).
    DATA: lt_slis_fcat TYPE slis_t_fieldcat_alv,
          ls_slis_fcat TYPE slis_s_fieldcat_alv.

    ls_slis_fcat-fieldname = 'FIELD1'.
    ls_slis_fcat-seltext_l = 'Field One'.
    ls_slis_fcat-col_pos   = 1.
    APPEND ls_slis_fcat TO lt_slis_fcat.

    DATA(lt_lvc_fcat) = lo_cut->convert_slis_to_lvc_fcat( lt_slis_fcat ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LVC field catalog should have 1 entry' act = lines( lt_lvc_fcat ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LVC fieldname should match' act = lt_lvc_fcat[ 1 ]-fieldname exp = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LVC coltext should match' act = lt_lvc_fcat[ 1 ]-coltext exp = 'Field One' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_display_alv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_slis_fcat_gen( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_alv_slis_fcat_gen=>tt_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight UP TO 2 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.
    DATA(lr_flights) = REF TO lt_flights.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_alv_with_slis_fcat( lr_flights ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein ALV-Grid, das auf Datenänderungen reagiert. Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `DATA_CHANGED`-Ereignis des `cl_gui_alv_grid` und protokollieren Sie die Änderungen. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Event-Registrierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SET HANDLER` mit `FOR` für die Event-Registrierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_editable,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_editable.
    TYPES tt_flight_editable TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_editable WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_flights  TYPE tt_flight_editable.
    DATA mv_log      TYPE string.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS display_editable_alv.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_mod_cells TYPE lvc_t_modc
        e_mod_rows  TYPE lvc_t_modr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_editable_alv.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          ls_layout    TYPE lvc_s_layo.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'. " Assumes a screen with a custom container named ALV_CONTAINER

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    ls_layout-edit = abap_true. " Enable editing

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        is_layout        = ls_layout
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_flights.

    SET HANDLER handle_data_changed FOR mo_alv_grid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    mv_log = |{ mv_log }Data changed event triggered. Modified cells: { lines( e_mod_cells ) }, Modified rows: { lines( e_mod_rows ) }\n|.
    " In a real scenario, you would process e_mod_cells and e_mod_rows
    " to update the internal table and potentially persist changes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_event_registration FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_data_changed_handler FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_registration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_event_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_editable_alv( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'ALV display and event registration executed without dump' act = abap_true ).
        " Cannot directly assert event handler is registered, but can check if ALV object exists
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'ALV grid object should be created' act = lo_cut->mo_alv_grid ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'ALV display or event registration caused a dump' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_data_changed_handler.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_event_handler( ).
    lo_cut->display_editable_alv( ).

    " Simulate data changed event
    DATA: lt_mod_cells TYPE lvc_t_modc,
          lt_mod_rows  TYPE lvc_t_modr.

    APPEND VALUE #( row_id = 1 col_id = 4 ) TO lt_mod_cells.
    APPEND VALUE #( row_id = 1 ) TO lt_mod_rows.

    " Call the event handler directly for testing
    lo_cut->handle_data_changed( e_mod_cells = lt_mod_cells e_mod_rows = lt_mod_rows ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Log should indicate data changed' pattern = 'Data changed event triggered' act = lo_cut->mv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Log should show 1 modified cell' pattern = 'Modified cells: 1' act = lo_cut->mv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Log should show 1 modified row' pattern = 'Modified rows: 1' act = lo_cut->mv_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Event-Registrierung mit `SET HANDLER <method> FOR <object>` ist der moderne Weg, um auf Ereignisse von GUI-Controls zu reagieren. Der `FOR`-Zusatz macht die Syntax kompakter. Im Event-Handler (`handle_data_changed`) können die übergebenen Parameter (`e_mod_cells`, `e_mod_rows`) genutzt werden, um detaillierte Informationen über die Änderungen im ALV zu erhalten und diese entsprechend zu verarbeiten.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis zusammen mit den Flugdetails in einem ALV-Grid an. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Berechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` mit `SUM` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_flight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_total
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE struct_total_flights.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_total_flights,
             flights     TYPE tt_flight_price,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF struct_total_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_flight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_total.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rs_result-flights = lt_flights.

    rs_result-total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_flight_sum( ).
    DATA(ls_result_lh) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_total( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH flights should not be empty' act = ls_result_lh-flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total price for LH should be positive' act = ( ls_result_lh-total_price > 0 ) ).

    DATA(ls_result_aa) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_total( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'AA flights should not be empty' act = ls_result_aa-flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total price for AA should be positive' act = ( ls_result_aa-total_price > 0 ) ).

    DATA(ls_result_xx) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_total( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Non-existent carrier should have no flights' act = ls_result_xx-flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' act = ls_result_xx-total_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ideal für Aggregationen wie das Summieren von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Er ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Berechnung des Gesamtpreises, ohne explizite `LOOP`- und `SUM`-Anweisungen. Dies führt zu kürzerem und besser verständlichem Code.
keywords: Math, REDUCE, Internal Tables, sflights, Aggregation, SUM

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf der Sitzplatzkapazität eines Fluges eine Kategorie ('Klein', 'Mittel', 'Groß') zuweist. Zeigen Sie die Flüge mit ihrer Kategorie in einem ALV-Grid an. Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Kategorisierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_flight_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_categorized,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_categorized.
    TYPES tt_flight_categorized TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_categorized WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_categorized.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_seat_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_flight_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_seat_category.
    rv_category = COND string(
      WHEN iv_seatsmax <= 100 THEN 'Klein'
      WHEN iv_seatsmax <= 250 THEN 'Mittel'
      WHEN iv_seatsmax > 250 THEN 'Groß'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_categorized_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                             connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                             seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax,
                             category = get_seat_category( ls_sflight-seatsmax ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_seat_category FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_categorized_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_seat_category.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_flight_category( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Category for 50 seats should be Klein' act = lo_cut->get_seat_category( 50 ) exp = 'Klein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Category for 100 seats should be Klein' act = lo_cut->get_seat_category( 100 ) exp = 'Klein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Category for 150 seats should be Mittel' act = lo_cut->get_seat_category( 150 ) exp = 'Mittel' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Category for 250 seats should be Mittel' act = lo_cut->get_seat_category( 250 ) exp = 'Mittel' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Category for 300 seats should be Groß' act = lo_cut->get_seat_category( 300 ) exp = 'Groß' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_categorized_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_flight_category( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_categorized_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Categorized flights should not be empty' act = lt_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_expected_category) = lo_cut->get_seat_category( ls_flight-seatsmax ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Category should match expected' act = ls_flight-category exp = lv_expected_category ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Implementierung von bedingten Zuweisungen. Anstatt mehrerer `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen kann die Logik in einer einzigen Zeile ausgedrückt werden, was den Code übersichtlicher macht und die Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, SWITCH, Internal Tables, ALV, sflights, Categorization

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum. Für jede Gruppe sollen die Anzahl der Flüge und der Gesamtpreis berechnet werden. Zeigen Sie die gruppierten Ergebnisse in einem ALV-Grid an.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    SELECT carrid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                LET flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR m IN GROUP ( c = c + 1 ) )
                                    total_price  = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT p = 0 FOR m IN GROUP ( p = p + m-price ) )
                                IN
                                ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid,
                                  fldate       = ls_flight-fldate,
                                  flight_count = flight_count,
                                  total_price  = total_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_grouped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Grouped data should not be empty' act = lt_grouped ).

    " Find a specific group (e.g., LH on a specific date)
    DATA(ls_group_lh) = VALUE #( lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20251203' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_group_lh IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count for LH on 20251203 should be positive' act = ( ls_group_lh-flight_count > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total price for LH on 20251203 should be positive' act = ( ls_group_lh-total_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check for uniqueness of groups
    DATA(lv_unique_groups) = lines( lt_grouped ).
    DATA(lt_distinct_groups) = VALUE tt_flight_group_result(
      FOR ls_entry IN lt_grouped
      ( carrid = ls_entry-carrid, fldate = ls_entry-fldate, flight_count = 0, total_price = 0 ) ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_distinct_groups COMPARING carrid fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'All groups should be unique' act = lv_unique_groups exp = lines( lt_distinct_groups ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax in Verbindung mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature für die Datenaggregation und -gruppierung in internen Tabellen. Es ermöglicht die Durchführung komplexer Gruppierungen und Berechnungen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck, was den Code extrem effizient und leicht verständlich macht.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, VALUE, REDUCE, sflights, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_layout DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_layout,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_layout.
    TYPES tt_flight_layout TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_layout WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_custom_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_layout IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_custom_alv.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lt_fcat      TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fcat      TYPE lvc_s_fcat,
          ls_layout    TYPE lvc_s_layo.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    " Field catalog definition
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'Airline'.
    ls_fcat-hotspot   = abap_true. " Make CARRID a hotspot
    APPEND ls_fcat TO lt_fcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'Flight No.'.
    ls_fcat-hotspot   = abap_false.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO lt_fcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'Flight Date'.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO lt_fcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'PLANETYPE'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'Plane Type'.
    ls_fcat-no_out    = abap_true. " Hide PLANETYPE column
    APPEND ls_fcat TO lt_fcat.

    " Layout definition
    ls_layout-zebra = abap_true. " Zebra pattern

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'. " Assumes a screen with a custom container named ALV_CONTAINER

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        is_layout        = ls_layout
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den `PRICE` für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) in einer sortierten Tabelle von Flugdaten (ähnlich `sflights`) um einen gegebenen Prozentsatz.

solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_modify_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
    METHODS update_prices IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                    iv_percentage TYPE p DECIMALS 2
                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_modify_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_prices.
    rt_flights = mt_flights. " Work on a copy

    LOOP AT rt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_del_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_first_n_flights.
    rt_remaining_flights = it_flights.

    ELSEIF iv_n > lines( rt_remaining_flights ).
      CLEAR rt_remaining_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechne für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Auslastung (`seatsocc` / `seatsmax`).
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_load,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_load  TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_load.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_load TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_load WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_load_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_loads) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_load.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_load_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    " Simulate data for sflights table
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 150. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 250.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 200. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 300.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_occ) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR member IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                     NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc ).
      DATA(lv_total_max) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR member IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                     NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsmax ).

      DATA(lv_avg_load) = COND f( WHEN lv_total_max > 0 THEN lv_total_occ / lv_total_max ELSE 0 ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      avg_load = lv_avg_load ) TO rt_avg_loads.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_load_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_load_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_load_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_result) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-avg_load exp = '0.55555555555555558' ). " (100+150)/(200+250) = 250/450 = 0.555...

    DATA(ls_aa_result) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-avg_load exp = '0.6' ). " (200+100)/(300+200) = 300/500 = 0.6
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine sehr mächtige Funktion, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und aggregierte Werte zu berechnen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe können komplexe Aggregationen deklarativ und effizient durchgeführt werden, was den Code deutlich lesbarer und wartbarer macht als manuelle Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Aggregation, Internal Tables, REDUCE

Instructions: Erstelle einen String, der alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` als kommaseparierte Liste enthält.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `DISTINCT` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carriers_string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_carriers_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    " Simulate data for sflights table
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'.

    rv_carriers_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR DISTINCT carrid IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ carrid }|
                           ELSE |{ s }, { carrid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

String Templates (`|...|`) ermöglichen eine einfache und lesbare String-Formatierung, während `COND` für bedingte Logik innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks sorgt.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in `sflights` die Fluggesellschaft und einen Status ('Full', 'Half', 'Empty') basierend auf der Auslastung (`seatsocc` vs `seatsmax`) enthält.
hint: Verwende `FOR` und `COND` oder `SWITCH` Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flightnum TYPE sflight-flightnum,
             status    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    " Simulate data for sflights table
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-flightnum = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 200. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-flightnum = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-flightnum = '0010'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 10. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200.

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                ( carrid    = flight-carrid,
                                  flightnum = flight-flightnum,
                                  status    = SWITCH string(
                                                WHEN flight-seatsocc = flight-seatsmax THEN 'Full'
                                                WHEN flight-seatsocc > flight-seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Half'
                                                ELSE 'Empty' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-status exp = 'Half' ).

Instructions: Rufe alle ArchiveLink-Verbindungen für ein Business-Objekt ab und erstelle eine Liste der Dokument-IDs, die älter als ein bestimmtes Datum sind.
hint: Verwende `cl_alink_connection=>get_links` und einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE` für die Datumsfilterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_filter_by_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_old_document_ids
      IMPORTING
        iv_objtype TYPE toav0-objtype
        iv_objkey  TYPE toav0-objkey
        iv_cut_off_date TYPE d
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_doc_ids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF toav0-docid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_filter_by_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_old_document_ids.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alink_link,
             objtype TYPE toav0-objtype,
             objkey  TYPE toav0-objkey,
             docid   TYPE toav0-docid,
             cdate   TYPE toav0-cdate,
           END OF ty_alink_link.
    TYPES tt_alink_links TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alink_link WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_all_links TYPE tt_alink_links.

    " Simulate data from cl_alink_connection=>get_links
    APPEND VALUE ty_alink_link( objtype = iv_objtype objkey = iv_objkey docid = 'DOC1' cdate = '20230101' ) TO lt_all_links.
    APPEND VALUE ty_alink_link( objtype = iv_objtype objkey = iv_objkey docid = 'DOC2' cdate = '20240101' ) TO lt_all_links.
    APPEND VALUE ty_alink_link( objtype = iv_objtype objkey = iv_objkey docid = 'DOC3' cdate = '20230601' ) TO lt_all_links.

    " Real usage would involve calling the actual method:
    " DATA(lo_alink) = NEW cl_alink_connection( ).
    " lo_alink->get_links( EXPORTING i_objtype = iv_objtype
    "                       i_objkey  = iv_objkey
    "                       IMPORTING e_links   = lt_all_links ).

    rt_doc_ids = VALUE #( FOR link IN lt_all_links
                          WHERE ( cdate < iv_cut_off_date )
                          ( link-docid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle einen einzelnen String, der alle Flugnummern von 'LH'-Flügen aus `sflights` enthält, getrennt durch Semikolons, aber nur wenn die Flugnummer mit '0' beginnt.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit String Templates und `FOR` mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_num_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flightnums
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_flightnums_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_num_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flightnums.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    " Simulate data for sflights table
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-flightnum = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-flightnum = '1234'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-flightnum = '0010'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-flightnum = '0500'.

    rv_flightnums_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND flightnum CP '0*' )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ flight-flightnum }|
                           ELSE |{ s };{ flight-flightnum }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flightnums FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flightnums.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_num_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flightnums( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0400;0500' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, der eine `WHERE`-Klausel enthält. Dies ermöglicht das Filtern und Aggregieren von Daten in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck. String Templates (`|...|`) und die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` sorgen für eine flexible und lesbare String-Konkatenation basierend auf Bedingungen, was den Code sehr kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, FOR, Filtering, String Processing, Aggregation, LOOP

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, aber mit einer zusätzlichen Spalte für die Auslastung in Prozent (`seatsocc_percent`).
hint: Nutze den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE #( )` und berechne die Prozentzahl direkt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_enricher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_enriched_flight,
             sflight_data      TYPE sflight,
             seatsocc_percent  TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_enriched_flight.
    TYPES tt_enriched_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_enriched_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_enriched_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE tt_enriched_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_enricher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enriched_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    " Simulate data for sflights table
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-flightnum = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-flightnum = '0010'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 150. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 300.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-flightnum = '0020'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 0. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100.

    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( sflight_data     = flight,
                                     seatsocc_percent = COND p( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0
                                                                THEN ( flight-seatsocc / flight-seatsmax ) * 100
                                                                ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_enrich_flights FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_enrich_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_enricher( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_enriched_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-seatsocc_percent exp = '50.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-seatsocc_percent exp = '50.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-seatsocc_percent exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE #( )` ist nicht nur zum Filtern, sondern auch zum Anreichern und Transformieren von internen Tabellen hervorragend geeignet. Man kann bestehende Felder übernehmen und neue Felder basierend auf Berechnungen oder Bedingungen hinzufügen, alles in einem einzigen, gut lesbaren Ausdruck. Die `COND`-Expression sorgt für eine sichere Division durch Null.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, Calculation, LOOP

Instructions: Iteriere über die `sflights`-Tabelle, um die Fluggesellschaften auszugeben, ohne die vollständigen Zeilen zu transportieren, wenn nur ein Feld benötigt wird.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` in Kombination mit `WHERE` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_distinct_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_distinct_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_distinct_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carriers.
    LOOP AT it_sflights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
                      GROUP BY carrid OF it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND ls_group_key-carrid TO rt_carriers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_distinct_carriers FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_distinct_carriers.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' flightnum = '0400' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' flightnum = '0010' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' flightnum = '0401' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_distinct_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_distinct_carriers( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` ist eine effiziente Methode, um über eine interne Tabelle zu iterieren, wenn man nur an den Schlüsselfeldern für `WHERE` oder `GROUP BY` interessiert ist und die vollständige Zeile nicht in den Arbeitsbereich oder das Feldsymbol kopiert werden muss. In Kombination mit `GROUP BY` ist dies eine sehr performante Art, eindeutige Werte zu ermitteln.
keywords: LOOP, TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) und erhöhen Sie den Preis jedes Fluges um 10%, indem Sie ein Field-Symbol zur direkten Modifikation verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)` für die effiziente In-Place-Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_loop_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_loop_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_prices.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights.
    LOOP AT rt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.10'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_modify_prices FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100.00 ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_loop_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = lo_cut->modify_flight_prices( lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_result>-price exp = 110.00 ).

explanation: Die Verwendung von `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` in einer `LOOP AT`-Anweisung ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung der Tabellenzeilen im Speicher, ohne dass Daten kopiert werden müssen. Dies ist effizienter als die Verwendung von `INTO WORK AREA` und anschließender `MODIFY`-Anweisung.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Flugstruktur (sflight) zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird, und lesen Sie deren Wert mit einem Field-Symbol.

CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen bestimmten Flug aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf `CARRID` und `CONNID` und weisen Sie die gefundene Zeile einem Field-Symbol zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.

    READ TABLE it_sflights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_sflight = <fs_sflight>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_read_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100.00 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 200.00 ) TO lt_sflights.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung eines `CLEANUP`-Blocks in einer `TRY...CATCH...ENDTRY`-Struktur, um sicherzustellen, dass Ressourcen freigegeben werden, auch wenn eine Ausnahme auftritt.
hint: Platzieren Sie die Logik zur Ressourcenfreigabe im `CLEANUP`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_cleanup_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_resource.
    DATA(lv_resource_status) = 'Resource not acquired'.
    DATA(lv_cleanup_status) = 'Cleanup not executed'.

    TRY.
        lv_resource_status = 'Resource acquired'.
        rv_log = rv_log && 'Resource acquired. '.

        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        rv_log = rv_log && 'Processing successful. '.

      CATCH cx_static_check.
        rv_log = rv_log && 'Exception caught. '.

      CLEANUP.
        lv_cleanup_status = 'Cleanup executed'.
        rv_log = rv_log && 'Cleanup executed. '.

    ENDTRY.

    rv_log = rv_log && 'Final resource status: ' && lv_resource_status && '. '.
    rv_log = rv_log && 'Final cleanup status: ' && lv_cleanup_status && '. '.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_on_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->process_resource( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Resource acquired.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Processing successful.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Cleanup executed.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Final cleanup status: Cleanup executed.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_on_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->process_resource( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Resource acquired.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Exception caught.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Cleanup executed.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Final cleanup status: Cleanup executed.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Processing successful.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, unabhängig davon, ob dies durch eine Ausnahme oder durch normalen Programmfluss geschieht. Dies ist entscheidend für die zuverlässige Freigabe von Ressourcen (z.B. Datenbankverbindungen, Dateihandles), um Ressourcenlecks zu vermeiden und die Stabilität der Anwendung zu gewährleisten.
keywords: TRY CATCH, CLEANUP, Error Handling, Resource Management

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_int_to_string( 12345 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '12345' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_overflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_conversion( ).
    TRY.
        " Eine sehr große Zahl, die einen Überlauf verursachen könnte, wenn der Zieltyp kleiner wäre.
        " Hier wird angenommen, dass 'string' groß genug ist, aber wir simulieren den Fall.
        " In der Realität würde man hier einen kleineren Zieltyp wählen, um den Überlauf zu provozieren.
        " Für diesen Test nehmen wir an, dass die Konvertierung von i nach string bei extremen Werten
        " (die hier nicht direkt darstellbar sind) einen Overflow auslösen könnte.
        " Da 'string' praktisch unbegrenzt ist, ist ein direkter Overflow von 'i' nach 'string' unwahrscheinlich.
        " Wir simulieren dies, indem wir die Ausnahme direkt auslösen, um den CATCH-Block zu testen.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_overflow.
        lo_cut->convert_int_to_string( 2147483647 ). " Max value for type I
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_SY_CONVERSION_OVERFLOW was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_overflow.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_SY_CONVERSION_OVERFLOW was correctly raised' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bestimmte Operationen, wie Typumwandlungen, können automatisch Standard-Ausnahmen auslösen. Es ist gute Praxis, diese Ausnahmen abzufangen und gegebenenfalls weiterzuleiten oder zu behandeln, um robuste Anwendungen zu gewährleisten. `CX_SY_CONVERSION_OVERFLOW` ist ein Beispiel für eine solche Ausnahme.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_CONVERSION_OVERFLOW, Type Conversion

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression mit einem Field-Symbol, um die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR <fs_sflight> IN itab ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( 0 ) )
                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit einem Field-Symbol ermöglicht sie eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Berechnung von Summen, Minima, Maxima oder anderen Aggregationen, da direkt auf die Tabellenzeilen zugegriffen wird.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Objekten (z.B. `sflights`) akzeptiert und eine bestimmte Methode auf jedem Objekt aufruft, wobei Sie ein Field-Symbol für den dynamischen Methodenaufruf verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (<fs_object>)->(<method_name>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_on_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_objects    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_on_objects.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE REF TO object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_objects ASSIGNING <fs_object>.
      TRY.
          CALL METHOD (<fs_object>)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING result = <fs_result>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND <fs_result> TO rt_results.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
          APPEND |Error calling method { iv_method_name }| TO rt_results.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
