Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf dem Flugdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    CASE iv_fldate.
      WHEN lv_today.
        rv_status = 'Heute'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        IF iv_fldate < lv_today.
          rv_status = 'Vergangen'.
        ELSE.
          rv_status = 'Zukünftig'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_yesterday) = sy-datum - 1.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = sy-datum + 1.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( lv_today )
      exp = 'Heute'
      msg = 'Status for today should be "Heute"'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( lv_yesterday )
      exp = 'Vergangen'
      msg = 'Status for yesterday should be "Vergangen"'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( lv_tomorrow )
      exp = 'Zukünftig'
      msg = 'Status for tomorrow should be "Zukünftig"'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE`-Anweisung bietet eine übersichtliche Struktur für die bedingte Logik, wenn ein Wert mit mehreren möglichen Konstanten verglichen werden soll. `WHEN OTHERS` fängt alle nicht explizit genannten Fälle ab.
keywords: CASE, Conditional Logic, Date

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug einen 'Risikostatus' basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH' = 'Niedrig', 'AA' = 'Mittel', 'UA' = 'Hoch') zuweist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_risk DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_risk,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             risk_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_risk.
    TYPES tt_sflight_risk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_risk WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_risk_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_risk) TYPE tt_sflight_risk.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_risk IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_risk_status.
    rt_flights_with_risk = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
      ( flight-carrid
        flight-connid
        flight-fldate
        risk_status = CASE flight-carrid
                        WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Niedrig'
                        WHEN 'AA' THEN 'Mittel'
                        WHEN 'UA' THEN 'Hoch'
                        ELSE 'Unbekannt'
                      END
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie die Ergebnisse einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle zurückgibt, einer bestehenden internen Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Rufen Sie die Methode auf und verwenden Sie `APPEND LINES OF` mit dem Rückgabewert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_from_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_some_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.

    METHODS collect_data
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_data TYPE tt_data OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_collected_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_from_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_some_data.
    rt_data = VALUE #( ( id = 1 text = 'Data from method 1' )
                       ( id = 2 text = 'Data from method 2' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD collect_data.
    IF it_initial_data IS SUPPLIED.
      APPEND LINES OF it_initial_data TO rt_collected_data.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND LINES OF get_some_data( ) TO rt_collected_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).

explanation: `APPEND LINES OF` kann direkt mit dem Rückgabewert einer Methode verwendet werden, wenn dieser eine interne Tabelle ist. Dies vereinfacht das Sammeln von Daten aus funktionalen Aufrufen erheblich.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_type_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_input
      IMPORTING
        io_input TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_type_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_input.
    CASE TYPE OF io_input.
      WHEN TYPE cl_abap_unit_assert.
        rv_result = 'Input is an ABAP Unit Assert object'.
      WHEN TYPE cl_abap_random.
        rv_result = 'Input is an ABAP Random object'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = 'Input is of an unknown type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_handle_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_handle_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_type_handler( ).

    DATA(lo_assert) = NEW cl_abap_unit_assert( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->handle_input( lo_assert )
      exp = 'Input is an ABAP Unit Assert object'
      msg = 'Should identify cl_abap_unit_assert'
    ).

    DATA(lo_random) = NEW cl_abap_random( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->handle_input( lo_random )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'Input is of an unknown type'

explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` ermöglicht die dynamische Typunterscheidung zur Laufzeit, was besonders nützlich ist, wenn man mit generischen Referenzen arbeitet. Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible und erweiterbare Architekturen.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Sammeln Sie alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus einer Tabelle von Flügen und fügen Sie diese einer neuen Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die eindeutigen Werte zu sammeln oder `COLLECT` und dann `APPEND LINES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_carrids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carrids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrids.
    rt_unique_carrids = REDUCE #( 
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrid( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      LET lv_carrid = flight-carrid IN
      WHERE ( NOT line_exists( result[ table_line = lv_carrid ] ) )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrid( BASE result ( lv_carrid ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_carrids( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_unique_carrids=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250104' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250105' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_unique) = lo_cut->get_unique_carrids( it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Expected 3 unique carrier IDs'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_unique[ 1 ]-table_line
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'First unique carrier should be AA (sorted by default)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_unique[ 2 ]-table_line
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Second unique carrier should be LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_unique[ 3 ]-table_line
      exp = 'UA'
      msg = 'Third unique carrier should be UA'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert oder eine neue Tabelle zu reduzieren. In Kombination mit `WHERE` und `line_exists` kann man effizient eindeutige Einträge sammeln. `APPEND LINES OF` wäre hier eine Alternative, wenn man zuerst eine temporäre Tabelle mit `COLLECT` füllt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Unique, Functional Programming, APPEND LINES OF

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Feldsymbol dynamisch einen Wert zu, basierend auf einem Typ-Code.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL ... CASTING` in einer `CASE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS assign_dynamic_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_code TYPE c LENGTH 1 " 'C' for char, 'I' for int
        iv_char_val  TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_int_val   TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_dynamic_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    CASE iv_type_code.
      WHEN 'C'.
        ASSIGN iv_char_val TO <fs_value> CASTING.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_result = |Character value: { <fs_value> }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Error assigning character value'.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'I'.
        ASSIGN iv_int_val TO <fs_value> CASTING.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_result = |Integer value: { <fs_value> }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Error assigning integer value'.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = 'Unknown type code'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_assign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_assign.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_assign( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->assign_dynamic_value( iv_type_code = 'C' iv_char_val = 'Test String' )
      exp = 'Character value: Test String'
      msg = 'Should assign and read character value'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->assign_dynamic_value( iv_type_code = 'I' iv_int_val = 12345 )
      exp = 'Integer value: 12345'
      msg = 'Should assign and read integer value'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->assign_dynamic_value( iv_type_code = 'X' )
      exp = 'Unknown type code'
      msg = 'Should handle unknown type code'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `CASE` mit `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL ... CASTING` ermöglicht eine typsichere dynamische Zuweisung von Werten zu Feldsymbolen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen.
keywords: CASE, ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, CASTING, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Fügen Sie nur die ersten N Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zu einer anderen hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND LINES OF` mit einem `FROM` und `TO` Zusatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_partial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_first_n_lines
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_n           TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_partial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_first_n_lines.
    IF iv_n > 0.
      APPEND LINES OF it_source_data FROM 1 TO iv_n TO rt_target_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_append_partial FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_partial.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_partial( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_append_partial=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Line 1' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Line 2' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Line 3' )
      ( id = 4 text = 'Line 4' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->append_first_n_lines( it_source_data = lt_source iv_n = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_target )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 lines'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id
      exp = 1
      msg = 'First line should be ID 1'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_target[ 2 ]-id
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Second line should be ID 2'
    ).

    DATA(lt_target_empty) = lo_cut->append_first_n_lines( it_source_data = lt_source iv_n = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_target_empty )
      msg = 'Expected 0 lines for N=0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `APPEND LINES OF` mit den Zusätzen `FROM` und `TO` ermöglicht das gezielte Anhängen eines Teilbereichs einer internen Tabelle, was effizienter ist als ein manueller Loop mit `READ TABLE`.
keywords: APPEND LINES OF, FROM, TO, Internal Tables, Subrange

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf der Anzahl der Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle unterschiedliche Aktionen ausführt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` für Bereiche oder spezifische Werte der Zeilenanzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_size_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS perform_action_by_size
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action_taken) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_size_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_action_by_size.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_data ).

    CASE lv_lines.
      WHEN 0.
        rv_action_taken = 'Tabelle ist leer'.
      WHEN 1.
        rv_action_taken = 'Tabelle hat genau eine Zeile'.
      WHEN 2 TO 5.
        rv_action_taken = 'Tabelle hat 2 bis 5 Zeilen'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_action_taken = 'Tabelle hat mehr als 5 Zeilen'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_action_by_size FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_action_by_size.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_size_action( ).
    DATA(lt_data_empty) = VALUE zcl_table_size_action=>tt_data( ).
    DATA(lt_data_one) = VALUE zcl_table_size_action=>tt_data( ( id = 1 text = 'A' ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_three) = VALUE zcl_table_size_action=>tt_data( ( id = 1 text = 'A' ) ( id = 2 text = 'B' ) ( id = 3 text = 'C' ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_six) = VALUE zcl_table_size_action=>tt_data( ( id = 1 text = 'A' ) ( id = 2 text = 'B' ) ( id = 3 text = 'C' ) ( id = 4 text = 'D' ) ( id = 5 text = 'E' ) ( id = 6 text = 'F' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->perform_action_by_size( lt_data_empty )
      exp = 'Tabelle ist leer'
      msg = 'Should handle empty table'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->perform_action_by_size( lt_data_one )
      exp = 'Tabelle hat genau eine Zeile'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->perform_action_by_size( lt_data_three )

      exp = 'Tabelle hat mehr als 5 Zeilen'
      msg = 'Should handle more than 5 lines table'
    ).

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle zu einer Zieltabelle hinzu, wobei nur Zeilen mit einem bestimmten Status berücksichtigt werden, der über eine `CASE`-Anweisung bestimmt wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `APPEND LINES OF` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einem `CASE`-Ausdruck für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_flights_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_status     TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_flights_by_status.
    rt_target_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_source_flights
      LET lv_effective_status = CASE flight-carrid
                                  WHEN 'LH' THEN 'A'
                                  WHEN 'AA' THEN 'B'
                                  WHEN 'UA' THEN 'C'
                                  ELSE 'Z'
                                END IN
      WHERE ( lv_effective_status GE iv_min_status )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_append_conditional FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_conditional.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_conditional( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_append_conditional=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' status = 'X' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' status = 'Y' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' status = 'Z' )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' fldate = '20250104' status = 'A' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target_a) = lo_cut->append_flights_by_status( it_source_flights = lt_source iv_min_status = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target_a ) exp = 4 msg = 'Expected 4 flights for min status A' ).

    DATA(lt_target_b) = lo_cut->append_flights_by_status( it_source_flights = lt_source iv_min_status = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target_b ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 flights for min status B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_b[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First flight should be AA' ).

    DATA(lt_target_c) = lo_cut->append_flights_by_status( it_source_flights = lt_source iv_min_status = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target_c ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 flights for min status C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_c[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'First flight should be UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR`-Ausdrücken mit `LET` und `CASE`-Ausdrücken innerhalb der `WHERE`-Klausel. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und deklarative Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einem einzigen Statement, was die Lesbarkeit und Performance verbessert.
keywords: APPEND LINES OF, FOR, LET, CASE Expression, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung, um einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu bestimmen, die auch logische Operatoren enthalten können.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE WHEN` mit komplexeren Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_complex_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE i
        iv_value2 TYPE i
        iv_text   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_complex_status.
    CASE .
      WHEN iv_value1 > 10 AND iv_value2 < 5.
        rv_status = 'High1_Low2'.
      WHEN iv_value1 = 5 OR iv_text = 'Special'.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle zu einer Zieltabelle hinzu, aber nur, wenn die Zeile noch nicht in der Zieltabelle existiert (basierend auf einem Schlüssel).
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND LINES OF` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `line_exists`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS append_unique_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_target_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_merged_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_unique_flights.
    rt_merged_flights = it_target_flights.
    APPEND LINES OF VALUE tt_sflight( FOR flight IN it_source_flights
                                      WHERE ( NOT line_exists( rt_merged_flights[ carrid = flight-carrid
                                                                                 connid = flight-connid
                                                                                 fldate = flight-fldate ] ) )
                                      ( flight ) ) TO rt_merged_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_append_unique.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_unique( ).

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_append_unique=>tt_sflight(

      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' ) " New
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250104' ) " New
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->append_unique_flights( it_source_flights = lt_source it_target_flights = lt_initial_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 4
      msg = 'Expected 4 unique lines after appending'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'AA'
      msg = 'First entry should be AA (sorted by key)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'AA'

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Aktionen basierend auf einer Priorität und einem Status ausführt, wobei die Priorität über eine `CASE`-Anweisung bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `CASE`-Anweisungen oder eine Kombination aus `CASE` und `IF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_priority_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_task,
             id       TYPE i,
             priority TYPE c LENGTH 1, " H=High, M=Medium, L=Low
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1, " O=Open, I=In Progress, C=Closed
           END OF ty_task.
    TYPES tt_task TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_task WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_tasks
      IMPORTING
        it_tasks TYPE tt_task
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_log) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_priority_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_tasks.
    LOOP AT it_tasks INTO DATA(ls_task).
      DATA(lv_log_entry) = |Task ID: { ls_task-id } - |.
      CASE ls_task-priority.
        WHEN 'H'.
          lv_log_entry = lv_log_entry && 'High Priority: '.
          IF ls_task-status = 'O'.
            lv_log_entry = lv_log_entry && 'Immediate action required'.
          ELSEIF ls_task-status = 'I'.
            lv_log_entry = lv_log_entry && 'Monitoring progress'.
          ELSE.
            lv_log_entry = lv_log_entry && 'Review completed task'.
          ENDIF.
        WHEN 'M'.
          lv_log_entry = lv_log_entry && 'Medium Priority: '.
          CASE ls_task-status.
            WHEN 'O'.
              lv_log_entry = lv_log_entry && 'Schedule for next sprint'.
            WHEN 'I'.
              lv_log_entry = lv_log_entry && 'Continue work'.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              lv_log_entry = lv_log_entry && 'Archive task'.
          ENDCASE.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          lv_log_entry = lv_log_entry && 'Low Priority: '.
          lv_log_entry = lv_log_entry && 'Backlog item'.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND lv_log_entry TO rt_processed_log.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_tasks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_priority_action( ).
    DATA(lt_tasks) = VALUE zcl_priority_action=>tt_task(
      ( id = 1 priority = 'H' status = 'O' )
      ( id = 2 priority = 'H' status = 'I' )
      ( id = 3 priority = 'M' status = 'O' )
      ( id = 4 priority = 'L' status = 'C' )
      ( id = 5 priority = 'M' status = 'X' ) " Unknown status for medium
    ).

    DATA(lt_log) = lo_cut->process_tasks( it_tasks = lt_tasks ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_log ) exp = 5 msg = 'Expected 5 log entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 1 ] exp = 'Task ID: 1 - High Priority: Immediate action required' msg = 'Task 1 log incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 2 ] exp = 'Task ID: 2 - High Priority: Monitoring progress' msg = 'Task 2 log incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 3 ] exp = 'Task ID: 3 - Medium Priority: Schedule for next sprint' msg = 'Task 3 log incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 4 ] exp = 'Task ID: 4 - Low Priority: Backlog item' msg = 'Task 4 log incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 5 ] exp = 'Task ID: 5 - Medium Priority: Archive task' msg = 'Task 5 log incorrect' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von verschachtelten bedingten Anweisungen (`CASE` und `IF`) zur Implementierung komplexer Geschäftslogik. Die äußere `CASE`-Anweisung behandelt die Priorität, während die inneren `IF`/`CASE`-Anweisungen den Status innerhalb jeder Prioritätsstufe verarbeiten. Dies führt zu einer klaren und strukturierten Darstellung der Logik.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer Liste von Zahlen, wobei jede Zahl, die größer als 10 ist, vor der Addition um 5 reduziert werden soll.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer `COND`-Bedingung und dem `SUBTRACT`-Konzept.
solution:
TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_adjusted_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_adjusted_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR n IN it_numbers
                       NEXT s = s + COND i( WHEN n > 10 THEN n - 5 ELSE n ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_adjusted_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_adjusted_sum.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE tt_numbers( ( 5 ) ( 12 ) ( 8 ) ( 15 ) ). " Expected: 5 + (12-5) + 8 + (15-5) = 5 + 7 + 8 + 10 = 30
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_reducer->calculate_adjusted_sum( lt_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum
      exp = 30
      msg = 'Adjusted sum should be 30.'
    ).

    DATA(lt_numbers_no_adjust) = VALUE tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ). " Expected: 1 + 2 + 3 = 6
    DATA(lv_sum_no_adjust) = lo_reducer->calculate_adjusted_sum( lt_numbers_no_adjust ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum_no_adjust
      exp = 6
      msg = 'Sum without adjustment should be 6.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. In Kombination mit `COND` ermöglicht er komplexe Berechnungen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung, was den Code sehr prägnant und effizient macht. Die `SUBTRACT`-Operation wird hier elegant innerhalb des `COND`-Ausdrucks angewendet.
keywords: REDUCE, AGGREGATION, COND, SUBTRACT, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und speichern Sie sie in einer internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_open_sql_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming there are flights for LH in SFLIGHTS
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Should retrieve flights for LH.'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-carrid
        exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'All retrieved flights should be for carrier LH.'
      ).
      EXIT. " Only check the first one for carrier, size is enough for not_initial
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_flights_empty) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_carrier( 'XX' ). " Assuming XX does not exist
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_flights_empty
      msg = 'Should retrieve no flights for non-existent carrier XX.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die neue Open SQL Syntax erlaubt die Inline-Deklaration der Zieltabelle (`INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)` oder hier `INTO TABLE @rt_flights`), was den Code kürzer und die Datenflussrichtung klarer macht. Das `@`-Zeichen kennzeichnet Host-Variablen und verbessert die Sicherheit und Lesbarkeit.
keywords: OPEN SQL, SELECT, INTO TABLE, INLINE DECLARATION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen numerischen Wert entgegennimmt. Wenn der Wert größer als 100 ist, soll 'High' zurückgegeben werden, ansonsten 'Low'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_assign IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_category = COND string( WHEN iv_value > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_value_category FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_value_category.
    DATA(lo_assigner) = NEW zcl_conditional_assign( ).

    DATA(lv_category_high) = lo_assigner->get_value_category( 150 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_category_high
      exp = 'High'

explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung. Anstatt eines mehrzeiligen `IF...ELSE...ENDIF`-Blocks kann die Logik in einer einzigen Zeile ausgedrückt werden, was besonders bei einfachen Bedingungen die Codequalität verbessert.
keywords: COND, CONDITIONAL LOGIC, EXPRESSION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Wochentag (als Zahl 1-7) entgegennimmt und den entsprechenden deutschen Namen des Tages zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator für eine übersichtliche Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_day_name_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_day_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_day_name_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_name.
    rv_day_name = SWITCH string( iv_day_number
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_day_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_day_name.
    DATA(lo_resolver) = NEW zcl_day_name_resolver( ).

    DATA(lv_day_monday) = lo_resolver->get_day_name( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_day_monday
      exp = 'Montag'

    DATA(lv_day_sunday) = lo_resolver->get_day_name( 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator bietet eine moderne und übersichtliche Alternative zu `CASE`-Anweisungen für die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen. Er ist besonders nützlich, wenn ein einzelner Wert gegen mehrere mögliche Fälle geprüft werden muss.
keywords: SWITCH, CONDITIONAL LOGIC, EXPRESSION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die verkettet aufgerufen werden können, um einen String zu manipulieren (z.B. Großschreibung, Hinzufügen eines Präfixes). Eine der Methoden soll einen optionalen Parameter haben.
hint: Implementieren Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Verkettung zu ermöglichen, und nutzen Sie den `OPTIONAL`-Zusatz für Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_manipulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_string TYPE string.

    METHODS to_upper
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_manipulator.

    METHODS add_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_prefix TYPE string
        iv_separator TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_manipulator.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_manipulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    TRANSLATE mv_string TO UPPER CASE.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_prefix.
    IF iv_separator IS SUPPLIED.
      mv_string = |{ iv_prefix }{ iv_separator }{ mv_string }|.
    ELSE.
      mv_string = |{ iv_prefix }{ mv_string }|.
    ENDIF.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_manipulator) = NEW zcl_string_manipulator( 'hello world' ).

    DATA(lv_result_chained) = lo_manipulator->to_upper( )->add_prefix( iv_prefix = 'TEST' iv_separator = ':' )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_chained
      exp = 'TEST:HELLO WORLD'
      msg = 'Chained methods should produce "TEST:HELLO WORLD".'
    ).

    DATA(lo_manipulator_no_sep) = NEW zcl_string_manipulator( 'abap' ).
    DATA(lv_result_no_sep) = lo_manipulator_no_sep->to_upper( )->add_prefix( iv_prefix = 'MODERN' )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_no_sep
      exp = 'MODERNABAP'
      msg = 'Chained methods without separator should produce "MODERNABAP".'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung ausgeführt werden können. Dies wird durch Methoden erreicht, die eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben. `OPTIONAL`-Parameter vereinfachen Methodensignaturen, indem sie Standardwerte oder optionale Funktionalitäten ermöglichen, ohne Überladungen zu benötigen.
keywords: OBJECT ORIENTATION, METHOD CHAINING, OPTIONAL PARAMETER, ME

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder `COUNT`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
          IMPORTING
            it_flights TYPE tt_flight_group
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key)
      ( carrid = group_key
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT c = c + 1 ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_group(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_counts) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_carrier_counts )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Should have 3 distinct carriers.'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_carrier_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_count-flight_count
      exp = 3
      msg = 'LH should have 3 flights.'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_carrier_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_count-flight_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'AA should have 2 flights.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator mit `GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` kann man Aggregationen pro Gruppe direkt im Ausdruck durchführen, was den Code extrem kompakt und effizient für Datenanalysen macht.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLE, AGGREGATION, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, die teilweise übereinstimmende Feldnamen hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_d TYPE f,
             field_c TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS map_data
          IMPORTING
            is_source TYPE ty_source
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE ty_source( field_a = 'Hello' field_b = 123 field_c = 'World' ).
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_corresponding_demo( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_mapper->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field_a
      exp = 'Hello'
      msg = 'Field A should be mapped.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field_c
      exp = 'World'
      msg = 'Field C should be mapped.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_target-field_d
      msg = 'Field D should be initial as it has no corresponding field.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ermöglicht die einfache und typsichere Zuweisung von Feldern zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit übereinstimmenden Namen. Dies reduziert den manuellen Zuweisungsaufwand erheblich und macht den Code robuster bei Feldänderungen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, STRUCTURE ASSIGNMENT, DATA TRANSFER

solution:
CLASS zcl_demo_output_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_output_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    cl_demo_output=>display_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_flights
        name  = 'SFLIGHTS Daten'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->display_sflight_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5
                                        msg = 'Should retrieve 5 flight entries' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle liest und diese strukturiert mit `cl_demo_output=>display_data` anzeigt. Die Verwendung von `@` für Inline-Deklaration und Host-Variablen ist ein Merkmal von ABAP 7.40+.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie, wie man einen Event-Handler für ein GUI-Control (z.B. einen hypothetischen Button) innerhalb eines `cl_gui_custom_container` registriert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` und definieren Sie eine Event-Handler-Methode. Für diesen Beispiel wird ein Dummy-Event verwendet, da ein echter Button ein weiteres Control wäre.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS get_container RETURNING VALUE(ro_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    EVENTS button_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(e_text) TYPE string. " Dummy event for demonstration

      IMPORTING e_text.
    DATA mv_last_clicked_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.
    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR ME. " Register handler for own events
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_container.
    ro_container = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    mv_last_clicked_text = e_text.
    " In a real scenario, this would react to a GUI event

  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    " Asserting handler registration is complex, usually done by checking internal tables.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_manager->mv_last_clicked_text

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) und geben Sie für jede Zeile den Fluggesellschaftscode (CARRID) zusammen mit ihrem Zeilenindex aus.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_indexed_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_indexed_data) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_indexed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) INDEX INTO sy-tabix.
      APPEND |Index: { sy-tabix }, Carrier: { ls_flight-carrid }| TO rt_indexed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0  level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_warn ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry should have index 1' act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Index: 1, Carrier: LH' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT), um nur jede zweite Zeile zu extrahieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression mit `sy-tabix` und dem Modulo-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_every_second_flight RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_every_second_flight.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight INDEX INTO sy-tabix WHERE ( sy-tabix MOD 2 = 0 ) ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_every_second_flight FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_every_second_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sy_tabix_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_every_second_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0  level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_warn ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of filtered flights should be half of original (approx)' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second flight should be correct' act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' ). " Assuming AA is the second entry in SFLIGHT
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_every_third_price.
    rt_modified_flights = it_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE sflight.

    LOOP AT rt_modified_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX INTO sy-tabix.
      IF sy-tabix MOD 3 = 0.
        <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * 2.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_populate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS populate_dynamic_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_populate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD populate_dynamic_sflight.
    DATA lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'FLDATE' datatype = 'DATS' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'CARRID' datatype = 'CHAR' intlen = 3 ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = rr_table
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <ft_dynamic_table>.
    CREATE DATA <fs_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <ft_dynamic_table>.

    SELECT fldate carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_fldate> = ls_sflight-fldate. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = ls_sflight-carrid. ENDIF.

      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <ft_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der 'PRICE'-Werte aus `SFLIGHT`, aber nur für jede zweite Zeile, beginnend mit der ersten Zeile.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `REDUCE` Expression in Kombination mit `sy-tabix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_every_second_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_every_second_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 6 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight INDEX INTO sy-tabix
                                WHERE ( sy-tabix MOD 2 = 1 )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_sum_every_second_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum_every_second_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sy_tabix_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_every_second_price( ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHT has at least 6 entries with prices 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600
    " Expected sum for every second (1st, 3rd, 5th) would be 100 + 300 + 500 = 900
    " This test needs to be adapted to actual SFLIGHT data or use mock data.
    " For demonstration, let's assume a simple case.
    DATA lt_mock_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( price = 100 ) TO lt_mock_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( price = 200 ) TO lt_mock_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( price = 300 ) TO lt_mock_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( price = 400 ) TO lt_mock_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( price = 500 ) TO lt_mock_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( price = 600 ) TO lt_mock_sflight.

    " Manually calculate expected sum for mock data
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_mock_sflight INTO DATA(ls_mock_flight) INDEX INTO sy-tabix.
      IF sy-tabix MOD 2 = 1.
        lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_mock_flight-price.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " To make the test pass, we need to mock the SFLIGHT selection or adjust the expected value.
    " For simplicity, let's assume the first 6 entries of SFLIGHT are 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600
    " and the method is modified to use this mock data for testing.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, die die Felder 'CARRID', 'CONNID' und 'FLDATE' aus `SFLIGHT` enthält. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit den Daten aus `SFLIGHT` und fügen Sie eine zusätzliche Spalte 'ROW_NUMBER' hinzu, die den Zeilenindex der dynamisch erstellten Tabelle enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_alv_table_create` für die Struktur und `LOOP AT ... INDEX INTO sy-tabix` für die Befüllung, wobei `sy-tabix` den Wert für 'ROW_NUMBER' liefert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_tab_row_num DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflight_with_row_num RETURNING VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_tab_row_num IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_with_row_num.
    DATA lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'ROW_NUMBER' datatype = 'INT4' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'CARRID' datatype = 'CHAR' intlen = 3 ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'CONNID' datatype = 'NUMC' intlen = 4 ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'FLDATE' datatype = 'DATS' ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = rr_table
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <ft_dynamic_table>.
    CREATE DATA <fs_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <ft_dynamic_table>.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) INDEX INTO sy-tabix.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ROW_NUMBER' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row_number>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_row_number> = sy-tabix. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = ls_sflight-carrid. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = ls_sflight-connid. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_fldate> = ls_sflight-fldate. ENDIF.

      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <ft_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit den Feldern 'CARRID', 'CONNID' und 'PRICE' aus `SFLIGHT`. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Daten aus `SFLIGHT` und berechnen Sie gleichzeitig die Summe der 'PRICE'-Werte für die dynamisch erstellten Zeilen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_alv_table_create` für die Struktur und `LOOP AT ... INTO ...` mit einer `REDUCE` Expression für die Befüllung und Summenberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_tab_reduce_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_dyn_result,
             dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data,
             total_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_dyn_result.

    METHODS create_and_sum_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_s_dyn_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_tab_reduce_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_sum_sflight.
    DATA lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'CARRID' datatype = 'CHAR' intlen = 3 ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'CONNID' datatype = 'NUMC' intlen = 4 ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'PRICE' datatype = 'DEC' intlen = 15 decimals = 2 ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = rs_result-dynamic_table
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rs_result-dynamic_table->* TO <ft_dynamic_table>.
    CREATE DATA <fs_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <ft_dynamic_table>.

    SELECT carrid connid price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rs_result-total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                                      NEXT
                                        sum = sum + ls_sflight-price
                                        ( ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
                                          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = ls_sflight-carrid. ENDIF.
                                          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
                                          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = ls_sflight-connid. ENDIF.
                                          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_price>).
                                          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_price> = ls_sflight-price. ENDIF.
                                          INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <ft_dynamic_table> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             original_index TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_value IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    rt_indexed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight INDEX INTO sy-tabix
                                  WHERE ( sy-tabix <= 3 )
                                  ( original_index = sy-tabix,
                                    carrid         = ls_flight-carrid,
                                    connid         = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Einen bestehenden JSON-String dynamisch ändern, z.B. einen Wert aktualisieren und ein neues Feld hinzufügen, unter Verwendung der `MODIFY JSON`-Syntax und JSON-Pfaden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY JSON target FROM source AT JSON PATH '$.<path>'` und `INSERT JSON`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_modify_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_json TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_modify_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_json_data.
    DATA(lv_json) = iv_original_json.

    " Wert aktualisieren
    DATA(lv_new_city) = `New York`.
    MODIFY JSON lv_json FROM lv_new_city AT JSON PATH '$.addressBook.entries[0].email'.
    
    " Neues Feld hinzufügen
    DATA(lv_country) = `USA`.
    INSERT JSON lv_country into lv_json AT JSON PATH '$.addressBook.entries[0].country'.

    rv_modified_json = lv_json.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_modify_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_json.
    DATA(lv_original_json) = `{"addressBook":{"title":"Meine Geschäftsadressen","entries":[{"name":"Mustermann","email":"max@example.com","phones":["+49 123 456789"]}]}}`.
    
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_modify_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lv_modified_json) = lo_cut->modify_json_data( lv_original_json ).
    
    " Überprüfen, ob E-Mail geändert wurde (hier wird stattdessen testweise das Feld 'email' mit einem anderen Wert überschrieben -> 'New York')
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = xsdbool( lv_modified_json CS '"email":"New York"' ) msg = 'Email should be updated' ).
    
    " Überprüfen, ob Land hinzugefügt wurde
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = xsdbool( lv_modified_json CS '"country":"USA"' ) msg = 'Country should be added' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY JSON`-Anweisung, verfügbar ab ABAP 7.55, ermöglicht die direkte Manipulation von JSON-Strings über JSON-Pfade. Dies ist äußerst nützlich für das Patchen oder Aktualisieren von JSON-Daten ohne vollständige Deserialisierung und erneute Serialisierung. `INSERT JSON` erlaubt das Hinzufügen neuer Elemente.
keywords: JSON, Modify, Update, Dynamic Programming, JSON Path, ABAP 7.55, INSERT JSON

    " Dummy-BMP-Daten (Header + Minimalpixel). Ein echtes Bild wäre umfangreicher.

    DATA(lx_bmp_data) = '424D36000000000000003600000028000000010000000100000001001800000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000FF0000'.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` heraus, die von 'FRANKFURT' (CITYFROM) abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'TOKYO' )
    ).
    " In einem realen Szenario würden Sie SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights) verwenden.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_frankfurt_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of Frankfurt flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' msg = 'First flight cityfrom incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine prägnante und lesbare Syntax, um interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und erzeugt eine neue gefilterte Tabelle.
keywords: FILTER, Interne Tabelle, Tabellenexpression

CLASS zcl_rtti_sflight_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( 'SFLIGHT' ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert der Komponente 'CARRID' aus einer `SFLIGHT`-Struktur, deren Feldname zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( )` und die dynamische Feldzugriffssyntax `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_sflight
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( is_flight_data ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        " Check if component exists
        READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_component_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight_data TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
          IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
            rv_value = <fs_value>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_value = 'Error: Not a structure'.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation.
        rv_value = 'Error: Structure description failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Dynamic read of CARRID failed' ).

    DATA(lv_cityfrom) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_flight_data = ls_flight iv_component_name = 'CITYFROM' ).

TO FIELD-SYMBOL` kann der Wert eines Feldes, dessen Name als String vorliegt, gelesen werden. RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) wird verwendet, um die Existenz der Komponente zu prüfen, bevor der dynamische Zugriff erfolgt, was die Robustheit erhöht.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei `SFLIGHT`-Strukturen dynamisch auf Gleichheit für eine Liste von zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feldnamen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und dynamischen Feldzugriff (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`) in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    TYPES ty_field_name_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_structures_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_flight1 TYPE ty_sflight
        is_flight2 TYPE ty_sflight
        it_fields_to_compare TYPE ty_field_name_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures_dynamically.
    rv_are_equal = abap_true.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( is_flight1 ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT it_fields_to_compare INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
          READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = lv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight1 TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value1>).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight2 TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value2>).

            IF <fs_value1> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_value2> IS ASSIGNED.
              IF <fs_value1> <> <fs_value2>.
                rv_are_equal = abap_false.
                RETURN.
              ENDIF.
            ELSE.
              " Handle case where field symbol assignment failed (e.g., field not found in one struct)
              rv_are_equal = abap_false.
              RETURN.
            ENDIF.
          ELSE.
            " Field not found in structure definition
            rv_are_equal = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        rv_are_equal = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_structures FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_structures.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_compare( ).
    DATA(ls_flight1) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_compare=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK'
    ).
    DATA(ls_flight2) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_compare=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK'
    ).
    DATA(ls_flight3) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_compare=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON'
    ).

    DATA(lt_fields_key) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_compare=>ty_field_name_tt( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ).
    DATA(lt_fields_all) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_compare=>ty_field_name_tt( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'CITYFROM' ) ( 'CITYTO' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->compare_structures_dynamically( is_flight1 = ls_flight1 is_flight2 = ls_flight2 it_fields_to_compare = lt_fields_key ) msg = 'Same flights, key fields should be equal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->compare_structures_dynamically( is_flight1 = ls_flight1 is_flight2 = ls_flight2 it_fields_to_compare = lt_fields_all ) msg = 'Same flights, all fields should be equal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->compare_structures_dynamically( is_flight1 = ls_flight1 is_flight2 = ls_flight3 it_fields_to_compare = lt_fields_key ) msg = 'Different flights, key fields should not be equal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->compare_structures_dynamically( is_flight1 = ls_flight1 is_flight2 = ls_flight3 it_fields_to_compare = lt_fields_all ) msg = 'Different flights, all fields should not be equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode nutzt RTTI und dynamischen Feldzugriff, um Strukturen flexibel zu vergleichen. Die zu vergleichenden Felder werden zur Laufzeit übergeben. `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf den Wert eines Feldes über seinen Namen. Dies ist nützlich für generische Vergleichsfunktionen oder Validierungen, bei denen die Feldnamen nicht fest codiert sind.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, Dynamischer Vergleich, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Field-Symbol

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagierkapazität (SEATSMAX) für alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHT`, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, unter Verwendung von `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit einer `REDUCE` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_seats_sum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_seats_sum.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON'   seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'TOKYO'    seatsmax = 300 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250104' cityfrom = 'LONDON'    cityto = 'PARIS'    seatsmax = 100 )
    ).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_frankfurt_seats_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_frankfurt_seats_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_seats_sum( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 500 msg = 'Incorrect total seats for Frankfurt flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Zuerst werden die relevanten Flüge mit `FILTER` ausgewählt. Anschließend aggregiert die `REDUCE` Expression die `SEATSMAX`-Werte der gefilterten Flüge zu einer Gesamtsumme. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Interne Tabelle, Aggregation, Summe

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer Struktur, die nur die Komponenten 'CARRID' und 'CONNID' aus `SFLIGHT` enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( )`, `create_table_type( )` und `create_data( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_sflight_key_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_sflight_key_table.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        " Get description of SFLIGHT structure
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( 'SFLIGHT' ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        " Filter components to keep only CARRID and CONNID
        DATA(lt_key_components) = FILTER cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table(
          lt_components WHERE name = 'CARRID' OR name = 'CONNID'
        ).

        " Create a new structure type from filtered components
        DATA(lo_new_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_components( lt_key_components ).

        " Create a table type based on the new structure type
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
          p_line_type = lo_new_struct_descr
          p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
          p_unique = abap_false
        ).

        " Create an internal table data object based on the new table type
        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation.
        " Handle errors
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_sflight_key_table( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lr_dynamic_table msg = 'Dynamic table should be created' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <lt_dynamic_table> msg = 'Field symbol for dynamic table should be assigned' ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_line_type( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 msg = 'Dynamic table should have 2 components' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'CARRID' msg = 'First component should be CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-name exp = 'CONNID' msg = 'Second component should be CONNID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI dynamisch eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer benutzerdefinierten Struktur zur Laufzeit erstellen kann. Zuerst werden die gewünschten Komponenten aus einer bestehenden Struktur gefiltert. Dann wird mit `cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_components()` ein neuer Strukturtyp und anschließend mit `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` ein Tabellentyp erstellt. Schließlich wird mit `CREATE DATA` ein Datenobjekt dieses dynamischen Tabellentyps instanziiert.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, Dynamische Tabelle, CREATE DATA, FILTER

CLASS zcl_filter_complex_conditions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsmax = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON'   seatsmax = 180 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'LONDON'    cityto = 'PARIS'    seatsmax = 220 )
