Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT`-Datensätzen dynamisch basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feldnamen und einem Vergleichswert.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit dynamischem Feldzugriff (`LINE_EXISTS` mit `WHERE (field_name) = value`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( NEW ty_sflight( ) ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Dynamic WHERE clause for FILTER is not directly supported like this.
          " Instead, we use a LOOP and dynamic ASSIGN.
          LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_flight TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_value>).
            IF <fs_field_value> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field_value> = iv_value.
              APPEND ls_flight TO rt_filtered_flights.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter=>ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'TOKYO' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result_carrid) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_value = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_carrid ) exp = 2 msg = 'Dynamic filter by CARRID failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_carrid[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First filtered CARRID incorrect' ).

    DATA(lt_result_cityfrom) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_field_name = 'CITYFROM' iv_value = 'DALLAS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_cityfrom ) exp = 1 msg = 'Dynamic filter by CITYFROM failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_cityfrom[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'DALLAS' msg = 'Filtered CITYFROM incorrect' ).

    DATA(lt_result_nonexistent) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' iv_value = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_nonexistent ) exp = 0 msg = 'Filter by non-existent field should return empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl der `FILTER` Operator selbst keine vollständig dynamischen `WHERE`-Klauseln mit variablen Feldnamen unterstützt, kann man RTTI und dynamischen Feldzugriff (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`) in einer `LOOP`-Schleife verwenden, um eine ähnliche Funktionalität zu erreichen. Dies ermöglicht es, Filterkriterien zur Laufzeit zu definieren, was für generische Suchfunktionen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamischer Filter, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Field-Symbol, Interne Tabelle

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHT`, die in einem bestimmten Datumsbereich liegen (z.B. FLDATE zwischen '20250101' und '20250105').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `BETWEEN` Operator im `FILTER` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_low TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_date_high TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_date_range.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250105' cityfrom = 'PARIS'     cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0200' fldate = '20250107' cityfrom = 'ATLANTA'   cityto = 'MIAMI' )
    ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fldate BETWEEN iv_date_low AND iv_date_high ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine gegebene Struktur eine bestimmte Komponente (z.B. 'CARRID') enthält, und geben Sie deren Typ-Kind zurück, falls vorhanden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( )` und `get_component_type( )` oder `get_components( )` mit `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS get_component_type_kind
      IMPORTING
        io_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_kind) TYPE c.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_type_kind.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( io_data ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        IF LINE_EXISTS( lt_components[ name = iv_component_name ] ).
          DATA(ls_component) = lt_components[ name = iv_component_name ].
          rv_type_kind = ls_component-type_descr_ref->type_kind.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle errors, e.g., if io_data is not a structure or is initial
        CLEAR rv_type_kind.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_component_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_component_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_component( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_rtti_check_component=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101'
    ).
    DATA lr_flight TYPE REF TO zcl_rtti_check_component=>ty_sflight.
    GET REFERENCE OF ls_flight INTO lr_flight.

    DATA(lv_carrid_type) = lo_cut->get_component_type_kind( io_data = lr_flight iv_component_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid_type exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char msg = 'CARRID type kind incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_fldate_type) = lo_cut->get_component_type_kind( io_data = lr_flight iv_component_name = 'FLDATE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_fldate_type exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date msg = 'FLDATE type kind incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_nonexistent_type) = lo_cut->get_component_type_kind( io_data = lr_flight iv_component_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_nonexistent_type msg = 'Non-existent component should return initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt RTTI, um dynamisch zu prüfen, ob eine Struktur eine bestimmte Komponente enthält und deren Typ-Kind abzurufen. `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p()` beschreibt die Struktur, und `get_components()` liefert eine Tabelle der Komponenten. `LINE_EXISTS` wird verwendet, um effizient zu prüfen, ob die Komponente existiert, und dann wird der `type_kind` des Typ-Deskriptors der Komponente ausgelesen.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, LINE_EXISTS, Dynamische Prüfung, Typ-Kind

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem beliebigen Feld und Wert filtert, wobei Feldname und Wert als Strings übergeben werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `FILTER` in einer `FOR`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ty_sflight_tt
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE ty_sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamic.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p( NEW ty_sflight( ) ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rt_filtered_table = VALUE ty_sflight_tt(
            FOR ls_entry IN it_source_table
            LET lv_current_value = '' IN
            BLOCK: " Dynamic assignment within LET is not directly supported, use helper FS
              ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_entry TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_value>).
              IF <fs_field_value> IS ASSIGNED.
                lv_current_value = <fs_field_value>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDBLOCK:
            WHERE lv_current_value = iv_filter_value
            ( ls_entry )
          ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generic_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_rtti_generic_filter=>ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'TOKYO' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_by_carrid) = lo_cut->filter_table_dynamic( it_source_table = lt_source iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_filter_value = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_by_carrid ) exp = 2 msg = 'Filter by CARRID failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_by_carrid[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First filtered CARRID incorrect' ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_by_cityfrom) = lo_cut->filter_table_dynamic( it_source_table = lt_source iv_field_name = 'CITYFROM' iv_filter_value = 'DALLAS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_by_cityfrom ) exp = 1 msg = 'Filter by CITYFROM failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_by_cityfrom[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'DALLAS' msg = 'Filtered CITYFROM incorrect' ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_nonexistent) = lo_cut->filter_table_dynamic( it_source_table = lt_source iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' iv_filter_value = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_nonexistent ) exp = 0 msg = 'Filter by non-existent field should return empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert RTTI und dynamischen Feldzugriff mit einer `FOR` Expression, um eine generische Filterfunktion für interne Tabellen zu erstellen. Der Feldname und der Filterwert werden zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben. Innerhalb der `FOR`-Schleife wird `ASSIGN COMPONENT` verwendet, um den Wert des dynamischen Feldes zu extrahieren und mit dem Filterwert zu vergleichen. Dies ermöglicht hochflexible Filterungen, ohne den Feldnamen fest codieren zu müssen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamischer Filter, FOR Expression, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Generisch

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Ergebnis einer Division. Fangen Sie eine mögliche Division durch Null ab und geben Sie stattdessen 0 zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_div_safe DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_div_safe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_safely.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_result = 0. " Handle division by zero
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_normal_division FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_div_safe( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Division by zero should return 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_normal_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_div_safe( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_safely( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle über ihren Index zu. Fangen Sie den Fehler ab, wenn der Index ungültig ist, und geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück.

CLASS zcl_itab_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

        iv_index TYPE i

CLASS zcl_itab_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_line_safely.
    TRY.
        rs_data = it_data[ iv_index ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        CLEAR rs_data. " Return initial structure if index is invalid
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf. Fangen Sie den Fehler ab, wenn die Methode nicht existiert, und geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)` und `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS dummy_method.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lv_message TYPE string.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        lv_message = lx_error->get_text( ).
        " In a real scenario, log the error or return it
        " cl_demo_output=>display( lv_message ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method.
    " This method exists for testing purposes
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Feldsymbol dynamisch einen Komponentenwert zu und heben Sie die Zuweisung anschließend auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und `UNASSIGN <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS process_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_component TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value_processed) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_temp_value TYPE string.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_temp_value = |Wert von { iv_component }: { <fs> }|.
      rv_value_processed = lv_temp_value.
    ELSE.
      rv_value_processed = |Komponente { iv_component } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs>. " Explicitly unassign the field symbol
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_assign( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Feldsymbol basierend auf einer Bedingung einen Wert zu. Heben Sie die Zuweisung auf, wenn die Bedingung nicht erfüllt ist oder der Feldsymbol nicht mehr benötigt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... TO <fs>` innerhalb einer `IF`-Anweisung und `UNASSIGN <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_condition TYPE abap_bool
        iv_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_conditionally.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_local_value TYPE string.

    IF iv_condition = abap_true.
      ASSIGN iv_value TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_local_value = <fs_value>.
        rv_result = |Zugewiesener Wert: { lv_local_value }|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " If condition is false, ensure field symbol is unassigned
      UNASSIGN <fs_value>.
      rv_result = 'Kein Wert zugewiesen.'.
    ENDIF.

    " Ensure unassignment at the end of the method, regardless of path
    UNASSIGN <fs_value>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_condition_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_condition_false FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_condition_true.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_conditional( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_value_conditionally( iv_condition = abap_true iv_value = 'Testwert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Zugewiesener Wert: Testwert' msg = 'Should assign and return value when condition is true' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_condition_false.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_conditional( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_value_conditionally( iv_condition = abap_false iv_value = 'Testwert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Kein Wert zugewiesen.' msg = 'Should not assign and return message when condition is false' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die bedingte Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols und die explizite Aufhebung der Zuweisung mit `UNASSIGN`, um sicherzustellen, dass das Feldsymbol nur dann gültig ist, wenn es benötigt wird. Dies verbessert die Code-Klarheit und vermeidet potenzielle Fehler.
keywords: UNASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Spalte einer internen Tabelle zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols nach der Verarbeitung auf. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_field_name) OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_generic_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_column_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_generic_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO rt_values.
      ELSE.
        APPEND |Feld '{ iv_column_name }' nicht gefunden in Zeile { sy-tabix }| TO rt_values.
        EXIT. " Stop if column not found
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Unassign after each use
    ENDLOOP.

    UNASSIGN <fs_sflight>. " Unassign after loop
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should return 5 values' ).

  METHOD test_invalid_column.

category: Dynamic Programming, Exception Handling, Field Symbols
Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einem Feldsymbol dynamisch einen Wert zuzuweisen. Fangen Sie mögliche Fehler ab (z.B. Feld nicht gefunden) und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol im Fehlerfall unzugewiesen ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_assign_error` und `UNASSIGN` im `CATCH` oder `FINALLY` Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_try_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_try_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN (iv_field_name) OF is_data TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = |Wert: { <fs_field> }|.
        ELSE.
          " This path is usually not taken if ASSIGN raises an exception for non-existent fields
          " but good for robustness if sy-subrc is checked explicitly.
          rv_value = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht gefunden (SY-SUBRC).|.
          UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Ensure unassigned if ASSIGN failed without exception
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_assign_error).
        rv_value = |Fehler bei Zuweisung: { lx_assign_error->get_text( ) }|.
        UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Ensure unassigned in case of exception
    ENDTRY.

    " Optional: UNASSIGN in FINALLY block for guaranteed unassignment
    " FINALLY.
    "   UNASSIGN <fs_field>.
    " ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_try_unassign( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Wert: TestName' msg = 'Should get value for valid field' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Es fängt Fehler ab, die während der Zuweisung auftreten können (z.B. wenn das Feld nicht existiert), und stellt sicher, dass das Feldsymbol in jedem Fall (Erfolg oder Fehler) explizit unzugewiesen wird, um undefiniertes Verhalten zu vermeiden.

hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN (lv_attribute_name) OF OBJECT lo_object TO <fs>` und `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_assign_error`.

CLASS zcl_object_property DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_property1 TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_property2 TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_dynamic_property
      IMPORTING
        iv_property_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_property IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_property1 = 'Value A'.
    mv_property2 = 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_dynamic_property.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_property> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN (iv_property_name) OF ME TO <fs_property>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = |Property '{ iv_property_name }': { <fs_property> }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_value = |Property '{ iv_property_name }' nicht gefunden (SY-SUBRC).|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_value = |Fehler beim Zugriff auf Property '{ iv_property_name }': { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.

    UNASSIGN <fs_property>. " Ensure unassigned
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA mo_out  TYPE REF TO if_oo_adt_classrun_out.

    METHODS handle_node_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_column_tree
      IMPORTING node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    mo_out = out.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      i_parent = lo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      i_item_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>item_sel_mode_single
    ).

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_nodes(
      FOR sflight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS )
      (
        node_key = |{ sflight-carrid }-{ sflight-connid }|,
        text     = |Flug { sflight-carrid } { sflight-connid } am { sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|,
        carrid   = sflight-carrid,
        connid   = sflight-connid,
        fldate   = sflight-fldate
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = NEW cl_gui_column_list( ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' width = 10 ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'CONNID' text = 'Connection' width = 10 ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' width = 12 ).

    mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights
      CHANGING
        p_column_list    = lo_columns
    ).

    SET HANDLER handle_node_double_click FOR mo_tree.

    mo_out->write( 'Column Tree created. Double-click a node to see details (requires GUI environment).' ).
    " To keep the program alive for event handling in a real scenario,
    " you'd typically need a screen and PBO/PAI loop.
    " For ADT classrun, this demonstrates event registration.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    DATA(lt_nodes) = mo_tree->get_selected_nodes( ).
    READ TABLE lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_selected_node) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lt_outtab) = mo_tree->get_outtab( ).
      READ TABLE lt_outtab INTO DATA(ls_sflight_detail) WITH KEY node_key = ls_selected_node-node_key.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        mo_out->write( |Selected Flight: { ls_sflight_detail-carrid } { ls_sflight_detail-connid } on { ls_sflight_detail-fldate DATE = USER }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Spaltenbaum, der hierarchische Flugdaten (Airline -> Flugverbindung) aus `sflights` anzeigt. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die hierarchische Datenstruktur zu erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_column_tree` und den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine geschachtelte Tabelle für die Baumstruktur zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             level    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_node.
    TYPES tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_tree) = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      i_parent = lo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      i_item_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>item_sel_mode_single
    ).

    DATA(lt_sflights) = SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_tree_nodes) = REDUCE zcl_tree_hierarchy=>tt_nodes(
      INIT nodes = VALUE zcl_tree_hierarchy=>tt_nodes( )
           current_key_idx = 0
      FOR sflight IN lt_sflights
      LET carrid_key = |CARR_{ sflight-carrid }| IN
      " Add airline node if not already present
      nodes = COND #(
        WHEN line_exists( nodes[ node_key = carrid_key ] ) THEN nodes
        ELSE VALUE #(
          nodes
          (
            node_key = carrid_key,
            parent_key = '',
            text = |Airline: { sflight-carrid }|,
            carrid = sflight-carrid,
            level = 0
          )
        )
      )
      " Add flight connection node
      nodes = VALUE #(
        nodes
        (
          node_key = |CONN_{ sflight-carrid }-{ sflight-connid }|,
          parent_key = carrid_key,
          text = |Flug: { sflight-connid } am { sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|,
          carrid = sflight-carrid,
          connid = sflight-connid,
          level = 1
        )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = NEW cl_gui_column_list( ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' width = 10 ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'CONNID' text = 'Connection' width = 10 ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'TEXT' text = 'Description' width = 30 ).

    lo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_NODE'
        it_outtab        = lt_tree_nodes
      CHANGING
        p_column_list    = lo_columns
    ).

    lo_tree->expand_all_nodes( ).

    out->write( 'Hierarchical Column Tree created (requires GUI environment to display).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hierarchy_data_reduction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hierarchy_data_reduction.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_hierarchy( ).
    " Simulate the data reduction logic
    DATA(lt_sflights_raw) = SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_tree_nodes_expected) = REDUCE zcl_tree_hierarchy=>tt_nodes(
      INIT nodes = VALUE zcl_tree_hierarchy=>tt_nodes( )
           current_key_idx = 0
      FOR sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      LET carrid_key = |CARR_{ sflight-carrid }| IN
      nodes = COND #(
        WHEN line_exists( nodes[ node_key = carrid_key ] ) THEN nodes
        ELSE VALUE #(
          nodes
          (
            node_key = carrid_key,
            parent_key = '',
            text = |Airline: { sflight-carrid }|,
            carrid = sflight-carrid,
            level = 0
          )
        )
      )
      nodes = VALUE #(
        nodes
        (
          node_key = |CONN_{ sflight-carrid }-{ sflight-connid }|,
          parent_key = carrid_key,
          text = |Flug: { sflight-connid } am { sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|,
          carrid = sflight-carrid,
          connid = sflight-connid,
          level = 1
        )
      )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_tree_nodes_expected,
      msg = 'Expected hierarchical nodes to be created.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_tree_nodes_expected ) MOD 2,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Expected an even number of nodes (airline + flight).' 
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = line_exists( lt_tree_nodes_expected[ node_key CP 'CARR_*' ] ),
      msg = 'Expected at least one airline node.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und kompakte Methode, um Datenaggregation und -transformation in einem Schritt durchzuführen, was zu deutlich weniger Code im Vergleich zu traditionellen Schleifen führt. `COND` und `VALUE` werden innerhalb von `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Logik weiter zu verdichten.
keywords: cl_gui_column_tree, REDUCE, Hierarchy, Internal Tables, UI, sflights

CLASS zcl_tree_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die aktuelle Aufrufhierarchie (Call Stack) des Programms und geben Sie die Namen der aufrufenden Programme und Methoden aus. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_context_info` und den `FOR`-Operator zur Verarbeitung.

CLASS zcl_call_stack_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_formatted_call_stack RETURNING VALUE(rt_call_stack_info) TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _helper_method.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_call_stack_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_call_stack.
    DATA(lt_call_stack) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_call_stack( ).

    rt_call_stack_info = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_stack_entry IN lt_call_stack
      (
        |Programm: { ls_stack_entry-progname }, Typ: { ls_stack_entry-progtype }, Methode: { ls_stack_entry-method }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _helper_method.
    rt_call_stack_info = get_formatted_call_stack( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_call_stack_info( ).
    lo_instance->_helper_method( ). " Call a helper to make the stack more interesting
    LOOP AT lo_instance->rt_call_stack_info INTO DATA(lv_line).
      out->write( lv_line ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transaction_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS execute_transaction_logic RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

    METHODS _handle_se38.

CLASS zcl_transaction_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_transaction_logic.
    DATA(lv_tcode) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_transaction_code( ).
    DATA(lv_program) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_program_name( ).

    rv_message = SWITCH string(
      lv_tcode
      WHEN 'SE16' THEN 'Aktion für Transaktion SE16 ausgeführt.'
      WHEN 'SE38' THEN 'Aktion für Transaktion SE38 ausgeführt.'
      ELSE |Keine spezifische Aktion für Transaktion '{ lv_tcode }' (Programm: { lv_program }).|
    ).

    " Example of calling specific methods based on SWITCH result (not directly in SWITCH expression)
    CASE lv_tcode.
      WHEN 'SE16'.
        _handle_se16( ).
      WHEN 'SE38'.
        _handle_se38( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        _handle_other( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _handle_se16.
    " Implement SE16 specific logic here
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _handle_se38.
    " Implement SE38 specific logic here
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _handle_other.
    " Implement generic logic here
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    out->write( execute_transaction_logic( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Spaltenbaum, der eine aggregierte Ansicht der Flugdaten aus `sflights` anzeigt. Gruppieren Sie die Flüge nach Airline und zeigen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Airline an. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_column_tree` und die Kombination von `SELECT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` zur Datenaggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             count    TYPE i,
             level    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_agg_node.
    TYPES tt_agg_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_agg_node WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_tree) = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      i_parent = lo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      i_item_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>item_sel_mode_single
    ).

    DATA(lt_sflights_grouped) = SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
                                  FROM sflights
                                  GROUP BY carrid
                                  ORDER BY carrid.

    DATA(lt_tree_nodes) = REDUCE tt_agg_nodes(
      INIT nodes = VALUE tt_agg_nodes( )
      FOR ls_group IN lt_sflights_grouped
      (
        nodes = VALUE #(
          nodes
          (
            node_key = |CARR_{ ls_group-carrid }|,
            parent_key = '',
            text = |Airline: { ls_group-carrid } (Flüge: { ls_group-flight_count })|,
            carrid = ls_group-carrid,
            count = ls_group-flight_count,
            level = 0
          )
        )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = NEW cl_gui_column_list( ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' width = 10 ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'COUNT' text = 'Flight Count' width = 15 ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'TEXT' text = 'Description' width = 40 ).

    lo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_AGG_NODE'
        it_outtab        = lt_tree_nodes
      CHANGING
        p_column_list    = lo_columns
    ).

    lo_tree->expand_all_nodes( ).

    out->write( 'Column Tree with aggregated flight data created (requires GUI environment to display).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Fehlerbedingung und nutzen Sie `cl_abap_context_info` um Informationen über den aktuellen Benutzer und das Programm im Fehlerfall zu protokollieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_name()` und `get_program_name()` innerhalb eines `CATCH`-Blocks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_context_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS simulate_error.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_out TYPE REF TO if_oo_adt_classrun_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_context_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_error.
    TRY.
        " Simulate a division by zero error
        DATA(lv_numerator) = 10.
        DATA(lv_denominator) = 0.
        DATA(lv_result) = lv_numerator / lv_denominator.

        mo_out->write( |Result: { lv_result }| ).

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        DATA(lv_user) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_name( ).
        DATA(lv_program) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_program_name( ).
        DATA(lv_tcode) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_transaction_code( ).

        mo_out->write( |FEHLER aufgetreten!| ).
        mo_out->write( |  Benutzer: { lv_user }| ).
        mo_out->write( |  Programm: { lv_program }| ).
        mo_out->write( |  Transaktion: { lv_tcode }| ).
        mo_out->write( |  Fehlermeldung: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }| ).

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    mo_out = out.
    simulate_error( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_logging_context FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_logging_context.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_context_log( ).
    " We cannot directly capture the output of mo_out->write in a unit test.
    " Instead, we verify that the error handling path is taken and context info is retrieved.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->simulate_error( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected an arithmetic error to be caught.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        " This catch block should not be reached if simulate_error handles it internally.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Error should be handled within simulate_error method.' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        " Catch any other unexpected exceptions
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'An unexpected exception occurred.' ).
    ENDTRY.

    " To properly test the logging, one would need to mock mo_out or redirect output.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Spaltenbaum, der die Felder einer beliebigen internen Tabelle dynamisch anzeigt. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Spalten zur Laufzeit zu definieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_column_tree` und RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) um die Struktur einer internen Tabelle zu analysieren und Spalten dynamisch zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_rtti_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS display_table_dynamically IMPORTING it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
           END OF ty_node.
    TYPES tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_rtti_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_table_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_tree) = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      i_parent = lo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      i_item_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>item_sel_mode_single
    ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = NEW cl_gui_column_list( ).
    DATA(lr_data) = REF TO it_data.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lr_data->* )->get_table_line_type( )->get_struct_descr( ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_columns->add_column( key = ls_component-name text = ls_component-name width = 20 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_tree_nodes) = VALUE tt_nodes(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lines( it_data )
      LET ls_data_line = it_data[ i ] IN
      (
        node_key = |LINE_{ i }|,
        text     = |{ i }: { cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_c( ls_data_line ) }|
      )
    ).

    lo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = lo_struct_descr->get_relative_name( )
        it_outtab        = it_data " Pass the original table for display
      CHANGING
        p_column_list    = lo_columns
    ).

    out->write( 'Column Tree with RTTI-defined columns created (requires GUI environment to display).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city_fr,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_subset WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lt_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS ) ( sflight )
    ).

    display_table_dynamically( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Spaltenbaum, der Flugdaten anzeigt. Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die einen Flug aus der angezeigten Liste entfernt und den Baum aktualisiert. Nutzen Sie moderne interne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_column_tree` und den `DELETE` Operator für interne Tabellen, um Einträge zu entfernen und den Baum neu zu laden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_delete_row DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS remove_flight IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.
    TYPES tt_sflight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_nodes.
    DATA mo_out TYPE REF TO if_oo_adt_classrun_out.

    METHODS initialize_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_delete_row IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD initialize_tree.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).
    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      i_parent = lo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      i_item_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>item_sel_mode_single
    ).

    mt_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight_nodes(
      FOR sflight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS )
      (
        node_key = |{ sflight-carrid }-{ sflight-connid }|,
        text     = |Flug { sflight-carrid } { sflight-connid } am { sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|,
        carrid   = sflight-carrid,
        connid   = sflight-connid,
        fldate   = sflight-fldate
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = NEW cl_gui_column_list( ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' width = 10 ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'CONNID' text = 'Connection' width = 10 ).
    lo_columns->add_column( key = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' width = 12 ).

    mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
      CHANGING
        p_column_list    = lo_columns
    ).

    mo_out->write( 'Initial Column Tree created.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_flight.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( mt_sflights ).

    DELETE mt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.

    IF lines( mt_sflights ) < lv_initial_lines.
      mo_out->write( |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } entfernt.| ).
      mo_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
          it_outtab        = mt_sflights
        CHANGING
          p_column_list    = mo_tree->get_column_list( )
      ).
    ELSE.
      mo_out->write( |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    mo_out = out.
    initialize_tree( ).
    remove_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ). " Example: Remove Lufthansa flight 0400
    remove_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '9999' ). " Example: Flight not found
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_delete_row( ).
    lo_cut->mo_out = NEW cl_abap_unit_test_out( ). " Mock output for testing

    " Manually initialize internal table for testing
    lo_cut->mt_sflights = VALUE zcl_tree_delete_row=>tt_sflight_nodes(
      ( node_key = 'LH-0400' carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum text = '...' )
      ( node_key = 'AA-0017' carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum text = '...' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lo_cut->mt_sflights ).

    lo_cut->remove_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lo_cut->mt_sflights ),
      exp = lv_initial_lines - 1,
      msg = 'Expected one flight to be removed.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = line_exists( lo_cut->mt_sflights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] ),
      msg = 'Removed flight should no longer exist.'
    ).

    lo_cut->remove_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '0000' ). " Try to remove non-existent flight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lo_cut->mt_sflights ),
      exp = lv_initial_lines - 1,
      msg = 'Table size should not change when removing non-existent flight.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Manipulation von Daten, die in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` angezeigt werden. Der `DELETE`-Operator für interne Tabellen wird verwendet, um einen spezifischen Flug aus der Datenquelle zu entfernen. Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob der aktuelle Benutzer über eine bestimmte Berechtigung verfügt. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_context_info` und `AUTHORITY-CHECK`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_name()` und führen Sie einen `AUTHORITY-CHECK` durch, um die Berechtigung zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_auth_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS check_authorization IMPORTING iv_auth_obj TYPE string iv_field1 TYPE string iv_value1 TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_authorized) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_out TYPE REF TO if_oo_adt_classrun_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_auth_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_authorization.
    DATA(lv_user) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_user_name( ).
    mo_out->write( |Prüfe Berechtigung für Benutzer '{ lv_user }' für Objekt '{ iv_auth_obj }' mit { iv_field1 } = '{ iv_value1 }'.| ).

    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT iv_auth_obj
      ID iv_field1 FIELD iv_value1.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_authorized = abap_true.
      mo_out->write( '  -> Berechtigung vorhanden.' ).
    ELSE.
      rv_authorized = abap_false.
      mo_out->write( |  -> Berechtigung NICHT vorhanden (SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }).| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    mo_out = out.
    " Example: Check for S_TCODE authorization for transaction SE16
    check_authorization( iv_auth_obj = 'S_TCODE' iv_field1 = 'TCD' iv_value1 = 'SE16' ).
    " Example: Check for S_DEVELOP authorization for object type 'CLAS'
    check_authorization( iv_auth_obj = 'S_DEVELOP' iv_field1 = 'OBJTYPE' iv_value1 = 'CLAS' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_authorization_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_authorization_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_auth_check( ).
    lo_cut->mo_out = NEW cl_abap_unit_test_out( ). " Mock output for testing

    " Testing AUTHORITY-CHECK directly in ABAP Unit is problematic as it depends on the current user's roles.
    " We can only verify that the method executes without dump and returns a boolean.
    DATA(lv_authorized_se16) = lo_cut->check_authorization( iv_auth_obj = 'S_TCODE' iv_field1 = 'TCD' iv_value1 = 'SE16' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_authorized_se16 = abap_true OR lv_authorized_se16 = abap_false ),
      msg = 'Authorization check should return a boolean value.'
    ).

    DATA(lv_authorized_dev) = lo_cut->check_authorization( iv_auth_obj = 'S_DEVELOP' iv_field1 = 'OBJTYPE' iv_value1 = 'CLAS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_authorized_dev = abap_true OR lv_authorized_dev = abap_false ),
      msg = 'Authorization check should return a boolean value.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Integration von `cl_abap_context_info` mit dem `AUTHORITY-CHECK` Statement zur Überprüfung von Benutzerberechtigungen. Es zeigt, wie der aktuelle Benutzername abgerufen und dann für eine Berechtigungsprüfung verwendet werden kann. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Sicherheitskonzept in ABAP, das hier in einem modernen Kontext präsentiert wird, um sicherzustellen, dass nur autorisierte Benutzer bestimmte Aktionen ausführen können.
keywords: cl_abap_context_info, AUTHORITY-CHECK, Security, Authorization, System Information, User

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus `sflights`, die nur die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `price` enthält. Der `price` soll dabei um 10% erhöht werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_transform_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES: tt_transformed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transform_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
          connid    = ls_flight-connid
          new_price = ls_flight-price * '1.10' ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_transform_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_prices( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_transformed_flight).
      DATA(lv_original_price) = 0.
      SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_original_price
        WHERE carrid = ls_transformed_flight-carrid
          AND connid = ls_transformed_flight-connid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          msg = 'Price should be increased by 10%'
          act = ls_transformed_flight-new_price
          exp = lv_original_price * '1.10'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_transform_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_prices( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` und `FOR` ermöglicht eine elegante und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Es ist eine deklarative Art, eine neue Tabelle zu füllen, basierend auf den Werten einer anderen, ohne explizite `LOOP`- und `APPEND`-Anweisungen, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, Transformation, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze (`seatsocc` + `seatsfree`) für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsfree
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) in einer internen Tabelle um einen festen Prozentsatz. Verwenden Sie dabei eine funktionale Methode.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die bedingte Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_itab_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_carrier_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage  TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 0 " e.g., 10 for 10%
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_itab_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_carrier_prices.
    ct_sflights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN ct_sflights
        ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid
                  THEN VALUE sflight( ls_flight EXCEPT price
                                      price = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ) ) 
                  ELSE ls_flight ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_db_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS update_flight_price_db
      IMPORTING
        is_key      TYPE ty_sflight_key
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_db_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price_db.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @is_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_sflight-price = iv_new_price.
      UPDATE sflight FROM @ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_db_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_multiple_db_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_db_multi( ).
    DATA: lt_initial_flights TYPE zcl_update_db_multi=>tt_sflight,
          lt_flights_to_update TYPE zcl_update_db_multi=>tt_sflight.

    lt_initial_flights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_initial_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        UPDATE sflight FROM ls_flight.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.

    lt_flights_to_update = lt_initial_flights.
    LOOP AT lt_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price + 50.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flights_db( EXPORTING it_flights_to_update = lt_flights_to_update ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Update should be successful' act = lv_success ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_db_flights)
      WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'UA') AND fldate = '20250101'.

    LOOP AT lt_db_flights INTO DATA(ls_db_flight).
      DATA(ls_expected_flight) = lt_flights_to_update[ KEY primary_key carrid = ls_db_flight-carrid
                                                                      connid = ls_db_flight-connid
                                                                      fldate = ls_db_flight-fldate ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'DB price should be updated' act = ls_db_flight-price exp = ls_expected_flight-price ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'UA') AND fldate = '20250101'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_db_multi( ).
    DATA lt_empty_flights TYPE zcl_update_db_multi=>tt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flights_db( EXPORTING it_flights_to_update = lt_empty_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Update with empty table should still be successful (no error)' act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der Preise. Geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_price_summary_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_summary_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                                   FOR GROUP ls_group_flight OF ls_flight
                                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_group_flight-price ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH summary should exist' act = ls_lh_summary ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH total price should match' act = ls_lh_summary-total_price exp = lv_expected_lh_price ).
    ENDIF.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA total price should match' act = ls_aa_summary-total_price exp = lv_expected_aa_price ).
    ENDIF.

In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe können komplexe Aggregationen deklarativ und effizient implementiert werden, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance verbessert.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Struktur `sflight` in eine andere Struktur mit teilweise übereinstimmenden Feldnamen. Führen Sie dies auch für interne Tabellen durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `CORRESPONDING`-Anweisung für Strukturen und Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES: tt_source_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             origin_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cost       TYPE sflight-price,
             currency   TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_target_flight.
    TYPES: tt_target_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flight_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_flight.

    METHODS map_flight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING carrid = airline_id
                                                connid = flight_num
                                                fldate = flight_date
                                                cityfrom = origin_city
                                                price = cost ).
    rs_target-currency = 'EUR'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_flight_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING carrid = airline_id
                                                connid = flight_num
                                                fldate = flight_date
                                                cityfrom = origin_city
                                                price = cost ).
    LOOP AT rt_target ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
      <fs_target>-currency = 'EUR'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_demo( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_demo=>ty_source_flight(
      carrid   = 'LH'
      connid   = '0400'
      fldate   = '20250101'
      cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
      price    = 100
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_flight_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Airline ID should match' act = ls_target-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight number should match' act = ls_target-flight_num exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight date should match' act = ls_target-flight_date exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Origin city should match' act = ls_target-origin_city exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Cost should match' act = ls_target-cost exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Currency should be EUR' act = ls_target-currency exp = 'EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_demo( ).
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_demo=>tt_source_flight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' price = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_source.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' price = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_source.

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_flight_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size should be 2' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_target_lh) = lt_target[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH Airline ID should match' act = ls_target_lh-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH Cost should match' act = ls_target_lh-cost exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH Currency should be EUR' act = ls_target_lh-currency exp = 'EUR' ).

    DATA(ls_target_aa) = lt_target[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA Airline ID should match' act = ls_target_aa-airline_id exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA Cost should match' act = ls_target_aa-cost exp = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA Currency should be EUR' act = ls_target_aa-currency exp = 'EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_db_set_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_initial_price2 WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101'.

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_db_price2) WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA 0017 price should remain 300' act = lv_db_price_aa exp = 300 ).

CLASS zcl_con_case_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_con_case_type IMPLEMENTATION.

    CONSTANTS lc_type_i TYPE c VALUE 'I'. " Repräsentiert den Typ INTEGER
    CASE TYPE OF ir_data->*.

      WHEN TYPE string.

solution:
CLASS zcl_con_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS set_field_dynamically IMPORTING iv_field_name TYPE string iv_value TYPE string CHANGING cs_data TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_dynamically.
    CONSTANTS lc_field1_name TYPE string VALUE 'FIELD1'.
    CONSTANTS lc_field2_name TYPE string VALUE 'FIELD2'.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs> TYPE any.

    IF iv_field_name = lc_field1_name.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lc_field1_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs> = CONV i( iv_value ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSEIF iv_field_name = lc_field2_name.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lc_field2_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs> = iv_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String-Parameter entgegennehmen und einen modifizierten String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen und `EXPORTING`/`IMPORTING` Parameter. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg` für eine typsichere dynamische Programmierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _reverse_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS _uppercase_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_mtddescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYN_METHOD_CALL' ).
        lo_method_descr = lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( iv_method_name ).

        " Dynamischer Methodenaufruf
        CALL METHOD (ME)->(iv_method_name)
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_input_value
          IMPORTING
            rv_output = rv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Fehler: Methode '{ iv_method_name }' konnte nicht dynamisch aufgerufen werden.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_clas_descr_error.
        rv_result = |Fehler: Klasse oder Methode '{ iv_method_name }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _reverse_string.
    rv_output = reverse( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _uppercase_string.
    rv_output = to_upper( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reverse.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = '_reverse_string' iv_input_value = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'olleH' msg = 'String sollte umgekehrt sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_uppercase.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = '_uppercase_string' iv_input_value = 'world' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'WORLD' msg = 'String sollte in Großbuchstaben sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'non_existent_method' iv_input_value = 'test' ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD (ME)->(iv_method_name)`. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_classdescr` und `cl_abap_mtddescr` ermöglicht eine typsichere Überprüfung der Methode vor dem Aufruf, was die Robustheit erhöht. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie String-Templates (`|...|`) und `NEW` für Objekterzeugung wird verwendet.
keywords: DYNAMIC, METHOD CALL, CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG, RTTI

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und lesen Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <FS>`. Die Zuweisung zu einem Feldsymbol ist hier der Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_s_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_s_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <lv_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <lv_field> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Der dynamische Feldzugriff mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <FS>` ist ein klassisches und mächtiges Feature in ABAP. In Kombination mit modernen String-Templates (`|{ <lv_field> }|`) kann der Wert eines Feldsymbols einfach in einen String konvertiert werden. Instructions: Führen Sie eine `SELECT`-Anweisung auf die Tabelle `SFLIGHT` aus, wobei die `WHERE`-Klausel dynamisch zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... WHERE (lv_where_clause)`. Achten Sie auf SQL-Injections und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_sql_condition` zur Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight,
           ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_where_clause TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    " Optional: Validierung der WHERE-Klausel zur Vermeidung von SQL-Injections
    " cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_sql_condition( iv_where_clause ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE (iv_where_clause).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim dynamischen SELECT mit WHERE-Klausel: { iv_where_clause }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_where FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_where RAISING cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_where( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( iv_where_clause = `CARRID = 'LH' AND CONNID = '0400'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden (Annahme: LH 0400 existiert)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden (Annahme: LH 0400 existiert)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_where( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error ).
    lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( iv_where_clause = `NON_EXISTENT_FIELD = 'X'` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel in `SELECT`-Anweisungen ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um Abfragen flexibel zur Laufzeit zu gestalten. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist ein Merkmal von Open SQL in modernen ABAP-Versionen (7.40+). Es ist entscheidend, die dynamisch erzeugte WHERE-Klausel sorgfältig zu validieren, um Sicherheitslücken wie SQL-Injections zu vermeiden. `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_sql_condition` kann hierfür verwendet werden (im Beispiel auskommentiert, da es eine spezifische Implementierung erfordert).
keywords: DYNAMIC, SELECT, WHERE, OPEN SQL, SFLIGHT, CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem Feld, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT lt_table BY (lv_field_name)`. Stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feld in der Tabellendefinition existiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_s_data,
           ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_data) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamic.
    rt_sorted_data = it_data.
    TRY.
        SORT rt_sorted_data BY (iv_field_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, falls Feld nicht existiert oder nicht sortierbar ist
        MESSAGE e001(sy) WITH |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' ist nicht sortierbar oder existiert nicht.| RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
