Instructions: Instanziieren Sie eine Klasse dynamisch, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die instanziierte Klasse soll eine Methode mit einer spezifischen Signatur implementieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (lv_class_name)`. Definieren Sie ein Interface, das die dynamisch instanziierten Klassen implementieren müssen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_dynamic_action.
  METHODS execute
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_action_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_action~execute.
    rv_output = |Action A: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_action~execute.
    rv_output = |Action B: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_class_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_execute
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_input      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_class_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_execute.
    DATA: lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO zif_dynamic_action.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        rv_result = lo_dynamic_object->execute( iv_input ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim Erzeugen von Klasse '{ iv_class_name }': { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die dynamische Instanziierung von Klassen mittels `CREATE OBJECT ... TYPE (lv_class_name)` ist ein Eckpfeiler der flexiblen Softwareentwicklung. Durch die Verwendung eines gemeinsamen Interfaces (`zif_dynamic_action`) wird sichergestellt, dass alle dynamisch erzeugten Objekte eine konsistente Schnittstelle für die Interaktion bieten. Dies ist ideal für Plugin-Architekturen oder Strategie-Muster.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer übergebenen Strukturdefinition und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_data` oder `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create_by_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_input,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_type TYPE string,
             field_len  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_input,
           ty_t_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        it_structure_def TYPE ty_t_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_ref     TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    LOOP AT it_structure_def INTO DATA(ls_input).
      ls_component-name = ls_input-field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( ls_input-field_type ).
      IF ls_input-field_len IS NOT INITIAL.
        ls_component-length = ls_input-field_len.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

        " Beispiel: Füllen der Tabelle mit Dummy-Daten
        CREATE DATA lr_line_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_line_ref->* TO <fs_line>.

        LOOP AT it_structure_def INTO ls_input.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_input-field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            CASE ls_input-field_type.
              WHEN 'STRING'.
                <fs_field> = |Value for { ls_input-field_name }|.
              WHEN 'I'.
                <fs_field> = 100.
              WHEN 'D'.
                <fs_field> = sy-datum.
              WHEN OTHERS.
                " Handle other types or leave empty
            ENDCASE.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim dynamischen Erzeugen der Tabelle: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_simple_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_complex_table FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_simple_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).
    DATA(lt_struct_def) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_create=>ty_t_input(
      ( field_name = 'ID' field_type = 'I' )
      ( field_name = 'TEXT' field_type = 'STRING' )
    ).

    DATA(lr_table_ref) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( lt_struct_def ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_table> msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 1 msg = 'Tabelle sollte einen Eintrag haben' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ANY.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_id> TYPE i.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_id>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_id> exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_complex_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).
    DATA(lt_struct_def) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_create=>ty_t_input(
      ( field_name = 'NAME' field_type = 'STRING' field_len = 20 )
      ( field_name = 'DATE_CREATED' field_type = 'D' )
      ( field_name = 'AMOUNT' field_type = 'P' field_len = 8 )
    ).

    DATA(lr_table_ref) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( lt_struct_def ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das dynamische Erzeugen von internen Tabellen ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das oft in generischen Frameworks oder bei der Verarbeitung von Metadaten benötigt wird. Mit `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` können zur Laufzeit beliebige Struktur- und Tabellentypen definiert werden. `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` ermöglicht dann die Instanziierung dieser dynamischen Typen. Feldsymbole sind unerlässlich, um auf die dynamisch erzeugten Daten zuzugreifen und sie zu manipulieren.
keywords: DYNAMIC, INTERNAL TABLE, CREATE DATA, RTTI, CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer sprachabhängigen Textdatei vom Applikationsserver unter Verwendung von `cl_cts_language_file_io`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_file`. Beachten Sie, dass diese Klasse für CTS-Sprachdateien gedacht ist und einen logischen Dateinamen erwartet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cts_file_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_logical_file TYPE string
        iv_language     TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_file_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_language_file.
    DATA: lv_file_path TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Ermitteln des physischen Dateipfads
        lv_file_path = cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_file_name(
          i_logical_file = iv_logical_file
          i_language     = iv_language
        ).

        " Datei lesen
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_file(
          EXPORTING
            i_file_name = lv_file_path
          IMPORTING
            e_content   = rv_content
        ).

      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_cts_language_file_io
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim Lesen der Sprachdatei '{ iv_logical_file }' ({ iv_language }): { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_existing_file FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing_file RAISING cx_cts_language_file_io FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cts_file_read( ).
    DATA(lv_test_file) = 'Z_TEST_LANG_FILE'. " Annahme: Diese logische Datei existiert und hat Inhalt
    DATA(lv_test_lang) = 'D'.
    DATA(lv_expected_content) = 'Dies ist ein Testinhalt für die Sprachdatei.'.

    " Vorbereitung: Datei schreiben, um sie später zu lesen
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_path) = cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_file_name( i_logical_file = lv_test_file i_language = lv_test_lang ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_cts_file_write_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS write_language_file_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_logical_file TYPE string
        iv_language     TYPE sy-langu
        it_lines        TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_file_write_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_language_file_lines.
    DATA: lv_file_path TYPE string,
          lv_content   TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_file_path = cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_file_name(
          i_logical_file = iv_logical_file
          i_language     = iv_language
        ).

        " Zeilen zu einem String verketten
        lv_content = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ``
          FOR <line> IN it_lines
          NEXT s = COND string(
            WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <line>
            ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <line>
          )
        ).

        cl_cts_language_file_io=>write_file(
          EXPORTING
            i_file_name = lv_file_path
            i_content   = lv_content
        ).

      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_cts_language_file_io
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim zeilenweisen Schreiben der Sprachdatei '{ iv_logical_file }' ({ iv_language }): { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie den Inhalt einer sprachabhängigen Datei in eine andere sprachabhängige Datei. Nutzen Sie `cl_cts_language_file_io`.
hint: Lesen Sie die Quelldatei und schreiben Sie den Inhalt dann in die Zieldatei.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cts_file_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_logical_file TYPE string
        iv_source_language     TYPE sy-langu
        iv_target_logical_file TYPE string
        iv_target_language     TYPE sy-langu
      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_file_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_language_file.
    DATA: lv_source_path TYPE string,
          lv_target_path TYPE string,
          lv_content     TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Quelldatei lesen
        lv_source_path = cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_file_name(
          i_logical_file = iv_source_logical_file
          i_language     = iv_source_language
        ).
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_file(
          EXPORTING
            i_file_name = lv_source_path
          IMPORTING
            e_content   = lv_content
        ).

        " Inhalt in Zieldatei schreiben
        lv_target_path = cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_file_name(
          i_logical_file = iv_target_logical_file
          i_language     = iv_target_language
        ).
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>write_file(
          EXPORTING
            i_file_name = lv_target_path
            i_content   = lv_content
        ).

      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_cts_language_file_io
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim Kopieren der Sprachdatei von '{ iv_source_logical_file }' nach '{ iv_target_logical_file }': { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_map_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ny_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

CLASS zcl_map_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ny_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( tocity = 'NEW YORK' )
                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                            connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere (seatsocc) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie den `NEW`-Operator für die Instanziierung und den `IMPORTING`-Parameter im Konstruktor.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_service.
  METHODS get_flight_details
    IMPORTING
      iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_service_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_service.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_service_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_flight_service~get_flight_details.
    " Mock implementation
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_flight_service TYPE REF TO zif_flight_service.

    METHODS process_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_flight_service TYPE REF TO zif_flight_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_flight_service = io_flight_service.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_flight.
    DATA(ls_flight) = mo_flight_service->get_flight_details(
      iv_carrid = iv_carrid
      iv_connid = iv_connid
      iv_fldate = iv_fldate
    ).
    IF ls_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_result = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } on { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } from { ls_flight-fromcity } to { ls_flight-tocity } has { ls_flight-seatsocc } occupied seats.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Flight not found.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_processor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_processor.
    " Create a mock service
    DATA(lo_mock_service) = NEW zcl_flight_service_mock( ).
    " Inject the mock service into the processor
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( io_flight_service = lo_mock_service ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_flight(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_connid = '400'
      iv_fldate = '20251203'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Flight should be found' act = lv_result exp = 'Flight not found.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konstruktor-Injektion ist ein Design-Pattern, das die Testbarkeit und Wartbarkeit von Klassen verbessert, indem Abhängigkeiten von außen übergeben werden, anstatt sie intern zu erzeugen. Dies fördert lose Kopplung.
keywords: Object Orientation, Constructor Injection, Dependency Injection, Interface, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit gleichen Namen übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
             extra_field TYPE c LENGTH 5,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map.
    DATA ls_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_struct=>ty_source.
    ls_source-field1 = 'Test1'.
    ls_source-field2 = 123.
    ls_source-field3 = 'Hello World'.

    DATA(ls_target) = NEW zcl_corresponding_struct( )->map_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field1 not mapped correctly' act = ls_target-field1 exp = ls_source-field1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field2 not mapped correctly' act = ls_target-field2 exp = ls_source-field2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Extra field should be initial' act = ls_target-extra_field ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CORRESPONDING` ermöglicht eine einfache und typsichere Zuweisung von Feldern zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit gleichen Namen, ohne explizite Feldzuweisungen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structures, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit einem einzelnen Eintrag, der aus einer bestehenden Struktur stammt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_new_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_single_entry_table
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_single_entry_table) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_new_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_single_entry_table.
    rt_single_entry_table = VALUE #( ( is_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_create_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_table.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE zcl_new_table_expression=>ty_flight_data.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0017'.
    ls_flight-fldate = '20251204'.

    DATA(lt_result) = NEW zcl_new_table_expression( )->create_single_entry_table( ls_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have one entry' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid mismatch' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = ls_flight-carrid ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Verbindung mit `( ... )` ermöglicht die direkte Initialisierung von internen Tabellen mit Werten, was besonders nützlich für die Erstellung von Tabellen mit wenigen Einträgen ist.
keywords: VALUE, Internal Tables, Table Expressions, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen, bei denen das Ergebnis einer Methode direkt als Eingabe für die nächste dient.
hint: Verwenden Sie funktionale Methodenaufrufe und `RETURNING VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_one
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

    METHODS multiply_by_two
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_one.
    rv_result = iv_value + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_by_two.
    rv_result = iv_value * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_value.
    rv_final_result = multiply_by_two( add_one( iv_initial_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_value( 5 ). " (5 + 1) * 2 = 12
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Method chaining result incorrect' act = lv_result exp = 12 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Funktionale Methodenaufrufe und die Verwendung von `RETURNING VALUE` ermöglichen es, Methodenaufrufe zu verketten, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht, ähnlich wie in funktionalen Programmiersprachen.
keywords: Methods, Method Chaining, Functional Programming, RETURNING VALUE, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_by_carrier,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count_by_carrier.
    TYPES tt_flight_count_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_group_key) = CORRESPONDING zcl_group_by_sflights=>ty_flight_count_by_carrier( ls_flight ).
      ls_group_key-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_group_key TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_lh_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'LH should have flights' act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine effiziente und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen, was die Aggregation und Verarbeitung von gruppierten Daten erheblich vereinfacht.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP AT, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in `sflight`, der von 'NEW YORK' abfliegt und mehr als 200 Passagiere hat. Wenn kein solcher Flug gefunden wird, geben Sie einen Initialwert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Tabellenexpression mit `DEFAULT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_ny_flight_over_200
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_ny_flight_over_200.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        rs_flight = lt_sflights[ fromcity = 'NEW YORK' AND seatsocc > 200 ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        CLEAR rs_flight.
    ENDTRY.

    " Modern approach with DEFAULT
    rs_flight = VALUE #( lt_sflights[ fromcity = 'NEW YORK' AND seatsocc > 200 ] DEFAULT is_initial_flight( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_initial_flight RETURNING VALUE(rs_initial) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_initial_flight.
    CLEAR rs_initial.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_found FOR TESTING. METHODS test_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression_default( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_first_ny_flight_over_200( ).

    " This test assumes such a flight exists in sflight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flight should be found' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
    IF ls_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect fromcity' act = ls_flight-fromcity exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Seats occupied should be > 200' act = ( ls_flight-seatsocc > 200 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_not_found.
    " To properly test 'not found', we'd need to mock sflight or ensure no such data exists.
    " For this example, we'll simulate by checking if the default is returned if no match.
    " This is a conceptual test, as sflight usually has data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression_default( ).
    " Temporarily clear sflight or use a custom table for a real test
    " For now, we rely on the DEFAULT behavior if no match is found.
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_first_ny_flight_over_200( ).
    " If no flight matches, ls_flight should be initial due to DEFAULT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flight should be initial if not found (conceptual)' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenexpressions mit `DEFAULT` ermöglichen es, einen Fallback-Wert zu definieren, wenn der gesuchte Eintrag in der internen Tabelle nicht gefunden wird. Dies vermeidet `CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND` und macht den Code robuster.
keywords: Table Expressions, DEFAULT, Internal Tables, Error Handling, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit aggregierten Daten aus `sflight`, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer, und berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze und die durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Flug.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
             avg_occupancy TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_agg.
    TYPES tt_flight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_flight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_aggregated_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                  GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                             connid = ls_flight-connid )
                                  ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
                                    connid = GROUP KEY-connid
                                    total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc )
                                    avg_occupancy = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT avg = 0
                                                                       FOR member IN GROUP
                                                                       NEXT avg = avg + member-seatsocc ) / GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Aggregated table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_aggregated ) ).

    " Example: Check for a specific flight (e.g., LH 400)
    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_agg_lh400) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Total seats for LH 400 should not be zero' act = ls_agg_lh400-total_seats exp = 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Avg occupancy for LH 400 should not be zero' act = ls_agg_lh400-avg_occupancy exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `VALUE` ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen in einem einzigen, hochfunktionalen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und leistungsstarke ABAP-Syntax.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, REDUCE, VALUE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle als `READ-ONLY` Parameter akzeptiert, um sicherzustellen, dass die übergebene Tabelle nicht innerhalb der Methode modifiziert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IMPORTING ... READ-ONLY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_only_parameter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_read_only_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data READ-ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_only_parameter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_read_only_table.
    " Attempting to modify it_data here would result in a syntax error.
    " For example: APPEND INITIAL LINE TO it_data. (Syntax error)
    " it_data[ 1 ]-text = 'Modified'. (Syntax error)

    rv_count = lines( it_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_read_only FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_only.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_only_parameter( ).
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_read_only_parameter=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Entry 1' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Entry 2' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->process_read_only_table( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect line count' act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
    " Verify original table is unchanged
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Original table entry 1 modified' act = lt_test_data[ 1 ]-text exp = 'Entry 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Zusatz `READ-ONLY` für `IMPORTING`-Parameter stellt sicher, dass die übergebenen Daten innerhalb der Methode nicht verändert werden können. Dies erhöht die Code-Sicherheit und -Klarheit, da es explizit die Absicht des Parameters kommuniziert.
keywords: Methods, Parameters, READ-ONLY, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_sel001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_example_sel001( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights( ).
    " In a real system, ensure SFLIGHTS contains data for 'LH' on '20250101' for a meaningful test.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No flights found, check SFLIGHTS data' ).
    " Example for asserting if data is expected:

    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 flight' ).

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `SUM` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_example_sel002 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechne die verbleibende Menge eines Artikels, indem du alle Entnahmen von der Anfangsmenge subtrahierst, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator mit `COND` für bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_example_tab001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_movement,
             movement_type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'I' for initial/inflow, 'O' for outflow
             quantity      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_movement.
    TYPES tt_item_movement TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_movement WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_remaining_quantity
      IMPORTING
        it_movements TYPE tt_item_movement
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining_quantity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_example_tab001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_quantity.
    rv_remaining_quantity = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_qty = 0
      FOR wa IN it_movements
      NEXT total_qty = COND #( WHEN wa-movement_type = 'I' THEN total_qty + wa-quantity
                               WHEN wa-movement_type = 'O' THEN total_qty - wa-quantity
                               ELSE total_qty ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_tab001 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_quantity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_tab001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_quantity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_example_tab001( ).
    DATA(lt_movements) = VALUE zcl_abap_ai_example_tab001=>tt_item_movement(
      ( movement_type = 'I' quantity = 100 )
      ( movement_type = 'O' quantity = 20 )
      ( movement_type = 'O' quantity = 30 )
      ( movement_type = 'I' quantity = 10 ) ).

    DATA(lv_remaining_quantity) = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_quantity( lt_movements ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining_quantity exp = 60 msg = 'Incorrect remaining quantity' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_movements) = VALUE zcl_abap_ai_example_tab001=>tt_item_movement( ).
    lv_remaining_quantity = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_quantity( lt_empty_movements ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining_quantity exp = 0 msg = 'Expected 0 for empty movements' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein leistungsstarker Operator, der die Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen auf eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Weise ermöglicht. In Kombination mit `COND` können komplexe bedingte Logiken direkt im Ausdruck abgebildet werden, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht als traditionelle Schleifen mit `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, COND, Internal Tables, SUBTRACT, VALUE

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug die Anzahl der freien Sitze berechnet (Gesamtsitze - belegte Sitze).
hint: Nutze `FOR` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_example_tab002 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_seats,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid         TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate         TYPE s_date,
             total_seats    TYPE s_seatsmax,
             occupied_seats TYPE s_seatsocc,
             free_seats     TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_seats.
    TYPES tt_flight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflights_raw,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflights_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflights_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights_raw TYPE tt_sflights_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_free_seats) TYPE tt_flight_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_example_tab002 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_free_seats.
    rt_free_seats = VALUE #( " Inline declaration for the result table
      FOR wa IN it_sflights_raw " Loop over the input table
      ( carrid         = wa-carrid
        connid         = wa-connid
        fldate         = wa-fldate
        total_seats    = wa-seatsmax
        occupied_seats = wa-seatsocc
        free_seats     = wa-seatsmax - wa-seatsocc ) ). " Calculate free seats
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_tab002 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_tab002 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_example_tab002( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_raw) = VALUE zcl_abap_ai_example_tab002=>tt_sflights_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 100 ) ).

    DATA(lt_free_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_free_seats( lt_sflights_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_free_seats ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_free_seats INTO DATA(ls_lh_flight) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 msg = 'LH flight not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_flight-free_seats exp = 50 msg = 'Incorrect free seats for LH 0400' ).

    READ TABLE lt_free_seats INTO DATA(ls_ua_flight) WITH KEY carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( exp = 0 msg = 'UA flight not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_flight-free_seats exp = 0 msg = 'Incorrect free seats for UA 0001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in `VALUE` Ausdrücken ermöglicht die Transformation von internen Tabellen auf eine sehr lesbare und funktionale Weise. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu schreiben, kann die neue Tabelle direkt aus der Quelltabelle abgeleitet werden, wobei Berechnungen wie die Subtraktion der belegten Sitze von den Gesamtsitzen inline durchgeführt werden.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, SUBTRACT, Functional Programming

Instructions: Wähle die zweite Seite von Flugdaten (5 Einträge pro Seite) aus `sflights` aus, sortiert nach Flugdatum.

solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_example_sel005 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_page,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_page.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_example_sel005 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_page.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      ORDER BY fldate, carrid, connid
      OFFSET @iv_offset ROWS
      FETCH NEXT @iv_limit ROWS ONLY
      INTO TABLE @rt_page.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has at least 10 entries for a second page to exist.

    DATA(lt_page1) = lo_cut->get_flight_page( iv_offset = 0 iv_limit = 5 ).

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_example_sel006 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate      TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc    TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax    TYPE s_seatsmax,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei Klassen, `ZCL_PROTECTED_DATA` und `ZCL_DATA_ACCESSOR`. `ZCL_PROTECTED_DATA` soll eine private Instanzvariable haben. `ZCL_DATA_ACCESSOR` soll als `FRIENDS` von `ZCL_PROTECTED_DATA` deklariert werden, um auf diese private Variable zugreifen zu können. Implementieren Sie eine Methode in `ZCL_DATA_ACCESSOR`, die den Wert der privaten Variable von `ZCL_PROTECTED_DATA` setzt und liest.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FRIENDS` Deklaration in der `CLASS ... DEFINITION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_protected_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_private_value TYPE i.
    FRIENDS zcl_data_accessor. " Grant access to ZCL_DATA_ACCESSOR
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_protected_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_private_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_private_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_and_get_protected_value
      IMPORTING
        io_protected_data TYPE REF TO zcl_protected_data
        iv_new_value      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_read_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_and_get_protected_value.
    " Access private member directly due to FRIENDS declaration
    io_protected_data->mv_private_value = iv_new_value.
    rv_read_value = io_protected_data->mv_private_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friends_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friends_access.
    DATA(lo_protected) = NEW zcl_protected_data( 10 ).
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_data_accessor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_protected->get_value( )
      exp = 10
      msg = 'Initial value should be 10' ).

    DATA(lv_new_value) = 25.
    DATA(lv_read_back) = lo_accessor->set_and_get_protected_value(
                           io_protected_data = lo_protected
                           iv_new_value      = lv_new_value ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_read_back
      exp = lv_new_value
      msg = 'Value set by friend should be read back correctly' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_protected->get_value( )
      exp = lv_new_value
      msg = 'Protected object''s value should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration ermöglicht einen kontrollierten Zugriff auf private und geschützte Komponenten einer Klasse, ohne die Kapselung vollständig aufzuheben. Dies ist nützlich für Testklassen, Factory-Klassen oder eng gekoppelte Helferklassen, die direkten Zugriff benötigen, aber nicht Teil der öffentlichen Schnittstelle sein sollen. Es ist eine moderne Alternative zu `PUBLIC` Attributen oder komplexen Getter/Setter-Methoden für spezielle Anwendungsfälle.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Encapsulation, Class, Private

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') und geben Sie die Flugnummern und Abflugorte aus. Nutzen Sie moderne Open SQL Syntax und eine `FOR`-Schleife zur Ausgabe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flights.
    " Using string templates and FOR loop for modern output
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_demo_output=>write( |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_flight-carrid }, Flugnummer: { ls_flight-connid }, Abflugort: { ls_flight-cityfrom }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_demo_output=>display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Die `FOR`-Schleife in Kombination mit String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Verarbeitung und Ausgabe der Daten. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere (SUM(SEATSMAX)) für alle Flüge der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA') unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem initialen Wert und einer Schleife über die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_max_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_max_seats.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_reduce_seats.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_sflights_reduce( ).

    " Test for carrier 'AA'

    " Manually verify expected value (e.g., by checking SFLIGHTS data)
    " For 'AA', sum of SEATSMAX is typically 1500 (5 flights * 300 seats)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_aa
      exp = 1500 " This value depends on your SFLIGHTS data for 'AA'
      msg = 'Gesamtzahl der Sitze für AA sollte 1500 sein.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 0
      msg = 'Gesamtzahl der Sitze für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft sollte 0 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren. Er ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Syntax für Operationen wie Summenbildung, Zählen oder das Finden von Min/Max-Werten, ohne explizite `LOOP`- und `ENDLOOP`-Statements. Dies verbessert die Code-Qualität und Wartbarkeit.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die eine maximale Sitzplatzkapazität von über 300 haben und deren Abflugort 'FRANKFURT' ist. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_large_flights_from_frankfurt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_flights_from_frankfurt.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights
                                    WHERE seatsmax > 300 AND cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_large_flights_from_frankfurt( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_filtered
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden, die die Kriterien erfüllen.' ).

    " Verify conditions for each filtered flight
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax > 300 )
        msg = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid } hat nicht genug Sitze.| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-cityfrom
        exp = 'FRANKFURT'
        msg = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid } startet nicht in FRANKFURT.| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Bedingungen zu filtern. Im Gegensatz zu einer manuellen `LOOP`-Schleife mit `DELETE` oder `APPEND` ist `FILTER` prägnanter, lesbarer und oft performanter, da es intern optimiert werden kann. Es ist ein Schlüsselmerkmal der modernen ABAP-Syntax für die Datenmanipulation.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming, WHERE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (Carrid, Connid) erzeugt und diese dann in einer Kette von Methodenaufrufen manipuliert (z.B. hinzufügen, sortieren, ausgeben). Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `NEW` für die Initialisierung und Method Chaining.
hint: Definieren Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_flight_key,
      tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_builder.

    METHODS sort_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_builder.

    METHODS get_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_keys.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ) TO mt_flights.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD sort_flights.
    SORT mt_flights BY carrid ASCENDING connid ASCENDING.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_flight_builder( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_builder->add_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' )
                               ->add_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' )
                               ->add_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0401' )
                               ->sort_flights( )
                               ->get_flights( ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_flight_builder=>tt_flight_keys(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result
      exp = lt_expected
      msg = 'Die sortierte Flugliste sollte korrekt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt hintereinander ausgeführt werden können. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. In Kombination mit `VALUE`-Konstruktorausdrücken für die Initialisierung von Datenstrukturen entsteht ein sehr moderner und ausdrucksstarker ABAP-Stil.
keywords: Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, VALUE, NEW, Constructor Expressions, Object Orientation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) pro Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in Open SQL.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_max_seats_by_carrier,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        max_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_max_seats_by_carrier,
      tt_max_seats_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_seats_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

'Wuff' für Hund, 'Miau' für Katze).
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE TYPE OF <reference_variable> WHEN TYPE <specific_type> INTO <data_reference>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_animal DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_animal_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_animal.
    CASE TYPE OF io_animal.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_dog INTO DATA(lo_dog).
        rv_action_result = |Hund sagt: { lo_dog->make_sound( ) }|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_cat INTO DATA(lo_cat).

Es ersetzt die ältere und unsichere `CAST`-Operation und ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration einer Datenreferenz (`INTO DATA(lo_dog)`), die bereits auf den spezifischen Typ gecastet ist. Dies verbessert die Typsicherheit und Lesbarkeit bei der Arbeit mit Objekt-Hierarchien.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer) in einer internen Tabelle existiert. Wenn ja, geben Sie eine Bestätigung zurück; andernfalls eine Fehlermeldung. Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Operator in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND string( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( ... ) THEN ... ELSE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_flight_key,
      tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_keys
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] )
        THEN |Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } existiert in der Liste.|
      ELSE
        |Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } existiert NICHT in der Liste.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_line_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_exists.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_sflights_check( ).

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflights_check=>tt_flight_keys(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).

    " Test existing flight
    DATA(lv_message_exists) = lo_checker->check_flight_existence(
                                 it_flights = lt_test_flights
                                 iv_carrid  = 'LH'
                                 iv_connid  = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message_exists
      exp = 'Flug LH-0400 existiert in der Liste.'
      msg = 'Nachricht für existierenden Flug ist falsch.' ).

    " Test non-existing flight
    DATA(lv_message_not_exists) = lo_checker->check_flight_existence(
                                     it_flights = lt_test_flights
                                     iv_carrid  = 'BA'
                                     iv_connid  = '0100' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message_not_exists
      exp = 'Flug BA-0100 existiert NICHT in der Liste.'
      msg = 'Nachricht für nicht existierenden Flug ist falsch.' ).

    " Test with empty table
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflights_check=>tt_flight_keys( ).
    DATA(lv_message_empty) = lo_checker->check_flight_existence(
                                 it_flights = lt_empty_flights
                                 iv_carrid  = 'LH'
                                 iv_connid  = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message_empty
      exp = 'Flug LH-0400 existiert NICHT in der Liste.'
      msg = 'Nachricht für leere Liste ist falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus dem `COND`-Operator und der `LINE_EXISTS`-Funktion bietet eine sehr elegante und performante Möglichkeit, die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen. `LINE_EXISTS` ist speziell für diesen Zweck optimiert und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten `READ TABLE` Operation mit anschließender `SY-SUBRC`-Prüfung. Dies führt zu kürzerem, klarerem und effizienterem Code, insbesondere bei der Arbeit mit Tabellenausdrücken.
keywords: COND, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Table Expressions

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze. Nutzen Sie den `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_itab_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flight_count TYPE i,
        total_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_itab_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_seats  = REDUCE sflight-seatsmax( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsmax ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_itab_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_itab_group_by.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_sflights_itab_group( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_grouper->get_flight_summary_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_summary
      msg = 'Es sollten Flugzusammenfassungen gefunden werden.' ).

    " Example assertion: Check summary for 'LH'
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_sflights_itab_group=>ty_flight_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_lh_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_lh_summary-carrid
      msg = 'Eintrag für LH sollte gefunden werden.'
      reverse = abap_true ).

    " These values depend on your SFLIGHTS data for 'LH'
    " Assuming LH has 5 flights, and total seatsmax is 2500 (5*500)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count
      exp = 5 " Adjust based on your SFLIGHTS data
      msg = 'Anzahl der Flüge für LH sollte 5 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_summary-total_seats
      exp = 2500 " Adjust based on your SFLIGHTS data
      msg = 'Gesamtsitzplätze für LH sollten 2500 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY`-Ausdruck ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature für die interne Tabellenverarbeitung. Er ermöglicht das Gruppieren von Tabellenzeilen und die Aggregation von Werten innerhalb jeder Gruppe in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu manuellen `LOOP`-Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END` oder dem Sortieren und Zählen von Hand. Die Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenaggregation zeigt die Flexibilität dieser Syntax.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur in einen JSON-String.
hint: Die `serialize`-Methode von `/ui2/cl_abap2json` funktioniert auch für Strukturen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_simple_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sgeocity-cityname,
             cityto   TYPE sgeocity-cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_flight_as_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_simple_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_as_json.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_info.

    SELECT SINGLE
        a~carrid, a~connid, a~fldate,
        b~cityname AS cityfrom,
        c~cityname AS cityto
      FROM sflight AS a
      INNER JOIN spfli AS d ON a~carrid = d~carrid AND a~connid = d~connid
      INNER JOIN sgeocity AS b ON d~cityfrom = b~cityid
      INNER JOIN sgeocity AS c ON d~cityto = c~cityid
      WHERE a~carrid = @iv_carrid AND a~connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @ls_flight.

    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_abap2json=>serialize( ls_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit geschachtelten Strukturen oder Tabellen in einen JSON-String.
hint: Die Klasse `/ui2/cl_abap2json` handhabt geschachtelte Typen automatisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_nested_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
             custtype TYPE sbook-custtype,
           END OF ty_booking.
    TYPES: tt_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookings TYPE tt_booking,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_nested_data_as_json
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_nested_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_data_as_json.
    DATA: lt_flight_detail TYPE tt_flight_detail,
          ls_flight_detail TYPE ty_flight_detail,
          lt_booking       TYPE tt_booking,
          ls_booking       TYPE ty_booking.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO @ls_flight_detail.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SELECT bookid, custtype
        FROM sbook
        WHERE carrid = @ls_flight_detail-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_flight_detail-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_flight_detail-fldate
        UP TO 2 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @lt_booking.
      ls_flight_detail-bookings = lt_booking.
      APPEND ls_flight_detail TO lt_flight_detail.
    ENDIF.

    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_abap2json=>serialize( lt_flight_detail ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'JSON string should contain "bookings"' act = lv_json CS '"bookings"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'JSON string should contain "bookid"' act = lv_json CS '"bookid"' ).

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine Struktur, wobei leere (initiale) Felder nicht im JSON-Output erscheinen sollen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_json_omit_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_json_omit_initial
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_omit_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_json_omit_initial.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_data.

    ls_data-field1 = 'Value1'.

    " field3 bleibt initial (leer)"

CLASS zcl_xlsx_create_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_xlsx_create_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_sheet    TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lt_sflight  TYPE tt_sflight,
          lv_row      TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_col      TYPE i VALUE 1.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.
    lo_sheet = lo_xlsx->create_sheet( 'Flugdaten' ).

    " Header schreiben
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE 'Carrier ID' ).
    lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE 'Connection ID' ).
    lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE 'Flight Date' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHTS lesen
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 3 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    " Daten in Zellen schreiben
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_col = 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE ls_sflight-connid ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rx_xlsx_data = lo_xlsx->get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_formatted_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_sheet1   TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_sheet2   TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_style_bold TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_style,
          lo_style_yellow TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_style,
          lt_sflight  TYPE tt_sflight.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.

    " Stil für Fettdruck erstellen
    lo_style_bold = lo_xlsx->create_style( ).
    lo_style_bold->set_font_bold( abap_true ).

    " Stil für gelben Hintergrund erstellen
    lo_style_yellow = lo_xlsx->create_style( ).
    lo_style_yellow->set_fill_pattern( cl_xlsx_style=>c_fill_solid ).
    lo_style_yellow->set_fill_background_color( 'FFFF00' ). " Gelb

    " Erstes Arbeitsblatt
    lo_sheet1 = lo_xlsx->create_sheet( 'Flüge' ).
    lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 VALUE 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_sheet1->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_style = lo_style_bold ).
    lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 VALUE 'Flugnummer' ).
    lo_sheet1->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_style = lo_style_bold ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 2 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = sy-tabix + 1 ip_column = 1 VALUE ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = sy-tabix + 1 ip_column = 2 VALUE ls_sflight-connid ).
      IF sy-tabix = 1.
        lo_sheet1->set_cell_style( ip_row = sy-tabix + 1 ip_column = 1 ip_style = lo_style_yellow ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Zweites Arbeitsblatt
    lo_sheet2 = lo_xlsx->create_sheet( 'Zusatzinfo' ).
    lo_sheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 VALUE 'Info' ).
    lo_sheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 VALUE 'Dies ist ein Test.' ).

    rx_xlsx_data = lo_xlsx->get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XLSX-Dokument mit dynamischen Spaltenüberschriften und verschiedenen Datentypen (Text, Zahl, Datum) basierend auf einer beliebigen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Struktur der internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und die Zellen entsprechend zu befüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_xlsx_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_sheet    TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>t_component_table,
          lv_row      TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_col      TYPE i VALUE 1.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.
    lo_sheet = lo_xlsx->create_sheet( 'Dynamische Daten' ).

    " RTTI: Struktur der internen Tabelle ermitteln
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Header schreiben
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE ls_component-name ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Daten schreiben
    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      lv_col = 1.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE ls_component-type_kind.
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
              lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE <fs_field> ).
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_p.
              lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE <fs_field> ).
            WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
              lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE <fs_field> ).
            WHEN OTHERS.
              " Weitere Typen behandeln oder als String schreiben
              lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col VALUE CONV string( <fs_field> ) ).
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rx_xlsx_data = lo_xlsx->get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

           END OF ty_test_data.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_xlsx.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_test_data,
          ls_data TYPE ty_test_data.

    ls_data-text_field = 'Hello'.
    ls_data-num_field = 123.
    ls_data-date_field = sy-datum.
    APPEND ls_data TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_dynamic_data( ).
    DATA(lx_xlsx_data) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_xlsx( lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'XLSX data should not be empty' act = lx_xlsx_data IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Header Text_Field incorrect' act = read_cell_value( ix_xlsx_data = lx_xlsx_data ip_row = 1 ip_col = 1 ) exp = 'TEXT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Data Text_Field incorrect' act = read_cell_value( ix_xlsx_data = lx_xlsx_data ip_row = 2 ip_col = 1 ) exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Data Num_Field incorrect' act = read_cell_value( ix_xlsx_data = lx_xlsx_data ip_row = 2 ip_col = 2 ) exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Data Date_Field incorrect' act = read_cell_value( ix_xlsx_data = lx_xlsx_data ip_row = 2 ip_col = 3 ) exp = CONV string( sy-datum ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_cell_value.
    DATA: lo_xlsx  TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_sheet TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet.
    TRY.
        lo_xlsx = cl_xlsx_document=>load_document( ix_xlsx_data ).
        lo_sheet = lo_xlsx->get_active_worksheet( ).
        rv_value = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = ip_row ip_column = ip_col ).
      CATCH cx_xlsx_document_error.
        rv_value = 'ERROR'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ermöglicht die dynamische Erstellung von XLSX-Dateien mit korrekten Spaltenüberschriften und der passenden Behandlung verschiedener Datentypen, was für generische Exportfunktionen unerlässlich ist.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_chart_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rx_xlsx_data) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_chart_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xlsx_with_chart.
    DATA: lo_xlsx     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_sheet    TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_chart    TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_chart.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.
    lo_sheet = lo_xlsx->create_sheet( 'Daten mit Chart' ).

    " Daten für das Diagramm
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 VALUE 'Kategorie' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 VALUE 'Wert' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 VALUE 'A' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 2 VALUE 10 ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 1 VALUE 'B' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 2 VALUE 25 ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 4 ip_column = 1 VALUE 'C' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 4 ip_column = 2 VALUE 15 ).

    " Diagramm erstellen
    lo_chart = lo_xlsx->create_chart( ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_xlsx_chart=>c_chart_type_column ).
    lo_chart->set_title( 'Beispiel-Chart' ).
    lo_chart->add_series( iv_category_range = 'A2:A4'
                          iv_value_range    = 'B2:B4'
                          iv_sheet_name     = 'Daten mit Chart' ).

    " Diagramm zum Arbeitsblatt hinzufügen
    lo_sheet->add_chart( ip_chart = lo_chart
                          ip_from_col = 4 ip_from_row = 1
                          ip_to_col = 10 ip_to_row = 15 ).

    rx_xlsx_data = lo_xlsx->get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie den Aufruf eines OData-Dienstes (z.B. für Mitarbeiterdaten) und parsen Sie die JSON-Antwort, um spezifische Informationen zu extrahieren. Nehmen Sie an, der Dienst liefert eine Liste von Mitarbeitern mit 'EmployeeID' und 'Name'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` für den Aufruf und `cl_abap_json=>deserialize` zum Parsen der JSON-Antwort in eine interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_odata_employee_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_employee,
        employee_id TYPE string,
        name        TYPE string,
      END OF ty_employee,
      tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_employee_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_response TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE tt_employees
      RAISING
        cx_static_check. " For JSON deserialization errors

  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_employee_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_employee_data.
    DATA(lt_employees_raw) = VALUE tt_employees( ). " Initialize with empty table

    cl_abap_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json        = iv_json_response
        pretty_mode = abap_false
      CHANGING
        data        = lt_employees_raw
    ).

    " In a real scenario, OData responses often have a 'd' or 'value' wrapper.
    " For simplicity, we assume direct array of employees.
    " If it were wrapped, e.g., { "d": { "results": [...] } },
    " you'd need to deserialize into a structure matching that.
    rt_employees = lt_employees_raw.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_valid_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_employee_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"employee_id":"001","name":"Alice"},{"employee_id":"002","name":"Bob"}]`.
    DATA(lt_employees) = lo_cut->parse_employee_data( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_employees )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 employees'
    ).

    DATA(ls_employee1) = lt_employees[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_employee1-employee_id
      exp = '001'
      msg = 'Employee 1 ID mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_employee1-name
      exp = 'Alice'
      msg = 'Employee 1 Name mismatch'

  METHOD test_parse_invalid_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_employee_parser( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
