      exp_class = 'CX_SY_JSON_SERIALIZER_ERROR'
      msg = 'Expected CX_SY_JSON_SERIALIZER_ERROR for invalid JSON'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Klasse `cl_abap_json` bietet eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit zur Deserialisierung von JSON-Daten, ohne manuelle String-Manipulationen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (CARRID), Verbindungsnummer (CONNID) und den Preis (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, aber nur für Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie dabei `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR` Schleife innerhalb eines `VALUE` Konstruktors, um die Daten zu filtern und zu projizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        price  TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_info,
      tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        price  = ls_flight-price ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 1000 ). " Assuming some flights are > 1000

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Expected some flights, but table is empty'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_flight-price > 1000
        msg = 'Flight price not above minimum threshold'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 999999 ). " Very high price, likely no flights

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Expected no flights for very high price threshold'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE` und `FOR` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite `LOOP` Schleife zu schreiben, wird die neue Tabelle direkt mit den gewünschten, gefilterten und projizierten Daten initialisiert. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionales Programmieren in ABAP.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Begrüßungstext generiert. Der Text soll Platzhalter für den Namen und das Datum enthalten. Anschließend soll ein spezifisches Wort im generierten Text durch ein anderes ersetzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie String Templates (`|...|`) für die Textgenerierung und die funktionale Form von `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_templates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_and_replace_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_templates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_replace_text.
    DATA(lv_initial_text) = |Hallo { iv_name }, heute ist der { iv_date DATE = ISO }. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Mitarbeit.|.

    rv_result_text = REPLACE(
      val = lv_initial_text
      occ = 1
      sub = 'Mitarbeit'
      with = 'Zusammenarbeit'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_text_generation_and_replace FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_text_generation_and_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_templates( ).
    DATA(lv_name) = 'Max Mustermann'.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_expected_date_iso) = |{ lv_date DATE = ISO }|. " Format date for comparison

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->generate_and_replace_text(
      iv_name = lv_name
      iv_date = lv_date
    ).

    DATA(lv_expected_part1) = |Hallo { lv_name }, heute ist der { lv_expected_date_iso }. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Zusammenarbeit.|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = lv_expected_part1
      msg = 'Generated and replaced text does not match expected value'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Zusammenarbeit'
      msg = 'Replaced word "Zusammenarbeit" not found'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Mitarbeit'
      msg = 'Original word "Mitarbeit" should not be present'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die funktionale Form von `REPLACE` ermöglicht eine kompakte Ersetzung von Teilstrings, ohne dass eine separate Variable für das Ergebnis benötigt wird.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie dafür den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE s_price
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_for_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_price_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'. " Lufthansa, usually has flights in sflights
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0 TYPE s_price.

    " Calculate expected price manually for comparison
    DATA lt_sflights_lh TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_lh WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_lh INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_expected_price = lv_expected_price + ls_flight-price.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = lv_expected_price
      msg = 'Total price for carrier does not match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'. " Non-existent carrier
    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Expected 0 for non-existent carrier'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable schrittweise aufzubauen, indem über die Elemente einer Tabelle iteriert wird. Dies ersetzt oft explizite `LOOP` Schleifen mit Zwischenvariablen und führt zu kompakterem und funktionalerem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights`, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und mit einem bestimmten Abflugort (CITYFROM) zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER` Operator ist die moderne Art, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
        cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
      END OF ty_flight_key,
      tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_cityfrom TYPE s_cityname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND cityfrom = iv_cityfrom 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem numerischen Wert eine Textbeschreibung zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie `COND` für eine einfache Bedingung und `SWITCH` für mehrere mögliche Werte.
hint: `COND` und `SWITCH` sind moderne Ausdrücke für bedingte Zuweisungen, die `IF` und `CASE` Anweisungen in vielen Fällen ersetzen können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_description_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_priority_description_switch
      IMPORTING
        iv_priority_level TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description_cond.
    rv_description = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 1 THEN 'Aktiv'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 2 THEN 'Inaktiv'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_priority_description_switch.
    rv_description = SWITCH string(
      iv_priority_level
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Hoch'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Mittel'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Niedrig'
      ELSE 'Nicht definiert'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine interne Tabelle. Demonstrieren Sie dabei die moderne Open SQL Syntax mit Hostvariablen (`@`) und `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`. Zeigen Sie, dass `CLOSE CURSOR` nicht mehr explizit benötigt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und Hostvariablen (`@`) für die WHERE-Klausel. Die Cursorverwaltung erfolgt implizit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_open_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
        cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
        price    TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight,
      tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_open_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    " Moderne Open SQL Syntax: Hostvariablen mit '@' und Inline-Deklaration mit DATA(...)
    " Der Cursor wird implizit geöffnet und geschlossen, kein explizites OPEN/FETCH/CLOSE CURSOR nötig.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_raw)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_flights = lt_flights_raw.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die moderne Open SQL Syntax ab ABAP 7.40 vereinfacht den Datenbankzugriff erheblich. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` und die Inline-Deklaration von Datenobjekten mit `DATA(...)` machen den Code kürzer und lesbarer. Vor allem entfällt die Notwendigkeit, Cursor explizit zu öffnen, zu fetchen und zu schließen (`OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR`, `CLOSE CURSOR`), da dies bei `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` implizit gehandhabt wird.
keywords: Open SQL, Host Variables, DATA, INTO TABLE, CLOSE CURSOR (obsolete), sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null simuliert und eine eigene, klassenbasierte Ausnahme auslöst. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme in einer aufrufenden Methode ab und behandeln Sie sie.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, die von `cx_static_check` erbt. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.

    METHODS perform_division_with_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_division_with_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
        rv_message = |Division erfolgreich: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero.
        rv_message = 'Fehler: Division durch Null nicht erlaubt!' .
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_message = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_division_by_zero.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero_handled FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handling( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 )
      exp_class = 'ZCX_DIVISION_BY_ZERO'
      msg = 'Expected ZCX_DIVISION_BY_ZERO for division by zero'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_handled.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_division_with_handling( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message
      exp = 'Fehler: Division durch Null nicht erlaubt!'
      msg = 'Expected specific error message for handled exception'
    ).

    lv_message = lo_cut->perform_division_with_handling( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_message
      exp = 'Division erfolgreich: 2.0000000000000000E+00'
      msg = 'Expected success message for valid division'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Klassenbasierte Ausnahmen sind der moderne Standard für die Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen eine strukturierte und typsichere Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken. Das Definieren eigener Ausnahmeklassen verbessert die Klarheit und Wartbarkeit des Codes, da spezifische Fehlerzustände klar identifiziert und behandelt werden können, anstatt generische Rückgabecodes zu verwenden.
keywords: Exception Handling, TRY, CATCH, Class-Based Exceptions, RAISE EXCEPTION

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie effizient, ob ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert, und lesen Sie ihn anschließend aus. Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und den Tabellenausdruck (`[]`) für den Zugriff.
hint: `LINE_EXISTS` ist eine performante Methode zur Existenzprüfung, und Tabellenausdrücke ermöglichen direkten Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        key   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data,
      tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS check_and_read_entry
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_key  TYPE c LENGTH 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_read_entry.
    IF line_exists( it_data[ key = iv_key ] ).
      rv_value = it_data[ key = iv_key ]-value.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Eintrag nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` ist eine moderne und performante Funktion, um die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, ohne einen Laufzeitfehler zu verursachen, falls die Zeile nicht gefunden wird. In Kombination mit dem Tabellenausdruck (`[]`) ermöglicht dies einen sehr kompakten und effizienten Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen, der `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC` in vielen Fällen ersetzt.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Tagen zwischen zwei Datumsangaben und addieren Sie eine bestimmte Anzahl von Tagen zu einem Datum. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Funktionen und -Klassen.

CLASS zcl_date_time_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_date1 TYPE d

CLASS zcl_date_time_ops IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD add_days_to_date.
    " Direkte Datumsarithmetik ab ABAP 7.40
    rv_new_date = iv_start_date + iv_days_to_add.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Klassenhierarchie mit einer abstrakten Basisklasse und zwei konkreten Unterklassen. Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie durch den Aufruf einer Methode über eine Referenz auf die Basisklasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT` für die Basisklasse und `REDEFINITION` in den Unterklassen. Instanziieren Sie Objekte mit `NEW` und weisen Sie sie einer Basisklassenreferenz zu.

CLASS zcl_animal DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS make_sound ABSTRACT.
    METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_animal IMPLEMENTATION.

    METHODS get_type REDEFINITION.

  METHOD make_sound.
    WRITE: / 'Wuff!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_type.
    rv_type = 'Hund'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS make_sound REDEFINITION.
    METHODS get_type REDEFINITION.

CLASS zcl_cat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD make_sound.
    WRITE: / 'Miau!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_type.
    rv_type = 'Katze'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zoo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_polymorphism.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zoo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_polymorphism.
    DATA: lo_animal TYPE REF TO zcl_animal.

    lo_animal = NEW zcl_dog( ).
    WRITE: / |Typ: { lo_animal->get_type( ) }|. " Output: Typ: Hund
    lo_animal->make_sound( ). " Output: Wuff!

    lo_animal = NEW zcl_cat( ).
    WRITE: / |Typ: { lo_animal->get_type( ) }|. " Output: Typ: Katze
    lo_animal->make_sound( ). " Output: Miau!
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run Time Type Information), um den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und dessen Komponenten dynamisch auszulesen. Demonstrieren Sie dies für eine Struktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_structdescr` für die Typbeschreibung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
      END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA: lo_descr_ref TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          ls_component TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_descr_ref = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_descr_ref.

        ls_component = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

        LOOP AT ls_component INTO DATA(ls_comp_info).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp_info-name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND |{ ls_comp_info-name }: { <fs_value> }| TO rt_components.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        APPEND 'Fehler: Das übergebene Objekt ist keine Struktur.' TO rt_components.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        APPEND 'Fehler: Typbeschreibung konnte nicht ermittelt werden.' TO rt_components.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_struct_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_struct_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_struct_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_access=>ty_flight_data.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_flight-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_struct_components( ls_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_components[ 1 ] exp = 'CARRID: LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_components[ 2 ] exp = 'CONNID: 0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_components[ 4 ] exp = 'CITYFROM: FRANKFURT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_struct_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_struct_components( lv_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_components[ 1 ] exp = 'Fehler: Das übergebene Objekt ist keine Struktur.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Typinformationen von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und dynamisch auf deren Komponenten zuzugreifen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Programme, die mit unterschiedlichen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen, ohne diese zur Kompilierzeit zu kennen. Die Kombination von `cl_abap_typedescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` bietet eine robuste Lösung für solche Szenarien.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Type Description, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining, indem Sie mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt hintereinander ausführen, wobei jede Methode das Objekt selbst zurückgibt.
hint: Jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, muss `ME` als Rückgabewert vom Typ der eigenen Klasse definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_builder.

    METHODS set_value2
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_builder.

    METHODS get_combined_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_combined) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck ist die moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
        total_price TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_price = REDUCE #( INIT p = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP ( p = p + <member>-price ) )
      ).
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summaries msg = 'Expected flight summaries' ).

    " Check a specific carrier if it exists in sflights
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_itab_group_by=>ty_flight_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO ls_lh_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 msg = 'LH flight count should be > 0' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-total_price > 0 msg = 'LH total price should be > 0' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_flights.
    " To test with empty sflights, one would need to mock the DB access
    " For simplicity, we assume sflights is never truly empty in a test system.
    " A more robust test would involve injecting test data or mocking.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summaries msg = 'Expected summaries even if sflights is small' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck ist eine der mächtigsten Neuerungen in ABAP 7.40 für die Verarbeitung interner Tabellen. Er ermöglicht das Gruppieren von Zeilen und die Durchführung von Aggregationen (wie `GROUP SIZE` oder `REDUCE` über `GROUP`) direkt in der Schleife. Dies ersetzt komplexe `SORT`, `LOOP` mit `AT NEW`/`AT END` und `COLLECT` Konstrukte durch eine viel lesbarere und effizientere Syntax.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, Aggregation, LOOP AT, REDUCE, sflights

CLASS zcl_cdo_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      EXPORTING
        et_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cdo_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    et_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate = iv_fldate )
                          ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
                            connid   = ls_flight-connid
                            fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
                            cityfrom = ls_flight-cityfrom
                            cityto   = ls_flight-cityto ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( |Gefilterte Flüge für { iv_carrid } am { iv_fldate }:| )->line( ).
    cl_demo_output=>write_data( et_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in `sflights` und geben Sie das Ergebnis aus.

CLASS zcl_cdo_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cdo_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).

    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( |Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze: { rv_total_seats }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie für jeden Flug in `sflights` an, ob er "Voll" (weniger als 10 freie Sitze) oder "Verfügbar" ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck und `cl_demo_output`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cdo_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_availability
      EXPORTING
        et_flight_status TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cdo_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_availability.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    et_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid
                                   status = COND string( WHEN ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) < 10 THEN 'Voll'
                                                        ELSE 'Verfügbar' ) ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( |Flugverfügbarkeit:| )->line( ).
    cl_demo_output=>write_data( et_flight_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis aus. Nutzen Sie `cl_demo_output` zur Darstellung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck mit `REDUCE` und `cl_demo_output`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cdo_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_stats
      EXPORTING
        et_results TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cdo_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_stats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_grouped_flight-price.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group_result(
               carrid        = ls_flight-carrid
               flight_count  = lv_flight_count
               average_price = COND #( WHEN lv_flight_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_flight_count ELSE 0 ) )
        TO et_results.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( |Flugstatistik nach Fluggesellschaft:| )->line( ).
    cl_demo_output=>write_data( et_results ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_grouped_flight_stats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Simulate sflight data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0011'. <fs_flight>-price = '250.00'.

    " Mock the SELECT statement
    DATA(lo_mock_sflight) = NEW cl_abap_unit_test_mock( ).
    lo_mock_sflight->mock_method( 'SELECT' ).
    lo_mock_sflight->set_return_value( 'SELECT' = mt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_test_mock_manager=>register_mock( 'SFLIGHT' = lo_mock_sflight ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_grouped_flight_stats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cdo_group_by( ).
    DATA lt_result TYPE zcl_cdo_group_by=>tt_flight_group_result.

    lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_stats(
      EXPORTING
        et_results = lt_result
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 groups' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First group carrier ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'LH flight count mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-average_price exp = '150.00' msg = 'LH average price mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second group carrier ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'AA flight count mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-average_price exp = '200.00' msg = 'AA average price mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mappen Sie eine Quellstruktur auf eine Zielstruktur, wobei Sie eine Transformation für ein Feld anwenden, das in der Zielstruktur einen anderen Typ hat (z.B. `sflight-price` (CURR) zu `string`).

CLASS zcl_cac_conv_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             id    TYPE i,

           END OF ty_source_data.

CLASS zcl_cac_conv_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für einen gegebenen Flug das Ankunftsdatum und die Ankunftszeit, wenn die Flugdauer bekannt ist, und geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` oder direkte Datums-/Zeitberechnungen und `cl_demo_output`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cdo_datetime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_schedule,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime     TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrdate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             arrtime     TYPE sflight-deptime,
           END OF ty_flight_schedule.

    METHODS calculate_arrival_time
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid    TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_deptime   TYPE sflight-deptime
        iv_duration  TYPE i " Duration in minutes
      EXPORTING
        es_schedule  TYPE ty_flight_schedule.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cdo_datetime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_arrival_time.
    DATA(lv_departure_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time(
                                       iv_date = iv_fldate
                                       iv_time = iv_deptime ).

    DATA(lv_arrival_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add(
                                     iv_tstmp = lv_departure_timestamp
                                     iv_secs  = iv_duration * 60 ).

    es_schedule-carrid = iv_carrid.
    es_schedule-connid = iv_connid.
    es_schedule-fldate = iv_fldate.
    es_schedule-deptime = iv_deptime.
    es_schedule-arrdate = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date_from_tstmp( lv_arrival_timestamp ).
    es_schedule-arrtime = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_time_from_tstmp( lv_arrival_timestamp ).

    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } Abflug: { iv_fldate DATE = USER } { iv_deptime TIME = USER }| )
                           ->write( |Ankunft (berechnet): { es_schedule-arrdate DATE = USER } { es_schedule-arrtime TIME = USER }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine Liste von Zahlen und addieren Sie diese zu einer Ergebnisliste, solange die Summe der bisherigen Zahlen einen bestimmten Schwellenwert nicht überschreitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife und `APPEND` in eine interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_sum_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_limit   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_sum_limit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    DATA(lv_current_sum) = 0.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.

    WHILE lv_current_sum <= iv_limit AND lv_index <= lines( it_numbers ).
      DATA(lv_number) = it_numbers[ lv_index ].
      IF lv_current_sum + lv_number <= iv_limit.
        lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + lv_number.
        APPEND lv_number TO rt_result.
      ELSE.
        EXIT. " Exit if adding the next number exceeds the limit
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_sum_within_limit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_sum_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 5 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 5 ) ). " Sum = 35, limit = 40
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_numbers( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_limit = 40 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_exceeds_limit.

  ENDMETHOD.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `WHILE` Schleife ist ideal für Iterationen, bei denen die Anzahl der Durchläufe nicht von vornherein feststeht, sondern von einer Bedingung abhängt. In diesem Beispiel wird sie verwendet, um Zahlen zu verarbeiten, solange eine kumulative Summe einen Grenzwert nicht überschreitet. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung von Tabellen sind moderne ABAP-Features.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle öffentlichen Attribute einer beliebigen ABAP-Klasse zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und `get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES: tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( p_all = abap_false ). " p_all = abap_false for public only

    LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attr).
      IF ls_attr-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_public.
        DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_attr-type_name ).
        APPEND VALUE ty_attribute_info( name = ls_attr-name type = lo_type_descr->get_absolute_name( ) ) TO rt_attributes.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem gegebenen String, wobei die Zahlen durch beliebige Nicht-Ziffern-Zeichen getrennt sein können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX` in einer `WHILE` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_remaining_text) = iv_text.

    WHILE lv_remaining_text IS NOT INITIAL.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '\d+' IN lv_remaining_text MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_match_offset) MATCH LENGTH DATA(lv_match_length).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lv_number_str) = lv_remaining_text+lv_match_offset(lv_match_length).
        APPEND lv_number_str TO rt_numbers.
        lv_offset = lv_match_offset + lv_match_length.
        lv_remaining_text = lv_remaining_text+lv_offset.
      ELSE.
        CLEAR lv_remaining_text. " No more numbers found
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_extract_simple FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_extract_simple.

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( ( '123' ) ).

  METHOD test_extract_multiple.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_numbers( 'Item 10, Price 20.50, Quantity 30.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination aus `WHILE` Schleife und `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX` ist eine leistungsstarke Methode, um wiederholt Muster in einem String zu finden und zu extrahieren. Durch die Anpassung des `lv_remaining_text` in jedem Schleifendurchlauf wird sichergestellt, dass die Suche nach dem letzten Treffer fortgesetzt wird. String-Templates und Inline-Deklarationen machen den Code lesbarer und kompakter.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle öffentlichen Methoden einer beliebigen ABAP-Klasse zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und `get_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name TYPE string,
             is_static TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES: tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_methods.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

    LOOP AT lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method).
      IF ls_method-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>visibility_public.
        APPEND VALUE ty_method_info( name = ls_method-name is_static = ls_method-is_static ) TO rt_methods.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_methods FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existent_class FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_methods.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_class_methods( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_public_methods( 'ZCL_RTTI_CLASS_METHODS' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-name exp = 'CONSTRUCTOR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-is_static exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-name exp = 'GET_PUBLIC_METHODS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-is_static exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_class.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_class_methods( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_exception_instance(
        class_name = 'CX_SY_DESCR_ERROR'
        method_call = 'lo_cut->get_public_methods( ''NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'' )'
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ähnlich wie bei Attributen kann RTTI auch verwendet werden, um Informationen über Methoden einer Klasse zu erhalten. `get_methods` liefert eine Tabelle mit Methodendeskriptoren, die Details wie Name, Sichtbarkeit und ob es sich um eine statische Methode handelt, enthalten. Dies ist nützlich für dynamische Aufrufe oder Code-Analyse-Tools.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine große interne Tabelle in festen Blöcken (Chunks) einer bestimmten Größe, bis alle Einträge verarbeitet wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife mit `LOOP AT ... FROM ... TO ...` oder `OFFSET` und `LENGTH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_chunk_processing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_chunk_processing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_in_chunks.
    DATA(lv_total_lines) = lines( it_data ).
    DATA(lv_current_offset) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_offset < lv_total_lines.
      DATA(lv_start_index) = lv_current_offset + 1.
      DATA(lv_end_index) = lv_current_offset + iv_chunk_size.
      IF lv_end_index > lv_total_lines.
        lv_end_index = lv_total_lines.
      ENDIF.

      LOOP AT it_data FROM lv_start_index TO lv_end_index INTO DATA(lv_item).
        " Simulate processing: e.g., double the value
        APPEND ( lv_item * 2 ) TO rt_processed_data.
      ENDLOOP.

      lv_current_offset = lv_current_offset + iv_chunk_size.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein übergebenes Objekt ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object` und `get_interfaces`.

CLASS zcl_rtti_interface_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        io_object      TYPE REF TO object
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_rtti_interface_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_object_descr) = cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ).

    LOOP AT lt_interfaces INTO DATA(ls_interface).

    rv_implements = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten, wobei Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag) übersprungen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife und die Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_workdays
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_workdays.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    rv_workdays = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Parameter einer bestimmten Methode einer Klasse zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name`, `get_method_descr` und `get_parameters`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param_info.
    TYPES: tt_param_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_method_parameters
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parameters) TYPE tt_param_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_method_parameters.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lo_method_descr) = lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( iv_method_name ).
    DATA(lt_parameters) = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).

    LOOP AT lt_parameters INTO DATA(ls_param).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_param-type_name ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_param_info(
               name = ls_param-name
               type = lo_type_descr->get_absolute_name( )
               kind = ls_param-kind
             ) TO rt_parameters.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle nach einem Feld und verarbeiten Sie jede Gruppe, bis eine bestimmte Anzahl von Elementen in der Gruppe erreicht ist oder die Gruppe endet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit einer `WHILE` Schleife innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_group_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             group_key TYPE string,
             value     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             group_key TYPE string,
             processed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_grouped_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_data
        iv_limit_per_group TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_group_limit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_grouped_data.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data) GROUP BY ( group_key = ls_data-group_key ) ASCENDING.
      DATA(ls_group_result) = VALUE ty_grouped_result( group_key = ls_data-group_key ).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_data INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        WHILE lv_count < iv_limit_per_group.
          APPEND ls_group_member-value TO ls_group_result-processed_values.
          lv_count = lv_count + 1.
          EXIT. " Process one item per while loop iteration
        ENDWHILE.
        IF lv_count >= iv_limit_per_group.
          EXIT. " Exit group loop if limit reached
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_group_result TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_with_limit FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_limit_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_with_limit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_group_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_while_group_limit=>tt_data(
      ( group_key = 'A' value = 1 ) ( group_key = 'A' value = 2 ) ( group_key = 'A' value = 3 )
      ( group_key = 'B' value = 10 ) ( group_key = 'B' value = 11 ) ( group_key = 'B' value = 12 ) ( group_key = 'B' value = 13 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_grouped_data( it_data = lt_data iv_limit_per_group = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-group_key exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result[ 1 ]-processed_values ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-processed_values[ 1 ] exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-processed_values[ 2 ] exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-group_key exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result[ 2 ]-processed_values ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-processed_values[ 1 ] exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-processed_values[ 2 ] exp = 11 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_no_limit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_group_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_while_group_limit=>tt_data(
      ( group_key = 'C' value = 100 ) ( group_key = 'C' value = 101 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_grouped_data( it_data = lt_data iv_limit_per_group = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-group_key exp = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result[ 1 ]-processed_values ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-processed_values[ 1 ] exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-processed_values[ 2 ] exp = 101 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_group_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_while_group_limit=>tt_data( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_grouped_data( it_data = lt_data iv_limit_per_group = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_limit_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_group_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_while_group_limit=>tt_data(
      ( group_key = 'X' value = 1 ) ( group_key = 'X' value = 2 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_grouped_data( it_data = lt_data iv_limit_per_group = 0 ).

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.

        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_table>.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl unter Verwendung einer `WHILE` Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife, die die Zahl schrittweise dekrementiert und multipliziert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      rv_factorial = 0. " Factorial not defined for negative numbers
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current_number > 0.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_current_number.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_type_name ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_component-type_name ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
               name = ls_component-name
               type = lo_type_descr->get_absolute_name( )

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Datei zeilenweise ein, bis eine bestimmte Anzahl von Zeilen gelesen wurde oder das Dateiende erreicht ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife in Kombination mit `OPEN DATASET`, `READ DATASET` und `CLOSE DATASET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_read_file_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_with_limit
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_max_lines TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lines) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_file_access.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_read_file_limit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_with_limit.
    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_access
        EXPORTING
          text = |Could not open file { iv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_line_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_line) TYPE string.

    WHILE lv_line_count < iv_max_lines.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND lv_line TO rt_lines.
        lv_line_count = lv_line_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT. " End of file reached
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... INIT ... FOR ... NEXT ...` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_agg_total_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_agg_total_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_passengers = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT total_passengers = total_passengers + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Sie initialisiert einen Wert (`total_passengers`) und iteriert dann über die Tabelle, um diesen Wert basierend auf den Elementen der Tabelle zu aktualisieren. Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen belegten Sitzplatz pro Flug in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe und die Anzahl der Flüge zu ermitteln, und dann die Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_agg_avg_seatsocc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_seats_occupied RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_agg_avg_seatsocc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_seats_occupied.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_seats = 0 TYPE i
           flight_count = 0 TYPE i
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT total_seats = total_seats + flight-seatsocc,
           flight_count = flight_count + 1
    ).

    rv_average = CONV decfloat16( ls_result-total_seats ) / ls_result-flight_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_agg_avg_seatsocc( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lv_average ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_average >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_agg_avg_seatsocc( ).
    " This test would ideally mock sflights to be empty.
    " For demonstration, we assume the method handles empty tables correctly.
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->get_average_seats_occupied( ).
    IF lv_average = 0. " This condition is met if sflights is empty or all seatsocc are 0

    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_average > 0 ).

Die Division erfolgt anschließend, um den Durchschnitt zu erhalten. Die Verwendung von `DECFLOAT16` sorgt für präzise Gleitkomma-Berechnungen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie mit einem `WITH`-Ausdruck in Open SQL die Top 3 Fluggesellschaften basierend auf der Anzahl der Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WITH` für eine Common Table Expression (CTE) und `GROUP BY` sowie `ORDER BY` und `UP TO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_with_clause DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_top_carrier,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_top_carrier.
    TYPES tt_top_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_top_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_carriers RETURNING VALUE(rt_top_carriers) TYPE tt_top_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_with_clause IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_carriers.
    SELECT WITH @(
      SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
        FROM sflights
        GROUP BY carrid
    ) AS flight_counts
    FROM flight_counts
    ORDER BY flight_count DESC
    UP TO 3 ROWS
    INTO TABLE @rt_top_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_with_clause( ).
    DATA(lt_top_carriers) = lo_cut->get_top_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lt_top_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_top_carriers ) <= 3 ).
    IF lines( lt_top_carriers ) > 1.
      LOOP AT lt_top_carriers INTO DATA(ls_current) FROM 1 TO lines( lt_top_carriers ) - 1.
        READ TABLE lt_top_carriers INTO DATA(ls_next) INDEX sy-tabix + 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_current-flight_count >= ls_next-flight_count ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `WITH`-Ausdruck (Common Table Expression - CTE) ermöglicht die Definition temporärer Resultsets, die innerhalb einer einzigen SQL-Anweisung referenziert werden können. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Struktur komplexer Abfragen, indem Zwischenergebnisse klar definiert werden.
keywords: Open SQL, WITH, CTE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, UP TO

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden und mehr als 100 belegte Sitze haben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND seatsocc > 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie mit einer `REDUCE`-Expression die Fluggesellschaft mit den meisten belegten Sitzen und die Gesamtzahl dieser Sitze aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine Struktur zu füllen, die die maximale Anzahl und die zugehörige Fluggesellschaft speichert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_seats_carrier,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             max_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_max_seats_carrier.

    METHODS get_carrier_with_max_seats RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_max_seats_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_with_max_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rs_result = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_carrier = VALUE ty_max_seats_carrier( carrid = '' max_seats = 0 )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE flight-seatsocc > max_carrier-max_seats
      NEXT max_carrier = VALUE ty_max_seats_carrier( carrid = flight-carrid max_seats = flight-seatsocc )
      ELSE
      NEXT max_carrier = max_carrier
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce_max( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_with_max_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_result-max_seats >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Diese `REDUCE`-Expression demonstriert die Aggregation in eine Struktur, um den Eintrag mit dem maximalen Wert zu finden. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb der `FOR`-Schleife und die `NEXT`-Anweisung mit `ELSE` ermöglichen eine präzise Steuerung der Aggregationslogik.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Structure, VALUE

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Chaining von Methodenaufrufen, indem Sie eine Klasse erstellen, die mehrere Operationen auf einem Wert ausführt und die Ergebnisse schrittweise zurückgibt.
hint: Sorgen Sie dafür, dass Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( 5 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methoden-Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz von Code, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem die Methoden, die das Chaining ermöglichen sollen, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, ME

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie den Status des Enterprise Search (ESH) Caches für einen bestimmten Cache-Typ (`S_ESH_ENG_CACHE`) unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `GET_CACHE_STATUS` der Klasse `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_status,
             cache_type TYPE string,
             is_active  TYPE abap_bool,
             last_update TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cache_status.

    METHODS check_esh_cache_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_status) TYPE ty_cache_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_esh_cache_status.
    DATA lv_is_active TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_last_update TYPE timestampl.

    TRY.
        cl_esh_ca_check=>get_cache_status(
          EXPORTING
            iv_cache_type = 'S_ESH_ENG_CACHE'
          IMPORTING
            ev_is_active  = lv_is_active
            ev_last_update = lv_last_update
        ).

        rs_status-cache_type = 'S_ESH_ENG_CACHE'.
        rs_status-is_active  = lv_is_active.
        rs_status-last_update = lv_last_update.

      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rs_status-cache_type = 'S_ESH_ENG_CACHE'.
        rs_status-is_active  = abap_false.
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or set a specific message
        " For this example, we just set is_active to false
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_esh_cache_status FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_check( ).
    DATA(ls_status) = lo_cut->check_esh_cache_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-cache_type exp = 'S_ESH_ENG_CACHE' ).
    " The actual status depends on the system configuration, so we can only assert its existence.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_status-is_active ).
    " Further assertions would require mocking CL_ESH_CA_CHECK or a known system state.
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: CL_ESH_CA_CHECK, Enterprise Search, Cache, System Interaction, GET_CACHE_STATUS

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Klassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt und zurückgibt.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_shape
      IMPORTING
        iv_shape_type TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_shape) TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_shape.
    CASE iv_shape_type.
      WHEN 'CIRCLE'.
        ro_shape = NEW zcl_circle( iv_value ).
      WHEN 'SQUARE'.
        ro_shape = NEW zcl_square( iv_value ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannter Formtyp: { iv_shape_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_circle.
    DATA(lo_circle) = zcl_shape_factory=>create_shape( iv_shape_type = 'CIRCLE' iv_value = '10' ).
    DATA(lv_area) = lo_circle->get_area( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_area exp = '314.1592653589793' msg = 'Area of circle with radius 10' delta = '0.0000000000001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_square.
    DATA(lo_square) = zcl_shape_factory=>create_shape( iv_shape_type = 'SQUARE' iv_value = '5' ).
    DATA(lv_area) = lo_square->get_area( ).

Die statische Methode `create_shape` in `ZCL_SHAPE_FACTORY` entscheidet basierend auf dem Eingabeparameter, welche konkrete Implementierung des Interfaces `ZIF_SHAPE` instanziiert wird. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und erleichtert die Erweiterbarkeit des Systems.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Interface, Class-Methods, Polymorphism, NEW

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch alle Attribute einer gegebenen Klasse und deren Typen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und die Methode `get_attributes()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES: tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

    LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
      DATA(ls_info) = VALUE ty_attribute_info(
        name = ls_attribute-name
        type = ls_attribute-type_descr->get_name( )
      ).
      APPEND ls_info TO rt_attributes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_class_attributes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_attributes( ).
    TRY.
        CLASS lcl_dummy DEFINITION.
          PUBLIC SECTION.
            DATA mv_field1 TYPE i.
            DATA mv_field2 TYPE string.
        ENDCLASS.
        CLASS lcl_dummy IMPLEMENTATION. ENDCLASS.

        DATA(lt_attributes_lcl_dummy) = lo_cut->get_class_attributes( 'LCL_DUMMY' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_attributes_lcl_dummy ) exp = 2 msg = 'LCL_DUMMY should have 2 public attributes' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attributes_lcl_dummy[ 1 ]-name exp = 'MV_FIELD1' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attributes_lcl_dummy[ 1 ]-type exp = 'I' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attributes_lcl_dummy[ 2 ]-name exp = 'MV_FIELD2' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_attributes_lcl_dummy[ 2 ]-type exp = 'STRING' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_descr_error caught' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Metadaten über ABAP-Typen zur Laufzeit abzufragen. `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name()` liefert ein Deskriptorobjekt, mit dem man über `get_attributes()` auf die Attribute einer Klasse zugreifen kann. Dies ist nützlich für generische Frameworks oder dynamische Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_classdescr, Attributes, Dynamic Programming, Reflection

Instructions: Prüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine gegebene Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und die Methode `get_interfaces()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS implements_interface
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name     TYPE string
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_implements) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_interfaces) = lo_class_descr->get_interfaces( ).

    IF line_exists( lt_interfaces[ name = iv_interface_name ] ).
      rb_implements = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_implements = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_implements_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_interface( ).
    TRY.
        INTERFACE lif_test.
          METHODS dummy_method.
        ENDINTERFACE.

        CLASS lcl_implementer DEFINITION.
          PUBLIC SECTION.
            INTERFACES lif_test.
        ENDCLASS.
        CLASS lcl_implementer IMPLEMENTATION.
          METHOD lif_test~dummy_method. ENDMETHOD.
        ENDCLASS.

        CLASS lcl_non_implementer DEFINITION.
        ENDCLASS.
        CLASS lcl_non_implementer IMPLEMENTATION.
        ENDCLASS.

        DATA(lb_implements) = lo_cut->implements_interface(
          iv_class_name     = 'LCL_IMPLEMENTER'
          iv_interface_name = 'LIF_TEST'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lb_implements exp = abap_true msg = 'LCL_IMPLEMENTER should implement LIF_TEST' ).

        lb_implements = lo_cut->implements_interface(
          iv_class_name     = 'LCL_NON_IMPLEMENTER'
          iv_interface_name = 'LIF_TEST'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lb_implements exp = abap_false msg = 'LCL_NON_IMPLEMENTER should not implement LIF_TEST' ).

        lb_implements = lo_cut->implements_interface(
          iv_class_name     = 'LCL_IMPLEMENTER'
          iv_interface_name = 'LIF_NON_EXISTENT'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lb_implements exp = abap_false msg = 'Should return false for non-existent interface' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_descr_error caught' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von RTTI (`cl_abap_classdescr=>get_interfaces()`) und dem modernen Tabellenausdruck `line_exists()` kann man effizient prüfen, ob eine Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Frameworks, die mit generischen Objekten arbeiten und deren Fähigkeiten zur Laufzeit überprüfen müssen.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_classdescr, Interface, Object Orientation, line_exists
