Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_call_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string " Generic return type for simplicity
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_call_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_result> TYPE any.

    CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING r_result = lr_data.

    IF lr_data IS BOUND.
      ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_result>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_result = |{ <fs_result> }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_call_dynamic_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_call_method( ).
    DATA(lo_get_user) = NEW zcl_get_user( ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_user) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
          io_object     = lo_get_user
          iv_method_name = 'GET_CURRENT_USER'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_user exp = sy-uname msg = 'Dynamically called method should return current user' ).

        DATA(lv_exception_caught) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
        TRY.
            lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
              io_object     = lo_get_user
              iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
            ).
          CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
            lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        ENDTRY.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_exception_caught exp = abap_true msg = 'cx_sy_dyn_call_error should be caught for non-existent method' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected exception cx_sy_dyn_call_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name)` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programmierung. Er ermöglicht es, Methoden zur Laufzeit aufzurufen, deren Namen erst dann bekannt sind. Dies ist entscheidend für Frameworks, die auf Konfiguration oder Benutzereingaben reagieren müssen.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attribute_type IMPLEMENTATION.

    TRY.
        CLASS lcl_test_class DEFINITION.
          PUBLIC SECTION.
            DATA mv_int TYPE i.

        TRY.

CLASS zcl_reca_add_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum innerhalb eines Start- und Enddatums liegt (inklusive).
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_RECA_DATE und die Methode IS_BETWEEN. Nutzen Sie eine COND-Expression für die Rückgabe.

CLASS zcl_reca_date_in_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_date_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_check_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_end_date   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_reca_date_in_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_date_in_range.
    DATA(lo_check_date) = cl_reca_date=>create_date_from_sy_datum( iv_check_date ).

    DATA(lo_end_date)   = cl_reca_date=>create_date_from_sy_datum( iv_end_date ).

    rv_is_in_range = lo_check_date->is_between(
      io_date_from = lo_start_date
      io_date_to   = lo_end_date
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_date_in_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_in_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reca_date_in_range( ).
    DATA(lv_start) = '20230101'.
    DATA(lv_end) = '20230131'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_date_in_range( '20230115', lv_start, lv_end ) msg = 'Date inside range' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_date_in_range( '20230101', lv_start, lv_end ) msg = 'Date equals start date' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_date_in_range( '20230131', lv_start, lv_end ) msg = 'Date equals end date' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_date_in_range( '20221231', lv_start, lv_end ) msg = 'Date before range' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_date_in_range( '20230201', lv_start, lv_end ) msg = 'Date after range' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `is_between` der Klasse `cl_reca_date` bietet eine intuitive und fehlerfreie Möglichkeit, zu prüfen, ob ein Datum in einem bestimmten Bereich liegt. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für die Datumsobjekte ist ein Beispiel für moderne Inline-Deklaration.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Tage aller Monate, die in einer gegebenen Liste von Datumswerten enthalten sind. Jeder Monat soll nur einmal gezählt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_reca_date` und die `REDUCE`-Anweisung, um eindeutige Monate zu identifizieren und deren Tage zu summieren.
solution:
TYPES: tt_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-datum WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_reca_sum_month_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_of_unique_month_days
      IMPORTING
        it_dates TYPE tt_dates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reca_sum_month_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_of_unique_month_days.
    DATA(lt_unique_months) = VALUE tt_dates(
      FOR <date> IN it_dates
      LET lo_date = cl_reca_date=>create_date_from_sy_datum( <date> )
          lv_first_day_of_month = lo_date->get_first_day_of_month( )
      IN
      ( lv_first_day_of_month ) OPTIONAL UNIQUE ).

    rv_total_days = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR <month_date> IN lt_unique_months
                              LET lo_month_date = cl_reca_date=>create_date_from_sy_datum( <month_date> )
                              IN
                              sum = sum + lo_month_date->get_days_in_month( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_month_days FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_month_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reca_sum_month_days( ).
    DATA(lt_test_dates) = VALUE zcl_reca_sum_month_days=>tt_dates(
      ( '20230101' ) ( '20230115' ) ( '20230205' ) ( '20230310' ) ( '20230320' ) ).

    DATA(lv_expected_days) = 31 + 28 + 31. "Jan (31), Feb (28), Mar (31)
    DATA(lv_actual_days) = lo_cut->get_sum_of_unique_month_days( lt_test_dates ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_days exp = lv_expected_days msg = 'Incorrect sum of unique month days' ).

    lt_test_dates = VALUE zcl_reca_sum_month_days=>tt_dates(
      ( '20240210' ) ( '20240220' ) ( '20240301' ) ). "Leap year
    lv_expected_days = 29 + 31. "Feb (29), Mar (31)
    lv_actual_days = lo_cut->get_sum_of_unique_month_days( lt_test_dates ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_days exp = lv_expected_days msg = 'Incorrect sum for leap year' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine Kombination aus `FOR`- und `REDUCE`-Expression. Die `FOR`-Expression mit `OPTIONAL UNIQUE` wird verwendet, um eine Liste der ersten Tage jedes eindeutigen Monats zu erstellen. Anschließend summiert die `REDUCE`-Expression die Anzahl der Tage für jeden dieser eindeutigen Monate mithilfe von `get_days_in_month`. Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `COUNT` oder `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_unique_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_unique_carriers.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT unique_carriers = VALUE string_table( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( <fs_flight>-carrid IS NOT INITIAL )
      NEXT unique_carriers = COND string_table(
        WHEN NOT ( <fs_flight>-carrid IS IN unique_carriers )
        THEN VALUE string_table( BASE unique_carriers ( <fs_flight>-carrid ) )
        ELSE unique_carriers )
      FINALLY = lines( unique_carriers ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_count_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_unique_carriers( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 ). "Assuming LH, AA, UA in standard SFLIGHTS
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher` in Kombination mit `find` und `offset`/`length` oder `cl_abap_regex` für eine 'Split'-ähnliche Funktionalität.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_split_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_split_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text ).

    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    WHILE lo_matcher->find( ).
      IF lo_matcher->offset > lv_offset.
        APPEND iv_text+lv_offset(lo_matcher->offset - lv_offset) TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
      lv_offset = lo_matcher->offset + lo_matcher->length.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_offset < strlen( iv_text ).
      APPEND iv_text+lv_offset TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_split_regex FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_regex.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_split_string( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_by_regex( iv_text = 'Apfel,Birne;Kirsche' iv_pattern = `[,;]` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Apfel' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'Birne' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = 'Kirsche' ).

    CLEAR lt_result.
    lt_result = lo_cut->split_by_regex( iv_text = 'Ein Wort' iv_pattern = ` ` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Ein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'Wort' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl ABAP keine direkte 'Split by Regex'-Funktion wie in anderen Sprachen bietet, kann dies mit `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` nachgebildet werden. Man sucht iterativ nach den Trennzeichen und extrahiert die Substrings dazwischen. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von Regex, die Flexibilität beim Parsen von Strings bietet.
keywords: REGEX, cl_abap_matcher, cl_abap_regex, Split, String Processing, Parsen

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem Text alle Wörter, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen und mindestens 3 Zeichen lang sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher` und ein geeignetes Regex-Muster mit Wortgrenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_capital_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_capital_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_words.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]{2,}\b`.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = lv_pattern text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_found_string( ) TO rt_words.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_words FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_capital_words( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Dies ist Ein Test mit Mehreren Wörtern. ABAP ist Toll.' .
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_words( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Dies' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'Ein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = 'Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ] exp = 'Mehreren' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 5 ] exp = 'Wörtern' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Fähigkeit von Regex, komplexe Muster zu erkennen, die über einfache Substring-Suchen hinausgehen. Die Kombination von Zeichenklassen (`[A-Z]`, `[a-zA-Z]`), Quantifizierern (`{2,}`) und Wortgrenzen (`\b`) ermöglicht eine präzise Extraktion von Wörtern, die spezifische Kriterien erfüllen.
keywords: REGEX, cl_abap_matcher, find, Extraktion, String Processing, Mustererkennung

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein gültiges deutsches Postleitzahlenformat (5 Ziffern) enthält und extrahieren Sie diese.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher` mit einer Capture Group.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_zip_code DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_zip_code
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_code) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_zip_code IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_zip_code.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\b(\d{5})\b`.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = lv_pattern text = iv_text ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rv_zip_code = lo_matcher->get_group( 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_zip_code_extraction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_zip_code_extraction.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_zip_code( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_zip_code( 'Meine PLZ ist 12345.' ) exp = '12345' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_zip_code( 'Keine PLZ hier.' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_zip_code( 'PLZ 123456 ist zu lang.' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_zip_code( 'PLZ 1234 ist zu kurz.' ) exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine Capture Group `(\d{5})` innerhalb des Regex-Musters, um den spezifischen Teil des Treffers (die 5 Ziffern) zu extrahieren. `GET_GROUP( 1 )` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf den Inhalt der ersten Capture Group. Dies ist sehr nützlich, wenn man bestimmte Teile eines passenden Strings isolieren möchte.
keywords: REGEX, cl_abap_matcher, Capture Group, Postleitzahl, Extraktion, Validierung

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die vor dem 1. Januar 2025 liegen. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE TABLE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und `FOR` für eine moderne Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_old_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_cut_off_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      CHANGING
        ct_flights      TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights.
    DELETE ct_flights WHERE fldate < iv_cut_off_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_flights=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_flights( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20240101' price = '100' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20260101' price = '300' ) TO lt_flights.

    lo_cut->delete_old_flights( EXPORTING iv_cut_off_date = '20250101' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE`-Syntax ist die moderne und effiziente Art, Zeilen aus internen Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu entfernen. Sie ist performanter und lesbarer als das Iterieren und Löschen innerhalb einer Schleife.
keywords: DELETE, INTERNAL TABLES, WHERE, CONDITIONAL LOGIC

Instructions: Entfernen Sie doppelte Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, wobei Duplikate anhand von Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer identifiziert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` nach dem Sortieren der Tabelle oder eine `HASHED TABLE` für Duplikatsfreiheit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_duplicates
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    SORT ct_flights BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_duplicates=>tt_sflight_full.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20240101' price = '100' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20240101' price = '100' ) TO lt_flights. " Duplicate
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20240101' price = '150' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20240102' price = '110' ) TO lt_flights. " Duplicate key, different fldate/price

    lo_cut->remove_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0010' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist die Standardmethode zum Entfernen von Duplikaten. Wichtig ist, dass die Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Schlüsselfeldern sortiert wird, da nur *benachbarte* Duplikate gelöscht werden.
keywords: DELETE, DUPLICATES, INTERNAL TABLES, SORT

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle, die einen bestimmten Wert in einem Feld haben, und geben Sie die Anzahl der gelöschten Zeilen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE` und die Systemvariable `sy-dbcnt`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_by_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_flights     TYPE tt_sflight_simple
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_by_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_by_carrid.
    DELETE ct_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
    rv_deleted_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_some FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_none FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_some.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_by_value=>tt_sflight_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_by_value( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->delete_by_carrid( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'LH' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_none.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_by_value=>tt_sflight_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_by_value( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->delete_by_carrid( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE`-Anweisung ist die bevorzugte Methode zum Löschen von Zeilen. `sy-dbcnt` liefert nach der Operation die Anzahl der tatsächlich gelöschten Zeilen, was für die Fehlerbehandlung oder Protokollierung nützlich ist.
keywords: DELETE, INTERNAL TABLES, WHERE, SY-DBCNT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer bestehenden Strukturdefinition (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `create_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

    ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    " Beispiel: Füllen mit Daten (hier statisch, könnte auch dynamisch sein)
    IF iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
      DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ).
      <fs_line> = ls_sflight.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <lt_table>.

      ls_sflight = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ).
      <fs_line> = ls_sflight.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <lt_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existent_struct EXPECTING CX_SY_DESCR_ERROR FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflight> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_sflight>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_sflight> ). " Should be initial before filling

    " Re-call to fill (simplified for test, in real scenario, filling would be part of the method)
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_sflight>.

    DATA(ls_sflight_data) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight_data TO <lt_sflight>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflight> ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lt_sflight>[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_struct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'NON_EXISTENT_STRUCT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine bestimmte Komponente (Feld) in einer Struktur vorhanden ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` und suchen Sie in der zurückgegebenen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS component_exists
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD component_exists.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data->* ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    IF line_exists( lt_components[ name = iv_component ] ).
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Komponentennamen und deren Typen (z.B. 'C', 'I', 'STRING') aus einer gegebenen Struktur aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` und iterieren Sie über die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data->* ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component_descr).
      DATA(lo_comp_type_descr) = ls_component_descr-type.
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component_descr-name
        type_kind = lo_comp_type_descr->kind_as_string( )
        length = lo_comp_type_descr->length
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, die in einer anderen internen Tabelle als 'Blacklist' aufgeführt sind. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE` mit `FOR ... IN` und `WHERE` oder `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_with_blacklist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_blacklist_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_blacklisted_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_blacklist_keys TYPE tt_blacklist_keys
      CHANGING
        ct_flights        TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_with_blacklist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_blacklisted_flights.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( ct_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                          WHERE ( carrid, connid ) IN it_blacklist_keys ).
    " This is a workaround for direct DELETE with IN for multiple fields.
    " A more direct approach would be to iterate and delete, or use a hashed table for blacklist lookup.
    " For simplicity and modern syntax, we'll demonstrate the FILTER approach to keep non-blacklisted.
    ct_flights = FILTER #( ct_flights EXCEPT IN lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_some_blacklisted FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_none_blacklisted FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_some_blacklisted.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_with_blacklist=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA: lt_blacklist TYPE zcl_delete_with_blacklist=>tt_blacklist_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_blacklist( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '200' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = '300' ) TO lt_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_blacklist.

    lo_cut->delete_blacklisted_flights( EXPORTING it_blacklist_keys = lt_blacklist CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_none_blacklisted.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_with_blacklist=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA: lt_blacklist TYPE zcl_delete_with_blacklist=>tt_blacklist_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_blacklist( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ) TO lt_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ) TO lt_blacklist.

    lo_cut->delete_blacklisted_flights( EXPORTING it_blacklist_keys = lt_blacklist CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das direkte Löschen von Zeilen, die in einer anderen Tabelle enthalten sind, ist mit `DELETE ... WHERE (field1, field2) IN other_table` nicht direkt möglich. Eine moderne Lösung ist die Verwendung von `FILTER` in Kombination mit `EXCEPT IN`, um die gewünschten Zeilen zu behalten und die Blacklist-Einträge effektiv zu entfernen. Alternativ könnte man die Blacklist in eine Hashed Table umwandeln und dann in einer Schleife mit `DELETE TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY` arbeiten.
keywords: DELETE, INTERNAL TABLES, FILTER, EXCEPT IN, BLACKLIST

Instructions: Führen Sie einen dynamischen Methodenaufruf auf einem Objekt durch, dessen Typ und Methodenname zur Laufzeit bekannt sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA: lt_methods     TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>tt_method_descr.
    DATA: ls_method_descr TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>ty_method_descr.

    lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    lt_methods = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

    READ TABLE lt_methods INTO ls_method_descr WITH KEY name = iv_method_name.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Method '{iv_method_name}' not found in class '{lo_class_descr->get_name()}'|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lv_result TYPE string.
    TRY.
        IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
          CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
            EXPORTING
              iv_input = iv_param_value " Annahme: Methode hat einen Parameter iv_input
            RECEIVING
              rv_output = lv_result.    " Annahme: Methode hat einen Rückgabewert rv_output
        ELSE.
          CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
            RECEIVING
              rv_output = lv_result.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = lv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Dynamic method call failed: {lx_dyn_call_error->get_text()}|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_behv_message~get_message.
    " Dummy implementation for interface
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    rv_greeting = 'Hello from target class!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from target class!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_with_param.

Dies ist nützlich für Frameworks, Plugins oder generische Verarbeitungslogiken. Die Syntax `CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name)` ist hierbei zentral.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer benutzerdefinierten Struktur, die zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und Typen generiert wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_definition,
             name     TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE string, " e.g., 'C', 'I', 'STRING'
             length   TYPE i OPTIONAL,
           END OF ty_field_definition.
    TYPES tt_field_definition TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_definition WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_definition
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table)      TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.
    DATA: lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      CLEAR ls_component.
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.

      CASE ls_field_def-type_kind.
        WHEN 'C'.
          lo_type_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( p_length = ls_field_def-length ).
        WHEN 'I'.
          lo_type_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          lo_type_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_descr_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Unsupported type kind: { ls_field_def-type_kind }|.
      ENDCASE.
      ls_component-type = lo_type_descr.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'NAME' type_kind = 'STRING' ) TO lt_field_defs.

    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    " Verify structure (simplified, actual verification would involve RTTI on <lt_dynamic_table>)
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-type->kind_as_string( ) exp = 'Integer' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-name exp = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-type->kind_as_string( ) exp = 'String' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_complex_table.
    DATA: lt_field_defs TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct_table=>tt_field_definition.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct_table( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'CODE' type_kind = 'C' length = 5 ) TO lt_field_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'VALUE' type_kind = 'I' ) TO lt_field_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'DESCRIPTION' type_kind = 'STRING' ) TO lt_field_defs.

    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'CODE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-type->kind_as_string( ) exp = 'Character' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-type->length exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unsupported_type.
    DATA: lt_field_defs TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct_table=>tt_field_definition.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct_table( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'FIELD' type_kind = 'UNKNOWN' ) TO lt_field_defs.

    lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von RTTI, um nicht nur Tabellen, sondern auch deren Zeilentypen dynamisch zu definieren. `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` wird verwendet, um eine Struktur aus einer Liste von Komponentenbeschreibungen zu erstellen, die wiederum mit `cl_abap_elemdescr` für elementare Typen generiert werden. Dies ist extrem flexibel für generische Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: RTTI, DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR, CREATE DATA

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein Objekt eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref` und `get_interfaces`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS implements_interface
      IMPORTING
        io_object       TYPE REF TO object
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    DATA(lt_interfaces) = lo_class_descr->get_interfaces( ).

    IF line_exists( lt_interfaces[ name = iv_interface_name ] ).
      rv_implements = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_implements = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_behv_message~get_message.
    " Dummy implementation for interface
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine Struktur, die Felder mit Initialwerten (NULL in JSON) enthält, und deserialisieren Sie diese zurück, um die korrekte Handhabung von NULL-Werten zu demonstrieren.
hint: CL_FDT_JSON behandelt Initialwerte in ABAP als JSON-Null und umgekehrt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_null_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS serialize_data
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS deserialize_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_null_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_data.
    DATA(lo_json_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_writer( ).
    lo_json_writer->write_data( is_data ).
    rv_json_string = lo_json_writer->get_json( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_data.
    DATA(lo_json_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create_reader( iv_json_string ).
    lo_json_reader->read_data( EXPORTING iv_target_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_struct_type( p_struct_type = NEW zcl_json_null_handling=>ty_data( ) )
                               IMPORTING ev_data        = rs_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_null_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_null_handling.
    DATA: ls_data_in TYPE zcl_json_null_handling=>ty_data.
    ls_data_in-field1 = 'Value1'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_null_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_data( ls_data_in ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain null for field2' substring = '"FIELD2":null' string = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain null for field3' substring = '"FIELD3":null' string = lv_json ).

    DATA(lv_json_with_null) = `{ "FIELD1": "Test", "FIELD2": null, "FIELD3": "Another Value" }`.
    DATA(ls_data_out) = lo_cut->deserialize_data( lv_json_with_null ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field1 mismatch' act = ls_data_out-field1 exp = 'Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field2 should be initial' act = ls_data_out-field2 exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field3 mismatch' act = ls_data_out-field3 exp = 'Another Value' ).

    DATA(lv_json_all_null) = `{ "FIELD1": null, "FIELD2": null, "FIELD3": null }`.
    DATA(ls_data_all_null) = lo_cut->deserialize_data( lv_json_all_null ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Field1 should be initial' act = ls_data_all_null-field1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Field2 should be initial' act = ls_data_all_null-field2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Field3 should be initial' act = ls_data_all_null-field3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: CL_FDT_JSON bietet eine konsistente Handhabung von ABAP-Initialwerten und JSON-Null-Werten, was die Interoperabilität mit Systemen, die explizite Null-Werte erwarten, vereinfacht und die Datenintegrität gewährleistet.
keywords: JSON, Null-Werte, CL_FDT_JSON, Serialisierung, Deserialisierung

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und deren Flugdatum nach dem 01.01.2025 liegt. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Ergebnissen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER tt_flights
      FROM lt_sflights
      WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
        AND fldate > '20250101'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'At least one flight from Frankfurt after 20250101 expected' act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Cityfrom should be FRANKFURT' act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Fldate should be after 20250101' act = ( ls_flight-fldate > '20250101' ) ).

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Liste von Dateinamen. Filtern Sie diese Liste, um nur die Dateinamen zu erhalten, die einem bestimmten MIME-Typ (z.B. 'application/pdf') entsprechen. Verwenden Sie die Konstanten aus `cl_fxs_mime_types`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_mime_type_from_extension` und den `FILTER` Operator. Die Konstanten für MIME-Typen finden Sie in `cl_fxs_mime_types`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_mime_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_filenames TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_mime_type TYPE string
        it_filenames        TYPE tt_filenames
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_filenames) TYPE tt_filenames.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_mime_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_mime_type.
    rt_filtered_filenames = FILTER tt_filenames
      FROM it_filenames
      WHERE cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_mime_type_from_extension( substring_after( val = table_line sep = '.' ) ) = iv_target_mime_type.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_pdf.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_mime_types( ).
    DATA(lt_filenames) = VALUE zcl_filter_mime_types=>tt_filenames(
      ( 'document.pdf' )
      ( 'report.docx' )
      ( 'image.jpg' )
      ( 'presentation.pdf' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_pdf_mime) = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_xslfo_supplementary-pdf.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_mime_type( iv_target_mime_type = lv_pdf_mime it_filenames = lt_filenames ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First file should be document.pdf' act = lt_result[1] exp = 'document.pdf' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second file should be presentation.pdf' act = lt_result[2] exp = 'presentation.pdf' ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_mime_type( iv_target_mime_type = lv_xml_mime it_filenames = lt_filenames ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected no files to match' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Es zeigt, wie man eine Liste von Strings basierend auf einer komplexeren Logik filtern kann, die externe Funktionen und vordefinierte Konstanten nutzt. CLASS zcl_filter_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_short.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_short.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_short_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ).

    rt_filtered_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_filtered_sflights MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid fldate = fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Bestellungen, wobei jede Bestellung eine geschachtelte interne Tabelle von Positionen enthält. Filtern Sie die Haupttabelle der Bestellungen, sodass nur Bestellungen übrig bleiben, die mindestens eine Position mit einem Nettowert über 1000 EUR haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer `LINE_EXISTS` Expression, um in der geschachtelten Tabelle zu suchen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_nested_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             item_id   TYPE i,
             net_value TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id TYPE i,
             items    TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_order,
           tt_orders TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_orders
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_orders) TYPE tt_orders.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_nested_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_orders.
    DATA(lt_all_orders) = VALUE tt_orders(
      ( order_id = 1 items = VALUE tt_items(
          ( item_id = 10 net_value = '500.00' )
          ( item_id = 20 net_value = '1200.00' ) ) )
      ( order_id = 2 items = VALUE tt_items(
          ( item_id = 10 net_value = '300.00' )
          ( item_id = 20 net_value = '750.00' ) ) )
      ( order_id = 3 items = VALUE tt_items(
          ( item_id = 10 net_value = '2000.00' ) ) )
      ( order_id = 4 items = VALUE tt_items(
          ( item_id = 10 net_value = '100.00' ) ) )
    ).

    rt_filtered_orders = FILTER tt_orders
      FROM lt_all_orders
      WHERE LINE_EXISTS( items[ net_value > '1000.00' ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die von 'NYC' abfliegen, und berechnen Sie gleichzeitig die Anzahl dieser Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_and_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " To make it more robust, we could insert test data or mock sflight
    " For simplicity, we assume sflight contains data.
    DATA(lt_sflights_check) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) dynamisch basierend auf einem übergebenen Feldnamen und einem Vergleichswert filtert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit dynamischen Komponenten oder `cl_abap_table_utilities` für komplexere dynamische Filterungen. Für einfache Fälle kann `COND` oder `CASE` mit dynamischem Feldzugriff verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamically_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamically_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Dynamic filtering using a CASE expression within FILTER
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER tt_flights
      FROM lt_sflights
      WHERE
        ( iv_field_name = 'CARRID'   AND table_line-carrid   = iv_value ) OR
        ( iv_field_name = 'CITYFROM' AND table_line-cityfrom = iv_value ) OR
        ( iv_field_name = 'CITYTO'   AND table_line-cityto   = iv_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anstatt die Filterbedingung fest zu kodieren, wird sie zur Laufzeit basierend auf den übergebenen Parametern (`iv_field_name`, `iv_value`) ausgewählt. Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die von 'BERLIN' abfliegen, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer der gefilterten Flüge enthält, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'BERLIN' )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und entfernen Sie Duplikate basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_distinct_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_distinct_flights) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_distinct_flights = VALUE tt_flight_keys(
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_distinct_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_distinct_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_distinct_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Verify uniqueness by trying to insert duplicates (will cause dump if not unique key)
    DATA(lt_check_duplicates) = VALUE zcl_filter_distinct=>tt_flight_keys(
      FOR flight IN lt_result
      ( flight ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of lines should be unique' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_check_duplicates ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_key).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrid should not be initial' act = ls_flight_key-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Connid should not be initial' act = ls_flight_key-connid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man Duplikate nach dem Filtern einer internen Tabelle entfernen kann. Durch die Kombination von `FILTER` mit einer `FOR` Expression, die die gefilterten Daten direkt in eine Hash-Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel (`UNIQUE KEY`) einfügt, werden Duplikate automatisch eliminiert. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um eindeutige Datensätze zu erhalten.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen, und sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse anschließend nach Flugdatum und Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `SORT` (oder `SORTED BY` in `FOR`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_and_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_and_sorted_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_and_sorted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ).

    SORT lt_filtered BY fldate ASCENDING carrid ASCENDING.

    rt_sorted_flights = lt_filtered.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_sort FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sort.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_and_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Verify sorting
    DATA: lv_prev_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
          lv_prev_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Cityfrom should be NEW YORK' act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'NEW YORK' ).

      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        IF ls_flight-fldate < lv_prev_fldate.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Flights not sorted by fldate ascending' ).
        ELSEIF ls_flight-fldate = lv_prev_fldate AND ls_flight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Flights not sorted by carrid ascending for same fldate' ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination des `FILTER` Operators mit der `SORT` Anweisung. Zuerst wird die interne Tabelle gefiltert, um die relevanten Datensätze zu isolieren. Anschließend wird die gefilterte Tabelle nach den gewünschten Kriterien sortiert. Dies ist ein häufiges Muster in der Datenverarbeitung, um eine spezifische Untermenge von Daten in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge zu präsentieren.
keywords: FILTER, SORT, Internal Tables, Sorting

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_and_grouped_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_and_grouped_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE tt_flight_groups(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
      GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_group_by FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_filter_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_grouped_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Verify grouping and counts (example check for LH)
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_group) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      lv_lh_count = ls_group-count.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_sflights_check) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND carrid = 'LH'
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_check.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Count for LH should match direct select' act = lv_lh_count exp = lines( lt_sflights_check ) ).

    " Check that all entries are from FRANKFURT (implicitly handled by filter)
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO ls_group.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrid should not be initial' act = ls_group-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Count should be positive' act = ( ls_group-count > 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `FILTER` Operator mit der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Expression. Dies ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle zu filtern und die gefilterten Daten anschließend nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren, wobei Aggregationen wie `GROUP SIZE` direkt im Ausdruck verwendet werden können. hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und einer `WHERE` Bedingung auf `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_group_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_min_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_min_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE tt_carrier_counts(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
      GROUP BY flight-carrid
      WHERE ( GROUP SIZE >= 2 )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus `sflight`, die zusätzlich ein Feld `status` enthält. Der Status soll 'Full' sein, wenn `seatsocc` > 300, 'Half Full' wenn `seatsocc` > 150, ansonsten 'Empty'.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit der `COND` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_cond_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_status) TYPE tt_sflight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_cond_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_with_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_sflights_status = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                  ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                    connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                    seatsocc = <fs_sflight>-seatsocc
                                    status = COND string( WHEN <fs_sflight>-seatsocc > 300 THEN 'Full'
                                                         WHEN <fs_sflight>-seatsocc > 150 THEN 'Half Full'
                                                         ELSE 'Empty' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflights_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_cond_logic( ).
    DATA(lt_status) = lo_cut->get_sflights_with_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_status ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_status ) > 0 ).

    DATA(ls_entry_full) = VALUE #( lt_status[ 1 ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_entry_full IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF ls_entry_full-seatsocc > 300.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry_full-status exp = 'Full' ).
      ELSEIF ls_entry_full-seatsocc > 150.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry_full-status exp = 'Half Full' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry_full-status exp = 'Empty' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND` Expression ermöglicht die Definition von bedingter Logik direkt in Ausdrücken, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE` können so komplexe Transformationen mit bedingten Feldwerten in einer einzigen Zeile realisiert werden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine flache interne Tabelle aus zwei verschachtelten internen Tabellen, die Gruppen und deren Unterelemente repräsentieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR ... IN ...` Ausdrücke innerhalb einer `VALUE` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flat_item,
             group_id TYPE i,
             item_id TYPE i,
             item_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flat_item.
    TYPES: tt_flat_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flat_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flattened_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flat_items) TYPE tt_flat_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flattened_items.
    DATA(lt_groups) = VALUE tt_item(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Group A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Group B' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sub_items_a) = VALUE tt_item(
      ( id = 101 value = 'Item A1' )
      ( id = 102 value = 'Item A2' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sub_items_b) = VALUE tt_item(
      ( id = 201 value = 'Item B1' )
      ( id = 202 value = 'Item B2' )
    ).

    rt_flat_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_group IN lt_groups
                             FOR ls_sub_item IN COND tt_item( WHEN ls_group-id = 1 THEN lt_sub_items_a
                                                              WHEN ls_group-id = 2 THEN lt_sub_items_b )
                             ( group_id = ls_group-id
                               item_id = ls_sub_item-id
                               item_value = ls_sub_item-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flattened_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flattened_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_nested_for( ).
    DATA(lt_flat) = lo_cut->get_flattened_items( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flat ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flat[ 1 ]-group_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flat[ 1 ]-item_value exp = 'Item A1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flat[ 4 ]-group_id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flat[ 4 ]-item_value exp = 'Item B2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verschachtelte `FOR` Ausdrücke in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglichen die effiziente und deklarative Transformation von hierarchischen Datenstrukturen in flache Tabellen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um Daten für die weitere Verarbeitung zu normalisieren.
keywords: FOR, Nested Loops, Internal Tables, VALUE, COND

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) über alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE` Expression mit `FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                   NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist ideal für Aggregationen und die Berechnung eines einzelnen Ergebnisses aus einer internen Tabelle. Sie ersetzt explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen durch einen deklarativen Ausdruck, was den Code kürzer und fehlerresistenter macht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus `sflight`, die zusätzlich die Auslastungsrate (`occupancy_rate`) pro Flug berechnet. Verwenden Sie `LET` um Zwischenergebnisse zu definieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_let_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_derived,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupancy_rate TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sflight_derived.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_derived TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_derived WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_with_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_derived) TYPE tt_sflight_derived.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_let_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_with_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_sflights_derived = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                       LET lv_total_seats = <fs_sflight>-seatsmax
                                           lv_occupied_seats = <fs_sflight>-seatsocc IN
                                       ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                         connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                         fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate
                                         occupancy_rate = COND decfloat16( WHEN lv_total_seats > 0 THEN ( lv_occupied_seats / lv_total_seats ) * 100 ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_derived) = lo_cut->get_sflights_with_occupancy( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_derived ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_derived ) > 0 ).

    DATA(ls_entry) = VALUE #( lt_derived[ 1 ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_entry IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_entry-occupancy_rate >= 0 AND ls_entry-occupancy_rate <= 100 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Strukturierung komplexer Berechnungen, indem Zwischenergebnisse benannt und wiederverwendet werden können, ohne separate Variablen deklarieren zu müssen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) den Flug mit der höchsten Anzahl belegter Sitze (`seatsocc`) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` oder `MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_max_per_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_max_occ,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_max_occ.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_max_occ TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_max_occ WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_occupancy_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_occ_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_max_occ.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_max_per_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_occupancy_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_max_occ_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                    ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                      connid = REDUCE sflight-connid( INIT max_connid = '' max_seats = 0
                                                                      FOR member IN GROUP <fs_sflight>
                                                                      WHERE ( member-seatsocc > max_seats )
                                                                      NEXT max_connid = member-connid
                                                                           max_seats = member-seatsocc )
                                      seatsocc = REDUCE sflight-seatsocc( INIT max_seats = 0
                                                                         FOR member IN GROUP <fs_sflight>
                                                                         NEXT max_seats = nmax( max_seats, member-seatsocc ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_max_occupancy_per_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_max) = VALUE #( lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_lh_max IS NOT INITIAL.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

GROUP BY ...` in Kombination mit der `REDUCE` Expression, um komplexe Aggregationen pro Gruppe durchzuführen. Hier wird der Flug mit der höchsten Belegung pro Fluggesellschaft ermittelt, was die Leistungsfähigkeit der modernen ABAP-Ausdrücke für Datenanalysen zeigt.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                            connid = flight-connid,
                            fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).

    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit einem FOR-Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. Die WHERE-Klausel innerhalb des FOR-Ausdrucks filtert die Quelldaten effizient, was zu kompakterem und lesbarerem Code führt als traditionelle LOOP-AT-WHERE-Konstrukte.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, LOOP
