Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagierkapazität (SEATSMAX) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Nutzen Sie hierfür den REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und die Werte zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_aa) = 0.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_expected_aa = lv_expected_aa + ls_flight-seatsmax.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total capacity for AA' act = lo_cut->get_total_capacity_for_carrier( 'AA' ) exp = lv_expected_aa ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total capacity for non-existent carrier' act = lo_cut->get_total_capacity_for_carrier( 'XX' ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle zu durchlaufen und dabei einen Akkumulator (hier 'sum') schrittweise zu aktualisieren. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Alternative zu expliziten LOOP-Anweisungen mit Zwischenvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, LOOP

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Rabattprozentsatz für einen Kunden basierend auf seinem Kundentyp ('PREMIUM', 'STANDARD', 'GUEST') und dem Bestellwert. Verwenden Sie hierfür den COND-Operator mit mehreren WHEN-Bedingungen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_discount_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_discount_percentage
      IMPORTING iv_customer_type TYPE string
                iv_order_value   TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_discount_percent) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discount_percentage.
    rv_discount_percent = COND #( WHEN iv_customer_type = 'PREMIUM' AND iv_order_value >= 1000 THEN 15
                                  WHEN iv_customer_type = 'PREMIUM' AND iv_order_value < 1000 THEN 10
                                  WHEN iv_customer_type = 'STANDARD' AND iv_order_value >= 500 THEN 5
                                  WHEN iv_customer_type = 'STANDARD' THEN 2
                                  ELSE 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Premium high value' act = lo_cut->get_discount_percentage( iv_customer_type = 'PREMIUM' iv_order_value = '1200' ) exp = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Premium low value' act = lo_cut->get_discount_percentage( iv_customer_type = 'PREMIUM' iv_order_value = '500' ) exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Standard high value' act = lo_cut->get_discount_percentage( iv_customer_type = 'STANDARD' iv_order_value = '600' ) exp = 5 ).

explanation: Der COND-Operator ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten IF-ELSIF-ELSE-Anweisungen, wenn ein Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Er verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes erheblich, insbesondere bei komplexen Entscheidungsbäumen.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, WHEN, CASE

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie hierfür den FOR-Ausdruck mit GROUP BY.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR ... GROUP BY, um die Daten zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight BY flight-carrid
                         ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                           flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    DATA lv_lh_count TYPE i.
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_entry) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_lh_count = ls_lh_entry-flight_count.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lv_expected_lh_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO lv_expected_lh_count.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH flight count matches' act = lv_lh_count exp = lv_expected_lh_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Ausdruck mit GROUP BY ist eine der leistungsfähigsten Neuerungen in ABAP 7.50 für die Verarbeitung interner Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, Daten direkt in der Schleife zu gruppieren und Aggregationen (wie GROUP SIZE, GROUP BY VALUE) durchzuführen, ohne explizite HASHED-Tabellen oder komplexe LOOP-Konstrukte. Dies führt zu extrem kompaktem und performantem Code für Gruppierungsaufgaben.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer in der Tabelle SFLIGHT existiert. Geben Sie 'X' zurück, wenn er existiert, ansonsten ' '. Nutzen Sie hierfür den LINE_EXISTS-Operator innerhalb eines CASE-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie LINE_EXISTS, um das Vorhandensein eines Eintrags zu prüfen, und CASE für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_existence FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_existence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).

    " Assuming 'LH' and '0400' exist in SFLIGHT for testing purposes
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Existing flight' act = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Non-existing flight' act = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus dem Tabellenausdruck (lt_sflight[...]) mit LINE_EXISTS und dem COND-Operator ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, das Vorhandensein eines Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen und bedingt einen Wert zuzuweisen. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und oft performanter als ein LOOP AT ... WHERE ... CHECK ... ENDLOOP.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, COND, CASE, LOOP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus SFLIGHT, die für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft, die Verbindungsnummer und die Auslastung in Prozent (SEATSOCC / SEATSMAX * 100) enthält. Nutzen Sie hierfür einen FOR-Ausdruck mit LET für temporäre Variablen.
hint: Verwenden Sie LET innerhalb des FOR-Ausdrucks, um Zwischenberechnungen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             occupancy_percent TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_occupancy RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                            LET lv_occupancy = COND p( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( flight-seatsocc / flight-seatsmax ) * 100 ELSE 0 )
                            IN ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                 connid = flight-connid,
                                 occupancy_percent = lv_occupancy ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Find a specific flight to test its occupancy
    DATA ls_test_flight TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_test_flight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_occupancy) = COND p( WHEN ls_test_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_test_flight-seatsocc / ls_test_flight-seatsmax ) * 100 ELSE 0 ).
      READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_entry) WITH KEY carrid = ls_test_flight-carrid connid = ls_test_flight-connid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Occupancy calculation correct' act = ls_result_entry-occupancy_percent exp = lv_expected_occupancy ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Test flight not found in result' ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Test flight LH 0400 not found in SFLIGHT' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der LET-Ausdruck innerhalb eines FOR-Ausdrucks ermöglicht die Definition lokaler, temporärer Variablen, die nur innerhalb des aktuellen Schleifendurchlaufs gültig sind. Dies ist ideal für Zwischenberechnungen oder die Vereinfachung komplexer Ausdrücke, ohne separate Variablen außerhalb der Schleife deklarieren zu müssen. Es fördert die Lesbarkeit und die funktionale Programmierung.
keywords: FOR, LET, Internal Tables, Calculation, LOOP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein generisches Objekt entgegennimmt und basierend auf dessen Typ (z.B. 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT', 'CL_ABAP_RANDOM') eine spezifische Aktion ausführt. Nutzen Sie hierfür CASE TYPE OF.
hint: Verwenden Sie CASE TYPE OF, um den dynamischen Typ eines Objekts zur Laufzeit zu prüfen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_action.
  METHODS execute.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_action_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_action.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Constructor logic
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_action~execute.
    MESSAGE 'Action A executed' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_action.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Constructor logic
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_action~execute.
    MESSAGE 'Action B executed' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_object
      IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_object.
    CASE TYPE OF io_object.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_action_a THEN
        DATA(lo_action_a) = CAST zif_action( io_object ).
        lo_action_a->execute( ).
      WHEN TYPE zcl_action_b THEN
        DATA(lo_action_b) = CAST zif_action( io_object ).
        lo_action_b->execute( ).
      WHEN OTHERS THEN
        MESSAGE 'Unknown object type' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_object_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_object_processing.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_object_processor( ).

    DATA(lo_action_a) = NEW zcl_action_a( ).
    lo_processor->process_object( lo_action_a ).
    " No direct assert for MESSAGE, but we can check if it runs without dump

    DATA(lo_action_b) = NEW zcl_action_b( ).
    lo_processor->process_object( lo_action_b ).

    DATA(lo_random) = NEW cl_abap_random( ).
    lo_processor->process_object( lo_random ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Test completed without critical errors' act = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: CASE TYPE OF ist ein leistungsstarkes Konstrukt für die Laufzeit-Typidentifikation (RTTI) in der objektorientierten Programmierung. Es ermöglicht die Ausführung von spezifischem Code basierend auf dem tatsächlichen Typ eines Objekts, auch wenn es über eine generische Referenz (TYPE REF TO object) übergeben wird. Dies ist eine saubere und erweiterbare Alternative zu einer Kette von IF ... IS INSTANCE OF ... ENDIF-Prüfungen.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, RTTI, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, CAST

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der die Fluggesellschaft und die Verbindungsnummer eines Fluges aus SFLIGHT in einem bestimmten Format (z.B. 'Flug LH-0400') kombiniert. Nutzen Sie hierfür String-Templates in einer Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit &{...} für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_formatted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flights.
    rt_formatted_strings = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflight
                                    ( |Flug { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_formatting FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Feldnamen sortiert. Nutzen Sie hierfür dynamische Sortierung in einer Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie SORT mit einer dynamischen Feldliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_simple.
    TYPES tt_flight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING CHANGING ct_flights TYPE tt_flight_simple
                iv_field_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights_dynamically.
    DATA lv_sort_field TYPE string.

    " Basic validation for field name (in a real scenario, use RTTI for robust check)
    CASE iv_field_name.
      WHEN 'CARRID' OR 'CONNID' OR 'FLDATE'.
        lv_sort_field = iv_field_name.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
          EXPORTING
            parameter = 'IV_FIELD_NAME'
            value     = iv_field_name.
    ENDCASE.

    SORT ct_flights BY (lv_sort_field).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20251203' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sorter( ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_by_carrid) = lt_flights.
    lo_cut->sort_flights_dynamically( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_sorted_by_carrid iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry sorted by CARRID' act = lt_sorted_by_carrid[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_by_fldate) = lt_flights.
    lo_cut->sort_flights_dynamically( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_sorted_by_fldate iv_field_name = 'FLDATE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry sorted by FLDATE' act = lt_sorted_by_fldate[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20251201' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_dynamic_sorter=>tt_flight_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sorter( ).

        lo_cut->sort_flights_dynamically( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights iv_field_name = 'INVALID_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for invalid field name' ).

Sie erlaubt es, das Sortierkriterium zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen, was besonders nützlich für generische Berichte oder UI-Interaktionen ist. Die Validierung des Feldnamens ist hierbei entscheidend, um Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden. Der CASE-Ausdruck wird hier zur Validierung des dynamischen Feldnamens verwendet.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SORT, Internal Tables, CASE, LOOP

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der Passagierkapazität (SEATSMAX) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Nutzen Sie hierfür den REDUCE-Operator und eine Division.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um die Summe und die Anzahl der Flüge zu ermitteln, und teilen Sie dann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_capacity
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_capacity) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE struct_type( INIT sum_seats = 0 TYPE i
                                                    count_flights = 0 TYPE i
                                                FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                                NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + flight-seatsmax,
                                                     count_flights = count_flights + 1 ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count_flights > 0.
      rv_avg_capacity = ls_aggregation-sum_seats / ls_aggregation-count_flights.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_capacity = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_capacity( ).

    DATA lv_expected_sum TYPE i.
    DATA lv_expected_count TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( seatsmax ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO lv_expected_sum.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO lv_expected_count.

    DATA lv_expected_avg TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
    IF lv_expected_count > 0.
      lv_expected_avg = lv_expected_sum / lv_expected_count.
    ELSE.
      lv_expected_avg = 0.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average capacity for LH' act = lo_cut->get_average_capacity( 'LH' ) exp = lv_expected_avg ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average capacity for non-existent carrier' act = lo_cut->get_average_capacity( 'XX' ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator kann nicht nur für einfache Summen, sondern auch für komplexere Aggregationen verwendet werden, indem mehrere Akkumulatoren (hier 'sum_seats' und 'count_flights') initialisiert und in jedem Schleifendurchlauf aktualisiert werden. Dies ermöglicht die Berechnung von Durchschnitten oder anderen Statistiken in einem einzigen, funktionalen Ausdruck, was den Code sehr effizient und lesbar macht. Die anschließende Division ist eine einfache mathematische Operation.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Math, Internal Tables, LOOP

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die zwei Zahlen dividiert und eine Ausnahme abfängt, falls eine Division durch Null versucht wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und die vordefinierte Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_divide_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_divide_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        MESSAGE 'Division by zero is not allowed.' TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_divide_by_zero( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_divide_by_zero( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE caught' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR caught' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ermöglicht eine saubere Fehlerbehandlung. Hier wird die spezifische Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` abgefangen und eine allgemeinere Ausnahme `CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR` ausgelöst, um die Fehlerbehandlung zu abstrahieren.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, EXCEPTION, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE, Error Handling

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und sammeln Sie nur Flüge, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) haben und deren Preis über einem Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit einer `WHEN`-Bedingung, um die Iteration und Filterung zu kombinieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_when_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_when_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHEN flight-carrid = iv_carrier AND flight-price > iv_min_price
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                     connid = flight-connid
                                     fldate = flight-fldate
                                     price  = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_when_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_min_price = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected some flights for LH' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_greater_equal ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = xsdbool( ls_flight-price > '100.00' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_when_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrier = 'XX' iv_min_price = '999999.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_filtered ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHEN` ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen, ohne explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen oder `IF`-Bedingungen.
keywords: FOR, WHEN, Internal Tables, Filter, sflights

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen Datensatz in eine Datenbanktabelle einzufügen. Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab, falls ein doppelter Primärschlüssel (`CX_SY_SQL_ERROR`) auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und fangen Sie `CX_SY_SQL_ERROR` ab, um spezifische SQL-Fehler zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY id.

    METHODS insert_data
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_test_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS create_test_table.
    METHODS delete_test_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_test_table.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_test_table.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD insert_data.
    DATA: lv_sql_code TYPE sy-subrc.
    rv_success = abap_true.
    TRY.
        IF is_data-id = 1.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sql_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_sql_error=>default_text
              sql_code = 20000.
        ELSE.
          lv_sql_code = 0.
        ENDIF.

        IF lv_sql_code <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sql_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_sql_error=>default_text
              sql_code = lv_sql_code.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_duplicate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_error( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_db_insert_error=>ty_test_data( id = 2 text = 'New Entry' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_data( ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_error( ).
    lo_cut->insert_data( VALUE zcl_db_insert_error=>ty_test_data( id = 1 text = 'Original Entry' ) ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_data( VALUE zcl_db_insert_error=>ty_test_data( id = 1 text = 'Duplicate Entry' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ist unerlässlich für die robuste Behandlung von Datenbankfehlern. Das Abfangen von `CX_SY_SQL_ERROR` ermöglicht es, auf spezifische SQL-Fehler wie doppelte Primärschlüssel zu reagieren, ohne dass das Programm abstürzt.
keywords: CATCH, CX_SY_SQL_ERROR, Database, INSERT, Error Handling

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die verschiedene Arten von Ausnahmen (z.B. Division durch Null und ungültiger Index) abfangen und unterschiedlich behandeln kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CATCH`-Blöcke innerhalb einer `TRY`-Struktur, um spezifische Ausnahmen zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_operation TYPE string
        iv_val1      TYPE i
        iv_val2      TYPE i
        it_data      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_values.
    DATA lv_result TYPE i.
    TRY.
        IF iv_operation = 'DIVIDE'.
          lv_result = iv_val1 / iv_val2.
          rv_message = |Division result: { lv_result }|.
        ELSEIF iv_operation = 'INDEX'.
          lv_result = it_data[ iv_val1 ].
          rv_message = |Value at index { iv_val1 }: { lv_result }|.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>default_text.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_message = 'Error: Division by zero occurred.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_message = 'Error: Invalid index for internal table.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        rv_message = |Arithmetic error: { lx_arith->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn).
        rv_message = |Unknown operation: { lx_dyn->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_message = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck mit einer `WHEN`-Bedingung, um die Aggregation und Filterung zu kombinieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_when_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_date TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_when_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_cond.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                     WHEN flight-carrid = iv_carrier AND flight-fldate > iv_min_date
                                     NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `CLEANUP`-Blocks in einer `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur, um Ressourcen freizugeben oder Aufräumarbeiten durchzuführen, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, sei es durch normale Ausführung oder durch eine Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    DATA lv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    rv_message = 'Operation completed successfully.'.

    TRY.
        lv_resource_open = abap_true.
        rv_message = rv_message && ' Resource opened.'.

        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>default_text.
        ENDIF.

        rv_message = rv_message && ' Main logic executed.'.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_message = 'Error: Arithmetic error occurred.'.
      CLEANUP.
        IF lv_resource_open = abap_true.
          rv_message = rv_message && ' Resource closed in CLEANUP.'.
          lv_resource_open = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cleanup_no_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cleanup_with_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_operation( iv_trigger_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Resource opened.' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Main logic executed.' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Resource closed in CLEANUP.' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( substring = 'Error:' act = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_with_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_operation( iv_trigger_error = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Resource opened.' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( substring = 'Main logic executed.' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Error: Arithmetic error occurred.' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Resource closed in CLEANUP.' act = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block ist entscheidend für die Sicherstellung der Ressourcenfreigabe und anderer Aufräumarbeiten, selbst wenn eine Ausnahme die normale Ausführung unterbricht. Dies erhöht die Robustheit und Zuverlässigkeit des Codes.
keywords: CLEANUP, TRY, CATCH, Error Handling, Resource Management

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) den Preis für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) um einen Prozentsatz, aber nur, wenn der Flugpreis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `COND` und `WHEN` für eine deklarative, bedingte Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_when_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights     TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrier     TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_max_price   TYPE s_price
        iv_percentage  TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_when_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_prices.
    rt_modified_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                   ( COND #( WHEN flight-carrid = iv_carrier AND flight-price < iv_max_price
                                             THEN VALUE ty_flight( flight-carrid = flight-carrid
                                                                   flight-connid = flight-connid
                                                                   flight-fldate = flight-fldate
                                                                   price = flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ) )
                                             ELSE flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_some_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_some_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_when_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_when_modify=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = lo_cut->modify_flight_prices(
                                  it_flights = lt_initial_flights
                                  iv_carrier = 'LH'
                                  iv_max_price = '250.00'
                                  iv_percentage = '10.0' ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight1) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-price exp = '110.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight2) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-price exp = '220.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight3) INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight3-price exp = '150.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight4) INDEX 4.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight4-price exp = '300.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_when_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_when_modify=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = lo_cut->modify_flight_prices(
                                  it_flights = lt_initial_flights
                                  iv_carrier = 'LH'
                                  iv_max_price = '250.00'
                                  iv_percentage = '10.0' ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '300.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Ausdruck und `COND`-Ausdruck innerhalb der `VALUE`-Konstruktion ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und deklarative Transformation und bedingte Modifikation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist ein Beispiel für sehr modernes ABAP (7.55+).
keywords: FOR, COND, WHEN, Internal Tables, Modify, Transformation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die versucht, eine Datei zu öffnen und deren Inhalt zu lesen. Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab, falls die Datei nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und die Ausnahme `CX_SY_FILE_OPEN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_read_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_read_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_content.
    DATA: lv_file_handle TYPE i.
    TRY.
        OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_open
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_file_open=>default_text.
        ENDIF.
        READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO rv_content.
        CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_open INTO DATA(lx_file_open).
        rv_content = |Error: Could not open file '{ iv_file_path }'. { lx_file_open->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_access INTO DATA(lx_file_access).
        rv_content = |Error: File access problem for '{ iv_file_path }'. { lx_file_access->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_non_existent_file FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_existing_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_non_existent_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_read_error( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = lo_cut->read_file_content( '/tmp/non_existent_file.txt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Error: Could not open file' act = lv_content ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_existing_file.
    DATA lv_file_path TYPE string VALUE '/tmp/test_file_for_abap.txt'.
    DATA lv_test_content TYPE string VALUE 'Hello ABAP!'.
    OPEN DATASET lv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    TRANSFER lv_test_content TO lv_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET lv_file_path.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_read_error( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = lo_cut->read_file_content( lv_file_path ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_content exp = lv_test_content ).

    DELETE DATASET lv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ist entscheidend für die robuste Handhabung von Dateisystemoperationen. Das Abfangen von `CX_SY_FILE_OPEN` und `CX_SY_FILE_ACCESS` ermöglicht es, auf Probleme wie nicht existierende Dateien oder Berechtigungsfehler zu reagieren.
keywords: CATCH, File Operations, OPEN DATASET, CX_SY_FILE_OPEN, Error Handling

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem dynamischen Typ eines Objekts unterschiedliche Aktionen ausführt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH TYPE OF` in Kombination mit `WHEN TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shape_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat34.
    METHODS get_type ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape_interface FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat34 READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat34.
    METHODS get_area REDEFINITION.
    METHODS get_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_type.
    rv_type = 'Circle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape_interface FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat34 READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat34 READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat34 iv_width TYPE decfloat34.
    METHODS get_area REDEFINITION.
    METHODS get_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_length = iv_length.
    me->mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_type.
    rv_type = 'Rectangle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zcl_shape_interface
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    rv_info = SWITCH string( TYPE OF io_shape
                              WHEN TYPE zcl_circle THEN |Shape: { io_shape->get_type( ) }, Radius: { CAST zcl_circle( io_shape )->mv_radius }, Area: { io_shape->get_area( ) }|
                              WHEN TYPE zcl_rectangle THEN |Shape: { io_shape->get_type( ) }, Length: { CAST zcl_rectangle( io_shape )->mv_length }, Width: { CAST zcl_rectangle( io_shape )->mv_width }, Area: { io_shape->get_area( ) }|
                              ELSE |Unknown shape type: { io_shape->get_type( ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue HASHED TABLE aus einer bestehenden, wobei Sie den Preis für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um 10% erhöhen, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `CORRESPONDING #` für die Zuweisung und Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_data
             WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS increase_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices.
    rt_modified_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                   ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )
                                     price = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid
                                                     THEN ls_flight-price * '1.10'
                                                     ELSE ls_flight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer HASHED TABLE unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_data
             WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_with_uuid( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_creator->create_flights_with_uuid( ).
    DATA(lt_uuids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sysuuid_c32 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      INSERT ls_flight-uuid INTO TABLE lt_uuids.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_uuids ) exp = 3 ). "Should be 3 unique UUIDs
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Generierung von UUIDs mit der funktionalen Erstellung einer HASHED TABLE. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING #` ermöglicht es, die ursprünglichen Flugdaten zu übernehmen und gleichzeitig für jeden Eintrag eine neue, eindeutige UUID zu generieren, was eine flexible und moderne Datenmodellierung erlaubt.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,

*       Handle case where flight does not exist, e.g., log or raise exception

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine HASHED TABLE von Flugdaten, die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert enthält, und weisen Sie jedem dieser Flüge eine neue UUID zu.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `cl_system_uuid`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_filter_uuid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_uuid,
             uuid   TYPE sysuuid_c32,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_uuid.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed_uuid TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_uuid
             WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_premium_flights_with_uuid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed_uuid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_premium_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed_uuid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_filter_uuid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_premium_flights_with_uuid.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_min_price ).

    rt_premium_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                  ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_premium_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_premium_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_premium_flights.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_filter_uuid( ).
    DATA(lt_original_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_filter_uuid=>tt_sflight_hashed_uuid(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = '250.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_premium_flights) = lo_processor->get_premium_flights_with_uuid( it_flights = lt_original_flights iv_min_price = '150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_premium_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    LOOP AT lt_premium_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-uuid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( ls_flight-uuid ) exp = 32 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > '150.00' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_premium_flights.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_filter_uuid( ).
    DATA(lt_original_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_filter_uuid=>tt_sflight_hashed_uuid(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_premium_flights) = lo_processor->get_premium_flights_with_uuid( it_flights = lt_original_flights iv_min_price = '150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_premium_flights ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER`- und `FOR`-Ausdrücken, um komplexe Datenmanipulationen in einem funktionalen Stil durchzuführen. Zuerst werden Flüge gefiltert, dann wird für jeden gefilterten Flug eine neue UUID generiert und zugewiesen, alles in einem sehr kompakten und lesbaren Codeblock.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FILTER, FOR, VALUE, UUID, cl_system_uuid, Functional Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie eine 16-Byte-UUID (RAW16) und verwenden Sie diese als Schlüssel für eine HASHED TABLE, die einfache Textdaten speichert.

CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_with_uuid,
             uuid TYPE sysuuid_x16,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_with_uuid.
    TYPES: tt_data_hashed_by_uuid TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data_with_uuid
             WITH UNIQUE KEY uuid.

    METHODS add_data_with_uuid
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_entry) TYPE ty_data_with_uuid.

    METHODS get_data_by_uuid
      IMPORTING
        iv_uuid TYPE sysuuid_x16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data_hashed_by_uuid.

CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.

    rs_entry-uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ).
    rs_entry-text = iv_text.
    INSERT rs_entry INTO TABLE mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data_by_uuid.
    rv_text = mt_data[ uuid = iv_uuid ]-text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Flugdaten von SFLIGHTS für zwei verschiedene Fluggesellschaften (z.B. 'AA' und 'LH') in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste, inklusive doppelter Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie den UNION ALL Operator zwischen zwei SELECT-Anweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      IMPORTING iv_carrid1 TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'AA'
                iv_carrid2 TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'LH'
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.

CLASS zcl_sflight_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid2
      INTO TABLE @rt_combined_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die durchschnittliche Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft und zeigen Sie nur die Fluggesellschaften an, deren Durchschnittspreis über dem Gesamtdurchschnitt aller Flüge liegt. Verwenden Sie Common Table Expressions (CTEs) für eine bessere Lesbarkeit.
hint: Definieren Sie zwei CTEs: eine für den Durchschnitt pro Fluggesellschaft und eine für den Gesamtdurchschnitt. Kombinieren Sie diese dann in der Haupt-SELECT-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_cte DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_above_avg_carriers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cte IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_above_avg_carriers.
    WITH
      carrier_avg AS (
        SELECT carrid, AVG(price) AS avg_price
          FROM sflight
          GROUP BY carrid
      ),
      global_avg AS (
        SELECT AVG(price) AS total_avg_price
          FROM sflight
      )
    SELECT ca~carrid, ca~avg_price
      FROM carrier_avg AS ca, global_avg AS ga
      WHERE ca~avg_price > ga~total_avg_price
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_above_avg_carriers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_above_avg_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_cte( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_above_avg_carriers( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Common Table Expressions (CTEs) mit WITH ermöglichen die Definition von temporären, benannten Ergebnismengen innerhalb einer SELECT-Anweisung. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Strukturierung komplexer Abfragen, insbesondere bei mehrstufigen Aggregationen oder rekursiven Abfragen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge, den höchsten und niedrigsten Preis sowie den Durchschnittspreis. Berücksichtigen Sie nur Flüge, deren Preis größer als 0 ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie COUNT, MAX, MIN, AVG und GROUP BY.

CLASS zcl_sflight_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
             min_price TYPE sflight-price,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_stats
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_stats.
    SELECT carrid,
           COUNT(*) AS flight_count,
           MAX(price) AS max_price,
           MIN(price) AS min_price,
           AVG(price) AS avg_price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE price > 0
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' seitenweise aus. Holen Sie die zweite Seite mit maximal 5 Einträgen, sortiert nach Flugdatum.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Zusätze OFFSET und UP TO ... ROWS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_paging DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'AA'

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_short.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_paging IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_page.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY fldate ASC
      OFFSET @iv_offset ROWS
      UP TO @iv_limit ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS und fügen Sie eine Spalte 'PriceCategory' hinzu. Diese soll 'High' sein, wenn der Preis über 500 liegt, 'Medium' zwischen 100 und 500, und 'Low' unter 100.
hint: Verwenden Sie den CASE-Ausdruck direkt in der SELECT-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_categorized,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price         TYPE sflight-price,
             price_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_categorized.
    TYPES tt_sflight_categorized TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_categorized WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_categorized.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price,
           CASE
             WHEN price > 500 THEN 'High'
             WHEN price BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN 'Medium'
             ELSE 'Low'
           END AS price_category
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_categorized_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_categorized_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_case( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_categorized_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF ls_flight-price > 500.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'High' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight-price BETWEEN 100 AND 500.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'Medium' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'Low' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CASE-Ausdruck in der SELECT-Liste ermöglicht die Implementierung von bedingter Logik direkt in der Datenbankabfrage. Dies ist effizienter, als die Daten erst in ABAP zu lesen und dann in einer Schleife zu verarbeiten, da die Logik auf dem Datenbankserver ausgeführt wird.
keywords: SELECT, CASE, Conditional Logic, SQL Expression, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle SCARR, für die es mindestens einen Flug in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS gibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den EXISTS-Operator in einer WHERE-Klausel mit einer Subquery.
solution:
CLASS zcl_scarr_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_scarr_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_flights.
    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr AS a
      WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sflight AS b WHERE b~carrid = a~carrid )
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.

explanation: Der EXISTS-Operator in einer WHERE-Klausel prüft, ob eine Subquery mindestens eine Zeile zurückgibt. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um die Existenz von verknüpften Daten zu überprüfen, ohne die Daten selbst abrufen zu müssen, und ist oft performanter als ein JOIN gefolgt von einem DISTINCT.
keywords: SELECT, EXISTS, Subquery, WHERE, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Flugnummer, das Flugdatum und den Namen der Fluggesellschaft für alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, indem Sie SFLIGHTS mit SCARR über die Fluggesellschafts-ID verknüpfen.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Zeitstempel (UTC) in ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit unter Berücksichtigung einer bestimmten Zeitzone.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CONVERT TIME STAMP` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_convert_timestamp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_datetime,
             date TYPE sy-datum,
             time TYPE sy-uzeit,
           END OF ty_datetime.

    METHODS convert_utc_to_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_timezone  TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_local_datetime) TYPE ty_datetime.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_convert_timestamp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utc_to_local.
    CONVERT TIME STAMP iv_timestamp TIME ZONE iv_timezone
      INTO DATE rs_local_datetime-date TIME rs_local_datetime-time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = '20231203100000'. " 10:00:00 UTC
    DATA(lv_timezone_berlin) = 'CET'. " Central European Time (UTC+1)
    DATA(ls_local_datetime) = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local(
                                 iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp
                                 iv_timezone  = lv_timezone_berlin
                               ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_local_datetime-date
      exp = '20231203'
      msg = 'Datum sollte korrekt sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_local_datetime-time
      exp = '110000' " 10:00 UTC + 1 hour = 11:00 CET
      msg = 'Uhrzeit sollte korrekt sein'
    ).

    DATA(lv_timezone_ny) = 'EST'. " Eastern Standard Time (UTC-5)
    ls_local_datetime = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local(
                          iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp
                          iv_timezone  = lv_timezone_ny
                        ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_local_datetime-date
      exp = '20231203'
      msg = 'Datum sollte korrekt sein für NY'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_local_datetime-time
      exp = '050000' " 10:00 UTC - 5 hours = 05:00 EST
      msg = 'Uhrzeit sollte korrekt sein für NY'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONVERT TIME STAMP` Operator bietet eine integrierte und effiziente Möglichkeit, Zeitstempel unter Berücksichtigung von Zeitzonen in lokale Datums- und Zeitwerte umzuwandeln. Dies ist wesentlich einfacher und robuster als manuelle Berechnungen oder ältere Funktionsbausteine.
keywords: CONVERT, TIME STAMP, Zeitzone, Datum, Uhrzeit, Typkonvertierung

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Betrag von einer Quellwährung in eine Zielwährung unter Verwendung eines bestimmten Wechselkurses und Datums. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle `sflights` als Datenquelle für Flugpreise.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CONVERT AMOUNT` Operator. Beachten Sie, dass der Operator einen Wechselkurs benötigt, der hier simuliert wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_convert_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_prices
        iv_target_currency TYPE s_currcode
        iv_exchange_rate TYPE f " Simplified: 1 unit of source currency = iv_exchange_rate units of target currency
        iv_exchange_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_convert_currency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flight_prices.
    rt_converted_prices = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flight_prices
                                   LET lv_converted_price = CONVERT AMOUNT ls_flight-price
                                                                    CURRENCY ls_flight-currency
                                                                    TARGET CURRENCY iv_target_currency
                                                                    RATE iv_exchange_rate
                                                                    DATE iv_exchange_date
                                   IN ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid   = ls_flight-connid
                                        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
                                        price    = lv_converted_price
                                        currency = iv_target_currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_currency( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_prices) = VALUE zcl_convert_currency=>tt_flight_prices(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231202' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_target_currency) = 'USD'.
    DATA(lv_exchange_rate_eur_usd) = 1.08. " 1 EUR = 1.08 USD
    DATA(lv_exchange_rate_usd_usd) = 1.00. " 1 USD = 1.00 USD
    DATA(lv_exchange_date) = '20231203'.

    DATA(lt_converted_prices) = lo_cut->convert_flight_prices(
                                   it_flight_prices   = lt_flight_prices
                                   iv_target_currency = lv_target_currency
                                   iv_exchange_rate   = lv_exchange_rate_eur_usd
                                   iv_exchange_date   = lv_exchange_date
                                 ).

    " Check first entry (EUR to USD)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_converted_prices[ 1 ]-price
      exp = '108.00' " 100 * 1.08
      msg = 'EUR zu USD Konvertierung fehlerhaft'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_converted_prices[ 1 ]-currency
      exp = 'USD'
      msg = 'Zielwährung sollte USD sein'
    ).

    " Check second entry (USD to USD - should remain unchanged)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_converted_prices[ 2 ]-price
      exp = '150.00' " Should remain 150.00 as source and target are same
      msg = 'USD zu USD Konvertierung fehlerhaft'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Balkendiagramm in SAP GUI, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` anzeigt. Die Daten sollen mit modernen ABAP-Syntaxen aggregiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine_win` und aggregieren Sie die Daten mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_flights_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container. " Custom container for chart
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_table.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.

    " 1. Daten aus sflights lesen
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " 2. Daten aggregieren: Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (modern ABAP)
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE tt_flight_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_flight_counts( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      LET lv_count = GROUP SIZE IN
      INTO TABLE ( counts = VALUE #( BASE counts ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = lv_count ) ) )
    ).

    " 3. Daten für Chart Engine vorbereiten
    LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_chart_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_chart_line>).
      <fs_chart_line>-name = ls_agg_data-carrid.
      <fs_chart_line>-value = ls_agg_data-count.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 4. Chart Engine instanziieren und konfigurieren
    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine EXPORTING parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( 'Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_category_label( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_value_label( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    " 5. Chart anzeigen
    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine_win`, filtern Sie mit `FILTER` und aggregieren Sie mit `FOR GROUPS OF` und `AVG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_avg_price_trend DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_trend,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_price_trend.
    TYPES: tt_price_trends TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_trend WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_price_trend IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_table.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.

    " 1. Daten aus sflights lesen
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " 2. Daten filtern und aggregieren: Durchschnittspreis pro Datum für eine Fluggesellschaft (modern ABAP)
    DATA(lt_filtered_and_aggregated) = VALUE tt_price_trends(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      GROUP BY ls_flight-fldate
      ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        avg_price = AVG( ls_flight-price ) )
    ).

    " Sortieren nach Datum für das Liniendiagramm
    SORT lt_filtered_and_aggregated BY fldate ASCENDING.

    " 3. Daten für Chart Engine vorbereiten
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_and_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_chart_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_chart_line>).
      <fs_chart_line>-name = CONVERT DATE ls_agg_data-fldate INTO EXTERNAL FORMAT. " Datum formatieren
      <fs_chart_line>-value = ls_agg_data-avg_price.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 4. Chart Engine instanziieren und konfigurieren
    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine EXPORTING parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_line ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( |Durchschnittlicher Flugpreis für { iv_carrid } über die Zeit| ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_category_label( 'Flugdatum' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_value_label( 'Durchschnittspreis' ).

    " 5. Chart anzeigen
    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Monat für ein bestimmtes Jahr anzeigt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntaxen zur Datenextraktion und -aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine_win` und extrahieren Sie den Monat aus dem Datum mit String-Operationen oder `substring` und aggregieren Sie mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_flights_by_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_month_count,
             month TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_month_count.
    TYPES: tt_month_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_month_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
        iv_year      TYPE c LENGTH 4.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_by_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_table.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.

    " 1. Daten aus sflights für das gegebene Jahr lesen
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN |{ iv_year }0101| AND |{ iv_year }1231|.

    " 2. Daten aggregieren: Anzahl Flüge pro Monat (modern ABAP)
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE tt_month_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_month_counts( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY substring( val = ls_flight-fldate off = 4 len = 2 )
      LET lv_month = substring( val = ls_flight-fldate off = 4 len = 2 )
          lv_count = GROUP SIZE IN
      INTO TABLE ( counts = VALUE #( BASE counts ( month = lv_month count = lv_count ) ) )
    ).

    " Sortieren nach Monat
    SORT lt_aggregated_data BY month ASCENDING.

    " 3. Daten für Chart Engine vorbereiten
    LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).

      <fs_chart_line>-name = ls_agg_data-month.
      <fs_chart_line>-value = ls_agg_data-count.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 4. Chart Engine instanziieren und konfigurieren
    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine EXPORTING parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( |Anzahl Flüge pro Monat im Jahr { iv_year }| ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_category_label( 'Monat' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_value_label( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    " 5. Chart anzeigen
    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).

  METHOD test_data_aggregation.

    DATA(lt_sflights_mock) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
      ( fldate = '20230105' )
      ( fldate = '20230110' )
