Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein gestapeltes Balkendiagramm in SAP GUI, das die Anzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft, aufgeteilt nach Flugklasse, für ein bestimmtes Flugdatum anzeigt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntaxen für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine_win` und aggregieren Sie die Daten mit verschachtelten `FOR GROUPS OF` oder `REDUCE` für die mehrdimensionale Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_stacked_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             class  TYPE s_class,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger_data.
    TYPES: tt_passenger_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
        iv_fldate    TYPE s_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_stacked_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_table.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.

    " 1. Daten aus sflights für das gegebene Flugdatum lesen
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE fldate = iv_fldate.

    " 2. Daten aggregieren: Anzahl Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft und Klasse (modern ABAP)
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = VALUE tt_passenger_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid class = ls_flight-class
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        class  = ls_flight-class
        count  = SUM( ls_flight-seatsocc ) )
    ).

    " 3. Daten für Chart Engine vorbereiten (gestapeltes Diagramm benötigt spezielle Struktur)
    " Hier wird eine vereinfachte Darstellung für die Chart Engine verwendet, die typischerweise
    " eine Serie pro Stapelkomponente erwartet.
    DATA: lt_series_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_table.
    DATA: lt_categories TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_category_table.

    " Kategorien (Fluggesellschaften)
    lt_categories = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN lt_aggregated_data GROUP BY ls_data-carrid
                               ( name = ls_data-carrid ) ).

    " Serien (Flugklassen) und deren Werte
    DATA(lt_classes) = VALUE string_table( FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN lt_aggregated_data GROUP BY ls_data-class
                                            ( ls_data-class ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_classes INTO DATA(lv_class).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_series_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_series>).
      <fs_series>-name = lv_class. " Name der Serie (Flugklasse)
      LOOP AT lt_categories INTO DATA(ls_category).
        DATA(lv_value) = 0.
        READ TABLE lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_entry)
          WITH KEY carrid = ls_category-name class = lv_class.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_value = ls_agg_entry-count.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND lv_value TO <fs_series>-values.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 4. Chart Engine instanziieren und konfigurieren
    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine EXPORTING parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_stacked_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( |Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft und Klasse am { CONVERT DATE iv_fldate INTO EXTERNAL FORMAT }| ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data( lt_series_data ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_categories( lt_categories ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_category_label( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_value_label( 'Anzahl Passagiere' ).

    " 5. Chart anzeigen
    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein Kontextmenü verwaltet. Eine separate 'Freund'-Klasse soll exklusiven Zugriff haben, um spezielle, private Menüpunkte hinzuzufügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FRIENDS` Deklaration in der `CLASS DEFINITION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_menu RETURNING VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS add_private_function IMPORTING iv_fcode TYPE ui_func iv_text TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_menu TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
    FRIENDS zcl_ctmenu_friend. " Declare friend class
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_menu.
    IF mo_menu IS INITIAL.
      mo_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
      mo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'PUBLIC_OPT' text = 'Public Option' ).
    ENDIF.
    ro_menu = mo_menu.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_private_function.
    mo_menu->add_function( fcode = iv_fcode text = iv_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_friend DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_special_option IMPORTING io_manager TYPE REF TO zcl_ctmenu_manager.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_friend IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_special_option.
    " Only a friend can call protected/private methods
    io_manager->add_private_function( iv_fcode = 'FRIEND_OPT' iv_text = 'Friend-Only Option' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_ctmenu_manager( ).
    DATA(lo_friend) = NEW zcl_ctmenu_friend( ).
    DATA(lo_menu) = lo_manager->get_menu( ).

    " Initially, only public option should be there
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu->get_function_text( 'PUBLIC_OPT' ) exp = 'Public Option' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_menu->get_function_text( 'FRIEND_OPT' ) ).

    " Friend adds special option
    lo_friend->add_special_option( lo_manager ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Dies demonstriert eine kontrollierte Kapselung und den gezielten Zugriff auf interne Funktionalität, was die Objektorientierung verbessert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, dessen Einträge von einem externen Status abhängen. Wenn der Status 'ACTIVE' ist, soll ein 'Deaktivieren'-Menüpunkt erscheinen, sonst ein 'Aktivieren'-Menüpunkt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator, um den Menüpunkt basierend auf einer Bedingung zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_status TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    CONSTANTS: gc_status_active TYPE ty_status VALUE 'ACTIVE',
               gc_status_inactive TYPE ty_status VALUE 'INACTIVE'.

    METHODS create_dynamic_menu
      IMPORTING iv_current_status TYPE ty_status
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_menu.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).

    DATA(ls_menu_item) = COND #(
      WHEN iv_current_status = gc_status_active THEN VALUE #( fcode = 'DEACT' text = 'Deaktivieren' )
      WHEN iv_current_status = gc_status_inactive THEN VALUE #( fcode = 'ACT' text = 'Aktivieren' )
      ELSE THROW cx_abap_invalid_parameter( textid = cx_abap_invalid_parameter=>default )
    ).

    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = ls_menu_item-fcode text = ls_menu_item-text ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'INFO' text = 'Information' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften (aus `sflights`). Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, das für jede Fluggesellschaft einen Eintrag anzeigt. Zusätzlich soll ein spezieller Menüpunkt die Gesamtzahl der Fluggesellschaften anzeigen, aggregiert mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Anzahl der Einträge zu zählen und `LOOP AT` um die Menüpunkte zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_airline_menu
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_airline_menu.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).

    " Using sflights for demo, assuming it's available
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_airlines) UP TO 5 ROWS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fallback if sflight is empty or not available
      lt_airlines = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
        ( carrid = 'UA' carrname = 'United Airlines' )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    " Add menu items for each airline
    LOOP AT lt_airlines INTO DATA(ls_airline).
      ro_menu->add_function( fcode = ls_airline-carrid text = ls_airline-carrname ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Aggregate count using REDUCE
    DATA(lv_airline_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                       FOR <fs_airline> IN lt_airlines
                                       NEXT count = count + 1 ).

    ro_menu->add_separator( ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'COUNT' text = |Total Airlines: { lv_airline_count }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_menu->get_function_text( 'AA' ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Die Menüpunkte werden mit einer `LOOP AT` Schleife hinzugefügt, und String Templates (`|...|`) werden für den Text des Zählmenüpunkts verwendet.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, das nur Fluggesellschaften (aus `sflights`) anzeigt, deren ID mit 'A' beginnt.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_filtered_airline_menu
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_filtered_airline_menu.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).

    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_airlines) UP TO 10 ROWS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lt_all_airlines = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
        ( carrid = 'UA' carrname = 'United Airlines' )
        ( carrid = 'AZ' carrname = 'Alitalia' )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    " Filter airlines starting with 'A'
    DATA(lt_filtered_airlines) = FILTER #( lt_all_airlines WHERE carrid CS 'A' ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_airlines INTO DATA(ls_airline).
      ro_menu->add_function( fcode = ls_airline-carrid text = ls_airline-carrname ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine private interne Tabelle von Benutzerdaten verwaltet. Eine 'Freund'-Klasse soll in der Lage sein, effizient auf diese privaten Daten zuzugreifen und einen Benutzer anhand seiner ID zu finden.

CLASS zcl_user_data_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_user,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_user.

    METHODS get_user_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_users TYPE tt_users.
    FRIENDS zcl_user_data_friend. " Declare friend class
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_user_data_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_users = it_initial_users.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_user_count.
    rv_count = lines( mt_users ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_user_data_friend DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING VALUE(rs_user) TYPE zcl_user_data_manager=>ty_user.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_user_data_friend IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_user_by_id.
    " Access private table of friend class

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü. Fügen Sie einen Menüpunkt nur hinzu, wenn er nicht bereits existiert. Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` um die Existenzprüfung effizient durchzuführen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` in einer `IF` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_unique_function
      IMPORTING io_menu TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu
                iv_fcode TYPE ui_func
                iv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_unique_function.
    " cl_ctmenu does not expose its internal table directly,
    " so we simulate the check on a conceptual list of functions.
    " In a real scenario, you might manage your own list of functions
    " before adding to cl_ctmenu, or use get_function_text to check existence.
    " For this example, we'll use get_function_text as a proxy for LINE_EXISTS concept.

    " A more direct use of LINE_EXISTS would be if cl_ctmenu exposed its internal table
    " of functions, e.g., IF LINE_EXISTS( io_menu->mt_functions[ fcode = iv_fcode ] ).

    " Using get_function_text as a proxy for checking existence
    IF io_menu->get_function_text( iv_fcode ) IS INITIAL.
      io_menu->add_function( fcode = iv_fcode text = iv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_unique_function FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_function FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_function.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ctmenu_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).

    lo_cut->add_unique_function( io_menu = lo_menu iv_fcode = 'OPT1' iv_text = 'Option 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu->get_function_text( 'OPT1' ) exp = 'Option 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_function.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ctmenu_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).

    lo_cut->add_unique_function( io_menu = lo_menu iv_fcode = 'OPT1' iv_text = 'Option 1' ).
    lo_cut->add_unique_function( io_menu = lo_menu iv_fcode = 'OPT1' iv_text = 'Option 1 - Duplicate' ). " Should not be added

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu->get_function_text( 'OPT1' ) exp = 'Option 1' ). " Original text should remain
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LINE_EXISTS` Operator (hier simuliert durch `get_function_text` da `cl_ctmenu` keine direkte interne Tabelle exponiert) ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, ohne eine explizite Schleife oder `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC` Prüfung. Dies führt zu prägnanterem und performanterem Code.
keywords: cl_ctmenu, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, GUI

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Datum. Verwenden Sie dabei die moderne Inline-Deklaration für die Zielvariable.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date

        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT SINGLE *
      FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight = ls_flight.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             city_from TYPE s_city,
             city_to TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_mapped_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date

CLASS zcl_flight_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid AS carrier_id, connid AS flight_num, fldate AS flight_date,
                   cityfrom AS city_from, cityto AS city_to
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight_info = ls_flight_data.
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Finden Sie den neuesten Flug für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie dabei eine performante Abfrage.
hint: Nutzen Sie SELECT ... UP TO 1 ROWS ... ORDER BY ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_latest_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_latest_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_latest_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flight.
    SELECT *
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight = ls_flight.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: SELECT ... UP TO 1 ROWS in Kombination mit ORDER BY ist eine performante Methode, um den "ersten" (oder "letzten" bei DESCENDING) Datensatz nach einer bestimmten Sortierung zu finden. Es ist effizienter als SELECT SINGLE, wenn die WHERE-Klausel nicht die Primärschlüssel vollständig abdeckt, da der Datenbank-Optimizer die Sortierung nutzen kann, um frühzeitig abzubrechen.
keywords: SELECT, UP TO 1 ROWS, ORDER BY, Database Access, Performance, SFLIGHTS

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(lv_carrid)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Nach einem SELECT SINGLE Statement wird die Systemvariable sy-subrc gesetzt. sy-subrc = 0 bedeutet, dass ein Datensatz gefunden wurde, während sy-subrc = 4 (oder andere Werte) bedeutet, dass kein Datensatz gefunden wurde. Die Verwendung von IF ... ELSE ... ENDIF mit abap_true/abap_false ist die moderne und klarste Art, solche Bedingungen zu behandeln.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, sy-subrc, Error Handling, Conditional Logic, ABAP_BOOL, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Status eines Fluges aus SFLIGHTS und geben Sie eine menschenlesbare Beschreibung basierend auf dem Status zurück. Verwenden Sie dabei eine CASE-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie SELECT SINGLE für das Feld STATUS und anschließend eine CASE-Expression für die Rückgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_desc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_desc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    SELECT SINGLE status
      FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(lv_status)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_description = CASE lv_status
                         WHEN 'X' THEN 'Cancelled'
                         WHEN 'O' THEN 'On Time'
                         WHEN 'D' THEN 'Delayed'
                         ELSE 'Unknown Status'
                       END.
    ELSE.
      rv_description = 'Flight not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für 'Transportmittel' mit einer abstrakten Methode zur Berechnung der 'Reisezeit'. Erstellen Sie dann eine konkrete Unterklasse 'Auto', die diese Methode implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie ABSTRACT CLASS und ABSTRACT METHODS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_transport_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_distance TYPE i.
    METHODS get_distance RETURNING VALUE(rv_distance) TYPE i.
    METHODS calculate_travel_time ABSTRACT
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_time_in_hours) TYPE decfloat16.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_distance TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transport_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_distance = iv_distance.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_distance.
    rv_distance = mv_distance.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_car_concrete DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_transport_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_distance TYPE i iv_speed TYPE i.
    METHODS calculate_travel_time REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_speed TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_car_concrete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( iv_distance ).
    mv_speed = iv_speed.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_travel_time.
    IF mv_speed > 0.
      rv_time_in_hours = mv_distance / mv_speed.
    ELSE.
      rv_time_in_hours = 0. " Cannot calculate if speed is zero
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Eine ABSTRACT CLASS kann nicht direkt instanziiert werden, sondern dient als Blaupause für Unterklassen. ABSTRACT METHODS müssen in jeder konkreten Unterklasse implementiert werden. Dies erzwingt eine bestimmte Schnittstelle und Logik in der Hierarchie und fördert Polymorphie.
keywords: ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHODS, Object Orientation, Inheritance, Polymorphism

Instructions: Erweitern Sie das Beispiel der Transportmittel. Erstellen Sie eine weitere konkrete Unterklasse 'Flugzeug' und demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie, indem Sie eine Liste von Transportmitteln durchlaufen und deren Reisezeit berechnen.

solution:

CLASS zcl_car_concrete DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_transport_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_car_concrete IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_travel_time.

CLASS zcl_plane_concrete DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_transport_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      rv_time_in_hours = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_type.
    rv_type = 'Plane'.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_transport_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_travel_result,
             type TYPE string,
             distance TYPE i,
             travel_time TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_travel_result.
    TYPES tt_travel_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_travel_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_transports
      IMPORTING
        it_transports TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_transport_abstract WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_travel_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transport_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_transports.
    LOOP AT it_transports INTO DATA(lo_transport).
      DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_travel_result(
          type        = lo_transport->get_type( )
          distance    = lo_transport->get_distance( )
          travel_time = lo_transport->calculate_travel_time( )
      ).
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA(lo_car) = NEW zcl_car_concrete( iv_distance = 200 iv_speed = 100 ).
    DATA(lo_plane) = NEW zcl_plane_concrete( iv_distance = 1000 iv_speed = 500 ).

    DATA lt_transports TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_transport_abstract WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND lo_car TO lt_transports.
    APPEND lo_plane TO lt_transports.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_transport_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_transports( lt_transports ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( lt_results ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_results INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_car_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Car' act = ls_car_result-type ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '2.0' act = ls_car_result-travel_time ).

    READ TABLE lt_results INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_plane_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Plane' act = ls_plane_result-type ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '2.0' act = ls_plane_result-travel_time ).

explanation: Polymorphie ermöglicht es, Objekte verschiedener Klassen über eine gemeinsame Referenz (hier die Referenz auf die abstrakte Basisklasse zcl_transport_abstract) zu behandeln. Jedes Objekt führt dabei seine eigene Implementierung der abstrakten Methoden aus, was den Code flexibel und erweiterbar macht.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Factory Method Pattern, um verschiedene Arten von 'Dokumenten' (z.B. 'Rechnung', 'Lieferschein') zu erstellen. Verwenden Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für den 'Dokumenten-Creator' und eine abstrakte Methode zur Erstellung des Dokuments.
hint: Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Creator-Klasse mit einer abstrakten Factory-Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_document.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_content RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_invoice_document DEFINITION FINAL.

    mv_id = iv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_delivery_document IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_document_creator_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.

CLASS zcl_document_creator_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template Method Pattern für einen 'Berichtsprozess'. Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse mit einer Template-Methode, die den Gesamtprozess steuert, und abstrakten Methoden für spezifische Schritte, die von Unterklassen implementiert werden müssen.
hint: Die Template-Methode ist konkret, die Schritte sind abstrakt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_report_template_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_report FINAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_report_output) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
    METHODS process_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_data TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_processed_data) TYPE string.
    METHODS format_output ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_processed_data TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_template_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_report.
    DATA(lv_raw_data) = get_data( ).
    DATA(lv_processed_data) = process_data( lv_raw_data ).
    rv_report_output = format_output( lv_processed_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_report_template_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS process_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_output REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    rv_data = 'Sales Data: Item A, 100 EUR; Item B, 200 EUR'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lv_sum) = 0.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\d+ EUR' IN iv_data RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).
    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      DATA(lv_value_str) = substring( val = iv_data off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length - 4 ).
      lv_sum = lv_sum + CONV i( lv_value_str ).
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_processed_data = |Total Sales: { lv_sum } EUR|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD format_output.
    rv_formatted_output = |--- Sales Report ---{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ iv_processed_data }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }--------------------|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inventory_report DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_report_template_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS process_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_output REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inventory_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    rv_data = 'Inventory Data: Product X, 50 pcs; Product Y, 30 pcs'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX 'Product \w+' IN iv_data RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).
    lv_count = lines( lt_matches ).
    rv_processed_data = |Number of Products: { lv_count }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD format_output.
    rv_formatted_output = |--- Inventory Report ---{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ iv_processed_data }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }--------------------|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für 'Loggable' Objekte. Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse 'BaseLogger', die dieses Interface implementiert und eine abstrakte Methode 'write_log_entry' sowie eine konkrete Methode 'log_message' bereitstellt. Implementieren Sie dann eine konkrete Unterklasse 'ConsoleLogger'.
hint: Eine abstrakte Klasse kann Interfaces implementieren und abstrakte Methoden aus dem Interface oder eigene abstrakte Methoden definieren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_loggable.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string
      iv_severity TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_base_logger_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_loggable.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_logger_name TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_logger_name TYPE string.
    METHODS write_log_entry ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        iv_formatted_entry TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_logger_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_logger_name = iv_logger_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_loggable~log_message.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_entry) = |{ lv_timestamp } [{ mv_logger_name }] { iv_severity }: { iv_message }|.
    write_log_entry( lv_formatted_entry ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_logger_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_logger_name TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS write_log_entry REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( iv_logger_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD write_log_entry.
    APPEND iv_formatted_entry TO gt_log_entries. " Global test table
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

DATA gt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_console_logging FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logging.
    CLEAR gt_log_entries.

    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( 'AppLogger' ).
    lo_logger->zif_loggable~log_message( iv_message = 'Application started.' iv_severity = 'INFO' ).
    lo_logger->zif_loggable~log_message( iv_message = 'Error occurred.' iv_severity = 'ERROR' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( gt_log_entries ) ).

    READ TABLE gt_log_entries INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_entry1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( substring = 'AppLogger' act = lv_entry1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( substring = 'INFO: Application started.' act = lv_entry1 ).

    READ TABLE gt_log_entries INDEX 2 INTO DATA(lv_entry2).

explanation: Eine abstrakte Klasse kann ein Interface implementieren und dabei sowohl konkrete Methoden für das Interface als auch eigene abstrakte Methoden definieren. Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String aus Flugdaten unter Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen und String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(...)` und `|...|` für Inline-Deklarationen und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_details) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_flight_details = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } kostet { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_flight_details = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators.

CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             airline TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_no TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_summary_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
      ( airline = ls_raw-carrid
        flight_no = ls_raw-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... NEXT ... )` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_expression=>tt_flight_price(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = '50.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_expression=>tt_flight_price( ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = '0.00'
      msg = 'Die Gesamtsumme für eine leere Tabelle sollte 0 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine sehr mächtige funktionale Programmiertechnik, die den Code extrem kompakt und effizient macht, insbesondere für Summierungen, Zählungen oder das Finden von Min/Max-Werten.
keywords: REDUCE, Constructor Expression, Internal Table, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen in der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle haben, unter Verwendung der neuen Open SQL Syntax mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY ... HAVING ...` für die Datenbankabfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer einfachen Excel-Datei (XLSX) in eine interne Tabelle. Die Excel-Datei enthält zwei Spalten: 'ID' und 'Text' in der ersten Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_excel_read_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_excel_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring " Binary content of the Excel file
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_read_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_excel_data.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet(
      iv_xstring = iv_xstring
    ).

    DATA(lt_worksheet_names) = lo_excel->if_fdt_doc_spreadsheet~get_worksheet_names( ).
    IF lt_worksheet_names IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_first_sheet) = lt_worksheet_names[ 1 ]-name.
      lo_excel->if_fdt_doc_spreadsheet~get_itab_from_worksheet(
        EXPORTING
          iv_worksheet_name = lv_first_sheet
          iv_has_header     = abap_true
        IMPORTING
          et_data           = rt_data
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_simple.
    " Create a dummy Excel file content (simplified for unit test)

    DATA(lv_xstring) = xstring_from_string( 'ID,Text\n1,Hello\n2,World' ). " This is NOT a real XLSX, just a placeholder

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_excel_read_simple( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->read_excel_data( lv_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lv_string) = REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '\n' IN iv_string WITH cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

        iv_string = lv_string

        rv_xstring = rv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer Excel-Datei und filtern Sie die Zeilen, die einen bestimmten Wert in einer Spalte enthalten, direkt beim Einlesen oder danach mit modernen ABAP-Features.
hint: Lesen Sie die Daten in eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie dann `FILTER` für die Selektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_read_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_and_filter_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filter_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_read_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_filter_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet(
      iv_xstring = iv_xstring
    ).

    DATA(lt_worksheet_names) = lo_excel->if_fdt_doc_spreadsheet~get_worksheet_names( ).
    IF lt_worksheet_names IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_first_sheet) = lt_worksheet_names[ 1 ]-name.
      DATA lt_all_data TYPE tt_data.
      lo_excel->if_fdt_doc_spreadsheet~get_itab_from_worksheet(
        EXPORTING
          iv_worksheet_name = lv_first_sheet
          iv_has_header     = abap_true
        IMPORTING
          et_data           = lt_all_data
      ).

      rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( lt_all_data WHERE text = iv_filter_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_write_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_formatted_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet(
      iv_document_name = 'Formatted_SFLIGHTS.xlsx'
    ).

    " cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet itself does not offer direct cell formatting methods.
    " However, when iv_has_header is true, it often applies a default header style.
    " For advanced formatting, one would typically use cl_fdt_xl_core or manipulate XML.
    " This example demonstrates the default header handling.
    lo_excel->if_fdt_doc_spreadsheet~add_itab_to_worksheet(
      EXPORTING
        iv_worksheet_name = 'Flight Data'
        it_data           = it_sflights
        iv_has_header     = abap_true " This often implies some default header formatting
    ).

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->if_fdt_doc_spreadsheet~get_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_get_sheets DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_excel_get_sheets IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_excel_read_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_excel_read_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet(
      iv_xstring = iv_xstring
    ).

    DATA(lt_worksheet_names) = lo_excel->if_fdt_doc_spreadsheet~get_worksheet_names( ).
    IF lt_worksheet_names IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_first_sheet) = lt_worksheet_names[ 1 ]-name.

      FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

      " Get data into a dynamic internal table
      lo_excel->if_fdt_doc_spreadsheet~get_itab_from_worksheet(
        EXPORTING
          iv_worksheet_name = lv_first_sheet
          iv_has_header     = abap_true
        IMPORTING
          et_data           = ro_data_ref
      ).

      ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Now <lt_dynamic_table> contains the data with dynamic structure.
        " You can process it using RTTI or dynamic programming.
        " For this example, we just ensure it's populated.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer Excel-Datei und konvertieren Sie eine Datumsspalte (im Format YYYYMMDD) in das interne ABAP-Datumsformat.

solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_read_date_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_with_date,
             id       TYPE i,
             text     TYPE string,
             date_str TYPE string,
             date_val TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_data_with_date.
    TYPES tt_data_with_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_with_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_and_convert_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_data) TYPE tt_data_with_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_read_date_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_convert_date.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet(
      iv_xstring = iv_xstring
    ).

    DATA(lt_worksheet_names) = lo_excel->if_fdt_doc_spreadsheet~get_worksheet_names( ).
    IF lt_worksheet_names IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_first_sheet) = lt_worksheet_names[ 1 ]-name.
      DATA lt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_with_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

      lo_excel->if_fdt_doc_spreadsheet~get_itab_from_worksheet(
        EXPORTING
          iv_worksheet_name = lv_first_sheet
          iv_has_header     = abap_true
        IMPORTING
          et_data           = lt_raw_data
      ).

      rt_converted_data = VALUE tt_data_with_date(
        FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_data
        ( id       = ls_raw-id
          text     = ls_raw-text
          date_str = ls_raw-date_str
          date_val = COND #( WHEN ls_raw-date_str IS NOT INITIAL AND strlen( ls_raw-date_str ) = 8
                             THEN CONVERT DATE ls_raw-date_str INTO sy-datum
                             ELSE sy-datum ) )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche Sitzplatzkapazität pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
        carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
        avg_seats   TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_avg_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    SELECT carrid,
           COUNT(*) AS flight_count,
           AVG( seatsmax ) AS avg_seats
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_avg_seats.
    " This private method could be used for more complex calculations
    " or if the average seats needed to be calculated differently for specific carriers.
    " For this example, it's just a placeholder to demonstrate private method usage.
    SELECT SINGLE AVG( seatsmax )
      FROM sflights
      INTO @rv_avg
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_details,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_details.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_details WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_details.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS:
      gc_min_date TYPE s_date VALUE '19000101'. " Example for a private constant
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    SELECT s~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           s~connid,
           s~fldate,
           s~price
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~fldate >= @iv_date
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Fluggesellschaften aus `SCARR`, die mindestens einen Flug in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` haben, dessen Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.

CLASS zcl_sflights_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carriers_with_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        price  TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_data.
    METHODS has_expensive_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_expensive) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_expensive_flights.
    SELECT carrid
      FROM scarr
      WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT *
                       FROM sflights
                       WHERE carrid = scarr~carrid
                         AND price > @iv_min_price )
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
    SORT rt_carriers.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD has_expensive_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE @abap_true
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND price > @iv_min_price
      INTO @rv_has_expensive.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_has_expensive = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungsnummer und Flugdatum. Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_single_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_last_read_carrid TYPE s_carr_id. " Private attribute to store last read carrier ID
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_single_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE *
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      mv_last_read_carrid = rs_flight-carrid.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR mv_last_read_carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` und fügen Sie ein neues Feld `flight_category` hinzu, das basierend auf dem Preis des Fluges 'Budget', 'Standard' oder 'Premium' anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `CASE`-Ausdruck direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_case_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_category,
        carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid        TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate        TYPE s_date,
        price         TYPE s_price,
        flight_category TYPE string,
      END OF ty_flight_with_category.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_category
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_category.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS:
      gc_budget_threshold  TYPE s_price VALUE '500',
      gc_premium_threshold TYPE s_price VALUE '1500'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_case_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_category.
    SELECT carrid,
           connid,
           fldate,
           price,
           CASE
             WHEN price < @gc_budget_threshold  THEN 'Budget'
             WHEN price >= @gc_premium_threshold THEN 'Premium'
             ELSE 'Standard'
           END AS flight_category
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_categorizer) = NEW zcl_sflights_case_select( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_premium_flight-price >= zcl_sflights_case_select=>gc_premium_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie alle Flüge von `SFLIGHTS` mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') mit allen Flügen einer anderen Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA'), die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `UNION`-Operator, um die Ergebnisse zweier `SELECT`-Anweisungen zu vereinen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_union,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
        price  TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_union.
    TYPES: tt_flight_union TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_union WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid1 TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_carrid2 TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_date_threshold TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_flight_union.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_union.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid2
        AND fldate >= @iv_date_threshold
      INTO TABLE @rt_combined_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    " This private method could be used for more complex filtering logic
    " before the UNION, demonstrating modularity.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combined_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combined_flights.
    DATA(lo_combiner) = NEW zcl_sflights_union( ).
    DATA(lv_date_threshold) = sy-datum - 365. " One year ago

    DATA(lt_combined_flights) = lo_combiner->get_combined_flights( iv_carrid1 = 'LH' iv_carrid2 = 'AA' iv_date_threshold = lv_date_threshold ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_combined_flights ).

    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_aa) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_combined_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_count_aa = lv_count_aa + 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-fldate >= lv_date_threshold ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count_lh > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count_aa > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `UNION ALL`-Operator ermöglicht das effiziente Kombinieren von Ergebnismengen aus mehreren `SELECT`-Anweisungen direkt auf der Datenbank. Dies ist performanter als das manuelle Zusammenführen von internen Tabellen im ABAP-Code. Die `PRIVATE SECTION` enthält eine private Methode, die die Logik zum Abrufen von Flügen für eine einzelne Fluggesellschaft kapselt, was die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Lesbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine paginierte Liste von Flügen aus `SFLIGHTS` ab, sortiert nach Flugdatum, beginnend bei einem bestimmten Offset und mit einer bestimmten Anzahl von Zeilen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ORDER BY`, `OFFSET` und `LIMIT` in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_paginated_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_offset TYPE i DEFAULT 0
        iv_limit  TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS:
      gc_default_limit TYPE i VALUE 10.
    DATA: mv_total_flights TYPE i. " Private attribute to store total count
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_paginated_flights.
    " Get total count for pagination metadata (optional, but good practice)
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @mv_total_flights.

    SELECT *
      FROM sflights
      ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING, carrid ASCENDING, connid ASCENDING
      OFFSET @iv_offset ROWS
      UP TO @iv_limit ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_pagination FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_pagination.
    DATA(lo_pager) = NEW zcl_sflights_pagination( ).

    DATA(lt_first_page) = lo_pager->get_paginated_flights( iv_offset = 0 iv_limit = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_first_page ) exp = 5 ).
    READ TABLE lt_first_page INTO DATA(ls_first_entry) INDEX 1.
    READ TABLE lt_first_page INTO DATA(ls_last_entry) INDEX 5.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_entry-fldate <= ls_last_entry-fldate ).

    DATA(lt_second_page) = lo_pager->get_paginated_flights( iv_offset = 5 iv_limit = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_second_page ) exp = 5 ).
    READ TABLE lt_second_page INTO DATA(ls_second_page_first_entry) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_second_page_first_entry-fldate >= ls_last_entry-fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, ignorieren Sie dabei die Mandantenprüfung, um auch mandantenübergreifende Daten abrufen zu können. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Fluggesellschafts-ID validiert wird.

CLASS zcl_sflights_client_spec DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_client_specified
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS validate_carrier_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_client_spec IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_client_specified.
    IF NOT validate_carrier_id( iv_carrid ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT * FROM sflights CLIENT SPECIFIED
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE mandt = @sy-mandt " Explicitly specify current client
        AND carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate_carrier_id.
    SELECT SINGLE @abap_true FROM scarr
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO @rv_is_valid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `IF_CALCULATOR` mit Methoden für Addition und Subtraktion. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen: `CL_BASIC_CALC` und `CL_ADV_CALC`. Demonstrieren Sie die polymorphe Verwendung der Objekte über das Interface.

solution:
INTERFACE if_calculator.
  METHODS add IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  METHODS subtract IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_basic_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_basic_calc IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_calculator~subtract.
    rv_result = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

    INTERFACES if_calculator.

  METHOD if_calculator~add.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2 + 1. "Advanced: adds 1 extra
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_calculator~subtract.
    rv_result = iv_num1 - iv_num2 - 1. "Advanced: subtracts 1 extra
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `IF_VALIDATOR` mit einer Methode `IS_VALID`. Fügen Sie eine Default-Implementierung für `IS_VALID` hinzu, die immer `true` zurückgibt. Implementieren Sie das Interface in einer Klasse `CL_CUSTOM_VALIDATOR` und überschreiben Sie die Default-Implementierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `METHODS ... DEFAULT` in der Interface-Definition.
solution:
INTERFACE if_validator.
  METHODS is_valid IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
  METHODS is_valid DEFAULT. " Default implementation
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS if_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid.
    rv_valid = abap_true. " Default: always valid
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_validator~is_valid.
    " Custom implementation: valid if value is not empty
    rv_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_value IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_method.
    DATA(lo_validator_custom) = NEW zcl_custom_validator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_validator_custom->is_valid( 'abc' ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Custom validator with value failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_validator_custom->is_valid( '' ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Custom validator with empty value failed' ).

    " To truly test the default implementation, one would need a class that does NOT override it.
    " The current test verifies the override works as expected.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den `PRICE` und die `CURRENCY` eines bestimmten Flugs in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung eines Struktur-Workareas und des modernen `UPDATE ... FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` Syntax.
hint: Deklarieren Sie eine Struktur, füllen Sie die Felder, einschließlich der Schlüsselfelder, und verwenden Sie dann `UPDATE sflight FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF wa_flight`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_new_currency TYPE sflight-curr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflight.

    " Read existing data to ensure the record exists and get other fields
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_flight-price = iv_new_price.
      ls_flight-curr  = iv_new_currency.

      UPDATE sflight FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_flight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'LH'.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid VALUE '0400'.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '20251203'.
    DATA mv_original_price TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA mv_original_currency TYPE sflight-curr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure a test record exists and store original values
    SELECT SINGLE price, curr FROM sflight INTO (mv_original_price, mv_original_currency)
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Insert a dummy record if it doesn't exist
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
        carrid = mv_carrid
        connid = mv_connid
        fldate = mv_fldate
        price  = 100.00
        curr   = 'EUR'
        planetype = 'BOEING'
        seatsmax = 300
        seatsocc = 100
        paymentsum = 10000
        seatsmax_b = 50
        seatsocc_b = 20
        seatsmax_f = 20
        seatsocc_f = 5
      ) ).
      COMMIT WORK.
      mv_original_price = 100.00.
      mv_original_currency = 'EUR'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original values
    UPDATE sflight SET price = mv_original_price, curr = mv_original_currency
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_flight.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = 250.50.
    DATA(lv_new_currency) = 'USD'.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_updater->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid = mv_carrid
      iv_connid = mv_connid
      iv_fldate = mv_fldate
      iv_new_price = lv_new_price
      iv_new_currency = lv_new_currency ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Update should be successful' ).

    " Verify the update
    DATA: ls_updated_flight TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE price, curr FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_updated_flight
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = lv_new_price msg = 'Price not updated correctly' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-curr exp = lv_new_currency msg = 'Currency not updated correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UPDATE ... FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` ist eine moderne und typsichere Art, Datenbanktabellen zu aktualisieren. Es verwendet die Schlüsselfelder der Struktur, um den zu aktualisierenden Datensatz zu finden, und aktualisiert alle anderen Felder, die in der Struktur gefüllt sind und in der Datenbanktabelle existieren.
keywords: UPDATE, OPEN SQL, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, CORRESPONDING FIELDS

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie die Anzahl der belegten Economy-Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) um einen festen Wert.

CLASS zcl_flight_seat_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_seat_updater IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'AA'.
    DATA mt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure test data exists and store original values
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_original_flights
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.
    IF lines( mt_original_flights ) = 0.
      " Insert dummy records if none exist
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 planetype = 'BOEING' ) ).
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20251202' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 200 planetype = 'AIRBUS' ) ).
      COMMIT WORK.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_original_flights
        WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original values
    LOOP AT mt_original_flights INTO DATA(ls_original).
      UPDATE sflight SET seatsocc = ls_original-seatsocc
        WHERE carrid = ls_original-carrid AND connid = ls_original-connid AND fldate = ls_original-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_increase_seats.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_seat_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_increase_by) = 5.
    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_updater->increase_occupied_seats(
      iv_carrid = mv_carrid
      iv_increase_by = lv_increase_by ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 0 msg = 'At least one row should be updated' ).

    " Verify the update
    DATA: lt_updated_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_updated_flights
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_updated_flights INTO DATA(ls_updated).
      READ TABLE mt_original_flights INTO DATA(ls_original)
        WITH KEY carrid = ls_updated-carrid connid = ls_updated-connid fldate = ls_updated-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_updated-seatsocc
          exp = ls_original-seatsocc + lv_increase_by
          msg = |Seats for flight { ls_updated-connid } not increased correctly| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die direkte Aktualisierung von Feldern in der Datenbanktabelle mit einer arithmetischen Operation im `SET`-Teil. Dies ist effizient, da die Operation direkt auf der Datenbank ausgeführt wird und keine Daten zum Applikationsserver transportiert werden müssen.
keywords: UPDATE, OPEN SQL, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, SET, WHERE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den `PLANETYPE` eines Flugs basierend auf der `SEATSOCC` dynamisch aktualisiert. Wenn `SEATSOCC` über einem Schwellenwert liegt, setzen Sie den `PLANETYPE` auf 'JUMBO', sonst auf 'SMALL'. Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und `UPDATE` in einer Schleife über die zu prüfenden Flüge.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` um Sperren zu setzen und `UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE` für die Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_planetype_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_planetype_by_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_threshold TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_planetype_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype_by_seats.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_new_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      FOR UPDATE.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-seatsocc > iv_threshold.
        lv_new_planetype = 'JUMBO'.
      ELSE.
        lv_new_planetype = 'SMALL'.
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_flight-planetype <> lv_new_planetype.
        UPDATE sflight SET planetype = lv_new_planetype
          WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid
            AND connid = ls_flight-connid
            AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_updated_count = rv_updated_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mass_update FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'DL'.
    DATA mt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure test data exists and store original values
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_original_flights
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.
    IF lines( mt_original_flights ) = 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' price = 100.00 curr = 'EUR' planetype = 'BOEING' ) ).
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20251202' price = 150.00 curr = 'EUR' planetype = 'AIRBUS' ) ).
      COMMIT WORK.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_original_flights
        WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original values
    LOOP AT mt_original_flights INTO DATA(ls_original).
      UPDATE sflight SET price = ls_original-price, curr = ls_original-curr
        WHERE carrid = ls_original-carrid AND connid = ls_original-connid AND fldate = ls_original-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mass_update.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_mass_flight_updater( ).
    DATA: lt_flights_to_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_flight_update LIKE LINE OF lt_flights_to_update.

    " Prepare data for update
    ls_flight_update-carrid = mv_carrid.
    ls_flight_update-connid = '0001'.
    ls_flight_update-fldate = '20251201'.
    ls_flight_update-price = 200.00.
    ls_flight_update-curr = 'USD'.
    APPEND ls_flight_update TO lt_flights_to_update.

    ls_flight_update-carrid = mv_carrid.
    ls_flight_update-connid = '0002'.
    ls_flight_update-fldate = '20251202'.
    ls_flight_update-price = 300.00.
    ls_flight_update-curr = 'GBP'.
    APPEND ls_flight_update TO lt_flights_to_update.

    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_updater->update_multiple_flights( lt_flights_to_update ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 2 msg = 'Two rows should be updated' ).

    " Verify the update
    DATA: lt_updated_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_updated_flights
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.

    READ TABLE lt_updated_flights INTO DATA(ls_updated_1) WITH KEY carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_1-price exp = 200.00 msg = 'Flight 0001 price not updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_1-curr exp = 'USD' msg = 'Flight 0001 currency not updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_flights INTO DATA(ls_updated_2) WITH KEY carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20251202'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_2-price exp = 300.00 msg = 'Flight 0002 price not updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_2-curr exp = 'GBP' msg = 'Flight 0002 currency not updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE` ist die effizienteste Methode, um mehrere Datensätze in einer Datenbanktabelle zu aktualisieren. Die interne Tabelle muss die Schlüsselfelder der Datenbanktabelle enthalten, um die zu aktualisierenden Datensätze zu identifizieren. Alle anderen Felder in der internen Tabelle, die in der Datenbanktabelle existieren, werden aktualisiert.
keywords: UPDATE, OPEN SQL, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, INTERNAL TABLE, MASS UPDATE

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `MODIFY` Befehl, um Datensätze in `SFLIGHTS` zu aktualisieren oder einzufügen. Wenn ein Flug existiert, soll der Preis aktualisiert werden; wenn nicht, soll ein neuer Flug eingefügt werden. Demonstrieren Sie dies für eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Der `MODIFY` Befehl kann sowohl `INSERT` als auch `UPDATE` basierend auf dem Vorhandensein des Primärschlüssels ausführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flights.
    MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE it_flights_data.
    rv_modified_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'BA'.
    DATA mt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Store original values for cleanup
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_original_flights
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Restore original values and delete any new test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.
    IF lines( mt_original_flights ) > 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM TABLE mt_original_flights.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_flights.
    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_flight_modifier( ).
    DATA: lt_flights_to_modify TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_flight_data LIKE LINE OF lt_flights_to_modify.

    " Data for update (existing flight)
    ls_flight_data-carrid = mv_carrid.
    ls_flight_data-connid = '0001'.
    ls_flight_data-fldate = '20251201'.
    ls_flight_data-price = 100.00.
    ls_flight_data-curr = 'EUR'.
    ls_flight_data-planetype = 'BOEING'.
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight_data. " Pre-insert for update test
    APPEND ls_flight_data TO lt_flights_to_modify.

    " Data for insert (new flight)
    ls_flight_data-carrid = mv_carrid.
    ls_flight_data-connid = '0002'.
    ls_flight_data-fldate = '20251202'.
    ls_flight_data-price = 250.00.
    ls_flight_data-curr = 'USD'.
    ls_flight_data-planetype = 'AIRBUS'.
    APPEND ls_flight_data TO lt_flights_to_modify.

    COMMIT WORK. " Commit pre-inserted data

    " Modify operation
    DATA(lv_modified_count) = lo_modifier->modify_flights( lt_flights_to_modify ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_modified_count exp = 2 msg = 'Two rows should be modified (1 update, 1 insert)' ).

    " Verify results
    DATA: lt_result_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_result_flights
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.

    READ TABLE lt_result_flights INTO DATA(ls_updated_flight) WITH KEY carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = 100.00 msg = 'Existing flight price should be 100.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result_flights INTO DATA(ls_inserted_flight) WITH KEY carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20251202'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_inserted_flight-price exp = 250.00 msg = 'New flight price should be 250.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `MODIFY` Befehl ist eine leistungsstarke Open SQL-Anweisung, die sowohl `INSERT` als auch `UPDATE` kombiniert. Wenn ein Datensatz mit dem angegebenen Primärschlüssel bereits existiert, wird er aktualisiert; andernfalls wird ein neuer Datensatz eingefügt. Dies vereinfacht die Logik für Upsert-Operationen.
keywords: MODIFY, OPEN SQL, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, UPSERT, INSERT, UPDATE

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle und fügen Sie Elemente hinzu, um die automatische Sortierung zu demonstrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES ... SORTED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...` und `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_decl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS add_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_decl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE rt_sorted_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
