CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flights.
    DATA: lt_input_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_input_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_input_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '002'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_input_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '002'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'. " Will be inserted after AA 001

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_decl( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_result) = lo_cut->add_flights( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sorted_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deklaration einer `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle beim Einfügen von Datensätzen automatisch nach den angegebenen Schlüsselfeldern sortiert wird. Dies vereinfacht die Datenhaltung und ermöglicht effiziente Zugriffe.
keywords: SORTED, Internal Tables, TYPES, UNIQUE KEY, INSERT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Standardtabelle und definieren Sie einen sortierten Sekundärschlüssel, um effiziente Zugriffe auf nicht-primäre Felder zu ermöglichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY` für den Sekundärschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_secondary_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data
             WITH EMPTY KEY
             WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY secondary_key COMPONENTS carrid fldate.

    METHODS get_flights_by_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_secondary_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_date.
    " Using the secondary key for efficient access
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights USING KEY secondary_key
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate = iv_fldate )
                                   ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Sekundärschlüssel ermöglichen es, eine interne Tabelle nach verschiedenen Kriterien effizient zu durchsuchen oder zu verarbeiten, ohne die Primärsortierung zu ändern. Ein `SORTED` Sekundärschlüssel bietet dabei die beste Performance für Zugriffe über `TABLE EXPRESSIONS` oder `LOOP AT ... USING KEY`.

Instructions: Durchlaufen Sie eine interne Standardtabelle und sortieren Sie die Ausgabe dynamisch nach einem oder mehreren Feldern, ohne die Originaltabelle zu ändern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO ... SORTED BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_sorted_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_info.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sorted_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_sorted_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) SORTED BY carrid ASCENDING fldate DESCENDING.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_sorted_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA: lt_input_flights TYPE zcl_loop_sorted_by=>ty_sflight_tab.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_input_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '002'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'. <fs_flight>-price = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_input_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_flight>-price = 150.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_input_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_flight>-price = 100.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_sorted_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250102' ). " AA, then 20250102 (desc)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ). " AA, then 20250101 (desc)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SORTED BY` Ergänzung in der `LOOP AT` Anweisung ermöglicht es, die Verarbeitung einer internen Tabelle in einer bestimmten Sortierreihenfolge durchzuführen, ohne die Originaltabelle physisch zu sortieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn temporäre Sortierungen für die Anzeige oder weitere Verarbeitung benötigt werden.
keywords: SORTED BY, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Dynamic Sorting

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Datensatz effizient aus einer sortierten internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des binären Suchalgorithmus.

CLASS zcl_read_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        it_sorted_flights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.

CLASS zcl_read_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    READ TABLE it_sorted_flights INTO rs_flight
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid
      BINARY SEARCH.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die `BINARY SEARCH` Option bei `READ TABLE` ist die effizienteste Methode, um Datensätze aus einer internen Tabelle zu lesen, vorausgesetzt, die Tabelle ist nach den Schlüsselfeldern sortiert. Dies reduziert die Suchzeit erheblich, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle nach bestimmten Kriterien und nutzen Sie dabei die Effizienz der sortierten Struktur.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_tab TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sorted_flights TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sorted_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie einen Integer-Wert, um sicherzustellen, dass er innerhalb der gültigen Grenzen des ABAP-Datentyps `i` liegt, und geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_value_int` und `max_value_int` für die Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_validate_int_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validate_int_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_int.
    IF iv_value >= cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_value_int AND
       iv_value <= cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_value_int.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_int FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_int_min FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_int_max FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_int.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_validate_int_range( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->validate_int( 100 ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->validate_int( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_value_int ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->validate_int( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_value_int ) exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_int_min.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_validate_int_range( ).
    " Test with a value just below min_value_int (requires a type that can hold it, e.g., i8 or string for comparison)
    " For simplicity, we'll just assert that a value outside the range would be false.
    " In real scenarios, one might pass a string or a larger integer type for validation.
    " Here, we simulate an 'out of range' scenario by checking a value that would conceptually be too small.
    " Note: ABAP 'i' type itself would cause overflow if assigned a value smaller than its min.
    " This test assumes 'iv_value' could theoretically be outside 'i' range if it came from a larger type or external source.
    " For a strict 'i' type, the check is more about conceptual range.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->validate_int( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_value_int - 1 ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_int_max.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_validate_int_range( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->validate_int( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_value_int + 1 ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_exceptional_values` für die Validierung von Datentypen ist eine robuste Methode, um Datenintegrität zu gewährleisten. Es verhindert, dass ungültige Werte, die außerhalb des zulässigen Bereichs eines Datentyps liegen, verarbeitet werden, was zu Fehlern oder unerwartetem Verhalten führen könnte.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse und werfen Sie diese, wenn ein ungültiger Wert übergeben wird. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und geben Sie die Fehlermeldung aus.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von CX_STATIC_CHECK erbt. Verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE und CATCH. Für die Nachrichtenklasse wird ZMSG_EXCEPTIONS angenommen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
                                  previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_input DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RAISING zcx_invalid_input.
    METHODS get_last_error RETURNING VALUE(rv_error_msg) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_error TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = VALUE if_t100_message=>t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG_EXCEPTIONS' msgno = '001' attr1 = 'IV_VALUE' ). " Beispiel: Nachricht 001 in ZMSG_EXCEPTIONS: 'Ungültiger Wert &1'
    ENDIF.
    mv_last_error = ''.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_error.
    rv_error_msg = mv_last_error.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_input.
    METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_process_input( ).
    DATA(lv_error_caught) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process( -5 ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        lv_error_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lx_invalid_input->get_text( ) IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Error message should not be initial' ).
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_error_caught exp = abap_true msg = 'Custom exception should be caught' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_process_input( ).
    DATA(lv_error_caught) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process( 10 ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input.
        lv_error_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_error_caught exp = abap_false msg = 'No exception should be raised for valid input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung und Verwendung einer eigenen Ausnahme-Klasse. Durch die Vererbung von CX_STATIC_CHECK und die Implementierung von IF_T100_MESSAGE kann die Ausnahme mit einer Meldung aus einer Nachrichtenklasse versehen werden, was eine standardisierte und lokalisierbare Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die einen String in eine Zahl konvertiert und dabei sowohl Konvertierungsfehler als auch Index-Fehler (wenn der String zu lang ist) abfängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere CATCH-Blöcke für CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER und CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_and_access IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string iv_index TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS get_last_error RETURNING VALUE(rv_error_msg) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_error TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_and_access.
    DATA lv_number TYPE i.
    DATA lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    TRY.
        lv_number = iv_input. " May raise CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER
        lv_char = iv_input+iv_index(1). " May raise CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS
        rv_result = lv_number + 1. " Just to use lv_number
        mv_last_error = ''.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number INTO DATA(lx_conv).
        mv_last_error = lx_conv->get_text( ).
        rv_result = -1. " Indicate error
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_range).
        mv_last_error = lx_range->get_text( ).
        rv_result = -2. " Indicate different error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_error.
    rv_error_msg = mv_last_error.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_range_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_catch( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_and_access( iv_input = 'ABC' iv_index = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -1 msg = 'Conversion error should return -1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_cut->get_last_error( ) IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Error message should be set' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_range_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_catch( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_and_access( iv_input = '123' iv_index = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -2 msg = 'Range error should return -2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_cut->get_last_error( ) IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Error message should be set' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_catch( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_and_access( iv_input = '123' iv_index = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 124 msg = 'No error, result should be 124' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_cut->get_last_error( ) msg = 'No error message should be set' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man verschiedene Arten von Systemausnahmen in separaten CATCH-Blöcken behandeln kann. Dies ermöglicht eine spezifische Reaktion auf unterschiedliche Fehlerursachen und verbessert die Fehlerdiagnose.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation durch, die eine beliebige Ausnahme auslösen könnte, und fangen Sie diese generisch mit CATCH OTHERS ab. Geben Sie die Fehlermeldung der abgefangenen Ausnahme aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie CATCH OTHERS INTO DATA(lx_exception) und lx_exception->get_text().
solution:
CLASS zcl_catch_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_last_error RETURNING VALUE(rv_error_msg) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_error TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_catch_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    TRY.
        " Simulate a risky operation that might cause various exceptions
        " e.g., a conversion error if iv_value is not numeric
        DATA(lv_number) = CONV i( iv_value ).
        " Or a range error if accessing a string with invalid offset
        DATA(lv_char) = iv_value+100(1). " This will likely cause an error if iv_value is short
        rv_success = abap_true.
        mv_last_error = ''.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception). " CX_ROOT is the base class for all exceptions
        mv_last_error = lx_exception->get_text( ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_error.
    rv_error_msg = mv_last_error.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_risky_operation_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_risky_operation_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcx_param_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_raise_with_param DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_raise_with_param IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_value.
    IF iv_value < 10.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_param_exception
        EXPORTING
          textid = VALUE if_t100_message=>t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG_EXCEPTIONS' msgno = '002' attr1 = 'IV_VALUE' ) " Beispiel: Nachricht 002 in ZMSG_EXCEPTIONS: 'Wert &1 ist zu niedrig'
          i_param_value = |Value { iv_value } is too low|.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des CLEANUP-Blocks in einer TRY...CATCH...ENDTRY-Struktur, um sicherzustellen, dass eine Ressource (z.B. ein Objekt) auch im Fehlerfall ordnungsgemäß freigegeben wird.
hint: Der CLEANUP-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im TRY-Block auftritt, bevor die Kontrolle an den CATCH-Block übergeben wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation IMPORTING iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool RETURNING VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_resource TYPE REF TO object. " Simulate a resource
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    rv_log = 'Start.'.
    TRY.
        mo_resource = NEW object( ). " Acquire resource
        rv_log = rv_log && ' Resource acquired.'.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Simulate an error
        ENDIF.
        rv_log = rv_log && ' Operation successful.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_log = rv_log && | Exception caught: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
      CLEANUP.
        IF mo_resource IS BOUND.
          CLEAR mo_resource. " Release resource
          rv_log = rv_log && ' Resource released in CLEANUP.'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
    rv_log = rv_log && ' End.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cleanup_with_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cleanup_no_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_with_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->perform_operation( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Resource acquired.' msg = 'Resource should be acquired' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Exception caught:' msg = 'Exception should be caught' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Resource released in CLEANUP.' msg = 'Resource should be released in CLEANUP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->perform_operation( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Resource acquired.' msg = 'Resource should be acquired' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Operation successful.' msg = 'Operation should be successful' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Exception caught:' msg = 'No exception should be caught' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Resource released in CLEANUP.' msg = 'Resource should NOT be released in CLEANUP if no exception' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CLEANUP-Block ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil der strukturierten Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Er stellt sicher, dass Ressourcen, die im TRY-Block akquiriert wurden, auch im Falle einer Ausnahme ordnungsgemäß freigegeben werden, bevor die Kontrolle an den CATCH-Block übergeben wird. Dies verhindert Ressourcenlecks und verbessert die Stabilität der Anwendung.
keywords: CATCH, CLEANUP, Exception Handling, Resource Management

solution:
REPORT z_alv_sflight_demo.

CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS main.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CLASS-DATA go_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    CLASS-DATA gt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE gt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

MODULE status_0100 OUTPUT.
  SET PF-STATUS 'MAIN100'.
  SET TITLEBAR 'ALV_SF_DEMO'.

  IF go_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER' " Name des Custom Controls auf dem Screen
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        lifetime_dyn_error = 5
        OTHERS = 6.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT go_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = go_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des ALV-Grids' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        go_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = gt_sflight
        ).
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_ex).
        MESSAGE lx_gui_ex->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_alv_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_creation.
    " GUI-Tests sind komplex und erfordern oft spezielle Test-Frameworks.
    " Hier wird nur die Instanziierung der Objekte und ein Flush-Aufruf getestet,
    " um zu prüfen, ob keine direkten Ausnahmen auftreten.
    DATA lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA lo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA lv_exception_caught TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.

        CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
          EXPORTING
            i_parent = lo_container.

        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_ex).
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |GUI Exception caught: { lx_gui_ex->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exception_caught exp = abap_false msg = 'No GUI exception should be caught during creation and flush' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_container msg = 'Container should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_alv_grid msg = 'ALV Grid should be created' ).

    " Cleanup (important for GUI objects in tests)
    IF lo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
    ENDIF.
    IF lo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD lo_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
    ENDIF.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |GUI Exception caught: { lx_gui_ex->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exception_caught exp = abap_false msg = 'No GUI exception should be caught during creation and flush' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_main_container msg = 'Main container should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_splitter msg = 'Splitter container should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_textedit1 msg = 'TextEdit 1 should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_textedit2 msg = 'TextEdit 2 should be created' ).

    " Cleanup
    IF lo_textedit1 IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD lo_textedit1->free.
    ENDIF.
    IF lo_textedit2 IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD lo_textedit2->free.
    ENDIF.
    IF lo_splitter IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD lo_splitter->free.
    ENDIF.
    IF lo_main_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD lo_main_container->free.
    ENDIF.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER`, um eine komplexe GUI-Anordnung zu erstellen. Zwei `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`-Controls werden in den Panels des Splitter Containers platziert. Die gesamte Logik zur Erstellung und Initialisierung der Controls ist in einem `TRY...CATCH cx_gui_exception` Block gekapselt, um eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung zu gewährleisten.
keywords: CL_GUI_CFW, CL_GUI_SPLITTER_CONTAINER, CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT, GUI Programming, CATCH, CX_GUI_EXCEPTION

hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um die Ergebnisse direkt in eine interne Tabelle zu sammeln.

CLASS zcl_alc_get_docs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_alc_get_docs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_document_ids.
    DATA: lt_links TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sae_sali. "Structure for ArchiveLink links

    " Simulate fetching links - in a real scenario, this would involve CL_ALINK_CONNECTION
    " For demonstration, we'll create dummy data.
    " A real call might look like:
    " cl_alink_connection=>get_links(
    "   EXPORTING
    "     i_objtyp = iv_bus_obj_type
    "     i_objid  = iv_bus_obj_id
    "   IMPORTING
    "     e_links  = lt_links
    " ).
    IF iv_bus_obj_type = 'BUS2032' AND iv_bus_obj_id = '4711'.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_links ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_link>).
      <fs_link>-docid = 'DOC0000000000001'.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_links ASSIGNING <fs_link>.
      <fs_link>-docid = 'DOC0000000000002'.
    ENDIF.

    rt_document_ids = VALUE #( FOR <fs_link> IN lt_links ( doc_id = <fs_link>-docid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Dokumente pro Dokumenttyp aus einer Liste von ArchiveLink-Verknüpfungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Aggregation über die interne Tabelle durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alc_count_docs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alink_link,
             doc_id   TYPE sae_docid,
             doc_type TYPE sae_doctyp,
           END OF ty_alink_link.
    TYPES tt_alink_links TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alink_link WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_doc_type_count,
             doc_type TYPE sae_doctyp,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_doc_type_count.
    TYPES tt_doc_type_counts TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_doc_type_count
                             WITH UNIQUE KEY doc_type.

    METHODS count_doc_types
      IMPORTING
        it_all_links TYPE tt_alink_links
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_doc_type_counts) TYPE tt_doc_type_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alc_count_docs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_doc_types.
    rt_doc_type_counts = REDUCE #( 
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_doc_type_counts( )
      FOR link IN it_all_links
      LET current_count = counts[ KEY doc_type_key COMPONENTS doc_type = link-doc_type ]-count OPTIONAL
      IN
      VALUE #( 
        counts
        ( doc_type = link-doc_type count = current_count + 1 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( doc_id = 'DOC1' doc_type = 'PDF' ) TO lt_test_links.
    APPEND VALUE #( doc_id = 'DOC2' doc_type = 'TIF' ) TO lt_test_links.
    APPEND VALUE #( doc_id = 'DOC3' doc_type = 'PDF' ) TO lt_test_links.
    APPEND VALUE #( doc_id = 'DOC4' doc_type = 'JPG' ) TO lt_test_links.
    APPEND VALUE #( doc_id = 'DOC5' doc_type = 'PDF' ) TO lt_test_links.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alc_count_docs( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->count_doc_types( it_all_links = lt_test_links ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Abrufen einer Dokumentbeschreibung direkt nach dem Abrufen eines Dokumentobjekts, indem Sie Methodenaufrufe verketten.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Möglichkeit, Methodenaufrufe direkt aneinanderzureihen, wenn eine Methode ein Objekt zurückgibt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alc_doc_prop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_document_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_doc_id TYPE sae_docid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alc_doc_prop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_document_description.
    " Simulate a document object with a method to get description
    " In a real scenario, CL_ALINK_CONNECTION might return a document object
    " or a method that directly retrieves properties.
    " For this example, we'll use a local helper class.
    CLASS lcl_document DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_id TYPE sae_docid.
        METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mv_doc_id TYPE sae_docid.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_document IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_doc_id = iv_id.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD get_description.
        CASE mv_doc_id.
          WHEN 'DOC0000000000001'.
            rv_desc = 'Rechnung 2023-001'.
          WHEN 'DOC0000000000002'.
            rv_desc = 'Lieferschein 2023-002'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_desc = 'Unbekanntes Dokument'.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    " Method chaining: NEW lcl_document( iv_doc_id ) returns an object,
    " on which get_description( ) is immediately called.
    rv_description = NEW lcl_document( iv_doc_id )->get_description( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_doc_description FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_doc_description.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alc_doc_prop( ).
    DATA(lv_desc1) = lo_cut->get_document_description( 'DOC0000000000001' ).
    DATA(lv_desc2) = lo_cut->get_document_description( 'DOC0000000000003' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_desc1
      exp = 'Rechnung 2023-001'
      msg = 'Description for DOC1 mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_desc2
      exp = 'Unbekanntes Dokument'
      msg = 'Description for unknown doc mismatch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (ABAP 7.40+) erlaubt es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten, wenn eine Methode ein Objekt zurückgibt, auf dem die nächste Methode aufgerufen werden kann. Dies führt zu kompakterem und flüssigerem Code, der die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: CL_ALINK_CONNECTION, Method Chaining, Object Orientation, NEW

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Methode der Klasse `CL_ALINK_CONNECTION` dynamisch aus, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)` und `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alc_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sae_objtyp OPTIONAL
        iv_bus_obj_id   TYPE sae_objid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alc_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_alink_conn TYPE REF TO cl_alink_connection.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA: ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.
    DATA: lt_links      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sae_sali.
    DATA: lv_message    TYPE string.

    " In a real scenario, CL_ALINK_CONNECTION would be instantiated or used statically.
    " For demonstration, we'll simulate its behavior.
    " Note: CL_ALINK_CONNECTION methods are mostly static or instance methods
    " that return data or perform actions. Dynamic calls are more complex
    " for methods with complex signatures. This example simplifies.

    TRY.
        CASE iv_method_name.
          WHEN 'GET_LINKS_SIMULATED'. "Simulated method
            IF iv_bus_obj_type IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_bus_obj_id IS NOT INITIAL.
              " Simulate CL_ALINK_CONNECTION=>GET_LINKS
              IF iv_bus_obj_type = 'BUS2032' AND iv_bus_obj_id = '4711'.
                APPEND VALUE #( docid = 'DOC_A' ) TO lt_links.
                APPEND VALUE #( docid = 'DOC_B' ) TO lt_links.
              ENDIF.
              rv_result = |Found { lines( lt_links ) } links for { iv_bus_obj_type }/{ iv_bus_obj_id }|.
            ELSE.
              rv_result = 'Missing parameters for GET_LINKS_SIMULATED'.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_result = |Method '{ iv_method_name }' not supported or found.|.
        ENDCASE.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call).
        rv_result = |Dynamic call error: { lx_dyn_call->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial INTO DATA(lx_initial).
        rv_result = |Object reference is initial: { lx_initial->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alc_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_method_name = 'GET_LINKS_SIMULATED'
      iv_bus_obj_type = 'BUS2032'
      iv_bus_obj_id = '4711'
    ).
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result1
      exp = 'Found 2 links for BUS2032/4711'
      msg = 'Dynamic call for GET_LINKS_SIMULATED failed'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_result2
      exp = 'not supported or found'
      msg = 'Dynamic call for non-existent method failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Methoden dynamisch aufrufen kann, deren Namen zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Dies ist nützlich für generische Frameworks oder wenn die auszuführende Logik von Konfigurationen abhängt. Die Verwendung von `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischen Methodennamen und `PARAMETER-TABLE` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in ABAP (ABAP 7.50+ für verbesserte Syntax).
keywords: CL_ALINK_CONNECTION, Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Runtime

Instructions: Setzen Sie eine Eigenschaft (z.B. 'visible') für eine Liste von `CL_GUI_CONTROL`-Instanzen auf einen bestimmten Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit `IN` und `FIELD-SYMBOL` oder `DATA` Inline-Deklaration, um über die Objektreferenzen zu iterieren und Methoden aufzurufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_set_props DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_control_ref TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control.
    TYPES tt_control_refs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_control_ref WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_controls_visible
      IMPORTING
        it_controls TYPE tt_control_refs
        iv_visible  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_set_props IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_controls_visible.
    " In a real GUI scenario, these would be actual GUI controls.
    " For demonstration, we'll simulate the SET_VISIBLE method.
    CLASS lcl_mock_control DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_control.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_visible TYPE abap_bool.
        METHODS set_visible IMPORTING i_visible TYPE abap_bool.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_mock_control IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD set_visible.
        mv_visible = i_visible.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT it_controls ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_control>).
      " Downcast to the mock control to access mv_visible for testing
      DATA(lo_mock_control) = CAST lcl_mock_control( <fs_control> ).
      lo_mock_control->set_visible( iv_visible ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      PUBLIC SECTION.

    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_mock_control IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD set_visible.
        mv_visible = i_visible.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_test_controls TYPE zcl_gui_set_props=>tt_control_refs.
    APPEND NEW lcl_mock_control( ) TO lt_test_controls.
    APPEND NEW lcl_mock_control( ) TO lt_test_controls.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_set_props( ).
    lo_cut->set_controls_visible( it_controls = lt_test_controls iv_visible = abap_true ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = CAST lcl_mock_control( lt_test_controls[ 1 ] )->mv_visible
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'First control not visible'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = CAST lcl_mock_control( lt_test_controls[ 2 ] )->mv_visible
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Second control not visible'
    ).

    lo_cut->set_controls_visible( it_controls = lt_test_controls iv_visible = abap_false ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = CAST lcl_mock_control( lt_test_controls[ 1 ] )->mv_visible
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'First control not hidden'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Syntax (ABAP 7.40+) ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, über interne Tabellen zu iterieren, insbesondere wenn man die Zeilen direkt modifizieren oder Methoden auf den enthaltenen Objektreferenzen aufrufen möchte. Die Inline-Deklaration von `DATA(lo_mock_control)` verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: CL_GUI_CONTROL, LOOP AT, FIELD-SYMBOL, Object Orientation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Registrieren Sie einen lokalen Event-Handler für ein GUI-Control-Ereignis mit der modernen `FOR EVENT` Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR EVENT evt OF o_control` um einen Event-Handler zu definieren und zu registrieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS register_event_handler
      IMPORTING
        io_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_event_fired TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS handle_event FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_event_handler.
    " In a real scenario, io_control would be an actual CL_GUI_BUTTON.
    " For testing, we'll use a mock button and simulate event firing.
    CLASS lcl_mock_button DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_button.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING parent TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
        METHODS fire_click_event.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_mock_button IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        super->constructor( parent = parent ).
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD fire_click_event.
        RAISE EVENT click EXPORTING sender = me.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_button) = CAST lcl_mock_button( io_control ).

    " Modern event handler registration (ABAP 7.50+)
    SET HANDLER me->handle_event FOR lo_button.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_event.
    mv_event_fired = abap_true.
    " In a real application, this method would contain the logic
    " to be executed when the button is clicked.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_container DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_container.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_container IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        " No actual GUI creation, just for type compatibility
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_mock_button DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_button.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING parent TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
        METHODS fire_click_event.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_mock_button IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        super->constructor( parent = parent ).
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD fire_click_event.
        RAISE EVENT click EXPORTING sender = me.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW lcl_dummy_container( ).
    DATA(lo_mock_button) = NEW lcl_mock_button( parent = lo_dummy_container ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_event_handler( ).

    lo_cut->register_event_handler( lo_mock_button ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->mv_event_fired
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Event should not have fired yet'
    ).

    lo_mock_button->fire_click_event( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->mv_event_fired
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Event should have fired'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SET HANDLER` Anweisung (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Registrierung von Event-Handlern. Anstatt separate `CLASS ... DEFINITION FOR EVENTS` und `CREATE OBJECT` für den Handler zu verwenden, kann der Handler direkt auf eine Instanz der verarbeitenden Klasse gesetzt werden. Dies vereinfacht die Event-Behandlung in ABAP.
keywords: CL_GUI_CONTROL, Event Handling, SET HANDLER, Object Orientation

Instructions: Führen Sie unterschiedliche Aktionen basierend auf dem tatsächlichen Typ einer `CL_GUI_CONTROL`-Referenz aus, indem Sie den `SWITCH` Ausdruck verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH` Ausdruck mit `TYPE OF` um den Typ eines Objekts zu prüfen und entsprechende Werte zurückzugeben.

CLASS zcl_gui_switch_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_gui_switch_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_control_type_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH #( cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( io_control ) " Get actual class name
      WHEN 'CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT' THEN 'Text Editor Control'
      WHEN 'CL_GUI_ALV_GRID' THEN 'ALV Grid Control'
      WHEN 'CL_GUI_BUTTON'   THEN 'Button Control'
      WHEN OTHERS            THEN 'Generic GUI Control'

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz eines GUI-Controls, dessen Typ zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit der `TYPE` Option und einem String-Feld für den Klassennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_control
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        io_parent     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_control) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_control.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA: ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    IF io_parent IS BOUND.
      ls_parameter-name = 'PARENT'.
      ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_parmbind_kind=>exporting.
      GET REFERENCE OF io_parent INTO ls_parameter-value.
      APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT ro_control TYPE (iv_class_name) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_textedit FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_create_dynamic_button.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_container DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_container.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_container IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        " No actual GUI creation, just for type compatibility
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW lcl_dummy_container( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_dynamic_create( ).

    DATA(lo_button) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_control(
      iv_class_name = 'CL_GUI_BUTTON'

    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

explanation: Die `CREATE OBJECT` Anweisung mit der `TYPE (class_name_variable)` Option (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht die dynamische Instanziierung von Objekten, deren Klassentyp zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Frameworks oder generische Oberflächen, die Controls basierend auf Konfigurationen erstellen müssen. Die `PARAMETER-TABLE` Syntax erlaubt die dynamische Übergabe von Konstruktorparametern.
keywords: CL_GUI_CONTROL, Dynamic Programming, CREATE OBJECT, RTTI, Object Orientation

CLASS zcl_gui_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Sammeln Sie die Klassennamen einer Liste von GUI-Controls in einer internen Tabelle, wobei Duplikate entfernt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und einer Hash-Tabelle, um eindeutige Klassennamen zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_unique_classes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_control_ref TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control.
    TYPES tt_control_refs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_control_ref WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_class_names TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_unique_class_names
      IMPORTING
        it_controls TYPE tt_control_refs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_class_names) TYPE tt_class_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_unique_classes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_class_names.
    rt_class_names = VALUE #( FOR control IN it_controls ( cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( control ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_class_names FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_class_names.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_container DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_container.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_container IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        " No actual GUI creation, just for type compatibility
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW lcl_dummy_container( ).
    DATA: lt_test_controls TYPE zcl_gui_unique_classes=>tt_control_refs.
    APPEND NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = lo_dummy_container ) TO lt_test_controls.
    APPEND NEW cl_gui_button( parent = lo_dummy_container ) TO lt_test_controls.
    APPEND NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = lo_dummy_container ) TO lt_test_controls. " Duplicate
    APPEND NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( parent = lo_dummy_container ) TO lt_test_controls.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_unique_classes( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_names) = lo_cut->get_unique_class_names( it_controls = lt_test_controls ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique_names )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Expected 3 unique class names'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( 'CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT' IS IN lt_unique_names )
      msg = 'CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT not found'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( 'CL_GUI_BUTTON' IS IN lt_unique_names )
      msg = 'CL_GUI_BUTTON not found'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( 'CL_GUI_ALV_GRID' IS IN lt_unique_names )
      msg = 'CL_GUI_ALV_GRID not found'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination des `VALUE` Operators mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und einer HASHED TABLE als Zieltyp (ABAP 7.50+) können eindeutige Werte aus einer Quelltabelle effizient gesammelt werden. Die HASHED TABLE stellt sicher, dass nur eindeutige Einträge gespeichert werden, was das manuelle Entfernen von Duplikaten überflüssig macht.
keywords: CL_GUI_CONTROL, VALUE, FOR, Hashed Table, Internal Tables, RTTI

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein GUI-Control eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementiert, um dessen Fähigkeiten zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen.

CLASS zcl_gui_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Simulate an interface for editable controls
    INTERFACE zif_editable_gui_control.
      METHODS set_editable IMPORTING iv_editable TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS lcl_editable_textedit DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_textedit IMPLEMENTING zif_editable_gui_control.

    IF io_control IS INSTANCE OF zif_editable_gui_control.
      rv_is_editable = abap_true.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Aktion auf einem GUI-Control aus, das über eine generische Referenz (`CL_GUI_CONTROL`) übergeben wird, indem Sie einen Downcast verwenden, um auf spezifische Methoden zuzugreifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CAST` um eine generische Objektreferenz in einen spezifischeren Typ umzuwandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_downcast_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_text_if_textedit
      IMPORTING
        io_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control
        iv_text    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_downcast_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_text_if_textedit.
    IF io_control IS INSTANCE OF cl_gui_textedit.
      DATA(lo_textedit) = CAST cl_gui_textedit( io_control ).
      " In a real scenario, this would set the text of the GUI control.
      " For demonstration, we'll simulate a property.
      CLASS lcl_mock_textedit DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_textedit.
        PUBLIC SECTION.
          DATA mv_text TYPE string.
          METHODS set_text_stream IMPORTING text TYPE string.
      ENDCLASS.
      CLASS lcl_mock_textedit IMPLEMENTATION.
        METHOD set_text_stream.
          mv_text = text.
        ENDMETHOD.
      ENDCLASS.
      CAST lcl_mock_textedit( lo_textedit )->set_text_stream( iv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_text_on_textedit FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_text_on_button FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_text_on_textedit.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_container DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_container.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_container IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        " No actual GUI creation, just for type compatibility
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_mock_textedit DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_textedit.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_text TYPE string.
        METHODS set_text_stream IMPORTING text TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_mock_textedit IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        super->constructor( parent = parent ).
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD set_text_stream.
        mv_text = text.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW lcl_dummy_container( ).
    DATA(lo_mock_textedit) = NEW lcl_mock_textedit( parent = lo_dummy_container ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_downcast_action( ).
    lo_cut->set_text_if_textedit( io_control = lo_mock_textedit iv_text = 'Hello ABAP' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_mock_textedit->mv_text
      exp = 'Hello ABAP'
      msg = 'Text on TextEdit not set correctly'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_text_on_button.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_container DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_gui_container.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_container IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        " No actual GUI creation, just for type compatibility
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW lcl_dummy_container( ).
    DATA(lo_button) = NEW cl_gui_button( parent = lo_dummy_container ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_downcast_action( ).
    lo_cut->set_text_if_textedit( io_control = lo_button iv_text = 'Should not set' ).

    " No direct way to assert that nothing happened on the button,
    " but we can assert that no exception occurred and the logic was skipped.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = abap_true

explanation: Der `CAST` Operator (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht den Downcast einer Objektreferenz von einem generischeren Typ (z.B. `CL_GUI_CONTROL`) zu einem spezifischeren Typ (z.B. `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`). Eine vorherige Prüfung mit `IS INSTANCE OF` ist gute Praxis, um Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer UUID als Schlüssel und fügen Sie Einträge hinzu. Suchen Sie dann einen Eintrag über die UUID.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TABLE OF` mit `WITH UNIQUE KEY` und `LINE OF` oder `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_table_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE sysuuid_c32,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_entry) TYPE ty_data.

    METHODS get_entry_by_uuid
      IMPORTING
        iv_uuid TYPE sysuuid_c32
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_entry) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_table_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    rs_entry = VALUE #( id = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ) text = iv_text ).
    INSERT rs_entry INTO TABLE mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_entry_by_uuid.
    READ TABLE mt_data INTO rs_entry WITH KEY id = iv_uuid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_uuid_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_uuid_table_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_uuid_table.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_uuid_table_handler( ).
    DATA(ls_entry1) = lo_handler->add_entry( 'First Entry' ).
    DATA(ls_entry2) = lo_handler->add_entry( 'Second Entry' ).

    DATA(ls_found_entry) = lo_handler->get_entry_by_uuid( ls_entry1-id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_entry-text exp = 'First Entry' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_entry-id exp = ls_entry1-id ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_uuid_table_not_found.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_uuid_table_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_non_existent_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_exception_type = 'CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND'
    ).
    lo_handler->get_entry_by_uuid( lv_non_existent_uuid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: UUIDs sind hervorragend als eindeutige Schlüssel in internen Tabellen geeignet. Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `VALUE #` für die Initialisierung und `READ TABLE` für den Zugriff, was Standardpraktiken in modernem ABAP sind.
keywords: UUID, Internal Tables, Sorted Table, Unique Key, VALUE #

CLASS zcl_fds_loop_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_fds_loop_modify IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` ist die effizienteste Methode, um interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen und deren Zeilen direkt zu modifizieren. Anstatt eine Work Area zu verwenden und die Zeile explizit mit `MODIFY TABLE` zurückzuschreiben, wird das Feldsymbol direkt auf die Tabellenzeile referenziert, was zu einer besseren Performance führt.

Instructions: Schreibe eine generische Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als Feldsymbol empfängt, die Anzahl der Zeilen zählt und den Wert eines dynamisch angegebenen Feldes in der ersten Zeile zurückgibt.
hint: Deklariere ein generisches Feldsymbol `<fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE` und ein weiteres `<fs_component> TYPE ANY` für den Feldzugriff. Nutze `ASSIGN TABLE FIELD(<fs_table>)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_generic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_generic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table        TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_line_count   TYPE i
        ev_first_row_component_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_generic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_generic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ev_line_count = lines( <fs_table> ).

    IF ev_line_count > 0.
      READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ev_first_row_component_value = <fs_component>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data,
           ty_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_generic_table_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_table_processing.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE ty_test_table,
          ls_data LIKE LINE OF lt_data.

    ls_data-id = 1. ls_data-text = 'First entry'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_data.
    ls_data-id = 2. ls_data-text = 'Second entry'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_data.

    DATA(lr_table) = REF TO lt_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_generic_table( ).

    DATA: lv_count TYPE i,
          lv_value TYPE string.

    lo_cut->process_generic_table(
      ir_table        = lr_table
      iv_component_name = 'TEXT'
      EXPORTING
        ev_line_count   = lv_count
        ev_first_row_component_value = lv_value
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 msg = 'Line count incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'First entry' msg = 'First row component value incorrect' ).

    CLEAR lt_data.
    lr_table = REF TO lt_data.
    lo_cut->process_generic_table(
      ir_table        = lr_table
      iv_component_name = 'TEXT'
      EXPORTING
        ev_line_count   = lv_count
        ev_first_row_component_value = lv_value
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'Empty table line count incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_value msg = 'Empty table component value should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von Feldsymbolen für generische Programmierung. Durch die Verwendung von `TYPE ANY TABLE` und `TYPE ANY` können Methoden mit beliebigen Tabellen- und Strukturtypen arbeiten. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das die Wiederverwendbarkeit von Code erheblich steigert, da man nicht für jeden Datentyp eine eigene Implementierung benötigt.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Generic Programming, ANY TABLE, Dynamic Access, RTTI

Instructions: Greife auf ein Feld in einer verschachtelten internen Tabelle zu, die Teil einer Struktur ist, und modifiziere es direkt.
hint: Nutze `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` für die verschachtelte Bearbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_nested_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_item,
             sub_id   TYPE i,
             sub_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sub_item,
           ty_sub_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sub_item WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_main_item,
             main_id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             nested_table TYPE ty_sub_items,
           END OF ty_main_item,
           ty_main_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_main_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_nested_value
      IMPORTING
        it_main_items TYPE ty_main_items
        iv_main_id    TYPE i
        iv_sub_id     TYPE i
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_items) TYPE ty_main_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_nested_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_nested_value.
    rt_modified_items = it_main_items.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_main_item> TYPE ty_main_item.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sub_item>  TYPE ty_sub_item.

    READ TABLE rt_modified_items ASSIGNING <fs_main_item> WITH KEY main_id = iv_main_id.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      READ TABLE <fs_main_item>-nested_table ASSIGNING <fs_sub_item> WITH KEY sub_id = iv_sub_id.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_sub_item>-sub_value = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_modify_nested_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_nested_value.
    DATA: lt_main TYPE zcl_fds_nested_access=>ty_main_items,
          ls_main LIKE LINE OF lt_main,
          ls_sub  LIKE LINE OF ls_main-nested_table.

    ls_main-main_id = 1.
    ls_main-description = 'Main Item 1'.
    ls_sub-sub_id = 10. ls_sub-sub_value = 'Old Value 10'. APPEND ls_sub TO ls_main-nested_table.
    ls_sub-sub_id = 20. ls_sub-sub_value = 'Old Value 20'. APPEND ls_sub TO ls_main-nested_table.
    APPEND ls_main TO lt_main.

    CLEAR ls_main.
    ls_main-main_id = 2.
    ls_main-description = 'Main Item 2'.
    ls_sub-sub_id = 30. ls_sub-sub_value = 'Old Value 30'. APPEND ls_sub TO ls_main-nested_table.
    APPEND ls_main TO lt_main.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_nested_access( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->modify_nested_value(
      it_main_items = lt_main
      iv_main_id    = 1
      iv_sub_id     = 20
      iv_new_value  = 'New Value 20'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_main_res>) WITH KEY main_id = 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_main_res> msg = 'Main item 1 not found' ).

    READ TABLE <fs_main_res>-nested_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sub_res>) WITH KEY sub_id = 20.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_sub_res> msg = 'Sub item 20 not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sub_res>-sub_value exp = 'New Value 20' msg = 'Nested value not updated' ).

    READ TABLE <fs_main_res>-nested_table ASSIGNING <fs_sub_res> WITH KEY sub_id = 10.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sub_res>-sub_value exp = 'Old Value 10' msg = 'Other nested value should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Feldsymbole vereinfachen den Zugriff und die direkte Modifikation von Daten in komplexen, verschachtelten Datenstrukturen. Anstatt temporäre Work Areas zu verwenden und Daten hin- und herzukopieren, ermöglichen Feldsymbole die direkte Referenzierung der Speicherbereiche, was den Code lesbarer und effizienter macht, insbesondere bei tiefen Hierarchien.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Nested Structures, Internal Tables, Data Access, Modify

Instructions: Lese eine spezifische Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem Schlüssel und modifiziere diese Zeile direkt, ohne eine separate `MODIFY` Anweisung zu verwenden.
hint: Nutze `READ TABLE itab WITH KEY ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_read_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product,
           ty_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS update_product_price
      IMPORTING
        it_products   TYPE ty_products
        iv_product_id TYPE i
        iv_new_price  TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_products) TYPE ty_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_read_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_product_price.
    rt_updated_products = it_products.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_product> TYPE ty_product.

    READ TABLE rt_updated_products ASSIGNING <fs_product> WITH KEY id = iv_product_id.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_product>-price = iv_new_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_product_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_product_price.
    DATA: lt_products TYPE zcl_fds_read_modify=>ty_products,
          ls_product  LIKE LINE OF lt_products.

    ls_product-id = 1. ls_product-name = 'Laptop'. ls_product-price = '1200.00'. APPEND ls_product TO lt_products.
    ls_product-id = 2. ls_product-name = 'Mouse'.  ls_product-price = '25.50'.  APPEND ls_product TO lt_products.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_read_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->update_product_price(
      it_products   = lt_products
      iv_product_id = 1
      iv_new_price  = '1250.00'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_updated_product>) WITH KEY id = 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_updated_product> msg = 'Product 1 not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_updated_product>-price exp = '1250.00' msg = 'Price not updated correctly' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_updated_product> WITH KEY id = 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_updated_product>-price exp = '25.50' msg = 'Other product price should be unchanged' ).

    DATA(lt_no_change) = lo_cut->update_product_price(
      it_products   = lt_products
      iv_product_id = 999 " Non-existent ID
      iv_new_price  = '100.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_no_change exp = lt_products msg = 'No change expected for non-existent ID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <fs>` ermöglicht das direkte Lesen und Modifizieren einer Tabellenzeile. Das Feldsymbol referenziert direkt die Zeile in der internen Tabelle, wodurch keine separate Work Area und keine `MODIFY` Anweisung erforderlich sind. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art, mit internen Tabellen zu arbeiten, da es unnötige Datenkopien vermeidet.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, READ TABLE, Internal Tables, Modify

Instructions: Füge alle Zeilen einer Quelltabelle an das Ende einer Zieltabelle an.

CLASS zcl_alo_simple_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           ty_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ty_data_table
        it_target_table TYPE ty_data_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_table) TYPE ty_data_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alo_simple_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_tables.
    rt_combined_table = it_target_table.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_append_tables FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_tables.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_alo_simple_append=>ty_data_table,
          lt_target TYPE zcl_alo_simple_append=>ty_data_table,
          ls_data   LIKE LINE OF lt_source.

    ls_data-id = 1. ls_data-text = 'Source 1'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_source.
    ls_data-id = 2. ls_data-text = 'Source 2'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_source.

    ls_data-id = 10. ls_data-text = 'Target 10'. APPEND ls_data TO lt_target.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alo_simple_append( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->append_tables( it_source_table = lt_source it_target_table = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Total lines incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO ls_data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-id exp = 10 msg = 'First line should be from target' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO ls_data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-id exp = 1 msg = 'Second line should be from source' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 3 INTO ls_data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-id exp = 2 msg = 'Third line should be from source' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `APPEND LINES OF` ist die Standardmethode, um den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle vollständig an eine andere anzuhängen. Es ist eine klare und effiziente Syntax, die die manuelle Iteration und das zeilenweise Anhängen überflüssig macht. Dies ist eine grundlegende, aber wichtige moderne ABAP-Funktion für die Tabellenmanipulation.

Instructions: Füge nur die Zeilen einer Quelltabelle an eine Zieltabelle an, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen (z.B. ID größer als ein Schwellenwert).
hint: Kombiniere `APPEND LINES OF` mit einem `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alo_filtered_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_filtered_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE ty_items
        iv_threshold    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_items) TYPE ty_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alo_filtered_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_filtered_items.
    APPEND LINES OF it_source_items
      FOR item IN it_source_items WHERE ( item-id > iv_threshold )
      TO rt_target_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_append_filtered_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_find_and_return DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             key   TYPE string,

           ty_configs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

CLASS zcl_fds_find_and_return IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_config_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_config> TYPE ty_config.

CLASS zcl_alo_group_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sales_item,
           ty_sales_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_sales_summary,
             region TYPE string,
             total_amount TYPE decfloat16,
             item_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sales_summary,
           ty_sales_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_sales_by_region
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_data TYPE ty_sales_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE ty_sales_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alo_group_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_sales_by_region.
    LOOP AT it_sales_data INTO DATA(ls_sales_item) GROUP BY ls_sales_item-region.
      DATA(lv_total_amount) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_sales_item
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-amount
      ).
      DATA(lv_item_count) = lines( GROUP ls_sales_item ).

      APPEND VALUE #( region = ls_sales_item-region
                      total_amount = lv_total_amount
                      item_count = lv_item_count ) TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_full,
           ty_sflights_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_proj,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_proj,
           ty_sflights_proj TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_proj WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS project_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE ty_sflights_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_projected_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_proj.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD project_sflight_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line> TYPE ty_sflight_full.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_line> TYPE ty_sflight_proj.

    LOOP AT it_source_flights ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_projected_flights ASSIGNING <fs_target_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_target_line>-carrid = <fs_source_line>-carrid.
        <fs_target_line>-connid = <fs_source_line>-connid.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_project_sflight_data.

    ls_source-carrid = 'LH'. ls_source-connid = '0400'. ls_source-fldate = sy-datum. ls_source-price = '120.00'. APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.
    ls_source-carrid = 'AA'. ls_source-connid = '0017'. ls_source-fldate = sy-datum. ls_source-price = '250.00'. APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_dynamic_projection( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->project_sflight_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Number of lines should be 2' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_line) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_line-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First line carrid incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_line-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'First line connid incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_result_line INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_line-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second line carrid incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_line-connid exp = '0017' msg = 'Second line connid incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Durch `APPEND INITIAL LINE TO ... ASSIGNING <fs>` wird eine neue leere Zeile erstellt und direkt einem Feldsymbol zugewiesen, was eine effiziente Befüllung ohne temporäre Work Areas ermöglicht.
