CLASS zcl_alo_conditional_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message,
           ty_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_if_not_empty
      IMPORTING
        it_source_messages TYPE ty_messages
        it_target_messages TYPE ty_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_messages) TYPE ty_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alo_conditional_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_if_not_empty.
    rt_combined_messages = it_target_messages.

    IF it_source_messages IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND LINES OF it_source_messages TO rt_combined_messages.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_append_if_not_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_if_not_empty.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_alo_conditional_append=>ty_messages,
          lt_target TYPE zcl_alo_conditional_append=>ty_messages,
          ls_msg    LIKE LINE OF lt_source.

    ls_msg-type = 'I'. ls_msg-text = 'Info 1'. APPEND ls_msg TO lt_target.

    " Testfall 1: Quelltabelle ist nicht leer
    ls_msg-type = 'W'. ls_msg-text = 'Warning 1'. APPEND ls_msg TO lt_source.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alo_conditional_append( ).
    DATA(lt_result1) = lo_cut->append_if_not_empty( it_source_messages = lt_source it_target_messages = lt_target ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result1 ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 messages when source is not empty' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result1 INDEX 2 INTO ls_msg.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_msg-text exp = 'Warning 1' msg = 'Warning message not appended' ).

    " Testfall 2: Quelltabelle ist leer
    CLEAR lt_source.
    DATA(lt_result2) = lo_cut->append_if_not_empty( it_source_messages = lt_source it_target_messages = lt_target ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result2 ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 message when source is empty' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result2 INDEX 1 INTO ls_msg.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_msg-text exp = 'Info 1' msg = 'Info message should remain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die bedingte Verwendung von `APPEND LINES OF` mit einer `IF ... IS NOT INITIAL` Prüfung ist eine einfache, aber effektive Methode, um sicherzustellen, dass nur dann Zeilen angehängt werden, wenn die Quelltabelle tatsächlich Daten enthält. Dies verhindert unnötige Operationen und hält den Code sauber. Es ist eine gängige Praxis im modernen ABAP, um robuste Datenverarbeitung zu gewährleisten.
keywords: APPEND LINES OF, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, IS NOT INITIAL

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die eine generische Referenz auf ein Objekt empfängt und dynamisch auf eine Methode dieses Objekts zugreift und diese aufruft, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` für die Referenz, `ASSIGN` für das Feldsymbol und `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_dynamic_callable.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object       TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_dynamic_callable.
  METHODS get_info RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_version RETURNING VALUE(rv_version) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_fds_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE if_dynamic_callable.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE string.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN io_object->* TO <fs_object>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL METHOD <fs_object>->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = <fs_result>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_result = <fs_result>.
          ELSE.
            rv_result = 'Method call failed'.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Object assignment failed'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Dynamic call error'.
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        rv_result = 'Object reference is initial'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS lcl_test_object DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES if_dynamic_callable.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_test_object IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD if_dynamic_callable~get_info.
        rv_info = 'Test Object Info'.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD if_dynamic_callable~get_version.
        rv_version = '1.0'.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_test_obj) = NEW lcl_test_object( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fds_dynamic_method_call( ).

    DATA(lv_info) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_test_obj iv_method_name = 'GET_INFO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'Test Object Info' msg = 'GET_INFO call failed' ).

    DATA(lv_version) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_test_obj iv_method_name = 'GET_VERSION' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_version exp = '1.0' msg = 'GET_VERSION call failed' ).

    DATA(lv_invalid_method) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_test_obj iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_invalid_method exp = 'Dynamic call error' msg = 'Invalid method call should fail' ).

    DATA lo_null_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA(lv_null_call) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_null_object iv_method_name = 'GET_INFO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_null_call exp = 'Object reference is initial' msg = 'Null object call should fail' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von Feldsymbolen in Verbindung mit dynamischen Methodenaufrufen. Durch die Zuweisung einer generischen Objektreferenz an ein Feldsymbol und die Verwendung von `CALL METHOD <fs_object>->(method_name)` kann eine Methode aufgerufen werden, deren Name erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Frameworks, Plugins oder generische Schnittstellen, wo die konkrete Implementierung oder der Methodenname variieren kann.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Dynamic Method Call, Object Orientation, RTTI, CALL METHOD

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Status basierend auf einem numerischen Wert zu. Verwenden Sie `COND` mit `WHEN`.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie verschiedene Objekttypen dynamisch in einer `CASE`-Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE TYPE OF` und `WHEN TYPE` für die Typunterscheidung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape IMPORTING io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
        rv_description = |Circle with radius { lo_circle->mv_radius } and area { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_area( ) }|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_square INTO DATA(lo_square).
        rv_description = |Square with side { lo_square->mv_side } and area { lo_square->zif_shape~get_area( ) }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unknown shape'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_shape FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_shape.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5' ).
    DATA(lo_square) = NEW zcl_square( iv_side = '4' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_circle ) exp = 'Circle with radius 5.0000000000000000 and area 78.5397500000000000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_square ) exp = 'Square with side 4.0000000000000000 and area 16.0000000000000000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` mit `WHEN TYPE` ermöglicht eine typsichere und elegante Behandlung von Polymorphie, indem der Objekttyp zur Laufzeit geprüft und in eine spezifische Referenz zugewiesen wird.
keywords: RTTI, CASE TYPE OF, WHEN TYPE, Object Orientation, Polymorphism

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen XML-String und extrahieren Sie den Wert eines Elements.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_value IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_value.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_string ).
        DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( '/data/item' ).
        IF lo_node IS BOUND.
          rv_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_xml_error).
        rv_value = |Error: { lx_xml_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<data><item>Hello XML</item></data>`.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->parse_value( lv_xml ) exp = 'Hello XML' ).

    DATA(lv_invalid_xml) = `<data><item>Hello XML</item>`.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( substring = 'Error' act = lo_cut->parse_value( lv_invalid_xml ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_xml_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_xml_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = 'data'

    ).
    lo_xml_document->set_root( lo_root ).

    DATA(lo_item) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = 'item'
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
      parent = lo_root
    ).
    lo_item->set_value( iv_item_value ).

    lo_xml_document->display( IMPORTING xml_string = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_cond_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cond_complex IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHEN iv_price < 100 AND iv_category = 'A' THEN 'Category A - Low'

      WHEN iv_price >= 500 AND iv_category = 'A' THEN 'Category A - High'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_price_range( iv_price = '200' iv_category = 'A' ) exp = 'Category A - Medium' ).

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String und extrahieren Sie sowohl Elementwerte als auch Attributwerte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_node_by_path` und `get_attribute`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id     TYPE string,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_xml_attr_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_items IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_attr_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_items.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_string ).
        DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->get_root( ).
        DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_root->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'item' ).

        LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(lo_item_node).
          DATA(ls_item) = VALUE ty_item(
            id     = lo_item_node->get_attribute( 'id' )
            name   = lo_item_node->get_value( )
            status = lo_item_node->get_attribute( 'status' )
          ).
          APPEND ls_item TO rt_items.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_xml_error).
        MESSAGE lx_xml_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_attr_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<items><item id="001" status="active">Product A</item><item id="002" status="inactive">Product B</item></items>`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_items( lv_xml ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Product A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-status exp = 'active' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = '002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Product B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-status exp = 'inactive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Nach dem Parsen des XML-Dokuments können Elemente mit `get_elements_by_tag_name` gefunden werden. Für jedes Element können dann Attributwerte mit `get_attribute` extrahiert werden.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, Parsing, Attributes, get_attribute

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert und geben Sie einen Status zurück.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key TYPE string,

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag (Text) für ein gegebenes Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` für numerische Wochentage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weekday_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name IMPORTING iv_date TYPE d RETURNING VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lv_weekday_num) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( iv_date ).

    CASE lv_weekday_num.
      WHEN 1 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Montag'.
      WHEN 2 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Dienstag'.
      WHEN 3 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Mittwoch'.
      WHEN 4 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Donnerstag'.
      WHEN 5 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Freitag'.
      WHEN 6 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Samstag'.
      WHEN 7 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Sonntag'.
      WHEN OTHERS THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Ungültiger Tag'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_weekday_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weekday_resolver( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( '20251201' ) exp = 'Montag' ). " 2025-12-01 is a Monday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( '20251207' ) exp = 'Sonntag' ). " 2025-12-07 is a Sunday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( '20251203' ) exp = 'Mittwoch' ). " 2025-12-03 is a Wednesday
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE`-Anweisung ist ideal, um einen Wert gegen eine Reihe von diskreten Werten zu prüfen und entsprechende Aktionen auszuführen. `cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday` liefert den numerischen Wochentag.
keywords: CASE, WHEN, Date/Time, Conditional Logic, Weekday

Instructions: Parsen Sie ein komplexeres XML-Dokument mit verschachtelten Elementen und extrahieren Sie Daten in eine strukturierte interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_elements_by_tag_name` und rekursiven Zugriff auf Kindknoten.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item,
             product_id TYPE string,
             quantity   TYPE i,
             price      TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_order_item.
TYPES: tt_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id   TYPE string,
             customer   TYPE string,
             items      TYPE tt_order_items,
           END OF ty_order.
TYPES: tt_orders TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_xml_complex_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_orders IMPORTING iv_xml_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_orders) TYPE tt_orders.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS parse_order_item IMPORTING io_item_node TYPE REF TO if_xml_node RETURNING VALUE(rs_item) TYPE ty_order_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_complex_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_orders.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_string ).
        DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->get_root( ).
        DATA(lt_order_nodes) = lo_root->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'order' ).

        LOOP AT lt_order_nodes INTO DATA(lo_order_node).
          DATA(ls_order) = VALUE ty_order(
            order_id = lo_order_node->get_attribute( 'id' )
            customer = lo_order_node->get_node_by_path( 'customer' )->get_value( )
          ).

          DATA(lt_item_nodes) = lo_order_node->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'item' ).
          LOOP AT lt_item_nodes INTO DATA(lo_item_node).
            APPEND parse_order_item( lo_item_node ) TO ls_order-items.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND ls_order TO rt_orders.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_xml_error).
        MESSAGE lx_xml_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD parse_order_item.
    rs_item = VALUE ty_order_item(
      product_id = io_item_node->get_node_by_path( 'product_id' )->get_value( )
      quantity   = io_item_node->get_node_by_path( 'quantity' )->get_value( )
      price      = io_item_node->get_node_by_path( 'price' )->get_value( )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_orders FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_orders.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_complex_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><orders><order id="ORD001" customer="Alice"><customer>Alice</customer><items><item><product_id>P001</product_id><quantity>2</quantity><price>10.50</price></item><item><product_id>P002</product_id><quantity>1</quantity><price>25.00</price></item></items></order><order id="ORD002" customer="Bob"><customer>Bob</customer><items><item><product_id>P003</product_id><quantity>5</quantity><price>5.99</price></item></items></order></orders>`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_orders( lv_xml ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-order_id exp = 'ORD001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-customer exp = 'Alice' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result[ 1 ]-items ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-items[ 1 ]-product_id exp = 'P001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-order_id exp = 'ORD002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-customer exp = 'Bob' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result[ 2 ]-items ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für komplexe XML-Strukturen kann `get_elements_by_tag_name` verwendet werden, um alle Knoten eines bestimmten Typs zu finden. Anschließend kann man rekursiv oder iterativ durch die Kindknoten navigieren, um verschachtelte Daten zu extrahieren und in ABAP-Strukturen abzubilden.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, Parsing, Nested Elements, Structured Data

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein komplexes XML-Dokument mit verschachtelten Elementen und Attributen aus einer strukturierten internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_node` mit `parent`-Parameter und `set_attribute`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item,
             product_id TYPE string,
             quantity   TYPE i,
             price      TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_order_item.
TYPES: tt_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id   TYPE string,
             customer   TYPE string,
             items      TYPE tt_order_items,
           END OF ty_order.
TYPES: tt_orders TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_xml_complex_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_complex_xml IMPORTING it_orders TYPE tt_orders RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS create_order_item_node IMPORTING io_parent_node TYPE REF TO if_xml_node is_item TYPE ty_order_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_complex_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_complex_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = 'orders'
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
    ).
    lo_xml_document->set_root( lo_root ).

    LOOP AT it_orders INTO DATA(ls_order).
      DATA(lo_order_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
        name = 'order'
        type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
        parent = lo_root
      ).
      lo_order_node->set_attribute( name = 'id' value = ls_order-order_id ).

      DATA(lo_customer_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
        name = 'customer'
        type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
        parent = lo_order_node
      ).
      lo_customer_node->set_value( ls_order-customer ).

      DATA(lo_items_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
        name = 'items'
        type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
        parent = lo_order_node
      ).

      LOOP AT ls_order-items INTO DATA(ls_item).
        create_order_item_node( io_parent_node = lo_items_node is_item = ls_item ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_xml_document->display( IMPORTING xml_string = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_order_item_node.
    DATA(lo_item_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = 'item'
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
      parent = io_parent_node
    ).

    DATA(lo_product_id_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = 'product_id'
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
      parent = lo_item_node
    ).
    lo_product_id_node->set_value( is_item-product_id ).

    DATA(lo_quantity_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = 'quantity'
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
      parent = lo_item_node
    ).
    lo_quantity_node->set_value( is_item-quantity ).

    DATA(lo_price_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
      name = 'price'
      type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element
      parent = lo_item_node
    ).
    lo_price_node->set_value( is_item-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_complex_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_complex_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_complex_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_orders) = VALUE tt_orders(
      ( order_id = 'ORD001' customer = 'Alice'
        items = VALUE tt_order_items(
          ( product_id = 'P001' quantity = 2 price = '10.50' )
          ( product_id = 'P002' quantity = 1 price = '25.00' )
        )
      )
      ( order_id = 'ORD002' customer = 'Bob'
        items = VALUE tt_order_items(
          ( product_id = 'P003' quantity = 5 price = '5.99' )
        )
      )
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_xml) = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><orders><order id="ORD001"><customer>Alice</customer><items><item><product_id>P001</product_id><quantity>2</quantity><price>10.50</price></item><item><product_id>P002</product_id><quantity>1</quantity><price>25.00</price></item></items></order><order id="ORD002"><customer>Bob</customer><items><item><product_id>P003</product_id><quantity>5</quantity><price>5.99</price></item></items></order></orders>`.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->generate_complex_xml( lt_orders ) exp = lv_expected_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Erstellung komplexer XML-Dokumente erfolgt durch das sequentielle Erzeugen von Knoten und deren Zuweisung zu einem `parent`-Knoten. Attribute werden mit `set_attribute` hinzugefügt und Elementwerte mit `set_value` gesetzt. Dies ermöglicht die Abbildung komplexer ABAP-Datenstrukturen in XML.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, Generation, Nested Elements, Attributes

Instructions: Klassifizieren Sie einen String basierend auf seinem Inhalt und seiner Länge. Verwenden Sie `COND` mit `WHEN` und String-Operatoren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `COND` mit `CONTAINS`, `STARTS WITH` oder `ENDS WITH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_string_classify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS classify_string IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_classification) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_string_classify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD classify_string.
    rv_classification = COND string(
      WHEN iv_input IS INITIAL THEN 'Empty String'
      WHEN iv_input STARTS WITH 'SAP' AND strlen( iv_input ) > 5 THEN 'SAP Long String'
      WHEN iv_input CONTAINS 'Error' THEN 'Contains Error'
      WHEN iv_input ENDS WITH 'OK' THEN 'Ends with OK'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'General String'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_classify_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_classify_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_string_classify( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->classify_string( '' ) exp = 'Empty String' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->classify_string( 'SAP ABAP' ) exp = 'SAP Long String' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->classify_string( 'System Error' ) exp = 'Contains Error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->classify_string( 'Process OK' ) exp = 'Ends with OK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->classify_string( 'Hello World' ) exp = 'General String' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->classify_string( 'SAP' ) exp = 'General String' ). " Length not > 5
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COND` kann effektiv mit verschiedenen String-Operatoren wie `STARTS WITH`, `CONTAINS` und `ENDS WITH` kombiniert werden, um komplexe String-basierte Klassifizierungen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Expression durchzuführen.
keywords: COND, WHEN, String Processing, Conditional Logic, String Operators

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert. Die Methode soll optional eine interne Tabelle als Eingabe akzeptieren, um die Testbarkeit zu gewährleisten. Wenn keine Tabelle übergeben wird, soll sie Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE (name) = value` für dynamische Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
        io_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL " Optional input table for testing
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights.
    DATA: lt_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF io_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_source_flights = io_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights
        UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_source_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)
      WHERE (iv_field_name) = iv_value.
      APPEND <fs_sflight> TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_connid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_loop_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_loop_filter=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights( iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_value = 'AA' io_sflights = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_connid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_loop_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_loop_filter=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights( iv_field_name = 'CONNID' iv_value = '0400' io_sflights = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_loop_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_loop_filter=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights( iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_value = 'XX' io_sflights = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel in `LOOP AT` ermöglicht es, das Filterkriterium zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen, was die Flexibilität des Codes erhöht. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Berichte oder Tools. Die optionale Eingabetabelle verbessert die Testbarkeit erheblich.
keywords: DYNAMIC, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Field-Symbols, WHERE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` dynamisch nach einem Feldnamen und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Die Methode soll optional eine interne Tabelle als Eingabe akzeptieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY (field_name) ...` in Kombination mit `SWITCH` für dynamische Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group_result,
             group_key TYPE string,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_group_result.
    TYPES tt_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_sflights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_group_field TYPE string
        io_sflights    TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_sflights_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF io_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_source_flights = io_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights
        UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_source_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)
      GROUP BY ( group_key = SWITCH string( iv_group_field
                                            WHEN 'CARRID' THEN <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                            WHEN 'CONNID' THEN <fs_sflight>-connid
                                            WHEN 'FLDATE' THEN <fs_sflight>-fldate
                                            ELSE '' ) ) " Dynamic field access for grouping
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_group_result( group_key = ls_group_key-group_key
                                    flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie dynamisch die Summe eines numerischen Feldes (z.B. `price`) aus einer internen Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`. Die Methode soll optional eine interne Tabelle als Eingabe akzeptieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem dynamischen Feldzugriff (z.B. über `SWITCH` und Konvertierung).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_dynamic_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_sum_field TYPE string
        io_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_sum) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_sum.
    DATA: lt_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF io_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_source_flights = io_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights
        UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_sum = REDUCE #( " Use REDUCE for aggregation
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_source_flights
      LET lv_field_value_str = SWITCH string( iv_sum_field
                                              WHEN 'PRICE' THEN <fs_sflight>-price
                                              ELSE '0' ) IN " Dynamic field access
      sum = sum + CONV p DECIMALS 2( lv_field_value_str ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` in eine neue Tabelle, die nur ausgewählte Felder enthält, deren Namen dynamisch zur Laufzeit übergeben werden. Die Methode soll optional eine interne Tabelle als Eingabe akzeptieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit dynamischem Feldzugriff über `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_field,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_field.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_field WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_row TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_sflights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
        io_sflights    TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_dynamic_row WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF io_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_source_flights = io_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights
        UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field_name> TYPE string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.

    rt_transformed_data = VALUE #( " Use FOR expression for transformation
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_source_flights
      ( VALUE #( " Create a new row for each flight
          FOR <fs_field_name> IN it_field_names
          LET lv_field_value = '' IN
            ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_field_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_component>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              lv_field_value = |{ <fs_component> }|. " Convert component value to string
            ENDIF.
          ( field_name = <fs_field_name> field_value = lv_field_value ) " Create dynamic field entry
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sort_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

           END OF ty_sflight.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_upto IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_flight_index_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
        io_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_index_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF io_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_source_flights = io_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights
        UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_source_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
      WITH KEY (iv_field_name) = iv_value.

    rv_index = sy-tabix.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... FROM ... TO ...` oder `LOOP AT ... DESCENDING` (falls verfügbar und passend). Für Standardtabellen ist `DESCENDING` nicht direkt verfügbar, daher ist ein Workaround mit `REVERSE` oder `FROM/TO` nötig.

CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_reverse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_reverse
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reversed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_reverse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_reverse.
    DATA: lt_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF io_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_source_flights = io_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights
        UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    " For standard tables, LOOP AT ... DESCENDING is not directly available.
    " A common modern approach is to reverse the table first.
    DATA(lt_temp_flights) = lt_source_flights.
    REVERSE lt_temp_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_temp_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND <fs_sflight> TO rt_reversed_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_is_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_dynamic_is_initial
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        io_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_loop_is_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_dynamic_is_initial.
    DATA: lt_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF io_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_source_flights = io_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights
        UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_source_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)
      WHERE (iv_field_name) IS INITIAL. " Dynamic IS INITIAL condition
      APPEND <fs_sflight> TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_link_data,
             object_type TYPE toav0-sap_object,
             object_id   TYPE toav0-object_id,
             doc_type    TYPE toav0-ar_object,
             archive_id  TYPE toav0-archiv_id,
             doc_id      TYPE toav0-arc_doc_id,
           END OF ty_link_data.
    TYPES: tt_link_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_link_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_alink_entries
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE toav0-sap_object
        iv_object_id   TYPE toav0-object_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_links) TYPE tt_link_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_alink_entries.
    DATA(lo_connection) = NEW cl_alink_connection( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_links_raw) = lo_connection->get_links(
          i_sap_object = iv_object_type
          i_object_id  = iv_object_id
        ).

        rt_links = VALUE #( FOR ls_link IN lt_links_raw
                            ( object_type = ls_link-sap_object
                              object_id   = ls_link-object_id
                              doc_type    = ls_link-ar_object
                              archive_id  = ls_link-archiv_id
                              doc_id      = ls_link-arc_doc_id ) ).

      CATCH cx_alink_error INTO DATA(lx_alink_error).
        MESSAGE lx_alink_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_check_exist IMPLEMENTATION.

        iv_old_archive_id TYPE toav0-archiv_id

        iv_new_doc_type   TYPE toav0-ar_object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_alink_entry.
    DATA(lo_connection) = NEW cl_alink_connection( ).
    DATA(lv_delete_success) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_create_success) = abap_false.

    TRY.
        " 1. Alten Link löschen
        lo_connection->delete_link(
          i_sap_object = iv_object_type
          i_object_id  = iv_object_id
          i_ar_object  = iv_old_doc_type
          i_archiv_id  = iv_old_archive_id
          i_arc_doc_id = iv_old_doc_id
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        lv_delete_success = abap_true.

        " 2. Neuen Link mit aktualisiertem Dokumenttyp anlegen
        lo_connection->create_link(
          i_sap_object = iv_object_type
          i_object_id  = iv_object_id
          i_ar_object  = iv_new_doc_type
          i_archiv_id  = iv_old_archive_id " Archiv-ID bleibt gleich
          i_arc_doc_id = iv_old_doc_id     " Dokument-ID bleibt gleich
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        lv_create_success = abap_true.

        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_alink_error INTO DATA(lx_alink_error).
        MESSAGE lx_alink_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.

    IF NOT lv_delete_success OR NOT lv_create_success.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_sflights_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_sflights_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und geben Sie das Ergebnis in einem String-Template aus.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `GROUP BY` in der `SELECT`-Anweisung mit `REDUCE` oder manueller Berechnung und `String Templates`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES: tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_and_format_avg_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_and_format_avg_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_avg_prices TYPE tt_avg_price.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Gruppieren und Durchschnitt berechnen
    lt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                             ( carrid    = GROUP carrid
                               avg_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                                             INIT sum = 0 count = 0
                                             FOR member IN GROUP
                                             NEXT sum = sum + member-price,
                                                  count = count + 1
                                             FINALLY: COND #( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum / count ELSE 0 ) )
                             ) ).

    " Formatierte Ausgabe mit String Templates
    rv_formatted_output = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = `Durchschnittspreise pro Fluggesellschaft:` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
      FOR ls_avg IN lt_avg_prices
      NEXT result = result && |  Fluggesellschaft { ls_avg-carrid }: { ls_avg-avg_price WIDTH = 10 ALIGN = RIGHT } EUR| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Bonus basierend auf der Leistung eines Mitarbeiters, wobei verschiedene Leistungskategorien unterschiedliche Bonusfaktoren haben. Nutzen Sie `CASE` und `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CASE`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `COND` für die Bonusberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_bonus DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_performance,
             employee_id TYPE string,
             performance_category TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             base_salary TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_employee_performance.

    METHODS calculate_bonus
      IMPORTING
        is_performance TYPE ty_employee_performance
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_bonus_amount) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_bonus IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonus.
    DATA(lv_bonus_factor) = COND p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2(
      WHEN is_performance-performance_category = 'EXCELLENT' THEN '0.15'
      WHEN is_performance-performance_category = 'GOOD'      THEN '0.10'
      WHEN is_performance-performance_category = 'AVERAGE'   THEN '0.05'
      ELSE '0.00'
    ).

    rv_bonus_amount = is_performance-base_salary * lv_bonus_factor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für jede Fluggesellschaft aus `SFLIGHTS` und filtern Sie nur die Fluggesellschaften heraus, deren Gesamtsumme einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `FILTER`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` für die Aggregation und `FILTER` für die Selektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_filtered_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_sum,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carr_sum.
    TYPES: tt_carr_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_and_filter_sums
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sums) TYPE tt_carr_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_filtered_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_and_filter_sums.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_all_sums) = VALUE tt_carr_sum(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid      = GROUP carrid
        total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                        INIT sum = 0
                        FOR member IN GROUP
                        NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) )
    ).

    rt_filtered_sums = FILTER #( lt_all_sums USING KEY primary_key WHERE total_price > iv_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte leer sein bei hohem Schwellenwert' ).

CLASS zcl_calculate_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_factorial_recursive
      IMPORTING
        iv_n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial_value.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Input must be non-negative'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_factorial = get_factorial_recursive( iv_n = iv_number ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_factorial_recursive.
    rv_result = COND i(
      WHEN iv_n = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE iv_n * get_factorial_recursive( iv_n = iv_n - 1 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_flight_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_carr_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carr_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_flight_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE tt_carr_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid       = GROUP carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den gleitenden Durchschnitt (Moving Average) der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft über die letzten N Flüge, sortiert nach Datum und Zeit.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `OFFSET` und `LINES OF` oder eine manuelle Schleife mit `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_moving_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_avg,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate      TYPE s_date,
             price       TYPE sflight-price,
             moving_avg  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_with_avg.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_moving_average
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_window_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_avg) TYPE tt_flight_with_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_moving_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_moving_average.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING, fltime ASCENDING.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-tabix.
      DATA(lv_start_index) = lv_current_index - iv_window_size + 1.
      IF lv_start_index < 1.
        lv_start_index = 1.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_window) = lt_sflights[ lv_start_index TO lv_current_index ].

      DATA(lv_sum_prices) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR ls_window_flight IN lt_window
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_window_flight-price
      ).

      DATA(lv_moving_avg) = COND sflight-price(
        WHEN lines( lt_window ) > 0 THEN lv_sum_prices / lines( lt_window )
        ELSE 0
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_with_avg(
        carrid     = ls_flight-carrid
        connid     = ls_flight-connid
        fldate     = ls_flight-fldate
        price      = ls_flight-price
        moving_avg = lv_moving_avg
      ) TO rt_flights_with_avg.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_moving_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_moving_average_small_window FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_moving_average_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_moving_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calculate_moving_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_moving_average(
      iv_carrid      = 'AA'
      iv_window_size = 3
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    " Prüfen Sie, ob der gleitende Durchschnitt korrekt berechnet wurde (Beispiel)
    IF lines( lt_result ) >= 3.
      " Annahme: Die ersten 3 Flüge von AA haben Preise 100, 200, 300
      " Der gleitende Durchschnitt für den 3. Flug wäre (100+200+300)/3 = 200
      " Dies ist ein vereinfachter Test, da SFLIGHTS-Daten variieren.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-moving_avg msg = 'Moving Average sollte berechnet werden' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_moving_average_small_window.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calculate_moving_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_moving_average(
      iv_carrid      = 'AA'
      iv_window_size = 1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) >= 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-moving_avg exp = lt_result[ 1 ]-price msg = 'Bei Fenstergröße 1 sollte MA = Preis sein' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_moving_average_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calculate_moving_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_moving_average(
      iv_carrid      = 'XX'
      iv_window_size = 3
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte leer sein für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Berechnung eines gleitenden Durchschnitts, einer komplexeren Aggregation. Es verwendet eine Kombination aus `SELECT` mit `ORDER BY`, um die Daten korrekt zu sortieren, und eine `LOOP`-Struktur, um über die Daten zu iterieren. Innerhalb der Schleife wird der `REDUCE`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) verwendet, um die Summe der Preise im aktuellen Fenster effizient zu berechnen, und `COND` für die Division durch Null-Prüfung. Dies zeigt, wie moderne ABAP-Features auch in komplexeren Algorithmen zu sauberem und effizientem Code führen.

hint: Nutzen Sie `MODIFY` mit einem internen Tabellenkonstruktor und `FOR` Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_price_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflight_updates TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND status <> 'C'.

    lt_sflight_updates = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                  ( carrid  = ls_sflight-carrid
                                    connid  = ls_sflight-connid
                                    fldate  = ls_sflight-fldate
                                    price   = ls_sflight-price * '1.10'
                                    currency = ls_sflight-currency
                                    planetype = ls_sflight-planetype
                                    seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc
                                    seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax
                                    status = ls_sflight-status ) ).

    MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflight_updates.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             new_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_seats.

CLASS zcl_sflight_seats_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflight_modify TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    " Prepare the internal table for MODIFY statement
    lt_sflight_modify = VALUE #( FOR ls_update IN it_flight_updates
                                  ( carrid = ls_update-carrid
                                    connid = ls_update-connid
                                    fldate = ls_update-fldate
                                    seatsocc = ls_update-new_seatsocc ) ).

    MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflight_modify.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sflight_status_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_sflight_status_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_status_by_occupancy.
    UPDATE sflight SET
      status = CASE WHEN seatsocc > ( seatsmax * 0.9 ) THEN 'F'
                    ELSE 'A'
               END
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             title      TYPE so_obj_des,

             obj_type   TYPE so_obj_tp,
           END OF ty_filtered_attachment.

    METHODS get_filtered_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_objtype    TYPE sibfboriid-objtype
        iv_objkey     TYPE sibfboriid-objkey

        iv_file_type  TYPE so_obj_tp

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_attachments.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query(
      i_objtype = iv_objtype
      i_objkey  = iv_objkey
    ).

    DATA(lt_raw_attachments) = lo_gos_query->get_attachment_list( ).

    rt_filtered = FILTER #( lt_raw_attachments USING KEY primary_key
                            WHERE creat_date >= iv_min_date
                              AND obj_type   = iv_file_type ).

    " Optional: Map to a simpler structure if needed
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR ls_filtered IN rt_filtered
                             ( title      = ls_filtered-obj_descr
                               created_at = ls_filtered-creat_date
                               obj_type   = ls_filtered-obj_type ) ).

CLASS zcl_gos_latest_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_latest_attachment_detail,
             title      TYPE so_obj_des,

CLASS zcl_gos_latest_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.

      i_objkey  = iv_objkey

CLASS zcl_gos_total_attachment_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_attachment_size
      IMPORTING
        iv_objtype TYPE sibfboriid-objtype
        iv_objkey  TYPE sibfboriid-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_size) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_gos_total_attachment_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_attachment_size.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query(
      i_objtype = iv_objtype
      i_objkey  = iv_objkey

    DATA(lt_raw_attachments) = lo_gos_query->get_attachment_list( ).

    rv_total_size = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR ls_attachment IN lt_raw_attachments

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Setzen Sie den Status von Flügen in SFLIGHTS auf 'D' (Delayed), wenn die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) zwischen 70% und 90% der maximalen Sitze (`seatsmax`) liegt und der aktuelle Status 'A' (Active) ist. CLASS zcl_sflight_delay_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_delayed_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_sflight_delay_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_delayed_status.
    UPDATE sflight SET
      status = 'D'
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND status = 'A'
        AND seatsocc BETWEEN ( seatsmax * 0.7 ) AND ( seatsmax * 0.9 ).
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0052' fldate = '20251203' seatsocc = 95 seatsmax = 100 status = 'A' ) ). " Should remain A

    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ]-status exp = 'A' msg = 'Flight 0051 should remain Active' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ]-status exp = 'A' msg = 'Flight 0052 should remain Active' ).

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugstatus in SFLIGHTS basierend auf einer externen Mapping-Tabelle. Wenn ein Flug in der Mapping-Tabelle gefunden wird, verwenden Sie den dort definierten neuen Status; ansonsten behalten Sie den aktuellen Status bei. Verwenden Sie eine `UPDATE` Anweisung mit einem `LEFT OUTER JOIN` auf eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE` mit `FROM itab` und `LEFT OUTER JOIN` auf eine interne Tabelle im `SET`-Teil (ABAP 7.55).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_mapped_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_map,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             new_status TYPE sflight-status,
           END OF ty_status_map.
    TYPES: tt_status_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status_map WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_status_from_map
      IMPORTING
        it_status_map TYPE tt_status_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_mapped_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_status_from_map.
    UPDATE sflight AS s
      SET status = COALESCE( m~new_status, s~status )
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN @it_status_map AS m
        ON s~carrid = m~carrid
       AND s~connid = m~connid
       AND s~fldate = m~fldate
      WHERE s~carrid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM @it_status_map ). " Optimize WHERE clause
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_with_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_with_map.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'UA'.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0060' fldate = '20251201' status = 'A' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0061' fldate = '20251202' status = 'A' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0062' fldate = '20251203' status = 'A' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_map) = VALUE zcl_sflight_mapped_update=>tt_status_map(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0060' fldate = '20251201' new_status = 'C' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0061' fldate = '20251202' new_status = 'D' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_mapped_update( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->update_status_from_map( it_status_map = lt_map ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 msg = 'All three flights should be processed (2 updated, 1 unchanged)' ).

    SELECT connid, status FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_results)
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid ORDER BY connid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-status exp = 'C' msg = 'Flight 0060 should be Cancelled' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ]-status exp = 'D' msg = 'Flight 0061 should be Delayed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ]-status exp = 'A' msg = 'Flight 0062 should remain Active' ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ermöglicht hochkomplexe und performante Massenaktualisierungen, bei denen die neuen Werte aus einer internen Tabelle stammen und bedingt zugewiesen werden können (hier mit `COALESCE`). CLASS zcl_sflight_planetype_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_planetype
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids      TYPE tt_carrid

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_sflight_planetype_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype.
    UPDATE sflight SET
      planetype = CASE WHEN seatsmax < 150 THEN 'SMALL'
                       ELSE 'LARGE'
                  END
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrids

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Datenreferenz basierend auf der Zeilenstruktur einer vorhandenen internen Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Werten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_descr_by_data` und `create data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        i_table TYPE any TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( i_table ).
        lo_line_descr  ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

        CREATE DATA r_data_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_line_descr.
        ASSIGN r_data_ref->* TO <fs_data>.

        IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Beispiel: Füllen der dynamischen Datenreferenz
          LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_component>.
            IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
              CASE ls_comp-type_descr_ref->type_kind.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
                  <fs_component> = 'Dynamic Value'.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
                  <fs_component> = 100.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num.
                  <fs_component> = '007'.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
                  <fs_component> = sy-datum.
                WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time.
                  <fs_component> = sy-uzeit.
                WHEN OTHERS.
                  " Do nothing or handle other types
              ENDCASE.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_create_data_error.
        " Handle errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Strukturen dynamisch Feld für Feld und geben Sie eine Liste der Feldnamen zurück, bei denen die Werte unterschiedlich sind.
hint: Iterieren Sie über Komponenten mit RTTI und vergleichen Sie Feldinhalte dynamisch mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_structures
      IMPORTING
        i_struct1 TYPE any
        i_struct2 TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_diff_fields) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_comp1> TYPE any,
                   <fs_comp2> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( i_struct1 ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE i_struct1 TO <fs_comp1>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE i_struct2 TO <fs_comp2>.

          IF <fs_comp1> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_comp2> IS ASSIGNED.
            IF <fs_comp1> <> <fs_comp2>.
              APPEND ls_comp-name TO r_diff_fields.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error if inputs are not structures or different types
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Vergleichsfunktionen, bei denen die Struktur zur Entwicklungszeit nicht bekannt ist.

  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_comp>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( i_template_struct ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA r_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN r_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Füllen der dynamischen Tabelle mit zwei Zeilen
          DO 2 TIMES.
            CREATE DATA REF TO i_template_struct.
            ASSIGN sy-data->* TO <fs_line>.

            LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
              IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED.
                CASE ls_comp-type_descr_ref->type_kind.
                  WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
                    <fs_comp> = |Dynamic Text { sy-index }|.
                  WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
                    <fs_comp> = sy-index * 10.
                  WHEN OTHERS.
                    " Default or specific handling
                ENDCASE.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.
            INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
          ENDDO.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_create_data_error cx_abap_invalid_table_descr.
        " Handle errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Anzahl von Spalten und Zeilen, wobei die Spaltentypen und -namen dynamisch festgelegt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_components` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_column_def.
    TYPES tt_column_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        i_column_defs TYPE tt_column_def
        i_num_rows    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_comp>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        " 1. Create components for the dynamic structure
        lt_components = VALUE #( FOR <col_def> IN i_column_defs
                                 ( name = <col_def>-name
                                   type_descr_ref = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( <col_def>-type ) ) ).

        " 2. Create dynamic structure descriptor
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_components( lt_components ).

        " 3. Create dynamic table descriptor
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        " 4. Create dynamic table data object
        CREATE DATA r_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN r_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          " 5. Fill the dynamic table with data
          DO i_num_rows TIMES.
            CREATE DATA REF TO lo_struct_descr.
            ASSIGN sy-data->* TO <fs_line>.

            LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
              IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED.
                CASE ls_comp-type_descr_ref->type_kind.
                  WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
                    <fs_comp> = |Char { sy-index }|.
                  WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
                    <fs_comp> = sy-index * 100.
                  WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
                    <fs_comp> = |String Value { sy-index }|.
                  WHEN OTHERS.
                    " Default or specific handling
                ENDCASE.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.
            INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
          ENDDO.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_create_data_error cx_abap_invalid_table_descr cx_abap_invalid_type_descr.
        " Handle errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_column_defs TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_gen=>tt_column_def.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'ID'   type = 'I' ) TO lt_column_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'TEXT' type = 'STRING' ) TO lt_column_defs.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_gen( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->generate_dynamic_table( i_column_defs = lt_column_defs i_num_rows = 3 ).
