Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle und fügen Sie jedem gefilterten Eintrag die ursprüngliche Zeilennummer (Index) hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `sy-tabix` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
        original_index TYPE i,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                   WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                     connid = flight-connid
                                     fldate = flight-fldate
                                     price = flight-price
                                     currency = flight-currency
                                     original_index = sy-tabix ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 100. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 250. <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 50. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_min_price = 150 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_result).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-original_index exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Iteration mit `WHERE`-Bedingung ist eine moderne und deklarative Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten und zu filtern. `sy-tabix` liefert innerhalb der `FOR`-Schleife den aktuellen Index des *ursprünglichen* Eintrags, was hier genutzt wird, um die ursprüngliche Position beizubehalten. Die `VALUE #-` Konstruktion ermöglicht die direkte Erzeugung der Ergebnistabelle mit den gewünschten Feldern.
keywords: sy-tabix, Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, VALUE #, Filter

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise der ersten N Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, wobei N ein gegebener Wert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `sy-tabix` als Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_summer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_n_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_summer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_first_n_flights.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
                               FOR flight IN it_sflights
                               WHERE ( sy-tabix <= iv_n_flights )
                               NEXT total_price = total_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie eine interne Tabelle so, dass nur jeder zweite Eintrag (basierend auf dem Index) einen bestimmten Wert in einem Feld erhält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `COND` und `sy-tabix % 2`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        id    TYPE i,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_item,
      ty_t_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_every_second_item
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_t_item
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_items) TYPE ty_t_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_every_second_item.
    rt_modified_items = VALUE #( FOR item IN it_items
                                 ( id = item-id
                                   value = COND string( WHEN sy-tabix MOD 2 = 0 THEN iv_new_value ELSE item-value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_items.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_table_modifier=>ty_t_item.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'Original 1' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 'Original 2' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 value = 'Original 3' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 4 value = 'Original 4' ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_modifier( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->modify_every_second_item( it_items = lt_input iv_new_value = 'Modified' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_item1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item1-value exp = 'Original 1' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_item2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item2-value exp = 'Modified' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_item3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item3-value exp = 'Original 3' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 4 INTO DATA(ls_item4).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item4-value exp = 'Modified' ).

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.

                      connid = <fs_group>-connid

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die die ersten N Einträge einer Quelltabelle enthält, wobei jeder Eintrag mit seinem ursprünglichen Index angereichert wird, aber nur, wenn der Index eine Primzahl ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `WHERE` und `sy-tabix` in Kombination mit einer Hilfsfunktion zur Primzahlprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_prime_index_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        id    TYPE i,
        value TYPE string,
        original_index TYPE i,
      END OF ty_data,
      ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_prime_indexed_first_n
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_limit       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_data) TYPE ty_t_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS is_prime
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_prime) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_prime_index_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_prime_indexed_first_n.
    rt_result_data = VALUE #( FOR item IN it_source_data
                               WHERE ( sy-tabix <= iv_limit AND is_prime( sy-tabix ) = abap_true )
                               ( id = item-id
                                 value = item-value
                                 original_index = sy-tabix ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_prime.
    IF iv_number <= 1.
      rv_is_prime = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_number = 2.
      rv_is_prime = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_number MOD 2 = 0.
      rv_is_prime = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_limit) = sqrt( iv_number ).
    DO.
      DATA(lv_divisor) = sy-index * 2 + 1.
      IF lv_divisor > lv_limit.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      IF iv_number MOD lv_divisor = 0.
        rv_is_prime = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rv_is_prime = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie alle Flüge aus einer Quelltabelle 'behalten', die nicht von der Fluggesellschaft 'UA' durchgeführt werden. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die neue Tabelle aufzubauen.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator kann verwendet werden, um eine neue Tabelle zu akkumulieren, indem unerwünschte Elemente übersprungen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_to_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS reduce_out_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier_to_exclude TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_to_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reduce_out_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight( )
                                    FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                    WHERE ( ls_flight-carrid <> iv_carrier_to_exclude )
                                    NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Hier wird er verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle zu akkumulieren, indem nur die Zeilen hinzugefügt werden, die eine bestimmte Bedingung (hier: Fluggesellschaft ist nicht 'UA') erfüllen. Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die die höchste Flugnummer (connid) für jede Fluggesellschaft (carrid) haben.
hint: Dies erfordert eine Vorverarbeitung, um die höchsten Flugnummern zu identifizieren, und dann eine Löschung basierend auf diesen Werten. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `MAX` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die zu löschenden Zeilen zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_max_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_connid_per_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_max_connid_per_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_max_connid_per_carrier TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_max_connid_per_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS delete_max_connid_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_max_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_max_connid_per_carrier.
    DATA(lt_max_connids) = VALUE tt_max_connid_per_carrier(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        max_connid = REDUCE #( INIT max_c = '' FOR flight IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT max_c = COND #( WHEN flight-connid > max_c THEN flight-connid ELSE max_c ) ) ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE line_exists( lt_max_connids[ carrid = carrid ] AND connid = lt_max_connids[ carrid = carrid ]-max_connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_max_connid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_max_connid.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_max_connid=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251202'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251202'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0100'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251203'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_max_connid( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_max_connid_per_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' ] ) ). " BA-0100 should be deleted
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Kombination von modernen ABAP-Features. Zuerst wird mit `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` eine Hilfstabelle erstellt, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die höchste Flugnummer enthält. Anschließend wird die ursprüngliche Tabelle mit `DELETE WHERE` und `LINE_EXISTS` gelöscht, indem Zeilen abgeglichen werden, die sowohl die Fluggesellschaft als auch die höchste Flugnummer aus der Hilfstabelle aufweisen. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und ausdrucksstarke Methode für komplexe Aggregations- und Löschszenarien.
keywords: DELETE, WHERE, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0100'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251202'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0200'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251203'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_by_pattern( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_flights_by_carrier_pattern( it_flights = lt_flights iv_pattern = '*A*' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CP`-Operator (Contains Pattern) in der `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht das Löschen von Zeilen basierend auf Mustervergleichen in String-Feldern. Dies ist eine flexible Methode, um Zeilen zu filtern, die bestimmte Teilstrings oder Wildcard-Muster enthalten.
keywords: DELETE, WHERE, CP, Pattern Matching, Wildcard, Internal Tables

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `FRIENDS` um einer anderen Klasse (ZCL_FRIEND_CLASS) Zugriff auf private Komponenten (Attribut und Methode) der Klasse ZCL_MAIN_CLASS zu gewähren.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FRIENDS` Deklaration in der Klassendefinition der ZCL_MAIN_CLASS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_main_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_private_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_private_attribute TYPE string VALUE 'Geheime Daten'.
    METHODS get_internal_secret RETURNING VALUE(rv_secret) TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_friend_class.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_main_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_private_data.
    rv_data = mv_private_attribute.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_internal_secret.
    rv_secret = 'Internes Geheimnis'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS access_main_class_secrets IMPORTING io_main_class TYPE REF TO zcl_main_class
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rs_secrets) TYPE REF TO string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD access_main_class_secrets.
    CREATE DATA rs_secrets TYPE string_table.
    APPEND io_main_class->mv_private_attribute TO rs_secrets->*.
    APPEND io_main_class->get_internal_secret() TO rs_secrets->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friend_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_access.
    DATA(lo_main) = NEW zcl_main_class( ).
    DATA(lo_friend) = NEW zcl_friend_class( ).
    DATA(lt_secrets) = lo_friend->access_main_class_secrets( lo_main ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_main->get_private_data() ). " Should be empty as it's private
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_secrets->* ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_secrets->*[1] exp = 'Geheime Daten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_secrets->*[2] exp = 'Internes Geheimnis' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration in `ZCL_MAIN_CLASS` erlaubt `ZCL_FRIEND_CLASS` den Zugriff auf private Attribute (`mv_private_attribute`) und Methoden (`get_internal_secret`) von `ZCL_MAIN_CLASS`, was die Kapselung kontrolliert durchbricht, wo es notwendig ist, ohne die Komponenten öffentlich zu machen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Encapsulation, Private Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine klassenbasierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn eine ungültige Eingabe (z.B. eine negative Zahl) erfolgt. Die Ausnahme soll eine Nachricht aus einer Nachrichtenklasse verwenden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, die `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt und `IF_T100_MESSAGE` implementiert. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` mit `TEXTID`.
solution:
MESSAGE-ID zmsg_abap_ai.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE if_abap_behv_message=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_positive_number IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i
                                    RAISING zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_positive_number.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Logik für positive Zahl
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_input.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    lo_processor->process_positive_number( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " No exception, so just assert something trivial
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_positive_number( -5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_invalid_input->get_text() exp = 'Negative Zahlen sind nicht erlaubt.' ). " Assuming message ZMSG_ABAP_AI 001 'Negative Zahlen sind nicht erlaubt.'
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung einer eigenen Ausnahme-Klasse, die `IF_T100_MESSAGE` implementiert, ermöglicht die Integration von Nachrichten aus dem Nachrichten-Editor (Transaktion SE91). Dies ist der moderne Weg, um Fehlermeldungen konsistent und mehrsprachig zu gestalten, anstatt hartkodierte Texte zu verwenden. `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` ist die Syntax für klassenbasierte Ausnahmen.
keywords: RAISE, EXCEPTION, Class-based Exceptions, IF_T100_MESSAGE, Error Handling

Instructions: Zeigen Sie, wie ein Interface (ZIF_DATA_PROVIDER) als `FRIENDS` einer Klasse (ZCL_DATA_STORAGE) deklariert werden kann, um allen Implementierungen des Interfaces Zugriff auf private Komponenten der Klasse zu gewähren.
hint: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration kann auch ein Interface referenzieren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_provider PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_stored_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_storage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_secret_value TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_storage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_secret_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_provider_impl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_storage TYPE REF TO zcl_data_storage.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_storage TYPE REF TO zcl_data_storage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_provider_impl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_storage = io_storage.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_stored_value.
    rv_value = mo_storage->mv_secret_value. " Accessing private member via friend interface
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_interface_friend_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_friend_access.
    DATA(lo_storage) = NEW zcl_data_storage( ).
    lo_storage->set_value( 'Interface Geheimnis' ).

    DATA(lo_provider) = NEW zcl_provider_impl( lo_storage ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_provider->zif_data_provider~get_stored_value( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Interface Geheimnis' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Indem `ZIF_DATA_PROVIDER` als `FRIENDS` von `ZCL_DATA_STORAGE` deklariert wird, erhalten alle Klassen, die `ZIF_DATA_PROVIDER` implementieren, automatisch Zugriff auf die privaten Komponenten von `ZCL_DATA_STORAGE`. Dies ist nützlich, um eine Gruppe von 'vertrauenswürdigen' Implementierungen zu definieren, die spezielle Zugriffsrechte benötigen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Interface, Object Orientation, Private Access

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `ASSERT ID` mit `FIELDS` um einen Shortdump bei einer kritischen Inkonsistenz auszulösen und relevante Feldwerte im Dump zu protokollieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSERT ID <id> FIELDS <field1> <field2> CONDITION <condition>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_critical_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_logic IMPORTING iv_value1 TYPE i iv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_logic.
    DATA(lv_sum) = iv_value1 + iv_value2.

    " Kritische Bedingung: Summe darf nicht 0 sein, wenn beide Werte positiv sind
    ASSERT ID z_abap_ai_critical " Eine frei definierbare Checkpoint-Gruppe
           FIELDS iv_value1 iv_value2 lv_sum
           CONDITION iv_value1 > 0 AND iv_value2 > 0 AND lv_sum = 0.

    " Weitere Logik...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_normal_case FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_critical_case FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_normal_case.
    DATA(lo_logic) = NEW zcl_critical_logic( ).
    lo_logic->execute_logic( iv_value1 = 5 iv_value2 = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " No shortdump expected
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_critical_case.
    DATA(lo_logic) = NEW zcl_critical_logic( ).
    " This test case is designed to trigger the ASSERT and cause a shortdump.
    " In a real unit test, one would typically avoid triggering actual shortdumps.
    " For demonstration, we simulate the condition that would lead to it.
    " To properly test ASSERT, one might need to configure checkpoint groups
    " to 'break' or 'log' instead of 'abort'.
    TRY.
        lo_logic->execute_logic( iv_value1 = 1 iv_value2 = -1 ). " This would not trigger the ASSERT
        lo_logic->execute_logic( iv_value1 = 0 iv_value2 = 0 ). " This would not trigger the ASSERT
        " A condition that would trigger the ASSERT (e.g., if sum of two positive numbers is 0, which is impossible)
        " For a realistic test, one would need a scenario where the condition *could* be true due to a bug.
        " Example: If a previous calculation error leads to iv_value1=1, iv_value2=-1, and a bug makes sum=0
        " For this example, we'll use values that would logically lead to a dump if the condition was different.
        " Let's assume a scenario where a bug could lead to iv_value1=1, iv_value2=1, and lv_sum=0
        " Since we cannot force lv_sum=0 with iv_value1=1, iv_value2=1, this test will not actually dump.
        " The purpose is to show the structure. To truly test, the condition needs to be met.
        " For a real test, one would mock the condition or ensure it's met.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assert INTO DATA(lx_assert).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Shortdump was triggered, but should be handled in production.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSERT ID` ermöglicht das Definieren von Prüfpunkten im Code, die bei Nichterfüllung einer Bedingung einen Shortdump auslösen können. Die `FIELDS` Option ist besonders nützlich, da sie die Werte der angegebenen Variablen direkt im Shortdump-Protokoll anzeigt, was die Fehleranalyse erheblich vereinfacht. Dies ist ein wichtiges Werkzeug für die Qualitätssicherung und Fehlerbehebung in kritischen Programmteilen.
keywords: ASSERT, SHORTDUMP, Debugging, Error Handling, Checkpoint Group

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Verhalten von `FRIENDS` in einer Vererbungshierarchie. Zeigen Sie, dass eine Freundschaftsbeziehung nicht vererbt wird.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Basisklasse, eine abgeleitete Klasse und eine Freundesklasse. Versuchen Sie, auf private Komponenten der Basis- und der abgeleiteten Klasse zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_class DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_base_public_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_base_private_data TYPE string VALUE 'Basis Geheimnis'.
    FRIENDS zcl_friend_of_base.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_base_public_data.
    rv_data = mv_base_private_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_derived_class DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_base_class FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_derived_public_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_derived_private_data TYPE string VALUE 'Abgeleitetes Geheimnis'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_derived_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_derived_public_data.
    rv_data = mv_derived_private_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_of_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS access_base_private IMPORTING io_base TYPE REF TO zcl_base_class
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
    METHODS access_derived_private IMPORTING io_derived TYPE REF TO zcl_derived_class
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_of_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD access_base_private.
    rv_data = io_base->mv_base_private_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD access_derived_private.
    " Dies würde einen Syntaxfehler verursachen, da ZCL_FRIEND_OF_BASE
    " kein Freund von ZCL_DERIVED_CLASS ist und somit keinen Zugriff hat.
    " rv_data = io_derived->mv_derived_private_data.
    rv_data = 'Kein Zugriff auf abgeleitete private Daten'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friend_inheritance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_inheritance.
    DATA(lo_derived) = NEW zcl_derived_class( ).
    DATA(lo_friend) = NEW zcl_friend_of_base( ).

    " Test access to base class private data via friend
    DATA(lv_base_secret) = lo_friend->access_base_private( lo_derived ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_base_secret exp = 'Basis Geheimnis' ).

    " Test access to derived class private data (should fail or return default message)
    DATA(lv_derived_secret) = lo_friend->access_derived_private( lo_derived ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_derived_secret exp = 'Kein Zugriff auf abgeleitete private Daten' ).

    " Verify public access still works
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_derived->get_base_public_data() exp = 'Basis Geheimnis' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_derived->get_derived_public_data() exp = 'Abgeleitetes Geheimnis' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, dass `FRIENDS` Beziehungen nicht vererbt werden. Obwohl `ZCL_FRIEND_OF_BASE` ein Freund von `ZCL_BASE_CLASS` ist und somit auf deren private Komponenten zugreifen kann, hat es keinen automatischen Zugriff auf die privaten Komponenten der abgeleiteten Klasse `ZCL_DERIVED_CLASS`. Jede Freundschaft muss explizit deklariert werden.
keywords: FRIENDS, Inheritance, Object Orientation, Private Access

Instructions: Lösen Sie eine Ausnahme mit einem dynamisch generierten Text aus, der Kontextinformationen enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Ihr dynamischer Text'`. Beachten Sie, dass der `TEXT` Parameter ab ABAP 7.50 verfügbar ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
                                RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = |Eingabe darf nicht leer sein. Aktueller Wert: '{ iv_input }'|.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_input = 'ERROR'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = |Kritischer Fehler bei Verarbeitung von '{ iv_input }'. Bitte prüfen Sie die Logs.|.
    ENDIF.
    " Normale Verarbeitung
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_empty_input_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_error_input_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_empty_input_exception.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_dynamic_exception_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_demo->perform_operation( '' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for empty input was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_exception->get_text() exp = 'Eingabe darf nicht leer sein. Aktueller Wert: ''' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_input_exception.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_dynamic_exception_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_demo->perform_operation( 'ERROR' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for error input was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_exception->get_text() exp = 'Kritischer Fehler bei Verarbeitung von ''ERROR''. Bitte prüfen Sie die Logs.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_input.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_dynamic_exception_demo( ).
    lo_demo->perform_operation( 'Valid Data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.50 können klassenbasierte Ausnahmen wie `CX_STATIC_CHECK` direkt mit einem dynamischen Text über den `TEXT` Parameter ausgelöst werden. Dies ermöglicht es, kontextspezifische Informationen direkt in die Fehlermeldung einzubetten, ohne eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse mit `IF_T100_MESSAGE` definieren zu müssen, was den Code vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: RAISE, EXCEPTION, Dynamic Text, String Templates, Error Handling, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse (ZCL_MULTI_FRIENDS) mit privaten Komponenten und deklarieren Sie zwei verschiedene Klassen (ZCL_FRIEND_A, ZCL_FRIEND_B) als ihre Freunde.
hint: Mehrere `FRIENDS` Deklarationen sind in der Klassendefinition möglich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_friends DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_public_info RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_secret_data TYPE string VALUE 'Top Secret'.
    METHODS get_hidden_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_friend_a.
    FRIENDS zcl_friend_b.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_friends IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_info.
    rv_info = 'Öffentliche Information'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_hidden_value.
    rv_value = 'Versteckter Wert'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS reveal_secret IMPORTING io_target TYPE REF TO zcl_multi_friends
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_secret) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reveal_secret.
    rv_secret = io_target->mv_secret_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_hidden_info IMPORTING io_target TYPE REF TO zcl_multi_friends
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_b IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_info = io_target->get_hidden_value( ).

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiple_friends FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_friends.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_multi_friends( ).
    DATA(lo_friend_a) = NEW zcl_friend_a( ).
    DATA(lo_friend_b) = NEW zcl_friend_b( ).

    DATA(lv_secret_a) = lo_friend_a->reveal_secret( lo_target ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_secret_a exp = 'Top Secret' ).

    DATA(lv_info_b) = lo_friend_b->get_hidden_info( lo_target ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info_b exp = 'Versteckter Wert' ).

    " Verify public access still works
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_target->get_public_info() exp = 'Öffentliche Information' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine Klasse kann mehrere Freundschaftsbeziehungen zu anderen Klassen oder Interfaces unterhalten. Jede `FRIENDS` Deklaration gewährt der genannten Klasse oder den Implementierungen des Interfaces Zugriff auf alle privaten und geschützten Komponenten der deklarierenden Klasse. Dies ermöglicht eine feingranulare Kontrolle über die Kapselung.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Multiple Friends, Private Access

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Fangen spezifischer Ausnahmen in einer `TRY...CATCH` Blockstruktur unter Verwendung von `INTO DATA(lx_...)`.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CATCH` Blöcke und die Inline-Deklaration `INTO DATA(lx_exception_variable)`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_specific_error_a DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_specific_error_a IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_specific_error_b DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_specific_error_b IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_error IMPORTING iv_error_type TYPE i
                            RAISING zcx_specific_error_a zcx_specific_error_b.
    METHODS handle_errors IMPORTING iv_error_type TYPE i
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_error.
    IF iv_error_type = 1.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_specific_error_a.
    ELSEIF iv_error_type = 2.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_specific_error_b.
    ELSE.
      " No error
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_errors.
    TRY.
        trigger_error( iv_error_type ).
        rv_message = 'Kein Fehler aufgetreten.'.
      CATCH zcx_specific_error_a INTO DATA(lx_error_a).
        rv_message = 'Fehler A gefangen: ' && lx_error_a->get_text( ).
      CATCH zcx_specific_error_b INTO DATA(lx_error_b).
        rv_message = 'Fehler B gefangen: ' && lx_error_b->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_error).
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Fehler gefangen: ' && lx_other_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH` Struktur mit mehreren `CATCH` Blöcken ermöglicht eine differenzierte Fehlerbehandlung basierend auf dem Typ der ausgelösten Ausnahme. Die Inline-Deklaration `INTO DATA(lx_...)` ist eine moderne ABAP-Syntax (ab 7.40), die die Deklaration der Ausnahme-Referenz direkt im `CATCH`-Statement erlaubt, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine wiederaufnehmbare (resumable) Ausnahme auslöst und zeigen Sie, wie diese gefangen und die Ausführung fortgesetzt werden kann.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Ausnahme-Klasse mit `RESUMABLE` und verwenden Sie `RESUME` im `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resumable_warning DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check RESUMABLE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE if_abap_behv_message=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resumable_warning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

MESSAGE-ID zmsg_abap_ai.

CLASS zcl_resumable_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
                           RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
                           RAISING zcx_resumable_warning.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resumable_warning
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_resumable_warning=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = |Verarbeitung erfolgreich für Wert { iv_value }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_resumable_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_resumable_warning.
    METHODS test_no_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_exception.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_resumable_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_final_result) = 'Initial'.
    TRY.
        lv_final_result = lo_demo->process_data( -10 ).
      CATCH RESUMABLE zcx_resumable_warning INTO DATA(lx_warning).
        " Log the warning, but continue processing
        lv_final_result = |Warnung gefangen: { lx_warning->get_text() }. Fortsetzung der Verarbeitung.|.
        RESUME.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_result exp = 'Verarbeitung erfolgreich für Wert -10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_exception.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_resumable_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_demo->process_data( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Verarbeitung erfolgreich für Wert 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahmen (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglichen es, auf eine Ausnahme zu reagieren, ohne den aktuellen Verarbeitungsblock sofort zu verlassen. Nach dem Fangen der Ausnahme im `CATCH RESUMABLE`-Block kann mit `RESUME` die Ausführung an der Stelle fortgesetzt werden, an der die Ausnahme ausgelöst wurde. Dies ist ideal für Warnungen oder nicht-kritische Fehler, die protokolliert, aber die weitere Programmausführung nicht unterbrechen sollen.
keywords: RAISE, RESUMABLE, EXCEPTION, CATCH RESUMABLE, Error Handling, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse (ZCL_DATA_CONTAINER) mit einem privaten Attribut und einer Methode. Deklarieren Sie eine lokale Klasse innerhalb einer Methode als `FRIENDS`, um dieser lokalen Klasse Zugriff auf die privaten Komponenten zu ermöglichen.
hint: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration kann auch eine lokale Klasse referenzieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_with_local_friend RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_internal_state TYPE string VALUE 'Container State'.
    METHODS get_internal_state RETURNING VALUE(rv_state) TYPE string.
    FRIENDS lc_local_friend.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_internal_state.
    rv_state = mv_internal_state.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_with_local_friend.
    CLASS lc_local_friend DEFINITION FOR TESTING.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS access_container IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO zcl_data_container
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lc_local_friend IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD access_container.
        rv_data = io_container->mv_internal_state && ' - ' && io_container->get_internal_state( ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_local_friend) = NEW lc_local_friend( ).
    rv_result = lo_local_friend->access_container( me ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_local_friend_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_local_friend_access.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW zcl_data_container( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_container->process_with_local_friend( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Container State - Container State' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, dass auch lokale Klassen, die innerhalb einer Methode definiert sind, als `FRIENDS` einer globalen Klasse deklariert werden können. Dies ermöglicht es, temporäre Hilfsklassen mit speziellen Zugriffsrechten zu erstellen, die nur im Kontext der Methode existieren, in der sie definiert sind. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik zur Strukturierung von Code und zur Kontrolle des Zugriffs.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Local Class, Private Access, Nested Class

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_no_data->get_text() exp = 'Keine Flugdaten für den angegebenen Carrier gefunden.' ). " Assuming message ZMSG_ABAP_AI 002 'Keine Flugdaten für den angegebenen Carrier gefunden.'

Es ist eine Best Practice, Ausnahmen auszulösen, wenn erwartete Daten nicht gefunden werden, anstatt leere Tabellen zurückzugeben und die Fehlerbehandlung dem Aufrufer zu überlassen. Dies macht den Code robuster und die Fehlerursache klarer. Die Verwendung von `IF_T100_MESSAGE` für die Ausnahme ermöglicht standardisierte Fehlermeldungen.
keywords: RAISE, EXCEPTION, SFLIGHT, Database Access, Error Handling, IF_T100_MESSAGE

CLASS zcl_for_itab_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE c LENGTH 3,
             connid   TYPE n LENGTH 4,

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE <result> FOR <wa> IN <itab> NEXT <result> = <expression>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE c LENGTH 3,
             connid   TYPE n LENGTH 4,
             fldate   TYPE d,
             price    TYPE p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2,
             currency TYPE c LENGTH 5,
             cityfrom TYPE c LENGTH 20,
             cityto   TYPE c LENGTH 20,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( 0 ) FOR ls_flight IN it_flights NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Byte-String, der UTF-8-kodierten Text enthält, in die interne System-Codepage (UTF-16BE auf modernen ABAP-Systemen) unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_conv_in_ce`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create` zur Erstellung des Konverters und `read` zur Konvertierung. Simulieren Sie einen UTF-8 Byte-String mit `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_system IMPORTING iv_utf8_xstring TYPE xstring RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_system.
    DATA: lo_conv TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          codepage = 'UTF-8'
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>endian_little " Annahme: UTF-8 ist Little Endian kodiert
        ).
        lo_conv->write( iv_utf8_xstring ).
        lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_string ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder Exception weiterleiten
        rv_string = 'ERROR: ' && lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_convert_utf8 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_utf8.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_conversion( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hallo Welt! ÄÖÜäöüß'.

    " Simulate UTF-8 byte string
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source      = lv_original_string
      codepage    = 'UTF-8'
      endian      = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>endian_little
    ).

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_system( lv_utf8_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_string exp = lv_original_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` ist die zentrale Klasse für die Konvertierung von externen Byte-Strings (z.B. aus Dateien oder Netzwerkstreams) in die interne ABAP-Zeichenkodierung und umgekehrt. Sie ermöglicht die präzise Steuerung von Codepage und Endianness, was für die Interoperabilität mit externen Systemen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_in_ce, Codepage Conversion, XSTRING, STRING, UTF-8, Endianness

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Flugtabelle nach Flügen, die nach 'NEW YORK' gehen, und extrahieren Sie dann die Flugnummern (connid) der verbleibenden Flüge in einer einzigen Ausdruckskette.

CLASS zcl_chain_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE c LENGTH 3,

CLASS zcl_chain_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '350.00' currency = 'USD' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LOS ANGELES' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250103' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )

Instructions: Konkatenieren Sie alle Flugnummern (connid) aus einer internen Tabelle zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem initialen leeren String und dem Verkettungsoperator `&&`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE c LENGTH 3,
             connid   TYPE n LENGTH 4,
             fldate   TYPE d,
             price    TYPE p LENGTH 11 DECIMALS 2,
             currency TYPE c LENGTH 5,
             cityfrom TYPE c LENGTH 20,
             cityto   TYPE c LENGTH 20,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_connids IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_connids.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_flight-connid ELSE s && ',' && ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_concatenate_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_string_concat=>tt_flight_data #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LOS ANGELES' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_connids( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0400,0017,0050' ).

    " Test with empty table
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_string_concat=>tt_flight_data #( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_connids( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_empty_result exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal, um eine Liste von Werten zu einem einzelnen Ergebnis zu aggregieren. In diesem Fall wird er verwendet, um alle Flugnummern aus einer internen Tabelle effizient zu einem kommagetrennten String zu verbinden, ohne explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Bedingungen außerhalb des Ausdrucks.
keywords: REDUCE, String Processing, Internal Tables, Concatenation, Functional Programming, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit zwei Spalten ('FIELD1', 'FIELD2') und fügen Sie zwei Zeilen hinzu, wobei die Feldwerte dynamisch zugewiesen werden. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create_by_data` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create_by_data` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA` und `ASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  LIKE LINE OF lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'FIELD1'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'FIELD2'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_int4( ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Add first row
    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_line>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_field1>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_field2>).
    IF <fs_field1> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_field1> = 'Value A'. ENDIF.
    IF <fs_field2> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_field2> = 100. ENDIF.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Add second row
    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <fs_line>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field1>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field2>.
    IF <fs_field1> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_field1> = 'Value B'. ENDIF.
    IF <fs_field2> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_field2> = 200. ENDIF.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_create( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <ls_dynamic_line> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_field1>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_field2>).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_field1> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field1> exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_field2> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field2> exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA` und Field-Symbols ist der moderne Weg, dies in ABAP zu erreichen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field-Symbols, CREATE DATA, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie das aktuelle Systemdatum und die Systemzeit und formatieren Sie diese in einem String unter Verwendung von String Templates und der Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET TIME STAMP FIELD` und `cl_abap_tstmp=>move_tstmp_to_char` oder direkte Formatierung in String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_time_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_timestamp RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_ts) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_time_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_timestamp.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD DATA(lv_timestamp).

    " Option 1: Using cl_abap_tstmp (more control over format)
    DATA(lv_date_char) TYPE d.
    DATA(lv_time_char) TYPE t.
    cl_abap_tstmp=>move_tstmp_to_char(
      EXPORTING
        tstmp_in = lv_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        date_out = lv_date_char
        time_out = lv_time_char
    ).
    rv_formatted_ts = |Datum: { lv_date_char DATE = USER } Zeit: { lv_time_char TIME = USER }|.

    " Option 2: Direct formatting in String Template (simpler for default formats)
    " rv_formatted_ts = |Aktueller Zeitpunkt: { lv_timestamp TIMESTAMP = ISO }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_timestamp( ).

    " Assert that the string contains 'Datum' and 'Zeit' and has a plausible length
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Datum' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Zeit' ).

Instructions: Führen Sie einen INNER JOIN zwischen den Tabellen `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR` durch, um Flugdaten zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft abzurufen. Verwenden Sie Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... INNER JOIN ... ON ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_inner_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT s~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           s~connid,
           s~fldate
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_inner_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inner_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_inner_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No flight data found for AA' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Incorrect carrier ID' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrname msg = 'Carrier name should not be initial' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `INNER JOIN` in Open SQL mit Inline-Deklarationen (`INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) und Hostvariablen (`@iv_carrid`) ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen ABAP-Datenbankzugriff. Es reduziert Boilerplate-Code, verbessert die Lesbarkeit und nutzt die Leistungsfähigkeit der Datenbank.
keywords: JOINS, Open SQL, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHT, SCARR

Instructions: Rufen Sie alle Fluggesellschaften ab und, falls vorhanden, die Flugdaten für eine bestimmte Verbindung. Zeigen Sie auch Fluggesellschaften an, die keine Flüge für diese Verbindung haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und beachten Sie die Platzierung der `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_left_outer_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_flight,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_carr_flight.
    TYPES tt_carr_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carr_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carr_flight) TYPE tt_carr_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_left_outer_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carr_flight_data.
    SELECT c~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           s~connid,
           s~fldate
      FROM scarr AS c
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sflight AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
                                   AND s~connid = @iv_connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_carr_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_left_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_outer_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_left_outer_join( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_cut->get_carr_flight_data( iv_connid = '0017' ). " A common connection ID for AA
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_data msg = 'No data found' ).
    DATA(lv_initial_connid_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_data) WHERE connid IS INITIAL.
      lv_initial_connid_count = lv_initial_connid_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_initial_connid_count exp = 0 msg = 'Expected some carriers without this connection' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LEFT OUTER JOIN` ist entscheidend, wenn Sie alle Einträge der linken Tabelle (hier `SCARR`) beibehalten möchten, auch wenn keine passenden Einträge in der rechten Tabelle (`SFLIGHT`) gefunden werden. Die Bedingung für `SFLIGHT` (`s~connid = @iv_connid`) muss in der `ON`-Klausel stehen, um das gewünschte Verhalten zu erzielen; eine `WHERE`-Klausel würde die Ergebnisse filtern und den Effekt des `LEFT OUTER JOIN` aufheben.
keywords: JOINS, LEFT OUTER JOIN, Open SQL, SFLIGHT, SCARR

Instructions: Rufen Sie Flugdaten, Fluggesellschaftsnamen und Währungscodes ab. Fügen Sie eine Spalte hinzu, die den Status des Flugpreises basierend auf einem Schwellenwert anzeigt, unter Verwendung einer `CASE`-Expression direkt im `SELECT`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie mehrere `INNER JOIN`s und eine `CASE`-Expression im `SELECT`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_multi_join_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname   TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             currency   TYPE sflight-currency,
             price_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_detailed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price DEFAULT 500
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_multi_join_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_detailed_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           s~connid,
           s~fldate,
           s~price,
           s~currency,
           CASE WHEN s~price > @iv_price_threshold THEN 'Expensive'
                ELSE 'Standard'
           END AS price_status
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_details
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_multi_join_case FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_join_case.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_multi_join_case( ).
    DATA(lt_details) = lo_cut->get_detailed_flights( iv_price_threshold = 300 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_details msg = 'No detailed flight data found' ).
    DATA(lv_expensive_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_standard_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_details INTO DATA(ls_detail).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_detail-carrname msg = 'Carrier name should not be initial' ).
      IF ls_detail-price_status = 'Expensive'.
        lv_expensive_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_detail-price_status = 'Standard'.
        lv_standard_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_expensive_found msg = 'Expected some expensive flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_standard_found msg = 'Expected some standard flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von modernem Open SQL durch die Kombination mehrerer `INNER JOIN`s mit einer `CASE`-Expression direkt im `SELECT`-Statement. Dies ermöglicht die Datenaggregation und -transformation direkt auf der Datenbankebene, was die Performance verbessert und den ABAP-Code vereinfacht.
keywords: JOINS, CASE, Open SQL, SFLIGHT, SCARR

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von `SFLIGHT` und `SBOOK` (Buchungen) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und zeigen Sie sowohl Flug- als auch Buchungsdetails an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UNION ALL` um die Ergebnisse von zwei `SELECT`-Statements zu kombinieren, wobei jedes `SELECT` einen `JOIN` enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_data,
             type     TYPE char1, " 'F' for Flight, 'B' for Booking
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             detail   TYPE string, " Flight price or Booking customer
           END OF ty_combined_data.
    TYPES tt_combined_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_data) TYPE tt_combined_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_data.
    SELECT 'F' AS type,
           s~carrid,
           s~connid,
           s~fldate,
           CAST( s~price AS abap_dec_prec31 ) AS detail " Cast price to string or compatible type
      FROM sflight AS s
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'B' AS type,
           b~carrid,
           b~connid,
           b~fldate,
           b~custname AS detail
      FROM sbook AS b
      WHERE b~carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_combined_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_union_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_join( ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->get_combined_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_combined msg = 'No combined data found for AA' ).
    DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_booking_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_combined INTO DATA(ls_combined).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_combined-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Incorrect carrier ID' ).
      IF ls_combined-type = 'F'.
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_combined-type = 'B'.
        lv_booking_count = lv_booking_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'Expected some flight entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_booking_count exp = 0 msg = 'Expected some booking entries' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNION ALL` in Open SQL ermöglicht die effiziente Kombination von Ergebnismengen aus mehreren `SELECT`-Statements. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um heterogene Daten aus verschiedenen Tabellen in einer einzigen Ergebnisstruktur zu präsentieren, ohne die Performance durch komplexe Joins zu beeinträchtigen.
keywords: JOINS, UNION ALL, Open SQL, SFLIGHT, SBOOK

Instructions: Rufen Sie Flugdaten ab und fügen Sie den Namen der Fluggesellschaft hinzu, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die in einer bestimmten Liste enthalten sind. Verwenden Sie einen `INNER JOIN` mit einer `IN`-Klausel.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, die eine `IN`-Klausel für die linke Tabelle verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_join_in_clause DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carr,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_carr.
    TYPES tt_flight_carr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_carr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_join_in_clause IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carriers.
    IF it_carrids IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT s~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           s~connid,
           s~fldate
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid IN @it_carrids
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_join_in_clause FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_in_clause.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_join_in_clause( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE sflight_carrid_tt( ( 'AA' ) ( 'LH' ) ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carriers( it_carrids = lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'No flights found for specified carriers' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' )
        msg = 'Flight from unexpected carrier found' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrname msg = 'Carrier name should not be initial' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination eines `INNER JOIN` mit einer `IN`-Klausel in der `WHERE`-Bedingung ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Daten aus verknüpften Tabellen basierend auf einer dynamischen Liste von Werten zu filtern. Dies vermeidet die Notwendigkeit, separate `SELECT`s oder `FOR ALL ENTRIES` zu verwenden, was zu besserer Performance und lesbarerem Code führt.
keywords: JOINS, Open SQL, IN clause, SFLIGHT, SCARR

Instructions: Rufen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Monat ab, zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `COUNT` in Kombination mit einem `INNER JOIN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INNER JOIN`, `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen wie `COUNT` im `SELECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_group_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_per_month,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             year_month TYPE char6,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count_per_month.
    TYPES tt_flight_count_per_month TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_per_month WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count_per_month.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_group_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    SELECT s~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           SUBSTRING( s~fldate, 1, 6 ) AS year_month,
           COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname, SUBSTRING( s~fldate, 1, 6 )
      ORDER BY s~carrid, year_month
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_group_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_group_join( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_counts msg = 'No flight counts found' ).
    LOOP AT lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_count-carrname msg = 'Carrier name should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_count-year_month msg = 'Year month should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_count-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'Flight count should be greater than 0' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination von `INNER JOIN` mit `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen direkt in Open SQL. Die Verwendung von `SUBSTRING` innerhalb des `SELECT` und `GROUP BY` ist eine moderne Möglichkeit, Daten auf der Datenbankebene zu transformieren und zu aggregieren, was die Datenübertragung und die ABAP-Verarbeitung reduziert und die Performance optimiert.
keywords: JOINS, GROUP BY, COUNT, Open SQL, SFLIGHT, SCARR
