Instructions: Führen Sie einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SBOOK` durch, um alle Flüge und deren Buchungsdetails abzurufen. Wenn ein Flug keine Buchungen hat, sollen die Buchungsfelder leer sein. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse nach Flügen, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel für die linke Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_left_join_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             custname TYPE sbook-custname,
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    TYPES tt_flight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_bookings
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_bookings) TYPE tt_flight_booking.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_left_join_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_bookings.
    SELECT s~carrid,
           s~connid,
           s~fldate,
           b~bookid,
           b~custname
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid
                                 AND s~connid = b~connid
                                 AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      WHERE s~fldate >= @iv_min_fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_bookings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_left_join_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_join_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_left_join_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_min_date) = sy-datum - 365. " Flights from last year until now
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_bookings( iv_min_fldate = lv_min_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_results msg = 'No flight/booking data found' ).
    DATA(lv_flights_only_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_flights_with_bookings_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_result-fldate >= lv_min_date ) msg = 'Flight date out of range' ).
      IF ls_result-bookid IS INITIAL.
        lv_flights_only_count = lv_flights_only_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_flights_with_bookings_count = lv_flights_with_bookings_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_flights_only_count exp = 0 msg = 'Expected some flights without bookings' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_flights_with_bookings_count exp = 0 msg = 'Expected some flights with bookings' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `LEFT OUTER JOIN`, um alle Flüge beizubehalten und optional Buchungsdetails hinzuzufügen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel wird auf die linke Tabelle (`SFLIGHT`) angewendet, um die Flüge vor dem Join zu filtern, was die Performance verbessert. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, relationale Daten abzufragen.
keywords: JOINS, LEFT OUTER JOIN, Open SQL, SFLIGHT, SBOOK, Filtering

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und aktualisieren Sie den Preis für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' um 10%.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` oder `LOOP AT ... REFERENCE INTO DATA(wa)` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices.
    rt_updated_flights = it_flights.
    LOOP AT rt_updated_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = iv_carrier.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_price_updater=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_price_updater( ).
    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_updater->update_prices( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_percentage = '10' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'Price for LH flight 1 should be updated' ).
    READ TABLE lt_updated ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Price for AA flight should not be updated' ).
    READ TABLE lt_updated ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '165.00' msg = 'Price for LH flight 2 should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ist die performanteste Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten, da keine Daten kopiert werden. Die `WHERE`-Klausel im `LOOP` ermöglicht eine effiziente Filterung direkt während der Iteration, ohne vorherige separate Filterung.
keywords: LOOP, Internal Table, Field-Symbol, WHERE, Update

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die von 'FRANKFURT' nach 'NEW YORK' gehen und geben Sie deren Flugnummern aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR ... IN ...` Iterationsanweisung mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_flights_by_route
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_city_from TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_city_to   TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flights_by_route.
    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                          WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_city_from AND cityto = iv_city_to )
                          ( flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_finder=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'. <fs_flight>-cityto = 'NEW YORK'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'LONDON'. <fs_flight>-cityto = 'NEW YORK'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'. <fs_flight>-cityto = 'NEW YORK'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'.

    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_flight_finder( ).
    DATA(lt_found_connids) = lo_finder->find_flights_by_route( it_flights = lt_flights iv_city_from = 'FRANKFURT' iv_city_to = 'NEW YORK' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_found_connids ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc msg = 'No error expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_found_connids[ 1 ] exp = '0400' msg = 'First flight ID incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_found_connids[ 2 ] exp = '0401' msg = 'Second flight ID incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR ... IN ...` Iterationsanweisung in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht die deklarative und kompakte Erstellung neuer interner Tabellen basierend auf Filterkriterien. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`-Schleifen mit `APPEND`.
keywords: FOR, Internal Table, Iteration Expression, WHERE, Filtering

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref).
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR member IN group_ref
                                 NEXT c = c + 1 ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_ref->*-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have 3 groups' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 3 msg = 'LH should have 3 flights' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'AA should have 1 flight' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'BA' INTO DATA(ls_ba_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ba_group-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'BA should have 1 flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke ABAP 7.50+ Funktion, die es ermöglicht, Daten in internen Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` können Aggregationen für jede Gruppe effizient durchgeführt werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Table, Aggregation, REDUCE

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie oft das Wort 'SAP' (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorierend) in einem gegebenen Text vorkommt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit der Option `IGNORING CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_substring_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_substring_occurrences.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_substring IN SECTION LENGTH OF iv_text
         IGNORING CASE
         RESULTS DATA(lt_results).
    rv_count = lines( lt_results ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_substring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_substring.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_string_counter( ).

    DATA(lv_count1) = lo_counter->count_substring_occurrences( iv_text = 'SAP ist toll. sap ist super. Mein SAP System.' iv_substring = 'SAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count1 exp = 3 msg = 'Should find 3 occurrences' ).

    DATA(lv_count2) = lo_counter->count_substring_occurrences( iv_text = 'Kein Treffer hier.' iv_substring = 'SAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count2 exp = 0 msg = 'Should find 0 occurrences' ).

    DATA(lv_count3) = lo_counter->count_substring_occurrences( iv_text = 'SAPSAP' iv_substring = 'SAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count3 exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 overlapping occurrences' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` ist die moderne und effiziente Methode, um alle Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem String zu finden. Die Option `IGNORING CASE` vereinfacht die Suche ohne manuelle Konvertierung der Groß-/Kleinschreibung. Instructions: Finden Sie alle gültigen E-Mail-Adressen in einem gegebenen Text unter Verwendung eines regulären Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem passenden Regex-Muster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA(lv_regex) = ` [A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,} `.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_text
         RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_emails = VALUE #( FOR match IN lt_matches
                         ( substring( val = iv_text off = match-offset len = match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_emails FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_emails.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_email_extractor( ).

    DATA(lv_text1) = 'Kontaktieren Sie uns unter info@example.com oder support@domain.co.uk. Ungültig: test@.com'.
    DATA(lt_emails1) = lo_extractor->extract_emails( lv_text1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_emails1 ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 emails' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails1[ 1 ] exp = 'info@example.com' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails1[ 2 ] exp = 'support@domain.co.uk' ).

    DATA(lv_text2) = 'Keine E-Mails hier.' .
    DATA(lt_emails2) = lo_extractor->extract_emails( lv_text2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_emails2 ) exp = 0 msg = 'Should find 0 emails' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` ist das Werkzeug der Wahl für komplexe Mustererkennung in Strings. Es ermöglicht die Extraktion von Informationen, die mit einfachen String-Operationen schwer zu handhaben wären. Die Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und `substring` ist eine moderne Art, die gefundenen Treffer zu verarbeiten.
keywords: FIND, REGEX, String, Pattern Matching, Email

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights` Tabelle, um nur Flüge mit einer Kapazität von mehr als 200 Passagieren zu erhalten, und speichern Sie diese in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer `FOR`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_capacity.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE seatsmax > iv_min_capacity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 250 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 180 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax = 300 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_capacity( it_flights = lt_flights iv_min_capacity = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine ABAP 7.40+ Funktion, die eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung filtert und eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Zeilen zurückgibt. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Methode, um Daten zu filtern, ohne eine explizite `LOOP`-Schleife schreiben zu müssen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, Filtering, Operator

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise in `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife über die interne Tabelle und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                           FOR flight IN it_flights
                                           WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                           NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = '250.00' msg = 'Total price for LH incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = '200.00' msg = 'Total price for AA incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_total_non_existent) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_non_existent exp = '0.00' msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiger Reduktionsoperator (ABAP 7.40+), der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem eine Schleife über die Elemente ausgeführt und ein Akkumulator aktualisiert wird. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` bietet es eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Möglichkeit zur Aggregation von Daten.
keywords: REDUCE, LOOP, Aggregation, Internal Table, FOR

Instructions: Suchen Sie in der Tabelle `sflights` nach einer Sequenz von zwei Flügen, die beide von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und geben Sie die Startzeile der Sequenz zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND IN TABLE` mit der Option `MATCH OFFSET` und `MATCH LENGTH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sequence_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_flight_sequence
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_city_from TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_start_line) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sequence_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_sequence.
    DATA: lt_pattern TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( cityfrom = iv_city_from ) TO lt_pattern.
    APPEND VALUE #( cityfrom = iv_city_from ) TO lt_pattern.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF TABLE lt_pattern IN TABLE it_flights
         MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_start_line = lv_offset + 1. " Convert 0-based offset to 1-based line number
    ELSE.
      rv_start_line = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_sequence FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_sequence.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_sequence_finder=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'LONDON' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0200' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_flight_sequence_finder( ).

    DATA(lv_start_line1) = lo_finder->find_flight_sequence( it_flights = lt_flights iv_city_from = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_start_line1 exp = 3 msg = 'Sequence should start at line 3' ).

    DATA(lv_start_line2) = lo_finder->find_flight_sequence( it_flights = lt_flights iv_city_from = 'PARIS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_start_line2 exp = 0 msg = 'No sequence expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FIND IN TABLE` ist eine spezielle Anweisung, um eine Sequenz von Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle zu finden, die einem bestimmten Muster entspricht. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen die relative Position von Datenpunkten wichtig ist. Die Rückgabe von `MATCH OFFSET` ermöglicht die genaue Lokalisierung des Fundes.
keywords: FIND, Internal Table, Sequence, Pattern, Offset

Instructions: Verknüpfen Sie die `sflights` Tabelle mit der `scarr` Tabelle, um für jeden Flug den Namen der Fluggesellschaft anzuzeigen. Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Schleifen.
hint: Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Schleifen mit `WHERE`-Bedingungen, um eine Join-Operation zu simulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_joiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_joined_flight.
    TYPES tt_joined_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_joined_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS join_flights_with_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carriers TYPE tt_scarr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_joined_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_joiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_flights_with_carriers.
    rt_joined_data = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                               FOR carrier IN it_carriers WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid )
                               ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
                                 carrname = carrier-carrname,
                                 connid   = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_join_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_joiner=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ) TO lt_flights. " Non-existent carrier

    DATA: lt_carriers TYPE zcl_flight_joiner=>tt_scarr.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' ) TO lt_carriers.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' ) TO lt_carriers.

    DATA(lo_joiner) = NEW zcl_flight_joiner( ).
    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_joiner->join_flights_with_carriers( it_flights = lt_flights it_carriers = lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should join 2 flights' ).

    READ TABLE lt_joined WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_flight-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' msg = 'LH carrier name incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_joined WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_flight-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' msg = 'AA carrier name incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verschachtelte `FOR`-Schleifen innerhalb eines `VALUE #(...)` Konstrukts (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglichen eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Simulation von Join-Operationen auf internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`-Schleifen mit `READ TABLE` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: FOR, LOOP, Nested Loop, Internal Table, Join, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern von `sflights` enthält, deren Fluggesellschaft 'UA' ist, unter Verwendung einer Iterationsanweisung und `COLLECT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung und `COLLECT` in der Zielstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_collected_connid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_collected_connid.
    TYPES tt_collected_connid TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_collected_connid WITH UNIQUE KEY connid.

    METHODS collect_ua_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_collected_connids) TYPE tt_collected_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_ua_flights.
    rt_collected_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                    WHERE ( carrid = 'UA' )
                                    ( connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_collect_ua_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_collect_ua_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_collector=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0018' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_collector) = NEW zcl_flight_collector( ).
    DATA(lt_collected) = lo_collector->collect_ua_flights( it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_collected ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should collect 2 UA flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_collected[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_collected[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0018' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `COLLECT` hier nicht direkt im `FOR`-Ausdruck verwendet wird (da `VALUE #` eine neue Tabelle erzeugt), demonstriert das Beispiel die moderne Art, eine gefilterte Liste von Werten zu erzeugen. Wenn die Zieltabelle eine `COLLECT`-Semantik hätte (z.B. eine Standardtabelle mit einem `COLLECT` in einer Schleife), würde dies die Aggregation von Zeilen mit gleichen Schlüsseln ermöglichen. Hier wird `VALUE #` mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` verwendet, um eine gefilterte Liste zu erstellen, was eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`-Schleifen mit `APPEND` ist.
keywords: FOR, Internal Table, Iteration Expression, WHERE, COLLECT (conceptual), VALUE

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einem gegebenen Text nach dem ersten Vorkommen des Wortes 'ABAP' und geben Sie dessen Position zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` mit der Option `OFFSET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_first_abap
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_offset) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_abap.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF 'ABAP' IN iv_text MATCH OFFSET rv_offset.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_offset = -1. " Indicate not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_first_abap FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_first_abap.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_abap_finder( ).

    DATA(lv_offset1) = lo_finder->find_first_abap( 'Das ist ein ABAP Programm.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_offset1 exp = 12 msg = 'Should find ABAP at offset 12' ).

    DATA(lv_offset2) = lo_finder->find_first_abap( 'Kein Treffer hier.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_offset2 exp = -1 msg = 'Should not find ABAP' ).

    DATA(lv_offset3) = lo_finder->find_first_abap( 'ABAP ist super.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_offset3 exp = 0 msg = 'Should find ABAP at offset 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF` ist die direkte und effiziente Methode, um das erste Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem String zu lokalisieren. Die Rückgabe des `MATCH OFFSET` ermöglicht die genaue Bestimmung der Startposition des gefundenen Teilstrings. Dies ist eine grundlegende, aber wichtige String-Operation.
keywords: FIND, String, Offset, First Occurrence

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen des Wortes 'alt' durch 'neu' in einem gegebenen Text, wobei die Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignoriert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit `IGNORING CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_all_ignoring_case
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_old_value TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_all_ignoring_case.
    rv_result_text = iv_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_value IN rv_result_text
            IGNORING CASE
            WITH iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_all.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_string_replacer( ).

    DATA(lv_text1) = 'Das ist ein alter Text. Ein ALTer Text.' .
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_replacer->replace_all_ignoring_case( iv_text = lv_text1 iv_old_value = 'alt' iv_new_value = 'neu' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Das ist ein neuer Text. Ein NEUer Text.' msg = 'All occurrences should be replaced' ).

    DATA(lv_text2) = 'Keine Ersetzung hier.' .
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_replacer->replace_all_ignoring_case( iv_text = lv_text2 iv_old_value = 'xyz' iv_new_value = 'abc' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 'Keine Ersetzung hier.' msg = 'No replacement should occur' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` ist die moderne und effiziente Methode, um alle Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem String zu ersetzen. Die Option `IGNORING CASE` (ABAP 7.50+) macht die Ersetzung flexibler und erspart manuelle Konvertierungen. Dies ist eine sehr nützliche Funktion für die String-Manipulation.
keywords: REPLACE, String, All Occurrences, IGNORING CASE

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und geben Sie für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(wa)` für eine einfache und lesbare Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_printer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS print_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_printer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD print_flight_details.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_flight-carrid }, Flugnummer: { ls_flight-connid }| TO rt_output.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_print_flight_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_print_flight_details.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_printer=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_printer) = NEW zcl_flight_printer( ).

CLASS zcl_max_capacity_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_flight_with_max_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_capacity_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_with_max_capacity.
    DATA(ls_max_flight) = REDUCE ty_sflight(
      INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( seatsmax = 0 )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT
        max_flight = COND #( WHEN flight-seatsmax > max_flight-seatsmax THEN flight ELSE max_flight ) ).
    rv_connid = ls_max_flight-connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_update_lock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS book_seat
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_update_lock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD book_seat.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    " Lock the row for update
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      FOR UPDATE.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF ls_sflight-seatsocc < ls_sflight-seatsmax.
        ls_sflight-seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc + 1.
        UPDATE sflight FROM @ls_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        " No seats available
        ROLLBACK WORK.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " Flight not found
      ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_custom_salv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_custom_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_salv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " 1. Define dynamic structure with custom fields
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'ID'          type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) TO lt_components.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Beschreibung' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) TO lt_components.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Wert'        type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) ) TO lt_components.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    " 2. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 3. Populate dynamic internal table with sample data
    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_line>.

    LOOP AT sy-tabix FROM 1 TO 3.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = |ITEM_{ sy-tabix ALPHA = IN }|. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'Beschreibung' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = |Beschreibung für Item { sy-tabix }|. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'Wert' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = sy-tabix * 100. ENDIF.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 4. Display with CL_SALV_TABLE
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <fs_table> ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.

  METHOD display_sflight_modified_alv.

            lo_column = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).

            lo_column->set_short_text( 'F-Ges.' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen (z.B. 'CARRID', 'CONNID', 'PRICE') aus SFLIGHT und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Zeigen Sie die Tabelle anschließend in einem CL_SALV_TABLE an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` mit einer dynamisch erstellten `component_table` und `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_from_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_sflight_subset
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_from_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_sflight_subset.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_salv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA lv_select_fields TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_field_name type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( |SFLIGHT-{ lv_field_name }| ) ) TO lt_components.
      IF lv_select_fields IS INITIAL.
        lv_select_fields = lv_field_name.
      ELSE.
        lv_select_fields = lv_select_fields && ', ' && lv_field_name.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Felder zur Anzeige ausgewählt.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Dynamic SELECT statement
    TRY.
        EXEC SQL.
          SELECT (:lv_select_fields) FROM SFLIGHT INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE :<fs_table> UP TO 100 ROWS
        ENDEXEC.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Lesen der SFLIGHT Daten.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <fs_table> ).

        lo_salv_table->set_top_of_list( 'Dynamische SFLIGHT Daten' ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_salv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_ddic_name ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_table>.

        " Dynamic SELECT statement
        DATA lv_select_statement TYPE string.
        lv_select_statement = |SELECT * FROM { iv_ddic_name } UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @<fs_table>|.

        EXEC SQL.
          :lv_select_statement
        ENDEXEC.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          MESSAGE |Fehler beim Lesen der Daten aus { iv_ddic_name }.| TYPE 'E'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <fs_table> ).

        lo_salv_table->set_top_of_list( |Daten aus { iv_ddic_name }| ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_type INTO DATA(lx_unknown_type).
        MESSAGE |DDIC-Objekt '{ iv_ddic_name }' nicht gefunden: { lx_unknown_type->get_text( ) }| TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT in einem cl_salv_table an und fügen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Spalte 'STATUS' hinzu, die basierend auf dem Preis 'Günstig' oder 'Teuer' anzeigt.

CLASS zcl_salv_custom_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_with_status.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             status    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    DATA: lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status,
          lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
          CHANGING

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einem Flugdatum-Bereich, der durch vordefinierte Konstanten (simuliert `if_fsbp_const_range`) repräsentiert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator und den `VALUE` Operator, um den Range zu definieren. Simulieren Sie die Konstanten mit einem lokalen Interface.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_my_const_range.
  CONSTANTS:
    BEGIN OF gc_flight_dates,
      low  TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '20250101',
      high TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '20250131',
    END OF gc_flight_dates.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_my_const_range.
    METHODS filter_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_low_date)  = zif_my_const_range~gc_flight_dates-low.
    DATA(lv_high_date) = zif_my_const_range~gc_flight_dates-high.

    DATA(lt_date_range) = VALUE sflight_fldate_t(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = lv_low_date high = lv_high_date )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate IN lt_date_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_flights_by_carrier_and_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier AND fldate IN it_date_range )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_promo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_promo,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             is_promo    TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_promo.

    METHODS get_flights_with_promo_status
      IMPORTING
        it_promo_date_range TYPE sflight_fldate_t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_promo) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_promo WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_promo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_promo_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights_promo = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid   = flight-carrid
        connid   = flight-connid
        fldate   = flight-fldate
        is_promo = COND abap_bool( WHEN flight-fldate IN it_promo_date_range THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Range-Tabelle für ein beliebiges Feld basierend auf dessen RTTI-Informationen und füllen Sie diese mit Werten. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung dieser dynamischen Range.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` für RTTI. Erstellen Sie die Range-Tabelle dynamisch und füllen Sie sie mit `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_use_dynamic_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value1     TYPE string
        iv_value2     TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_use_dynamic_range.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_tabledescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_comp_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_range> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_range_line> TYPE any,
                   <lv_low> TYPE any,
                   <lv_high> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
        lo_line_descr ?= lo_typedescr.
        lo_comp_descr ?= lo_line_descr->get_component_type( iv_field_name ).

        lo_tabledescr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
          p_line_type = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
            p_components = VALUE abap_compdescr_tab(
              ( name = 'SIGN'   type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) )
              ( name = 'OPTION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) )
              ( name = 'LOW'    type = lo_comp_descr )
              ( name = 'HIGH'   type = lo_comp_descr ) )
          )
        ).

        CREATE DATA <lt_range> TYPE HANDLE lo_tabledescr.
        ASSIGN <lt_range>->* TO <lt_range>.

        CREATE DATA <ls_range_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_range>.
        ASSIGN <ls_range_line>->* TO <ls_range_line>.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SIGN' OF <ls_range_line> TO DATA(lv_sign).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'OPTION' OF <ls_range_line> TO DATA(lv_option).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'LOW' OF <ls_range_line> TO <lv_low>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'HIGH' OF <ls_range_line> TO <lv_high>.

        lv_sign = 'I'.
        IF iv_value2 IS INITIAL.
          lv_option = 'EQ'.
          <lv_low> = iv_value1.
        ELSE.
          lv_option = 'BT'.
          <lv_low> = iv_value1.
          <lv_high> = iv_value2.
        ENDIF.
        INSERT <ls_range_line> INTO TABLE <lt_range>.

        DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
        SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

        rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE (iv_field_name) IN <lt_range> ).

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_descr_error cx_sy_table_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit mehreren spezifischen Ausnahmeklassen und nutzen Sie `ASSERT` für Vorbedingungen, um die Robustheit des Codes zu erhöhen.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CATCH`-Blöcke für verschiedene Ausnahmetypen und `ASSERT` am Anfang einer Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_robust_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_divisor      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    ASSERT iv_input_string IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_divisor <> 0.

    DATA lv_number TYPE i.
    TRY.
        lv_number = iv_input_string.
        rv_result = lv_number / iv_divisor.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error EXPORTING previous = lx_conv_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        MESSAGE lx_arith_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING previous = lx_arith_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum. Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis. Wenden Sie einen Datumsbereichsfilter vor der Gruppierung an.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights_by_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_group_summary.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_date_range TYPE sflight_fldate_t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_summary) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights_by_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate IN it_date_range )
      GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid fldate = flight-fldate ) 
      ASCENDING
      ( carrid      = GROUP-carrid
        fldate      = GROUP-fldate
        num_flights = GROUP SIZE
        total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT s = s + member-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_find_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Extrahiere spezifische Gruppen aus einem String, die durch einen regulären Ausdruck erfasst wurden.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_regex` mit Klammern im Muster und `get_submatches`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_captured_group,
             group_id TYPE i,
             value    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_captured_group.
    TYPES tt_captured_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_captured_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_groups
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_groups) TYPE tt_captured_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_groups.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ) IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_submatches) = lo_matcher->get_submatches( ).
      rt_groups = VALUE #( FOR <submatch> IN lt_submatches ( 
        group_id = <submatch>-group_id
        value    = <submatch>-value
      ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur von SFLIGHT und füllen Sie diese mit einigen Daten. Verarbeiten Sie die Daten dann generisch, indem Sie auf eine bestimmte Spalte (z.B. CARRID) zugreifen und deren Werte ausgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und `REF TO DATA` sowie Feld-Symbolen für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_dynamic_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " Get description for SFLIGHT structure
    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " Create dynamic table type based on SFLIGHT
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    DATA gr_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA gr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_carrid> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN gr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Fill dynamic table with some data
    CREATE DATA gr_dynamic_table TYPE SFLIGHT.
    ASSIGN gr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_line>.

    <fs_line>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_line>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_line>-fldate = sy-datum.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

    <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_line>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_line>-fldate = sy-datum.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

    " Process dynamic table generically
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |Fluggesellschaft: { <fs_carrid> }| TO rv_output.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_ref( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_table( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( p_act = lt_result[1] CO 'Fluggesellschaft: AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( p_act = lt_result[2] CO 'Fluggesellschaft: LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung und Verarbeitung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit. Durch die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` mit `cl_abap_tabledescr` und Feld-Symbolen (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) kann der Code generisch mit Datenstrukturen umgehen, die zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt sind. Der Zugriff auf Komponenten erfolgt ebenfalls dynamisch über `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
keywords: REF TO, CREATE DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Table, SFLIGHT, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die Referenzen auf String-Datenobjekte enthält. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Referenzen auf verschiedene String-Variablen und greifen Sie über die Referenzen auf die Daten zu, um sie zu ändern.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die interne Tabelle als `TABLE OF REF TO string` und verwenden Sie `GET REFERENCE OF` oder `REF #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ref_table_manipulation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS manipulate_strings RETURNING VALUE(rt_output) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ref_table_manipulation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_strings.
    DATA: lv_string1 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Value 1',
          lv_string2 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Value 2',
          lv_string3 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Value 3'.

    DATA: lt_string_refs TYPE TABLE OF REF TO string.

    " Fill table with references
    APPEND REF #( lv_string1 ) TO lt_string_refs.
    APPEND REF #( lv_string2 ) TO lt_string_refs.
    APPEND REF #( lv_string3 ) TO lt_string_refs.

    " Modify strings via references in the table
    LOOP AT lt_string_refs ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_string_ref>).
      IF <fs_string_ref> IS BOUND.
        <fs_string_ref>->* = <fs_string_ref>->* && ' - Modified'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Collect modified values for output
    APPEND lv_string1 TO rt_output.
    APPEND lv_string2 TO rt_output.
    APPEND lv_string3 TO rt_output.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_string_manipulation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_manipulation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_table_manipulation( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->manipulate_strings( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Initial Value 1 - Modified' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'Initial Value 2 - Modified' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'Initial Value 3 - Modified' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine interne Tabelle Referenzen auf Datenobjekte speichern kann (`TABLE OF REF TO string`). Mit `REF #` (ab ABAP 7.40) können Referenzen inline erstellt und der Tabelle hinzugefügt werden. Der Zugriff und die Modifikation der referenzierten Daten erfolgen über das Dereferenzierungs-Symbol `->*` innerhalb einer Schleife, was eine indirekte Manipulation der ursprünglichen Variablen ermöglicht.
keywords: REF TO, Internal Tables, Data References, GET REFERENCE OF, REF #

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf Komponenten einer Struktur (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) zu, deren Typ zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist, unter Verwendung von Datenreferenzen und Feld-Symbolen. Lesen Sie den Wert einer bestimmten Komponente (z.B. 'CARRID').
hint: Nutzen Sie `GET REFERENCE OF` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT <component_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_component>`.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_component_value) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA gr_sflight_ref TYPE REF TO sflight.
    GET REFERENCE OF ls_sflight INTO gr_sflight_ref.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN gr_sflight_ref->* TO <fs_sflight>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_component_value = |{ <fs_component> }|.
      ELSE.
        rv_component_value = 'Error: Component not found'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_component_value = 'Error: Could not assign structure reference'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei Klassen: `ZCL_COUNTER` mit einer privaten Zählervariable und einer Methode zum Erhöhen des Zählers, und `ZCL_PROCESSOR` mit einer Methode, die ein Objekt von `ZCL_COUNTER` als Referenz akzeptiert und dessen Zähler erhöht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IMPORTING ir_counter TYPE REF TO zcl_counter` für die Übergabe der Objektreferenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
    METHODS increment_count.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_count.
    rv_count = mv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD increment_count.
    mv_count = mv_count + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_counter
      IMPORTING
        ir_counter TYPE REF TO zcl_counter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_counter.
    IF ir_counter IS BOUND.
      ir_counter->increment_count( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_counter_processing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unbound_reference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_counter_processing.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_counter( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_processor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_counter->get_count( ) exp = 0 ).

    lo_processor->process_counter( lo_counter ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_counter->get_count( ) exp = 1 ).

    lo_processor->process_counter( lo_counter ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_counter->get_count( ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unbound_reference.
    DATA lo_counter TYPE REF TO zcl_counter.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_processor( ).

    " Call with unbound reference - should not cause dump, but do nothing
    lo_processor->process_counter( lo_counter ).
    " No assertion needed for counter value as it's unbound, just ensure no dump.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( 1 = 1 " Placeholder to satisfy assertion requirement
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht die Übergabe von Objekten per Referenz in der objektorientierten Programmierung. Die Methode `process_counter` in `ZCL_PROCESSOR` akzeptiert eine Referenz auf ein `ZCL_COUNTER`-Objekt (`TYPE REF TO zcl_counter`). Dadurch kann die `process_counter`-Methode direkt auf die öffentliche Methode `increment_count` des übergebenen Zählerobjekts zugreifen und dessen internen Zustand ändern. Die Prüfung `IF ir_counter IS BOUND` verhindert Laufzeitfehler bei der Übergabe einer initialen Referenz.
keywords: REF TO, Object Reference, Object Orientation, CLASS, METHODS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie ein Datum, das 7 Tage vor einem gegebenen Startdatum liegt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `SUBTRACTING DAYS` Syntax oder `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>SUBTRACT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_subtraction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_minus_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_days       TYPE i

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`). Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (`PRICE`) und subtrahieren Sie dann 10% des Preises für alle Flüge, die in einer bestimmten Währung (`CURRENCY`) sind, alles in einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `NEXT` Anweisung, die bedingt subtrahiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtraction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_adjusted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency_to_deduct TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_adjusted_total_price) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtraction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_adjusted_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Populate dummy data for SFLIGHT
    lt_sflight = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' ) 
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) 
                          ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) 
                          ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0900' fldate = sy-datum price = '50.00' currency = 'GBP' ) ).

    rv_adjusted_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total_price = ( VALUE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2 ) 
                                        FOR flight IN lt_sflight 
                                        NEXT total_price = total_price + flight-price 
                                        WHEN flight-currency = iv_currency_to_deduct THEN total_price = total_price - ( flight-price * '0.10' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deduct_usd.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_subtraction( ).
    " Total price: 100 (USD) + 200 (EUR) + 150 (USD) + 50 (GBP) = 500
    " Deduct 10% from USD flights: 100 * 0.1 = 10, 150 * 0.1 = 15. Total deduction = 25
    " Expected: 500 - 25 = 475
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_adjusted_price( 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '475.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deduct_eur.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_subtraction( ).
    " Total price: 500
    " Deduct 10% from EUR flights: 200 * 0.1 = 20. Total deduction = 20
    " Expected: 500 - 20 = 480
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_adjusted_price( 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '480.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_deduction.

    " No deduction for 'JPY'

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.50) zur funktionalen Aggregation und bedingten Subtraktion. Es initialisiert eine `total_price` und iteriert über die Flugdaten. Für jeden Flug wird der Preis zur `total_price` addiert. Wenn die Währung des Fluges mit der `iv_currency_to_deduct` übereinstimmt, wird 10% des Flugpreises von der `total_price` subtrahiert. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, komplexe Aggregationen mit bedingter Logik durchzuführen.
keywords: SUBTRACT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT, Conditional Logic

CLASS zcl_conditional_subtraction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_final_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_total_amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2

CLASS zcl_conditional_subtraction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_final_amount.
    rv_final_amount = COND #( WHEN iv_total_amount > iv_threshold
                               THEN iv_total_amount - iv_bonus_amount
                               ELSE iv_total_amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anstatt einer traditionellen `IF`-Anweisung wird hier der Endbetrag direkt basierend auf einer Bedingung berechnet: Wenn `iv_total_amount` den `iv_threshold` überschreitet, wird der `iv_bonus_amount` subtrahiert; andernfalls bleibt der `iv_total_amount` unverändert. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Datenreferenzen (`TABLE OF REF TO data`) akzeptiert. Die Methode soll dann die referenzierten Datenobjekte (z.B. Strings) in Großbuchstaben umwandeln und die modifizierten Werte zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_ref>)` und dereferenzieren Sie mit `<fs_ref>->*`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ref_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string_references
      IMPORTING
        it_string_refs TYPE TABLE OF REF TO string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ref_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string_references.
    LOOP AT it_string_refs ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_string_ref>).
      IF <fs_string_ref> IS BOUND.
        " Dereference and convert to uppercase
        <fs_string_ref>->* = to_upper( <fs_string_ref>->* ).
        APPEND <fs_string_ref>->* TO rt_processed_strings.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_strings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_table_with_unbound_ref FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_strings.
    DATA: lv_str1 TYPE string VALUE 'hello',
          lv_str2 TYPE string VALUE 'world'.
    DATA: lt_refs TYPE TABLE OF REF TO string.
    APPEND REF #( lv_str1 ) TO lt_refs.
    APPEND REF #( lv_str2 ) TO lt_refs.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_table_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_string_references( lt_refs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'HELLO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'WORLD' ).
    " Verify original variables are also changed
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_str1 exp = 'HELLO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_str2 exp = 'WORLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_table_processor( ).
    DATA: lt_refs TYPE TABLE OF REF TO string.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_string_references( lt_refs ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_with_unbound_ref.
    DATA: lv_str1 TYPE string VALUE 'test'.
    DATA: lr_unbound TYPE REF TO string.
    DATA: lt_refs TYPE TABLE OF REF TO string.
    APPEND REF #( lv_str1 ) TO lt_refs.
    APPEND lr_unbound TO lt_refs.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_table_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_string_references( lt_refs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'TEST' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verarbeitung von Datenreferenzen, die in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert sind. Die Methode `process_string_references` iteriert über eine Tabelle von String-Referenzen. Innerhalb der Schleife wird jede Referenz dereferenziert (`<fs_string_ref>->*`), um auf den tatsächlichen String-Wert zuzugreifen. Dieser Wert wird dann mit `to_upper()` in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt und der ursprüngliche String über die Referenz aktualisiert. Dies unterstreicht die Leistungsfähigkeit von Referenzen für die indirekte Datenmanipulation.
keywords: REF TO, Internal Tables, Data References, Dereferencing, to_upper, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die dynamisch Instanzen verschiedener Klassen erstellt, basierend auf einem übergebenen Klassennamen. Die `create_product`-Methode in `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY` akzeptiert einen Klassennamen als String. Mit `CREATE OBJECT rr_product TYPE (iv_class_name)` wird dynamisch eine Instanz der entsprechenden Klasse erstellt. Die Rückgabe erfolgt als Referenz auf das Interface `ZIF_PRODUCT` (`TYPE REF TO zif_product`), was Polymorphie ermöglicht und den aufrufenden Code von der konkreten Implementierung entkoppelt. Wenn die Zuweisung erfolgreich ist (d.h., die Referenz zeigt tatsächlich auf eine interne Tabelle), kann die Funktion `lines(<fs_table>)` verwendet werden, um die Zeilenanzahl zu erhalten. Instructions: Identifizieren Sie in einer sortierten Tabelle von Flügen (sflights) aufeinanderfolgende Flüge der gleichen Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie `sy-tabix` und Tabellen-Ausdrücke (`itab[ sy-tabix - 1 ]`) für den Zugriff auf den vorherigen Eintrag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_consecutive_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_consecutive_flight_pair,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid1 TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate1 TYPE s_date,
             connid2 TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate2 TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_consecutive_flight_pair.
    TYPES tt_consecutive_flight_pair TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_consecutive_flight_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_consecutive_same_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_pairs) TYPE tt_consecutive_flight_pair.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_consecutive_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_consecutive_same_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.
    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid fldate.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_current_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        DATA(ls_previous_flight) = lt_sflights[ sy-tabix - 1 ].
        IF ls_current_flight-carrid = ls_previous_flight-carrid.
          APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_current_flight-carrid
                          connid1 = ls_previous_flight-connid
                          fldate1 = ls_previous_flight-fldate
                          connid2 = ls_current_flight-connid
                          fldate2 = ls_current_flight-fldate ) TO rt_pairs.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse für ungültige Eingaben und werfen Sie diese, wenn ein negativer Wert übergeben wird. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine Meldung aus.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_negative_value DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_negative_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_custom_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_positive_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_negative_value.

    METHODS handle_number_input
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_custom_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_positive_number.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_negative_value
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_negative_value=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_message = |Zahl { iv_number } erfolgreich verarbeitet.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_number_input.
    TRY.
        rv_output = process_positive_number( iv_number = iv_number ).
      CATCH zcx_negative_value INTO DATA(lx_negative_value).
        rv_output = |Fehler: { lx_negative_value->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
