    METHODS test_negative_number FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_number.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_custom_exception( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->handle_number_input( iv_number = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Zahl 10 erfolgreich verarbeitet.' msg = 'Positive number expected to be processed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_number.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_custom_exception( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->handle_number_input( iv_number = -5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_result needle = 'Fehler: Negative Werte sind nicht erlaubt.' msg = 'Negative value error expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die Erstellung und Verwendung eigener, anwendungsspezifischer Ausnahme-Klassen. Durch das Erben von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` wird die Ausnahme zu einer prüfbaren Ausnahme, die explizit im Methoden-Interface deklariert werden muss. Die `IF_T100_MESSAGE`-Schnittstelle ermöglicht die Verwendung von Nachrichten aus der Nachrichtenpflege.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `CLEANUP`-Blocks in der Ausnahmebehandlung, um eine simulierte Ressource (z.B. eine Datei) zu schließen, auch wenn eine Ausnahme auftritt.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt, bevor die Ausnahme weitergegeben wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_resource.
    DATA lv_resource_status TYPE string VALUE 'geschlossen'.

    TRY.
        lv_resource_status = 'offen'.
        rv_log = rv_log && 'Ressource geöffnet. '.

        IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.

        rv_log = rv_log && 'Ressource erfolgreich verarbeitet. '.

      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_log = rv_log && 'Ausnahme abgefangen. '.

      CLEANUP.
        IF lv_resource_status = 'offen'.
          lv_resource_status = 'geschlossen'.
          rv_log = rv_log && 'Ressource im CLEANUP geschlossen. '.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.

    rv_log = rv_log && |Endgültiger Status der Ressource: { lv_resource_status }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_no_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->process_resource( iv_simulate_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Ressource geöffnet.' msg = 'Resource should be opened' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Ressource erfolgreich verarbeitet.' msg = 'Resource should be processed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Endgültiger Status der Ressource: geschlossen' msg = 'Resource should be closed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'im CLEANUP' msg = 'Cleanup should not be explicitly mentioned if no error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->process_resource( iv_simulate_error = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Ressource geöffnet.' msg = 'Resource should be opened' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Ausnahme abgefangen.' msg = 'Exception should be caught' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Ressource im CLEANUP geschlossen.' msg = 'Resource should be closed in cleanup' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_log needle = 'Endgültiger Status der Ressource: geschlossen' msg = 'Resource should be closed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block stellt sicher, dass wichtige Aufräumarbeiten (z.B. das Schließen von Dateien oder Datenbankverbindungen) immer ausgeführt werden, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt oder nicht. Dies ist entscheidend für die Stabilität und Ressourcenverwaltung in Anwendungen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CLEANUP, Exceptions

Instructions: Führen Sie zwei Operationen aus, die unterschiedliche Ausnahmen werfen können (z.B. Division durch Null und Zugriff auf einen ungültigen Tabellenindex). Behandeln Sie jede Ausnahme in einem separaten `CATCH`-Block.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CATCH`-Anweisungen nach dem `TRY`-Block, um spezifische Ausnahmen abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_multiple_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operations
      IMPORTING
        iv_scenario TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_multiple_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operations.
    DATA lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i VALUE #( ( 10 ) ( 5 ) ).

    TRY.
        IF iv_scenario = 1. " Simulate division by zero
          DATA(lv_result) = lt_numbers[1] / 0.
          rv_message = |Ergebnis: { lv_result }|.
        ELSEIF iv_scenario = 2. " Simulate invalid table index access
          DATA(lv_value) = lt_numbers[3]. " Index 3 does not exist
          rv_message = |Wert am Index 3: { lv_value }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_message = 'Kein Fehler simuliert.'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_message = 'Fehler: Arithmetische Operation fehlgeschlagen (z.B. Division durch Null).'.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_message = 'Fehler: Tabellenzeile nicht gefunden (ungültiger Index).'.
      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_message = 'Ein unbekannter Fehler ist aufgetreten.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_operations( iv_scenario = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_result needle = 'Arithmetische Operation fehlgeschlagen' msg = 'Arithmetic error expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_multiple_catch( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_operations( iv_scenario = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_result needle = 'Tabellenzeile nicht gefunden' msg = 'Invalid index error expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Zeigt, wie verschiedene Arten von Ausnahmen in einem `TRY`-Block spezifisch behandelt werden können. Durch die Verwendung mehrerer `CATCH`-Blöcke kann der Code auf unterschiedliche Fehlerursachen gezielt reagieren, was zu robusterem und wartbarerem Code führt. Die Reihenfolge der `CATCH`-Blöcke ist wichtig, da spezifischere Ausnahmen vor allgemeineren abgefangen werden sollten.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, deren Index ungerade ist.

CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_odd_flight_price_sum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_odd_flight_price_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( sy-tabix MOD 2 <> 0 )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine externe Operation aufruft (simuliert durch eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme werfen kann) und deren Ergebnis weiterverarbeitet. Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `TRY`-Blöcke, um sowohl Fehler der externen Operation als auch Fehler bei der Nachbearbeitung separat zu behandeln.
hint: Platzieren Sie einen `TRY`-Block innerhalb eines anderen `TRY`-Blocks, um verschiedene Fehlerstufen zu isolieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_try_blocks DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS external_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_fail TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_data TYPE string
        iv_fail_post_processing TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.

    METHODS execute_full_process
      IMPORTING
        iv_fail_external TYPE abap_bool
        iv_fail_post_processing TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_try_blocks IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD external_operation.
    IF iv_fail = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.
    rv_data = 'Daten von externer Operation'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_fail_post_processing = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = |Verarbeitete Daten: { iv_input_data }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_full_process.
    DATA lv_external_data TYPE string.

    TRY. " Outer TRY for external operation
        lv_external_data = external_operation( iv_fail = iv_fail_external ).
        rv_status = 'Externe Operation erfolgreich. '.

        TRY. " Inner TRY for post-processing
            rv_status = rv_status && process_data( iv_input_data = lv_external_data
                                                    iv_fail_post_processing = iv_fail_post_processing ).
            rv_status = rv_status && ' Nachbearbeitung erfolgreich.' .
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
            rv_status = rv_status && |Fehler bei Nachbearbeitung: { lx_conversion_error->get_text( ) }|.
        ENDTRY.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arithmetic_error).
        rv_status = |Fehler bei externer Operation: { lx_arithmetic_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_status = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_status needle = 'Nachbearbeitung erfolgreich.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_external_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_try_blocks( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_status needle = 'Fehler bei externer Operation:' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( haystack = lv_status needle = 'Nachbearbeitung' ).

explanation: Verschachtelte `TRY`-Blöcke ermöglichen eine sehr feingranulare Fehlerbehandlung, indem sie Fehler in verschiedenen Phasen eines Prozesses isolieren und spezifisch darauf reagieren können. Der äußere Block fängt Fehler der Hauptoperation ab, während der innere Block Fehler in einer nachfolgenden, abhängigen Operation behandelt. Dies erhöht die Robustheit und die Diagnosefähigkeit des Codes.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Nested Exceptions, Error Handling

Instructions: Finden Sie den Index des ersten Flugs in der Tabelle `sflights`, der eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft hat und dessen Flugdatum nach einem bestimmten Datum liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_INDEX` mit einem Tabellen-Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_index_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE sy-tabix.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_index_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_index.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    TRY.
        rv_index = LINE_INDEX( lt_sflights[ WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > iv_fldate ] ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_index = 0. " Indicate not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieser Ansatz nutzt `LINE_INDEX` in Kombination mit einem Tabellen-Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, um den Index des ersten passenden Eintrags zu finden. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und performante Methode, die den expliziten `LOOP AT` und `CHECK` überflüssig macht. `sy-tabix` wird hier implizit durch `LINE_INDEX` ermittelt.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation aus, die eine Ausnahme werfen kann. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine generische Fehlermeldung zurück, wenn der Fehler auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_root` für eine generische Fehlerbehandlung.

CLASS zcl_try_generic_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_try_generic_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    TRY.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          " Simulate an error, e.g., division by zero
          DATA(lv_dummy) = 1 / 0.
        ENDIF.
        rv_message = 'Operation erfolgreich ausgeführt.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_message = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Einträge in einer internen Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben, und geben Sie zusätzlich den Index des ersten und letzten gefundenen Eintrags an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO ...` und `sy-tabix` für die Indexermittlung, sowie `LINES` für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_count_indices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             count      TYPE i,
             first_index TYPE sy-tabix,
             last_index  TYPE sy-tabix,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_carrier_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_info) TYPE ty_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_tabix_count_indices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_info.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    rs_info-first_index = 0.
    rs_info-last_index = 0.
    rs_info-count = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid.
        rs_info-count = rs_info-count + 1.
        IF rs_info-first_index = 0.
          rs_info-first_index = sy-tabix.
        ENDIF.
        rs_info-last_index = sy-tabix.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sy_tabix_count_indices( ).
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_carrier_info( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ls_info-count > 0 msg = 'Count should be greater than 0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ls_info-first_index > 0 msg = 'First index should be found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ls_info-last_index >= ls_info-first_index msg = 'Last index should be valid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-last_index exp = 0 msg = 'Last index should be 0' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `sy-tabix` innerhalb einer `LOOP`-Schleife, um den Index des ersten und letzten gefundenen Eintrags zu ermitteln, der ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllt. Obwohl moderne ABAP-Syntax oft auf funktionale Ansätze setzt, ist `sy-tabix` in expliziten Schleifen weiterhin das Mittel der Wahl, wenn der aktuelle Zeilenindex benötigt wird.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Komponenten (Feldnamen und Typen) einer gegebenen Struktur zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_structure->* ) ).
    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( )
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle eines bestimmten Typs (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_name` und `CREATE DATA ... TYPE HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT_T' if such a type exists, or 'SFLIGHT' for a standard table of SFLIGHT
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
    DATA(lo_tabledescr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Assuming the table type is of SFLIGHT for demonstration
      " In a real scenario, you'd need more RTTI to determine row type and fill generically
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_tabledescr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
          IF lo_line_descr->get_name( ) = 'SFLIGHT'.
            APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_line>).
            IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
              <ls_line>-carrid = 'LH'.
              <ls_line>-connid = '0400'.
              <ls_line>-fldate = sy-datum.
            ENDIF.
            APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
            IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
              <ls_line>-carrid = 'AA'.
              <ls_line>-connid = '0017'.
              <ls_line>-fldate = sy-datum - 1.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
          " Not a structure type, handle appropriately or skip filling
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_sflight_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'SFLIGHT' ). " SFLIGHT is a structure, so it creates a table of SFLIGHT

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_sflight> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_sflight_table->* TO <lt_sflight>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflight> ) exp = 2 ).

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf, deren Name als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object` und `CALL METHOD ... PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object      TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters  TYPE abap_parmbind_tab OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string. " Simplified return for demo

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS dummy_method_1
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS dummy_method_2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ) ).
    DATA(lo_methoddescr) = lo_classdescr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ). " Check if method exists

    DATA lt_parameter_table TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    IF it_parameters IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_parameter_table = it_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lv_return_value TYPE string.
    DATA ls_return_param TYPE abap_parmbind.
    ls_return_param-name = 'RV_OUTPUT'. " Assuming a return parameter named RV_OUTPUT
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_return_value INTO ls_return_param-value.
    APPEND ls_return_param TO lt_parameter_table.

    CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameter_table.

    rv_result = lv_return_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method_1.
    rv_output = |Hello from dummy_method_1 with input: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method_2.
    rv_output = 'Hello from dummy_method_2'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_with_param FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_no_param FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_with_param.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_method( ).
    DATA(ls_param) TYPE abap_parmbind.
    ls_param-name = 'IV_INPUT'.
    DATA(lv_input_value) = 'Test Input'.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_input_value INTO ls_param-value.
    DATA(lt_params) TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    APPEND ls_param TO lt_params.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'DUMMY_METHOD_1'
      it_parameters = lt_params
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from dummy_method_1 with input: Test Input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_no_param.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_method( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'DUMMY_METHOD_2'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from dummy_method_2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `describe_by_object` liefert den Typdeskriptor eines Objekts. Dieser wird nach `cl_abap_classdescr` gecastet, um Methodeninformationen zu erhalten. Der eigentliche dynamische Aufruf erfolgt über `CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameter_table`. Die `abap_parmbind_tab` wird verwendet, um Parameter dynamisch zu übergeben, inklusive des Rückgabewerts.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamischer Methodenaufruf, CALL METHOD, PARAMETER-TABLE, cl_abap_classdescr

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Funktion, die den Inhalt einer beliebigen Struktur als String im Format "Feldname: Wert, Feldname: Wert" zurückgibt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` mit Field-Symbols und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_structure_content_as_string
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_content_as_string.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_structure->* ) ).
    DATA lt_parts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_value> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ir_structure->* TO <lv_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ ls_component-name }: { <lv_value> }| TO lt_parts.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_content_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR part IN lt_parts NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN part ELSE s && ', ' && part ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

            carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH',

            cityfrom TYPE s_cityname VALUE 'Frankfurt',
          END OF ls_flight_data.
    GET REFERENCE OF ls_flight_data INTO DATA(lr_flight_data).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_display( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = lo_cut->get_structure_content_as_string( lr_flight_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_content
      exp = 'CARRID: LH, CONNID: 0400, CITYFROM: Frankfurt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: RTTI, Generische Verarbeitung, Strukturen, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, REDUCE, String-Templates

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob zwei beliebige Variablen denselben Datentyp haben.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die Typdeskriptoren oder deren Namen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_comparison DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS are_types_equal
      IMPORTING
        iv_data1 TYPE any
        iv_data2 TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_comparison IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_types_equal.
    DATA(lo_typedescr1) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data1 ).
    DATA(lo_typedescr2) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data2 ).
    rb_equal = COND abap_bool( WHEN lo_typedescr1->get_name( ) = lo_typedescr2->get_name( ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_equal_types FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unequal_types FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_equal_types.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_comparison( ).
    DATA(lv_string1) = 'abc'.
    DATA(lv_string2) = 'def'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->are_types_equal( iv_data1 = lv_string1 iv_data2 = lv_string2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unequal_types.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_comparison( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = 'abc'.
    DATA(lv_int) = 123.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->are_types_equal( iv_data1 = lv_string iv_data2 = lv_int ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Typdeskriptoren beider Variablen werden über `describe_by_data` ermittelt. Ein einfacher Vergleich der von `get_name()` zurückgegebenen Typnamen reicht aus, um die Gleichheit der Typen festzustellen. Die Verwendung von `COND` ist eine moderne Kurzschreibweise.
keywords: RTTI, Typvergleich, cl_abap_typedescr, COND

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle öffentlichen Attribute einer Klasse zur Laufzeit und deren Typen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und `get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             visibility TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES: tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_public_attr TYPE string VALUE 'Public Value'.
    DATA mv_private_attr TYPE i VALUE 100.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).
    LOOP AT lo_classdescr->get_attributes( ) INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
      APPEND VALUE ty_attribute_info(
        name = ls_attribute-name
        type = ls_attribute-type_descr->get_name( )
        visibility = SWITCH string( ls_attribute-visibility
                                   WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>public THEN 'Public'
                                   WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>protected THEN 'Protected'
                                   WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>private THEN 'Private'
                                   ELSE 'Unknown' ) 
      ) TO rt_attributes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_class_attributes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_class_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_cut->get_class_attributes( 'ZCL_RTTI_CLASS_ATTRIBUTES' ).

    " Check for public attribute
    DATA(ls_public_attr) = lt_attributes[ name = 'MV_PUBLIC_ATTR' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_public_attr-type exp = '\TYPE=STRING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_public_attr-visibility exp = 'Private' ). " Attributes are private by default if not specified

    " Check for private attribute
    DATA(ls_private_attr) = lt_attributes[ name = 'MV_PRIVATE_ATTR' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_private_attr-type exp = '\TYPE=I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_private_attr-visibility exp = 'Private' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` wird verwendet, um den Typdeskriptor der Klasse zu erhalten, der dann zu `cl_abap_classdescr` gecastet wird. `get_attributes()` liefert eine Tabelle mit Attributinformationen. `SWITCH` ist eine moderne Syntax für bedingte Zuweisungen.
keywords: RTTI, Klasse, Attribute, cl_abap_classdescr, SWITCH

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein angegebener Feldname in einer gegebenen Struktur existiert.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_validation( ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Dezimalstellen eines numerischen Feldes zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_data` und das Attribut `decimals`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_numeric_properties DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_decimals
      IMPORTING
        iv_numeric_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decimals) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_rtti_numeric_properties IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_decimals.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_numeric_data ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_elemdescr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_typedescr ).
        rv_decimals = lo_elemdescr->decimals.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Not an elementary type, or not a numeric elementary type
        rv_decimals = -1. " Indicate error or not applicable
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Anzahl belegter Sitze anzuzeigen, und stellen Sie das Ergebnis im ALV dar. Verwenden Sie dabei den FILTER-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_filtered_sflights IMPORTING iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE seatsocc >= iv_min_seats ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_table   = lt_filtered_sflights ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_sflights_filter( ).
    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has entries with seatsocc > 100
    lo_cut->display_filtered_sflights( 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception should occur' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator ermöglicht eine prägnante und funktionale Filterung interner Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife zu schreiben, um Zeilen zu filtern, wird hier eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Daten in einer einzigen Anweisung erstellt. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: ALV, CL_SALV_TABLE, FILTER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, NUMBER

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis in einem ALV an. Verwenden Sie dabei den REDUCE-Operator für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE, um über die Flugdaten zu iterieren und die Summe pro Fluggesellschaft zu akkumulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_seats,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_airline_seats.
    TYPES tt_airline_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_aggregated_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_seats) = REDUCE tt_airline_seats(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_airline_seats( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
      GROUP BY carrid
      " ( carrid = flight-carrid total_seats = SUM( flight-seatsocc ) )
      LET total_seats_for_group = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_seats = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP flight
        NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + member-seatsocc )
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid total_seats = total_seats_for_group ) )
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_table   = lt_aggregated_seats ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV-Grid, das dynamisch Spalten basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen anzeigt. Die Daten stammen aus SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_SALV_TABLE=>FACTORY mit einem dynamisch erstellten Feldkatalog oder einer dynamischen internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_alv IMPORTING it_fieldnames TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_alv.
    DATA: lo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight,
          lr_data     TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_table    TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_struct> TYPE ANY STRUCTURE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Create dynamic internal table based on requested fields
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lt_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table(
      FOR fieldname IN it_fieldnames
      LET comp = lo_struct_descr->get_component( fieldname )
      IN ( name = comp-name type = comp-type_descr ) ).

    DATA(lo_dyn_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_dyn_struct_descr OCCURS 0.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_struct>.
      CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_dyn_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dyn_struct>).
      LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_comp>-name OF <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_comp>-name OF <fs_dyn_struct> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dyn_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_dyn_field> = <fs_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_dyn_struct> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( EXPORTING r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                 IMPORTING r_salv_table = lo_alv
                                 CHANGING  t_table      = <fs_table> ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Färben Sie Zeilen in einem ALV-Grid basierend auf einer Bedingung ein. Zeigen Sie Flugdaten an und heben Sie Flüge mit einer geringen Auslastung (z.B. SEATSOCC < 50) hervor.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_conditional_color DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_colored_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_conditional_color IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_colored_sflights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_colored,
             sflight,
             row_color TYPE lvc_t_scol,
           END OF ty_sflight_colored.
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_sflights_colored TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight_colored.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_raw INTO DATA(ls_sflight_raw).
      DATA(ls_sflight_colored) = VALUE ty_sflight_colored( sflight = ls_sflight_raw ).
      IF ls_sflight_raw-seatsocc < 50.
        ls_sflight_colored-row_color = VALUE lvc_t_scol( ( fname = '' color = '3' ) ). " Farbe 3 = Rot
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_colored TO lt_sflights_colored.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_table   = lt_sflights_colored ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column_row_color) = lo_columns->get_column( 'ROW_COLOR' ).
        lo_column_row_color->set_technical( if_salv_c_bool_sap=>true ). " Technische Spalte ausblenden

        DATA(lo_display_settings) = lo_alv->get_display_settings( ).
        lo_display_settings->set_colorize_rows( if_salv_c_bool_sap=>true ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_rtti_metadata IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    " Beschreiben Sie die Struktur der SFLIGHT-Tabelle
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_metadata_line,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
             decimals TYPE i,
           END OF ty_metadata_line.
    DATA lt_metadata TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_metadata_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = ls_component-type_descr.
      APPEND VALUE ty_metadata_line(
        name     = ls_component-name
        type     = lo_type_descr->get_type_kind_as_string( )
        length   = lo_type_descr->length
        decimals = lo_type_descr->decimals
      ) TO lt_metadata.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_table   = lt_metadata ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung (SEATSOCC / SEATSMAX) pro Flug und zeigen Sie diese zusammen mit den Flugdaten in einem ALV an. Verwenden Sie dabei den VALUE-Operator für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer zusätzlichen Spalte für die Auslastung und füllen Sie diese mit dem VALUE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_avg_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_avg_occupancy.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_occupancy,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_sflight_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    DATA(lt_sflights_occupancy) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_occupancy(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid    = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
        seatsocc  = ls_sflight-seatsocc
        seatsmax  = ls_sflight-seatsmax
        occupancy = COND f( WHEN ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_sflight-seatsocc / ls_sflight-seatsmax ) ELSE 0 ) )
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_table   = lt_sflights_occupancy ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column_occupancy) = lo_columns->get_column( 'OCCUPANCY' ).
        lo_column_occupancy->set_long_text( 'Auslastung (%)' ).
        lo_column_occupancy->set_output_length( 10 ).
        lo_column_occupancy->set_decimals( 2 ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Anhang, der Daten aus einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) im CSV-Format enthält, unter Verwendung von `cl_bcs_utilities`.
hint: Konvertieren Sie die interne Tabelle in einen String, dann in `xstring` und fügen Sie diesen als Anhang hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE so_obj_des
        iv_content         TYPE string
        it_sflights        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_attachment.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string,
          lv_xstring    TYPE xstring.

    " Convert internal table to CSV string
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_csv_string = |
        { lv_csv_string }{ ls_sflight-carrid },{ ls_sflight-connid },{ ls_sflight-fldate },{ ls_sflight-planetype }
      |.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Convert string to xstring (UTF-8)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = lv_csv_string
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring.

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_document(
      i_document_type = 'RAW'
      i_subject       = iv_subject
      i_text          = cl_bcs_utilities=>string_to_soli_tab( iv_content )
    ).

    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'CSV'
      i_attachment_subject = 'sflights_data.csv'
      i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lv_xstring )
      i_att_content_hex    = lv_xstring
    ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_recipient(
      i_email_address = iv_recipient_email
    ).

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_send_request(
      i_document  = lo_document
      i_recipient = lo_recipient
    ).

    lo_send_request->send(
      i_with_dialog = abap_false
    ).

    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Bestimmung der 'Temperatur' von Daten basierend auf einem Alterungsdatum. Die Klasse `cl_abap_stack_temperature` wird hier konzeptionell verwendet, da ihre direkte Anwendung oft in Systemprogrammen liegt. Die Lösung soll ein Datum in eine 'Temperaturkategorie' (Hot, Warm, Cold) einordnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie Datumsberechnungen und den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck für die Kategorisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_temperature,
             date_field TYPE sy-datum,
             temperature TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_temperature.

    METHODS get_data_temperature
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE string.

    METHODS analyze_data_set
      IMPORTING
        it_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_temperatures) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_temperature.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_temperature.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_days_old) = lv_today - iv_date.

    rv_temperature = SWITCH string(
      lv_days_old
      WHEN BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 'Hot'
      WHEN BETWEEN 31 AND 365 THEN 'Warm'
      ELSE 'Cold'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD analyze_data_set.
    rt_temperatures = VALUE #( FOR ls_date IN it_dates
                                ( date_field = ls_date,
                                  temperature = get_data_temperature( ls_date ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_temperature FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_analyze_set FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_temperature.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_data_aging_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->get_data_temperature( lv_today ) exp = 'Hot' msg = 'Today should be Hot' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->get_data_temperature( lv_today - 15 ) exp = 'Hot' msg = '15 days old should be Hot' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->get_data_temperature( lv_today - 100 ) exp = 'Warm' msg = '100 days old should be Warm' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->get_data_temperature( lv_today - 400 ) exp = 'Cold' msg = '400 days old should be Cold' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_analyze_set.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_data_aging_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lt_dates) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-datum(
      ( lv_today )
      ( lv_today - 60 )
      ( lv_today - 700 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_analyzer->analyze_data_set( lt_dates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 results' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-temperature exp = 'Hot' msg = 'First date should be Hot' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-temperature exp = 'Warm' msg = 'Second date should be Warm' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-temperature exp = 'Cold' msg = 'Third date should be Cold' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert konzeptionell die Logik hinter der Datenalterung, indem es ein Datum in eine 'Temperaturkategorie' einordnet. Es nutzt moderne ABAP-Features wie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck für die bedingte Logik und den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` für die effiziente Transformation interner Tabellen. Obwohl `cl_abap_stack_temperature` eine Systemklasse ist, die nicht direkt für solche Anwendungslogik gedacht ist, veranschaulicht dieses Beispiel die Art von Logik, die zur Bestimmung der Daten 'Temperatur' verwendet werden könnte.
keywords: Data Aging, Date Calculation, Conditional Logic, SWITCH, FOR, VALUE, cl_abap_stack_temperature

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugdaten aus `sflights` enthält, bei denen die maximale Kapazität größer als 300 ist, und füllen Sie dabei nur die Felder `carrid`, `connid`, `fldate`, `planetype`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_capacity_flights.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                          WHERE ( seatsmax > 300 )
                          ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid,
                            connid    = ls_flight-connid,
                            fldate    = ls_flight-fldate,
                            planetype = ls_flight-planetype ) ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status_message

        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_is_canceled TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_message.

      WHEN iv_is_canceled = abap_true THEN 'Storniert'
      ELSE 'Planmäßig'
    ) }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglichen die einfache Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken. Der `COND`-Ausdruck bietet eine kompakte Möglichkeit, bedingte Logik direkt in einem Ausdruck zu implementieren, was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht als traditionelle `IF`-Statements.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 150 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' seatsocc = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 250 msg = 'Total seats for LH incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'AA' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 200 msg = 'Total seats for AA incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'XX' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = 0 msg = 'Total seats for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Schleife mit einer Akkumulatorvariable (`INIT sum = 0`) und einer `NEXT`-Anweisung in einem einzigen, funktionalen Ausdruck zu kapseln. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code, der die Absicht der Aggregation klar kommuniziert.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Wandeln Sie einen numerischen Statuscode in eine beschreibende Textnachricht um. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH #( ... WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_description

        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH string(
      iv_status_code
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Erfolgreich verarbeitet'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Wird bearbeitet'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Fehler aufgetreten'
      ELSE 'Unbekannter Status'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_status_description FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_description.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_description( 1 ) exp = 'Erfolgreich verarbeitet' msg = 'Status 1 incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_description( 2 ) exp = 'Wird bearbeitet' msg = 'Status 2 incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_description( 3 ) exp = 'Fehler aufgetreten' msg = 'Status 3 incorrect' ).

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und elegante Alternative zur traditionellen `CASE`-Anweisung, wenn es darum geht, einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zu bestimmen. Er ist ein Ausdruck, der direkt in Zuweisungen oder anderen Ausdrücken verwendet werden kann, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht. Die Lesbarkeit wird durch die klare Zuordnung von `WHEN`-Bedingungen zu `THEN`-Ergebnissen verbessert.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Mapping, Expressions

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights`, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die in den nächsten 7 Tagen stattfinden, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit Datumsberechnungen (z.B. `cl_abap_tstmp=>add_days`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_upcoming_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_upcoming_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_upcoming_flights.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_date_in_7_days) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add_days( iv_date = lv_today iv_days = 7 ).

    rt_upcoming_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights
                                    WHERE fldate BETWEEN lv_today AND lv_date_in_7_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = lv_today ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = lv_today + 3 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = lv_today + 7 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0030' fldate = lv_today + 8 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_upcoming_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 upcoming flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First flight should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'Third flight should be UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingungen zu schreiben, kann die Filterlogik direkt im Ausdruck definiert werden. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich und ist besonders nützlich für komplexe Filterkriterien.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Date Calculation, sflights, Table Expressions

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chaining) in einer funktionalen Weise, um eine Reihe von Operationen auf einem Objekt auszuführen. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen String schrittweise modifiziert.
hint: Methoden, die `ME->` zurückgeben, ermöglichen das Chaining.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS append IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS prepend IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD append.
    mv_string = mv_string && iv_text.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD prepend.
    mv_string = iv_text && mv_string.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_string = to_upper( mv_string ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_string_builder( 'Hello' ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->append( ' World' )->to_upper( )->prepend( 'ABAP: ' )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABAP: HELLO WORLD' msg = 'Method chaining result incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten, was den Code flüssiger und lesbarer macht. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME->`) zurückgibt. Dieses funktionale Programmierparadigma verbessert die Ausdruckskraft des Codes und ist ein Merkmal moderner objektorientierter Entwicklung.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Functional Programming, String Manipulation

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch Daten aus einer beliebigen Datenbanktabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellennamen und einer WHERE-Klausel. Die Ergebnisse sollen in einer dynamisch erzeugten internen Tabelle gespeichert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und `SELECT ... FROM (...)` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        iv_where_clause TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_data> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_table_name).
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_data>.

    DATA(lv_select_statement) = |SELECT * FROM { iv_table_name }|.
    IF iv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_select_statement = |{ lv_select_statement } WHERE { iv_where_clause }|.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_select_statement } INTO TABLE @<lt_data>
        ENDEXEC.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_dyn_prg_error=>dynamic_sql_error
            previous = lx_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_read_sflights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_sflights_where FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_sflights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_reader( ).
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_reader->read_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHTS' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_sflights>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_sflights> msg = 'Should read data from SFLIGHTS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflights> ) exp = 0 msg = 'SFLIGHTS should not be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_sflights_where.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_reader( ).
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_reader->read_dynamic_table( iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHTS' iv_where_clause = "carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'" ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_sflights>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_sflights> msg = 'Should read filtered data from SFLIGHTS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflights> ) exp = 0 msg = 'Filtered SFLIGHTS should not be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert fortgeschrittene dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Es verwendet `CREATE DATA` zur Laufzeit, um eine interne Tabelle eines beliebigen Typs zu erzeugen, und `EXEC SQL` für dynamisches Open SQL. Dies ist nützlich für generische Datenzugriffsschichten oder Tools, die mit unbekannten Tabellenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Die Verwendung von Field-Symbols ist hierbei unerlässlich.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Open SQL, CREATE DATA, Field-Symbols, Database Access

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage in der Zukunft liegt, und das Datum, das 60 Tage in der Vergangenheit liegt, unter Verwendung der Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp`.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calculator( ).

Anstatt manuelle Additionen oder Subtraktionen auf `sy-datum` durchzuführen, die zu Fehlern führen können (z.B. bei Monats- oder Jahreswechseln), ermöglichen die Methoden `add_days` und `subtract_days` eine sichere und präzise Berechnung. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Factory-Methode, die verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter zurückgibt. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einem Interface für die Flugdatenausgabe.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein Interface und eine Factory-Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die `NEW` mit dem Interface-Typ verwendet.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_output.
  METHODS get_formatted_flight_info
    IMPORTING
      is_sflight TYPE sflights
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_output_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_output_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_output~get_formatted_flight_info.
    rv_output = |Flug { is_sflight-carrid } { is_sflight-connid } am { is_sflight-fldate } ({ is_sflight-planetype })|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_output_detailed DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_output_detailed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_output~get_formatted_flight_info.
    rv_output = |Flug { is_sflight-carrid } { is_sflight-connid } am { is_sflight-fldate } mit { is_sflight-seatsocc }/{ is_sflight-seatsmax } Sitzen ({ is_sflight-planetype })|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_output_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_output_handler
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_handler) TYPE REF TO zif_flight_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_output_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_output_handler.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'SIMPLE'.
        ro_handler = NEW zcl_flight_output_simple( ).
      WHEN 'DETAILED'.
        ro_handler = NEW zcl_flight_output_detailed( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        ro_handler = NEW zcl_flight_output_simple( ). " Default
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_factory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-planetype = 'A320'.
    ls_sflight-seatsocc = 100.
    ls_sflight-seatsmax = 150.

    DATA(lo_simple_handler) = zcl_flight_output_factory=>create_output_handler( 'SIMPLE' ).
    DATA(lv_simple_output) = lo_simple_handler->get_formatted_flight_info( ls_sflight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_simple_output exp = |Flug LH 0400 am { sy-datum } (A320)| msg = 'Simple output incorrect' ).

    DATA(lo_detailed_handler) = zcl_flight_output_factory=>create_output_handler( 'DETAILED' ).
    DATA(lv_detailed_output) = lo_detailed_handler->get_formatted_flight_info( ls_sflight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_detailed_output exp = |Flug LH 0400 am { sy-datum } mit 100/150 Sitzen (A320)| msg = 'Detailed output incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory-Pattern ist ein grundlegendes Entwurfsmuster in der objektorientierten Programmierung. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine Factory-Klasse (`zcl_flight_output_factory`) verwendet werden kann, um Instanzen verschiedener Implementierungen eines Interfaces (`zif_flight_output`) zu erzeugen, ohne dass der Client die konkreten Klassen kennen muss. Dies fördert die Entkopplung und Flexibilität des Codes, da neue Implementierungen hinzugefügt werden können, ohne die aufrufende Logik ändern zu müssen.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Interface, Polymorphism

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `FOR`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ... ( VALUE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_summary.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights
                          GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid, connid = ls_group-connid ) ASCENDING
                          ( carrid      = ls_group-carrid,
                            connid      = ls_group-connid,
                            total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' seatsocc = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 75 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 groups' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_0400) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_0400-total_seats exp = 150 msg = 'LH 0400 total seats incorrect' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_0010) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_0010-total_seats exp = 200 msg = 'AA 0010 total seats incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`-Syntax in ABAP 7.50 ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und temporären Tabellen durch einen einzigen, gut lesbaren Ausdruck. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird der Code extrem kompakt und effizient.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit 5 zufälligen Flugnummern. Jede Flugnummer soll ein 8-stelliger String sein, bestehend aus Großbuchstaben (A-Z) und Ziffern (0-9).
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` für die Zeichenauswahl und String-Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flight_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_random_flight_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE tt_flight_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_flight_numbers.
    DATA(lv_chars) = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_char_count) = strlen( lv_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = lv_char_count - 1 ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_flight_number) = ``.
      DO 8 TIMES.
        DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
        lv_flight_number = lv_flight_number && lv_chars+lv_random_index(1).
      ENDDO.
      APPEND lv_flight_number TO rt_flight_numbers.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere alle Flüge aus `sflights`, deren Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit liegt, und weise ihnen einen Status 'Completed' zu, ansonsten 'Scheduled'. Nutze `FILTER` und `COND`.
hint: Verwende `FILTER` für die Tabellenfilterung und `FOR` mit `COND` für die bedingte Statuszuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                             connid = ls_sflight-connid
                             fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                             status = COND string(
                                        WHEN ls_sflight-fldate < sy-datum THEN 'Completed'
                                        ELSE 'Scheduled'
                                      )
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status_assignment.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein', operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_equal ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate < sy-datum.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Completed' msg = 'Vergangene Flüge sollten Completed sein' ).
      ELSE.

Innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks wird `COND` verwendet, um den Status 'Completed' oder 'Scheduled' basierend auf dem Flugdatum zuzuweisen.
