explanation: Die Verwendung von klassenbasierten Ausnahmen (`zcx_division_by_zero` erbt von `cx_static_check`) ist der moderne Standard für die Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht eine klare Trennung von Fehlererkennung und Fehlerbehandlung und verbessert die Robustheit und Wartbarkeit des Codes im Vergleich zu traditionellen `SY-SUBRC`-Prüfungen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Logger) über den Konstruktor injiziert bekommt. Die Klasse soll `FINAL` sein und die injizierte Abhängigkeit nutzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FINAL`-Zusatz für die Klasse und `IMPORTING` im Konstruktor für die Injektion.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a log file or console.
    " For demo, we just simulate it.
    WRITE: / 'LOG:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING iv_data TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_logger = io_logger.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    mo_logger->log_message( |Processing data: { iv_data }| ).
    " ... further processing ...
    mo_logger->log_message( |Data '{ iv_data }' processed successfully.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_service_processor( io_logger = lo_logger ).

    " We can't directly assert console output, but we can check if the method runs without error.
    " In a real test, you'd mock the logger to capture its calls.
    lo_processor->process_data( 'Testdaten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Service processor executed with logger.' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt Dependency Injection über den Konstruktor, ein zentrales Prinzip der modernen Objektorientierung. Die Klasse `zcl_service_processor` erhält ihre Abhängigkeit (`zif_logger`) von außen, anstatt sie selbst zu instanziieren. Dies fördert lose Kopplung, erleichtert das Testen (durch Mocking) und erhöht die Flexibilität. Der `FINAL`-Zusatz verhindert die Vererbung der Klasse und signalisiert, dass sie als abgeschlossen betrachtet wird.
keywords: Object Orientation, Dependency Injection, Constructor, FINAL, Interface, Logger

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und eine bestimmte Flugverbindung haben. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine prägnante Syntax für die Filterung interner Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_adv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_key
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_adv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_key.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
                                      AND connid = is_flight_key-connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ). " Expecting one flight for AA 0017
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie alle doppelten Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne String-Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und `CONDENSE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces and replace multiple spaces with single space
    rv_cleaned_string = REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_temp WITH ' '.
    rv_cleaned_string = CONV string( CONDENSE( rv_cleaned_string ) ).

    " Final trim for leading/trailing spaces (CONDENSE might leave one leading space if original had it)
    rv_cleaned_string = |{ rv_cleaned_string ALPHA = IN }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_clean_string_normal FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_clean_string_with_multiple_spaces FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_clean_string_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_clean_string_only_spaces FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_string_normal.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_string( '  Hello World  ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_clean_string_with_multiple_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_string( '  This   is    a   test  ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'This is a test' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_clean_string_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_string( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_clean_string_only_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_string( '     ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN ... WITH ' '` und `CONDENSE` ist eine effiziente Methode zur String-Bereinigung. Der Regex ersetzt alle Sequenzen von Leerzeichen (inkl. Tabs, Zeilenumbrüche) durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen. `CONDENSE` entfernt dann führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen und ersetzt interne Mehrfachleerzeichen durch Einzelne. Die abschließende `ALPHA = IN` Option im String-Template stellt sicher, dass auch nachfolgende Leerzeichen entfernt werden, die `CONDENSE` bei String-Typen manchmal belässt.
keywords: String Processing, Regex, REPLACE, CONDENSE, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) in eine neue Tabelle umwandelt, wobei nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthalten sind und Duplikate entfernt werden. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit einem `SET`-Typ.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` mit einem `HASHED TABLE` oder `SORTED TABLE` um Duplikate automatisch zu entfernen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_unique_flight_keys TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_key
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_unique_flight_keys

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE` um Flüge aus SFLIGHTS in Paketen zu verarbeiten. Demonstrieren Sie die Verarbeitung von 2 Paketen zu je 5 Zeilen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD ... FOR SELECT ... PACKAGE SIZE ... FETCH NEXT CURSOR ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING iv_package_size TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_package TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO 2 TIMES. " Process 2 packages
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor
        INTO TABLE @lt_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_processed_data.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_package_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_package_processing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_package( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights_in_packages( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 10 ).

    " Verify content (optional, depending on test data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result[ 10 ]-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `OPEN CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE` ist eine effiziente Methode, um sehr große Datenmengen in Blöcken zu verarbeiten, ohne den gesamten Datensatz in den Arbeitsspeicher zu laden. `WITH HOLD` hält den Cursor über Commits hinweg offen. Die Inline-Deklaration `@lt_package` vereinfacht den Code.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, PACKAGE SIZE, Database Cursor, Large Data, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine gegebene Liste von Flügen. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE ... INIT ... FOR ... NEXT ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = 300 currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 600 ).

    CLEAR lt_test_flights.
    lv_total = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen oder anderen Iteratoren in einer einzigen Anweisung. Er ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung, das explizite `LOOP` und `SUM` Anweisungen oft überflüssig macht und den Code kompakter und lesbarer gestaltet.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, Math

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in einer internen Tabelle existiert, und geben Sie gegebenenfalls dessen Index zurück. Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS( itab[ KEY ... ] )` und `LINE_INDEX( itab[ KEY ... ] )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_exists_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS find_flight_index
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
                iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
                iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_index.
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE ty_sflight_key( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ).

    IF LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      rv_index = LINE_INDEX( it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
    ELSE.
      rv_index = 0. " Not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_flight.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_line_exists_index=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_line_exists_index( ).

    DATA(lv_index_found) = lo_cut->find_flight_index( it_flights = lt_test_flights
                                                      iv_carrid  = 'LH'
                                                      iv_connid  = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index_found exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lv_index_not_found) = lo_cut->find_flight_index( it_flights = lt_test_flights
                                                          iv_carrid  = 'XX'
                                                          iv_connid  = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index_not_found exp = 0 ).

    DATA(lv_index_found_first) = lo_cut->find_flight_index( it_flights = lt_test_flights
                                                            iv_carrid  = 'AA'
                                                            iv_connid  = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index_found_first exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` sind funktionale Ausdrücke, die einen effizienten und lesbaren Zugriff auf Zeilen in internen Tabellen ermöglichen, insbesondere bei Verwendung von Tabellenschlüsseln. Sie ersetzen oft explizite `READ TABLE` Anweisungen und sind Teil des modernen ABAP für die interne Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Internal Tables, Lookup, Table Key

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HelloWorld' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Ranges-Tabelle, deren Feldname und Werte zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_range_table`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_range_table` und `ASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_ranges DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_range
      IMPORTING iv_fieldname TYPE fieldname
                it_values    TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_range) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_ranges IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_range.
    DATA: lr_range_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_type  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    " Define the structure of a range line (SIGN, OPTION, LOW, HIGH)
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'SIGN'   type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( 1 ) ) TO lt_components.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'OPTION' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( 2 ) ) TO lt_components.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'LOW'    type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( iv_fieldname ) ) TO lt_components.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'HIGH'   type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( iv_fieldname ) ) TO lt_components.

    lr_line_type = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lr_range_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_line_type
                                                p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                                p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_range TYPE HANDLE lr_range_type.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_range_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_range->* TO <fs_range_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_range_line> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA <fs_range_line> TYPE HANDLE lr_line_type.

    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      ASSIGN <fs_range_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line_wa>).
      <fs_line_wa>-sign = 'I'.
      <fs_line_wa>-option = 'EQ'.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'LOW' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line_wa> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_low>).
      <fs_low> = lv_value.
      APPEND <fs_line_wa> TO <fs_range_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_range_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_range_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_ranges( ).
    DATA(lt_test_values) = VALUE string_table( ( 'AA' ) ( 'LH' ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_range) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_range( iv_fieldname = 'S_CARR_ID' it_values = lt_test_values ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_range_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_range->* TO <fs_range_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_range_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_range_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_range_line> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN <fs_range_table>[ 1 ] TO <fs_range_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_range_line>-sign exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_range_line>-option exp = 'EQ' ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'LOW' OF STRUCTURE <fs_range_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_low>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_low> exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung einer Ranges-Tabelle zur Laufzeit, was für generische Services wie `FS_BP_AL_GENERIC_SERVICES` unerlässlich sein kann. Es verwendet RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) über `cl_abap_elemdescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` sowie `CREATE DATA` und `ASSIGN` für den dynamischen Zugriff. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature für hochflexible Anwendungen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Ranges, CREATE DATA, ASSIGN, cl_abap_dyn_prg

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' enthält, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE #( )` für die Filterung und Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_lh_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_lh_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                  connid = flight-connid,
                                  fldate = flight-fldate,
                                  planetype = flight-planetype ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'All flights should be LH' act = ( NOT line_exists( lt_result[ carrid <> 'LH' ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine kompakte und deklarative Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt einer expliziten `LOOP` und `APPEND`, wird die neue Tabelle in einem einzigen Ausdruck erstellt, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filter, Transformation

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Annulliert') basierend auf einer Bedingung (z.B. Verspätung in Minuten), unter Verwendung eines `COND`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND` Operator, um einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_delay_minutes TYPE i
        iv_is_cancelled  TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_is_cancelled = abap_true THEN 'Annulliert'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 60      THEN 'Stark verspätet'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 0       THEN 'Verspätet'
      ELSE 'Pünktlich' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Annulliert' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 0 iv_is_cancelled = abap_true ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Stark verspätet' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 90 iv_is_cancelled = abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Verspätet' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 15 iv_is_cancelled = abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Pünktlich' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 0 iv_is_cancelled = abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf einer Reihe von Bedingungen in einem einzigen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen und führt zu kürzerem, klarerem und funktionalerem Code.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` für den Startwert und `NEXT` für die Aggregationslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_flights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO @lv_expected_sum.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( iv_carrid = lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = lv_expected_sum act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einem funktionalen Stil. Er ist eine moderne und prägnante Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit Akkumulatorvariablen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit bei Aggregationsaufgaben.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Entwerfen Sie eine Klasse, die Methoden-Chaining ermöglicht, um eine Reihe von Konfigurationsoperationen auf einem Objekt auszuführen (Builder-Pattern).
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden, die gechained werden sollen, `ME` zurück, um die Instanz für weitere Aufrufe bereitzustellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_config_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_setting1 TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA: mv_setting2 TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS set_setting1
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_builder.

    METHODS set_setting2
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_builder.

    METHODS build
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_config) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_builder.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_setting1.
    me->mv_setting1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein ungültiger Flugnummernbereich übergeben wird, und behandeln Sie diese Ausnahme mit `TRY...CATCH`.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_range DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_range IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_max_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_range.

    METHODS process_flight_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_max_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_range.
    IF iv_min_connid > iv_max_connid.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_range
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_flight_range=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_flight_range.
    TRY.
        me->validate_flight_range( iv_min_connid = iv_min_connid
                                   iv_max_connid = iv_max_connid ).
        rv_message = |Flugnummernbereich { iv_min_connid } bis { iv_max_connid } ist gültig.|.
    CATCH zcx_invalid_flight_range.
        rv_message = |Fehler: Ungültiger Flugnummernbereich. Minimale ID ({ iv_min_connid }) ist größer als maximale ID ({ iv_max_connid }).|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach einem bestimmten Flugzeugtyp und geben Sie nur die Flugnummern zurück, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )` und `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_by_plane DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_by_planetype
      IMPORTING
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_by_plane IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_by_planetype.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_sflight( lt_all_flights WHERE planetype = iv_planetype ).

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights ( flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_planetype) = 'A310'.

    SELECT connid FROM sflight WHERE planetype = @lv_planetype INTO TABLE @lt_expected_connids.

    DATA(lt_result_connids) = lo_cut->get_connids_by_planetype( iv_planetype = lv_planetype ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = lines( lt_expected_connids ) act = lines( lt_result_connids ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_expected_connids INTO DATA(lv_expected_connid).

    ENDLOOP.

In Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und einer `FOR`-Schleife kann man die gefilterten Daten direkt in eine neue Struktur oder Tabelle transformieren. Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Feldes einer Struktur (z.B. `SFLIGHT-CARRID`) zur Laufzeit unter Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und ihre Unterklassen wie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_type_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
        iv_field_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type_info.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_data_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.
    DATA: ls_component    TYPE abap_compdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        READ TABLE lo_struct_descr->components INTO ls_component WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_data_descr ?= ls_component-type_descr.
          rv_type_info = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' hat Typ '{ lo_data_descr->type_kind }' (Länge: { lo_data_descr->length }).|.
        ELSE.
          rv_type_info = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht in Struktur '{ iv_struct_name }' gefunden.|.
        ENDIF.
    CATCH cx_sy_unknown_descr.
        rv_type_info = |Struktur '{ iv_struct_name }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere funktionale Operationen (Filterung, Transformation, Aggregation) auf einer internen Tabelle von Flügen, um die durchschnittliche Auslastung der Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER`, `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` in einer Kette von Ausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_analytics DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analytics IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lt_relevant_flights) = FILTER tt_sflight( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax > 0 ).

    IF lt_relevant_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_occupancy) = REDUCE f( INIT sum_occ = 0.0
                                         FOR flight IN lt_relevant_flights
                                         NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + ( CONV f( flight-seatsocc ) / flight-seatsmax ) ).

    rv_avg_occupancy = lv_total_occupancy / lines( lt_relevant_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_avg_occupancy_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_avg_occupancy_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_avg_occupancy_no_max_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_occupancy_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_analytics( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum_ratio) = 0.0.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.
    SELECT seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND seatsmax > 0 INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_db_flights).
    LOOP AT lt_db_flights INTO DATA(ls_db_flight).
      lv_expected_sum_ratio = lv_expected_sum_ratio + ( CONV f( ls_db_flight-seatsocc ) / ls_db_flight-seatsmax ).
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_expected_avg) = COND f( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_expected_sum_ratio / lv_count ELSE 0.0 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_occupancy( iv_carrid = lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = lv_expected_avg act = lv_result delta = '0.001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_occupancy_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_analytics( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_occupancy( iv_carrid = 'XX' ). " Non-existent airline
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 0.0 act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_occupancy_no_max_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_analytics( ).
    " Assuming there might be flights with seatsmax = 0 or no flights for a specific carrier
    " This test case needs to be carefully designed if sflight always has seatsmax > 0
    " For demonstration, let's assume 'SQ' might have such data or no data
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_occupancy( iv_carrid = 'SQ' ).
    " The actual expected value depends on the SFLIGHT data for 'SQ'
    " If 'SQ' has no flights or all seatsmax=0, result should be 0.0
    " If 'SQ' has valid flights, it should be calculated.
    " For now, just assert it's not an error.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_result >= 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit funktionaler Programmierung in ABAP durch die Verkettung von `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Es ermöglicht die Durchführung komplexer Datenmanipulationen und Aggregationen in einer sehr prägnanten und ausdrucksstarken Weise, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert. Dies ist ein Kernmerkmal von modernem ABAP ab Version 7.40/7.50.
keywords: Functional Programming, FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Chaining

CLASS zcl_abap_group_by_members DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und finden Sie den Durchschnitt der gebuchten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit der Aggregatfunktion `AVG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_group_by_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_booked_seats,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_booked_seats TYPE f,
           END OF ty_avg_booked_seats.
    METHODS get_avg_booked_seats
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_booked_seats) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_booked_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group_by_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_booked_seats.
    rt_avg_booked_seats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights
                                   GROUP BY flight-carrid
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                     avg_booked_seats = AVG( flight-bookedseats ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_avg_booked_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_booked_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-bookedseats = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-bookedseats = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-bookedseats = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-bookedseats = 100.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_group_by_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_booked_seats( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-avg_booked_seats exp = 75.0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-avg_booked_seats exp = 150.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `AVG` Aggregatfunktion in `FOR GROUPS` berechnet den Durchschnittswert eines numerischen Feldes für jede Gruppe. Dies ist eine weitere leistungsstarke Funktion für die Datenanalyse direkt in ABAP.
keywords: GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, AVG, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

CLASS zcl_abap_group_nested_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             bookedseats TYPE sflight-bookedseats,

                                    flights = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP flight

                                                         bookedseats = member-bookedseats ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_period_current IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_period_info.
    TRY.
        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_current_period(

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Geschäftsperiode für ein gegebenes Datum (z.B. '20251201') unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS` und geben Sie das Ergebnis aus. Fangen Sie Fehler ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie die statische Methode `GET_PERIOD_FOR_DATE` und behandeln Sie Ausnahmen mit `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_for_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_period_for_date_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_for_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_period_for_date_info.
    TRY.
        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_for_date(
          EXPORTING
            iv_date    = iv_date
          IMPORTING
            ev_gjahr   = DATA(lv_gjahr)
            ev_perio   = DATA(lv_perio)
        ).
        rv_info = |Datum { iv_date DATE = USER } liegt in Geschäftsjahr: { lv_gjahr }, Periode: { lv_perio ALPHA = OUT }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_info = |Fehler beim Ermitteln der Periode für Datum { iv_date DATE = USER }: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_table_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_data,
             gjahr     TYPE gjahr,
             perio     TYPE perio,
             start_date TYPE sy-datum,
             end_date   TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_period_data.
    TYPES tt_period_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_three_periods
      IMPORTING
        iv_gjahr TYPE gjahr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_periods) TYPE tt_period_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_table_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_three_periods.
    rt_periods = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 3
                          LET lv_gjahr = iv_gjahr
                              lv_perio = |{ i ALPHA = OUT }|
                          IN
                          ( TRY.
                                cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_dates(
                                  EXPORTING
                                    iv_gjahr   = lv_gjahr
                                    iv_perio   = lv_perio
                                  IMPORTING
                                    ev_start_date = DATA(lv_start_date)
                                    ev_end_date   = DATA(lv_end_date)
                                ).
                                ( gjahr = lv_gjahr, perio = lv_perio, start_date = lv_start_date, end_date = lv_end_date )
                              CATCH cx_root.
                                ( gjahr = lv_gjahr, perio = lv_perio, start_date = '00000000', end_date = '00000000' ) " Fehlerfall
                            ENDTRY ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Tage im ersten Quartal eines Jahres (z.B. 2025) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators und `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_period_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_q1_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_gjahr TYPE gjahr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_q1_days.
    rv_total_days = REDUCE i( INIT days = 0
                              FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 3
                              LET lv_perio = |{ i ALPHA = OUT }|
                              IN
                              ( days = days + 
                                ( TRY.
                                      cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_dates(
                                        EXPORTING
                                          iv_gjahr   = iv_gjahr
                                          iv_perio   = lv_perio
                                        IMPORTING
                                          ev_start_date = DATA(lv_start_date)
                                          ev_end_date   = DATA(lv_end_date)
                                      ).
                                      cl_abap_date_helper=>num_of_days_between( iv_date1 = lv_start_date iv_date2 = lv_end_date ) + 1
                                    CATCH cx_root.
                                      0 " Im Fehlerfall 0 Tage hinzufügen
                                  ENDTRY ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_days) = lo_cut->calculate_q1_days( '2025' ).
    " 2025 ist kein Schaltjahr. Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mär (31) = 90 Tage
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Gesamttage für Q1 2025 sollten 90 sein' act = lv_total_days exp = 90 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die mehrere Aufrufe der `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS` Klasse verkettet und dabei eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` und `WHEN OTHERS` für jeden Schritt sicherstellt. Die Methode soll das Startdatum der aktuellen Periode ermitteln und dann das Enddatum der nächsten Periode.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke oder eine zentrale Fehlerbehandlung nach jedem Schritt, um die Kette von Operationen abzusichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_chained_period_dates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_chained_period_dates.
    DATA: lv_current_gjahr TYPE gjahr,
          lv_current_perio TYPE perio,
          lv_start_date    TYPE sy-datum,
          lv_next_gjahr    TYPE gjahr,
          lv_next_perio    TYPE perio,
          lv_end_date      TYPE sy-datum.

    TRY.
        " 1. Aktuelle Periode ermitteln
        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_current_period(
          IMPORTING
            ev_gjahr = lv_current_gjahr
            ev_perio = lv_current_perio
        ).

        " 2. Startdatum der aktuellen Periode ermitteln
        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_dates(
          EXPORTING
            iv_gjahr      = lv_current_gjahr
            iv_perio      = lv_current_perio
          IMPORTING
            ev_start_date = lv_start_date
        ).

        " 3. Nächste Periode ermitteln (Beispiel: +1 Monat)
        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>add_months_to_date(
          EXPORTING
            iv_date  = lv_start_date
            iv_months = 1
          IMPORTING
            ev_date  = DATA(lv_date_in_next_period)
        ).

        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_for_date(
          EXPORTING
            iv_date    = lv_date_in_next_period
          IMPORTING
            ev_gjahr   = lv_next_gjahr
            ev_perio   = lv_next_perio
        ).

        " 4. Enddatum der nächsten Periode ermitteln
        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_dates(
          EXPORTING
            iv_gjahr    = lv_next_gjahr
            iv_perio    = lv_next_perio
          IMPORTING
            ev_end_date = lv_end_date
        ).

        rv_info = |Aktuelle Periode { lv_current_perio ALPHA = OUT }/{ lv_current_gjahr } Start: { lv_start_date DATE = USER }. Nächste Periode { lv_next_perio ALPHA = OUT }/{ lv_next_gjahr } Ende: { lv_end_date DATE = USER }|.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_info = |Fehler in der Perioden-Kette: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie mit dem `COND` Operator, ob ein gegebenes Datum in der aktuellen Geschäftsperiode liegt. Geben Sie 'Ja' oder 'Nein' zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` in Kombination mit `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS=>GET_PERIOD_FOR_DATE` und `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS=>GET_CURRENT_PERIOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_date_in_current_period
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_date_in_current_period.
    DATA: lv_current_gjahr TYPE gjahr,
          lv_current_perio TYPE perio,
          lv_date_gjahr    TYPE gjahr,
          lv_date_perio    TYPE perio.

    TRY.
        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_current_period(
          IMPORTING
            ev_gjahr = lv_current_gjahr
            ev_perio = lv_current_perio
        ).

        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_for_date(
          EXPORTING
            iv_date    = iv_date
          IMPORTING
            ev_gjahr   = lv_date_gjahr
            ev_perio   = lv_date_perio
        ).

        rv_result = COND string(
                      WHEN lv_current_gjahr = lv_date_gjahr AND lv_current_perio = lv_date_perio
                        THEN 'Ja'
                      ELSE 'Nein' ).

      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_result = 'Fehler bei der Periodenprüfung'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage in einer gegebenen Geschäftsperiode (z.B. 2025, Periode 1) unter Verwendung von `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS` und einer Schleife mit `REDUCE` oder `FOR`.
hint: Ermitteln Sie Start- und Enddatum der Periode und iterieren Sie dann über die Tage, um Arbeitstage zu zählen. Nutzen Sie `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS=>IS_WORKDAY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_workdays_in_period
      IMPORTING
        iv_gjahr TYPE gjahr
        iv_perio TYPE perio
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_workdays_in_period.
    DATA: lv_start_date TYPE sy-datum,
          lv_end_date   TYPE sy-datum.

    TRY.
        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_dates(
          EXPORTING
            iv_gjahr      = iv_gjahr
            iv_perio      = iv_perio
          IMPORTING
            ev_start_date = lv_start_date
            ev_end_date   = lv_end_date
        ).

        rv_workdays = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                FOR d = lv_start_date THEN d + 1 UNTIL d > lv_end_date
                                IN
                                ( count = count + COND #( WHEN cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>is_workday( d ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_workdays = 0. " Im Fehlerfall 0 Arbeitstage
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Methode, die basierend auf einer Eingabe (z.B. 'CURRENT' oder 'FOR_DATE') die entsprechende `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS` Methode aufruft und das Ergebnis zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN OTHERS` für unbekannte Eingaben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` für die Auswahl der Methode und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung. Dynamische Methodenaufrufe sind hier nicht direkt nötig, da die Auswahl über `CASE` erfolgt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_period_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_period_function
      IMPORTING
        iv_function_name TYPE string
        iv_date          TYPE sy-datum OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_period_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_period_function.
    DATA: lv_gjahr TYPE gjahr,
          lv_perio TYPE perio.

    TRY.
        CASE iv_function_name.
          WHEN 'CURRENT'.
            cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_current_period(
              IMPORTING
                ev_gjahr = lv_gjahr
                ev_perio = lv_perio
            ).
            rv_result = |Aktuelle Periode: { lv_gjahr }/{ lv_perio ALPHA = OUT }|.

          WHEN 'FOR_DATE'.
            IF iv_date IS INITIAL.
              RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value.
            ENDIF.
            cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_for_date(
              EXPORTING
                iv_date    = iv_date
              IMPORTING
                ev_gjahr   = lv_gjahr
                ev_perio   = lv_perio
            ).
            rv_result = |Periode für { iv_date DATE = USER }: { lv_gjahr }/{ lv_perio ALPHA = OUT }|.

          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_result = |Unbekannte Funktion: { iv_function_name }|.
        ENDCASE.

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        rv_result = |Fehler: Datum für 'FOR_DATE' fehlt. { lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die die `BS_PERIOD_API` kapselt und eine Methode `get_period_details` bereitstellt. Diese Methode soll das Geschäftsjahr, die Periode, das Start- und Enddatum für ein gegebenes Datum zurückgeben. Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung innerhalb der Methode.
hint: Kapseln Sie die Aufrufe von `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS` in einer eigenen Klasse und verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_period_service.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_details,
           gjahr      TYPE gjahr,
           perio      TYPE perio,
           start_date TYPE sy-datum,
           end_date   TYPE sy-datum,
         END OF ty_period_details.

  METHODS get_period_details
    IMPORTING
      iv_date TYPE sy-datum
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_details) TYPE ty_period_details
    RAISING
      cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_period_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_period_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_period_service~get_period_details.
    DATA: lv_gjahr TYPE gjahr,
          lv_perio TYPE perio.

    TRY.
        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_for_date(
          EXPORTING
            iv_date    = iv_date
          IMPORTING
            ev_gjahr   = lv_gjahr
            ev_perio   = lv_perio
        ).

        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_dates(
          EXPORTING
            iv_gjahr      = lv_gjahr
            iv_perio      = lv_perio
          IMPORTING
            ev_start_date = rs_details-start_date
            ev_end_date   = rs_details-end_date
        ).

        rs_details-gjahr = lv_gjahr.
        rs_details-perio = lv_perio.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Spezifischere Fehlerbehandlung oder Weiterleitung der Ausnahme
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value
            previous = lx_root.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Geschäftsjahr und -periode des Flugdatums. Ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis. Nutzen Sie `CL_BS_PERIOD_TOOLSET_BASICS` zur Periodenermittlung und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` und einer Unterabfrage oder einer temporären internen Tabelle zur Periodenermittlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_period_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             gjahr      TYPE gjahr,
             perio      TYPE perio,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_by_period
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_period_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_by_period.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                            GROUP BY ( gjahr = VALUE gjahr( TRY cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_for_date( EXPORTING iv_date = flight-fldate IMPORTING ev_gjahr = DATA(lv_gjahr) ) CATCH cx_root. '0000' ) )
                                       ( perio = VALUE perio( TRY cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_for_date( EXPORTING iv_date = flight-fldate IMPORTING ev_perio = DATA(lv_perio) ) CATCH cx_root. '00' ) )
                            IN
                            ( gjahr       = flight-gjahr
                              perio       = flight-perio
                              num_flights = GROUP SIZE
                              total_price = SUM( flight-price ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl iterativ mit einer WHILE-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und moderne Inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_factorial_while DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_factorial_while IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_result) = 1.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 1.

    WHILE lv_counter <= iv_number.
      lv_result = lv_result * lv_counter.
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_factorial = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Aufgaben (Strings) aus einer "Warteschlange", bis diese leer ist. Simulieren Sie dabei eine asynchrone Abarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife in Kombination mit `READ TABLE ... INDEX 1`, `DELETE ... INDEX 1` und `WAIT UP TO` für die Simulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_queue_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_queue
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_tasks TYPE tt_tasks
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_tasks) TYPE tt_tasks.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_queue_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA(lt_task_queue) = it_initial_tasks.
    DATA(lv_task)       TYPE string.

    WHILE lt_task_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_task_queue INDEX 1 INTO lv_task.
      DELETE lt_task_queue INDEX 1.

      " Simulate processing time
      WAIT UP TO '0.01' SECONDS.

      APPEND lv_task TO rt_processed_tasks.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_queue_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_tasks) = VALUE zcl_queue_processor=>tt_tasks( ( 'Task A' ) ( 'Task B' ) ( 'Task C' ) ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_queue( lt_initial_tasks ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 3 msg = 'All tasks should be processed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ] exp = 'Task A' msg = 'First task should be Task A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 3 ] exp = 'Task C' msg = 'Last task should be Task C' ).

    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_queue( lt_initial_tasks ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_processed msg = 'Empty queue should result in empty processed list' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INDEX 1` simuliert das Entnehmen von Elementen aus einer FIFO-Warteschlange. `WAIT UP TO` ist ein modernes Statement zur Simulation von Wartezeiten.

Instructions: Suchen Sie in der Tabelle `sflights` nach dem ersten Flug, dessen Preis einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet, und geben Sie das Flugdatum zurück. Brechen Sie die Suche ab, sobald der Flug gefunden wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `READ TABLE` und einer booleschen Variable.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_first_expensive_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_date) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_expensive_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.
    DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE sflight.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_sflights ) AND lv_found = abap_false.
      READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_index INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF ls_sflight-price > iv_max_price.
          rv_flight_date = ls_sflight-fldate.
          lv_found = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem String, die durch Leerzeichen getrennt sind, bis ein nicht-numerisches Zeichen oder das Ende des Strings erreicht ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `FIND REGEX` und `SUBSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS extract_leading_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_leading_numbers.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = 0.
    DATA(lv_current_string) = iv_input_string.

    WHILE lv_current_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      FIND REGEX '\d+' IN lv_current_string MATCH OFFSET lv_offset MATCH LENGTH lv_length.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_offset = 0. " Found a number at the beginning
        DATA(lv_number_str) = lv_current_string(lv_length).
        TRY.
            APPEND CONV i( lv_number_str ) TO rt_numbers.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Should not happen if regex is correct, but good practice
            EXIT.
        ENDTRY.
        lv_current_string = lv_current_string+lv_length.
        " Remove leading spaces for next iteration
        FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '\S' IN lv_current_string MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_current_string = lv_current_string+lv_offset.
        ELSE.
          CLEAR lv_current_string. " Only spaces left
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        EXIT. " No number at the beginning or no number found
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen einfachen Iterator, der eine Sequenz von Zahlen generiert, bis ein bestimmter Endwert erreicht ist. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife intern für die Generierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife in einer Methode, die den nächsten Wert zurückgibt und einen internen Zustand verwaltet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_start TYPE i
        iv_end   TYPE i.
    METHODS has_next
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_next) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_next
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_number) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current TYPE i.
    DATA mv_end     TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current = iv_start - 1. " Start before the first number
    mv_end     = iv_end.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD has_next.
    rv_has_next = COND abap_bool( WHEN mv_current < mv_end THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_next.
    IF NOT has_next( ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero. " Placeholder for 'no more elements'
    ENDIF.
    mv_current = mv_current + 1.
    rv_next_number = mv_current.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_iterator) = NEW zcl_number_iterator( iv_start = 1 iv_end = 3 ).

      APPEND lo_iterator->get_next( ) TO lt_result.
    ENDWHILE.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_iterator_empty.

    DATA(lt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    WHILE lo_iterator->has_next( ).
      APPEND lo_iterator->get_next( ) TO lt_result.
    ENDWHILE.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR'
      ACT = #( lo_iterator->get_next( ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine `WHILE`-Schleife verwendet werden kann, um einen benutzerdefinierten Iterator zu implementieren. Die `has_next`-Methode prüft die Bedingung, während `get_next` den nächsten Wert liefert und den internen Zustand aktualisiert. Die `WHILE`-Schleife im Testfall demonstriert die Nutzung des Iterators. `COND` ist ein moderner bedingter Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS serialize_dynamic_object

        io_object TYPE REF TO object

        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle in Batches von maximal 3 Zeilen pro Iteration, bis alle Zeilen verarbeitet wurden.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife in Kombination mit `LOOP AT ... FROM ... TO` und `DELETE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_batch_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_in_batches
      IMPORTING
        it_input_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_batch_size TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_batches) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_batch_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_in_batches.
    DATA(lt_remaining_data) = it_input_data.
    DATA(lv_current_batch_size) TYPE i.

    WHILE lt_remaining_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_current_batch_size = MIN( val1 = iv_batch_size val2 = lines( lt_remaining_data ) ).
      DATA(lt_current_batch) = VALUE tt_data( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lv_current_batch_size ( lt_remaining_data[ i ] ) ).
      APPEND lt_current_batch TO rt_processed_batches.
      DELETE lt_remaining_data FROM 1 TO lv_current_batch_size.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie alle doppelten Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings, bis der String keine weiteren Änderungen mehr erfährt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` und einer Bedingung, die prüft, ob sich der String geändert hat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    DATA(lv_current_string) = iv_input.
    DATA(lv_previous_string) = lv_current_string.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces first
    lv_current_string = |{ lv_current_string ALPHA = IN }|.

    WHILE abap_true.
      lv_previous_string = lv_current_string.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '  ' IN lv_current_string WITH ' '.
      IF lv_current_string = lv_previous_string.
        EXIT. " No more double spaces found
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_cleaned_string = lv_current_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_sflight_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen JSON-String schrittweise mit dem JSON-Writer, indem Sie einzelne Felder und Arrays hinzufügen.

CLASS zcl_json_streaming_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_json_stream
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_streaming_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_json_stream.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_writer( ).

    lo_writer->start_object( ).
      lo_writer->write_name( 'Header' ).
      lo_writer->start_object( ).
        lo_writer->write_name( 'DocId' ).
        lo_writer->write_value( 'STREAM_DOC_001' ).
        lo_writer->write_name( 'Date' ).
        lo_writer->write_value( sy-datum ).
      lo_writer->end_object( ).

      lo_writer->write_name( 'Items' ).
      lo_writer->start_array( ).
        lo_writer->start_object( ).
          lo_writer->write_name( 'ItemId' ).
          lo_writer->write_value( 10 ).
          lo_writer->write_name( 'Description' ).
          lo_writer->write_value( 'Item A' ).
        lo_writer->end_object( ).
        lo_writer->start_object( ).
          lo_writer->write_name( 'ItemId' ).
          lo_writer->write_value( 20 ).
          lo_writer->write_name( 'Description' ).
          lo_writer->write_value( 'Item B' ).
        lo_writer->end_object( ).
      lo_writer->end_array( ).
    lo_writer->end_object( ).

    rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_json( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alink_connection=>create_connection` und füllen Sie die Parameterstruktur `is_connection`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_create_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_data,
             object_type TYPE toav0-objtype,
             object_id   TYPE toav0-objkey,
             doc_type    TYPE toav0-doctyp,
             arc_doc_id  TYPE toav0-arc_doc_id,
             comp_id     TYPE toav0-comp_id,
             ar_object   TYPE toav0-ar_object,
           END OF ty_connection_data.

    METHODS simulate_create_connection
      IMPORTING
        is_input_data       TYPE ty_connection_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_output_data) TYPE ty_connection_data
      RAISING
        cx_alink_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_create_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_create_connection.
    DATA: ls_connection TYPE cl_alink_connection=>ty_s_connection.

    ls_connection-objtype = is_input_data-object_type.
    ls_connection-objkey  = is_input_data-object_id.
    ls_connection-doctyp  = is_input_data-doc_type.
    ls_connection-arc_doc_id = is_input_data-arc_doc_id.
    ls_connection-comp_id = is_input_data-comp_id.
    ls_connection-ar_object = is_input_data-ar_object.

    " In a real scenario, this would create the connection.
    " For simulation, we just return the input data as if it was created.
    " cl_alink_connection=>create_connection( EXPORTING is_connection = ls_connection ).

    rs_output_data = is_input_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_get_all_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object_key,
             object_type TYPE toav0-objtype,
             object_id   TYPE toav0-objkey,
           END OF ty_object_key.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_data,
             object_type TYPE toav0-objtype,
             object_id   TYPE toav0-objkey,
             doc_type    TYPE toav0-doctyp,
             arc_doc_id  TYPE toav0-arc_doc_id,
             comp_id     TYPE toav0-comp_id,
             ar_object   TYPE toav0-ar_object,
           END OF ty_connection_data.
    TYPES tt_connection_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS simulate_get_all_connections
      IMPORTING
        is_object_key       TYPE ty_object_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connections) TYPE tt_connection_data
      RAISING
        cx_alink_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_get_all_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_get_all_connections.
    DATA: ls_object_key TYPE cl_alink_connection=>ty_s_object_key.

    ls_object_key-objtype = is_object_key-object_type.
    ls_object_key-objkey  = is_object_key-object_id.

    " In a real scenario, this would fetch all connections.
    " For simulation, we return dummy data.
    " DATA(lt_result) = cl_alink_connection=>get_connections_for_object( EXPORTING is_object_key = ls_object_key ).

    rt_connections = VALUE tt_connection_data(
      ( object_type = is_object_key-object_type
        object_id   = is_object_key-object_id
        doc_type    = 'ZPDF'
        arc_doc_id  = 'ARCHIVEDOCID001'
        comp_id     = '0001'
        ar_object   = 'SD_ORDER' )
      ( object_type = is_object_key-object_type
        object_id   = is_object_key-object_id
        doc_type    = 'ZIMG'
        arc_doc_id  = 'ARCHIVEDOCID002'
        comp_id     = '0002'
        ar_object   = 'SD_ORDER_ATT' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_check_exists_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_key,
             object_type TYPE toav0-objtype,
             object_id   TYPE toav0-objkey,
             doc_type    TYPE toav0-doctyp,
             arc_doc_id  TYPE toav0-arc_doc_id,
           END OF ty_connection_key.

    METHODS simulate_check_exists
      IMPORTING
        is_key_data         TYPE ty_connection_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists)    TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_alink_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_check_exists_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_check_exists.
    DATA: ls_connection_key TYPE cl_alink_connection=>ty_s_connection_key.

    ls_connection_key-objtype = is_key_data-object_type.
    ls_connection_key-objkey  = is_key_data-object_id.
    ls_connection_key-doctyp  = is_key_data-doc_type.
    ls_connection_key-arc_doc_id = is_key_data-arc_doc_id.

    " In a real scenario, this would check for existence.
    " For simulation, we return true if arc_doc_id is not empty.
    " rv_exists = cl_alink_connection=>check_connection_exists( EXPORTING is_connection_key = ls_connection_key ).

    IF is_key_data-arc_doc_id IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_simulate_check_not_exists.
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_alink_check_exists_sim=>ty_connection_key(
      object_type = 'BUS2032'
      object_id   = '4500000001'
      doc_type    = 'ZPDF'
      arc_doc_id  = ''
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alink_check_exists_sim( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->simulate_check_exists( ls_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connection should not exist' act = lv_exists exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert die Überprüfung der Existenz einer ArchiveLink-Verbindung. Die Methode `check_connection_exists` von `cl_alink_connection` ist nützlich, um vor dem Versuch, eine Verbindung zu lesen oder zu löschen, zu prüfen, ob sie überhaupt vorhanden ist. Die Simulation basiert auf dem Vorhandensein der `arc_doc_id`.
keywords: ArchiveLink, Check, Exists, cl_alink_connection

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Abrufen von Metadaten für eine ArchiveLink-Verbindung, z.B. den Ablagezeitpunkt oder den Benutzer, der das Dokument abgelegt hat.
hint: Die Klasse `cl_alink_connection` bietet keine direkte Methode zum Abrufen von Metadaten. Dies würde normalerweise über die `TOA01` oder `TOA03` Tabellen oder spezifische Funktionsbausteine erfolgen. Hier wird eine Simulation der Datenrückgabe gezeigt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alink_get_metadata_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_key,
             object_type TYPE toav0-objtype,
             object_id   TYPE toav0-objkey,
             doc_type    TYPE toav0-doctyp,
             arc_doc_id  TYPE toav0-arc_doc_id,
           END OF ty_connection_key.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_metadata,
             arc_date TYPE d,
             arc_time TYPE t,
             arc_user TYPE syuname,
             status   TYPE toav0-status,
           END OF ty_metadata.

    METHODS simulate_get_metadata
      IMPORTING
        is_key_data         TYPE ty_connection_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_metadata)  TYPE ty_metadata
      RAISING
        cx_alink_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_get_metadata_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_get_metadata.
    " In a real scenario, metadata would be read from TOA01/TOA03 or via function modules.
    " cl_alink_connection itself focuses on connection management, not document metadata.
    " For simulation, we return dummy metadata based on the arc_doc_id.

    IF is_key_data-arc_doc_id IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_alink_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_alink_error=>connection_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    rs_metadata-arc_date = sy-datum - 10.
    rs_metadata-arc_time = '100000'.
    rs_metadata-arc_user = 'SIMUSER'.
    rs_metadata-status   = 'X'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_simulate_get_metadata FOR TESTING RAISING cx_alink_error.
    METHODS test_simulate_get_metadata_fail FOR TESTING RAISING cx_alink_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simulate_get_metadata.
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_alink_get_metadata_sim=>ty_connection_key(
      object_type = 'BUS2032'
      object_id   = '4500000001'
      doc_type    = 'ZPDF'
      arc_doc_id  = 'ARCHIVEDOCID123'
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alink_get_metadata_sim( ).
    DATA(ls_metadata) = lo_cut->simulate_get_metadata( ls_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Archiving user should be SIMUSER' act = ls_metadata-arc_user exp = 'SIMUSER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be X' act = ls_metadata-status exp = 'X' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_simulate_get_metadata_fail.
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_alink_get_metadata_sim=>ty_connection_key(
      object_type = 'BUS2032'
      object_id   = '4500000001'
      doc_type    = 'ZPDF'
      arc_doc_id  = ''
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alink_get_metadata_sim( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->simulate_get_metadata( ls_key ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_alink_error' ).
      CATCH cx_alink_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected cx_alink_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert das Abrufen von Metadaten für eine ArchiveLink-Verbindung. Es ist wichtig zu beachten, dass `cl_alink_connection` primär für die Verwaltung der *Verbindungen* zu Dokumenten zuständig ist, nicht für die Dokumenten-Metadaten selbst. Diese werden typischerweise aus den ArchiveLink-Tabellen (TOA01, TOA03) oder über andere Funktionsbausteine gelesen. Die Simulation zeigt, wie eine solche Metadatenabfrage konzeptionell aussehen könnte.
keywords: ArchiveLink, Metadata, Simulation, cl_alink_connection

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json` um einen JSON-String zu validieren, ohne ihn vollständig zu deserialisieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_fdt_json=>create_reader` und versuchen Sie, den JSON-String zu parsen. Eine erfolgreiche Instanziierung des Readers ohne Exception deutet auf gültiges JSON hin.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_json_string

        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_validate IMPLEMENTATION.

    TRY.
        cl_fdt_json=>create_reader( iv_json_string ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
