Tritt dabei keine `cx_fdt_json_error`-Exception auf, ist der JSON-String syntaktisch korrekt. Dies ist eine schnelle Methode zur Überprüfung der JSON-Gültigkeit, ohne die Daten vollständig in ABAP-Strukturen zu überführen.
keywords: JSON, Validation, Error Handling, cl_fdt_json

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) entgegennimmt und den Preis aller Flüge um 10% erhöht. Verwenden Sie dabei Field-Symbols für die effiziente Bearbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs>` und modifizieren Sie die Feld-Symbol-Komponente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dyn_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_prices
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE REF TO tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dyn_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices.
    CHECK io_sflights IS BOUND.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT io_sflights->* ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.10'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_initial_ref FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fld_dyn_table=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dyn_table( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_sflights_ref) = REF #(lt_sflights).
    lo_cut->increase_prices( io_sflights = lo_sflights_ref ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'Price should be increased by 10%' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_ref.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dyn_table( ).
    DATA: lo_sflights_ref TYPE REF TO zcl_fld_dyn_table=>tt_sflight. " Initial reference

    TRY.
        lo_cut->increase_prices( io_sflights = lo_sflights_ref ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_ref_is_initial exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught cx_sy_ref_is_initial' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Field-Symbols ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf die Daten einer internen Tabelle ohne Kopieren, was besonders bei großen Tabellen performanter ist. Hier wird ein `REF TO` verwendet, um die Tabelle als Referenz zu übergeben und innerhalb der Methode über das Dereferenzieren `->*` und ein Field-Symbol zu bearbeiten.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Performance, Reference

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige Variable vom Typ `data` entgegennimmt und deren Datentyp (z.B. 'C', 'I', 'P') sowie die Länge zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und die Attribute des zurückgegebenen Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_type_info,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             length    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_type_info.

    METHODS get_data_type_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_type_info) TYPE ty_type_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_type_info.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    rs_type_info-type_kind = lo_descr->type_kind.
    rs_type_info-length    = lo_descr->length.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_char_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_int_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_string_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_char_type.
    DATA: lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'Hello'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_info( ).
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_data_type_info( lv_char ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-length    exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_int_type.
    DATA: lv_int TYPE i VALUE 123.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_info( ).
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_data_type_info( lv_int ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-length    exp = 4 ). " Length of I is 4 bytes
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA: lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Test String'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_info( ).
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_data_type_info( lv_string ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_typedescr` und ihre Unterklassen ermöglichen die Laufzeit-Typidentifikation (RTTI). `describe_by_data` liefert ein Typbeschreibungsobjekt, über das man auf Metadaten wie `type_kind` und `length` zugreifen kann, um generische Datenverarbeitung zu ermöglichen.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_typedescr, Type Information, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine Struktur (z.B. SFLIGHT) und den Namen einer Komponente als String entgegennimmt. Die Methode soll den Wert dieser Komponente zurückgeben. Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols für den dynamischen Zugriff.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT <component_name> OF STRUCTURE <structure> TO <fs_component>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dyn_comp_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure    TYPE data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dyn_comp_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Component '{ iv_component_name }' not found or not accessible.|.
    ENDIF.
    rv_value = <fs_component>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_component FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_component FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_component.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dyn_comp_access( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_structure = ls_sflight iv_component_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    DATA(lv_connid) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_structure = ls_sflight iv_component_name = 'CONNID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_component.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dyn_comp_access( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_component_value( is_structure = ls_sflight iv_component_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught cx_sy_assign_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Befehl `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit. Dies ist nützlich für generische Programme, die Feldnamen als Parameter erhalten. Das Field-Symbol `<fs_component>` kann dann wie eine normale Variable verwendet werden.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Structure, Component Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige Struktur vom Typ `data` entgegennimmt und eine interne Tabelle mit den Namen aller ihrer Komponenten zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ) ).
    IF lo_struct_descr IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input is not a structure.'.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info( name = ls_component-name
                                      type_kind = ls_component-type->type_kind ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_components FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_structure_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_components.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_comps( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( ls_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'SFLIGHT should have components' act = COND #( WHEN lines( lt_components ) > 0 THEN '' ELSE 'X' ) ).
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'CARRID' INTO DATA(ls_comp_carrid).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp_carrid-type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char ).
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'CONNID' INTO DATA(ls_comp_connid).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp_connid-type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_structure_input.
    DATA: lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_comps( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_structure_components( lv_char ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_struct_descr_error exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught cx_sy_struct_descr_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_structdescr` (eine Unterklasse von `cl_abap_typedescr`) ist spezifisch für Strukturen. Mit `get_components` kann man eine Liste aller Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit abrufen, inklusive deren Namen und Typbeschreibungsobjekten. Dies ist essenziell für generische Datenverarbeitung und Metaprogrammierung.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, Structure, Components, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle entgegennimmt und die Anzahl der Zeilen zurückgibt. Die Methode soll generisch sein und mit jeder Art von interner Tabelle funktionieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE` und `LINES()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_any_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_line_count
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_any_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_line_count.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <fs_table>. " Not strictly necessary for LINES(), but good practice for generic access

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_count = lines( <fs_table> ).
    ELSE.
      rv_count = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Ein Field-Symbol vom Typ `ANY TABLE` ermöglicht dann den generischen Zugriff auf die Tabelle, z.B. um die Zeilenanzahl mit `LINES()` zu ermitteln. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Frameworks.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Namen einer Dictionary-Struktur (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') als String entgegennimmt und eine dynamisch erzeugte interne Tabelle dieses Typs zurückgibt. Die Tabelle soll mit einigen Beispieldaten gefüllt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_descr_error,
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ) ).
    IF lo_struct_descr IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_descr_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Structure '{ iv_struct_name }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                              p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
                              p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
                              p_unique     = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA ro_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    IF ro_table_ref IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Failed to create dynamic table.'.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_wa>).

      " Fill with some sample data
      IF iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
        <fs_wa>-('CARRID') = 'LH'.
        <fs_wa>-('CONNID') = '0400'.
        <fs_wa>-('FLDATE') = sy-datum.
        <fs_wa>-('PRICE') = '100.00'.
        <fs_wa>-('CURRENCY') = 'EUR'.
        INSERT <fs_wa> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

        <fs_wa>-('CARRID') = 'AA'.
        <fs_wa>-('CONNID') = '0017'.
        <fs_wa>-('FLDATE') = sy-datum + 1.
        <fs_wa>-('PRICE') = '250.50'.
        <fs_wa>-('CURRENCY') = 'USD'.
        INSERT <fs_wa> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle vom Typ `data` entgegennimmt und prüft, ob sie eine Komponente mit dem Namen 'CARRID' besitzt. Geben Sie `ABAP_TRUE` oder `ABAP_FALSE` zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data`, `get_table_line_type` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_component`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_has_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS has_carrid_component
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_has_carrid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_has_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_carrid_component.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_line_type   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ) ).
        lo_line_type = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

        IF lo_line_type IS BOUND.
          TRY.
              lo_line_type->get_component( 'CARRID' ).
              rb_has_carrid = abap_true.
            CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
              rb_has_carrid = abap_false.
          ENDTRY.
        ELSE.
          rb_has_carrid = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_typedescr_error.
        rb_has_carrid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten und einen Feldnamen als String entgegennimmt. Die Methode soll alle Einträge filtern, bei denen der Wert des angegebenen Feldes initial ist. Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und dynamischen Zugriff.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs> TO <fs_comp>` mit `IS INITIAL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_filter_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_initial_field
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_filter_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_initial_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Component '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure.|.
      ENDIF.

      IF <fs_field> IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND <fs_sflight> TO rt_filtered_sflights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field>`). Dies ermöglicht es, eine generische Filterlogik zu implementieren, die auf beliebige Felder einer Struktur angewendet werden kann, ohne den Feldnamen fest zu codieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige Variable vom Typ `data` entgegennimmt und eine interne Tabelle mit den Namen aller ihrer Komponenten zurückgibt, falls es sich um eine Struktur handelt. Andernfalls soll eine leere Tabelle zurückgegeben werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_comps_safe DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_name,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_name.
    TYPES tt_component_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_component_names_if_struct
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE tt_component_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_comps_safe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_names_if_struct.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND VALUE ty_component_name( name = ls_component-name ) TO rt_component_names.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Not a structure, return empty table
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_delete_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

CLASS zcl_fld_delete_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle vom Typ `data` entgegennimmt und eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur die Komponenten 'CARRID' und 'CONNID' enthält, falls diese in der Originaltabelle existieren. Die neue Tabelle soll denselben Zeileninhalt haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI, um den Zeilentyp der Quelltabelle zu analysieren, einen neuen Zeilentyp zu erstellen und dann die Zieltabelle dynamisch zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_project_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS project_sflight_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_projected_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_descr_error,
        cx_sy_create_data_error,
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_project_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD project_sflight_fields.
    DATA: lo_source_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_source_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_new_components     TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: lo_new_struct_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_new_table_descr    TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_comp>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_comp>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_descr_error EXPORTING text = 'Source table not assigned'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_source_table_descr = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_table> ) ).
    lo_source_line_descr  = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    " Check for CARRID and CONNID in source structure
    TRY.
        lo_source_line_descr->get_component( 'CARRID' ).
        APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr( name = 'CARRID' type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT-CARRID' ) ) TO lt_new_components.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
        " CARRID not found
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        lo_source_line_descr->get_component( 'CONNID' ).
        APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr( name = 'CONNID' type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT-CONNID' ) ) TO lt_new_components.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
        " CONNID not found
    ENDTRY.

    IF lt_new_components IS INITIAL.
      " No relevant components found, return empty table of generic type
      lo_new_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( p_components = VALUE #( ) ).
    ELSE.
      lo_new_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( p_components = lt_new_components ).
    ENDIF.

    lo_new_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                             p_line_type  = lo_new_struct_descr
                             p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
                             p_unique     = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA ro_projected_table TYPE HANDLE lo_new_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_projected_table->* TO <fs_target_table>.

    IF <fs_target_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error EXPORTING text = 'Failed to create target table'.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA <fs_target_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_new_struct_descr.

    LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      ASSIGN <fs_target_line>->* TO <fs_target_comp>.
      IF <fs_target_comp> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING text = 'Failed to assign target line'.
      ENDIF.

      " Copy data for existing components
      LOOP AT lt_new_components INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_comp>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_comp> TO <fs_target_comp>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_target_comp> = <fs_source_comp>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_target_comp> INTO TABLE <fs_target_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' ) TO lt_source.

    READ TABLE <fs_projected_table> ASSIGNING <fs_projected_line> INDEX 1.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_projected_line>-connid exp = '0400' ).

    DATA: lt_source TYPE tt_partial_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_project_table( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_expected_line,

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = ( sy-subrc = 0 ) msg = 'CONNID should not be in projected table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_project_non_sflight.
    DATA: lt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 'Test' TO lt_strings.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_project_table( ).
    DATA(lo_projected_ref) = lo_cut->project_sflight_fields( lt_strings ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_projected_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_projected_ref->* TO <fs_projected_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Projected table should be assigned' act = COND #( WHEN <fs_projected_table> IS ASSIGNED THEN '' ELSE 'X' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_projected_table> ) exp = 1 ). " One line, but empty structure

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_projected_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <fs_projected_table> ASSIGNING <fs_projected_line> INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <fs_projected_line> msg = 'Projected line should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten und einen Feldnamen als String entgegennimmt. Die Methode soll den Inhalt dieses Feldes für alle Zeilen in Großbuchstaben umwandeln. Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und dynamischen Zugriff.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs> TO <fs_comp>` mit `TO UPPER CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_to_upper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_field_to_upper
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights     TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_to_upper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_field_to_upper.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Component '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure.|.
      ENDIF.

      " Only convert character-like types
      DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_field> ).
      IF lo_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR
         lo_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
        TRANSLATE <fs_field> TO UPPER CASE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_currency_to_upper.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' currency = 'eur' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_to_upper( ).
    lo_cut->convert_field_to_upper( iv_field_name = 'CURRENCY' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-currency exp = 'EUR' ).

  METHOD test_non_char_field.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fld_to_upper=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_to_upper( ).
    lo_cut->convert_field_to_upper( iv_field_name = 'PRICE' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Numeric field should not be changed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fld_to_upper=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_to_upper( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_field_to_upper( iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught cx_sy_assign_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige Variable vom Typ `data` entgegennimmt und eine Beschreibung ihres Typs als String zurückgibt (z.B. 'CHAR (10)', 'INT', 'TABLE OF SFLIGHT').
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methoden `get_ddic_object_name`, `get_relative_name` oder `get_pretty_name` der Typbeschreibungsobjekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_desc_str DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_desc_str IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_description.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).

    CASE lo_typedescr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
        rv_description = |CHAR ({ lo_typedescr->length })|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num.
        rv_description = |NUMC ({ lo_typedescr->length })|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
        rv_description = 'INT'.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
        DATA(lo_packed_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_typedescr ).
        rv_description = |PACKED ({ lo_packed_descr->length }, { lo_packed_descr->decimals })|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
        rv_description = 'FLOAT'.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
        rv_description = 'STRING'.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
        rv_description = |STRUCTURE ({ lo_struct_descr->get_ddic_object_name( ) ALIGN = LEFT PAD = ' ' })|.
        IF rv_description IS INITIAL.
          rv_description = 'LOCAL STRUCTURE'.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).
        DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        DATA(lv_line_desc) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_desc_str( )->get_type_description( lo_line_descr->get_relative_name( ) ).
        rv_description = |TABLE OF { lv_line_desc }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = |UNKNOWN TYPE ({ lo_typedescr->type_kind })|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten entgegennimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, in der alle Zeilen dupliziert sind. Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und die moderne Syntax `FOR ... IN ...`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_duplicate_rows DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS duplicate_all_rows
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_duplicated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_duplicate_rows IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD duplicate_all_rows.
    rt_duplicated_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_source_flights
                                     ( <fs_flight> )
                                     ( <fs_flight> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_duplicate_two_rows.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_source.

    READ TABLE lt_duplicated INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    READ TABLE lt_duplicated INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    READ TABLE lt_duplicated INDEX 3 ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_duplicate_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_fld_duplicate_rows=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_duplicate_rows( ).
    DATA(lt_duplicated) = lo_cut->duplicate_all_rows( lt_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_duplicated ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_duplicate_single_row.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_fld_duplicate_rows=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_duplicate_rows( ).
    DATA(lt_duplicated) = lo_cut->duplicate_all_rows( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_duplicated ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_duplicated INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    READ TABLE lt_duplicated INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Syntax `FOR ... IN ...` in Kombination mit `VALUE #(` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, interne Tabellen zu manipulieren. Hier wird ein Field-Symbol `<fs_flight>` verwendet, um jede Zeile der Quelltabelle zu referenzieren. Durch das zweimalige Hinzufügen `( <fs_flight> )` wird jede Zeile dupliziert, ohne dass explizite `APPEND`-Anweisungen oder Work Areas benötigt werden. Dies ist eine funktionale und effiziente Methode.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle vom Typ `data` entgegennimmt und eine interne Tabelle mit den Namen aller ihrer Schlüsselkomponenten zurückgibt, falls die Tabelle einen definierten Schlüssel hat.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_keys`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_table_keys DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_component,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_component.
    TYPES tt_key_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_key_components
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_key_components) TYPE tt_key_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_table_keys IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_key_components.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ) ).

        LOOP AT lo_table_descr->get_keys( ) INTO DATA(ls_key_def).
          LOOP AT ls_key_def-components INTO DATA(ls_component_name).
            APPEND VALUE ty_key_component( name = ls_component_name ) TO rt_key_components.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_typedescr_error.
        " Not a table or error in type description, return empty table
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten und einen Feldnamen als String entgegennimmt. Die Methode soll die Tabelle nach diesem Feld sortieren. Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und dynamische Sortierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SORT itab BY (<field_name>)` mit dynamischem Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dyn_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights     TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sort_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dyn_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    DATA: lt_sort_fields TYPE SORTED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    APPEND iv_field_name TO lt_sort_fields.

    SORT ct_sflights BY (lt_sort_fields).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sort_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Dynamic sort by field '{ iv_field_name }' failed.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( iv_field_name = 'PRICE' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

explanation: Die dynamische Sortierung einer internen Tabelle ist ein mächtiges Feature für generische Anwendungen. Anstatt den Feldnamen fest zu codieren, kann eine interne Tabelle von Feldnamen (`lt_sort_fields`) verwendet werden, um die Sortierkriterien zur Laufzeit zu übergeben. Dies ermöglicht es, die Sortierung basierend auf Benutzereingaben oder Konfigurationen anzupassen. Field-Symbols sind hier implizit beteiligt, da die Sortieroperation direkt auf die Tabellenzeilen zugreift.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, SORT, Internal Tables, Dynamic Sort

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String und extrahieren Sie den Wert eines bestimmten Elements.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Parsen und `find_node` oder `get_elements_by_tag_name` zum Navigieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parse_element DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_get_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_tag_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_element IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_get_value.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( iv_tag_name ).
        IF lo_node IS BOUND.
          rv_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Handle parsing error
        rv_value = 'ERROR: XML Parse Error'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein komplexes XML-Dokument aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`), wobei jeder Eintrag ein 'Flight'-Element mit 'Carrid', 'Connid' und 'Fldate' als Kind-Elemente darstellt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` Iterationen und `cl_xml_document` Methoden, um die XML-Struktur dynamisch aufzubauen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_create_from_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flights_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_from_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flights_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( ).
    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Flights' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root_node ).

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Flight' ).
      lo_root_node->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

      DATA(lo_carrid_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Carrid' ).
      lo_carrid_node->set_value( ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_carrid_node ).

      DATA(lo_connid_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Connid' ).
      lo_connid_node->set_value( ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_connid_node ).

      DATA(lo_fldate_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Fldate' ).
      lo_fldate_node->set_value( ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_fldate_node ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das mehrere 'Item'-Elemente enthält, und sammeln Sie deren Werte in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_elements_by_tag_name` und `LOOP AT` über die zurückgegebene Node-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parse_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_xml_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_tag_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE tt_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_xml_to_table.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_tag_name ).

        LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(lo_node).
          APPEND lo_node->get_value( ) TO rt_values.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Handle parsing error
        APPEND 'ERROR: XML Parse Error' TO rt_values.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_item_node->set_value( 'Namespace Test' ).
    lo_root_node->append_child( lo_item_node ).

    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie ein bestehendes XML-Dokument, indem Sie den Wert eines Elements ändern und ein Element löschen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `find_node`, `set_value` und `remove_child`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).

        " Change value of 'Item1'
        DATA(lo_item1) = lo_xml_document->find_node( 'Item1' ).
        IF lo_item1 IS BOUND.
          lo_item1->set_value( 'New Value for Item1' ).
        ENDIF.

        " Delete 'Item2'
        DATA(lo_item2) = lo_xml_document->find_node( 'Item2' ).
        IF lo_item2 IS BOUND.
          DATA(lo_parent) = lo_item2->get_parent( ).
          IF lo_parent IS BOUND.
            lo_parent->remove_child( lo_item2 ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_modified_xml ).

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        rv_modified_xml = 'ERROR: XML Parse Error'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_modify_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_modify( ).
    DATA(lv_original_xml) = '<Root><Item1>Old Value</Item1><Item2>To Be Deleted</Item2><Item3>Keep</Item3></Root>'.
    DATA(lv_modified_xml) = lo_cut->modify_xml( lv_original_xml ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Item1>New Value for Item1</Item1>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Item2>To Be Deleted</Item2>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_xml exp = '<Item3>Keep</Item3>' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Modifikation eines XML-Dokuments. Es demonstriert, wie man den Wert eines bestehenden Elements ändert (`set_value`) und wie man ein Element aus der Struktur entfernt (`remove_child`). Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen XML-Daten aktualisiert oder bereinigt werden müssen.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, Modifikation, set_value, remove_child, find_node, MOVE

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine einfache ABAP-Struktur in XML und deserialisieren Sie sie zurück in eine ABAP-Struktur unter Verwendung von `CALL TRANSFORMATION`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` für die Standard-XML-Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_transformation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS serialize_to_xml
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS deserialize_from_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_transformation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_to_xml.
    DATA(lv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE data = is_data
      RESULT XML lv_xstring.
    rv_xml_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_from_xml.
    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ).
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE XML lv_xstring
      RESULT data = rs_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialization_deserialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialization_deserialization.
    DATA: ls_original_data TYPE zcl_xml_transformation=>ty_data,
          ls_deserialized_data TYPE zcl_xml_transformation=>ty_data.

    ls_original_data = VALUE #( field1 = 'Test String' field2 = 123 ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_transformation( ).

    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->serialize_to_xml( ls_original_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<FIELD1>Test String</FIELD1>' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<FIELD2>123</FIELD2>' ).

    ls_deserialized_data = lo_cut->deserialize_from_xml( lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_deserialized_data-field1 exp = ls_original_data-field1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_deserialized_data-field2 exp = ls_original_data-field2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug in modernem ABAP, um ABAP-Datenstrukturen (Tabellen, Strukturen, Objekte) automatisch in XML zu serialisieren und umgekehrt zu deserialisieren. Dies vereinfacht den Datenaustausch erheblich und reduziert den manuellen XML-Parsing-Code. Die Konvertierung zwischen `string` und `xstring` ist dabei notwendig.
keywords: XML, CALL TRANSFORMATION, Serialisierung, Deserialisierung, ID-Transformation, MOVE

Instructions: Parsen Sie ein XML-Dokument und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` mit `COND` um spezifische Attribute von Elementen zu sammeln, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_elements_by_tag_name` und dann `REDUCE` oder `FOR` mit `COND` über die Node-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_reduce_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_ids
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_tag_name   TYPE string
        iv_attribute  TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_ids) TYPE tt_ids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_reduce_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_ids.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_tag_name ).

        rt_filtered_ids = VALUE #( FOR lo_node IN lt_nodes
                                     LET lv_attr_value = lo_node->get_attribute( iv_attribute ) IN
                                     WHERE ( lv_attr_value = iv_filter_value )
                                     ( lo_node->get_attribute( 'id' ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Handle parsing error
        APPEND 'ERROR: XML Parse Error' TO rt_filtered_ids.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_ids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_ids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_reduce_attributes( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = '<Root><Item id="A1" type="TypeX"/><Item id="B2" type="TypeY"/><Item id="C3" type="TypeX"/></Root>'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_ids(
      iv_xml_string = lv_xml
      iv_tag_name = 'Item'
      iv_attribute = 'type'
      iv_filter_value = 'TypeX'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'A1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'C3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_reduce_attributes( ).

Es ermöglicht das effiziente Filtern und Sammeln von Daten aus XML-Dokumenten basierend auf Attributwerten, ohne explizite `LOOP` und `IF` Anweisungen, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das eine Liste von 'Product'-Elementen enthält. Jedes 'Product' hat 'Name' und 'Price' als Kind-Elemente. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Gesamtpreise zu berechnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zur Erstellung und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation der Preise nach dem Parsen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_products_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_products_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( ).
    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Products' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root_node ).

    LOOP AT it_products INTO DATA(ls_product).
      DATA(lo_product_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Product' ).
      lo_root_node->append_child( lo_product_node ).

      DATA(lo_name_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Name' ).
      lo_name_node->set_value( ls_product-name ).
      lo_product_node->append_child( lo_name_node ).

      DATA(lo_price_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Price' ).
      lo_price_node->set_value( ls_product-price ).
      lo_product_node->append_child( lo_price_node ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lt_price_nodes) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( 'Price' ).

        rv_total_price = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0
                                            FOR lo_node IN lt_price_nodes
                                            NEXT sum = sum + lo_node->get_value( ) ).

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Handle parsing error
        rv_total_price = -1. " Indicate error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_xml_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_calculation.
    DATA: lt_products TYPE zcl_xml_reduce_sum=>tt_products,
          ls_product  TYPE zcl_xml_reduce_sum=>ty_product.

    ls_product = VALUE #( name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.50' ).
    APPEND ls_product TO lt_products.
    ls_product = VALUE #( name = 'Mouse' price = '25.00' ).
    APPEND ls_product TO lt_products.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_products_xml( lt_products ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lv_xml ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '1225.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_xml_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = '<Products></Products>'.
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `REDUCE` in Kombination mit XML-Parsing. Nach dem Extrahieren aller 'Price'-Elemente wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Summe der Preise in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung zu berechnen. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Muster in ABAP, um Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, REDUCE, Aggregation, Parsen, decfloat16, MOVE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das Kommentare enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_comment` um einen Kommentar-Node zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_comment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_xml_with_comment RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_comment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_with_comment.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( ).
    DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Document' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root_node ).

    DATA(lo_comment_node) = lo_xml_document->create_comment( 'This is a sample comment.' ).
    lo_root_node->append_child( lo_comment_node ).

    DATA(lo_data_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Content' ).
    lo_data_node->set_value( 'Some data here.' ).
    lo_root_node->append_child( lo_data_node ).

    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie ein XML-Dokument und verwenden Sie `FILTER` um nur Elemente zu extrahieren, deren Attributwerte eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, und sammeln Sie deren Werte.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_elements_by_tag_name` und dann `FILTER` über die Node-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_filter_elements DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_element_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_tag_name   TYPE string
        iv_attribute  TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_values) TYPE tt_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_filter_elements IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_element_values.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_data( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_tag_name ).

        rt_filtered_values = VALUE #( FOR lo_node IN FILTER #( lt_nodes USING KEY default
                                                                WHERE get_attribute( iv_attribute ) = iv_filter_value )
                                      ( lo_node->get_value( ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Handle parsing error
        APPEND 'ERROR: XML Parse Error' TO rt_filtered_values.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_element_values FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_element_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_filter_elements( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = '<Root><Item type="A">Value1</Item><Item type="B">Value2</Item><Item type="A">Value3</Item></Root>'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_element_values(
      iv_xml_string = lv_xml
      iv_tag_name = 'Item'
      iv_attribute = 'type'
      iv_filter_value = 'A'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Value1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'Value3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_filter_elements( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = '<Root><Item type="A">Value1</Item></Root>'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_element_values(
      iv_xml_string = lv_xml
      iv_tag_name = 'Item'
      iv_attribute = 'type'
      iv_filter_value = 'C'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `FILTER`-Funktion in ABAP, um eine Liste von XML-Nodes basierend auf einem Attributwert zu filtern. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Methode, um Daten aus komplexen XML-Strukturen zu extrahieren, die bestimmten Kriterien entsprechen, und ist ein Kernstück des funktionalen Programmierstils in modernem ABAP.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, FILTER, Attribute, Parsen, funktionale Programmierung, MOVE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Methoden-Chaining ermöglicht, um mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung auszuführen.
hint: Jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, muss `RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_object` zurückgeben.

CLASS zcl_chainable_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_object.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_factor TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_object.
    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    me = me. " Return current instance for chaining
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_factor.
    me = me. " Return current instance for chaining
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_obj) = NEW zcl_chainable_object( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_obj->set_value( 5 )->multiply( 2 )->get_value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methoden-Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt sequenziell in einer Zeile zu verketten. Dies wird durch das Zurückgeben der eigenen Instanz (`me`) in jeder Methode erreicht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine statische Methode, die eine Tabelle von Zahlen entgegennimmt und eine neue Tabelle mit den Quadraten dieser Zahlen zurückgibt, unter Verwendung moderner Tabellenoperationen.

CLASS zcl_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus den Tabellen `SFLIGHT` und `SPFLI` mittels eines `INNER JOIN`, um Flugnummern und Abflugorte zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... INNER JOIN ... ON ... INTO TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flight_origins
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_origins.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_info.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_origins FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_origins.
    DATA(lt_flights) = zcl_flight_data_reader=>get_flight_origins( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lines( lt_flights ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

explanation: Der `INNER JOIN` in Open SQL ist eine effiziente Methode, um Daten aus mehreren Datenbanktabellen zu kombinieren, basierend auf übereinstimmenden Werten in den Join-Bedingungen. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist Teil des neuen Open SQL Syntax.
keywords: JOINS, Open SQL, Database Access, INNER JOIN, SFLIGHT, SPFLI

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten und optional die Währung des Flugpreises aus `SFLIGHT` und `SCURX` mittels eines `LEFT OUTER JOIN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... LEFT OUTER JOIN ... ON ... INTO TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_currency_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_currency,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             currtext TYPE scurx-currtext,
           END OF ty_flight_currency.
    TYPES: tt_flight_currency TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_currency WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flight_currencies
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_currency) TYPE tt_flight_currency.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_currency_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_currencies.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price, s~currency, x~currtext
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN scurx AS x ON s~currency = x~currkey
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_currency.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_currencies FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_currencies.
    DATA(lt_flights) = zcl_flight_currency_reader=>get_flight_currencies( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lines( lt_flights ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-currency IS NOT INITIAL.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_flight-currtext IS NOT INITIAL ). 
      ENDIF.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein `LEFT OUTER JOIN` gibt alle Zeilen aus der linken Tabelle (`SFLIGHT`) zurück und die übereinstimmenden Zeilen aus der rechten Tabelle (`SCURX`). Wenn keine Übereinstimmung in der rechten Tabelle gefunden wird, werden `NULL`-Werte für die Spalten der rechten Tabelle zurückgegeben. Dies ist nützlich, wenn Sie alle Daten aus einer Tabelle benötigen, auch wenn keine zugehörigen Daten in einer anderen Tabelle vorhanden sind.
keywords: JOINS, Open SQL, Database Access, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SFLIGHT, SCURX

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Daten aus `SFLIGHT`, `SPFLI` und `SGEOCITY` (für den Abflugort) mittels mehrerer `INNER JOIN`s, um detaillierte Fluginformationen zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `INNER JOIN`s und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` für eine flexible Datenzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_detailed_flight,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom   TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto     TYPE spfli-cityto,
             countryfrom TYPE sgeocity-country,
             countryto   TYPE sgeocity-country,
           END OF ty_detailed_flight.
    TYPES: tt_detailed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_detailed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_detailed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_detailed_flights) TYPE tt_detailed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_detailed_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate,
           p~cityfrom, p~cityto,
           gfrom~country AS countryfrom,
           gto~country AS countryto
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      INNER JOIN sgeocity AS gfrom ON p~cityfrom = gfrom~city
      INNER JOIN sgeocity AS gto ON p~cityto = gto~city
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_detailed_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_detailed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_detailed_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = zcl_complex_flight_reader=>get_detailed_flights( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lines( lt_flights ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_flight-countryfrom IS NOT INITIAL ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_flight-countryto IS NOT INITIAL ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Mehrere `INNER JOIN`s ermöglichen die Verknüpfung von drei oder mehr Tabellen in einer einzigen `SELECT`-Anweisung. `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Feldnamen in der Zielstruktur teilweise mit den ausgewählten Spalten übereinstimmen, was die manuelle Zuordnung reduziert.
keywords: JOINS, Open SQL, Database Access, Multiple Joins, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, SFLIGHT, SPFLI, SGEOCITY

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft und jeden Abflugort die Anzahl der Flüge, indem Sie `SFLIGHT` und `SPFLI` verbinden und das Ergebnis gruppieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... COUNT(*) ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flight_counts_by_origin
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_origin.
    SELECT s~carrid, p~cityfrom, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, p~cityfrom
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lt_counts) = zcl_flight_aggregator=>get_flight_counts_by_origin( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_counts IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lines( lt_counts ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_count-flight_count > 0 ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `JOIN` mit `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen wie `COUNT(*)` ermöglicht es, zusammenfassende Daten über verknüpfte Tabellen hinweg direkt in der Datenbank abzufragen. Dies ist sehr effizient, da die Aggregation auf Datenbankebene erfolgt.
keywords: JOINS, Open SQL, Database Access, GROUP BY, Aggregation, SFLIGHT, SPFLI

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flüge, die von einem bestimmten Land abfliegen, indem Sie `SFLIGHT` und `SPFLI` verbinden und eine Subquery mit `EXISTS` auf `SGEOCITY` verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_by_country DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flights_from_country
      IMPORTING
        iv_country TYPE sgeocity-country
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_by_country IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_country.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT *
                           FROM sgeocity AS g
                          WHERE g~city = p~cityfrom
                            AND g~country = @iv_country )
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flights_from_germany FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_from_germany.
    DATA(lt_flights) = zcl_flight_by_country=>get_flights_from_country( 'DE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lines( lt_flights ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      SELECT SINGLE country FROM sgeocity WHERE city = @ls_flight-cityfrom INTO @DATA(lv_country).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_country exp = 'DE' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHERE EXISTS`-Klausel mit einer Subquery ist eine leistungsstarke Methode, um Zeilen basierend auf der Existenz von übereinstimmenden Zeilen in einer anderen Tabelle zu filtern, ohne diese Tabelle direkt joinen zu müssen. Dies kann in bestimmten Szenarien effizienter sein als ein `INNER JOIN`, insbesondere wenn nur die Existenz und nicht die Daten der zweiten Tabelle relevant sind.
keywords: JOINS, Open SQL, Database Access, EXISTS, Subquery, SFLIGHT, SPFLI, SGEOCITY

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
      FOR ls_price IN it_flight_prices
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_price-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = VALUE zcl_flight_price_calculator=>tt_flight_prices #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' price = '50.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_prices ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen mit Akkumulatoren in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung auszudrücken, was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Lesen Sie den ersten Eintrag für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und deklarieren Sie die Zielstruktur inline.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS` mit `INTO @DATA(...)` für eine moderne und effiziente Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_first_flight_by_carrier

        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight_by_carrier.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 1 ROWS INTO @DATA(ls_flight_data) WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rs_flight = ls_flight_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_first_flight_by_carrier( 'AA' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reader( ).

keywords: Open SQL, SELECT, INTO @DATA, UP TO 1 ROWS, SFLIGHT, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die jeweils die Instanz der Klasse zurückgeben, um Methodenaufrufe zu verketten (Fluent Interface).
hint: Jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, muss `ME` als Rückgabewert vom Typ der eigenen Klasse haben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_text  TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS set_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.

    METHODS add_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.

    METHODS build
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_text.
    me->mv_text = me->mv_text && iv_text.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build.
    rv_result = |Value: { me->mv_value }, Text: { me->mv_text }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_fluent_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_interface.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_fluent_builder( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->set_value( 10 )->add_text( 'Hello' )->add_text( ' World' )->build( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Value: 10, Text: Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_builder->mv_value exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_builder->mv_text exp = 'Hello World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, auch bekannt als Fluent Interface, verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss von Objektinteraktionen, indem Methoden die Instanz des Objekts (`ME`) zurückgeben. Dies ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten, was den Code kompakter und ausdrucksstärker macht.
keywords: Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, Object Orientation, ME

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie grundlegende Informationen (z.B. MIME-Typ, Breite, Höhe) für ein Bild, das als XSTRING vorliegt, unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_FXS_IMAGE_INFO`.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_image_properties FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_image FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_image_properties.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_image_info_determiner( ).
    " Simulate a minimal 1x1 white GIF image (GIF89a header + image data)
    DATA(lv_gif_xstring) = '47494638396101000100800000FFFFFF00000021F90401000000002C00000000010001000002024401003B'X.
    DATA(ls_properties) = lo_cut->get_image_properties( lv_gif_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_properties-mime_type exp = 'image/gif' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_properties-width     exp = 1 ).

    TRY.
