        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception CX_FXS_IMAGE_INFO not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_info.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Exception CX_FXS_IMAGE_INFO caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_FXS_IMAGE_INFO` ist ein spezialisiertes Werkzeug zur Bestimmung von Metadaten aus Bilddaten, die im XSTRING-Format vorliegen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Szenarien der Dokumentengenerierung (z.B. mit XSL-FO) oder bei der Verarbeitung von binären Bildinhalten. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW ...`) ist hier ein Beispiel für modernen ABAP-Stil.
keywords: CL_FXS_IMAGE_INFO, XSTRING, Image Processing, MIME Type, GET_MIME_TYPE, GET_WIDTH, GET_HEIGHT

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator für eine einfache und sichere Datenübertragung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_copier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_x TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS copy_matching_fields
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_copier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_matching_fields.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_copy_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_copier( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_copier=>ty_source( field1 = 'Value A' field2 = 123 field3 = 'Not Copied' ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->copy_matching_fields( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-field_x ). " Should not be copied from field3
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ist ein modernes Feature, das das Kopieren von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit übereinstimmenden Feldnamen vereinfacht. Er ersetzt die Notwendigkeit, jedes Feld einzeln zuzuweisen, und ist robuster gegenüber Änderungen in den Feldlisten, da er nur die tatsächlich übereinstimmenden Felder berücksichtigt.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structures, Data Transfer, Field Assignment

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere Zeilen zu einer internen Tabelle hinzu, die aus einer anderen Tabelle stammen, aber nur, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF` mit einem `FILTER` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_filtered_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Klassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erzeugt, unter Verwendung von `NEW` mit Typ-Referenz.
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW #( )` mit einer Typ-Referenz, um dynamisch Objekte zu erzeugen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    DATA(lv_class_name) = |ZCL_PRODUCT_{ iv_product_type ALPHA = UPPRC }|.
    TRY.
        ro_product = NEW #( lv_class_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Could not create product of type { iv_product_type }: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_create_product_a.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Product A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_product_b.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Product B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid_product.
    TRY.
        zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'C' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Factory-Methoden sind ein wichtiges Entwurfsmuster in der objektorientierten Programmierung. In modernem ABAP kann die dynamische Objekterzeugung mit `NEW #( lv_class_name )` sehr elegant umgesetzt werden. Dies ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit zu entscheiden, welche konkrete Klasse instanziiert werden soll, und fördert die lose Kopplung und Erweiterbarkeit des Systems.
keywords: Factory Method, Object Orientation, NEW, Dynamic Object Creation, Interface

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `REDUCE` für eine effiziente Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    " Dummy data for demonstration.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' seatsocc = 80 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' seatsocc = 120 )
    ).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden. Da `FILTER` keine dynamischen Feldnamen direkt unterstützt, nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `LET` und `SWITCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE`, `LET` und `SWITCH` um den Feldwert dynamisch zu ermitteln und dann mit `COND` zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE tt_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic.
    rt_filtered_data = VALUE tt_data(
      FOR <fs_row> IN it_data
      LET lv_field_value = SWITCH string( iv_field_name
                                           WHEN 'FIELD1' THEN <fs_row>-field1
                                           WHEN 'FIELD2' THEN |{ <fs_row>-field2 }|
                                           ELSE '' )
      IN COND #( WHEN lv_field_value = iv_value THEN <fs_row> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_dynamic_filter_field1.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_filter=>tt_data(
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 )
      ( field1 = 'B' field2 = 2 )
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 3 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic( it_data = lt_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' iv_value = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-field2 exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-field2 exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_filter_field2.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_filter=>tt_data(
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 )
      ( field1 = 'B' field2 = 2 )
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 3 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic( it_data = lt_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' iv_value = '2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-field1 exp = 'B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_filter=>tt_data(
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic( it_data = lt_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' iv_value = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamisches Filtern von internen Tabellen erfordert oft Workarounds, da `FILTER` keine dynamischen Feldnamen in der `WHERE`-Klausel erlaubt. Hier wird eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE`, `LET` und `SWITCH` verwendet, um den Feldwert dynamisch zu ermitteln und dann mit `COND` zu filtern. Dies ist eine moderne, funktionale Art, dynamische Anforderungen zu erfüllen.
keywords: FOR, COND, SWITCH, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugtabelle `sflight` nach Flügen, deren Fluggesellschaften in einer separaten Liste von 'Premium'-Fluggesellschaften enthalten sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und die Tabellenfunktion `LINE_EXISTS` in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_premium_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_premium_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_premium_carriers TYPE tt_premium_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_premium_flights.
    " Dummy data for demonstration.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251202' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251203' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251204' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE LINE_EXISTS( it_premium_carriers[ table_line = carrid ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, in der für jeden Flug der Status 'Active' ist, wenn das Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt, sonst 'Past'. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND` um die neue Tabelle zu füllen und den Status zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_in_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_in_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    " Dummy data for demonstration.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251202' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251203' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251204' )
    ).

    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE tt_flight_status(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      (
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
        status = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-fldate >= sy-datum THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Past' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie verschiedene Objekttypen in einer Liste polymorph. Wenn es sich um einen Flug handelt, geben Sie die Flugnummer zurück; wenn es sich um eine Buchung handelt, die Buchungsnummer. Nutzen Sie `CASE TYPE OF` mit `WHEN TYPE`.
hint: Definieren Sie Interfaces und Klassen, um Polymorphie zu demonstrieren, und verwenden Sie `CASE TYPE OF` zur Typunterscheidung.
solution:
INTERFACE if_flight_data.
  METHODS get_flight_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

INTERFACE if_booking_data.
  METHODS get_booking_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS lcl_flight DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_flight_data.
    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_flight_data~get_flight_id.
    rv_id = |{ mv_carrid }-{ mv_connid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_booking DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_booking_data.
    DATA: mv_bookid TYPE sbook-bookid.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_bookid TYPE sbook-bookid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_booking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_bookid = iv_bookid.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD if_booking_data~get_booking_id.
    rv_id = |{ mv_bookid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_type_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING io_data TYPE REF TO object RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_type_of IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    CASE TYPE OF io_data.
      WHEN TYPE lcl_flight INTO DATA(lo_flight).
        rv_info = lo_flight->if_flight_data~get_flight_id( ).
      WHEN TYPE lcl_booking INTO DATA(lo_booking).
        rv_info = lo_booking->if_booking_data~get_booking_id( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_info = 'Unknown Type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_switch_type_flight FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_switch_type_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` mit `WHEN TYPE` ist eine moderne und typsichere Methode, um polymorphe Objekte basierend auf ihrem tatsächlichen Typ zu verarbeiten. Es ist eine elegante Alternative zu `RTTI` (Run-Time Type Information) für einfache Typunterscheidungen und fördert sauberen, objektorientierten Code.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, WHEN TYPE, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, RTTI

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Kundendaten und markieren Sie ungültige Einträge. Ein Eintrag ist ungültig, wenn die E-Mail-Adresse fehlt oder nicht das '@'-Zeichen enthält. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit dem Validierungsstatus.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` und `COND` um die Validierungslogik anzuwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             id       TYPE string,
             name     TYPE string,
             email    TYPE string,
             is_valid TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_customer.
    TYPES tt_customer TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_customer WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_customers
      IMPORTING
        it_customers TYPE tt_customer
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_validated_customers) TYPE tt_customer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_validate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_customers.
    rt_validated_customers = VALUE tt_customer(
      FOR ls_customer IN it_customers
      (
        id       = ls_customer-id,
        name     = ls_customer-name,
        email    = ls_customer-email,
        is_valid = COND abap_bool(
                     WHEN ls_customer-email IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_customer-email CA '@' THEN abap_true
                     ELSE abap_false
                   )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_validate_customers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validate_customers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_validate( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_filter_validate=>tt_customer(
      ( id = 'C1' name = 'Alice'   email = 'alice@example.com' )
      ( id = 'C2' name = 'Bob'     email = '' )
      ( id = 'C3' name = 'Charlie' email = 'charlie.example.com' )
      ( id = 'C4' name = 'David'   email = 'david@test.com' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->validate_customers( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 'C1' ]-is_valid exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 'C2' ]-is_valid exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 'C3' ]-is_valid exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ id = 'C4' ]-is_valid exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung verwendet eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` und `COND`, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, wobei jeder Eintrag validiert und ein `is_valid`-Flag gesetzt wird. Dies ist eine funktionale und lesbare Methode zur Datenbereinigung und -validierung, die die Logik direkt in der Tabellenerstellung integriert.
keywords: FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Data Cleansing, Validation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUP` und `FILTER`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUP` um die Gruppierung durchzuführen und `FILTER` (implizit durch die Gruppierung) um die Elemente zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    " Dummy data for demonstration.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251202' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251203' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251204' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251205' )
    ).

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE tt_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).

Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Gruppierungen und Zählungen durchzuführen.
keywords: FOR GROUP, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern der Flüge enthält, die in den nächsten 7 Tagen stattfinden. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` um die relevanten Flüge auszuwählen und `FOR` um die neue Struktur zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_upcoming_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_upcoming_flight.
    TYPES tt_upcoming_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_upcoming_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_upcoming_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_upcoming_flights) TYPE tt_upcoming_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_upcoming_flights.
    " Dummy data for demonstration. Adjust dates for current testing.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_seven_days_later) = sy-datum + 7.

    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = lv_today - 1 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = lv_today + 2 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = lv_today + 5 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = lv_today + 8 )
    ).

    rt_upcoming_flights = VALUE tt_upcoming_flight(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate BETWEEN lv_today AND lv_seven_days_later )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_upcoming_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upcoming_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_upcoming_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0010' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert `FILTER` und `FOR` in einer einzigen Tabellenexpression. Zuerst werden die Flüge nach dem Datum gefiltert, und dann wird die gefilterte Menge mit `FOR` in die gewünschte Zielstruktur transformiert. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten zu filtern und gleichzeitig zu transformieren.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, Date/Time

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug existiert. Wenn ja, geben Sie die Flugnummer zurück, andernfalls eine Fehlermeldung. Nutzen Sie `COND` mit `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` um den Rückgabewert zu bestimmen und `LINE_EXISTS` um die Existenz des Eintrags zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_id_or_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_id_or_error.
    " Dummy data for demonstration.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' )
    ).

    rv_result = COND string(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] )
        THEN |Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } gefunden|
      ELSE |Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } nicht gefunden|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die Tageszeit (Morgen, Mittag, Abend, Nacht) basierend auf einer Uhrzeit. Nutzen Sie `SWITCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` mit `WHEN` um verschiedene Zeitbereiche zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_time_of_day DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_time_of_day
      IMPORTING
        iv_time TYPE sy-uzeit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_period) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_time_of_day IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_time_of_day.
    rv_period = SWITCH #( iv_time
                          WHEN BETWEEN '060000' AND '115959' THEN 'Morgen'
                          WHEN BETWEEN '120000' AND '175959' THEN 'Mittag'
                          WHEN BETWEEN '180000' AND '215959' THEN 'Abend'
                          ELSE 'Nacht' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

explanation: `SWITCH` ist ideal, um einen Wert basierend auf mehreren diskreten oder Bereichsbedingungen zuzuweisen. Die Verwendung von `WHEN BETWEEN` in `SWITCH` für Zeitbereiche ist eine sehr moderne und lesbare Art, solche Logik zu implementieren, die traditionelle `IF-ELSE IF` Kaskaden ersetzt und den Code deutlich vereinfacht.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Date/Time, WHEN BETWEEN

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort) und füllen Sie diese direkt mit drei Einträgen unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators und `FOR`-Ausdrücken.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR`-Ausdrücken zur direkten Initialisierung und Befüllung der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 3
      ( carrid   = COND #( WHEN i = 1 THEN 'LH' WHEN i = 2 THEN 'UA' ELSE 'AA' )
        connid   = COND #( WHEN i = 1 THEN '0400' WHEN i = 2 THEN '0010' ELSE '0050' )
        cityfrom = COND #( WHEN i = 1 THEN 'FRANKFURT' WHEN i = 2 THEN 'NEW YORK' ELSE 'DALLAS' )
        cityto   = COND #( WHEN i = 1 THEN 'NEW YORK' WHEN i = 2 THEN 'CHICAGO' ELSE 'LOS ANGELES' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-cityto exp = 'LOS ANGELES' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht die direkte Initialisierung von Datenobjekten. In Kombination mit `FOR`-Ausdrücken können interne Tabellen kompakt und deklarativ mit Werten befüllt werden, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht als traditionelle `APPEND`-Schleifen.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Inline Declaration, sflights

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und eine Statusbezeichnung enthält. Der Status soll 'Langstrecke' sein, wenn die Flugnummer mit '0' beginnt (simuliert Langstrecke), ansonsten 'Kurzstrecke'. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um die neue Tabelle zu füllen, und den `COND`-Operator, um den Status basierend auf der Flugnummer zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights IMPORTING it_flights  TYPE tt_flight_data
                              RETURNING VALUE(rt_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_status = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( connid = ls_flight-connid
        status = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-connid CP '0*' THEN 'Langstrecke' ELSE 'Kurzstrecke' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_for_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_for_cond=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'JFK' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '1000' cityfrom = 'ORD' cityto = 'LAX' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' cityfrom = 'DFW' cityto = 'LAX' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Langstrecke' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-status exp = 'Kurzstrecke' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 3 ]-status exp = 'Langstrecke' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator ermöglicht die Iteration über interne Tabellen und die direkte Konstruktion einer neuen Tabelle. In Kombination mit dem `COND`-Operator können bedingte Zuweisungen innerhalb der Schleife kompakt und ausdrucksstark formuliert werden, was zu sehr prägnantem Code führt.
keywords: FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Transformation, String Processing

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. Initialisieren Sie eine Variable und addieren Sie in einer Schleife die Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES: tt_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_capacity IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_capacity
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-capacity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_reduce=>tt_flight_capacity(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' capacity = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '1000' capacity = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' capacity = 100 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 450 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen. Er ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Einträge iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable aktualisiert. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, um die gewünschten Einträge zu selektieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city IMPORTING iv_city     TYPE s_city
                                            it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_city ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_from_city FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_from_city.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_filter=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'JFK' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '1000' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'LAX' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LAX' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_city( iv_city = 'FRANKFURT' it_all_flights = lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Selection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Begrüßungsnachricht, die den Namen eines Benutzers und das aktuelle Datum enthält. Nutzen Sie String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie Backticks (`` ` ``) für String-Templates und `|...|` für Ausdrücke innerhalb des Templates.

CLASS zcl_str_templates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_str_templates IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug basierend auf seiner Fluggesellschaft einen 'Airline-Typ' zu. 'LH' soll 'Lufthansa', 'UA' 'United Airlines', 'AA' 'American Airlines' sein, alle anderen 'Unbekannt'. Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator.
hint: Der `SWITCH`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte Zuweisung basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_airline_type IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_airline_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airline_type.
    rv_airline_type = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
                                 WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa'
                                 WHEN 'UA' THEN 'United Airlines'
                                 WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines'
                                 ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_airline_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_airline_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_airline_type( 'LH' ) exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_airline_type( 'UA' ) exp = 'United Airlines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_airline_type( 'AA' ) exp = 'American Airlines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_airline_type( 'XX' ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator ist eine moderne und sehr lesbare Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen für bedingte Zuweisungen. Er ermöglicht es, einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen kompakt und deklarativ zu bestimmen.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, String Processing

Instructions: Formatieren Sie ein gegebenes Datum und eine Uhrzeit gemäß einem spezifischen Ländereinstellung (z.B. Deutsch) und Format (z.B. 'DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS'). Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_DATFM`.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `CL_ABAP_DATFM` mit der gewünschten Ländereinstellung und verwenden Sie die Methode `GET_DATE_FORMATTED` oder `GET_TIME_FORMATTED`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datfm_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_datetime IMPORTING iv_date    TYPE sy-datum
                                      iv_time    TYPE sy-uzeit
                                      iv_country TYPE sy-langu OPTIONAL
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_datetime) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datfm_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_datetime.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = NEW cl_abap_datfm( iv_country ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_date) = lo_datfm->get_date_formatted( iv_date ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_time) = lo_datfm->get_time_formatted( iv_time ).

    rv_formatted_datetime = |{ lv_formatted_date } { lv_formatted_time }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datfm_format( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = '20231203'.
    DATA(lv_time) = '143000'.

    " Test with German locale (assuming default system settings or 'DE' for country)
    DATA(lv_formatted_de) = lo_cut->format_datetime( iv_date = lv_date iv_time = lv_time iv_country = 'DE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_de exp = '03.12.2023 14:30:00' ).

    " Test with US locale (assuming 'EN' for country)
    DATA(lv_formatted_en) = lo_cut->format_datetime( iv_date = lv_date iv_time = lv_time iv_country = 'EN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_en exp = '12/03/2023 02:30:00 PM' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_DATFM` bietet eine standardisierte und internationalisierungskonforme Möglichkeit, Datums- und Zeitwerte basierend auf Ländereinstellungen zu formatieren. Dies ist essenziell für Anwendungen, die in verschiedenen Regionen eingesetzt werden, und vermeidet manuelle, fehleranfällige Formatierungen.
keywords: Date/Time, Internationalization, CL_ABAP_DATFM, Formatting

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Wenn der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück. Nutzen Sie die neue `READ TABLE` Syntax mit `VALUE` und `OPTIONAL`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... INTO DATA(...) ... OPTIONAL` und den `VALUE`-Operator, um den Rückgabewert zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_read_optional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_detail IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                                        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
                                RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_read_optional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_detail.
    rs_flight = VALUE #( 
      it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] OPTIONAL
      DEFAULT VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' cityfrom = 'UNKNOWN' cityto = 'UNKNOWN' ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_detail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_detail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_read_optional( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_read_optional=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'JFK' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '1000' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'LAX' )
    ).

    " Test existing flight
    DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_detail( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' it_flights = lt_input_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).

    " Test non-existing flight
    DATA(ls_default_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_detail( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0050' it_flights = lt_input_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_default_flight-carrid exp = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_default_flight-cityfrom exp = 'UNKNOWN' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die neue `READ TABLE` Syntax in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und `OPTIONAL` ermöglicht das direkte Lesen eines Tabelleneintrags und die Zuweisung eines Standardwerts, falls der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird. Dies vereinfacht den Code erheblich, da explizite `IF sy-subrc <> 0` Prüfungen entfallen.
keywords: READ TABLE, VALUE, Internal Tables, Optional

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen übertragen werden sollen. Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
hint: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator ist eine moderne und typsichere Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `LOOP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY ( field1 = itab-field1 ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_itb_group_by=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'JFK' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '1000' cityfrom = 'ORD' cityto = 'LAX' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'MUC' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0050' cityfrom = 'DFW' cityto = 'LAX' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' cityfrom = 'MUC' cityto = 'JFK' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'UA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis aller Flüge in der `sflight` Tabelle für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` und `FOR` Ausdrücke zur Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).

    rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_price_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    " Setup test data for 'LH' (Lufthansa)
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 currency = 'EUR' ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' price = 300 currency = 'EUR' ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    " Expected average: (100+200+300)/3 = 200

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->get_average_price( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price for LH incorrect' act = lv_avg exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_price_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_avg) = lo_cut->get_average_price( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price should be 0 for non-existent carrier' act = lv_avg exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt `REDUCE` um die Summe der Flugpreise in einem funktionalen Stil zu berechnen, gefolgt von einer einfachen Division durch die Anzahl der Zeilen (`lines()`), um den Durchschnitt zu erhalten. Dies ist kompakter und lesbarer als eine klassische LOOP-Anweisung.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, AVERAGE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtere alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, deren Preis über dem Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge dieser Gesellschaft liegt.
hint: Kombiniere `REDUCE` für den Durchschnitt und `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Filterung.
solution:
TYPES: sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_filter_above_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_above_avg
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_above_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_above_avg.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( flight-price > lv_avg_price )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_above_avg FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_all_same_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_above_avg.
    " Setup test data for 'AA' (American Airlines)
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = '20250103' price = 300 ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    " Average for AA would be (100+200+300)/3 = 200. Expected: flight with price 300.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_above_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_res) = lo_cut->get_flights_above_avg( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 1 flight above average' act = lines( lt_res ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected price 300' act = lt_res[ 1 ]-price exp = 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_above_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_res) = lo_cut->get_flights_above_avg( 'ZZ' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be empty for no data' act = lt_res ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_all_same_price.
    " Setup test data for 'BB'
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BB' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BB' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' price = 150 ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    " Average for BB is 150. No flights should be above average.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_above_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_res) = lo_cut->get_flights_above_avg( 'BB' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be empty if all prices are same as average' act = lt_res ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Kombination von `REDUCE` zur Berechnung eines Aggregatwerts (Durchschnitt) und `VALUE #( FOR ... WHERE ... )` zur Filterung einer internen Tabelle basierend auf diesem Wert. Dies ist ein sehr effizienter und lesbarer Weg, um Daten zu transformieren und zu filtern.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Filtering, AVERAGE

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft nach ihrer Verbindungs-ID (`connid`) und berechne den durchschnittlichen Preis für jede Verbindung.
hint: Nutze `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_avg_price,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_avg_price.
TYPES: tt_flight_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_group_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_price_by_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_flight_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_by_connid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid )
      ( 
        carrid    = flight-carrid,
        connid    = flight-connid,
        avg_price = REDUCE s_price(
                      INIT sum_price = 0
                      FOR member IN GROUP
                      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price
                    ) / lines( GROUP )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_avg_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_avg_price.
    " Setup test data for 'UA' (United Airlines)
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '200' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '200' fldate = '20250102' price = 400 ) ) INTO TABLE sflight.
    " Expected:
    " CONNID '100': Avg (100+200)/2 = 150
    " CONNID '200': Avg (300+400)/2 = 350

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_res) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_by_connid( 'UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 groups' act = lines( lt_res ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_res_100) = lt_res[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Avg price for 100 incorrect' act = ls_res_100-avg_price exp = 150 ).

    DATA(ls_res_200) = lt_res[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'UA' connid = '200' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Avg price for 200 incorrect' act = ls_res_200-avg_price exp = 350 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_res) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_by_connid( 'YY' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be empty for no data' act = lt_res ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die leistungsstarke `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax, um Daten in einer internen Tabelle zu gruppieren. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird dann `REDUCE` verwendet, um den Durchschnittspreis zu berechnen. CLASS zcl_calc_avg_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f. " Use float for average
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_avg_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR num IN it_numbers
      NEXT total = total + num
    ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / lines( it_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit einer Vergleichslogik (`COND`).

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = 0. " Or initial value of s_price
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT max_val = 0 " Assuming prices are non-negative
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_val = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_val THEN flight-price ELSE max_val )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concat_connids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_concatenated_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concat_connids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_concatenated_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY connid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_connids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid ELSE result && ',' && flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_number_parity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filter_sort_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sorted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sorted_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sort_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sorted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    rt_filtered_sorted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( flight-price > iv_min_price )

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer Fluggesellschaft, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung im `FOR`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_future_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_future_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_total_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( flight-fldate > iv_min_fldate )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die einen bestimmten Mindestpreis überschreiten.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
TYPES: tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_carrier_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_stats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_stats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_stats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_stats = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( flight-price > iv_min_price ) GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      ( 
        carrid       = flight-carrid,
        flight_count = lines( GROUP ),
        avg_price    = REDUCE s_price(
                           INIT sum_price = 0
                           FOR member IN GROUP
                           NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price
                         ) / lines( GROUP )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine dynamische interne Tabelle, die die Fluggesellschaften und die Anzahl ihrer Flüge enthält, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an Flügen haben.
hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` und `COND` für die Filterung der Gruppen.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_flight_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_flight_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET lv_count = lines( GROUP ) IN
      WHERE ( lv_count >= iv_min_flights )
      ( 
        carrid       = flight-carrid,
        flight_count = lv_count
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft den höchsten und niedrigsten Flugpreis enthält.
hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` für Min/Max-Berechnung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_min_max_price,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             min_price TYPE s_price,
             max_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_min_max_price.
TYPES: tt_min_max_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_min_max_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_min_max_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_max_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_min_max_prices) TYPE tt_min_max_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_max_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_max_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_min_max_prices = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      ( 
        carrid    = flight-carrid,
        min_price = REDUCE s_price(
                      INIT min_val = flight-price " Initialize with first price in group
                      FOR member IN GROUP
                      NEXT min_val = COND #( WHEN member-price < min_val THEN member-price ELSE min_val )
                    ),
        max_price = REDUCE s_price(
                      INIT max_val = flight-price " Initialize with first price in group
                      FOR member IN GROUP
                      NEXT max_val = COND #( WHEN member-price > max_val THEN member-price ELSE max_val )
                    )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und geben Sie jede zweite Zeile zusammen mit ihrem Index aus. Demonstrieren Sie sowohl `sy-tabix` als auch `LINE_INDEX`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO ...` mit `sy-tabix` und eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `LINE_INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tabix_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tabix_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA(lv_output) = VALUE string_table( ).

    " Using LOOP AT ... INTO ... with sy-tabix
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE ( sy-tabix MOD 2 ) = 0.
      APPEND |sy-tabix: { sy-tabix }, Flight: { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }| TO lv_output.
    ENDLOOP.

    APPEND `---` TO lv_output.

    " Using FOR expression with LINE_INDEX
    lv_output = VALUE string_table( BASE lv_output
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights INDEX INTO lv_index WHERE ( lv_index MOD 2 ) = 0
      ( |LINE_INDEX: { lv_index }, Flight: { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }| )
    ).
    rt_result = lv_output.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tabix_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_tabix_demo=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'BB' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'CC' connid = '003' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'DD' connid = '004' fldate = '20250104' )
      ( carrid = 'EE' connid = '005' fldate = '20250105' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = `sy-tabix: 2, Flight: BB-002` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = `---` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[4] exp = `LINE_INDEX: 2, Flight: BB-002` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `sy-tabix` ist ein klassisches Systemfeld, das den aktuellen Zeilenindex in einer `LOOP`-Schleife enthält. In modernen ABAP-Versionen kann `LINE_INDEX` in `FOR`-Ausdrücken eine ähnliche Funktionalität bieten, oft mit besserer Lesbarkeit und in funktionalen Kontexten.
keywords: sy-tabix, LOOP, FOR, LINE_INDEX, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zugreift, deren Wert ändert und das Feldsymbol anschließend explizit unassigniert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS manipulate_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        io_data       TYPE REF TO ty_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE io_data->* TO <fs_any>.

    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Attempt to assign new value, handling type conversion if necessary
      TRY.
          <fs_any> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
          " Handle type mismatch, e.g., log error or raise exception
          MESSAGE `Type conversion failed for component` TYPE 'W'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_any>. " Explicitly unassign the field symbol
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_unassign_dynamic=>ty_data( field1 = 'Initial' field2 = 10 ).

    lo_cut->manipulate_dynamic_field(

    lo_cut->manipulate_dynamic_field(

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle nach `carrid` und `connid`. Für jede Gruppe, geben Sie den `carrid`, `connid` und den `LINE_INDEX` des ersten Elements der Gruppe aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS ... OF ...` und `GROUP INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group_info,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             first_idx TYPE i,
           END OF ty_group_info.
    TYPES tt_group_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_group_first_index
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_group_indices) TYPE tt_group_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_group_first_index.
    " Populate sflights for demo if empty
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_db)
        UP TO 10 ROWS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        it_flights = lt_sflight_db.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rt_group_indices = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS <group_key> OF ls_flight IN it_flights
        GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
        ASCENDING
      ( 
        carrid    = <group_key>-carrid
        connid    = <group_key>-connid
        first_idx = GROUP INDEX
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_indices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_tabix( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_tabix=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250103' price = 110 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = 210 )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_group_info ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_group_info[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_group_info[1]-connid exp = '0017' ).

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle, weisen Sie jede Zeile einem Feldsymbol zu, ändern Sie einen Wert und unassignieren Sie das Feldsymbol explizit nach der Verarbeitung jeder Zeile.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING ...` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_table_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      CHANGING
        ct_items TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_table_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_item> TYPE ty_item.

    LOOP AT ct_items ASSIGNING <fs_item>.
      <fs_item>-value = |Processed { <fs_item>-value }|.
      UNASSIGN <fs_item>. " Explicitly unassign after processing
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_process_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_table_line( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_unassign_table_line=>tt_item(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Item B' )
      ( id = 3 value = 'Item C' )
    ).

    lo_cut->process_items( CHANGING ct_items = lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[1]-value exp = 'Processed Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[2]-value exp = 'Processed Item B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[3]-value exp = 'Processed Item C' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_check> TYPE zcl_unassign_table_line=>ty_item.
    ASSIGN lt_items[1] TO <fs_check>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_check>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( <fs_check> IS ASSIGNED ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl Feldsymbole am Ende ihres Gültigkeitsbereichs automatisch unassigniert werden, kann die explizite Verwendung von `UNASSIGN` innerhalb einer Schleife die Absicht verdeutlichen oder in komplexeren Szenarien, in denen ein Feldsymbol wiederverwendet wird, nützlich sein.
