Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `UNASSIGN` und `IS ASSIGNED`, um die Gültigkeit eines Feldsymbols zu überprüfen. Weisen Sie ein Feldsymbol zu, unassignieren Sie es und überprüfen Sie dann seinen Status.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`, `UNASSIGN` und `IF fs IS ASSIGNED`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_field_symbol_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_log) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_field_symbol_status.
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Hello World'.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_text> TYPE ANY.

    APPEND `Initial: <fs_text> IS NOT ASSIGNED` TO rv_status_log.

    ASSIGN lv_text TO <fs_text>.
    IF <fs_text> IS ASSIGNED.
      APPEND `After ASSIGN: <fs_text> IS ASSIGNED` TO rv_status_log.
    ELSE.
      APPEND `After ASSIGN: <fs_text> IS NOT ASSIGNED (Error!)` TO rv_status_log.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_text>.
    IF <fs_text> IS ASSIGNED.
      APPEND `After UNASSIGN: <fs_text> IS ASSIGNED (Error!)` TO rv_status_log.
    ELSE.
      APPEND `After UNASSIGN: <fs_text> IS NOT ASSIGNED` TO rv_status_log.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fs_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fs_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_check( ).
    DATA(lt_log) = lo_cut->check_field_symbol_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_log ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[1] exp = `Initial: <fs_text> IS NOT ASSIGNED` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[2] exp = `After ASSIGN: <fs_text> IS ASSIGNED` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[3] exp = `After UNASSIGN: <fs_text> IS NOT ASSIGNED` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `UNASSIGN` und `IS ASSIGNED` ist grundlegend für die sichere Handhabung von Feldsymbolen. `IS ASSIGNED` ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit zu überprüfen, ob ein Feldsymbol auf ein gültiges Datenobjekt zeigt, was Fehler wie `ASSIGN_TYPE_CONFLICT` verhindern kann.
keywords: UNASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, IS ASSIGNED, Error Handling

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die kumulative Summe des `price`-Feldes aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, aber nur für die ersten N Zeilen, wobei N dynamisch übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `sy-tabix`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Klausel, die `sy-tabix` verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_cumulative_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
        iv_max_idx TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cumulative_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cumulative_price.
    " Populate sflights for demo if empty
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_db)
        UP TO 10 ROWS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        it_flights = lt_sflight_db.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rv_cumulative_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( sy-tabix <= iv_max_idx )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cumulative_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_tabix( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_tabix=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'BB' connid = '002' price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'CC' connid = '003' price = 300 )
      ( carrid = 'DD' connid = '004' price = 400 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_sum_2_items) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_max_idx = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_2_items exp = 300 ).

    DATA(lv_sum_all_items) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_max_idx = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_all_items exp = 1000 ).

    DATA(lv_sum_no_items) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_max_idx = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_no_items exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein leistungsstarker funktionaler Operator, der es ermöglicht, eine Tabelle zu aggregieren. In Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und der `WHERE`-Klausel, die `sy-tabix` verwendet, kann man komplexe Aggregationen basierend auf dem Zeilenindex durchführen.
keywords: REDUCE, sy-tabix, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die einen beliebigen Wert über ein Feldsymbol empfängt, dessen Typ zur Laufzeit überprüft und den Wert in einen String umwandelt. Das Feldsymbol soll nach der Verarbeitung unassigniert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs> TYPE ANY`, `GET REFERENCE OF` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_generic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_generic_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_value TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_generic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_generic_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_value->* TO <fs_any>.

    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Determine type and convert to string
      DATA(lv_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_any> ).
      CASE lv_type_descr->type_kind.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR
             cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
          rv_string_value = <fs_any>.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num OR
             cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR
             cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
          rv_string_value = |{ <fs_any> }|.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          rv_string_value = 'Unsupported Type'.
      ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      rv_string_value = 'Field symbol not assigned'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_any>. " Explicitly unassign
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generic_processing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unassign_after_generic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_processing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_generic( ).

    DATA(lv_string) = 'Test String'.
    DATA(lv_result_string) = lo_cut->process_generic_value( REF #( lv_string ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_string exp = 'Test String' ).

    DATA(lv_int) = 123.
    DATA(lv_result_int) = lo_cut->process_generic_value( REF #( lv_int ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_int exp = '123' ).

    DATA(lv_float) = '123.45'.
    DATA(lv_result_float) = lo_cut->process_generic_value( REF #( lv_float ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_float exp = 'Unsupported Type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unassign_after_generic.
    DATA(lv_data) = 'Some data'.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_check> TYPE ANY.
    ASSIGN lv_data TO <fs_check>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_check> IS ASSIGNED ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_generic( ).
    lo_cut->process_generic_value( REF #( lv_data ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_check> IS ASSIGNED ).
    UNASSIGN <fs_check>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( <fs_check> IS ASSIGNED ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: In generischen Methoden, die mit `TYPE REF TO data` und Feldsymbolen arbeiten, ist `UNASSIGN` wichtig, um die Kontrolle über die Zuweisung zu behalten. `cl_abap_typedescr` ist ein modernes Werkzeug zur Laufzeit-Typanalyse.
keywords: UNASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, TYPE REF TO data, cl_abap_typedescr, Object Orientation, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, die zusätzlich zu den ursprünglichen Feldern eine Spalte für die Zeilennummer (Index) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `sy-tabix` oder `LINE_INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tabix_line_number DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_index,
             line_num TYPE i,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_index.
    TYPES tt_sflight_with_index TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_index WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_line_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_index) TYPE tt_sflight_with_index.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tabix_line_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_line_numbers.
    " Populate sflights for demo if empty
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_db)
        UP TO 5 ROWS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        it_flights = lt_sflight_db.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flights_with_index = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights INDEX INTO lv_index
      ( line_num = lv_index
        carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_add_line_numbers FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_add_line_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tabix_line_number( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_tabix_line_number=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'BB' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'CC' connid = '003' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_line_numbers( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-line_num exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-line_num exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-carrid exp = 'CC' ).

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie, wie `UNASSIGN` verwendet werden kann, um ein Feldsymbol, das auf eine große Datenmenge zeigt, explizit freizugeben, um potenziell Speicher früher freizugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_memory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_large_data,
             field1 TYPE string LENGTH 255,
             field2 TYPE string LENGTH 255,
             field3 TYPE string LENGTH 255,
             field4 TYPE string LENGTH 255,
             field5 TYPE string LENGTH 255,
           END OF ty_large_data.
    TYPES tt_large_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_large_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_large_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_large_data.
    METHODS get_memory_usage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_memory_kb) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_memory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_large_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_large_table> TYPE tt_large_data.

    " Assign the large table to a field symbol
    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_large_table>.

    IF <fs_large_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Simulate some processing
      LOOP AT <fs_large_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
        <fs_line>-field1 = 'Processed'.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    " Explicitly unassign the field symbol to potentially release memory earlier
    UNASSIGN <fs_large_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_memory_usage.
    " This is a placeholder. Actual memory measurement is complex and
    " not directly exposed in simple ABAP statements for specific objects.
    " In a real scenario, one might use transaction S_ALR_87000001 or
    " analyze memory dumps. For demo, we return a dummy value.
    rv_memory_kb = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > 1000
      ( field1 = |Data { i } A| field2 = |Data { i } B| field3 = |Data { i } C|
        field4 = |Data { i } D| field5 = |Data { i } E| )

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle, um nur die Flüge zu erhalten, die in der ersten Hälfte der Tabelle erscheinen (basierend auf dem Index).
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit `sy-tabix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_half_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_half_flights.
    " Populate sflights for demo if empty
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_db)
        UP TO 10 ROWS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        it_flights = lt_sflight_db.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_half_size) = CEIL( lines( it_flights ) / 2 ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE ( sy-tabix <= lv_half_size ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle. Wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist, weisen Sie ein Feldsymbol zu und verarbeiten Sie es. Unassignieren Sie das Feldsymbol explizit, bevor die nächste Iteration beginnt, um sicherzustellen, dass es nur bei Bedarf zugewiesen ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ...`, `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`, `IF ... IS ASSIGNED` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_in_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_conditional_assign
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_ids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_in_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_conditional_assign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_current_item> TYPE ty_data.

    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_item).
      UNASSIGN <fs_current_item>. " Ensure it's unassigned at start of each iteration

      IF ls_item-id MOD 2 = 0. " Process only even IDs
        ASSIGN ls_item TO <fs_current_item>. " Assign to the current loop line

        IF <fs_current_item> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Simulate processing
          APPEND <fs_current_item>-id TO rt_processed_ids.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_assign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_assign.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_in_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_unassign_in_loop=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'B' )
      ( id = 3 value = 'C' )
      ( id = 4 value = 'D' )
      ( id = 5 value = 'E' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result_ids) = lo_cut->process_conditional_assign( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_ids ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_ids[1] exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_ids[2] exp = 4 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_check> TYPE zcl_unassign_in_loop=>ty_data.
    ASSIGN lt_input[1] TO <fs_check>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_check>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( <fs_check> IS ASSIGNED ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das explizite `UNASSIGN` eines Feldsymbols am Anfang einer Schleifeniteration stellt sicher, dass es nur dann zugewiesen ist, wenn die Bedingung erfüllt ist. Dies kann helfen, unbeabsichtigte Verwendungen eines Feldsymbols aus einer vorherigen Iteration zu vermeiden.
keywords: UNASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, LOOP AT, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Paginierungslogik für eine interne Tabelle. Geben Sie eine bestimmte Anzahl von Zeilen ab einem Startindex zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... FROM ... TO ...` oder einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `sy-tabix` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tabix_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_page_of_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
        iv_page_size TYPE i
        iv_page_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_page_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tabix_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_page_of_flights.
    " Populate sflights for demo if empty
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_db)
        UP TO 20 ROWS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        it_flights = lt_sflight_db.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_start_index) = ( iv_page_number - 1 ) * iv_page_size + 1.
    DATA(lv_end_index)   = lv_start_index + iv_page_size - 1.

    rt_page_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( sy-tabix >= lv_start_index AND sy-tabix <= lv_end_index )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_pagination FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_pagination.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tabix_pagination( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_tabix_pagination=>tt_sflight(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > 10
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = |{ i ALPHA = IN }| fldate = '20250101' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_page1) = lo_cut->get_page_of_flights( it_flights = lt_input iv_page_size = 3 iv_page_number = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_page1 ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_page1[1]-connid exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_page1[3]-connid exp = '003' ).

    DATA(lt_page2) = lo_cut->get_page_of_flights( it_flights = lt_input iv_page_size = 3 iv_page_number = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_page2 ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_page2[1]-connid exp = '004' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_page2[3]-connid exp = '006' ).

    DATA(lt_page_last) = lo_cut->get_page_of_flights( it_flights = lt_input iv_page_size = 3 iv_page_number = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_page_last ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_page_last[1]-connid exp = '010' ).

    DATA(lt_page_empty) = lo_cut->get_page_of_flights( it_flights = lt_input iv_page_size = 3 iv_page_number = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_page_empty ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `sy-tabix` ist ideal für die Implementierung von Paginierungslogik, da es den aktuellen Zeilenindex liefert. In Kombination mit `FOR`-Ausdrücken und `WHERE`-Klauseln können Sie effizient Teilmengen einer Tabelle extrahieren.
keywords: sy-tabix, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Pagination

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu. Wenn die Komponente ein Feldsymbol ist, unassignieren Sie es explizit, bevor Sie es neu zuweisen oder verlassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_data,
             sub_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sub_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_main_data,
             id        TYPE i,
             value     TYPE string,
             sub_data  TYPE ty_sub_data,
           END OF ty_main_data.
    TYPES tt_main_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_main_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_nested_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_id         TYPE i
        iv_component  TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_main_data  TYPE tt_main_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_nested_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_main_line> TYPE ty_main_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_nested_component> TYPE ANY.

    READ TABLE ct_main_data ASSIGNING <fs_main_line> WITH KEY id = iv_id.
    IF <fs_main_line> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Unassign any previously assigned nested component field symbol
      UNASSIGN <fs_nested_component>.

      " Dynamically assign to the component
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_main_line> TO <fs_nested_component>.

      IF <fs_nested_component> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Attempt to assign new value
        TRY.
            <fs_nested_component> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
            MESSAGE `Type conversion failed for nested component` TYPE 'W'.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_main_line>. " Unassign main line field symbol
    UNASSIGN <fs_nested_component>. " Ensure nested field symbol is also unassigned
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_nested FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unassign_nested_fs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_nested.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_nested( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_unassign_nested=>tt_main_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Main 1' sub_data = VALUE #( sub_field = 'Sub 1' ) )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Main 2' sub_data = VALUE #( sub_field = 'Sub 2' ) )
    ).

    lo_cut->update_nested_field(
      iv_id        = 1
      iv_component = 'VALUE'
      iv_new_value = 'Updated Main 1'
      CHANGING ct_main_data = lt_data
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[1]-value exp = 'Updated Main 1' ).

    lo_cut->update_nested_field(
      iv_id        = 2
      iv_component = 'SUB_DATA-SUB_FIELD'
      iv_new_value = 'Updated Sub 2'
      CHANGING ct_main_data = lt_data
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[2]-sub_data-sub_field exp = 'Updated Sub 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unassign_nested_fs.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_unassign_nested=>ty_main_data( id = 1 sub_data = VALUE #( sub_field = 'Test' ) ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_outer> TYPE zcl_unassign_nested=>ty_main_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_inner> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ls_data TO <fs_outer>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SUB_DATA-SUB_FIELD' OF STRUCTURE <fs_outer> TO <fs_inner>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_outer> IS ASSIGNED ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_inner> IS ASSIGNED ).

    UNASSIGN <fs_inner>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( <fs_inner> IS ASSIGNED ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_outer> IS ASSIGNED ).

    UNASSIGN <fs_outer>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( <fs_outer> IS ASSIGNED ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim dynamischen Zugriff auf verschachtelte Strukturen über Feldsymbole ist es wichtig, die Gültigkeit der Feldsymbole zu verwalten. Explizites `UNASSIGN` hilft, sicherzustellen, dass ein Feldsymbol nicht versehentlich auf ein falsches oder veraltetes Datenobjekt zeigt, insbesondere wenn es in einer Schleife oder bei wiederholten dynamischen Zuweisungen verwendet wird.
keywords: UNASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Dynamic Programming, Nested Structures

Instructions: Übersetzen Sie einen Textschlüssel (z.B. aus dem OTR) in eine Zielsprache. Da OTR-Objekte nicht direkt im Beispiel erstellt werden können, simulieren wir dies mit einem festen Text und einer Zielsprache.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_i18n_utils=>get_text_by_key`. Für einen echten Test müsste ein OTR-Objekt existieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_translate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_translated_text IMPORTING iv_text_key TYPE string iv_language TYPE sy-langu RETURNING VALUE(rv_translated_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_translate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_translated_text.
    " In a real scenario, iv_text_key would refer to an OTR object or a message class text.
    " For demonstration, we simulate a translation.
    CASE iv_text_key.
      WHEN 'HELLO_WORLD'.
        CASE iv_language.
          WHEN 'DE'.
            rv_translated_text = 'Hallo Welt'.
          WHEN 'EN'.
            rv_translated_text = 'Hello World'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_translated_text = 'Hello World'. " Fallback
        ENDCASE.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_translated_text = iv_text_key. " No translation found
    ENDCASE.
    " A real implementation would use cl_i18n_utils=>get_text_by_key or similar for OTR/message class.
    " Example: rv_translated_text = cl_i18n_utils=>get_text_by_key( iv_text_key = iv_text_key iv_language = iv_language ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Strukturen desselben Typs dynamisch auf Gleichheit aller Komponenten.
hint: Iterieren Sie über Komponenten mit RTTI und vergleichen Sie die Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field_char TYPE string,
             field_int  TYPE i,
             field_date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_s_data.

    METHODS compare_structures IMPORTING is_data1 TYPE ty_s_data
                                              is_data2 TYPE ty_s_data
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rb_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_data1 ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value1> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value2> TYPE any.

    rb_are_equal = abap_true. " Assume equal until proven otherwise

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE is_data1 TO <fs_value1>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE is_data2 TO <fs_value2>.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF <fs_value1> <> <fs_value2>.
          rb_are_equal = abap_false.
          EXIT. " Found a difference, no need to check further
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        " This case should ideally not happen if both structures are of the same type
        " and described by the same descriptor.
        rb_are_equal = abap_false. " Component not found in one of the structures (error)
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_structures FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_structures.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_data1) TYPE zcl_rtti_compare_struct=>ty_s_data.
    DATA(ls_data2) TYPE zcl_rtti_compare_struct=>ty_s_data.
    DATA(ls_data3) TYPE zcl_rtti_compare_struct=>ty_s_data.

    ls_data1-field_char = 'ABC'.
    ls_data1-field_int = 123.
    ls_data1-field_date = '20250101'.

    ls_data2 = ls_data1. " Copy for equality

    ls_data3-field_char = 'XYZ'.
    ls_data3-field_int = 456.
    ls_data3-field_date = '20250102'.

    " Test equal structures
    DATA(lb_equal) = lo_cut->compare_structures( is_data1 = ls_data1 is_data2 = ls_data2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lb_equal msg = 'Identical structures should be equal' ).

    " Test unequal structures
    DATA(lb_unequal) = lo_cut->compare_structures( is_data1 = ls_data1 is_data2 = ls_data3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lb_unequal msg = 'Different structures should be unequal' ).

    " Test partial difference
    ls_data3 = ls_data1.
    ls_data3-field_int = 999.
    DATA(lb_partial_unequal) = lo_cut->compare_structures( is_data1 = ls_data1 is_data2 = ls_data3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lb_partial_unequal msg = 'Structures with one difference should be unequal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Ansatz nutzt RTTI, um generisch über alle Komponenten zweier Strukturen zu iterieren und deren Werte zu vergleichen. Dies ist eine flexible Lösung, wenn der Strukturtyp zur Entwicklungszeit nicht fest codiert werden kann oder wenn eine generische Vergleichsfunktion benötigt wird.
keywords: RTTI, Vergleich, Struktur, Dynamisch, cl_abap_structdescr, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Feld-Symbol

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typ (z.B. CHAR, NUMC, DATE) einer spezifischen Komponente einer Struktur zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_type_kind( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_comp_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             material_id TYPE matnr,
             quantity    TYPE i,
             delivery_dt TYPE sy-datum,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_item.

    METHODS get_component_type_kind IMPORTING is_item       TYPE ty_s_item
                                                  iv_comp_name  TYPE string
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rv_type_kind) TYPE c LENGTH 1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_comp_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_type_kind.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( is_item ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp) WITH KEY name = iv_comp_name.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_comp-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ).
      " Or directly: DATA(lo_type_descr) = ls_comp-type_descr.
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_type_descr ).
      rv_type_kind = lo_elem_descr->type_kind.
    ELSE.
      " Handle error: component not found
      rv_type_kind = ''.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS zcl_it_delete_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS delete_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_delete_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid <> 'AA' OR connid <> '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_it_delete_filter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '100'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '200'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum + 1.
    <fs_flight>-price = '150'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_delete_filter( ).

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHTS, basierend auf den Feldern Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        io_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    ro_flights = io_flights. " Copy input table
    SORT ro_flights BY carrid connid. " Duplicates must be adjacent
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ro_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_it_delete_duplicates=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '200'.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Methode, um doppelte Einträge aus internen Tabellen zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den Vergleichsfeldern zu sortieren, da nur direkt aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate gelöscht werden. Die `COMPARING` Klausel ermöglicht die Angabe der Felder, die für die Duplikatsprüfung relevant sind.
keywords: DELETE, Duplicates, Internal Tables, SORT

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Strings aus einer Liste, die ein bestimmtes Substring enthalten, unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `CONTAINS` oder `CP` (Contains Pattern) für die Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_filter_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_string
        iv_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE tt_string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_filter_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_strings.
    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( it_strings WHERE table_line CP '*' && iv_substring && '*' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_strings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_strings.
    DATA(lt_test_strings) = VALUE zcl_str_filter_delete=>tt_string(
      ( 'Hello World' )
      ( 'ABAP is great' )
      ( 'Modern ABAP' )
      ( 'Hello SAP' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_filter_delete( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_strings( it_strings = lt_test_strings iv_substring = 'SAP' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ table_line = 'Hello SAP' ] ). " Should not contain 'Hello SAP'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Hello World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine prägnante Syntax, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Elemente enthält, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. In diesem Fall werden Strings, die das angegebene Substring enthalten, ausgeschlossen. Die Verwendung von `CP` (Contains Pattern) ermöglicht eine flexible Mustersuche.
keywords: DELETE, FILTER, String Processing, Internal Tables, CP

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl (Integer) innerhalb eines angegebenen Bereichs (inklusive Minimum und Maximum).

CLASS zcl_random_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD get_random_int.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(

Die Methode `create` initialisiert den Zufallszahlengenerator mit dem gewünschten Bereich, und `get_next` liefert die nächste Zufallszahl. Dies ist die empfohlene moderne Methode für Zufallszahlen in ABAP.
keywords: RANDOM, Math, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Integer

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_random_int` mit einer Schleife und String-Templates, um Zeichen zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_alphanum_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_alphanum_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = lv_chars_len - 1 ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lc_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_random_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_random_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 10.
    DATA(lv_random_str) = lo_cut->get_random_alphanum_string( lv_length ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lv_random_str ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_str ) exp = lv_length ).
    " Check if it contains only alphanumeric characters (basic check)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_random_str CP 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789*' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert die Zufallszahlengenerierung mittels `cl_abap_random_int` mit String-Operationen. In einer Schleife wird für jede Position des Zielstrings ein zufälliger Index generiert, um ein Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Satz von alphanumerischen Zeichen auszuwählen. String-Templates (`&&`) werden für die effiziente String-Verkettung verwendet.
keywords: RANDOM, String Processing, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, String Templates

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHTS aus.
hint: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen, generieren Sie einen zufälligen Index und lesen Sie die Tabelle mit diesem Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_flights ).
    IF lv_lines = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_lines ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE it_flights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_random_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_random_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_random_flight_empty FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_random_flight.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_random_table_entry=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '100'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '200'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'SQ'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '300'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_entry( ).
    DATA(ls_random_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( ls_random_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_test_flights[ carrid = ls_random_flight-carrid
                                                                  connid = ls_random_flight-connid
                                                                  fldate = ls_random_flight-fldate ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_random_flight_empty.
    DATA: lt_empty_flights TYPE zcl_random_table_entry=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_entry( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_table_line_not_found ).
    lo_cut->get_random_flight( lt_empty_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode nutzt `lines()` um die Anzahl der Einträge in der internen Tabelle zu ermitteln. Anschließend wird mit `cl_abap_random_int` ein zufälliger Index innerhalb des gültigen Bereichs generiert. `READ TABLE ... INDEX ...` ermöglicht dann den direkten Zugriff auf den zufällig ausgewählten Eintrag. Eine Ausnahmebehandlung stellt sicher, dass leere Tabellen korrekt behandelt werden.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, READ TABLE

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHTS zufällig durch Hinzufügen eines temporären Zufallsfeldes und Sortieren.
hint: Fügen Sie ein temporäres Feld für eine Zufallszahl hinzu, füllen Sie es mit `cl_abap_random_int` und sortieren Sie die Tabelle nach diesem Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_shuffle_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             random_key TYPE i, " Temporary field for shuffling
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_shuffle_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_flights.
    rt_shuffled_flights = it_flights.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 1000000 ). " Large range for better randomness

    LOOP AT rt_shuffled_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-random_key = lo_random->get_next( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT rt_shuffled_flights BY random_key.

    " Remove the temporary random_key field if not needed further
    " This step is optional and depends on whether the caller expects the original structure
    " For this example, we keep it to demonstrate the shuffle.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_random_shuffle_table=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '100'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '200'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'SQ'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '300'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0002'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '400'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_shuffle_table( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_flights) = lo_cut->shuffle_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_flights ) exp = lines( lt_test_flights ) ).
    " It's hard to deterministically test if a shuffle is 'random', but we can check if it's different.
    " There's a small chance it could be the same, but highly unlikely with enough entries.
    DATA(lv_is_different) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_original).
      IF ls_original-carrid <> lt_shuffled_flights[ sy-tabix ]-carrid OR
         ls_original-connid <> lt_shuffled_flights[ sy-tabix ]-connid.
        lv_is_different = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_is_different ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Mischen einer internen Tabelle wird erreicht, indem jedem Eintrag ein temporäres Zufallsfeld hinzugefügt und dieses mit Werten von `cl_abap_random_int` gefüllt wird. Anschließend wird die Tabelle nach diesem Zufallsfeld sortiert. Dies führt zu einer zufälligen Anordnung der ursprünglichen Einträge. Das temporäre Feld kann bei Bedarf nach dem Mischen entfernt werden.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, SORT, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Shuffle

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb eines angegebenen Datumsbereichs.
hint: Wandeln Sie die Start- und Enddaten in Tage um, generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl für die Tage und wandeln Sie diese zurück in ein Datum.

CLASS zcl_random_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_end_date   TYPE d

        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    DATA(lv_start_days) = iv_start_date - '00000000'. " Days since 00000000
    DATA(lv_end_days)   = iv_end_date - '00000000'.

    IF lv_start_days > lv_end_days.
      " Swap if start date is after end date
      DATA(lv_temp) = lv_start_days.
      lv_start_days = lv_end_days.
      lv_end_days = lv_temp.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = lv_start_days
      max = lv_end_days
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_random_date = '00000000' + lv_random_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_delete_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_and_count_flights
      IMPORTING
        io_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      EXPORTING
        ev_deleted_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_remaining_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_delete_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_and_count_flights.
    ro_remaining_flights = io_flights.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ro_remaining_flights ).

    DELETE ro_remaining_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    ev_deleted_count = lv_initial_lines - lines( ro_remaining_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_delete_by_keylist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE HASHED KEY carrid connid.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_it_delete_by_keylist IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von N eindeutigen Zufallszahlen innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in einer Schleife und speichern Sie die Zahlen in einer Hash-Tabelle, um Duplikate zu vermeiden, bis N eindeutige Zahlen gesammelt wurden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_unique_numbers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min    TYPE i
        iv_max    TYPE i
        iv_count  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE tt_unique_numbers
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " If range is too small for count
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    IF iv_count < 0 OR iv_min > iv_max OR ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ) < iv_count.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = iv_min max = iv_max ).

    DO.
      IF lines( rt_unique_numbers ) = iv_count.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      INSERT lo_random->get_next( ) INTO TABLE rt_unique_numbers.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_random_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_unique_random_numbers_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_min) = 1.
    DATA(lv_max) = 10.
    DATA(lv_count) = 5.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_min = lv_min iv_max = lv_max iv_count = lv_count ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_count ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_num >= lv_min AND lv_num <= lv_max ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_unique_random_numbers_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_numbers( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_arithmetic_error ).
    lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 2 iv_count = 5 ). " Range too small
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode generiert eine Liste von eindeutigen Zufallszahlen. Sie verwendet eine `HASHED TABLE` als Ziel, da diese automatisch Duplikate verhindert. In einer `DO`-Schleife werden Zufallszahlen mit `cl_abap_random_int` generiert und in die Hash-Tabelle eingefügt, bis die gewünschte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen erreicht ist. Eine Vorabprüfung stellt sicher, dass der Bereich groß genug ist, um die angeforderte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen zu liefern.
keywords: RANDOM, Unique, Math, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Hashed Table

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem Text und geben Sie diese als Liste zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` und die Methode `find_all`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_number_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d+`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_regex->find_all( text = iv_text ).

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_matches ( <match>-offset_and_length[0]-text ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_regex_number_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( '123' ) ( '456' ) ( '7890' ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_extractor->extract_numbers( 'Text with 123 numbers and 456 more, finally 7890.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_numbers.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_regex_number_extractor( ).

Mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck können die extrahierten Textelemente kompakt in eine `string_table` überführt werden. `\d+` steht für eine oder mehrere Ziffern.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand mehrerer Trennzeichen (z.B. Komma, Semikolon oder Leerzeichen) auf und geben Sie die nicht-leeren Teile zurück.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und `substring` oder `split` mit einem Regex-Muster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_multi_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_multiple_delimiters
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_multi_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_multiple_delimiters.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `[,;\s]+`. " Matches one or more commas, semicolons, or spaces
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern ).

    " Using FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX with the pattern object
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lo_regex->get_pattern( ) IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    DATA(lv_last_offset) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      DATA(lv_part) = iv_text+lv_last_offset( ls_match-offset - lv_last_offset ).
      IF lv_part IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND lv_part TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_offset = ls_match-offset + ls_match-length.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add the remaining part after the last delimiter
    DATA(lv_remaining_part) = iv_text+lv_last_offset.
    IF lv_remaining_part IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND lv_remaining_part TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst werden alle Trennzeichen gefunden, dann wird der String basierend auf deren Positionen in Teile zerlegt. Der `lv_pattern` `[,;\s]+` matcht ein oder mehrere Kommas, Semikolons oder Leerzeichen. Die Verwendung von `substring` mit Offset und Länge ist eine moderne Art, String-Teile zu extrahieren.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem Log-Eintrag im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS - MESSAGE' das Datum, die Uhrzeit und die Nachricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit Capturing Groups.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
         log_date TYPE d,
         log_time TYPE t,
         message  TYPE string,
       END OF ty_log_entry.

CLASS zcl_regex_log_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_log_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_line TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_log_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_log_entry.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) (\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}) - (.*)$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_by_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern ).

    IF lo_regex->match( text = iv_log_line ).
      DATA(lt_submatches) = lo_regex->get_submatches( ).
      IF lines( lt_submatches ) = 3. " Expecting 3 capturing groups
        rs_log_entry-log_date = lt_submatches[1]-text.
        rs_log_entry-log_time = lt_submatches[2]-text.
        rs_log_entry-message  = lt_submatches[3]-text.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_basic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_simple_model.
    DATA: lo_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
    DATA: lv_vrml_data TYPE string.

    " Simulate a simple VRML cube
    lv_vrml_data = `
#VRML V2.0 utf8
Shape {
  geometry Box { size 2 2 2 }
  appearance Appearance {
    material Material { diffuseColor 1 0 0 }
  }
}`.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_3d_viewer
          EXPORTING
            parent = io_container.

        lo_3d_viewer->load_model_from_stream(
          EXPORTING
            i_stream_type = 'VRML'
            i_stream_data = lv_vrml_data
            i_model_id    = 'CUBE_001'
        ).

        " Optional: Set camera position for better view
        lo_3d_viewer->set_camera_position(
          i_x = 5.0
          i_y = 5.0
          i_z = 5.0
          i_look_at_x = 0.0
          i_look_at_y = 0.0
          i_look_at_z = 0.0
        ).

        io_container->set_visible( abap_true ).

      CATCH cx_gui_error cx_ecl_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer als String, Datum) enthält, und konvertieren Sie dabei die Flugnummer in einen String.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` für die Initialisierung und `CONV` für die Typkonvertierung innerhalb der `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_conv_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid_str TYPE string,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_converted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_conv_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_converted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                          ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                            connid_str = CONV string( <fs_sflight>-connid )
                            fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_converted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_converted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_conv_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_converted_flights( 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights ),
      exp = 3,
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Zeilen zurückgegeben werden.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid_str,
      msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte nicht leer sein.'
    ).
    DATA(lv_first_connid_str) = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid_str.
    DATA(lv_first_connid_int) = CONV i( lv_first_connid_str ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_first_connid_str,
      exp = CONV string( lv_first_connid_int ),
      msg = 'Konvertierung sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE` und `FOR` ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Initialisierung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. `CONV` wird hier inline für die Typkonvertierung verwendet.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, CONV, INTERNAL_TABLES, TYPE_CONVERSION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der eine kommaseparierte Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_for_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrid_list
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrid_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_for_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_list.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS.

    rv_carrid_list = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                    FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                                        ELSE s && `, ` && <fs_sflight>-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: In einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), ersetzen Sie im Feld `CARRID` alle Vorkommen des Buchstabens 'A' durch 'X'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und die Funktion `REPLACE` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_replace_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_car_id
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_modified) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_replace_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_car_id.
    rt_sflights_modified = it_sflights.
    LOOP AT rt_sflights_modified ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      <fs_sflight>-carrid = REPLACE( val = <fs_sflight>-carrid old = 'A' new = 'X' occ = 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_in_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_in_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_itb_replace_field=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0001'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0002'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_replace_field( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_car_id( lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight>-carrid exp = 'XX' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und der `REPLACE`-Funktion innerhalb der Schleife ist die effiziente und moderne Art, Feldwerte in internen Tabellen zu manipulieren.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_descr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_kind
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_table_kind) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_descr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_kind.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ).
    CASE lo_table_descr->table_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard THEN rv_table_kind = 'Standard Table'.
      WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_sorted  THEN rv_table_kind = 'Sorted Table'.
      WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed  THEN rv_table_kind = 'Hashed Table'.
      WHEN OTHERS THEN rv_table_kind = 'Unknown'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_kind FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_kind.
    DATA: lt_standard_table TYPE zcl_rtti_table_descr=>tt_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_table_descr( ).
    DATA(lv_kind) = lo_cut->get_table_kind( lt_standard_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_kind exp = 'Standard Table' ).

    TYPES tt_sorted_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF zcl_rtti_table_descr=>ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY field1.
    DATA(lt_sorted_table) TYPE tt_sorted_data.
    lv_kind = lo_cut->get_table_kind( lt_sorted_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_kind exp = 'Sorted Table' ).

    TYPES tt_hashed_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF zcl_rtti_table_descr=>ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY field1.
    DATA(lt_hashed_table) TYPE tt_hashed_data.
    lv_kind = lo_cut->get_table_kind( lt_hashed_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_kind exp = 'Hashed Table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_source_table TYPE zcl_rtti_create_table=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source_table.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_create_table( ).
    DATA(lo_new_table_ref) = lo_cut->create_empty_table_like( lt_source_table ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_new_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_new_table_ref->* TO <lt_new_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_new_table> ). " Should be empty

      act = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_source_table )->get_relative_name( )

    ). " Check if types match
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Namen und Typen aller Felder (Komponenten) der Zeilenstruktur einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data`, dann `get_table_line_type` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_column_info
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_column_info) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_info.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ).
    DATA(lo_line_type_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_line_type_descr->get_components( ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = <fs_component>-name
        type = <fs_component>-type_descr->get_relative_name( )
      ) TO rt_column_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_column_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_column_info.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_rtti_table_columns=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_table_columns( ).
    DATA(lt_column_info) = lo_cut->get_column_info( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_column_info ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_column_info WITH KEY name = 'CARRID' ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_col_info>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_col_info>-type exp = 'CARRID' ).

    READ TABLE lt_column_info WITH KEY name = 'CONNID' ASSIGNING <fs_col_info>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_col_info>-type exp = 'CONNID' ).

    READ TABLE lt_column_info WITH KEY name = 'FLDATE' ASSIGNING <fs_col_info>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_col_info>-type exp = 'FLDATE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` kann man tief in die Struktur von internen Tabellen und deren Zeilentypen eintauchen, um Metadaten zur Laufzeit zu erhalten.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine interne Tabelle einen bestimmten Sekundärschlüssel besitzt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_secondary_keys`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_key_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_data_with_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY
                           WITH UNIQUE HASHED KEY id COMPONENTS id.

    METHODS has_secondary_key
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_key_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_key) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_key_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_secondary_key.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ).
    DATA(lt_secondary_keys) = lo_table_descr->get_secondary_keys( ).

    LOOP AT lt_secondary_keys ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_key>).
      IF <fs_key>-name = iv_key_name.
        rv_has_key = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_has_key = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_has_secondary_key_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_has_secondary_key_false FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_has_secondary_key_true.
    DATA: lt_table_with_key TYPE zcl_rtti_table_key_check=>tt_data_with_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_table_key_check( ).
    DATA(lv_has_key) = lo_cut->has_secondary_key( it_table = lt_table_with_key iv_key_name = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_has_secondary_key_false.
    DATA: lt_table_without_key TYPE zcl_rtti_table_key_check=>tt_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_table_key_check( ).
    DATA(lv_has_key) = lo_cut->has_secondary_key( it_table = lt_table_without_key iv_key_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_KEY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_has_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_secondary_keys` der Klasse `cl_abap_tabledescr` ermöglicht die dynamische Abfrage von Sekundärschlüsseln einer internen Tabelle, was für generische Tabellenverarbeitung nützlich ist.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine interne Tabelle einen Primärschlüssel hat und welche Felder diesen bilden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und die Attribute `has_primary_key` und `key_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_primary_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data_with_pk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY id.
    TYPES tt_data_no_pk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_primary_key_info
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_key_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_primary_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_primary_key_info.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ).

    IF lo_table_descr->has_primary_key = abap_true.
      DATA(lv_key_components) = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR comp IN lo_table_descr->key_components
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN comp ELSE s && ', ' && comp )
      ).
      rs_key_info = |Tabelle hat Primärschlüssel. Komponenten: { lv_key_components }|.
    ELSE.
      rs_key_info = 'Tabelle hat keinen Primärschlüssel (oder ist eine Standardtabelle ohne expliziten Schlüssel).'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_primary_key_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_primary_key_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_primary_key_exists.
    DATA: lt_table_with_pk TYPE zcl_rtti_primary_key=>tt_data_with_pk.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_primary_key( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_primary_key_info( lt_table_with_pk ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Tabelle hat Primärschlüssel. Komponenten: ID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_primary_key_not_exists.
    DATA: lt_table_no_pk TYPE zcl_rtti_primary_key=>tt_data_no_pk.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_primary_key( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_primary_key_info( lt_table_no_pk ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Tabelle hat keinen Primärschlüssel (oder ist eine Standardtabelle ohne expliziten Schlüssel).').
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die RTTI-Klasse `cl_abap_tabledescr` bietet Attribute wie `has_primary_key` und `key_components`, um Primärschlüsselinformationen dynamisch abzufragen. Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` für die String-Konkatenation ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den `CARRID` eines bestimmten Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf dem `CONNID` und `FLDATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE itab FROM wa TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_single_row DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_single_row IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_carrier.
    DATA(ls_flight_update) = VALUE ty_sflight(
      carrid = iv_new_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
    ).

    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM ls_flight_update TRANSPORTING carrid
      WHERE connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_single_row FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_single_row.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_modify_single_row=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_single_row( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_carrier(
      EXPORTING
        iv_connid     = '0017'
        iv_fldate     = '20250101'
        iv_new_carrid = 'DL'
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    = lt_flights
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_updated_flight) WITH KEY connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-carrid exp = 'DL' msg = 'Carrier should be updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_unchanged_flight) WITH KEY connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_unchanged_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Other carrier should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...` Syntax ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, spezifische Felder eines oder mehrerer Einträge in einer internen Tabelle zu aktualisieren, ohne explizit eine Schleife zu verwenden. `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht die kompakte Initialisierung der Arbeitsstruktur.
keywords: MODIFY TABLE, TRANSPORTING, WHERE, Internal Tables, VALUE
