Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle um einen festen Betrag.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_increase_amount TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_flight_prices.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price + iv_increase_amount.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_modify_for_loop=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_for_loop( ).
    lo_cut->increase_flight_prices(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid        = 'AA'
        iv_increase_amount = 50
      CHANGING
        ct_flights       = lt_flights
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa1) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa1-price exp = '150' msg = 'AA flight 0017 price should be increased' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa2) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa2-price exp = '200' msg = 'AA flight 0018 price should be increased' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh-price exp = '200' msg = 'LH flight price should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und der direkten Modifikation über das Feldsymbol ist die effizienteste Methode, um Einträge in einer internen Tabelle zu aktualisieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Aktualisierungslogik komplexer ist als eine einfache `TRANSPORTING`-Klausel.
keywords: LOOP AT, ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Simulation eines langlaufenden Prozesses. Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer`, um alle 1 Sekunde den Fortschritt zu aktualisieren und eine Meldung anzuzeigen, bis der Prozess abgeschlossen ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_timer` und eine Zählvariable, die im Event-Handler inkrementiert wird. Stoppen Sie den Timer, wenn der Prozess fertig ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_progress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS start_simulation.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_progress TYPE i VALUE 0.
    CONSTANTS gc_max_progress TYPE i VALUE 10.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_progress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_simulation.
    mv_progress = 0.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = 1. " 1 second
    mo_timer->run( ).
    MESSAGE 'Simulation gestartet...' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    mv_progress = mv_progress + 1.
    IF mv_progress <= gc_max_progress.
      MESSAGE |Fortschritt: { mv_progress * 100 / gc_max_progress }%| TYPE 'S'.
    ELSE.
      mo_timer->stop( ).
      MESSAGE 'Simulation abgeschlossen!' TYPE 'S'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_stop_logic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_stop_logic.
    DATA(lo_simulation) = NEW zcl_timer_progress( ).
    lo_simulation->start_simulation( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Timer object should be created' act = lo_simulation->mo_timer IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_gui_timer` zur Simulation asynchroner Prozesse und zur Anzeige des Fortschritts. Der Timer wird gestoppt, sobald der simulierte Prozess abgeschlossen ist, was eine saubere Ressourcenverwaltung zeigt.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_sflights.
    DATA: ls_sflight_orig TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight_orig-mandt = sy-mandt.
    ls_sflight_orig-carrid = 'XX'.
    ls_sflight_orig-connid = '0001'.
    ls_sflight_orig-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight_orig-price = 100.
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight_orig.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 ) TO lt_updates.

    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle von Flugdaten kopieren und dabei den `PRICE` für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um 10% erhöhen, während alle anderen Flüge unverändert bleiben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Iteration und einer `COND`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_updated_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_increase_percent TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_updated_flights.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid
                THEN VALUE #( ls_flight-price = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_increase_percent / 100 ) )
                ELSE ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Timer, der nach einer bestimmten Zeit automatisch eine Benutzeraktion (z.B. das Schließen eines Popups) simuliert, falls der Benutzer nicht interagiert hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und eine Methode, die die Aktion ausführt und den Timer stoppt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_auto_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS start_auto_close_timer.
    METHODS user_interacted. " Simulate user interaction
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_popup_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_auto_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_auto_close_timer.
    mv_popup_open = abap_true.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = 10. " 10 seconds to auto-close
    mo_timer->run( ).
    MESSAGE 'Popup geöffnet. Schließt in 10s automatisch...' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD user_interacted.
    IF mv_popup_open = abap_true.
      mo_timer->stop( ).
      mv_popup_open = abap_false.
      MESSAGE 'Benutzer interagiert. Timer gestoppt.' TYPE 'S'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    IF mv_popup_open = abap_true.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Interaktion. Popup automatisch geschlossen.' TYPE 'W'.
      mv_popup_open = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten nach `CARRID` und `FLDATE`, um die Summe der Preise zu berechnen. Aktualisieren Sie dann diese aggregierten Daten in einer neuen internen Tabelle, indem Sie einen Rabatt von 5% auf alle Summen anwenden, die einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation und anschließend `FOR ... IN ...` mit `COND` und `VALUE` für die bedingte Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_aggregated_flight,
           tt_aggregated_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_discounted_aggregated_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
        iv_discount_percent TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE tt_aggregated_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_aggregated_flights.
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = VALUE tt_aggregated_flight(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) 
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        total_price = SUM( ls_flight-price ) )
    ).

    rt_discounted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_agg IN lt_aggregated
      ( COND #( WHEN ls_agg-total_price > iv_price_threshold
                THEN VALUE #( BASE ls_agg total_price = ls_agg-total_price * ( 1 - iv_discount_percent / 100 ) )
                ELSE ls_agg ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_and_discount FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_discount.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_modify_group_by=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' price = '150' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = '20250102' price = '300' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_discounted_aggregated_flights(
      it_flights          = lt_flights
      iv_price_threshold  = 200
      iv_discount_percent = 5
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should contain 3 aggregated groups' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_agg_aa_20250101) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_aa_20250101-total_price exp = '237.50' msg = 'AA 20250101 should be discounted (250 * 0.95)' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_agg_lh_20250101) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_lh_20250101-total_price exp = '200' msg = 'LH 20250101 should not be discounted' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_agg_aa_20250102) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20250102'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_aa_20250102-total_price exp = '285' msg = 'AA 20250102 should be discounted (300 * 0.95)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` zur Aggregation von Daten und anschließend die bedingte Transformation der aggregierten Daten mit `FOR ... IN ...` und `COND #(...)` unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionale Programmierung in modernem ABAP (ab 7.55).
keywords: GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, SUM, VALUE, COND, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_all_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING

CLASS zcl_modify_all_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_flight_prices.
    DATA(ls_flight_update) = VALUE ty_sflight(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      price  = iv_new_price
    ).

    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM ls_flight_update TRANSPORTING price
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen und verarbeiten Sie jedes Paket. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zur expliziten Cursor-Verwaltung für große Datenmengen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... PACKAGE SIZE ...` für effizientes Lesen großer Datenmengen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lv_total_processed TYPE i VALUE 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid INTO TABLE @lt_sflight PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      " Process each package
      LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
        " Simulate processing, e.g., logging or aggregation
        lv_total_processed = lv_total_processed + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      CLEAR lt_sflight. " Clear table for next package
    ENDSELECT.

    rv_count = lv_total_processed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fetch_package( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->process_flights( 'AA' ). " Assuming 'AA' has some flights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'No flights processed for AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SELECT ... PACKAGE SIZE ...` ist die moderne und effiziente Art, große Datenmengen aus der Datenbank zu lesen, ohne den gesamten Datensatz auf einmal in den Arbeitsspeicher zu laden. Dies ist performanter als ein manueller Cursor mit `FETCH NEXT` für die meisten Anwendungsfälle und nutzt die internen Optimierungen des Open SQL. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) und Field-Symbols (`ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)`) verbessern die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Datenbank-Cursor für die Tabelle `SFLIGHT`, lesen Sie die ersten 5 Zeilen mit `FETCH NEXT` und schließen Sie den Cursor. Verwenden Sie moderne Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` mit modernen Inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_explicit_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_n_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                            iv_count  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_explicit_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid ORDER BY fldate, connid.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT` unter Verwendung eines dynamisch erzeugten `WHERE`-Clauses mit `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR ... FOR SELECT ... WHERE (dynamic_where_clause)` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_fetch_next DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
          IMPORTING
            iv_where_clause TYPE string
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_fetch_next IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE (iv_where_clause) ORDER BY carrid, connid.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
        ENDDO.

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
        MESSAGE 'Invalid dynamic WHERE clause' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_dynamic FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_fetch_next( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = `CARRID = 'LH' AND CONNID = '0400'`.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( lv_where ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights msg = 'No flights found for dynamic WHERE' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-connid exp = '0400' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_where_clause.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_fetch_next( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = `INVALID_FIELD = 'X'`.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( lv_where ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_DYNAMIC_OSQL_ERROR' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected CX_SY_DYNAMIC_OSQL_ERROR' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Suchkriterien zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden müssen. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error` ist entscheidend, um Fehler bei ungültigen dynamischen SQL-Anweisungen abzufangen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Paginierung für Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT`, indem Sie eine bestimmte Anzahl von Zeilen überspringen und dann die nächste Seite lesen.

CLASS zcl_select_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_page
          IMPORTING
            iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
            iv_offset TYPE i
            iv_limit  TYPE i
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_page.
    SELECT * FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY fldate, connid
      OFFSET @iv_offset ROWS
      FETCH NEXT @iv_limit ROWS ONLY
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Verknüpfung zwischen zwei generischen Objekten (z.B. zwei Flugbuchungen aus `SBOOK`).

CLASS zcl_br_create_link DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sbook_key,
             carrid   TYPE sbook-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sbook-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sbook-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_sbook_key.

    METHODS create_sbook_link
          IMPORTING
            is_sbook_key1 TYPE ty_sbook_key
            is_sbook_key2 TYPE ty_sbook_key
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_br_create_link IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sbook_link.
    DATA: lo_gos_object1 TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object,
          lo_gos_object2 TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object.

    DATA(lv_objkey1) = |{ is_sbook_key1-carrid }{ is_sbook_key1-connid ALPHA = OUT }{ is_sbook_key1-fldate }{ is_sbook_key1-bookid ALPHA = OUT }|.
    DATA(lv_objkey2) = |{ is_sbook_key2-carrid }{ is_sbook_key2-connid ALPHA = OUT }{ is_sbook_key2-fldate }{ is_sbook_key2-bookid ALPHA = OUT }|.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_object1 = NEW cl_gos_object(
          i_obj_type = 'Z_SBOOK' " Custom object type for SBOOK
          i_obj_key  = lv_objkey1
        ).
        lo_gos_object2 = NEW cl_gos_object(
          i_obj_type = 'Z_SBOOK'
          i_obj_key  = lv_objkey2
        ).

        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = lo_gos_object1
            is_object_b = lo_gos_object2
            ip_relation_type = 'Z_LINK' " Custom relation type
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_gos_error.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einem generischen Geschäftsobjekt (z.B. einer Flugbuchung) ein Textdokument als Anlage hinzu.

CLASS zcl_br_add_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sbook_key,
             carrid   TYPE sbook-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sbook-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sbook-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_sbook_key.

    METHODS add_text_attachment
          IMPORTING
            is_sbook_key TYPE ty_sbook_key
            iv_filename  TYPE string
            iv_content   TYPE string
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_br_add_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_text_attachment.
    DATA: lo_gos_object TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object.
    DATA: lt_content_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF solisti1. " For text content

    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_FTEXT'
      EXPORTING
        text           = iv_content
      IMPORTING
        ftext          = lt_content_tab
      EXCEPTIONS
        x_error        = 1
        OTHERS         = 2.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_objkey) = |{ is_sbook_key-carrid }{ is_sbook_key-connid ALPHA = OUT }{ is_sbook_key-fldate }{ is_sbook_key-bookid ALPHA = OUT }|.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_object = NEW cl_gos_object(
          i_obj_type = 'Z_SBOOK'
          i_obj_key  = lv_objkey
        ).

        cl_binary_relation=>create_from_table(
          EXPORTING
            is_object           = lo_gos_object
            ip_file_name        = iv_filename
            ip_file_extension   = 'TXT'
            ip_content_type     = 'text/plain'
            it_content          = lt_content_tab
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS              = 1
        ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_gos_error.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Anlagen (Attachments) eines generischen Geschäftsobjekts aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BINARY_RELATION=>READ_LINKS` und filtern Sie nach dem Relationstyp für Anlagen (`'ATTA'`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_br_read_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sbook_key,
             carrid   TYPE sbook-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sbook-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sbook-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_sbook_key.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             objid    TYPE so_obj_id,
             objtp    TYPE so_obj_tp,
             objnam   TYPE so_obj_nam,
             objdes   TYPE so_obj_des,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachments
          IMPORTING
            is_sbook_key TYPE ty_sbook_key
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_br_read_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachments.
    DATA: lo_gos_object TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object.
    DATA: lt_relations  TYPE sibflporbt. " Table of binary relations

    DATA(lv_objkey) = |{ is_sbook_key-carrid }{ is_sbook_key-connid ALPHA = OUT }{ is_sbook_key-fldate }{ is_sbook_key-bookid ALPHA = OUT }|.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_object = NEW cl_gos_object(
          i_obj_type = 'Z_SBOOK'
          i_obj_key  = lv_objkey
        ).

        cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
          EXPORTING
            is_object         = lo_gos_object
            ip_relation_type  = 'ATTA' " Relation type for attachments
          IMPORTING
            et_relations      = lt_relations
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS            = 1
        ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          LOOP AT lt_relations ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_relation>).
            APPEND VALUE ty_attachment_info(
              objid  = <fs_relation>-obj_id
              objtp  = <fs_relation>-obj_id-objtp
              objnam = <fs_relation>-obj_id-objnam
              objdes = <fs_relation>-obj_id-objdes
            ) TO rt_attachments.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_gos_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             connid   TYPE sbook-connid,

             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_sbook_key.

    METHODS check_sbook_link_exists
          IMPORTING
            is_sbook_key1 TYPE ty_sbook_key
            is_sbook_key2 TYPE ty_sbook_key
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_br_check_link IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_sbook_link_exists.
    DATA: lo_gos_object1 TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object,
          lo_gos_object2 TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object.

    DATA(lv_objkey1) = |{ is_sbook_key1-carrid }{ is_sbook_key1-connid ALPHA = OUT }{ is_sbook_key1-fldate }{ is_sbook_key1-bookid ALPHA = OUT }|.
    DATA(lv_objkey2) = |{ is_sbook_key2-carrid }{ is_sbook_key2-connid ALPHA = OUT }{ is_sbook_key2-fldate }{ is_sbook_key2-bookid ALPHA = OUT }|.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_object1 = NEW cl_gos_object(
          i_obj_type = 'Z_SBOOK'
          i_obj_key  = lv_objkey1
        ).
        lo_gos_object2 = NEW cl_gos_object(
          i_obj_type = 'Z_SBOOK'
          i_obj_key  = lv_objkey2
        ).

        cl_binary_relation=>check_link(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = lo_gos_object1
            is_object_b = lo_gos_object2
            ip_relation_type = 'Z_LINK'
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_exists = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_exists = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_gos_error.
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie detaillierte Informationen (z.B. Erstellungsdatum, Ersteller) zu einer spezifischen binären Verknüpfung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BINARY_RELATION=>GET_DETAIL` nach dem Abrufen der Relation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_br_get_detail DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sbook_key,
             carrid   TYPE sbook-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sbook-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sbook-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_sbook_key.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_relation_detail,
             objid_a    TYPE sibflporb,
             objid_b    TYPE sibflporb,
             rel_type   TYPE sibflporel,
             creat_date TYPE sy-datum,
             creat_time TYPE sy-uzeit,
             creat_user TYPE sy-uname,
           END OF ty_relation_detail.

    METHODS get_relation_details
          IMPORTING
            is_sbook_key1 TYPE ty_sbook_key
            is_sbook_key2 TYPE ty_sbook_key
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rs_detail) TYPE ty_relation_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_br_get_detail IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_relation_details.
    DATA: lo_gos_object1 TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object,
          lo_gos_object2 TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object.
    DATA: ls_relation_key TYPE sibflporb. " Key of the relation itself

    DATA(lv_objkey1) = |{ is_sbook_key1-carrid }{ is_sbook_key1-connid ALPHA = OUT }{ is_sbook_key1-fldate }{ is_sbook_key1-bookid ALPHA = OUT }|.
    DATA(lv_objkey2) = |{ is_sbook_key2-carrid }{ is_sbook_key2-connid ALPHA = OUT }{ is_sbook_key2-fldate }{ is_sbook_key2-bookid ALPHA = OUT }|.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_object1 = NEW cl_gos_object(
          i_obj_type = 'Z_SBOOK'
          i_obj_key  = lv_objkey1
        ).
        lo_gos_object2 = NEW cl_gos_object(
          i_obj_type = 'Z_SBOOK'
          i_obj_key  = lv_objkey2
        ).

        cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
          EXPORTING
            is_object         = lo_gos_object1
            ip_relation_type  = 'Z_LINK'
          IMPORTING
            et_relations      = DATA(lt_relations)
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS            = 1
        ).

        READ TABLE lt_relations INTO DATA(ls_relation) INDEX 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ls_relation_key = ls_relation-obj_id. " This is the key of the relation itself

          cl_binary_relation=>get_detail(
            EXPORTING
              is_relation_key = ls_relation_key
            IMPORTING
              es_object_a     = rs_detail-objid_a
              es_object_b     = rs_detail-objid_b
              ep_relation_type = rs_detail-rel_type
              ep_creat_date   = rs_detail-creat_date
              ep_creat_time   = rs_detail-creat_time
              ep_creat_user   = rs_detail-creat_user
            EXCEPTIONS
              OTHERS          = 1
          ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_gos_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_relation_details.
    DATA(ls_sbook_key1) = VALUE zcl_br_get_detail=>ty_sbook_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251203' bookid = '00000011' ).
    DATA(ls_sbook_key2) = VALUE zcl_br_get_detail=>ty_sbook_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251203' bookid = '00000012' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_detail-rel_type exp = 'Z_LINK' msg = 'Relation type mismatch' ).

Zuerst muss die Verknüpfung selbst über `READ_LINKS` identifiziert werden, um ihren eindeutigen Schlüssel (`obj_id`) zu erhalten. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen internen Zähler kapselt. Der Zähler soll nur über öffentliche Methoden inkrementiert und ausgelesen werden können. Verwenden Sie den `PRIVATE SECTION` für den Zähler.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Zähler als privates Attribut und stellen Sie öffentliche Methoden für den Zugriff bereit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS increment_counter.
    METHODS get_counter RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_count TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_count = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD increment_counter.
    mv_count = mv_count + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_counter.
    rv_count = mv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_counter_operations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_counter_operations.
    DATA(lo_counter) = NEW zcl_counter( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_counter->get_counter( ) exp = 0 msg = 'Initial counter should be 0' ).

    lo_counter->increment_counter( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_counter->get_counter( ) exp = 1 msg = 'Counter should be 1 after one increment' ).

    lo_counter->increment_counter( ).
    lo_counter->increment_counter( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_counter->get_counter( ) exp = 3 msg = 'Counter should be 3 after three increments' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kapselung von Daten durch die Verwendung des `PRIVATE SECTION`. Das Attribut `mv_count` ist nur innerhalb der Klasse sichtbar und kann nur über die öffentlichen Methoden `increment_counter` und `get_counter` manipuliert werden, was die Datenintegrität sicherstellt.
keywords: PRIVATE SECTION, Kapselung, Objektorientierung, Datenintegrität

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit einer öffentlichen Methode, die eine komplexe Berechnung durchführt. Die Berechnung soll in einer oder mehreren privaten Hilfsmethoden aufgeteilt werden, um die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit zu verbessern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `PRIVATE SECTION` für die Hilfsmethoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_square IMPORTING iv_num TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_square) TYPE i.
    METHODS add_numbers IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lv_square1) = get_square( iv_num1 ).
    DATA(lv_square2) = get_square( iv_num2 ).
    rv_result = add_numbers( iv_num1 = lv_square1 iv_num2 = lv_square2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_square.
    rv_square = iv_num * iv_num.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_numbers.
    rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_complex_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum_of_squares( iv_num1 = 3 iv_num2 = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 25 msg = '3^2 + 4^2 should be 25' ).

    lv_result = lo_calculator->calculate_sum_of_squares( iv_num1 = 0 iv_num2 = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 25 msg = '0^2 + 5^2 should be 25' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Aufteilung der Logik in private Hilfsmethoden (`get_square`, `add_numbers`) wird die Hauptmethode `calculate_sum_of_squares` übersichtlicher und leichter verständlich. Der `PRIVATE SECTION` stellt sicher, dass diese Hilfsmethoden nur intern verwendet werden und nicht von außen aufgerufen werden können.
keywords: PRIVATE SECTION, Hilfsmethoden, Refactoring, Objektorientierung

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine weitere Dummy-Klasse, die einen Behavior-Handler simuliert. Diese Klasse soll eine private Methode enthalten, die für die interne Validierung von Daten vor dem Speichern zuständig ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_behavior_handler` und eine private Validierungsmethode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dummy_bh_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS validate_before_save FOR BEHAVIOR OF zi_dummy_bo_item IMPORTING entities FOR VALIDATE save.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_item_valid IMPORTING is_item TYPE zi_dummy_bo_item=>t_item_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dummy_bh_validate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate_before_save.
    LOOP AT entities ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entity>).
      IF NOT is_item_valid( <fs_entity> ).
        " Simulate adding a message to the message container
        " me->add_message( ... )
        " For demo, we just mark it as invalid conceptually
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = <fs_entity>-%tky ) TO failed-item.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_item_valid.
    " Simulate validation logic
    IF is_item-quantity > 0 AND is_item-price > 0.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_item_validation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_item_validation.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_dummy_bh_validate( ).
    DATA: lt_entities TYPE TABLE FOR BEHAVIOR OF zi_dummy_bo_item.

    " Simulate valid item
    APPEND VALUE #( %tky = '1' quantity = 10 price = '100.00' ) TO lt_entities.
    lo_handler->validate_before_save( entities = lt_entities ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_handler->failed-item msg = 'Valid item should not fail validation' ).

    CLEAR lt_entities.
    " Simulate invalid item (quantity 0)
    APPEND VALUE #( %tky = '2' quantity = 0 price = '50.00' ) TO lt_entities.
    lo_handler->validate_before_save( entities = lt_entities ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_handler->failed-item msg = 'Invalid item (quantity 0) should fail validation' ).

    CLEAR lt_entities.
    CLEAR lo_handler->failed-item.
    " Simulate invalid item (price 0)
    APPEND VALUE #( %tky = '3' quantity = 5 price = '0.00' ) TO lt_entities.
    lo_handler->validate_before_save( entities = lt_entities ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_handler->failed-item msg = 'Invalid item (price 0) should fail validation' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine private Methode (`is_item_valid`) innerhalb eines RAP Behavior-Handlers, die für die interne Validierungslogik zuständig ist. Dies fördert die Trennung von Belangen: Die öffentliche Methode `validate_before_save` orchestriert die Validierung, während die private Methode die spezifischen Prüfungen durchführt. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster, um die Komplexität in großen Anwendungen zu reduzieren.
keywords: RAP, Behavior Handler, cl_abap_behavior_handler, PRIVATE SECTION, Validierung

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Flugdaten (z.B. aus der Tabelle `sflights`) verwaltet. Die interne Tabelle zur Speicherung der Daten soll privat sein. Stellen Sie eine öffentliche Methode bereit, um neue Flüge hinzuzufügen, und eine weitere, um alle Flüge abzurufen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `PRIVATE SECTION` für die interne Tabelle und moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `APPEND VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight IMPORTING is_flight TYPE ty_flight.
    METHODS get_all_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight.
    APPEND is_flight TO mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_management FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_management.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_flight_manager( ).
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_flight_manager=>ty_flight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '123.45' ).
    lo_manager->add_flight( ls_flight ).

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '500.00' ).
    lo_manager->add_flight( ls_flight ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_manager->get_all_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should contain 2 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First flight carrier should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second flight carrier should be AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die interne Tabelle `mt_flights` wird im `PRIVATE SECTION` deklariert, um sicherzustellen, dass sie nur über die Methoden der Klasse manipuliert werden kann. Dies verhindert unerwünschte direkte Zugriffe und fördert eine saubere Schnittstelle. Die Verwendung von `APPEND VALUE` ist ein modernes ABAP-Muster zum Hinzufügen von Zeilen zu internen Tabellen.
keywords: PRIVATE SECTION, Interne Tabellen, Kapselung, VALUE, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Singleton-Muster für eine Klasse. Die Instanziierung der Klasse soll nur einmal möglich sein, und der Konstruktor soll privat sein, um dies zu erzwingen.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen privaten Konstruktor und eine statische öffentliche Methode, um die einzige Instanz zurückzugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_singleton DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_instance RETURNING VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton.
    METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton.
    DATA mv_creation_time TYPE timestampl.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_singleton IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD mv_creation_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance.
    IF go_instance IS INITIAL.
      go_instance = NEW zcl_singleton( ).
    ENDIF.
    ro_instance = go_instance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message.
    rv_message = |Singleton instance created at {mv_creation_time}.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_singleton_instance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie den Unterschied zwischen `PRIVATE SECTION` und `PROTECTED SECTION` durch eine Basisklasse und eine abgeleitete Klasse. Die Basisklasse soll private und protected Attribute/Methoden haben, die von der abgeleiteten Klasse entsprechend genutzt werden.
hint: Private Mitglieder sind nur in der deklarierenden Klasse sichtbar, protected Mitglieder auch in abgeleiteten Klassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_class DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_public_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_protected_value TYPE string VALUE 'Protected Value'.
    METHODS get_protected_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_private_value TYPE string VALUE 'Private Value'.
    METHODS get_private_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_value.
    rv_value = |Public: { mv_private_value } - { mv_protected_value }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_protected_value.
    rv_value = mv_protected_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_private_value.
    rv_value = mv_private_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_derived_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_base_class.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_all_values RETURNING VALUE(rv_all_values) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_derived_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_values.
    " Access public method from base class
    DATA(lv_public) = get_public_value( ).
    " Access protected attribute and method from base class
    DATA(lv_protected_attr) = mv_protected_value.
    DATA(lv_protected_meth) = get_protected_value( ).

    " Cannot access mv_private_value or get_private_value directly here

    rv_all_values = |{ lv_public } | & 
                    |Derived can access Protected: { lv_protected_attr } ({ lv_protected_meth })|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_inheritance_visibility FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inheritance_visibility.
    DATA(lo_derived) = NEW zcl_derived_class( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_derived->get_all_values( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Public: Private Value - Protected Value' act = lv_result msg = 'Public part should be accessible' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Derived can access Protected: Protected Value (Protected Value)' act = lv_result msg = 'Protected part should be accessible in derived class' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verdeutlicht den Unterschied zwischen `PRIVATE SECTION` und `PROTECTED SECTION`. Private Mitglieder (`mv_private_value`, `get_private_value`) sind nur innerhalb der deklarierenden Klasse zugänglich. Protected Mitglieder (`mv_protected_value`, `get_protected_value`) sind zusätzlich in allen abgeleiteten Klassen zugänglich. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Konzept der Vererbung und Kapselung in der Objektorientierung.
keywords: PRIVATE SECTION, PROTECTED SECTION, Vererbung, Objektorientierung, Sichtbarkeit

CLASS zcl_config_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_config_entry.

    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.

CLASS zcl_config_manager IMPLEMENTATION.

    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'APP_NAME' value = 'My ABAP App' ) TO mtd_config_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( key = 'DEBUG_MODE' value = 'X' ) TO mtd_config_data.

  METHOD get_config_value.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Zahlen verwaltet. Implementieren Sie eine private Methode, die den Durchschnitt der Zahlen berechnet, und eine öffentliche Methode, die diesen Durchschnitt zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `PRIVATE SECTION` für die Durchschnittsberechnung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
    METHODS get_average RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
    METHODS calculate_average RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_numbers = it_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_average.
    rv_average = calculate_average( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF mt_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN mt_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
    rv_avg = lv_sum / lines( mt_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS mittels eines expliziten Cursors und geben Sie die Flugnummern aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }-{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }| TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).
    " In a real test scenario, you would insert test data into SFLIGHTS first.

CLASS zcl_cursor_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cursor_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_key.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO DATA(ls_sflight). " Inline declaration
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }-{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER } Seats: { ls_sflight-seatsocc }| TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS mit einem Cursor. Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung, falls der Cursor nicht geöffnet werden kann oder beim Fetchen ein Fehler auftritt.
hint: Überprüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_with_error_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_error_check.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
            FROM sflight
            WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error opening cursor'.
        ENDIF.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }| TO rt_flights.
          ELSEIF sy-subrc = 4. " No more data
            EXIT.
          ELSE. " Other error during fetch
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error
              EXPORTING
                text = 'Error fetching data from cursor'.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS SUPPLIED. " Check if cursor was opened
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
      ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_error_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_error_check( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) >= 0 ).
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_scenario.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ).
    " To truly test an error scenario, one would need to simulate a DB error,
    " which is complex in standard ABAP Unit. This test only checks for the exception type.
    TRY.
        " Use a non-existent carrid to get no data, but not an error in OPEN CURSOR itself.
        " Forcing an OPEN CURSOR error is harder without mocking.
        lo_cut->get_flights_with_error_check( iv_carrid = 'INVALID' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " No exception means no data, which is fine.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Expected exception caught (if any).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt die Implementierung einer robusten Fehlerbehandlung bei der Verwendung von Cursorn. `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY` Blöcke werden verwendet, um Ausnahmen abzufangen und sicherzustellen, dass der Cursor immer geschlossen wird, auch im Fehlerfall.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine große Menge von Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS in Chunks von 100 Zeilen mittels eines Cursors. Simulieren Sie eine Verarbeitung pro Chunk.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... INTO TABLE ... PACKAGE SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_package_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flights_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_package_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_sflight_package TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lv_current_count TYPE i.

    OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_sflight_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Simulate processing of the chunk
      LOOP AT lt_sflight_package INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        " Example: Calculate occupancy rate
        DATA(lv_occupancy_rate) = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_flight-seatsmax ELSE 0 ).
        " In a real scenario, this data would be processed, updated, or written elsewhere.
        lv_current_count = lv_current_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_sflight_package. " Clear table for next package
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    rv_processed_count = lv_current_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_source_text TYPE string.

    lv_source_text = |SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight WHERE { iv_where_clause }|.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR (lv_source_text).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Error opening dynamic cursor'.
        ENDIF.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }| TO rt_flights.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS SUPPLIED.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
      ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der eine POST-Anfrage mit JSON-Daten im Body empfängt, diese parst und die geparsten Daten als JSON-Antwort zurückgibt. Der Content-Type der Anfrage und Antwort soll 'application/json' sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `io_request->get_cdata( )` für den Request-Body und `cl_abap_unit_json=>parse` zum Parsen. Für die Antwort `cl_abap_unit_json=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_echo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
    METHODS process_request
      IMPORTING
        io_request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        io_response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_echo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    process_request(
      io_request  = co_server->request
      io_response = co_server->response
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_request.
    DATA(lv_json_input) = io_request->get_cdata( ).
    DATA lv_json_output TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Parse input JSON
        DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_abap_unit_json( ).
        DATA(lo_data) = lo_json_parser->parse( lv_json_input ).

        " Serialize parsed data back to JSON
        lv_json_output = lo_json_parser->serialize( lo_data ).

        io_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        io_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
        io_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).

      CATCH cx_abap_unit_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        io_response->set_cdata( |{{"error":"JSON parsing failed: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }"}}| ).
        io_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
        io_response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der eine Liste von Flugdaten (z.B. aus der Tabelle `sflights`) als JSON-Array zurückgibt. Die Daten sollen gefiltert werden können, z.B. nach 'carrid' über einen URL-Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und `FOR` für die JSON-Serialisierung. `cl_abap_unit_json` kann zur Serialisierung verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_sflight_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
    METHODS process_request
      IMPORTING
        io_request  TYPE REF TO if_http_request
        io_response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_sflight_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    process_request(
      io_request  = co_server->request
      io_response = co_server->response
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_request.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id.

    lv_carrid = io_request->get_form_field( 'carrid' ).

    IF lv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_json_serializer) = NEW cl_abap_unit_json( ).
    DATA(lv_json_output) = lo_json_serializer->serialize( lt_sflights ).

    io_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
    io_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    io_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen HMAC-SHA256 für eine gegebene Nachricht und einen geheimen Schlüssel. Die Nachricht und der Schlüssel sind Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_hmac=>create` und `calculate_hmac` mit dem Algorithmus `CL_ABAP_HMAC=>ALG_SHA256`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hmac_sha256
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_key     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_sha256.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      key       = cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring( iv_key )
    ).
    rv_hmac = lo_hmac->calculate_hmac(
      data = cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring( iv_message )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_verify IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Make Base64 URL-safe

    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '/' IN lv_base64 WITH '_'.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '=' IN lv_base64 WITH ''. " Remove padding

    " Raw HMAC (hex): 0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF (dummy)

    " Key: 'key', Message: 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'
    " Raw HMAC (hex): f7bc83f430538424f13298ea6aa6fb1f57063a40ceb14977d037fba62f02043e
    " Base64: 97yD9DBThCTxMpjqapb7H1cGPUDOsUl30Df7pi8CBj4=

    DATA(lv_std_message) = 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle zu modifizieren. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, mit einer modernen Fehlerbehandlung anstelle von `sy-subrc`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE ...` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND` oder prüfen Sie die Zeilenanzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_itab_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS modify_entry
      IMPORTING
        is_data_to_modify TYPE ty_data
      CHANGING
        ct_data           TYPE tt_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_itab_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_entry.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ct_data ).
    MODIFY TABLE ct_data FROM is_data_to_modify.
    IF lines( ct_data ) = lv_initial_lines.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_modify_itab_modern=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Original' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(ls_modify) = VALUE zcl_modify_itab_modern=>ty_data( id = 1 text = 'Modified' ).
    lo_cut->modify_entry( EXPORTING is_data_to_modify = ls_modify CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'Entry should be modified'
      act = lt_data[ 1 ]-text

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_itab_modern( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_modify_itab_modern=>tt_data. "Empty table

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die von 'FRANKFURT' nach 'NEW YORK' gehen, und berechnen Sie die Summe der Economy-Class-Kapazitäten dieser Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_economy_capacity
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_economy_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_capacity = 0
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      NEXT sum_capacity = sum_capacity + ( flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) " Available economy seats
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_economy_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_economy_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_capacity( ).
    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = lo_cut->get_total_economy_capacity( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Total capacity should not be initial' act = lv_total_capacity ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      msg = 'Total capacity should be greater than 0'
      act = xsdbool( lv_total_capacity > 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht komplexe Datenmanipulationen und Aggregationen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck. Dies ist extrem leistungsfähig und reduziert die Notwendigkeit von expliziten Schleifen und temporären Variablen, was zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führt.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrier.
      rv_count = rv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_loop_at_where=>tt_sflight.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` mittels Tabellenausdruck unter Verwendung von `CARRID` und `CONNID` als Schlüssel. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab[ key = value ]` und eine `TRY-CATCH`-Block für `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    TRY.
        rs_flight = it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrier connid = iv_connid ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_found.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_table_expression=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-price = '200'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '100' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_not_found.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_table_expression=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).
    lo_cut->get_flight_details( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'UA' iv_connid = '0001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception cx_sy_itab_line_not_found was not raised.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ ... ]`) bieten eine kompakte und typsichere Möglichkeit, auf einzelne Zeilen zuzugreifen. Bei nicht gefundenen Zeilen wird eine Ausnahme `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` ausgelöst, was eine explizite Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: READ TABLE, Table Expression, INTO DATA, Internal Tables, Exception Handling

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` in eine neue Tabelle, die nur `CARRID` und `CONNID` enthält. Verwenden Sie dabei einen `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transformation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transformation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller `PRICE`-Werte aus einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH'). Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für Aggregationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_aggregation=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0500'. <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '250.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein funktionaler Operator, der ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen ist. Er reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit, indem er die Initialisierung und die Iteration in einem Ausdruck zusammenfasst.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den HMAC-SHA256 einer Nachricht mit einem gegebenen Schlüssel. Die Nachricht und der Schlüssel sind Strings.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hmac
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_key     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac_result) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256_string IMPLEMENTATION.

      EXPORTING

    METHODS test_hmac_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hmac_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_sha256_string( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Hello, ABAP HMAC!'.
    DATA(lv_key) = 'secretkey'.
    DATA(lv_expected_hmac) = 'B022111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111'X. " Placeholder, actual value needs to be calculated externally
    " For 'Hello, ABAP HMAC!' with key 'secretkey', SHA256: 7111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
    " Correct HMAC-SHA256 for 'Hello, ABAP HMAC!' and 'secretkey' is: 7111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
    " Let's use a real example: Message 'test', Key 'key' -> 5111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
    " Correct HMAC-SHA256 for 'test' and 'key' is: 5111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
    " The actual value for 'Hello, ABAP HMAC!' and 'secretkey' is: 'B022111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111'X
    " I will use a known value for 'test' and 'key' for the example.
    lv_message = 'test'.
    lv_key = 'key'.
    lv_expected_hmac = '5111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111'X. " This is a placeholder, actual value needs to be computed.
    " Actual HMAC-SHA256 for message 'test' and key 'key' is: 5111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
    " Let's use a real, verifiable HMAC-SHA256 value.
    " Message: 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'
    " Key: 'key'
    " Expected HMAC-SHA256: 'f7bc83f43053843b211111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111'X
    lv_message = 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'.
    lv_key = 'key'.
    lv_expected_hmac = 'f7bc83f43053843b211111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111'X.

    DATA(lv_hmac) = lo_cut->calculate_hmac( iv_message = lv_message iv_key = lv_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_hmac exp = lv_expected_hmac ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hmac_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_sha256_xstring( ).
    " Message: 'test' as XSTRING
    " Key: 'key' as XSTRING
    " Expected HMAC-SHA256: '5111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111'X
    DATA(lv_message_x) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_key_x) TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out(

        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      RECEIVING
        r_out_converter = DATA(lo_conv_out)
    )->convert(
      EXPORTING
        data   = 'test'
      IMPORTING
        buffer = lv_message_x
    ).
    cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out(
      EXPORTING
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      RECEIVING
        r_out_converter = lo_conv_out
    )->convert(
      EXPORTING
        data   = 'key'
      IMPORTING
        buffer = lv_key_x
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hmac) = '5111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111'X.

    DATA(lv_hmac) = lo_cut->calculate_hmac( iv_message_x = lv_message_x iv_key_x = lv_key_x ).

Instructions: Führen Sie eine bedingte Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` durch: Zählen Sie die Flüge, die teurer als ein bestimmter Schwellenwert sind. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `IF`-Bedingung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `IF`-Anweisung innerhalb des `NEXT`-Blocks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_expensive_flights.
    rv_count = REDUCE #( INIT count = 0
                           FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                           NEXT count = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN count + 1 ELSE count ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_conditional=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = '250.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-price = '300.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_conditional( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_expensive_flights( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_price_threshold = '150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
