Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die die `CARRID` und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` enthält. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_for_group_by=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0500'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'SQ'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen und `COLLECT`-Anweisungen für Aggregationen und Gruppierungen.

Instructions: Verketten Sie die `CARRID` aller Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit String-Templates (`&&`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS concatenate_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carriers.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_flight-carrid ELSE s && `, ` && ls_flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_concatenate_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_carriers.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_string_concat=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'SQ'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_carriers( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'LH, AA, SQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_concatenate_empty.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_string_concat=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_carriers( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist sehr flexibel und kann nicht nur für numerische Aggregationen, sondern auch für String-Manipulationen verwendet werden. In Kombination mit String-Templates (`&&`) und dem `COND`-Operator ermöglicht er eine elegante und effiziente Verkettung von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, COND, Internal Tables, String Processing, Concatenation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Daten für ein einfaches Balkendiagramm vorbereitet und ein `cl_gui_chart_engine` Objekt mit diesen Daten konfiguriert.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_bar_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data,
           ty_chart_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_bar_chart
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_chart_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_chart_engine) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_bar_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_bar_chart.
    " Create a dummy chart engine instance for data preparation.
    " In a real scenario, this would be linked to a custom container on a screen.
    " For testing purposes, we can instantiate it without a container.
    " Note: Direct instantiation without container might lead to issues in some contexts,
    " but for setting data and properties, it's often sufficient for testing.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_chart_engine.

    " Prepare data for the chart engine using modern ABAP VALUE operator
    DATA(lt_chart_data_internal) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data_tab( ).
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      APPEND VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data(
        name = ls_data-label
        value = ls_data-value
      ) TO lt_chart_data_internal.
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_chart_engine->set_data( lt_chart_data_internal ).
    ro_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ). " Bar chart

    " Further configuration could go here (e.g., titles, colors)
    ro_chart_engine->set_title( 'Simple Bar Chart' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Liniendiagramm, das mehrere Datenreihen (z.B. Umsatz und Kosten über Monate) darstellt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaggregation und -transformation.

CLASS zcl_chart_line_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_data,
             month TYPE string,
             sales TYPE decfloat16,
             costs TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_monthly_data,
           ty_monthly_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_monthly_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_line_chart
      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_chart_line_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_line_chart.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_chart_engine.

    " Prepare data for multiple series
    DATA(lt_series_sales) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data_tab(
      FOR ls_month IN it_monthly_data
        ( name = ls_month-month
          value = ls_month-sales )
    ).

    DATA(lt_series_costs) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data_tab(
      FOR ls_month IN it_monthly_data
        ( name = ls_month-month
          value = ls_month-costs )
    ).

    DATA(lt_chart_series) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_series_tab(
      ( name = 'Sales' data = lt_series_sales )
      ( name = 'Costs' data = lt_series_costs )
    ).

    ro_chart_engine->set_series_data( lt_chart_series ).
    ro_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line ). " Line chart
    ro_chart_engine->set_title( 'Monthly Sales vs. Costs' ).
    ro_chart_engine->set_x_axis_title( 'Month' ).
    ro_chart_engine->set_y_axis_title( 'Amount' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` darstellt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` zur Datenaggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` um die Daten aus `sflights` zu aggregieren, bevor Sie sie an `cl_gui_chart_engine` übergeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_sflights_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS prepare_flight_chart
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_chart_engine) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflights_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_chart.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_chart_engine.

    " Aggregate flight data from sflights using modern ABAP SQL and REDUCE
    SELECT FROM sflights
           FIELDS carrid, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
           GROUP BY carrid
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight_counts).

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_data_tab(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flight_counts
        ( name = ls_flight-carrid
          value = ls_flight-flight_count )
    ).

    ro_chart_engine->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    ro_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    ro_chart_engine->set_title( 'Number of Flights per Carrier (SFLIGHTS)' ).
    ro_chart_engine->set_x_axis_title( 'Airline Carrier' ).
    ro_chart_engine->set_y_axis_title( 'Number of Flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Here, we assume sflights has data and focus on chart configuration.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_sflights_agg( ).

    " Further assertions would require inspecting the data set on the chart,
    " which is not directly exposed for easy testing.

CLASS zcl_pak_get_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package_info,
             package_name TYPE devclass,
             description  TYPE as4text,

CLASS zcl_pak_get_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_package_details.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle ABAP-Klassen in einem bestimmten Paket und seinen direkten Unterpaketen, die von einem bestimmten Benutzer erstellt wurden. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `REDUCE` und `FILTER`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `get_package_objects` und `get_subpackages` mit `REDUCE` und `FILTER` zur Datenaggregation und -selektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_complex_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_class_name TYPE seoc_objnm.
    TYPES: ty_class_name_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_class_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_classes_by_user_in_package
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
        iv_created_by   TYPE as4user
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_class_names) TYPE ty_class_name_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_complex_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_classes_by_user_in_package.
    DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_packages_to_check) = VALUE ty_package_name_tab( ( iv_package_name ) ).

    TRY.
        " Get direct subpackages and add to the list to check
        DATA(lt_subpackages) = lo_package_queries->get_subpackages( iv_package_name ).
        LOOP AT lt_subpackages INTO DATA(ls_subpak).
          APPEND ls_subpak-devclass TO lt_packages_to_check.
        ENDLOOP.

        " Collect all classes from main package and subpackages, then filter by creator
        rt_class_names = REDUCE ty_class_name_tab(
          INIT classes = VALUE ty_class_name_tab( )
          FOR lv_package IN lt_packages_to_check
          LET lt_objects = lo_package_queries->get_package_objects( lv_package ) IN
          FOR ls_object IN lt_objects
            WHERE ( ls_object-obj_type = 'CLAS' AND ls_object-as4user = iv_created_by )
            APPEND ls_object-obj_name TO classes
        ).

      CATCH cx_pak_exception.
        " Handle exception
        CLEAR rt_class_names.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_flights
      RETURNING

  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS fill_sflights.

CLASS zcl_modern_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_sflights.
    mt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO'   cityto = 'MIAMI' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' cityfrom = 'DENVER'    cityto = 'HOUSTON' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_frankfurt_flights.
    fill_sflights( ).
    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN mt_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
      ( conv string( ls_flight-connid ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere aller Flüge in einer simulierten 'sflights'-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für eine kompakte Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             passmax  TYPE sflight-max_p_f,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
    METHODS fill_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_flights.
    mt_flights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' passmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' passmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0120' passmax = 80 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' passmax = 120 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    fill_flights( ).
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-passmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_total_passengers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_passengers( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total passengers sum mismatch' act = lv_total exp = 550 ).  " 150 + 200 + 80 + 120 = 550
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES tt_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight
      WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_city_from
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid         TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cityfrom) TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_flights.
    METHODS fill_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expressions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_sflights.
    mt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO'   cityto = 'MIAMI' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_city_from.
    fill_sflights( ).
    rv_cityfrom = mt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-cityfrom.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie den Einsatz von verketteten Methodenaurufen (Method Chaining) und Inline-Deklarationen bei der Arbeit mit einer Service-Klasse.
hint: Instanziieren Sie Objekte direkt im Aufruf und verknüpfen Sie Methodenaufrufe. Nutzen Sie `DATA(...)` Inline.
solution:
CLASS zcl_service_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS set_param1 IMPORTING iv_p1 TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_service_builder.
    METHODS set_param2 IMPORTING iv_p2 TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_service_builder.
    METHODS execute RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_param1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_param2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_param1.
    mv_param1 = iv_p1.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_param2.
    mv_param2 = iv_p2.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute.
    rv_result = |Service executed with: { mv_param1 } and { mv_param2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lv_result) = NEW zcl_service_builder( )
      ->set_param1( 'ValueA' )
      ->set_param2( 'ValueB' )
      ->execute( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'Chained method call result mismatch'
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Service executed with: ValueA and ValueB' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verkettete Methodenaufrufe (seit ABAP 7.40) erhöhen die Lesbarkeit und ermöglichen eine 'flüssige' API, indem sie es erlauben, mehrere Methoden auf derselben Objektreferenz in einer einzigen Anweisung aufzurufen. Jede Methode, die eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt zurückgibt (`me`), kann eine weitere Methode verketten. Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(...) = NEW ...` hält den Code sauber.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Prozess, der so lange läuft, bis ein bestimmter Zählerstand erreicht ist oder eine externe Bedingung (Flag) erfüllt ist. Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Die `WHILE`-Schleife ist ideal für dynamische, nicht-feste Iterationsanzahlen, bei denen die Abbruchbedingung während der Ausführung variieren kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_while_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS process_until_condition
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_iterations   TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_is_finished TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_while_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_until_condition.
    DATA(lv_current_count) = 0.
    mv_is_finished = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_current_count < iv_max_iterations AND mv_is_finished = abap_false.
      " Simulate some work
      lv_current_count = lv_current_count + 1.
      IF lv_current_count = 5. " Example: External condition met after 5 iterations
        mv_is_finished = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_processed_count = lv_current_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_while_loop_early_exit FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_while_loop_full_iterations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_while_loop_early_exit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_while_loop( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->process_until_condition( iv_max_iterations = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'While loop early exit mismatch' act = lv_count exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_while_loop_full_iterations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_while_loop( ).
    " No early exit if iv_max_iterations is low
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->process_until_condition( iv_max_iterations = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'While loop full iterations mismatch' act = lv_count exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHILE`-Schleife, obwohl nicht neu in ABAP, ist weiterhin relevant für Szenarien, in denen die Anzahl der Iterationen nicht im Voraus bekannt ist und von internen oder externen Bedingungen abhängt. In diesem Fall wird der Schleifenabbruch durch einen Zähler oder eine boolesche Variable dynamisch gesteuert. Obwohl moderne Konstrukte oft bevorzugt werden, hat `WHILE` seinen Platz für solche Anwendungsfälle.
keywords: WHILE, Control Flow, Loop, Dynamic Condition

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die konzeptionelle Verwendung der spezialisierten `CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR`-Klasse in einem modernen ABAP-Kontext, indem Sie eine einfache Liste von 'Bild-IDs' verarbeiten oder deren Status prüfen.
hint: Die `CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR`-Klasse ist typischerweise in spezifischen SAP-Modulen zu finden. Zeigen Sie eine Instanziierung und einen hypothetischen Methodenaufruf, der in einer `WHILE`-Schleife verwendet werden könnte, um eine dynamische Verarbeitung zu simulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_processing_concept DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES tt_image_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_images_conceptually
      IMPORTING
        it_image_ids        TYPE tt_image_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    " Deklaration einer lokalen Dummy-Klasse als Stellvertreter für CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde hier die SAP-Klasse verwendet.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_image_processor DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION:
        METHODS process_single_image IMPORTING iv_image_id TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_dummy_image_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD process_single_image.
        " Simulieren der Bildverarbeitung
        WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS. " Simulate duration
        rv_success = abap_true.
        IF iv_image_id CA 'ERROR'. " Simulate an error for some IDs
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_processing_concept IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_images_conceptually.
    DATA(lo_image_processor) = NEW lcl_dummy_image_processor( ). " In real-world: NEW cl_fxs_image_processor( )
    DATA(lt_pending_images) = it_image_ids.
    DATA(lv_num_pending) = lines( lt_pending_images ).

    WHILE lv_num_pending > 0.
      DATA(lv_current_image_id) = lt_pending_images[ 1 ].
      DELETE lt_pending_images INDEX 1.
      lv_num_pending = lines( lt_pending_images ).

      IF lo_image_processor->process_single_image( lv_current_image_id ).
        rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        " Log error or re-add to pending list for retry
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_image_processing FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_image_processing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_image_processing_concept( ).
    DATA(lt_images) = VALUE zcl_image_processing_concept=>tt_image_ids(
      ( 'img_001' ) ( 'img_002' ) ( 'img_ERROR_003' ) ( 'img_004' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_processed) = lo_cut->process_images_conceptually( lt_images ).

    " Expect 3 successful processes (excluding 'ERROR' image)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Processed count mismatch' act = lv_processed exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Integration von spezialisierten SAP-Klassen wie `CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR` in moderne ABAP-Implementierungen. Da die genaue Implementierung dieser Klasse extern ist, wird hier eine Dummy-Klasse `lcl_dummy_image_processor` verwendet, um die konzeptuelle Nutzung zu zeigen: Instanziierung und Aufruf einer hypothetischen Verarbeitungsmethode in einer `WHILE`-Schleife. Die `WHILE`-Schleife ist hier nützlich, um eine sequentielle Abarbeitung einer dynamischen Liste von Elementen zu simulieren, bis alle Elemente verarbeitet wurden oder bestimmte Abbruchkriterien erfüllt sind. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...) = ...`) werden für sauberen Code verwendet.
keywords: CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR, WHILE, Object Orientation, Utility Class, Inline Declaration, Image Processor

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus einer simulierten 'sflights'-Tabelle, die eine Mindestpassagierkapazität (z.B. > 100) haben und von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') betrieben werden, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Benutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine neue, gefilterte interne Tabelle zu erzeugen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             passmax  TYPE sflight-max_p_f,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity          TYPE i
        iv_carrid                TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_flights.
    METHODS fill_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_sflights.
    mt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' passmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' passmax = 90 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' passmax = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0050' passmax = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' passmax = 80 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    fill_sflights( ).
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( mt_sflights WHERE ( passmax > iv_min_capacity AND carrid = iv_carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_filter FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_min_capacity = 100 iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered flights count mismatch' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    " Check specific content if needed
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First filtered flight connid mismatch' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'second filtered flight connid mismatch' act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator (seit ABAP 7.50) bietet eine funktionale Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern und das Ergebnis direkt in einer neuen Tabelle zu speichern. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zur manuellen Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingungen und dem Anhängen an eine neue Tabelle, was den Code kompakter und ausdrucksstärker macht.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus 'sflights' nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY` Anweisung um Daten in einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_result.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_flights.
    METHODS fill_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_sflights.
    mt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' )
      ( carrid = 'LU' connid = '0402' ) ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    fill_sflights( ).

    LOOP AT mt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group).
      READ TABLE ls_group ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_first_in_group>) INDEX 1.
      rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #(
        BASE rt_grouped_flights
        ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
          num_flights = GROUP SIZE )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of distinct carriers mismatch' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = VALUE zcl_group_by_flights=>ty_grouped_result( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_count WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH flights count mismatch' act = ls_lh_count-num_flights exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = VALUE zcl_group_by_flights=>ty_grouped_result( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_aa_count WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA flights count mismatch' act = ls_aa_count-num_flights exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung (seit ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen ähnlich wie die `GROUP BY`-Klausel in SQL. Es erlaubt das Gruppieren von Zeilen nach bestimmten Kriterien und das Arbeiten mit den resultierenden Gruppen. `GROUP SIZE` ist eine nützliche Systemvariable innerhalb des Gruppen-Loops, die die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe angibt. Dies modernisiert die Datenaggregation erheblich.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Table, Aggregation, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Suchen Sie dynamisch nach einem Feld in einer beliebigen Struktur und geben Sie seinen Inhalt zurück. Nutzen Sie hierfür Field-Symbols und dynamische Zuweisungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols mit der `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Anweisung, um auf Felder dynamisch zuzugreifen. `REF TO DATA` kann zur generischen Übergabe von Strukturen genutzt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_field_content_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        ir_data             TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content)   TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_content_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_struct> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_struct>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>initial_reference.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>not_found_in_structure.
    ENDIF.

    rv_content = CONV string( <fs_field> ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_access_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access_field_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access_success.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_test_data,
            id     TYPE i VALUE 100,
            name   TYPE string VALUE 'Test Name',
            status TYPE string VALUE 'ACTIVE',
          END OF ls_test_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).

    DATA(lv_id_content) = lo_cut->get_field_content_dynamic( ir_data = REF #( ls_test_data ) iv_field_name = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'ID content mismatch' act = lv_id_content exp = '100' ).

    DATA(lv_name_content) = lo_cut->get_field_content_dynamic( ir_data = REF #( ls_test_data ) iv_field_name = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Name content mismatch' act = lv_name_content exp = 'Test Name' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_access_field_not_found RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_test_data,
            f1 TYPE string VALUE 'Val',
          END OF ls_test_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_assign_error ).
    lo_cut->get_field_content_dynamic( ir_data = REF #( ls_test_data ) iv_field_name = 'FIELD_NOT_EXIST' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Komponenten von Strukturen mittels Field-Symbols (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und der Anweisung `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...` ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik in ABAP, die seit Version 7.40+ durch `REF TO DATA` und Inline-Deklarationen moderner und sicherer wird. Es ermöglicht die Implementierung generischer Funktionen, die zur Laufzeit auf beliebige Felder zugreifen können.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, REF TO DATA, RTTI

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie den CORRESPONDING # Operator für Strukturen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_struct_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_diff TYPE string, " Different field name
           END OF ty_target.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer generischen Struktur in eine Einkaufsbelegposition-Struktur und setzen Sie den Positionstyp auf einen Standardwert aus CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS, falls er nicht explizit in der Quelle vorhanden ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie CORRESPONDING mit BASE und setzen Sie den Standardwert nach dem Kopiervorgang.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_mmpur_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_generic_item,
             material TYPE matnr,
             quantity TYPE menge_d,
             price    TYPE netpr_d,
           END OF ty_generic_item.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_po_item,
             material   TYPE matnr,
             quantity   TYPE menge_d,
             price      TYPE netpr_d,
             item_cat   TYPE ekgrp,
             plant      TYPE werks_d,
           END OF ty_po_item.

    METHODS map_generic_to_po_item
      IMPORTING
        is_generic_item TYPE ty_generic_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_po_item) TYPE ty_po_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_mmpur_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_generic_to_po_item.
    " Initialize with default item category
    rs_po_item = VALUE #( item_cat = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard ).
    " Copy corresponding fields from generic item
    rs_po_item = CORRESPONDING #( BASE (rs_po_item) is_generic_item ).
    " Set a default plant if not provided by generic item
    IF rs_po_item-plant IS INITIAL.
      rs_po_item-plant = '1000'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_map_with_defaults FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_with_defaults.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_mmpur_combine( ).
    DATA(ls_generic) = VALUE zcl_corr_mmpur_combine=>ty_generic_item( material = 'MAT1' quantity = 10 price = '100.00' ).
    DATA(ls_po_item) = lo_cut->map_generic_to_po_item( is_generic_item = ls_generic ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_po_item-material exp = 'MAT1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_po_item-item_cat exp = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_po_item-plant exp = '1000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_with_plant.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_mmpur_combine( ).
    DATA(ls_generic) = VALUE zcl_corr_mmpur_combine=>ty_generic_item( material = 'MAT2' quantity = 5 price = '50.00' ).
    DATA(ls_po_item_with_plant) = VALUE zcl_corr_mmpur_combine=>ty_po_item( material = 'MAT2' quantity = 5 price = '50.00' item_cat = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard plant = '2000' ).
    DATA(ls_po_item) = lo_cut->map_generic_to_po_item( is_generic_item = ls_generic ).
    ls_po_item-plant = '2000'. " Manually set plant for comparison, as generic_item doesn't have it

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_po_item-material exp = 'MAT2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_po_item-item_cat exp = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_po_item-plant exp = '2000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den CORRESPONDING-Operator mit der BASE-Ergänzung, um eine Zielstruktur mit Standardwerten (hier: Positionstyp aus CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS) zu initialisieren und dann generische Daten zu kopieren. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Datenzuordnung mit intelligenten Standardwerten.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Bestellpositionen in eine neue Tabelle, wobei Sie den Positionstyp auf einen Standardwert setzen, falls er leer ist, und andere Felder kopieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Schleife mit dem VALUE-Operator und CORRESPONDING #.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_corr_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_item,
             po_number  TYPE ebeln,
             po_item    TYPE ebelp,
             material   TYPE matnr,
             item_cat   TYPE ekgrp,
           END OF ty_source_item.
    TYPES: ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_item,
             po_number  TYPE ebeln,
             po_item    TYPE ebelp,
             material   TYPE matnr,
             item_cat   TYPE ekgrp,
             status     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_item.
    TYPES: ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_po_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_corr_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_po_items.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                           ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source
                                 BASE ( item_cat = COND #( WHEN ls_source-item_cat IS INITIAL THEN cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard ELSE ls_source-item_cat ) )
                                 status = 'Processed' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_corr_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_for_corr_transform=>ty_source_table(
      ( po_number = '4500000001' po_item = '00010' material = 'MAT_A' item_cat = '' )
      ( po_number = '4500000001' po_item = '00020' material = 'MAT_B' item_cat = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_consignment )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_po_items( it_source = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_cat exp = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Processed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-item_cat exp = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_consignment ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus FOR-Schleife, VALUE-Operator und CORRESPONDING # ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Die BASE-Ergänzung innerhalb des CORRESPONDING-Operators erlaubt es, Standardwerte zu setzen oder bestehende Werte bedingt zu überschreiben, was den Code sehr ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, Interne Tabelle, Transformation, CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle, wobei Sie bestimmte Felder ausschließen und andere Felder explizit zuordnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den CORRESPONDING # Operator mit den Ergänzungen EXCEPT und MAPPING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_except_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id          TYPE i,
             name        TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
             value       TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES: ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             target_id   TYPE i,
             target_name TYPE string,
             target_desc TYPE string,
             status      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES: ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_except_and_map
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_except_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_except_and_map.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source EXCEPT value MAPPING target_id = id target_name = name ).
    LOOP AT rt_target ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
      <fs_target>-status = 'Copied'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_except_and_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_except_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_except_mapping=>ty_source_table(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' description = 'Desc A' value = 100 )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' description = 'Desc B' value = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->copy_except_and_map( it_source = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-target_id exp = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-target_id exp = 2 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Bestellpositionen validiert. Die Validierung soll prüfen, ob der Positionstyp gültig ist, indem sie eine Konstante aus CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS verwendet und eine Fehlermeldung zurückgibt, falls ungültig.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS für die Validierung und eine interne Tabelle für die Fehlermeldungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mmpur_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_po_item,
             po_number  TYPE ebeln,
             po_item    TYPE ebelp,
             item_cat   TYPE ekgrp,
           END OF ty_po_item.
    TYPES: ty_po_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_po_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_validation_error,
             po_number TYPE ebeln,
             po_item   TYPE ebelp,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_validation_error.
    TYPES: ty_validation_errors TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_validation_error WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_po_items
      IMPORTING
        it_po_items TYPE ty_po_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_errors) TYPE ty_validation_errors.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mmpur_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_po_items.
    DATA(lv_valid_item_cats) = VALUE string_table(
      ( cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard )
      ( cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_consignment )
      ( cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_subcontracting )
    ).

    rt_errors = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_po_items
                           WHERE ( NOT ( ls_item-item_cat IN lv_valid_item_cats ) )
                           ( po_number = ls_item-po_number,
                             po_item   = ls_item-po_item,
                             message   = |Ungültiger Positionstyp '{ ls_item-item_cat }'| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_items FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_items FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mmpur_validation( ).
    DATA(lt_po_items) = VALUE zcl_mmpur_validation=>ty_po_items(

      ( po_number = '4500000001' po_item = '00020' item_cat = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_consignment )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_errors ) msg = 'No errors expected for valid items' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mmpur_validation( ).
    DATA(lt_po_items) = VALUE zcl_mmpur_validation=>ty_po_items(
      ( po_number = '4500000002' po_item = '00010' item_cat = 'Z001' ) " Invalid item category
      ( po_number = '4500000002' po_item = '00020' item_cat = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard )

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine moderne Validierungslogik unter Verwendung von CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS für die Definition gültiger Werte. Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Bestellpositionen nach Material und berechnen Sie die Gesamtmenge für jedes Material. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei nur Standardpositionen, die durch CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS definiert sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator mit einer GROUP BY-Klausel und filtern Sie mit CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_mmpur_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_po_item,
             po_number  TYPE ebeln,
             po_item    TYPE ebelp,
             material   TYPE matnr,
             quantity   TYPE menge_d,
             item_cat   TYPE ekgrp,
           END OF ty_po_item.
    TYPES: ty_po_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_po_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material_summary,
             material TYPE matnr,
             total_qty TYPE menge_d,
           END OF ty_material_summary.
    TYPES: ty_material_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_material_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_standard_po_qty
      IMPORTING
        it_po_items TYPE ty_po_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_material_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_mmpur_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_standard_po_qty.
    rt_summary = REDUCE ty_material_summaries
      FOR GROUPS OF material_group IN it_po_items
      WHERE ( item_cat = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard )
      GROUP BY material_group-material
      INTO DATA(ls_summary)
      ( material = material_group-material
        total_qty = SUM( material_group-quantity ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_qty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_qty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_mmpur_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_po_items) = VALUE zcl_reduce_mmpur_agg=>ty_po_items(
      ( po_number = '4500000001' po_item = '00010' material = 'MAT_A' quantity = 10 item_cat = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard )
      ( po_number = '4500000001' po_item = '00020' material = 'MAT_B' quantity = 20 item_cat = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_consignment )
      ( po_number = '4500000002' po_item = '00010' material = 'MAT_A' quantity = 15 item_cat = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard )
      ( po_number = '4500000003' po_item = '00010' material = 'MAT_C' quantity = 5  item_cat = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base=>item_cat_standard )
    ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->aggregate_standard_po_qty( it_po_items = lt_po_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two materials expected in summary' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ material = 'MAT_A' ]-total_qty exp = 25 msg = 'Total quantity for MAT_A should be 25' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ material = 'MAT_C' ]-total_qty exp = 5 msg = 'Total quantity for MAT_C should be 5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summary[ material = 'MAT_B' ]-total_qty msg = 'MAT_B should not be in summary as it is not standard item' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator mit GROUP BY ist eine leistungsstarke funktionale Methode zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Die WHERE-Klausel innerhalb der FOR GROUPS OF-Anweisung ermöglicht es, die Aggregation auf bestimmte Kriterien (hier: Standardpositionen über CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS) zu beschränken, was zu sehr effizientem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, Interne Tabelle, Aggregation, CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS, ABAP 7.50

hint: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle, konvertieren Sie jeden String mit `cl_abap_conv_obj` und fügen Sie ihn zum XSTRING hinzu. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für eine kompakte Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_separator     TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_xstr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_xstring.
    DATA(lv_separator) = COND string( WHEN iv_separator IS INITIAL THEN '' ELSE iv_separator ).
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).

    LOOP AT it_input_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_string EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 4 ).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.
      IF sy-tabix < lines( it_input_strings ) AND lv_separator IS NOT INITIAL.
        lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_separator EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_output_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_table_to_xstring( it_input_strings = lt_test_strings iv_separator = lv_separator ).

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie ein zufälliges Passwort bestehend aus 10 alphanumerischen Zeichen (Großbuchstaben und Ziffern).
hint: Generieren Sie zufällige Zahlen für ASCII-Werte und konvertieren Sie diese in Zeichen. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_int`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rand_password_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rand_password_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = strlen( lc_chars ) - 1 ).
    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_password = rv_password && lc_chars+lv_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_password_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_password_chars FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_password_length.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_rand_password_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_generator->generate_random_password( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_password ) exp = 10 msg = 'Generated password has incorrect length' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_password_chars.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_rand_password_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_generator->generate_random_password( 10 ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_allowed_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_is_alphanumeric) = abap_true.
    DO strlen( lv_password ) TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = lv_password+sy-index(1).
      IF NOT ( find( val = lc_allowed_chars sub = lv_char ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
        lv_is_alphanumeric = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_alphanumeric exp = abap_true msg = 'Generated password contains invalid characters' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Zufallszahlengenerierung mit String-Operationen, um ein zufälliges Passwort zu erstellen. Es wird ein Pool von erlaubten Zeichen definiert, und dann werden zufällige Indizes verwendet, um Zeichen aus diesem Pool auszuwählen und aneinanderzuhängen. Dies ist eine gängige Methode zur Erzeugung von temporären Passwörtern oder IDs.
keywords: RANDOM, cl_abap_random_int, String Generation, Password, Alphanumeric

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Bestimmen Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen in der Tabelle und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für den Index.

CLASS zcl_rand_sflight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_rand_sflight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      " Handle case where no flights are found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = lv_table_size ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Reihenfolge der Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) zufällig.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine temporäre Tabelle mit zufälligen Schlüsseln und sortieren Sie danach. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rand_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_shuffled,
             random_key TYPE i,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom   TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto     TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight_shuffled.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_shuffled WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_rand_sflight_selector=>ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rand_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 1 max = 1000000 ).

    DATA(lt_temp_shuffled) = VALUE tt_sflight_shuffled(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( )
        carrid     = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid     = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate     = ls_sflight-fldate
        cityfrom   = ls_sflight-cityfrom
        cityto     = ls_sflight-cityto )
    ).

    SORT lt_temp_shuffled BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_shuffled IN lt_temp_shuffled
      ( carrid   = ls_shuffled-carrid
        connid   = ls_shuffled-connid
        fldate   = ls_shuffled-fldate
        cityfrom = ls_shuffled-cityfrom
        cityto   = ls_shuffled-cityto )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflights.
    DATA(lo_shuffler) = NEW zcl_rand_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_original_sflights) TYPE zcl_rand_table_shuffler=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_original_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lines( lt_original_sflights ) < 2.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Not enough sflights for shuffling test' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_shuffled_sflights) = lo_shuffler->shuffle_sflights( lt_original_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) msg = 'Shuffled table has incorrect number of rows' ).

    " Check if content is the same (ignoring order)
    DATA(lt_original_sorted) = lt_original_sflights.
    SORT lt_original_sorted BY carrid connid fldate.
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sorted) = lt_shuffled_sflights.
    SORT lt_shuffled_sorted BY carrid connid fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled_sorted exp = lt_original_sorted msg = 'Shuffled table content mismatch' ).

    " Check if order is likely different (probabilistic test)
    DATA(lv_is_same_order) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_original_sflights INTO DATA(ls_orig).
      READ TABLE lt_shuffled_sflights INTO DATA(ls_shuff) INDEX sy-tabix.
      IF ls_orig <> ls_shuff.
        lv_is_same_order = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_same_order exp = abap_false msg = 'Table order did not change after shuffling (unlikely)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Mischen einer internen Tabelle wird hier durch das Hinzufügen eines zufälligen Schlüssels zu jedem Eintrag und anschließendes Sortieren nach diesem Schlüssel erreicht. Die `FOR`-Iteration ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, die temporäre Tabelle zu füllen. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um eine zufällige Reihenfolge zu erzielen.
keywords: RANDOM, cl_abap_random_int, Internal Table, Shuffle, Sort, FOR

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb des aktuellen Jahres.
hint: Bestimmen Sie die Anzahl der Tage im aktuellen Jahr und generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl für den Tag des Jahres. Addieren Sie diese dann zum Jahresanfang.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rand_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date_in_year
      IMPORTING
        iv_year TYPE sy-datum-year
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rand_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date_in_year.
    DATA(lv_first_day_of_year) = iv_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_last_day_of_year) = iv_year && '1231'.

    DATA(lv_days_in_year) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_between( iv_date1 = lv_first_day_of_year iv_date2 = lv_last_day_of_year ) + 1.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( ) min = 0 max = lv_days_in_year - 1 ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_random_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = lv_first_day_of_year iv_days = lv_random_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings, wobei jeder String als separate Datei innerhalb eines ZIP-Archivs behandelt wird. Das Ergebnis soll ein XSTRING sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ADD` und `SAVE` Methoden von `CL_ABAP_ZIP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_multi_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_string_entry,
             name TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_string_entry.
    TYPES: tt_string_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_string_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_entries
      IMPORTING
        it_entries TYPE tt_string_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_strings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_entries.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    LOOP AT it_entries INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      lo_zip->add(
        EXPORTING
          i_name    = ls_entry-name
          i_content = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( ls_entry-content ) 
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_zip->save(
      RECEIVING
        r_zip = rv_compressed_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compress_multi_strings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compress_multi_strings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_multi_strings( ).
    DATA(lt_entries) = VALUE zcl_zip_multi_strings=>tt_string_entries(
      ( name = 'file1.txt' content = 'Content of file 1' )
      ( name = 'file2.txt' content = 'Content of file 2' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_compressed) = lo_cut->compress_entries( lt_entries ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Compressed XSTRING should not be initial' act = lv_compressed ).

    DATA(lo_unzip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_unzip->load( i_zip = lv_compressed ).
    DATA(lt_files) = lo_unzip->get_files( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should contain 2 files' act = lines( lt_files ) exp = 2 ).

CLASS zcl_zip_unzip_multi_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             name TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_zip_unzip_multi_strings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_entries.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( i_zip = iv_compressed_xstring ).

    DATA(lt_files) = lo_zip->get_files( ).
    LOOP AT lt_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      DATA(lv_content_x) = lo_zip->get( i_name = ls_file-name ).
      DATA(lv_content_s) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_content_x ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_string_entry( name = ls_file-name content = lv_content_s ) TO rt_entries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, konvertieren Sie diese in ein CSV-Format und komprimieren Sie das CSV als eine Datei in einem ZIP-Archiv.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT`, `LOOP AT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF`, `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für CSV-Generierung und `CL_ABAP_ZIP` für die Komprimierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_sflights_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_sflights_to_csv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_sflights_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflights_to_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_csv_header) = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY;PLANETYPE;SEATSMAX;SEATSOCC;PAYMENTSUM;DISTANCE;UNIT'.
    DATA(lt_csv_lines) = VALUE string_table( ( lv_csv_header ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate };{ ls_sflight-price };{ ls_sflight-currency };{ ls_sflight-planetype };{ ls_sflight-seatsmax };{ ls_sflight-seatsocc };{ ls_sflight-paymentsum };{ ls_sflight-distance };{ ls_sflight-unit }| TO lt_csv_lines.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_csv_content) = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR line IN lt_csv_lines NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN line ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && line ) ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      EXPORTING
        i_name    = 'sflights.csv'
        i_content = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_csv_content )
    ).
    lo_zip->save(
      RECEIVING
        r_zip = rv_compressed_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compress_sflights_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compress_sflights_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_sflights_csv( ).
    DATA(lv_compressed) = lo_cut->compress_sflights_to_csv( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Compressed XSTRING should not be initial' act = lv_compressed ).

    DATA(lo_unzip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_unzip->load( i_zip = lv_compressed ).
    DATA(lt_files) = lo_unzip->get_files( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should contain 1 file' act = lines( lt_files ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filename should be sflights.csv' act = lt_files[ 1 ]-name exp = 'sflights.csv' ).

    DATA(lv_csv_x) = lo_unzip->get( i_name = 'sflights.csv' ).
    DATA(lv_csv_s) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_csv_x ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CSV content should not be initial' act = lv_csv_s ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'CSV header check' sub = 'CARRID;CONNID' in = lv_csv_s ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von Datenbankzugriff, String-Templates, `REDUCE` für die effiziente CSV-Generierung und `CL_ABAP_ZIP` für die Komprimierung. `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE=>CR_LF` sorgt für plattformunabhängige Zeilenumbrüche.
keywords: CL_ABAP_ZIP, SFLIGHTS, CSV, REDUCE, String Templates, CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, Compression

Instructions: Zu einem gegebenen Zeitstempel eine bestimmte Anzahl von Sekunden addieren und subtrahieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_arithmetic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_and_subtract_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_seconds     TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_added_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        ev_subtracted_tstmp TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_arithmetic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_and_subtract_seconds.
    DATA(lo_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc_tstmp( iv_start_tstmp ).

    DATA(lo_added_tstmp) = lo_tstmp->add_seconds( iv_seconds ).
    ev_added_tstmp = lo_added_tstmp->get_utc_tstmp( ).

    ev_subtracted_tstmp = lo_subtracted_tstmp->get_utc_tstmp( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_difference IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Einen Zeitstempel in ein benutzerdefiniertes String-Format (z.B. 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS') umwandeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates und `cl_abap_tstmp->get_date_time_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_tzone TYPE timezone OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc_tstmp( iv_tstmp ).
    DATA: lv_date TYPE sy-datum, lv_time TYPE sy-uzeit.

    lo_tstmp->get_date_time_components(
      EXPORTING
        tzone = COND #( WHEN iv_tzone IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_tzone ELSE sy-tzone )
      IMPORTING
        date  = lv_date
        time  = lv_time
    ).

    rv_formatted_string = |{ lv_date DATE = ISO } { lv_time TIME = ISO }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_timestamp FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp) = '20231026100000.0000000'. " UTC

    " Annahme: Lokale Zeitzone ist CET, und 20231026100000 UTC ist 20231026120000 CET (Sommerzeit)
    " oder 20231026110000 CET (Winterzeit). Hier nehmen wir an, es ist 12:00:00 CET.
    DATA(lv_formatted_cet) = lo_cut->format_timestamp( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp iv_tzone = 'CET' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_cet exp = '2023-10-26 12:00:00' msg = 'Formatierung CET fehlgeschlagen' ).

    " Ohne explizite Zeitzone (nutzt sy-tzone)
    DATA(lv_formatted_default) = lo_cut->format_timestamp( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp ).
    " Hier müsste der Test dynamisch die sy-tzone berücksichtigen oder einen festen Wert annehmen.
    " Für den Test nehmen wir an, sy-tzone ist auch CET.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_default exp = '2023-10-26 12:00:00' msg = 'Formatierung Standard-Zeitzone fehlgeschlagen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt String-Templates (`|...|`) und die `DATE = ISO`, `TIME = ISO` Formatierungsoptionen, um Datum und Uhrzeit aus einem Zeitstempel in ein lesbares Format zu bringen. Die `COND` Expression wird verwendet, um optional eine Zeitzone zu übergeben oder die Standard-Systemzeitzone (`sy-tzone`) zu verwenden. Dies ist eine sehr flexible und moderne Art der String-Formatierung in ABAP.

Die Verwendung von `COND` für die optionale Zeitzone macht den Code flexibel und robust. Das Ergebnis ist immer ein UTC-Zeitstempel, der dann bei Bedarf konvertiert werden kann.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zeitstempeln und verarbeiten Sie diese in einer Schleife, wobei jeder Zeitstempel in jedem Schritt um eine Stunde erhöht wird. Verwenden Sie Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lv_ts)` für Inline-Deklarationen, `FOR ... IN` für die Schleife und `cl_abap_tstmp->add_seconds`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_loop_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_timestamps TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF timestampl WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_timestamps
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_count       TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_tstmp) TYPE tt_timestamps.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_loop_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_timestamps.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = iv_start_tstmp.

    LOOP AT sy-tabix FROM 1 TO iv_count INTO DATA(lv_index).
      APPEND lv_current_tstmp TO rt_processed_tstmp.
      DATA(lo_tstmp_obj) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc_tstmp( lv_current_tstmp ).
      lv_current_tstmp = lo_tstmp_obj->add_seconds( 3600 )->get_utc_tstmp( ). " Add 1 hour
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_loop_timestamps.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_loop_data( ).
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = '20231026100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_count) = 3.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_timestamps(
      iv_start_tstmp = lv_start_tstmp
      iv_count       = lv_count
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_count msg = 'Anzahl der Zeitstempel in der Tabelle falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '20231026100000.0000000' msg = 'Erster Zeitstempel falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = '20231026110000.0000000' msg = 'Zweiter Zeitstempel falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = '20231026120000.0000000' msg = 'Dritter Zeitstempel falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lv_current_tstmp)`, `DATA(lv_index)`) in Kombination mit einer `LOOP AT sy-tabix` Schleife. Die Zeitstempel-Arithmetik wird durch Methodenverkettung (`add_seconds(...)->get_utc_tstmp()`) kompakt und effizient dargestellt. Dies ist ein typisches Muster für die moderne Verarbeitung von Daten in Schleifen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einem Start- und Endzeitstempel für das Flugdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und `cl_abap_tstmp` für den Vergleich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        it_flights     TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_tstmp.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE
      ( cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_date_time( date = fldate time = deptime )->get_utc_tstmp( ) >= iv_start_tstmp AND
        cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_date_time( date = fldate time = arrtime )->get_utc_tstmp( ) <= iv_end_tstmp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_filter_sflight( ).
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231026' deptime = '100000' arrtime = '120000' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20231026' deptime = '130000' arrtime = '150000' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20231027' deptime = '080000' arrtime = '100000' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = '20231026090000.0000000'. " UTC

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_tstmp(
      it_flights     = lt_test_flights

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 msg = 'Falsche Anzahl gefilterter Flüge' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Falscher Flug gefiltert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'Falscher Flug gefiltert' ).

In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um Flüge zu finden, deren Start- und Ankunftszeitstempel innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs liegen. Die Zeitstempel werden dynamisch aus Datum und Uhrzeit der Flugdaten mit `cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_date_time` erstellt und direkt im Filterausdruck verglichen. Dies ist sehr kompakt und effizient.
