CLASS zcl_conv_stream_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_file_stream.
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
      encoding = 'UTF-16LE'
    ).

    LOOP AT it_utf8_lines INTO DATA(lv_line).
      lo_conv_out->write( lv_line ).
      lo_conv_out->flush( ). " Flush buffer to ensure data is available
      DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
      lo_conv_out->clear_buffer( ).

      lo_conv_in->write( lv_xstring ).
      lo_conv_in->flush( ).
      DATA(lv_converted_line) TYPE string.
      lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = lv_converted_line ).
      lo_conv_in->clear_buffer( ).
      APPEND lv_converted_line TO rt_utf16_lines.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung bei einer ungültigen Zeichenkonvertierung.
hint: Fangen Sie die Ausnahme `CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_invalid_string TYPE string
        iv_source_encoding TYPE string
        iv_target_encoding TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_out(
          encoding = iv_source_encoding
        ).
        DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_obj=>create_in(
          encoding = iv_target_encoding
        ).

        lo_conv_out->write( iv_invalid_string ).
        DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).

        lo_conv_in->reset( ).
        lo_conv_in->write( lv_xstring ).
        lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = rv_converted_string ).

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Handle the error, e.g., log it or re-raise
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_codepage
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error
            textid = lx_conv_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_char) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>horizontal_tab. " A character that might cause issues with certain encodings
    DATA(lv_source_enc) = 'UTF-8'.
    DATA(lv_target_enc) = 'ASCII'. " ASCII cannot represent all UTF-8 chars

    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling( iv_invalid_string = lv_invalid_char iv_source_encoding = lv_source_enc iv_target_encoding = lv_target_enc ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei Zeichenkonvertierungen. Wenn eine Konvertierung aufgrund inkompatibler Zeichen oder Codepages fehlschlägt, wird die Ausnahme `CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE` ausgelöst. Durch das Fangen dieser Ausnahme kann das Programm angemessen reagieren, z.B. den Fehler protokollieren oder eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung anzeigen. Dies ist entscheidend für die Stabilität und Zuverlässigkeit von Anwendungen, die mit unterschiedlichen Zeichensätzen arbeiten.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine Diagrammdarstellung auf. Gruppieren Sie die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle mit CARRID und der Anzahl der Flüge sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` Expression in Kombination mit `REDUCE` oder `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flights IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flights-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( carrid       = flights-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob Lufthansa (LH) Flüge hat
    DATA(ls_lh_flights) = VALUE #( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_lh_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_lh_flights-flight_count exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt eine `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` Expression, um die Flugdaten effizient nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe zu ermitteln. Dies ist eine moderne und sehr performante Art, Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `COLLECT` zu verwenden. `VALUE #()` erzeugt die neue interne Tabelle direkt.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, FOR, GROUP BY, VALUE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie das aktuelle Geschäftsjahr und die aktuelle Geschäftsperiode unter Verwendung der Klasse `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `get_current_period` der Klasse `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_current_period DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_current_period,
             fiscal_year TYPE gjahr,
             fiscal_period TYPE monat,
           END OF ty_current_period.

    METHODS get_current_fiscal_period
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_current_period) TYPE ty_current_period.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_current_period IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_fiscal_period.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    " Annahme: Geschäftsjahresvariante 'K4' (Kalenderjahr)
    lo_period_toolset->get_current_period(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date         = lv_date
        iv_fisc_year_variant = 'K4'
      IMPORTING
        ev_fiscal_year  = rs_current_period-fiscal_year
        ev_fiscal_period = rs_current_period-fiscal_period
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_current_period( ).
    DATA(ls_current_period) = lo_cut->get_current_fiscal_period( ).

Die Methode `get_current_period` erlaubt die einfache Ermittlung des Geschäftsjahres und der -periode für ein gegebenes Datum und eine Geschäftsjahresvariante. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu manuellen Berechnungen oder Funktionsbausteinen, die oft weniger flexibel sind.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS, um nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines) zu erhalten. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle mit den gefilterten Flügen sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FILTER` Expression, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aa_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_aa_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aa_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_aa_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie eine Klasse zur Konfiguration von Diagrammeigenschaften für `cl_gui_chart_engine`. Die Klasse soll Methoden für das Setzen von Titel, Achsenbeschriftungen und Datenserien bereitstellen, die method chaining ermöglichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `NEW` Operator und geben Sie `ME` in den Setter-Methoden zurück, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
    METHODS set_title IMPORTING iv_title TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chart_config.
    METHODS set_x_axis_label IMPORTING iv_label TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chart_config.
    METHODS set_y_axis_label IMPORTING iv_label TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chart_config.
    METHODS add_data_series IMPORTING it_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_table RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chart_config.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_chart_engine = io_chart_engine.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_title.
    mo_chart_engine->set_title( iv_title ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_x_axis_label.
    mo_chart_engine->set_x_axis_label( iv_label ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_y_axis_label.
    mo_chart_engine->set_y_axis_label( iv_label ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_data_series.
    mo_chart_engine->add_data_series( it_data ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    " Mock cl_gui_chart_engine for testing purposes
    DATA(lo_mock_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).

    DATA(lo_config) = NEW zcl_chart_config( lo_mock_chart ).

    " Test method chaining
    lo_config->set_title( 'My Chart' )
            ->set_x_axis_label( 'X-Axis' )
            ->set_y_axis_label( 'Y-Axis' ).

    " In a real scenario, you would assert on the state of lo_mock_chart
    " For this example, we just check if the chaining itself works without syntax errors.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_config ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ist ein modernes Designmuster, das die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit von Code verbessert, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung verkettet werden. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Setter-Methode eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Konfigurationsklassen wie diese, die viele Eigenschaften setzen.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, NEW, ME, cl_gui_chart_engine

Instructions: Transformieren Sie die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS in eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID), die Flugnummer (CONNID) und das Flugdatum (FLDATE) enthält. Verwenden Sie dabei eine moderne Syntax.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_flight_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                   fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS nach Geschäftsperiode. Verwenden Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics`, um die Geschäftsperiode für jedes Flugdatum zu bestimmen, und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Periode.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` mit einem Inline-Aufruf von `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_by_period DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_flight_count,
             fiscal_year TYPE gjahr,
             fiscal_period TYPE monat,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_period_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_period_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_per_period
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_period_counts) TYPE tt_period_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_by_period IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_per_period.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).

    rt_period_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flights IN lt_sflights
                                 GROUP BY ( fiscal_year   = lo_period_toolset->get_fiscal_year( iv_date = flights-fldate iv_fisc_year_variant = 'K4' )
                                            fiscal_period = lo_period_toolset->get_fiscal_period( iv_date = flights-fldate iv_fisc_year_variant = 'K4' ) )
                                 WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( fiscal_year   = GROUP KEY-fiscal_year
                                   fiscal_period = GROUP KEY-fiscal_period
                                   flight_count  = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flights_per_period FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_per_period.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_by_period( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_per_period( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).

Die Geschäftsperiode wird für jedes Flugdatum 'on the fly' mit `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` ermittelt und direkt als Gruppierungskriterium verwendet. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen in einer einzigen, sehr ausdrucksstarken Anweisung.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, FOR, GROUP BY, VALUE, cl_bs_period_toolset_basics, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Geschäftsperioden für ein gegebenes Geschäftsjahr dynamisch generiert. Die Funktion soll die Klasse `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie Methoden von `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` wie `get_number_of_periods` und `get_period_start_date` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_periods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_info,
             fiscal_year TYPE gjahr,
             fiscal_period TYPE monat,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_period_info.
    TYPES tt_period_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_periods
      IMPORTING iv_fiscal_year TYPE gjahr
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_periods) TYPE tt_period_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_periods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_periods.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).
    DATA(lv_fisc_year_variant) = 'K4'. " Beispiel: Kalenderjahr

    DATA(lv_num_periods) = lo_period_toolset->get_number_of_periods(
                                 iv_fiscal_year     = iv_fiscal_year
                                 iv_fisc_year_variant = lv_fisc_year_variant ).

    DO lv_num_periods TIMES.
      DATA(lv_period) = sy-index.
      DATA(ls_period_info) = VALUE ty_period_info(
        fiscal_year   = iv_fiscal_year
        fiscal_period = |{ lv_period ALPHA = OUT }|
      ).

      lo_period_toolset->get_period_start_date(
        EXPORTING
          iv_fiscal_year     = iv_fiscal_year
          iv_fiscal_period   = lv_period
          iv_fisc_year_variant = lv_fisc_year_variant
        IMPORTING
          ev_date            = ls_period_info-start_date
      ).

      lo_period_toolset->get_period_end_date(
        EXPORTING
          iv_fiscal_year     = iv_fiscal_year
          iv_fiscal_period   = lv_period
          iv_fisc_year_variant = lv_fisc_year_variant
        IMPORTING
          ev_date            = ls_period_info-end_date
      ).
      APPEND ls_period_info TO rt_periods.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_periods FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_periods.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_periods( ).
    DATA(lt_periods) = lo_cut->generate_periods( '2024' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_periods ) exp = 12 ). " Kalenderjahr hat 12 Perioden

    DATA(ls_first_period) = lt_periods[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_period-fiscal_year exp = '2024' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_period-fiscal_period exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_period-start_date exp = '20240101' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für jede Geschäftsperiode aus den SFLIGHTS-Daten. Verwenden Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` zur Periodenbestimmung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE` und `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_passengers_per_period DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_passenger_sum,
             fiscal_year TYPE gjahr,
             fiscal_period TYPE monat,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_period_passenger_sum.
    TYPES tt_period_passenger_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_passenger_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passengers_per_period
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_passenger_sums) TYPE tt_period_passenger_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_passengers_per_period IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passengers_per_period.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = NEW cl_bs_period_toolset_basics( ).

    rt_passenger_sums = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flights IN lt_sflights
                                 GROUP BY ( fiscal_year   = lo_period_toolset->get_fiscal_year( iv_date = flights-fldate iv_fisc_year_variant = 'K4' )
                                            fiscal_period = lo_period_toolset->get_fiscal_period( iv_date = flights-fldate iv_fisc_year_variant = 'K4' ) )
                                 WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( fiscal_year      = GROUP KEY-fiscal_year
                                   fiscal_period    = GROUP KEY-fiscal_period
                                   total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP
                                                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Geschäftsperiode wird dynamisch mit `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` bestimmt. `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Summenbildung innerhalb jeder Gruppe, was den Code sehr effizient und lesbar macht.

CLASS zcl_flight_period_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um die Struktur einer internen Tabelle dynamisch zu analysieren und die Namen der Felder zu ermitteln. Dies könnte nützlich sein, um Daten für eine generische Diagramm-Engine vorzubereiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_table_structure
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_field_names) TYPE tt_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_table_structure.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE ty_field_info( name = ls_component-name type = ls_component-type_descr->get_type_kind( ) ) TO rt_field_names.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,

    DATA lt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_table_analyzer( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_field2-type exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int ).

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Hier wird `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` verwendet, um die Beschreibung einer internen Tabelle zu erhalten, und dann `get_table_line_type` und `get_components`, um die Feldnamen und -typen der Zeilenstruktur zu extrahieren. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die für generische Frameworks oder Tools, wie z.B. eine flexible Diagramm-Engine, unerlässlich ist.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) für alle Flüge in SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie eine moderne Aggregationsmethode.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE` Expression, um die Summe zu bilden und dann den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_seatsocc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_seats_occupied
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_seatsocc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_seats_occupied.
    SELECT seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_seats).

    IF lt_seats IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_seats> IN lt_seats NEXT sum = sum + <fs_seats>-seatsocc ).
      rv_average = lv_total_seats / lines( lt_seats ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_seats FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_seatsocc( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->get_average_seats_occupied( ).

    " Da SFLIGHTS Daten variieren können, prüfen wir auf einen plausiblen Wert
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_average exp = 0.0 ). " Sollte > 0 sein
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_average > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_average < 1000 ). " Plausibler Maximalwert
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Sie ermöglicht es, einen einzelnen Wert (hier die Summe der belegten Sitze) aus einer Tabelle zu berechnen. In Kombination mit `lines()` für die Anzahl der Einträge kann der Durchschnitt sehr prägnant ermittelt werden. Dies ist effizienter und lesbarer als eine explizite Schleife mit manueller Summenbildung.
keywords: Math, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AZ' für Alitalia) existieren. Das Ergebnis soll ein boolescher Wert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LINE_EXISTS` Expression in Kombination mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_carrier_exists
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_carrier_exists.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carrids).

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN line_exists( lt_carrids[ carrid = iv_carrid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die `LINE_EXISTS` Expression in Kombination mit einem Tabellenausdruck (`lt_carrids[ carrid = iv_carrid ]`) ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art, zu prüfen, ob eine Zeile mit einer bestimmten Bedingung in einer internen Tabelle existiert. Dies ist wesentlich performanter und lesbarer als eine Schleife mit `CHECK` oder `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC` Prüfung. Die `COND` Expression wird verwendet, um den booleschen Wert direkt zuzuweisen.
keywords: Conditional Logic, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, COND, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der ein Array von Personenobjekten enthält, und geben Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Daten zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_array_size` und `get_value_by_path` in einer Schleife mit String-Templates für den JSONPath.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parse_array DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person,
             name TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_person,
           tt_persons TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_person WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS parse_person_array
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_persons) TYPE tt_persons
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_array IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_person_array.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = cl_clb_parse_json=>create_parser( iv_json_string ).
    lo_json_parser->parse_json_string( ).

    DATA(lv_array_size) = lo_json_parser->get_array_size( '/persons' ).
    LOOP AT sy-tab_range FROM 0 TO lv_array_size - 1 INTO DATA(lv_index).
      DATA(ls_person) = VALUE ty_person( ).
      lo_json_parser->get_value_by_path(
        EXPORTING
          iv_path = |/persons[{ lv_index }]/name|
        IMPORTING
          ev_value = ls_person-name
      ).
      lo_json_parser->get_value_by_path(
        EXPORTING
          iv_path = |/persons[{ lv_index }]/age|
        IMPORTING
          ev_value = ls_person-age
      ).
      APPEND ls_person TO rt_persons.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_person_array FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_array FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_person_array.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_parse_array( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `{"persons": [{"name": "Max", "age": 30}, {"name": "Anna", "age": 25}]}`.
    DATA(lt_persons) = lo_cut->parse_person_array( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_persons ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_persons INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_person1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person1-name exp = 'Max' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person1-age exp = 30 ).
    READ TABLE lt_persons INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_person2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person2-name exp = 'Anna' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person2-age exp = 25 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_array.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_parse_array( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `{"persons": []}`.
    DATA(lt_persons) = lo_cut->parse_person_array( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_persons ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Parsen eines JSON-Arrays. Durch die Kombination von `get_array_size` und einer Schleife mit dynamisch generierten JSONPath-Ausdrücken (`|/persons[{ lv_index }]/name|`) können einzelne Elemente eines Arrays effizient extrahiert werden.
keywords: JSON, Array, Parsing, cl_clb_parse_json, JSONPath

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine einfache interne Tabelle (`sflights`) in einem `cl_gui_alv_grid` an. Beachten Sie, dass für die Ausführung ein Dynpro mit einem Custom Container benötigt wird.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein Custom Container, instanziieren Sie `cl_gui_alv_grid` und rufen Sie `set_table_for_first_display` auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_simple_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_simple_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        lifetime_set_error = 5
        OTHERS = 6
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_alv_grid) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        error_cntl_create = 1
        error_cntl_init = 2
        error_cntl_link = 3
        error_dp_create = 4
        OTHERS = 5
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating ALV grid' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        is_variant       = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid handle = '001' fieldcat_name = 'SFLIGHTS' )
        i_save           = 'A'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights
      EXCEPTIONS
        invalid_parameter_combination = 1
        program_error                 = 2
        too_many_lines                = 3
        OTHERS                        = 4.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error setting ALV table' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Hinweis: Für die tatsächliche Anzeige muss ein Dynpro 100 mit einem Custom Container
    " namens 'ALV_CONTAINER' existieren und aufgerufen werden.
    " CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Ereignisbehandlung für einen Doppelklick auf eine Zeile im ALV-Grid, um die Details der ausgewählten Flugverbindung anzuzeigen. Beachten Sie, dass für die Ausführung ein Dynpro mit einem Custom Container benötigt wird.

    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Passen Sie den Feldkatalog eines ALV-Grids dynamisch an, um bestimmte Spalten auszublenden oder die Reihenfolge zu ändern. Beachten Sie, dass für die Ausführung ein Dynpro mit einem Custom Container benötigt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `get_frontend_fieldcatalog` und `set_frontend_fieldcatalog`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_dynamic_fcat.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_dynamic_fcat.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE mt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).
    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = lo_container ).

    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        is_variant       = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid handle = '001' fieldcat_name = 'SFLIGHTS' )
        i_save           = 'A'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fieldcat. " Get initial field catalog

    " Modify field catalog: Hide 'PLANETYPE', change position of 'CARRID'
    LOOP AT lt_fieldcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).
      CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.
        WHEN 'PLANETYPE'.
          <fs_fcat>-tech = abap_true. " Hide column
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          <fs_fcat>-col_pos = 10. " Move to end (example)
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_frontend_fieldcatalog
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.

    " Hinweis: Für die tatsächliche Anzeige muss ein Dynpro 100 mit einem Custom Container
    " namens 'ALV_CONTAINER' existieren und aufgerufen werden.
    " CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fieldcat_modification FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fieldcat_modification.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    " Simulate initial field catalog
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CARRID' col_pos = 1 ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CONNID' col_pos = 2 ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' col_pos = 3 ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Modify field catalog: Hide 'PLANETYPE', change position of 'CARRID'
    LOOP AT lt_fieldcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).
      CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.
        WHEN 'PLANETYPE'.
          <fs_fcat>-tech = abap_true. " Hide column
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          <fs_fcat>-col_pos = 10. " Move to end (example)
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    READ TABLE lt_fieldcat WITH KEY fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_planetype>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_planetype>-tech ).

    READ TABLE lt_fieldcat WITH KEY fieldname = 'CARRID' ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_carrid>-col_pos exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Anpassung des Feldkatalogs ermöglicht eine flexible Steuerung der Spaltenanzeige im ALV. Durch `set_table_for_first_display` kann der initiale Feldkatalog abgerufen und anschließend mit `set_frontend_fieldcatalog` aktualisiert werden. `refresh_table_display` sorgt für die sofortige Anzeige der Änderungen.
keywords: ALV, cl_gui_alv_grid, Field Catalog, Dynamic, Display

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Möglichkeit, Zeilen im ALV-Grid zu markieren und die markierten Zeilen auszulesen. Beachten Sie, dass für die Ausführung ein Dynpro mit einem Custom Container benötigt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_ready_for_input` und `get_selected_rows`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_row_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_selection.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    METHODS handle_user_command FOR EVENT user_command OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_row_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_selection.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE mt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' ).
    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = lo_container ).

    SET HANDLER handle_user_command FOR mo_alv_grid.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        is_variant       = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid handle = '001' fieldcat_name = 'SFLIGHTS' )
        i_save           = 'A'
        i_grid_title     = 'Flüge mit Zeilenauswahl'
        i_bypassing_buffer = abap_true
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_sflights.

    " Enable row selection
    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
      EXPORTING
        i_ready_for_input = 1. " 1 for single selection, 2 for multiple selection

    " Add a button to read selected rows
    DATA(lo_toolbar) = mo_alv_grid->get_toolbar_object( ).
    lo_toolbar->add_button(
      EXPORTING
        fcode = 'READ_SEL'
        icon  = icon_read_selected
        butn_type = 0
        text  = 'Ausgewählte lesen'
        quickinfo = 'Ausgewählte Zeilen lesen'
    ).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_toolbar_interactive.

    " Hinweis: Für die tatsächliche Anzeige muss ein Dynpro 100 mit einem Custom Container
    " namens 'ALV_CONTAINER' existieren und aufgerufen werden.
    " CALL SCREEN 100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_user_command.
    IF e_ucomm = 'READ_SEL'.
      DATA: lt_selected_rows TYPE lvc_t_row,
            ls_sflight       TYPE sflights,
            lv_message       TYPE string.

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->get_selected_rows
        IMPORTING
          et_index_rows = lt_selected_rows.

      IF lt_selected_rows IS NOT INITIAL.
        LOOP AT lt_selected_rows INTO DATA(ls_row).
          READ TABLE mt_sflights INDEX ls_row-index INTO ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            lv_message = lv_message && |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } |.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        MESSAGE lv_message TYPE 'I'.
      ELSE.
        MESSAGE 'Keine Zeilen ausgewählt.' TYPE 'I'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_selected_rows FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_selected_rows.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_row_selection( ).
    " Simulate ALV grid and data
    DATA(lo_alv_mock) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'DUMMY' ) ).
    ASSIGN lo_cut->mo_alv_grid TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_alv_grid>).

Instructions: Erstelle eine E-Mail mit einem Anhang, dessen MIME-Typ korrekt gesetzt ist, und bereite sie zum Versand vor.
hint: Nutze `cl_bcs` und `cl_document_bcs` in Kombination mit `cl_fxs_mime_types`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_with_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment,
             filename TYPE string,
             content  TYPE xstring,
             mimetype TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attachment.
    TYPES: tt_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_email_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_subject     TYPE string
        iv_body        TYPE string
        it_attachments TYPE tt_attachments OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_with_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_email_document.
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = iv_body
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    LOOP AT it_attachments INTO DATA(ls_attachment).
      DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
        i_type    = 'ATT'
        i_text    = ls_attachment-content
        i_subject = ls_attachment-filename
      ).
      lo_attachment->set_mime_type( ls_attachment-mimetype ).
      lo_document->add_attachment(
        i_document = lo_attachment
        i_attachment_type = ls_attachment-mimetype
        i_attachment_size = xstrlen( ls_attachment-content )
        i_attachment_header = ls_attachment-filename
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_document = lo_document.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahiere den Haupt-MIME-Typ und die Parameter aus einem HTTP Content-Type Header-String (z.B. 'application/json; charset=utf-8').
hint: Nutze String-Funktionen wie `FIND`, `SUBSTRING`, `SPLIT` und ggf. `cl_abap_regex`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_content_type_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parameter,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_parameter.
    TYPES: tt_parameters TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_content_type_info,
             main_type  TYPE string,
             parameters TYPE tt_parameters,
           END OF ty_content_type_info.

    METHODS parse_content_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_content_type_header TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_content_type_info) TYPE ty_content_type_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_content_type_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_content_type.
    DATA: lv_main_part TYPE string,
          lv_param_part TYPE string.

    SPLIT iv_content_type_header AT ';' INTO lv_main_part lv_param_part.

    rs_content_type_info-main_type = to_lower( condense( lv_main_part ) ).

    IF lv_param_part IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_param_strings) = VALUE string_table( ).
      SPLIT lv_param_part AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_param_strings.

      LOOP AT lt_param_strings INTO DATA(lv_param_string).
        DATA: lv_param_name TYPE string,
              lv_param_value TYPE string.
        SPLIT lv_param_string AT '=' INTO lv_param_name lv_param_value.
        IF lv_param_name IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_param_value IS NOT INITIAL.
          APPEND VALUE ty_parameter(
            name  = to_lower( condense( lv_param_name ) )
            value = condense( replace( val = lv_param_value regex = `"` with = `` ) )
          ) TO rs_content_type_info-parameters.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_content_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_content_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_content_type_parser( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->parse_content_type( 'application/json; charset=utf-8; boundary="foo"' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-main_type exp = 'application/json' msg = 'Main type incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_result-parameters ) exp = 2 msg = 'Parameter count incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE ls_result-parameters WITH KEY name = 'charset' INTO DATA(ls_param_charset).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_param_charset-value exp = 'utf-8' msg = 'Charset parameter incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE ls_result-parameters WITH KEY name = 'boundary' INTO DATA(ls_param_boundary).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_param_boundary-value exp = 'foo' msg = 'Boundary parameter incorrect' ).

    ls_result = lo_cut->parse_content_type( 'text/html' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-main_type exp = 'text/html' msg = 'Simple main type incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_result-parameters msg = 'Parameters should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt moderne String-Funktionen wie `SPLIT`, `TO_LOWER`, `CONDENSE` und `REPLACE` um einen komplexen HTTP-Header zu parsen. Dies ist eine effiziente und lesbare Methode, um strukturierte Informationen aus Strings zu extrahieren, die oft im Zusammenhang mit der Verarbeitung von Web-Anfragen und -Antworten stehen, wo MIME-Typen eine zentrale Rolle spielen.
keywords: HTTP, Content-Type, MIME, String Processing, Parsing, `SPLIT`, `CONDENSE`

CLASS zcl_class_attribute_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_class_attribute_reader( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_attributes msg = 'No attributes found' ).

Instructions: Rufe eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf, deren Name als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String-Wert setzen.
hint: Nutze `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS call_method_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_test_object) = NEW zcl_test_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).

    out->write( |Initial value: { lo_test_object->mv_value }| ).

    lo_caller->call_method_dynamically(
      io_object      = lo_test_object
      iv_method_name = 'SET_VALUE'
      iv_value       = 'Dynamic Call Successful'
    ).

    out->write( |Value after dynamic call: { lo_test_object->mv_value }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object
          EXPORTING
            iv_new_value = iv_value. " Assuming method has this parameter
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., method not found or wrong parameters
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_dyn_call_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Transformiere eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer anderen Struktur unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators.
hint: Nutze den `FOR`-Operator für die Transformation von Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             display_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_to_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_to_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                           ( carrier_id    = ls_sflight-carrid
                             flight_date   = ls_sflight-fldate
                             display_price = |{ ls_sflight-price } { ls_sflight-currency }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_for_transformer=>tt_sflight(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Excel-Datei mit zwei Spalten ('Flugnummer', 'Datum') und einigen Beispieldaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_FDT_XL_SPREADSHEET` zum Erstellen und Befüllen der Excel-Datei.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflight_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring. " Returns binary content of the Excel file
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_excel->get_active_worksheet( ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_column = 1 ip_row = 1 ip_value = 'Flugnummer' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_column = 2 ip_row = 1 ip_value = 'Datum' ).

    " Add data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_column = 1 ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid && ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_column = 2 ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet~get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = ( xstrlen( lv_xstring ) > 100 ) ).

CLASS zcl_excel_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( iv_xstring ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_excel->get_active_worksheet( ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 2. " Start from second row (after header)
    DO.
      DATA(lv_flight_id) = lo_worksheet->get_cell_string( ip_column = 1 ip_row = lv_row ).
      DATA(lv_fldate_str) = lo_worksheet->get_cell_string( ip_column = 2 ip_row = lv_row ).

      IF lv_flight_id IS INITIAL. " No more data
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      TRY.
          APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data(
              flight_id = lv_flight_id
              fldate    = cl_abap_datfm=>convert_date_from_ext( lv_fldate_str ) " Assuming YYYYMMDD or similar
          ) TO rt_flight_data.
        CATCH cx_abap_datfm_error.
          " Handle date conversion error, e.g., log it or skip row
      ENDTRY.

      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                 WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid
                                   fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    LOOP AT lt_future_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = ( ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA: lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_all WHERE fldate > sy-datum.
    IF lines( lt_sflight_all ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_future_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`SFLIGHT`) nach einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften und geben Sie nur die eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften zurück.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_filter_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrids.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_unique_carrids = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN FILTER #( lt_sflight IN it_filter_carrids WHERE carrid = carrid )
                                 ( <fs>-carrid ) ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_carrids COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                       <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

        ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

          " Fill with some dummy data (example for SFLIGHT)
          IF iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
            DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
            SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data) UP TO 2 ROWS.

            LOOP AT lt_sflight_data INTO ls_sflight.
              <fs_line> = CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ).
              APPEND <fs_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
            ENDLOOP.
          ELSE.
            " Generic filling for other structures (simplified)
            " This part would need more sophisticated dynamic field assignment
            " For demonstration, we just add one empty line for non-SFLIGHT
            APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle errors, e.g., structure not found
        CLEAR rr_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONDENSE` und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` oder `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES` mit `REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_clean DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_clean IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    CONDENSE rv_cleaned_string NO-GAPS.

    " Replace multiple spaces with single space using regex
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ' '.

    " CONDENSE NO-GAPS also removes single spaces between words, which is not always desired.
    " A better approach for 'remove multiple spaces' is regex.
    " If only leading/trailing and multiple internal spaces are to be removed, and single spaces kept:
    rv_cleaned_string = |
      { rv_cleaned_string ALPHA = OUT }
    |.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ' '.
    rv_cleaned_string = rv_cleaned_string && | |.
    CONDENSE rv_cleaned_string NO-GAPS.

    " Corrected approach for leading/trailing and multiple internal spaces
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input.
    rv_cleaned_string = cl_abap_string_utilities=>trim( rv_cleaned_string ). " Trim leading/trailing
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ' '.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, dessen Einträge dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle generiert werden. Jeder Eintrag soll den Namen eines Fluges aus der `sflights` Tabelle darstellen.

CLASS zcl_cmenu_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,

             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

  METHOD get_dynamic_menu.

      DATA(lv_text) = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }|.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) verwaltet. Ein Kontextmenü soll eine Aktion 'Status ändern' anbieten, die den Status eines ausgewählten Fluges in der internen Tabelle auf 'C' (Confirmed) setzt. Demonstrieren Sie die `MODIFY` Anweisung für interne Tabellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE` mit `WHERE` für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cmenu_modify_it DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
    METHODS modify_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_status TYPE char1.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cmenu_modify_it IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' status = 'A' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' status = 'A' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' status = 'A' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD modify_flight_status.
    MODIFY TABLE mt_flights FROM VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate status = iv_new_status )
      TRANSPORTING status
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_internal_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cmenu_modify_it( ).
    lo_cut->modify_flight_status(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_connid = '0400'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
      iv_new_status = 'C'
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights( ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight status should be C' act = ls_flight-status exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Vorbereitung eines Kontextmenüs, das bei Auswahl eines Eintrags eine Aktion auslösen soll. Die Aktion soll eine interne Tabelle modifizieren. Der Fokus liegt auf der Strukturierung der Logik, die durch ein Menüereignis ausgelöst würde.
hint: Obwohl `cl_ctmenu` keine direkten Event-Handler im Unit-Test-Kontext hat, können Sie die Logik für die Reaktion auf einen Funktionscode vorbereiten und testen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cmenu_event_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             processed TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_menu RETURNING VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
    METHODS process_menu_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_fcode TYPE cl_ctmenu=>fcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cmenu_event_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_data = VALUE #( ( id = 1 value = 'Item A' processed = abap_false )
                       ( id = 2 value = 'Item B' processed = abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_menu.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'PROCESS_1' text = 'Prozess Item 1' ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'PROCESS_2' text = 'Prozess Item 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_menu_action.
    CASE iv_fcode.
      WHEN 'PROCESS_1'.
        MODIFY TABLE mt_data FROM VALUE #( id = 1 processed = abap_true ) TRANSPORTING processed WHERE id = 1.
      WHEN 'PROCESS_2'.
        MODIFY TABLE mt_data FROM VALUE #( id = 2 processed = abap_true ) TRANSPORTING processed WHERE id = 2.
      WHEN OTHERS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, das eine 'Massendatenänderung' für eine Liste von Flügen ermöglicht. Die Menüaktion soll eine Methode aufrufen, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten mit der `FOR` Iteration und `MODIFY` aktualisiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ctmenu` und die `FOR` Iteration in Kombination mit `MODIFY TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cmenu_mass_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_menu RETURNING VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
    METHODS perform_mass_update
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_to_update TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_new_status TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cmenu_mass_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_all_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' status = 'A' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' status = 'A' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' status = 'A' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' status = 'A' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_menu.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'MASS_UPDATE' text = 'Massendatenänderung' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_mass_update.
    LOOP AT it_flights_to_update INTO DATA(ls_flight_to_update).
      MODIFY TABLE mt_all_flights FROM VALUE #( 
        carrid = ls_flight_to_update-carrid
        connid = ls_flight_to_update-connid
        fldate = ls_flight_to_update-fldate
        status = iv_new_status
      ) TRANSPORTING status
        WHERE carrid = ls_flight_to_update-carrid
          AND connid = ls_flight_to_update-connid
          AND fldate = ls_flight_to_update-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    rt_updated_flights = mt_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mass_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cmenu_mass_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_to_process) = VALUE zcl_cmenu_mass_modify=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH flight status should be X' act = ls_flight_lh-status exp = 'X' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA flight status should be X' act = ls_flight_aa-status exp = 'X' ).

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id    TYPE string,

             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES: ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_itab_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_table.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                           ( id    = CONV i( ls_source-id )
                             value = CONV i( ls_source-value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

  ENDMETHOD.
