        lo_cut->transform_file_content(
          iv_source_path = '/tmp/non_existent_source.txt'
          iv_target_path = gc_target_file
          iv_add_line    = 'Test'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_abap_file_utilities_error not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Expected exception caught.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `read_file` und `write_file` für eine Dateitransformation. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei essenziell, um robuste Anwendungen zu gewährleisten. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` sorgt für plattformunabhängige Zeilenumbrüche.
keywords: cl_abap_file_utilities, File Operations, Read, Write, Transformation, Error Handling

Instructions: Füge Zeilen in eine interne Tabelle ein, die nur eindeutige Einträge zulässt, und demonstriere die Verwendung von `INSERT ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` oder `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` mit einer Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel.
hint: Verwende eine Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel (z.B. `UNIQUE HASHED KEY` oder `UNIQUE SORTED KEY`). `INSERT` wird bei Duplikaten fehlschlagen, es sei denn, `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` wird verwendet (was aber bei UNIQUE Keys nicht sinnvoll ist, da es dann nicht eingefügt wird). Besser ist es, den Rückgabewert `sy-subrc` zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_unique_keys DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_unique_items TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_item
      WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_item
      IMPORTING
        iv_id    TYPE i
        iv_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_items TYPE tt_unique_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_unique_keys IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_item.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = iv_id value = iv_value ) INTO TABLE ct_items.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_inserted = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_inserted = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_unique_item FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_item FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_unique_keys( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_insert_unique_keys=>tt_unique_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Item A' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->add_item( iv_id = 2 iv_value = 'Item B' CHANGING ct_items = lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_inserted exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_unique_keys( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_insert_unique_keys=>tt_unique_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Original Item' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->add_item( iv_id = 1 iv_value = 'Duplicate Item' CHANGING ct_items = lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_inserted exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 1 ]-value exp = 'Original Item' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei internen Tabellen mit eindeutigem Schlüssel (z.B. `UNIQUE HASHED KEY`) stellt der `INSERT` Befehl sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge hinzugefügt werden. Wenn ein Eintrag mit einem bereits existierenden Schlüssel eingefügt werden soll, schlägt der `INSERT` fehl (SY-SUBRC = 4), und die Tabelle bleibt unverändert. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode zur Verwaltung von eindeutigen Datensätzen.
keywords: INSERT, Unique Key, Hashed Table, Internal Tables, Duplicate Keys

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Terminen (repräsentiert durch eine interne Tabelle) nach einem bestimmten Datumsbereich unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax. Nutzen Sie die Klasse `cl_appointment` zur Validierung oder Manipulation der Termindaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE` und `VALUE` für die Tabellenverarbeitung. `cl_appointment` kann für Datumsberechnungen oder Validierungen nützlich sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment,
             id        TYPE string,
             date_from TYPE d,
             date_to   TYPE d,
             subject   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_appointment.
    TYPES tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_appointments
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
        iv_start_date   TYPE d
        iv_end_date     TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_appointments.
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR appointment IN it_appointments
                           WHERE ( date_from LE iv_end_date AND date_to GE iv_start_date )
                           ( appointment ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_appointments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE zcl_appointment_filter=>tt_appointments(
      ( id = 'A001' date_from = '20250101' date_to = '20250105' subject = 'Meeting 1' )
      ( id = 'A002' date_from = '20250103' date_to = '20250107' subject = 'Meeting 2' )
      ( id = 'A003' date_from = '20250106' date_to = '20250110' subject = 'Meeting 3' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_appointments( it_appointments = lt_appointments
                                                  iv_start_date = '20250102'
                                                  iv_end_date = '20250106' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 'A001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 'A002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren. Dies ist eine moderne, deklarative und effiziente Art, Daten zu filtern, ohne explizite Schleifen zu verwenden. Die Logik für `cl_appointment` wäre in einer realen Anwendung komplexer, hier liegt der Fokus auf der Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, FILTER, Date/Time, cl_appointment

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen einfachen Timer mit `cl_gui_timer`, der ein Ereignis nach einer bestimmten Zeit auslöst. Da keine GUI-Elemente direkt manipuliert werden können, soll das Ereignis eine interne Variable aktualisieren und dies in einem Unit Test überprüft werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und implementieren Sie ein Ereignis-Handler-Interface. Denken Sie daran, den Timer zu starten und zu stoppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_timer_event_handler.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.

    METHODS if_timer_event_handler~handle_event.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER me->if_timer_event_handler~handle_event FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_timer_event_handler~handle_event.
    mv_counter = mv_counter + 1.
    " In a real GUI scenario, you would update a screen element here.
    " For this example, we just increment a counter.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_event.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_example( ).

    " Start timer for 1 second (1000 ms)
    lo_cut->start_timer( 1000 ).

    " Wait for the event to trigger. In a real scenario, this would be asynchronous.
    " For unit testing, we simulate a wait or directly call the handler if possible.
    " Since cl_gui_timer is a GUI control, direct testing is tricky without a GUI context.
    " We'll simulate the event for testing purposes.
    " In a real application, the event would be triggered by the GUI framework.
    " For this test, we'll manually call the handler to verify the logic.
    lo_cut->if_timer_event_handler~handle_event( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_counter exp = 1 ).

    lo_cut->stop_timer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_gui_timer` zur Implementierung eines Timers. Obwohl `cl_gui_timer` eine GUI-Klasse ist, wird hier das Prinzip der Ereignisbehandlung und der Kapselung in einer Klasse gezeigt. Der Unit Test simuliert den Ereignisaufruf, um die Logik des Handlers zu überprüfen, da eine echte GUI-Interaktion in einem Unit Test nicht möglich ist. Die Verwendung von `SET HANDLER` ist der moderne Weg, Ereignisse zu abonnieren.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, Object Orientation, Events, Timer, GUI

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Carrier, Flugnummer, Preis) und berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge für einen bestimmten Carrier unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `WHERE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR flight IN it_flights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = '300.00' ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = '200.00' ).

    DATA(lv_total_ua) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_ua exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu aggregieren. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle in einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem eine Schleife mit einer Akkumulatorvariablen (`INIT sum`) und einer `NEXT`-Anweisung definiert wird. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` ist dies sehr ausdrucksstark und effizient.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, FOR, WHERE, Math

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie dynamisch eine Klasse, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Klasse muss ein bestimmtes Interface implementieren, um die Kompatibilität sicherzustellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `cl_abap_classdescr` oder `cl_abap_typedescr` für die Typbeschreibung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_dynamic_action.
  METHODS execute RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_action.
    METHODS zif_dynamic_action~execute RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_action~execute.
    rv_result = 'Action A executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_action.
    METHODS zif_dynamic_action~execute RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_class_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_action~execute.
    rv_result = 'Action B executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_object) TYPE REF TO zif_dynamic_action
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_object.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    IF lo_class_descr IS NOT BOUND OR lo_class_descr->is_instantiatable = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error.
    ENDIF.

    ro_dynamic_object = NEW ( iv_class_name ) ( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_creation_fail FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_creation.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_dynamic_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_action_a) = lo_factory->create_dynamic_object( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_CLASS_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_action_a->execute( ) exp = 'Action A executed' ).

    DATA(lo_action_b) = lo_factory->create_dynamic_object( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_CLASS_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_action_b->execute( ) exp = 'Action B executed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_creation_fail.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_dynamic_factory( ).
    TRY.
        lo_factory->create_dynamic_object( 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_factory->create_dynamic_object( 'ZCL_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Objekterzeugung mit `NEW (class_name)` ist eine moderne und flexible Methode, um Klasseninstanzen zur Laufzeit zu erstellen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Frameworks oder bei der Implementierung von Factory-Mustern. Die Verwendung eines Interfaces (`zif_dynamic_action`) stellt sicher, dass die dynamisch erzeugten Objekte eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle haben und typsicher verwendet werden können.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, NEW, TYPE HANDLE, Factory Pattern

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen Namen, der optional einen Vornamen, einen mittleren Namen und einen Nachnamen enthält, in einem String-Template. Wenn der mittlere Name leer ist, soll er nicht angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` innerhalb eines String-Templates, um bedingte Logik anzuwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_name_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_first_name  TYPE string
        iv_middle_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_last_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_name_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_name.
    rv_formatted_name = |{ iv_first_name } { COND string( WHEN iv_middle_name IS NOT INITIAL THEN |{ iv_middle_name } | ELSE `` ) }{ iv_last_name }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_name_with_middle FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_format_name_without_middle FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_name_with_middle.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_name_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_name) = lo_cut->format_name( iv_first_name = 'John' iv_middle_name = 'M.' iv_last_name = 'Doe' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'John M. Doe' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_name_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_name) = lo_cut->format_name( iv_first_name = 'Jane' iv_last_name = 'Smith' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'Jane Smith' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne Art der String-Formatierung in ABAP. In Kombination mit dem `COND`-Operator können bedingte Ausdrücke direkt in das Template eingebettet werden, was den Code sehr lesbar und kompakt macht. Dies vermeidet die Notwendigkeit von `IF`-Anweisungen für einfache bedingte Formatierungen.
keywords: String Processing, String Templates, COND, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen, um eine Liste von Zahlen zu verarbeiten (filtern, transformieren, summieren) in einem funktionalen Stil. Nutzen Sie den `LET`-Ausdruck für Zwischenergebnisse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `LET` und `REDUCE` in einer Kette.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      LET filtered_numbers = VALUE #( FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num > 0 ) ( num ) )
          transformed_numbers = VALUE #( FOR num IN filtered_numbers ( num * 2 ) )
      FOR num IN transformed_numbers
      NEXT total = total + num
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_numbers_empty FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      1 2 -3 4 5 -6
    ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->process_numbers( lt_numbers ).
    " Expected: (1*2) + (2*2) + (4*2) + (5*2) = 2 + 4 + 8 + 10 = 24
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 24 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_numbers_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->process_numbers( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert einen funktionalen Programmierstil in ABAP durch die Verkettung von Operationen mit `REDUCE` und `LET`. Der `LET`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen Hilfsvariablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks, was die Lesbarkeit bei komplexen Transformationen verbessert. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu verarbeiten, da es deklarativ ist und Zwischenergebnisse vermeidet.
keywords: Object Orientation, Functional Programming, REDUCE, LET, FOR, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach dem Carrier und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Carrier. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_groups) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_flight_groups = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights BY flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-flight_count exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_aa) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_ua) = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_flights_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert und rufen Sie gegebenenfalls seinen Index ab. Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke mit `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` in Kombination mit Tabellenausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS check_and_get_index
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_key  TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index  TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_get_index.
    ev_exists = xsdbool( line_exists( it_data[ key = iv_key ] ) ).
    IF ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = line_index( it_data[ key = iv_key ] ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_line_exists_and_index FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_line_not_exists FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_exists_and_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_table_checker=>tt_data(
      ( key = 'A' value = 'Value A' )
      ( key = 'B' value = 'Value B' )
      ( key = 'C' value = 'Value C' )
    ).

    DATA lv_exists TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.

    lo_cut->check_and_get_index( EXPORTING it_data = lt_data iv_key = 'B' IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_line_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_table_checker=>tt_data(
      ( key = 'A' value = 'Value A' )
    ).

    DATA lv_exists TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->check_and_get_index( EXPORTING it_data = lt_data iv_key = 'D' IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_false ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_index ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ key = value ]`) sind eine sehr moderne und prägnante Art, auf Zeilen in internen Tabellen zuzugreifen. In Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` ermöglichen sie eine effiziente Überprüfung der Existenz und das Abrufen des Index einer Zeile, ohne explizite `READ TABLE`-Anweisungen. `xsdbool` konvertiert einen logischen Ausdruck in einen `abap_bool`-Wert.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expressions, LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen aus. Nutzen Sie RTTI-Klassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_typedescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_structure
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_structure.
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = ir_data.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lo_data_ref ).

    IF lo_type_descr->kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error EXPORTING text = 'Input is not a structure'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_type_descr ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR comp IN lt_components
                             ( name = comp-name
                               type = comp-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_analyze_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_analyze_non_structure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_analyze_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA ls_test_struct TYPE zcl_rtti_analyzer=>ty_test_struct.
    GET REFERENCE OF ls_test_struct INTO DATA(lr_data).

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->analyze_structure( lr_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ]-type exp = 'STRING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-name exp = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ]-type exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 3 ]-name exp = 'FIELD3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 3 ]-type exp = 'D' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_analyze_non_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello'.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_string INTO DATA(lr_data).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->analyze_structure( lr_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Expected behavior
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Die Klassen `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` sind die modernen Werkzeuge dafür. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die Komponenten einer Struktur dynamisch auslesen kann, was für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen oder Metadaten-basierte Anwendungen unerlässlich ist. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` macht die Transformation der RTTI-Ergebnisse in eine benutzerfreundliche Tabelle sehr kompakt.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Structures, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle. Behandeln Sie den Fall einer leeren Tabelle, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Elemente. Nutzen Sie `COND` für die Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
    rv_average = CONV decfloat34( lv_sum ) / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Summenbildung mit der Funktion `lines()` zur Bestimmung der Anzahl der Elemente. Die explizite Prüfung auf eine leere Tabelle und die Verwendung von `CONV decfloat34` für eine präzise Division sind Best Practices. `REDUCE` ist hier die moderne und effiziente Art, eine Summe zu berechnen, ohne eine explizite Schleife zu schreiben.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten, wobei Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag) ausgeschlossen sind. Nutzen Sie moderne Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_date_helper` oder eine Schleife mit `cl_abap_date_time` Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_workday_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_workdays
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_workday_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_workdays.
    DATA lv_current_date TYPE d VALUE iv_start_date.
    WHILE lv_current_date LE iv_end_date.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_time=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_workdays_same_day FOR TESTING.

  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_workday_calculator( ).
    " 20251201 (Mon) to 20251205 (Fri) = 5 workdays

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_workdays_across_weekend.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings. Nutzen Sie moderne String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und `CONDENSE` oder `strip`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input_string.
    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    rv_cleaned_string = |{ rv_cleaned_string ALPHA = IN }|.
    " Replace multiple spaces with single space
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ' '.
    " Remove leading/trailing spaces again in case regex introduced one at start/end
    rv_cleaned_string = |{ rv_cleaned_string ALPHA = IN }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Annulliert') basierend auf der Flugzeit und dem Statuscode. Angenommen, ein Flug ist 'Verspätet', wenn die geplante Ankunftszeit überschritten ist, und 'Annulliert', wenn der Statuscode 'X' ist. Sonst ist er 'Pünktlich'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             deptime  TYPE s_ltime,
             arrtime  TYPE s_ltime,
             actdeptime TYPE s_ltime,
             actarrtime TYPE s_ltime,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'X' for cancelled
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_in TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_multiple_flight_statuses
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_in TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_out) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN is_flight_in-status = 'X' THEN 'Annulliert'
      WHEN is_flight_in-actarrtime > is_flight_in-arrtime THEN 'Verspätet'
      ELSE 'Pünktlich'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_multiple_flight_statuses.
    rt_flights_out = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights_in
                               ( ls_flight WITH flight_status = get_flight_status( ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiple_flight_statuses FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_flight_status=>ty_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    " Test Case 1: Cancelled
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' status = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_flight ) exp = 'Annulliert' msg = 'Cancelled flight' ).

    " Test Case 2: Delayed
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' arrtime = '100000' actarrtime = '103000' status = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_flight ) exp = 'Verspätet' msg = 'Delayed flight' ).

    " Test Case 3: On Time
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' arrtime = '100000' actarrtime = '095000' status = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_flight ) exp = 'Pünktlich' msg = 'On-time flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_flight_statuses.

    DATA(lt_flights_in) = VALUE zcl_flight_status=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' status = 'X' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' arrtime = '100000' actarrtime = '103000' status = '' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' arrtime = '100000' actarrtime = '095000' status = '' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights_out[ 2 ]-flight_status exp = 'Verspätet' ).

explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. In `get_multiple_flight_statuses` wird `VALUE #( FOR ... )` verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren und dabei die Methode `get_flight_status` für jede Zeile aufzurufen, was eine funktionale und moderne Art der Tabellenverarbeitung darstellt.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Entfernung pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE` für die Gruppenverarbeitung und Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_distance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             distance TYPE s_distance,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_distance,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_distance TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_distance.
    TYPES tt_avg_distance TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_distance WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_distance_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_distances) TYPE tt_avg_distance.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_distance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_distance_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, distance
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_distance) = REDUCE s_distance(
        INIT sum_dist = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum_dist = sum_dist + <fs_flight>-distance
      ).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT count = count + 1
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_avg_distance(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        average_distance = COND #( WHEN lv_flight_count > 0 THEN lv_total_distance / lv_flight_count ELSE 0 )
      ) TO rt_avg_distances.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_distance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_distance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_distance( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_distances) = lo_cut->get_average_distance_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_avg_distances ).

    " Verify that all entries have a non-negative average distance
    LOOP AT lt_avg_distances INTO DATA(ls_avg).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_avg-average_distance >= 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature ab ABAP 7.50, das die Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen erheblich vereinfacht. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe und `COND` für die Vermeidung von Division durch Null, ermöglicht dies eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Datenverarbeitung, die zuvor komplexe Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen erforderte.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, COND, Internal Tables, Grouping

Instructions: Selektieren Sie alle Flugverbindungen aus `SFLIGHTS` für Fluggesellschaften, die in einer internen Tabelle `lt_carriers` enthalten sind.

CLASS zcl_fae_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers_in TYPE tt_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_fae_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carriers_in IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers_in
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers_in-carrid.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `FOR ALL ENTRIES` ist ein klassisches und effizientes Open SQL-Muster, um Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle basierend auf Werten in einer internen ABAP-Tabelle zu selektieren. Es vermeidet N+1-Probleme und ist oft performanter als einzelne `SELECT`-Anweisungen in einer Schleife. Die `@`-Syntax für Hostvariablen ist hier ebenfalls zu beachten. Die Prüfung auf `IS NOT INITIAL` ist entscheidend, um leere `FOR ALL ENTRIES`-Abfragen zu vermeiden, die alle Zeilen zurückgeben würden.

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flüge für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften aus `SFLIGHTS`. Fügen Sie anschließend eine neue Spalte 'Statusfarbe' hinzu, die 'Grün' für pünktliche Flüge, 'Gelb' für verspätete und 'Rot' für annullierte Flüge anzeigt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einer nachfolgenden `LOOP` und `COND`-Expression zur Bestimmung der Statusfarbe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_cond_postproc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_color,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             deptime    TYPE s_ltime,
             arrtime    TYPE s_ltime,
             actdeptime TYPE s_ltime,
             actarrtime TYPE s_ltime,
             status     TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'X' for cancelled
             status_color TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_color.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_color TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_color WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status_color
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers_in TYPE tt_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_colored) TYPE tt_flight_with_color.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_cond_postproc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status_color.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carriers_in IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT *
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers_in
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers_in-carrid.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flights_colored = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                  ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight )
                                    status_color = COND string(
                                      WHEN ls_sflight-status = 'X' THEN 'Rot'
                                      WHEN ls_sflight-actarrtime > ls_sflight-arrtime THEN 'Gelb'
                                      ELSE 'Grün'
                                    )
                                  ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_flights_with_color FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_carriers_color FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_with_color.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_cond_postproc( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_fae_cond_postproc=>tt_carrier(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights_colored) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status_color( lt_carriers ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften die Gesamtzahl der Flüge, die als 'Langstrecke' (über 5000 km) gelten.

CLASS zcl_fae_reduce_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             distance TYPE s_distance,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_long_haul_flight_count
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers_in TYPE tt_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_long_haul_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_reduce_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_long_haul_flight_count.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    IF it_carriers_in IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, distance
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers_in
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers_in-carrid.
    ENDIF.

    rv_long_haul_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT count = count + COND #( WHEN ls_flight-distance > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften akzeptiert und für jede Fluggesellschaft einen 'Risikostatus' zurückgibt. Der Status soll 'Hoch' sein, wenn die Fluggesellschaft mehr als 50 Flüge hat, 'Mittel' bei 10-50 Flügen und 'Niedrig' bei weniger als 10 Flügen. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Anzahl der Flüge zu zählen und `COND` um den Risikostatus zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_carrier_risk DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_risk,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             risk_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_risk.
    TYPES tt_carrier_risk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_risk WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_risk_status
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers_in TYPE tt_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_risks) TYPE tt_carrier_risk.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_risk IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_risk_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carriers_in IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers_in
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers_in-carrid.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_carriers_in INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = ls_carrier-carrid )
        NEXT count = count + 1
      ).

      DATA(lv_risk_status) = COND string(
        WHEN lv_flight_count > 50 THEN 'Hoch'
        WHEN lv_flight_count >= 10 THEN 'Mittel'
        ELSE 'Niedrig'
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_risk(
        carrid = ls_carrier-carrid
        risk_status = lv_risk_status
      ) TO rt_carrier_risks.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_top_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_top_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_top_carrier.
    TYPES tt_top_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_top_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_long_distance_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_carriers) TYPE tt_top_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_top_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_long_distance_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      WHERE distance > 1000
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 " Ensure only carriers with at least one such flight are considered
      ORDER BY flight_count DESC
      INTO TABLE @rt_top_carriers
      UP TO 3 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für HTTP-Methoden (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von HTTP-Methoden filtert und nur diejenigen zurückgibt, die 'sicher' sind (GET). Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ENUM` und den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM http_method_type,
             GET,
             POST,
             PUT,
             DELETE,
           END OF ENUM http_method_type.

    METHODS get_safe_methods
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_safe_methods) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_safe_methods.
    DATA(lt_all_methods) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ENUM OF http_method_type FROM GET TO DELETE

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Berechtigungsstufen (READ, WRITE, ADMIN). Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob eine gegebene Berechtigungsstufe eine höhere oder gleiche Berechtigung als eine andere hat. Nutzen Sie die implizite numerische Reihenfolge der Enumerationswerte.
hint: Enumerationswerte können direkt verglichen werden, da sie intern numerisch repräsentiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_authorization_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM authorization_level,
             READ  VALUE IS INITIAL,
             WRITE,
             ADMIN,
           END OF ENUM authorization_level.

    METHODS has_sufficient_authorization
      IMPORTING
        iv_required_level TYPE authorization_level
        iv_user_level     TYPE authorization_level
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_sufficient) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_authorization_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_sufficient_authorization.
    rb_is_sufficient = COND #( WHEN iv_user_level >= iv_required_level THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_vs_write FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_admin_vs_read FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_write_vs_admin FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_equal_levels FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_vs_write.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_authorization_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_checker->has_sufficient_authorization(
      iv_required_level = zcl_authorization_checker=>authorization_level-WRITE,
      iv_user_level     = zcl_authorization_checker=>authorization_level-READ ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_admin_vs_read.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_authorization_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_checker->has_sufficient_authorization(
      iv_required_level = zcl_authorization_checker=>authorization_level-READ,
      iv_user_level     = zcl_authorization_checker=>authorization_level-ADMIN ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_write_vs_admin.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_authorization_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_checker->has_sufficient_authorization(
      iv_required_level = zcl_authorization_checker=>authorization_level-ADMIN,
      iv_user_level     = zcl_authorization_checker=>authorization_level-WRITE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_equal_levels.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_authorization_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_checker->has_sufficient_authorization(
      iv_required_level = zcl_authorization_checker=>authorization_level-WRITE,
      iv_user_level     = zcl_authorization_checker=>authorization_level-WRITE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Enumerationen in ABAP werden intern als numerische Werte behandelt, beginnend bei 0 für den ersten Wert. Dies ermöglicht direkte Vergleiche (`>=`) zwischen den Werten, um Hierarchien oder Berechtigungsstufen zu modellieren. Der `COND` Operator bietet eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung.
keywords: ENUMERATION, Vergleich, Berechtigungen, COND, abap_bool

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für Dateitypen (TEXT, CSV, XML, JSON). Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Dateitypen in eine andere interne Tabelle umwandelt, die nur die Dateitypen enthält, die als 'textbasiert' gelten (TEXT, CSV, XML, JSON). Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ENUM` und den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife über die Enumeration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_type_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM file_type,
             TEXT,
             CSV,
             XML,
             JSON,
             BINARY,
             IMAGE,
           END OF ENUM file_type.

    METHODS get_text_based_file_types
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_text_types) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_type_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text_based_file_types.
    rt_text_types = REDUCE string_table(
      INIT text_types = VALUE string_table( )
      FOR ENUM OF file_type FROM TEXT TO IMAGE
      WHERE ( ENUM = file_type-TEXT OR
              ENUM = file_type-CSV OR
              ENUM = file_type-XML OR
              ENUM = file_type-JSON )
      NEXT text_types = VALUE #( BASE text_types ( CONV string( ENUM ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_text_based_types FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_text_based_types.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_file_type_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_text_types) = lo_processor->get_text_based_file_types( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_text_types ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_text_types exp = 'TEXT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_text_types exp = 'CSV' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_text_types exp = 'XML' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_text_types exp = 'JSON' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lt_text_types exp = 'BINARY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lt_text_types exp = 'IMAGE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer einzigen Anweisung. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die 'textbasierten' Dateitypen aus der Enumeration enthält. Die `FOR ENUM OF` Schleife und die `WHERE` Bedingung machen den Code sehr deklarativ und effizient.
keywords: ENUMERATION, REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Interne Tabellen, Dateitypen

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Systeminformationen zurückgibt, die für jeden Eintrag den Benutzernamen, das Datum und die Uhrzeit der letzten Aktion (simuliert) enthält. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_syst` und den `FOR` Operator.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_syst` Methoden mit dem `FOR` Operator und `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_action_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             username  TYPE syuname,
             action    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES: tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_simulated_log
      IMPORTING
        it_actions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log) TYPE tt_log_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_simulated_log.
    DATA(lv_current_ts) = cl_abap_syst=>get_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_username)   = cl_abap_syst=>get_uname( ).

    rt_log = VALUE #( FOR action_text IN it_actions
                      INDEX INTO idx

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem gegebenen String, der eine Paketbeschreibung darstellt (z.B. 'Z_MY_PACKAGE_DEV_001'), den Paketnamen ('Z_MY_PACKAGE') und die Umgebung ('DEV'). Verwenden Sie String-Templates und reguläre Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND REGEX` und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_package_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             environment TYPE string,
           END OF ty_package_info.

    METHODS parse_package_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_desc TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_package_info) TYPE ty_package_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_package_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_package_string.
    DATA(lv_regex) = `Z_(\w+)_(\w+)_(\d+)`. " Example: Z_MY_PACKAGE_DEV_001
    FIND REGEX lv_regex IN iv_package_desc SUBMATCHES DATA(lv_name_part), DATA(lv_env_part), DATA(lv_num_part).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_package_info-name = |Z_{ lv_name_part }|.
      rs_package_info-environment = lv_env_part.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR rs_package_info.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Geben Sie den Wert des Feldes zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE *
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_field_value = <lv_field>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie für jede Gruppe die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = lv_count ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden und dann den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    SELECT price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices).

    IF lt_prices IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                                  FOR price_entry IN lt_prices
                                                  NEXT sum = sum + price_entry-price ).
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_prices ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem eine Schleife durchlaufen und ein Akkumulator aktualisiert wird. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, aber mit einem zusätzlichen Feld für den Status ('Active' oder 'Inactive' basierend auf dem Abflugdatum). Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING` in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_status) TYPE tt_flight_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_flights_with_status = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                      ( CORRESPONDING #( flight )
                                        status = COND string( WHEN flight-fldate >= lv_today THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_modifier( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).

    DATA(lv_active_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_inactive_found) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-status = 'Active'.
        lv_active_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-status = 'Inactive'.
        lv_inactive_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_active_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_inactive_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `VALUE #(...)`-Konstruktor mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und dem `CORRESPONDING #(...)`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen. `CORRESPONDING` kopiert alle gleichnamigen Felder, während das `status`-Feld dynamisch mit einem `COND`-Ausdruck basierend auf dem Flugdatum gesetzt wird. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art der Datenmanipulation.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run Time Type Information), um die Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und deren Namen und Typen auszugeben. Nehmen Sie eine Struktur an, die Paketinformationen enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package_data,
             name        TYPE devclass,
             responsible TYPE uname,
             created_on  TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_package_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS inspect_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE ty_package_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.

CLASS zcl_rtti_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD inspect_structure.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).

    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info( name = ls_component-name
                                      type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` die Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als 10 Flüge haben, und geben Sie die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl ihrer Flüge zurück. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in Open SQL.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT COUNT(*)` mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_many_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHT) basierend auf einer optionalen Fluggesellschaft und/oder einer optionalen Mindestflugnummer. Wenn ein Parameter leer ist, soll er nicht als Filterkriterium dienen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit `IS INITIAL` in der WHERE-Klausel, um optionale Bedingungen zu handhaben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_optional_conditions
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_opt TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid_opt TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_optional_conditions.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( iv_carrid_opt IS INITIAL OR carrid = iv_carrid_opt )
                                      AND ( iv_connid_opt IS INITIAL OR connid >= iv_connid_opt ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_optional_cond FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_optional_cond.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_dynamic( ).
    DATA lt_result TYPE zcl_filter_dynamic=>tt_sflight.

    " Test 1: Filter by carrier only
    lt_result = lo_cut->filter_optional_conditions( iv_carrid_opt = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights for LH' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_1).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Wrong carrier (Test 1)' act = ls_flight_1-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test 2: Filter by connection ID only
    lt_result = lo_cut->filter_optional_conditions( iv_connid_opt = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights for connid >= 0400' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_2).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Wrong connection ID (Test 2)' act = ( ls_flight_2-connid >= '0400' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test 3: Filter by both
    lt_result = lo_cut->filter_optional_conditions( iv_carrid_opt = 'AA' iv_connid_opt = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No flights for AA and connid >= 0017' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_3).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Wrong carrier (Test 3)' act = ls_flight_3-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Wrong connection ID (Test 3)' act = ( ls_flight_3-connid >= '0017' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test 4: No filter (should return all)
    lt_result = lo_cut->filter_optional_conditions( ).
    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( VALUE #( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight AS s INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_sflight) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Not all flights returned' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_total_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung von `IS INITIAL` in der `WHERE`-Klausel des `FILTER`-Operators können optionale Filterkriterien elegant gehandhabt werden. Dies vermeidet komplexe `IF`-Strukturen und hält den Code deklarativ und lesbar.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Optional Conditions, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHT) nach Flügen, deren Preis über dem Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge liegt.
hint: Berechnen Sie zuerst den Durchschnittspreis und verwenden Sie diesen dann im `FILTER`-Operator. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_custom_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_above_average_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_custom_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_above_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_average_price) = get_average_price( lt_sflight ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > lv_average_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_average_price.
    IF it_sflight IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                                 FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight
                                                 NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( it_sflight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_above_average FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_above_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_custom_comp( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_above_average_price( ).

    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                                 FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                                 NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
    DATA(lv_average_price) = COND sflight-price( WHEN lines( lt_all_flights ) > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lines( lt_all_flights ) ELSE 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Price not above average' act = ( ls_flight-price > lv_average_price ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'All flights returned, average price calculation might be off' act = ( lines( lt_filtered ) < lines( lt_all_flights ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie der `FILTER`-Operator mit komplexeren Bedingungen verwendet werden kann, die auf zuvor berechneten Werten basieren. Die Berechnung des Durchschnitts mit `REDUCE` ist ein weiteres Beispiel für moderne ABAP-Syntax.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Custom Logic, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Runden Sie eine Dezimalzahl auf die nächste ganze Zahl, runden Sie auf die nächsthöhere ganze Zahl (Ceiling) und auf die nächstniedrigere ganze Zahl (Floor) mit `cl_abap_math`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `ceil`, `floor` und `round` der Klasse `cl_abap_math`.
solution:

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Potenz einer Zahl und die Quadratwurzel einer Zahl mit `cl_abap_math`.

CLASS zcl_math_pow_sqrt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_math_results,
             original_base TYPE decfloat34,
             original_exp  TYPE decfloat34,
             power_result  TYPE decfloat34,
             sqrt_result   TYPE decfloat34,

      IMPORTING

        iv_exp  TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_math_pow_sqrt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_pow_and_sqrt.
    rs_results-original_base = iv_base.
    rs_results-original_exp  = iv_exp.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_trig_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_trig_pi_half FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_trig_pi FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_tan_raises_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_trig_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_trigonometry( ).
    DATA(ls_results) = lo_cut->calculate_trigonometric( '0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-sin_value exp = '0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-cos_value exp = '1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-tan_value exp = '0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_trig_pi_half.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_trigonometry( ).
    DATA(lv_pi_half) = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) / '2'.
    DATA(ls_results) = lo_cut->calculate_trigonometric( lv_pi_half ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-sin_value exp = '1' dec = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-cos_value exp = '0' dec = 15 ).
    " Tangens von Pi/2 ist undefiniert, sollte eine Ausnahme werfen oder sehr großen Wert haben
    " Hier testen wir nur, dass es keinen direkten Fehler gibt, der Wert ist aber nicht 1
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( abs( ls_results-tan_value ) > '1000000' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_trig_pi.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_trigonometry( ).
    DATA(lv_pi) = cl_abap_math=>pi( ).
    DATA(ls_results) = lo_cut->calculate_trigonometric( lv_pi ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-sin_value exp = '0' dec = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-cos_value exp = '-1' dec = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-tan_value exp = '0' dec = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_tan_raises_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_trigonometry( ).
    " Test for angle where tan is undefined (e.g., PI/2 + n*PI)
    DATA(lv_angle) = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) / '2'.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_trigonometric( lv_angle ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR for tan(PI/2)' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        " Expected exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `decfloat34` gewährleistet dabei eine hohe Präzision. Die Behandlung von Ausnahmen, wie bei undefinierten Tangenswerten, ist für robuste Anwendungen unerlässlich.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_difference
      IMPORTING

        iv_date2 TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_date_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_difference.
    DATA(lv_tstmp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date1 ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date2 ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( tstmp1 = lv_tstmp1 tstmp2 = lv_tstmp2 ).
    rv_days = lv_diff_seconds / 86400. " 86400 Sekunden pro Tag
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechne die kumulative Differenz zwischen aufeinanderfolgenden Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` um eine Aggregation über die Differenzen zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_cumulative_difference
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_difference) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cumulative_difference.
    rv_difference = REDUCE i(
      INIT result = 0
           previous_number = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT
        result = result + ( number - previous_number )
        previous_number = number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cumulative_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_diff( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 5 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_difference( lt_numbers ).
    " Expected: (10-0) + (20-10) + (5-20) + (30-5) = 10 + 10 - 15 + 25 = 30
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 ).

    lt_numbers = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 5 ) ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->get_cumulative_difference( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).

    lt_numbers = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->get_cumulative_difference( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifenlogik in einer einzigen, lesbaren Expression zu kapseln, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht.
keywords: REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLES, SUBTRACT, AGGREGATION, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING
