CLASS zcl_shift_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_and_shift.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF ' ' IN SECTION OFFSET 0 OF lv_temp_string
         MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ev_extracted_part = lv_temp_string(lv_offset).
      SHIFT lv_temp_string BY ( lv_offset + 1 ) PLACES LEFT. " +1 to remove the space
      rv_remaining_string = lv_temp_string.

CLASS zcl_shift_padding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS pad_string_left
      IMPORTING
        iv_input     TYPE string
        iv_length    TYPE i
        iv_pad_char  TYPE c LENGTH 1 DEFAULT ' '
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_padded_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_padding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD pad_string_left.
    IF STRLEN( iv_input ) >= iv_length.
      rv_padded_string = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_padding_length) = iv_length - STRLEN( iv_input ).
    DATA(lv_padding) = REPEAT( val = iv_pad_char occ = lv_padding_length ).

    rv_padded_string = lv_padding && iv_input.

    " Alternative using SHIFT (less modern for padding, but demonstrates SHIFT)
    " DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.
    " DATA(lv_target) TYPE string LENGTH iv_length.
    " lv_target = lv_temp. " Fills with spaces on the right
    " SHIFT lv_target RIGHT BY lv_padding_length PLACES. " Shifts content to the right
    " OVERLAY lv_target WITH lv_padding. " Overlays the shifted spaces with pad_char
    " rv_padded_string = lv_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dieses Beispiel zeigt die modernere Herangehensweise, kommentiert aber auch die `SHIFT`-basierte Alternative, um den Fokus auf das Keyword zu halten.

Instructions: Berechne die durchschnittliche Differenz zwischen dem Gesamtpreis und dem bezahlten Preis für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle, die der Struktur von `sflights` ähnelt.
hint: Nutze `FOR` und `REDUCE`, um die Summe der Differenzen zu bilden und dann den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             paid_price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price_difference
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_diff) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_difference.
    IF it_flight_prices IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_diff = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_diff) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_diff = 0
      FOR flight_price IN it_flight_prices
      NEXT
        sum_diff = sum_diff + ( flight_price-total_price - flight_price-paid_price )
    ).

    rv_average_diff = lv_total_diff / lines( it_flight_prices ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( total_price = 100 paid_price = 80 ) " Diff 20
      ( total_price = 150 paid_price = 100 ) " Diff 50
      ( total_price = 200 paid_price = 190 ) " Diff 10
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_average_price_difference( lt_test_data ).
    " Expected: (20 + 50 + 10) / 3 = 80 / 3 = 26.66...
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '26.67' ). " Using '26.67' due to potential float precision

    lt_test_data = VALUE zcl_avg_price_diff=>tt_flight_price(

    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.00' ).

Instructions: Extrahiere dynamisch einen Teil eines Strings basierend auf einer Startposition und Länge, wobei der Rest des Strings nach links verschoben wird, um den extrahierten Teil zu entfernen.
hint: Nutze `SUBSTRING` für die Extraktion und `SHIFT` für die In-Place-Manipulation des Reststrings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_shift_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_and_shift_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_input    TYPE string
        iv_offset   TYPE i
        iv_length   TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_extracted_part TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_shift_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_and_shift_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_input_len) = STRLEN( iv_input ).

    IF iv_offset < 0 OR iv_offset >= lv_input_len OR iv_length <= 0.
      ev_extracted_part = ''.
      rv_remaining_string = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_actual_length) = MIN( val1 = iv_length val2 = lv_input_len - iv_offset ).

    ev_extracted_part = substring( val = iv_input off = iv_offset len = lv_actual_length ).

    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input.
    " Remove the part before the extracted part
    IF iv_offset > 0.
      SHIFT lv_temp_string LEFT BY iv_offset PLACES.
    ENDIF.

    " Remove the extracted part itself
    SHIFT lv_temp_string LEFT BY lv_actual_length PLACES.

    rv_remaining_string = lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_shift_extract FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_shift_extract.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_shift_extract( ).
    DATA(lv_extracted) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_remaining) TYPE string.

    " Extract middle part
    lv_remaining = lo_cut->extract_and_shift_dynamic( EXPORTING ev_extracted_part = lv_extracted IV_INPUT = 'ABCDEFGHIJ' IV_OFFSET = 3 IV_LENGTH = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_extracted exp = 'DEFG' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining exp = 'ABHIJ' ).

    " Extract from start
    lv_remaining = lo_cut->extract_and_shift_dynamic( EXPORTING ev_extracted_part = lv_extracted IV_INPUT = 'ABCDEFGHIJ' IV_OFFSET = 0 IV_LENGTH = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_extracted exp = 'ABC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining exp = 'DEFGHIJ' ).

    " Extract till end
    lv_remaining = lo_cut->extract_and_shift_dynamic( EXPORTING ev_extracted_part = lv_extracted IV_INPUT = 'ABCDEFGHIJ' IV_OFFSET = 7 IV_LENGTH = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_extracted exp = 'HIJ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining exp = 'ABCDEFG' ).

    " Invalid offset
    lv_remaining = lo_cut->extract_and_shift_dynamic( EXPORTING ev_extracted_part = lv_extracted IV_INPUT = 'ABC' IV_OFFSET = 5 IV_LENGTH = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_extracted exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining exp = 'ABC' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene String-Manipulation, bei der `SUBSTRING` für die Extraktion und `SHIFT` für die In-Place-Entfernung des extrahierten Teils verwendet wird. Es zeigt, wie man mit dynamischen Offsets und Längen umgeht und dabei die `SHIFT`-Anweisung für effiziente Modifikationen nutzt, auch wenn String-Templates und Funktionen oft flexibler sind.

Instructions: Entferne alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens aus einem String, indem der String nach jedem Vorkommen verschoben wird.
hint: Nutze eine Schleife mit `FIND` und `SHIFT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_remove_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_char_by_shifting
      IMPORTING
        iv_input    TYPE string
        iv_char_to_remove TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_remove_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_char_by_shifting.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input.
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i.

    DO.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_char_to_remove IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset OF lv_temp_string
           MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_found_offset).

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Shift the part after the found character to the left
        SHIFT lv_temp_string LEFT BY 1 PLACES IN CHARACTER MODE.
        " Adjust offset for next search (stay at current position, as string length decreased)
        lv_offset = lv_found_offset.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rv_cleaned_string = lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne für jeden Flug in der `sflights` Tabelle die Differenz zwischen der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität und der tatsächlich belegten Sitzplatzanzahl und speichere das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutze den `FOR`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren und dabei die Differenz zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_diff_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seats_diff TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_seat_differences
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_diffs) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_diff_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_seat_differences.
    rt_sflight_diffs = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                 ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                   connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                   fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                                   seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax
                                   seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc
                                   seats_diff = ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_seat_differences.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_diff_table( ).
    DATA(lt_test_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 60 price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 180 price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20230101' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 50 price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '737' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_seat_differences( lt_test_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-seats_diff exp = 40 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-seats_diff exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-seats_diff exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug, um neue interne Tabellen aus bestehenden zu konstruieren. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um für jeden Eintrag in der `sflights`-Tabelle eine neue Zeile zu erstellen und dabei die Differenz der Sitzplätze direkt zu berechnen. Dies ist ein sehr prägnanter und effizienter Weg, um Daten zu transformieren und zu aggregieren.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine Schleife zum Vertauschen von Elementen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING it_input      TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_shuffled) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    rt_shuffled = it_input.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( rt_shuffled ).
    IF lv_size <= 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = 1 iv_max = lv_size ).

    LOOP AT rt_shuffled ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-tabix.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      " Swap current line with a random line
      SWAP rt_shuffled INDEX lv_current_index WITH rt_shuffled INDEX lv_random_index.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle.
    DATA: lt_original TYPE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_data,
          ls_data     TYPE zcl_table_shuffler=>ty_data.

    DO 10 TIMES.
      ls_data-value = sy-index.
      APPEND ls_data TO lt_original.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).
    " Check if content is the same, just order is different
    DATA(lt_original_sorted) = lt_original.
    SORT lt_original_sorted BY value.
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sorted) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_shuffled_sorted BY value.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled_sorted exp = lt_original_sorted ).
    " It's highly improbable that the shuffled table is identical to the original for 10 elements
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled exp = lt_original ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode mischt eine interne Tabelle, indem sie jede Zeile mit einer zufällig ausgewählten anderen Zeile vertauscht. `cl_abap_random_int` wird verwendet, um die Zufallsindizes zu generieren. `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ist eine effiziente Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Internal Tables, Shuffle, Sort

Instructions: Generiere eine interne Tabelle mit N einzigartigen Zufallszahlen innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine Hash-Tabelle, um die Einzigartigkeit zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING iv_count      TYPE i
                iv_min        TYPE i DEFAULT 1
                iv_max        TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    IF iv_count <= 0 OR iv_min > iv_max OR iv_count > ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ).
      " Invalid input or impossible to generate unique numbers
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = iv_min iv_max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_generated_numbers) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      TRY.
          INSERT lv_random_num INTO TABLE lt_generated_numbers.
        CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
          " Number already exists, try again in the next iteration
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDDO.

    rt_unique_numbers = VALUE #( FOR num IN lt_generated_numbers ( num ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_random FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 ).
    " Check for uniqueness
    DATA(lt_unique_check) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      INSERT lv_num INTO TABLE lt_unique_check.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_check ) exp = 5 ).
    " Check range
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO lv_num.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_num >= 1 AND lv_num <= 10 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 10 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 5 ). " Impossible

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode generiert eine angegebene Anzahl einzigartiger Zufallszahlen. Eine Hash-Tabelle wird verwendet, um sicherzustellen, dass jede generierte Zahl nur einmal vorkommt. Bei einem Duplikat wird einfach eine neue Zahl generiert. `VALUE #( FOR ... )` ist eine moderne Syntax zur Transformation von Tabellen.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Unique, Hash Table, Internal Tables

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Datenbank-Cursor für die Tabelle SFLIGHT, lesen Sie die ersten 5 Zeilen und schließen Sie den Cursor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflight_with_cursor
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_with_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight.

    DO 5 TIMES.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_sflights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cursor_read.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->read_sflight_with_cursor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 5 ).
    " Check if data is actually read (first entry should not be initial)
    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_first_entry IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung von Datenbank-Cursorn. `OPEN CURSOR` initialisiert den Cursor, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` liest Zeile für Zeile, und `CLOSE CURSOR` gibt die Datenbankressourcen frei. `WITH HOLD` hält den Cursor über einen COMMIT/ROLLBACK hinweg offen, was in bestimmten Szenarien nützlich sein kann.
keywords: CLOSE CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, Database Access, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor und stellen Sie sicher, dass er auch im Fehlerfall immer geschlossen wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY` um `CLOSE CURSOR` zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflight_robust
      IMPORTING iv_max_rows   TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING   cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_robust.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight.

        DO iv_max_rows TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_sflights.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Log error or handle specifically
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
      ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cursor_robust FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cursor_robust_empty FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cursor_robust.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->read_sflight_robust( iv_max_rows = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 3 ).
    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_first_entry IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cursor_robust_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->read_sflight_robust( iv_max_rows = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY`-Struktur ist entscheidend, um sicherzustellen, dass Ressourcen wie Datenbank-Cursor auch bei Laufzeitfehlern ordnungsgemäß freigegeben werden. Der `FINALLY`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht, und garantiert so das `CLOSE CURSOR`.
keywords: CLOSE CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, Error Handling, TRY...CATCH...FINALLY

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische SQL-Abfrage mit einem Cursor aus und schließen Sie diesen anschließend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR WITH SOURCE`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_dyn,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_dyn.
    TYPES tt_sflight_dyn TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_dyn WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_dynamic_sflight
      IMPORTING iv_table_name TYPE string
                iv_where_cond TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_sflight_dyn
      RAISING   cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_sflight.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_dyn.
    DATA: lv_sql_statement TYPE string.

    lv_sql_statement = |SELECT carrid, connid FROM { iv_table_name }|.
    IF iv_where_cond IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_sql_statement = lv_sql_statement && | WHERE { iv_where_cond }|.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR (lv_sql_statement).

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_result.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_dyn_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
      ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sql FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sql_with_where FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sql_invalid_table EXPECTING CX_SY_DYNAMIC_SQL_ERROR.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sql.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->read_dynamic_sflight( iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_sql_with_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->read_dynamic_sflight( iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT' iv_where_cond = 'CARRID = ''LH''' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_sql_invalid_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql( ).
    lo_cut->read_dynamic_sflight( iv_table_name = 'INVALID_TABLE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von dynamischem SQL mit Cursorn. Der SQL-Statement wird zur Laufzeit konstruiert und dann mit `OPEN CURSOR FOR (lv_sql_statement)` ausgeführt. Die `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY`-Struktur ist hier besonders wichtig, um Ressourcen freizugeben, da dynamische Abfragen fehleranfälliger sein können.
keywords: CLOSE CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, Dynamic SQL, Database Access, String Templates

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in Paketen (chunks) mit einem Cursor und schließen Sie diesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_package_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflight_in_packages
      IMPORTING iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_all_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_package_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_all_sflights.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_package_read FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_package_read_small_size FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_package_read.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_package_size( ).
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = lo_cut->read_sflight_in_packages( iv_package_size = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_all_sflights IS NOT INITIAL ).
    " Verify that the number of entries is consistent with SFLIGHT table
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_count_sflight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_all_sflights ) exp = lv_count_sflight ).

  METHOD test_package_read_small_size.

explanation: Das Lesen von Daten in Paketen mittels `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE` ist eine effiziente Methode, um große Datenmengen zu verarbeiten, ohne den gesamten Datensatz auf einmal in den Arbeitsspeicher zu laden. Dies verbessert die Performance und reduziert den Speicherverbrauch. `CLOSE CURSOR` ist hier essenziell, um die Datenbankverbindung nach Abschluss der Verarbeitung freizugeben.
keywords: CLOSE CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, PACKAGE SIZE, Database Access, Performance

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `SELECT FOR UPDATE` Abfrage mit einem Cursor aus, verarbeiten Sie die Daten und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Datenbank-Sperren durch `CLOSE CURSOR` freigegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR ... FOR UPDATE`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_for_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_sflight_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                iv_add_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i
      RAISING   cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_for_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_sflight_seats.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc FROM sflight
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
          FOR UPDATE.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.

          " Simulate update: increase occupied seats
          ls_sflight-seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc + iv_add_seats.

          UPDATE sflight SET seatsocc = @ls_sflight-seatsocc
            WHERE carrid = @ls_sflight-carrid
              AND connid = @ls_sflight-connid
              AND fldate = @ls_sflight-fldate.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_updated_count = rv_updated_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
        COMMIT WORK.
      ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_with_cursor FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_with_cursor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_for_update( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_add_seats) = 1.

    " Get initial count and seats for 'LH'
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO @DATA(lv_initial_count).
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO @DATA(lv_initial_seats).

    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_sflight_seats( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_add_seats = lv_add_seats ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = lv_initial_count ).

    " Verify updated seats
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO @DATA(lv_final_seats).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_seats exp = lv_initial_seats + ( lv_initial_count * lv_add_seats ) ).

    " Clean up: revert changes (assuming test data can be reverted)
    UPDATE sflight SET seatsocc = seatsocc - @lv_add_seats WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_for_update( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_sflight_seats( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_add_seats = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SELECT FOR UPDATE` sperrt die ausgewählten Zeilen in der Datenbank, um konsistente Updates zu gewährleisten. Die Verwendung eines Cursors ermöglicht die zeilenweise Verarbeitung und Aktualisierung. Es ist entscheidend, den Cursor mit `CLOSE CURSOR` zu schließen und einen `COMMIT WORK` durchzuführen, um die Sperren freizugeben und die Änderungen zu persistieren. Die `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY`-Struktur stellt sicher, dass der Cursor immer geschlossen wird, auch wenn ein Fehler auftritt.
keywords: CLOSE CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FOR UPDATE, Locking, Database Access, COMMIT WORK

CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS: main.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    CLASS-METHODS: pbo_0100,
                   pai_0100.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    CALL SCREEN 0100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pbo_0100.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
      CREATE OBJECT go_tree
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container
          node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

      DATA(lt_sflight) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
      SELECT carrid connid fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 50 ROWS.

      DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE string_table( FOR sflight_line IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = sflight_line-carrid ) ASCENDING carrid
                                            ( sflight_line-carrid ) ).

      LOOP AT lt_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
        DATA(lv_carrid_key) = |CARR_{ lv_carrid }|.
        go_tree->add_node(
          i_relat_node_key = ' '
          i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_first_child
          i_node_text      = lv_carrid
          i_node_key       = lv_carrid_key
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
          DATA(lv_flight_key) = |FLIGHT_{ ls_sflight-carrid }_{ ls_sflight-connid }_{ ls_sflight-fldate }|.
          go_tree->add_node(
            i_relat_node_key = lv_carrid_key
            i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
            i_node_text      = |Flug { ls_sflight-connid } am { ls_sflight-fldate }|
            i_node_key       = lv_flight_key
          ).
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.

      go_tree->expand_node( 'CARR_LH' ). " Beispiel: Lufthansa erweitern
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pai_0100.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'EXIT'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

*
*PROCESS AFTER INPUT.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Fortschrittsbalken (`Progress Indicator`) auf einem Dynpro, der den Fortschritt einer simulierten langlaufenden Operation anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_PROGRESS_INDICATOR` und aktualisieren Sie den Fortschritt in einer Schleife.
solution:
REPORT z_gui_progress_demo.

CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS: main.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_progress  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_progress_indicator.
    CLASS-METHODS: pbo_0100,
                   pai_0100,
                   simulate_long_running_task.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    CALL SCREEN 0100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pbo_0100.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
      CREATE OBJECT go_progress
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.
      go_progress->set_text( 'Vorbereitung...' ).
      go_progress->set_range( EXPORTING from = 0 to = 100 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pai_0100.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'START'.
        simulate_long_running_task( ).
      WHEN 'EXIT'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_long_running_task.
    DATA: lv_percentage TYPE i.

    DO 100 TIMES.
      lv_percentage = sy-index.
      go_progress->set_text( |Verarbeite Schritt { lv_percentage } von 100...| ).
      go_progress->set_value( lv_percentage ).
      cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ). " Wichtig, um die Anzeige zu aktualisieren
      WAIT UP TO '0.05' SECONDS.
    ENDDO.
    go_progress->set_text( 'Vorgang abgeschlossen!' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS: main.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_input     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
                go_button    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

                   pai_0100,
                   handle_process_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button IMPORTING sender.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    CALL SCREEN 0100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pbo_0100.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
      CREATE OBJECT go_input
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.
      go_input->set_text_as_stream( '0' ).

      CREATE OBJECT go_button
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container
          text   = 'Zahl verarbeiten'.
      SET HANDLER lcl_app=>handle_process_click FOR go_button.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pai_0100.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'EXIT'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_process_click.
    DATA: lv_input_text TYPE string,
          lv_number     TYPE i.

    go_input->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_input_text ).

    TRY.
        lv_number = lv_input_text.
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Verarbeitete Zahl:' lv_number 'Quadrat:' ( lv_number * lv_number ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        MESSAGE e000(00) WITH 'Ungültige Zahleneingabe!'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch mehrere Buttons auf einem Dynpro basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Daten. Jeder Button soll eine eindeutige ID haben und bei Klick eine Meldung mit seiner ID ausgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife, um `CL_GUI_BUTTON` Instanzen zu erstellen. Speichern Sie die Referenzen in einer internen Tabelle und nutzen Sie `SET HANDLER` für jedes Button-Ereignis.
solution:
REPORT z_gui_dynamic_buttons_demo.

CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS: main.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_button_data,
             id   TYPE string,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_button_data.
    TYPES: tt_button_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_button_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                gt_buttons   TYPE TABLE OF REF TO cl_gui_button.

    CLASS-METHODS: pbo_0100,
                   pai_0100,
                   handle_dynamic_button FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    CALL SCREEN 0100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pbo_0100.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_button_data(
        ( id = 'BTN_001' text = 'Button 1' )
        ( id = 'BTN_002' text = 'Button 2' )
        ( id = 'BTN_003' text = 'Button 3' )
      ).

      LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
        DATA(lo_button) = NEW cl_gui_button(
          parent = go_container
          text   = ls_data-text
          fcode  = ls_data-id " FCODE kann als ID verwendet werden
        ).
        APPEND lo_button TO gt_buttons.
        SET HANDLER lcl_app=>handle_dynamic_button FOR lo_button.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pai_0100.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'EXIT'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_dynamic_button.
    MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Button geklickt:' sender->fcode.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                go_button    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

                   pai_0100,

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    CALL SCREEN 0100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pbo_0100.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
      CREATE OBJECT go_button
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container
          text   = 'Statusleiste aktualisieren'.
      SET HANDLER lcl_app=>handle_update_click FOR go_button.

      " Initialen Status setzen
      cl_gui_cfw=>set_statusbar_text( 'Bereit für Aktionen...' ).

    ENDIF.

    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'EXIT'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(lv_random_number) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( ) min = 1 max = 3 )->get_next( ).
    CASE lv_random_number.
      WHEN 1.
        cl_gui_cfw=>set_statusbar_text( 'Aktion erfolgreich abgeschlossen!' ).
        cl_gui_cfw=>set_statusbar_icon( 'SAPICON://@0V@' ). " Success-Icon

        cl_gui_cfw=>set_statusbar_icon( 'SAPICON://@0W@' ). " Warning-Icon
      WHEN 3.
        cl_gui_cfw=>set_statusbar_text( 'Fehler bei der Verarbeitung!' ).
        cl_gui_cfw=>set_statusbar_icon( 'SAPICON://@0X@' ). " Error-Icon
    ENDCASE.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Drag-and-Drop-Funktionalität zwischen zwei Text-Edit-Controls auf einem Dynpro.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT` und implementieren Sie die Ereignisse `DRAG` und `DROP`.
solution:
REPORT z_gui_drag_drop_demo.

CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS: main.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container1 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_container2 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_text1      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
                go_text2      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    CLASS-METHODS: pbo_0100,
                   pai_0100,
                   handle_drag FOR EVENT drag OF cl_gui_textedit IMPORTING sender dragdrop_object,
                   handle_drop FOR EVENT drop OF cl_gui_textedit IMPORTING sender dragdrop_object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    CALL SCREEN 0100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pbo_0100.
    IF go_container1 IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container1
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER1'.
      CREATE OBJECT go_text1
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container1.
      go_text1->set_text_as_stream( 'Ziehen Sie diesen Text.' ).
      go_text1->set_drag_mode( cl_gui_textedit=>drag_mode_full ).
      SET HANDLER lcl_app=>handle_drag FOR go_text1.

      CREATE OBJECT go_container2
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER2'.
      CREATE OBJECT go_text2
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container2.
      go_text2->set_text_as_stream( 'Legen Sie hier ab.' ).
      go_text2->set_drop_mode( cl_gui_textedit=>drop_mode_full ).
      SET HANDLER lcl_app=>handle_drop FOR go_text2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pai_0100.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'EXIT'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_drag.
    DATA: lv_text TYPE string.
    sender->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_text ).
    dragdrop_object->set_data( lv_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_drop.
    DATA: lv_text TYPE string.
    dragdrop_object->get_data( IMPORTING data = lv_text ).
    sender->set_text_as_stream( lv_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Toolbar Control und fügen Sie dynamisch Buttons hinzu. Implementieren Sie die Ereignisbehandlung für die Toolbar-Buttons.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR` und `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER`. Fügen Sie Buttons mit `ADD_BUTTON` hinzu und behandeln Sie das `BUTTON_CLICK` Ereignis.
solution:

CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS: main.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_toolbar   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    CLASS-METHODS: pbo_0100,
                   pai_0100,
                   handle_toolbar_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar IMPORTING fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    CALL SCREEN 0100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pbo_0100.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
      CREATE OBJECT go_toolbar
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.

      go_toolbar->add_button(
        EXPORTING
          fcode = 'BTN_NEW'
          icon  = 'SAPICON://@0Y@'
          text  = 'Neu'
          tooltip = 'Neuen Eintrag erstellen'
      ).
      go_toolbar->add_button(
        EXPORTING
          fcode = 'BTN_SAVE'
          icon  = 'SAPICON://@0S@'
          text  = 'Speichern'
          tooltip = 'Änderungen speichern'
      ).
      go_toolbar->add_separator(
        EXPORTING
          fcode = 'SEP1'
      ).
      go_toolbar->add_button(
        EXPORTING
          fcode = 'BTN_EXIT'
          icon  = 'SAPICON://@0X@'
          text  = 'Beenden'
          tooltip = 'Anwendung beenden'
      ).

      SET HANDLER lcl_app=>handle_toolbar_click FOR go_toolbar.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pai_0100.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'EXIT'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_toolbar_click.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'BTN_NEW'.
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Neuer Eintrag angelegt.'.
      WHEN 'BTN_SAVE'.
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Daten gespeichert.'.
      WHEN 'BTN_EXIT'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Unbekannter Toolbar-Button geklickt:' fcode.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Grid Control, das eine einfache Tabelle von Zahlen anzeigt und die Möglichkeit bietet, eine Zelle zu bearbeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_ALV_GRID` und konfigurieren Sie das Layout für die Bearbeitbarkeit. Achten Sie auf das `DATA_CHANGED` Ereignis.
solution:
REPORT z_gui_editable_grid_demo.

CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS: main.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_number_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_number_data.
    TYPES: tt_number_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
                gt_numbers   TYPE tt_number_data.
    CLASS-METHODS: pbo_0100,
                   pai_0100,
                   handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_alv_grid IMPORTING e_onf4 e_onf4_before e_ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    CALL SCREEN 0100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pbo_0100.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
      CREATE OBJECT go_alv_grid
        EXPORTING
          i_parent = go_container.

      " Initialdaten
      gt_numbers = VALUE tt_number_data(
        ( id = 1 value = 10 )
        ( id = 2 value = 20 )
        ( id = 3 value = 30 )
      ).

      DATA(ls_layout) TYPE lvc_s_layo.
      ls_layout-edit = abap_true. " Grid bearbeitbar machen

      go_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'Z_GUI_EDITABLE_GRID_DEMO=>TY_NUMBER_DATA'
          is_layout        = ls_layout
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = gt_numbers
      ).

      SET HANDLER lcl_app=>handle_data_changed FOR go_alv_grid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pai_0100.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'SAVE'.
        go_alv_grid->check_changed_data( ). " Änderungen vom Frontend ins Backend übertragen
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Daten gespeichert. Aktuelle Werte:'
          gt_numbers[1]-value gt_numbers[2]-value gt_numbers[3]-value.
      WHEN 'EXIT'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    " Hier könnten Validierungen oder weitere Verarbeitungen erfolgen
    MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Daten im Grid geändert!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie das Control Framework, um eine Meldungsleiste (Message Bar) zu implementieren, die verschiedene Arten von Nachrichten (Erfolg, Warnung, Fehler) anzeigt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT` in einem `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` und aktualisieren Sie dessen Text und Hintergrundfarbe dynamisch, um eine Meldungsleiste zu simulieren.
solution:
REPORT z_gui_message_bar_demo.

CLASS lcl_app DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS: main.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA: go_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
                go_message_text TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
                go_button_success TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button,
                go_button_warning TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button,
                go_button_error   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    CLASS-METHODS: pbo_0100,
                   pai_0100,
                   handle_message_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_app IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD main.
    CALL SCREEN 0100.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pbo_0100.
    IF go_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT go_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

      CREATE OBJECT go_message_text
        EXPORTING
          parent = go_container.
      go_message_text->set_text_as_stream( 'Bereit für Nachrichten...' ).
      go_message_text->set_readonly_mode( abap_true ).
      go_message_text->set_background_color( color = 0 ). " Standardfarbe

      DATA(lo_button_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'BUTTON_CONTAINER' ). " Separater Container für Buttons

      CREATE OBJECT go_button_success
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_button_container
          text   = 'Erfolg'.
      SET HANDLER lcl_app=>handle_message_click FOR go_button_success.

      CREATE OBJECT go_button_warning
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_button_container
          text   = 'Warnung'.
      SET HANDLER lcl_app=>handle_message_click FOR go_button_warning.

      CREATE OBJECT go_button_error
        EXPORTING
          parent = lo_button_container
          text   = 'Fehler'.
      SET HANDLER lcl_app=>handle_message_click FOR go_button_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pai_0100.
    CASE sy-ucomm.
      WHEN 'EXIT'.
        LEAVE PROGRAM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_message_click.
    DATA: lv_message TYPE string,
          lv_color   TYPE i.

    CASE sender->fcode.
      WHEN go_button_success->fcode.
        lv_message = 'Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen!'.
        lv_color = 6. " Grün
      WHEN go_button_warning->fcode.
        lv_message = 'Warnung: Bitte überprüfen Sie die Eingaben.'.
        lv_color = 4. " Gelb
      WHEN go_button_error->fcode.
        lv_message = 'Fehler: Die Operation konnte nicht ausgeführt werden.'.
        lv_color = 1. " Rot
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_message = 'Unbekannte Nachricht.'.
        lv_color = 0. " Standard
    ENDCASE.

    go_message_text->set_text_as_stream( lv_message ).
    go_message_text->set_background_color( color = lv_color ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Screen 0100                                                         *
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*PROCESS BEFORE OUTPUT.
*  MODULE pbo_0100.
*
*PROCESS AFTER INPUT.
*  MODULE pai_0100.
*
* (Dynpro 0100 muss zwei Custom Controls mit den Namen 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER' und 'BUTTON_CONTAINER' und einen Button 'EXIT' enthalten.)
unit_test:

    DATA: lo_message_text_mock TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,

    lcl_app=>go_button_success = lo_button_mock. " Referenz für den Handler setzen

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Sammeln Sie die Flugnummern in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE` und `COND` für die Filterung und Projektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_lh_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND fldate > sy-datum )
                          ( flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_future_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_future_lh_flights( ).

    " For a robust test, one would insert test data into sflight.
    " Assuming no future flights in standard sflight for this assert.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_aa
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_aa.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' )
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lv_total_price ).

CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ua_flights_starting_with_0
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ua_flights_starting_with_0.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = 'UA' AND connid CP '0*' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `NEW`-Operator erlaubt die direkte Übergabe von Parametern an den Konstruktor einer Klasse während der Instanziierung. Dies ist eine kompakte und lesbare Syntax, die die Notwendigkeit separater `CREATE OBJECT` und `CALL METHOD constructor` Anweisungen eliminiert.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `GROUP` Schlüsselwort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_group_result) = VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_group_result TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    " For a precise test, one would insert specific test data.
    " Check if the table is not empty and contains expected carriers.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_counts ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lt_flight_counts[ 1 ]-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen direkt in der Schleife. Dies vereinfacht Aggregationen und Analysen erheblich, da keine temporären Tabellen oder manuelle Sortierungen mehr erforderlich sind. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Flugnummern (CONNID) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_concat_for_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_connids) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_concat_for_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_connids.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_concatenated_connids = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid
                            ELSE |{ result },{ flight-connid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_lh_connids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_concatenate_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_lh_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_concat_for_reduce( ).
    " Assuming sflight contains LH flights with connids like '0400', '0401'
    " For a precise test, one would insert specific test data.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_connids( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_result ).
    " Example check if '0400' is part of the string
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'LH connids should be concatenated' pattern = '0400' in = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_concatenate_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_concat_for_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_connids( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert `FOR` und `REDUCE` mit String-Templates, um eine effiziente und lesbare Verkettung von String-Werten aus einer internen Tabelle zu erreichen. Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck akkumuliert die Werte bedingt, um das anfängliche Komma zu vermeiden, was eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der String-Aggregation darstellt.
keywords: FOR, REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, String Processing, LOOP AT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle `sflights` durchlaufen und nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 1000 in die neue Tabelle kopieren. Verwenden Sie dabei eine Inline-Deklaration für die Zieltabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO NEW` für die Inline-Deklaration und direkte Befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_into_new DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_expensive_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_expensive_flight.
    TYPES tt_expensive_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_expensive_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_expensive_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_into_new IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE price > 1000.
      APPEND VALUE ty_expensive_flight(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        price  = ls_flight-price
      ) TO rt_expensive_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_into_new( ).
    DATA(lt_expensive_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( ).

    " For a precise test, one would insert specific test data.
    " Check if the table is not empty if there are expensive flights.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lt_expensive_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(wa)` mit `WHERE` und `APPEND VALUE #( ... )` ist eine moderne und lesbare Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und zu transformieren. Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(wa)` macht den Code kürzer und klarer, während `APPEND VALUE` die Zeilenkonstruktion vereinfacht.
keywords: LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Inline Declaration, VALUE

Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail mit einem Betreff und einem Text, der dynamische Werte aus String-Templates verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_BCS` für den E-Mail-Versand und String-Templates für den Nachrichtentext.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_simple_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_sender_name     TYPE string
        iv_report_name     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_simple_email.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lv_body) = |Hallo { iv_sender_name }, \n\n| &&
                     |Dies ist eine Test-E-Mail vom ABAP-System. \n| &&
                     |Der Bericht '{ iv_report_name }' wurde erfolgreich ausgeführt. \n\n| &&
                     |Mit freundlichen Grüßen,\nIhr ABAP-System|.

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                           i_type    = 'RAW'
                           i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_body )
                           i_subject = iv_subject ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    rv_success = lo_bcs->send( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_email_simple( ).
    " ACHTUNG: Für einen echten Test müsste eine E-Mail-Adresse verwendet werden,
    " die tatsächlich existiert und empfangen werden kann.
    " Hier wird nur der Aufruf simuliert.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->send_simple_email(
                           iv_recipient_email = 'test@example.com'
                           iv_subject         = 'Test E-Mail von ABAP'
                           iv_sender_name     = 'ABAP System'
                           iv_report_name     = 'Z_TEST_REPORT' ).
    " In einem echten Szenario würde man hier prüfen, ob die E-Mail im Spool liegt
    " oder ob der Sendestatus erfolgreich war. Für Unit-Tests ist dies schwierig.
    " Wir prüfen hier nur, ob der Sendebefehl erfolgreich war.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'E-Mail-Versand sollte erfolgreich sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `CL_BCS` für den E-Mail-Versand in Kombination mit modernen String-Templates (ab ABAP 7.50) zur dynamischen Erstellung des Nachrichtentextes. Die `NEW` Operator und `DATA()` Inline-Deklaration vereinfachen die Objekterzeugung und Variablenverwaltung.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einer internen Tabelle als CSV-Anhang. Die Daten sollen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` stammen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_BCS` und `CL_BCS_DOCUMENT` für den Anhang. Konvertieren Sie die interne Tabelle manuell in ein CSV-Format und dann in `XSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_email_with_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_filename        TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflight_data.csv'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    METHODS convert_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_data           TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstr) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_csv.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lt_sflight) = get_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = convert_to_csv( lt_sflight ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                           i_type    = 'RAW'
                           i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( 'Siehe Anhang für Flugdaten.' )
                           i_subject = iv_subject ).

    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'BIN'
      i_attachment_subject = iv_filename
      i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lv_csv_xstring )
      i_att_content_hex    = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix( lv_csv_xstring ) ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    rv_success = lo_bcs->send( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_to_csv.
    DATA: lv_header TYPE string,
          lv_line   TYPE string,
          lv_csv    TYPE string.

    " Header
    lv_header = |"CARRID";"CONNID";"FLDATE";"PRICE";"CURRENCY"|.
    APPEND lv_header TO lv_csv.

    " Data
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lv_line = |"{ ls_data-carrid }";"{ ls_data-connid }";"{ ls_data-fldate }"|
                && |;"{ ls_data-price }"|
                && |;"{ ls_data-currency }"|.
      APPEND lv_line TO lv_csv.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_csv_xstr = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring( lv_csv ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email_with_csv FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_convert_to_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email_with_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_email_csv( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->send_email_with_csv(
                           iv_recipient_email = 'test_csv@example.com'
                           iv_subject         = 'Flugdaten als CSV'
                           iv_filename        = 'flugdaten.csv' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'E-Mail-Versand mit CSV-Anhang sollte erfolgreich sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_convert_to_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_email_csv( ).
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_bcs_email_csv=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lv_csv_xstr) = lo_cut->convert_to_csv( lt_test_data ).
    DATA(lv_csv_string) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string( lv_csv_xstr ).

    DATA(lv_expected_csv) = |"CARRID";"CONNID";"FLDATE";"PRICE";"CURRENCY"\n|
                            && |"AA";"001";"20250101";"100.00";"EUR"\n|
                            && |"LH";"002";"20250102";"200.50";"USD"|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_csv_string
      exp = lv_expected_csv
      msg = 'CSV-Konvertierung sollte korrekt sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Daten aus der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle mit der neuen `SELECT`-Syntax abruft und diese in ein CSV-Format konvertiert. Die Konvertierung in `XSTRING` und das Anhängen an eine E-Mail erfolgt über `CL_BCS` und `CL_BCS_DOCUMENT`. String-Templates werden für die CSV-Formatierung verwendet.
keywords: CL_BCS, E-Mail, Attachment, CSV, Internal Tables, SELECT, XSTRING, String Templates

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger, deren E-Mail-Adressen in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert sind. Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um die Empfängerliste zu erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BCS` und eine `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` für die dynamische Erstellung der Empfängerobjekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_multi_recipients DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_recipient,
             email TYPE ad_smtpadr,
             name  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_recipient.
    TYPES: tt_recipients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_recipient WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_email_to_multiple
      IMPORTING
        it_recipients      TYPE tt_recipients
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_multi_recipients IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_to_multiple.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                           i_type    = 'RAW'
                           i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
                           i_subject = iv_subject ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Using FOR expression to add multiple recipients
    LOOP AT it_recipients INTO DATA(ls_recipient).
      DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( ls_recipient-email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    rv_success = lo_bcs->send( ).

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email_multiple FOR TESTING.

    APPEND VALUE #( email = 'recipient2@example.com' name = 'Empfänger Zwei' ) TO lt_recipients.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->send_email_to_multiple(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      msg = 'E-Mail-Versand an mehrere Empfänger sollte erfolgreich sein' ).

Anstatt manuell `ADD_RECIPIENT` für jeden Empfänger aufzurufen, wird eine `LOOP AT` mit Inline-Deklaration verwendet. Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Flugdatum enthält, und formatieren Sie das Datum neu. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING` oder direkter Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
             airline TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_no TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE string, " Formatted date
           END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_raw_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_raw) TYPE tt_sflight_raw.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflight_data.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = get_raw_sflight_data( ).

    rt_transformed = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_data
                              ( airline     = ls_raw-carrid
                                flight_no   = ls_raw-connid
                                flight_date = |{ ls_raw-fldate DATE = USER }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_raw_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_raw.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle (`SFLIGHT`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Preise zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_prices)  TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lt_prices) = get_sflight_prices( iv_carrid ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                FOR ls_price IN lt_prices
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_price-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_prices.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_prices.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
