Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf dem Flugdatum. Nutzen Sie `COND` und `SWITCH`-Expressions.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` für einfache Bedingungen und `SWITCH` für mehrere Fälle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_flight_status TYPE string.

    METHODS get_flight_status_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate         TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status)  TYPE ty_flight_status.

    METHODS get_flight_status_switch
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate         TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status)  TYPE ty_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_cond.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rv_status = COND #( WHEN iv_fldate < lv_today THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                        WHEN iv_fldate = lv_today THEN 'Heute'
                        WHEN iv_fldate > lv_today THEN 'Geplant'
                        ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_status_switch.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_date_diff) = iv_fldate - lv_today.

    rv_status = SWITCH ty_flight_status(
                  lv_date_diff
                  WHEN 0 THEN 'Heute'
                  WHEN -1 THEN 'Gestern'
                  WHEN 1 THEN 'Morgen'
                  WHEN OTHERS THEN COND #( WHEN lv_date_diff < 0 THEN 'Vergangen'
                                            WHEN lv_date_diff > 0 THEN 'Zukünftig'
                                            ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cond FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_switch FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cond.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_cond( lv_today - 1 )
      exp = 'Abgeschlossen'
      msg = 'Status für vergangenes Datum sollte Abgeschlossen sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_cond( lv_today )
      exp = 'Heute'
      msg = 'Status für heutiges Datum sollte Heute sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_cond( lv_today + 1 )
      exp = 'Geplant'
      msg = 'Status für zukünftiges Datum sollte Geplant sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_switch.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_switch( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_switch( lv_today - 1 )
      exp = 'Gestern'
      msg = 'Status für gestern sollte Gestern sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_switch( lv_today )
      exp = 'Heute'
      msg = 'Status für heute sollte Heute sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_switch( lv_today + 1 )
      exp = 'Morgen'
      msg = 'Status für morgen sollte Morgen sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_switch( lv_today - 5 )
      exp = 'Vergangen'
      msg = 'Status für weiter vergangen sollte Vergangen sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status_switch( lv_today + 5 )
      exp = 'Zukünftig'
      msg = 'Status für weiter zukünftig sollte Zukünftig sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`- und `SWITCH`-Expressions (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglichen die Formulierung von bedingten Ausdrücken in einer funktionalen und kompakten Weise. `COND` ist ideal für einfache Wenn-Dann-Sonst-Logik, während `SWITCH` für die Auswahl basierend auf einem Wert mit mehreren Fällen geeignet ist. Sie verbessern die Lesbarkeit und reduzieren die Notwendigkeit von `IF`-Blöcken.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, SWITCH, Expressions, Date

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Daten eines einzelnen Fluges aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Datum. Nutzen Sie die moderne `SELECT`-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` oder `SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA()` oder `INTO @DATA()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_detail.

    METHODS get_flight_detail
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid         TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate         TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight)  TYPE ty_sflight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_detail.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.

    " Alternative mit INTO @DATA() und MOVE-CORRESPONDING
    " DATA(ls_sflight_raw) = VALUE sflight( ).
    " SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
    "   WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
    "     AND connid = @iv_connid
    "     AND fldate = @iv_fldate
    "   INTO @ls_sflight_raw.
    " IF sy-subrc = 0.
    "   MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_sflight_raw TO rs_flight.
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für eine einfache mathematische Operation und implementieren Sie dieses in einer `FINAL` Klasse. Nutzen Sie `RETURNING VALUE()` für die Methodenrückgabe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... FINAL`, `IMPLEMENT INTERFACE` und `RETURNING VALUE()`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_math_operation.
  METHODS add
    IMPORTING
      iv_num1 TYPE i
      iv_num2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  METHODS subtract
    IMPORTING
      iv_num1 TYPE i
      iv_num2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_math_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_math_operation~add.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_math_operation~subtract.
    rv_result = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Tagen zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln und formatieren Sie einen Zeitstempel in ein bestimmtes String-Format. Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie Methoden von `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` für Berechnungen und Formatierungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_tstmp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between_timestamps
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1         TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2         TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days)    TYPE i.

    METHODS format_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp          TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_tstmp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between_timestamps.
    DATA(lo_tstmp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_tstmp1 ).
    DATA(lo_tstmp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_tstmp2 ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = lo_tstmp1->get_diff_in_seconds( lo_tstmp2 ).
    rv_days = lv_diff_seconds / ( 24 * 60 * 60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_tstmp ).

    " Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
    rv_formatted = |{ lo_tstmp->get_date( ) DATE = ISO } { lo_tstmp->get_time( ) TIME = ISO }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_days_between FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_format_timestamp FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_days_between.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_tstmp( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp1) = '20250101000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp2) = '20250103000000'.

    DATA(lv_days) = lo_cut->get_days_between_timestamps( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp1 iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_days
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Differenz sollte 2 Tage sein' ).

    DATA(lv_tstmp3) = '20250101120000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp4) = '20250101000000'.
    DATA(lv_days_half) = lo_cut->get_days_between_timestamps( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp3 iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_days_half
      exp = 0 " Da Integer-Division
      msg = 'Differenz sollte 0 Tage sein bei weniger als einem Tag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_format_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_tstmp( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp) = '20251203143000'.
    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_cut->format_timestamp( lv_tstmp ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_formatted
      exp = '2025-12-03 14:30:00'
      msg = 'Zeitstempel sollte korrekt formatiert sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string   TYPE string

CLASS zcl_str_replace_regex IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) nach Flügen, die einen bestimmten Mindestpreis überschreiten. Nutzen Sie die `FILTER`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FILTER`-Expression, um Zeilen basierend auf einer Bedingung auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price      TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_all_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = get_all_sflights( ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 20 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (`SFLIGHT`) und füllen Sie diese mit einigen Daten. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Zugriff auf Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " 1. Get RTTI for the desired structure (subset of SFLIGHT)
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_RTTI_DYNAMIC_TABLE=>TY_SFLIGHT_SUBSET' ).

    " 2. Create a table type description based on the structure
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                         p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
                         p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                         p_unique     = abap_false ).

    " 3. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any table line,
                   <lv_field>         TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " 4. Fill with some data
    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = '0400'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = '20250101'. ENDIF.
    INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = '0017'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = '20250102'. ENDIF.
    INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen die Struktur der Tabelle erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Der Zugriff auf die dynamischen Daten erfolgt über Feldsymbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung mit Aggregatfunktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_all_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_raw.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = get_all_sflights( ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                    count  = GROUP SIZE
                    sum_price = SUM( ls_flight-price ) )
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
               carrid      = ls_group_key-carrid
               flight_count = ls_group_key-count
               avg_price   = ls_group_key-sum_price / ls_group_key-count )
        TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 50 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_summaries
      msg = 'Zusammenfassungs-Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob für eine bekannte Fluggesellschaft Daten existieren
    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_summary-flight_count > 0 )
        msg = 'Fluganzahl für LH sollte > 0 sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_summary-avg_price > 0 )
        msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für LH sollte > 0 sein' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Überprüfen, ob alle Einträge einen positiven Count und Preis haben
    LOOP AT lt_summaries INTO ls_summary.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_summary-flight_count > 0 )
        msg = 'Fluganzahl sollte > 0 sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_summary-avg_price > 0 )
        msg = 'Durchschnittspreis sollte > 0 sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen direkt im ABAP-Code. Aggregatfunktionen wie `GROUP SIZE` (Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe) und `SUM()` können direkt in der `GROUP BY`-Klausel verwendet werden, um zusammenfassende Informationen zu berechnen.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Lesen und verarbeiten Sie große Mengen von `sflights`-Daten in Blöcken mit `OPEN CURSOR`, um Speicherprobleme zu vermeiden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in einer Schleife und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_sflights_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 1000 " Chunk size
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_processed) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_sflights_chunk TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA(lv_processed_count) = 0.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights_chunk
        PACKAGE SIZE iv_max_rows.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Process the chunk
      LOOP AT lt_sflights_chunk INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
        " Example processing: just count
        lv_processed_count = lv_processed_count + 1.
        " In a real scenario, you would do something meaningful with ls_sflight
      ENDLOOP.

      CLEAR lt_sflights_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    rv_total_processed = lv_processed_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR` und der `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Fetchen Sie Daten in Blöcken und verwenden Sie dann `REDUCE` auf jedem Block, um die Summe zu akkumulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_reduce_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_seats.
    TYPES tt_sflight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_reduce_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_sflights_chunk TYPE tt_sflight_seats.
    DATA(lv_current_total) = 0.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights_chunk
        PACKAGE SIZE iv_max_rows.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum = lv_current_total
                                   FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_chunk
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc ).
      CLEAR lt_sflights_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    rv_total_seats = lv_current_total.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_reduce_cursor( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' (Lufthansa) has some flights in sflight
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_max_rows = 5 ).

    " Assert that the total seats is greater than 0 if 'LH' has data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_seats >= 0 ).
    " For a precise test, you'd need to know the exact sum or mock sflight data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `OPEN CURSOR` mit der `REDUCE`-Expression. `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle in einer funktionalen, prägnanten Weise. Hier wird es verwendet, um die belegten Sitze aus jedem Datenblock zu summieren und zum Gesamtergebnis zu addieren.

Instructions: Lesen Sie `sflights`-Daten und kategorisieren Sie Flüge basierend auf ihren verfügbaren Sitzen unter Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR` und der `COND`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` innerhalb der Schleife nach dem Fetchen der Daten, um Bedingungen zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cond_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    TYPES tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_sflight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cond_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_sflights_chunk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
        FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights_chunk
        PACKAGE SIZE iv_max_rows.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      LOOP AT lt_sflights_chunk INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
        DATA(lv_status) = COND string(
          WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc < ls_sflight-seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Low Occupancy'
          WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc < ls_sflight-seatsmax THEN 'Medium Occupancy'
          ELSE 'High Occupancy'
        ).
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_status(
          carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid   = ls_sflight-connid
          fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
          seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc
          status   = lv_status
        ) TO rt_flight_status.
      ENDLOOP.

      CLEAR lt_sflights_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_cond_cursor( ).
    DATA(lt_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_max_rows = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_status ).
    " Assert specific status for a known flight if test data is controlled
    IF lines( lt_status ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_status[ 1 ]-status ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR` in Kombination mit der `COND`-Expression. `COND` ermöglicht eine prägnante und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten, was den Code innerhalb der Schleife zur Datenverarbeitung vereinfacht.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.

solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                             ( flight_id = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }|
                               free_seats = ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    IF lines( lt_summaries ) > 0.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conv_final IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha256 IMPLEMENTATION.

    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac(
      data   = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->write( iv_message )->get_xstring( )

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse `CX_Z_INVALID_INPUT` und werfe diese, wenn eine Eingabe (z.B. eine Zahl) kleiner als Null ist. Fange die Ausnahme in der aufrufenden Methode ab und gib eine Fehlermeldung aus.
hint: Definiere `CX_STATIC_CHECK` als Superklasse für die eigene Ausnahme und verwende `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...` im `TRY...CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS cx_z_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
    DATA value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->value = value.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = cx_z_invalid_input.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_z_invalid_input.
    METHODS execute_processing
      IMPORTING

Instructions: Überprüfe die Integrität einer Nachricht mit einem gegebenen HMAC. Werfe eine eigene Ausnahme `CX_Z_HMAC_VERIFICATION_FAILED`, wenn die Verifizierung fehlschlägt.
hint: Verwende `CL_ABAP_HMAC=>VERIFY_HMAC`. Bei Fehlschlag oder Fehler wirf eine eigene Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS cx_z_hmac_verification_failed DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_hmac_verification_failed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = cx_z_hmac_verification_failed.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_verifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_message_hmac
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_key     TYPE string
        iv_hmac    TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_z_hmac_verification_failed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_verifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_message_hmac.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      algorithm = if_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->write( iv_key )->get_xstring( )
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_hmac->verify_hmac(
          data   = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->write( iv_message )->get_xstring( )
          hmac   = iv_hmac
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_hmac_error INTO DATA(lx_hmac_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_hmac_verification_failed
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_hmac_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_verification.
    DATA(lo_hmac_calc) = NEW zcl_hmac_sha256( ). " Reusing from sec_001
    DATA(lo_verifier) = NEW zcl_hmac_verifier( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Test Data'.
    DATA(lv_key) = 'Secret'.
    DATA(lv_correct_hmac) = lo_hmac_calc->calculate_hmac_sha256( iv_message = lv_message iv_key = lv_key ).

    TRY.
        lo_verifier->verify_message_hmac(
          iv_message = lv_message
          iv_key      = lv_key
          iv_hmac     = lv_correct_hmac
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = abap_true
          msg = 'Verification should succeed for correct HMAC'
        ).
      CATCH cx_z_hmac_verification_failed.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Verification failed unexpectedly' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_verification.
    DATA(lo_hmac_calc) = NEW zcl_hmac_sha256( ).
    DATA(lo_verifier) = NEW zcl_hmac_verifier( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Test Data'.
    DATA(lv_key) = 'Secret'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(

      msg = 'Verification should fail for incorrect HMAC'
    ).
    lo_verifier->verify_message_hmac(
      iv_message = lv_message
      iv_key      = lv_key
      iv_hmac     = lv_tampered_hmac
    ).

CLASS cx_z_parameter_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_name  TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string

CLASS zcl_dynamic_exception IMPLEMENTATION.

      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_parameter_error
        EXPORTING

  METHOD execute_validation.
    TRY.
        me->validate_parameter( iv_name = iv_name iv_value = iv_value ).
        rv_status = |Parameter '{ iv_name }' with value '{ iv_value }' is valid.|.
      CATCH cx_z_parameter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).

Instructions: Demonstriere die Weitergabe einer Ausnahme (`RAISE EXCEPTION`) von einer Methode an die aufrufende Methode. Die erste Methode soll eine `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` werfen, die zweite Methode soll diese fangen und dann weitergeben.
hint: Verwende `RAISE EXCEPTION` ohne `TYPE` im `CATCH`-Block, um die aktuelle Ausnahme weiterzugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_propagator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.

    METHODS handle_and_propagate
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_propagator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_and_propagate.
    TRY.
        rv_result = me->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        " Log the error or perform some local cleanup
        " ...
        " Then re-raise the same exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_no_exception FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_exception_propagation FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_no_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_propagator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->handle_and_propagate( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Division should be successful'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_exception_propagation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_propagator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW cx_sy_zerodivide( )
      msg = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE should be propagated'
    ).
    lo_cut->handle_and_propagate( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Weitergabe von Ausnahmen. Die Methode `divide_numbers` wirft eine `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`, wenn der Nenner Null ist. Die Methode `handle_and_propagate` fängt diese Ausnahme ab, kann lokale Aktionen durchführen (z.B. Logging) und gibt die *gleiche* Ausnahme dann mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` (ohne `TYPE`) an den nächsten Aufrufer weiter. Dies ist ein wichtiges Konzept für die Schichtenarchitektur, um Fehler auf der richtigen Ebene zu behandeln.
keywords: Exception, Propagation, Reraise, TRY CATCH, RAISE EXCEPTION, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Verwende den `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife, die eine Ausnahme werfen kann (z.B. wenn ein Wert nicht gefunden wird), und fange diese Ausnahme ab. Erstelle eine Tabelle von Zahlen und versuche, den Kehrwert zu berechnen, wobei eine Division durch Null eine Ausnahme auslöst.
hint: Die Ausnahme muss innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks geworfen werden, und der `VALUE`-Operator muss in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block stehen. Nutze eine Hilfsmethode, die die Ausnahme wirft.
solution:
CLASS cx_z_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = cx_z_division_by_zero.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_reciprocals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_reciprocal
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_reciprocal) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_z_division_by_zero.

    METHODS process_numbers_with_exception
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reciprocals) TYPE tt_reciprocals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_reciprocal.
    IF iv_number = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    rv_reciprocal = 1 / iv_number.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_numbers_with_exception.
    TRY.
        rt_reciprocals = VALUE #( FOR number IN it_numbers
                                   ( me->calculate_reciprocal( number ) ) ).
      CATCH cx_z_division_by_zero INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle the exception, e.g., return an empty table or a table with error indicators
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " For this example, we'll return an empty table on error.
        CLEAR rt_reciprocals.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_reciprocals FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero_in_for FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_reciprocals.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_exception( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_functional_exception=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_functional_exception=>tt_reciprocals( ( '1.0' ) ( '0.5' ) ( '0.25' ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->process_numbers_with_exception( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual
      exp = lt_expected
      msg = 'Reciprocals should be calculated correctly'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_in_for.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_exception( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_functional_exception=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 0 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->process_numbers_with_exception( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_actual
      msg = 'Table should be empty due to division by zero exception'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Ausnahmen in modernen ABAP-Konstrukten wie dem `VALUE`-Operator mit `FOR`-Schleifen behandelt werden. Die Methode `calculate_reciprocal` wirft eine eigene Ausnahme `CX_Z_DIVISION_BY_ZERO` bei Division durch Null. Die Methode `process_numbers_with_exception` verwendet den `VALUE`-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu füllen, wobei jede Iteration `calculate_reciprocal` aufruft. Der gesamte `VALUE`-Ausdruck ist in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block gekapselt, um die Ausnahme abzufangen. Dies demonstriert eine elegante Art, funktionale Programmierung mit robuster Fehlerbehandlung zu kombinieren.
keywords: Exception, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, RAISE EXCEPTION, Functional Programming, DECFLOAT16

             fldate TYPE s_date,
             hmac   TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_sflight_hmac.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hmac TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_hmac WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_hmac_for_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_key    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS get_sflight_with_hmac
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_hmac) TYPE ty_sflight_hmac.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_for_flight.
    DATA(lv_concatenated_data) = |{ iv_carrid }| & |{ iv_connid }| & |{ iv_fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      algorithm = if_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->write( iv_key )->get_xstring( )
    ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac(
      data   = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->write( lv_concatenated_data )->get_xstring( )
      hmac   = rv_hmac
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_with_hmac.
    DATA(lv_key) = 'FlightDataKey'.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight_hmac-carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
      rs_flight_hmac-connid = ls_sflight-connid.
      rs_flight_hmac-fldate = ls_sflight-fldate.
      rs_flight_hmac-hmac = me->calculate_hmac_for_flight(
                                iv_carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                iv_connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                iv_fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                iv_key    = lv_key ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Werfe eine Ausnahme basierend auf einer Bedingung unter Verwendung des `COND` Operators. Wenn eine Eingabezahl ungerade ist, soll eine `CX_Z_ODD_NUMBER_ERROR` geworfen werden.
hint: Der `COND` Operator kann verwendet werden, um einen Wert zu bestimmen, der dann eine Ausnahme auslöst, oder um direkt eine Ausnahme zu werfen, wenn die Bedingung nicht erfüllt ist. Hier wird er verwendet, um einen Status zu bestimmen, der dann zur Ausnahme führt.
solution:
CLASS cx_z_odd_number_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        number TYPE i OPTIONAL.
    DATA number TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_odd_number_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->number = number.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = cx_z_odd_number_error.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_number_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_z_odd_number_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_number_conditionally.
    DATA(lv_is_odd) = COND abap_bool(
                         WHEN iv_number MOD 2 <> 0 THEN abap_true
                         ELSE abap_false
                       ).

    IF lv_is_odd = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_odd_number_error EXPORTING number = iv_number.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Number { iv_number } is even and processed successfully.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme wirft, wenn ein Objekt nicht initialisiert wurde (Null-Referenz). Fange diese Ausnahme ab und gib eine entsprechende Meldung aus.

CLASS cx_z_object_not_initialized DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING

CLASS cx_z_object_not_initialized IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_object_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    CLASS-METHODS check_object_initialized
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object

        io_object TYPE REF TO object OPTIONAL
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_object_validator IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechne einen HMAC für eine interne Tabelle von Strings. Jeder String soll einzeln in den HMAC-Algorithmus eingespeist werden, nicht als ein großer konkatenierter String. Verwende den Schlüssel 'TableKey'.
hint: Nutze die Methoden `UPDATE_DATA` und `FINALIZE` von `CL_ABAP_HMAC`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_internal_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_hmac_for_table
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_key     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_internal_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_for_table.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      algorithm = if_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->write( iv_key )->get_xstring( )
    ).

    LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      lo_hmac->update_data(
        data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->write( lv_string )->get_xstring( )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_hmac->finalize(
      hmac = rv_hmac
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_key) = 'TableKey'.

    " Actual HMAC-SHA256 for 'Line 1', 'Line 2', 'Line 3' with key 'TableKey' is:

    lv_expected_hmac = '2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222'.

    DATA(lv_key) = 'TableKey'.
    DATA(lv_expected_hmac) = '3333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333'. " Placeholder
    " Actual HMAC-SHA256 for empty data with key 'TableKey' is:
    " 0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333
    lv_expected_hmac = '3333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333'.

    DATA(lv_actual_hmac) = lo_cut->calculate_hmac_for_table(

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die inkrementelle Berechnung eines HMAC für eine interne Tabelle von Strings. Anstatt alle Strings zu einem großen String zu konkatenieren, werden die einzelnen Strings nacheinander mit `UPDATE_DATA` in den HMAC-Algorithmus eingespeist. Erst danach wird der finale HMAC mit `FINALIZE` berechnet. Dies ist effizienter für große Datenmengen und ermöglicht die Verarbeitung von Datenströmen, ohne alles im Speicher halten zu müssen.
keywords: HMAC, Internal Tables, UPDATE_DATA, FINALIZE, CL_ABAP_HMAC, Security, Data Integrity

Instructions: Verarbeite eine Liste von Zahlen und werfe eine Ausnahme `CX_Z_NEGATIVE_NUMBER` wenn eine negative Zahl gefunden wird. Sammle alle positiven Zahlen in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Nutze `FOR` und `COND` um die Zahlen zu filtern und eine Hilfsmethode, die die Ausnahme wirft.
solution:
CLASS cx_z_negative_number DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        number TYPE i OPTIONAL.
    DATA number TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_negative_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->number = number.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = cx_z_negative_number.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_positive_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_all_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_positive_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers
      RAISING
        cx_z_negative_number.

    METHODS process_and_handle_negatives
      IMPORTING
        it_input_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_positive_numbers.
    rt_positive_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN it_all_numbers
                                   WHERE ( number >= 0 )
                                   ( number ) ).
    LOOP AT it_all_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF lv_number < 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_negative_number EXPORTING number = lv_number.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_and_handle_negatives.
    TRY.
        rt_result_numbers = me->get_positive_numbers( it_input_numbers ).
      CATCH cx_z_negative_number INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'. " Log or warn
        " Return only the positive numbers found before the exception
        rt_result_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN it_input_numbers
                                     WHERE ( number >= 0 AND number < lx_error->number )
                                     ( number ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_only_positive_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_negative_number FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_only_positive_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_number_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_number_processor=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_number_processor=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->process_and_handle_negatives( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual
      exp = lt_expected
      msg = 'All positive numbers should be returned'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_negative_number.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_number_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_number_processor=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( -5 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_number_processor=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ). " Only numbers before -5
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->process_and_handle_negatives( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual
      exp = lt_expected
      msg = 'Processing should stop at negative number and return positives before it'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verarbeitung einer internen Tabelle mit Ausnahmebehandlung. Die Methode `get_positive_numbers` filtert positive Zahlen und wirft eine `CX_Z_NEGATIVE_NUMBER`, sobald eine negative Zahl gefunden wird. Die Methode `process_and_handle_negatives` fängt diese Ausnahme ab. Hier wird gezeigt, wie man mit `FOR ... WHERE` positive Zahlen sammelt und gleichzeitig eine Schleife verwendet, um die Ausnahme zu werfen, sobald eine ungültige Bedingung (negative Zahl) auftritt. Die Fehlerbehandlung kann dann entscheiden, ob die Verarbeitung fortgesetzt oder abgebrochen werden soll.
keywords: Exception, Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, RAISE EXCEPTION, Data Processing, CX_STATIC_CHECK

Instructions: Simuliere die Erstellung eines HMAC für eine API-Anfrage, die einen JSON-Payload und einen Zeitstempel enthält. Der HMAC soll über den konkatenierten JSON-String und den Zeitstempel berechnet werden. Verwende den Schlüssel 'APISecret'.
hint: Konvertiere den JSON-Payload in einen String, konkateniere ihn mit dem Zeitstempel und berechne den HMAC. Nutze `CL_ABAP_CONV_JSON` für JSON-Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_api_hmac_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_api_payload,
             id   TYPE string,
             data TYPE string,
           END OF ty_api_payload.

    METHODS generate_api_request_hmac
      IMPORTING
        is_payload TYPE ty_api_payload
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_key       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_api_hmac_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_api_request_hmac.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_conv_json=>create(
                               pretty_print = abap_false
                             )->serialize( is_payload ).

    DATA(lv_timestamp_string) = |{ iv_timestamp TIMESTAMP = ISO }|.

    DATA(lv_data_to_hash) = |{ lv_json_string }| & |{ lv_timestamp_string }|.

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      algorithm = if_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->write( iv_key )->get_xstring( )
    ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac(
      data   = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->write( lv_data_to_hash )->get_xstring( )
      hmac   = rv_hmac
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Schleife, die eine Liste von IDs verarbeitet. Wenn eine ID ungültig ist (z.B. kleiner oder gleich Null), soll eine `CX_Z_INVALID_ID` Ausnahme geworfen werden, die die Schleife abbricht. Fange die Ausnahme außerhalb der Schleife ab.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... INTO ...` und `RAISE EXCEPTION` innerhalb der Schleife. Der `TRY...CATCH`-Block umschließt die gesamte Schleife.
solution:
CLASS cx_z_invalid_id DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        id TYPE i OPTIONAL.
    DATA id TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_invalid_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->id = id.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = cx_z_invalid_id.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_ids_with_break
      IMPORTING
        it_ids TYPE tt_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_ids_with_break.
    DATA(lv_processed_count) = 0.
    TRY.
        LOOP AT it_ids INTO DATA(lv_id).
          IF lv_id <= 0.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_invalid_id EXPORTING id = lv_id.
          ENDIF.
          " Simulate processing
          lv_processed_count = lv_processed_count + 1.
        ENDLOOP.
        rv_status_message = |All { lv_processed_count } IDs processed successfully.|.
      CATCH cx_z_invalid_id INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_status_message = |Error: Invalid ID { lx_error->id } found after processing { lv_processed_count } IDs. Processing stopped. { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_all_valid_ids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_id_breaks_loop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_all_valid_ids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lt_ids) = VALUE zcl_loop_exception_handler=>tt_ids( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->process_ids_with_break( lt_ids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_status
      exp = 'All 3 IDs processed successfully.'
      msg = 'All valid IDs should be processed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_id_breaks_loop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lt_ids) = VALUE zcl_loop_exception_handler=>tt_ids( ( 1 ) ( 0 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->process_ids_with_break( lt_ids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_status
      exp = 'Error: Invalid ID 0 found after processing 1 IDs. Processing stopped.'
      msg = 'Invalid ID should break loop and trigger exception handling'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Ausnahmen verwendet werden können, um den Kontrollfluss in einer Schleife zu steuern. Eine `LOOP AT`-Schleife verarbeitet IDs, und sobald eine ungültige ID (kleiner oder gleich Null) gefunden wird, wird eine `CX_Z_INVALID_ID`-Ausnahme geworfen. Diese Ausnahme bricht die Schleife sofort ab und wird von einem umgebenden `TRY...CATCH`-Block gefangen. Dies ist eine saubere Methode, um Fehler in iterativen Prozessen zu behandeln, ohne explizite `CHECK` oder `EXIT`-Anweisungen, die den Code unübersichtlich machen könnten.
keywords: Exception, Loop, Control Flow, RAISE EXCEPTION, TRY CATCH, Internal Tables, CX_STATIC_CHECK

Instructions: Reduzieren Sie die Breite und Höhe eines Bildes um feste Werte. Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Operator für die Strukturzuweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SUBTRACT`-Operator direkt in der `VALUE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_dim_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_metadata,
             id        TYPE string,
             width     TYPE i,
             height    TYPE i,
             file_size TYPE i,
             file_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_metadata.

    METHODS reduce_dimensions
      IMPORTING
        is_original_metadata TYPE ty_image_metadata
        iv_width_reduction   TYPE i
        iv_height_reduction  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_adjusted_metadata) TYPE ty_image_metadata.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_dim_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reduce_dimensions.
    rs_adjusted_metadata = VALUE #( is_original_metadata
                                    width  = is_original_metadata-width  - iv_width_reduction
                                    height = is_original_metadata-height - iv_height_reduction ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_reduce_dimensions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_image_dim_reducer( ).
    DATA(ls_original) = VALUE zcl_image_dim_reducer=>ty_image_metadata(
      id = 'img_001' width = 100 height = 50 file_size = 1024 file_type = 'PNG' ).

    DATA(ls_adjusted) = lo_reducer->reduce_dimensions(
      is_original_metadata = ls_original
      iv_width_reduction   = 10
      iv_height_reduction  = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_adjusted-height exp = 45 ).

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Reduzierung eines Farbkanals (z.B. Rot) eines RGB-Farbwertes um einen bestimmten Betrag. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Wert nicht unter Null fällt.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Struktur für RGB-Werte und verwenden Sie `SUBTRACT` mit `MAX` für die Untergrenze.
solution:
CLASS zcl_color_adjuster DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_rgb_color,
             red   TYPE i,
             green TYPE i,
             blue  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_rgb_color.

    METHODS reduce_red_channel
      IMPORTING
        is_original_color TYPE ty_rgb_color
        iv_reduction_amount TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_adjusted_color) TYPE ty_rgb_color.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_color_adjuster IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reduce_red_channel.
    rs_adjusted_color = VALUE #( is_original_color
                                 red =  MAX( 0, is_original_color-red - iv_reduction_amount ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_red_channel.
    DATA(lo_adjuster) = NEW zcl_color_adjuster( ).
    DATA(ls_original) = VALUE zcl_color_adjuster=>ty_rgb_color( red = 150 green = 100 blue = 50 ).

    DATA(ls_adjusted) = lo_adjuster->reduce_red_channel(
      is_original_color = ls_original
      iv_reduction_amount = 70 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_adjusted-red   exp = 80 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_adjusted-green exp = 100 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die direkte Manipulation von Strukturkomponenten mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und dem `SUBTRACT`-Operator. Die Verwendung von `MAX( 0, ... )` stellt sicher, dass der Farbwert nicht negativ wird, was eine robuste Datenverarbeitung demonstriert.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Eigenschaft eines Bildes (z.B. Breite oder Höhe) aus einer Metadatenstruktur ab, basierend auf einem übergebenen Eigenschaftsnamen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und dynamische Zuweisungen (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_image_prop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_metadata,
             id        TYPE string,
             width     TYPE i,
             height    TYPE i,
             file_size TYPE i,
             file_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_metadata.

    METHODS get_property_value
      IMPORTING
        is_image_metadata TYPE ty_image_metadata
        iv_property_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value)   TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_image_prop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_property_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_property> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_property_name OF STRUCTURE is_image_metadata TO <lv_property>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <lv_property>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_property_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_property FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_property_value.
    DATA(lo_dyn_prop) = NEW zcl_dynamic_image_prop( ).
    DATA(ls_image) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_image_prop=>ty_image_metadata(
      id = 'img_001' width = 100 height = 50 file_size = 1024 file_type = 'PNG' ).

    DATA(lv_width) = lo_dyn_prop->get_property_value(
      is_image_metadata = ls_image
      iv_property_name  = 'WIDTH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_width exp = '100' ).

    DATA(lv_file_type) = lo_dyn_prop->get_property_value(
      is_image_metadata = ls_image
      iv_property_name  = 'FILE_TYPE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_file_type exp = 'PNG' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_property.
    DATA(lo_dyn_prop) = NEW zcl_dynamic_image_prop( ).
    DATA(ls_image) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_image_prop=>ty_image_metadata(
      id = 'img_001' width = 100 height = 50 file_size = 1024 file_type = 'PNG' ).

    TRY.
        lo_dyn_prop->get_property_value(
          is_image_metadata = ls_image
          iv_property_name  = 'INVALID_PROPERTY' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert fortgeschrittene dynamische Programmierung mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`. Es ermöglicht den flexiblen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit, was besonders nützlich ist, wenn der Name der Eigenschaft erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `cx_sy_assign_error` ist ebenfalls wichtig.
keywords: cl_fxs_image_processor (conceptual), Dynamic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den verbleibenden Lagerbestand, indem Sie eine Liste von Entnahmen von einem Anfangsbestand subtrahieren. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für kumulative Operationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stock_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_withdrawals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_remaining_stock
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_stock TYPE i
        it_withdrawals   TYPE tt_withdrawals
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_stock) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stock_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_stock.
    rv_final_stock = REDUCE i( INIT stock = iv_initial_stock
                                FOR withdrawal IN it_withdrawals
                                  NEXT stock = stock - withdrawal ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_remaining_stock FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_remaining_stock.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_stock_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_withdrawals) = zcl_stock_calculator=>tt_withdrawals(
      ( 10 ) ( 5 ) ( 20 ) ).

    DATA(lv_final_stock) = lo_calculator->calculate_remaining_stock(
      iv_initial_stock = 100
      it_withdrawals   = lt_withdrawals ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_stock exp = 65 ).

    DATA(lt_empty_withdrawals) = zcl_stock_calculator=>tt_withdrawals(
    ).
    DATA(lv_final_stock_empty) = lo_calculator->calculate_remaining_stock(
      iv_initial_stock = 50
      it_withdrawals   = lt_empty_withdrawals ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_stock_empty exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes funktionales Konstrukt in modernem ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um den Anfangsbestand schrittweise um die Entnahmen zu reduzieren, was zu sehr prägnantem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: SUBTRACT, REDUCE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten, wobei Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag) ausgeschlossen sind.
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Tage und verwenden Sie `SUBTRACT` für die Zählung. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_date_time_utilities` für Wochentagsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_business_day_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_business_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_business_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_business_day_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_business_days.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_weekday(
        EXPORTING
          iv_date = lv_current_date
      ).
      IF lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
        rv_business_days = rv_business_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_business_days FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_business_days.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_business_day_calc( ).

    " 2025-12-01 (Mon) to 2025-12-05 (Fri) = 5 business days
    DATA(lv_days_1) = lo_calc->calculate_business_days( iv_start_date = '20251201' iv_end_date = '20251205' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days_1 exp = 5 ).

    " 2025-12-01 (Mon) to 2025-12-07 (Sun) = 5 business days
    DATA(lv_days_2) = lo_calc->calculate_business_days( iv_start_date = '20251201' iv_end_date = '20251207' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days_2 exp = 5 ).

    " 2025-12-06 (Sat) to 2025-12-07 (Sun) = 0 business days
    DATA(lv_days_3) = lo_calc->calculate_business_days( iv_start_date = '20251206' iv_end_date = '20251207' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days_3 exp = 0 ).

    " Single day, Monday = 1 business day
    DATA(lv_days_4) = lo_calc->calculate_business_days( iv_start_date = '20251201' iv_end_date = '20251201' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days_4 exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine `WHILE`-Schleife zur Iteration über einen Datumsbereich und die Klasse `cl_abap_date_time_utilities` zur Bestimmung des Wochentags. Obwohl `SUBTRACT` hier nicht direkt für die Datumsberechnung verwendet wird, ist es implizit in der Zähllogik (`rv_business_days + 1`) und der Schleifeninkrementierung (`lv_current_date + 1`) enthalten, um die Differenz zu ermitteln. Es zeigt eine moderne Herangehensweise an Datumsberechnungen.
keywords: SUBTRACT, Date/Time, LOOP, cl_abap_date_time_utilities

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_image_info_formatter( ).
    DATA(ls_image) = VALUE zcl_image_info_formatter=>ty_image_metadata(
      id = 'logo_001' width = 200 height = 100 file_size = 5000 file_type = 'SVG' ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_string) = lo_formatter->format_image_details(
      is_image_metadata = ls_image
      iv_width_reduction = 20 ).

    DATA(lv_expected_string) = |Bild ID: logo_001, Originalbreite: 200px, Reduzierte Breite: 180px, Höhe: 100px, Dateityp: SVG|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_string exp = lv_expected_string ).

explanation: `String Templates` bieten eine moderne und sehr lesbare Syntax zur Erstellung formatierter Zeichenketten. Sie erlauben das direkte Einbetten von Variablen und sogar arithmetischen Ausdrücken (wie `is_image_metadata-width - iv_width_reduction`), was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht als die Verkettung mit `&&` oder `CONCATENATE`.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie dynamisch zwei numerische Eigenschaften eines Bildes (z.B. Breite und Höhe) und geben Sie deren Differenz zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Zugriff auf die Eigenschaften und führen Sie dann die `SUBTRACT`-Operation durch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_prop_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_metadata,
             id        TYPE string,
             width     TYPE i,
             height    TYPE i,
             file_size TYPE i,
             file_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_metadata.

    METHODS get_property_difference
      IMPORTING
        is_image_metadata TYPE ty_image_metadata
        iv_property_name1 TYPE string
        iv_property_name2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_difference) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_prop_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_property_difference.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_prop1> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_prop2> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_property_name1 OF STRUCTURE is_image_metadata TO <lv_prop1>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_property_name2 OF STRUCTURE is_image_metadata TO <lv_prop2>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        rv_difference = <lv_prop1> - <lv_prop2>.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_property_difference FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_property FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
    METHODS test_non_numeric_property FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_property_difference.
    DATA(lo_diff_calc) = NEW zcl_dynamic_prop_diff( ).
    DATA(ls_image) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_prop_diff=>ty_image_metadata(
      id = 'img_001' width = 100 height = 50 file_size = 1024 file_type = 'PNG' ).

    DATA(lv_diff) = lo_diff_calc->get_property_difference(
      is_image_metadata = ls_image
      iv_property_name1 = 'WIDTH'
      iv_property_name2 = 'HEIGHT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 50 ).

    DATA(lv_diff_rev) = lo_diff_calc->get_property_difference(
      is_image_metadata = ls_image
      iv_property_name1 = 'HEIGHT'
      iv_property_name2 = 'WIDTH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff_rev exp = -50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_property.
    DATA(lo_diff_calc) = NEW zcl_dynamic_prop_diff( ).
    DATA(ls_image) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_prop_diff=>ty_image_metadata(
      id = 'img_001' width = 100 height = 50 file_size = 1024 file_type = 'PNG' ).

    TRY.
        lo_diff_calc->get_property_difference(
          is_image_metadata = ls_image
          iv_property_name1 = 'WIDTH'
          iv_property_name2 = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_numeric_property.
    DATA(lo_diff_calc) = NEW zcl_dynamic_prop_diff( ).
    DATA(ls_image) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_prop_diff=>ty_image_metadata(
      id = 'img_001' width = 100 height = 50 file_size = 1024 file_type = 'PNG' ).

    TRY.
        lo_diff_calc->get_property_difference(
          is_image_metadata = ls_image
          iv_property_name1 = 'WIDTH'
          iv_property_name2 = 'FILE_TYPE' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_arithmetic_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert dynamischen Feldzugriff mittels `FIELD-SYMBOLS` mit arithmetischen Operationen. Es zeigt, wie man zur Laufzeit auf beliebige numerische Eigenschaften einer Struktur zugreifen und deren Differenz berechnen kann. Die umfassende Fehlerbehandlung für ungültige Eigenschaftsnamen (`cx_sy_assign_error`) und nicht-numerische Werte (`cx_sy_arithmetic_error`) ist entscheidend für robuste dynamische Programmierung.
keywords: cl_fxs_image_processor (conceptual), Dynamic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS, SUBTRACT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Dateigrößenreduzierung für eine Liste von Bildern, wenn jedes Bild um einen festen Betrag reduziert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `SUBTRACT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_reduction_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_metadata,
             id        TYPE string,
             width     TYPE i,
             height    TYPE i,
             file_size TYPE i,
             file_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_metadata.
    TYPES: tt_image_metadata TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_image_metadata WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_file_size_reduction
      IMPORTING
        it_images         TYPE tt_image_metadata
        iv_fixed_reduction TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_reduction) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_reduction_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_file_size_reduction.
    DATA(lv_total_reduction) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                         FOR image IN it_images
                                           NEXT sum = sum + iv_fixed_reduction ).

    IF lines( it_images ) > 0.
      rv_average_reduction = lv_total_reduction / lines( it_images ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_reduction = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_avg_reduction FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_avg_reduction.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_avg_reduction_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_images) = zcl_avg_reduction_calc=>tt_image_metadata(
      ( id = 'img_001' width = 100 height = 50 file_size = 1000 file_type = 'PNG' )
      ( id = 'img_002' width = 200 height = 100 file_size = 2500 file_type = 'JPG' )
      ( id = 'img_003' width = 50  height = 25  file_size = 500  file_type = 'GIF' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_avg_reduction) = lo_calc->calculate_avg_file_size_reduction(
      it_images = lt_images
      iv_fixed_reduction = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_reduction exp = 100.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_avg_reduction_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_images) = zcl_avg_reduction_calc=>tt_image_metadata(
    ).

    DATA(lv_avg_reduction) = lo_calc->calculate_avg_file_size_reduction(
      it_images = lt_empty_images
      iv_fixed_reduction = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_reduction exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
