explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe der Reduzierungen über alle Bilder in der internen Tabelle zu berechnen. Anschließend wird der Durchschnitt ermittelt. Dies zeigt eine moderne, funktionale Art der Datenaggregation, die den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht. Die Division durch `lines( it_images )` ist eine einfache Form der Durchschnittsberechnung.
keywords: Image Processor, FOR, REDUCE, SUBTRACT, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein Bild repräsentiert und eine Methode zum Anpassen der Helligkeit (simuliert durch Subtraktion eines Wertes) bereitstellt.
hint: Objektorientiertes Design mit einer Methode, die den `SUBTRACT`-Operator verwendet und den internen Zustand des Objekts ändert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_brightness TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_id TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_id        TYPE string
        iv_brightness TYPE i.

    METHODS reduce_brightness
      IMPORTING
        iv_reduction_amount TYPE i.

    METHODS get_image_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_id = iv_id.
    mv_brightness = iv_brightness.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reduce_brightness.
    mv_brightness = mv_brightness - iv_reduction_amount.
    IF mv_brightness < 0.
      mv_brightness = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_image_info.
    rv_info = |Image ID: { mv_id }, Current Brightness: { mv_brightness }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_brightness FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_brightness_floor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_brightness.
    DATA(lo_image) = NEW zcl_image( iv_id = 'photo_001' iv_brightness = 200 ).
    lo_image->reduce_brightness( iv_reduction_amount = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_image->mv_brightness exp = 150 ).

    DATA(lv_info) = lo_image->get_image_info( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'Image ID: photo_001, Current Brightness: 150' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_brightness_floor.
    DATA(lo_image) = NEW zcl_image( iv_id = 'photo_002' iv_brightness = 30 ).
    lo_image->reduce_brightness( iv_reduction_amount = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_image->mv_brightness exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert grundlegende objektorientierte Prinzipien: Kapselung von Daten (Helligkeit, ID) und Verhalten (Helligkeit reduzieren) in einer Klasse. Die Methode `reduce_brightness` verwendet den `SUBTRACT`-Operator, um den internen Zustand des Objekts zu ändern, und stellt sicher, dass die Helligkeit nicht unter Null fällt. `String Templates` werden für die Informationsausgabe verwendet.
keywords: Object Orientation, SUBTRACT, Image Processor (conceptual)

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle von Bildmetadaten, in der die Breite jedes Bildes um einen festen Wert reduziert wurde, ohne die Originaltabelle zu ändern.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, und den `VALUE`-Operator für die Strukturmodifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_table_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_metadata,
             id        TYPE string,
             width     TYPE i,
             height    TYPE i,
             file_size TYPE i,
             file_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_metadata.
    TYPES: tt_image_metadata TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_image_metadata WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS reduce_widths_in_new_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original_images TYPE tt_image_metadata
        iv_width_reduction TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reduced_images) TYPE tt_image_metadata.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_table_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reduce_widths_in_new_table.
    rt_reduced_images = VALUE tt_image_metadata(
      FOR ls_image IN it_original_images
        ( VALUE #( ls_image width = ls_image-width - iv_width_reduction ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_widths_in_new_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_original_table_unchanged FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_widths_in_new_table.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_image_table_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = zcl_image_table_reducer=>tt_image_metadata(
      ( id = 'img_001' width = 100 height = 50 file_size = 1000 file_type = 'PNG' )
      ( id = 'img_002' width = 200 height = 100 file_size = 2500 file_type = 'JPG' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_reduced) = lo_reducer->reduce_widths_in_new_table(
      it_original_images = lt_original
      iv_width_reduction = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_reduced ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_reduced[ 1 ]-width exp = 80 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_reduced[ 2 ]-width exp = 180 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_original_table_unchanged.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_image_table_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_original_copy) = zcl_image_table_reducer=>tt_image_metadata(
      ( id = 'img_001' width = 100 height = 50 file_size = 1000 file_type = 'PNG' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_original_before_call) = lt_original_copy.

    lo_reducer->reduce_widths_in_new_table(
      it_original_images = lt_original_copy
      iv_width_reduction = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_original_copy[ 1 ]-width exp = lt_original_before_call[ 1 ]-width ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP mit dem `FOR`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren. Jede Zeile der neuen Tabelle wird durch den `VALUE`-Operator erstellt, der die Breite des Bildes mit dem `SUBTRACT`-Operator reduziert. Dies ist eine elegante Methode, um Daten zu transformieren, ohne die Originaldaten zu modifizieren, was die Code-Wartbarkeit und -Vorhersehbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: Image Processor, FOR, VALUE, SUBTRACT, Internal Tables

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die 'Effektive Breite' eines Bildes: Wenn die Breite größer als die Höhe ist, reduzieren Sie die Breite um 10%; andernfalls reduzieren Sie die Höhe um 10%. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.
hint: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht konditionelle Zuweisungen in einer einzigen Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_effective_dim_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_metadata,
             id        TYPE string,
             width     TYPE i,
             height    TYPE i,
             file_size TYPE i,
             file_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_metadata.

    METHODS calculate_effective_width
      IMPORTING
        is_image_metadata TYPE ty_image_metadata
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_effective_width) TYPE i.

    METHODS calculate_effective_height
      IMPORTING
        is_image_metadata TYPE ty_image_metadata
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_effective_height) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_effective_dim_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_effective_width.
    rv_effective_width = COND #( WHEN is_image_metadata-width > is_image_metadata-height
                                 THEN is_image_metadata-width - ( is_image_metadata-width * 10 / 100 )
                                 ELSE is_image_metadata-width ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_effective_height.
    rv_effective_height = COND #( WHEN is_image_metadata-width > is_image_metadata-height
                                  THEN is_image_metadata-height
                                  ELSE is_image_metadata-height - ( is_image_metadata-height * 10 / 100 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_effective_dimensions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_effective_dimensions.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_effective_dim_calc( ).

    " Case 1: Width > Height
    DATA(ls_image_wide) = VALUE zcl_effective_dim_calc=>ty_image_metadata(
      id = 'wide_img' width = 200 height = 100 ).
    DATA(lv_eff_width_wide) = lo_calc->calculate_effective_width( ls_image_wide ).
    DATA(lv_eff_height_wide) = lo_calc->calculate_effective_height( ls_image_wide ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_eff_width_wide  exp = 180 ). " 200 - 20
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_eff_height_wide exp = 100 ).

    " Case 2: Height >= Width
    DATA(ls_image_tall) = VALUE zcl_effective_dim_calc=>ty_image_metadata(
      id = 'tall_img' width = 100 height = 200 ).
    DATA(lv_eff_width_tall) = lo_calc->calculate_effective_width( ls_image_tall ).
    DATA(lv_eff_height_tall) = lo_calc->calculate_effective_height( ls_image_tall ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_eff_width_tall  exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_eff_height_tall exp = 180 ). " 200 - 20
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator (Conditional Expression) ermöglicht es, Werte basierend auf Bedingungen zuzuweisen, ähnlich einem Ternary-Operator in anderen Sprachen. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code für konditionelle Logik. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Reduktion der Breite oder Höhe eines Bildes basierend auf dem Seitenverhältnis zu steuern, wobei der `SUBTRACT`-Operator für die Reduktion eingesetzt wird.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, SUBTRACT, Image Processor (conceptual)

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine 'Image Processor'-Operation, die eine Liste von Bild-IDs verarbeitet und für jede ID eine 'Verarbeitungszeit' zurückgibt, die von einer Basiszeit subtrahiert wird, um die 'verbleibende Zeit' zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` für die Iteration über IDs und `REDUCE` für die Berechnung der verbleibenden Zeit, wobei `SUBTRACT` verwendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_proc_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processing_result,
             image_id TYPE string,
             processing_time TYPE i,
             remaining_time TYPE i,
           END OF ty_processing_result.
    TYPES: tt_processing_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processing_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS simulate_processing_times
      IMPORTING
        it_image_ids TYPE string_table
        iv_base_time TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_processing_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_proc_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_processing_times.
    rt_results = VALUE tt_processing_results(
      FOR image_id IN it_image_ids
      LET lv_proc_time = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 10 max = 50 )->get_next( )
      IN
        ( image_id        = image_id,
          processing_time = lv_proc_time,
          remaining_time  = iv_base_time - lv_proc_time )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_simulate_processing_times FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simulate_processing_times.
    DATA(lo_simulator) = NEW zcl_image_proc_sim( ).
    DATA(lt_image_ids) = VALUE string_table( ( 'IMG_A' ) ( 'IMG_B' ) ( 'IMG_C' ) ).
    DATA(lv_base_time) = 100.

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_simulator->simulate_processing_times(
      it_image_ids = lt_image_ids
      iv_base_time = lv_base_time ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).

    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_result-processing_time >= 10 AND ls_result-processing_time <= 50 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-remaining_time exp = lv_base_time - ls_result-processing_time ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit dem `LET`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren. Für jede Bild-ID wird eine zufällige Verarbeitungszeit generiert (`cl_abap_random_int`) und dann mit dem `SUBTRACT`-Operator die verbleibende Zeit berechnet. Dies demonstriert eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung und -transformation in ABAP.
keywords: cl_fxs_image_processor, Image Processor, SUBTRACT, FOR, LET, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die absolute Differenz zwischen zwei Zahlen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `ABS`-Funktionsaufruf nach der `SUBTRACT`-Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abs_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_absolute_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_number1 TYPE i
        iv_number2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_absolute_difference) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abs_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_absolute_difference.
    rv_absolute_difference = ABS( iv_number1 - iv_number2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_absolute_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_absolute_difference.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_abs_difference( ).

    DATA(lv_diff1) = lo_calc->calculate_absolute_difference( iv_number1 = 10 iv_number2 = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff1 exp = 5 ).

    DATA(lv_diff2) = lo_calc->calculate_absolute_difference( iv_number1 = 5 iv_number2 = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff2 exp = 5 ).

    DATA(lv_diff3) = lo_calc->calculate_absolute_difference( iv_number1 = 7 iv_number2 = 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff3 exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die einfache, aber häufig benötigte Berechnung der absoluten Differenz zwischen zwei Zahlen. Es verwendet den `SUBTRACT`-Operator gefolgt von der eingebauten `ABS`-Funktion, um sicherzustellen, dass das Ergebnis immer positiv ist. Dies ist eine grundlegende mathematische Operation, die in vielen Kontexten, einschließlich der Bildverarbeitung (z.B. Pixel-Differenzen), nützlich ist.
keywords: SUBTRACT, ABS, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll mit der Klasse `cl_s_aut_bal_log`, fügen Sie eine Erfolgs- und eine Fehlermeldung hinzu und speichern Sie das Protokoll.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log`, `add_message` und `save_log`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_save_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_save_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log(
      iv_object    = 'ZDEMO'
      iv_subobject = 'LOG'
    ).

    lo_log->add_message(
      iv_msgty = 'S'
      iv_msgid = '00'
      iv_msgno = '001'
      iv_msgv1 = 'Erfolgsmeldung'
    ).

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und geben Sie den Index der aktuellen Zeile aus. Zeigen Sie zuerst die klassische Methode mit `sy-tabix` und dann die moderne Methode mit `LOOP AT ... INDEX INTO`.
hint: Vergleichen Sie `sy-tabix` mit `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(idx)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_index_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_indexed_values_classic
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_indexed_data) TYPE string_table.

    METHODS get_indexed_values_modern
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_indexed_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_index_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_indexed_values_classic.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      APPEND |Index: { sy-tabix }, Value: { ls_data-value }| TO rt_indexed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_indexed_values_modern.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data) INDEX INTO DATA(lv_index).
      APPEND |Index: { lv_index }, Value: { ls_data-value }| TO rt_indexed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( field1 = ... field2 = ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced,
           tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_reduced_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_reduced_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-connid ).

Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu schreiben und Zeile für Zeile zu füllen, wird die neue Tabelle direkt aus der Quelltabelle generiert, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( ).

    " Da die Daten in SFLIGHT variieren können, prüfen wir nur, ob das Ergebnis > 0 ist.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde man mit festen Testdaten arbeiten.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine funktionale und kompakte Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit einer akkumulierenden Variable zu schreiben, wird der Reduktionsprozess deklarativ beschrieben, was den Code kürzer und oft verständlicher macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum, sflights

Instructions: Wählen Sie Daten aus den Tabellen `sflights` und `sbook` aus und kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse mit `UNION ALL` in einer einzigen internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie die moderne Open SQL Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... UNION ALL SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_combined_data,
           tt_combined_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined_data) TYPE tt_combined_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flight_data.
    SELECT FROM sflight AS sf
           FIELDS sf~carrid AS key_field, sf~connid AS value
      UNION ALL
    SELECT FROM sbook AS sb
           FIELDS sb~carrid AS key_field, sb~bookid AS value
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_combined_raw) UP TO 20 ROWS.

    rt_combined_data = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_combined_raw
      ( key_field = ls_raw-key_field,
        value     = ls_raw-value )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_union( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_combined_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    " Überprüfen Sie, ob sowohl Flug- als auch Buchungsdaten vorhanden sind (heuristisch)
    DATA(lv_has_flight) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_booking) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-value CA '0123456789'. " Heuristik: connid ist numerisch, bookid auch
        lv_has_flight = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_entry-value IS NOT INITIAL. " Einfache Prüfung
        lv_has_booking = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_booking ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Open SQL Syntax erlaubt die direkte Verwendung von `UNION` (oder `UNION ALL`) innerhalb der `SELECT`-Anweisung, um Ergebnisse aus mehreren Tabellen zu kombinieren. In Kombination mit der Inline-Deklaration `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` wird der Code für den Datenbankzugriff erheblich vereinfacht und ist besser lesbar.
keywords: Open SQL, UNION, UNION ALL, DATA, Database, sflights, sbook

Instructions: Entwerfen Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining (Fluent Interface) zu ermöglichen.
hint: Geben Sie `ME` als Referenz auf die aktuelle Instanz zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_interface.

    METHODS set_value2
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_interface.

    METHODS get_combined_value
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_combined) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_combined_value.
    rv_combined = |{ mv_value1 } - { mv_value2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_interface.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_fluent_interface( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->set_value1( 10 )->set_value2( 'Test' )->get_combined_value( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '10 - Test' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, auch bekannt als Fluent Interface, verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe aneinanderzureihen. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Objektinstanz (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, ME

Instructions: Führen Sie einen INNER JOIN zwischen den Tabellen `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR` durch, um die Flugdetails zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft abzurufen. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle mit `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE` und `CARRNAME` sein.

CLASS zcl_sql_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sql_inner_join IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, c~carrname
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen LEFT OUTER JOIN zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SPFLI` durch, um alle Flüge und deren entsprechende Flugverbindungen abzurufen. Wenn keine Verbindung für einen Flug gefunden wird, soll 'N/A' für die Felder `CITYFROM` und `CITYTO` angezeigt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und die `COALESCE`-Funktion, um Standardwerte für `NULL`-Ergebnisse zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_left_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_connection,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_connection.
    TYPES tt_flight_connection TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_connections
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_connection.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_left_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_connections.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate,
           COALESCE(p~cityfrom, 'N/A') AS cityfrom,
           COALESCE(p~cityto, 'N/A') AS cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_left_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_outer_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_left_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_connections( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lines( lt_flights ), msg = 'No flights returned' ).

    " Check for an entry that should have a connection (e.g., LH 0400)
    DATA(ls_connected_flight) = VALUE zcl_sql_left_join=>ty_flight_connection(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO ls_connected_flight WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_connected_flight-cityfrom exp = 'N/A', msg = 'LH 0400 should have a cityfrom' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Known flight LH 0400 not found. Check SFLIGHT/SPFLI data.' ).
    ENDIF.

    " To test 'N/A', we would need a flight in SFLIGHT that has no matching entry in SPFLI.
    " This is hard to guarantee without test data setup or mocking. We assume COALESCE works.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` stellt sicher, dass alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` im Ergebnis enthalten sind, auch wenn keine passende Verbindung in `SPFLI` gefunden wird. `COALESCE` (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ersetzt `NULL`-Werte (die bei nicht gefundenen Joins entstehen) durch einen definierten Standardwert, was die Datenkonsistenz verbessert.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, COALESCE, Open SQL, SFLIGHT, SPFLI

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Gesamtzahl der Sitze, die für Flüge von 'FRANKFURT' nach 'NEW YORK' verfügbar sind, indem Sie `SFLIGHT` und `SPFLI` verbinden und die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft gruppieren. Zeigen Sie die Fluggesellschaft und die Summe der maximalen Sitze an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN`, `WHERE` für die Städte, `GROUP BY` für die Fluggesellschaft und die Aggregatfunktion `SUM` für die Sitze.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_city_from TYPE spfli-cityfrom
                iv_city_to   TYPE spfli-cityto
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    SELECT s~carrid, SUM( s~seatsmax ) AS total_seats
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      WHERE p~cityfrom = @iv_city_from
        AND p~cityto   = @iv_city_to
      GROUP BY s~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( iv_city_from = 'FRANKFURT' iv_city_to = 'NEW YORK' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lines( lt_result ), msg = 'No aggregated data returned' ).

    " Check for a specific carrier's total seats if known (e.g., LH for FRA-NYC)
    DATA(ls_lh_seats) = VALUE zcl_sql_group_by=>ty_carrier_seats( carrid = 'LH' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_seats WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_seats-total_seats, msg = 'LH total seats should not be initial' ).
      " Assuming LH has flights from FRA to NYC, check if total seats is positive
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_seats-total_seats > 0, msg = 'LH total seats should be greater than 0' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'LH flights from FRANKFURT to NEW YORK not found. Check SFLIGHT/SPFLI data.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `INNER JOIN`, `WHERE`-Klauseln zur Filterung, `GROUP BY` zur Aggregation und der Aggregatfunktion `SUM`. Die Inline-Deklaration und der `@`-Escape-Charakter sind moderne ABAP-Features, die den Code sauberer machen.
keywords: JOIN, GROUP BY, SUM, Open SQL, Aggregate Functions, SFLIGHT, SPFLI

Instructions: Finden Sie die Top 3 der Fluggesellschaften (nach `CARRID`), die die meisten Flüge mit einer maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität von über 100 Sitzen anbieten. Zeigen Sie die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl ihrer Flüge an.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN`, `GROUP BY`, `COUNT`, `HAVING` zur Filterung aggregierter Daten, `ORDER BY` zur Sortierung und `UP TO 3 ROWS` zur Begrenzung der Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_having_top DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_carriers_by_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_having_top IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_carriers_by_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~seatsmax > 100
      GROUP BY s~carrid
      HAVING COUNT( * ) > 0 " Ensure only carriers with at least one flight are counted
      ORDER BY flight_count DESC
      UP TO 3 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_carriers_by_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) <= 3, msg = 'More than 3 carriers returned' ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_top_carrier-flight_count > 0, msg = 'Top carrier flight count should be positive' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert fortgeschrittene Open SQL-Features: `INNER JOIN` für Datenintegration, `WHERE` für initiale Filterung, `GROUP BY` für Aggregation, `HAVING` für die Filterung der aggregierten Ergebnisse, `ORDER BY` für die Sortierung und `UP TO N ROWS` zur Begrenzung der Ergebnisliste. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Ranglisten direkt in der Datenbank zu erstellen.
keywords: JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, UP TO, Open SQL, Aggregate Functions, SFLIGHT, SCARR

Instructions: Rufen Sie alle Flüge ab, die von 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden, und zeigen Sie die Flugnummer, das Datum und den Namen der Fluggesellschaft an. Sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Flugdatum absteigend und begrenzen Sie auf die ersten 5 Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INNER JOIN`, `WHERE` zur Filterung nach Fluggesellschaft, `ORDER BY` für die Sortierung und `UP TO 5 ROWS` zur Begrenzung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_order_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_latest_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_order_limit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, c~carrname
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY s~fldate DESC
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_order_limit FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_order_limit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_order_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_latest_flights_by_carrier( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights, msg = 'No flights returned for LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) <= 5, msg = 'More than 5 flights returned' ).

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 1.
      " Check if sorting is correct (descending date)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate >= lt_flights[ 2 ]-fldate,
        msg = 'Flights are not sorted by date descending' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check if all returned flights are for the specified carrier
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH', msg = 'Incorrect carrier returned' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `INNER JOIN` zur Kombination von Daten, einer `WHERE`-Klausel zur Filterung, `ORDER BY` zur Sortierung der Ergebnisse und `UP TO N ROWS` zur Begrenzung der Anzahl der zurückgegebenen Zeilen. Dies ist nützlich für Paging oder das Abrufen der neuesten/ältesten Einträge.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, WHERE, ORDER BY, UP TO, Open SQL, SFLIGHT, SCARR

Instructions: Suchen Sie effizient einen Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHT`-Daten, die nach `CARRID` und `CONNID` sortiert ist, um einen bestimmten Flug zu finden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` mit `BINARY SEARCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_binary_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_flight_binary
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
                iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_binary_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_binary.
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = it_flights.
    SORT lt_sorted_flights BY carrid connid.

    READ TABLE lt_sorted_flights INTO rs_flight
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid
      BINARY SEARCH.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_flight_binary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_flight_binary.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itb_binary_search=>tt_sflight_data.

    " Test data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250105' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250110' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_binary_search( ).

    " Test 1: Found entry
    DATA(ls_found) = lo_cut->find_flight_binary( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found-fldate exp = '20250105', msg = 'LH 0400 not found correctly' ).

    " Test 2: Not found entry
    DATA(ls_not_found) = lo_cut->find_flight_binary( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_not_found-carrid, msg = 'Non-existent flight found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `BINARY SEARCH`-Option bei `READ TABLE` ermöglicht eine sehr schnelle Suche in internen Tabellen, vorausgesetzt, die Tabelle ist nach den Schlüsselfeldern sortiert. Dies ist besonders effizient bei großen Datenmengen, da die Suchzeit logarithmisch zur Anzahl der Einträge wächst (O(log n)).
keywords: BINARY SEARCH, READ TABLE, Internal Table, SORT

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie effizient, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in einer internen Tabelle existiert, ohne die gesamten Daten des Eintrags zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY ... BINARY SEARCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_binary_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_exists_binary
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
                iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_binary_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists_binary.
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = it_flights.
    SORT lt_sorted_flights BY carrid connid.

    READ TABLE lt_sorted_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid
      BINARY SEARCH.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_check_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_flight_exists.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itb_binary_exists=>tt_sflight_key.

    " Test data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_binary_exists( ).

    " Test 1: Existent entry
    DATA(lv_exists_lh) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists_binary( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists_lh exp = abap_true, msg = 'LH 0400 should exist' ).

    " Test 2: Non-existent entry
    DATA(lv_exists_xx) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists_binary( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists_xx exp = abap_false, msg = 'XX 9999 should not exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Option `TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` in Kombination mit `READ TABLE ... BINARY SEARCH` ist die effizienteste Methode, um die Existenz eines Eintrags in einer sortierten internen Tabelle zu überprüfen. Es werden keine Daten in den Arbeitsbereich kopiert, was die Performance weiter optimiert, insbesondere bei breiten Tabellenzeilen.
keywords: BINARY SEARCH, READ TABLE, TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS, Internal Table, EXISTENCE CHECK

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in eine bereits nach `CARRID` und `CONNID` sortierte interne Tabelle ein, sodass die Sortierreihenfolge erhalten bleibt. Suchen Sie anschließend den eingefügten Eintrag mittels `BINARY SEARCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... BINARY SEARCH` um die Einfügeposition zu finden (`sy-subrc = 4`), und dann `INSERT ... INDEX sy-tabix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_binary_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_and_find_flight
      IMPORTING CHANGING ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
                iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
                iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_binary_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_and_find_flight.
    " Ensure the table is sorted before attempting binary search for insertion point
    SORT ct_flights BY carrid connid.

    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
      carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ).

    READ TABLE ct_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
      WITH KEY carrid = ls_new_flight-carrid connid = ls_new_flight-connid
      BINARY SEARCH.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0. " If not found, insert at the determined position
      INSERT ls_new_flight INTO ct_flights INDEX sy-tabix.
    ENDIF.

    " Now find the (potentially newly inserted) flight using binary search
    READ TABLE ct_flights INTO rs_flight
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid
      BINARY SEARCH.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_and_find.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itb_binary_insert=>tt_sflight_data.

    " Initial test data (unsorted)
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250110' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_binary_insert( ).

    " Insert a new flight that fits in between
    DATA(ls_inserted_flight) = lo_cut->insert_and_find_flight(
      CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights
      iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250105' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_inserted_flight-fldate exp = '20250105', msg = 'Inserted flight not found correctly' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3, msg = 'Table size incorrect after insertion' ).

    " Verify the table is still sorted
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        IF ls_flight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid OR ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-connid < lv_prev_connid ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Table is not sorted after insertion' ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Wenn `READ TABLE ... BINARY SEARCH` keinen Eintrag findet (`sy-subrc = 4`), enthält `sy-tabix` den Index, an dem der neue Eintrag eingefügt werden sollte, um die Sortierreihenfolge zu erhalten. Dies ist eine performante Methode, um sortierte Tabellen dynamisch zu aktualisieren.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die nach `CARRID` und `CONNID` sortiert ist (kann Duplikate für andere Felder enthalten). Finden Sie den ersten Eintrag für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer mittels `BINARY SEARCH` und verarbeiten Sie dann alle nachfolgenden Einträge für dieselbe Kombination.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... BINARY SEARCH` um den Startpunkt zu finden, und dann `LOOP AT ... FROM sy-tabix WHERE` oder eine Schleife mit `sy-tabix` und `WHILE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_binary_group_proc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flight_group
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full
                iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_group_data) TYPE tt_sflight_full.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_binary_group_proc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_group.
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = it_flights.
    SORT lt_sorted_flights BY carrid connid fldate. " Sort by all relevant fields for consistent grouping

    DATA(ls_search_key) = VALUE ty_sflight_full(
      carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ).

    READ TABLE lt_sorted_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
      WITH KEY carrid = ls_search_key-carrid connid = ls_search_key-connid
      BINARY SEARCH.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_start_index) = sy-tabix.
      LOOP AT lt_sorted_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
        FROM lv_start_index
        WHERE carrid = ls_search_key-carrid AND connid = ls_search_key-connid.
        APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_group_data.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

FROM sy-tabix WHERE` die gesamte Gruppe effizient verarbeitet. Dies ist eine performante Technik, um zusammenhängende Datenblöcke in großen, sortierten internen Tabellen zu handhaben, ohne die gesamte Tabelle durchlaufen zu müssen.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT` in einer internen Tabelle nach `CARRID` und `CONNID` (z.B. Summe der maximalen Sitze) und verwenden Sie dann `BINARY SEARCH`, um die aggregierten Daten für einen bestimmten Flug abzurufen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COLLECT`, um die Aggregation durchzuführen, da `COLLECT` die Tabelle nach den Schlüsselfeldern sortiert hält, was `BINARY SEARCH` ermöglicht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_collect_binary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_flight_data
      IMPORTING it_raw_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated) TYPE tt_sflight_agg.

    METHODS find_aggregated_flight
      IMPORTING it_aggregated TYPE tt_sflight_agg
                iv_carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid     TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_found) TYPE ty_sflight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_collect_binary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flight_data.
    DATA: ls_agg_line TYPE ty_sflight_agg.

    LOOP AT it_raw_flights INTO DATA(ls_raw_flight).
      ls_agg_line-carrid = ls_raw_flight-carrid.
      ls_agg_line-connid = ls_raw_flight-connid.
      ls_agg_line-total_seats = ls_raw_flight-seatsmax.
      COLLECT ls_agg_line INTO rt_aggregated.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_aggregated_flight.
    READ TABLE it_aggregated INTO rs_found
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid
      BINARY SEARCH.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_collect_and_binary_search FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_collect_and_binary_search.
    DATA: lt_raw_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Test data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_raw_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_raw_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 300 ) TO lt_raw_flights. " Duplicate key for aggregation
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsmax = 180 ) TO lt_raw_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_collect_binary( ).

    " Step 1: Aggregate data using COLLECT
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_flight_data( lt_raw_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated ) exp = 3, msg = 'Incorrect number of aggregated entries' ).

    " Step 2: Find aggregated data using BINARY SEARCH
    DATA(ls_found_agg) = lo_cut->find_aggregated_flight(
      it_aggregated = lt_aggregated iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_agg-total_seats exp = 500, msg = 'LH 0400 aggregated seats incorrect' ).

    " Test for non-existent aggregated entry
    DATA(ls_not_found_agg) = lo_cut->find_aggregated_flight(
      it_aggregated = lt_aggregated iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_not_found_agg-carrid, msg = 'Non-existent aggregated flight found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COLLECT` ist eine spezielle Anweisung für interne Tabellen, die Einträge nach ihren Schlüsselfeldern aggregiert. Ein wichtiger Nebeneffekt ist, dass `COLLECT` die interne Tabelle implizit nach den Schlüsselfeldern sortiert hält. Dies ermöglicht es, anschließend `READ TABLE ... BINARY SEARCH` auf der aggregierten Tabelle zu verwenden, um performant auf die aggregierten Daten zuzugreifen.
keywords: BINARY SEARCH, COLLECT, Internal Table, Aggregation, SORT

solution:
CLASS zcl_convert_amount_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency_data,
             amount_string TYPE string,
             exchange_rate TYPE f,
           END OF ty_currency_data.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_amount) TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2.

CLASS zcl_convert_amount_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_converted_amount.
    DATA(lv_amount_p) = CONV p( is_data-amount_string ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS cumulative_subtract
      IMPORTING

        it_numbers     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i

CLASS zcl_subtract_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD cumulative_subtract.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten, unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag).
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Schleife und die `SUBTRACT` Anweisung, um Tage zu iterieren und Wochentage zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workdays_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workdays_between.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d VALUE iv_date_from.
    DATA: lv_day_of_week  TYPE i.

    IF iv_date_from > iv_date_to.
      rv_workdays = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      lv_day_of_week = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).
      " 1 = Montag, 7 = Sonntag
      IF lv_day_of_week <> 6 AND lv_day_of_week <> 7.
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_current_date = iv_date_to.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Differenzen zwischen MAXSEATS und SEATSCC für alle Flüge in der `sflight` Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft betreffen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_sum_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_seat_differences
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_diff) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_sum_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_seat_differences.
    rv_total_diff = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_diff = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT total_diff = total_diff + ( ls_sflight-maxseats - ls_sflight-seatscc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Minuten.
hint: Subtrahieren Sie die Zeitstempel und teilen Sie das Ergebnis durch 60, um Minuten zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_timestamp_minutes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_minutes_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp_from TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp_to   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_timestamp_minutes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_minutes_difference.
    DATA(lv_seconds_diff) = iv_timestamp_to - iv_timestamp_from.
    rv_minutes = lv_seconds_diff / 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_positive_minutes FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_minutes FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_minutes FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_partial_minutes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_minutes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_timestamp_minutes( ).
    DATA(lv_ts_from) = '20231201100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_ts_to)   = '20231201100500.0000000'. " 5 Minuten später
    DATA(lv_minutes) = lo_cut->get_minutes_difference( iv_timestamp_from = lv_ts_from iv_timestamp_to = lv_ts_to ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_minutes exp = 5 msg = 'Differenz von 5 Minuten sollte korrekt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_minutes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_timestamp_minutes( ).
    DATA(lv_ts_from) = '20231201100500.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_ts_to)   = '20231201100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_minutes) = lo_cut->get_minutes_difference( iv_timestamp_from = lv_ts_from iv_timestamp_to = lv_ts_to ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_minutes exp = -5 msg = 'Negative Differenz von 5 Minuten sollte korrekt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_minutes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_timestamp_minutes( ).
    DATA(lv_ts) = '20231201100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_minutes) = lo_cut->get_minutes_difference( iv_timestamp_from = lv_ts iv_timestamp_to = lv_ts ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_minutes exp = 0 msg = 'Gleiche Zeitstempel sollten 0 Minuten ergeben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_partial_minutes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_timestamp_minutes( ).
    DATA(lv_ts_from) = '20231201100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_ts_to)   = '20231201100130.0000000'. " 1 Minute 30 Sekunden
    DATA(lv_minutes) = lo_cut->get_minutes_difference( iv_timestamp_from = lv_ts_from iv_timestamp_to = lv_ts_to ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_minutes exp = 1 msg = '1 Minute 30 Sekunden sollte 1 Minute ergeben (Integer-Division).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Subtraktion von zwei Zeitstempeln (`TIMESTAMPL`) ergibt ein Zeitintervall in Sekunden. Durch die anschließende Division durch 60 kann diese Differenz in Minuten umgerechnet werden. Da das Ergebnis einem Integer zugewiesen wird, erfolgt eine automatische Abrundung, was für die Berechnung ganzer Minuten nützlich ist.
keywords: SUBTRACT, TIMESTAMP, TIME DIFFERENCE, MATH, DATE/TIME, DIVISION

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen JSON-String, der Name und Alter enthält, in eine entsprechende ABAP-Struktur.

solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parser_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             name TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_json_parser_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_person_data.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).

  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_person.
    DATA(lv_json) = '{ "name": "Max Mustermann", "age": 30 }'.

    DATA(ls_person) = lo_parser->parse_person_data( lv_json ).

    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_json_parser_simple( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_clb_parse_json` zum Deserialisieren eines JSON-Strings in eine vordefinierte ABAP-Struktur. Die Methode `json_to_data` ist effizient und direkt, erfordert jedoch, dass die ABAP-Struktur die JSON-Felder exakt widerspiegelt. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `cx_clb_json_parse_error` ist essentiell für robuste Anwendungen.
keywords: JSON, Parsing, Deserialisierung, cl_clb_parse_json, Struktur

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_robustly.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    TRY.
        lo_parser->json_to_data( EXPORTING iv_json = iv_json_string CHANGING c_data = rs_data ).
      CATCH cx_clb_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: z.B. Loggen des Fehlers, Setzen von Default-Werten
        rs_data-value = 'Error: ' && lx_error->get_text( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String in ein generisches Datenreferenzobjekt, wenn die genaue Struktur zur Kompilierzeit unbekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` mit einem `DATA` Referenzobjekt und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parser_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_dynamic_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_parse_error.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        io_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parser_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_dynamic_json.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    CREATE DATA ro_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    lo_parser->json_to_data( EXPORTING iv_json = iv_json_string CHANGING c_data = ro_data_ref ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_struct> TYPE any STRUCTURE,
                   <fs_field>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_data_ref->* TO <fs_struct>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie eine Liste von JSON-Objekten und transformieren Sie diese in eine neue interne Tabelle, wobei Sie moderne ABAP-Ausdrücke wie `FOR` und `VALUE` verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie JSON-Parsing mit `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_item,
             item_code TYPE string,
             item_desc TYPE string,
             item_qty  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_raw_item.
    TYPES: tt_raw_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_item,
             material_number TYPE string,
             description     TYPE string,
             quantity        TYPE i,
             status_text     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_processed_item.
    TYPES: tt_processed_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_transform
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE tt_processed_items
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_transform.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_items) TYPE tt_raw_items.
    lo_parser->json_to_data( EXPORTING iv_json = iv_json_string CHANGING c_data = lt_raw_items ).

    rt_processed_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_items
                                  ( material_number = ls_raw-item_code,
                                    description     = ls_raw-item_desc,
                                    quantity        = ls_raw-item_qty,
                                    status_text     = COND string( WHEN ls_raw-item_qty > 0 THEN 'Available' ELSE 'Out of Stock' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_json_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_transformer->process_and_transform( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_processed INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_item1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item1-material_number exp = 'MAT001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item1-status_text exp = 'Available' ).

    READ TABLE lt_processed INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_item2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item2-material_number exp = 'MAT002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item2-status_text exp = 'Out of Stock' ).

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Objekten enthält, und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um einen aggregierten Wert (z.B. Gesamtsumme) zu berechnen.
hint: Parsen Sie das JSON in eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie dann `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
             qty   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_value) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_value.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    DATA(lt_items) TYPE tt_items.
    lo_parser->json_to_data( EXPORTING iv_json = iv_json_string CHANGING c_data = lt_items ).

    rv_total_value = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT total = 0
                                        FOR ls_item IN lt_items
                                        NEXT total = total + ( ls_item-price * ls_item-qty ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Objekten enthält, und verwenden Sie `WHEN` in einer `COND`-Expression, um einen Status basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu setzen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie JSON-Parsing mit `COND WHEN` für bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_cond_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_task,
             task_id   TYPE string,
             priority  TYPE string,
             is_urgent TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_task.
    TYPES: tt_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_task WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_task,
             task_id     TYPE string,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_processed_task.
    TYPES: tt_processed_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_task WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_tasks_with_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_tasks) TYPE tt_processed_tasks
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_cond_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_tasks_with_status.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_tasks) TYPE tt_tasks.
    lo_parser->json_to_data( EXPORTING iv_json = iv_json_string CHANGING c_data = lt_raw_tasks ).

    rt_processed_tasks = VALUE #( FOR ls_task IN lt_raw_tasks
                                  ( task_id = ls_task-task_id,
                                    status_text = COND string(
                                      WHEN ls_task-is_urgent = abap_true THEN 'High Priority - Urgent'
                                      WHEN ls_task-priority = 'HIGH' THEN 'High Priority'
                                      WHEN ls_task-priority = 'MEDIUM' THEN 'Medium Priority'
                                      ELSE 'Low Priority' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in einer Tabelle unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Initialisieren Sie den Akkumulator mit `VALUE` und addieren Sie im `REDUCE`-Ausdruck die `seatsocc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_seats FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_sflights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' seatsocc = 50 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 300
      msg = 'Die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze ist falsch.' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_empty exp = 0
      msg = 'Gesamtzahl für leere Tabelle sollte 0 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem ein Akkumulator schrittweise aktualisiert wird. Dies ist eine funktionale und moderne Art der Datenverarbeitung.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = VALUE string( COND #( 
      WHEN is_flight-seatsocc < is_flight-seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Gering ausgelastet'
      WHEN is_flight-seatsocc >= is_flight-seatsmax / 2 AND is_flight-seatsocc < is_flight-seatsmax THEN 'Normal ausgelastet'
      WHEN is_flight-seatsocc = is_flight-seatsmax THEN 'Voll ausgelastet'

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen GUI-Timer, der nach einer bestimmten Zeit (z.B. 3 Sekunden) ein Ereignis auslöst. Die Lösung soll die Einrichtung des Timers und die Behandlung des Ereignisses in einer Klasse zeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und seine Methoden `interval`, `run`, `stop`. Definieren Sie ein lokales Ereignis und einen Handler dafür.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_finished.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval_seconds TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    " Hier würde die Logik ausgeführt, die nach dem Timer-Intervall passieren soll.
    " Für dieses Beispiel lösen wir ein eigenes Ereignis aus.
    RAISE EVENT timer_finished.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_timer_triggered TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS test_timer_setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS handle_test_event FOR EVENT timer_finished OF zcl_gui_timer_example.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SET HANDLER handle_test_event FOR ME.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_timer_setup.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_example( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_test_event FOR lo_cut.

    " Timer starten (würde in einem echten GUI-Kontext laufen)
    lo_cut->start_timer( 3 ).

    " Da wir keinen echten GUI-Kontext haben, rufen wir den Handler direkt auf,
    " um die Logik zu testen, die der Timer auslösen würde.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde das Ereignis 'finished' von cl_gui_timer
    " nach 3 Sekunden ausgelöst und handle_timer_event aufgerufen.
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ). " Direkter Aufruf für Testzwecke

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_timer_triggered exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Das Timer-Ereignis sollte ausgelöst worden sein.' ).

    lo_cut->stop_timer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_test_event.
    mv_timer_triggered = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_gui_timer` ist eine Standardklasse für die ereignisgesteuerte Zeitsteuerung in SAP GUI-Anwendungen. Obwohl die Klasse selbst älter ist, ist die Verwendung von lokalen Ereignissen und Event-Handlern ein moderner und sauberer Weg, um asynchrone Prozesse in ABAP zu modellieren. Der Unit-Test demonstriert, wie man die durch den Timer ausgelöste Logik testet, auch ohne aktiven GUI-Kontext.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen GUI-Timer, dessen Intervall dynamisch basierend auf einer Berechnung (z.B. Anzahl der Flüge * 1 Sekunde, maximal 10 Sekunden) gesetzt wird. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` für die Berechnung des Intervalls.
hint: Berechnen Sie das Intervall mit `VALUE i( COND #( ... ) )` und setzen Sie es mit `mo_timer->interval`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_timer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_triggered.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_dynamic_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_flights TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_timer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_dynamic_timer.
    DATA(lv_calculated_interval) = VALUE i( COND #(
      WHEN iv_number_of_flights <= 0 THEN 1 " Mindestintervall
      WHEN iv_number_of_flights > 10 THEN 10 " Maximalintervall
      ELSE iv_number_of_flights ) ).

    mo_timer->interval = lv_calculated_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    RAISE EVENT timer_triggered.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_timer_triggered TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS test_dynamic_interval FOR TESTING.
    METHODS handle_test_event FOR EVENT timer_triggered OF zcl_dynamic_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SET HANDLER handle_test_event FOR ME.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_interval.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_timer( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_test_event FOR lo_cut.

    " Testfall: 5 Flüge -> 5 Sekunden Intervall
    lo_cut->start_dynamic_timer( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mo_timer->interval exp = 5
      msg = 'Intervall für 5 Flüge falsch.' ).
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_timer_triggered exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Timer-Ereignis sollte ausgelöst werden.' ).
    mv_timer_triggered = abap_false.
    lo_cut->stop_timer( ).

    " Testfall: 15 Flüge -> 10 Sekunden Intervall (maximal)
    lo_cut->start_dynamic_timer( 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mo_timer->interval exp = 10
      msg = 'Intervall für 15 Flüge falsch (Maximalwert).' ).
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_timer_triggered exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Timer-Ereignis sollte ausgelöst werden.' ).
    mv_timer_triggered = abap_false.
    lo_cut->stop_timer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_test_event.
    mv_timer_triggered = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die dynamische Intervallberechnung mit `VALUE` und `COND` mit der GUI-Timer-Funktionalität. Die moderne Syntax für die Intervallberechnung macht den Code sehr ausdrucksstark und vermeidet temporäre Variablen, während `cl_gui_timer` die zeitgesteuerte Ausführung in der GUI ermöglicht.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, VALUE, COND, GUI, Dynamisch, Intervall

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Aktualisierung eines Statusfeldes in einer GUI nach einer bestimmten Zeit, ausgelöst durch einen `cl_gui_timer`. Die Klasse soll einen internen Status verwalten, der durch das Timer-Ereignis geändert wird.
hint: Der Timer löst ein Ereignis aus, das eine Methode zur Statusaktualisierung aufruft. Der Status wird als Klassenattribut gespeichert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS status_updated EXPORTING VALUE(i_new_status) TYPE string.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_update_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_delay_seconds TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.
    METHODS get_current_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string VALUE 'Initial'.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_update_timer.
    mv_status = 'Warten auf Update...'.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_delay_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_status.
    rv_status = mv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    mv_status = 'Update abgeschlossen!'.
    RAISE EVENT status_updated EXPORTING i_new_status = mv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_received_status TYPE string.
    METHODS test_status_update FOR TESTING.
    METHODS handle_status_event FOR EVENT status_updated OF zcl_status_updater
      IMPORTING i_new_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SET HANDLER handle_status_event FOR ME.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_status_updater( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_status_event FOR lo_cut.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_current_status( ) exp = 'Initial'
      msg = 'Initialer Status falsch.' ).

    lo_cut->start_update_timer( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_current_status( ) exp = 'Warten auf Update...'
      msg = 'Status nach Start falsch.' ).

    " Simulieren des Timer-Ereignisses
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_current_status( ) exp = 'Update abgeschlossen!'
      msg = 'Status nach Update falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_received_status exp = 'Update abgeschlossen!'
      msg = 'Empfangener Status im Event-Handler falsch.' ).

    lo_cut->stop_timer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_status_event.
    mv_received_status = i_new_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
