Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine verzögerte Aktualisierung einer Flugtabelle. Nach dem Start eines Timers soll nach einer bestimmten Zeit eine gefilterte Flugtabelle neu geladen werden, wobei die Filterung mit `VALUE` und `FOR` erfolgt.
hint: Das Timer-Ereignis löst eine Methode aus, die `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` verwendet, um die Daten neu zu laden und zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delayed_flight_refresh DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    EVENTS flights_refreshed EXPORTING VALUE(i_refreshed_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_refresh_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_delay_seconds TYPE i
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflights
        iv_filter_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
    METHODS stop_timer.
    METHODS get_current_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mt_current_flights TYPE tt_sflights.
    DATA mt_source_flights TYPE tt_sflights.
    DATA mv_filter_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.

    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS refresh_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delayed_flight_refresh IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_refresh_timer.
    mt_source_flights = it_source_flights.
    mv_filter_carrid = iv_filter_carrid.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_delay_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_current_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    refresh_flights( ).
    RAISE EVENT flights_refreshed EXPORTING i_refreshed_flights = mt_current_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD refresh_flights.
    mt_current_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN mt_source_flights WHERE ( carrid = mv_filter_carrid )
                                  ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_received_flights TYPE zcl_delayed_flight_refresh=>tt_sflights.
    METHODS test_delayed_refresh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS handle_refresh_event FOR EVENT flights_refreshed OF zcl_delayed_flight_refresh
      IMPORTING i_refreshed_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SET HANDLER handle_refresh_event FOR ME.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delayed_refresh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delayed_flight_refresh( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_refresh_event FOR lo_cut.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_delayed_flight_refresh=>tt_sflights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' )
    ).

    lo_cut->start_refresh_timer( iv_delay_seconds = 1
                                 it_source_flights = lt_all_flights
                                 iv_filter_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_cut->get_current_flights( )
      msg = 'Tabelle sollte vor dem Timer-Ereignis leer sein.' ).

    " Simulieren des Timer-Ereignisses
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ).

    DATA(lt_refreshed) = lo_cut->get_current_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_refreshed ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Tabelle sollte nach dem Update 2 Einträge haben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( mt_received_flights ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Empfangene Tabelle im Event-Handler sollte 2 Einträge haben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_refreshed[1]-carrid exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Erster Eintrag der aktualisierten Tabelle falsch.' ).

    lo_cut->stop_timer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_refresh_event.
    mt_received_flights = i_refreshed_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `cl_gui_timer` für zeitgesteuerte Aktionen mit modernen ABAP-Ausdrücken (`VALUE`, `FOR`, `WHERE`) für die effiziente Datenverarbeitung. Ein Timer löst ein Ereignis aus, das wiederum eine Methode zur Filterung und Aktualisierung einer internen Tabelle aufruft. Dies ist ein häufiges Muster für die asynchrone Datenaktualisierung in GUI-Anwendungen.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb des Gruppen-Loops `VALUE #( FOR ... IN GROUP ... )` zum Zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_count.
    TYPES tt_carr_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carr_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = VALUE i( FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                 ( 1 ) ). " Zählt einfach die Elemente in der Gruppe
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = lv_count ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251203' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251203' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Fluggesellschaften gefunden werden.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-count exp = 3
      msg = 'Anzahl Flüge für LH falsch.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-count exp = 1
      msg = 'Anzahl Flüge für AA falsch.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'BA' INTO DATA(ls_ba_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ba_count-count exp = 1
      msg = 'Anzahl Flüge für BA falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `VALUE` und einem `FOR`-Ausdruck innerhalb des Gruppen-Loops kann man Aggregationen oder Zählungen pro Gruppe sehr elegant und effizient durchführen. Dies ersetzt komplexe `AT NEW`/`AT END`-Konstrukte.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, VALUE, Internal Tables, Gruppierung, Aggregation

Instructions: Finden Sie den niedrigsten Flugpreis (PRICE) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von REDUCE mit dem MIN-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Tabellenexpression mit FILTER und REDUCE, um den Minimalwert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_lh_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_min_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_lh_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_min_price = REDUCE #( INIT min_price = CONV sflight-price( '9999999999999999.99' ) " Initial high value
                           FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                           NEXT min_price = MIN( min_price, flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_min_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_min_price) = lo_cut->get_min_lh_price( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt LH-Flüge und der niedrigste Preis ist > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No LH flights found or price is 0' act = lv_min_price exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Min price should be greater than 0' act = ( lv_min_price > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung verwendet eine moderne Tabellenexpression mit `REDUCE` und dem `MIN`-Operator, um den niedrigsten Flugpreis effizient zu finden. `FILTER` wird verwendet, um nur die relevanten Flüge zu berücksichtigen. Dies ist kompakter und lesbarer als eine klassische LOOP-Anweisung.

hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...)` in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Iteration und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_filtered_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aa_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_aa_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_filtered_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aa_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_aa_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' )
                             ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                               connid = flight-connid,
                               fldate = flight-fldate,
                               price  = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aa_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_filtered_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_aa_flights) = lo_cut->get_aa_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find some AA flights' act = lt_aa_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_aa_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be AA' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE #(...)` Expression mit `FOR` und `WHERE` ermöglicht das deklarative Füllen einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Filterbedingung. Dies ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Art, Daten zu filtern und in eine neue Tabelle zu überführen, ohne explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den kleineren von zwei übergebenen Integer-Werten. Verwenden Sie den MIN-Operator.

CLASS zcl_min_of_two DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                                  iv_val2 TYPE i
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_minimum) TYPE i.

unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Test 2: 10, 5' act = lo_cut->get_minimum( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 5 ) exp = 5 ).

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer internen Tabelle von Strings nur die Strings hinzu, die nicht bereits in der Tabelle vorhanden sind. Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `APPEND` in einer Schleife oder einer Tabellenexpression.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `LINE_EXISTS` oder eine explizite `LOOP` mit `IF NOT LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_unique_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS append_unique IMPORTING it_new_strings TYPE tt_strings
                          CHANGING  ct_target_strings TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_unique_strings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_unique.
    ct_target_strings = VALUE #( BASE ct_target_strings
                                 FOR new_str IN it_new_strings
                                 WHERE ( NOT line_exists( ct_target_strings[ table_line = new_str ] ) )
                                 ( new_str ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_append_unique FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_unique.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_unique_strings( ).
    DATA lt_target TYPE zcl_append_unique_strings=>tt_strings VALUE `('A', 'B', 'C')`.
    DATA lt_new    TYPE zcl_append_unique_strings=>tt_strings VALUE `('B', 'D', 'E', 'A')`.

    lo_cut->append_unique( EXPORTING it_new_strings = lt_new
                           CHANGING  ct_target_strings = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 5 unique strings' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain D' act = line_exists( lt_target[ table_line = 'D' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain E' act = line_exists( lt_target[ table_line = 'E' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain A' act = line_exists( lt_target[ table_line = 'A' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt eine `VALUE #(...)` Expression mit `FOR` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, die `LINE_EXISTS` verwendet. Dies ermöglicht das effiziente Hinzufügen von Elementen zu einer internen Tabelle, wobei Duplikate vermieden werden, ohne eine explizite `LOOP` und `READ TABLE` zu schreiben. Es ist eine sehr deklarative und moderne Art der Tabellenmanipulation.
keywords: APPEND, Internal Tables, Unique, LINE_EXISTS, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Finden Sie das früheste Flugdatum (FLDATE) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'UA' (United Airlines) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Nutzen Sie REDUCE mit dem MIN-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `MIN` auf dem Datumsfeld, ähnlich wie bei numerischen Werten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_flight_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_ua_date RETURNING VALUE(rv_min_date) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_flight_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_ua_date.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_min_date = REDUCE #( INIT min_date = CONV sflight-fldate( '99991231' ) " Initial high date
                           FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = 'UA' )
                           NEXT min_date = MIN( min_date, flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_min_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_flight_date( ).
    DATA(lv_min_date) = lo_cut->get_min_ua_date( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt UA-Flüge und das früheste Datum ist nicht initial
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find a minimum date for UA flights' act = lv_min_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Min date should be a valid date' act = ( lv_min_date >= '19000101' AND lv_min_date <= '21001231' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ähnlich wie bei numerischen Werten kann der `MIN`-Operator in einer `REDUCE`-Expression auch für Datumsfelder verwendet werden, um das früheste Datum zu finden. Dies ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Methode, um Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, MINIMUM, Date, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten zurückgibt. Fügen Sie diese Objekte dann einer internen Tabelle hinzu, die in der aufrufenden Klasse definiert ist. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `APPEND` mit einer Methode, die eine Tabelle zurückgibt.
hint: Die Methode kann eine interne Tabelle zurückgeben, die direkt mit `APPEND LINES OF` oder einer `VALUE`-Expression zugewiesen werden kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS collect_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_flights.
    DATA(lo_provider) = NEW zcl_flight_provider( ).

    " Moderne Art, eine Tabelle von einer Methode zu erhalten und zuzuweisen
    rt_all_flights = lo_provider->get_flights_for_carrier( iv_carrid = iv_carrid ).

    " Alternativ, wenn bereits Daten in rt_all_flights vorhanden wären:
    " APPEND LINES OF lo_provider->get_flights_for_carrier( iv_carrid = iv_carrid ) TO rt_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_collect_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_collect_flights.
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW zcl_flight_consumer( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_consumer->collect_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should collect LH flights' act = lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie eine Methode eine interne Tabelle zurückgeben kann, die dann direkt einer anderen internen Tabelle zugewiesen oder mit `APPEND LINES OF` hinzugefügt werden kann. Dies fördert die Modularität und die Verwendung von funktionalen Methoden, was zu saubererem und besser wartbarem Code führt.
keywords: APPEND, Object Orientation, Internal Tables, Method Call

Instructions: Finden Sie die minimale Länge eines Strings in einer Liste von Strings. Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit dem MIN-Operator und STRLEN.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `MIN` und der Funktion `STRLEN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_string_length DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_min_length IMPORTING it_strings TYPE tt_strings
                           RETURNING VALUE(rv_min_len) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_string_length IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_length.
    IF it_strings IS INITIAL.
      rv_min_len = 0. " Oder eine andere Fehlerbehandlung
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_len = REDUCE #( INIT min_len = 999999 " Initial high value
                           FOR str IN it_strings
                           NEXT min_len = MIN( min_len, STRLEN( str ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_min_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_string_length( ).
    DATA lt_test_strings TYPE zcl_min_string_length=>tt_strings VALUE `('Hello', 'ABAP', 'World', 'SAP')`.
    DATA(lv_min_len) = lo_cut->get_min_length( lt_test_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min_len exp = 3 ). " 'SAP' hat Länge 3

    lt_test_strings = `('Longer String', 'Short', 'Medium')`.
    lv_min_len = lo_cut->get_min_length( lt_test_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min_len exp = 5 ). " 'Short' hat Länge 5
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_string_length( ).
    DATA lt_empty_strings TYPE zcl_min_string_length=>tt_strings.
    DATA(lv_min_len) = lo_cut->get_min_length( lt_empty_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min_len exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von `REDUCE` in Kombination mit der eingebauten Funktion `STRLEN` und dem `MIN`-Operator, um die minimale Stringlänge in einer internen Tabelle zu finden. Dies ist eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Methode, um solche Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, MINIMUM, STRLEN, String Processing, Aggregation

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer internen Tabelle von Strukturen nur die Zeilen hinzu, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt und deren Fluggesellschaft 'DL' (Delta Airlines) ist. Verwenden Sie eine `VALUE`-Expression mit `FOR`, `WHERE` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...)` mit `FOR`, `WHERE` für die Fluggesellschaft und `COND` für den Preis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_cond_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dl_premium_flights IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_cond_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dl_premium_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                          WHERE ( carrid = 'DL' AND flight-price > iv_min_price )
                          ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer internen Tabelle von Strings dynamisch Werte hinzu, die aus einer Methode stammen, die eine Liste von Strings zurückgibt. Die Methode soll nur Strings zurückgeben, die eine bestimmte Mindestlänge haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND LINES OF` mit dem Ergebnis einer funktionalen Methode, die eine `FILTER`-Expression enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_string_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_long_strings IMPORTING it_all_strings TYPE tt_strings
                                       iv_min_length  TYPE i
                               RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE tt_strings.

    METHODS append_filtered_strings IMPORTING it_source_strings TYPE tt_strings
                                            iv_min_length     TYPE i
                                    CHANGING  ct_target_strings TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_string_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_long_strings.
    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( it_all_strings USING KEY primary_key WHERE ( STRLEN( table_line ) >= iv_min_length ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD append_filtered_strings.
    APPEND LINES OF get_long_strings( it_all_strings = it_source_strings
                                      iv_min_length  = iv_min_length )
      TO ct_target_strings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_append_dynamic_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_dynamic_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_string_filter( ).
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_dynamic_string_filter=>tt_strings VALUE `('Apple', 'Banana', 'Cat', 'Dog', 'Elephant')`.
    DATA lt_target TYPE zcl_dynamic_string_filter=>tt_strings VALUE `('Initial')`.

    lo_cut->append_filtered_strings( EXPORTING it_source_strings = lt_source
                                              iv_min_length     = 5
                                     CHANGING  ct_target_strings = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 4 strings (Initial, Apple, Banana, Elephant)' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain Apple' act = line_exists( lt_target[ table_line = 'Apple' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should NOT contain Cat' act = line_exists( lt_target[ table_line = 'Cat' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `APPEND LINES OF` mit dem Ergebnis einer funktionalen Methode. Die Methode `get_long_strings` verwendet eine `FILTER`-Expression, um Strings basierend auf ihrer Länge zu filtern. Dies ist eine moderne und flexible Art, Daten dynamisch zu verarbeiten und zu internen Tabellen hinzuzufügen.
keywords: APPEND, FILTER, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Method Call, STRLEN, MINIMUM

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und finden Sie für jede Gruppe den niedrigsten Flugpreis. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` und `REDUCE` mit `MIN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppe `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_price_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_min_price_by_carrier,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             min_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_min_price_by_carrier.
    TYPES tt_min_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_min_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_min_prices) TYPE tt_min_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_price_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_prices.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_min_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                             ( carrid    = flight-carrid,
                               min_price = REDUCE #( INIT min_p = CONV sflight-price( '9999999999999999.99' )
                                                     FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                     NEXT min_p = MIN( min_p, member-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_min_prices_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_by_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_min_prices) = lo_cut->get_min_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find min prices for carriers' act = lt_min_prices ).

    " Beispielprüfung für eine bekannte Fluggesellschaft
    DATA(ls_lh_min) = VALUE #( lt_min_prices[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_lh_min IS SUPPLIED.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH min price should be > 0' act = ( ls_lh_min-min_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aa_min) = VALUE #( lt_min_prices[ carrid = 'AA' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_aa_min IS SUPPLIED.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'AA min price should be > 0' act = ( ls_aa_min-min_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY` mit einer `REDUCE`-Expression innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Dies ermöglicht es, Daten nach einem Kriterium zu gruppieren und dann Aggregationen (hier das Minimum) für jede Gruppe zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung in ABAP.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, REDUCE, MINIMUM, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten nur die Flüge hinzu, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität (SEATSMAX) haben. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE` und `APPEND` (implizit durch `VALUE #(...)`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...)` mit `FOR` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, die auf SEATSMAX prüft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_min_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_min_capacity IMPORTING iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_min_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_min_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( seatsmax >= iv_min_seats )
                             ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
                               connid   = flight-connid,
                               seatsmax = flight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten nur die Flüge hinzu, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen (SEATSOCC - SEATSMAX) haben. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE` und `LET` für die Berechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...)` mit `FOR`, `WHERE` und `LET` um die freien Sitze zu berechnen und zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_free_seats,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_free_seats.
    TYPES tt_flight_free_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_free_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_min_free_seats IMPORTING iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_free_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_min_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                          LET lv_free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc IN
                          WHERE ( lv_free_seats >= iv_min_free_seats )
                          ( carrid    = flight-carrid,
                            connid    = flight-connid,
                            free_seats = lv_free_seats ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_min_free_seats_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_free_seats_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_free_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_min_free_seats) = 50.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_min_free_seats( iv_min_free_seats = lv_min_free_seats ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find flights with min free seats' act = lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Free seats should be >= min_free_seats' act = ( ls_flight-free_seats >= lv_min_free_seats ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_min_price_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_price_for_conn IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                           iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_min_price_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price_for_conn.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_min_price = REDUCE #( INIT min_p = CONV sflight-price( '9999999999999999.99' )
                             FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid )
                             NEXT min_p = MIN( min_p, flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Struktur basierend auf einer Laufzeit-Typbeschreibung und füllen Sie deren Felder mit Werten, die ebenfalls dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und anschließend `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_value,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_value.
    TYPES ty_t_field_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_struct
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table
        it_field_values      TYPE ty_t_field_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data)       TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_struct.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_struct> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( it_field_definitions ).
        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_struct>.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          LOOP AT it_field_values INTO DATA(ls_field_value).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_value-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              <fs_field> = ls_field_value-value.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid type definition
        CLEAR rr_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_sflights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights   TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_sflights_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sort_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    IF ct_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_success = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if the field exists in the structure of the internal table
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_sort_field OF STRUCTURE ct_sflights[ 1 ] TO <fs_sort_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SORT ct_sflights BY (<fs_sort_field>).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false. "Sort field not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Expected ISO-8859-1 bytes for 'Hello World!äöü'

      IMPORTING
        iv_protocol   TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_host       TYPE string
        iv_port       TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_path       TYPE string OPTIONAL
        it_query_params TYPE ty_t_query_params OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_url_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_url.
    DATA: lt_query_params_raw TYPE cl_http_utility=>if_http_utility~query_params_table.

    LOOP AT it_query_params INTO DATA(ls_param).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_param-name value = ls_param-value ) TO lt_query_params_raw.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_url = cl_http_utility=>create_url(
      protocol     = iv_protocol
      host         = iv_host
      port         = iv_port
      path         = iv_path
      query_params = lt_query_params_raw
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null simuliert. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper`, um eine aussagekräftige Fehlermeldung zu generieren, die den Fehlerkontext enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error` und `cl_message_helper=>add_message_to_t100_exception`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_div_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_div_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      DATA(lo_exception) = NEW cx_sy_arithmetic_error( ).
      cl_message_helper=>add_message_to_t100_exception(
        EXPORTING
          i_msgid = 'SY'
          i_msgno = '000'
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgv1 = 'Division durch Null'
          i_msgv2 = |Zähler: { iv_numerator }, Nenner: { iv_denominator }|
        CHANGING
          c_exception = lo_exception
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION lo_exception.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_result) = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_divide_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_divide_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_divide_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_div_by_zero( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_arithmetic_error expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lx_arith->previous ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_arith->get_text( )
          exp = 'Division durch Null Zähler: 10, Nenner: 0'
          msg = 'Incorrect exception message'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_div_by_zero( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
        " No assert needed, just ensure no exception is raised
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'No exception expected for valid division' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `add_message_to_t100_exception` von `cl_message_helper` ermöglicht es, eine T100-Nachricht direkt in eine Ausnahme zu integrieren. Dies ist eine moderne und saubere Art, Fehlermeldungen zu standardisieren und den Kontext des Fehlers in der Ausnahme zu speichern, anstatt nur generische Texte zu verwenden. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die dynamische Nachrichtenerstellung verwendet.
keywords: EXCEPTION, MESSAGE, cl_message_helper, cx_sy_arithmetic_error, String Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die mehrere Validierungsfehler simuliert. Sammeln Sie alle Fehlermeldungen in einer internen Tabelle und geben Sie diese zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper=>add_message` und `cl_message_helper=>get_messages`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE i
        iv_value2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_data.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    IF iv_value1 <= 0.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG' " Assuming message class ZMSG exists with message 001
        i_msgno = '001'
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgv1 = 'Wert 1'
        i_msgv2 = 'muss positiv sein'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_value2 >= 100.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG' " Assuming message class ZMSG exists with message 002
        i_msgno = '002'
        i_msgty = 'W'
        i_msgv1 = 'Wert 2'
        i_msgv2 = 'ist zu hoch'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_messages = lo_msg_helper->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_collect_messages FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_collect_messages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_collector( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->validate_data( iv_value1 = 0 iv_value2 = 150 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_messages INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_msg1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_msg1-msgty exp = 'E' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_msg1-msgno exp = '001' ).

    READ TABLE lt_messages INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_msg2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_msg2-msgty exp = 'W' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_msg2-msgno exp = '002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_messages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_collector( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->validate_data( iv_value1 = 10 iv_value2 = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_messages ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_message_helper` bietet eine zentrale Instanz zur Sammlung und Verwaltung von Nachrichten. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Validierungsszenarien, wo mehrere Fehler oder Warnungen gesammelt und am Ende gemeinsam präsentiert werden sollen, anstatt die Verarbeitung bei der ersten Nachricht abzubrechen. Die Verwendung von `NEW cl_message_helper()` stellt sicher, dass die Nachrichteninstanz lokal und isoliert ist.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem Datenbanksystemtyp unterschiedliche Open SQL-Abfragen auf die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` ausführt. Wenn es sich um HANA handelt, soll eine spezifische HANA-Funktion (simuliert) verwendet werden, ansonsten eine Standardabfrage.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_db_sys=>get_db_type` und `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` für die bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_conditional_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             db_info  TYPE string, " To store DB specific info
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_conditional_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    DATA(lv_db_type) = cl_db_sys=>get_db_type( ).
    DATA(lv_db_info) = |DB Type: { lv_db_type }|.

    IF lv_db_type = 'HDB'. " HANA Database
      " Simulate a HANA-specific SQL feature, e.g., a specific function
      SELECT FROM sflights
        FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency,
               @lv_db_info AS db_info " Add DB info to result
        INTO TABLE @rt_sflight_data
        UP TO 5 ROWS.
      " In a real scenario, you might use a native SQL function here
      " e.g., SELECT ..., NATIVE_SQL_FUNCTION(field) AS special_field ...
    ELSE. " Other databases
      SELECT FROM sflights
        FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency,
               @lv_db_info AS db_info " Add DB info to result
        INTO TABLE @rt_sflight_data
        UP TO 5 ROWS.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_application_error
      IMPORTING
        i_error_code TYPE string
        i_error_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_application_error.
    DATA(lv_db_type) = cl_db_sys=>get_db_type( ).

    " Simulate a detailed error message using cl_message_helper
    " Assuming message class ZMSG exists with message 005: 'Application Error: &1 - &2. DB Type: &3'
    DATA: ls_message_vars TYPE symsg.
    ls_message_vars-msgid = 'ZMSG'.
    ls_message_vars-msgno = '005'.
    ls_message_vars-msgty = 'E'.
    ls_message_vars-msgv1 = i_error_code.
    ls_message_vars-msgv2 = i_error_text.
    ls_message_vars-msgv3 = lv_db_type.

    DATA(lv_full_error_message) = cl_message_helper=>get_message_text(
      EXPORTING
        i_message = ls_message_vars
    ).

    " In a real scenario, this would write to a log table (e.g., BAL_LOG_CREATE)
    " or an external logging service. For this example, we just output to console.
    cl_demo_output=>display( lv_full_error_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob eine bestimmte Datenbankfunktion (simuliert durch einen String-Parameter) vom aktuellen Datenbanksystem unterstützt wird. Geben Sie eine entsprechende Nachricht zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_db_sys=>get_db_type` und eine `CASE`-Anweisung, um die Unterstützung zu simulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_capability_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_db_function_support
      IMPORTING
        iv_function_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_supported) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_support_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_function_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_capability_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_db_function_support.
    DATA(lv_db_type) = cl_db_sys=>get_db_type( ).

    CASE lv_db_type.
      WHEN 'HDB'. " HANA Database
        IF iv_function_name = 'NATIVE_HANA_FUNCTION' OR iv_function_name = 'SQL_SCRIPT_PROC'.
          rv_is_supported = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_supported = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        IF iv_function_name = 'STANDARD_SQL_FUNCTION'.
          rv_is_supported = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_supported = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_support_message.
    DATA(lv_db_type) = cl_db_sys=>get_db_type( ).
    IF check_db_function_support( iv_function_name = iv_function_name ).
      rv_message = |Funktion '{ iv_function_name }' wird auf { lv_db_type } unterstützt.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Funktion '{ iv_function_name }' wird auf { lv_db_type } NICHT unterstützt.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_hana_function_support.

        msg = 'HANA function should not be supported on non-HANA'

        substring = 'NICHT unterstützt'
        in = lo_cut->get_support_message( 'NATIVE_HANA_FUNCTION' )

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_capability_check( ).

    IF lv_db_type <> 'HDB'.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
        substring = 'unterstützt'

    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme fängt und die darin enthaltenen Nachrichten (falls vorhanden) mit `cl_message_helper` extrahiert und anzeigt.

CLASS zcl_exc_msg_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_display_error
      IMPORTING
        io_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_msg_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_display_error.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_msg_helper->get_messages_from_exception( io_exception ).

    IF lt_messages IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_demo_output=>display( 'Extrahierte Nachrichten aus Ausnahme:' ).
      LOOP AT lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
        cl_demo_output=>display( |{ ls_message-msgty } { ls_message-msgid }/{ ls_message-msgno }: { cl_message_helper=>get_message_text( ls_message ) }| ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      cl_demo_output=>display( |Keine spezifischen Nachrichten in Ausnahme gefunden. Text: { io_exception->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_message_helper=>add_message_to_t100_exception(
      EXPORTING

        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgv1 = 'Testfehler'

        c_exception = lo_exception
    ).

    DATA(lv_old_output) = cl_demo_output=>get_output( ).

    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid

    me->message_helper = message_helper.

CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_data_processing_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_value <= 0.
      DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
      lo_msg_helper->add_message(
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG' " Assuming message class ZMSG exists with message 007: 'Fehler: Wert &1 muss positiv sein.'
        i_msgno = '007'
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgv1 = iv_value
      ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_data_processing_error(
        textid = zcx_data_processing_error=>default_text
        message_helper = lo_msg_helper
      ).
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate successful processing
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Nachricht mit Platzhaltern generiert und den formatierten Text zurückgibt, ohne die Nachricht anzuzeigen. Verwenden Sie String-Templates für die Nachrichtenvariablen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_message_helper=>get_message_text` und String-Templates für die `symsgv` Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_format_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_message
      IMPORTING
        i_msgid TYPE symsgid
        i_msgno TYPE symsgno
        i_param1 TYPE string OPTIONAL
        i_param2 TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_format_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_message.
    DATA: ls_message TYPE symsg.
    ls_message-msgid = i_msgid.
    ls_message-msgno = i_msgno.
    ls_message-msgty = 'I'. " Informational message type
    ls_message-msgv1 = i_param1.
    ls_message-msgv2 = i_param2.

    rv_formatted_text = cl_message_helper=>get_message_text(
      EXPORTING
        i_message = ls_message
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle, bei denen der Flugpreis über einem bestimmten Wert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_sflight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_sflight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_expensive_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights. " Copy table
    DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE price > iv_max_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_sflight_price=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '250.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0402'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '50.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_sflight_price( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_expensive_flights( it_flights = lt_flights iv_max_price = '150.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = '50.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...` Syntax ist eine effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit, mehrere Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Sie ist performanter als das Schleifen über die Tabelle und das Löschen einzelner Zeilen.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Tables, WHERE, sflights

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem Schlüsselfeld.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...`. Die Tabelle muss vorher sortiert sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_data = it_data.
    SORT rt_unique_data BY key_field. " Must be sorted for ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_data COMPARING key_field.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_delete_duplicates=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'A' value_field = 'Value1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'A' value_field = 'Value2' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'B' value_field = 'Value3' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'A' value_field = 'Value4' ) TO lt_data. " This 'A' is not adjacent
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'C' value_field = 'Value5' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'C' value_field = 'Value6' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( it_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-key_field exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-key_field exp = 'A' ). " The non-adjacent 'A' remains
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-key_field exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-key_field exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine performante Anweisung, um redundante, direkt aufeinanderfolgende Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Feldern zu sortieren, da die Anweisung nur *angrenzende* Duplikate berücksichtigt.
keywords: DELETE, ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Tables, SORT

Instructions: Löschen Sie eine spezifische Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle, die durch einen eindeutigen Schlüssel identifiziert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_by_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS delete_item_by_id
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_item
        iv_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_by_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_item_by_id.
    rt_modified_items = it_items.
    DELETE TABLE rt_modified_items WITH TABLE KEY id = iv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_item FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_item.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_delete_by_key=>tt_item.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'Item A' ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 'Item B' ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 value = 'Item C' ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_by_key( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_item_by_id( it_items = lt_items iv_id = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result[ id = 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result[ id = 3 ] ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_check) = lt_result[ id = 2 ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Item with ID 2 should have been deleted.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Item with ID 2 successfully deleted.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Löschen einer Zeile mittels `DELETE TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...` ist die modernste und effizienteste Methode, um eine Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, wenn der Schlüssel bekannt ist. Bei Tabellen mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel ist dies besonders performant.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Tables, TABLE KEY, UNIQUE KEY

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flugverbindungen aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT`, die vor einem bestimmten Datum liegen und einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM ... WHERE ...`. Achten Sie auf die Transaktionssicherheit (COMMIT/ROLLBACK).
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_sflight_db DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_old_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_sflight_db IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights.
    DELETE FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      AND fldate < iv_fldate.
    rv_deleted_count = sy-dbcnt. " Number of deleted rows
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_db_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'XX',
          mv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Insert test data
    mv_fldate = sy-datum - 10. " 10 days ago
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '001' fldate = mv_fldate price = '100' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '003' fldate = mv_fldate - 5 price = '150' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Clean up test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_db_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_sflight_db( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_old_flights( iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_fldate = sy-datum - 7 ). " Delete flights older than 7 days ago

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 2 ). " Should delete 2 flights (10 days ago and 15 days ago)

    " Verify remaining flights
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_count) WHERE carrid = mv_carrid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE FROM dbtab WHERE ...` Anweisung ist der Standardweg, um Daten aus Datenbanktabellen zu entfernen. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` ist moderne Syntax (ab 7.40). Es ist entscheidend, `COMMIT WORK` nach dem Löschen aufzurufen, um die Änderungen dauerhaft zu speichern, oder `ROLLBACK WORK` im Fehlerfall.
keywords: DELETE, Database Tables, SFLIGHT, WHERE, COMMIT WORK

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Wert in einer anderen Liste von Werten enthalten ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife mit `DELETE` und `line_exists` für die Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_with_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_items_in_list
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_item
        it_ids_to_delete TYPE tt_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_with_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_items_in_list.
    rt_modified_items = it_items.

    LOOP AT rt_modified_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).
      IF line_exists( it_ids_to_delete[ table_line = <fs_item>-id ] ).
        DELETE rt_modified_items. " Deletes the current line in the loop
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_items_in_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_items_in_list.
    DATA: lt_items TYPE zcl_delete_with_loop=>tt_item.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'Apple' ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 'Banana' ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 value = 'Cherry' ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 4 value = 'Date' ) TO lt_items.

    DATA: lt_ids_to_delete TYPE zcl_delete_with_loop=>tt_ids.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_ids_to_delete.
    APPEND 4 TO lt_ids_to_delete.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_items_in_list( it_items = lt_items it_ids_to_delete = lt_ids_to_delete ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result[ id = 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result[ id = 3 ] ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_check) = lt_result[ id = 2 ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Item with ID 2 should have been deleted.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Item with ID 2 successfully deleted.' ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_check2) = lt_result[ id = 4 ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Item with ID 4 should have been deleted.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Item with ID 4 successfully deleted.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `DELETE ... WHERE ...` oft die bevorzugte Methode ist, kann in komplexeren Szenarien, in denen die Löschbedingung eine Prüfung gegen eine andere Tabelle erfordert, eine Schleife mit `DELETE` innerhalb der Schleife verwendet werden. Die `line_exists` Tabellenexpression (ab 7.40) ermöglicht eine effiziente Prüfung, ob ein Eintrag in der Liste der zu löschenden IDs vorhanden ist.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Tables, LOOP, line_exists, Table Expression

Instructions: Berechnen Sie ein Datum, das 30 Tage, 2 Monate und 1 Jahr in der Zukunft liegt, ausgehend vom aktuellen Systemdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `ADD_DAYS`, `ADD_MONTHS` und `ADD_YEARS` der Klasse `CL_HRPAD_DATE_COMPUTATIONS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_add_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_future_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_add_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_future_date.
    DATA(lo_date_comp) = cl_hrpad_date_computations=>get_instance( ).

    DATA(lv_date_plus_30_days) = lo_date_comp->add_days(
                                    iv_date = iv_start_date
                                    iv_days = 30 ).

    DATA(lv_date_plus_2_months) = lo_date_comp->add_months(
                                     iv_date = lv_date_plus_30_days
                                     iv_months = 2 ).

    rv_future_date = lo_date_comp->add_years(
                       iv_date = lv_date_plus_2_months
                       iv_years = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_add_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lv_expected_date) = cl_hrpad_date_computations=>get_instance( )->add_days( iv_date = lv_start_date iv_days = 30 ).
    lv_expected_date = cl_hrpad_date_computations=>get_instance( )->add_months( iv_date = lv_expected_date iv_months = 2 ).
    lv_expected_date = cl_hrpad_date_computations=>get_instance( )->add_years( iv_date = lv_expected_date iv_years = 1 ).

    DATA(lv_result_date) = lo_cut->calculate_future_date( lv_start_date ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum und einem Referenzdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_DIFFERENCE_IN_YEARS` oder eine Kombination aus `GET_DIFFERENCE_IN_DAYS` und Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_age_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age_in_years
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_reference_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_age_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age_in_years.
    DATA(lo_date_comp) = cl_hrpad_date_computations=>get_instance( ).

    " CL_HRPAD_DATE_COMPUTATIONS does not have a direct GET_DIFFERENCE_IN_YEARS method
    " that accounts for full years. A common approach is to check month/day.
    rv_age = lo_date_comp->get_difference_in_years(
               iv_date1 = iv_reference_date
               iv_date2 = iv_birth_date ).

    " Adjust if birthday hasn't occurred yet in the reference year
    IF iv_reference_date < lo_date_comp->add_years(
                               iv_date = iv_birth_date
                               iv_years = rv_age ).
      rv_age = rv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age3 exp = 35 ).

Die Klasse `CL_HRPAD_DATE_COMPUTATIONS` bietet zwar keine direkte Methode dafür, aber ihre `ADD_YEARS` und `GET_DIFFERENCE_IN_YEARS` Methoden können kombiniert werden, um eine robuste Lösung zu implementieren.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum ein gültiges Datum ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `CHECK_DATE` der Klasse `CL_HRPAD_DATE_COMPUTATIONS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_date.
    DATA(lo_date_comp) = cl_hrpad_date_computations=>get_instance( ).
    TRY.
        lo_date_comp->check_date( iv_date = iv_date ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_hrpad_invalid_date.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_validation( ).

    " Valid dates
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_date( '20250101' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_date( '20240229' ) exp = abap_true ). " Leap year

    " Invalid dates
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_date( '20250229' ) exp = abap_false ). " Not a leap year
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_date( '20250431' ) exp = abap_false ). " April has 30 days
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_date( '20251301' ) exp = abap_false ). " Invalid month
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_date( '00000000' ) exp = abap_false ). " Initial date is invalid
  ENDMETHOD.

Sie berücksichtigt alle Kalenderregeln, einschließlich Schaltjahren, und ist der bevorzugte Weg, um die Datenintegrität zu gewährleisten, anstatt eigene, fehleranfällige Prüfungen zu implementieren. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine statische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) filtert und nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `FILTER`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flights_by_carrier

        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight

      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_non_existing_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_existing_carrier.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = zcl_flight_filter=>get_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights for LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First flight carrier incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    DATA(lt_filtered) = zcl_flight_filter=>get_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = 'UA' ).

CLASS zcl_rest_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_status_code TYPE i.
    CLASS-METHODS is_success_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE ty_status_code
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_success) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_rest_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_success_status.
    rv_is_success = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN iv_status_code >= cl_rest_status_code=>ok AND
           iv_status_code < cl_rest_status_code=>multiple_choices
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine statische Methode, die die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` berechnet. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife über die gefilterte Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_total_passengers_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_reduced
        iv_carrier     TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers_by_carrier.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von HTTP-Statuscodes als Eingabe nimmt und prüft, ob alle Codes gültige, von `cl_rest_status_code` definierte Codes sind.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Liste und prüfen Sie gegen bekannte Konstanten oder eine Hilfsmethode von `cl_rest_status_code` (falls vorhanden, sonst manuelle Prüfung).
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_status_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_status_code TYPE i.
    TYPES: tt_status_codes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status_code WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS are_all_status_codes_valid
      IMPORTING
        it_status_codes TYPE tt_status_codes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_all_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_known_status_code
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE ty_status_code
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_known) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_status_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_all_status_codes_valid.
    rv_all_valid = abap_true.
    LOOP AT it_status_codes INTO DATA(lv_status_code).
      IF NOT is_known_status_code( lv_status_code ).
        rv_all_valid = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_known_status_code.
    " This is a simplified check. In a real scenario, one might check against
    " a comprehensive list of all CL_REST_STATUS_CODE constants or a range.
    " For demonstration, we check common ranges.
    rv_is_known = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN ( iv_status_code >= 100 AND iv_status_code < 600 )
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
    " More specific checks could be added, e.g.,
    " WHEN iv_status_code = cl_rest_status_code=>ok OR
    "      iv_status_code = cl_rest_status_code=>created OR ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine statische Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen quadriert und nur die Ergebnisse zurückgibt, die größer als 100 sind. Nutzen Sie `MAP` (implizit durch `FOR` mit `VALUE`) und `FILTER`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Transformation und `WHERE` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_number TYPE i.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    rt_processed_numbers = VALUE #(
      FOR lv_num IN it_numbers
      WHERE ( lv_num * lv_num > 100 )
      ( lv_num * lv_num )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine statische Factory-Methode, die ein Objekt einer REST-Antwortklasse erzeugt und den HTTP-Statuscode auf 'Not Found' setzt, wenn keine Daten gefunden wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-METHODS` für die Factory und `cl_rest_status_code=>not_found`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_response DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_status_code TYPE i.
    DATA mv_status_code TYPE ty_status_code READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_payload     TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE ty_status_code
        iv_payload     TYPE string OPTIONAL.

    CLASS-METHODS create_success_response
      IMPORTING
        iv_payload TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_response) TYPE REF TO zcl_rest_response.

    CLASS-METHODS create_not_found_response
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_id TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_response) TYPE REF TO zcl_rest_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_response IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_status_code = iv_status_code.
    mv_payload     = iv_payload.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_success_response.
    ro_response = NEW zcl_rest_response(
      iv_status_code = cl_rest_status_code=>ok
      iv_payload     = iv_payload
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_not_found_response.
    DATA(lv_message) = COND string(
      WHEN iv_resource_id IS NOT INITIAL
      THEN |Resource with ID '{ iv_resource_id }' not found.|
      ELSE |Resource not found.|
    ).
    ro_response = NEW zcl_rest_response(
      iv_status_code = cl_rest_status_code=>not_found
      iv_payload     = lv_message
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
