    DATA(lo_response) = zcl_rest_response=>create_success_response( iv_payload = '{"data":"some_data"}' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_response msg = 'Response object should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->mv_status_code exp = cl_rest_status_code=>ok msg = 'Status code for success incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->mv_payload exp = '{"data":"some_data"}' msg = 'Payload for success incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_not_found_with_id.
    DATA(lo_response) = zcl_rest_response=>create_not_found_response( iv_resource_id = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_response msg = 'Response object should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->mv_status_code exp = cl_rest_status_code=>not_found msg = 'Status code for not found incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->mv_payload exp = 'Resource with ID ''123'' not found.' msg = 'Payload for not found with ID incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->mv_payload exp = 'Resource not found.' msg = 'Payload for not found without ID incorrect' ).

explanation: Diese Klasse demonstriert das Factory-Pattern mit `CLASS-METHODS` zur Erzeugung von `zcl_rest_response`-Objekten. Die Factory-Methoden (`create_success_response`, `create_not_found_response`) kapseln die Logik zur Initialisierung der Antwortobjekte und setzen dabei die passenden HTTP-Statuscodes mithilfe von `cl_rest_status_code`. String-Templates und `COND` werden für die dynamische Fehlermeldung verwendet.

CLASS zcl_rtti_create_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_create_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_set_data.
    DATA lo_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_descr = CAST cl_abap_datadescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ) ).
        CREATE DATA lo_descr->get_data_reference( ) ASSIGN <fs_data>.
        <fs_data> = iv_value. " This will cause a dump if type is not compatible, e.g. 'I' and 'ABC'

      CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem gegebenen Zeilentypnamen und fügen Sie eine Zeile hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und Feld-Symbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_create_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_add_row IMPORTING iv_line_type_name TYPE string iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_create_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_add_row.
    DATA lo_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.
    DATA lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_line_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_line_type_name ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_line_descr ).
        CREATE DATA lo_table_descr->get_data_reference( ) ASSIGN <fs_table>.

        CREATE DATA lo_line_descr->get_data_reference( ) ASSIGN <fs_line>.
        <fs_line> = iv_value. " This will cause a dump if type is not compatible
        APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_compatible.
    DATA(lo_data_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    DATA lo_target_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    TRY.
        lo_target_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_target_type_name ).
        IF lo_data_descr->kind = lo_target_descr->kind AND lo_data_descr->get_name( ) = lo_target_descr->get_name( ).
          rv_is_compatible = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        rv_is_compatible = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: add_numbers IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i,
             concatenate_strings IMPORTING iv_str1 TYPE string iv_str2 TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object iv_method_name TYPE string iv_param1 TYPE any OPTIONAL iv_param2 TYPE any OPTIONAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_result = iv_str1 && iv_str2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter TYPE abap_parmbind.
    DATA lo_result_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    IF iv_param1 IS SUPPLIED.
      ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM1'. " Annahme: Parametername für add_numbers
      ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_importing.
      GET REFERENCE OF iv_param1 INTO ls_parameter-value.
      APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_param2 IS SUPPLIED.
      ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM2'. " Annahme: Parametername für add_numbers
      ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_importing.
      GET REFERENCE OF iv_param2 INTO ls_parameter-value.
      APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA lo_result_ref TYPE string. " Annahme: Rückgabewert ist STRING

    CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
      RECEIVING RESULTS INTO lo_result_ref.

    ASSIGN lo_result_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_result>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_result = <fs_result>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle mit einer modernen ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_sum_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_sum_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_filter_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_num_filter_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die dynamische Zuweisung von Komponenten zwischen zwei internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, aber logisch zusammengehörigen Daten, unter Verwendung von CL_ABAP_CORRESPONDING.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_CORRESPONDING=>CREATE und die MAP-Optionen für die Feldzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_source,
        carrid_src TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid_src TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate_src TYPE s_date,
        seatsocc_src TYPE s_seatsocc,
      END OF ty_s_source,
      ty_t_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_source WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_s_target,
        airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
        flight_date TYPE s_date,
        occupied_seats TYPE s_seatsocc,
      END OF ty_s_target,
      ty_t_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_t_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_t_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = it_source
      destination = rt_target
      mapping     = VALUE cl_abap_corresponding=>mapping_table_type(
        ( src = 'CARRID_SRC' dest = 'AIRLINE_ID' )
        ( src = 'CONNID_SRC' dest = 'FLIGHT_NUM' )
        ( src = 'FLDATE_SRC' dest = 'FLIGHT_DATE' )
        ( src = 'SEATSOCC_SRC' dest = 'OCCUPIED_SEATS' )
      )
    ).
    lo_corresponding->execute( EXPORTING source = it_source IMPORTING destination = rt_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_mapping=>ty_t_source,
          lt_target TYPE zcl_corresponding_mapping=>ty_t_target.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid_src = 'LH' connid_src = '0400' fldate_src = '20251203' seatsocc_src = 100 ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid_src = 'AA' connid_src = '0010' fldate_src = '20251204' seatsocc_src = 150 ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_mapping( ).
    lt_target = lo_cut->map_flight_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-occupied_seats exp = 150 ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: CL_ABAP_CORRESPONDING ermöglicht eine flexible und dynamische Zuweisung von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, selbst wenn die Feldnamen unterschiedlich sind. Dies reduziert manuellen Zuweisungscode und erhöht die Wartbarkeit, insbesondere bei komplexen Datenstrukturen. Die Verwendung von Constructor Expressions wie VALUE für die Mapping-Tabelle macht den Code sehr kompakt.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CORRESPONDING, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Mapping, VALUE

Instructions: Zeigen Sie, wie man Daten aus der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle in einem CL_GUI_ALV_GRID anzeigt, wobei die Datenbeschaffung und -übergabe moderne ABAP-Syntax verwendet.
hint: Verwenden Sie Open SQL mit Inline-Deklaration und CL_GUI_ALV_GRID->SET_TABLE_FOR_FIRST_DISPLAY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_display_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_display_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    " Fetch data using modern Open SQL
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights) UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Create container (dummy for unit test, real container in report)
      " In a real report, a custom container on a screen would be used.
      CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'. "#EC CI_SUBRC
      CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid EXPORTING i_parent = lo_container.

      " Prepare field catalog (optional, ALV can derive it)
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline ID' )
        ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Connection' )
        ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' )
        ( fieldname = 'PRICE' text = 'Price' )
        ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' text = 'Currency' )
      ).

      " Display ALV
      CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          is_variant                    = VALUE disvariant( report = sy-repid handle = 'ALV_SFLIGHTS' )
          i_save                        = 'A'
          i_default                     = 'X'
          is_layout                     = VALUE lvc_s_layo( cwidth_opt = 'X' )
          it_fieldcatalog               = lt_fieldcat
        CHANGING
          it_outtab                     = lt_sflights
        EXCEPTIONS
          program_error                 = 1
          cntl_error                    = 2
          cntl_system_error             = 3
          sel_without_online            = 4
          selfield_don_not_exist        = 5
          col_not_exist                 = 6
          others                        = 7.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Handle error
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    " This unit test can only verify the instantiation and method call, not the visual display.
    " For real ALV testing, integration tests are needed.
    " We'll check if the method runs without dump.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_display_sflights( ).
    lo_cut->display_sflights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( 1 = 1 " Placeholder, actual assertion is difficult without UI interaction

solution:
CLASS zcl_for_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_summary,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_s_flight_summary,
      ty_t_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE sflights_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_t_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_summary = VALUE ty_t_flight_summary(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der FOR-Operator ist ein mächtiger Konstruktorausdruck, der es erlaubt, interne Tabellen basierend auf den Elementen einer anderen Tabelle zu erzeugen oder zu transformieren. Er ersetzt explizite LOOP-Anweisungen und macht den Code funktionaler, kompakter und oft performanter, da die Schleifenverarbeitung intern optimiert werden kann.
keywords: FOR, Constructor Expression, Internal Tables, Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise in einer SFLIGHTS-Tabelle unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Initialisieren Sie eine Variable mit dem REDUCE-Operator und addieren Sie in jeder Iteration den Preis hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE sflights_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( price = '100.00' ) 
      ( price = '250.50' )
      ( price = '50.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ein Konstruktorausdruck, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Er ist ideal für Summierungen, Zählungen oder die Ermittlung von Min/Max-Werten und ersetzt explizite Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen. Dies führt zu sehr prägnantem und funktionalem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, Constructor Expression, Aggregation, Math, Functional Programming

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Die moderne Open SQL-Syntax ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration von Zielvariablen (DATA(...)) und erfordert das Escape-Zeichen '@' vor Host-Variablen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit, reduziert die Notwendigkeit expliziter Deklarationen und hilft, Syntaxfehler zu vermeiden, da der Compiler die Typen besser überprüfen kann. Es ist der empfohlene Stil für neue Entwicklungen.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining, indem Sie mehrere funktionale Methodenaufrufe aneinanderreihen, um eine Zeichenkette zu manipulieren.
hint: Erstellen Sie funktionale Methoden, die 'ME' zurückgeben, um weitere Methodenaufrufe zu ermöglichen.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS replace_char IMPORTING iv_old TYPE c iv_new TYPE c RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    TRANSLATE mv_string TO UPPER CASE.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_char.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old IN mv_string WITH iv_new.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lv_result) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( 'hello world' )->to_upper( )->replace_char( iv_old = 'O' iv_new = 'X' )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HELLX WXRLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenverkettung) ist ein Designmuster, bei dem Methoden so implementiert werden, dass sie eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (ME) zurückgeben. Dies ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Anweisung aneinanderzureihen, was den Code flüssiger und lesbarer macht. Es ist ein Merkmal des funktionalen Programmierstils in der objektorientierten Entwicklung.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Functional Programming, OO

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator, um einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zuzuweisen.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc
        iv_seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_seatsocc >= iv_seatsmax THEN 'Fully Booked'
      WHEN iv_seatsocc >= iv_seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Partially Booked'
      ELSE 'Available'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_days_to_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE d.

CLASS zcl_date_calculation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_future_date.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date(

    ).

      iv_tstmp = lv_future_timestamp
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie in einer ABAP-Klasse Methoden, die das Zoomen und Verschieben (Panning) in einem `CL_GUI_ECL_2DVIEWER` Control steuern.
hint: Verwenden Sie Methoden wie `ZOOM_IN`, `ZOOM_OUT`, `PAN_LEFT`, `PAN_RIGHT` des `CL_GUI_ECL_2DVIEWER` Controls.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_navigation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zoom_in_viewer
      IMPORTING
        io_ecl_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer OPTIONAL.
    METHODS zoom_out_viewer
      IMPORTING
        io_ecl_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer OPTIONAL.
    METHODS pan_viewer
      IMPORTING
        io_ecl_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer OPTIONAL
        iv_direction  TYPE c LENGTH 1 " 'L', 'R', 'U', 'D'
        iv_distance   TYPE i DEFAULT 10.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_action TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_navigation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zoom_in_viewer.
    " In a real scenario, io_ecl_viewer->ZOOM_IN( ) would be called.
    IF io_ecl_viewer IS BOUND.
      " io_ecl_viewer->zoom_in( ).
    ENDIF.
    mv_last_action = 'ZOOM_IN'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zoom_out_viewer.
    " In a real scenario, io_ecl_viewer->ZOOM_OUT( ) would be called.
    IF io_ecl_viewer IS BOUND.
      " io_ecl_viewer->zoom_out( ).
    ENDIF.
    mv_last_action = 'ZOOM_OUT'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD pan_viewer.
    " In a real scenario, specific pan methods would be called.
    IF io_ecl_viewer IS BOUND.
      CASE iv_direction.
        WHEN 'L'. " io_ecl_viewer->pan_left( iv_distance ).
        WHEN 'R'. " io_ecl_viewer->pan_right( iv_distance ).
        WHEN 'U'. " io_ecl_viewer->pan_up( iv_distance ).
        WHEN 'D'. " io_ecl_viewer->pan_down( iv_distance ).
        WHEN OTHERS. " Invalid direction
      ENDCASE.
    ENDIF.
    mv_last_action = |PAN_{iv_direction}_{iv_distance}|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_text_in_editor
      IMPORTING
        io_abap_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit OPTIONAL
        iv_search_string TYPE string
        iv_start_line    TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_start_col     TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_found_position) TYPE ty_s_position.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_position,
             line TYPE i,
             col  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_position.
    DATA mt_mock_code_lines TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_text_in_editor.
    CLEAR rs_found_position.
    IF io_abap_editor IS BOUND.
      " In a real scenario, io_abap_editor->FIND_STRING would be called.
      " For this example, we simulate the search on mock data.
      " io_abap_editor->find_string(
      "   EXPORTING
      "     string = iv_search_string
      "     start_line = iv_start_line
      "     start_column = iv_start_col
      "   IMPORTING
      "     found_line = rs_found_position-line
      "     found_column = rs_found_position-col
      " ).
    ENDIF.

    " Simulate search on internal mock data
    LOOP AT mt_mock_code_lines INTO DATA(lv_line) FROM iv_start_line.
      DATA(lv_line_idx) = sy-tabix.
      DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
      IF lv_line_idx = iv_start_line.
        lv_offset = iv_start_col - 1.
      ENDIF.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_search_string IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset OF lv_line MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_match_offset).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rs_found_position-line = lv_line_idx.
        rs_found_position-col = lv_match_offset + 1.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Suchen Sie nach Methoden wie `SET_LAYER_VISIBILITY` oder `SET_OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES` mit Layer-spezifischen Parametern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_layers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_layer_visibility
      IMPORTING
        io_ecl_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer OPTIONAL
        iv_layer_name TYPE string
        iv_visible    TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_layer_status,
             layer_name TYPE string,
             is_visible TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_s_layer_status.
    DATA mt_layer_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_layer_status WITH UNIQUE KEY layer_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_layers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_layer_visibility.
    IF io_ecl_viewer IS BOUND.
      " In a real scenario, io_ecl_viewer->SET_LAYER_VISIBILITY would be called.
      " (Assuming such a method exists or can be simulated via SET_VIEW_ATTRIBUTES)
      " io_ecl_viewer->set_layer_visibility( layer_name = iv_layer_name visible = iv_visible ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_layer) = VALUE ty_s_layer_status( layer_name = iv_layer_name is_visible = iv_visible ).
    MODIFY TABLE mt_layer_status FROM ls_layer.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT ls_layer INTO TABLE mt_layer_status.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von klassenbasierten Ausnahmen mit `TRY...CATCH` und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` für eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RAISING zcx_negative_value.
    METHODS handle_process IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_negative_value DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_negative_value EXPORTING textid = zcx_negative_value=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Weitere Verarbeitung...
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_process.
    TRY.
        process_value( iv_value ).
        rv_message = |Wert { iv_value } erfolgreich verarbeitet.|.
      CATCH zcx_negative_value.
        rv_message = |Fehler: Negativer Wert { iv_value } nicht erlaubt.|.
      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_message = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sammeln und Verarbeiten von Nachrichten mit `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` anstelle direkter `MESSAGE` Anweisungen.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER`, fügen Sie Nachrichten mit `ADD_MESSAGE` hinzu und lesen Sie sie mit `GET_MESSAGES` aus.

CLASS zcl_message_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_and_get_messages IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_message_helper=>ty_t_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_and_get_messages.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgv1 = 'Eingabe' iv_msgv2 = 'darf nicht leer sein' ).
    ELSEIF iv_input = 'WARN'.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgv1 = 'Achtung' iv_msgv2 = 'spezielle Eingabe' ).
    ELSE.
      lo_msg_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '000' iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgv1 = 'Erfolg' iv_msgv2 = 'Eingabe verarbeitet' ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_messages = lo_msg_helper->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle filtern und transformieren, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR <wa> IN <itab> WHERE ( <condition> ) ( <transformation> ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid connid cityfrom cityto price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND price > 100 )
                          ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
                            connid   = flight-connid,
                            cityfrom = flight-cityfrom,
                            cityto   = flight-cityto,
                            price    = flight-price * '1.1' ) ). " 10% Preiserhöhung
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_transform FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_results FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_transform.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_flights[ 1 ]-price > 100 * '1.1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_results.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 'XX' ). " Nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert Boilerplate-Code im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit `APPEND`.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, FOR, VALUE, FILTER, TRANSFORMATION, DECLARATIVE

hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ( field1, field2, ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             month  TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_agg.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE ty_t_flight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_t_flight_raw.
    SELECT carrid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 200 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_raw) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight_raw-carrid,
                                                            month  = ls_flight_raw-fldate+4(2) ) ASCENDING
                                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA lv_total_price TYPE s_price VALUE 0.
      DATA lv_flight_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_group_member-price.
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_agg( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                  month  = ls_group_key-month
                                  total_price = lv_total_price
                                  flight_count = lv_flight_count ) TO rt_aggregated_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation_logic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->aggregate_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_aggregated ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob für 'LH' im Monat '03' Daten existieren
    READ TABLE lt_aggregated WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' month = '03' INTO DATA(ls_agg_lh_03).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_agg_lh_03-total_price > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_agg_lh_03-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT GROUP`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine effiziente und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist ideal für die Vorbereitung von Daten für Berichte oder Diagramme, da Aggregationen direkt im Schleifendurchlauf durchgeführt werden können, ohne manuelle Sortierungen oder zusätzliche Hilfstabellen.
keywords: AGGREGATION, GROUP BY, LOOP AT GROUP, DATA PROCESSING, CHARTING, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE type( INIT result = initial_value FOR <wa> IN <itab> NEXT result = result + <expression> )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_t_flight_price.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Er ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung, was den Code deutlich kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht als traditionelle `LOOP`- und `SUM`-Konstrukte.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `COND` und `SWITCH` Ausdrücke, um Werte basierend auf Bedingungen zuzuweisen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND type( WHEN condition THEN value ELSE value )` und `SWITCH type( operand WHEN value THEN result ELSE result )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_switch_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_cond IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_status_switch IMPORTING iv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1 RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_cond.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_value < 0 THEN 'Negativ'
      WHEN iv_value = 0 THEN 'Null'
      ELSE 'Positiv'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status_switch.
    rv_status = SWITCH string(
      iv_char
      WHEN 'A' THEN 'Anfang'
      WHEN 'M' THEN 'Mitte'
      WHEN 'Z' THEN 'Ende'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_optional_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS greet_user IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string OPTIONAL iv_greeting TYPE string DEFAULT 'Hallo' RETURNING VALUE(rv_full_greeting) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_optional_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD greet_user.
    IF iv_name IS INITIAL.
      rv_full_greeting = |{ iv_greeting } unbekannter Benutzer!|.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT anzeigt. Nutzen Sie VALUE und FOR für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ... ) für die Aggregation und bereiten Sie die Daten für cl_gui_chart_engine_win auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_flights_by_carr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_by_carr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
                                   num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = get_flight_counts( ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_count IN lt_flight_counts
                               ( category = ls_count-carrid
                                 value    = ls_count-num_flights ) ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( |Fluggesellschaft| ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( |Anzahl Flüge| ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Liniendiagramm, das die Summe der Flugpreise pro Monat für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHT anzeigt. Nutzen Sie REDUCE für die Aggregation.
hint: Aggregieren Sie die Daten mit REDUCE, um die Summe der Preise pro Monat zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_prices_by_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_price,
             month TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_monthly_price.
    TYPES: tt_monthly_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_monthly_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_monthly_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_monthly_prices) TYPE tt_monthly_price.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_prices_by_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_monthly_prices = REDUCE tt_monthly_price(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_monthly_price( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      LET lv_month = ls_flight-fldate+4(2) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_monthly_price(
        FOR ls_entry IN result
        WHERE ( month = lv_month )
        ( ls_entry )
        ( COND #( WHEN line_exists( result[ month = lv_month ] ) THEN
                    VALUE ty_monthly_price( month = lv_month
                                            total_price = result[ month = lv_month ]-total_price + ls_flight-price )
                  ELSE
                    VALUE ty_monthly_price( month = lv_month
                                            total_price = ls_flight-price ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_monthly_prices) = get_monthly_prices( iv_carrid = iv_carrid ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_price IN lt_monthly_prices
                               ( category = ls_price-month
                                 value    = ls_price-total_price ) ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_line ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Flugpreise pro Monat für { iv_carrid }| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( |Monat| ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( |Gesamtpreis| ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_monthly_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_prices_by_month( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_monthly_prices( 'LH' ).

    " Assertions would depend on actual SFLIGHT data for 'LH'
    " For example, if there's data for month '03' with total price 1000:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ month = '03' ]-total_price exp = 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " SFLIGHT might be empty in test systems

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Tortendiagramm, das die Verteilung der Buchungen für Flüge mit einem bestimmten Status (z.B. 'C' für confirmed) aus SFLIGHT anzeigt. Nutzen Sie FILTER für die Vorselektion.
hint: Filtern Sie die Daten mit FILTER, um nur die relevanten Buchungen zu berücksichtigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_bookings_by_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_status,
             status TYPE sbook-resrc,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_booking_status.
    TYPES: tt_booking_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_booking_distribution
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE sbook-resrc
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_distribution) TYPE tt_booking_status.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        iv_status         TYPE sbook-resrc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_bookings_by_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_booking_distribution.
    DATA: lt_sbook TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, bookid, customid, custtype, smoker, luggweight, wunit, seats, passform, passname, passbirth, resrc
      FROM sbook
      INTO TABLE @lt_sbook.

    DATA(lt_filtered_bookings) = FILTER sbook_tab FROM lt_sbook WHERE resrc = iv_status.

    rt_distribution = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_booking IN lt_filtered_bookings GROUP BY ( status = ls_booking-resrc ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( status = GROUP KEY-status
                                   count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_distribution) = get_booking_distribution( iv_status = iv_status ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_distribution
                               ( category = ls_entry-status
                                 value    = ls_entry-count ) ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_pie ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Buchungsverteilung für Status '{ iv_status }'| ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_labels DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        it_data           TYPE tt_data
        iv_chart_type     TYPE i DEFAULT cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_labels IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN it_data
                               ( category = ls_data-label
                                 value    = ls_data-value ) ).

    DATA(lv_max_value) = REDUCE decfloat34(
      INIT max_val = 0
      FOR ls_entry IN lt_chart_data
      NEXT max_val = nmax( max_val = max_val val = ls_entry-value ) ).

    DATA(lv_title) = |Datenanalyse: Höchster Wert { lv_max_value }|.
    DATA(lv_x_axis) = |Kategorie|.
    DATA(lv_y_axis) = |Wert|.

    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( lv_title ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( lv_x_axis ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( lv_y_axis ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    lo_cut->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_line

          )->set_title( 'Monatliche Umsätze'
          )->set_axis_labels( iv_x_label = 'Monat' iv_y_label = 'Umsatz' ).

    " In a real scenario, you'd assert the internal state of lo_cut after chaining.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_chart_type exp = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_line ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_title exp = 'Monatliche Umsätze' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->mt_data ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, dessen Datenpunkte basierend auf einer Bedingung unterschiedlich aufbereitet werden (z.B. Flugstatus 'C' oder 'X'). Nutzen Sie COND.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_cond_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             status TYPE sbook-resrc,
             value  TYPE decfloat34,

    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_chart_cond_data IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sbook IN it_sbook
                         ( carrid = ls_sbook-carrid
                           status = ls_sbook-resrc
                           value  = COND #( WHEN ls_sbook-resrc = 'C' THEN 100 " Confirmed gets 100 points
                                            WHEN ls_sbook-resrc = 'X' THEN 50  " Cancelled gets 50 points
                                            ELSE 10 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,

        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_conditional_data) = get_conditional_data( it_sbook = it_sbook ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_conditional_data
                               ( category = |{ ls_entry-carrid }-{ ls_entry-status }|
                                 value    = ls_entry-value ) ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Bedingte Datenpunkte nach Status| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( |Flug/Status| ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( |Wert| ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_chart_switch_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_categorized_flight,
             category TYPE string,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

        parent = lo_container

        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_categorized_data) = get_categorized_data( it_sflight = it_sflight ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_categorized_data
                               ( category = ls_entry-category
                                 value    = ls_entry-value ) ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_pie ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Flugpreise nach Kontinent| ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, indem Sie den Chart-Engine-Objekt direkt mit NEW instanziieren und sofort eine Methode aufrufen.
hint: Nutzen Sie DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( ... )->set_chart_type(...).
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_new_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_data,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_simple_data.
    TYPES: tt_simple_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simple_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        it_data           TYPE tt_simple_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_new_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN it_data
                               ( category = ls_data-label
                                 value    = ls_data-value ) ).

    " Instanziierung mit NEW und sofortiger Methodenaufruf
    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win(
      parent = lo_container
    )->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar
    )->set_data( lt_chart_data
    )->set_title( |Einfaches Diagramm mit NEW|
    )->set_x_axis_label( |Element|
    )->set_y_axis_label( |Menge| ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Monat aus SFLIGHT anzeigt. Nutzen Sie eine verschachtelte FOR-Schleife mit GROUP BY für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte FOR-Ausdrücke mit GROUP BY, um Daten nach zwei Kriterien zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_month_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             month  TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_month_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_month_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_month_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_month
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_month_count.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_month.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_carr IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_carr-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 FOR GROUPS OF ls_month IN ls_carr GROUP BY ( month = ls_month-fldate+4(2) ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
                                   month = GROUP KEY-month
                                   num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = get_flight_counts_by_month( ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_count IN lt_flight_counts
                               ( category = |{ ls_count-carrid }-{ ls_count-month }|
                                 value    = ls_count-num_flights ) ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Monat| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( |Fluggesellschaft/Monat| ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( |Anzahl Flüge| ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, das die durchschnittliche Auslastung von Flügen pro Fluggesellschaft anzeigt. Nutzen Sie REDUCE für die Berechnung des Durchschnitts.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um die Summe der belegten Sitze und die Gesamtzahl der Flüge zu aggregieren und daraus den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_occupancy.
    TYPES: tt_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_occupancy
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_occupancy.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 LET lv_total_occupied = REDUCE i(
                                   INIT sum_occ = 0
                                   FOR ls_member IN GROUP
                                   NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + ls_member-seatsocc )
                                     lv_total_max = REDUCE i(
                                   INIT sum_max = 0
                                   FOR ls_member IN GROUP
                                   NEXT sum_max = sum_max + ls_member-seatsmax ) IN
                                 ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
                                   avg_occupancy = COND decfloat34(
                                     WHEN lv_total_max > 0 THEN CONV decfloat34( lv_total_occupied ) / lv_total_max * 100
                                     ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_occupancy) = get_average_occupancy( ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_occupancy
                               ( category = ls_entry-carrid
                                 value    = ls_entry-avg_occupancy ) ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Durchschnittliche Flugauslastung pro Fluggesellschaft| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( |Fluggesellschaft| ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( |Auslastung (%)| ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft anzeigt, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen haben. Nutzen Sie FILTER und GROUP BY.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_filtered_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        iv_min_flights    TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_filtered_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
      ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
        num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).

    rt_flight_counts = FILTER #( lt_grouped_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE num_flights > iv_min_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = get_filtered_flight_counts( iv_min_flights = iv_min_flights ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_count IN lt_flight_counts
                               ( category = ls_count-carrid
                                 value    = ls_count-num_flights ) ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Fluggesellschaften mit mehr als { iv_min_flights } Flügen| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( |Fluggesellschaft| ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( |Anzahl Flüge| ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, das die Top N Fluggesellschaften nach Gesamtumsatz anzeigt. Nutzen Sie REDUCE und SORT für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Aggregieren Sie den Umsatz mit REDUCE, sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse und wählen Sie die Top N aus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_top_n_revenue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_revenue,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_revenue TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_carr_revenue.
    TYPES: tt_carr_revenue TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_revenue WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_revenue
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_top_n_revenue) TYPE tt_carr_revenue.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        iv_top_n          TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_top_n_revenue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_revenue.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_revenue_by_carr) = VALUE tt_carr_revenue(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
      ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
        total_revenue = REDUCE decfloat34(
          INIT sum_price = 0
          FOR ls_member IN GROUP
          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_member-price ) ) ).

    SORT lt_revenue_by_carr BY total_revenue DESCENDING.

    rt_top_n_revenue = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_top_n AND i <= lines( lt_revenue_by_carr )
                                 ( lt_revenue_by_carr[ i ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_top_n_revenue) = get_top_n_revenue( iv_top_n = iv_top_n ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_top_n_revenue
                               ( category = ls_entry-carrid
                                 value    = ls_entry-total_revenue ) ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Top { iv_top_n } Fluggesellschaften nach Umsatz| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( |Fluggesellschaft| ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( |Gesamtumsatz| ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sorted_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
                                   num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).

    SORT rt_flight_counts BY carrid ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = get_sorted_flight_counts( ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_count IN lt_flight_counts
                               ( category = ls_count-carrid
                                 value    = ls_count-num_flights ) ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar ).

    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( |Fluggesellschaft| ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( |Anzahl Flüge| ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft anzeigt, wobei die Datenpunkte nur für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft hervorgehoben werden. Nutzen Sie COND für die Hervorhebung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_highlight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_highlight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             highlight_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_count_highlight.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count_highlight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_highlight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        iv_highlight_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_highlight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highlighted_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_highlight(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
      ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
        num_flights = GROUP SIZE
        highlight_category = COND string(
          WHEN GROUP KEY-carrid = iv_highlight_carrid THEN 'Highlighted'
          ELSE 'Normal' ) ) ).

    rt_flight_counts = lt_grouped_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_chart_data_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_highlighted_counts) = get_highlighted_flight_counts( iv_highlight_carrid = iv_highlight_carrid ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_highlighted_counts
                               ( category = ls_entry-carrid
                                 value    = ls_entry-num_flights
                                 series   = ls_entry-highlight_category ) ). " Use series for highlighting

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (Hervorhebung: { iv_highlight_carrid })| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_label( |Fluggesellschaft| ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_label( |Anzahl Flüge| ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei gegebenen Datumsangaben (Enddatum - Startdatum).
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_tstmp` um Datumsangaben in Zeitstempel zu konvertieren und die Differenz in Sekunden zu ermitteln, die dann in Tage umgerechnet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_diff_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_days_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_diff_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_days_difference.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_from) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date_from ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp_to)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date_to ).

    DATA(lv_seconds_diff) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
                                       tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_to
                                       tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_from
                                     ).
    rv_days = lv_seconds_diff / ( 24 * 60 * 60 ). " Convert seconds to days
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme der Mengen in einer internen Tabelle und ziehe davon einen festen Rabattwert ab. Nutze dabei funktionale Programmierung.
hint: Verwende den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu bilden, und dann eine einfache Subtraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sub DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id  TYPE i,
             qty TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_net_quantity
      IMPORTING
        it_items      TYPE tt_items
        iv_discount   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_net_qty) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sub IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_net_quantity.
    DATA(lv_total_qty) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_item> IN it_items
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_item>-qty
    ).
    rv_net_qty = lv_total_qty - iv_discount.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_itab_reduce_sub=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 qty = 10 )
      ( id = 2 qty = 20 )
      ( id = 3 qty = 30 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_net_quantity( it_items = lt_items iv_discount = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 45 msg = 'Reduction and subtraction failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: SUBTRACT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechne den Nettobetrag, indem Sie einen Rabatt von einem Bruttobetrag abziehen. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei die Währung und die Dezimalstellenverschiebung.

CLASS zcl_curr_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_net_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_gross_amount TYPE bapi_curr
        iv_discount     TYPE bapi_curr
        iv_currency     TYPE bapi_currcy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_net_amount) TYPE bapi_curr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_curr_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_net_amount.
    " In ABAP werden CURR-Felder automatisch mit der Währungstabelle TCURX behandelt.
    " Die Subtraktion erfolgt korrekt unter Berücksichtigung der Dezimalstellen.
    rv_net_amount = iv_gross_amount - iv_discount.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      iv_discount      = '10.25'
      iv_currency     = 'EUR'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '90.25' msg = 'Currency subtraction failed for EUR' ).

Das System handhabt die Dezimalstellenverschiebung basierend auf der zugehörigen Währungseinheit (Feld vom Typ `CUKY`) automatisch, was eine korrekte und moderne Art der Währungsberechnung darstellt.
keywords: SUBTRACT, Currency, Decimal Shift, BAPI_CURR

Instructions: Berechne die Differenz in vollen Minuten zwischen zwei Uhrzeiten (Endzeit - Startzeit).
hint: Konvertiere die Uhrzeiten in Sekunden seit Mitternacht und subtrahiere sie, um die Differenz in Minuten zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_diff_minutes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_minutes_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_time_from TYPE t
        iv_time_to   TYPE t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_diff_minutes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_minutes_difference.
    DATA(lv_seconds_from) = ( iv_time_from+0(2) * 3600 ) + ( iv_time_from+2(2) * 60 ) + iv_time_from+4(2).
    DATA(lv_seconds_to)   = ( iv_time_to+0(2) * 3600 ) + ( iv_time_to+2(2) * 60 ) + iv_time_to+4(2).

    DATA(lv_seconds_diff) = lv_seconds_to - lv_seconds_from.
    rv_minutes = lv_seconds_diff / 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_time_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_time_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_time_diff_minutes( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_minutes_difference( iv_time_from = '100000' iv_time_to = '103000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 msg = 'Time difference calculation failed (30 min)' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_minutes_difference( iv_time_from = '100000' iv_time_to = '110000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 60 msg = 'Time difference calculation failed (60 min)' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_minutes_difference( iv_time_from = '103000' iv_time_to = '100000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -30 msg = 'Time difference calculation failed (negative)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Uhrzeiten in Sekunden umrechnet, um eine präzise Differenz zu berechnen. Die anschließende Division durch 60 liefert die Differenz in Minuten. Dies ist eine gängige und effiziente Methode für Zeitberechnungen in ABAP.
keywords: SUBTRACT, Time, Calculation

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_str IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utf8_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_utf8_to_str( ).
    " 'Hallo Welt!' in UTF-8 (hex: 48616c6c6f2057656c7421)
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = '48616C6C6F2057656C7421'X.
    DATA(lv_result_string) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_xstring_to_string( lv_utf8_xstring ).

Die Methode `create` ermöglicht die Angabe der Quellcodepage, während `read` die eigentliche Konvertierung durchführt.

Instructions: Konvertiere einen 4-Byte-Integer-Wert, der im Big-Endian-Format vorliegt, in das systemeigene Little-Endian-Format (oder umgekehrt, je nach Systemarchitektur).
hint: Setze den `endian`-Parameter in `cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create` auf `cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big` oder `cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_endian DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_big_endian_to_system
      IMPORTING
        iv_big_endian_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integer) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_endian IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_big_endian_to_system.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8' " Codepage ist hier irrelevant, da nur Endian-Konvertierung für Binärdaten
      endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big
    ).
    lo_conv->read( EXPORTING input = iv_big_endian_xstring IMPORTING data = rv_integer ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_endian_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_endian_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_endian( ).
    " Integer 256 (0x0100) in Big-Endian: 01 00 (hex)
    DATA(lv_big_endian_256) = '00000100'X. " Assuming 4-byte integer
    DATA(lv_result_256) = lo_cut->convert_big_endian_to_system( lv_big_endian_256 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_256 exp = 256 msg = 'Big-Endian to system conversion failed for 256' ).

    " Integer 1 (0x0001) in Big-Endian: 00 01 (hex)
    DATA(lv_big_endian_1) = '00000001'X.
    DATA(lv_result_1) = lo_cut->convert_big_endian_to_system( lv_big_endian_1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_1 exp = 1 msg = 'Big-Endian to system conversion failed for 1' ).

    " Integer 65535 (0xFFFF) in Big-Endian: 00 00 FF FF (hex)
    DATA(lv_big_endian_65535) = '0000FFFF'X.
    DATA(lv_result_65535) = lo_cut->convert_big_endian_to_system( lv_big_endian_65535 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_65535 exp = 65535 msg = 'Big-Endian to system conversion failed for 65535' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` ist nicht nur für Codepage-Konvertierungen zuständig, sondern kann auch die Byte-Reihenfolge (Endianness) von Binärdaten anpassen. Durch die Angabe von `endian = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big` wird sichergestellt, dass die Eingabedaten als Big-Endian interpretiert und bei Bedarf in das systemeigene Format konvertiert werden.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_in_ce, Endian, Byte Order, XSTRING, Integer

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Lesen des Inhalts einer Datei, die in der Codepage 'ISO-8859-1' gespeichert ist, und konvertieren Sie diesen Inhalt in einen ABAP-String.

CLASS zcl_file_conv_iso DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_iso_file_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_content_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_xml_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_extract.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.

        DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_xpath( iv_xpath ).
        IF lo_node IS BOUND.
          rv_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error cx_xml_xpath_error.
        rv_value = 'ERROR'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen XML-String aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) unter Verwendung von `cl_xml_document`.
hint: Erstellen Sie XML-Knoten und Attribute dynamisch und fügen Sie diese dem Dokument hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_sflight_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sflight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
        name = 'Flights'
        type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
          name = 'Flight'
          type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element ).
      lo_root->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

      lo_flight_node->set_attribute( name = 'Carrier' value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_flight_node->set_attribute( name = 'Connection' value = ls_sflight-connid ).

      DATA(lo_date_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
          name = 'Date'
          type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element ).
      lo_date_node->set_value( CONV string( ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_date_node ).

      DATA(lo_price_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
          name = 'Price'
          type = if_xml_node=>co_node_element ).
      lo_price_node->set_value( CONV string( ls_sflight-price ) ).
      lo_price_node->set_attribute( name = 'Currency' value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lo_flight_node->append_child( lo_price_node ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_xml_document->render_pretty_print( ).
    rv_xml_string = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lo_xml_document->get_xstring( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_xml.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_xml_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_xml_generator=>tt_sflight(
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251203' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251204' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) ).

    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_generator->generate_sflight_xml( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Generated XML should not be empty' act = lv_xml IS INITIAL ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'XML should contain Price node' pattern = '<Price Currency="EUR">100.00</Price>' act = lv_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die interne Tabelle im Test ist ein Beispiel für moderne ABAP-Syntax.
