Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String, der Namespaces verwendet, und extrahieren Sie einen Wert mittels XPath, der die Namespaces berücksichtigt.
hint: Registrieren Sie Namespaces bei `cl_xml_document` vor der XPath-Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_namespace_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_extract_ns
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
        it_namespaces TYPE cl_xml_document=>tt_namespace_binding OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespace_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_extract_ns.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_xml_string ) ).

        IF it_namespaces IS NOT INITIAL.
          LOOP AT it_namespaces INTO DATA(ls_ns).
            lo_xml_document->set_namespace_binding(
                prefix = ls_ns-prefix
                uri    = ls_ns-uri ).
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_xpath( iv_xpath ).
        IF lo_node IS BOUND.
          rv_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error cx_xml_xpath_error.
        rv_value = 'ERROR'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_with_namespace.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_xml_namespace_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<ns:root xmlns:ns="http://example.com/ns"><ns:item>Namespace Value</ns:item></ns:root>`.
    DATA(lv_xpath) = `/ns:root/ns:item`.

        ( prefix = 'ns' uri = 'http://example.com/ns' ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_parser->parse_and_extract_ns(
        iv_xml_string = lv_xml
        iv_xpath      = lv_xpath
        it_namespaces = lt_namespaces ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Namespace Value' msg = 'Value should be extracted with namespace' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_without_namespace_fail.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_xml_namespace_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<ns:root xmlns:ns="http://example.com/ns"><ns:item>Namespace Value</ns:item></ns:root>`.
    DATA(lv_xpath) = `/ns:root/ns:item`. " XPath with prefix, but no binding provided
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_parser->parse_and_extract_ns(
        iv_xml_string = lv_xml
        iv_xpath      = lv_xpath ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' msg = 'Should return empty if namespace not bound' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei XML-Dokumenten mit Namespaces ist es entscheidend, diese vor der XPath-Abfrage im `cl_xml_document` zu registrieren. Die Methode `set_namespace_binding` ermöglicht dies. Ohne die korrekte Bindung schlagen XPath-Abfragen, die Namespace-Präfixe verwenden, fehl.
keywords: XML, Namespace, XPath, cl_xml_document, Advanced

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, und formatieren Sie diese als String.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             flight_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
                              ( flight_id = |{ ls_raw-carrid }-{ ls_raw-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_flight_transformer=>tt_sflight_raw(
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two entries expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-flight_id exp = 'LH-00000400' msg = 'First flight ID incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-flight_id exp = 'AA-00000017' msg = 'Second flight ID incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transform_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_flight_transformer=>tt_sflight_raw( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( lt_raw ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_transformed msg = 'Empty table should result in empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` und `VALUE` ist eine sehr mächtige und kompakte Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu transformieren. Sie ermöglicht die Iteration über eine Quelltabelle und die direkte Konstruktion einer neuen Zieltabelle mit den gewünschten Daten und Formaten, hier unter Verwendung von String Templates (`|...|`) und `ALPHA = OUT` für die Konvertierung von numerischen Feldern.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, String Templates, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten Status-String für einen Flug, der je nach Status ('C' für Cancelled, 'D' für Delayed, sonst 'On Time') eine andere Nachricht anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie String Templates und den `COND` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_status TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_status.
    rv_status_text = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid ALPHA = OUT } is { 
      COND string(
        WHEN iv_status = 'C' THEN 'Cancelled'
        WHEN iv_status = 'D' THEN 'Delayed'
        ELSE 'On Time' ) 
    }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_status_cancelled FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_delayed FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_on_time FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_cancelled.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_flight_status_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_formatter->format_flight_status( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_status = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Flight LH 00000400 is Cancelled.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_delayed.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_flight_status_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_formatter->format_flight_status( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_status = 'D' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Flight AA 00000017 is Delayed.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_on_time.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_flight_status_formatter( ).

explanation: String Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine flexible und lesbare Syntax zur String-Formatierung. In Kombination mit dem `COND` Operator können bedingte Ausdrücke direkt in den String eingebettet werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: String Templates, COND, Conditional Logic, String Processing

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften in eine interne Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Open SQL Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result)` und `WHERE carrid IN @it_carriers`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_single_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_multiple_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_single_carrier.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_flight_reader=>tt_carriers( ( 'LH' ) ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_carriers( lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Should find flights for LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First flight should be LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_multiple_carriers.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_flight_reader=>tt_carriers( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_carriers( lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Should find flights for LH and AA' ).
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) THEN c = c + 1 ).
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' ) THEN c = c + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_lh_count > 0 msg = 'Should contain LH flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_aa_count > 0 msg = 'Should contain AA flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_no_data.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_flight_reader=>tt_carriers( ( 'XX' ) ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_carriers( lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Should find no flights for nonexistent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne Open SQL Syntax ermöglicht die direkte Zuweisung von Abfrageergebnissen an eine inline deklarierte interne Tabelle (`INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result)`). Die Verwendung von Host-Variablen in der `WHERE`-Klausel (`WHERE carrid IN @it_carriers`) ist ebenfalls ein Standard der modernen Syntax und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Sicherheit.
keywords: Open SQL, DATA, INTO TABLE, WHERE IN, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `Flight` mit Attributen für Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Instanziieren Sie Objekte dieser Klasse und füllen Sie deren Attribute mit Constructor Expressions (`NEW` und `VALUE`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW` für die Objekterzeugung und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung von Strukturen oder Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid READ-ONLY,
          mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid.

    METHODS get_flight_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->mv_connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_id.
    rv_id = |{ mv_carrid }-{ mv_connid ALPHA = OUT }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flights.
    rt_flights = NEW zcl_flight_table(
        VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN it_flight_data
                 ( NEW zcl_flight( iv_carrid = ls_data-carrid
                                   iv_connid = ls_data-connid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flights READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    METHODS get_flight_ids RETURNING VALUE(rt_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_ids.
    rt_ids = VALUE #( FOR lo_flight IN mt_flights ( lo_flight->get_flight_id( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_factory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_creation.
    DATA(lo_flight) = NEW zcl_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_flight->mv_carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_flight->get_flight_id( ) exp = 'LH-00000400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_factory.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_flight_factory( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_flight_factory=>ty_flight_data_tt(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
        ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' ) ).
    DATA(lo_flight_table) = lo_factory->create_flights( lt_data ).
    DATA(lt_ids) = lo_flight_table->get_flight_ids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_ids ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_ids[ 1 ] exp = 'AA-00000017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_ids[ 2 ] exp = 'UA-00000001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Constructor Expressions mit `NEW` und `VALUE` ermöglichen eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Objekterzeugung und -initialisierung. Anstatt Objekte zeilenweise zu erstellen und Attribute zuzuweisen, kann dies in einem einzigen Ausdruck geschehen, was besonders bei der Erstellung von Tabellen mit Objektreferenzen vorteilhaft ist.
keywords: Object Orientation, NEW, VALUE, Constructor Expressions, Class

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Verwenden Sie dabei `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `GROUP` Schlüsselwort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_raw_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count(
          carrid      = ls_group_key-carrid
          flight_count = lv_count
      ) TO rt_grouped_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight_raw(
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
        ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' ) ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 msg = 'Three groups expected' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 3 msg = 'LH should have 3 flights' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_group) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'AA should have 1 flight' ).

    DATA(ls_ua_group) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_group-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'UA should have 1 flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight_raw( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_raw ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_grouped msg = 'Empty table should result in empty grouped table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion ab ABAP 7.50, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Verarbeitung von gruppierten Daten, ohne manuelle Sortierung oder Schleifen über sortierte Daten.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, Aggregation, LOOP AT, Data Processing

Instructions: Bereiten Sie eine JSON-Struktur aus Flugdaten (`sflights`) vor, die als Eingabe für eine hypothetische 2D-Visualisierung dienen könnte. Die JSON-Struktur soll eine Liste von Flügen enthalten, wobei jeder Flug die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den Preis als separate Felder hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_json_writer` oder `CALL TRANSFORMATION` für die JSON-Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_json_preparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_json
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_json_preparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_json.
    DATA(lo_writer) = NEW cl_abap_conv_json_writer( PRETTY_PRINT = abap_true ).
    TRY.
        lo_writer->write_begin_object( ).
        lo_writer->write_name( 'flights' ).
        lo_writer->write_begin_array( ).

        LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          lo_writer->write_begin_object( ).
          lo_writer->write_name_value( name = 'carrier' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
          lo_writer->write_name_value( name = 'connection' value = ls_flight-connid ).
          lo_writer->write_name_value( name = 'price' value = ls_flight-price ).
          lo_writer->write_name_value( name = 'currency' value = ls_flight-currency ).
          lo_writer->write_end_object( ).
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_writer->write_end_array( ).
        lo_writer->write_end_object( ).
        rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_json( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_json_error.
        rv_json_string = 'ERROR_JSON_SERIALIZATION'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_prepare_json FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_prepare_empty_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prepare_json.
    DATA(lo_preparer) = NEW zcl_flight_json_preparer( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_json_preparer=>tt_sflight_data(
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_preparer->prepare_flight_json( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_json msg = 'Generated JSON should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json pattern = '"carrier": "LH"' msg = 'JSON should contain LH carrier' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json pattern = '"price": 100.00' msg = 'JSON should contain price' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json pattern = '"flights": [' msg = 'JSON should be a flights array' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_prepare_empty_json.
    DATA(lo_preparer) = NEW zcl_flight_json_preparer( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_json_preparer=>tt_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_preparer->prepare_flight_json( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json pattern = '"flights": []' msg = 'Empty table should result in empty JSON array' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_conv_json_writer` bietet eine objektorientierte und typsichere Möglichkeit, JSON-Strings zu generieren. Durch das sequentielle Schreiben von Objekten, Arrays, Namen und Werten kann eine komplexe JSON-Struktur präzise aufgebaut werden. Dies ist ideal für die Vorbereitung von Daten für externe Systeme oder UI-Komponenten wie einen 2D-Viewer.
keywords: JSON, Serialization, cl_abap_conv_json_writer, Data Preparation, Visualization

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Ergebnissen. Verwenden Sie dabei den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator für die effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_price
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_price.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine Aggregation über die Tabellenzeilen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( it_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die mit 'A' beginnen. Verwenden Sie dabei `REDUCE` und String Templates.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_carrier_concatenator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_filtered_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_all_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_concatenator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_filtered_carriers.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
        INIT result = ''
        FOR ls_carrier IN it_all_carriers WHERE ( ls_carrier CP 'A*' )
        NEXT result = COND string(
            WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN ls_carrier
            ELSE |{ result }, { ls_carrier }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die bedingte Logik innerhalb von `REDUCE` (`COND string(...)`) ermöglicht es, das Komma nur zwischen den Elementen hinzuzufügen, was zu einem sauberen Ergebnisstring führt.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer internen Tabelle und deren Typen zur Laufzeit (RTTI).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_table_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_info) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_table_components.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
              name = ls_component-name
              type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( )
          ) TO rt_component_info.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle RTTI error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend können spezifische Deskriptoren wie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` verwendet werden, um Details über Tabellen und deren Komponenten zu erhalten. Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren basierend auf einem Geburtsdatum und dem aktuellen Datum. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` oder direkte Datumsarithmetik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age_in_years
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
        iv_current_date TYPE d OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age_in_years.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = COND d(
        WHEN iv_current_date IS INITIAL THEN sy-datum
        ELSE iv_current_date ).

    rv_age = lv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).

    IF lv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) OR
       ( lv_current_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND
         lv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) ) THEN
      rv_age = rv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = 30 msg = 'Age should be 30' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Range für Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) und filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) basierend auf diesem Range. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( )` für die Range-Erstellung und `FILTER` für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carriers    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE ranges of s_carr_id(
      FOR ls_carrier IN it_carriers
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls_carrier )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_range_filter_sflight=>tt_sflight,
          lt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20251201' price = '100' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20251201' price = '200' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' fldate = '20251202' price = '150' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '004' fldate = '20251202' price = '250' ) TO lt_sflights.

    APPEND 'AA' TO lt_carriers.
    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_carriers.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_filter_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_sflights it_carriers = lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt `VALUE #( ... FOR ... )` um einen Range dynamisch aus einer Liste von Werten zu erstellen. Anschließend wird der `FILTER` Operator verwendet, um die interne Tabelle effizient und deklarativ zu filtern, wobei der erstellte Range direkt im `WHERE`-Teil genutzt wird. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Art, Daten zu manipulieren.
keywords: RANGES, VALUE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Wert in einem dynamisch erstellten Range liegt. Der Range soll sowohl Inklusionen als auch Exklusionen enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `IN` Operatorprüfung direkt mit dem Range.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_check_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_value_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_check_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_value_in_range.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE ranges of s_carr_id(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'UA' high = 'XX' )
    ).

    IF iv_value IN lt_carrid_range.
      rv_in_range = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_in_range = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_value_in_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_value_in_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_check_value( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_value_in_range( 'AA' ) msg = 'AA should be in range' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_value_in_range( 'LH' ) msg = 'LH should be excluded' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_value_in_range( 'UA' ) msg = 'UA should be in range' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_value_in_range( 'SQ' ) msg = 'SQ should not be in range' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die direkte Verwendung des `IN`-Operators mit einem Range, der sowohl Inklusions- (`I`) als auch Exklusions- (`E`) Einträge enthält. Die Range-Tabelle wird mit `VALUE #( )` kompakt initialisiert. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Werte gegen komplexe Kriterien zu prüfen.
keywords: RANGES, IN Operator, Conditional Logic, Dynamic Range

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` unter Verwendung eines Ranges für die Flugverbindungsnummer (CONNID).
hint: Der `IN` Operator in `SELECT` kann direkt mit Ranges verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_select_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_connid_range
      IMPORTING
        it_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_select_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_connid_range.
    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE ranges of s_conn_id(
      FOR ls_connid IN it_connids
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls_connid )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE connid IN @lt_connid_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_select_with_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_with_range.
    DATA: lt_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND '0017' TO lt_connids.
    APPEND '0400' TO lt_connids.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_select_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_connid_range( lt_connids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result should be initial if SFLIGHT is empty or no matching data' ).
    " Note: For a real test, SFLIGHT would need to be mocked or contain known data.
    " Here, we just ensure the call works and returns a table.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result should not be initial if SFLIGHT has data for 0017 or 0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die direkte Verwendung eines Ranges im `WHERE`-Teil einer `SELECT`-Anweisung. Die Range-Tabelle wird mit `VALUE #( ... FOR ... )` erstellt. Dies ist eine Standardpraxis in ABAP, um flexible Selektionskriterien an die Datenbank zu übergeben, und ist seit langem verfügbar, aber die Erstellung des Ranges mit `FOR` ist modern.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei separate Ranges für Fluggesellschaften zu einem einzigen, konsolidierten Range.

CLASS zcl_range_merge DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_range_merge IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_ranges.
    DATA(lt_range1) = VALUE ranges of s_carr_id(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_range2) = VALUE ranges of s_carr_id(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'SQ' high = 'XX' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_merge( ).
    DATA(lt_merged) = lo_cut->merge_carrier_ranges( it_range1 = lt_range1 it_range2 = lt_range2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = 'LH' IN lt_merged ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = 'UA' IN lt_merged ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = 'SQ' IN lt_merged ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = 'XY' IN lt_merged ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine moderne und kompakte Art, zwei Ranges zu kombinieren. Anstatt eine Schleife zu verwenden, wird der `VALUE #( BASE ... ( LINES OF ... ) )` Ausdruck genutzt, um die Einträge des zweiten Ranges an den ersten anzuhängen. Dies ist sehr effizient und reduziert Boilerplate-Code.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Range, der alle Fluggesellschaften außer 'AA' und 'LH' einschließt, und verwenden Sie diesen, um eine interne Tabelle zu filtern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( )` mit `sign = 'E'` (Exclude) und `option = 'EQ'` (Equal) für die auszuschließenden Werte, gefolgt von einem generischen `sign = 'I'` (Include) und `option = 'CP'` (Contains Pattern) für alle anderen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_exclude_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_exclude_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_exclude_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_exclude_carriers.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE ranges of s_carr_id(
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = '*' ) " Include all others
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_exclude_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exclude_filter.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_range_exclude_filter=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20251201' price = '100' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = '20251201' price = '200' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '003' fldate = '20251202' price = '150' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '004' fldate = '20251202' price = '250' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_exclude_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_exclude_carriers( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung eines komplexeren Ranges, der bestimmte Werte ausschließt und alle anderen einschließt. Die Kombination von `sign = 'E'` und `sign = 'I'` mit `option = 'CP' low = '*'` ermöglicht eine flexible Filterung. Der `FILTER` Operator wird dann verwendet, um die interne Tabelle basierend auf diesem Range zu filtern, was eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Methode ist.
keywords: RANGES, Exclude, FILTER, Internal Tables, Complex Range

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei, füllen Sie sie mit Daten und formatieren Sie die Kopfzeile fett.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_sheet`, `set_cell_value` und `create_style` mit `set_font_bold`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_header_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_formatted_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_header_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_formatted_xlsx.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->create_sheet( 'Flight Data' ).

    " Create a bold style
    DATA(lo_style_bold) = lo_xlsx->create_style( ).
    lo_style_bold->set_font_bold( abap_true ).

    " Define headers
    DATA(lt_headers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Carrier ID' ) ( 'Connection ID' ) ( 'Flight Date' ) ( 'Price' ) ).

    " Write header row and apply bold style
    DATA(lv_col) = 1.
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_headers INTO DATA(lv_header).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = lv_header ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_style = lo_style_bold ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Write data rows
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    LOOP AT it_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_col = 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer hochgeladenen XLSX-Datei (repräsentiert durch einen XSTRING) und geben Sie den Inhalt des ersten Arbeitsblatts als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xlsx_document=>load_document` und `get_sheet_data`.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_excel_row.
    TYPES: tt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_first_sheet_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_xlsx_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sheet_data) TYPE tt_excel_data
      RAISING
        cx_xlsx_document_error.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_first_sheet_data.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = cl_xlsx_document=>load_document( iv_xlsx_xstring ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ). " Get first sheet (index 1)

    IF lo_sheet IS BOUND.
      rt_sheet_data = lo_sheet->get_sheet_data( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_xlsx_data.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA: lt_dummy_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 'Header1,Header2,Header3' TO lt_dummy_data.
    APPEND 'Value1,Value2,Value3' TO lt_dummy_data.

    " Simulate creating a simple XLSX to have a valid xstring for reading
    DATA(lo_xlsx_writer) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    lo_xlsx_writer->add_sheet_from_table( ip_sheet_name = 'TestSheet' it_table = lt_dummy_data ).
    lv_xstring = lo_xlsx_writer->get_package_data( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_read_data( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->read_first_sheet_data( lv_xstring ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Read data should not be empty' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 rows (header + data)' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-col1 exp = 'Header1' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-col1 exp = 'Value1' ).
      CATCH cx_xlsx_document_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Lesen einer XLSX-Datei beginnt mit `cl_xlsx_document=>load_document`, das einen XSTRING der Datei akzeptiert. Anschließend kann man über `get_sheet_by_index` oder `get_sheet_by_name` auf einzelne Arbeitsblätter zugreifen. Die Methode `get_sheet_data` liest den Inhalt des Arbeitsblatts in eine interne Tabelle von Strings, wobei jede Zeile der Excel-Datei einem Eintrag in der internen Tabelle entspricht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei mit dynamisch generierten Spaltenüberschriften und entsprechenden Daten. Die Spaltenstruktur soll zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische interne Tabelle, dann `add_sheet_from_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE abap_type,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES: tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_info
        it_data_rows         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY " Each string is a comma-separated row
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_xlsx_document_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_xlsx.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind( p_type_kind = ls_field_def-type
                                                          p_length    = ls_field_def-length ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    DATA l_table TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA l_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN l_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_row> TYPE any.
    LOOP AT it_data_rows INTO DATA(lv_data_row).
      CREATE DATA l_table TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN l_table->* TO <ls_dynamic_row>.

      DATA(lt_values) = cl_abap_table_utilities=>string_to_string_table( iv_string = lv_data_row iv_separator = ',' ).
      DATA(lv_index) = 1.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          IF lv_index <= lines( lt_values ).
            <lv_field_value> = lt_values[ lv_index ].
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_row> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    lo_xlsx->add_sheet_from_table( ip_sheet_name = 'Dynamic Data'
                                    it_table      = <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei und setzen Sie die Breite der Spalten automatisch basierend auf dem Inhalt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_column_width_auto` nach dem Befüllen des Arbeitsblatts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_auto_width DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_xlsx_auto_width
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_auto_width IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xlsx_auto_width.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->create_sheet( 'Auto Width Demo' ).

    " Write header
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Short Header' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'A Very Long Header That Needs More Space' ).

    " Write data
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_data-col1 ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_data-col2 ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Set auto width for columns 1 and 2
    lo_sheet->set_column_width_auto( ip_column = 1 ).
    lo_sheet->set_column_width_auto( ip_column = 2 ).

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines Fluges in einer internen Tabelle basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft und der Flugnummer. Der neue Preis soll 150.00 betragen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE itab FROM wa WHERE ...` oder `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` gefolgt von `MODIFY TABLE ... INDEX ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_it_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_it_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA(ls_flight_wa) = VALUE ty_sflight(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      price  = iv_new_price
    ).

    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM ls_flight_wa TRANSPORTING price
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_it_where( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_modify_it_where=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_new_price = '150.00' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_updated_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = '150.00' msg = 'Price should be updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' INTO DATA(ls_unchanged_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_unchanged_flight-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Other flight should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM ... WHERE ... TRANSPORTING ...` Syntax ermöglicht eine effiziente und zielgerichtete Aktualisierung von Zeilen in internen Tabellen, ohne explizit über die Tabelle zu loopen. `TRANSPORTING` stellt sicher, dass nur die angegebenen Felder aktualisiert werden.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, WHERE, TRANSPORTING

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_existing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_it_corr( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_modify_it_corr=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_update) = VALUE zcl_modify_it_corr=>ty_update_data(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '180.00'
    ).
    lo_cut->update_flights_corr( is_update_data = ls_update CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_updated_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = '180.00' msg = 'Existing flight price should be updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-fldate exp = '20251201' msg = 'Other fields should remain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_new.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_it_corr( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_modify_it_corr=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE zcl_modify_it_corr=>ty_update_data(
      carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' price = '300.00'
    ).
    lo_cut->update_flights_corr( is_update_data = ls_new_flight CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' INTO DATA(ls_inserted_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_inserted_flight-fldate msg = 'New flight fldate should be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_inserted_flight-price exp = '300.00' msg = 'New flight price should be set' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table size should increase' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM CORRESPONDING #( ... )` Syntax ist eine moderne und prägnante Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu übertragen und gleichzeitig eine 'Upsert'-Operation (Update oder Insert) in der Zieltabelle durchzuführen. Nur Felder mit identischen Namen werden übertragen.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, CORRESPONDING, Upsert

CLASS zcl_modify_it_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS upsert_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_price    TYPE sflight-price
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_it_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upsert_flight.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM VALUE #( 
      carrid   = iv_carrid
      connid   = iv_connid
      fldate   = iv_fldate
      price    = iv_price
      currency = iv_currency
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_it_value( ).

    lo_cut->upsert_flight(
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'

    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Price should be 100.00' ).

  METHOD test_update_existing.

hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` um eine temporäre Tabelle mit den aktualisierten Werten zu erstellen und dann `MODIFY TABLE itab FROM TABLE temp_itab`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_it_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS increase_prices_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_it_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_flight IN ct_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( 
        carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        price    = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 )
        currency = ls_flight-currency
      )
    ).

    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM TABLE lt_modified_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_db_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid

CLASS zcl_modify_db_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_sflight_price.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_sflight-price = iv_new_price.
      MODIFY sflight FROM ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie mehrere Flugdatensätze in der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Änderungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY sflights FROM TABLE itab`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_db_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_update.
    TYPES tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_sflights_from_table
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_sflight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_db_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_sflights_from_table.
    DATA lt_sflight_db TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA ls_sflight_db TYPE sflight.

    LOOP AT it_updates INTO DATA(ls_update).
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight_db
        WHERE carrid = ls_update-carrid
          AND connid = ls_update-connid
          AND fldate = ls_update-fldate.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_sflight_db-price = ls_update-price.
        APPEND ls_sflight_db TO lt_sflight_db.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_sflight_db IS NOT INITIAL.
      MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflight_db.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei mit Flugdaten aus `sflights`. Vor dem Schreiben sollen die Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle um einen festen Betrag erhöht werden. Speichern Sie die Datei im temporären Verzeichnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xlsx_document` zum Erstellen der Datei und `MODIFY TABLE` für die Datenvorbereitung. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tmp_container=>get_tmp_directory( )` für den Speicherort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_create_xlsx_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_modified_sflights_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_price_increase TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_file_path) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_create_xlsx_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_modified_sflights_xlsx.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    DATA ls_sflight_db TYPE sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Modify prices in the internal table
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid_filter.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price + iv_price_increase.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx->get_active_worksheet( ).

    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Price' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_value = 'Currency' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_flight-price ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_flight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_tmp_dir) = cl_abap_tmp_container=>get_tmp_directory( ).
    DATA(lv_file_name) = |{ lv_tmp_dir }/ModifiedFlights_{ sy-uzeit }.xlsx|.

    lo_xlsx->save( iv_filename = lv_file_name ).
    rv_file_path = lv_file_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_read_xlsx_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS read_xlsx_and_upsert_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_xlsx_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_xlsx_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_xlsx_and_upsert_flights.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( iv_filename = iv_file_path ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx->get_active_worksheet( ).

    DATA(lv_max_row) = lo_worksheet->get_max_row( ).
    DATA(lv_max_col) = lo_worksheet->get_max_column( ).

    " Initialize with some existing data for upsert demonstration
    rt_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    LOOP AT lo_worksheet->get_rows( ) INTO DATA(ls_row).
      IF ls_row-row_id = 1. " Skip header row
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(ls_flight_from_xlsx) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
        carrid   = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row-row_id ip_column = 1 )->get_value( )
        connid   = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row-row_id ip_column = 2 )->get_value( )
        fldate   = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row-row_id ip_column = 3 )->get_value( )
        price    = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row-row_id ip_column = 4 )->get_value( )
        currency = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row-row_id ip_column = 5 )->get_value( )
      ).

      MODIFY TABLE rt_flights FROM ls_flight_from_xlsx.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie nur spezifische Felder eines Flugdatensatzes in einer internen Tabelle, nachdem Sie den Index des Datensatzes ermittelt haben.

CLASS zcl_modify_it_index_trans DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_fields
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_new_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_it_index_trans IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_fields.
    DATA ls_flight_wa TYPE ty_sflight.
    DATA lv_index TYPE sy-tabix.

    READ TABLE ct_flights INTO ls_flight_wa WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_index = sy-tabix.
      ls_flight_wa-price = iv_new_price.
      ls_flight_wa-currency = iv_new_currency.

      MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM ls_flight_wa TRANSPORTING price currency INDEX lv_index.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle filtern und die Preise der gefilterten Flüge um einen festen Betrag erhöhen. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und `FOR` für die Transformation.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` um die neue Tabelle zu erstellen. `MODIFY` wird hier nicht direkt auf die Zieltabelle angewendet, sondern die Zieltabelle wird neu erstellt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_and_modified_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_price_increase TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_and_modified_flights.
    rt_result_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER tt_sflight( it_source_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid_filter )
      ( 
        carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        price    = ls_flight-price + iv_price_increase
        currency = ls_flight-currency
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_modify.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_for_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_source_flights) = VALUE zcl_filter_for_modify=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_modified_flights(
      it_source_flights = lt_source_flights
      iv_carrid_filter  = 'LH'
      iv_price_increase = '50.00'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Result table should have 2 entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_lh1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh1-price exp = '150.00' msg = 'LH 0400 price should be 150.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' INTO DATA(ls_lh2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh2-price exp = '250.00' msg = 'LH 0401 price should be 250.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' INTO DATA(ls_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_aa-carrid msg = 'AA flight should not be in result' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die Kombination aus `FILTER`-Operator und `FOR`-Expression, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen. `FILTER` wählt die relevanten Zeilen aus, und `FOR` transformiert diese Zeilen, indem es den Preis erhöht. Dies ist ein funktionaler Ansatz, der die ursprüngliche Tabelle unverändert lässt und eine neue, modifizierte Tabelle zurückgibt.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, Internal Table, Functional Programming, Transformation

Instructions: Führen Sie eine bedingte Aktualisierung von Flugdaten in einer internen Tabelle durch. Nur wenn der Preis eines Fluges unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, soll er auf diesen Schwellenwert angehoben werden. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für die In-Place-Modifikation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)` und eine `IF`-Bedingung innerhalb des Loops.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_prices_to_minimum
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_prices_to_minimum.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-price < iv_min_price.
        <fs_flight>-price = iv_min_price.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei mit mehreren Arbeitsblättern. Das erste Blatt soll Flugdaten enthalten, das zweite Blatt eine Zusammenfassung der Fluggesellschaften. Nutzen Sie `cl_xlsx_document` und `MODIFY` für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xlsx_document` und `add_worksheet` für mehrere Blätter. Bereiten Sie die Daten für jedes Blatt separat vor, ggf. mit `MODIFY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_create_multi_sheet_xlsx DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS create_multi_sheet_xlsx
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_file_path) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_create_multi_sheet_xlsx IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_xlsx.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    DATA lt_carrier_summary TYPE tt_carrier_summary.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    " Prepare summary data using MODIFY for upsert
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(ls_summary_wa) = VALUE ty_carrier_summary(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        num_flights = 1
        total_price = ls_flight-price
      ).
      MODIFY TABLE lt_carrier_summary FROM ls_summary_wa.
      IF sy-subrc = 4. " If not found, it was inserted. If found, update.
        READ TABLE lt_carrier_summary INTO ls_summary_wa WITH KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
        ls_summary_wa-num_flights = ls_summary_wa-num_flights + 1.
        ls_summary_wa-total_price = ls_summary_wa-total_price + ls_flight-price.
        MODIFY TABLE lt_carrier_summary FROM ls_summary_wa.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).

    " Sheet 1: Flight Data
    DATA(lo_sheet1) = lo_xlsx->get_active_worksheet( ).
    lo_sheet1->set_name( 'Flight Data' ).
    lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Price' ).
    lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_value = 'Currency' ).
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_flight-price ).
      lo_sheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_flight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sheet 2: Carrier Summary
    DATA(lo_sheet2) = lo_xlsx->add_worksheet( 'Carrier Summary' ).
    lo_sheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_sheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Number of Flights' ).
    lo_sheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Total Price' ).
    lv_row = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_carrier_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      lo_sheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_summary-carrid ).
      lo_sheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_summary-num_flights ).
      lo_sheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_summary-total_price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_tmp_dir) = cl_abap_tmp_container=>get_tmp_directory( ).
    DATA(lv_file_name) = |{ lv_tmp_dir }/MultiSheetFlights_{ sy-uzeit }.xlsx|.

    lo_xlsx->save( iv_filename = lv_file_name ).
    rv_file_path = lv_file_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine XLSX-Datei ein, die Flugdaten und eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften enthält, deren Preise um einen bestimmten Prozentsatz erhöht werden sollen. Aktualisieren Sie die Flugdaten in einer internen Tabelle entsprechend.
hint: Lesen Sie beide Datensätze aus der XLSX-Datei. Verwenden Sie dann `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für die bedingte Preisaktualisierung in der Flugdatentabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_xlsx_cond_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_adjustment,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_price_adjustment.
    TYPES tt_price_adjustment TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_adjustment WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS read_xlsx_and_adjust_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_xlsx_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_xlsx_cond_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_xlsx_and_adjust_prices.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( iv_filename = iv_file_path ).

    DATA(lo_sheet_flights) = lo_xlsx->get_worksheet_by_name( 'Flight Data' ).
    DATA(lo_sheet_adjustments) = lo_xlsx->get_worksheet_by_name( 'Price Adjustments' ).

    " Read Flight Data
    LOOP AT lo_sheet_flights->get_rows( ) INTO DATA(ls_row_flight).
      IF ls_row_flight-row_id = 1. CONTINUE. ENDIF.
      DATA(ls_flight_from_xlsx) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
        carrid   = lo_sheet_flights->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row_flight-row_id ip_column = 1 )->get_value( )
        connid   = lo_sheet_flights->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row_flight-row_id ip_column = 2 )->get_value( )
        fldate   = lo_sheet_flights->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row_flight-row_id ip_column = 3 )->get_value( )
        price    = lo_sheet_flights->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row_flight-row_id ip_column = 4 )->get_value( )
        currency = lo_sheet_flights->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row_flight-row_id ip_column = 5 )->get_value( )
      ).
      INSERT ls_flight_from_xlsx INTO TABLE rt_adjusted_flights.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Read Price Adjustments
    DATA lt_adjustments TYPE tt_price_adjustment.
    LOOP AT lo_sheet_adjustments->get_rows( ) INTO DATA(ls_row_adj).
      IF ls_row_adj-row_id = 1. CONTINUE. ENDIF.
      DATA(ls_adjustment) = VALUE ty_price_adjustment(
        carrid     = lo_sheet_adjustments->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row_adj-row_id ip_column = 1 )->get_value( )
        percentage = lo_sheet_adjustments->get_cell_value( ip_row = ls_row_adj-row_id ip_column = 2 )->get_value( )
      ).
      INSERT ls_adjustment INTO TABLE lt_adjustments.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Apply adjustments to flights
    LOOP AT rt_adjusted_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      READ TABLE lt_adjustments INTO DATA(ls_adjustment_found) WITH KEY carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + ls_adjustment_found-percentage / 100 ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
