CLASS zcl_grp_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    METHODS get_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      count  = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität (`seatsocc`) und die maximale Flugdauer (`fltime`) pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und aggregieren Sie innerhalb der Gruppe.

CLASS zcl_grp_agg_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             max_fltime TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_agg.
    METHODS get_aggregated_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_agg_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_occ) = 0.
      DATA(lv_max_fltime) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_total_occ = lv_total_occ + ls_member-seatsocc.
        IF ls_member-fltime > lv_max_fltime.
          lv_max_fltime = ls_member-fltime.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      total_occ = lv_total_occ
                      max_fltime = lv_max_fltime ) TO rt_aggregated_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und speichern Sie alle Flüge jeder Gruppe in einer internen Tabelle als Komponente des Gruppenergebnisses.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP DATA` in der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_itab_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    METHODS get_grouped_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_itab_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key)
         GROUP DATA(lt_group_members) WITHOUT MEMBERS. " Use WITHOUT MEMBERS to get the group table directly

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flights = lt_group_members ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_itab_component( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ). " Check if any data exists
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
      " Verify that each group has flights
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_group).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_group-flights ).
        " Verify that all flights in a group belong to the correct carrier
        LOOP AT ls_group-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = ls_group-carrid ).
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `GROUP DATA(lt_group_members)`-Syntax in Verbindung mit `WITHOUT MEMBERS` (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, die gesamte Gruppe von Zeilen als interne Tabelle direkt in einer Komponente des Gruppenergebnisses zu speichern. Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung (`carrid`, `connid`). Speichern Sie für jede Gruppe die Gruppenschlüssel und eine interne Tabelle der zugehörigen Flüge, wobei nur `fldate` und `planetype` in der internen Tabelle enthalten sein sollen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `FOR ... IN GROUP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_corr_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_detail,
           tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_connection,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid  TYPE sflight-connid,
             details TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ty_grouped_connection.
    METHODS get_grouped_connections RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_connections) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_corr_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_connections.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_connections = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group_key IN lt_sflights GROUP BY carrid = ls_group_key-carrid,
                                                              connid = ls_group_key-connid
      ( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        connid = ls_group_key-connid
        details = VALUE #( FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group_key
                           ( fldate = ls_member-fldate
                             planetype = ls_member-planetype ) ) 
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Passagierauslastung (`seatsocc / seatsmax`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` innerhalb der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occ TYPE f,
           END OF ty_avg_occupancy.
    METHODS get_avg_occupancy RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_occupancy) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_seatsocc) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                          FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                          NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-seatsocc ).
      DATA(lv_total_seatsmax) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                          FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                          NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-seatsmax ).

      DATA(lv_avg_occ) = COND f( WHEN lv_total_seatsmax > 0 THEN lv_total_seatsocc / lv_total_seatsmax ELSE 0 ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      avg_occ = lv_avg_occ ) TO rt_avg_occupancy.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, die die gleiche Struktur wie `sflight` hat, aber nur die Felder `carrid` und `connid` enthält. Füllen Sie diese dynamische Tabelle mit Daten aus `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_sflight_subset
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_sflight_subset.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " 1. Get description of SFLIGHT structure
    DATA(lo_sflight_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ) ).

    " 2. Create a new structure description with subset of components
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    LOOP AT lo_sflight_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF ls_component-name = 'CARRID' OR ls_component-name = 'CONNID'.
        APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lo_subset_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " 3. Create a new table type description based on the subset structure
    DATA(lo_subset_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                      p_line_type = lo_subset_struct_descr
                                      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
                                      p_unique_key = VALUE #( ( name = 'CARRID' ) ( name = 'CONNID' ) ) ). " Example key

    " 4. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_subset_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 5. Fill dynamic table
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_line>).

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_carrid> = ls_sflight-carrid.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_connid> = ls_sflight-connid.
      ENDIF.

      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_sflight_subset( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_dynamic_table ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    " Verify structure of the dynamic table
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_dynamic_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_line_descr->get_components( ) ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->get_components( )[ 1 ]-name exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->get_components( )[ 2 ]-name exp = 'CONNID' ).

    " Verify data content (e.g., first entry)
    DATA: ls_sflight_first TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight_first.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
      READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_carrid> exp = ls_sflight_first-carrid ).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_connid> exp = ls_sflight_first-connid ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie dynamisch die Struktur zweier interner Tabellen (z.B. `sflight` und eine benutzerdefinierte Struktur) und ermitteln Sie, ob sie identisch sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>compare_types` oder vergleichen Sie die Komponentenlisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_custom_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_custom_flight,
           tt_custom_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_custom_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_table_structures
      IMPORTING
        io_table_data1 TYPE REF TO data
        io_table_data2 TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_identical) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_structures.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_any_table1> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <lt_any_table2> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    ASSIGN io_table_data1->* TO <lt_any_table1>.
    ASSIGN io_table_data2->* TO <lt_any_table2>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0. " One or both are not tables
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr1) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_any_table1> ) ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr2) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_any_table2> ) ).

    " Compare table kinds (STANDARD, SORTED, HASHED)
    IF lo_table_descr1->get_table_kind( ) <> lo_table_descr2->get_table_kind( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Compare line types (structures)
    DATA(lo_line_descr1) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr1->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr2) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr2->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    " Compare components (fields)
    DATA(lt_components1) = lo_line_descr1->get_components( ).
    DATA(lt_components2) = lo_line_descr2->get_components( ).

    IF lines( lt_components1 ) <> lines( lt_components2 ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_components1 INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
      READ TABLE lt_components2 INTO DATA(ls_comp2) WITH KEY name = ls_comp1-name.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Component not found in second table
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      " Compare type descriptions (e.g., data type, length)
      IF ls_comp1-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) <> ls_comp2-type_descr->get_relative_name( ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_are_identical = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_identical_tables FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_different_field_count FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_identical_tables.
    DATA: lt_sflights1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_sflights2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_tables( ).
    DATA(lv_identical) = lo_cut->compare_table_structures( io_table_data1 = REF #( lt_sflights1 ) io_table_data2 = REF #( lt_sflights2 ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_different_field_type.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mod,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE string, " Different type
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_mod,

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_sflight_mod TYPE tt_sflight_mod.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_tables( ).
    DATA(lv_identical) = lo_cut->compare_table_structures( io_table_data1 = REF #( lt_sflights ) io_table_data2 = REF #( lt_sflight_mod ) ).

  METHOD test_different_table_kind.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    DATA: lt_sflights_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_sflights_hsh TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_compare_tables( ).
    DATA(lv_identical) = lo_cut->compare_table_structures( io_table_data1 = REF #( lt_sflights_std ) io_table_data2 = REF #( lt_sflights_hsh ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_identical exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung (`carrid`, `connid`). Für jede Gruppe sollen die Gruppenschlüssel und eine interne Tabelle der zugehörigen Flüge zurückgegeben werden, wobei die Flüge nach `fldate` absteigend sortiert sein sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `FOR ... IN GROUP` und `SORT` innerhalb der Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_sorted_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_detail,
           tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_connection_sorted,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid  TYPE sflight-connid,
             details TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ty_grouped_connection_sorted.
    METHODS get_grouped_sorted_connections RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_connections) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_connection_sorted WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_sorted_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_sorted_connections.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_connections = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group_key IN lt_sflights GROUP BY carrid = ls_group_key-carrid,
                                                              connid = ls_group_key-connid
      ( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        connid = ls_group_key-connid
        details = VALUE #( FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group_key
                           ( fldate = ls_member-fldate
                             planetype = ls_member-planetype
                             seatsocc = ls_member-seatsocc ) ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING ) 
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_sorted_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_sorted_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_sorted_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_sorted_connections( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ). " Check if any data exists
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
      " Verify that each group has details and details are sorted
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_group).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_group-details ).
        DATA(lv_prev_fldate) = '99991231'. " Initialize with a date later than any possible flight date
        LOOP AT ls_group-details INTO DATA(ls_detail).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_detail-fldate <= lv_prev_fldate ) ).
          lv_prev_fldate = ls_detail-fldate.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Gruppierung um eine Sortierung der Gruppenelemente. Der `ORDER BY`-Zusatz innerhalb des `VALUE #( FOR ... IN GROUP ... )` ermöglicht es, die geschachtelte interne Tabelle direkt bei der Erstellung zu sortieren, was zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS OF, FOR IN GROUP, ORDER BY, Internal Tables, Sorting

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer beliebigen Anzahl von Spalten und Typen, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` basierend auf einer dynamisch erstellten Komponentenliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string, " ABAP type name, e.g., 'CARRID', 'STRING', 'I'
           END OF ty_component_def,
           tt_component_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_component_defs TYPE tt_component_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_component_defs INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_comp_def-type ).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_comp_def-name
                      type_descr = lo_type_descr ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
                                p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Fill with some example data
    DO 3 TIMES.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_line>).

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ).
            WHEN 'CARRID' OR 'STRING'.
              <fs_field> = |Value { sy-index } for { ls_component-name }|.
            WHEN 'I'.
              <fs_field> = sy-index * 10.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              " Handle other types or leave initial
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine flache hierarchische Tabelle aus SFLIGHT- und SBOOK-Daten, die für die Anzeige in einem CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE geeignet ist. Die Hierarchie soll 'Carrier' -> 'Flight' -> 'Booking' darstellen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte FOR- und VALUE-Ausdrücke mit GROUP BY, um die hierarchische Struktur zu erstellen und eindeutige NODE_KEYs zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_data_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
             node_type  TYPE string, " e.g., 'CARRIER', 'FLIGHT', 'BOOKING'
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flight_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_sbook   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_tree.
    rt_tree_data = VALUE #( " Outer loop for Carriers
      FOR <carrier_group> IN it_sflight GROUP BY <carrier_group>-carrid ASCENDING AS GROUP_KEY
      ( LET carrier_node_key = CONV lvc_nkey( |C_{ <carrier_group>-carrid }| ) IN
        VALUE #( " Inner loop for Flights within each Carrier
          ( node_key = carrier_node_key
            parent_key = ''
            text = |Carrier: { <carrier_group>-carrid }|
            level = 0
            node_type = 'CARRIER' )
          FOR <flight_group> IN <carrier_group> GROUP BY <flight_group>-connid ASCENDING AS GROUP_KEY
          ( LET flight_node_key = CONV lvc_nkey( |F_{ <carrier_group>-carrid }_{ <flight_group>-connid }| ) IN
            VALUE #( " Innermost loop for Bookings within each Flight
              ( node_key = flight_node_key
                parent_key = carrier_node_key
                text = |Flight: { <flight_group>-carrid } { <flight_group>-connid } ({ <flight_group>-planetype })|
                level = 1
                node_type = 'FLIGHT' )
              FOR <booking> IN it_sbook WHERE ( carrid = <flight_group>-carrid AND connid = <flight_group>-connid AND fldate = <flight_group>-fldate )
              ( node_key = CONV lvc_nkey( |B_{ <booking>-bookid }| )
                parent_key = flight_node_key
                text = |Booking: { <booking>-bookid } (Type: { <booking>-custtype })|
                level = 2
                node_type = 'BOOKING' )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_tree FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_tree.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_sbook   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lt_sflight = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 100 )
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A321' seatsocc = 120 )
                           ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'B747' seatsocc = 250 ) ).

    lt_sbook = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '00000001' custtype = 'B' )
                         ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '00000002' custtype = 'E' )
                         ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '00000003' custtype = 'B' )
                         ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '00000004' custtype = 'F' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_data_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_data) = lo_cut->generate_flight_tree( it_sflight = lt_sflight it_sbook = lt_sbook ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Tree data should not be initial' act = lt_tree_data IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected number of nodes' act = lines( lt_tree_data ) exp = 9 ). " 2 Carriers + 3 Flights + 4 Bookings

    DATA(ls_node_flight) = lt_tree_data[ node_key = 'F_LH_0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Parent key for flight LH 0400' act = ls_node_flight-parent_key exp = 'C_LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Level for flight LH 0400' act = ls_node_flight-level exp = 1 ).

    DATA(ls_node_booking) = lt_tree_data[ node_key = 'B_00000001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Parent key for booking 00000001' act = ls_node_booking-parent_key exp = 'F_LH_0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Level for booking 00000001' act = ls_node_booking-level exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung einer hierarchischen Datenstruktur, die für einen CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE geeignet ist, unter Verwendung von verschachtelten FOR- und VALUE-Ausdrücken. Die GROUP BY-Klausel ermöglicht eine effiziente Gruppierung der Daten auf verschiedenen Ebenen (Carrier, Flight), während die LET-Anweisung lokale Variablen für die NODE_KEY-Generierung bereitstellt. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, komplexe Datenaggregationen und -transformationen durchzuführen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch einen Feldkatalog (LVC_T_FCAT) für einen CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE basierend auf einer Liste von Spaltendefinitionen. Fügen Sie automatisch die technischen Felder NODE_KEY und PARENT_KEY hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator mit einem FOR-Ausdruck, um den Feldkatalog zu konstruieren. Überprüfen Sie die Existenz von NODE_KEY/PARENT_KEY und fügen Sie diese bei Bedarf hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_fcat_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_def,
             fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,
             text      TYPE string,
             width     TYPE i,
             is_key    TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_column_def.
    TYPES: tt_column_defs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_field_catalog
      IMPORTING
        it_column_defs TYPE tt_column_defs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_fcat_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_field_catalog.
    rt_fcat = VALUE #( " Construct initial field catalog from user definitions
      FOR <col_def> IN it_column_defs
      ( fieldname = <col_def>-fieldname
        coltext   = <col_def>-text
        col_pos   = CONV i( sy-tabix ) " Use sy-tabix for column position
        outputlen = <col_def>-width
        key       = <col_def>-is_key
      )
    ).

    " Add NODE_KEY and PARENT_KEY as technical fields if not explicitly defined
    IF NOT line_exists( rt_fcat[ fieldname = 'NODE_KEY' ] ).
      APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'NODE_KEY' coltext = 'Node Key' col_pos = lines( rt_fcat ) + 1 tech = abap_true ) TO rt_fcat.
    ENDIF.
    IF NOT line_exists( rt_fcat[ fieldname = 'PARENT_KEY' ] ).
      APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'PARENT_KEY' coltext = 'Parent Key' col_pos = lines( rt_fcat ) + 1 tech = abap_true ) TO rt_fcat.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_fcat.
    DATA: lt_column_defs TYPE zcl_tree_fcat_gen=>tt_column_defs.

    lt_column_defs = VALUE #( ( fieldname = 'TEXT' text = 'Description' width = 50 is_key = abap_false )
                               ( fieldname = 'LEVEL' text = 'Hierarchy Level' width = 10 is_key = abap_false )
                               ( fieldname = 'NODE_TYPE' text = 'Type' width = 20 is_key = abap_false ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_fcat_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_fcat) = lo_cut->generate_field_catalog( it_column_defs = lt_column_defs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Field catalog should not be initial' act = lt_fcat IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected number of columns' act = lines( lt_fcat ) exp = 5 ). " 3 user-defined + NODE_KEY + PARENT_KEY

    DATA(ls_col_text) = lt_fcat[ fieldname = 'TEXT' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Column text for TEXT' act = ls_col_text-coltext exp = 'Description' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Column position for TEXT' act = ls_col_text-col_pos exp = 1 ).

    DATA(ls_col_node_key) = lt_fcat[ fieldname = 'NODE_KEY' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Technical flag for NODE_KEY' act = ls_col_node_key-tech exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein Feldkatalog für einen CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE dynamisch mit dem VALUE-Operator und einem FOR-Ausdruck erstellt werden kann. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die anzuzeigenden Spalten zur Laufzeit variieren. Die automatische Ergänzung der technischen Felder NODE_KEY und PARENT_KEY stellt sicher, dass der Feldkatalog vollständig ist. Die Verwendung von `lines( rt_fcat ) + 1` für die `col_pos` ist eine moderne Art, die Spaltenpositionen sequenziell zu vergeben.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine flache hierarchische Tabelle (wie für CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE verwendet) und ein Start-NODE_KEY. Extrahieren Sie alle Kind- und Enkelknoten (den gesamten Unterbaum) des Startknotens unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Implementieren Sie eine rekursive Methode, die FILTER und FOR-Ausdrücke verwendet, um die direkten Kinder zu finden und dann rekursiv deren Unterbäume zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sub_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
             node_type  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_subtree
      IMPORTING
        it_all_nodes TYPE tt_tree_nodes
        iv_start_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_subtree) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_children_recursive
      IMPORTING
        it_all_nodes TYPE tt_tree_nodes
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_children) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sub_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_subtree.
    DATA(ls_start_node) = it_all_nodes[ KEY node_key COMPONENTS node_key = iv_start_node_key DEFAULT `(node_key='', parent_key='', text='', level=0, node_type='')` ].
    IF ls_start_node-node_key IS INITIAL.
      RETURN. " Start node not found
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_start_node TO rt_subtree.
    APPEND LINES OF get_children_recursive( it_all_nodes = it_all_nodes iv_parent_key = iv_start_node_key ) TO rt_subtree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_children_recursive.
    DATA(lt_direct_children) = FILTER zcl_tree_sub_extractor=>tt_tree_nodes( it_all_nodes WHERE parent_key = iv_parent_key ).
    IF lt_direct_children IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND LINES OF lt_direct_children TO rt_children.

    LOOP AT lt_direct_children INTO DATA(ls_child).
      APPEND LINES OF get_children_recursive( it_all_nodes = it_all_nodes iv_parent_key = ls_child-node_key ) TO rt_children.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_subtree FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_subtree.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_pkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
             node_type  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_all_nodes) = VALUE tt_tree_nodes(
      ( node_key = 'R1' parent_key = '' text = 'Root 1' level = 0 node_type = 'ROOT' )
      ( node_key = 'C1' parent_key = 'R1' text = 'Child 1' level = 1 node_type = 'CHILD' )
      ( node_key = 'G1' parent_key = 'C1' text = 'Grandchild 1' level = 2 node_type = 'GRANDCHILD' )
      ( node_key = 'G2' parent_key = 'C1' text = 'Grandchild 2' level = 2 node_type = 'GRANDCHILD' )
      ( node_key = 'C2' parent_key = 'R1' text = 'Child 2' level = 1 node_type = 'CHILD' )
      ( node_key = 'R2' parent_key = '' text = 'Root 2' level = 0 node_type = 'ROOT' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_sub_extractor( ).

    " Test subtree of 'R1'
    DATA(lt_subtree_r1) = lo_cut->get_subtree( it_all_nodes = lt_all_nodes iv_start_node_key = 'R1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 5 nodes in subtree R1' act = lines( lt_subtree_r1 ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Subtree R1 contains G1' act = line_exists( lt_subtree_r1[ node_key = 'G1' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Subtree R1 does not contain R2' act = line_exists( lt_subtree_r1[ node_key = 'R2' ] ) ).

    " Test subtree of 'C1'
    DATA(lt_subtree_c1) = lo_cut->get_subtree( it_all_nodes = lt_all_nodes iv_start_node_key = 'C1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 nodes in subtree C1' act = lines( lt_subtree_c1 ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Subtree C1 contains G2' act = line_exists( lt_subtree_c1[ node_key = 'G2' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Subtree C1 does not contain R1' act = line_exists( lt_subtree_c1[ node_key = 'R1' ] ) ).

    " Test non-existent node
    DATA(lt_subtree_non_existent) = lo_cut->get_subtree( it_all_nodes = lt_all_nodes iv_start_node_key = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Subtree of non-existent node should be initial' act = lt_subtree_non_existent ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie SFLIGHT-Daten zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und dann nach Flugnummer (connid). Berechnen Sie für jede Flugnummer die Summe der belegten Sitze (seatsocc) und geben Sie die Ergebnisse in einer verschachtelten Struktur zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie verschachtelte FOR-Ausdrücke mit GROUP BY, um die Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_group,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights    TYPE tt_flight_summary,
           END OF ty_carrier_group.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_sum_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_carrier_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_sum_flights.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( " Group by Carrier
      FOR <carrier_group> IN it_sflight GROUP BY <carrier_group>-carrid ASCENDING AS GROUP_KEY
      ( carrid = GROUP_KEY
        flights = VALUE #( " Group by Flight within each Carrier
          FOR <flight_group> IN <carrier_group> GROUP BY <flight_group>-connid ASCENDING AS GROUP_KEY
          ( connid = GROUP_KEY
            total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <flight> IN <flight_group> NEXT sum = sum + <flight>-seatsocc ) )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine verschachtelte Datenstruktur, in der bestimmte Elemente oder deren Werte basierend auf Bedingungen mit COND oder SWITCH innerhalb des VALUE-Ausdrucks hinzugefügt oder geändert werden.
hint: Integrieren Sie COND- oder SWITCH-Ausdrücke direkt in die VALUE-Konstruktoren für Strukturen und interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_nesting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_detail,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_detail.
    TYPES: tt_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header,
             id      TYPE string,
             status  TYPE string,
             details TYPE tt_details,
           END OF ty_header.
    TYPES: tt_headers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_header WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_conditional_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_include_extra_detail TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_headers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_nesting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_conditional_data.
    rt_data = VALUE #( " List of Headers
      ( id = 'H001' status = 'NEW' details = VALUE #( " Details for H001
          ( key = 'CreatedBy' value = 'UserA' )
          ( key = 'Date' value = |{ sy-datum DATE = ISO }| )
          ( COND #( WHEN iv_include_extra_detail = abap_true THEN ( key = 'ExtraInfo' value = 'Special' ) ELSE THROW cx_abap_invalid_value( ) ) ) " Conditionally add an item
        ) )
      ( id = 'H002' status = 'PROCESSED' details = VALUE #( " Details for H002
          ( key = 'ProcessedBy' value = 'SystemX' )
          ( key = 'StatusText' value = SWITCH string( 'PROCESSED'
                                        WHEN 'PROCESSED' THEN 'Completed Successfully'
                                        WHEN 'NEW' THEN 'Pending'
                                        ELSE 'Unknown' ) )
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Summen aus einer verschachtelten internen Tabelle. Zum Beispiel: Gesamtumsatz pro Kunde und dann den gesamten Umsatz über alle Kunden hinweg.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, möglicherweise verschachtelt oder in Kombination mit FOR-Ausdrücken, um die Aggregation auf mehreren Ebenen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_level_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             amount    TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id  TYPE string,
             items     TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_order.
    TYPES: tt_orders TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             customer_id TYPE string,
             orders      TYPE tt_orders,
           END OF ty_customer.
    TYPES: tt_customers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_customer WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_revenue
      IMPORTING
        it_customers TYPE tt_customers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_level_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_revenue.
    rv_total_revenue = REDUCE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2(
      INIT total_sum = 0
      FOR <customer> IN it_customers
      NEXT total_sum = total_sum + REDUCE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2(
        INIT customer_sum = 0
        FOR <order> IN <customer>-orders
        NEXT customer_sum = customer_sum + REDUCE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2(
          INIT order_sum = 0
          FOR <item> IN <order>-items
          NEXT order_sum = order_sum + <item>-amount
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_revenue FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_revenue.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             amount    TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id  TYPE string,
             items     TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_order.
    TYPES: tt_orders TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             customer_id TYPE string,
             orders      TYPE tt_orders,
           END OF ty_customer.
    TYPES: tt_customers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_customer WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_customers) = VALUE tt_customers(
      ( customer_id = 'CUST001' orders = VALUE #( 
          ( order_id = 'ORD001' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM001' amount = '10.50' ) ( item_id = 'ITM002' amount = '5.00' ) ) )
          ( order_id = 'ORD002' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM003' amount = '20.00' ) ) )
        ) )
      ( customer_id = 'CUST002' orders = VALUE #( 
          ( order_id = 'ORD003' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM004' amount = '15.25' ) ( item_id = 'ITM005' amount = '7.75' ) ) )
        ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_level_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_revenue) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue( it_customers = lt_customers ).

    " Expected: (10.50 + 5.00 + 20.00) + (15.25 + 7.75) = 35.50 + 23.00 = 58.50
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Calculated total revenue is incorrect' act = lv_total_revenue exp = '58.50' ).

    " Test with empty data
    DATA(lt_empty_customers) = VALUE tt_customers( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_revenue) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue( it_customers = lt_empty_customers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total revenue for empty data should be 0' act = lv_empty_revenue exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Durch die Verschachtelung von REDUCE-Ausdrücken kann eine 'Summe der Summen' oder ähnliche komplexe Aggregationen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck berechnet werden. Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine verschachtelte interne Tabelle, indem Sie ein berechnetes Feld zu jedem Unterelement hinzufügen und ein Feld des Ober-Elements basierend auf den Unterelementen aktualisieren. Nutzen Sie den MAP-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den MAP-Operator auf der äußeren Tabelle und dann erneut auf der inneren Tabelle, um Transformationen auf mehreren Ebenen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_map_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             price     TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             quantity  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in.
    TYPES: tt_items_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_in,
             order_id  TYPE string,
             items     TYPE tt_items_in,
           END OF ty_order_in.
    TYPES: tt_orders_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             price     TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             quantity  TYPE i,
             line_total TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2, " New calculated field
           END OF ty_item_out.
    TYPES: tt_items_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_out,
             order_id  TYPE string,
             total_order_value TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2, " New calculated field
             items     TYPE tt_items_out,
           END OF ty_order_out.
    TYPES: tt_orders_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_orders
      IMPORTING
        it_orders TYPE tt_orders_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_orders) TYPE tt_orders_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_map_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_orders.
    rt_transformed_orders = MAP tt_orders_out FROM it_orders
      USING tt_items_out = tt_items_out
      ( order_id = order_id
        items = MAP tt_items_out FROM items
          ( item_id = item_id
            price = price
            quantity = quantity
            line_total = price * quantity ) " Calculate line_total
        total_order_value = REDUCE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR <item> IN items
          NEXT sum = sum + ( <item>-price * <item>-quantity ) ) " Calculate total_order_value
      ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_orders FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_orders.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             price     TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             quantity  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in.
    TYPES: tt_items_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_in,
             order_id  TYPE string,
             items     TYPE tt_items_in,
           END OF ty_order_in.
    TYPES: tt_orders_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_orders_in) = VALUE tt_orders_in(
      ( order_id = 'ORD001' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM001' price = '10.00' quantity = 2 )
                                             ( item_id = 'ITM002' price = '5.50' quantity = 3 ) ) )
      ( order_id = 'ORD002' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM003' price = '20.00' quantity = 1 ) ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_map_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_orders_out) = lo_cut->transform_orders( it_orders = lt_orders_in ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Transformed orders should not be initial' act = lt_orders_out IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 transformed orders' act = lines( lt_orders_out ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_ord001_out) = lt_orders_out[ order_id = 'ORD001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total order value for ORD001' act = ls_ord001_out-total_order_value exp = '36.50' ). " 10*2 + 5.5*3 = 20 + 16.5 = 36.5
    DATA(ls_itm001_out) = ls_ord001_out-items[ item_id = 'ITM001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Line total for ITM001' act = ls_itm001_out-line_total exp = '20.00' ).

    DATA(ls_ord002_out) = lt_orders_out[ order_id = 'ORD002' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total order value for ORD002' act = ls_ord002_out-total_order_value exp = '20.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den MAP-Operator (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.55) für die Transformation von verschachtelten internen Tabellen. Es zeigt, wie man sowohl neue Felder in den Unterelementen berechnet (`line_total`) als auch ein Feld im Ober-Element basierend auf den aggregierten Werten der Unterelemente (`total_order_value` mit REDUCE) aktualisiert. Instructions: Filtern Sie eine verschachtelte interne Tabelle basierend auf Bedingungen, die sowohl für die Ober- als auch für die Unterelemente gelten. Zum Beispiel: Kunden, die mindestens eine Bestellung mit einem Artikel über einem bestimmten Wert haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator mit verschachtelten WHERE-Klauseln oder EXISTS-Ausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             amount    TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id  TYPE string,
             items     TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_order.
    TYPES: tt_orders TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             customer_id TYPE string,
             name        TYPE string,
             orders      TYPE tt_orders,
           END OF ty_customer.
    TYPES: tt_customers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_customer WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_customers_by_item_amount
      IMPORTING
        it_customers TYPE tt_customers
        iv_min_amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_customers) TYPE tt_customers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_customers_by_item_amount.
    rt_filtered_customers = FILTER tt_customers( it_customers
      WHERE EXISTS orders[ EXISTS items[ amount > iv_min_amount ] ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_customers.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             amount    TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id  TYPE string,
             items     TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_order.
    TYPES: tt_orders TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             customer_id TYPE string,
             name        TYPE string,
             orders      TYPE tt_orders,
           END OF ty_customer.
    TYPES: tt_customers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_customer WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_customers) = VALUE tt_customers(
      ( customer_id = 'CUST001' name = 'Alice' orders = VALUE #( 
          ( order_id = 'ORD001' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM001' amount = '10.00' ) ( item_id = 'ITM002' amount = '5.00' ) ) )
          ( order_id = 'ORD002' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM003' amount = '20.00' ) ) )
        ) )
      ( customer_id = 'CUST002' name = 'Bob' orders = VALUE #( 
          ( order_id = 'ORD003' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM004' amount = '15.00' ) ( item_id = 'ITM005' amount = '7.00' ) ) )
        ) )
      ( customer_id = 'CUST003' name = 'Charlie' orders = VALUE #( 
          ( order_id = 'ORD004' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM006' amount = '3.00' ) ) )
        ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_filter( ).

    " Filter for items > 10.00
    DATA(lt_filtered_10) = lo_cut->filter_customers_by_item_amount( it_customers = lt_customers iv_min_amount = '10.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 customers for amount > 10' act = lines( lt_filtered_10 ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Alice should be included' act = line_exists( lt_filtered_10[ customer_id = 'CUST001' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Bob should be included' act = line_exists( lt_filtered_10[ customer_id = 'CUST002' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Charlie should not be included' act = line_exists( lt_filtered_10[ customer_id = 'CUST003' ] ) ).

    " Filter for items > 25.00
    DATA(lt_filtered_25) = lo_cut->filter_customers_by_item_amount( it_customers = lt_customers iv_min_amount = '25.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected 0 customers for amount > 25' act = lt_filtered_25 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Kette von funktionalen Operationen (Filtern, Transformieren, Aggregieren) auf einer verschachtelten Datenstruktur durch. Beispiel: Filtern Sie Kunden, transformieren Sie deren Bestellungen und aggregieren Sie dann die Werte der Artikel.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FILTER, MAP und REDUCE in einer fließenden Kette von Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_nested_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             price     TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             quantity  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in.
    TYPES: tt_items_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_in,
             order_id  TYPE string,
             items     TYPE tt_items_in,
           END OF ty_order_in.
    TYPES: tt_orders_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer_in,
             customer_id TYPE string,
             name        TYPE string,
             orders      TYPE tt_orders_in,
           END OF ty_customer_in.
    TYPES: tt_customers_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_customer_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             net_value TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2, " Price * Quantity
           END OF ty_item_out.
    TYPES: tt_items_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_out,
             order_id  TYPE string,
             total_net_value TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
             items     TYPE tt_items_out,
           END OF ty_order_out.
    TYPES: tt_orders_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer_out,
             customer_id TYPE string,
             name        TYPE string,
             filtered_orders TYPE tt_orders_out,
             grand_total_value TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_customer_out.
    TYPES: tt_customers_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_customer_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_customer_data
      IMPORTING
        it_customers TYPE tt_customers_in
        iv_min_order_value TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_customers) TYPE tt_customers_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_nested_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_customer_data.
    rt_processed_customers = MAP tt_customers_out FROM it_customers
      USING tt_orders_out = tt_orders_out
      USING tt_items_out = tt_items_out
      ( customer_id = customer_id
        name = name
        filtered_orders = MAP tt_orders_out FROM FILTER tt_orders_in( orders
          WHERE REDUCE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2( INIT sum = 0 FOR <item> IN items NEXT sum = sum + ( <item>-price * <item>-quantity ) ) > iv_min_order_value )
          ( order_id = order_id
            items = MAP tt_items_out FROM items
              ( item_id = item_id
                net_value = price * quantity )
            total_net_value = REDUCE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2(
              INIT sum = 0
              FOR <item> IN items
              NEXT sum = sum + ( <item>-price * <item>-quantity ) ) )
        grand_total_value = REDUCE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR <order> IN filtered_orders
          NEXT sum = sum + <order>-total_net_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_ops.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             price     TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             quantity  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in.
    TYPES: tt_items_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_in,
             order_id  TYPE string,
             items     TYPE tt_items_in,
           END OF ty_order_in.
    TYPES: tt_orders_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer_in,
             customer_id TYPE string,
             name        TYPE string,
             orders      TYPE tt_orders_in,
           END OF ty_customer_in.
    TYPES: tt_customers_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_customer_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_customers_in) = VALUE tt_customers_in(
      ( customer_id = 'CUST001' name = 'Alice' orders = VALUE #( 
          ( order_id = 'ORD001' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM001' price = '10.00' quantity = 2 ) ( item_id = 'ITM002' price = '5.00' quantity = 3 ) ) ) " Total 35.00
          ( order_id = 'ORD002' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM003' price = '8.00' quantity = 1 ) ) ) " Total 8.00
        ) )
      ( customer_id = 'CUST002' name = 'Bob' orders = VALUE #( 
          ( order_id = 'ORD003' items = VALUE #( ( item_id = 'ITM004' price = '15.00' quantity = 2 ) ( item_id = 'ITM005' price = '7.00' quantity = 1 ) ) ) " Total 37.00
        ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chained_nested_ops( ).
    DATA(lt_processed_customers) = lo_cut->process_customer_data( it_customers = lt_customers_in iv_min_order_value = '10.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Processed customers should not be initial' act = lt_processed_customers IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 processed customers' act = lines( lt_processed_customers ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_alice_out) = lt_processed_customers[ customer_id = 'CUST001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Alice should have 1 filtered order' act = lines( ls_alice_out-filtered_orders ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Alice grand total' act = ls_alice_out-grand_total_value exp = '35.00' ).
    DATA(ls_alice_ord001_out) = ls_alice_out-filtered_orders[ order_id = 'ORD001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Alice ORD001 total net value' act = ls_alice_ord001_out-total_net_value exp = '35.00' ).
    DATA(ls_alice_itm001_out) = ls_alice_ord001_out-items[ item_id = 'ITM001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Alice ITM001 net value' act = ls_alice_itm001_out-net_value exp = '20.00' ).

    DATA(ls_bob_out) = lt_processed_customers[ customer_id = 'CUST002' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Bob should have 1 filtered order' act = lines( ls_bob_out-filtered_orders ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Bob grand total' act = ls_bob_out-grand_total_value exp = '37.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der Verkettung funktionaler Operatoren (FILTER, MAP, REDUCE) auf verschachtelten Datenstrukturen. In einem einzigen, fließenden Ausdruck werden Kunden gefiltert, deren Bestellungen transformiert (neue Felder berechnet), und dann die Werte auf verschiedenen Ebenen aggregiert. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster des funktionalen Programmierens in ABAP 7.55+, das zu extrem kompaktem, lesbarem und wartbarem Code führt, der komplexe Datenmanipulationen deklarativ beschreibt.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur ausliest und deren Werte in eine interne Tabelle von Schlüssel-Wert-Paaren umwandelt. Nutzen Sie RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA und CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, um die Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit zu analysieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_value_pair,
             component_name TYPE string,
             component_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_value_pair.
    TYPES: tt_key_value_pairs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_value_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_struct_to_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_key_value_pairs) TYPE tt_key_value_pairs
      RAISING
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial
        cx_sy_struct_creation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_struct_to_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    IF ir_data IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> )->checked_cast( cl_abap_structdescr=>get_type_descr( <fs_data> ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component_descr).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component_descr-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( component_name = ls_component_descr-name
                        component_value = |{ <fs_component> }| ) TO rt_key_value_pairs.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_struct_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_struct FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_initial_ref EXPECTING CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_struct_conversion.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string VALUE 'Value1',
             field2 TYPE i VALUE 123,
             field3 TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA(ls_test_struct) = VALUE ty_test_struct( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_to_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_struct_to_table( REF #( ls_test_struct ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 components' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_field1) = lt_result[ component_name = 'FIELD1' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of FIELD1' act = ls_field1-component_value exp = 'Value1' ).

    DATA(ls_field2) = lt_result[ component_name = 'FIELD2' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of FIELD2' act = ls_field2-component_value exp = '123' ).

    DATA(ls_field3) = lt_result[ component_name = 'FIELD3' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of FIELD3' act = ls_field3-component_value exp = 'X' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_struct.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_empty_struct,
           END OF ty_empty_struct.
    DATA(ls_empty_struct) = VALUE ty_empty_struct( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_to_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_struct_to_table( REF #( ls_empty_struct ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table for empty struct should be initial' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_ref.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_to_table( ).
    lo_cut->convert_struct_to_table( lr_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR und CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, um die Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit dynamisch zu ermitteln. Die Werte der Komponenten werden dann in eine interne Tabelle von Schlüssel-Wert-Paaren umgewandelt. Dies ist eine moderne Technik für generische Datenverarbeitung und Integration, bei der die Struktur der Daten nicht zur Kompilierzeit bekannt sein muss. Die Verwendung von `REF #()` und `->*` für die Dereferenzierung ist ebenfalls ein modernes ABAP-Muster.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feld sortiert. Das Sortierfeld und die Sortierrichtung (aufsteigend/absteigend) sollen als Parameter übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie dynamische Sortierung mit dem SORT-Statement und dem dynamischen Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_sort_field TYPE fieldname
        iv_descending TYPE abap_bool OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    DATA(lv_sort_order) = COND string( WHEN iv_descending = abap_true THEN 'DESCENDING' ELSE 'ASCENDING' ).

    " Dynamic sort using string concatenation for the field name and order
    SORT ct_data BY (iv_sort_field) (lv_sort_order).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_id_asc.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_sort=>tt_data(
      ( id = 3 name = 'Charlie' value = '30.00' )

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_sort( ).
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
                                    iv_sort_field = 'ID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First ID should be 1' act = lt_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last ID should be 3' act = lt_data[ 3 ]-id exp = 3 ).

  METHOD test_sort_name_desc.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_sort=>tt_data(
      ( id = 3 name = 'Charlie' value = '30.00' )
      ( id = 1 name = 'Alice' value = '10.00' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Bob' value = '20.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_sort( ).
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
                                    iv_sort_field = 'NAME'
                                    iv_descending = abap_true ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last name should be Alice' act = lt_data[ 3 ]-name exp = 'Alice' ).

  METHOD test_sort_value_asc.

      ( id = 3 name = 'Charlie' value = '30.00' )
      ( id = 1 name = 'Alice' value = '10.00' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Bob' value = '20.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_sort( ).
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
                                    iv_sort_field = 'VALUE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First value should be 10.00' act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value exp = '10.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last value should be 30.00' act = lt_data[ 3 ]-value exp = '30.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_invalid_field.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_sort=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Alice' value = '10.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_sort( ).
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
                                    iv_sort_field = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Sortierung einer internen Tabelle, bei der das Sortierfeld und die Sortierrichtung zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Die moderne Syntax `SORT ct_data BY (iv_sort_field) (lv_sort_order)` ermöglicht dies auf eine sehr flexible Weise. Der COND-Operator wird verwendet, um die Sortierrichtung ('ASCENDING'/'DESCENDING') basierend auf einem booleschen Parameter zu bestimmen. Dies ist ein häufiges Muster in der dynamischen Programmierung, um generische Funktionen für die Datenmanipulation zu erstellen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SORT, Internal Tables, COND, Dynamic Field

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die prüft, ob ein Objekt eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementiert, und wenn ja, die Methode einer Schnittstelle dynamisch aufruft. Nutzen Sie RTTI und dynamische Methodenaufrufe.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_OBJECTDESCR und CL_ABAP_INTFDESCR für die RTTI-Analyse und CALL METHOD für den dynamischen Aufruf.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_processable.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_processor_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processable~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processor A processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processable~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processor B handled: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_invoker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS invoke_processable
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_input  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_invoker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD invoke_processable.
    DATA(lo_object_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object )->checked_cast( cl_abap_objectdescr=>get_type_descr( io_object ) ).

    DATA(lv_interface_name) = 'ZIF_PROCESSABLE'.

    IF lo_object_descr->has_interface( lv_interface_name ) = abap_true.
      DATA(lo_interface_ref) = CAST zif_processable( io_object ).
      rv_result = lo_interface_ref->process_data( iv_input = iv_input ).
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Object does not implement { lv_interface_name }|.

Instructions: Verketten Sie eine Liste von Strings zu einem einzigen String, wobei jeder String in Anführungszeichen gesetzt und durch ein Komma getrennt wird. Nutzen Sie String-Templates und den REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um die Strings zu iterieren und String-Templates für die Formatierung und Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_list_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_string_list
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_list_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_string_list.
    rv_formatted_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR <string> IN it_strings
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |'{ <string> }'|
        ELSE |{ result },'{ <string> }'| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle nach mehreren Kriterien und geben Sie nur die ersten N Ergebnisse zurück. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator mit einer WHERE-Klausel und dann den FOR-Ausdruck mit UP TO N ROWS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_filter_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_limit
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
        iv_category TYPE string
        iv_min_value TYPE i
        iv_limit TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_filter_limit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_limit.
    rt_filtered_items = VALUE #( FOR <item> IN FILTER tt_items( it_items WHERE category = iv_category AND value >= iv_min_value ) UP TO iv_limit ROWS
                                 ( <item> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_filter_limit_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_limit_success.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_table_filter_limit=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 category = 'A' value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 category = 'B' value = 20 )
      ( id = 3 category = 'A' value = 15 )
      ( id = 4 category = 'A' value = 25 )
      ( id = 5 category = 'B' value = 30 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_filter_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_limit( it_items = lt_items
                                                iv_category = 'A'
                                                iv_min_value = 10
                                                iv_limit = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 items' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item ID' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second item ID' act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_limit_less_than_limit.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_table_filter_limit=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 category = 'A' value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 category = 'B' value = 20 )
      ( id = 3 category = 'A' value = 15 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_filter_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_limit( it_items = lt_items
                                                iv_category = 'A'
                                                iv_min_value = 10
                                                iv_limit = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 items (less than limit)' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item ID' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second item ID' act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_limit_no_match.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_table_filter_limit=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 category = 'A' value = 10 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_filter_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_limit( it_items = lt_items
                                                iv_category = 'C'
                                                iv_min_value = 5
                                                iv_limit = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected 0 items (no match)' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die effiziente Kombination des FILTER-Operators mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und der UP TO N ROWS-Klausel. Der FILTER-Operator selektiert Zeilen basierend auf mehreren Kriterien, während der FOR-Ausdruck die Ergebnisse in eine neue Tabelle überführt und die `UP TO N ROWS`-Klausel die Anzahl der zurückgegebenen Zeilen begrenzt. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und performante Methode, um Daten zu filtern und zu paginieren, ohne explizite Schleifen oder IF-Anweisungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, FOR, UP TO N ROWS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittswert einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle, wobei nur Zeilen berücksichtigt werden, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator in Kombination mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und einer WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             group TYPE string,
             value TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_value_item.
    TYPES: tt_value_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_value_items
        iv_group TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lt_filtered_items) = FILTER tt_value_items( it_items WHERE group = iv_group ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_filtered_items ).

    IF lv_count = 0.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2(
      INIT total_sum = 0
      FOR <item> IN lt_filtered_items
      NEXT total_sum = total_sum + <item>-value
    ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
