CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_average_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_calculation.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_average_calculator=>tt_value_items(
      ( id = 1 group = 'A' value = '10.00' )
      ( id = 2 group = 'B' value = '20.00' )
      ( id = 3 group = 'A' value = '15.00' )
      ( id = 4 group = 'A' value = '20.00' )
      ( id = 5 group = 'B' value = '30.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average( it_items = lt_items iv_group = 'A' ).

    " Expected: (10 + 15 + 20) / 3 = 45 / 3 = 15.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average for group A is incorrect' act = lv_average exp = '15.00' ).

    DATA(lv_average_b) = lo_cut->calculate_average( it_items = lt_items iv_group = 'B' ).
    " Expected: (20 + 30) / 2 = 50 / 2 = 25.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average for group B is incorrect' act = lv_average_b exp = '25.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_no_match.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_average_calculator=>tt_value_items(
      ( id = 1 group = 'A' value = '10.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average( it_items = lt_items iv_group = 'C' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average for no matching group should be 0' act = lv_average exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_empty_table.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_average_calculator=>tt_value_items( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average( it_items = lt_items iv_group = 'A' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average for empty table should be 0' act = lv_average exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Berechnung eines Durchschnittswerts unter Verwendung des FILTER-Operators zur Vorselektion der relevanten Daten und des REDUCE-Operators zur Summenbildung. Die Kombination dieser Operatoren ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Implementierung von Aggregationslogik. Die explizite Prüfung auf eine leere Ergebnismenge nach dem Filtern verhindert eine Division durch Null und macht den Code robust.
keywords: Math, REDUCE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Average

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null abfängt und einen spezifischen Fehlercode zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit `WHEN OTHERS` für unerwartete Fehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error` für die spezifische Ausnahme und `WHEN OTHERS` für alle anderen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_division_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS divide_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_division_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD divide_safe.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        " Spezifische Behandlung für Division durch Null
        rv_result = -1. " Fehlercode oder Standardwert
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        " Allgemeine Fehlerbehandlung für alle anderen Ausnahmen
        " Hier könnte man lx_exception->get_text( ) protokollieren
        rv_result = -2. " Anderer Fehlercode
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_arithmetic_error ).
    lo_handler->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_safe.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result_ok) = lo_handler->divide_safe( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_ok exp = 5 ).

    DATA(lv_result_error) = lo_handler->divide_safe( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu. Wenn keine der spezifischen Bedingungen zutrifft, verwenden Sie einen Standardwert. Nutzen Sie den `COND` Ausdruck mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Der `COND` Ausdruck ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF` oder `CASE` Anweisungen für die Wertzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 1 THEN 'Aktiv'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 2 THEN 'Inaktiv'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 3 THEN 'Gesperrt'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_status_text FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_status_text.
    DATA(lo_cond) = NEW zcl_conditional_value( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cond->get_status_text( 1 ) exp = 'Aktiv' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cond->get_status_text( 2 ) exp = 'Inaktiv' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cond->get_status_text( 3 ) exp = 'Gesperrt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cond->get_status_text( 99 ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cond->get_status_text( 0 ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Ausdruck bietet eine prägnante Möglichkeit, Werte basierend auf Bedingungen zuzuweisen. `WHEN OTHERS` stellt sicher, dass immer ein Wert zugewiesen wird, selbst wenn keine der expliziten Bedingungen erfüllt ist, was den Code robuster macht.
keywords: COND, WHEN OTHERS, Conditional Logic, Expression

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf einem Schlüssel in eine Struktur.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    READ TABLE lt_all_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate
      INTO @rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_by_key FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_by_key.
    " Setup: Insert test data
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab (
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ) ).

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO @DATA(...)`.

CLASS zcl_flight_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }| TO rt_output.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, Daten aus `sflights` zu lesen. Fangen Sie mögliche Datenbankfehler ab und protokollieren Sie diese. Wenn ein Fehler auftritt, geben Sie eine leere Tabelle zurück.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` mit `TRY...CATCH` und `WHEN OTHERS` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_db_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_safely RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_db_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_safely.
    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
          FROM sflights
          INTO TABLE @rt_flights.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        " Spezifische Behandlung für Open SQL Fehler
        " Hier könnte man lx_db_error->get_text( ) protokollieren
        CLEAR rt_flights.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        " Allgemeine Fehlerbehandlung für alle anderen Ausnahmen
        " Hier könnte man lx_exception->get_text( ) protokollieren
        CLEAR rt_flights.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_safely( ).

    " und prüfen, ob lt_flights leer ist.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ). " Assuming sflights has data, or assert_initial if an error is simulated
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert moderne `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` Syntax mit robuster Fehlerbehandlung mittels `TRY...CATCH`. Die Verwendung von `CATCH cx_root` (oder `WHEN OTHERS` in einem `CASE` für Ausnahmen) stellt sicher, dass alle unerwarteten Fehler abgefangen und behandelt werden, was die Stabilität der Anwendung erhöht.
keywords: SELECT, INTO TABLE, TRY CATCH, WHEN OTHERS, Database Access, Exception Handling

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem String bestimmte Zeichen. Wenn das zu ersetzende Zeichen nicht gefunden wird, soll ein Standard-String zurückgegeben werden. Nutzen Sie `REPLACE` und `COND` mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE` für die Ersetzung und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung des Standard-Strings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_char_or_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_old_char     TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_new_char     TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_char_or_default.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_char IN lv_temp_string WITH iv_new_char.

    rv_output_string = COND string(
      WHEN lv_temp_string <> iv_input_string THEN lv_temp_string
      WHEN OTHERS THEN |{ iv_input_string } (keine Ersetzung)| 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_replace_not_found FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_found.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_string_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_char_or_default( iv_input_string = 'Hello World' iv_old_char = 'o' iv_new_char = 'x' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hellx Wxrld' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_not_found.
    DATA(lo_replacer) = NEW zcl_string_replacer( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_char_or_default( iv_input_string = 'Hello World' iv_old_char = 'z' iv_new_char = 'x' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World (keine Ersetzung)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung verwendet `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` für die String-Manipulation und den `COND` Ausdruck mit `WHEN OTHERS` für die bedingte Zuweisung eines Standardwertes, falls keine Ersetzung stattgefunden hat. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, solche Logik zu implementieren.
keywords: REPLACE, COND, WHEN OTHERS, String Processing, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck für eine funktionale Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                FOR flight IN it_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price_empty FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_sflight (
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.50' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '450.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_empty.
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_sflight( ).
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die funktionale Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Berechnungen wie Summen, Minima, Maxima oder andere Reduktionen in einer sehr kompakten und lesbaren Form durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine generische Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine Standardfehlermeldung zurück. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit `WHEN OTHERS`.

CLASS zcl_generic_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    TRY.
        IF iv_input = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = |Operation erfolgreich mit { iv_input }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        " Allgemeine Fehlerbehandlung für alle Ausnahmen
        rv_result = |Fehler aufgetreten: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist entscheidend für die Robustheit einer Anwendung, da es unerwartete Programmabbrüche verhindert und eine kontrollierte Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `LOOP AT GROUP` für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrid_price.
    METHODS get_total_prices_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_total_prices) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = VALUE sflight-price( ).
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_sum_price = lv_sum_price + ls_group_member-price.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_price( carrid = group_key-carrid total_price = lv_sum_price ) TO rt_total_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    DATA(lv_aa_price) = 0.
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_aa_price = ls_entry-total_price.
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_aa_price exp = 0 msg = 'AA total price should exist and be non-zero' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `LOOP AT GROUP` explizit über die Elemente einer Gruppe iteriert, um Aggregationen wie die Summe zu berechnen. Dies ist flexibler als die impliziten Aggregatfunktionen und erlaubt komplexere Berechnungen pro Gruppe.

CLASS zcl_grp_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             curr     TYPE sflight-curr,
             num_flights TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_grp_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid curr = ls_sflight-curr ) 
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        curr = ls_sflight-curr
        num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REFERENCE INTO` und einer Schleife über die Gruppe, um das Maximum zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_result DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_highest_price_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_highest_price_flight.
    METHODS get_highest_price_flight_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_highest_price_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_result IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_price_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
         ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(group_key)
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref). " group_ref points to the first element of the group

      DATA(ls_highest_price_flight) = group_ref->*. " Initialize with first flight in group
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        IF ls_group_member-price > ls_highest_price_flight-price.
          ls_highest_price_flight = ls_group_member.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_highest_price_flight(
        carrid = ls_highest_price_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_highest_price_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_highest_price_flight-fldate
        price  = ls_highest_price_flight-price
      ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_highest_price_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_highest_price_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_result( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_highest_price_flight_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_entry-price msg = 'AA highest price flight should exist and have a price' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REFERENCE INTO` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf das erste Element der Gruppe, was nützlich ist, um einen Startwert für Aggregationen zu setzen. Die explizite Schleife `LOOP AT GROUP` wird dann verwendet, um das Element mit dem höchsten Preis zu finden. Dies ist eine flexible Methode für komplexe Aggregationen, die nicht direkt durch implizite Funktionen abgedeckt werden.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP AT GROUP, REFERENCE INTO

category: Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, Functional Programming
Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Auslastung (occupancy) der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_occupancy) = REDUCE f(
        INIT sum_occupancy = 0.0
        FOR ls_member IN GROUP group_key
        NEXT sum_occupancy = sum_occupancy + ( ls_member-seatsocc / ls_member-seatsmax )
      ).
      DATA(lv_avg_occupancy) = COND f( WHEN group_key-*-count > 0 THEN lv_total_occupancy / group_key-*-count ELSE 0.0 ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_occupancy( carrid = group_key-carrid average_occupancy = lv_avg_occupancy ) TO rt_occupancy.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Feldzuordnung für eine interne Tabelle durch, deren Feldnamen zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_dyn_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id_src TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             val_src TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_line,
           ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             id_tgt TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             val_tgt TYPE i,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target_line,
           ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS map_dynamic_itab IMPORTING it_source TYPE ty_source_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_dyn_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_dynamic_itab.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = it_source
      destination = rt_target
      mapping     = VALUE sabp_dyn_map_table(
        ( source_name = 'ID_SRC'  dest_name = 'ID_TGT' )
        ( source_name = 'VAL_SRC' dest_name = 'VAL_TGT' )
      )
    ).
    lo_corresponding->execute( EXPORTING source = it_source IMPORTING destination = rt_target ).

    LOOP AT rt_target ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
      <fs_target>-status = 'P'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft, aber nur solche, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_future_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             future_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_future_flight_count.
    METHODS get_future_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_future_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
         GROUP WHERE ls_sflight-fldate > sy-datum
         INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_future_flight_count( carrid = group_key-carrid future_flights = group_key-*-count ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und erstellen Sie für jede Gruppe eine Liste der Flugverbindungsnummern (connid).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Aggregation einer Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_list_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_connid_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_carrier_connections,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connections TYPE ty_connid_list,
           END OF ty_carrier_connections.
    METHODS get_connections_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_connections WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_list_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connections_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid 
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connections = VALUE ty_connid_list( FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_sflight ( ls_member-connid ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_list_agg( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_entry-connections msg = 'LH connections list should not be empty' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( ls_entry-connections ) > 0 ) msg = 'LH connections list should contain entries' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_fae_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_fae_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_scarr_lh TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @lt_scarr_lh

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für alle Flüge der Lufthansa (LH) die Anzahl der freien Sitze. Verwenden Sie FOR ALL ENTRIES und eine moderne Tabellenexpression.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR ALL ENTRIES, um die LH-Flüge zu holen, und dann eine FOR-Expression mit VALUE, um die freien Sitze zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             free_seats  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_free_seats RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_free_seats.
    DATA lt_scarr_lh TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_sflight_lh TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @lt_scarr_lh
      WHERE carrname = 'Lufthansa'.

    IF lt_scarr_lh IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_scarr_lh
        WHERE carrid = @lt_scarr_lh-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_lh.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight_lh
                               ( carrid     = flight-carrid
                                 connid     = flight-connid
                                 fldate     = flight-fldate
                                 free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_free_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_data) = lo_cut->get_lh_free_seats( ).

    " Assuming some Lufthansa flights exist in SFLIGHT and SCARR
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_data msg = 'No Lufthansa flights found' ).

    " Check a specific entry if possible, or just the calculation logic
    LOOP AT lt_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight_info).
      IF ls_flight_info-carrid = 'LH'. " Example check
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight_info-free_seats >= 0 msg = 'Free seats cannot be negative' ).
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Daten zu transformieren.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.

CLASS zcl_subtract_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between.
    DATA(lv_timestamp_from) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date_from ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp_to)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date_to ).

    DATA(lv_seconds_diff) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( tstmp1 = lv_timestamp_to tstmp2 = lv_timestamp_from ).

    rv_days = lv_seconds_diff / ( 24 * 3600 ). " Sekunden pro Tag
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT, die nicht in der SCARR-Tabelle als aktive Fluggesellschaften (z.B. carrname ist nicht leer) existieren. Verwenden Sie FOR ALL ENTRIES.
hint: Holen Sie sich alle aktiven Fluggesellschaften und verwenden Sie dann FOR ALL ENTRIES mit DELETE TABLE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_delete_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_inactive_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_delete_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_inactive_flights.
    DATA lt_active_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Get all active carrier IDs (where carrname is not initial)
    SELECT carrid
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @lt_active_carrids
      WHERE carrname IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF lt_active_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Delete flights whose carrid is NOT in the list of active carriers
      DELETE ct_flights WHERE carrid NOT IN lt_active_carrids.
    ELSE.
      " If no active carriers, delete all flights
      CLEAR ct_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_empty_percentage
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
        iv_occupied     TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_empty_percent) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_empty_percentage.
    IF iv_max_capacity <= 0.
      rv_empty_percent = 100.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_occupied_df) TYPE decfloat34 VALUE iv_occupied.
    DATA(lv_max_df) TYPE decfloat34 VALUE iv_max_capacity.

    DATA(lv_occupied_percent) = ( lv_occupied_df / lv_max_df ) * 100.

    rv_empty_percent = 100 - lv_occupied_percent.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_check_existence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_carrier_has_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_flights) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_check_existence IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_carrier_has_flights.
    DATA lt_single_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND iv_carrid TO lt_single_carrier.

    DATA lt_dummy_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF lt_single_carrier IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_single_carrier
        WHERE carrid = @lt_single_carrier-carrid
        UP TO 1 ROWS
        INTO TABLE @lt_dummy_result.
    ENDIF.

    rv_has_flights = COND abap_bool( WHEN lines( lt_dummy_result ) > 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_balance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_amounts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_non_negative_balance
      IMPORTING
        it_amounts TYPE tt_amounts
        iv_initial_balance TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_balance) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_balance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_non_negative_balance.
    rv_final_balance = REDUCE i( INIT balance = iv_initial_balance
                                 FOR amount IN it_amounts
                                 NEXT balance = SWITCH i( WHEN balance - amount < 0 THEN 0
                                                          ELSE balance - amount ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_aggregate_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_aggregate_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_filtered.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE sflight-seatsocc(
                         INIT sum_seats = 0
                         FOR flight IN lt_sflight_filtered
                         NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_min_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_seats.
    TYPES tt_sflight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_seat_occupancy_range
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_range) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_min_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_seat_occupancy_range.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_range = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_min_seats) = REDUCE sflight-seatsocc(
                              INIT min_val = it_flights[1]-seatsocc
                              FOR flight IN it_flights
                              NEXT min_val = nmin( min_val, flight-seatsocc ) ).

    DATA(lv_max_seats) = REDUCE sflight-seatsocc(
                              INIT max_val = it_flights[1]-seatsocc
                              FOR flight IN it_flights
                              NEXT max_val = nmax( max_val, flight-seatsocc ) ).

    rv_range = lv_max_seats - lv_min_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie die letzten 'N' Zeichen von einem String. Verwenden Sie moderne String-Operationen und SUBTRACT.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und den SUBTRACT-Operator für die Längenberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_string_len DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_last_n_chars
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_n_chars      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_string_len IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_last_n_chars.
    DATA(lv_input_len) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_chars_to_keep) = lv_input_len - iv_n_chars.

    IF lv_chars_to_keep <= 0.
      rv_result_string = ''.
    ELSE.
      rv_result_string = iv_input_string(0, lv_chars_to_keep).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine 'Left Outer Join'-ähnliche Operation zwischen SFLIGHT und SCARR durch, um alle Flüge und die entsprechenden Fluggesellschaftsnamen zu erhalten. Wenn keine Fluggesellschaft gefunden wird, soll der Name leer bleiben. Verwenden Sie FOR ALL ENTRIES und eine FOR-Expression mit COND.
hint: Holen Sie sich zuerst alle Flüge, dann die Fluggesellschaftsnamen mit FOR ALL ENTRIES und mappen Sie sie mit einer FOR-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_left_outer_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_carrname,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             carrname  TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_flight_with_carrname.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_carrname TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_carrname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrname RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_flight_with_carrname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_left_outer_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrname.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    IF lt_sflight IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, carrname
        FROM scarr
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_sflight
        WHERE carrid = @lt_sflight-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.
    ENDIF.

    " Create a hashed table for quick lookup of carrier names
    DATA(lt_scarr_h) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF scarr WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid
                           FOR entry IN lt_scarr ( entry ).

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                           ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                             connid   = flight-connid
                             fldate   = flight-fldate
                             carrname = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_scarr_h[ carrid = flight-carrid ] )
                                                THEN lt_scarr_h[ carrid = flight-carrid ]-carrname
                                                ELSE '' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result should not be empty' ).

  METHOD test_no_matching_carrier.

    " For now, we'll just check if any entry has an empty carrname (if such data exists).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'Found flight with no matching carrier name' ).

      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( abap_true msg = 'No flight found with no matching carrier name' ).

  METHOD test_empty_sflight.
    " This test would require mocking SFLIGHT to return no data.
    " For now, we assume the method handles an empty SFLIGHT gracefully.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_left_outer_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrname( ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result should be empty if SFLIGHT is empty' ).

Eine Hashed Table (`lt_scarr_h`) wird für einen schnellen Lookup erstellt. Die FOR-Expression (ABAP 7.50+) mit der COND-Expression (ABAP 7.40+) und `line_exists` (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht es, den Fluggesellschaftsnamen bedingt zuzuweisen, was eine elegante Lösung für den 'Left Outer Join'-Fall darstellt.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer eines Fluges in Minuten, gegeben Start- und Endzeitstempel. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax und SUBTRACT.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>SUBTRACT und teilen Sie das Ergebnis durch 60.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_timestamps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_duration_in_minutes
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_duration_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_timestamps IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_duration_in_minutes.
    DATA(lv_seconds_diff) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( tstmp1 = iv_end_tstmp tstmp2 = iv_start_tstmp ).
    rv_duration_minutes = lv_seconds_diff / 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Diese Sekundendifferenz wird dann durch 60 geteilt, um die Dauer in Minuten zu erhalten. Die Inline-Deklaration und die klare Struktur der Methode sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben und von Fluggesellschaften durchgeführt werden, die in einer dynamisch erzeugten Liste enthalten sind. Verwenden Sie FOR ALL ENTRIES und eine FILTER-Expression.
hint: Erstellen Sie die Liste der Fluggesellschaften dynamisch, filtern Sie dann die Flüge mit FOR ALL ENTRIES und verfeinern Sie das Ergebnis mit FILTER.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_filter_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             free_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_summary.
    TYPES tt_sflight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_min_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_allowed_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min_free_seats  TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_filter_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_min_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_allowed_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_allowed_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_allowed_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight_raw USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats
                                    MAPPING carrid     = carrid
                                            connid     = connid
                                            fldate     = fldate
                                            free_seats = seatsmax - seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_allowed_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_match_criteria FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_filter_free_seats( ).
    DATA lt_allowed_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_allowed_carrids.
    APPEND 'AA' TO lt_allowed_carrids.

    " Assuming SFLIGHT has:
    " LH, 0400, seatsmax=100, seatsocc=50 (free=50)
    " LH, 0401, seatsmax=100, seatsocc=80 (free=20)
    " AA, 0017, seatsmax=150, seatsocc=100 (free=50)
    " AA, 0018, seatsmax=150, seatsocc=140 (free=10)

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_min_free_seats( it_allowed_carrids = lt_allowed_carrids iv_min_free_seats = 30 ).

    " Expected: LH 0400 (50 free), AA 0017 (50 free)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] ) msg = 'LH 0400 should be present' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ] ) msg = 'AA 0017 should be present' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_allowed_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_filter_free_seats( ).
    DATA lt_allowed_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_min_free_seats( it_allowed_carrids = lt_allowed_carrids iv_min_free_seats = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result should be empty for no allowed carriers' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_match_criteria.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_filter_free_seats( ).
    DATA lt_allowed_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_allowed_carrids.

    " Assuming LH flights exist but none have 1000 free seats
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_min_free_seats( it_allowed_carrids = lt_allowed_carrids iv_min_free_seats = 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result should be empty if no flights match criteria' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert FOR ALL ENTRIES für die initiale Datenbankabfrage mit der FILTER-Expression (ABAP 7.50+) zur weiteren Verfeinerung der Daten. Die Berechnung der freien Sitze (`seatsmax - seatsocc`) erfolgt direkt in der WHERE-Klausel der FILTER-Expression. Die MAPPING-Klausel ermöglicht eine direkte Transformation der Struktur, was den Code sehr deklarativ und effizient macht.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Data Transformation, SUBTRACT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, bei denen die maximale Kapazität (SEATSMAX) größer als 200 ist. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Konstruktoren.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ita_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_large_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ita_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE ( seatsmax > 200 ) (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid
    ) ).
    rt_flights = lt_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_large_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ita_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_large_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erwartete Anzahl von Einträgen' exp = 2 act = lines( lt_result ) ). " Annahme: Es gibt 2 Flüge mit SEATSMAX > 200 in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erster Eintrag CARRIER' exp = 'AA' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid ).

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für ein 'Logger'-Objekt mit einer Methode zum Schreiben von Nachrichten. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse und demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE` und `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTS ...`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In einer realen Anwendung würde hier in ein Log geschrieben (z.B. SYSLOG, Datenbank).
    " Für dieses Beispiel verwenden wir WRITE für die Konsolenausgabe.
    WRITE: / |Log-Nachricht: { iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_message.
    DATA(lo_logger) = CAST zif_logger( NEW zcl_console_logger( ) ).
    " Die Methode log_message gibt direkt auf die Konsole aus.
    " Ein direkter Assert auf die Ausgabe ist in ABAP Unit nicht trivial.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob der Aufruf keine Ausnahme wirft.
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Testnachricht für den Logger' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Logger-Aufruf sollte keine Ausnahme werfen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Interfaces (`IMPLEMENTS`) fördert die lose Kopplung und ermöglicht Polymorphie. Die Klasse `zcl_console_logger` implementiert das Interface `zif_logger`, wodurch sie als jeder Typ behandelt werden kann, der `zif_logger` implementiert. `WRITE` wird hier für eine einfache Konsolenausgabe im Beispiel verwendet.
keywords: Interface, IMPLEMENTS, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, WRITE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze (SEATSMAX) aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie dabei den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ita_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ita_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_for_carrier.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ita_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_for_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Summe der Sitzplätze für AA' exp = 600 act = lv_total_seats ). " Annahme: AA hat Flüge mit 300 und 300 Sitzen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Schleife zu durchlaufen und einen Wert schrittweise zu akkumulieren, was zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges ('Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Unbekannt') basierend auf einer gegebenen Verspätungszeit in Minuten. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung eines Wertes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_delay_minutes TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes <= 0 THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 0 AND iv_delay_minutes <= 30 THEN 'Leicht verspätet'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 30 THEN 'Stark verspätet'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Pünktlich' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Leicht verspätet' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 15 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Stark verspätet' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 60 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Pünktlich' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( -10 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine kompakte und ausdrucksstarke bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er ersetzt mehrzeilige `IF`-`ELSE IF`-Konstrukte und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expression, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Datum. Verwenden Sie dabei die neue Open SQL-Syntax mit Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_select_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_select_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_single_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_single_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_select_single( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20251203' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flug sollte gefunden werden' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'AA' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '0017' act = ls_flight-connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die neue Open SQL-Syntax mit Inline-Deklarationen (`INTO @DATA(...)`) vereinfacht den Datenbankzugriff erheblich. Sie macht explizite `DATA`-Deklarationen überflüssig und verbessert die Lesbarkeit, da die Datenstruktur direkt aus der `SELECT`-Anweisung abgeleitet wird.
keywords: Open SQL, SELECT SINGLE, Inline Declaration, Database Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null durchführt und eine eigene, klassenbasierte Ausnahme wirft, wenn der Divisor Null ist. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme ab.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` sowie `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_divide_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_divide_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_divide_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 5 act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Es sollte eine Ausnahme geworfen werden.' ).
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Ausnahme erfolgreich abgefangen.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Klassenbasierte Ausnahmen sind der moderne Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen eine strukturierte und typsichere Fehlerbehandlung, die die Wartbarkeit und Robustheit des Codes verbessert. `TRY...CATCH` ist das zentrale Konstrukt zum Abfangen von Ausnahmen.
keywords: Exceptions, TRY CATCH, Class-based exceptions, Error Handling, RAISE EXCEPTION

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einem bestimmten Datum zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` für die deklarative Filterung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ita_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ita_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
    ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate = iv_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ita_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_fldate = '20251203' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erwartete Anzahl von Einträgen' exp = 1 act = lines( lt_result ) ). " Annahme: Ein Flug für AA am 20251203
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'AA' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '20251203' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist deklarativ und vermeidet explizite Schleifen, was den Code kürzer und verständlicher macht. Die Verwendung von `USING KEY` kann die Performance bei großen Tabellen verbessern.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, Selection, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die nacheinander aufgerufen werden können (Method Chaining), um eine Zeichenkette zu verarbeiten (z.B. trimmen, Großbuchstaben, Präfix hinzufügen).
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden `ME` zurück, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS trim_string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS add_prefix IMPORTING iv_prefix TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim_string.
    CONDENSE mv_current_string NO-GAPS.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    TRANSLATE mv_current_string TO UPPER CASE.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_prefix.
    mv_current_string = iv_prefix && mv_current_string.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lv_result) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( '  hello world  ' )->trim_string( )->to_upper( )->add_prefix( 'ABAP: ' )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'ABAP: HELLOWORLD' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen, flüssigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, insbesondere bei Objekten, die eine Reihe von Transformationen durchführen. Jede Methode, die das Chaining fortsetzen soll, muss eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Functional Programming, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie das aktuelle Datum und die aktuelle Uhrzeit und formatieren Sie diese für die Ausgabe. Verwenden Sie `GET TIME STAMP` und `CONVERT DATE/TIME`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GET TIME STAMP FIELD` und `CONVERT DATE/TIME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_datetime RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_dt) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_datetime.
    DATA: lv_timestamp TYPE timestampl,
          lv_date      TYPE sy-datum,
          lv_time      TYPE sy-uzeit.

    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_timestamp.

    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_timestamp
      INTO DATE lv_date
      TIME lv_time
      TIME ZONE sy-zonlo.

    rv_formatted_dt = |Aktuelles Datum: { lv_date DATE = USER }, Aktuelle Uhrzeit: { lv_time TIME = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_formatted_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_formatted_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_datetime( ).

    " Da Datum und Uhrzeit dynamisch sind, prüfen wir nur das Format.
    " Beispiel: 'Aktuelles Datum: 03.12.2025, Aktuelle Uhrzeit: 10:30:00'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches_regex( exp = 'Aktuelles Datum: \d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4}, Aktuelle Uhrzeit: \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `GET TIME STAMP` und `CONVERT DATE/TIME` sind die Standardmethoden, um mit Zeitstempeln zu arbeiten und diese in lesbare Datums- und Zeitformate umzuwandeln. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`DATE = USER`, `TIME = USER`) sorgt für eine benutzerfreundliche Formatierung.
keywords: Date, Time, Timestamp, CONVERT, GET TIME STAMP, String Templates

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitzplätze pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie dabei den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ita_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             avg_seats   TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_seats_by_flight RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ita_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_seats_by_flight.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc
    ) ).

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid, connid = ls_group-connid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid    = ls_group-carrid,
        connid    = ls_group-connid,
        avg_seats = REDUCE f( INIT sum = 0.0 count = 0
                               FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group
                                 NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-seatsocc, count = count + 1
                               FINALLY sum / count ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_avg_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ita_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_seats_by_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lt_result ).
    " Annahme: Für Flug AA 0017 gibt es 2 Einträge mit 100 und 150 Sitzen, Durchschnitt 125
    DATA(ls_aa_0017) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Durchschnitt für AA 0017' exp = 125.0 act = ls_aa_0017-avg_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS`-Syntax (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature zur Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` ermöglicht sie komplexe Berechnungen pro Gruppe in einer deklarativen und hochperformanten Weise, was traditionelle `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und manuelle Aggregationen ersetzt.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes in einer Struktur ausliest, dessen Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie dabei die neue Syntax für dynamische Feldzugriffe.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Syntax `(field_name)` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    TRY.
        rv_value = is_data-(iv_field_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        rv_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden oder Typkonflikt'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_success.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Hello' act = lv_value ).

    lv_value = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '123' act = lv_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_field_value_not_found.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Test'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden oder Typkonflikt' act = lv_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Feldzugriff mit der Syntax `(field_name)` (ab ABAP 7.50) ist eine moderne und typsichere Alternative zu `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO <fs>`. Er ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur oder eines Objekts, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, und ist dabei besser in Ausdrücke integrierbar.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Dynamic Field Access, ABAP 7.50, TRY CATCH

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine WHILE-Schleife, um alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Substrings in einem Text zu finden und zu ersetzen, ohne die `REPLACE ALL` Anweisung zu verwenden. Demonstrieren Sie dabei moderne String-Operationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND`, `OFFSET`, `LENGTH` und String-Templates innerhalb der WHILE-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_replace_while DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_text       TYPE string
        iv_old_sub    TYPE string
        iv_new_sub    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replace_while IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_substring.
    DATA(lv_current_text) = iv_text.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_found_offset) = 0.

    WHILE lv_offset < strlen( lv_current_text ).
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_old_sub IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset OF lv_current_text MATCH OFFSET lv_found_offset.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_current_text = |{ lv_current_text(lv_found_offset) }{ iv_new_sub }{ lv_current_text+lv_found_offset+strlen(iv_old_sub) }|.
        lv_offset = lv_found_offset + strlen( iv_new_sub ).
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_result = lv_current_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_single FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_replace_multiple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_replace FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_single.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replace_while( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_old_sub = 'World' iv_new_sub = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello ABAP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_replace_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replace_while( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring( iv_text = 'ABAP is great, ABAP is fun.' iv_old_sub = 'ABAP' iv_new_sub = 'SAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'SAP is great, SAP is fun.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replace_while( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring( iv_text = 'No match here' iv_old_sub = 'XYZ' iv_new_sub = 'ABC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'No match here' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replace_while( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring( iv_text = '' iv_old_sub = 'A' iv_new_sub = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife in Kombination mit `FIND` und String-Templates, um eine Zeichenkette iterativ zu manipulieren. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, komplexe String-Operationen durchzuführen, wenn die Standard-Anweisungen nicht ausreichen oder eine feinere Kontrolle erforderlich ist. String-Templates (`|...|`) verbessern die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: WHILE, String Processing, FIND, String Templates, REPLACE

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie die Klasse `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` und setzen Sie einige grundlegende Eigenschaften. Da eine vollständige GUI-Anwendung hier nicht möglich ist, konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Objektinitialisierung und das Setzen von Parametern, die später in einem Dynpro verwendet würden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` und Methoden wie `SET_PROPERTY` oder `SET_DATA_SOURCE` (falls vorhanden) der Viewer-Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_setup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS setup_viewer
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE string
        iv_data_source    TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_viewer)  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_setup IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der ersten N geraden Zahlen, die größer als ein gegebener Startwert sind, unter Verwendung einer `WHILE`-Schleife und der `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die geraden Zahlen zu finden, und `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_even_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_value TYPE i
        iv_count       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum)  TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_even_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    DATA(lt_even_numbers) = VALUE i_table( ).
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_start_value.
    DATA(lv_found_count) = 0.

    WHILE lv_found_count < iv_count.
      IF lv_current_number MOD 2 = 0.
        APPEND lv_current_number TO lt_even_numbers.
        lv_found_count = lv_found_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR number IN lt_even_numbers
      NEXT sum = sum + number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten (aus der Tabelle `sflights`) für die potenzielle Anzeige in einem 2D-Viewer vor. Extrahieren Sie relevante Felder und formatieren Sie sie als String-Tabelle, die als 'Annotations' oder 'Properties' an den Viewer übergeben werden könnte. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT`, `FOR` und String-Templates, um die Daten zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_for_viewer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
             distance TYPE sflight-distance,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_viewer_annotations TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_annotations
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_annotations) TYPE tt_viewer_annotations.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_for_viewer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_annotations.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_spfli    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO iv_max_entries ROWS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = lt_sflights-carrid AND connid = lt_sflights-connid.

    rt_annotations = VALUE tt_viewer_annotations(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET city_data = lt_spfli[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid ] IN
      ( |Flight: { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }, Date: { flight-fldate DATE = USER }
         From: { city_data-cityfrom } To: { city_data-cityto } Distance: { flight-distance } KM| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Zahl so lange durch 2 teilt, bis sie ungerade wird, und dabei die Anzahl der Divisionen zählt. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Die `WHILE`-Bedingung sollte prüfen, ob die Zahl gerade ist. Verwenden Sie den `MOD`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_divide_until_odd DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_divisions
      IMPORTING
        iv_number       TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_odd_number   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_divisions) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divide_until_odd IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_divisions.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.
    DATA(lv_divisions) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_number MOD 2 = 0 AND lv_current_number <> 0.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number / 2.
      lv_divisions = lv_divisions + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    ev_odd_number = lv_current_number.
    rv_divisions = lv_divisions.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
