Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Warteschlange (Queue) unter Verwendung einer internen Tabelle. Fügen Sie Elemente hinzu und entfernen Sie sie in einer `WHILE`-Schleife, bis die Warteschlange leer ist. Demonstrieren Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Tabellenmanipulation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `APPEND` zum Hinzufügen und `DELETE TABLE INDEX 1` zum Entfernen des ersten Elements. Die `WHILE`-Bedingung sollte `NOT it_queue IS INITIAL` sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_queue_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_queue_elements TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_queue
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_elements TYPE tt_queue_elements
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_order) TYPE tt_queue_elements.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_queue_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA(lt_queue) = it_initial_elements.
    DATA(lt_processed) = VALUE tt_queue_elements( ).
    DATA(lv_element) = VALUE string( ).

    WHILE NOT lt_queue IS INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1 INTO lv_element.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND lv_element TO lt_processed.
        DELETE TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1.
      ELSE.
        " Should not happen if WHILE condition is met
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rt_processed_order = lt_processed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um dynamisch eine Methode auf einem Objekt vom Typ `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` aufzurufen. Da der Viewer eine GUI-Klasse ist, simulieren Sie den Aufruf einer generischen 'SET_PROPERTY'-Methode mit dynamischen Parametern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `cl_abap_methdescr` für RTTI und `CALL METHOD` mit `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_viewer_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_viewer_method_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        io_viewer_ref TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_property_name TYPE string
        iv_property_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_viewer_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_viewer_method_dynamic.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_meth_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr,
          lt_parameters  TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter   TYPE abap_parmbind.

    TRY.
        " Get RTTI for the class
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_viewer_ref ).

        " Get RTTI for the method
        lo_meth_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( iv_method_name ).

        " Prepare parameters for SET_PROPERTY
        ls_parameter-name = 'PROPERTY_NAME'.
        ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_parmbind=>exporting.
        GET REFERENCE OF iv_property_name INTO ls_parameter-value.
        APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

        ls_parameter-name = 'PROPERTY_VALUE'.
        ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_parmbind=>exporting.
        GET REFERENCE OF iv_property_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
        APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

        " Dynamic method call
        CALL METHOD io_viewer_ref->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_rtti_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Retry-Logik für eine hypothetische Operation, die fehlschlagen kann. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Operation maximal N-mal zu wiederholen, bis sie erfolgreich ist oder die maximale Anzahl von Versuchen erreicht ist. Fügen Sie eine künstliche Verzögerung zwischen den Versuchen ein.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einem Zähler und einer Bedingung für den Erfolg. `WAIT UP TO` kann für die Verzögerung verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_retry_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_with_retry
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i
        iv_sim_success_on_try TYPE i " Simulate success on this try number (1-based)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_retry_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_with_retry.
    DATA(lv_current_try) = 0.
    DATA(lv_operation_successful) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_current_try < iv_max_retries AND lv_operation_successful = abap_false.
      lv_current_try = lv_current_try + 1.

      " Simulate an operation that might fail
      IF lv_current_try = iv_sim_success_on_try.
        lv_operation_successful = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        " Simulate a delay before retrying
        WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_success = lv_operation_successful.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie die Fibonacci-Sequenz bis zu einem bestimmten Grenzwert. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Zahlen zu berechnen und in einer internen Tabelle zu speichern.
hint: Die `WHILE`-Bedingung sollte prüfen, ob die nächste Fibonacci-Zahl den Grenzwert überschreitet. Verwenden Sie `APPEND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fibonacci_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_fibonacci_sequence TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_sequence
      IMPORTING
        iv_limit       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sequence) TYPE tt_fibonacci_sequence.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fibonacci_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sequence.
    DATA(lv_a) = 0.
    DATA(lv_b) = 1.
    DATA(lv_next) = 0.

    IF iv_limit < 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_limit >= 0.
      APPEND lv_a TO rt_sequence.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_limit >= 1.
      APPEND lv_b TO rt_sequence.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_next <= iv_limit.
      lv_next = lv_a + lv_b.
      IF lv_next > iv_limit.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_next TO rt_sequence.
      lv_a = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_next.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_hotspot_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES tt_raw_hotspots TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_hotspot WITH EMPTY KEY.

             hotspot_id TYPE string,

             tooltip    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_viewer_hotspot.

      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE string.

    " In a real scenario, you would call a method on mo_viewer to add these hotspots.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um eine interne Tabelle zu verarbeiten, indem Sie Elemente basierend auf einer Bedingung entfernen und die verbleibenden Elemente in einer neuen Tabelle sammeln. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle `sflights` und entfernen Sie Flüge mit einer Distanz unter einem bestimmten Wert.
hint: Iterieren Sie mit `WHILE NOT itab IS INITIAL`. Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE INDEX 1` und `DELETE TABLE INDEX 1` in Kombination mit `APPEND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_while DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_distance
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_distance TYPE sflight-distance
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_while IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_distance.
    DATA(lt_working_flights) = it_flights.
    DATA(ls_flight) TYPE sflight.

    WHILE NOT lt_working_flights IS INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_working_flights INDEX 1 INTO ls_flight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF ls_flight-distance >= iv_min_distance.
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_filtered_flights.
        ENDIF.
        DELETE TABLE lt_working_flights INDEX 1.
      ELSE.
        " Should not happen if WHILE condition is met
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen komplexen, durch Kommas getrennten String, der auch Anführungszeichen enthalten kann, in eine interne Tabelle von Komponenten. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und moderne String-Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND`, `SUBSTRING`, `COND` und `WHILE` für die iterative Tokenisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parser_while DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_line TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser_while IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_string.
    DATA(lv_remaining_string) = iv_csv_line.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_length) = 0.
    DATA(lv_component) = VALUE string( ).

    WHILE lv_remaining_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF lv_remaining_string(1) = `'` OR lv_remaining_string(1) = `"`.
        " Handle quoted field
        DATA(lv_quote_char) = lv_remaining_string(1).
        DATA(lv_end_quote_pos) = 0.
        FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_quote_char IN SECTION OFFSET 1 OF lv_remaining_string MATCH OFFSET lv_end_quote_pos.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_component = lv_remaining_string+1(lv_end_quote_pos - 1).
          lv_length = lv_end_quote_pos + 1.
          IF lv_remaining_string+lv_length(1) = `,`.
            lv_length = lv_length + 1.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          " Malformed CSV, no closing quote
          lv_component = lv_remaining_string.
          lv_length = strlen( lv_remaining_string ).
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        " Handle unquoted field
        DATA(lv_comma_pos) = 0.
        FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF `,` IN lv_remaining_string MATCH OFFSET lv_comma_pos.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_component = lv_remaining_string(lv_comma_pos).
          lv_length = lv_comma_pos + 1.
        ELSE.
          lv_component = lv_remaining_string.
          lv_length = strlen( lv_remaining_string ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_component TO rt_components.
      lv_remaining_string = lv_remaining_string+lv_length.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_dynamic_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

        it_config_params TYPE tt_config_params

CLASS zcl_ecl_dynamic_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD configure_viewer.
    DATA(lt_params_to_process) = it_config_params.
    DATA(ls_param) TYPE ty_config_param.
    rv_success = abap_true.

    WHILE NOT lt_params_to_process IS INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_params_to_process INDEX 1 INTO ls_param.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        TRY.
            io_viewer_ref->set_property( property_name = ls_param-name property_value = ls_param-value ).
          CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_gui_error.
            " Log error or handle specific exceptions
            rv_success = abap_false.
            " Continue processing other parameters even if one fails
        ENDTRY.
        DELETE TABLE lt_params_to_process INDEX 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die gruppierten Daten zu verarbeiten und für jede Gruppe eine Zusammenfassung zu erstellen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Gruppierung und Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Gruppen zu verarbeiten. `REDUCE` kann für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppe verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights_while DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             total_distance TYPE sflight-distance,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights_while IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      ( flight )
    ).

    DATA(lt_summary_temp) = VALUE tt_flight_summary( ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_distance) = REDUCE sflight-distance(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + member-distance
      ).

      DATA(lv_num_flights) = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT count = count + 1
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        fldate = ls_group_key-fldate
        total_distance = lv_total_distance
        num_flights = lv_num_flights
      ) TO lt_summary_temp.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Now process the temporary summary table using WHILE loop
    DATA(lt_summary_to_process) = lt_summary_temp.
    DATA(ls_current_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary.

    WHILE NOT lt_summary_to_process IS INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_summary_to_process INDEX 1 INTO ls_current_summary.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_current_summary TO rt_summary.
        DELETE TABLE lt_summary_to_process INDEX 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp und einer Liste von Feldnamen füllt. Die Daten sollen aus der Tabelle `sflights` stammen. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Felder zu verarbeiten und dynamisch Daten zuzuweisen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabelle, `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Feldzugriff und eine `WHILE`-Schleife für die Datenzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHTS'
        it_field_names     TYPE tt_field_names
        iv_max_rows        TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field_value>   TYPE ANY.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Fetch data from sflights
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS.

    DATA(lv_current_row) = 0.
    DATA(lt_sflights_to_process) = lt_sflights.

    WHILE lv_current_row < iv_max_rows AND NOT lt_sflights_to_process IS INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_sflights_to_process INDEX 1 INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Create new line for dynamic table
        CREATE DATA REF TO (iv_table_type_name).
        ASSIGN sy->ptr->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

        " Dynamically assign field values
        DATA(lt_fields_to_process) = it_field_names.
        DATA(lv_field_name) = VALUE string( ).

        WHILE NOT lt_fields_to_process IS INITIAL.
          READ TABLE lt_fields_to_process INDEX 1 INTO lv_field_name.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_field_value>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field_value>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <lv_field_value> = <lv_field_value>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
            DELETE TABLE lt_fields_to_process INDEX 1.
          ELSE.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDWHILE.

        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
        DELETE TABLE lt_sflights_to_process INDEX 1.
        lv_current_row = lv_current_row + 1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Aktualisierung eines `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` Objekts in einer `WHILE`-Schleife, um einen Fortschritt oder eine Animation darzustellen. Da eine echte GUI-Animation komplex ist, konzentrieren Sie sich auf die iterative Aktualisierung eines 'Status'-Eigenschaftswerts des Viewers.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einem Zähler und `SET_PROPERTY` des Viewers. Fügen Sie eine kleine Verzögerung mit `WAIT UP TO` ein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_animator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS animate_viewer_status
      IMPORTING
        io_viewer_ref TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer
        iv_steps      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_animator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD animate_viewer_status.
    DATA(lv_current_step) = 0.
    rv_success = abap_true.

    WHILE lv_current_step < iv_steps.
      lv_current_step = lv_current_step + 1.
      DATA(lv_status_message) = |Processing step { lv_current_step } of { iv_steps }|.

      TRY.
          io_viewer_ref->set_property( property_name = 'StatusMessage' property_value = lv_status_message ).
          " In a real GUI, you might also call io_viewer_ref->flush( ) to update immediately.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_gui_error.
          rv_success = abap_false.
          EXIT. " Stop animation on error
      ENDTRY.

      " Simulate work or a short delay
      WAIT UP TO 0.1 SECONDS.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights-Struktur), bei denen die Fluggesellschaft 'AA' ist, unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle ohne diese Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die gewünschten Einträge enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_exclude_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid <> iv_exclude_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250104' price = '250' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_flights = lt_flights iv_exclude_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights-Struktur), die nur die Flüge enthält, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität für Economy-Sitze haben, und entfernen Sie dabei alle anderen. Verwenden Sie eine moderne Tabellenexpression.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc_e TYPE sflight-seatsocc_e,
             seatsmax_e TYPE sflight-seatsmax_e,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_economy_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_ext
        iv_min_economy_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax_e
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_economy_capacity.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                   WHERE ( seatsmax_e >= iv_min_economy_seats )
                                   ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_by_economy_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_economy_capacity.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_capacity_filter=>tt_sflight_ext.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax_e = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax_e = 50 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax_e = 120 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0987' seatsmax_e = 80 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_by_economy_capacity( it_flights = lt_flights iv_min_economy_seats = 90 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE #( FOR ... WHERE ... ( ... ) )`-Konstruktion ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu initialisieren und gleichzeitig zu filtern. Sie ist deklarativ, kompakt und vermeidet explizite Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.

CLASS zcl_i18n_text_retriever DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_text_by_language
      IMPORTING
        iv_text_id TYPE string " e.g., 'GREETING'
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_text_retriever IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text_by_language.
    CASE iv_text_id.
      WHEN 'GREETING'.
        CASE iv_language.
          WHEN 'D'.
            rv_text = 'Hallo Welt!'.
          WHEN 'E'.
            rv_text = 'Hello World!'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_text = 'Hello World!'. " Default to English
        ENDCASE.
      WHEN 'FAREWELL'.
        CASE iv_language.
          WHEN 'D'.
            rv_text = 'Auf Wiedersehen!'.
          WHEN 'E'.
            rv_text = 'Goodbye!'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_text = 'Goodbye!'.
        ENDCASE.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_text = 'Text not found'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Strings fallunabhängig und gebietsschema-sensitiv. Simulieren Sie die Funktionalität einer I18N-Utility-Klasse, die komplexe Vergleichsregeln handhaben könnte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TO UPPER` oder `TO LOWER` für einen einfachen fallunabhängigen Vergleich. Erklären Sie, dass `cl_i18n_utils` komplexere Unicode- und gebietsschema-spezifische Regeln hätte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_string_comparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_case_insensitive
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1 TYPE string
        iv_string2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS compare_locale_sensitive_case_ins
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1 TYPE string
        iv_string2 TYPE string
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_string_comparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_case_insensitive.
    rv_are_equal = COND #( WHEN to_upper( iv_string1 ) = to_upper( iv_string2 ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_locale_sensitive_case_ins.
    " Simulation: In a real scenario, cl_i18n_utils would handle complex Unicode
    " and locale-specific casing rules (e.g., German 'ß' vs 'SS').
    " For this example, we'll use a simple TO_UPPER, but acknowledge its limitations.
    DATA lv_string1_upper TYPE string.
    DATA lv_string2_upper TYPE string.

    " In a real I18N class, this would involve more sophisticated logic
    " potentially using external libraries or specific kernel functions.
    lv_string1_upper = to_upper( iv_string1 ).
    lv_string2_upper = to_upper( iv_string2 ).

    rv_are_equal = COND #( WHEN lv_string1_upper = lv_string2_upper THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_compare_strings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_strings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_string_comparer( ).

    " Test case-insensitive comparison
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_case_insensitive( iv_string1 = 'Hello' iv_string2 = 'hello' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_case_insensitive( iv_string1 = 'World' iv_string2 = 'word' ) exp = abap_false ).

    " Test locale-sensitive (simulated) case-insensitive comparison
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_locale_sensitive_case_ins( iv_string1 = 'Straße' iv_string2 = 'strasse' iv_language = 'D' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_locale_sensitive_case_ins( iv_string1 = 'Straße' iv_string2 = 'STRASSE' iv_language = 'D' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->compare_locale_sensitive_case_ins( iv_string1 = 'Test' iv_string2 = 'tEst' iv_language = 'E' ) exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein gebietsschema-sensitiver und fallunabhängiger String-Vergleich ist für korrekte Sortierung, Suche und Validierung in internationalen Daten unerlässlich. Während `TO_UPPER` eine einfache Lösung bietet, würde eine Klasse wie `cl_i18n_utils` die komplexen Regeln von Unicode und verschiedenen Sprachen (z.B. die Behandlung von 'ß' im Deutschen oder 'İ' im Türkischen) korrekt implementieren, was mit einfachen String-Funktionen nicht möglich ist.

hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung zur Simulation. Erklären Sie, dass `cl_i18n_utils` eine robuste Zuordnung von Sprache zu Textrichtung bieten würde.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_text_direction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_text_direction TYPE c LENGTH 3 VALUE 'LTR'. " LTR (Left-to-Right) or RTL (Right-to-Left)

    METHODS get_text_direction
      IMPORTING
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_direction) TYPE ty_text_direction.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_text_direction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text_direction.
    CASE iv_language.
      WHEN 'AR' OR 'HE'. " Arabic, Hebrew are typically RTL
        rv_direction = 'RTL'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_direction = 'LTR'. " Most other languages are LTR
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_text_direction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_text_direction.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_text_direction( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_text_direction( 'D' ) exp = 'LTR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_text_direction( 'E' ) exp = 'LTR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_text_direction( 'AR' ) exp = 'RTL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_text_direction( 'HE' ) exp = 'RTL' ).

explanation: Die Bestimmung der Textrichtung ist für die korrekte Darstellung von Benutzeroberflächen in Sprachen wie Arabisch oder Hebräisch (die von rechts nach links gelesen werden) unerlässlich. Eine Klasse wie `cl_i18n_utils` würde eine zentrale und zuverlässige Quelle für diese Information bieten, anstatt sie manuell über `CASE`-Anweisungen zu verwalten.
keywords: I18N, Text Direction, LTR, RTL, Locale, cl_i18n_utils (simulated)

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights-Struktur), die einen Preis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert haben, und geben Sie die gelöschten Einträge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE` mit `WHERE` und `FOR` in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_deleter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_and_return_low_price_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_deleted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_deleter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_and_return_low_price_flights.
    rt_deleted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN ct_flights
                                   WHERE ( price < iv_min_price )
                                   ( flight ) ).

    DELETE ct_flights WHERE price < iv_min_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_low_price_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_low_price_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_price_deleter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0987' price = '75' currency = 'GBP' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_deleter( ).
    DATA(lt_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_and_return_low_price_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights IMPORTING iv_min_price = '90' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_deleted ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_deleted[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_deleted[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine Kombination aus modernen ABAP-Features: Zuerst wird mit einer `FOR`-Expression und `VALUE` eine Tabelle der zu löschenden Einträge erstellt. Anschließend werden die Einträge mit der `DELETE`-Anweisung und einer `WHERE`-Klausel aus der Originaltabelle entfernt. Dies ist effizient und ermöglicht es, sowohl die verbleibenden als auch die gelöschten Daten zu verwalten.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, FOR, VALUE, WHERE, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Formatieren Sie eine Liste von Werten in einem String-Template, wobei die Formatierung gebietsschema-sensitiv ist. Simulieren Sie die Integration mit einer I18N-Utility-Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates in Kombination mit simulierten I18N-Formatierungsfunktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_template_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_list_with_locale
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE string_table
        iv_locale TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_list) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS simulate_i18n_format_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
        iv_locale TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_template_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_list_with_locale.
    DATA(lv_separator) = COND string(
      WHEN iv_locale = 'D' THEN ', '
      WHEN OTHERS THEN '; ' ).

    rv_formatted_list = |
      Die formatierten Werte für Locale { iv_locale } sind:
      { REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ''
          FOR value IN it_values
          NEXT s = COND string(
            WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN simulate_i18n_format_value( value = value locale = iv_locale )
            ELSE s && lv_separator && simulate_i18n_format_value( value = value locale = iv_locale ) ) ) }.
    |.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_i18n_format_value.
    " This method simulates a call to cl_i18n_utils=>format_value_by_locale
    " For simplicity, we'll just add a prefix based on locale.
    CASE iv_locale.
      WHEN 'D'.
        rv_formatted_value = |DE:{ iv_value }|.
      WHEN 'E'.
        rv_formatted_value = |EN:{ iv_value }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_formatted_value = |{ iv_value }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_list_template FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_list_template.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_template_formatter( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Item1' ) ( 'Item2' ) ( 'Item3' ) ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_de) = lo_cut->format_list_with_locale( it_values = lt_values iv_locale = 'D' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_de exp = 'Die formatierten Werte für Locale D sind: DE:Item1, DE:Item2, DE:Item3.' ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_en) = lo_cut->format_list_with_locale( it_values = lt_values iv_locale = 'E' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_en exp = 'Die formatierten Werte für Locale E sind: EN:Item1; EN:Item2; EN:Item3.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von String-Templates und dem `REDUCE`-Operator, um dynamisch und gebietsschema-sensitiv formatierte Listen zu erstellen. Die Integration mit einer simulierten `cl_i18n_utils`-Methode zeigt, wie I18N-Funktionalität nahtlos in moderne ABAP-Syntax eingebettet werden kann, um komplexe, lokalisierte Ausgaben zu generieren.
keywords: I18N, String Templates, REDUCE, Locale, Formatting, cl_i18n_utils (simulated)

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur in einen JSON-String.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_to_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             field1 TYPE string,

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_std_flights) TYPE zcl_conv_table_type=>tt_sflight_std.

Dies ist besonders nützlich, um die Vorteile von Hash-Tabellen (schneller Zugriff über Schlüssel) zu nutzen, nachdem Daten initial in einer Standardtabelle gesammelt wurden. Die Tabellenkonstruktor-Syntax (`VALUE #(...)`) wird hier implizit genutzt.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Down-Cast von einer Interface-Referenz auf eine konkrete Klassenreferenz durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CONV`-Operator für den Down-Cast.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * 3. " Simplified area calculation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_down_cast DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_down_cast
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_circle) TYPE REF TO zcl_circle.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_down_cast IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_down_cast.
    ro_circle = CONV #( io_shape ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_down_cast FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_down_cast.
    DATA(lo_shape) TYPE REF TO zif_shape.
    lo_shape = NEW zcl_circle( 5 ).

    DATA(lo_caster) = NEW zcl_conv_down_cast( ).
    DATA(lo_circle_casted) = lo_caster->perform_down_cast( lo_shape ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_circle_casted msg = 'Down-cast should result in a non-initial object' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_circle_casted->mv_radius exp = 5 msg = 'Radius should be 5 after down-cast' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV`-Operator ermöglicht einen sicheren Down-Cast von einer generischeren Referenz (z.B. Interface-Referenz) auf eine spezifischere Referenz (z.B. Klassenreferenz). Das System prüft zur Laufzeit, ob der tatsächliche Objekttyp kompatibel ist. Bei Erfolg wird die Referenz zugewiesen; bei Inkompatibilität kommt es zu einer Laufzeitfehlermeldung (CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR), was die Typsicherheit erhöht.
keywords: CONV, Object Orientation, Casting, Interface, Down-Cast

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft aus den Tabellen `sflight` und `scarr` mittels `INNER JOIN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... INNER JOIN ... ON ... INTO TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_inner_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_with_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_inner_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_inner_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inner_join.
    DATA(lo_joiner) = NEW zcl_join_inner_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_joiner->get_flights_with_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid msg = 'Carrier ID should be filled' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrname msg = 'Carrier Name should be filled' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `INNER JOIN` ist die Standardmethode in Open SQL, um Datensätze aus zwei oder mehr Datenbanktabellen zu kombinieren, basierend auf einer Übereinstimmung in den angegebenen Join-Bedingungen. Nur Datensätze, für die eine Übereinstimmung in beiden Tabellen gefunden wird, werden im Ergebnis enthalten sein. Die Alias-Vergabe (`AS s`, `AS c`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und vermeidet Namenskollisionen.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, SELECT, sflight, scarr, Database Access

Instructions: Selektieren Sie alle Flugdaten und, falls vorhanden, die zugehörigen Buchungsdaten aus `sflight` und `sbook` mittels `LEFT OUTER JOIN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... LEFT OUTER JOIN ... ON ... INTO TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_left_outer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             customid TYPE sbook-customid,
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    TYPES: tt_flight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_bookings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_bookings) TYPE tt_flight_booking.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_left_outer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_bookings.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid, b~customid
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid
                                AND s~connid = b~connid
                                AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights_bookings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_left_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_outer_join.
    DATA(lo_joiner) = NEW zcl_join_left_outer( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_bookings) = lo_joiner->get_flights_with_bookings( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_bookings msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if there are entries where booking data might be initial (no booking found)
    DATA(lv_initial_bookings) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_bookings INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-bookid IS INITIAL.
        lv_initial_bookings = lv_initial_bookings + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_initial_bookings >= 0 ) msg = 'Should have at least some flights, some possibly without bookings' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` gibt alle Datensätze der linken Tabelle (`sflight`) zurück und die passenden Datensätze der rechten Tabelle (`sbook`). Wenn für einen Datensatz in der linken Tabelle keine Übereinstimmung in der rechten Tabelle gefunden wird, werden die Spalten der rechten Tabelle mit Initialwerten (NULL) gefüllt. Dies ist nützlich, wenn Sie alle 'linken' Daten sehen möchten, unabhängig davon, ob passende 'rechte' Daten existieren.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SELECT, sflight, sbook, Database Access

Instructions: Selektieren Sie alle Flüge für eine bestimmte Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `sflight` unter Verwendung von `FOR ALL ENTRIES`.
hint: Zuerst die benötigten Schlüssel in eine interne Tabelle selektieren, dann `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für die zweite Tabelle verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_for_all_entries DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_for_all_entries IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_for_all_entries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_all_entries.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_join_for_all_entries( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT 'AA' INTO TABLE lt_carrids.
    INSERT 'LH' INTO TABLE lt_carrids.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if all returned flights belong to the specified carriers
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      READ TABLE lt_carrids WITH KEY table_line = ls_flight-carrid TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } is not in the requested carrier list| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR ALL ENTRIES` ist eine leistungsstarke Open SQL-Erweiterung, die eine Alternative zu Joins darstellen kann, insbesondere wenn die 'linke' Tabelle (hier `it_carrids`) relativ klein ist und die 'rechte' Tabelle (`sflight`) sehr groß. Es vermeidet das Senden einer großen Anzahl von Einzel-SELECTs an die Datenbank und kann die Performance erheblich verbessern, da die Datenbank die WHERE-Klausel dynamisch basierend auf den Einträgen der internen Tabelle aufbaut. Es ist wichtig, die interne Tabelle vor der Verwendung auf Nicht-Initialität zu prüfen.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, JOIN, Performance, SELECT, sflight

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten und Fluggesellschaftsnamen in eine interne Tabelle, deren Struktur nicht exakt den Datenbanktabellen entspricht, unter Verwendung von `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
hint: Definieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den gewünschten Feldern und verwenden Sie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_custom_flight_info,
             airline_id    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             airline_name  TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_number TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_custom_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_custom_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_custom_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_custom_flight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_custom_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_custom_flight_info.
    SELECT s~carrid    AS airline_id,
           c~carrname  AS airline_name,
           s~connid    AS flight_number,
           s~fldate    AS flight_date
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flight_info.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_corresponding_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_fields.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_join_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_info) = lo_selector->get_custom_flight_info( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_info msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    IF lines( lt_flight_info ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_info[ 1 ]-airline_id msg = 'Airline ID should be filled' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_info[ 1 ]-airline_name msg = 'Airline Name should be filled' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_info[ 1 ]-flight_number msg = 'Flight Number should be filled' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` ist nützlich, wenn die Struktur der Ziel-internen Tabelle nicht exakt der Selektionsliste entspricht, aber einige Feldnamen übereinstimmen. Das System ordnet die Werte automatisch den Feldern mit identischen Namen zu. Dies reduziert den manuellen Zuweisungsaufwand und erhöht die Flexibilität bei der Datenaufnahme. Es ist jedoch wichtig, Aliasnamen in der SELECT-Liste zu verwenden, wenn die Feldnamen in den Datenbanktabellen nicht direkt den gewünschten Feldnamen in der internen Tabelle entsprechen.
keywords: JOIN, SELECT, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, sflight, scarr, Database Access

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten und den Namen der Fluggesellschaft. Fügen Sie eine Spalte hinzu, die den Status des Fluges basierend auf dem Datum anzeigt (z.B. 'PAST', 'FUTURE', 'TODAY').
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Expression direkt im `SELECT`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_case_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname    TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_case_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate,
           CASE WHEN s~fldate < @sy-datum THEN 'PAST'
                WHEN s~fldate = @sy-datum THEN 'TODAY'
                ELSE 'FUTURE'
           END AS flight_status
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_case_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_case_expression.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_join_case_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if flight_status is correctly assigned for at least one entry (if data exists)
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate < sy-datum.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_status exp = 'PAST' msg = 'Flight status should be PAST' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_status exp = 'TODAY' msg = 'Flight status should be TODAY' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_status exp = 'FUTURE' msg = 'Flight status should be FUTURE' ).
      ENDIF.
      EXIT. " Only check the first entry for simplicity
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE`-Expression in Open SQL ermöglicht es, bedingte Logik direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung auf der Datenbankebene auszuführen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um abgeleitete Spalten zu erstellen, ohne die Daten erst in ABAP lesen und dann verarbeiten zu müssen. Es reduziert den Datenverkehr zwischen Datenbank und Applikationsserver und verbessert die Performance.
keywords: JOIN, SELECT, CASE, Conditional Logic, sflight, scarr, Database Access

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen in eine interne Tabelle mit nur einem Feld, indem Sie den `MAP`-Operator verwenden, um ein spezifisches Feld zu extrahieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONV` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `MAP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_carrids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_carrids.
    rt_carrids = CONV tt_carrids( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_table_map_conv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_map_conv.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_table_map( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) TYPE zcl_conv_table_map=>tt_sflight_full.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_converter->extract_carrids( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrids ) exp = 3 msg = 'Result table should have 3 entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrids[ 1 ] exp = 'AA' msg = 'First entry should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrids[ 2 ] exp = 'LH' msg = 'Second entry should be LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `CONV` mit der `FOR`-Iteration und der Tabellenkonstruktor-Syntax ist ein Beispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP. Es ermöglicht die Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, indem für jeden Eintrag der Quelltabelle ein neuer Eintrag in der Zieltabelle erzeugt wird. Dies ist sehr kompakt und lesbar für solche Mapping-Szenarien.
keywords: CONV, Internal Tables, FOR, MAP, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge, die in der `sflight`-Tabelle vorhanden sind, unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und `JOIN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY ...` mit Aggregatfunktionen und einem `INNER JOIN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_summary.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count, SUM( s~price ) AS total_price
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_join.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_join_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_aggregator->get_carrier_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summary msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if at least one carrier has a flight count > 0
    DATA(lv_found_flights) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-flight_count > 0.
        lv_found_flights = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_flights msg = 'At least one carrier should have flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `INNER JOIN` mit `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen (`COUNT`, `SUM`) in einem `SELECT`-Statement ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um zusammenfassende Daten direkt von der Datenbank abzurufen. Anstatt alle Detaildaten zu lesen und dann in ABAP zu aggregieren, wird die Aggregation auf der Datenbankebene durchgeführt, was den Datenverkehr und die Verarbeitungszeit reduziert. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der modernen Datenbeschaffung in ABAP.
keywords: JOIN, GROUP BY, Aggregation, SELECT, sflight, scarr, Database Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum) und füllen Sie diese direkt bei der Deklaration mit einigen Werten. Die Tabelle soll nach Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Datum sortiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für die Zeilenstruktur und `VALUE #(...)` zur Initialisierung einer `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_initial_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initial_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( " Initialisiert eine sortierte Tabelle mit Werten
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' ) " Einzigartig durch fldate
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250110' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sorted_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sorted_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_create( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_initial_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ). " Prüft die Sortierung nach carrid
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ). " Prüft die Sortierung nach fldate innerhalb von carrid/connid
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SORTED TABLE` bietet performanten Zugriff über den Schlüssel und hält die Daten immer sortiert. Die `VALUE #(...)` Syntax ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung von internen Tabellen direkt bei der Deklaration.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, VALUE #, Internal Tables, Initialization, UNIQUE KEY

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer sortierten Tabelle basierend auf einem Schlüssel. Überprüfen Sie zuerst, ob der Eintrag existiert, und greifen Sie dann sicher darauf zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und den Tabellenausdruck `itab[key]` für den performanten und sicheren Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( " Initialisiert die interne Tabelle
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250110' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    IF line_exists( mt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      rs_flight = mt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error. " Wirft eine Ausnahme, wenn der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( " Prüft, ob eine Ausnahme geworfen wird
      EXPORTING
        class = 'CX_SY_READ_ERROR'
      CHANGING
        act   = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` prüft effizient die Existenz eines Eintrags, bevor der Tabellenausdruck (`itab[key]`) verwendet wird, um den Eintrag ohne Gefahr eines Dumps bei Nichtexistenz zu lesen. Dies ist performanter und sicherer als `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC` in vielen Fällen.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, LINE_EXISTS, TABLE_LINE, Internal Tables, Read, Tabellenausdruck

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie das Flugdatum eines bestehenden Eintrags in einer sortierten Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE itab FROM wa` für sortierte Tabellen mit eindeutigem Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS update_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_new_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( " Initialisiert die interne Tabelle
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250110' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_date.
    DATA(ls_flight_update) = VALUE ty_flight_data( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_new_fldate ).
    MODIFY TABLE mt_flights FROM ls_flight_update. " Aktualisiert den Eintrag basierend auf dem Schlüssel in ls_flight_update
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_date( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_new_fldate = '20251231' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ]-fldate exp = '20251231' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_date( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_new_fldate = '20251231' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `MODIFY TABLE FROM wa` ist die moderne und effiziente Art, einen Eintrag in einer sortierten Tabelle zu aktualisieren, wenn der Schlüssel der Workarea mit dem Tabellenschlüssel übereinstimmt. Die Tabelle bleibt dabei sortiert. Dies ist besonders effizient bei `SORTED TABLE`.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, MODIFY TABLE, Internal Tables, Update

Instructions: Entfernen Sie doppelte Einträge aus einer sortierten Tabelle basierend auf einem Teil des Schlüssels (z.B. gleiche Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer, aber unterschiedliches Datum, wobei nur der erste behalten wird).
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` mit der `COMPARING` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_dedup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid connid. " Non-unique key für dieses Beispiel

    METHODS remove_duplicate_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_dedup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicate_flights.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flights. " Kopie für die Modifikation
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid. " Entfernt Duplikate basierend auf carrid und connid
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_dedup( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_dups) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_dedup=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' ) " Duplikat für carrid/connid
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250110' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_unique_flights) = lo_cut->remove_duplicate_flights( lt_flights_with_dups ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique_flights[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ). " Der erste LH 0400 Eintrag sollte erhalten bleiben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine einfache und effiziente Methode, um aufeinanderfolgende doppelte Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Da die Tabelle bereits sortiert ist, funktioniert dies hier optimal, um Duplikate basierend auf den angegebenen Feldern zu eliminieren.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Tables, Duplicates, COMPARING

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle mit Daten aus einer Standardtabelle, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übernommen werden und die Daten direkt in der Zieltabelle sortiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #` und `CORRESPONDING #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES: tt_target_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS populate_sorted_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD populate_sorted_table.
    rt_target_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_source> IN it_source_data " Iteriert über die Quelltabelle
                               ( CORRESPONDING #( <fs_source> ) ) ). " Übernimmt passende Felder und fügt sie in die Zieltabelle ein
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_populate_sorted_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_populate_sorted_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_for_corr( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_for_corr=>tt_source_data(
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250110' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' price = '150.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->populate_sorted_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ). " Prüft die automatische Sortierung
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE #` und `FOR` Schleife mit `CORRESPONDING #` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und deklarative Transformation und Befüllung von internen Tabellen. Die `SORTED TABLE` stellt sicher, dass die Zieltabelle automatisch sortiert wird, was die Performance bei nachfolgenden Zugriffen verbessert.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Transformation, VALUE #

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer sortierten Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( s_price )0 " Initialisiert die Summe
                               FOR flight IN it_flights " Iteriert über die Flüge
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ). " Addiert den Preis jedes Fluges zur Summe
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_reduce=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250110' price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '450.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_reduce=>tt_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne und sehr lesbare Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP` Schleifen für solche Anwendungsfälle und funktioniert effizient mit `SORTED TABLE`.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine sortierte Tabelle, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ). " Filtert die Tabelle nach der Fluggesellschaft
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine sortierte Tabelle von Flugdaten verwaltet und Methoden zum Hinzufügen und Abrufen von Flügen bereitstellt. Nutzen Sie den `NEW` Operator zur Instanziierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `NEW` Operator zur Instanziierung und kapseln Sie die `SORTED TABLE` als privates Attribut.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS add_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_all_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight.
    INSERT is_flight INTO TABLE mt_flights. " Fügt den Flug in die sortierte Tabelle ein
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_and_get_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_and_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_flight_manager( ).
    DATA(ls_flight1) = VALUE zcl_flight_manager=>ty_flight_data( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ).
    DATA(ls_flight2) = VALUE zcl_flight_manager=>ty_flight_data( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_manager->add_flight( ls_flight1 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_manager->add_flight( ls_flight2 ) ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_manager->get_all_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ). " Prüft die Sortierung
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_flight.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_flight_manager( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_flight_manager=>ty_flight_data( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_manager->add_flight( ls_flight ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_manager->add_flight( ls_flight ) ). " Einfügen eines Duplikats sollte fehlschlagen
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_manager->get_all_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kapselung einer `SORTED TABLE` in einer Klasse und die Bereitstellung von Methoden für den Zugriff und die Manipulation ist ein grundlegendes Prinzip der Objektorientierung. Der `NEW` Operator ist die moderne Art, Objekte zu instanziieren, und `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` ist effizient für sortierte Tabellen.
keywords: Object Orientation, NEW, SORTED TABLE, Encapsulation, INSERT TABLE

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` und speichern Sie diese direkt in einer sortierten internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` mit einer `SORTED TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_into_sorted_tab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             mandt  TYPE sflight-mandt,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_into_sorted_tab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT mandt, carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights. " Daten werden direkt in die sortierte Tabelle gelesen und sortiert
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_sflights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_sflights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
