CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_into_sorted_tab( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_sflights ). " Prüft, ob Daten gelesen wurden
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ). " Prüft die Sortierung (Annahme: AA ist die erste)
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_sflights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_into_sorted_tab( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_sflights ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ). " Prüft, ob nur LH-Flüge enthalten sind
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Syntax `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ist die moderne Art, Daten aus der Datenbank in eine interne Tabelle zu lesen. Wenn die Zieltabelle eine `SORTED TABLE` ist, werden die Daten direkt beim Lesen in der richtigen Reihenfolge eingefügt, was die Performance optimiert, da keine nachträgliche Sortierung erforderlich ist.
keywords: SELECT, INTO TABLE, SORTED TABLE, Database Access, Open SQL, DATA(...)

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine sortierte Tabelle basierend auf einer übergebenen Feldliste sortiert und zurückgibt. (Hinweis: Die Sortierung einer `SORTED TABLE` ist statisch definiert. Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine dynamische Sortierung einer Standardtabelle, die dann in eine `SORTED TABLE` überführt wird, um die Vorteile der `SORTED TABLE` für den Zugriff zu nutzen.)
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT itab BY (field_list)` für die dynamische Sortierung einer Standardtabelle, bevor Sie sie in eine `SORTED TABLE` überführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort_to_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_standard_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sorted_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_dynamically_sorted_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_standard_flights
        iv_sort_field TYPE string " Feldname für die dynamische Sortierung
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sorted_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort_to_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamically_sorted_flights.
    DATA lt_temp_flights TYPE tt_standard_flights.
    lt_temp_flights = it_flights.

    SORT lt_temp_flights BY (iv_sort_field). " Dynamische Sortierung der Standardtabelle

    rt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_temp_flights
                                   ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) ) ). " Überführung in die sortierte Tabelle
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sort_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sort_by_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sort_by_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort_to_sorted( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_sort_to_sorted=>tt_standard_flights(
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250110' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' price = '150.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_by_carrid) = lo_cut->get_dynamically_sorted_flights( it_flights = lt_initial_flights iv_sort_field = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_carrid[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_by_carrid[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_sort_by_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort_to_sorted( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_sort_to_sorted=>tt_standard_flights(
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250110' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' price = '150.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_by_price) = lo_cut->get_dynamically_sorted_flights( it_flights = lt_initial_flights iv_sort_field = 'PRICE' ).

explanation: Obwohl `SORTED TABLE` eine statisch definierte Sortierreihenfolge hat, kann man eine Standardtabelle dynamisch sortieren (`SORT itab BY (field_list)`) und die sortierten Daten dann in eine `SORTED TABLE` überführen. Dies kombiniert die Flexibilität der dynamischen Sortierung mit den Performance-Vorteilen der `SORTED TABLE` für nachfolgende Zugriffe.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SORT, SORTED TABLE, Internal Tables, Dynamic Sort

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge in einer sortierten Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_group=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250110' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_carrier_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_group=>tt_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke moderne Funktion, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. In Kombination mit `SORTED TABLE` ist dies besonders effizient, da die Daten bereits vorsortiert sind, was die Gruppierung beschleunigt. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Grouping, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten N Flüge aus einer sortierten Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_top_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_n           TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_n_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights.
    rt_top_n_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_all_flights UP TO iv_n ROWS
                                  ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `UP TO N ROWS` ermöglicht das einfache und effiziente Extrahieren der ersten N Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle. Bei einer `SORTED TABLE` sind dies direkt die N kleinsten Elemente gemäß der Sortierreihenfolge, was diese Syntax sehr nützlich für 'Top N'-Szenarien macht.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, UP TO N ROWS, Internal Tables, Data Retrieval, Top N

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue sortierte Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft enthält, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS summarize_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                           ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                             num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_summarize_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_summarize_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_transform=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250110' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ]-num_flights exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'AA' ]-num_flights exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ carrid = 'UA' ]-num_flights exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_summarize_flights_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_transform=>tt_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE #`, `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und `GROUP SIZE` ist eine sehr moderne und leistungsstarke Methode, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und gleichzeitig in eine neue Struktur zu transformieren. Dies ist eine deklarative und effiziente Alternative zu komplexen `LOOP` und `COLLECT` Anweisungen und funktioniert hervorragend mit `SORTED TABLE`.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Transformation, Aggregation, Functional Programming, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle programmatisch. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu bilden, und anschließend die `lines()`-Funktion.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_avg_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_avg_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_sflights ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag (Text) basierend auf einer numerischen Eingabe (1-7) unter Verwendung einer `SWITCH`-Expression und Konstanten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` und `CONSTANTS` für die Wochentage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weekday_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_day_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_mon TYPE i VALUE 1, lc_tue TYPE i VALUE 2, lc_wed TYPE i VALUE 3,
      lc_thu TYPE i VALUE 4, lc_fri TYPE i VALUE 5, lc_sat TYPE i VALUE 6,
      lc_sun TYPE i VALUE 7.

    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH #( iv_day_number
      WHEN lc_mon THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN lc_tue THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN lc_wed THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN lc_thu THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN lc_fri THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN lc_sat THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN lc_sun THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und filtern Sie diese in einer `FOR`-Schleife, wobei der Fluggesellschaftscode als Konstante definiert ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONSTANTS`, `SELECT`, `FOR` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_carrier_lh TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH'.

    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = lc_carrier_lh ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_filter->get_lh_flights( ).

    " Check if all returned flights are 'LH'
    LOOP AT lt_lh_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check if at least some LH flights are found (assuming SFLIGHT has LH data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_lh_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_id.
    CONSTANTS:
      lc_table_name TYPE tabname VALUE 'SFLIGHT',
      lc_field_carrid TYPE fieldname VALUE 'CARRID',
      lc_field_connid TYPE fieldname VALUE 'CONNID',
      lc_field_fldate TYPE fieldname VALUE 'FLDATE'.

    SELECT SINGLE (lc_field_carrid)
      FROM (lc_table_name)
      INTO @rv_carrier_id
      WHERE (lc_field_carrid) = @iv_carrid
        AND (lc_field_connid) = @iv_connid
        AND (lc_field_fldate) = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Daten in einen JSON-String, aber nur mit den Feldern CARRID, CONNID und PRICE, wobei PRICE in 'FlightPrice' umbenannt wird.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Zwischenstruktur mit den gewünschten Feldern und verwenden Sie dann `cl_fdt_json`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_map_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_output,
             carrier_id  TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection  TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_output,
           tt_flight_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_mapped_sflights_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_map_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mapped_sflights_json.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights) UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    DATA(lt_mapped_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_output(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_flights
      (
        carrier_id = ls_raw-carrid,
        connection = ls_raw-connid,
        flight_price = ls_raw-price
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_writer( ).
    lo_writer->write_data( lt_mapped_flights ).
    rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_json_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mapped_json_output FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapped_json_output.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_json_map_fields( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_mapper->get_mapped_sflights_json( iv_max_rows = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_json
      msg = 'JSON string should not be initial'
      cond = lv_json IS INITIAL
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_json CS 'carrier_id' AND lv_json CS 'connection' AND lv_json CS 'flight_price' )
      msg = 'JSON string should contain mapped flight data'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = ( lv_json CS 'CARRID' OR lv_json CS 'CONNID' OR lv_json CS 'PRICE' )
      msg = 'JSON string should not contain original field names'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine Zwischenstruktur und die moderne `FOR`-Iteration, um Felder umzubenennen und auszuwählen, bevor die Daten in JSON serialisiert werden. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Anpassung des JSON-Outputs.
keywords: JSON, Serialisierung, Feldmapping, FOR, VALUE, cl_fdt_json

solution:

REPORT z_gui_text_container.

CLASS zcl_gui_text_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS display_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string.
    METHODS free_objects.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_text_editor    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_text_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating custom container' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_text_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating text editor' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_text.
    IF mo_text_editor IS BOUND.
      mo_text_editor->set_text_as_stream( iv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_objects.
    IF mo_text_editor IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_text_editor->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_custom_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_custom_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

DATA go_text_display TYPE REF TO zcl_gui_text_display.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  CALL SCREEN 9000.

MODULE pbo_9000 OUTPUT.
  IF go_text_display IS NOT BOUND.
    go_text_display = NEW zcl_gui_text_display( 'MY_CONTAINER' ).
    go_text_display->display_text( 'Dies ist ein Beispieltext im Custom Container.' ).
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE pai_9000 INPUT.
  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
      go_text_display->free_objects( ).
      LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.

    " In einem echten Unit-Test für GUI-Objekte würde man Test-Doubles oder Dependency Injection verwenden.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die dynamische Erstellung und Zerstörung eines benutzerdefinierten Containers und seines Inhalts basierend auf einer Benutzerinteraktion (z.B. einem Button-Klick). (Hinweis: Ein Dynpro 9000 mit einem Custom Control Element namens 'DYNAMIC_CONTAINER' und einem Button 'TOGGLE' wird vorausgesetzt.)
hint: Verwenden Sie `FREE` für die Zerstörung des Containers und seiner Steuerelemente. Überprüfen Sie den Status der Referenzvariablen (`IS BOUND`).

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS toggle_container_content.
    METHODS free_objects.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_text_editor    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mv_container_active TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA mv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD toggle_container_content.
    IF mv_container_active = abap_false.
      " Create container and content
      CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = mv_container_name
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS         = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating custom container' TYPE 'E'. RETURN. ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_text_editor
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_custom_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating text editor' TYPE 'E'. RETURN. ENDIF.

      mo_text_editor->set_text_as_stream( 'Dynamisch erstellter Text.' ).
      mv_container_active = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      " Destroy container and content
      IF mo_text_editor IS BOUND.
        CALL METHOD mo_text_editor->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        CLEAR mo_text_editor.
      ENDIF.
      IF mo_custom_container IS BOUND.
        CALL METHOD mo_custom_container->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        CLEAR mo_custom_container.
      ENDIF.
      mv_container_active = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_objects.
    IF mo_text_editor IS BOUND. CALL METHOD mo_text_editor->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1. ENDIF.
    IF mo_custom_container IS BOUND. CALL METHOD mo_custom_container->free EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS free_objects.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

CLASS zcl_gui_alv_events IMPLEMENTATION.

      EXPORTING

      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating custom container' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights_with_events.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = mo_custom_container
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_alv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        CREATE OBJECT mo_event_handler.
        SET HANDLER mo_event_handler->on_double_click FOR mo_alv_table->get_event_handler( ).

        mo_alv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_objects.
    IF mo_alv_table IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_table->cl_salv_table~free( ).
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_custom_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_custom_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_json_omit_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_json_omit_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights_omit_initial.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    " Modify one entry to have initial values for demonstration
    IF lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.
      lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price = 0.
      lt_sflights[ 1 ]-currency = ''.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_writer(
      i_omit_initial_values = abap_true

    rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_json_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen JSON-String, der ein Array von Objekten enthält, wobei jedes Objekt eine Flugverbindung (CARRID, CONNID) und eine Liste von Passagieren für diese Verbindung darstellt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` und `cl_fdt_json`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger,
             name TYPE string,
             seat TYPE string,
           END OF ty_passenger,
           tt_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_passengers,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             passengers TYPE tt_passengers,
           END OF ty_flight_with_passengers,
           tt_flights_with_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_passengers_json
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_passengers_json.
    DATA: lt_sbook TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook.

    " Simulate some passenger data
    lt_sbook = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' customid = '1' passname = 'Max Mustermann' seat = '1A' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' customid = '2' passname = 'Erika Musterfrau' seat = '1B' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' customid = '3' passname = 'John Doe' seat = '2C' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_flights_with_passengers(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sbook IN lt_sbook GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sbook-carrid connid = ls_sbook-connid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_sbook-carrid
        connid = ls_sbook-connid
        passengers = VALUE tt_passengers(
          FOR ls_passenger IN GROUP ls_sbook
          ( name = ls_passenger-passname
            seat = ls_passenger-seat )
        )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_writer( ).
    lo_writer->write_data( lt_grouped_flights ).
    rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_json_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_json_output FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_json_output.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_json_group_by( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_processor->get_flights_with_passengers_json( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_json
      msg = 'JSON string should not be initial'
      cond = lv_json IS INITIAL
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_json CS 'LH' AND lv_json CS '0400' AND lv_json CS 'passengers' AND lv_json CS 'Max Mustermann' )
      msg = 'JSON should contain grouped flight and passenger data'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_json CS 'AA' AND lv_json CS '0017' AND lv_json CS 'John Doe' )
      msg = 'JSON should contain all grouped data'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke `FOR ... GROUP BY`-Syntax in modernem ABAP, um Daten zu aggregieren und in eine verschachtelte Struktur zu transformieren, die dann effizient in einen JSON-String serialisiert wird. Dies ist ideal für die Erstellung komplexer JSON-Strukturen aus relationalen Daten.
keywords: JSON, Serialisierung, GROUP BY, FOR, VALUE, cl_fdt_json, Datenaggregation

CLASS zcl_gui_picture_viewer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating custom container' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_db_modify_04 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_from_table
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_db_modify_04 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_from_table.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT *
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
        <fs_sflight>-price = iv_new_price.
      ENDLOOP.
      MODIFY sflights FROM TABLE @lt_sflights.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche maximale Kapazität.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_max_seats TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_stats
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_stats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(flight) GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                         INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                      FOR member IN GROUP
                                        NEXT sum = sum + member-max_seats ).
      DATA(lv_avg_seats) = COND f( WHEN lv_flight_count > 0 THEN lv_total_seats / lv_flight_count ELSE 0 ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_stats( carrid        = group_key-carrid
                                     flight_count  = lv_flight_count
                                     avg_max_seats = lv_avg_seats ) TO rt_stats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_get_carrier_stats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_stats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) >= 0 ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit Aggregationsoperatoren wie `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe können komplexe Analysen effizient durchgeführt werden.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, sflights, Aggregation, LOOP AT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'FLIGHT_STATUS' hinzu, die basierend auf dem Flugdatum 'PLANNED' oder 'COMPLETED' anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer `COND`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_add_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid       TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate       TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_seats    TYPE sflight-max_seats,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_add_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          ( CORRESPONDING #( flight )
                            flight_status = COND string( WHEN flight-fldate > sy-datum THEN 'PLANNED'
                                                        ELSE 'COMPLETED' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_add_column( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) >= 0 ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_flight-flight_status ).
      IF ls_first_flight-fldate > sy-datum.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-flight_status exp = 'PLANNED' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-flight_status exp = 'COMPLETED' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität aus der Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie dessen Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um den Eintrag mit dem Maximum zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_max_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_max_flight.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_max_flight) TYPE ty_max_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_max_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_max_flight = REDUCE ty_max_flight(
      INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_max_flight( carrid = '' connid = '' max_seats = 0 )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_flight = COND ty_max_flight( WHEN flight-max_seats > max_flight-max_seats
                                            THEN VALUE ty_max_flight( carrid = flight-carrid
                                                                      connid = flight-connid
                                                                      max_seats = flight-max_seats )
                                            ELSE max_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Durch die Kombination mit `COND` kann der Akkumulatorwert bedingt aktualisiert werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (z.B. SFLIGHT) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Datenbank.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` für die Tabellendefinition. Für den Datenzugriff `SELECT * FROM (table_name) INTO TABLE (data_ref->*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.

        IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name) INTO TABLE <lt_table> UP TO 10 ROWS.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation_error cx_sy_table_creation_error.
        " Handle errors appropriately
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prog_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und ändern Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Handle conversion error if value type mismatch
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine zirkuläre Verschiebung (Rotation) von Zeichen in einem String durch.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SHIFT` mit String-Operationen wie `substring` oder String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_circular DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS rotate_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_places       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rotated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_circular IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD rotate_string.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
    IF lv_length = 0 OR iv_places = 0.
      rv_rotated_string = iv_input_string.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_actual_places) = iv_places MOD lv_length.
    IF lv_actual_places < 0.
      lv_actual_places = lv_length + lv_actual_places.
    ENDIF.

    rv_rotated_string = |
      { iv_input_string+lv_actual_places(lv_length - lv_actual_places) }
      { iv_input_string(lv_actual_places) }
    |.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über eine interne Tabelle und greifen Sie auf Felder zu, deren Namen zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, um einen Gesamtwert zu berechnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line>  TYPE sflight,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        TRY.
            rv_sum = rv_sum + <fs_field>.
          CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Handle non-numeric fields or conversion errors
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten und füllen Sie diese mit Werten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` mit einer dynamisch erstellten Feldtabelle und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_def,
           tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data)       TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'STRING' ).
        WHEN 'INT'.
          ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'I' ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Default to string or handle error
          ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'STRING' ).
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                       <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                       <fs_field>         TYPE any.

        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line_ref>).

          " Example: Fill with some data
          LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line_ref> TO <fs_field>.
            IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
              CASE ls_field_def-type.
                WHEN 'STRING'.
                  <fs_field> = |Value for { ls_field_def-name }|.
                WHEN 'INT'.
                  <fs_field> = sy-tabix * 10.
              ENDCASE.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND <fs_line_ref> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

          " Add another row
          CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <fs_line_ref>.
          LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line_ref> TO <fs_field>.
            IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
              CASE ls_field_def-type.
                WHEN 'STRING'.
                  <fs_field> = |Another value for { ls_field_def-name }|.
                WHEN 'INT'.
                  <fs_field> = sy-tabix * 20.
              ENDCASE.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND <fs_line_ref> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation_error cx_sy_table_creation_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prog_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `GROUP BY` Klausel für eine interne Tabelle, um Daten basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feld zu gruppieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY (field_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_grouped,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_grouped,
           tt_sflight_grouped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_grouped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_sflight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_group_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_sflight_grouped.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_sflight_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_group_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY (iv_group_field) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group_key>).
      DATA ls_grouped_line LIKE LINE OF rt_grouped_data.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_group_key> TO <fs_group_field>.
      IF <fs_group_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        ls_grouped_line-carrid = <fs_group_field>.
      ENDIF.
      ls_grouped_line-count = GROUP SIZE.
      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group_key> INTO DATA(ls_member).
        ls_grouped_line-total_price = ls_grouped_line-total_price + ls_member-price.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_grouped_line TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `REDUCE` Operation für eine interne Tabelle, um einen einzelnen Wert basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feld zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit dynamischem Feldzugriff über `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rv_total = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight
      LET
        lv_current_value = 0
      IN
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs_field>.
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          TRY.
              lv_current_value = <fs_field>.
            CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error cx_sy_conversion_error.
              " Ignore non-numeric fields
          ENDTRY.
        ENDIF.
        NEXT sum = sum + lv_current_value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um die Ausnahme `CX_SY_JSON_READER_ERROR` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_data) TYPE ty_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_json_reader_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string CHANGING data = rs_flight_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_reader_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_json_reader_error EXPORTING previous = lx_json_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_json FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_json_reader_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_json.
    DATA(lv_invalid_json) = `{"CARRID":"LH","CONNID":"400","FLDATE":"20231203"`." Fehlendes schließendes Klammer
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_json_reader_error ).
    lo_cut->deserialize_with_error_handling( lv_invalid_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung ist bei der Verarbeitung externer Daten unerlässlich. Das Abfangen von `CX_SY_JSON_READER_ERROR` beim Deserialisieren von JSON-Strings ermöglicht es, ungültige Eingaben elegant zu behandeln und die Anwendung vor Abstürzen zu schützen.
keywords: JSON, Error Handling, Exception, TRY CATCH, /UI2/CL_JSON

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie Teile eines Strings basierend auf einem regulären Ausdruck. Nutzen Sie `REPLACE` mit `REGEX`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_replace_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_with_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_regex_pattern TYPE string
        iv_replacement   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replace_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_with_regex.
    rv_output_string = REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX iv_regex_pattern IN iv_input_string WITH iv_replacement.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_regex FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_regex.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_replace_regex( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_with_regex( iv_input_string = 'Email: test@example.com, another@domain.org' iv_regex_pattern = '\w+@\w+\.\w+' iv_replacement = '[EMAIL_HIDDEN]' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Email: [EMAIL_HIDDEN], [EMAIL_HIDDEN]' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_with_regex( iv_input_string = '123-456-7890' iv_regex_pattern = '\d{3}-\d{3}-\d{4}' iv_replacement = 'PHONE_NUMBER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'PHONE_NUMBER' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` Anweisung ist eine sehr mächtige Funktion in modernem ABAP, um komplexe Muster in Strings zu finden und zu ersetzen. Dies ist ideal für Datenbereinigung, Validierung oder Formatierung, wo einfache String-Ersetzungen nicht ausreichen.
keywords: REPLACE, REGEX, String Processing, Regular Expression, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende Leerzeichen aus einem String. Demonstrieren Sie sowohl die klassische `SHIFT`-Anweisung als auch die moderne, funktionale Alternative.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE` oder die moderne Funktion `STRIP` bzw. die `ALPHA = OUT` Option in String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_remove_leading_space DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_leading_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_remove_leading_space IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_leading_spaces.
    " Klassische SHIFT-Anweisung (als Kommentar zur Demonstration)
    " DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.
    " SHIFT lv_temp LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE.
    " rv_output = lv_temp.

    " Moderne ABAP-Funktion (STRIP oder ALPHA = OUT)
    rv_output = |{ iv_input ALPHA = OUT }|. " Alternativ: rv_output = strip( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_spaces FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_remove_leading_space( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->remove_leading_spaces( '   Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World' msg = 'Führende Leerzeichen sollten entfernt werden' ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->remove_leading_spaces( 'Hello World   ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World   ' msg = 'Nur führende Leerzeichen sollten entfernt werden' ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->remove_leading_spaces( 'Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World' msg = 'Keine Änderung bei fehlenden Leerzeichen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ALPHA = OUT` Option in String-Templates oder die `STRIP` Funktion sind die modernen und funktionalen Alternativen zu `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE`. Sie sind prägnanter und oft performanter, da sie direkt auf den String wirken, ohne eine temporäre Variable zu benötigen.
keywords: SHIFT, STRING_TEMPLATE, STRIP, ALPHA, String Processing

Instructions: Führen Sie eine zyklische Verschiebung eines Strings um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Positionen nach links durch. Demonstrieren Sie die moderne String-Slicing-Methode.
hint: Kombinieren Sie String-Slicing und Verkettung. Die klassische Methode wäre `SHIFT LEFT CIRCULAR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_cyclic_shift DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS cyclic_shift_left
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_positions TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_cyclic_shift IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD cyclic_shift_left.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    IF lv_length = 0 OR iv_positions = 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_actual_shift) = iv_positions MOD lv_length.
    IF lv_actual_shift = 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Moderne String-Operationen: Slicing und Verkettung
    rv_output = iv_input+lv_actual_shift( lv_length - lv_actual_shift ) &&
                iv_input( lv_actual_shift ).

    " Klassische SHIFT-Anweisung (als Kommentar zur Demonstration)
    " DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.
    " SHIFT lv_temp LEFT CIRCULAR BY lv_actual_shift PLACES.
    " rv_output = lv_temp.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cyclic_shift FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cyclic_shift.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_cyclic_shift( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->cyclic_shift_left( iv_input = 'ABCDE' iv_positions = 2 ) exp = 'CDEAB' msg = 'Shift 2 left' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->cyclic_shift_left( iv_input = 'ABCDE' iv_positions = 5 ) exp = 'ABCDE' msg = 'Shift by length' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->cyclic_shift_left( iv_input = 'ABCDE' iv_positions = 0 ) exp = 'ABCDE' msg = 'Shift by 0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->cyclic_shift_left( iv_input = '' iv_positions = 3 ) exp = '' msg = 'Empty string' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->cyclic_shift_left( iv_input = 'ABCDE' iv_positions = 7 ) exp = 'CDEAB' msg = 'Shift > length' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Während `SHIFT ... CIRCULAR` eine direkte Anweisung für zyklische Verschiebungen ist, demonstriert die moderne Lösung mit String-Slicing (`iv_input+offset(length)`) und Verkettung (`&&`) die Flexibilität und Lesbarkeit funktionaler String-Operationen in ABAP.
keywords: SHIFT, STRING_SLICING, STRING_CONCATENATION, String Processing

Instructions: Maskieren Sie die mittleren Zeichen eines Strings (z.B. Kreditkartennummer) mit Sternchen, wobei die ersten und letzten vier Zeichen sichtbar bleiben. Nutzen Sie moderne String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Slicing, die Funktion `REPEAT` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_mask_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS mask_sensitive_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_mask_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mask_sensitive_string.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    IF lv_length <= 8. " Nicht genug Zeichen zum Maskieren
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_first_part) = iv_input(4).
    DATA(lv_last_part) = iv_input+ ( lv_length - 4 ) (4).
    DATA(lv_middle_length) = lv_length - 8.

    " Moderne Lösung mit String-Templates und REPEAT
    rv_output = |{ lv_first_part }{ repeat( val = '*' occ = lv_middle_length ) }{ lv_last_part }|.

    " Klassische SHIFT-basierte Lösung (als Kommentar zur Demonstration)
    " DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.
    " DATA(lv_offset) = 4.
    " DO lv_middle_length TIMES.
    "   lv_temp+lv_offset(1) = '*'.
    "   lv_offset = lv_offset + 1.
    " ENDDO.
    " rv_output = lv_temp.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mask_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mask_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_mask_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mask_sensitive_string( '1234567890123456' ) exp = '1234********3456' msg = 'Standard Kreditkartennummer' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mask_sensitive_string( '12345678' ) exp = '12345678' msg = 'Zu kurz zum Maskieren' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mask_sensitive_string( '123456789' ) exp = '1234*6789' msg = 'Ungerade Länge' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mask_sensitive_string( '' ) exp = '' msg = 'Leerer String' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Lösung nutzt String-Slicing, die eingebaute Funktion `REPEAT` und String-Templates, um den String prägnant und effizient zu maskieren. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig als eine manuelle Zeichenverschiebung mit `SHIFT` in einer Schleife.
keywords: SHIFT, STRING_TEMPLATE, REPEAT, String Processing, Data Masking

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und bereiten Sie diese für die Darstellung der Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft in einem Diagramm mit `cl_gui_chart_engine` vor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation. Die `cl_gui_chart_engine` benötigt Daten in einem bestimmten Format.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        it_summary TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_flight_summary( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA:
      lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

    " Annahme: Ein Custom Container mit dem Namen 'CHART_CONTAINER' existiert auf dem Dynpro
    " oder wird dynamisch erstellt (hier nur Platzhalter für die Demonstration).
    " In einer echten Anwendung müsste der Container auf einem Dynpro platziert werden.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CHART_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container.

    " Daten für das Diagramm vorbereiten
    DATA:
      lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_tab,
      ls_chart_data LIKE LINE OF lt_chart_data.

    LOOP AT it_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      ls_chart_data-name = ls_summary-carrid.
      ls_chart_data-value = ls_summary-flight_count.
      APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Diagramm konfigurieren und anzeigen
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ). " Beispiel: Balkendiagramm
    lo_chart->set_title( 'Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summary IS INITIAL exp = abap_false msg = 'Zusammenfassung sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_summary ) msg = 'Es sollten Zeilen in der Zusammenfassung sein' ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob Lufthansa (LH) Flüge hat
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'LH sollte Flüge haben' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_flight_summary` nutzt `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` um die Daten aus `sflights` effizient zu aggregieren. Dies ist eine moderne, funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung, die den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... ENDLOOP` mit `AT NEW`/`AT END`. Die `display_chart` Methode zeigt die Integration mit `cl_gui_chart_engine`.
keywords: cl_gui_chart_engine, REDUCE, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Data Aggregation, GUI

Instructions: Selektieren Sie dynamisch Flugdaten aus `sflights` basierend auf einem vom Benutzer bereitgestellten Kriterium (z.B. `CARRID`) und bereiten Sie die Daten für ein Diagramm mit `cl_gui_chart_engine` vor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... WHERE (dynamic_condition)` für die dynamische Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
        price  TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_where_condition TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS display_chart_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_dynamic_where) = iv_where_condition.
    IF lv_dynamic_where IS INITIAL.
      lv_dynamic_where = 'CARRID = ''LH'''. " Standardbedingung, falls keine angegeben
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamische SELECT-Anweisung
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE (lv_dynamic_where)
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart_dynamic.
    DATA:
      lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      lo_chart     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CHART_CONTAINER'. " Annahme: Ein Custom Container existiert auf dem Dynpro

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container.

    DATA:
      lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_tab,
      ls_chart_data LIKE LINE OF lt_chart_data.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      ls_chart_data-name = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }|.
      ls_chart_data-value = ls_flight-price.
      APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line ). " Beispiel: Liniendiagramm
    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flugpreise nach dynamischer Auswahl' ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_dynamic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_dynamic_selection( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( iv_where_condition = 'CARRID = ''AA''' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights IS INITIAL exp = abap_false msg = 'Flüge für AA sollten gefunden werden' ).

    ENDLOOP.

    lt_flights = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( iv_where_condition = 'CARRID = ''XX''' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Keine Flüge für XX erwartet' ).
