ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsmax = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 110 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 130 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_eur.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_currency( it_sflights = mt_sflights iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '250.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_usd.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_currency( it_sflights = mt_sflights iv_currency = 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '750.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_none.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_currency( it_sflights = mt_sflights iv_currency = 'GBP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. Die WHERE-Klausel filtert die Einträge, und NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price akkumuliert die Summe effizient und lesbar, was die Notwendigkeit expliziter LOOP-Anweisungen und Hilfsvariablen reduziert.
keywords: REDUCE, COMPUTE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Finde den höchsten Flugpreis aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwende den REDUCE-Operator, um den Maximalwert zu ermitteln. Initialisiere den Maximalwert mit einem sehr kleinen Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_by_carrier.
    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0 " Initialize with a value that any price will exceed
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT max_price = nmax( val1 = max_price val2 = flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_currency.
    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
           count     TYPE i             VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price,
           count     = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_aggregation-sum_price / ls_aggregation-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_cond_sum IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + COND #( WHEN flight-fldate > sy-datum THEN flight-price ELSE 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Für jede Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, finde den höchsten Flugpreis und gib die Fluggesellschaft und den Maximalpreis zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_per_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_by_carrier,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_max_price_by_carrier,
           tt_max_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE tt_max_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_per_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_max_price) = REDUCE #( 
        INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = grouped_flight-price )
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_max_price_by_carrier( 
        carrid    = ls_group_key-carrid
        max_price = lv_max_price
      ) TO rt_max_prices.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weighted_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weighted_avg) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_average_price.
    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_product TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
           sum_weight  TYPE i             VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_product = sum_product + ( flight-price * flight-seatsmax ),
           sum_weight  = sum_weight + flight-seatsmax
    ).

    IF ls_aggregation-sum_weight > 0.
      rv_weighted_avg = ls_aggregation-sum_product / ls_aggregation-sum_weight.
    ELSE.
      rv_weighted_avg = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

CLASS zcl_max_price_entry IMPLEMENTATION.

    rs_flight = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_flight TYPE ty_sflight

      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_flight-price THEN flight ELSE max_flight )

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_top_flight_per_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_flight_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_top_flight_per_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_flight_per_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(ls_top_flight) = REDUCE #( 
        INIT max_flight TYPE ty_sflight
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN grouped_flight-price > max_flight-price THEN grouped_flight ELSE max_flight )
      ).

      APPEND ls_top_flight TO rt_top_flights.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_max_fldate_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_range_by_carrier,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_date_range_by_carrier,
           tt_date_range_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_range_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_max_fldate_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_date_ranges) TYPE tt_date_range_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_max_fldate_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_max_fldate_per_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(ls_date_agg) = REDUCE #( 
        INIT min_d TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '99991231'
             max_d TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '00000000'
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT min_d = nmin( val1 = min_d val2 = grouped_flight-fldate ),
             max_d = nmax( val1 = max_d val2 = grouped_flight-fldate )
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_date_range_by_carrier( 
        carrid    = ls_group_key-carrid
        min_fldate = ls_date_agg-min_d
        max_fldate = ls_date_agg-max_d
      ) TO rt_date_ranges.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Standardabweichung der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwende den REDUCE-Operator, um Summe, Summe der Quadrate und Anzahl zu akkumulieren, um die Standardabweichung zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_std_dev DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_price_std_deviation
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_std_dev) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_std_dev IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_std_deviation.
    DATA(ls_agg) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE f VALUE 0
           sum_sq_price TYPE f VALUE 0
           count TYPE i VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price,
           sum_sq_price = sum_sq_price + ( flight-price * flight-price ),
           count = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_agg-count > 1.
      DATA(lv_mean) = ls_agg-sum_price / ls_agg-count.
      DATA(lv_variance) = ( ls_agg-sum_sq_price / ls_agg-count ) - ( lv_mean * lv_mean ).
      rv_std_dev = sqrt( lv_variance ).
    ELSE.
      rv_std_dev = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsmax = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 110 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 130 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_std_dev_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_std_dev( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_price_std_deviation( it_sflights = mt_sflights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    " Prices: 100, 150, 200. Mean = 150. Variance = ((100-150)^2 + (150-150)^2 + (200-150)^2)/3 = (2500 + 0 + 2500)/3 = 5000/3 = 1666.66. Std Dev = sqrt(1666.66) = 40.82
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = round( val = lv_result dec = 2 ) exp = '40.82' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_std_dev_aa.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_std_dev( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_price_std_deviation( it_sflights = mt_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    " Prices: 250, 300. Mean = 275. Variance = ((250-275)^2 + (300-275)^2)/2 = (625 + 625)/2 = 1250/2 = 625. Std Dev = sqrt(625) = 25.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = round( val = lv_result dec = 2 ) exp = '25.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_std_dev_none.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_std_dev( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_price_std_deviation( it_sflights = mt_sflights iv_carrid = 'BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Berechnung der Standardabweichung ist ein komplexeres statistisches Problem, das die Summe der Werte, die Summe der Quadrate der Werte und die Anzahl der Werte erfordert. Der REDUCE-Operator kann all diese Akkumulatoren gleichzeitig verwalten, was eine sehr effiziente und moderne Implementierung ermöglicht. Die Verwendung von Gleitkommazahlen (TYPE F) und der Funktion SQRT ist hierbei entscheidend.
keywords: REDUCE, COMPUTE, Internal Tables, Math, Standard Deviation, Aggregation, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Baum, der Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` anzeigt. Die Lösung soll die Daten für den Baum aufbereiten und die Logik zum Hinzufügen von Knoten demonstrieren.

CLASS zcl_simple_flight_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE lvc_value,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_tree_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_flight_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_flight_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_node     TYPE ty_flight_node,
          lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey VALUE 0,
          lv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid connid.

    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) = ''.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid <> lv_prev_carrid.
        " Add carrier node
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        ls_node-node_key = lv_node_key.
        ls_node-parent_key = ' '.
        ls_node-text = <fs_flight>-carrid.
        APPEND ls_node TO rt_nodes.
        lv_parent_key = lv_node_key.
        lv_prev_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid.
      ENDIF.

      " Add flight node
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      ls_node-node_key = lv_node_key.
      ls_node-parent_key = lv_parent_key.
      ls_node-text = |{ <fs_flight>-connid } - { <fs_flight>-fldate DATE = USER }|.
      APPEND ls_node TO rt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Logik, die auf die Auswahl eines Flugknotens im Baum reagiert und die zugehörigen Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum) zurückgibt. Die 'Auswahl' wird durch die Übergabe des Knotenschlüssels simuliert.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_node_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.

    METHODS get_flight_detail_for_node
      IMPORTING iv_node_text TYPE lvc_value
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight_detail) TYPE ty_flight_detail
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_node_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_detail_for_node.
    DATA: lv_connid TYPE s_conn_id,
          lv_fldate TYPE s_date.

    " Extract CONNID and FLDATE from node text (e.g., '0017 - 20251203')
    TRY.
        FIND REGEX '(\d{4}) - (\d{8})' IN iv_node_text SUBMATCHES lv_connid, lv_fldate.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Invalid node text format'.
        ENDIF.
    CATCH cx_sy_regex_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Regex error during node text parsing'.
    ENDTRY.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE connid = @lv_connid
        AND fldate = @lv_fldate
      INTO @rs_flight_detail.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Flight data not found for node'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_flight_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE lvc_value,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_child_nodes) TYPE tt_flight_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_flight_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey VALUE 0.

    SELECT connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
          node_key = lv_node_key
          parent_key = iv_parent_key
          text = |{ <fs_flight>-connid } - { <fs_flight>-fldate DATE = USER }|
      ) TO rt_child_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.

    CONSTANTS: gc_action_show_details TYPE string VALUE 'SHOW_DETAILS'.

    METHODS execute_context_menu_action
      IMPORTING iv_node_text TYPE lvc_value
                iv_function_code TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight_detail) TYPE ty_flight_detail
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_context_menu_action.
    DATA: lv_connid TYPE s_conn_id,
          lv_fldate TYPE s_date.

    IF iv_function_code = gc_action_show_details.
      TRY.
          FIND REGEX '(\d{4}) - (\d{8})' IN iv_node_text SUBMATCHES lv_connid, lv_fldate.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
              EXPORTING
                text = 'Invalid node text format for details'.
          ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_regex_error.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Regex error during node text parsing for details'.
      ENDTRY.

      SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        WHERE connid = @lv_connid
          AND fldate = @lv_fldate
        INTO @rs_flight_detail.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Flight data not found for context menu action'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Unknown function code'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_sflights_multi_sheet
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_excel_document) TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.

CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_multi_sheet.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid.

    ro_excel_document = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>create_spreadsheet( ).

    DATA(lv_first_sheet) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      IF lv_first_sheet = abap_false.
        ro_excel_document->add_sheet( i_name = ls_flight-carrid ).
        ro_excel_document->set_active_sheet( i_name = ls_flight-carrid ).
      ELSE.
        ro_excel_document->set_active_sheet( i_name = ls_flight-carrid ).
        lv_first_sheet = abap_false.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_flights_for_carrier) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
          FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
          ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
            connid = <fs_flight>-connid
            fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate )
      ).

      ro_excel_document->add_data( EXPORTING i_data = lt_flights_for_carrier ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Baum, der die Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge aus `sflights` anzeigt. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die alle Knoten eines bestimmten Typs (z.B. nur Fluggesellschaften) expandiert oder kollabiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_node_state` mit `cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_state_expanded` oder `node_state_collapsed`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_expand_collapse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE lvc_value,
             is_carrier TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_tree_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_flight_nodes.

    METHODS get_carrier_node_keys
      IMPORTING it_all_nodes TYPE tt_flight_nodes
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_keys) TYPE lvc_t_nkey.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_expand_collapse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey VALUE 0,
          lv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid connid.

    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) = ''.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid <> lv_prev_carrid.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
            node_key = lv_node_key
            parent_key = ' '
            text = <fs_flight>-carrid
            is_carrier = abap_true
        ) TO rt_nodes.
        lv_parent_key = lv_node_key.
        lv_prev_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid.
      ENDIF.

      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
          node_key = lv_node_key
          parent_key = lv_parent_key
          text = |{ <fs_flight>-connid } - { <fs_flight>-fldate DATE = USER }|
          is_carrier = abap_false
      ) TO rt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_carrier_node_keys.
    rt_carrier_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_node IN it_all_nodes WHERE ( is_carrier = abap_true ) ( ls_node-node_key ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_keys FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_expand_collapse( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_tree_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Nodes should be generated' act = lines( lt_nodes ) ).

    DATA(lt_carrier_keys) = lo_cut->get_carrier_node_keys( lt_nodes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier keys should be found' act = lines( lt_carrier_keys ) ).

    " Verify that all found keys correspond to carrier nodes
    LOOP AT lt_carrier_keys INTO DATA(lv_key).
      READ TABLE lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node) WITH KEY node_key = lv_key.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Found key should belong to a carrier node' act = ls_node-is_carrier ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Datenaufbereitung um ein Flag `is_carrier`, um Knotentypen zu identifizieren. Die Methode `get_carrier_node_keys` verwendet eine moderne `FOR`-Iteration mit `WHERE`-Klausel, um effizient alle Knotenschlüssel von Fluggesellschaften zu sammeln. Diese Schlüssel könnten dann an `cl_gui_simple_tree=>set_node_state` übergeben werden, um alle Fluggesellschaften zu expandieren oder zu kollabieren.
keywords: cl_gui_simple_tree, Expand, Collapse, Node State, FOR, WHERE

CLASS zcl_excel_cond_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_sflights_cond_format
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_excel_document) TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_cond_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_cond_format.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lt_header   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    ro_excel_document = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>create_spreadsheet( ).

    " Add header row
    APPEND 'Airline' TO lt_header.
    APPEND 'Flight No.' TO lt_header.
    APPEND 'Flight Date' TO lt_header.
    APPEND 'Price' TO lt_header.
    APPEND 'Currency' TO lt_header.
    ro_excel_document->add_data( EXPORTING i_data = lt_header ).

    " Add flight data
    ro_excel_document->add_data( EXPORTING i_data = lt_sflights ).

    " Define conditional format for prices > 500
    DATA(lo_cond_format) = ro_excel_document->create_conditional_format( ).
    DATA(lo_format_style) = ro_excel_document->create_style( ).
    lo_format_style->set_font_color( i_color = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>co_color_red ).
    lo_format_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).

    lo_cond_format->add_rule(
      i_range_from_row = 2 " Data starts from row 2
      i_range_to_row   = lines( lt_sflights ) + 1
      i_range_from_col = 4 " Price column is 4
      i_range_to_col   = 4
      i_type           = if_fdt_xl_conditional_format=>co_type_cell_value
      i_operator       = if_fdt_xl_conditional_format=>co_operator_greater_than
      i_value1         = '500'
      i_style          = lo_format_style
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_freeze_pane DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD export_sflights_freeze_pane.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lt_header   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights

    ro_excel_document = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>create_spreadsheet( ).

    APPEND 'Airline' TO lt_header.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Baum, der Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge anzeigt. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen bestimmten Knoten im Baum sucht und dessen Knotenschlüssel zurückgibt.
hint: Die Methode sollte die interne Datenstruktur des Baumes durchsuchen, um den passenden Knoten zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_node_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text TYPE lvc_value,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_tree_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_flight_nodes.

    METHODS find_node_by_text
      IMPORTING it_all_nodes TYPE tt_flight_nodes
                iv_search_text TYPE lvc_value
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey VALUE 0,
          lv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid connid.

    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) = ''.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid <> lv_prev_carrid.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
            node_key = lv_node_key
            parent_key = ' '
            text = <fs_flight>-carrid
        ) TO rt_nodes.
        lv_parent_key = lv_node_key.
        lv_prev_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid.
      ENDIF.

      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
          node_key = lv_node_key
          parent_key = lv_parent_key
          text = |{ <fs_flight>-connid } - { <fs_flight>-fldate DATE = USER }|
      ) TO rt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_node_by_text.
    READ TABLE it_all_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node) WITH KEY text = iv_search_text.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_node_key = ls_node-node_key.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Node not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_existing_node FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_non_existing_node FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_existing_node.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_node_search( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_tree_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Nodes should be generated' act = lines( lt_nodes ) ).

    " Find a known carrier node
    DATA(lv_search_text_carrier) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_found_key_carrier) = lo_cut->find_node_by_text( it_all_nodes = lt_nodes iv_search_text = lv_search_text_carrier ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier node key should be found' act = lv_found_key_carrier ).

    " Find a known flight node (assuming '0017 - 20251203' exists from sflights)
    DATA(lv_search_text_flight) = '0017 - 20251203'.
    DATA(lv_found_key_flight) = lo_cut->find_node_by_text( it_all_nodes = lt_nodes iv_search_text = lv_search_text_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flight node key should be found' act = lv_found_key_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_non_existing_node.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_node_search( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_tree_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_abap_invalid_parameter ).
    lo_cut->find_node_by_text( it_all_nodes = lt_nodes iv_search_text = 'NON_EXISTENT_NODE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man einen bestimmten Knoten in der internen Datenstruktur eines Baumes anhand seines Textes sucht. Es verwendet `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY` für eine effiziente Suche in der flachen Knotentabelle. Bei Erfolg wird der Knotenschlüssel zurückgegeben, andernfalls wird eine Exception ausgelöst.
keywords: cl_gui_simple_tree, Node Search, Data Retrieval, READ TABLE

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie das Feld `carrid` in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten für alle Einträge, die einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode haben, auf einen neuen Wert. Nutzen Sie hierfür moderne ABAP-Syntax mit `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Schleife in Kombination mit der `WHERE`-Klausel, um die Zeilen direkt zu aktualisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_old_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_new_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
         WHERE carrid = iv_old_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-carrid = iv_new_carrid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itb_modify_for=>ty_t_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    <fs_flight>-price  = '100.00'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'.
    <fs_flight>-price  = '200.00'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'.
    <fs_flight>-price  = '150.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_for( ).
    lo_cut->update_flights( EXPORTING iv_old_carrid = 'AA' iv_new_carrid = 'UA' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'First flight carrid should be UA' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Second flight carrid should be LH' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'Third flight carrid should be UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Syntax in Kombination mit der `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht eine effiziente und lesbare In-Place-Modifikation von Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle. Das Feldsymbol `<fs_flight>` referenziert direkt die Zeile in der Tabelle, wodurch Änderungen sofort wirksam werden, ohne dass ein explizites `MODIFY ct_flights FROM <fs_flight>` notwendig ist.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten. Identifizieren Sie den Flug eindeutig über Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungsnummer und Flugdatum. Nutzen Sie hierfür die moderne `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM VALUE ... WHERE` Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE itab FROM VALUE #( ... ) TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_table_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        is_key        TYPE ty_sflight
        iv_new_price  TYPE s_price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_table_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM VALUE #( BASE is_key price = iv_new_price )
           TRANSPORTING price
           WHERE carrid = is_key-carrid AND connid = is_key-connid AND fldate = is_key-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flight_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itb_modify_table_line=>ty_t_sflight.
    DATA(ls_flight1) = VALUE zcl_itb_modify_table_line=>ty_sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ).
    DATA(ls_flight2) = VALUE zcl_itb_modify_table_line=>ty_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight1 INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    INSERT ls_flight2 INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_table_line( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      EXPORTING
        is_key       = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
        iv_new_price = '120.00'
      CHANGING
        ct_flights   = lt_flights
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_updated_flight) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = '120.00' msg = 'Price for AA 0017 should be updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO ls_updated_flight WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Price for LH 0400 should remain unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY TABLE itab FROM wa TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...` Syntax ist die moderne und effiziente Art, spezifische Zeilen einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem Schlüssel oder einer Bedingung zu aktualisieren. Der `VALUE #(...)` Operator ermöglicht die direkte Erstellung einer Struktur mit den zu aktualisierenden Werten, was den Code kompakter macht.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, TABLE LINE, WHERE, CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie mehrere Einträge in der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` basierend auf Daten in einer internen Tabelle. Es sollen nur die Felder aktualisiert werden, die in der internen Tabelle gefüllt sind und in beiden Strukturen übereinstimmen. Nutzen Sie hierfür `MODIFY DATABASE TABLE ... FROM TABLE ... CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE lt_updates CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_modify_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_update.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE ty_t_sflight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_affected) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_modify_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_sflight_data.
    MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE it_updates CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF.
    rv_rows_affected = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_sflight_data.
    DATA: lt_updates TYPE zcl_db_modify_corr_fields=>ty_t_sflight_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_modify_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lv_rows_affected) = 0.

    DATA: ls_sflight_db TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight_db = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' ).
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight_db.
    ls_sflight_db = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ).
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight_db.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_updates.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_updates.

    lv_rows_affected = lo_cut->update_sflight_data( lt_updates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_affected exp = 2 msg = 'Two rows should be affected' ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250102'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY DATABASE TABLE ... FROM TABLE ... CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` Anweisung ist die moderne und sichere Methode, um mehrere Datenbankeinträge basierend auf einer internen Tabelle zu aktualisieren. `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` stellt sicher, dass nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen und nicht-initialen Werten aus der Quelltabelle in die Zieltabelle übertragen werden, was Fehler reduziert und die Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: MODIFY, Database, CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie ein Feld in einer verschachtelten Struktur innerhalb einer internen Tabelle. Die Aktualisierung soll nur für bestimmte Zeilen erfolgen, die eine Bedingung erfüllen. Nutzen Sie hierfür verschachtelte `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Schleifen und den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und innerhalb der Schleife den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_nested_data,
             item_id TYPE i,
             value   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_nested_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_main_data,
             header_id TYPE i,
             status    TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             details   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_nested_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_main_data.
    TYPES ty_t_main_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_main_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_nested_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_header_id TYPE i
        iv_item_id   TYPE i
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_main_data TYPE ty_t_main_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_nested_value.
    LOOP AT ct_main_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_main_data>)
         WHERE header_id = iv_header_id.
      LOOP AT <fs_main_data>-details ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_detail>)
           WHERE item_id = iv_item_id.
        <fs_detail>-value = COND #( WHEN <fs_detail>-value IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_new_value ELSE <fs_detail>-value ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_nested_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_nested_value.
    DATA: lt_main_data TYPE zcl_itb_modify_nested=>ty_t_main_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( header_id = 1 status = 'A'
                    details = VALUE #( ( item_id = 10 value = 'Old Value 1' )
                                       ( item_id = 20 value = 'Old Value 2' ) ) ) TO lt_main_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( header_id = 2 status = 'B'
                    details = VALUE #( ( item_id = 10 value = 'Another Old Value' )
                                       ( item_id = 30 value = 'Initial' ) ) ) TO lt_main_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_nested( ).
    lo_cut->update_nested_value(
      EXPORTING
        iv_header_id = 1
        iv_item_id   = 10
        iv_new_value = 'New Value for Item 10'
      CHANGING
        ct_main_data = lt_main_data
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_main_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_main>) WITH KEY header_id = 1.
    ASSERT sy-subrc = 0.
    READ TABLE <fs_main>-details ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_detail>) WITH KEY item_id = 10.
    ASSERT sy-subrc = 0.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_detail>-value exp = 'New Value for Item 10' msg = 'Value for header 1, item 10 should be updated' ).

    READ TABLE <fs_main>-details ASSIGNING <fs_detail> WITH KEY item_id = 20.
    ASSERT sy-subrc = 0.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_detail>-value exp = 'Old Value 2' msg = 'Value for header 1, item 20 should be unchanged' ).

    READ TABLE lt_main_data ASSIGNING <fs_main> WITH KEY header_id = 2.
    ASSERT sy-subrc = 0.
    READ TABLE <fs_main>-details ASSIGNING <fs_detail> WITH KEY item_id = 10.
    ASSERT sy-subrc = 0.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_detail>-value exp = 'Another Old Value' msg = 'Value for header 2, item 10 should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus verschachtelten `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Schleifen ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff und die Modifikation von Daten in verschachtelten internen Tabellen. Der `COND`-Operator (Conditional Expression) bietet eine moderne und kompakte Möglichkeit, Werte bedingt zuzuweisen, was den Code lesbarer und funktionaler macht.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, Nested Structures, FOR, COND

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Flügen, die einen bestimmten Status haben, und aktualisieren Sie dann ein Feld (z.B. `price`) für diese gefilterten Flüge in der Originaltabelle. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `FILTER`-Operator und `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` um eine Teilmenge der Daten zu erhalten, und dann `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` auf der Originaltabelle, um die entsprechenden Zeilen zu modifizieren, geprüft mit `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1, " Added status for filtering
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_new_price     TYPE s_price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights       TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_keys_to_update) = VALUE ty_t_sflight(
      FOR flight IN ct_flights WHERE ( status = iv_filter_status )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF line_exists( lt_keys_to_update[ carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                         connid = <fs_flight>-connid
                                         fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate ] ).
        <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itb_modify_filter=>ty_t_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' status = 'X' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' status = ' ' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' status = 'X' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_filter( ).
    lo_cut->update_filtered_flights(
      EXPORTING
        iv_filter_status = 'X'
        iv_new_price     = '999.99'
      CHANGING
        ct_flights       = lt_flights
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '999.99' msg = 'Price for AA 0017 should be updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Price for LH 0400 should be unchanged' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '999.99' msg = 'Price for AA 0018 should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator erzeugt eine neue interne Tabelle mit den gefilterten Zeilen. Um die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren, werden die Schlüssel der gefilterten Zeilen gesammelt und dann in einer Schleife über die Originaltabelle verwendet, um die entsprechenden Zeilen zu finden und zu aktualisieren. `LINE_EXISTS` bietet eine performante Möglichkeit, die Existenz einer Zeile in der Hilfstabelle zu prüfen.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, FILTER, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer privaten Methode. Demonstrieren Sie, wie eine separate Testklasse über die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration auf diese private Methode zugreifen kann, um sie zu testen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FRIENDS <test_class_name>` in der `DEFINITION` der zu testenden Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_private_method_holder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_secret_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _calculate_secret_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_secret) TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_private_method_holder_test. " Grant access to test class
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_private_method_holder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_secret_value.
    rv_value = _calculate_secret_value( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _calculate_secret_value.
    rv_secret = 'MySecretValue'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS zcl_private_method_holder_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_private_method_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_private_method_holder_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_private_method_access.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_private_method_holder( ).
    DATA(lv_secret) = lo_instance->_calculate_secret_value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_secret exp = 'MySecretValue' msg = 'Private method should return the correct secret value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration in der `DEFINITION` einer Klasse erlaubt es einer oder mehreren anderen Klassen, auf alle Komponenten (PUBLIC, PROTECTED, PRIVATE) der befreundeten Klasse zuzugreifen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Unit-Tests, da es ermöglicht, private Implementierungsdetails zu testen, ohne die Kapselung für andere Klassen aufbrechen zu müssen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Unit Test, Object Orientation, Encapsulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die interne Zustände verwaltet. Implementieren Sie eine separate Helper-Klasse, die für die Validierung oder Manipulation dieser internen Zustände zuständig ist. Gewähren Sie der Helper-Klasse über `FRIENDS` Zugriff auf die privaten Komponenten der Hauptklasse.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Helper-Klasse als `FRIENDS` in der Hauptklasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_data IMPORTING iv_data TYPE string.
    METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_internal_data TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_data_validator. " Grant access to validator class
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_data.
    mv_internal_data = iv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data.
    rv_data = mv_internal_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_data
      IMPORTING
        io_data_manager TYPE REF TO zcl_data_manager
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS manipulate_data
      IMPORTING
        io_data_manager TYPE REF TO zcl_data_manager
        iv_prefix       TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_data.
    IF io_data_manager->mv_internal_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD manipulate_data.
    io_data_manager->mv_internal_data = iv_prefix && io_data_manager->mv_internal_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friend_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_access.
    DATA(lo_data_manager) = NEW zcl_data_manager( ).
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_data_validator( ).

    lo_data_manager->set_data( 'OriginalData' ).

    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_validator->validate_data( lo_data_manager ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_true msg = 'Data should be valid' ).

    lo_validator->manipulate_data( io_data_manager = lo_data_manager iv_prefix = 'PREFIX_' ).
    DATA(lv_manipulated_data) = lo_data_manager->get_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_manipulated_data exp = 'PREFIX_OriginalData' msg = 'Data should be manipulated by friend class' ).

    lo_data_manager->set_data( '' ).
    lv_is_valid = lo_validator->validate_data( lo_data_manager ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_false msg = 'Empty data should be invalid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration ermöglicht es der `zcl_data_validator`-Klasse, direkt auf das private Attribut `mv_internal_data` der `zcl_data_manager`-Klasse zuzugreifen. Dies ist ein Beispiel für eine kontrollierte Ausnahme der Kapselung, die in bestimmten Design-Szenarien, wie bei Helper- oder Utility-Klassen, sinnvoll sein kann, um eine engere Zusammenarbeit zwischen Klassen zu ermöglichen, ohne die Schnittstelle der Hauptklasse unnötig zu erweitern.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Helper Class

Instructions: Verwalten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Konfigurationseinstellungen. Wenn eine Einstellung mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel bereits existiert, aktualisieren Sie ihren Wert; andernfalls fügen Sie eine neue Einstellung hinzu. Nutzen Sie hierfür `LINE_EXISTS` und `MODIFY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` in einer `IF`-Bedingung, um zu prüfen, ob eine Zeile existiert, und dann `MODIFY` oder `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_config_entry.
    TYPES ty_t_config_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS update_or_insert_config
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_config_entries TYPE ty_t_config_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_or_insert_config.
    DATA(ls_new_entry) = VALUE ty_config_entry( key = iv_key value = iv_value ).

    IF line_exists( ct_config_entries[ key = iv_key ] ).
      MODIFY TABLE ct_config_entries FROM ls_new_entry.
    ELSE.
      INSERT ls_new_entry INTO TABLE ct_config_entries.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_or_insert_config FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_or_insert_config.
    DATA: lt_config TYPE zcl_itb_modify_line_exists=>ty_t_config_entries.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_line_exists( ).

    lo_cut->update_or_insert_config( iv_key = 'SETTING_A' iv_value = 'Value1' CHANGING ct_config_entries = lt_config ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_config ) exp = 1 msg = 'One entry should be present after first insert' ).
    READ TABLE lt_config INTO DATA(ls_entry) WITH KEY key = 'SETTING_A'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-value exp = 'Value1' msg = 'Value of SETTING_A should be Value1' ).

    lo_cut->update_or_insert_config( iv_key = 'SETTING_A' iv_value = 'UpdatedValue' CHANGING ct_config_entries = lt_config ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_config ) exp = 1 msg = 'Still one entry after update' ).
    READ TABLE lt_config INTO ls_entry WITH KEY key = 'SETTING_A'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-value exp = 'UpdatedValue' msg = 'Value of SETTING_A should be UpdatedValue' ).

    lo_cut->update_or_insert_config( iv_key = 'SETTING_B' iv_value = 'Value2' CHANGING ct_config_entries = lt_config ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_config ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two entries after second insert' ).
    READ TABLE lt_config INTO ls_entry WITH KEY key = 'SETTING_B'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-value exp = 'Value2' msg = 'Value of SETTING_B should be Value2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `LINE_EXISTS` und `MODIFY`/`INSERT` ermöglicht eine elegante und performante "Upsert"-Logik für interne Tabellen. `LINE_EXISTS` prüft effizient, ob eine Zeile mit dem angegebenen Schlüssel existiert, bevor entschieden wird, ob eine bestehende Zeile modifiziert oder eine neue eingefügt werden soll.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugbuchungen nach Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer. Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der Buchungen und den Gesamtpreis. Aktualisieren Sie dann eine separate interne Tabelle mit diesen aggregierten Daten. Nutzen Sie hierfür `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppe `REDUCE` für die Aggregation. Anschließend `MODIFY` die Zieltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             bookid   TYPE s_book_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_booking.
    TYPES ty_t_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             total_bookings TYPE i,
             total_price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_aggregated_flight.
    TYPES ty_t_aggregated_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS aggregate_and_update
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings        TYPE ty_t_booking
      CHANGING
        ct_aggregated_data TYPE ty_t_aggregated_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_update.
    LOOP AT it_bookings INTO DATA(ls_booking) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_booking-carrid connid = ls_booking-connid )
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_group_member>-price
      ).

      DATA(lv_total_bookings) = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ).

      DATA(ls_aggregated_entry) = VALUE ty_aggregated_flight(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        connid = ls_group_key-connid
        total_bookings = lv_total_bookings
        total_price    = lv_total_price
      ).

      MODIFY TABLE ct_aggregated_data FROM ls_aggregated_entry.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_and_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_and_update.
    DATA: lt_bookings TYPE zcl_itb_modify_group_by=>ty_t_booking.
    DATA: lt_aggregated TYPE zcl_itb_modify_group_by=>ty_t_aggregated_flight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' bookid = 'B1' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' bookid = 'B2' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' bookid = 'B3' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' bookid = 'B4' price = '120.00' ) TO lt_bookings.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' bookid = 'B5' price = '300.00' ) TO lt_bookings.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_group_by( ).
    lo_cut->aggregate_and_update(
      EXPORTING
        it_bookings        = lt_bookings
      CHANGING
        ct_aggregated_data = lt_aggregated
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_agg_aa0017) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_aa0017-total_bookings exp = 2 msg = 'AA 0017: Total bookings should be 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_aa0017-total_price exp = '250.00' msg = 'AA 0017: Total price should be 250.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_agg_lh0400) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_lh0400-total_bookings exp = 2 msg = 'LH 0400: Total bookings should be 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_lh0400-total_price exp = '500.00' msg = 'LH 0400: Total price should be 500.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_agg_aa0018) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_aa0018-total_bookings exp = 1 msg = 'AA 0018: Total bookings should be 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_aa0018-total_price exp = '120.00' msg = 'AA 0018: Total price should be 120.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated ) exp = 3 msg = 'Total aggregated entries should be 3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe können Aggregationen mit Operatoren wie `REDUCE` durchgeführt werden. Die Ergebnisse werden dann verwendet, um eine Zieltabelle mittels `MODIFY` zu aktualisieren, wobei `MODIFY` hier sowohl für das Einfügen neuer als auch für das Aktualisieren bestehender aggregierter Daten dient.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, GROUP BY, LOOP AT

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten den Preis eines Fluges nur dann, wenn der aktuelle Preis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit dem `COND`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und innerhalb der Schleife `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung des Preises.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_price_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold_price TYPE s_price
        iv_new_price       TYPE s_price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights         TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price_conditionally.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-price = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price < iv_threshold_price THEN iv_new_price ELSE <fs_flight>-price ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_price_conditionally FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_price_conditionally.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itb_modify_cond=>ty_t_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_cond( ).
    lo_cut->update_price_conditionally(
      EXPORTING
        iv_threshold_price = '150.00'
        iv_new_price       = '125.00'
      CHANGING
        ct_flights         = lt_flights
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '125.00' msg = 'Price for AA 0017 should be updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Price for LH 0400 should be unchanged' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-price exp = '125.00' msg = 'Price for UA 0020 should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Schleife in Kombination mit dem `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und effiziente bedingte Aktualisierung von Feldern in einer internen Tabelle. Der `COND`-Operator wählt den zuzuweisenden Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung aus, was den Code sehr lesbar macht.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, COND, Conditional Logic, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Basisklasse mit einem `PROTECTED` Attribut. Implementieren Sie eine separate Klasse, die keine Unterklasse der Basisklasse ist, aber über die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration auf das `PROTECTED` Attribut der Basisklasse zugreifen kann.
hint: Deklarieren Sie das Attribut als `PROTECTED` in der Basisklasse und die zugreifende Klasse als `FRIENDS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_with_protected DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_protected_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_protected_data TYPE string VALUE 'Protected Data'.
    FRIENDS zcl_protected_accessor. " Grant access to accessor class
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_with_protected IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_protected_value.
    rv_value = mv_protected_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_protected_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_protected_data
      IMPORTING
        io_base_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_base_with_protected
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
    METHODS set_protected_data
      IMPORTING
        io_base_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_base_with_protected
        iv_new_data      TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_protected_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_protected_data.
    rv_data = io_base_instance->mv_protected_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_protected_data.
    io_base_instance->mv_protected_data = iv_new_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_protected_friend_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_protected_friend_access.
    DATA(lo_base) = NEW zcl_base_with_protected( ).
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_protected_accessor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_base->get_protected_value( ) exp = 'Protected Data' msg = 'Initial protected value should be correct' ).

    DATA(lv_read_data) = lo_accessor->read_protected_data( lo_base ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_read_data exp = 'Protected Data' msg = 'Friend should read protected data correctly' ).

    lo_accessor->set_protected_data( io_base_instance = lo_base iv_new_data = 'New Protected Data' ).
    DATA(lv_updated_data) = lo_base->get_protected_value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_data exp = 'New Protected Data' msg = 'Friend should update protected data correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Normalerweise können `PROTECTED` Komponenten nur von der Klasse selbst und ihren Unterklassen zugegriffen werden. Durch die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration wird `zcl_protected_accessor` eine Ausnahme von dieser Regel gewährt, sodass sie direkt auf das `PROTECTED` Attribut `mv_protected_data` von `zcl_base_with_protected` zugreifen und es sogar ändern kann, obwohl sie keine Unterklasse ist. Dies kann in Szenarien nützlich sein, in denen eine enge Kopplung zwischen zwei nicht-hierarchischen Klassen erforderlich ist.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Protected Access, Encapsulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die aggregierte Daten aus einer Quelltabelle enthält. Gruppieren Sie die Quelltabelle nach bestimmten Kriterien und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe Summen oder Zählungen. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und den `VALUE`-Operator. Anschließend `MODIFY` eine Zieltabelle mit diesen neuen aggregierten Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR GROUPS ... OF ... GROUP BY ... )` um die aggregierte Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_for_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sales_item.
    TYPES ty_t_sales_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_sales,
             region TYPE string,
             total_amount TYPE decfloat16,
             product_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_aggregated_sales.
    TYPES ty_t_aggregated_sales TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_sales WITH UNIQUE KEY region.

    METHODS process_sales_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_items     TYPE ty_t_sales_item
      CHANGING
        ct_summary_by_region TYPE ty_t_aggregated_sales.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_for_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sales_data.
    DATA(lt_new_aggregated_data) = VALUE ty_t_aggregated_sales(
      FOR GROUPS <group_key> OF ls_item IN it_sales_items GROUP BY ls_item-region
      (
        region        = <group_key>
        total_amount  = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_item> IN GROUP <group_key> NEXT s = s + <fs_item>-amount )
        product_count = lines( GROUP <group_key> )
      )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_new_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_new_agg).
      MODIFY TABLE ct_summary_by_region FROM ls_new_agg.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

GROUP BY` Expression in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator ist eine sehr mächtige und deklarative Methode, um aggregierte Daten aus einer Quelltabelle zu extrahieren und in eine neue Zieltabelle zu überführen. Anschließend wird die `MODIFY`-Anweisung verwendet, um eine bestehende Zieltabelle mit diesen neu berechneten aggregierten Werten zu aktualisieren oder neue Einträge hinzuzufügen.
