Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Singleton-Designmuster für eine Klasse, sodass nur eine einzige Instanz dieser Klasse existieren kann. Nutzen Sie hierfür einen privaten Konstruktor und eine statische `GET_INSTANCE`-Methode, die über die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration auf den privaten Konstruktor zugreift.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Konstruktor als `PRIVATE` und die Klasse selbst als `FRIENDS` für den Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_singleton DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_instance RETURNING VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton.
    METHODS get_creation_time RETURNING VALUE(rv_time) TYPE timestampl.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton.
    DATA mv_creation_time TYPE timestampl.
    METHODS constructor.
    FRIENDS zcl_singleton. " Grant access to itself for the static method
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_singleton IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD mv_creation_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance.
    IF go_instance IS NOT BOUND.
      go_instance = NEW zcl_singleton( ).
    ENDIF.
    ro_instance = go_instance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_creation_time.
    rv_time = mv_creation_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_singleton_instance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_singleton_instance.
    DATA(lo_instance1) = zcl_singleton=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_instance2) = zcl_singleton=>get_instance( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance1 exp = lo_instance2 msg = 'Both instances should be the same object' ).

    DATA(lv_time1) = lo_instance1->get_creation_time( ).
    DATA(lv_time2) = lo_instance2->get_creation_time( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_time1 exp = lv_time2 msg = 'Creation time should be identical for both references' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Singleton-Muster stellt sicher, dass eine Klasse nur eine einzige Instanz hat und einen globalen Zugriffspunkt darauf bietet. Durch einen privaten Konstruktor wird die direkte Instanziierung von außen verhindert. Die `FRIENDS`-Deklaration der Klasse für sich selbst (oder genauer: für die statische Methode `GET_INSTANCE`) ermöglicht es der statischen Methode, den privaten Konstruktor aufzurufen und die einzige Instanz zu erzeugen und zu verwalten.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Singleton Pattern, Design Patterns, Private Constructor

Instructions: Transformieren und aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine neue interne Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators. Anschließend verwenden Sie die resultierende Tabelle, um eine bestehende Zieltabelle zu aktualisieren oder neue Einträge hinzuzufügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die neue Tabelle zu konstruieren, und dann `LOOP AT ... MODIFY` auf der Zieltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_data.
    TYPES ty_t_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_summary_data,
             category TYPE string,
             total_value TYPE i,
             entry_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_summary_data.
    TYPES ty_t_summary_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_summary_data WITH UNIQUE KEY category.

    METHODS process_and_update_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_data        TYPE ty_t_raw_data
      CHANGING
        ct_summary_data    TYPE ty_t_summary_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_update_summary.
    DATA(lt_new_summary) = REDUCE ty_t_summary_data(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_t_summary_data( )
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_data
      LET existing_line = result[ KEY category = ls_raw-category OPTIONAL ] IN
      NEXT result = COND #(
        WHEN existing_line IS BOUND
        THEN VALUE ty_t_summary_data(
               FOR ls_res IN result
               ( COND #( WHEN ls_res-category = ls_raw-category
                         THEN VALUE #( BASE ls_res total_value = ls_res-total_value + ls_raw-value
                                                entry_count = ls_res-entry_count + 1 )
                         ELSE ls_res ) ) ) )
        ELSE VALUE ty_t_summary_data( BASE result ( category = ls_raw-category
                                                    total_value = ls_raw-value
                                                    entry_count = 1 ) )
      )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_new_summary INTO DATA(ls_new_sum).
      MODIFY TABLE ct_summary_data FROM ls_new_sum.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_and_update_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_and_update_summary.
    DATA: lt_raw TYPE zcl_itb_modify_reduce=>ty_t_raw_data.
    DATA: lt_summary TYPE zcl_itb_modify_reduce=>ty_t_summary_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 category = 'A' value = 10 ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 category = 'B' value = 20 ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 category = 'A' value = 15 ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 4 category = 'C' value = 5 ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 5 category = 'B' value = 25 ) TO lt_raw.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_reduce( ).
    lo_cut->process_and_update_summary(
      EXPORTING
        it_raw_data        = lt_raw
      CHANGING
        ct_summary_data    = lt_summary
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_cat_a) WITH KEY category = 'A'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_cat_a-total_value exp = 25 msg = 'Category A: Total value should be 25' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_cat_a-entry_count exp = 2 msg = 'Category A: Entry count should be 2' ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_cat_b) WITH KEY category = 'B'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_cat_b-total_value exp = 45 msg = 'Category B: Total value should be 45' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_cat_b-entry_count exp = 2 msg = 'Category B: Entry count should be 2' ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_cat_c) WITH KEY category = 'C'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_cat_c-total_value exp = 5 msg = 'Category C: Total value should be 5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_cat_c-entry_count exp = 1 msg = 'Category C: Entry count should be 1' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 3 msg = 'Total summary entries should be 3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle zu iterieren und ein einzelnes Ergebnis (hier eine neue interne Tabelle) aufzubauen. In diesem Beispiel wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um Daten nach Kategorien zu aggregieren und Summen sowie Zählungen zu berechnen. Die resultierende aggregierte Tabelle wird dann verwendet, um eine Zieltabelle mittels `MODIFY` zu aktualisieren. Die Verwendung von `COND` innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine elegante bedingte Logik für das Hinzufügen oder Aktualisieren von Einträgen in der Ergebnis-Tabelle.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation, COND, VALUE

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis (PRICE) in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.

CLASS zcl_max_price_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_flight_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT max_price = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_price = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_price THEN flight-price ELSE max_price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_sorted_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

  METHOD get_flight_with_max_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine Liste von Flugobjekten mit einem Attribut für den Flugpreis. Finden Sie das Flugobjekt mit dem höchsten Flugpreis unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: `REDUCE` kann auch Objekte zurückgeben. Initialisieren Sie den Reducer mit dem ersten Objekt und vergleichen Sie dann die Preise.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_object DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA carrid TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY.
    DATA connid TYPE s_conn_id READ-ONLY.
    DATA price  TYPE s_price READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                  iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                                  iv_price  TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->connid = iv_connid.
    me->price  = iv_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_obj_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_flight_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_flight_obj IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_objects
                                     RETURNING VALUE(ro_max_flight) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_obj_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_flight_obj.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ro_max_flight = REDUCE REF TO zcl_flight_object(
      INIT max_flight_obj = it_flights[ 1 ]
      FOR flight_obj IN it_flights
      NEXT max_flight_obj = COND REF TO zcl_flight_object(
        WHEN flight_obj->price > max_flight_obj->price THEN flight_obj
        ELSE max_flight_obj
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_max_obj_reduce=>tt_flight_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_price = '250.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '0010' iv_price = '300.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0401' iv_price = '120.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_obj_reduce( ).
    DATA(lo_max_flight) = lo_cut->get_max_price_flight_obj( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Max flight object should be bound' act = lo_max_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Max price should be 300.00' exp = '300.00' act = lo_max_flight->price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Max flight carrid should be UA' exp = 'UA' act = lo_max_flight->carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_max_obj_reduce=>tt_flight_objects.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_obj_reduce( ).
    DATA(lo_max_flight) = lo_cut->get_max_price_flight_obj( lt_flights ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator kann nicht nur primitive Datentypen, sondern auch Objektreferenzen aggregieren. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und funktionale Art, das 'beste' Objekt aus einer Liste basierend auf einem Kriterium zu finden, ohne explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen.

CLASS zcl_sorted_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY fldate carrid connid.

    METHODS get_max_price_from_sorted RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_from_sorted.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data_sorted(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid fldate = flight-fldate price = flight-price )
    ).

    IF lt_sorted_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lv_max_price TYPE s_price VALUE '0.00'.
    LOOP AT lt_sorted_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price > lv_max_price.
        lv_max_price = ls_flight-price.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_max_price = lv_max_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) den höchsten Flugpreis (PRICE) in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` Operators.

solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_per_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_max_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             max_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrid_max_price.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_max_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_max_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_per_carrid RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrid_max_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_per_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_result = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        max_price = REDUCE s_price(
          INIT max_p = flight-price
          FOR member IN GROUP flight
          NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN member-price > max_p THEN member-price ELSE max_p )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

CLASS zcl_max_price_sql_group IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine SORTED Tabelle von Flugdaten und verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert zu finden. Anschließend finden Sie den höchsten Preis unter den gefilterten Flügen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE` für die SORTED Tabelle, `FILTER` für die Filterung und `REDUCE` für die Maximalwertsuche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sorted_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_max_price_filtered IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE s_price
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sorted_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_filtered.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data_sorted(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid fldate = flight-fldate price = flight-price )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_flight_data_sorted(
      lt_sorted_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price
    ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT max_p = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-price
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_p THEN flight-price ELSE max_p )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_max FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_initial_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_max.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sorted_max( ).
    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_price_filtered( '150.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Max price should be greater than 150.00' act = ( lv_max_price > '150.00' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Max price should be positive' act = ( lv_max_price > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sorted_max( ).
    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_price_filtered( '999999.00' ). " Very high price, no matches
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Max price should be 0 for no matching flights' exp = 0 act = lv_max_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_initial_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sorted_max( ).
    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_price_filtered( '10.00' ).
    " If sflights was empty, lv_max_price would be 0.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Max price should be 0 for empty initial table' exp = 0 act = lv_max_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `VALUE` zur Erstellung einer `SORTED TABLE`, `FILTER` zur deklarativen Filterung dieser Tabelle und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation des Maximalwerts. Diese Syntax ist ab ABAP 7.55 verfügbar und ermöglicht sehr ausdrucksstarken und effizienten Code für komplexe Datenmanipulationen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme auslöst und diese mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log` protokolliert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `cl_s_aut_bal_log` zur Protokollierung der Ausnahmeinformationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_log_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i.
    METHODS get_log_messages RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_s_aut_bal_log=>tt_messages.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_log_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF mo_log IS INITIAL.
      mo_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ).
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
        ENDIF.
        DATA(lv_result) = 100 / iv_value.
        DATA(ls_message_ok) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_msg(
          msgty = 'S',
          msgid = 'ZTEST_MSG', " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige Nachrichtenklasse
          msgno = '002',
          msgv1 = |Processing successful for { iv_value }|
        )->get_message_data( ).
        mo_log->add_message( ls_message_ok ).

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        DATA(ls_message_err) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_msg(
          msgty = 'E',
          msgid = 'ZTEST_MSG', " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige Nachrichtenklasse
          msgno = '003',
          msgv1 = |Arithmetic error: { lx_arith->get_text( ) }|
        )->get_message_data( ).
        mo_log->add_message( ls_message_err ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_messages.
    IF mo_log IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_messages = mo_log->get_messages( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_tree_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 20 ROWS ).

        ( node_key = |CARR_{ flight-carrid }|, parent_key = '', text = |Airline: { flight-carrid }|, level = 0 )

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einer Bedingung eine Meldung mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log` protokolliert, wobei der `COND` Operator für die Bedingung verwendet wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND` Operator, um den Meldungstyp oder den Inhalt der Meldung bedingt zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_log_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_status IMPORTING iv_status TYPE string.
    METHODS get_log_messages RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_s_aut_bal_log=>tt_messages.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_log_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_status.
    IF mo_log IS INITIAL.
      mo_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_msgty) = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status = 'OK' THEN 'S'
      WHEN iv_status = 'WARNING' THEN 'W'
      ELSE 'E'
    ).

    DATA(lv_msg_text) = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status = 'OK' THEN |Status is OK.|
      WHEN iv_status = 'WARNING' THEN |Status is WARNING!|
      ELSE |Status is ERROR: { iv_status }|
    ).

    DATA(ls_message) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_msg(
      msgty = lv_msgty,
      msgid = 'ZTEST_MSG', " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige Nachrichtenklasse
      msgno = '004',
      msgv1 = lv_msg_text
    )->get_message_data( ).

    mo_log->add_message( ls_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_messages.
    IF mo_log IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_messages = mo_log->get_messages( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Anzahl der Knoten in einer `cl_gui_column_tree` Datenstruktur mit dem `REDUCE` Operator aggregiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Knoten zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_node.
    TYPES tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_tree_nodes RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_tree_nodes.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 3 ROWS ).

    DATA(lt_all_nodes) = VALUE tt_nodes(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        ( node_key = |CARR_{ flight-carrid }|, parent_key = '', text = |Airline: { flight-carrid }|, level = 0 )
        ( node_key = |CONN_{ flight-carrid }_{ flight-connid }|, parent_key = |CARR_{ flight-carrid }|, text = |Connection: { flight-connid }|, level = 1 )
        ( node_key = |DATE_{ flight-carrid }_{ flight-connid }_{ flight-fldate }|, parent_key = |CONN_{ flight-carrid }_{ flight-connid }|, text = |Date: { flight-fldate }|, level = 2 )
    ).

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR node IN lt_all_nodes WHERE ( node_key IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_tree_nodes( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `cl_gui_column_tree` Instanz und verwenden Sie `SWITCH` in Kombination mit `String Templates`, um dynamisch den Text für Baumknoten basierend auf einem Wert zu generieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_node.
    TYPES tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_tree_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_tree_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS ).

    rt_tree_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        ( node_key = |CARR_{ flight-carrid }|, parent_key = '', 
          text = SWITCH string( flight-carrid 
                   WHEN 'LH' THEN |Lufthansa ({ flight-carrid })|
                   WHEN 'AA' THEN |American Airlines ({ flight-carrid })|
                   ELSE |Other Airline ({ flight-carrid })| ),
          level = 0 )
        ( node_key = |CONN_{ flight-carrid }_{ flight-connid }|, parent_key = |CARR_{ flight-carrid }|, 
          text = |Connection: { flight-connid }|, level = 1 )
        ( node_key = |DATE_{ flight-carrid }_{ flight-connid }_{ flight-fldate }|, parent_key = |CONN_{ flight-carrid }_{ flight-connid }|, 
          text = |Date: { flight-fldate }|, level = 2 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_column_tree` und demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `GROUP BY` in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung, um aggregierte Daten für den Baum vorzubereiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in der `SELECT`-Anweisung, um Daten zu aggregieren, bevor sie in den Baum geladen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_groupby DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE string,
             level      TYPE i,
             count      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_node.
    TYPES tt_grouped_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_tree_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_grouped_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_groupby IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
            carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
            connid TYPE s_conn_id,
            num_flights TYPE i,
          END OF ty_grouped_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, COUNT(*) AS num_flights
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid, connid
      INTO TABLE @lt_grouped_flights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_tree_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR group IN lt_grouped_flights
        ( node_key = |CARR_{ group-carrid }|, parent_key = '', text = |Airline: { group-carrid }|, level = 0, count = 0 )
        ( node_key = |CONN_{ group-carrid }_{ group-connid }|, parent_key = |CARR_{ group-carrid }|, text = |Connection: { group-connid } ({ group-num_flights } flights)|, level = 1, count = group-num_flights )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_log_for_errors DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    IF mo_log IS INITIAL.
      mo_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ).

    DATA(lt_log_messages) = VALUE cl_s_aut_bal_log=>tt_messages(
      FOR error IN it_errors
        ( NEW cl_s_aut_bal_msg(
            msgty = 'E',
            msgid = 'ZTEST_MSG', " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige Nachrichtenklasse
            msgno = '007',
            msgv1 = |Error { error-id }: { error-text }|
          )->get_message_data( ) )
    ).

    mo_log->add_messages( lt_log_messages ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_messages.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom  TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto    TYPE s_cityname,
             custom_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_corr IMPLEMENTATION.

    lt_sflight_ext = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights MAPPING custom_text = |Flight from { cityfrom } to { cityto }| EXCEPT carrid connid fldate ).

    rt_tree_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight_ext IN lt_sflight_ext

        ( node_key = |CONN_{ flight_ext-carrid }_{ flight_ext-connid }|, parent_key = |CARR_{ flight_ext-carrid }|, text = flight_ext-custom_text, level = 1 )

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Meldungen mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log` protokolliert, wobei die Meldungen aus einer Kette von Methodenaufrufen (`Method Chaining`) stammen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `Method Chaining` für die Erstellung und Protokollierung mehrerer Meldungen in einer flüssigen Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_log_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_chained_messages.
    METHODS get_log_messages RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_s_aut_bal_log=>tt_messages.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log.
    METHODS add_info_message IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_bal_log_chain.
    METHODS add_warning_message IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_bal_log_chain.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_log_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_info_message.
    IF mo_log IS INITIAL.
      mo_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ).
    ENDIF.
    DATA(ls_message) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_msg(
      msgty = 'I',
      msgid = 'ZTEST_MSG', " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige Nachrichtenklasse
      msgno = '008',
      msgv1 = iv_text
    )->get_message_data( ).
    mo_log->add_message( ls_message ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_warning_message.
    IF mo_log IS INITIAL.
      mo_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ).
    ENDIF.
    DATA(ls_message) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_msg(
      msgty = 'W',
      msgid = 'ZTEST_MSG', " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige Nachrichtenklasse
      msgno = '009',
      msgv1 = iv_text
    )->get_message_data( ).
    mo_log->add_message( ls_message ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_chained_messages.
    me->add_info_message( 'Erster Schritt abgeschlossen' )->
       add_warning_message( 'Zweiter Schritt mit Warnung' )->
       add_info_message( 'Dritter Schritt erfolgreich' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_messages.
    IF mo_log IS NOT INITIAL.
      rt_messages = mo_log->get_messages( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_chained_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_chained_messages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_log_chain( ).
    lo_cut->log_chained_messages( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->get_log_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgty exp = 'W' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 3 ]-msgty exp = 'I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `Method Chaining` (Methodenverkettung) ist ein modernes objektorientiertes Muster, das die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes verbessert, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung verkettet werden. CLASS zcl_tree_basic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node_data,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             level    TYPE i,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_tree_node_data.
    TYPES tt_tree_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_tree_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_tree_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_basic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_tree_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
                         FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( carrid = sflight-carrid, connid = sflight-connid, fldate = sflight-fldate,
        cityfrom = sflight-cityfrom, cityto = sflight-cityto )
    ).

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.
    DATA(lt_carrier_nodes) = VALUE tt_tree_node_data(
      FOR GROUP OF sflight IN lt_sflights BY ( carrid = sflight-carrid )
      ( node_key = CONV #( ++lv_node_key ),
        text = sflight-carrid,
        level = 0,
        is_folder = abap_true,
        carrid = sflight-carrid )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_carrier_nodes ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrier_node>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_tree_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_root_node>).
      <fs_root_node>-node_key = <fs_carrier_node>-node_key.
      <fs_root_node>-text = <fs_carrier_node>-text.
      <fs_root_node>-level = <fs_carrier_node>-level.
      <fs_root_node>-is_folder = <fs_carrier_node>-is_folder.
      <fs_root_node>-carrid = <fs_carrier_node>-carrid.

      DATA(lt_flight_nodes) = VALUE tt_tree_node_data(
        FOR sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = <fs_carrier_node>-carrid )
        ( node_key = CONV #( ++lv_node_key ),
          text = |Flug { sflight-connid } von { sflight-cityfrom } nach { sflight-cityto }|,
          level = 1,
          parent_key = <fs_carrier_node>-node_key,
          is_folder = abap_false,
          carrid = sflight-carrid,
          connid = sflight-connid,
          cityfrom = sflight-cityfrom,
          cityto = sflight-cityto )
      ).
      APPEND LINES OF lt_flight_nodes TO rt_tree_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_tree_with_context_menu.
    " In a real scenario, a custom container would be passed here.
    " For this example, we create a dummy container to allow instantiation.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        lifetime_error_dynpro_dynpro = 5
        OTHERS = 6
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error, e.g., raise exception or log
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ro_column_tree = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        OTHERS = 5
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_context_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_context_menu->add_function(
      fcode = 'SHOW_DETAILS'
      text = 'Details anzeigen'
    ).

    ro_column_tree->set_node_context_menu(
      menu = lo_context_menu
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.

    " Clean up dummy container if not needed later
    lo_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Flugdaten aus `sflights` liest und für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` vorbereitet. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die diese Daten basierend auf einem Suchkriterium (Fluggesellschaft) filtert und die gefilterte Datenstruktur zurückgibt. Die eigentliche Anzeige im Baum ist hier nicht Teil der Lösung, sondern die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen, um die Daten effizient zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_filter_nodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node_data,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             level    TYPE i,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_tree_node_data.
    TYPES tt_tree_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_tree_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_tree_node_data.
    METHODS filter_tree_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_all_data  TYPE tt_tree_node_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_tree_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_filter_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_tree_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
                         FROM sflight UP TO 20 ROWS )
      ( carrid = sflight-carrid, connid = sflight-connid, fldate = sflight-fldate,
        cityfrom = sflight-cityfrom, cityto = sflight-cityto )
    ).

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.
    DATA(lt_carrier_nodes) = VALUE tt_tree_node_data(
      FOR GROUP OF sflight IN lt_sflights BY ( carrid = sflight-carrid )
      ( node_key = CONV #( ++lv_node_key ),
        text = sflight-carrid,
        level = 0,
        is_folder = abap_true,
        carrid = sflight-carrid )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_carrier_nodes ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrier_node>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_tree_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_root_node>).
      <fs_root_node>-node_key = <fs_carrier_node>-node_key.
      <fs_root_node>-text = <fs_carrier_node>-text.
      <fs_root_node>-level = <fs_carrier_node>-level.
      <fs_root_node>-is_folder = <fs_carrier_node>-is_folder.
      <fs_root_node>-carrid = <fs_carrier_node>-carrid.

      DATA(lt_flight_nodes) = VALUE tt_tree_node_data(
        FOR sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = <fs_carrier_node>-carrid )
        ( node_key = CONV #( ++lv_node_key ),
          text = |Flug { sflight-connid } von { sflight-cityfrom } nach { sflight-cityto }|,
          level = 1,
          parent_key = <fs_carrier_node>-node_key,
          is_folder = abap_false,
          carrid = sflight-carrid,
          connid = sflight-connid,
          cityfrom = sflight-cityfrom,
          cityto = sflight-cityto )
      ).
      APPEND LINES OF lt_flight_nodes TO rt_tree_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_tree_data.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_all_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid OR level = 0 ).
    " Also include parent nodes if their children are filtered
    DATA(lt_filtered_parents) = VALUE tt_tree_node_data(
      FOR ls_node IN rt_filtered_data WHERE ( level = 1 )
      ( it_all_data[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS node_key = ls_node-parent_key ] )
    ).
    INSERT LINES OF lt_filtered_parents INTO TABLE rt_filtered_data.
    SORT rt_filtered_data BY node_key.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_filtered_data COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_bar_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_count_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_bar_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight UP TO 50 ROWS )
      ( carrid = sflight-carrid, connid = sflight-connid )
    ).

    rt_chart_data = VALUE tt_chart_data(
      FOR GROUP OF sflight IN lt_sflights BY ( carrid = sflight-carrid )
      ( category = sflight-carrid,
        value = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR flight IN GROUP sflight NEXT count = count + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode soll die vorbereiteten Daten zurückgeben. Die Implementierung des Drilldowns (Event-Behandlung) ist hier nicht Teil der Lösung, sondern die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Aggregieren Sie die Daten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anteile. Die Chart Engine kann Tortendiagramme darstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_pie_drilldown DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE f, " Percentage or count
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_distribution_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_pie_drilldown IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_distribution_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( carrid = sflight-carrid, connid = sflight-connid )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    IF lv_total_flights = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE tt_chart_data(
      FOR GROUP OF sflight IN lt_sflights BY ( carrid = sflight-carrid )
      ( category = sflight-carrid,
        value = CONV f( REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR flight IN GROUP sflight NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) / lv_total_flights * 100 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Daten aus `sflights` aggregiert, um die Entwicklung der durchschnittlichen Passagierauslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax) pro Fluggesellschaft über die Flugdaten hinweg darzustellen. Die Methode soll eine interne Tabelle zurückgeben, die für ein Liniendiagramm mit mehreren Datenreihen geeignet ist.
hint: Gruppieren Sie die Daten nach Flugdatum und Fluggesellschaft. Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt pro Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_line_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             category TYPE string, " Flight Date
             value    TYPE f,     " Average Occupancy
             series   TYPE string, " Carrier
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupancy_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_line_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_data.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
                         FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( carrid = sflight-carrid, fldate = sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc = sflight-seatsocc, seatsmax = sflight-seatsmax )
    ).

    rt_chart_data = VALUE tt_chart_data(
      FOR GROUP OF sflight IN lt_sflights BY ( fldate = sflight-fldate, carrid = sflight-carrid )
      ( category = |{ sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }|,
        series = sflight-carrid,
        value = COND f( WHEN REDUCE i( INIT total_seats = 0 FOR flight IN GROUP sflight NEXT total_seats = total_seats + flight-seatsmax ) > 0
                        THEN CONV f( REDUCE i( INIT total_occupied = 0 FOR flight IN GROUP sflight NEXT total_occupied = total_occupied + flight-seatsocc ) )
                             / REDUCE i( INIT total_seats = 0 FOR flight IN GROUP sflight NEXT total_seats = total_seats + flight-seatsmax )
                        ELSE 0 ) )
    ).
    SORT rt_chart_data BY category ASCENDING series ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_chart_instance.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        lifetime_error_dynpro_dynpro = 5
        OTHERS = 6
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ro_chart_engine = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win(
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        OTHERS = 5
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ro_chart_engine->set_chart_type(
      chart_type = cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.

    lo_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_and_draw.
    io_chart->set_data_table(
      EXPORTING
        data_table = it_new_data
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.

    io_chart->draw_chart(
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE sflights FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<interne_tabelle>`. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die interne Tabelle die Schlüsselfelder der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle enthält.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.

          mv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '20251203'.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate seatsmax = 100 ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_update( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_sflights_update=>tt_sflight_update(
      ( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate seatsmax = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_rows) = lo_cut->update_flight_seats( lt_updates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows exp = 1 ).

    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight( ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-seatsmax exp = 150 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid fldate = mv_fldate price = mv_initial_price ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_increase_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_price_update( ).

    DATA(lv_rows) = lo_cut->increase_flight_price( iv_carrid = mv_carrid iv_connid = mv_connid iv_fldate = mv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows exp = 1 ).

    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight( ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid AND fldate = mv_fldate.

    DATA(lv_expected_price) = mv_initial_price * '1.10'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-price exp = lv_expected_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` in Open SQL-Anweisungen ist seit ABAP 7.40 Standard. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Sicherheit, da es explizit macht, welche Variablen aus dem ABAP-Programm stammen. Die direkte Berechnung im `SET`-Ausdruck ist ebenfalls eine moderne und prägnante Art, Feldwerte zu aktualisieren.
keywords: UPDATE, Open SQL, Host Variables, Database Operations, SET

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die die grundlegende Logik zur Initialisierung und zum Hinzufügen von Knoten zu einem `cl_gui_list_tree`-Objekt kapselt. Die Klasse soll eine Methode bereitstellen, um einen Baum mit einer einfachen Hierarchie zu füllen. (Hinweis: Für einen vollständigen UI-Test wäre ein Dynpro erforderlich, hier wird die interne Logik getestet).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_list_tree=>create_tree` und `add_node` Methoden. Denken Sie daran, dass `cl_gui_list_tree` ein Frontend-Objekt ist und eine Verbindung zum Frontend benötigt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_simple_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_node_data TYPE tt_node_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_list_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_simple_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'. " Dummy container for backend logic

    CREATE OBJECT ro_list_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.

    ro_list_tree->set_table_for_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        nodes = VALUE lvc_t_nkey( ) " Initial empty table
      CHANGING
        table_structure_name = 'LVC_S_NKEY' ).

    LOOP AT it_node_data INTO DATA(ls_node).
      ro_list_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = ls_node-parent_key
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_node_text      = ls_node-text
        i_node_key       = ls_node-node_key ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Simulate flushing for backend test
    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_build_tree FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_tree.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_node_data) = VALUE zcl_tree_builder=>tt_node_data(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Root Node' parent_key = '' )
      ( node_key = 'CHILD1' text = 'Child 1' parent_key = 'ROOT' )
      ( node_key = 'CHILD2' text = 'Child 2' parent_key = 'ROOT' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_tree) = lo_cut->build_simple_tree( lt_node_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_tree->get_selected_nodes( ) ). " No nodes selected initially

    " More robust tests would involve checking the internal state of the tree,
    " but cl_gui_list_tree doesn't expose node data easily for backend testing.
    " This test primarily checks for successful object creation and method execution.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_tree ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `cl_gui_list_tree`-Klasse ist ein Standard-SAP-GUI-Control zur Darstellung hierarchischer Daten. Die Lösung zeigt, wie man Knoten programmatisch hinzufügt. Obwohl ein vollständiger Test der UI-Interaktion ein Dynpro erfordert, demonstriert dieser Code die Backend-Logik zur Baumstrukturierung. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die interne Tabelle und `CREATE OBJECT` ist moderner ABAP-Stil.
keywords: cl_gui_list_tree, UI, Tree Control, Object Orientation, Frontend Services

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die die Logik zur Registrierung eines Ereignishandlers für das 'NODE_DOUBLE_CLICK'-Ereignis eines `cl_gui_list_tree`-Objekts demonstriert. Die Methode soll den Schlüssel des doppelt angeklickten Knotens zurückgeben. (Hinweis: Die Ereignisauslösung wird im Unit-Test simuliert).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` für das Ereignis und die Methode `get_selected_node` oder die Parameter des Ereignisses.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS node_double_click EXPORTING VALUE(e_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_list_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_list_tree
      IMPORTING node_key.

    DATA: mv_last_clicked_node TYPE lvc_nkey.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_list_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_list_tree = io_list_tree.
    SET HANDLER handle_double_click FOR mo_list_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    mv_last_clicked_node = node_key.
    RAISE EVENT node_double_click EXPORTING e_node_key = node_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_node_double_click FOR TESTING.

    DATA: mv_event_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    METHODS handle_test_event FOR EVENT node_double_click OF zcl_tree_event_handler
      IMPORTING e_node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_test_event.
    mv_event_node_key = e_node_key.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_node_double_click.
    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_list_tree) = NEW cl_gui_list_tree( parent = lo_dummy_container ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_event_handler( lo_list_tree ).
    SET HANDLER handle_test_event FOR lo_cut.

    DATA(lv_test_node_key) = 'TEST_NODE'.

    " Simulate the event being raised by the tree control
    CALL METHOD lo_list_tree->node_double_click
      EXPORTING
        node_key = lv_test_node_key.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_last_clicked_node exp = lv_test_node_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_event_node_key exp = lv_test_node_key ).

    FREE OBJECT lo_list_tree.
    FREE OBJECT lo_dummy_container.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Ereignisbehandlung in ABAP Objects erfolgt über `SET HANDLER`. Hier wird eine lokale Klasse als Handler für das `NODE_DOUBLE_CLICK`-Ereignis des `cl_gui_list_tree` registriert. Die Methode `handle_double_click` empfängt den `node_key` als Parameter. Im Unit-Test wird das Ereignis manuell ausgelöst, um die korrekte Verarbeitung zu überprüfen. Die Verwendung von `RAISE EVENT` in der Handler-Methode ermöglicht es, das Ereignis an weitere Abonnenten weiterzuleiten.
keywords: cl_gui_list_tree, UI, Event Handling, Object Orientation, SET HANDLER

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, wobei Sie nur die Felder 'CARRID', 'CONNID' und 'FLDATE' übernehmen. Nutzen Sie dafür eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR <work_area> IN <source_table> INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF <target_table>`. Die Zielstruktur muss nicht alle Felder der Quelltabelle enthalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_reduced_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reduced_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_reduced_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    rt_reduced_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                  ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_reduced_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_reduced_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_reduced) = lo_cut->get_reduced_flights( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_reduced ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_reduced ) exp = 5 ).

    LOOP AT lt_reduced INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-fldate ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Iteration in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und `CORRESPONDING #`-Ausdruck ist eine sehr moderne und prägnante Art, interne Tabellen zu transformieren. `CORRESPONDING #` füllt die Felder der Zielstruktur automatisch, wenn die Namen übereinstimmen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und Fehler reduziert.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, Data Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller 'PRICE'-Werte aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie dafür den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator aggregiert Werte einer internen Tabelle. Definieren Sie einen Startwert und eine Logik zur Akkumulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.

    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'UA'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = mv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20251202' price = '200.00' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0003' fldate = '20251203' price = '50.00' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = mv_carrid OR carrid = 'LH'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( mv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '300.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem eine Akkumulationslogik definiert wird. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code für Aggregationen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Daten, um nur Flüge mit einer maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität von über 200 zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie dafür den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator erstellt eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung. Verwenden Sie `FILTER #( <source_table> WHERE <bedingung> )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_large_capacity_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_capacity_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE seatsmax > 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 180 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 300 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' seatsmax = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_large_capacity_flights( lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Anstatt eine explizite `LOOP`-Anweisung zu schreiben, kann die Filterbedingung direkt im Operator angegeben werden, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Functional Programming, Data Selection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Flugdatum eines SFLIGHTS-Eintrags in einem lesbaren Format kombiniert. Nutzen Sie dafür String-Templates.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug überbucht ist (SEATSOCC > SEATSMAX). Geben Sie 'Überbucht' oder 'Verfügbar' zurück. Nutzen Sie dafür den `COND`-Operator.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_status = COND string(

keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, Expressions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie dafür eine Kombination aus `REDUCE` und `DIVIDE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden und zählen Sie die Einträge. Teilen Sie dann die Summe durch die Anzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                      count = 0
                                FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price,
                                       count = count + 1 ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum_price / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie dafür den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `LOOP AT` Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT <itab> INTO <wa> GROUP BY <key_fields>`. Innerhalb der Gruppe können Sie `COUNT(*)` verwenden oder die Elemente der Gruppe iterieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_group_result) = VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_group_result TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen XML-String und extrahieren Sie den Wert eines bestimmten Knotens (z.B. den Textinhalt des Knotens '<Name>').
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Laden des XML und navigieren Sie durch die DOM-Struktur, um den gewünschten Knoten zu finden.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_name DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name_from_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_name IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_name_from_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_ucs2_xstring( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_root_node) = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
        DATA(lo_name_node) = lo_root_node->find_node( 'Name' ).
        IF lo_name_node IS BOUND.
          rv_name = lo_name_node->get_value( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        rv_name = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` repräsentiert. Jede Flugverbindung soll als eigener Knoten mit Attributen für Carrier, Connection und Price dargestellt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Erstellen des Dokuments und `FOR`-Ausdrücke, um die Daten aus der internen Tabelle zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_create_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flights_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_create_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flights_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flights' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_flight_node->set_attribute( name = 'Carrier' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_flight_node->set_attribute( name = 'Connection' value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_flight_node->set_attribute( name = 'Price' value = |{ ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }| ).
      lo_root->append_child( lo_flight_node ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_create_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_xml_create_flights=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '<Flights>' in = lv_xml msg = 'XML should contain root tag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '<Flight Carrier="LH" Connection="0400" Price="100.00 EUR"/>' in = lv_xml msg = 'XML should contain first flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '<Flight Carrier="AA" Connection="0017" Price="250.50 USD"/>' in = lv_xml msg = 'XML should contain second flight' ).

Die Daten werden aus einer internen Tabelle mittels `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)` verarbeitet. Instructions: Laden Sie einen XML-String, ändern Sie den Wert eines spezifischen Knotens (z.B. '<Status>') und serialisieren Sie das modifizierte XML zurück in einen String.

CLASS zcl_xml_modify_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_xml_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_new_status TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_modify_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_xml_status.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_ucs2_xstring( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_status_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( 'Status' ).
        IF lo_status_node IS BOUND.
          lo_status_node->set_value( iv_new_status ).
        ENDIF.
        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_modified_xml ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_modified_xml = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle 'Flight'-Knoten und deren 'Carrier'-Attribute aus einem XML-String unter Verwendung von XPATH.
hint: Nutzen Sie die XPATH-Funktionalität von `cl_xml_document` (z.B. `select_nodes`) und `FOR`-Ausdrücke zur Iteration über die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrier TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid  TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_xpath
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_xpath.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_ucs2_xstring( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_xml_document->select_nodes( '/Flights/Flight' ).

        rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR lo_node IN lo_node_list
                                   LET lo_element = CAST cl_xml_element( lo_node )
                                   IN ( carrier = lo_element->get_attribute( 'Carrier' )
                                        connid  = lo_element->get_attribute( 'Connection' ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_xpath_query FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xpath_query.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_xpath_query( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<Flights><Flight Carrier="LH" Connection="0400"/><Flight Carrier="AA" Connection="0017"/></Flights>`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_xml_xpath_query=>tt_flight_info(
      ( carrier = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrier = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_xpath( lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find two flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual exp = lt_expected msg = 'Extracted flight info should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_xpath_query( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<Flights><OtherData/></Flights>`.
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_xpath( lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_actual msg = 'Should return empty table if no flights found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die XPATH-Funktionalität von `cl_xml_document` zur effizienten Abfrage von XML-Daten. `select_nodes` führt die XPATH-Abfrage aus und gibt eine Liste von Knoten zurück. Ein `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` wird verwendet, um die Attribute der gefundenen Knoten in eine interne Tabelle zu transformieren. `CAST` ist notwendig, da `select_nodes` `if_xml_node` zurückgibt, wir aber `if_xml_element` für Attribute benötigen.
keywords: XML, XPATH, Query, cl_xml_document, FOR, VALUE, Internal Table

Instructions: Fügen Sie einem bestehenden XML-Dokument einen neuen Knoten mit Textinhalt hinzu und serialisieren Sie es.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_element`, `create_text_node` und `append_child`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_add_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_node_to_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_parent_tag TYPE string
        iv_new_tag    TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_add_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_node_to_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_ucs2_xstring( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_parent_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( iv_parent_tag ).

        IF lo_parent_node IS BOUND.
          DATA(lo_new_element) = lo_xml_document->create_element( iv_new_tag ).
          DATA(lo_text_node) = lo_xml_document->create_text_node( iv_new_value ).
          lo_new_element->append_child( lo_text_node ).
          lo_parent_node->append_child( lo_new_element ).
        ENDIF.

        lo_xml_document->render_2_string( IMPORTING stream = rv_modified_xml ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_modified_xml = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_node FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parent_not_found FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_node.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_add_node( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_xml) = `<Root><Data>Existing Data</Data></Root>`.
    DATA(lv_expected_xml) = `<Root><Data>Existing Data</Data><NewNode>New Value</NewNode></Root>`.
    DATA(lv_actual_xml) = lo_cut->add_node_to_xml( iv_xml_string = lv_initial_xml
                                                  iv_parent_tag = 'Root'
                                                  iv_new_tag    = 'NewNode'

CLASS zcl_timefm_timezone_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_timefm_timezone_conv IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Stunden und Minuten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_timefm` Methoden zur Berechnung von Zeitdifferenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timefm_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_time_diff,
             hours   TYPE i,
             minutes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_time_diff.

    METHODS calculate_time_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_time_diff) TYPE ty_time_diff.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timefm_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_time_difference.
    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_timefm=>diff_tstmpl_in_seconds(
                               tstmpl1 = iv_timestamp1
                               tstmpl2 = iv_timestamp2 ).

    rs_time_diff-hours = lv_diff_seconds DIV 3600.
    rs_time_diff-minutes = ( lv_diff_seconds MOD 3600 ) DIV 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timefm_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timefm_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lv_weekday_num) = cl_abap_timefm=>get_weekday(
                              date = iv_date ).

    CASE lv_weekday_num.
      WHEN 1 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Sonntag'.
      WHEN 2 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Montag'.
      WHEN 3 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Dienstag'.
      WHEN 4 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Mittwoch'.
      WHEN 5 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Donnerstag'.
      WHEN 6 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Freitag'.
      WHEN 7 THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Samstag'.
      WHEN OTHERS THEN rv_weekday_name = 'Ungültiges Datum'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Datum, Flugnummer). Formatieren Sie alle Flugdaten in der Tabelle in das 'YYYY-MM-DD'-Format und geben Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den formatierten Daten zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `cl_abap_format=>get_instance( )->format_date( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fmt_table_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_formatted_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate_formatted TYPE string,
           END OF ty_formatted_flight_data.

    TYPES tt_formatted_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_formatted_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_data) TYPE tt_formatted_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_fmt_table_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_dates.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( iv_locale = 'EN' ). " Für YYYY-MM-DD

    rt_formatted_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flight_data
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                   fldate_formatted = lo_formatter->format_date( iv_date = ls_flight-fldate iv_pattern = 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
