CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flight_dates.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_fmt_table_dates=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20231201' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20231231' ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fmt_table_dates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->format_flight_dates( it_flight_data = lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte gleich sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate_formatted exp = '2023-12-01' msg = 'Erstes Datum sollte korrekt formatiert sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-fldate_formatted exp = '2023-12-31' msg = 'Zweites Datum sollte korrekt formatiert sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen Wert dynamisch basierend auf dem Datentyp eines Feldes, das durch RTTI ermittelt wird. Wenn es sich um ein Datum handelt, formatieren Sie es als 'DD.MM.YYYY'.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_format` mit RTTI (`cl_abap_typedescr`) um den Datentyp zu ermitteln und entsprechend zu formatieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fmt_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fmt_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_value ).
    DATA(lo_formatter) = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( iv_locale = 'DE' ).

    CASE lo_type_descr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
        rv_formatted_value = lo_formatter->format_date( iv_date = iv_value iv_pattern = 'DD.MM.YYYY' ).
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time.
        rv_formatted_value = lo_formatter->format_time( iv_time = iv_value ).
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
        rv_formatted_value = lo_formatter->format_number( iv_number = iv_value ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_formatted_value = |{ iv_value }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie ein dynamisches Mapping zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, wobei die Mapping-Regeln (welche Felder gemappt werden und mit welchen Namen) zur Laufzeit in einer Mapping-Tabelle definiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_corresponding=>create( )` und die Methode `map( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_dynamic_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             target_id   TYPE i,
             target_name TYPE string,
             amount      TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
             status      TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapping_rule,
             source_field TYPE string,
             target_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mapping_rule.
    TYPES tt_mapping_rules TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapping_rule WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS dynamic_map
      IMPORTING
        is_source      TYPE ty_source
        it_map_rules   TYPE tt_mapping_rules
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_dynamic_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_map.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
                                source      = is_source
                                destination = rs_target ).

    LOOP AT it_map_rules INTO DATA(ls_rule).
      lo_corresponding->add_mapping(
        source_name      = ls_rule-source_field
        destination_name = ls_rule-target_field ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_corresponding->map( CHANGING destination = rs_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mappen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine Zieltabelle. Schließen Sie dabei das Feld `planetype` vom Mapping aus und verwenden Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Logik, um das Feld `seatsmax` in ein neues Feld `max_capacity` zu übertragen.

CLASS zcl_cor_except_using DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_target,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid       TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate       TYPE s_date,
             max_capacity TYPE i,
             "planetype ist hier nicht enthalten
           END OF ty_sflight_target.
    TYPES tt_sflight_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflights_custom
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_sflight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_except_using IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflights_custom.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_sflights EXCEPT planetype
                                 USING ( max_capacity = seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und geben Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und das früheste Flugdatum zurück. Formatieren Sie das früheste Datum im 'DD.MM.YYYY'-Format.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `cl_abap_format`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fmt_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             earliest_fldate_formatted TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fmt_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_formatter) = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( iv_locale = 'DE' ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_earliest_date) = cl_abap_datfm=>max_date.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        IF ls_group_member-fldate < lv_earliest_date.
          lv_earliest_date = ls_group_member-fldate.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_flight_count
                      earliest_fldate_formatted = lo_formatter->format_date( iv_date = lv_earliest_date iv_pattern = 'DD.MM.YYYY' ) ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mappen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine Zieltabelle, wobei Sie nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) berücksichtigen und gleichzeitig das Feld `planetype` ausschließen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_filter_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered_target,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid       TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate       TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax     TYPE s_seatsmax,
             "planetype ist hier nicht enthalten
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered_target.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered_target.

CLASS zcl_cor_filter_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_filtered_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( lt_filtered_sflights EXCEPT planetype ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen entgegennimmt und eine bestimmte Spalte (Datum, Währung oder Zahl) in dieser Tabelle formatiert. Die Spalte und ihr Typ sollen dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_format` in Kombination mit RTTI und dynamischer Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fmt_generic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_row,
             key_field TYPE string,
             date_col  TYPE d,
             curr_col  TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
             num_col   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_row.
    TYPES tt_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_table_column
      IMPORTING
        io_data_table TYPE tt_data_table
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_column_type TYPE c LENGTH 1 " D=Date, C=Currency, N=Number
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fmt_generic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_table_column.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( iv_locale = 'DE' ).

    LOOP AT io_data_table INTO DATA(ls_row).
      DATA(lv_formatted_value) = ``.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE ls_row TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CASE iv_column_type.
          WHEN 'D'. " Date
            lv_formatted_value = lo_formatter->format_date( iv_date = <fs_field> ).
          WHEN 'C'. " Currency (assuming EUR for simplicity)
            lv_formatted_value = lo_formatter->format_currency( iv_amount = <fs_field> iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
          WHEN 'N'. " Number
            lv_formatted_value = lo_formatter->format_number( iv_number = <fs_field> ).
          WHEN OTHERS.
            lv_formatted_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
        ENDCASE.
      ELSE.
        lv_formatted_value = 'Column not found'.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_formatted_value TO rt_formatted_table.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Mapping-Klasse, die zur Laufzeit eine Mapping-Definition (Quell- und Zielfelder) erhält und dann eine interne Tabelle von Quellstrukturen in eine interne Tabelle von Zielstrukturen mappt. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_corresponding`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_corresponding=>create( )` und `add_mapping( )` in einer generischen Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_generic_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapping_rule,
             source_field TYPE string,
             target_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mapping_rule.
    TYPES tt_mapping_rules TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapping_rule WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS perform_mapping
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_map_rules   TYPE tt_mapping_rules
        it_target_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_generic_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_mapping.
    DATA: lo_source_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_target_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    lo_source_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_data ).
    lo_target_type = it_target_type.

    DATA(lo_corresponding) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
                                source_type      = lo_source_type
                                destination_type = lo_target_type ).

    LOOP AT it_map_rules INTO DATA(ls_rule).
      lo_corresponding->add_mapping(
        source_name      = ls_rule-source_field
        destination_name = ls_rule-target_field ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_corresponding->map_table(
      source      = it_source_data
      CHANGING
        destination = rt_target_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

             target_name TYPE string,
             status      TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target_data.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Domänenwerten (z.B. `BOOLE_D`) in eine Map (Hash-Tabelle) umwandelt, wobei der Domänenwert der Schlüssel und der Text der Wert ist. Anschließend mappen Sie eine Eingabetabelle von Werten auf diese Texte.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_reca_ddic_doma` und den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Map zu erstellen, und `FOR` für das Mapping.
solution:
CLASS zcl_domain_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_domain_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ddtext WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line. "Key is ddvalue_l, value is ddtext
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input_value,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE ddvalue_l,
           END OF ty_input_value.
    TYPES tt_input_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_boolean_values IMPORTING it_input TYPE tt_input_values
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_mapped_values) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_domain_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_boolean_values.
    DATA(lo_domain) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>create( 'BOOLE_D' ).
    DATA(lt_fixed_values_raw) = lo_domain->get_fixed_values_with_text( sy-langu ).

    DATA(lv_domain_map) = REDUCE ty_domain_map(
                            INIT map = VALUE ty_domain_map( )
                            FOR <fs_value> IN lt_fixed_values_raw
                              NEXT map = VALUE ty_domain_map( BASE map ( key = <fs_value>-low value = <fs_value>-ddtext ) ) ).

    rt_mapped_values = VALUE #( FOR <fs_input> IN it_input
                                ( lv_domain_map[ <fs_input>-value ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Spalte einer internen Tabelle von Strings in eine interne Tabelle von XSTRINGs (UTF-16 Little Endian), um sie für eine Dateiübertragung vorzubereiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und den `FOR` Operator mit `MAP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mass_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_string_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             text   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_string_data.
    TYPES tt_string_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_string_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_xstring_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             x_text TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_xstring_data.
    TYPES tt_xstring_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_xstring_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_to_utf16le IMPORTING it_string_data TYPE tt_string_data
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rt_xstring_data) TYPE tt_xstring_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mass_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_utf16le.
    DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
                                 encoding  = 'UTF-16LE' " Little Endian
                                 byteorder = cl_abap_conv_ce=>byteorder_lsb_first ).

    rt_xstring_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_data> IN it_string_data
                                LET lv_xstring = '' IN
                                ( id = <fs_data>-id,
                                  x_text = REDUCE xstring(
                                               INIT x = lv_xstring
                                               FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > 1 " Dummy loop for single conversion
                                               NEXT x = lo_converter->reset_buffer( ) THEN lo_converter->write( <fs_data>-text ) THEN lo_converter->get_buffer( ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_convert_table_to_utf16le.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mass_converter( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_mass_converter=>tt_string_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Test' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'ÄÖÜ' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_table_to_utf16le( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 entries' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First xstring incorrect' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-x_text exp = '5400650073007400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second xstring incorrect' act = lt_result[ 2 ]-x_text exp = 'C400D600DC00' ).

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen String mit ungültigen Zeichen für eine bestimmte Codepage (z.B. ASCII) zu konvertieren und fangen Sie die erwartete Ausnahme ab. Geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_conversion_codepage`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conversion_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling IMPORTING iv_string TYPE string
                                           RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conversion_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = '4103' ). " ASCII
    TRY.
        lo_converter->write( data = iv_string ).
        DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_converter->get_buffer( ).
        " For demonstration, convert back to string to show success
        DATA(lo_converter_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = '4103' ).
        lo_converter_in->read( EXPORTING input = lv_xstring IMPORTING data = rv_result ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).
        rv_result = |Fehler bei der Codepage-Konvertierung: { lx_codepage_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
        rv_result = |Allgemeiner Konvertierungsfehler: { lx_conversion_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings und konvertieren Sie nur die gefilterten Einträge in ein XSTRING (UTF-8).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` in Kombination mit dem `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_converted_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             x_value TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_converted_data.
    TYPES tt_converted_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_converted_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_filtered_data IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_converted_data) TYPE tt_converted_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_filtered_data.
    DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).

    rt_converted_data = VALUE #( FOR <fs_data> IN FILTER tt_data FROM it_data WHERE ( id MOD 2 = 0 )
                                 LET lv_xstring = '' IN
                                 ( id = <fs_data>-id,
                                   x_value = REDUCE xstring(
                                                 INIT x = lv_xstring
                                                 FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > 1
                                                 NEXT x = lo_converter->reset_buffer( ) THEN lo_converter->write( <fs_data>-value ) THEN lo_converter->get_buffer( ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( id = 1 value = 'One' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Two' )
      ( id = 3 value = 'Three' )
      ( id = 4 value = 'Four' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_filtered_data( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 filtered entries' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First filtered xstring incorrect' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-x_value exp = '54776F' ). " 'Two' in UTF-8
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second filtered xstring incorrect' act = lt_result[ 2 ]-x_value exp = '466F7572' ). " 'Four' in UTF-8
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es ermöglicht das Filtern von Daten in einer internen Tabelle und die anschließende Konvertierung der gefilterten Elemente in einem einzigen, modernen Ausdruck, was die Code-Lesbarkeit und Effizienz erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie eine Liste von Strings zu einem einzigen XSTRING (UTF-8), wobei jeder String durch ein Trennzeichen getrennt ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und den `REDUCE` Operator zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstring_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS aggregate_strings_to_xstring IMPORTING it_strings TYPE string_table
                                           IMPORTING iv_delimiter TYPE string
                                           RETURNING VALUE(rv_aggregated_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_strings_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).

    rv_aggregated_xstring = REDUCE xstring(
                                INIT x_result = VALUE xstring( )
                                FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > lines( it_strings )
                                NEXT x_result = COND xstring(
                                                   WHEN i = 1 THEN
                                                     lo_converter->reset_buffer( ) THEN lo_converter->write( it_strings[ i ] ) THEN lo_converter->get_buffer( )
                                                   ELSE
                                                     lo_converter->reset_buffer( ) THEN lo_converter->write( iv_delimiter ) THEN lo_converter->write( it_strings[ i ] ) THEN lo_converter->get_buffer( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_delimiter) = ';'.
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = '46697273743B5365636F6E643B5468697264'. " 'First;Second;Third' in UTF-8

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_strings_to_xstring( it_strings = lt_input_strings iv_delimiter = lv_delimiter ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Aggregated xstring incorrect' act = lv_result exp = lv_expected_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Datenquelle, Formatierung) implementieren. Nutzen Sie `sflights` als Datenquelle.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_report_line TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_report_generator DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS:
          generate_report FINAL
            RETURNING VALUE(rt_report) TYPE tt_report_line.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS:
          get_data ABSTRACT
            RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data,
          format_data ABSTRACT
            IMPORTING
              it_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
            RETURNING VALUE(rt_formatted_data) TYPE tt_report_line.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_simple_sflight_report DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_report_generator PUBLIC FINAL.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS:
          get_data REDEFINITION,
          format_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD generate_report.
        DATA(lt_raw_data) = get_data( ).
        rt_report = format_data( lt_raw_data ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_simple_sflight_report IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_data.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @rt_data
          UP TO 3 ROWS. " For example
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD format_data.
        APPEND 'Carrier | Connection | Date | Price | Currency' TO rt_formatted_data.
        APPEND '-------------------------------------------------' TO rt_formatted_data.
        LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
          APPEND |{ ls_data-carrid WIDTH = 7 }| &&
                 |{ ls_data-connid WIDTH = 11 }| &&
                 |{ ls_data-fldate WIDTH = 12 DATE = USER }| &&
                 |{ ls_data-price WIDTH = 8 DECIMALS = 2 }| &&
                 |{ ls_data-currency WIDTH = 8 }| TO rt_formatted_data.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

      constructor IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_discount_strategy,

        IMPORTING
          iv_amount TYPE decfloat16

CLASS zcl_percentage_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_percentage = iv_percentage.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_discount.
    rv_discounted_amount = iv_amount * ( 1 - mv_percentage / 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_fixed_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_fixed_amount = iv_fixed_amount.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_discount.

    IF rv_discounted_amount < 0.
      rv_discounted_amount = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.

    rv_final_amount = mo_strategy->calculate_discount( iv_amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `Shape` mit einem Attribut für die Farbe und abstrakten Methoden zur Berechnung von Fläche und Umfang. Implementieren Sie konkrete Unterklassen wie `Circle` und `Rectangle`.
hint: Attribute können in abstrakten Klassen definiert und in Unterklassen verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shape_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor IMPORTING iv_color TYPE string,
      get_color   RETURNING VALUE(rv_color) TYPE string,
      calculate_area ABSTRACT
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16,
      calculate_perimeter ABSTRACT
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_perimeter) TYPE decfloat16.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_color TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle_concrete DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor IMPORTING iv_color TYPE string iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      calculate_area REDEFINITION,
      calculate_perimeter REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    CONSTANTS: gc_pi TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '3.1415926535'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle_concrete DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor IMPORTING iv_color TYPE string iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      calculate_area REDEFINITION,
      calculate_perimeter REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_color = iv_color.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_color.
    rv_color = mv_color.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle_concrete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SUPER->constructor( iv_color ).
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = gc_pi * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_perimeter.
    rv_perimeter = 2 * gc_pi * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle_concrete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SUPER->constructor( iv_color ).
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_perimeter.
    rv_perimeter = 2 * ( mv_length + mv_width ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse, die neben abstrakten Instanzmethoden auch eine statische Methode enthält. Die statische Methode soll eine Hilfsfunktion für die abstrakte Typenhierarchie bereitstellen.
hint: Statische Methoden können in abstrakten Klassen definiert und direkt über den Klassennamen aufgerufen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_processor DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      get_processor_info RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
    METHODS:
      process_data ABSTRACT
        IMPORTING
          iv_input TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_processor PUBLIC FINAL.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      process_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_processor PUBLIC FINAL.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      process_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_processor_info.
    rv_info = 'This is an abstract processor utility.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rv_output = to_upper( iv_input ). " Modern ABAP string function
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_number) = CONV decfloat16( iv_input ).
        rv_output = |{ lv_number * 2 }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_output = 'Invalid Number'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_static_method.
    DATA(lv_info) = zcl_abstract_processor=>get_processor_info( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_info exp = 'abstract processor' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_string_processor.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_string_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_processor->process_data( 'hello world' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = 'HELLO WORLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_number_processor( ).

Die statische Methode `get_processor_info` bietet eine klassenweite Funktionalität, die nicht an eine Instanz gebunden ist, aber im Kontext der abstrakten Hierarchie steht. Moderne String-Funktionen wie `to_upper` und Inline-Konvertierungen werden verwendet.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Datenfilter mit einer abstrakten Methode `filter_data`. Implementieren Sie konkrete Filter für `sflights` basierend auf Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und Preis. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `FILTER`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT METHOD` für die Filterlogik und `FILTER` für die Implementierung in den Unterklassen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_data_filter_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS:
          filter_data ABSTRACT
            IMPORTING
              it_source_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
            RETURNING
              VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_carrid_filter DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_data_filter_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS:
          constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS:
          filter_data REDEFINITION.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_price_filter DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_data_filter_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS:
          constructor IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS:
          filter_data REDEFINITION.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mv_min_price TYPE sflight-price.
        DATA mv_max_price TYPE sflight-price.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_carrid_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD filter_data.
        rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_source_data WHERE carrid = mv_carrid ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_price_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_min_price = iv_min_price.
        mv_max_price = iv_max_price.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD filter_data.
        rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_source_data WHERE price BETWEEN mv_min_price AND mv_max_price ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Validatoren mit einer abstrakten Methode `validate`. Implementieren Sie konkrete Validatoren, die verschiedene Prüfungen durchführen und bei Fehlern eine Exception werfen. Nutzen Sie `CX_STATIC_CHECK` für die Exceptions.
hint: Abstrakte Methoden können Exceptions deklarieren, die von den Implementierungen geworfen werden müssen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_validation_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_validation_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validator_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      validate ABSTRACT
        IMPORTING
          iv_value TYPE string
        RAISING
          zcx_validation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_validator_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      validate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_validator DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_validator_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      validate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate.
    IF iv_value IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_validation_error( textid = zcx_validation_error=>default_text
                                                previous = NEW cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_text ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate.
    IF NOT iv_value CO '0123456789'. " Simple check for demo
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_validation_error( textid = zcx_validation_error=>default_text
                                                previous = NEW cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_text ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Daten-Mapper mit einer abstrakten Methode `map_data`. Implementieren Sie konkrete Mapper, die Daten von einem Format in ein anderes transformieren. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Transformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT METHOD` für die Mapping-Logik und `FOR`/`VALUE` für die effiziente Transformation.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data_a,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data_a.
    TYPES tt_target_data_a TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data_a WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data_b,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data_b.
    TYPES tt_target_data_b TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data_b WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_data_mapper_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS:
          map_data ABSTRACT
            IMPORTING
              it_source TYPE tt_source_data
            RETURNING
              VALUE(ro_mapped_data) TYPE REF TO object. " Return generic object, cast later
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_mapper_to_a DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_data_mapper_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS:
          map_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_mapper_to_b DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_data_mapper_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS:
          map_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_mapper_to_a IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD map_data.
        DATA(lt_target) = VALUE tt_target_data_a(
          FOR ls_source IN it_source
            LET lv_id = COND i( WHEN ls_source-field1 CO '0123456789' THEN CONV i( ls_source-field1 ) ELSE 0 )
            IN ( id = lv_id, name = ls_source-field2 )
        ).
        ro_mapped_data = REF #( lt_target ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_mapper_to_b IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD map_data.
        DATA(lt_target) = VALUE tt_target_data_b(
          FOR ls_source IN it_source
            ( key = ls_source-field1, value = ls_source-field2 )
        ).
        ro_mapped_data = REF #( lt_target ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS test_mapper_to_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mapper_to_b FOR TESTING.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_source_data TYPE tt_source_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_source_data = VALUE #( ( field1 = '1' field2 = 'Item One' )
                              ( field1 = '2' field2 = 'Item Two' )
                              ( field1 = 'X' field2 = 'Invalid ID' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mapper_to_a.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_mapper_to_a( ).
    DATA(lo_mapped_data) = lo_mapper->map_data( mt_source_data ).
    DATA(lt_target) TYPE tt_target_data_a.
    ASSIGN lo_mapped_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
    IF <fs_target> IS ASSIGNED.
      lt_target = <fs_target>.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[1]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[3]-id exp = 0 ). " Invalid ID maps to 0
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mapper_to_b.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_mapper_to_b( ).
    DATA(lo_mapped_data) = lo_mapper->map_data( mt_source_data ).
    DATA(lt_target) TYPE tt_target_data_b.
    ASSIGN lo_mapped_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
    IF <fs_target> IS ASSIGNED.
      lt_target = <fs_target>.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[1]-key exp = '1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[2]-value exp = 'Item Two' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie abstrakte Klassen für Daten-Mapping-Strategien verwendet werden können. Die konkreten Mapper implementieren die abstrakte `map_data`-Methode und nutzen dabei die leistungsstarken `FOR`- und `VALUE`-Ausdrücke, um interne Tabellen deklarativ und effizient zu transformieren. Dies ist ein Kernstück des modernen ABAP-Programmierstils.
keywords: ABSTRACT, METHOD, FOR, VALUE, INTERNAL TABLES, DATA TRANSFORMATION, OBJECT ORIENTATION, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Event-Handler mit einer abstrakten Methode `handle_event`. Implementieren Sie konkrete Handler, die auf verschiedene Event-Typen reagieren. Demonstrieren Sie die Registrierung und den Aufruf der Handler.

Implementieren Sie konkrete Aggregatoren, die Daten aus `sflights` auf unterschiedliche Weise aggregieren (z.B. Summe der Preise, Anzahl der Flüge). Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_aggregator_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS:
          aggregate_data ABSTRACT
            IMPORTING
              it_source_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
            RETURNING
              VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string. " Return string for generic display
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_sum_price_aggregator DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_aggregator_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS:
          aggregate_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_count_flights_aggregator DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_aggregator_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS:
          aggregate_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_sum_price_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD aggregate_data.
        DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR ls_data IN it_source_data
          NEXT sum = sum + ls_data-price
        ).
        rv_result = |Total Price: { lv_total_price }|.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_count_flights_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD aggregate_data.
        DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i(
          INIT count = 0
          FOR ls_data IN it_source_data
          NEXT count = count + 1
        ).
        rv_result = |Number of Flights: { lv_flight_count }|.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für dynamische Feldzugriffe mit einer abstrakten Methode `get_field_value`. Implementieren Sie konkrete Zugriffsklassen, die den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch aus einer Struktur oder Tabelle lesen. Nutzen Sie RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT METHOD` für den Feldzugriff und RTTI (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`) für die dynamische Feldermittlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_accessor DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_field_value ABSTRACT
        IMPORTING
          io_data     TYPE REF TO data
          iv_field_name TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_struct_field_accessor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_dynamic_field_accessor PUBLIC FINAL.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_field_value REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_field_accessor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_dynamic_field_accessor PUBLIC FINAL.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_field_value REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_struct_field_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_struct> TYPE any STRUCTURE,
                   <fs_field>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_data->* TO <fs_struct>.
    IF <fs_struct> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_field_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED AND lines( <fs_table> ) > 0.
      READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_length_rule DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_rule_checker_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor IMPORTING iv_min_length TYPE i.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:

CLASS zcl_length_rule IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_min_length = iv_min_length.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD check_rule.
    rb_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN strlen( iv_value ) >= mv_min_length THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_contains_digit_rule IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_rule.
    rb_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_value CP '*[0-9]*' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Daten-Gruppierer mit einer abstrakten Methode `group_data`. Implementieren Sie konkrete Gruppierer, die Daten aus `sflights` nach verschiedenen Kriterien gruppieren. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in `FOR` oder `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT METHOD` für die Gruppierungslogik und `FOR ... GROUP BY` oder `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die effiziente Gruppierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_by_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_grouped_by_carrid.
    TYPES tt_grouped_by_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_by_fldate,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_by_fldate.
    TYPES tt_grouped_by_fldate TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_by_fldate WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_grouper_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS:
          group_data ABSTRACT
            IMPORTING
              it_source_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
            RETURNING
              VALUE(ro_grouped_data) TYPE REF TO object. " Return generic object, cast later
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_group_by_carrid DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_grouper_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS:
          group_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_group_by_fldate DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_grouper_abstract PUBLIC FINAL.
      PROTECTED SECTION.
        METHODS:
          group_data REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_group_by_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD group_data.
        DATA(lt_grouped) = VALUE tt_grouped_by_carrid(
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN it_source_data GROUP BY ls_data-carrid
          ( carrid = ls_data-carrid,
            count = GROUP SIZE,
            total_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
              INIT sum = 0
              FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_data
              NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-price
            )
          )
        ).
        ro_grouped_data = REF #( lt_grouped ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_group_by_fldate IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD group_data.
        DATA(lt_grouped) = VALUE tt_grouped_by_fldate(
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN it_source_data GROUP BY ls_data-fldate
          ( fldate = ls_data-fldate,
            count = GROUP SIZE
          )
        ).
        ro_grouped_data = REF #( lt_grouped ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_test_data = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' )
                            ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = 250 currency = 'USD' )
                            ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 currency = 'EUR' )
                            ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = 300 currency = 'USD' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_carrid.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_group_by_carrid( ).
    DATA(lo_grouped_data) = lo_grouper->group_data( mt_test_data ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) TYPE tt_grouped_by_carrid.
    ASSIGN lo_grouped_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_grouped>).
    IF <fs_grouped> IS ASSIGNED.
      lt_grouped = <fs_grouped>.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[1]-count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[1]-total_price exp = 250 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_fldate.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_group_by_fldate( ).
    DATA(lo_grouped_data) = lo_grouper->group_data( mt_test_data ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) TYPE tt_grouped_by_fldate.
    ASSIGN lo_grouped_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_grouped>).
    IF <fs_grouped> IS ASSIGNED.
      lt_grouped = <fs_grouped>.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[1]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped[1]-count exp = 2 ).

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie die digitale Signatur eines XML-Dokuments mithilfe der Klasse `cl_secxml_helper`. Das Beispiel-XML enthält eine einfache Signatur.
hint: Nutzen Sie Methoden wie `create_signature_verifier` und `verify_signature` der `cl_secxml_helper` Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_verify_signature DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_xml_signature
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_verify_signature IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_xml_signature.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_document,
          lo_verifier     TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_signature_verifier.

    TRY.
        " Create XML document from xstring
        lo_xml_document = cl_secxml_document=>create_from_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

        " Create signature verifier
        lo_verifier = cl_secxml_helper=>create_signature_verifier( lo_xml_document ).

        " Verify signature
        rv_is_valid = lo_verifier->verify_signature( ).

      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_verify_xml_signature FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_verify_xml_signature.
    " Dummy XML with a placeholder signature.
    " In a real scenario, this XML would be genuinely signed.
    " For testing purposes, we simulate a valid/invalid scenario.
    DATA(lv_signed_xml_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
        <data>
          <item id="1">Value 1</item>
          <Signature xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#">
            <SignedInfo>
              <CanonicalizationMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/TR/2001/REC-xml-c14n-20010315"/>
              <SignatureMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#rsa-sha1"/>
              <Reference URI="">
                <Transforms>
                  <Transform Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#enveloped-signature"/>
                </Transforms>
                <DigestMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#sha1"/>
                <DigestValue>PLACEHOLDER_DIGEST_VALUE=</DigestValue>
              </Reference>
            </SignedInfo>
            <SignatureValue>PLACEHOLDER_SIGNATURE_VALUE=</SignatureValue>
            <KeyInfo>
              <X509Data>
                <X509Certificate>PLACEHOLDER_CERTIFICATE</X509Certificate>
              </X509Data>
            </KeyInfo>
          </Signature>
        </data>'
        CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_verify_signature( ).
    " This test will likely fail in a real system without a valid signature/certificate setup.
    " For demonstration, we assume a valid signature would return true.
    " A proper unit test would involve generating a known signed XML and verifying it.
    " Here, we just check if the method runs without crashing and returns a boolean.
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->verify_xml_signature( lv_signed_xml_xstr ).

    " Since we cannot easily create a valid signed XML in a simple unit test,
    " we assert that the method returns a boolean value.
    " In a real scenario, you'd have a pre-signed XML and assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_is_valid = abap_true OR lv_is_valid = abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_secxml_helper` bietet eine Schnittstelle zur Handhabung von XML-Signaturen. `create_signature_verifier` erstellt ein Objekt, das dann `verify_signature` aufruft, um die Integrität und Authentizität des XML-Dokuments zu prüfen. Die Komplexität der Zertifikats- und Schlüsselverwaltung wird dabei abstrahiert.
keywords: XML, Security, Digital Signature, cl_secxml_helper, cl_secxml_document

Instructions: Verschlüsseln und entschlüsseln Sie einen Teil eines XML-Dokuments mit `cl_secxml_helper`. Verwenden Sie ein einfaches XML-Fragment.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_encryptor` und `create_decryptor` der `cl_secxml_helper` Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_encrypt_decrypt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS encrypt_xml_element
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
        iv_xpath    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_encrypted_xml) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS decrypt_xml_element
      IMPORTING
        iv_encrypted_xml TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decrypted_xml) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_encrypt_decrypt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD encrypt_xml_element.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_document,
          lo_encryptor    TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_encryptor.
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_secxml_document=>create_from_xstring( iv_xml_data ).
        " For a real scenario, you'd need a proper key/certificate setup.
        " This is a simplified example.
        lo_encryptor = cl_secxml_helper=>create_encryptor(
                            i_xml_document = lo_xml_document
                            i_encryption_method = cl_secxml_helper=>co_enc_aes256_cbc
                            i_key_transport_method = cl_secxml_helper=>co_key_rsa_oaep ).
        lo_encryptor->encrypt_element( i_xpath = iv_xpath ).
        rv_encrypted_xml = lo_xml_document->get_xstring( ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        " Handle error
        rv_encrypted_xml = iv_xml_data. " Return original on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decrypt_xml_element.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_document,
          lo_decryptor    TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_decryptor.
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_secxml_document=>create_from_xstring( iv_encrypted_xml ).
        " For a real scenario, you'd need a proper key/certificate setup.
        lo_decryptor = cl_secxml_helper=>create_decryptor( lo_xml_document ).
        lo_decryptor->decrypt_document( ).
        rv_decrypted_xml = lo_xml_document->get_xstring( ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        " Handle error
        rv_decrypted_xml = iv_encrypted_xml. " Return original on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_encrypt_decrypt FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_encrypt_decrypt.
    DATA(lv_original_xml_str) =
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
        <root>
          <sensitive_data>This is secret information.</sensitive_data>
          <public_data>This is public.</public_data>
        </root>'.
    DATA(lv_original_xml_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_original_xml_str CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_xpath_to_encrypt) = '/root/sensitive_data'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_encrypt_decrypt( ).

    " Encrypt
    DATA(lv_encrypted_xml_xstr) = lo_cut->encrypt_xml_element(
                                      iv_xml_data = lv_original_xml_xstr
                                      iv_xpath    = lv_xpath_to_encrypt ).

    " Decrypt
    DATA(lv_decrypted_xml_xstr) = lo_cut->decrypt_xml_element( lv_encrypted_xml_xstr ).
    DATA(lv_decrypted_xml_str) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_decrypted_xml_xstr CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).

    " Assert that the decrypted XML contains the original sensitive data
    " Note: Due to the complexity of key management in unit tests,
    "       a direct comparison of the full XML might be difficult.
    "       We'll check for the presence of the original sensitive data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
        act = lv_decrypted_xml_str
        exp = 'This is secret information.'
        msg = 'Decrypted XML should contain the original sensitive data.' ).

    " Also assert that the encrypted XML does NOT contain the sensitive data in plain text
    DATA(lv_encrypted_xml_str) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_encrypted_xml_xstr CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains(
        act = lv_encrypted_xml_str
        exp = 'This is secret information.'
        msg = 'Encrypted XML should not contain the original sensitive data in plain text.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `cl_secxml_helper` Klasse ermöglicht die Verschlüsselung und Entschlüsselung von XML-Elementen. Mit `create_encryptor` und `encrypt_element` kann ein spezifischer Teil des XML-Dokuments verschlüsselt werden. `create_decryptor` und `decrypt_document` kehren diesen Vorgang um. Die tatsächliche Schlüsselverwaltung ist in einem Produktivsystem komplexer und würde über dieses Beispiel hinausgehen.
keywords: XML, Encryption, Decryption, Security, cl_secxml_helper, XPath

Instructions: Kanonisieren Sie ein XML-Dokument, um eine konsistente Darstellung für Signaturzwecke zu gewährleisten. Dies ist wichtig, da geringfügige Änderungen (z.B. Leerzeichen) die Signatur ungültig machen könnten.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Kanonisierungsfunktionen von `cl_secxml_helper`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_canonicalize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS canonicalize_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_canonical_xml) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_canonicalize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD canonicalize_xml.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_document,
          lo_canonicalizer TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_canonicalizer.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_secxml_document=>create_from_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

        " Create canonicalizer (e.g., C14N without comments)
        lo_canonicalizer = cl_secxml_helper=>create_canonicalizer(
                               i_xml_document = lo_xml_document
                               i_canonicalization_method = cl_secxml_helper=>co_c14n_1_0_no_comments ).

        lo_canonicalizer->canonicalize_document( ).
        rv_canonical_xml = lo_xml_document->get_xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        " Handle error
        rv_canonical_xml = iv_xml_data. " Return original on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_canonicalize_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_canonicalize_xml.
    DATA(lv_xml_with_whitespace_str) =
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
        <root>
          <item>  Value 1  </item>
          <item   attr="test">Value 2</item>
        </root>'.
    DATA(lv_xml_with_whitespace_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_xml_with_whitespace_str CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).

    DATA(lv_xml_clean_str) =
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><root><item>  Value 1  </item><item attr="test">Value 2</item></root>'.
    DATA(lv_xml_clean_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_xml_clean_str CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_canonicalize( ).
    DATA(lv_canonical_xml_xstr) = lo_cut->canonicalize_xml( lv_xml_with_whitespace_xstr ).
    DATA(lv_canonical_xml_str) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_canonical_xml_xstr CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).

    " Note: C14N without comments removes whitespace *between* elements, but not within text nodes or attributes.
    " The exact output depends on the C14N algorithm and XML content.
    " For this simple test, we expect a specific canonical form.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lv_canonical_xml_str
        exp = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><root><item>  Value 1  </item><item attr="test">Value 2</item></root>'
        msg = 'XML should be canonicalized correctly.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kanonisierung von XML-Dokumenten ist ein wichtiger Schritt in der XML-Sicherheit, um eine eindeutige Darstellung des Dokuments zu gewährleisten, unabhängig von Formatierungsdetails wie Leerzeichen oder Attributreihenfolge. `cl_secxml_helper=>create_canonicalizer` ermöglicht die Anwendung verschiedener Kanonisierungsalgorithmen.
keywords: XML, Canonicalization, Security, cl_secxml_helper, C14N

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie eine digitale Signatur für ein XML-Dokument unter Verwendung von `cl_secxml_helper`. Das Beispiel soll ein einfaches XML-Dokument signieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie Methoden wie `create_signature_generator` und `sign_document`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_generate_signature DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_xml_signature
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_signed_xml) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_generate_signature IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_xml_signature.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_document,
          lo_generator    TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_signature_generator.

    TRY.
        lo_xml_document = cl_secxml_document=>create_from_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

        " For a real scenario, you'd need a proper key/certificate setup.
        " This is a simplified example using dummy data.
        lo_generator = cl_secxml_helper=>create_signature_generator(
                            i_xml_document = lo_xml_document
                            i_signature_method = cl_secxml_helper=>co_sig_rsa_sha1
                            i_canonicalization_method = cl_secxml_helper=>co_c14n_1_0_no_comments
                            i_digest_method = cl_secxml_helper=>co_dig_sha1 ).

        " Add a reference to the entire document
        lo_generator->add_reference( i_uri = '' ).

        " Sign the document (requires a key, which is complex to simulate here)
        " In a real system, you would pass a key object.
        " For this example, we'll just call the method, acknowledging it needs a key.
        lo_generator->sign_document( ). " Requires a key to be set up in a real system

        rv_signed_xml = lo_xml_document->get_xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        " Handle error
        rv_signed_xml = iv_xml_data. " Return original on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_xml_signature FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_xml_signature.
    DATA(lv_original_xml_str) =
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
        <data>
          <item id="1">Value 1</item>
          <item id="2">Value 2</item>
        </data>'.
    DATA(lv_original_xml_xstr) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_original_xml_str CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_generate_signature( ).
    DATA(lv_signed_xml_xstr) = lo_cut->generate_xml_signature( lv_original_xml_xstr ).
    DATA(lv_signed_xml_str) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_signed_xml_xstr CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ).

    " Assert that the signed XML contains a <Signature> element.
    " A full verification would require a valid key and certificate setup.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
        act = lv_signed_xml_str
        exp = '<Signature xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#">'
        msg = 'Signed XML should contain a Signature element.' ).

    " Assert that the signed XML is different from the original (due to signature addition)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
        act = lv_signed_xml_xstr
        exp = lv_original_xml_xstr
        msg = 'Signed XML should be different from original XML.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_secxml_helper` ermöglicht die Erzeugung digitaler Signaturen für XML-Dokumente. `create_signature_generator` konfiguriert den Signaturprozess (Signaturmethode, Kanonisierung, Digest-Methode). Das Hinzufügen von Referenzen (`add_reference`) und das eigentliche Signieren (`sign_document`) sind die Kernschritte. Die Verwaltung der privaten Schlüssel für die Signatur ist in einem realen System komplex und wird hier vereinfacht dargestellt.
keywords: XML, Security, Digital Signature, cl_secxml_helper, Signature Generation

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von XML-Dokumentpfaden (gespeichert in einer internen Tabelle) und überprüfen Sie die Signatur jedes Dokuments. Sammeln Sie die Ergebnisse (Dateiname und Signaturstatus) in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Iterieren Sie mit `FOR...IN...` über die Pfade und verwenden Sie `cl_secxml_helper` für die Signaturprüfung. Nutzen Sie `COND` für den Status.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_batch_verify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_signature_result,
             file_path TYPE string,
             is_valid  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_signature_result.
    TYPES tt_signature_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_signature_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS verify_multiple_xml_signatures
      IMPORTING
        it_xml_paths TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_signature_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_batch_verify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_multiple_xml_signatures.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_document,
          lo_verifier     TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_signature_verifier.

    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR path IN it_xml_paths
                            LET lv_is_valid = COND abap_bool(
                                TRY.
                                    " Simulate reading XML from path (not possible in pure ABAP unit test)
                                    " For demo, we'll use a dummy XML. In real scenario, read file content.
                                    lo_xml_document = cl_secxml_document=>create_from_xstring(
                                        cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                                            '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><data><item>Test</item></data>'
                                            CODEPAGE = 'UTF-8' ) ).
                                    lo_verifier = cl_secxml_helper=>create_signature_verifier( lo_xml_document ).
                                    WHEN lo_verifier->verify_signature( ) THEN abap_true
                                    ELSE abap_false
                                  CATCH cx_secxml_error THEN abap_false ) IN
                            ( file_path = path, is_valid = lv_is_valid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_verify_multiple_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_verify_multiple_xml.
    DATA: lt_xml_paths TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    APPEND '/tmp/doc1.xml' TO lt_xml_paths.
    APPEND '/tmp/doc2.xml' TO lt_xml_paths.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_batch_verify( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->verify_multiple_xml_signatures( lt_xml_paths ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-file_path exp = '/tmp/doc1.xml' ).
    " Due to dummy XML, both will likely be false unless a valid signature is simulated.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-is_valid exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ]-file_path exp = '/tmp/doc2.xml' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ]-is_valid exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Iteration über eine interne Tabelle mit `FOR...IN...` und die Nutzung der `cl_secxml_helper` Klasse zur Signaturprüfung. Der `LET` Ausdruck und der `COND` Operator ermöglichen es, den Signaturstatus für jedes Dokument kompakt zu ermitteln und direkt in die Ergebnis-Tabelle zu mappen. Die tatsächliche XML-Datei müsste in einem realen Szenario von den angegebenen Pfaden gelesen werden.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, XML, Security, cl_secxml_helper, COND, LET

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Produkt aller Zahlen in einer Liste von Ganzzahlen unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer Multiplikationsoperation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE i(
      INIT product = 1
      FOR number IN iv_numbers
      NEXT product = product * number ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_product( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 24 msg = 'Product of 1,2,3,4 should be 24' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_multiply( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_zero.

    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 0 ) ( 4 ) ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Flugpreise der `sflights`-Tabelle um einen Faktor multipliziert, und verwenden Sie dabei eine Inline-Deklaration und einen `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` und einer Inline-Deklaration für die Zieltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS multiply_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_factor TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_multiplied_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflights`-Daten, um nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 zu erhalten, und multiplizieren Sie dann den Preis dieser gefilterten Flüge mit einem Faktor von 1.2. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und eine Inline-Multiplikation.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_factor TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_multiplied) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_multiply.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_multiplied = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > 500 )
                                     ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                       connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                       fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                       price  = ls_sflight-price * iv_factor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_corr_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle in eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie dabei eine dynamisch erstellte `RANGE`-Tabelle für das Feld `CARRID`. Simulieren Sie die `if_fsbp_const_range` Konstanten für die `RANGE`-Tabelle.
hint: Erstellen Sie die `RANGE`-Tabelle mit `VALUE` und verwenden Sie sie in der `WHERE`-Klausel des `SELECT`-Statements mit `IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_dyn_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,

CLASS zcl_db_dyn_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_dynamic_range.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle nach `CARRID` und `CONNID`. Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe das Produkt der `PRICE`-Werte und die Summe der `SEATSMAX`-Werte. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             price_product TYPE decfloat16,
             seats_sum   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_aggregate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_aggregate.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_price_product) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT product = '1.0'
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT product = product * <fs_flight>-price ).

      DATA(lv_seats_sum) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsmax ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      connid = ls_group_key-connid
                      price_product = lv_price_product
                      seats_sum = lv_seats_sum ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_and_aggregate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_aggregate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_multiply( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_and_aggregate( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).

    " Basic check: ensure grouping happened and values are non-zero for non-empty groups
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_grouped_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_grouped_entry-price_product > 0 ) msg = 'Price product should be positive' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_grouped_entry-seats_sum > 0 ) msg = 'Seats sum should be positive' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in ABAP 7.50+, das die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen direkt im Code ermöglicht. In Kombination mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator können komplexe Aggregationen (wie Produkt und Summe) für jede Gruppe effizient berechnet werden, ohne temporäre Tabellen oder manuelle Schleifen.

Instructions: Multiplizieren Sie zwei Dezimalzahlen und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Nachkommastellen. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Berechnung und Rundung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `decfloat16` für präzise Dezimalberechnungen und die `nmax` Funktion für die Rundung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_decimal_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS multiply_and_round
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE decfloat16
        iv_value2 TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_decimal_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_and_round.
    DATA(lv_raw_result) = iv_value1 * iv_value2.
    rv_result = nmax( val1 = lv_raw_result dec = 2 ). " nmax rounds to specified decimals
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_positive_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_rounding FOR TESTING.
