CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_decimal_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->multiply_and_round( iv_value1 = '10.50' iv_value2 = '2.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '21.00' msg = '10.50 * 2.00 should be 21.00' ).

  METHOD test_negative_numbers.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten und multiplizieren Sie den `PRICE` jedes Eintrags mit einem Faktor, aber nur, wenn der `CARRID` 'LH' ist. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und einem `COND`-Ausdruck für die bedingte Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_cond_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS multiply_lh_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_factor TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_cond_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_lh_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_modified_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                     ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                       connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                       fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                       price  = COND decfloat16(
                                                  WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH' THEN ls_sflight-price * iv_factor
                                                  ELSE ls_sflight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_multiply_lh_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiply_lh_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_cond_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_factor) = '1.5'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->multiply_lh_prices( lv_factor ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).

    DATA lt_original_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_original_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_flight).
      DATA(ls_original_flight) = lt_original_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_result_flight-carrid connid = ls_result_flight-connid fldate = ls_result_flight-fldate ].
      IF ls_result_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_flight-price exp = ls_original_flight-price * lv_factor msg = 'LH price should be multiplied' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_flight-price exp = ls_original_flight-price msg = 'Other prices should remain unchanged' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR`-Ausdrücken mit `VALUE` und `COND` ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Bedingte Logik kann direkt in die Feldzuweisung integriert werden, was den Code kürzer und leichter verständlich macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, COND, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Math, MULTIPLY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `RANGE`-Tabelle für das Feld `FLDATE` der `sflights`-Tabelle, die Flüge in einem bestimmten Datumsbereich (z.B. letztes Quartal) einschließt und Flüge an einem spezifischen Feiertag ausschließt. Simulieren Sie `if_fsbp_const_range` Konstanten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` für die `RANGE`-Tabelle und kombinieren Sie `I` (Include) und `E` (Exclude) Zeichen mit `BT` (Between) und `EQ` (Equal) Optionen für Datumsfelder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             high   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES tt_range_fldate TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_date_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_end_date   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_holiday    TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fldate_range) TYPE tt_range_fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_date_range.
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_include TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_sign_exclude TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'E',
               lc_option_between TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'BT',
               lc_option_equal TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    rt_fldate_range = VALUE #( ( sign = lc_sign_include option = lc_option_between low = iv_start_date high = iv_end_date )
                               ( sign = lc_sign_exclude option = lc_option_equal   low = iv_holiday    high = '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_date_range_content FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_range_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_date_range( ).
    DATA(lv_start) = sy-datum - 90.
    DATA(lv_end) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_holiday) = sy-datum - 30.

    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_date_range( iv_start_date = lv_start iv_end_date = lv_end iv_holiday = lv_holiday ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 2 msg = 'Range table should have 2 entries' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-sign   exp = 'I' msg = 'First entry sign should be I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-option exp = 'BT' msg = 'First entry option should be BT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-low    exp = lv_start msg = 'First entry low should be start date' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-high   exp = lv_end msg = 'First entry high should be end date' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 2 ]-sign   exp = 'E' msg = 'Second entry sign should be E' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 2 ]-option exp = 'EQ' msg = 'Second entry option should be EQ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 2 ]-low    exp = lv_holiday msg = 'Second entry low should be holiday date' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von `RANGE`-Tabellen für Datumsfelder mit dem `VALUE`-Operator ist entscheidend für flexible Selektionsbildschirme und Berichte. Die Kombination von `INCLUDE` und `EXCLUDE` mit Datumsbereichen und spezifischen Daten ermöglicht eine präzise Filterung.
keywords: VALUE, RANGE, Dynamic Programming, Date/Time, Internal Tables, if_fsbp_const_range

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten. Für jeden Eintrag, dessen `CARRID` 'LH' ist, multiplizieren Sie den `PRICE` mit 1.1 und den `SEATSMAX` mit 0.9. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und innerhalb der Schleife `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` für die bedingte Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_corr_cond_mult DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_corr_cond_mult IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                     ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight
                                         MAPPING
                                           price = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' THEN ls_flight-price * '1.1' ELSE ls_flight-price ) 
                                           seatsmax = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' THEN ls_flight-seatsmax * '0.9' ELSE ls_flight-seatsmax ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      DATA(ls_original_flight) = lt_original_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_result_flight-carrid connid = ls_result_flight-connid fldate = ls_result_flight-fldate ].
      IF ls_result_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_flight-price    exp = ls_original_flight-price * '1.1' msg = 'LH price should be multiplied' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR`-Ausdrücken mit `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING` sowie eingebetteten `COND`-Ausdrücken. Es ermöglicht die bedingte Transformation mehrerer Felder einer Struktur innerhalb einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen, hochfunktionalen Anweisung, was den Code extrem kompakt und wartbar macht.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um den Typ eines Feldes in einer Struktur zu ermitteln. Wenn es sich um einen numerischen Typ handelt, multiplizieren Sie seinen Wert mit einem Faktor. Dies demonstriert die dynamische Typanalyse und -manipulation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_DATADESCR` für RTTI und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS multiply_numeric_field
      CHANGING
        cs_data   TYPE ty_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field  TYPE string
        iv_factor TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_numeric_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE any.
    DATA: lo_data_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr,
          lv_type_kind  TYPE c.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lo_data_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lv_field> ).
      lv_type_kind = lo_data_descr->type_kind.

      IF lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat
      OR lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float
      OR lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed
      OR lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int
      OR lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int1
      OR lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int2
      OR lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int8.
        <lv_field> = <lv_field> * iv_factor.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_multiply_decfloat FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiply_integer FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_numeric_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiply_decfloat.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_multiply( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_multiply=>ty_data( id = 1 value = '50.00' text = 'Test' ).
    lo_cut->multiply_numeric_field( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                    IMPORTING iv_field = 'VALUE' iv_factor = '2.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-value exp = '100.00' msg = 'Decfloat value should be multiplied' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiply_integer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_multiply( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_multiply=>ty_data( id = 10 value = '20.00' text = 'Test' ).
    lo_cut->multiply_numeric_field( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                    IMPORTING iv_field = 'ID' iv_factor = '3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-id exp = 30 msg = 'Integer value should be multiplied' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_numeric_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_multiply( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_multiply=>ty_data( id = 1 value = '50.00' text = 'Test' ).
    lo_cut->multiply_numeric_field( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                    IMPORTING iv_field = 'TEXT' iv_factor = '2.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-text exp = 'Test' msg = 'Non-numeric field should not be changed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_multiply( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_multiply=>ty_data( id = 1 value = '50.00' text = 'Test' ).
    lo_cut->multiply_numeric_field( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                    IMPORTING iv_field = 'NONEXISTENT' iv_factor = '2.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-value exp = '50.00' msg = 'No change expected for invalid field' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die Analyse und Manipulation von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit. Hier wird `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` verwendet, um den Typ eines dynamisch angegebenen Feldes zu bestimmen. Wenn es sich um einen numerischen Typ handelt, wird der Wert über ein Feldsymbol multipliziert. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für generische Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, Type Description, Math, MULTIPLY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten. Für jeden Eintrag, dessen `CARRID` 'LH' ist, multiplizieren Sie den `PRICE` mit 1.1. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `REPLACE`.

CLASS zcl_itab_replace_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `RANGE`-Tabelle für das Feld `CARRID` der `sflights`-Tabelle, die alle Fluggesellschaften enthält, die mit 'A' beginnen oder 'L' enthalten. Simulieren Sie die Verwendung von Konstanten wie `if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include` und `if_fsbp_const_range=>option_cp`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Operator, um die `RANGE`-Tabelle mit den entsprechenden `SIGN` und `OPTION` Werten zu füllen, insbesondere `CP` für Mustervergleiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_range_cp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES tt_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_pattern_carrid_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE tt_range_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_range_cp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_pattern_carrid_range.
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_include TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_cp    TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'CP'.

    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( ( sign = lc_sign_include option = lc_option_cp low = 'A*' high = '' )
                               ( sign = lc_sign_include option = lc_option_cp low = '*L*' high = '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_pattern_range_content FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_pattern_range_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_range_cp( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_pattern_carrid_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 2 msg = 'Range table should have 2 entries' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für einen Open SQL-Query, die optional nach `CARRID` und `CONNID` aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` filtert.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und Inline-`IF`-Ausdrücke, um die WHERE-Bedingungen dynamisch hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_flight_where
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_where_clause) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_flight_where.
    DATA(lv_condition_carrid) = COND string(
                                  WHEN iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL THEN |CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }'|
                                  ELSE '' ).
    DATA(lv_condition_connid) = COND string(
                                  WHEN iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL THEN |CONNID = '{ iv_connid }'|
                                  ELSE '' ).

    " Kombiniere die Bedingungen mit AND, wenn beide vorhanden sind
    IF lv_condition_carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_condition_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = |{ lv_condition_carrid } AND { lv_condition_connid }|.
    ELSEIF lv_condition_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = lv_condition_carrid.
    ELSEIF lv_condition_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = lv_condition_connid.
    ELSE.
      rv_where_clause = '1 = 1'. " Keine Bedingung gesetzt
    ENDIF.

    IF rv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = |WHERE { rv_where_clause }|.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_carrids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS join_carrids
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_joined_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_join_carrids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_carrids.
    rv_joined_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string(
                WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_sflight-carrid

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen E-Mail-Betreff, der dynamisch einen Projektnamen und eine Liste von fehlerhaften Modulen enthält. Die Liste der Module soll nur angezeigt werden, wenn Fehler vorliegen.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates mit `COND string` und den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Modulliste zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_subject_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_modules TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_error_subject
      IMPORTING
        iv_project_name TYPE string
        it_error_modules TYPE ty_t_modules OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_subject) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_subject_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_error_subject.
    DATA(lv_module_list) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR module IN it_error_modules
      NEXT s = COND string(
                WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN module
                ELSE |{ s }, { module }| ) ).

    DATA(lv_error_details) = COND string(
      WHEN lv_module_list IS NOT INITIAL THEN | (Module: { lv_module_list })|
      ELSE '' ).

    rv_subject = |[Projekt: { iv_project_name }] Fehlerbericht{ lv_error_details }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern und transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf Bedingungen mit `FOR` und `CASE`-Ausdrücken.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Iteration mit `WHERE` und einem `CASE`-Ausdruck innerhalb der `VALUE`-Konstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_for_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_classified_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_classified_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_for_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_classified_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_classified_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                     WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                     ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                                       connid   = flight-connid
                                       fldate   = flight-fldate
                                       price    = flight-price
                                       currency = flight-currency
                                       status   = CASE
                                                    WHEN flight-price > 1000 THEN 'Premium'
                                                    WHEN flight-price > 500  THEN 'Business'
                                                    ELSE 'Economy'
                                                  END
                                     ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_classification FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_classification.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_for_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_classified_flights( 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Should not be initial if sflights has data

    " Check some expected classifications (assuming sflights has diverse prices)
    DATA(lv_premium_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_business_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_economy_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-status = 'Premium'.
        lv_premium_count = lv_premium_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-status = 'Business'.
        lv_business_count = lv_business_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-status = 'Economy'.
        lv_economy_count = lv_economy_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_premium_count > 0 OR lv_business_count > 0 OR lv_economy_count > 0 ).
    " More specific assertions would require knowing the exact sflights data, but this checks basic functionality.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Iteration, `WHERE`-Klausel und `CASE`-Ausdruck innerhalb einer `VALUE`-Konstruktion ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen ABAP-Code. Sie ermöglicht das Filtern und Transformieren von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung, was den Code extrem kompakt, lesbar und effizient macht.
keywords: FOR, CASE, Internal Tables, VALUE, SFLIGHTS, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate von Preisen aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_MATH` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_MATH=>pow`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squared_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_of_squares) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squared_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_sum_of_squares = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT sum = 0
                                          FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                          NEXT sum = sum + cl_abap_math=>pow( base = flight-price exp = 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = cl_abap_math=>pow( base = 100 exp = 2 ) + cl_abap_math=>pow( base = 200 exp = 2 ).
    " In a real scenario, you'd inject this test data into the method or mock the SELECT.
    " For this example, we rely on the general check.
  ENDMETHOD.

INTERFACE zif_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC.

  ENDMETHOD.

    ro_processor = SWITCH #( iv_type
                             WHEN 'A' THEN NEW zcl_processor_a( )
                             WHEN 'B' THEN NEW zcl_processor_b( )
                             ELSE THROW cx_sy_create_object_error( textid = cx_sy_create_object_error=>cx_sy_create_object_error ) ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).

CLASS zcl_sum_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugverbindungen, basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft und der Flugnummer.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS delete_adj_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adj_duplicates.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights.
    SORT rt_sflights BY carrid connid. " Important for ADJACENT DUPLICATES

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_adj_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_adj_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight       TYPE sflight.

    " Create test data with adjacent duplicates
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights. " Duplicate
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0401'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0401'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights. " Duplicate
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights. " Not adjacent

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_adj_duplicates( lt_test_flights ).

    " Expected result: 3 unique entries (LH 0400, LH 0401, AA 0017)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    " Verify content (after sorting, the order changes)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Anweisung, um redundante, direkt aufeinanderfolgende Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Feldern zu sortieren, damit alle Duplikate nebeneinander liegen.

CLASS zcl_delete_db_entries DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DELETE FROM sflight

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_old_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_old_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_db_entries( ).
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'AA',
          lv_connid TYPE sflight-connid VALUE '0017',
          lv_date   TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '20200101'.

    " Prepare test data: Insert some entries that will be deleted
    DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = lv_carrid.
    ls_sflight-connid = lv_connid.
    ls_sflight-fldate = '20191231'. " This should be deleted
    ls_sflight-price = '100'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'EUR'.
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight.

    ls_sflight-fldate = '20200102'. " This should NOT be deleted
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight.

    " Count initial entries to verify deletion
    DATA(lv_initial_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_initial_count
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate < lv_date.

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_old_flights(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_date   = lv_date
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = lv_initial_count ).

    " Verify that the entry with fldate < iv_date is gone
    DATA(lv_remaining_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_remaining_count
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate < lv_date.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining_count exp = 0 ).

    " Clean up: Delete all test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe und die Anzahl zu ermitteln, und berechnen Sie dann den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
           count TYPE i = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price,
           count = count + 1 ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_aggregation-sum / ls_aggregation-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_expected_avg_lh) = 0.
    SELECT AVG( price ) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_avg_lh WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price_lh exp = lv_expected_avg_lh ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Standardabweichung der Flugpreise für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und mathematische Funktionen für die Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_std_dev DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_std_dev_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_std_dev) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_std_dev IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_std_dev_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) < 2. " Standard deviation requires at least 2 data points
      rv_std_dev = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE f = 0
           count TYPE i = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price,
           count = count + 1 ).

    DATA(lv_mean) = ls_aggregation-sum_price / ls_aggregation-count.

    DATA(lv_sum_of_squares) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_sq TYPE f = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_sq = sum_sq + ( ( ls_flight-price - lv_mean ) ** 2 ) ).

    rv_std_dev = sqrt( lv_sum_of_squares / ( ls_aggregation-count - 1 ) ). " Sample standard deviation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_std_dev_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_std_dev_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_std_dev( ).

    " Prepare test data for 'LH' (assuming some prices exist)
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight, ls_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-price = 100. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-price = 120. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-price = 140. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lv_std_dev_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_std_dev_price( 'LH' ).

    " Expected standard deviation for [100, 120, 140] is approx 20.0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_std_dev_lh exp = 20.000000000000000E+000 delta = '0.000001' ).

    " Test case: Non-existing carrier
    DATA(lv_std_dev_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_std_dev_price( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_std_dev_xx exp = 0 ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND price IN (100, 120, 140).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung der Standardabweichung demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von `REDUCE` für mehrstufige Aggregationen und die Verwendung von mathematischen Operatoren (`**` für Potenz, `sqrt()` für Quadratwurzel) in modernen ABAP-Ausdrücken. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Berechnungen direkt im Code, ohne auf externe Funktionen zurückgreifen zu müssen.
keywords: NUMBER, Math, Statistics, Standard Deviation, REDUCE, SQRT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) und filtern Sie diese nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen. Wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden, lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` und `COND` für die Tabellenerstellung und `RAISE EXCEPTION` bei leeren Ergebnissen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.

    CLASS zcx_no_flights_found DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_no_flights_found IMPLEMENTATION.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc < iv_min_seats )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_no_flights_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flights = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie eine Liste von Flugnummern auf Gültigkeit, indem Sie prüfen, ob sie in der `sflights`-Tabelle existieren. Wenn eine ungültige Flugnummer gefunden wird, lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit `IN` und `LINE_EXISTS` für die Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_numbers TYPE string_table.

    CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_number DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_flight_number TYPE string READ-ONLY.
        METHODS constructor
          IMPORTING
            textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
            previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
            iv_flight_number TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_number IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CALL METHOD super->constructor
          EXPORTING
            textid   = textid
            previous = previous.
        mv_flight_number = iv_flight_number.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_numbers.
    DATA(lv_invalid_flight) = ''.
    LOOP AT it_flight_numbers INTO DATA(lv_flight_num).
      IF NOT line_exists( sflights[ fltno = lv_flight_num ] ).
        lv_invalid_flight = lv_flight_num.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_number
          EXPORTING
            iv_flight_number = lv_invalid_flight.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus der `sflights`-Tabelle. Wenn keine Flüge für die Fluggesellschaft gefunden werden, lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE s_seatsocc.

    CLASS zcx_no_flights_for_carrier DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_no_flights_for_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lt_flights_for_carrier) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    IF lines( lt_flights_for_carrier ) IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_for_carrier
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_no_flights_for_carrier=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE s_seatsocc(
      INIT sum_seats = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights_for_carrier
      NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Annulliert') basierend auf einem Statuscode. Verwenden Sie eine `SWITCH`-Anweisung und lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus, wenn ein unbekannter Statuscode übergeben wird.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

    CLASS zcx_unknown_status_code DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_status_code TYPE char1 READ-ONLY.
        METHODS constructor
          IMPORTING
            textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
            previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
            iv_status_code TYPE char1 OPTIONAL.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_unknown_status_code IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CALL METHOD super->constructor
          EXPORTING
            textid   = textid
            previous = previous.
        mv_status_code = iv_status_code.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_status_code
      WHEN 'A' THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN 'B' THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN 'C' THEN 'Annulliert'
      ELSE THROW zcx_unknown_status_code( iv_status_code = iv_status_code )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob ein gegebener Wert in den zulässigen Werten einer bestimmten DDIC-Domäne enthalten ist. Lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus, wenn die Domäne nicht existiert oder der Wert ungültig ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_reca_ddic_doma` zur Abfrage der Domänenwerte und eine Klasse für Ausnahmen.

CLASS zcl_domain_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_domain_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        iv_value TYPE string.

    CLASS zcx_domain_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_message TYPE string READ-ONLY.
        METHODS constructor
          IMPORTING
            textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
            previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
            iv_message TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_domain_error IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CALL METHOD super->constructor
          EXPORTING
            textid   = textid
            previous = previous.
        mv_message = iv_message.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_domain_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_domain_value.
    DATA: lt_domain_values TYPE cl_reca_ddic_doma=>ty_t_dd07v.

    TRY.
        cl_reca_ddic_doma=>get_domain_values(
          EXPORTING
            iv_domname = iv_domain_name
          IMPORTING
            et_dd07v   = lt_domain_values
        ).

        IF lt_domain_values IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_domain_error
            EXPORTING
              iv_message = |Domäne '{ iv_domain_name }' existiert nicht oder hat keine Werte.|.
        ENDIF.

        IF NOT line_exists( lt_domain_values[ domvalue_l = iv_value ] ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_domain_error
            EXPORTING
              iv_message = |Wert '{ iv_value }' ist für Domäne '{ iv_domain_name }' ungültig.|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_reca_ddic_error INTO DATA(lx_ddic_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_domain_error
          EXPORTING
            iv_message = |Fehler beim Zugriff auf Domäne '{ iv_domain_name }': { lx_ddic_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rental_contract_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_contract_data,
             contract_id TYPE string,
             start_date  TYPE d,
             end_date    TYPE d,
           END OF ty_contract_data.

    METHODS validate_contract_dates
      IMPORTING
        is_contract TYPE ty_contract_data.

    CLASS zcx_contract_date_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_contract_id TYPE string READ-ONLY.
        DATA mv_error_message TYPE string READ-ONLY.
        METHODS constructor
          IMPORTING
            textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
            previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
            iv_contract_id TYPE string OPTIONAL
            iv_error_message TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_contract_date_error IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CALL METHOD super->constructor
          EXPORTING
            textid   = textid
            previous = previous.
        me->mv_contract_id = iv_contract_id.
        me->mv_error_message = iv_error_message.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rental_contract_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_contract_dates.
    IF is_contract-end_date < is_contract-start_date.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_contract_date_error

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Einträge in eine interne Tabelle ein, die aus einer anderen Tabelle stammen, aber nur, wenn sie bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen und noch nicht vorhanden sind. Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `COND` und `EXCEPT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `EXCEPT` für die effiziente Tabellenmanipulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_merger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS merge_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_existing_flights TYPE sflight_tab
        it_new_flights TYPE sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_merged_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.

    CLASS zcx_merge_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_merge_error IMPLEMENTATION.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_merger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_flights.
    rt_merged_flights = VALUE sflight_tab(
      BASE it_existing_flights
      FOR ls_new_flight IN it_new_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' AND seatsocc < 100 ) " Beispielkriterium für neue Flüge
      ( COND #( WHEN NOT line_exists( it_existing_flights[ carrid = ls_new_flight-carrid
                                                          connid = ls_new_flight-connid
                                                          fldate = ls_new_flight-fldate ] )
                 THEN ls_new_flight
                 ELSE THROW zcx_merge_error( ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_merge_new_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_merge_duplicate_flights_raises_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_merge_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_new_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_merger( ).
    DATA(lt_existing) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 50 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_new) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 60 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 70 ) " Wird nicht hinzugefügt wegen Kriterium
    ).
    DATA(lt_merged) = lo_cut->merge_flights( it_existing_flights = lt_existing it_new_flights = lt_new ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_merged ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_merged[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_merge_duplicate_flights_raises_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_merger( ).
    DATA(lt_existing) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 50 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_new) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 50 ) " Duplikat
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->merge_flights( it_existing_flights = lt_existing it_new_flights = lt_new ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_merge_error for duplicate entry' ).
      CATCH zcx_merge_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception zcx_merge_error caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `VALUE` Operator mit `BASE` zur Initialisierung einer internen Tabelle mit bestehenden Daten. Die `FOR` Schleife iteriert über neue Flüge. Die `WHERE` Klausel filtert die neuen Flüge nach bestimmten Kriterien. Innerhalb der Schleife wird mit `COND` und `LINE_EXISTS` geprüft, ob ein Flug bereits existiert. Wenn ein Duplikat gefunden wird, wird eine Ausnahme mit `THROW` ausgelöst, was eine sehr moderne und kompakte Art der Tabellenmanipulation und Fehlerbehandlung darstellt.
keywords: VALUE, BASE, FOR, COND, LINE_EXISTS, THROW, Internal Tables, Merge, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces zurückgibt. Lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus, wenn der Typ unbekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein Interface, mehrere Implementierungsklassen und eine Factory-Methode mit `NEW` und `THROW`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_processor PUBLIC.
  METHODS process_flight
    IMPORTING
      is_flight TYPE sflight
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_economy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_economy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_processor~process_flight.
    rv_result = |Processing Economy flight { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_business DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_business IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_processor~process_flight.
    rv_result = |Processing Business flight { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_processor
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_class TYPE char1 " E for Economy, B for Business
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_processor) TYPE REF TO zif_flight_processor.

    CLASS zcx_unknown_flight_class DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_unknown_flight_class IMPLEMENTATION.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_processor.
    ro_processor = SWITCH #( iv_flight_class
      WHEN 'E' THEN NEW zcl_flight_processor_economy( )
      WHEN 'B' THEN NEW zcl_flight_processor_business( )
      ELSE THROW zcx_unknown_flight_class( )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Eine Factory-Methode (`get_processor`) gibt basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter unterschiedliche Implementierungen eines Interfaces (`zif_flight_processor`) zurück. Die `SWITCH` Expression in Kombination mit dem `NEW` Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Implementierung der Factory-Logik. Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von Flugpreisen für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der `sflights`-Tabelle. Wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden, lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

    CLASS zcx_no_flights_for_avg DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_no_flights_for_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA(lt_flights_for_carrier) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    IF lines( lt_flights_for_carrier ) IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_for_avg
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_no_flights_for_avg=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                          FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights_for_carrier
                                          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_flights_for_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_for_avg_raises_exception FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_no_flights_for_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_avg( ).
    " Assuming 'AA' has flights with prices in sflights
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = 0 msg = 'Expected average price > 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_for_avg_raises_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_avg( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_average_price( iv_carrid = 'YY' ). " Assuming 'YY' has no flights
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_no_flights_for_avg' ).
      CATCH zcx_no_flights_for_avg.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception zcx_no_flights_for_avg caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `VALUE` Operator zur Filterung der Flüge und den `REDUCE` Operator zur Berechnung der Summe der Flugpreise. Die Anzahl der Flüge wird mit `lines()` ermittelt. Die Division erfolgt direkt. Eine Ausnahme wird ausgelöst, wenn keine Flüge für die angegebene Fluggesellschaft gefunden werden, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden und eine klare Fehlerbehandlung zu ermöglichen.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Average, Internal Tables, RAISE, Exception, sflights

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_pie_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count,
           tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_pie_chart_data
      IMPORTING it_flight_counts TYPE tt_flight_count
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>data_series_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_pie_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_pie_chart_data.
    DATA lv_total_flights TYPE i.
    lv_total_flights = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_count IN it_flight_counts NEXT s = s + ls_count-flight_count ).

    IF lv_total_flights = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA ls_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>data_series.
    LOOP AT it_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_flight_count).
      ls_data_series-name = ls_flight_count-carrid.
      ls_data_series-value = ( ls_flight_count-flight_count * 100 ) / lv_total_flights. " Percentage
      APPEND ls_data_series TO rt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    DATA lt_sflights_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

        cl_fdt_json=>json_deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            iv_json_string = iv_json_string
          IMPORTING

        ).
        rv_error_message = 'Deserialisierung erfolgreich'.

        rv_error_message = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_chart_data
      IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>data_series_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_chart_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_flight_data(
      lt_sflights WHERE price > iv_min_price
    ).

    DATA ls_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>data_series.
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      ls_data_series-name = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }|.
      ls_data_series-value = ls_flight-price.
      APPEND ls_data_series TO rt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        iv_name_field   TYPE string
        iv_value_field  TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>data_series_type
      RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_generic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_chart_data.
    DATA ls_data_series TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>data_series.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_name> TYPE any,
                   <fs_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_name_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_name>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val=>illegal_component
            component = iv_name_field.
      ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_value_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val=>illegal_component
            component = iv_value_field.
      ENDIF.

      ls_data_series-name = <fs_name>.
      ls_data_series-value = <fs_value>.
      APPEND ls_data_series TO rt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template Method Pattern. Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse mit einer Template-Methode, die einen Algorithmus definiert, aber einige Schritte als abstrakte Methoden delegiert. Konkrete Unterklassen sollen diese abstrakten Schritte implementieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHODS` für die variablen Schritte des Algorithmus.
solution:
" Abstract Base Class for Report Generation
CLASS zcl_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report FINAL. " Template Method
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table,
      format_header ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_header) TYPE string,
      format_line ABSTRACT IMPORTING is_data TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_line) TYPE string,
      output_report ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_report_lines TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report.
    DATA: lt_raw_data     TYPE string_table,
          lt_report_lines TYPE string_table.

    " Step 1: Get Data (abstract)
    lt_raw_data = get_data( ).

    " Step 2: Format Header (abstract)
    APPEND format_header( ) TO lt_report_lines.

    " Step 3: Format Data Lines (abstract)
    LOOP AT lt_raw_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      APPEND format_line( ls_data ) TO lt_report_lines.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Step 4: Output Report (abstract)
    output_report( lt_report_lines ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Concrete Report Generator for Console Output
CLASS zcl_console_report_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_report_generator.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_data REDEFINITION,
      format_header REDEFINITION,
      format_line REDEFINITION,
      output_report REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_report_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    rt_data = VALUE #( ( 'Item 1' ) ( 'Item 2' ) ( 'Item 3' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_header.
    rv_header = '--- Console Report ---'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_line.
    rv_formatted_line = |* { is_data } *|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD output_report.
    LOOP AT it_report_lines INTO DATA(lv_line).
      cl_demo_output=>write_text( lv_line ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_report_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_report_generation.
    DATA(lo_console_report) = NEW zcl_console_report_gen( ).
    " This test primarily checks if the template method runs without dump
    " and if the output methods are called. Actual output verification
    " would require mocking cl_demo_output, which is more complex.
    " For simplicity, we just ensure the process completes.
    lo_console_report->generate_report( ).

    " A more robust test would involve capturing the output,
    " but for this example, we assume successful execution implies
    " the template method and its abstract steps are correctly wired.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Check for no dump
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template Method Pattern wird hier verwendet, um den Skelett-Algorithmus zur Berichterstellung in der abstrakten Klasse `zcl_report_generator` zu definieren. Die variablen Schritte (`get_data`, `format_header`, `format_line`, `output_report`) sind als `ABSTRACT METHODS` deklariert und müssen von konkreten Unterklassen implementiert werden. Dies ermöglicht die Wiederverwendung des Algorithmus, während spezifische Implementierungsdetails flexibel bleiben. `VALUE #(...)` wird für die einfache Initialisierung von internen Tabellen verwendet.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse, die eine Standardimplementierung für eine Methode bereitstellt, aber auch eine abstrakte "Hook"-Methode enthält, die von Unterklassen überschrieben werden kann, um spezifisches Verhalten hinzuzufügen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie eine konkrete Methode mit einer `ABSTRACT METHOD` in der abstrakten Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_process_template DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data FINAL IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      transform_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_raw_data TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_transformed_data) TYPE string,
      log_step DEFAULT. " Hook method with default empty implementation
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    " Standard step 1
    DATA(lv_intermediate) = |Processing: { iv_input }|.
    log_step( ). " Call hook

    " Abstract step 2
    rv_output = transform_data( lv_intermediate ).
    log_step( ). " Call hook
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_step.
    " Default empty implementation - subclasses can override
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_process_template.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      transform_data REDEFINITION,
      log_step REDEFINITION. " Override hook
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data.
    rv_transformed_data = |Transformed: { iv_raw_data }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_step.
    " Specific logging for this concrete processor
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( 'Logging from concrete processor...' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_concrete_processor FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_concrete_processor.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_concrete_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result)    = lo_processor->process_data( 'Initial Data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Transformed: Processing: Initial Data' ).
    " The log_step method's output is to cl_demo_output, which is hard to test directly.
    " The main assertion is on the data transformation.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese abstrakte Klasse `zcl_process_template` bietet eine `FINAL` Template-Methode `process_data`, die einen festen Ablauf definiert. Sie delegiert einen Teil des Verhaltens an die `ABSTRACT METHOD transform_data`, die von Unterklassen implementiert werden muss. Zusätzlich gibt es eine `DEFAULT` Methode `log_step`, die als Hook dient und eine leere Standardimplementierung hat. Unterklassen können diese Hook-Methode überschreiben, um spezifische Aktionen (z.B. Logging) an bestimmten Punkten des Algorithmus auszuführen, ohne den Kernalgorithmus zu ändern.

Obwohl `COMPUTE` eine ältere Syntax ist, wird sie hier in Kombination mit der modernen Inline-Datendeklaration (`DATA(...)`) verwendet, um den Code kompakter zu gestalten. In vielen Fällen können solche Berechnungen in modernen ABAP-Versionen auch direkt in Ausdrücken ohne explizites `COMPUTE` erfolgen, z.B. `rv_average = ( iv_num1 + iv_num2 + iv_num3 ) / 3.`. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie eine moderne `FOR`-Schleife und die `COMPUTE`-Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN` für die Schleife und `COMPUTE` für die Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_of_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
                                         RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_of_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lv_current_sum) = 0.
    FOR number IN it_numbers.
      DATA(lv_square) = 0.

CLASS zcl_flight_revenue_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_revenue
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_currency TYPE sycurr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_revenue_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_revenue.
    DATA: lv_converted_price TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
          lv_total_sum     TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_total_revenue = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
                                 FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                 LET lv_converted_price = 0 IN
                                 CALCULATE lv_converted_price = flight-price
                                           CURRENCY flight-currency
                                           TARGET CURRENCY iv_target_currency
                                           EXCHANGE RATE TYPE 'M'
                                           DATE sy-datum
                                 IN
                                 NEXT sum = sum + lv_converted_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_prices.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                             LET lv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
                                                             FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                             NEXT sum = sum + member-price )
                                 lv_count = lines( GROUP flight ) IN
                             ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                               avg_price = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN ( CALCULATE lv_total_price / lv_count ) ELSE 0 ) ) ).

    " SCET: Die Ergebnisse könnten in einem ALV-Grid angezeigt werden.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_commission_calc IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine 'CALCULATE'-Operation durch, die potenziell zu einem Überlauf oder einer Division durch Null führen kann. Implementieren Sie eine moderne Fehlerbehandlung, um solche Situationen abzufangen und eine aussagekräftige Fehlermeldung zu generieren.

CLASS zcl_calc_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_safe_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS get_error_message
      IMPORTING
        io_exception TYPE REF TO cx_sy_arithmetic_error
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_safe_calculation.
    TRY.
        CALCULATE rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sy_arithmetic_error(
          textid = lx_arith_error->textid
          previous = lx_arith_error
        ).
    ENDTRY.
    " SCET: Fehler könnten hier protokolliert oder in einem Tool angezeigt werden.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_error_message.
    rv_message = io_exception->get_text( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_of_squares_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid

        VALUE(rv_sum_of_squares) TYPE p LENGTH 31 DECIMALS 2.

CLASS zcl_sum_of_squares_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_sum_of_squares = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 31 DECIMALS 2
                                 FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                                 LET lv_squared_price = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 31 DECIMALS 2 IN
                                 CALCULATE lv_squared_price = flight-price ** 2
                                 IN
                                 NEXT sum = sum + lv_squared_price ).

    " SCET: Diese Art von Berechnung könnte Teil einer statistischen Analyse sein.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `CALCULATE` in Kombination mit String-Operationen, um einen Wert aus einem formatierten String zu extrahieren, zu berechnen und das Ergebnis wieder in einem String zu formatieren. Stellen Sie sich vor, dies ist Teil einer 'SCET'-Ausgabe.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND` oder `REGEX` zum Extrahieren und String-Templates zum Formatieren. `CALCULATE` für die eigentliche Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_string_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_calculate
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_string_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_calculate.
    DATA(lv_value_str) = ''.
    DATA(lv_factor_str) = ''.
    DATA(lv_value) = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
    DATA(lv_factor) = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
    DATA(lv_result) = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.

    " Example: Extract 'Value: 123.45' and 'Factor: 2.0'
    FIND REGEX 'Value: (\d+\.\d+)' IN iv_input_string SUBMATCHES lv_value_str.
    FIND REGEX 'Factor: (\d+\.\d+)' IN iv_input_string SUBMATCHES lv_factor_str.

    IF lv_value_str IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_factor_str IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          lv_value = lv_value_str.
          lv_factor = lv_factor_str.
          CALCULATE lv_result = lv_value * lv_factor.
          rv_output_string = |SCET: Berechnet: { lv_value } * { lv_factor } = { lv_result }|.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
          rv_output_string = |SCET: Fehler bei der Konvertierung oder Berechnung.|.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_output_string = |SCET: Werte konnten nicht extrahiert werden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dock_scet_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_calculation_tree.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_alv_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_tree.
    DATA mt_outtab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF lvc_s_out.
    DATA mt_node_info TYPE lvc_t_nkey.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dock_scet_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_calculation_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid = sy-repid
        dynnr = sy-dynnr
        side  = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        ratio = 40.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_tree
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_docking_container
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'. " Dummy structure for ALV tree

    DATA(lv_root_node_key) = 'ROOT'.
    mo_alv_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = ''
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_alv_tree=>relat_root
      i_node_text      = 'SCET: Berechnungsübersicht'
      i_node_key       = lv_root_node_key
    ).

    DATA(lv_calc_node_key) = 'CALC_001'.
    mo_alv_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = lv_root_node_key
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_alv_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'CALCULATE: Flugpreisberechnung'
      i_node_key       = lv_calc_node_key
    ).

    DATA(lv_price) = 500.
    DATA(lv_tax_rate) = '0.10'.
    DATA(lv_final_price) = 0.
    CALCULATE lv_final_price = lv_price * ( 1 + lv_tax_rate ).

    mo_alv_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = lv_calc_node_key
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_alv_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = |Basispreis: { lv_price }|
      i_node_key       = 'PARAM_PRICE'
    ).
    mo_alv_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = lv_calc_node_key
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_alv_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = |Steuersatz: { lv_tax_rate }|
      i_node_key       = 'PARAM_TAX'
    ).
    mo_alv_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = lv_calc_node_key
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_alv_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = |Ergebnis (inkl. Steuer): { lv_final_price }|
      i_node_key       = 'RESULT_FINAL'
    ).

    mo_alv_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = mt_outtab
    ).

    mo_alv_tree->expand_node( lv_root_node_key ).
    mo_alv_tree->expand_node( lv_calc_node_key ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Standardabweichung der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights`. Nutzen Sie `CALCULATE` für die mathematischen Operationen und moderne ABAP-Features für die Datenaggregation.
hint: Berechnen Sie zuerst den Durchschnitt, dann die Summe der quadrierten Abweichungen vom Durchschnitt, und schließlich die Standardabweichung. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `CALCULATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_std_dev_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_std_deviation
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_std_dev) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_std_dev_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_std_deviation.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_filtered_flights ).

    IF lv_count = 0.
      rv_std_dev = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum_prices) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
                                   FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                   NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).

    DATA(lv_average_price) = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
    CALCULATE lv_average_price = lv_sum_prices / lv_count.

    DATA(lv_sum_squared_diffs) = REDUCE #( INIT sum_diff = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
                                          FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                          LET lv_diff = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2 IN
                                          CALCULATE lv_diff = flight-price - lv_average_price
                                          IN
                                          NEXT sum_diff = sum_diff + ( CALCULATE lv_diff ** 2 ) ).

    DATA(lv_variance) = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
    CALCULATE lv_variance = lv_sum_squared_diffs / lv_count.

    CALCULATE rv_std_dev = SQRT( lv_variance ).

    " SCET: Statistische Auswertungen wie diese sind typisch für Analysetools.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_std_deviation FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_std_deviation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_std_dev_calc( ).

    " Add some test data to sflights (prices: 100, 200, 300 for LH)
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'EUR' ).
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum price = 300 currency = 'EUR' ).

    DATA(lv_std_dev_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_std_deviation( 'LH' ).
    " Expected: Avg = 200. Diffs: -100, 0, 100. Squared diffs: 10000, 0, 10000. Sum = 20000. Variance = 20000/3 = 6666.66. Std Dev = SQRT(6666.66) approx 81.65
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_std_dev_lh exp = '81.65' msg = 'Standard deviation for LH incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_std_dev_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_std_deviation( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_std_dev_empty exp = 0 msg = 'Standard deviation for empty set should be 0' ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH'. " Clean up test data
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer simulierten Sprachdatei (z.B. eine Liste von Übersetzungen) zeilenweise in eine interne Tabelle ein. Filtern Sie dabei leere Zeilen heraus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN DATASET` zum Lesen und eine `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE`-Klausel für die Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_language_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS read_and_filter_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_lines) TYPE tt_language_lines.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_filter_language_file.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    DATA: lt_raw_lines TYPE tt_language_lines.

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND lv_line TO lt_raw_lines.
      ENDDO.
      CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
    ENDIF.

    " Modern ABAP: Filter out empty lines using a FOR expression
    rt_filtered_lines = VALUE #( FOR line IN lt_raw_lines WHERE ( line IS NOT INITIAL ) ( line ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    OPEN DATASET mv_test_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.

Instructions: Speichern Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Sprachschlüsseln und Texten als JSON-Datei.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_json_serializer` und `OPEN DATASET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_json_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_translation_entry,
             key  TYPE string,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ts_translation_entry.
    TYPES: tt_translation_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_translation_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS write_translations_to_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        it_translations TYPE tt_translation_entries
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_io_error
        cx_abap_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_json_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_translations_to_json.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize( data = it_translations pretty_print = abap_true ).

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING UTF-8.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim Öffnen der Datei { iv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.

    TRANSFER lv_json_string TO iv_file_path.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim Schreiben in die Datei { iv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
