Instructions: Versuchen Sie, eine Sprachdatei zu lesen. Fangen Sie mögliche Dateifehler ab und geben Sie eine spezifische Fehlermeldung basierend auf dem `sy-subrc` zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für Ausnahmen und `SWITCH` für `sy-subrc`-Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_robust_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_language_file_robustly
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_language_file_robustly.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_full_content TYPE string.

    TRY.
        OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          " Use SWITCH for sy-subrc based error messages
          DATA(lv_error_msg) = SWITCH string( sy-subrc
            WHEN 4 THEN |Datei { iv_file_path } nicht gefunden.|
            WHEN 8 THEN |Keine Berechtigung für Datei { iv_file_path }.|
            WHEN OTHERS THEN |Unbekannter Fehler beim Öffnen von { iv_file_path } (SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }).|
          ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io_error
            EXPORTING
              text = lv_error_msg.
        ENDIF.

        DO.
          READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          lv_full_content = lv_full_content && lv_line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
        ENDDO.
        CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
        rv_content = lv_full_content.

      CATCH cx_abap_file_io_error INTO DATA(lx_file_error).
        " Re-raise the specific file I/O error
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_file_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Catch any other unexpected errors
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unerwarteter Fehler beim Dateizugriff: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_entry_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_prefixed_entries
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_prefix    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_entry_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_prefixed_entries.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    DATA: lt_raw_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim Öffnen der Datei { iv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_line TO lt_raw_lines.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.

    " Modern ABAP: Use REDUCE to count entries with a specific prefix
    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                             FOR line IN lt_raw_lines
                             WHERE ( line IS NOT INITIAL AND line CS '=' )
                             LET lv_key = substring_before( val = line sep = '=' ) IN
                             NEXT ( COND #( WHEN lv_key CP |{ iv_prefix }*| THEN count + 1 ELSE count ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine simulierte Sprachdatei, die Schlüssel-Wert-Paare enthält. Filtern Sie alle Einträge heraus, deren Schlüssel mit 'MSG_' beginnt und deren Wert eine bestimmte Mindestlänge überschreitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FILTER`-Expression mit einer komplexen Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lang_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_lang_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ts_lang_entry.
    TYPES: tt_lang_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_lang_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_language_entries
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_min_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_entries) TYPE tt_lang_entries
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_filter_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_language_entries.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    DATA: lt_raw_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_all_entries TYPE tt_lang_entries.

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim Öffnen der Datei { iv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_line IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_line CS '='.
        APPEND VALUE ts_lang_entry(
          key = substring_before( val = lv_line sep = '=' )
          value = substring_after( val = lv_line sep = '=' )
        ) TO lt_all_entries.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.

    " Modern ABAP: Use FILTER expression for complex filtering
    rt_filtered_entries = FILTER #( lt_all_entries USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( key CP 'MSG_*' AND
                                            strlen( value ) > iv_min_length ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine simulierte Sprachdatei und extrahieren Sie einen spezifischen Textblock, der zwischen zwei Marker-Zeilen liegt (z.B. `###START_BLOCK###` und `###END_BLOCK###`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` und `substring` oder String-Operationen in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_block_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_block
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_start_marker TYPE string
        iv_end_marker TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_block_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_block_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_block.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_full_content TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_in_block TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim Öffnen der Datei { iv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_in_block = abap_true.
        IF lv_line = iv_end_marker.
          lv_in_block = abap_false.
          EXIT. " Block ended, stop reading
        ELSE.
          rv_block_content = rv_block_content && lv_line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
        ENDIF.
      ELSEIF lv_line = iv_start_marker.
        lv_in_block = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.

    IF lv_in_block = abap_true. " If end marker was not found
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |End-Marker '{ iv_end_marker }' nicht gefunden nach Start-Marker '{ iv_start_marker }'|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_comparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_lang_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ts_lang_entry.
    TYPES: tt_lang_entries TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ts_lang_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS compare_language_files
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path1 TYPE string
        iv_file_path2 TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        et_common_entries TYPE tt_lang_entries
        et_only_in_file1 TYPE tt_lang_entries
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_io_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS read_entries_from_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_entries) TYPE tt_lang_entries
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_comparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_language_files.
    DATA(lt_entries1) = read_entries_from_file( iv_file_path1 ).
    DATA(lt_entries2) = read_entries_from_file( iv_file_path2 ).

    " Modern ABAP: Compare internal tables using INTERSECT and EXCEPT
    et_common_entries = INTERSECT #( lt_entries1 lt_entries2 ).
    et_only_in_file1 = EXCEPT #( lt_entries1 FROM lt_entries2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_entries_from_file.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim Öffnen der Datei { iv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.
    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_line IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_line CS '='.
        APPEND VALUE ts_lang_entry(
          key = substring_before( val = lv_line sep = '=' )
          value = substring_after( val = lv_line sep = '=' )
        ) TO rt_entries.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine simulierte Sprachdatei, die hierarchische Daten in einem einfachen Format enthält (z.B. `SECTION.KEY=VALUE`). Parsen Sie diese Daten in eine geschachtelte interne Tabelle unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit geschachtelten `FOR`-Iteratoren und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hierarchical_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_entry,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ts_entry.
    TYPES: tt_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_section,
             name    TYPE string,
             entries TYPE tt_entries,
           END OF ts_section.
    TYPES: tt_sections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_section WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_hierarchical_lang_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sections) TYPE tt_sections
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_io_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_raw_data,
             section TYPE string,
             key     TYPE string,
             value   TYPE string,
           END OF ts_raw_data.
    TYPES: tt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_raw_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_raw_data) TYPE tt_raw_data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_io_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchical_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_hierarchical_lang_file.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = read_raw_data( iv_file_path ).

    " Modern ABAP: Use VALUE with nested FOR and GROUP BY to build hierarchical structure
    rt_sections = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( section = ls_group-section ) ASCENDING
                           ( name = ls_group-section
                             entries = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN GROUP ls_group
                                                ( key = ls_entry-key value = ls_entry-value ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_raw_data.
    DATA: lv_line TYPE string.
    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_file_io_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim Öffnen der Datei { iv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.
    DO.
      READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO lv_line.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_line IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_line CS '.' AND lv_line CS '='.
        DATA(lv_section_key) = substring_before( val = lv_line sep = '.' ).
        DATA(lv_key_value) = substring_after( val = lv_line sep = '.' ).
        DATA(lv_key) = substring_before( val = lv_key_value sep = '=' ).
        DATA(lv_value) = substring_after( val = lv_key_value sep = '=' ).
        APPEND VALUE ts_raw_data(
          section = lv_section_key
          key     = lv_key
          value   = lv_value
        ) TO rt_raw_data.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen BAPI-Aufruf, der Nachrichten im Format `BAPIRET2` zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` um diese Nachrichten zu sammeln und anzuzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER=>ADD_MESSAGES_FROM_BAPIRET2` und `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER=>GET_MESSAGES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bapi_message_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_bapiret2,
             type       TYPE bapi_mtype,
             id         TYPE bapi_msgid,
             number     TYPE bapi_msgno,
             message    TYPE bapi_msgv1, " Simplified for example
             message_v1 TYPE bapi_msgv1,
             message_v2 TYPE bapi_msgv2,
             message_v3 TYPE bapi_msgv3,
             message_v4 TYPE bapi_msgv4,
           END OF ty_bapiret2.
    TYPES: tt_bapiret2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_bapiret2 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_bapi_messages
      IMPORTING
        it_bapiret2 TYPE tt_bapiret2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_message_helper=>tt_message_text.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bapi_message_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_bapi_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    " Simulate BAPIRET2 conversion to standard BAPIRET2 table
    DATA(lt_bapiret2_std) = VALUE bapiret2_t(
      FOR ls_bapiret2 IN it_bapiret2 (
        type       = ls_bapiret2-type
        id         = ls_bapiret2-id
        number     = ls_bapiret2-number
        message_v1 = ls_bapiret2-message_v1
        message_v2 = ls_bapiret2-message_v2
        message_v3 = ls_bapiret2-message_v3
        message_v4 = ls_bapiret2-message_v4
      )
    ).

    lo_message_helper->add_messages_from_bapiret2(
      EXPORTING
        it_bapiret2 = lt_bapiret2_std
    ).

    rt_messages = lo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen verarbeitet. Wenn eine Zahl negativ ist, soll eine spezifische Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme für negative Zahlen und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_negative_number DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    DATA mv_number TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL
        iv_number TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_negative_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->mv_number = iv_number.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RAISING
        zcx_negative_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF lv_number < 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_negative_number
          EXPORTING
            textid = zcx_negative_number=>default_text
            iv_number = lv_number.
      ENDIF.
      " Further processing of positive numbers...
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_message_to_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS trigger_error_and_raise_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_text TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.

CLASS zcl_message_to_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_error_and_raise_exception.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    " Simulate adding an error message
    lo_message_helper->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        iv_msgty = 'E'
        iv_msgid = '00' " Generic message class
        iv_msgno = '001' " Message: &1
        iv_msgv1 = iv_error_text
    ).

    " Raise exception if any error messages exist
    lo_message_helper->raise_exception_if_error( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_no_exception_for_no_error FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_raise_message_digest_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_to_exception( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->trigger_error_and_raise_exception( 'Simulierter Fehler' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_abap_message_digest was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest INTO DATA(lx_digest).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Exception caught as expected.' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_digest->get_text( ) exp = 'Simulierter Fehler' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_exception_for_no_error.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
    " Add a warning, not an error
    lo_message_helper->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        iv_msgty = 'W'
        iv_msgid = '00'
        iv_msgno = '001'
        iv_msgv1 = 'Simulierte Warnung'
    ).
    " This should not raise an exception
    lo_message_helper->raise_exception_if_error( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected for warnings.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER=>RAISE_EXCEPTION_IF_ERROR` ist eine leistungsstarke Methode, um die Kontrolle des Programmflusses bei aufgetretenen Fehlern zu zentralisieren. Es wandelt gesammelte Fehlermeldungen in eine `CX_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST` Ausnahme um, die dann im `TRY...CATCH` Block behandelt werden kann. Dies fördert eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung und vermeidet die manuelle Prüfung von Nachrichtenlisten.
keywords: cl_message_helper, CX_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST, Exception Handling, Message to Exception

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem gegebenen String. Wenn Ersetzungen stattgefunden haben, geben Sie den modifizierten String zurück, andernfalls den Originalstring. Nutzen Sie `sy-subrc`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_string TYPE string
        iv_old_substring   TYPE string
        iv_new_substring   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_substring.
    rv_result_string = iv_original_string. " Initialize with original
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_substring IN rv_result_string WITH iv_new_substring.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " No replacement occurred, rv_result_string is already original
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine generische Ausnahme ab und extrahieren Sie deren Text. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einer simulierten Ausnahme.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CATCH OTHERS` und die Methode `GET_TEXT` der Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_any_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exception_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_any_exception.
    TRY.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          " Simulate an exception, e.g., division by zero
          DATA(lv_zero) TYPE i VALUE 0.
          DATA(lv_result) TYPE i VALUE 10 / lv_zero.
        ENDIF.
        rv_exception_text = 'No exception occurred.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_exception_text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_catch_generic_exception.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_exception.

Die Methode `GET_TEXT` der `CX_ROOT`-Klasse (und ihrer Unterklassen) ist der Standardweg, um eine menschenlesbare Beschreibung der aufgetretenen Ausnahme zu erhalten. Instructions: Verwenden Sie die `MESSAGE ... INTO ...` Syntax, um eine Nachricht zu erzeugen und deren Details (Typ, ID, Nummer, Variablen) in Strukturfeldern zu erfassen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MESSAGE ID <msgid> TYPE <msgty> NUMBER <msgno> WITH <v1> <v2> <v3> <v4> INTO <structure-field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_capture DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_details,
             msgty TYPE sy-msgty,
             msgid TYPE sy-msgid,
             msgno TYPE sy-msgno,
             msgv1 TYPE sy-msgv,
             msgv2 TYPE sy-msgv,
             msgv3 TYPE sy-msgv,
             msgv4 TYPE sy-msgv,
           END OF ty_message_details.

    METHODS capture_message_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_msgid TYPE sy-msgid
        iv_msgno TYPE sy-msgno
        iv_msgty TYPE sy-msgty
        iv_v1    TYPE sy-msgv OPTIONAL
        iv_v2    TYPE sy-msgv OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_message_details) TYPE ty_message_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_capture IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD capture_message_details.
    MESSAGE ID iv_msgid TYPE iv_msgty NUMBER iv_msgno
      WITH iv_v1 iv_v2 '' '' INTO DATA(lv_message_text).

    rs_message_details = VALUE ty_message_details(
      msgty = sy-msgty
      msgid = sy-msgid
      msgno = sy-msgno
      msgv1 = sy-msgv1
      msgv2 = sy-msgv2
      msgv3 = sy-msgv3
      msgv4 = sy-msgv4
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie einen Funktionsbaustein auf und verwenden Sie einen `SWITCH` Ausdruck, um verschiedene `sy-subrc` Werte zu behandeln und einen entsprechenden Status-String zurückzugeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL FUNCTION` und den `SWITCH` Ausdruck für die `sy-subrc` Auswertung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fm_subrc_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_alpha_conversion
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fm_subrc_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_alpha_conversion.
    DATA: lv_output TYPE string.

    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        input  = iv_input
      IMPORTING
        output = lv_output
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.

    rv_status = SWITCH string(
      sy-subrc
      WHEN 0 THEN |Erfolgreich konvertiert: { lv_output }|
      WHEN 1 THEN |Fehler bei Konvertierung (sy-subrc = 1)|
      ELSE        |Unbekannter Fehler (sy-subrc = { sy-subrc })|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fm_subrc_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->process_alpha_conversion( '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Erfolgreich konvertiert: 0000000123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fm_subrc_handler( ).
    " Simulate an input that might cause an error or unexpected sy-subrc
    " (CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT typically doesn't error for valid input)
    " For demonstration, let's assume a hypothetical scenario where sy-subrc could be 1.
    " In a real scenario, you'd test with input known to cause a specific sy-subrc.
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->process_alpha_conversion( 'INVALID_INPUT' ).
    " The actual sy-subrc for 'INVALID_INPUT' with ALPHA_INPUT is 0, returning 'INVALID_INPUT'
    " To properly test sy-subrc <> 0, a different FM or a mock would be needed.
    " For this example, we'll assert for the success case, as ALPHA_INPUT is robust.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Erfolgreich konvertiert: INVALID_INPUT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH` Ausdruck bietet eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen, um verschiedene Werte von `sy-subrc` nach einem Funktionsbausteinaufruf zu behandeln. In Kombination mit String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglicht dies die einfache Erstellung dynamischer Statusmeldungen.
keywords: sy-subrc, CALL FUNCTION, SWITCH, String Templates, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Operation ausführt, die fehlschlagen kann. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und verwenden Sie `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` um eine Fehlermeldung zu protokollieren, anstatt das Programm abzubrechen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER=>ADD_MESSAGE` im `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_to_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_fail_operation TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_to_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
    rv_success = abap_true.

    TRY.
        IF iv_fail_operation = abap_true.
          " Simulate an exception, e.g., a database error
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        lo_message_helper->add_message(
          EXPORTING
            iv_msgty = 'E'
            iv_msgid = '00'
            iv_msgno = '001' " Message: &1
            iv_msgv1 = lx_root->get_text( )
        ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.

    " Messages can be retrieved later, e.g., for display on UI
    " DATA(lt_messages) = lo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_risky_operation_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_risky_operation_failure_logged FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_risky_operation_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_to_message( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_risky_operation_failure_logged.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_to_message( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).

    " Verify that a message was added to the message helper (indirectly)
    " This requires accessing the message helper instance, which is local to the method.
    " For a robust test, the message helper would need to be passed in or be a class attribute.
    " For this example, we rely on the return value rv_success.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Error message should have been logged (indirectly tested).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch das Abfangen von Ausnahmen mit `TRY...CATCH` und das anschließende Protokollieren der Fehlerdetails über `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` kann die Anwendung robust auf Fehler reagieren, ohne den Programmfluss abrupt zu beenden. Stattdessen werden Fehlermeldungen gesammelt und können später zentral verarbeitet oder dem Benutzer präsentiert werden, was eine bessere User Experience ermöglicht.
keywords: TRY...CATCH, CL_MESSAGE_HELPER, Exception Handling, Message Logging

CLASS zcl_flight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION` Befehl, um eine wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahme auszulösen. Fangen Sie diese ab und setzen Sie die Verarbeitung fort.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Ausnahme mit `RESUMABLE` und nutzen Sie `RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resumable_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check RESUMABLE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resumable_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rv_log = |Start processing value { iv_value }.
|.
    TRY.
        IF iv_value < 0.
          RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resumable_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_resumable_error=>default_text.
        ENDIF.
        rv_log = rv_log && |Value { iv_value } processed successfully.
|.
      CATCH RESUMABLE zcx_resumable_error INTO DATA(lx_resumable).
        rv_log = rv_log && |Caught resumable error: { lx_resumable->get_text( ) }.
|.
        " Continue processing after the error
        rv_log = rv_log && |Continuing processing after error for value { iv_value }.
|.
    ENDTRY.
    rv_log = rv_log && |End processing.
|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_resumable_exception_caught FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_resumable_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_exception_caught.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resumable_process( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->process_data( -10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Caught resumable error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Continuing processing after error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'End processing' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_resumable_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resumable_process( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->process_data( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Value 5 processed successfully' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Caught resumable error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'End processing' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahmen (`RESUMABLE`) ermöglichen es, Fehler zu behandeln, ohne den aktuellen Verarbeitungsblock zu verlassen. Nach dem `CATCH RESUMABLE` Block wird die Ausführung direkt nach der `RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION` Anweisung fortgesetzt. Dies ist nützlich für Fehler, die zwar protokolliert, aber den weiteren Programmablauf nicht verhindern sollen, wie z.B. bei der Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen, wo einzelne fehlerhafte Einträge übersprungen werden können.
keywords: RESUMABLE, RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION, CATCH RESUMABLE, Exception Handling, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` um eine Nachricht mit Platzhaltern zu erstellen und den vollständigen Nachrichtentext zu erhalten.

CLASS zcl_message_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_msgid TYPE sy-msgid
        iv_msgno TYPE sy-msgno
        iv_msgty TYPE sy-msgty
        iv_v1    TYPE sy-msgv OPTIONAL
        iv_v2    TYPE sy-msgv OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_message.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    lo_message_helper->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        iv_msgty = iv_msgty
        iv_msgid = iv_msgid
        iv_msgno = iv_msgno
        iv_msgv1 = iv_v1
        iv_msgv2 = iv_v2
    ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
    IF lines( lt_messages ) > 0.
      rv_message_text = lt_messages[ 1 ].
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_message_with_vars.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine statische Methode, die den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` berechnet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-METHODS` und den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_math DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_math IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für 'LH' und 'AA' in sflights
    DATA(lv_avg_lh) = zcl_flight_math=>calculate_average_price( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_avg_aa) = zcl_flight_math=>calculate_average_price( 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_avg_xx) = zcl_flight_math=>calculate_average_price( 'XX' ). " Nicht existierende Airline

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_avg_lh exp = 0 msg = 'Average price for LH should not be zero' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_avg_aa exp = 0 msg = 'Average price for AA should not be zero' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_xx exp = 0 msg = 'Average price for non-existent carrier should be zero' ).

    " Zusätzlicher Test mit bekannten Werten (falls sflights manipulierbar wäre)
    " Für einen echten Test müsste man Testdaten in sflights einfügen oder mocken.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und kompakten Weise. In Kombination mit `CLASS-METHODS` wird die Berechnung des Durchschnitts in einer wiederverwendbaren und objektorientierten Methode gekapselt.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, REDUCE, Math, sflights, ABAP 7.40, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer statischen Factory-Methode, die Instanzen einer anderen Klasse basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erzeugt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Interfaces.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-METHODS` für die Factory und `NEW` mit dem Interface-Typ.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_shape
      IMPORTING
        iv_shape_type TYPE string
        iv_param      TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_shape) TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_shape.
    CASE iv_shape_type.
      WHEN 'CIRCLE'.
        ro_shape = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = iv_param ).
      WHEN 'SQUARE'.
        ro_shape = NEW zcl_square( iv_side = iv_param ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_create_object_error=>cx_sy_create_object_error.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS transform_flights_to_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights_to_info.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      ( airline_id = ls_flight-carrid,
        flight_num = ls_flight-connid,
        flight_date = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_rtti_inspector=>get_type_name( REF #( lt_table ) ) exp = '\TYPE=ZCL_RTTI_INSPECTOR=>TT_FLIGHTS' msg = 'Table type incorrect' ).

    " Hinweis: Der genaue Name für interne Tabellen kann variieren, je nachdem wie sie deklariert sind.
    " Hier wird der Name der lokalen Typdefinition in der Testklasse verwendet.
    " Für eine generische Tabelle wäre es z.B. \TYPE=STANDARD TABLE OF SFLIGHT.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Die `CLASS-METHOD` `get_type_name` nutzt `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` (ab ABAP 7.40) um ein Typbeschreibungsobjekt zu erhalten, von dem der Typname abgefragt werden kann. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programmierung und Metadaten-Verarbeitung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine statische Methode, die dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zugreift und dessen Wert als String zurückgibt. Der Feldname wird als Parameter übergeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-METHODS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit Field-Symbols.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_field_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            id   TYPE i VALUE 100,
            name TYPE string VALUE 'Test Name',

      is_structure = ls_data

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und Field-Symbols. Dies ist ein Kernstück der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP. Die `CLASS-METHOD` kapselt diese Logik, und die moderne Ausnahmebehandlung mit `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` stellt sicher, dass Fehler bei ungültigen Feldnamen korrekt behandelt werden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine statische Methode, die eine Division durch Null simuliert und diese mit einer modernen Ausnahmebehandlung abfängt. Die Methode soll einen Fehlertext zurückgeben, wenn eine Ausnahme auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-METHODS` und `TRY...CATCH` mit `cx_sy_arithmetic_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_or_error) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result_or_error = |Result: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result_or_error = |Error: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result_or_error = |Unexpected Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division.
    DATA(lv_result) = zcl_error_handler=>divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Result: 5' msg = 'Normal division failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lv_error_result) = zcl_error_handler=>divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( substring = 'Division by zero' act = lv_error_result msg = 'Division by zero error not caught' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Ausnahmebehandlung in ABAP mit `TRY...CATCH` (ab ABAP 7.40). Die `CLASS-METHOD` kapselt die Logik, und spezifische Ausnahmen wie `cx_sy_arithmetic_error` werden abgefangen, um eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung zu gewährleisten. `get_text()` wird verwendet, um den Fehlertext zu erhalten.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Error Handling, TRY...CATCH, cx_sy_arithmetic_error, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine statische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft gruppiert und für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge ermittelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-METHODS` und den `FOR` Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE tt_carrier_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = zcl_flight_grouper=>group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_grouped_flights msg = 'Grouped table should not be empty' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob die Gruppierung korrekt ist (Beispiel für 'LH')
    DATA(ls_lh_group) = VALUE #( lt_grouped_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_lh_group IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'LH flight count should not be zero' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Überprüfen, ob die Summe der Flight Counts der Gesamtanzahl der Flüge entspricht
    DATA(lv_total_flights) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_total_flights.

    DATA(lv_sum_grouped_flights) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR group_entry IN lt_grouped_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + group_entry-flight_count
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_grouped_flights exp = lv_total_flights msg = 'Sum of grouped flights should match total flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF` Operator in Verbindung mit `VALUE` (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne Art, Aggregationen und Gruppierungen durchzuführen, ohne explizite Schleifen und `COLLECT`-Anweisungen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, FOR GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, sflights, ABAP 7.50, Grouping

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung moderner Aggregationssyntax. Demonstrieren Sie eine Alternative zu traditionellen `COMPUTE`-Anweisungen in Schleifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression, um eine Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_lh_passenger_sum RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_passenger_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_passenger_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_passenger_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_passenger_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->get_lh_passenger_sum( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge von LH in sflights und die Summe ist > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Summe sollte nicht initial sein' act = lv_sum exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Summe sollte positiv sein' act = lv_sum > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen Feldkatalog für eine interne Tabelle, die Flugdaten aus `sflights` enthält, unter Verwendung von RTTI und `FOR`-Iteratoren. Die Methode soll den Feldkatalog zurückgeben, der dann für `cl_gui_alv_grid` verwendet werden könnte.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `FOR` für die Feldkatalogerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_fcat_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_field_catalog
      IMPORTING
        it_data         TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fcat)  TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_fcat_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_catalog.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          ls_comp         TYPE abap_compdescr.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).

    rt_fcat = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR comp IN lo_struct_descr->get_components( )
      ( fieldname = to_upper( comp-name ) " Feldnamen in Großbuchstaben für ALV
        coltext   = comp-name )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_field_catalog_generation.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_alv_fcat_generator=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_fcat_generator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl der Felder im Feldkatalog' act = lines( lt_fcat ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Feldname sollte CARRIER sein' act = lt_fcat[ 1 ]-fieldname exp = 'CARRID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) um die Struktur der übergebenen Daten zur Laufzeit zu analysieren. Mit einer `FOR`-Expression wird dann ein Feldkatalog (`lvc_t_fcat`) dynamisch erstellt. Dies ist eine moderne und flexible Methode, um den Feldkatalog für `cl_gui_alv_grid` zu generieren, ohne ihn manuell hart zu kodieren.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die mehr als 200 freie Sitze haben. Die Methode soll die gefilterte Tabelle zurückgeben. Dies ist eine moderne Art der Datenvorbereitung für eine mögliche `cl_gui_alv_grid` Anzeige.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FILTER`-Expression, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_seats.
    TYPES: tt_flight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER tt_flight_seats(
      VALUE tt_flight_seats(
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid    = flight-carrid
          connid    = flight-connid
          fldate    = flight-fldate
          seatsocc  = flight-seatsocc
          seatsmax  = flight-seatsmax
          seatsfree = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc )
      )
      WHERE seatsfree > iv_min_free_seats
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( 200 ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge mit mehr als 200 freien Sitzen
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden' act = lines( lt_filtered ) > 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Freie Sitze sollten > 200 sein' act = ls_flight-seatsfree > 200 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression ermöglicht das Filtern von internen Tabellen auf eine sehr deklarative und effiziente Weise. In Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Expression zur Transformation und Berechnung des Feldes `seatsfree` wird der Code extrem kompakt und lesbar. Dies ist ideal für die Vorbereitung von Daten, die später in einem `cl_gui_alv_grid` angezeigt werden sollen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, cl_gui_alv_grid

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus `sflights`, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und die Differenz zwischen maximalen und belegten Sitzen enthält. Nutzen Sie moderne Syntax zur Transformation der Daten, die für eine `cl_gui_alv_grid` Anzeige vorbereitet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapped_flight,
             airline   TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_no TYPE s_conn_id,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_mapped_flight.
    TYPES: tt_mapped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflights_to_custom_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mapped_flights) TYPE tt_mapped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflights_to_custom_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_mapped_flights = VALUE tt_mapped_flight(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( airline   = flight-carrid,
        flight_no = flight-connid,
        free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_mapper( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_mapped ) > 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_mapped INTO DATA(ls_mapped).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Airline sollte nicht initial sein' act = ls_mapped-airline ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flugnummer sollte nicht initial sein' act = ls_mapped-flight_no ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage nach einem gegebenen Startdatum liegt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung der Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` als moderne Alternative zu manuellen Datumsberechnungen mit `COMPUTE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` für Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_days_to_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date   TYPE sy-datum
        iv_days_to_add  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_days_to_date.
    DATA: lv_timestamp TYPE timestampl.

    " Datum in Timestamp umwandeln
    cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( EXPORTING id_date = iv_start_date IMPORTING ed_tstmp = lv_timestamp ).

    " Tage hinzufügen (Sekunden = Tage * 24 * 60 * 60)
    cl_abap_tstmp=>add( EXPORTING id_tstmp = lv_timestamp id_secs = iv_days_to_add * 86400 IMPORTING ed_tstmp = lv_timestamp ).

    " Timestamp zurück in Datum umwandeln
    cl_abap_tstmp=>move_tstmp_to_date( EXPORTING id_tstmp = lv_timestamp IMPORTING ed_date = rv_result_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` und transformieren Sie diese mit modernen internen Tabellenoperationen (z.B. `FOR`, `VALUE`) in eine neue Struktur, die für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_alv_grid` vorbereitet ist. Die Methode soll die vorbereiteten Daten zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` um die Daten zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_data_preparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alv_flight_display,
             airline_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_id    TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date  TYPE s_date,
             occupied_seats TYPE s_seatsocc,
             max_seats    TYPE s_seatsmax,
             free_seats   TYPE i,
             status       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_alv_flight_display.
    TYPES: tt_alv_flight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alv_flight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_display_data) TYPE tt_alv_flight_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_data_preparer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_display_data = VALUE tt_alv_flight_display(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc IN
      ( airline_id   = flight-carrid,
        flight_id    = flight-connid,
        flight_date  = flight-fldate,
        occupied_seats = flight-seatsocc,
        max_seats    = flight-seatsmax,
        free_seats   = lv_free_seats,
        status       = COND string(
                           WHEN lv_free_seats > 50 THEN 'Available'
                           WHEN lv_free_seats > 0 THEN 'Limited'
                           ELSE 'Full' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_prepare_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prepare_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_data_preparer( ).
    DATA(lt_prepared_data) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Vorbereitete Daten sollten nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_prepared_data ) > 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_prepared_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Airline ID sollte nicht initial sein' act = ls_data-airline_id ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Freie Sitze sollten korrekt berechnet sein' act = ls_data-free_seats >= 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Status sollte gesetzt sein' act = ( ls_data-status = 'Available' OR ls_data-status = 'Limited' OR ls_data-status = 'Full' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR`-Expression, `VALUE`-Operator und `LET`-Expression zur Transformation und Anreicherung von Daten aus der Datenbank. Es werden neue Felder wie `free_seats` berechnet und ein `status` basierend auf Bedingungen zugewiesen, alles innerhalb einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. Die so vorbereiteten Daten sind ideal für die direkte Übergabe an eine `cl_gui_alv_grid` Instanz zur Anzeige.
keywords: cl_gui_alv_grid, FOR, VALUE, LET, COND, Internal Tables, Data Preparation, COMPUTE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights`. Nutzen Sie moderne Syntax für die Aggregation und Berechnung, die eine Alternative zu expliziten `COMPUTE`-Anweisungen in Schleifen darstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid       TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    IF lv_flight_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_total_seats / lv_flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, die die Notwendigkeit manueller Schleifen und `COMPUTE`-Anweisungen für Aggregationen eliminiert. Die Verwendung von `DECFLOAT16` sorgt für präzise Gleitkomma-Berechnungen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Factory-Muster zur Erstellung von Flugobjekten basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-OO-Features.

CLASS zcl_flight_factory IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und den `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Befehl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data         TYPE ty_flight_data
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine einzelne Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem Schlüssel und prüfen Sie, ob die Zeile gefunden wurde, ohne `sy-subrc` explizit zu verwenden. Wenn die Zeile nicht gefunden wird, soll ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden.

CLASS zcl_read_table_optional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_table_optional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = it_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid
                                     connid = iv_connid
                                     fldate = iv_fldate ] OPTIONAL.
    IF ls_sflight IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_price = ls_sflight-price.
    ELSE.
      rv_price = '0.00'. " Standardwert, wenn nicht gefunden
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` und `VALUE` mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_and_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count,
           tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_and_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS <key> OF <line> IN it_sflights
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = <line>-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = <key>-carrid
                                   count  = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_and_count( ).

Das Ergebnis wird direkt in eine neue interne Tabelle geschrieben (`INTO TABLE` ist hier implizit durch die Zuweisung an `rt_carrier_counts`).

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in einer internen Tabelle und prüfen Sie mit `sy-subrc`, ob der Eintrag erfolgreich aktualisiert wurde. Wenn nicht, geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE` mit `WHERE` und prüfen Sie den Wert von `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_table_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_table_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid
                                            connid = iv_connid
                                            fldate = iv_fldate
                                            price  = iv_new_price )
      TRANSPORTING price
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_table_subrc( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights
                                                    IMPORTING iv_carrid   = 'LH'
                                                              iv_connid   = '0400'
                                                              iv_fldate   = '20250101'
                                                              iv_new_price = '150.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_fail.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_modify_table_subrc=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_table_subrc( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Obwohl moderne ABAP-Syntax viele `sy-subrc`-Prüfungen überflüssig macht, bleibt `sy-subrc` bei Operationen wie `MODIFY TABLE` ein wichtiges Mittel zur Überprüfung des Erfolgs. Dieses Beispiel zeigt die klassische, aber weiterhin relevante Verwendung von `sy-subrc` nach einer `MODIFY`-Anweisung, um festzustellen, ob ein Eintrag erfolgreich aktualisiert wurde. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` für die zu modifizierende Zeile ist jedoch eine moderne Verbesserung.
keywords: Internal Tables, MODIFY TABLE, sy-subrc, Error Handling

CLASS zcl_delete_table_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

WHERE` und die anschließende Prüfung von `sy-subrc` in modernem Kontext.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = '0.00'
                                     FOR <line> IN it_sflights
                                     NEXT sum = sum + <line>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '450.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle in einem einzigen Ausdruck. Hier wird die Summe der Flugpreise berechnet, indem ein Initialwert (`INIT sum = '0.00'`) definiert und dann in einer Schleife über die Tabelle (`FOR <line> IN it_sflights`) der Preis jeder Zeile zum Akkumulator (`NEXT sum = sum + <line>-price`) addiert wird. Das Ergebnis wird direkt einer skalaren Variable zugewiesen, was die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten Schleife und manueller Summenbildung eliminiert.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer aus `sflights` enthält, und fügen Sie ein Präfix zur Flugnummer hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit String-Templates.

CLASS zcl_transform_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info,
           tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transform_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flight_info.
    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR <line> IN it_sflights
                               ( carrid = <line>-carrid
                                 flight_id = |FL-{ <line>-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Hier wird für jede Zeile der Quelltabelle (`FOR <line> IN it_sflights`) eine neue Zeile für die Zieltabelle erstellt, wobei die `connid` mit einem String-Template (`|FL-{ <line>-connid }|`) modifiziert wird. Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in eine Zahl und fangen Sie mögliche Konvertierungsfehler mit modernen Mitteln ab. Geben Sie im Fehlerfall einen Standardwert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für Ausnahmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_catch_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integer) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_catch_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_int.
    TRY.
        rv_integer = CONV i( iv_string ).

CLASS zcl_insert_table_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS add_new_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        it_new_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_all_inserted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_table_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_new_flights.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ct_sflights ).

    INSERT LINES OF it_new_flights INTO TABLE ct_sflights.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " All lines inserted successfully or some were duplicates and ignored
      " Check if the number of lines increased by the expected amount (excluding duplicates)
      IF ( lines( ct_sflights ) - lv_initial_lines ) = lines( it_new_flights ).
        rv_all_inserted = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        " Some duplicates were present and not inserted
        rv_all_inserted = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " An error occurred during insertion (e.g., non-unique key for non-unique table)
      rv_all_inserted = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Bei Tabellen mit eindeutigem Schlüssel (wie hier `UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate`) werden doppelte Einträge nicht eingefügt. `sy-subrc` wird hier verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob die Operation erfolgreich war. Eine zusätzliche Prüfung der Zeilenanzahl ist notwendig, um festzustellen, ob alle *neuen* Zeilen erfolgreich hinzugefügt wurden. CLASS zcl_replace_table_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_carrier_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_old_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_new_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_replaced_any) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_table_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_carrier_flights.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ct_sflights ).

    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>) WHERE carrid = iv_old_carrid.
      <fs_sflight>-carrid = iv_new_carrid.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_replaced_any = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_replaced_any = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: ls_duplicate_flight TYPE zcl_insert_single_subrc=>ty_sflight.
    ls_duplicate_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_single_subrc( ).
    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->add_single_flight( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights
                                                    IMPORTING is_new_flight = ls_duplicate_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_inserted exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price exp = '100.00' ). " Original price remains
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT` Anweisung wird verwendet, um eine einzelne Zeile in eine interne Tabelle einzufügen. Bei Tabellen mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel (`UNIQUE KEY`) wird `sy-subrc` auf einen Wert ungleich 0 gesetzt, wenn versucht wird, einen Eintrag mit einem bereits existierenden Schlüssel einzufügen. Dies ermöglicht eine direkte Überprüfung, ob die Einfügung erfolgreich war oder ob ein Duplikat verhindert wurde. Dies ist ein klares Beispiel für die Verwendung von `sy-subrc` zur Validierung von Einfügeoperationen in Tabellen.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, sy-subrc, Duplicate Handling, INTO TABLE

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein oder aktualisieren Sie eine bestehende Zeile, falls der Schlüssel bereits existiert. Prüfen Sie mit `sy-subrc`, ob ein neuer Eintrag hinzugefügt oder ein bestehender aktualisiert wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE` ohne `WHERE` Klausel und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_insert_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS upsert_flight
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action_performed) TYPE string. " 'INSERTED' or 'UPDATED'
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_insert_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upsert_flight.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_sflights FROM is_flight_data.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_action_performed = 'UPDATED'. " Entry existed and was updated
    ELSEIF sy-subrc = 4.
      rv_action_performed = 'INSERTED'. " Entry did not exist and was inserted
    ELSE.
      rv_action_performed = 'ERROR'. " Other error
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_modify_insert_subrc=>ty_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_insert_subrc( ).
