                                              IMPORTING is_flight_data = ls_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_action exp = 'INSERTED' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_existing.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_modify_insert_subrc=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_modify_insert_subrc=>ty_sflight.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_insert_subrc( ).
    DATA(lv_action) = lo_cut->upsert_flight( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights
                                              IMPORTING is_flight_data = ls_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_action exp = 'UPDATED' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY TABLE` Anweisung ohne `WHERE`-Klausel verhält sich wie ein 'UPSERT' (Update or Insert) für interne Tabellen mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel. Wenn ein Eintrag mit dem angegebenen Schlüssel bereits existiert, wird er aktualisiert; andernfalls wird ein neuer Eintrag eingefügt. Der Wert von `sy-subrc` nach dieser Operation gibt Aufschluss darüber, welche Aktion durchgeführt wurde: `sy-subrc = 0` bedeutet, dass ein bestehender Eintrag aktualisiert wurde, während `sy-subrc = 4` (für Tabellen mit eindeutigem Schlüssel) bedeutet, dass ein neuer Eintrag eingefügt wurde. Dies ist ein effizientes Muster für die Datenpflege in internen Tabellen.
keywords: Internal Tables, MODIFY TABLE, UPSERT, sy-subrc, Conditional Logic, INTO TABLE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für diese Flüge.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die traditionelle Fehlerbehandlung mit `sy-subrc` nach einem `READ TABLE` und vergleichen Sie diese mit einer modernen `TRY...CATCH` Block für eine potenzielle Ausnahme (z.B. Division durch Null).
hint: Verwenden Sie `sy-subrc` nach `READ TABLE` und `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data_old
      IMPORTING
        iv_id    TYPE i
        it_data  TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS process_data_new
      IMPORTING
        iv_id    TYPE i
        it_data  TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_old.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_data.

    READ TABLE it_data INTO ls_data WITH KEY id = iv_id.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF ls_data-value = 0.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Division durch Null (sy-subrc-Stil)'.
      ELSE.
        rv_result = |Ergebnis: { 100 / ls_data-value } (sy-subrc-Stil)|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Fehler: ID nicht gefunden (sy-subrc-Stil)'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data_new.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_data( ).

    TRY.
        ls_data = it_data[ id = iv_id ]. " Access table with key, raises CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND if not found
        rv_result = |Ergebnis: { 100 / ls_data-value } (TRY-CATCH-Stil)|.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: ID nicht gefunden (TRY-CATCH-Stil)'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Division durch Null (TRY-CATCH-Stil)'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_004 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_old_error_handling FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_new_error_handling FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_004 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_old_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_handling( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_err_handling=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 value = 0 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result_found) = lo_cut->process_data_old( iv_id = 1 it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_found exp = 'Ergebnis: 10 (sy-subrc-Stil)' msg = 'Should handle found value' ).

    DATA(lv_result_zero) = lo_cut->process_data_old( iv_id = 2 it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_zero exp = 'Fehler: Division durch Null (sy-subrc-Stil)' msg = 'Should handle division by zero' ).

    DATA(lv_result_not_found) = lo_cut->process_data_old( iv_id = 3 it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_not_found exp = 'Fehler: ID nicht gefunden (sy-subrc-Stil)' msg = 'Should handle not found ID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_new_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_handling( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_err_handling=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 value = 0 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result_found) = lo_cut->process_data_new( iv_id = 1 it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_found exp = 'Ergebnis: 10 (TRY-CATCH-Stil)' msg = 'Should handle found value (new)' ).

    DATA(lv_result_zero) = lo_cut->process_data_new( iv_id = 2 it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_zero exp = 'Fehler: Division durch Null (TRY-CATCH-Stil)' msg = 'Should handle division by zero (new)' ).

    DATA(lv_result_not_found) = lo_cut->process_data_new( iv_id = 3 it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_not_found exp = 'Fehler: ID nicht gefunden (TRY-CATCH-Stil)' msg = 'Should handle not found ID (new)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Modernes ABAP bevorzugt die Ausnahmebehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` gegenüber der Prüfung von `sy-subrc`, da Ausnahmen den Fehlerkontext besser kapseln und die Fehlerbehandlung zentralisieren. Der direkte Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen mit `itab[ key ]` wirft bei Nicht-Finden eine Ausnahme, was `sy-subrc` überflüssig macht.
keywords: Error Handling, TRY CATCH, Exceptions, sy-subrc, Internal Tables, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR, CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Annulliert') basierend auf einer Status-ID unter Verwendung von `COND` und `SWITCH` Ausdrücken.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_flight_status_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_id TYPE i

CLASS zcl_cond_switch IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHEN iv_status_id = 1 THEN 'Pünktlich'

      iv_status_id
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Annulliert'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Kette von Operationen auf einem Wert ausführt (z.B. Addieren, Multiplizieren), und instanziieren Sie sie mit dem `NEW` Operator.
hint: Definieren Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.

CLASS zcl_oo_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_chaining.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_chaining.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Method Chaining, bei dem Methoden `ME` (eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Instanz) zurückgeben, erlaubt es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen, flüssigen Zeile zu verketten, was die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes verbessert.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft sowie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für jede Gruppe.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ...` mit `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_passengers_in_group) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid         = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count   = GROUP SIZE
        total_passengers = lv_total_passengers_in_group
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_007 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test_007 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_group_by=>tt_flights(

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum von heute in einer Woche und die aktuelle Uhrzeit plus 30 Minuten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die neuen arithmetischen Operatoren für Datum und Uhrzeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_time_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_future_date_time
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_future_dt) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_time_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_future_date_time.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_now) = sy-uzeit.

    DATA(lv_next_week) = lv_today + 7.
    DATA(lv_future_time) = lv_now + ( 30 * 60 ). " 30 minutes in seconds

    CREATE DATA rs_future_dt TYPE REF TO struct.
    ASSIGN rs_future_dt->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_future_dt>).
    <fs_future_dt> = VALUE #( date = lv_next_week time = lv_future_time ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_008 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_date_time_arithmetic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_008 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_time_arithmetic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_time_ops( ).
    DATA(lr_future_dt) = lo_cut->calculate_future_date_time( ).

    ASSIGN lr_future_dt->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_future_dt>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_future_dt> msg = 'Future date/time structure should be bound' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_date) = sy-datum + 7.
    DATA(lv_expected_time) = sy-uzeit + ( 30 * 60 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_future_dt>-date exp = lv_expected_date msg = 'Future date should be today + 7 days' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_future_dt>-time exp = lv_expected_time msg = 'Future time should be now + 30 minutes' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Modernes ABAP erlaubt die direkte arithmetische Operationen auf Datum- und Zeitfeldern, was die Berechnung von zukünftigen oder vergangenen Zeitpunkten erheblich vereinfacht und den Code lesbarer macht. Die Verwendung von `sy-datum` und `sy-uzeit` für das aktuelle Datum und die aktuelle Uhrzeit ist Standard.
keywords: Date, Time, Arithmetic, sy-datum, sy-uzeit

CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
             price  TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_products.
    rt_filtered_products = FILTER #( it_all_products USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE active = abap_true AND price > iv_price_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit `sy-subrc` zur dynamischen Feldzuweisung und prüfen Sie den Erfolg der Zuweisung. Wenn das Feld nicht gefunden wird, geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`. Prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` danach.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE ty_data
        iv_component TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |Feld '{ iv_component }' gefunden: { <fs_component> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = |Fehler: Feld '{ iv_component }' nicht gefunden (sy-subrc = { sy-subrc })|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_010 DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_assign_component FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_010 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_component.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_assign( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_assign=>ty_data(
      field1 = 'Test String'
      field2 = 123
      field3 = sy-datum
    ).

    DATA(lv_result_found) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_structure = ls_test_data iv_component = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_found exp = 'Feld 'FIELD1' gefunden: Test String' msg = 'Should find FIELD1' ).

    DATA(lv_result_not_found) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_structure = ls_test_data iv_component = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_not_found exp = 'Fehler: Feld 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' nicht gefunden (sy-subrc = 4)' msg = 'Should report field not found' ).

    DATA(lv_result_field2) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_structure = ls_test_data iv_component = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_field2 exp = 'Feld 'FIELD2' gefunden: 123' msg = 'Should find FIELD2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist ein grundlegendes Werkzeug für die dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Die Prüfung von `sy-subrc` nach dieser Anweisung ist weiterhin der Standardweg, um den Erfolg der Zuweisung zu überprüfen, insbesondere wenn das Vorhandensein eines Feldes zur Laufzeit nicht garantiert ist. Dies zeigt eine Situation, in der `sy-subrc` auch in modernem Code relevant bleibt.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN, sy-subrc, Reflection

CLASS zcl_gui_picture_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS picture_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(e_x_pos) TYPE i VALUE(e_y_pos) TYPE i.

    METHODS display_clickable_picture
      IMPORTING
        iv_url            TYPE string
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_picture TYPE REF TO cl_gui_picture.

    METHODS handle_picture_click FOR EVENT picture_click OF cl_gui_picture
      IMPORTING
        x_pos
        y_pos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_picture_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_clickable_picture.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
          EXPORTING
            container_name = iv_container_name.

        CREATE OBJECT mo_picture
          EXPORTING
            parent = lo_custom_container.

        SET HANDLER me->handle_picture_click FOR mo_picture.

        mo_picture->load_picture_from_url(
          EXPORTING
            url = iv_url
        ).

      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_error).
        MESSAGE lx_gui_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_picture_click.
    " Ereignis weiterleiten oder direkt verarbeiten
    RAISE EVENT picture_clicked EXPORTING e_x_pos = x_pos e_y_pos = y_pos.
    " In einem echten Programm könnte hier z.B. ein Popup mit den Koordinaten erscheinen.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_picture_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE, die für die Anzeige in einem ALV-Grid geeignet ist, und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode CREATE_DYNAMIC_TABLE und definieren Sie den Feldkatalog basierend auf SFLIGHT-Feldern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_sflight_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat,
          lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    " Feldkatalog für dynamische Tabelle definieren
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Airline'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Flight No.'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'D'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 8. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Flight Date'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'P'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 11. ls_fieldcat-decimals = 2. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Price'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CURRENCY'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 5. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Currency'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.

    TRY.
        cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
          EXPORTING
            it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
          IMPORTING
            ep_table_descriptor = lr_table_descr
        ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                       <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          DATA(lt_sflight_static) = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
            ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '123.45' currency = 'EUR' )
            ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = '500.00' currency = 'USD' )
          ).

          LOOP AT lt_sflight_static INTO DATA(ls_sflight_static).
            CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <fs_dynamic_table>.
            ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>). IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = ls_sflight_static-carrid. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>). IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = ls_sflight_static-connid. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>). IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_fldate> = ls_sflight_static-fldate. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_price>). IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_price> = ls_sflight_static-price. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CURRENCY' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_currency>). IF <fs_currency> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_currency> = ls_sflight_static-currency. ENDIF.
              APPEND <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

        rr_dynamic_table = lr_data.

      CATCH cx_alv_table_create INTO DATA(lx_alv_create).
        MESSAGE lx_alv_create->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_data).
        MESSAGE lx_create_data->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle für ein ALV, die zusätzlich zu den Datenbankfeldern ein berechnetes Feld enthält (z.B. 'TOTAL_PRICE' = PRICE * QUANTITY).
hint: Erweitern Sie den Feldkatalog mit dem berechneten Feld und füllen Sie es dynamisch mit Feldsymbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_calc_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             quantity TYPE sbook-passform,
           END OF ty_booking_raw.
    TYPES: tt_booking_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_booking_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_calc_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_booking_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat,
          lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    " Feldkatalog für dynamische Tabelle definieren (Basisfelder)
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Airline'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Flight No.'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'D'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 8. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Flight Date'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'P'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 11. ls_fieldcat-decimals = 2. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Price'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CURRENCY'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 5. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Currency'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'QUANTITY'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'P'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 3. ls_fieldcat-decimals = 0. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Quantity'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.

    " Berechnetes Feld hinzufügen
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'TOTAL_PRICE'.
    ls_fieldcat-inttype   = 'P'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 16.
    ls_fieldcat-decimals  = 2.
    ls_fieldcat-coltext   = 'Total Price'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.

    TRY.
        cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
          EXPORTING
            it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
          IMPORTING
            ep_table_descriptor = lr_table_descr
        ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                       <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          DATA(lt_booking_raw_static) = VALUE tt_booking_raw(
            ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '123.45' currency = 'EUR' quantity = 2 )
            ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = '500.00' currency = 'USD' quantity = 1 )
            ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251203' price = '75.50' currency = 'USD' quantity = 3 )
          ).

          LOOP AT lt_booking_raw_static INTO DATA(ls_booking_raw_static).
            CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <fs_dynamic_table>.
            ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>). IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = ls_booking_raw_static-carrid. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>). IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = ls_booking_raw_static-connid. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>). IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_fldate> = ls_booking_raw_static-fldate. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_price>). IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_price> = ls_booking_raw_static-price. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CURRENCY' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_currency>). IF <fs_currency> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_currency> = ls_booking_raw_static-currency. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'QUANTITY' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_quantity>). IF <fs_quantity> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_quantity> = ls_booking_raw_static-quantity. ENDIF.

              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TOTAL_PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_total_price>).
              IF <fs_total_price> IS ASSIGNED.
                <fs_total_price> = ls_booking_raw_static-price * ls_booking_raw_static-quantity.
              ENDIF.

              APPEND <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

        rr_dynamic_table = lr_data.

      CATCH cx_alv_table_create INTO DATA(lx_alv_create).
        MESSAGE lx_alv_create->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_data).
        MESSAGE lx_create_data->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und Datentypen generiert wird.
hint: Erstellen Sie den Feldkatalog programmatisch basierend auf einer dynamischen Definition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_struct_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             fieldname TYPE fieldname,
             inttype   TYPE inttype,
             intlen    TYPE intlen,
             decimals  TYPE decimals,
             coltext   TYPE lvc_coltext,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES: tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_table_from_def
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_struct_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_from_def.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat,
          lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_fieldcat-fieldname = ls_field_def-fieldname.
      ls_fieldcat-inttype   = ls_field_def-inttype.
      ls_fieldcat-intlen    = ls_field_def-intlen.
      ls_fieldcat-decimals  = ls_field_def-decimals.
      ls_fieldcat-coltext   = ls_field_def-coltext.
      APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
          EXPORTING
            it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
          IMPORTING
            ep_table_descriptor = lr_table_descr
        ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

        rr_dynamic_table = lr_data.

      CATCH cx_alv_table_create INTO DATA(lx_alv_create).
        MESSAGE lx_alv_create->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_data).
        MESSAGE lx_create_data->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, die aus einer Datenbanktabelle (z.B. SFLIGHT) gelesen und mit modernen ABAP-Features transformiert wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und `FOR` oder `MAP` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_data_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_data_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_sflight_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat,
          lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    " Feldkatalog definieren (Beispiel: nur CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE_EUR)
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Airline'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Flight No.'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'D'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 8. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Flight Date'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'PRICE_EUR'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'P'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 11. ls_fieldcat-decimals = 2. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Price (EUR)'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.

    TRY.
        cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
          EXPORTING
            it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
          IMPORTING
            ep_table_descriptor = lr_table_descr
        ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                       <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          DATA lt_sflight_db TYPE tt_sflight_raw.
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
            FROM sflight
            INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight_db
            UP TO 2 ROWS.

          " Daten transformieren und dynamisch füllen (modernes ABAP)
          <fs_dynamic_table> = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_db
                                        LET lv_price_eur = COND dmbtr( WHEN ls_sflight-currency = 'USD' THEN ls_sflight-price * '0.9' " Dummy conversion
                                                                      ELSE ls_sflight-price ) IN
                                        ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
                                          connid    = ls_sflight-connid
                                          fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
                                          price_eur = lv_price_eur ) ).
        ENDIF.

        rr_dynamic_table = lr_data.

      CATCH cx_alv_table_create INTO DATA(lx_alv_create).
        MESSAGE lx_alv_create->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_data).
        MESSAGE lx_create_data->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( iv_act = <fs_table>
                                      msg = 'Dynamic table should be assigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( <fs_table> )
                                           msg = 'Dynamic table should contain entries' ).

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE_EUR' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_price_eur>).
      IF <fs_price_eur> IS ASSIGNED.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_price_eur>
                                               msg = 'PRICE_EUR should be filled' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'PRICE_EUR component not found' ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Could not read first entry' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es zeigt, wie Daten aus der Datenbank gelesen und direkt bei der Zuweisung zur dynamischen Tabelle mit `FOR` und `COND` transformiert werden können. Dies ist ein sehr effizienter und lesbarer Weg, um Daten für ALV-Berichte vorzubereiten.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE, die Felder aus mehreren Datenbanktabellen (z.B. SFLIGHT und SBOOK) kombiniert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT JOIN` und füllen Sie den Feldkatalog entsprechend der kombinierten Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_multi_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking_raw,
             sflight_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             sflight_connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             sflight_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             sbook_bookid     TYPE sbook-bookid,
             sbook_customid   TYPE sbook-customid,
             sbook_passform   TYPE sbook-passform,
           END OF ty_flight_booking_raw.
    TYPES: tt_flight_booking_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_joined_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_multi_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_joined_table.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat,
          lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    " Feldkatalog für kombinierte Felder definieren
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SFLIGHT_CARRID'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Airline'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SFLIGHT_CONNID'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Flight No.'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SFLIGHT_FLDATE'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'D'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 8. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Flight Date'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SBOOK_BOOKID'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 10. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Booking ID'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SBOOK_CUSTOMID'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 8. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Customer ID'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SBOOK_PASSFORM'. ls_fieldcat-inttype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 1. ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Passenger Form'. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat. CLEAR ls_fieldcat.

    TRY.
        cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
          EXPORTING
            it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
          IMPORTING
            ep_table_descriptor = lr_table_descr
        ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                       <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          DATA lt_flight_booking_db TYPE tt_flight_booking_raw.
          SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid, b~customid, b~passform
            FROM sflight AS s
            INNER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
            INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_flight_booking_db
            UP TO 3 ROWS.

          " Daten in die dynamische Tabelle kopieren
          <fs_dynamic_table> = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_flight_booking_db
                                        ( sflight_carrid = ls_entry-sflight_carrid
                                          sflight_connid = ls_entry-sflight_connid
                                          sflight_fldate = ls_entry-sflight_fldate
                                          sbook_bookid   = ls_entry-sbook_bookid
                                          sbook_customid = ls_entry-sbook_customid
                                          sbook_passform = ls_entry-sbook_passform ) ).
        ENDIF.

        rr_dynamic_table = lr_data.

      CATCH cx_alv_table_create INTO DATA(lx_alv_create).
        MESSAGE lx_alv_create->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_data).
        MESSAGE lx_create_data->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_evt_button_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS button_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(e_sender) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    METHODS create_button
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_button) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button IMPORTING sender.
    DATA mv_click_count TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_evt_button_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_button.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(

      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
        text   = iv_text
    ).
    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR ro_button.

  METHOD handle_button_click.

    RAISE EVENT button_clicked EXPORTING e_sender = sender.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus sflights für ein Zeitdiagramm vor, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Datum anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT mit GROUP BY und COUNT(*) sowie FOR und VALUE für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cht_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
        date  TYPE d,
        value TYPE i,
      END OF ty_chart_data,
      tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cht_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_date.
    SELECT FROM sflights
           FIELDS fldate, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
           GROUP BY fldate
           ORDER BY fldate ASC
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data).

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_data ( date = ls_raw-fldate value = ls_raw-flight_count ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cht_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_chart_data) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_date( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_chart_data
      msg = 'Chart data should not be empty'
    ).

    DATA(lv_prev_date) = sy-datlo.
    LOOP AT lt_chart_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_data-date >= lv_prev_date )
        msg = 'Data should be sorted by date'
      ).
      lv_prev_date = ls_data-date.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie dynamisch einen Feldkatalog für ein ALV Grid basierend auf der Struktur einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_SALV_TABLE=>FACTORY und GET_COLUMNS oder CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_fieldcat_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data_for_alv,
        id   TYPE i,
        text TYPE string,
        date TYPE d,
      END OF ty_data_for_alv,
      tt_data_for_alv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_for_alv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_field_catalog
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data_for_alv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat. " Type for ALV field catalog
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_fieldcat_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_field_catalog.
    DATA(lo_salv_table) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = NEW cl_gui_container( )
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv_table)
      CHANGING
        t_table = it_data
    ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv_table->get_columns( ).
    DATA(lt_columns_descr) = lo_columns->get_column_headers( ).

    rt_field_catalog = VALUE #( FOR ls_col_descr IN lt_columns_descr
                                 ( fieldname = ls_col_descr-columnname
                                   seltext_l = ls_col_descr-text
                                   outputlen = ls_col_descr-outputlen ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_field_catalog_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_field_catalog_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_fieldcat_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_alv_fieldcat_gen=>tt_data_for_alv(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Test A' date = '20230101' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Test B' date = '20230102' )

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Daten aus sflights für ein Zeitdiagramm mit mehreren Datenreihen vor, z.B. die Anzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie GROUP BY, REDUCE und VALUE für die Aggregation und Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cht_multi_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        fldate     TYPE s_date,
        seatsocc   TYPE s_seatsocc,
        seatsmax   TYPE s_seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_chart_series_data,
        date  TYPE d,
        value TYPE f,
      END OF ty_chart_series_data,
      tt_chart_series_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_series_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_multi_series_output,
        flight_counts TYPE tt_chart_series_data,
        avg_occupancy TYPE tt_chart_series_data,
      END OF ty_multi_series_output.

    METHODS get_multi_series_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_output) TYPE ty_multi_series_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cht_multi_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_multi_series_data.
    SELECT fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights).

    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_raw_flights GROUP BY ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ASCENDING
      ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        seatsocc = REDUCE s_seatsocc( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs>-seatsocc )
        seatsmax = REDUCE s_seatsmax( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs>-seatsmax ) )
    ).

    rs_output-flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR ls_grouped IN lt_grouped_data
                                       ( date = ls_grouped-fldate
                                         value = ( ls_grouped-seatsmax > 0 ? ls_grouped-seatsmax / 100 : 0 ) ) ). " Placeholder for actual flight count, using seatsmax as proxy

    rs_output-avg_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR ls_grouped IN lt_grouped_data
                                       ( date = ls_grouped-fldate
                                         value = ( ls_grouped-seatsmax > 0 ? ( ls_grouped-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_grouped-seatsmax : 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multi_series_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_series_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cht_multi_series( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_multi_series_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_result-flight_counts
      msg = 'Flight counts series should not be empty'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_result-avg_occupancy
      msg = 'Average occupancy series should not be empty'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( ls_result-flight_counts )
      exp = lines( ls_result-avg_occupancy )
      msg = 'Both series should have the same number of data points'
    ).

    IF lines( ls_result-avg_occupancy ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_occupancy) = ls_result-avg_occupancy[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_first_occupancy-value >= 0 AND ls_first_occupancy-value <= 100 )
        msg = 'Average occupancy should be between 0 and 100'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die ein CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE-Objekt konfiguriert und dabei mögliche Ausnahmen abfängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für die Ausnahmebehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cht_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS configure_chart_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_chart) TYPE REF TO cl_time_chart_simple
      RAISING
        cx_root.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cht_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD configure_chart_safe.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'CHART_CONTAINER_ERR'
            dynpro_program = sy-repid
            dynpro_number   = sy-dynnr
        ).
        ro_chart = NEW cl_time_chart_simple(
          EXPORTING
            parent = lo_container
        ).
        ro_chart->set_title( iv_title ).

      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        " Log the error or handle it gracefully
        MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_root EXPORTING text = lx_gui->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_root EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_handling_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_handling_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cht_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lo_chart) = lo_cut->configure_chart_safe( 'Valid Title' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_chart
      msg = 'Chart object should be created successfully'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_handling_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cht_error_handling( ).
    TRY.
        " Simulate a failure, e.g., by passing invalid parameters if possible,
        " or by mocking the GUI environment to raise an exception.
        " For cl_gui_cfw, direct simulation of failure is hard without mocking.
        " We'll test that if an exception occurs, it's caught and re-raised as cx_root.
        " This test primarily verifies the TRY-CATCH block structure.
        " A more realistic test would involve injecting a failing dependency.
        DATA(lo_chart) = lo_cut->configure_chart_safe( '' ). " Empty title might not cause exception

        " To force an exception for testing, one might temporarily modify the environment
        " or use a test double. For this example, we assume a scenario where an internal
        " GUI error could occur during instantiation or method call.
        " If no exception is raised, the assert_fail will trigger.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected an exception, but none occurred.' ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
          act = lx_root
          msg = 'Exception should be caught and re-raised'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von TRY...CATCH zur robusten Fehlerbehandlung bei der Konfiguration von GUI-Controls. Es fängt generische GUI-Ausnahmen ab und re-raist sie als CX_ROOT, um eine einheitliche Fehlerbehandlung zu ermöglichen. Der Unit Test prüft sowohl den Erfolgsfall als auch, dass Ausnahmen korrekt abgefangen und weitergeleitet werden.
keywords: cl_time_chart_simple, TRY...CATCH, cx_gui_exception, cx_root, Error Handling, UI Configuration

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_capacity = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_capacity = sum_capacity + flight-seatsocc + flight-seatsfree
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA') unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Summe der Preise und die Anzahl der Flüge zu ermitteln, und teilen Sie diese dann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE struct {
      sum_price TYPE decfloat16;
      count     TYPE i
    }(
      INIT sum_price = 0 count = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price,
           count     = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum_price / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Average price should not be initial' act = lv_avg_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average price should be greater than 0' act = ( lv_avg_price > 0 ) ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der freien Sitze für alle Flüge, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. 'LH' und '0400'), und speichern Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine SORTED TABLE und den FOR-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` und den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` für die Transformation und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_free_seats_for_conn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_seats,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             free_seats TYPE s_seats,
           END OF ty_flight_seats.
    TYPES: tt_flight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_free_seats_by_connection
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_free_seats) TYPE tt_flight_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_free_seats_for_conn IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_free_seats_by_connection.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_free_seats = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid )
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                   connid = flight-connid,
                                   fldate = flight-fldate,
                                   free_seats = flight-seatsfree ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result table should contain entries' act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Wrong connid' act = <fs_result>-connid exp = '0400' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht es, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die gefilterten und transformierten Daten enthält. Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze für jede Gruppe. Nutzen Sie hierfür LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und den REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppe den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grouped_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupied_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grouped_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupied_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_occupied) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_seats = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + grouped_flight-seatsocc
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_seats( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_occupied_seats = lv_total_occupied ) TO rt_carrier_seats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouped_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grouped_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_occupied_seats_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result table should contain entries' act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).
    DATA(lv_lh_seats) = VALUE i( FOR entry IN lt_result WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( entry-total_occupied_seats ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH seats should be greater than 0' act = ( lv_lh_seats > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke Gruppierung von Daten direkt in der Schleife. In Kombination mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator innerhalb der Gruppe können Aggregationen für jede Gruppe effizient berechnet werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.

CLASS zcl_filtered_economy_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filtered_economy_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_economy_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    rv_total_economy_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_seats = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + flight-seatsocc

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id

CLASS zcl_flight_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    rb_exists = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ) THEN abap_true

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug die Flugnummer und die verbleibende Kapazität (Gesamtkapazität - belegte Sitze) enthält. Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator mit FOR-Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_remaining_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             remaining_capacity TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_remaining_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_remaining_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_capacity = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                             ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                               connid = flight-connid,
                               fldate = flight-fldate,
                               remaining_capacity = flight-seatsfree ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in einer SORTED TABLE. Nutzen Sie READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING` mit einem Tabellenschlüssel, um den Eintrag direkt zu modifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE sflight.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
      rb_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20251203'.
    DATA(lv_new_price) = '123.45'.

    DATA(lb_updated) = lo_cut->update_price( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_connid = lv_connid iv_fldate = lv_fldate iv_new_price = lv_new_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight should be updated' act = lb_updated ).

    DATA: lt_sflights_check TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights_check.
    READ TABLE lt_sflights_check ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_check>)
      WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price should be updated correctly' act = <fs_flight_check>-price exp = lv_new_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING`-Anweisung in Verbindung mit einem `SORTED TABLE` und einem vollständigen Schlüssel ermöglicht einen sehr schnellen Zugriff auf einen Tabelleneintrag. Durch die Zuweisung an ein Feldsymbol kann der Eintrag direkt und effizient im Speicher modifiziert werden, ohne dass ein `MODIFY` oder `UPDATE` erforderlich ist.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, READ TABLE, ASSIGNING, Internal Tables, Modification, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine SORTED TABLE von Flügen und fügen Sie neue Flüge hinzu. Demonstrieren Sie die automatische Sortierung und die Behandlung von Duplikaten bei UNIQUE KEY.
hint: Deklarieren Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` und verwenden Sie `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS add_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_new_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_current_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flights.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 2 ROWS INTO TABLE rt_current_flights.

    LOOP AT it_new_flights INTO ls_sflight.
      TRY.
          INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE rt_current_flights.
        CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
*         Handle duplicate key if necessary, e.g., log it
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).
    DATA: lt_new_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'AZ'. ls_flight-connid = '100'. ls_flight-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_new_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AZ'. ls_flight-connid = '101'. ls_flight-fldate = '20251202'.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_new_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AZ'. ls_flight-connid = '100'. ls_flight-fldate = '20251201'. "Duplicate
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_new_flights.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_flights( lt_new_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result table should contain entries' act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Duplicate should not be inserted' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ). "2 initial + 2 new unique
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry carrid should be AZ' act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'AZ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass Einträge immer sortiert sind und keine doppelten Schlüsselwerte enthalten. Der `INSERT`-Befehl versucht, neue Zeilen einzufügen. Bei einem doppelten Schlüssel wird eine `CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY`-Exception ausgelöst, die abgefangen werden kann. Dies demonstriert die automatische Datenintegrität und Sortierung.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INSERT, UNIQUE KEY, Internal Tables, Exceptions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge, die in den nächsten 7 Tagen stattfinden, unter Verwendung von Datumskalkulationen und REDUCE.

solution:
CLASS zcl_future_flight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_price_next_7_days
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_future_flight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_price_next_7_days.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_next_week) = lv_today + 7.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN @lv_today AND @lv_next_week.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine SORTED TABLE von Flügen und verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Mindestanzahl freier Sitze enthält, und berechnen Sie gleichzeitig die durchschnittliche Auslastung dieser Flüge.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seats,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seats,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES: tt_filtered_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_and_avg_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE s_seats
      EXPORTING
        et_filtered_flights TYPE tt_filtered_flights
        ev_avg_occupancy    TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_and_avg_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    et_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( flight-seatsfree >= iv_min_free_seats )
                                     ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                       connid = flight-connid,
                                       fldate = flight-fldate,
                                       seatsocc = flight-seatsocc,
                                       seatsmax = flight-seatsmax ) ).

    DATA(ls_occupancy_data) = REDUCE struct {
      total_occupied TYPE i;
      total_max      TYPE i
    }(
      INIT total_occupied = 0 total_max = 0
      FOR flight IN et_filtered_flights
      NEXT total_occupied = total_occupied + flight-seatsocc,
           total_max      = total_max + flight-seatsmax
    ).

    IF ls_occupancy_data-total_max > 0.
      ev_avg_occupancy = ( ls_occupancy_data-total_occupied / ls_occupancy_data-total_max ) * 100.
    ELSE.
      ev_avg_occupancy = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Gruppe. Geben Sie für jede Gruppe die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid
           connid
           fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = GROUP SIZE.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = lv_carrid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_grouper->group_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_counts ).

    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_count-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'LH should have flights' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke ABAP 7.40+ Syntax, um Daten in internen Tabellen effizient zu gruppieren. Die `GROUP SIZE` Funktion innerhalb der Schleife ermöglicht das einfache Zählen von Elementen pro Gruppe. Dies ist wesentlich effizienter als manuelle Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, WHEN, Internal Tables, Grouping, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden, unter Verwendung der Tabelle `sflight`.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price_after_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_after_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid
           connid
           fldate
           price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( fldate > iv_date )
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_status_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_item,
             id     TYPE i,
             text   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_status_item.
    TYPES: tt_status_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_status_table
      IMPORTING
        it_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status_table) TYPE tt_status_items.

CLASS zcl_status_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_status_table.
    rt_status_table = VALUE #( FOR id_val IN it_ids
                               ( id = id_val

                                          WHEN id_val = 1 THEN 'Aktiv'
                                          WHEN id_val = 2 THEN 'Inaktiv'
                                          ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) ) ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_severity_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_error_severity_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_severity.
    rv_severity = SWITCH #( iv_error_code

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflight` und fügen Sie eine berechnete Spalte 'FlightStatus' hinzu, die basierend auf dem Flugdatum 'Vergangen', 'Heute' oder 'Zukünftig' anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `CASE WHEN` Expression direkt in Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    SELECT carrid,
           connid,
           fldate,
           CASE
             WHEN fldate < @lv_today THEN 'Vergangen'
             WHEN fldate = @lv_today THEN 'Heute'
             WHEN fldate > @lv_today THEN 'Zukünftig'
             ELSE 'Unbekannt'
           END AS flight_status
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights_with_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_sql_case) = NEW zcl_open_sql_case( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_sql_case->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate < sy-datum.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_status exp = 'Vergangen' ).
      ELSE IF ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_status exp = 'Heute' ).
      ELSE IF ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_status exp = 'Zukünftig' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften aus `sflight` enthält, die eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen überschreiten. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung auf `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_min_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_min_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid
           connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) 
                         WHERE ( GROUP SIZE > iv_min_flights )
                         ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid, count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es ermöglicht die Erstellung neuer Tabellen basierend auf Gruppierungen und Bedingungen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch einen Wert aus einer Struktur liest. Der Feldname wird als String übergeben. Wenn das Feld nicht existiert, soll ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden. Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `SWITCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff und `SWITCH` für die bedingte Zuweisung des Standardwerts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    rv_value = SWITCH #( sy-subrc
                         WHEN 0 THEN |
                           { <fs_value> }|
                         ELSE 'Feld nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
