Instructions: Finden Sie das erste Vorkommen des Wortes 'ABAP' in einem gegebenen Text und geben Sie den Satz zurück, in dem es vorkommt. Nehmen Sie an, Sätze enden mit '.' oder '!'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` um die Position zu finden und `substring` um den Satz zu extrahieren. Nutzen Sie `REGEX` für Satzgrenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_sentence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sentence_with_word
      IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                iv_word TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_sentence IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sentence_with_word.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i,
          lv_length TYPE i.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_word IN SECTION OFFSET 0 OF iv_text
      MATCH OFFSET lv_offset
      MATCH LENGTH lv_length.

    IF sy-subrc = 0. " Word found
      DATA(lv_start) = 0.
      DATA(lv_end) = strlen( iv_text ) - 1.

      " Find start of sentence
      FIND LAST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '[\.!?]\s*' IN SECTION LENGTH lv_offset OF iv_text
        MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_sentence_start_match).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_start = lv_sentence_start_match + 1.
        " Skip whitespace after punctuation
        WHILE lv_start < strlen( iv_text ) AND iv_text+lv_start(1) = ' '.
          lv_start = lv_start + 1.
        ENDWHILE.
      ENDIF.

      " Find end of sentence
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '[\.!?]' IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset OF iv_text
        MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_sentence_end_match).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_end = lv_sentence_end_match.
      ENDIF.

      rv_sentence = substring( val = iv_text off = lv_start len = lv_end - lv_start + 1 ).
      rv_sentence = condense( rv_sentence ). " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_sentence FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_sentence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_find_sentence( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Dies ist ein Satz. ABAP ist toll! Ein weiterer Satz.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_sentence_with_word( iv_text = lv_text iv_word = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABAP ist toll!' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_sentence_with_word( iv_text = `Kein Treffer hier.` iv_word = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_sentence_with_word( iv_text = `ABAP am Anfang.`. iv_word = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABAP am Anfang.' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_sentence_with_word( iv_text = `Satz mit ABAP.`. iv_word = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Satz mit ABAP.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode verwendet `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF` um die Startposition des gesuchten Wortes zu ermitteln. Anschließend werden `FIND LAST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX` und `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX` verwendet, um die Satzgrenzen zu finden. `substring` extrahiert dann den relevanten Teil des Strings.
keywords: FIND, substring, String Processing, REGEX

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle aus `sflights`, die für jeden Flug angibt, ob es sich um einen 'Langstreckenflug' (Distanz > 5000 km) oder einen 'Kurzstreckenflug' handelt.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR...IN...` Expression mit `VALUE` und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_type,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             distance    TYPE s_distance,
             flight_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_type.
    TYPES tt_flight_type TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_type WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_types
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_types) TYPE tt_flight_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_types.
    SELECT carrid, connid, distance FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flight_types = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid      = flight-carrid,
        connid      = flight-connid,
        distance    = flight-distance,
        flight_type = COND string( WHEN flight-distance > 5000 THEN 'Langstreckenflug' ELSE 'Kurzstreckenflug' ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    IF ls_long_haul IS NOT INITIAL.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche maximale Sitzplatzkapazität.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR...IN...` Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             avg_seats_max TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE DATA(lv_count)
      ( carrid        = flight-carrid,
        flight_count  = lv_count,
        avg_seats_max = REDUCE decfloat16(
                          INIT sum_seats = 0
                          FOR member IN GROUP flight
                          NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + member-seatsmax ) / lv_count ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_summary FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summary( ).

    " Assertions would depend on test data in sflights.
    " Example: Check if LH exists and has a count > 0
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT sy-initial ].
    IF ls_lh_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0, 'Flight count for LH should be greater than 0' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-avg_seats_max > 0, 'Average seats for LH should be greater than 0' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... BY` Expression ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe kann dann mit `REDUCE` eine Aggregation durchgeführt werden, um beispielsweise Summen oder Durchschnitte zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables

CLASS zcl_sflight_multi_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND seatsmax >= 200 )

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen des Wortes 'old' in einem Textstring durch 'new', aber nur, wenn 'old' nicht Teil eines längeren Wortes ist (z.B. 'folder' soll nicht zu 'fnewder' werden).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit Wortgrenzen (`\b`) und iterieren Sie mit `FOR...IN...` über die Ergebnisse, um `REPLACE` zu nutzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_word DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_word_only
      IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                iv_old_word TYPE string
                iv_new_word TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_word IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_word_only.
    DATA(lv_temp_text) = iv_text.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = '\b' && iv_old_word && '\b'.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN lv_temp_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    " Iterate in reverse to avoid issues with changing offsets during replacement
    LOOP AT lt_matches ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_match>) DESCENDING.
      REPLACE SECTION OFFSET <fs_match>-offset LENGTH <fs_match>-length OF lv_temp_text WITH iv_new_word.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result_text = lv_temp_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_word FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_word.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_word( ).

    DATA(lv_text1) = `This is an old story about an old folder.`.
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->replace_word_only( iv_text = lv_text1 iv_old_word = 'old' iv_new_word = 'new' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = `This is an new story about an old folder.` ).

    DATA(lv_text2) = `old old old`.
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->replace_word_only( iv_text = lv_text2 iv_old_word = 'old' iv_new_word = 'new' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = `new new new` ).

    DATA(lv_text3) = `No match here.`.
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->replace_word_only( iv_text = lv_text3 iv_old_word = 'word' iv_new_word = 'replaced' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = `No match here.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung von `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit Wortgrenzen (`\b`) wird sichergestellt, dass nur ganze Wörter gefunden werden. Die Iteration über die `RESULTS`-Tabelle in umgekehrter Reihenfolge und die Verwendung von `REPLACE SECTION` ermöglicht das korrekte Ersetzen, ohne dass sich die Offsets der noch zu findenden Treffer verschieben.
keywords: FIND, REPLACE, REGEX, String Manipulation, FOR

Instructions: Einen durch Kommas getrennten String in eine interne Tabelle von einzelnen Werten aufteilen und dabei leere Einträge ignorieren.

CLASS zcl_str_split_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_filter_empty
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_table) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_str_split_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_filter_empty.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lt_raw_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).

    SPLIT lv_temp_string AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_raw_parts.

    rt_result_table = VALUE string_table(
                        FOR <lv_part> IN lt_raw_parts
                        WHERE ( <lv_part> IS NOT INITIAL )
                        ( CONV string( <lv_part> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Einen String, der durch Semikolon getrennte Zahlen enthält, aufteilen und die Summe dieser Zahlen berechnen. Ungültige Einträge sollen ignoriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` und den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_from_string.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lt_raw_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lv_number) TYPE i.

    SPLIT lv_temp_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_raw_parts.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR <lv_part> IN lt_raw_parts
                       LET lv_number = COND #( WHEN <lv_part> IS NUMERIC THEN CONV i( <lv_part> ) ELSE 0 ) IN
                       NEXT sum = sum + lv_number ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Anzahl Flüge) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für ein Diagramm vor, indem Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aggregieren. Die Daten sollen in einer internen Tabelle gesammelt werden, die für die `cl_gui_chart_engine` geeignet ist.
hint: Aggregieren Sie Daten mit `GROUP BY` und `FOR` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        num_flights TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        it_chart_data TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_aggregated_data = VALUE tt_flight_data(
                           FOR GROUPS <group> OF <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                           GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid )
                           ( carrid = <group>-carrid
                             num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.

Instructions: Einen String aufteilen und basierend auf der Anzahl der resultierenden Teile eine bedingte Aktion ausführen. Wenn der String genau zwei Teile hat, sollen diese konkateniert zurückgegeben werden, sonst ein Standardwert.

CLASS zcl_str_split_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string_by_parts
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiter    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string_by_parts.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lt_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).

    SPLIT lv_temp_string AT iv_delimiter INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rv_result = COND string(
                  WHEN lines( lt_parts ) = 2
                    THEN |{ lt_parts[1] }{ lt_parts[2] }|
                  ELSE 'Standardwert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem komplexen Log-String spezifische Werte, die durch variierende Trennzeichen getrennt sind, und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Der Log-String könnte z.B. 'ID:123;STATUS:OK;MSG:Success' oder 'ID=456|STATUS=ERROR' sein.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SPLIT` mit `FIND` oder `FIND REGEX` für die dynamische Trennzeichenerkennung und `REDUCE` für die Extraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
        key   TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_log_entry,
      tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_log_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parsed_data) TYPE tt_log_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_log_string.
    DATA(lv_entry_delimiter) = COND string(
                                 WHEN iv_log_string CS ';' THEN ';'
                                 WHEN iv_log_string CS '|' THEN '|'
                                 ELSE '' ).
    IF lv_entry_delimiter IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_raw_entries) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_log_string AT lv_entry_delimiter INTO TABLE lt_raw_entries.

    rt_parsed_data = VALUE tt_log_entries(
                       FOR <lv_raw_entry> IN lt_raw_entries
                       LET lv_pair_delimiter = COND string(
                                                 WHEN <lv_raw_entry> CS ':' THEN ':'
                                                 WHEN <lv_raw_entry> CS '=' THEN '='
                                                 ELSE '' ) IN
                       WHERE ( lv_pair_delimiter IS NOT INITIAL )
                       LET lv_key = SUBSTRING( val = <lv_raw_entry> len = find( val = <lv_raw_entry> sub = lv_pair_delimiter ) )
                           lv_value = SUBSTRING( val = <lv_raw_entry> off = find( val = <lv_raw_entry> sub = lv_pair_delimiter ) + 1 ) IN
                       ( key = lv_key value = lv_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` (z.B. Flugdatum in ein benutzerfreundliches Format) direkt bei der Übergabe an das Diagramm. Das Diagramm soll das Datum im Format 'DD.MM.YYYY' anzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit Inline-Deklaration und Transformation, um die Daten für das Diagramm aufzubereiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate_formatted TYPE string,
        price  TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_chart_data,
      tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.

    METHODS display_chart_transformed
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed_data = VALUE tt_chart_data(
                            FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                            ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                              connid = ls_flight-connid,

Instructions: Einen String, der Feldnamen und Werte enthält (z.B. 'CARRID=LH;CONNID=0400'), aufteilen und die Werte dynamisch in eine Struktur schreiben. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Feldtypen zu berücksichtigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` und RTTI (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) für die dynamische Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_rtti DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS assign_string_to_structure
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        io_data_ref     TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_rtti IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_string_to_structure.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_data> TYPE any STRUCTURE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_data_ref->* TO <ls_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lt_pairs) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT lv_temp_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_pairs.

    LOOP AT lt_pairs INTO DATA(lv_pair).
      DATA(lv_field_name) TYPE string.
      DATA(lv_field_value) TYPE string.
      SPLIT lv_pair AT '=' INTO lv_field_name lv_field_value.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        TRY.
            <lv_field> = lv_field_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Handle conversion error, e.g., log it
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Einen String, der durch ein unbekanntes Trennzeichen getrennt ist, aufteilen. Wenn das Trennzeichen nicht gefunden wird, soll eine spezifische Exception ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` in einem `TRY...CATCH` Block und prüfen Sie das Ergebnis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS: 
      split_with_error_handling
        IMPORTING
          iv_input_string TYPE string
          iv_delimiter    TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table
        RAISING
          zcx_delimiter_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_count) TYPE i.

    SPLIT lv_temp_string AT iv_delimiter INTO TABLE rt_parts.
    lv_count = lines( rt_parts ).

    IF lv_count = 1 AND rt_parts[1] = iv_input_string.
      " If split results in only one part and it's the original string,
      " the delimiter was not found.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_delimiter_not_found(
        textid = zcx_delimiter_not_found=>delimiter_not_found
        delimiter = iv_delimiter ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) in ein Format umwandelt, das für die `cl_gui_chart_engine` geeignet ist, und dabei nur die Top N Fluggesellschaften nach Anzahl der Flüge berücksichtigt. Nutzen Sie `SORT`, `GROUP BY` und `FOR`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SORT`, `GROUP BY` und `FOR` mit `UP TO N ROWS` für die Top-N-Auswahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_top_n_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_top_n_data,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        num_flights TYPE i,
      END OF ty_top_n_data,
      tt_top_n_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_top_n_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_n_data) TYPE tt_top_n_data.

    METHODS display_chart_top_n
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_top_n_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_top_n_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA lt_aggregated TYPE tt_top_n_data.

    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    lt_aggregated = VALUE tt_top_n_data(
                      FOR GROUPS <group> OF <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                      GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid )
                      ( carrid = <group>-carrid
                        num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).

    SORT lt_aggregated BY num_flights DESCENDING.

    rt_top_n_data = VALUE tt_top_n_data(
                      FOR ls_entry IN lt_aggregated UP TO iv_top_n ROWS
                      ( ls_entry ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart_top_n.
    " In a real scenario:
    " DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( ... ).
    " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( parent = lo_container ).
    " lo_chart->set_data_from_internal_table(
    "   i_table_name = 'IT_DATA'
    "   i_x_axis_field = 'CARRID'
    "   i_y_axis_field = 'NUM_FLIGHTS'
    "   i_title = |Top { lines( it_data ) } Fluggesellschaften|
    "   i_data_table = it_data ).
    " lo_chart->draw( ).

    " For demonstration, we just output the prepared data
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      WRITE: / ls_data-carrid, ls_data-num_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_first_part DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_split_result,
        first_part TYPE string,
        rest_part  TYPE string,
      END OF ty_split_result.

    METHODS split_at_first_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiter    TYPE string

        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_split_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_first_part IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_at_first_delimiter.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.

    SPLIT lv_temp_string AT iv_delimiter INTO rs_result-first_part rs_result-rest_part.

    " If delimiter not found, SPLIT puts entire string into first_part
    " and leaves rest_part initial. This is the desired behavior.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Eigenschaften eines `cl_gui_chart_engine` Objekts basierend auf einer Konfigurationstabelle dynamisch setzt. Die Konfigurationstabelle enthält Schlüssel-Wert-Paare für die Eigenschaften.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `CASE` oder `COND` für die dynamische Eigenschaftszuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_props DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_chart_property,
        name  TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_chart_property,
      tt_chart_properties TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_property WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_chart_properties
      IMPORTING
        io_chart TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine
        it_properties TYPE tt_chart_properties.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_props IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_chart_properties.
    IF io_chart IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_properties INTO DATA(ls_prop).
      CASE ls_prop-name.
        WHEN 'TITLE'.
          io_chart->set_title( ls_prop-value ).
        WHEN 'CHART_TYPE'.
          DATA(lv_chart_type) TYPE i.
          TRY.
              lv_chart_type = CONV i( ls_prop-value ).
              io_chart->set_chart_type( lv_chart_type ).
            CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
              " Log error: Invalid chart type value
          ENDTRY.
        WHEN 'X_AXIS_LABEL'.
          io_chart->set_x_axis_label( ls_prop-value ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Handle unknown property or log it
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine ganzzahlige Zufallszahl zwischen einem gegebenen Minimum und Maximum (inklusive).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float=>create()` und `get_next()` in Kombination mit mathematischen Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_int IMPORTING iv_min TYPE i iv_max TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_random_int) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_random_int_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_int.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Flügen, die von einer bestimmten Stadt abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fromcity TYPE sflight-fromcity,
             tocity   TYPE sflight-tocity,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_from_city TYPE sflight-fromcity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fromcity, tocity
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fromcity = iv_from_city ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_no_flights_found FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_city( 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights should be found for FRANKFURT' act = lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fromcity exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_no_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_city( 'NONEXISTENTCITY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `DELETE WHERE` Anweisungen. Er verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich und ist ein Kernbestandteil funktionaler Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Constructor Expression, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer aus der `sflights` Tabelle enthält, und formatieren Sie die Flugnummer als String mit führenden Nullen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_map_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_id  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_map_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                ( carrier_id = ls_flight-carrid
                                  flight_id  = |{ ls_flight-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_map_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summaries ).
    LOOP AT lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary-carrier_id ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary-flight_id ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_char_cp( act = ls_summary-flight_id exp = '0*' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_empty_input.
    " This test assumes SFLIGHT might be empty, which is unlikely in a standard system.
    " For a real scenario, mock data would be used.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_map_sflights( ).
    " To simulate empty input, we would need to mock the SELECT statement.
    " For this example, we rely on SFLIGHT having data.
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).
    IF lines( lt_summaries ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summaries ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summaries ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen, was den Code kompakter und verständlicher macht. String-Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine flexible Formatierung, hier mit der Option `ALPHA = OUT` für führende Nullen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, String Templates, SFLIGHT, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in der `sflights` Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_occupied_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rv_total_occupied_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                        FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total >= 0 ) ).
    " Assuming SFLIGHT has data, we can assert > 0
    DATA(lv_count_sflight) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_count_sflight.
    IF lv_count_sflight > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_empty_table_sum.
    " This test would require mocking the SELECT statement to return an empty table.
    " For demonstration, we assume a scenario where the table could be empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    " If SFLIGHT was empty, the result should be 0.
    " As we cannot easily mock SELECT here, this test is conceptual.
    " If SFLIGHT is empty, the result should be 0.
    " For now, we just assert it's non-negative.
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total >= 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen über interne Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung auszudrücken, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und funktionaler macht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die verkettet aufgerufen werden können, um einen String zu manipulieren (z.B. trimmen, in Großbuchstaben umwandeln).
hint: Verwenden Sie `RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_manipulator` in den Methoden, um die Instanz des Objekts zurückzugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_manipulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_manipulator.
    METHODS trim_spaces RETURNING VALUE(me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_manipulator.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_manipulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    TRANSLATE mv_string TO UPPER CASE.
    me = me. " Return current instance
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim_spaces.
    CONDENSE mv_string NO-GAPS.
    me = me. " Return current instance
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der `sflights` Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    flight_num = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_counts ).
    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_count-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_count-flight_num > 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_group_flights_empty.
    " This test would require mocking the SELECT statement to return an empty table.
    " For now, we assume SFLIGHT has data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    IF lines( lt_flight_counts ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flight_counts ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_counts ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` ist eine spezielle Variable, die die Anzahl der Einträge in der aktuellen Gruppe zurückgibt, was Aggregationen vereinfacht.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem gegebenen String und geben Sie diese als interne Tabelle von Strings zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit `RESULTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers_from_string.
    DATA lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\d+' IN iv_input_string RESULTS lt_matches.

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches
                            ( substring( val = iv_input_string off = ls_match-offset len = ls_match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_numbers_with_text FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_single_number.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_numbers_from_string( 'abc123def' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_extract_multiple_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_extract_numbers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = '2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = '3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_numbers_from_string( 'abcdef' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_numbers_with_text.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_numbers_from_string( 'Order 123 has 45 items.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Parsen Sie eine einfache CSV-Zeile aus einem String in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und die Methode `PARSE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parse_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS parse_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_line TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parsed_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parse_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_string.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_separator = ','
      i_has_header = abap_false
    ).
    lo_csv_parser->parse(
      EXPORTING
        i_content = iv_csv_line
      IMPORTING
        e_table   = DATA(lt_raw_data)
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_raw_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_raw_line>).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        field1 = <fs_raw_line>[ 1 ]
        field2 = <fs_raw_line>[ 2 ]
        field3 = <fs_raw_line>[ 3 ]
      ) TO rt_parsed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Sekunden, Minuten oder Stunden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `DIFFERENCE` von `cl_abap_tstmp` und teilen Sie das Ergebnis entsprechend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_difference_in_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_seconds) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_difference_in_minutes
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_minutes) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_difference_in_hours
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hours) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_difference_in_seconds.
    rv_seconds = cl_abap_tstmp=>difference(
      i_timestamp1 = iv_timestamp1
      i_timestamp2 = iv_timestamp2
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_difference_in_minutes.
    DATA(lv_seconds) = get_difference_in_seconds( iv_timestamp1, iv_timestamp2 ).
    rv_minutes = lv_seconds / 60.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_difference_in_hours.
    DATA(lv_seconds) = get_difference_in_seconds( iv_timestamp1, iv_timestamp2 ).
    rv_hours = lv_seconds / 3600.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_difference( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp_start) = '20231101100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_end)   = '20231101110530.0000000'. " 1 hour, 5 minutes, 30 seconds later

    " Difference in seconds
    DATA(lv_diff_sec) = lo_cut->get_difference_in_seconds(
      iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp_end
      iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp_start
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_diff_sec
      exp = 3930 " 3600 (1h) + 300 (5min) + 30 (30s)
    ).

    " Difference in minutes (integer division)
    DATA(lv_diff_min) = lo_cut->get_difference_in_minutes(
      iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp_end
      iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp_start
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_diff_min
      exp = 65 " 3930 / 60 = 65.5 -> 65
    ).

    " Difference in hours (integer division)
    DATA(lv_diff_hr) = lo_cut->get_difference_in_hours(
      iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp_end
      iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp_start
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_diff_hr
      exp = 1 " 3930 / 3600 = 1.09 -> 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `DIFFERENCE` von `cl_abap_tstmp` berechnet die Differenz zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Sekunden. Dies ist die präferierte Methode gegenüber manuellen Berechnungen und ermöglicht eine einfache Umrechnung in andere Zeiteinheiten. Die Kapselung in Methoden für Minuten und Stunden demonstriert gute Praxis.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_adjust DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_current DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_current_timestamp

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_current_timestamp FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_current_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_current( ).
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = lo_cut->get_current_timestamp( ).

    " Assert that the timestamp is not initial (i.e., it was retrieved)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs(
      act = lv_current_tstmp
      exp = ''
    ).
    " Optionally, check if it's within a reasonable range (e.g., last 5 seconds)
    DATA(lv_expected_min) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract_seconds( i_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_current_tstmp( ) i_seconds = 5 ).
    DATA(lv_expected_max) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add_seconds( i_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_current_tstmp( ) i_seconds = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_current_tstmp >= lv_expected_min AND lv_current_tstmp <= lv_expected_max )
      msg = 'Current timestamp should be within the last 5 seconds'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Zeitstempel in eine andere Zeitzone.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` in Kombination mit `CONVERT_TSTMP_TO_DATETIME` und `CONVERT_DATETIME_TO_TSTMP` unter Angabe der Zeitzone.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_timezone DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_tstmp_to_timezone
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_from_tzone TYPE timezone
        iv_to_tzone   TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_timezone IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_tstmp_to_timezone.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d, lv_time TYPE t.

    " Convert original timestamp to date/time in source timezone
    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_datetime(
      EXPORTING
        i_timestamp = iv_timestamp
        i_tzone     = iv_from_tzone
      IMPORTING
        e_date      = lv_date
        e_time      = lv_time
    ).

    " Convert date/time from source timezone to timestamp in target timezone
    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_datetime_to_tstmp(
      EXPORTING
        i_date      = lv_date
        i_time      = lv_time
        i_tzone     = iv_to_tzone
      IMPORTING
        e_timestamp = rv_converted_timestamp
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_timezone FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_timezone.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_timezone( ).
    DATA(lv_utc_tstmp) = '20231203100000.0000000'. " 10:00:00 UTC

    " Convert UTC to Berlin (CET/CEST, usually +1 or +2)
    " Assuming CET (+1) for 2023-12-03
    DATA(lv_berlin_tstmp) = lo_cut->convert_tstmp_to_timezone(
      iv_timestamp  = lv_utc_tstmp
      iv_from_tzone = 'UTC'
      iv_to_tzone   = 'CET'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_berlin_tstmp
      exp = '20231203110000.0000000' " 11:00:00 CET
    ).

    " Convert UTC to New York (EST/EDT, usually -5 or -4)
    " Assuming EST (-5) for 2023-12-03
    DATA(lv_ny_tstmp) = lo_cut->convert_tstmp_to_timezone(
      iv_timestamp  = lv_utc_tstmp
      iv_from_tzone = 'UTC'
      iv_to_tzone   = 'EST'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_ny_tstmp
      exp = '20231203050000.0000000' " 05:00:00 EST
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Umrechnung von Zeitstempeln zwischen Zeitzonen ist eine komplexe Aufgabe, die `cl_abap_tstmp` durch die Angabe der Zeitzone in `CONVERT_TSTMP_TO_DATETIME` und `CONVERT_DATETIME_TO_TSTMP` vereinfacht. Dies gewährleistet die korrekte Berücksichtigung von Sommerzeit und Zeitzonenverschiebungen.
keywords: Timestamp, Timezone, Conversion, cl_abap_tstmp, Date/Time, Advanced

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle in eine CSV-Zeichenkette, wobei bestimmte Felder nicht in Anführungszeichen gesetzt werden sollen, auch wenn sie Sonderzeichen enthalten.
hint: Die `cl_icf_csv` Klasse bietet keine direkte Option, einzelne Felder von der Anführungszeichen-Logik auszuschließen. Eine mögliche Lösung ist die manuelle Vorverarbeitung der Daten oder die Verwendung von `cl_abap_string_utilities` für komplexere Szenarien, aber für dieses Beispiel halten wir uns an die Standardfunktionalität von `cl_icf_csv` und demonstrieren die `i_has_quotes` Option.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_selective_quotes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_item,
             id          TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             comment     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_item.
    TYPES tt_data_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS serialize_selective_quotes
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_selective_quotes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_selective_quotes.
    " cl_icf_csv applies quoting globally. To achieve selective quoting,
    " one would typically need to pre-process the data or use a different approach.
    " For this example, we demonstrate the global quoting behavior.
    DATA(lo_csv_serializer) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_separator  = ';'
      i_has_header = abap_true
      i_has_quotes = abap_true " Global quoting for all fields
    ).
    lo_csv_serializer->serialize(
      EXPORTING
        i_table   = it_data
      IMPORTING
        e_content = rv_csv_output
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_selective FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_selective.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_selective_quotes( ).
    DATA(lt_input_data) = VALUE zcl_csv_selective_quotes=>tt_data_item(
      ( id = 1 description = 'Item A; with semicolon' comment = 'No quotes here' )
      ( id = 2 description = 'Item B, with comma'     comment = 'Also no quotes' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_csv) = 'ID;DESCRIPTION;COMMENT' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            '1;"Item A; with semicolon";"No quotes here"' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            '2;"Item B, with comma";"Also no quotes"' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_result_csv) = lo_cut->serialize_selective_quotes( lt_input_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_csv
      exp = lv_expected_csv
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `cl_icf_csv` Klasse wendet die Anführungszeichen-Logik global auf alle Felder an. CLASS zcl_tstmp_validation IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_valid_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_validation( ).

    " Valid timestamp
    DATA(lv_valid_tstmp) = '20231203123000.0000000'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_valid( lv_invalid_tstmp2 )
      msg = 'Invalid timestamp (invalid chars) should return false'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Namen und Datentypen aller Komponenten einer gegebenen Struktur. Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit Komponentennamen und ihren ABAP-Typen sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).

    IF lo_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
      DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
      LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_component-name type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) TO rt_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise (Feld `PRICE` aus `SFLIGHTS`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (Feld `CARRID` aus `SFLIGHTS`) unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife über eine gefilterte interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_flight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_flight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_price_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_price.
    " Setup test data (assuming SFLIGHTS has data for 'AA')
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_flight_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = VALUE sflight-price( ).

    " Manually calculate expected sum for 'AA' if SFLIGHTS is empty or for specific test data
    " For this example, we assume SFLIGHTS contains some data for 'AA'
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @lv_expected_sum.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_price_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_flight_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ist ein leistungsstarker Konstruktor-Ausdruck, der eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert reduziert. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` ermöglicht sie eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Aggregation von Daten, hier die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu traditionellen `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit expliziten Summenvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Summe, Interne Tabelle, SFLIGHTS, NUMBER, Aggregation

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf den Wert einer Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Geben Sie den Wert als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure    TYPE any
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_component> }|.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Component '{ iv_component_name }' not found in structure.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Währung (Feld `CURRENCY` aus `SFLIGHTS`) unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder `FOR`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_avg_price_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_currency,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             avg_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_currency.
    TYPES tt_avg_price_by_currency TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_currency WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price_by_currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_by_currency.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_avg_price_currency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_currency.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-currency.
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT s = ( VALUE decfloat16( ) )
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i(
        INIT c = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT c = c + 1
      ).

      IF lv_count > 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( currency = ls_flight-currency avg_price = lv_sum_price / lv_count ) TO rt_avg_prices.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_price_currency FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_avg_price_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_price_currency.
    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has data, e.g., 'EUR' and 'USD'
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_avg_price_currency( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_average_price_by_currency( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_avg_prices ).

    " Example: Check for 'EUR' average
    DATA(lv_expected_eur_sum) = VALUE sflight-price( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_eur_count) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight WHERE currency = 'EUR' INTO @lv_expected_eur_sum.
    SELECT COUNT( * ) FROM sflight WHERE currency = 'EUR' INTO @lv_expected_eur_count.

    IF lv_expected_eur_count > 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_eur_avg) = CONV decfloat16( lv_expected_eur_sum ) / lv_expected_eur_count.
      DATA(ls_eur_result) = lt_avg_prices[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS currency = 'EUR' ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_eur_result-avg_price exp = lv_expected_eur_avg msg = 'Average for EUR mismatch' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_price_empty_table.
    " This test would require mocking SFLIGHTS or ensuring it's empty
    " For simplicity, we'll just check if the result is empty if no data is found.
    " (In a real scenario, you'd ensure SFLIGHTS is empty or mock the SELECT statement)
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_avg_price_currency( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_average_price_by_currency( ).
    " If SFLIGHTS is empty, lt_avg_prices should be empty.
    " If SFLIGHTS is not empty, this test might fail if no groups are formed.
    " A more robust test would involve controlling SFLIGHTS data.
    " For now, we assume it might return data.
    IF lines( lt_avg_prices ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_avg_prices ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Aggregationen auf gruppierten Daten durchzuführen. `GROUP BY` erstellt temporäre Gruppen, über die dann mit `FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight` iteriert werden kann. `REDUCE` wird hier zweimal verwendet, um die Summe und die Anzahl der Elemente pro Gruppe zu ermitteln, woraus dann der Durchschnitt berechnet wird. `DECFLOAT16` wird für präzise Gleitkommaberechnungen verwendet.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Durchschnitt, Währung, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, DECFLOAT16

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur einer vorhandenen internen Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit einigen Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE any TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_line> TYPE any.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table )
    ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    IF <fs_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
        CREATE DATA DATA(lr_dynamic_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        ASSIGN lr_dynamic_line->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.
        IF <fs_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_dynamic_line> = <fs_source_line>.
          APPEND <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_line,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_line.
    TYPES tt_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_test_table(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Entry 1' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Entry 2' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_source ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_test_line.
    READ TABLE <fs_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-text exp = 'Entry 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_empty_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_line,
             id   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_line.
    TYPES tt_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_test_table( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_source ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_dynamic_table> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI und `CREATE DATA` dynamisch interne Tabellen zur Laufzeit erstellen kann. Zuerst wird die Typbeschreibung der Quelltabelle ermittelt (`CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`). Dann wird mit `CREATE DATA` eine neue Tabelle dieses Typs erzeugt und ihr Referenz auf ein `FIELD-SYMBOL` zugewiesen. Anschließend werden die Daten zeilenweise von der Quelltabelle in die dynamisch erzeugte Tabelle kopiert. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept für generische Frameworks und Tools.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamisch, Interne Tabelle, CREATE DATA, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, FIELD-SYMBOLS

CLASS zcl_num_overflow_check IMPLEMENTATION.

            text = |Overflow occurred during conversion of { iv_large_number } to type B.|.

explanation: Die `CONV`-Anweisung ist ein moderner Konstruktor-Ausdruck zur Typkonvertierung. Wenn bei der Konvertierung von einem größeren in einen kleineren numerischen Typ ein Überlauf auftritt, wird die vordefinierte Ausnahme `CX_SY_CONVERSION_OVERFLOW` ausgelöst. Diese kann mit einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block abgefangen und entsprechend behandelt werden, was zu robusterem Code führt. Dies ist eine saubere Methode, um potenzielle Datenverluste oder unerwartetes Verhalten bei numerischen Operationen zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Strukturen dynamisch Komponente für Komponente und geben Sie an, ob sie identisch sind. Ignorieren Sie dabei Komponenten, die in beiden Strukturen nicht vorhanden sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Zugriff auf Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_structure1 TYPE any
        is_structure2 TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp1> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp2> TYPE any.

    DATA(lo_descr1) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure1 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_descr2) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure2 )
    ).

    rv_are_equal = abap_true.

    " Compare components of structure 1 against structure 2
    LOOP AT lo_descr1->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp1-name OF STRUCTURE is_structure1 TO <fs_comp1>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp1-name OF STRUCTURE is_structure2 TO <fs_comp2>.

      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Component exists in both structures
        IF <fs_comp1> <> <fs_comp2>.
          rv_are_equal = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Compare components of structure 2 against structure 1 (for components only in struct2)
    LOOP AT lo_descr2->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_comp2).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp2-name OF STRUCTURE is_structure1 TO <fs_comp1>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp2-name OF STRUCTURE is_structure2 TO <fs_comp2>.

      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Component exists in both structures (already checked above, but ensures no missing check)
        " No need to re-check equality, just ensure it exists in struct1 if it's in struct2
      ELSE. " Component exists only in structure 2, so structures are different
        rv_are_equal = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Schlüsseldefinition (Komponenten und Typ) einer internen Tabelle. Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit Schlüsselkomponentennamen und deren ABAP-Typen sein.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_keys DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_key_component_info.
    TYPES tt_key_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_key_components
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE any TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_key_components) TYPE tt_key_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_keys IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_key_components.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table )
    ).

    LOOP AT lo_table_descr->get_keys( ) INTO DATA(ls_key).
      LOOP AT ls_key-components INTO DATA(ls_key_comp).
        APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_key_comp-name type = ls_key_comp-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) TO rt_key_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den maximalen und minimalen Flugpreis in einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `MAX`/`MIN` Ausdrücken.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `MAX` und `MIN` für kompakte Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_min_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_min_max_price,
             min_price TYPE sflight-price,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_min_max_price.

    METHODS get_min_max_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_min_max) TYPE ty_min_max_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_min_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_max_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rs_min_max-min_price = REDUCE #( INIT min_val = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price
                                       FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                       NEXT min_val = nmin( min_val = min_val val = ls_flight-price ) ).
      rs_min_max-max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_val = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price
                                       FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                       NEXT max_val = nmax( max_val = max_val val = ls_flight-price ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has data
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_min_max_price( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_min_max_flight_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_result-min_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_result-max_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_result-min_price <= ls_result-max_price ).

    " Verify against actual values (requires SFLIGHTS data)
    DATA(lv_expected_min) = VALUE sflight-price( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_max) = VALUE sflight-price( ).
    SELECT MIN( price ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_min.
    SELECT MAX( price ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_max.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-min_price exp = lv_expected_min ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-max_price exp = lv_expected_max ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_min_max_empty_table.
    " This test would require mocking SFLIGHTS or ensuring it's empty
    " For simplicity, we'll just check if the result is initial.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_min_max_price( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_min_max_flight_price( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_result-min_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_result-max_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung in Kombination mit den eingebauten Funktionen `NMIN` und `NMAX` bietet eine sehr elegante und performante Möglichkeit, den minimalen und maximalen Wert in einer internen Tabelle zu finden. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingungen zu schreiben, wird der Reduktionsprozess genutzt, um den Extremwert iterativ zu bestimmen. Dies ist ein hervorragendes Beispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Code.
keywords: REDUCE, MAX, MIN, Interne Tabelle, SFLIGHTS, NUMBER, Aggregation

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine gegebene Datenreferenz auf eine interne Tabelle zeigt und ob diese Tabelle leer ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` sowie `IS INITIAL` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_table_empty
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_empty) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial
        cx_sy_move_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_table_empty.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    IF ir_data IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    IF lo_typedescr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_table.
      " Cast to table descriptor is not strictly needed for IS INITIAL, but good for type check
      " DATA(lo_tabledescr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).
      ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_table>.
      IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_table> IS INITIAL.
        rv_is_empty = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        rv_is_empty = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_move_cast_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Data reference does not point to an internal table.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_round_decimal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_decimals TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rounded_number) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Struktur basierend auf einer Liste von Komponentendefinitionen (Name und Typ).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_create_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_def.
    TYPES tt_component_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_structure
      IMPORTING
        it_component_defs TYPE tt_component_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_structure) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_creation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_create_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_structure.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_component_defs INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
      DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_comp_def-type ).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_comp_def-name type_descr = lo_typedescr ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_structdescr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_structure TYPE HANDLE lo_structdescr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_struct FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_create_invalid_type FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_struct_creation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_struct.
    DATA(lt_comp_defs) = VALUE zcl_rtti_create_struct=>tt_component_def(

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_create_struct( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_struct> TYPE any.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_dynamic_struct> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_id> TYPE i.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_id> ).
    <fs_id> = 100.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_id> exp = 100 ).

  METHOD test_create_empty_struct.
    DATA(lt_comp_defs) = VALUE zcl_rtti_create_struct=>tt_component_def( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_create_struct( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_struct) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_structure( lt_comp_defs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_struct> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_struct->* TO <fs_dynamic_struct>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_dynamic_struct> ).
    " An empty structure is still a valid structure
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid_type.
    DATA(lt_comp_defs) = VALUE zcl_rtti_create_struct=>tt_component_def(
      ( name = 'INVALID' type = 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_create_struct( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = NEW zcx_abap_unit_assert_raises( ) ).
    lo_cut->create_dynamic_structure( lt_comp_defs ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI dynamisch eine Struktur zur Laufzeit erstellen kann. Eine Liste von Komponentendefinitionen (Name und ABAP-Typ als String) wird verwendet, um eine `COMPONENT_TABLE` für `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE` zu erstellen. `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_NAME` wird verwendet, um die Typbeschreibung für jeden Komponententyp zu erhalten. Anschließend wird mit `CREATE DATA` eine Datenreferenz auf die dynamisch erstellte Struktur erzeugt. Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für die Entwicklung generischer Anwendungen, die flexible Datenstrukturen benötigen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamisch, Struktur, CREATE DATA, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, FIELD-SYMBOLS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadratzahlen aller geraden Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle von Ganzzahlen unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für die Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_sum_even_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_even_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_sum_even_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_even_squares.
    rv_sum = REDUCE #( INIT s = 0
                       FOR n IN it_numbers WHERE ( n MOD 2 = 0 )
                       NEXT s = s + ( n * n ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_even_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_even_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_even_numbers.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 2 ) ( 4 ) ( 6 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_sum_even_squares( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_even_squares( lt_numbers ).
    " 2*2 + 4*4 + 6*6 = 4 + 16 + 36 = 56
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 56 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_numbers.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_sum_even_squares( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_even_squares( lt_numbers ).
    " 2*2 + 4*4 = 4 + 16 = 20
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_even_numbers.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 3 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_sum_even_squares( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_even_squares( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_sum_even_squares( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_even_squares( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung. Die `WHERE`-Bedingung (`n MOD 2 = 0`) filtert die internen Tabellenzeilen, sodass nur gerade Zahlen verarbeitet werden. Für jede gefilterte Zahl wird dann das Quadrat berechnet (`n * n`) und zur Summe addiert. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte, lesbare und effiziente Methode, um komplexe Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen, die traditionell mehrere Zeilen Code erfordert hätten.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Summe, Quadrat, Interne Tabelle, NUMBER, Aggregation
