Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie Daten aus einer bestehenden internen Tabelle filtern und nur die korrespondierenden Felder in die neue Tabelle kopieren, unter Verwendung des `VALUE` Operators und einer `FOR`-Schleife.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` mit `CORRESPONDING #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_corr_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_corr_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_target_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_source_flights
        WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) 
        ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_it_corr_for_value=>tt_sflight_full.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251203'.
    <fs_flight>-price = '100'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    <fs_flight>-planetype = 'A320'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_source ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251204'.
    <fs_flight>-price = '200'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.
    <fs_flight>-planetype = 'B747'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_corr_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_source_flights = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verwendet den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und `CORRESPONDING #( ... )` um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen. Dies ermöglicht eine kompakte und deklarative Transformation von Daten, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen kopiert werden.
keywords: INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Data Transformation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach einem bestimmten Kriterium und kopieren Sie die gefilterten Einträge in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer reduzierten Struktur, wobei nur korrespondierende Felder übernommen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` und `CORRESPONDING #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full
        iv_carrid         TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_source_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
        ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE s_price
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine komplexe Transformation einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten durch, indem Sie den `FOR` Operator verwenden, um neue Strukturen zu erstellen und dabei nur korrespondierende Felder zu übernehmen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` mit `CORRESPONDING #( ... )` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_corr_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_processed,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             formatted_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_processed.
    TYPES tt_sflight_processed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_processed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_processed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_corr_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( 
          ls_raw 
          MAPPING 
            airline_id = carrid 
            flight_num = connid 
            flight_date = fldate 
          EXCEPT 
            price currency 
          ADD 
            formatted_price = |{ ls_raw-price } { ls_raw-currency }|
        ) 
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_raw TYPE zcl_it_for_corr_map=>tt_sflight_raw.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_raw ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_raw>).
    <fs_raw>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_raw>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_raw>-fldate = '20251203'.
    <fs_raw>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_raw>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_corr_map( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_flight_data( it_raw_flights = lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-flight_num exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-formatted_price exp = '100.00 EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING` ermöglicht eine sehr flexible und deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Man kann Felder umbenennen (`MAPPING`), ausschließen (`EXCEPT`) und neue Felder hinzufügen (`ADD`), was den Code für komplexe Mappings extrem vereinfacht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, ADD, Internal Tables, Data Transformation

CLASS zcl_date_is_weekend DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_date) = cl_reca_date=>create( iv_date ).

CLASS zcl_it_copy_corr_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_mime_type_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_mime_type = VALUE #(
      CASE iv_file_extension && ''
        WHEN 'pdf' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_application_pdf

        WHEN 'png' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_png

        WHEN 'xml' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_application_xml

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle direkten Unterpakete eines gegebenen ABAP-Entwicklungspakets und geben Sie diese als String-Tabelle zurück. Behandeln Sie mögliche Ausnahmen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die statische Methode GET_ALL_SUBPACKAGES der Klasse CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES und eine TRY-CATCH-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_package_subpackages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_direct_subpackages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_subpackages) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_pak_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_package_subpackages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_direct_subpackages.
    TRY.
        cl_pak_package_queries=>get_all_subpackages(
          EXPORTING
            i_package     = iv_package_name
            i_direct_only = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            r_subpackages = DATA(lt_devclasses)
        ).
        rt_subpackages = VALUE #( FOR ls_devclass IN lt_devclasses ( ls_devclass ) ).
      CATCH cx_pak_exception INTO DATA(lx_pak_exception).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_pak_exception
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_pak_exception.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener MIME-Typ zu einer Liste von erlaubten Bild-MIME-Typen gehört. Nutzen Sie hierfür die Konstanten von CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES und moderne Tabellenoperationen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_image_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_image) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_image_mime_type.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_allowed_image_types,
                 jpeg TYPE string VALUE cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_jpeg,
                 png  TYPE string VALUE cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_png,
                 gif  TYPE string VALUE cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_gif,
                 bmp  TYPE string VALUE cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_bmp,
               END OF gc_allowed_image_types.

    DATA(lt_allowed_types) = VALUE string_table(
      ( gc_allowed_image_types-jpeg )
      ( gc_allowed_image_types-png )
      ( gc_allowed_image_types-gif )
      ( gc_allowed_image_types-bmp )
    ).

    rv_is_image = COND abap_bool( WHEN line_exists( lt_allowed_types[ table_line = iv_mime_type ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie den MAP-Operator (FOR ... IN ... MAPPING) in Kombination mit dem COND-Operator und den Konstanten von CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_extensions_to_mimes
      IMPORTING
        it_extensions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mime_types) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_extensions_to_mimes.
    rt_mime_types = VALUE #( FOR extension IN it_extensions
                             LET mime_type = COND string(
                               CASE extension && ''
                                 WHEN 'pdf' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_application_pdf
                                 WHEN 'jpg' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_jpeg
                                 WHEN 'png' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_png
                                 WHEN 'txt' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_text_plain
                                 WHEN 'xml' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_application_xml
                                 WHEN 'json' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_application_json
                                 ELSE '' " Filter out unknown extensions by returning initial
                               END )
                             WHERE ( mime_type IS NOT INITIAL )
                             ( mime_type ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_package_class_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_classes_in_package_tree
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_class_names) TYPE string_table
      RAISING

CLASS zcl_package_class_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_classes_in_package_tree.
    DATA: lt_packages TYPE cl_pak_package_queries=>tt_devclass.
    APPEND iv_package_name TO lt_packages.

    TRY.
        cl_pak_package_queries=>get_all_subpackages(
          EXPORTING
            i_package     = iv_package_name
            i_direct_only = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            r_subpackages = DATA(lt_subpackages)
        ).
        APPEND LINES OF lt_subpackages TO lt_packages.

        rt_class_names = VALUE #( FOR package IN lt_packages
                                  LET objects = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_development_objects( package )
                                  FOR object IN objects
                                  WHERE ( object_type = 'CLAS' )
                                  ( object-object_name ) ).
      CATCH cx_pak_exception INTO DATA(lx_pak_exception).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_pak_exception
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_pak_exception.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle ABAP-Klassen, die in einem gegebenen Paket oder seinen direkten Unterpaketen definiert sind und deren Namen einem bestimmten Muster entsprechen (z.B. 'ZCL_DEMO*'). Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Tabellenoperatoren und String-Funktionen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie die Logik aus PAK_005 mit einer zusätzlichen Filterung mittels CP-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_package_class_pattern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_classes_by_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
        iv_class_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_class_names) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_pak_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_package_class_pattern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_classes_by_pattern.
    DATA: lt_packages TYPE cl_pak_package_queries=>tt_devclass.
    APPEND iv_package_name TO lt_packages.

    TRY.
        cl_pak_package_queries=>get_all_subpackages(
          EXPORTING
            i_package     = iv_package_name
            i_direct_only = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            r_subpackages = DATA(lt_subpackages)
        ).
        APPEND LINES OF lt_subpackages TO lt_packages.

        rt_class_names = VALUE #( FOR package IN lt_packages
                                  LET objects = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_development_objects( package )
                                  FOR object IN objects
                                  WHERE ( object_type = 'CLAS' AND object-object_name CP iv_class_pattern )
                                  ( object-object_name ) ).
      CATCH cx_pak_exception INTO DATA(lx_pak_exception).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_pak_exception
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_pak_exception.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Produkt-IDs und deren Status (als Enumeration) erhält und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die die ID und die Textbeschreibung des Status enthält. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und einer `CASE`-Expression.

CLASS zcl_enum_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM product_status,
             new,
             in_progress,
             completed,
           END OF ENUM product_status.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_input,
             id     TYPE i,
             status TYPE product_status,
           END OF ty_product_input.
    TYPES: ty_product_inputs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_output,
             id          TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_product_output.
    TYPES: ty_product_outputs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_status_to_description
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE ty_product_inputs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_products_desc) TYPE ty_product_outputs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_status_to_description.
    rt_products_desc = VALUE #( FOR product IN it_products ( 
      id          = product-id
      description = CASE product-status
                      WHEN product_status=>new         THEN 'New Product'
                      WHEN product_status=>in_progress THEN 'Product in Progress'
                      WHEN product_status=>completed   THEN 'Product Completed'
                      ELSE 'Unknown Status'
                    END
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD get_next_phase.
    rv_next_phase = CASE iv_current_phase

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Produkte mit dem Status 'Neu' in einer Produktliste. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR product IN it_products WHERE ( ... ) NEXT count = count + 1 )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM product_status,
             new,
             in_progress,
             completed,
           END OF ENUM product_status.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE product_status,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: ty_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_new_products
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE ty_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_new_products.
    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                             FOR product IN it_products
                             WHERE ( status = product_status=>new )
                             NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_new_products FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_new_products.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_enum_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_products) = VALUE zcl_enum_reduce=>ty_products(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Product A' status = zcl_enum_reduce=>product_status=>new )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Product B' status = zcl_enum_reduce=>product_status=>in_progress )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Product C' status = zcl_enum_reduce=>product_status=>completed )
      ( id = 4 name = 'Product D' status = zcl_enum_reduce=>product_status=>new )
      ( id = 5 name = 'Product E' status = zcl_enum_reduce=>product_status=>in_progress )
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_new_products( lt_products ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Weise. Hier wird er verwendet, um Elemente basierend auf einem Enumerationswert zu zählen, was zu expressivem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: ENUMERATION, Internal Tables, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle mit den Namen aller definierten Werte einer Enumeration zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie die RTTI-Klasse `cl_abap_enum_descr` und den `FOR`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_enum_descr=>get_enum_descr` und `get_values` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_all_values DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM traffic_light_phase,
             red,
             yellow,
             green,
           END OF ENUM traffic_light_phase.

    TYPES: ty_enum_value_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_phase_names RETURNING VALUE(rt_phase_names) TYPE ty_enum_value_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_all_values IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_phase_names.
    DATA(lo_enum_descr) = cl_abap_enum_descr=>get_enum_descr(
                                 p_name = 'ZCL_ENUM_ALL_VALUES=>TRAFFIC_LIGHT_PHASE' ).
    DATA(lt_enum_values) = lo_enum_descr->get_values( ).

    rt_phase_names = VALUE #( FOR value_ref IN lt_enum_values ( value_ref->get_name( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_phase_names FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_phase_names.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_enum_all_values( ).
    DATA(lt_phase_names) = lo_cut->get_all_phase_names( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_phase_names ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_phase_names[ 1 ]-table_line ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_phase_names[ 2 ]-table_line exp = 'YELLOW' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit dem `FOR`-Operator und `VALUE` können alle Enumerationswerte effizient in eine interne Tabelle gesammelt werden, was für Metadaten-Operationen nützlich ist.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das inkrementelle Lesen von Daten aus einem externen Stream (z.B. einer Datei, die zeilenweise gelesen wird) und konvertieren Sie jede Zeile von einer bestimmten Codepage.
hint: Der Konverter kann inkrementell Daten lesen, indem `read` mehrfach aufgerufen wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_stream_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_stream_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_stream_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding       TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_stream_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_stream_data.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_length TYPE i,
          lv_chunk  TYPE xstring,
          lv_line   TYPE string.

    lv_length = xstrlen( iv_stream_xstring ).

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_encoding
    ).

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_length.
      " Simulate reading chunks (e.g., a line or a fixed size)
      lv_chunk = iv_stream_xstring+lv_offset(10).
      lo_conv->convert(
        EXPORTING
          input = lv_chunk
        IMPORTING
          data  = lv_line
      ).
      IF lv_line IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND lv_line TO rt_lines.
      ENDIF.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + 10.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Read any remaining data after the last chunk
    lo_conv->flush(
      IMPORTING
        data = lv_line
    ).
    IF lv_line IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND lv_line TO rt_lines.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_codepage_to_codepage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_codepage
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
        iv_target_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_target_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_codepage_to_codepage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_codepage.
    DATA: lv_abap_string TYPE string.

    " First, convert source XSTRING to internal ABAP string
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_source_encoding
      input    = iv_source_xstring
    ).
    lo_conv_in->read(
      IMPORTING
        data = lv_abap_string
    ).

    " Then, convert internal ABAP string to target XSTRING
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_target_encoding
    ).
    lo_conv_out->write(
      EXPORTING
        data = lv_abap_string
    ).
    rv_target_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle SFLIGHTS, filtern Sie nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Währung, um die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Währung zu ermitteln. Verwenden Sie dabei Feldsymbole für den Zugriff auf die Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) mit einer WHERE-Klausel und GROUP BY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_loop_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_count,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ts_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_loop_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
         WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
         GROUP BY <fs_flight>-curr
         ASCENDING INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_flight> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group_member>).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE #( currency = ls_group_key-curr
                      count    = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Begrüßungsnachricht unter Verwendung von String-Templates. Die Nachricht soll sich basierend auf der Tageszeit (Morgen, Tag, Abend) und einem optionalen Benutzernamen anpassen. Verwenden Sie COND und SWITCH für die Logik.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_templates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_username TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_str_templates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    DATA(lv_time) = sy-uzeit. " Current time

    DATA(lv_time_of_day) = SWITCH string( lv_time
      WHEN BETWEEN '060000' AND '115959' THEN 'Morgen'
      WHEN BETWEEN '120000' AND '175959' THEN 'Tag'
      ELSE 'Abend'
    ).

    rv_greeting = |Guten { lv_time_of_day }{ COND string( WHEN iv_username IS NOT INITIAL THEN | { iv_username}| ELSE | | ) }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Kette von Operationen (z.B. Wert setzen, Wert addieren, Wert multiplizieren) auf einem internen Wert ermöglicht, indem Sie Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) verwenden.
hint: Jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (ME) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_method_chain.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_method_chain.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chain FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chain.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_oo_method_chain( 10 ). " Initial value 10
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 5 )->multiply( 2 )->get_result( ). " (10 + 5) * 2 = 30

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = NEW zcl_oo_method_chain( 1 )->add( 1 )->add( 1 )->multiply( 3 )->get_result( ). " (1 + 1 + 1) * 3 = 9
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 9 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht eine flüssige und lesbare Syntax für sequentielle Operationen auf einem Objekt. Jede Methode gibt dabei eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz zurück, was die Verkettung ermöglicht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, Class

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE mit einem initialen Wert und einer Schleife über die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) " Redundant here due to SELECT WHERE, but shows usage
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce( ).
    " Assuming 'AA' has flights with prices in SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price( 'AA' ).

    " For a real test, we'd need to know the exact sum or mock SFLIGHTS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_total ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie ein einfaches XML-Dokument und extrahieren Sie einen Wert. Erläutern Sie, wie die Klasse CL_SECXML_HELPER für Sicherheitsprüfungen in einem realen Szenario verwendet werden könnte.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_SXML_READER zum Parsen von XML. Erwähnen Sie CL_SECXML_HELPER für XML-Sicherheitsprüfungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_xml.
    DATA: lo_sxml_reader TYPE REF TO cl_sxml_reader,
          lx_sxml_error  TYPE REF TO cx_sxml_error.

    TRY.
        lo_sxml_reader = cl_sxml_string_reader=>create( iv_xml_string ).

        DO.
          lo_sxml_reader->next_node( ).
          IF lo_sxml_reader->node_type = if_sxml_reader=>co_nt_element_open AND
             lo_sxml_reader->name = 'Value'.
            lo_sxml_reader->next_node( ).
            IF lo_sxml_reader->node_type = if_sxml_reader=>co_nt_value.
              rv_value = lo_sxml_reader->get_value( ).
              EXIT.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
          IF lo_sxml_reader->node_type = if_sxml_reader=>co_nt_final THEN
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

        lo_sxml_reader->close( ).

      CATCH cx_sxml_error INTO lx_sxml_error.
        " Handle XML parsing error
        rv_value = |Error parsing XML: { lx_sxml_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_xml FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_xml_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<Root><Data><Value>ExpectedData</Value></Data></Root>`. 
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->parse_xml( lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ExpectedData' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_xml_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_xml) = `<Root><Data><Value></Data></Root>`. " Malformed XML
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->parse_xml( lv_invalid_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Error parsing XML' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse CL_SXML_READER bietet einen effizienten Pull-Parser für XML-Dokumente. In Bezug auf Sicherheit ist es wichtig, XML-Dokumente vor der Verarbeitung auf potenzielle Angriffe (z.B. XML External Entity (XXE) Angriffe) zu prüfen. Hierfür kann die Klasse CL_SECXML_HELPER (SXML_SEC) verwendet werden, um XML-Dokumente zu validieren und sicherzustellen, dass sie keine schädlichen Inhalte enthalten, bevor sie geparst werden. Dies ist besonders relevant, wenn XML von externen, nicht vertrauenswürdigen Quellen stammt.
keywords: XML, CL_SXML_READER, CL_SECXML_HELPER, SXML_SEC, Security, XML Parsing

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Verwenden Sie FIELD-SYMBOLS und ASSIGN COMPONENT.
hint: Deklarieren Sie ein Feldsymbol vom Typ ANY TABLE oder ANY und verwenden Sie ASSIGN COMPONENT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ts_data.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ts_data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_component_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_component_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_access=>ts_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_access( ).

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Hello' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_component_not_found.
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_access=>ts_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_access( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_component_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Component not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Komponentenzuweisung mittels FIELD-SYMBOLS und ASSIGN COMPONENT ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in der dynamischen Programmierung. Es ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, was für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Structure Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle transformieren. Für jeden Eintrag in der Quelltabelle soll ein neuer Eintrag in der Zieltabelle erstellt werden, der nur ausgewählte Felder enthält und ein Feld umbenennt. Verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator mit VALUE.
hint: Nutzen Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ) für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_source_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ts_source_flight.
    TYPES: tt_source_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_target_flight,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ts_target_flight.
    TYPES: tt_target_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_target_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_target_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source_flights
                                 ( airline_id  = ls_source-carrid
                                   flight_num  = ls_source-connid
                                   flight_date = ls_source-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Typ eines übergebenen Objekts zur Laufzeit ermittelt und den Klassennamen zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR und ihre Unterklassen, insbesondere CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_name DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_class_name
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_class_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_name IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_name.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
        rv_class_name = lo_class_descr->get_name( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_class_name = 'Not an object reference or cast error'.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_not_found.
        rv_class_name = 'Type description not found'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle E-Mail-Adressen in einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit der Methode `create_with_pattern` und `find_all`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_find_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_find_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_emails.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_with_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND ls_match-found TO rt_emails.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_find_emails( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->find_emails( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = `info@example.com` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = `support@domain.co.uk` ).

Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Muster in Strings zu finden.
keywords: REGEX, FIND, EMAIL, STRING, CL_ABAP_REGEX

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Zeitstempel, den Log-Level und die Nachricht aus einer Logzeile im Format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS [LEVEL] - MESSAGE".
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit Capturing Groups und `find` oder `match` und `get_submatches`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
         timestamp TYPE string,
         level     TYPE string,
         message   TYPE string,
       END OF ty_log_entry.
TYPES: tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_log_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_line TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_log_data.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}) \[([A-Z]+)\] - (.*)$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_with_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_log_line ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      DATA(lt_submatches) = lo_matcher->get_submatches( ).
      rs_log_entry-timestamp = lt_submatches[1]-found.
      rs_log_entry-level = lt_submatches[2]-found.
      rs_log_entry-message = lt_submatches[3]-found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_extract_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_extract_log( ).
    DATA(lv_log_line) = `2023-12-01 10:30:00 [INFO] - Dies ist eine Testnachricht.`.
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->extract_log_data( lv_log_line ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-timestamp exp = `2023-12-01 10:30:00` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-level exp = `INFO` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-message exp = `Dies ist eine Testnachricht.` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_extract_log( ).

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->extract_log_data( lv_log_line ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_result-timestamp ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_result-level ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_result-message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Capturing Groups `(...)` in regulären Ausdrücken sind extrem nützlich, um spezifische Teile eines Strings zu extrahieren. Nach einem erfolgreichen `match` liefert `get_submatches` eine Tabelle mit den gefundenen Gruppen, was eine strukturierte Datenextraktion ermöglicht. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode zur Verarbeitung von strukturierten Textdaten.
keywords: REGEX, EXTRACT, LOG, CAPTURING_GROUPS, CL_ABAP_MATCHER

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen von jeder Zeile in einem mehrzeiligen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit `pcre_options = 'm'` (multi-line) und `replace_all`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_trim_multiline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_multiline_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_trimmed_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_trim_multiline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_lines.
    DATA(lv_pattern_leading) = `^\s+`.
    DATA(lv_pattern_trailing) = `\s+$`.

    DATA(lo_regex_leading) = cl_abap_regex=>create_with_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern_leading pcre_options = 'm' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher_leading) = lo_regex_leading->create_matcher( text = iv_multiline_text ).
    DATA(lv_temp_text) = lo_matcher_leading->replace_all( replacement = `` ).

    DATA(lo_regex_trailing) = cl_abap_regex=>create_with_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern_trailing pcre_options = 'm' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher_trailing) = lo_regex_trailing->create_matcher( text = lv_temp_text ).
    rv_trimmed_text = lo_matcher_trailing->replace_all( replacement = `` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_trim_lines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_trim_lines.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_trim_multiline( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `  Zeile 1 mit Leerzeichen  
    Zeile 2 auch   
Zeile 3 ohne führende, aber mit nachfolgenden   `.
    DATA(lv_expected) = `Zeile 1 mit Leerzeichen
Zeile 2 auch
Zeile 3 ohne führende, aber mit nachfolgenden`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->trim_lines( lv_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `pcre_options = 'm'` (Multi-Line) bewirkt, dass `^` und `$` nicht den Anfang/das Ende des gesamten Strings, sondern den Anfang/das Ende jeder Zeile im String markieren. Dies ermöglicht das gezielte Entfernen von Leerzeichen am Anfang (`^\s+`) und Ende (`\s+$`) jeder einzelnen Zeile, was eine saubere Textverarbeitung für mehrzeilige Inhalte gewährleistet.
keywords: REGEX, WHITESPACE, MULTILINE, REPLACE, STRING_PROCESSING

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen von zwei oder mehr aufeinanderfolgenden Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit dem Muster `\s{2,}` und `replace_all`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_normalize_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS normalize_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_normalized_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_normalize_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_spaces.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\s{2,}`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_with_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    rv_normalized_text = lo_matcher->replace_all( replacement = ` ` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_normalize_spaces FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_change FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_normalize_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_normalize_spaces( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `Dies   ist    ein    Text   mit  vielen    Leerzeichen.`.
    DATA(lv_expected) = `Dies ist ein Text mit vielen Leerzeichen.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->normalize_spaces( lv_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_change.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_normalize_spaces( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `Dies ist ein Text.`.
    DATA(lv_expected) = `Dies ist ein Text.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->normalize_spaces( lv_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der reguläre Ausdruck `\s{2,}` findet zwei oder mehr (`{2,}`) aufeinanderfolgende Leerzeichen (`\s`). Die `replace_all`-Methode ersetzt alle diese Vorkommen durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen, was eine einfache und effektive Normalisierung von Texten ermöglicht.
keywords: REGEX, WHITESPACE, REPLACE, NORMALIZE, CL_ABAP_MATCHER

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt, wobei die Groß- und Kleinschreibung ignoriert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit `pcre_options = 'i'` und dem Anker `^`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_starts_with_ci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS starts_with_prefix_ci
      IMPORTING
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_starts_with) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_starts_with_ci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD starts_with_prefix_ci.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^` && iv_prefix.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_with_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern pcre_options = 'i' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    rv_starts_with = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_starts_with_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_starts_with_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_starts_with_empty_prefix FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_starts_with_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_starts_with_ci( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->starts_with_prefix_ci( iv_text = `HelloWorld` iv_prefix = `hello` ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->starts_with_prefix_ci( iv_text = `ABAP Development` iv_prefix = `abap` ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_starts_with_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_starts_with_ci( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->starts_with_prefix_ci( iv_text = `HelloWorld` iv_prefix = `world` ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->starts_with_prefix_ci( iv_text = `Development` iv_prefix = `abap` ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_starts_with_empty_prefix.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_starts_with_ci( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->starts_with_prefix_ci( iv_text = `AnyText` iv_prefix = `` ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Anker `^` im regulären Ausdruck stellt sicher, dass das Muster am Anfang des Strings gefunden wird. In Kombination mit `pcre_options = 'i'` wird die Groß- und Kleinschreibung ignoriert, was eine flexible Präfixprüfung ermöglicht. Die `match`-Methode liefert ein direktes `abap_bool`-Ergebnis.
keywords: REGEX, PREFIX, CASE_INSENSITIVE, MATCH, CL_ABAP_REGEX

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle URLs (beginnend mit http:// oder https://) aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit einem geeigneten URL-Muster und `find_all`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_extract_urls DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_all_urls
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_urls) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_urls IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_all_urls.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9-.]+(?:\/[^\s]*)?`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_with_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND ls_match-found TO rt_urls.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_urls FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_urls FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_urls.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_extract_urls( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Besuchen Sie unsere Website unter https://www.example.com oder http://blog.test.org/artikel. Auch https://sap.com ist wichtig.`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_all_urls( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = `https://www.example.com` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = `http://blog.test.org/artikel` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = `https://sap.com` ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_urls.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_extract_urls( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Dies ist ein Text ohne URLs.`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_all_urls( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Extrahieren von URLs erfordert einen komplexeren regulären Ausdruck, der verschiedene Teile einer URL (Protokoll, Domain, Subdomain, Pfad) abdeckt. `cl_abap_regex` und `find_all` sind hierfür die perfekte Kombination, um alle passenden URLs aus einem Text zu isolieren. Dies ist eine robuste Lösung für Web-Content-Analyse.
keywords: REGEX, URL, EXTRACT, FIND, CL_ABAP_REGEX

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine interne Standardtabelle ein, die Flugdaten enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator, um die Zeile direkt zu konstruieren und `INSERT` sie in die Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ins_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS insert_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_planetype TYPE s_planetye
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ins_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_single_flight.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flights( ). " Initialize empty table

    INSERT VALUE ty_flight(
      carrid    = iv_carrid
      connid    = iv_connid
      fldate    = iv_fldate
      planetype = iv_planetype
    ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_single FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_single.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ins_simple( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_single_flight(
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'
      iv_connid   = '0400'
      iv_fldate   = '20251203'
      iv_planetype = 'A320'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht die direkte Konstruktion einer Struktur und deren Einfügung in eine interne Tabelle in einem einzigen, lesbaren Schritt, was den Code kompakter macht.
keywords: INSERT, VALUE, Internal Tables, Standard Table

Instructions: Fügen Sie Daten aus einer Quellstruktur in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur die übereinstimmenden Felder übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` in Verbindung mit `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ins_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS insert_corresponding_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source_data TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ins_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_corresponding_data.
    DATA(lt_target_data) = VALUE tt_target_data( ).

    INSERT CORRESPONDING #( is_source_data ) INTO TABLE lt_target_data.

    rt_target_data = lt_target_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ins_corresponding( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_ins_corresponding=>ty_source_data(
      carrid   = 'AA'
      connid   = '0017'
      cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'
      cityto   = 'SAN FRANCISCO'
      fldate   = '20251204'
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_corresponding_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20251204' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-planetype ). " Field not in source
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INSERT CORRESPONDING` ermöglicht das einfache Übertragen von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, indem nur die Felder mit identischen Namen zugewiesen werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um Redundanz zu vermeiden und den Code sauber zu halten.
keywords: INSERT, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Structure Assignment

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie mehrere Zeilen basierend auf einer Schleife und dem `FOR` Operator einfügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` für die Konstruktion der Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ins_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS insert_multiple_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ins_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_multiple_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
      ( carrid = |AA| connid = |{ 100 + i ALPHA = IN }| fldate = sy-datum )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_multiple FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ins_for_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_multiple_flights( 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0103' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative und kompakte Erzeugung von internen Tabellen, indem Zeilen basierend auf einer Schleife oder anderen Iterationsmechanismen generiert werden. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Tabellen zu füllen.
keywords: INSERT, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Table Constructor

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen in eine sortierte interne Tabelle ein und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Sortierreihenfolge beibehalten wird.
hint: `INSERT` in eine sortierte Tabelle fügt die Zeile automatisch an der korrekten Position ein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ins_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key
                              WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    METHODS insert_into_sorted_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        io_existing_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ins_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_into_sorted_table.
    rt_flights = io_existing_flights. " Start with existing data

    INSERT VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid )
           INTO TABLE rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_sorted FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_sorted.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ins_sorted( ).
    DATA(lt_initial) = VALUE zcl_ins_sorted=>tt_flights_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_into_sorted_table(
      iv_carrid = 'BA'
      iv_connid = '0123'
      io_existing_flights = lt_initial
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ). " BA should be inserted in between
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Einfügen in eine sortierte Tabelle mit `INSERT` wird die neue Zeile automatisch an der korrekten Position platziert, um die Sortierreihenfolge beizubehalten. Dies ist effizienter als das manuelle Sortieren nach jedem Einfügevorgang.
keywords: INSERT, Sorted Table, Internal Tables, Unique Key

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile an einer bestimmten Position (Index) in eine interne Standardtabelle ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `INDEX` Klausel mit `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ins_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,

CLASS zcl_ins_index IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_items = io_existing_items.

           INTO rt_items INDEX iv_index.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_index FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ins_index( ).
    DATA(lt_initial) = VALUE zcl_ins_index=>tt_items(

explanation: Die `INDEX` Klausel bei `INSERT` ermöglicht die präzise Kontrolle über die Position, an der eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle eingefügt wird. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Reihenfolge der Elemente eine Rolle spielt und die Tabelle nicht sortiert ist.
keywords: INSERT, INDEX, Internal Tables, Standard Table

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende doppelte Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`. Die Tabelle muss vorher nach den relevanten Feldern sortiert sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_adj_dups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        io_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_adj_dups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_data = io_data.

    " Important: Table must be sorted by the fields to be checked for duplicates
    SORT rt_data BY key_field.

    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_data COMPARING key_field.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_adj_dups FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_adj_dups.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_adj_dups( ).
    DATA(lt_initial) = VALUE zcl_del_adj_dups=>tt_data(
      ( key_field = 'A' value_field = 'Val1' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value_field = 'Val2' )
      ( key_field = 'A' value_field = 'Val3' ) " Duplicate key_field, but not adjacent
      ( key_field = 'B' value_field = 'Val4' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value_field = 'Val5' ) " Adjacent duplicate key_field
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_adjacent_duplicates( lt_initial ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ). " A, B, A (after sort) -> A, B
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-key_field exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-key_field exp = 'A' ). " The second 'A' is now adjacent
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-key_field exp = 'B' ).

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur die übereinstimmenden Felder übertragen werden und die Quelltabelle gefiltert wird.

CLASS zcl_ins_corr_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_source_flight.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_target_flight.
    TYPES tt_target_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS insert_filtered_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_city TYPE s_cityname
        io_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flights
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ins_corr_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_filtered_corresponding.
    rt_target_flights = VALUE tt_target_flights(
      FOR ls_source IN FILTER #( io_source_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_filter_city )
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Schlüssel in einer anderen internen Tabelle vorhanden sind.

CLASS zcl_del_by_other_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_key.
    TYPES tt_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_flights_by_keys
      IMPORTING
        io_flights_to_delete TYPE tt_keys
        io_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_by_other_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_keys.
    rt_remaining_flights = io_all_flights.

    LOOP AT io_flights_to_delete INTO DATA(ls_key).
      DELETE rt_remaining_flights WHERE carrid = ls_key-carrid AND connid = ls_key-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251204' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251204' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_keys_to_delete) = VALUE zcl_del_by_other_table=>tt_keys(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_flights_by_keys(
      io_flights_to_delete = lt_keys_to_delete
      io_all_flights = lt_all_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY`, `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    METHODS get_carrier_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_flights BY flight-carrid
                             ( carrid       = flight-carrid
                               flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                               avg_price    = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                                              FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                              NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) / GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_reduce FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summaries ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne `FOR`-Iteration mit `GROUP BY` für interne Tabellen, um Daten nach `carrid` zu gruppieren. Innerhalb der Gruppe wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Summe der Preise zu berechnen, und `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften. Wenn der `carrid` 'LH' ist, soll der `carrname` 'Lufthansa German Airlines' sein, ansonsten der Standardname aus `scarr`. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `COND` im `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_enhanced,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_enhanced.
    METHODS get_enhanced_carriers RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_enhanced WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enhanced_carriers.
    DATA: lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR ls_scarr IN lt_scarr
                           ( carrid   = ls_scarr-carrid
                             carrname = COND #( WHEN ls_scarr-carrid = 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa German Airlines'
                                                ELSE ls_scarr-carrname ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_cond FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_cond.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_enhanced_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_carriers ).

    DATA(ls_lh) = lt_carriers[ carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT sy-initial ].
    IF ls_lh IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa German Airlines' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aa) = lt_carriers[ carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT sy-initial ].
    IF ls_aa IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` und `COND` im `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation und -transformation. `COND` ersetzt hierbei komplexe `IF`-Blöcke und macht den Code deutlich lesbarer und wartbarer.
keywords: FOR, COND, VALUE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere oder von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit gleichen Namen übertragen werden sollen. Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_source,
           BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
             extra_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.

    METHODS map_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding_struct FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_corresponding_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_struct.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corresponding=>ty_source,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_corresponding=>ty_target.

    ls_source-field1 = 10.
    ls_source-field2 = 'Hello'.
    ls_source-field3 = 'World'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding( ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->map_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-extra_field ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_corresponding_table.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_corresponding=>ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_corresponding=>ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 1 field2 = 'A' field3 = 'X' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 2 field2 = 'B' field3 = 'Y' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding( ).
    lt_target = lo_cut->map_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-field1 exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-field2 exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-extra_field ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ist eine moderne und typsichere Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`. Er ermöglicht das Zuweisen von Komponenten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, deren Namen übereinstimmen, und unterstützt auch die Zuweisung von Werten zu zusätzlichen Feldern oder die Anwendung von Transformationen.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `sflights` und `scarr` durch und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel in Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_expensive_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_expensive_flight.
    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_expensive_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~price
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~price > @iv_min_price
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( iv_min_price = '500' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > '500' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination eines `INNER JOIN` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung. Dies ist die effizienteste Methode, um Daten bereits auf der Datenbankebene zu filtern und reduziert den Datenverkehr zwischen Datenbank und Applikationsserver. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` ist hierbei Standard in modernem Open SQL.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, WHERE, Open SQL, Database Access, Filtering, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `sflights` und `sbook` durch und verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung in der `SELECT`-Liste, um den Buchungsstatus ('Gebucht' oder 'Nicht gebucht') basierend auf dem Vorhandensein einer Buchungs-ID anzuzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und `CASE` im `SELECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate      TYPE s_date,
             booking_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    METHODS get_flight_booking_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_booking_status.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate,
           CASE WHEN b~bookid IS NOT NULL THEN 'Gebucht'
                ELSE 'Nicht gebucht'
           END AS booking_status
      FROM sflights AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND
                                     s~connid = b~connid AND
                                     s~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_booking_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_booking_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_case( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flight_booking_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).

    DATA(lv_booked_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_not_booked_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-booking_status = 'Gebucht'.
        lv_booked_count = lv_booked_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-booking_status = 'Nicht gebucht'.
        lv_not_booked_count = lv_not_booked_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_booked_count > 0 OR lv_not_booked_count > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert einen `LEFT OUTER JOIN` mit einer `CASE`-Anweisung direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste. Die `CASE`-Anweisung ermöglicht es, bedingte Logik direkt auf der Datenbank auszuführen und das Ergebnis als neue Spalte zurückzugeben. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke Funktion in modernem Open SQL (ab ABAP 7.55), um Daten vorzuverarbeiten und die Komplexität im Applikationsschicht-Code zu reduzieren.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, CASE, Open SQL, Database Access, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.55
