Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in einen Integer. Wenn der String 'ERROR' enthält, soll der Wert -1 zurückgegeben werden, ansonsten der konvertierte Integer. Behandeln Sie auch den Fall, dass der String nicht numerisch ist.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CONV` mit einem `COND` Ausdruck und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_cond_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integer) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_cond_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_conditionally.
    rv_integer = COND i(
      WHEN iv_input_string = 'ERROR' THEN -1
      ELSE
        TRY.
            CONV i( iv_input_string )
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            -2 " Indicate a non-numeric string error
        ENDTRY
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_valid_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_numeric_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_cond_error( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_conditionally( 'ERROR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_cond_error( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_conditionally( '42' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 42 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_numeric_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_cond_error( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_conditionally( 'ABC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `CONV` mit `COND` ermöglicht eine elegante und kompakte Implementierung von bedingten Typkonvertierungen. Der `TRY...CATCH`-Block innerhalb des `COND`-Ausdrucks behandelt potenzielle Konvertierungsfehler für nicht-numerische Strings.
keywords: CONV, COND, TRY...CATCH, Conditional Conversion, Error Handling

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id     TYPE string,
             value  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES: tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             item_id TYPE i,
             data    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES: tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_conv_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS convert_table_with_for
          IMPORTING
            it_source TYPE tt_source_table
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_with_for.
    rt_target = VALUE tt_target_table(
      FOR ls_source IN it_source
        ( item_id = CONV i( ls_source-id )
          data    = CONV string( ls_source-value ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` an. Markieren Sie dabei alle Flüge, deren `FLDATE` in der Vergangenheit liegt, mit einer roten Hintergrundfarbe in der Spalte `FLDATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_SALV_COLUMNS_LIST` und `CL_SALV_COLUMN` um Spalteneigenschaften zu manipulieren. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` für die Datenaufbereitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_col_prop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_colored,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             color    TYPE lvc_t_scol, " For cell coloring
           END OF ty_sflight_colored.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_colored TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_colored WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_colored_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE tt_sflight_colored.
    METHODS display_colored_sflights IMPORTING it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight_colored.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_col_prop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_colored_sflight_data.
    DATA lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw.

    rt_sflight = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight_raw
                          ( carrid   = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                            connid   = <fs_sflight>-connid
                            fldate   = <fs_sflight>-fldate
                            price    = <fs_sflight>-price
                            currency = <fs_sflight>-currency
                            color    = COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-fldate < sy-datum
                                               THEN VALUE lvc_t_scol( ( fname = 'FLDATE' color-col = 6 color-int = 0 color-inv = 0 ) )
                                               ELSE VALUE lvc_t_scol( ) )
                          ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_colored_sflights.
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container  = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = it_sflight
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_color_column( 'COLOR' ). " Set the column for cell coloring

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_colored_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_colored_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_col_prop( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_colored) = lo_cut->get_colored_sflight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_sflight_colored msg = 'Colored SFLIGHT data should not be empty' ).

    " Check if at least one past flight date is colored
    DATA(lv_found_colored) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_colored INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF ls_sflight-fldate < sy-datum AND ls_sflight-color IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_found_colored = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_colored = abap_true msg = 'Expected at least one past flight date to be colored' ).

    " Check if a future flight date is NOT colored (if any exist)
    DATA(lv_found_uncolored) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_colored INTO ls_sflight.
      IF ls_sflight-fldate >= sy-datum AND ls_sflight-color IS INITIAL.
        lv_found_uncolored = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_uncolored = abap_true msg = 'Expected at least one future flight date to be uncolored' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_colored_sflight_data` nutzt `VALUE #( FOR ... ( ... ) )` und den `COND` Operator, um die interne Tabelle `lt_sflight_colored` effizient zu füllen und gleichzeitig die Farbinformationen für vergangene Flugdaten zu setzen. `CL_SALV_TABLE` wird dann verwendet, um diese Daten anzuzeigen, wobei die Spalte `COLOR` als Steuerungsspalte für die Zellfärbung definiert wird. Dies demonstriert moderne Datenmanipulation und ALV-Anpassung.
keywords: CL_SALV_TABLE, FOR, VALUE, COND, Cell Coloring, ALV Reporting, SFLIGHT

CLASS zcl_alv_grid_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE tt_sflight.
    METHODS display_sflights_dynamic_fcat IMPORTING it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_grid_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights_dynamic_fcat.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lt_fcat      TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. " Assumes a screen with this custom control

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    " Generate field catalog dynamically
    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT' " Or use cl_alv_table_create for dynamic table
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_sflight
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat. " Field catalog will be filled automatically

    " Set some properties if needed, e.g., column width optimization
    LOOP AT lt_fcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat>).
      <fs_fcat>-col_opt = abap_true.
    ENDLOOP.
    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_frontend_fieldcatalog
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat.

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
      EXPORTING
        i_ready_for_input = 0. " Display only

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.

    " To ensure the ALV is visible, typically this would be part of a PBO module
    " and the screen would be called. For this example, we assume a screen is active.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    " Generate field catalog dynamically
    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_sflight
        it_fieldcatalog  = lt_fcat.

    " Add custom button to toolbar
    DATA(lo_toolbar) = mo_alv_grid->get_toolbar_object( ).

      EXPORTING

        icon      = icon_information
        butn_type = 0
        text      = 'Mein Button'
        quickinfo = 'Klicken Sie hier!'

    " Register event handler for toolbar button click
    SET HANDLER me->on_toolbar_button_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

      EXPORTING

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.

CLASS zcl_alv_grid_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv_with_sum.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_alv_grid  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lt_fcat      TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fcat      TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container.

    " Prepare field catalog manually to set DO_SUM
    CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        ct_fieldcat      = lt_fcat.

    READ TABLE lt_fcat INTO ls_fcat WITH KEY fieldname = 'PRICE'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_fcat-do_sum = 'X'.
      MODIFY lt_fcat FROM ls_fcat INDEX sy-tabix.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_sflight.

    CALL METHOD lo_alv_grid->refresh_table_display.
  ENDMETHOD.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container  = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING

          CHANGING
            t_table      = it_sflight
        ).

        " Enable multiple row selection
        DATA(lo_selections) = mo_salv_table->get_selections( ).
        lo_selections->set_selection_mode( if_salv_c_selection_mode=>multiple ).

        " Register event handler for double click
        DATA(lo_events) = mo_salv_table->get_event_manager( ).

        mo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).

    DATA lt_selected_rows TYPE salv_t_row.
    DATA lv_message TYPE string.

    lt_selected_rows = mo_salv_table->get_selections( )->get_selected_rows( ).

    IF lt_selected_rows IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_message = |{ lines( lt_selected_rows ) } Zeile(n) ausgewählt. Doppelklick auf Zeile { row } Spalte { column }.|.

      lv_message = |Doppelklick auf Zeile { row } Spalte { column }. Keine Zeilen ausgewählt.|.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und summiere die Anzahl der gebuchten Sitze.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_sum_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_sum_seats.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
                                                INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seats_for_carrier) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_total_seats_for_carrier = lv_total_seats_for_carrier + ls_member-seatsocc.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      total_seats = lv_total_seats_for_carrier ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_group_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_itab_group_sum=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 75 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_and_sum_seats( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(ls_expected_lh) = VALUE zcl_itab_group_sum=>ty_grouped_result( carrid = 'LH' total_seats = 225 ).
    DATA(ls_expected_aa) = VALUE zcl_itab_group_sum=>ty_grouped_result( carrid = 'AA' total_seats = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ). " Check if entry exists
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_seats exp = ls_expected_lh-total_seats ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-total_seats exp = ls_expected_aa-total_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Aggregationen wie Summen können direkt innerhalb der Gruppen-Schleife berechnet werden, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als ältere Ansätze mit `AT NEW`/`AT END`.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP AT, VALUE

             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_count_flights.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                                         connid = ls_sflight-connid )
                                                INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key.
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      connid = ls_group_key-connid
                      flight_count = lv_flight_count ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE`.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_find_max_price.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
                                                INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_max_price_for_carrier) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT max_p = 0
        FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT max_p = nmax( max_p, ls_member-price )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      max_price = lv_max_price_for_carrier ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis enthält.
hint: Nutze `VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ... )` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_summary.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_grouped_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group_member IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_group_member-carrid
      (
        carrid = ls_group_member-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        average_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT total_price = 0.0
               count = 0
          FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group_member
          NEXT
            total_price = total_price + ls_member-price
            count = count + 1
          FINALLY
            IF count > 0.
              total_price = total_price / count.
            ENDIF.
            total_price
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Sie ermöglicht es, eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, deren Zeilen aus den Aggregationen der Gruppen der Quelltabelle bestehen, alles in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit expliziter Schleifen und temporärer Variablen erheblich.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_to_local_tz DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_local_datetime,
             date TYPE d,
             time TYPE t,
           END OF ty_local_datetime.
    METHODS convert_utc_to_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_utc_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_tzone     TYPE tznzone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_local_datetime) TYPE ty_local_datetime.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_to_local_tz IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utc_to_local.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_obj) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utclong( iv_utclong = iv_utc_tstmp ).
    lv_tstmp_obj->move(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_obj->get_utclong( )
        iv_tzone = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        ev_date  = rs_local_datetime-date
        ev_time  = rs_local_datetime-time
    ).

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_utc_to_local FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utc_to_local.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_to_local_tz( ).
    DATA(lv_utc_tstmp) = '20231026100000'. " 10:00:00 UTC
    DATA(lv_tzone_berlin) = 'CET'. " Central European Time (UTC+1, or UTC+2 during DST)

    " Assuming 26.10.2023, 10:00 UTC is 12:00 CET (DST active)
    DATA(ls_local_datetime) = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local( iv_utc_tstmp = lv_utc_tstmp iv_tzone = lv_tzone_berlin ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_datetime-date exp = '20231026' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_datetime-time exp = '120000' ).

    " Test with a different timezone, e.g., New York (EST = UTC-5)
    DATA(lv_tzone_ny) = 'EST'. " Eastern Standard Time (UTC-5)
    " 26.10.2023, 10:00:00 UTC should be 05:00:00 EST
    ls_local_datetime = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local( iv_utc_tstmp = lv_utc_tstmp iv_tzone = lv_tzone_ny ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_datetime-date exp = '20231026' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_datetime-time exp = '050000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `move`-Methode von `cl_abap_tstmp` ist nicht nur für die Konvertierung in Datum und Uhrzeit zuständig, sondern kann auch direkt die Umrechnung in eine angegebene Zeitzone vornehmen. Dies ist entscheidend für Anwendungen, die mit globalen Daten und lokalen Benutzerzeiten arbeiten, und vermeidet komplexe manuelle Zeitzonenberechnungen.
keywords: cl_abap_tstmp, Timestamp, Zeitzone, Konvertierung, UTC, SABP_CONVERT

solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_unique_str DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_planetype,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             unique_planetype_list TYPE string,
           END OF ty_grouped_planetype.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_planetype TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_planetype WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_planetype_list
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_planetype.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_unique_str IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_planetype_list.
    rt_result = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group_member IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_group_member-carrid
      (
        carrid = ls_group_member-carrid
        unique_planetype_list = REDUCE string(
          INIT lv_list = ''
               lt_unique_types = VALUE string_table( )
          FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group_member
          NEXT
            IF NOT line_exists( lt_unique_types[ table_line = ls_member-planetype ] ).
              APPEND ls_member-planetype TO lt_unique_types.
            ENDIF.
          FINALLY
            lv_list = cl_abap_string_utilities=>string_table_to_string(
                                                    it_string_table = lt_unique_types
                                                    iv_separator    = ', ' ).
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' planetype = '747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' planetype = 'A320' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' planetype = '737' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' planetype = '747' ) " Duplicate for LH

CLASS zcl_tstmp_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_comparison_result,
             is_equal TYPE abap_bool,
             tstmp1_is_earlier TYPE abap_bool,
             tstmp2_is_earlier TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_comparison_result.
    METHODS compare_timestamps
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_comparison_result.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_timestamps.
    IF iv_tstmp1 = iv_tstmp2.
      rs_result-is_equal = abap_true.
    ELSEIF iv_tstmp1 < iv_tstmp2.
      rs_result-tstmp1_is_earlier = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rs_result-tstmp2_is_earlier = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_compare.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp1) = '20231026100000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp2) = '20231026100100'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp3) = '20231026100000'.

    " Test tstmp1 < tstmp2
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->compare_timestamps( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp1 iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_result-is_equal ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_result-tstmp1_is_earlier ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_result-tstmp2_is_earlier ).

    " Test tstmp2 > tstmp1
    ls_result = lo_cut->compare_timestamps( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp2 iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_result-is_equal ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_result-tstmp1_is_earlier ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_result-tstmp2_is_earlier ).

    " Test tstmp1 = tstmp3
    ls_result = lo_cut->compare_timestamps( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp1 iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_result-is_equal ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_result-tstmp1_is_earlier ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( ls_result-tstmp2_is_earlier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `timestampl`-Felder direkt verglichen werden können, ist es wichtig zu verstehen, dass `cl_abap_tstmp` die zugrunde liegende Logik für die korrekte Interpretation von Zeitstempeln bereitstellt. Für einfache Vergleiche sind direkte Operatoren ausreichend, aber für komplexere Szenarien (z.B. unter Berücksichtigung von Zeitzonen) ist die Klasse unerlässlich. Dieses Beispiel zeigt den direkten Vergleich, der für `timestampl` Typen funktioniert.
keywords: cl_abap_tstmp, Timestamp, Vergleich, Conditional Logic, SABP_CONVERT

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein gegebener Zeitstempel in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract` mit dem aktuellen Zeitstempel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_is_future DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_future
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_is_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_future.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utclong( iv_utclong = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ) ).
    DATA(lv_input_tstmp_obj) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utclong( iv_utclong = iv_tstmp ).
    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = lv_input_tstmp_obj->subtract( lv_current_tstmp ).
    IF lv_diff_seconds > 0.
      rv_is_future = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_future = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_future FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_future.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_is_future( ).
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).

    " Test future timestamp (10 seconds from now)
    DATA(lv_future_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utclong( lv_current_tstmp )->add( 10 )->get_utclong( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_future( lv_future_tstmp ) ).

    " Test past timestamp (10 seconds ago)
    DATA(lv_past_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utclong( lv_current_tstmp )->subtract( 10 )->get_utclong( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_future( lv_past_tstmp ) ).

    " Test current timestamp (should be false or very close to false)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_future( lv_current_tstmp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung von `cl_abap_tstmp` zur Erzeugung von Zeitstempelobjekten und der `subtract`-Methode zur Berechnung der Differenz in Sekunden kann auf einfache und zuverlässige Weise überprüft werden, ob ein Zeitstempel in der Zukunft oder Vergangenheit liegt. Dies ist präziser als der direkte Vergleich von `timestampl`-Feldern, da es die objektorientierten Funktionen der Klasse nutzt.
keywords: cl_abap_tstmp, Timestamp, Conditional Logic, Arithmetik, Zukunft, Vergangenheit, SABP_CONVERT

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Konvertiere eine interne Tabelle von sflights-Daten in JSON, wobei nur bestimmte Felder berücksichtigt werden sollen.
hint: Erstelle eine lokale Struktur mit den gewünschten Feldern und nutze FOR-Ausdrücke, um die Daten zu filtern und zu mappen, bevor du sie serialisierst.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_filtered_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES: tt_filtered_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS serialize_filtered_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rv_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_filtered_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_filtered_sflights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( ).
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_data) = VALUE tt_filtered_flights(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        price  = ls_flight-price )
    ).

    rv_json = /ui2/cl_abap2json=>serialize( lt_filtered_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_serialize_filtered FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_filtered_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_filtered_sflights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'JSON output should not be empty' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON output contains CARRID' substring = '"CARRID":' in_string = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON output contains CONNID' substring = '"CONNID":' in_string = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON output contains PRICE' substring = '"PRICE":' in_string = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( msg = 'JSON output should not contain FLDATE' substring = '"FLDATE":' in_string = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man mit modernen ABAP-FOR-Ausdrücken eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten in eine neue Struktur mit nur ausgewählten Feldern mappt und diese dann in JSON serialisiert. Dies ist effizient, um nur relevante Daten an das Frontend zu senden und die Payload zu reduzieren.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in einer internen Tabelle `sflights_tab` unter Verwendung eines Tabellenausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MODIFY TABLE itab INDEX ...` oder `MODIFY TABLE itab TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...` mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_itab_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_itab_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    " Find the line using a table expression and modify it
    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM DATA(ls_flight_update)
      INDEX ct_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate ]-index
      TRANSPORTING price = iv_new_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_modify_itab_expr=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_itab_expr( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    " Call the method to update
    lo_cut->update_flight_price( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA'
                                           iv_connid = '0017'
                                           iv_fldate = sy-datum
                                           iv_new_price = '150.00'
                                 CHANGING  ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    " Assert the change
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ]-price
                                         exp = '150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ]-price
                                         exp = '200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Tabellenausdrücken in der `MODIFY` Anweisung ermöglicht eine präzise und lesbare Adressierung der zu ändernden Zeile, ohne vorher eine explizite `READ TABLE` Anweisung zu benötigen. Dies ist besonders effizient, wenn der Schlüssel bekannt ist.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, Table Expression, Index

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle `sflights_discounted` aus `sflights_tab`, wobei Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 EUR einen Rabatt von 10% erhalten. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `FOR`-Schleife und den `VALUE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( COND ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_discounted_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_flights.
    rt_discounted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                     ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > 500
                                                THEN VALUE #( BASE ls_flight price = ls_flight-price * '0.9' )
                                                ELSE ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_discounted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discounted_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_modify_for_value=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_for_value( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '600.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '400.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lt_discounted) = lo_cut->get_discounted_flights( lt_flights ).

    " Assert the changes
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_discounted[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ]-price
                                         exp = '540.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_discounted[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ]-price
                                         exp = '400.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und dem `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und gut lesbarem Code, der die Logik der Datenmanipulation direkt ausdrückt.
keywords: Internal Table, FOR, VALUE, COND, Functional Programming

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights_main` mit Daten aus einer temporären Tabelle `sflights_updates`. Nur die Felder `PRICE` und `CURRENCY` sollen aktualisiert werden, andere Felder sollen unverändert bleiben. Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( itab ) itab_updates MAPPING ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flights_with_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_sflight
      CHANGING
        ct_main_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_with_corresponding.
    ct_main_flights = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( ct_main_flights ) it_updates
                                        MAPPING carrid = carrid
                                                connid = connid
                                                fldate = fldate
                                        EXCEPT planetype ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_corresponding_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_update.
    DATA: lt_main_flights TYPE zcl_modify_corresponding=>tt_sflight,
          lt_updates      TYPE zcl_modify_corresponding=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_corresponding( ).

    " Initial main data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_main_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_main>).
    <fs_main>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_main>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_main>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_main>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_main>-currency = 'EUR'.
    <fs_main>-planetype = 'BOEING747'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_main_flights ASSIGNING <fs_main>.
    <fs_main>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_main>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_main>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_main>-price = '200.00'.
    <fs_main>-currency = 'EUR'.
    <fs_main>-planetype = 'AIRBUS320'.

    " Update data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_updates ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_update>).
    <fs_update>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_update>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_update>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_update>-price = '150.00'.
    <fs_update>-currency = 'USD'.
    <fs_update>-planetype = 'CONCORDE'. " This should not be updated

    lo_cut->update_flights_with_corresponding( EXPORTING it_updates = lt_updates
                                               CHANGING  ct_main_flights = lt_main_flights ).

    " Assert the changes
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_main_flights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ]-price

Durch die `MAPPING`-Klausel können Schlüsselfelder für die Zuordnung definiert und mit `EXCEPT` Felder von der Aktualisierung ausgeschlossen werden, was zu sehr präzisem und wartbarem Code führt.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MODIFY sflights FROM wa` oder `UPDATE sflights SET ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_db_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_db_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    " Read existing entry to ensure it exists and get other fields
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_sflight-price = iv_new_price.
      MODIFY sflight FROM ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_db_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_db_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_db_single( ).
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA: lv_original_price TYPE sflight-price.

    " Prepare test data (ensure an entry exists or create one)
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'XX'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0001'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-price = '100.00'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'EUR'.
    ls_sflight-planetype = 'A380'.
    MODIFY sflight FROM ls_sflight.
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Store original price for assertion
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO lv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = sy-datum.

    " Call the method to update
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'XX'
                                                    iv_connid = '0001'
                                                    iv_fldate = sy-datum
                                                    iv_new_price = '120.00' ).

    " Assert success and the updated price
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_updated_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price
                                         exp = '120.00' ).

    " Clean up: revert to original state or delete test data
    ls_sflight-price = lv_original_price.
    MODIFY sflight FROM ls_sflight.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY` Anweisung für Datenbanktabellen ist eine einfache und direkte Methode, um einzelne Datensätze zu aktualisieren oder einzufügen. In Kombination mit `COMMIT WORK` und `ROLLBACK WORK` wird die Transaktionssicherheit gewährleistet. Die moderne Syntax erlaubt die direkte Zuweisung von Werten zu Strukturfeldern.
keywords: MODIFY, Database Table, SFLIGHTS, COMMIT WORK, UPDATE

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie mehrere Flugdatensätze in der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Änderungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY sflights FROM TABLE itab`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_db_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_update.
    TYPES tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_multiple_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_sflight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_db_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_multiple_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Read existing entries to get full data and then update
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_updates
      WHERE carrid = it_updates-carrid
        AND connid = it_updates-connid
        AND fldate = it_updates-fldate.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      READ TABLE it_updates INTO DATA(ls_update) WITH KEY carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                                      connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                                      fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_sflight>-price = ls_update-price.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_sflight IS NOT INITIAL.
      MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` um 5%.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE sflights SET price = price * 1.05 WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_db_arithmetic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS increase_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_db_arithmetic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_flight_prices.
    DATA(lv_factor) = 1 + ( iv_percentage / 100 ).

    UPDATE sflight SET price = price * lv_factor
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_db_arithmetic( ).
    DATA: lt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Prepare test data
    DATA: ls_sflight_test TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight_test-carrid = 'XX'.
    ls_sflight_test-connid = '0004'.
    ls_sflight_test-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight_test-price = '100.00'.
    ls_sflight_test-currency = 'EUR'.
    ls_sflight_test-planetype = 'A380'.
    MODIFY sflight FROM ls_sflight_test.

    ls_sflight_test-connid = '0005'.
    ls_sflight_test-price = '200.00'.
    MODIFY sflight FROM ls_sflight_test.
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Read original prices
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_original_flights
      WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND ( connid = '0004' OR connid = '0005' ) AND fldate = sy-datum.

    " Call the method to increase prices by 5%
    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_cut->increase_flight_prices( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_percentage = '5' ).

    " Assert the number of updated rows
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated, exp = 2 ).

    " Assert the updated prices
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_updated_price1)
      WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0004' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_updated_price2)
      WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0005' AND fldate = sy-datum.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price1, exp = '105.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price2, exp = '210.00' ).

    " Clean up: revert prices to original
    LOOP AT lt_original_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_orig>).
      UPDATE sflight SET price = <fs_orig>-price
        WHERE carrid = <fs_orig>-carrid
          AND connid = <fs_orig>-connid
          AND fldate = <fs_orig>-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UPDATE` Anweisung mit arithmetischen Ausdrücken in der `SET`-Klausel (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht die direkte Berechnung und Aktualisierung von Feldwerten auf der Datenbank. Dies ist sehr effizient, da die Berechnung direkt im Datenbanksystem stattfindet und keine Daten zum Applikationsserver transportiert werden müssen.
keywords: UPDATE, Database Table, Arithmetic Expression, SFLIGHTS, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen und zeigen Sie ein einfaches Kontextmenü mit zwei Einträgen in einem SAP GUI-Programm an.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_ctmenu`, fügen Sie Einträge mit `add_function` hinzu und rufen Sie `load_gui_status` auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_menu.

    CLASS-METHODS handle_menu_selection
      IMPORTING
        iv_fcode TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_menu.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).

    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'F_ITEM1' text = 'Option 1' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'F_ITEM2' text = 'Option 2' ).

    " In a real report/dynpro, you would call SET PF-STATUS 'MENU_STATUS' EXCLUDING lo_menu->get_excluded_functions.
    " For demonstration, we simulate the menu display and selection.
    MESSAGE 'Context menu created. Select an option (F_ITEM1 or F_ITEM2).' TYPE 'I'.

    " In a real scenario, the user would click and trigger PAI/AT USER-COMMAND.
    " Here, we just show the menu structure.
    " To actually display it, this code would be in a PBO module or AT USER-COMMAND handler.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_menu_selection.
    CASE iv_fcode.
      WHEN 'F_ITEM1'.
        MESSAGE 'Option 1 selected!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN 'F_ITEM2'.
        MESSAGE 'Option 2 selected!' TYPE 'S'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        MESSAGE 'Unknown option selected.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_menu_creation.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'F_TEST1' text = 'Test Option 1' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'F_TEST2' text = 'Test Option 2' ).

    " Assert that menu items are added (indirectly by checking internal table)
    DATA(lt_functions) = lo_menu->get_functions( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_functions ), exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_functions[ 1 ]-fcode, exp = 'F_TEST1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_functions[ 2 ]-fcode, exp = 'F_TEST2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_menu_handling.
    " Test the handling method directly
    zcl_simple_context_menu=>handle_menu_selection( 'F_ITEM1' ).
    " No direct assert for MESSAGE, but we can check if no exception occurred.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

    zcl_simple_context_menu=>handle_menu_selection( 'F_ITEM2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

Obwohl die eigentliche Anzeige und Interaktion GUI-spezifisch ist, demonstriert dieses Beispiel die moderne Objektorientierung zur Strukturierung der Menülogik. Die Ereignisbehandlung erfolgt typischerweise über `AT USER-COMMAND`.
keywords: cl_ctmenu, Context Menu, SAP GUI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü, das dynamisch Einträge basierend auf einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften hinzufügt. Wenn ein Benutzer einen Eintrag auswählt, soll die ausgewählte Fluggesellschaft in einer Meldung angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_function` in einer Schleife und implementieren Sie `AT USER-COMMAND` oder eine ähnliche Logik für die Ereignisbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_dynamic_menu
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrid.

    CLASS-METHODS handle_dynamic_selection
      IMPORTING
        iv_fcode TYPE sy-ucomm.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_menu.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    DATA(lv_index) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      lo_menu->add_function( fcode = |CARR_{ lv_index WIDTH = 3 ALPHA = IN }|
                              text  = |Flüge von { lv_carrid }|
                              icon  = icon_flight ).
    ENDLOOP.

    MESSAGE 'Dynamic context menu created. Select a flight option.' TYPE 'I'.
    " In a real report/dynpro, this would be part of PBO and SET PF-STATUS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_dynamic_selection.
    IF iv_fcode CS 'CARR_'.
      DATA(lv_carrid_index) = iv_fcode+4(3).
      " In a real scenario, you'd map this index back to the actual carrid.
      " For this example, we'll just show the fcode.
      MESSAGE |Selected function code: { iv_fcode }| TYPE 'S'.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Unknown dynamic option selected.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_menu_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_menu_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_menu_creation.
    DATA: lt_carrids TYPE zcl_dynamic_context_menu=>tt_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_context_menu( ).

    APPEND 'AA' TO lt_carrids.
    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_carrids.
    APPEND 'UA' TO lt_carrids.

    lo_cut->display_dynamic_menu( lt_carrids ).

    " Indirectly check menu items by creating a menu and comparing
    DATA(lo_menu_check) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu_check->add_function( fcode = 'CARR_001' text = 'Flüge von AA' icon = icon_flight ).
    lo_menu_check->add_function( fcode = 'CARR_002' text = 'Flüge von LH' icon = icon_flight ).
    lo_menu_check->add_function( fcode = 'CARR_003' text = 'Flüge von UA' icon = icon_flight ).

    DATA(lt_functions_expected) = lo_menu_check->get_functions( ).
    " Cannot directly get functions from lo_cut's internal menu object, so we test the logic.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking cl_ctmenu.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_functions_expected ), exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_functions_expected[ 1 ]-fcode, exp = 'CARR_001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_menu_handling.
    zcl_dynamic_context_menu=>handle_dynamic_selection( 'CARR_001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

    zcl_dynamic_context_menu=>handle_dynamic_selection( 'UNKNOWN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " MESSAGE E does not raise exception in unit test
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `cl_ctmenu` verwendet werden kann, um dynamisch Menüeinträge zu erstellen, was besonders nützlich ist, wenn die Menüoptionen von Laufzeitdaten abhängen. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) für `fcode` und `text` ist eine moderne und lesbare Art, Strings zu formatieren. Die Ereignisbehandlung simuliert die Reaktion auf die dynamisch generierten Funktionscodes.
keywords: cl_ctmenu, Context Menu, Dynamic, String Templates, SAP GUI, Event Handling

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer internen Tabelle von Flugbeschreibungen alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Wortes durch ein anderes Wort. Nutzen Sie hierfür `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` innerhalb einer `LOOP AT` Schleife und `MODIFY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ... IN ... WITH ...` und `MODIFY itab INDEX sy-tabix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_replace_in_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_description,
             id          TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_description.
    TYPES tt_descriptions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_description WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_word_in_descriptions
      IMPORTING
        iv_old_word TYPE string
        iv_new_word TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_descriptions TYPE tt_descriptions.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_in_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_word_in_descriptions.
    LOOP AT ct_descriptions ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_desc>).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_word IN <fs_desc>-description WITH iv_new_word.
      " MODIFY is implicit when using field symbols, but explicit MODIFY is also possible
      " MODIFY TABLE ct_descriptions FROM <fs_desc> INDEX sy-tabix.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_word FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_word.
    DATA: lt_descriptions TYPE zcl_replace_in_itab=>tt_descriptions.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_replace_in_itab( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_descriptions ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_desc>).
    <fs_desc>-id = 1.
    <fs_desc>-description = 'This is a test description with test words.'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_descriptions ASSIGNING <fs_desc>.
    <fs_desc>-id = 2.
    <fs_desc>-description = 'Another test with multiple test words.'.

    lo_cut->replace_word_in_descriptions( EXPORTING iv_old_word = 'test'
                                                    iv_new_word = 'sample'
                                          CHANGING  ct_descriptions = lt_descriptions ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_descriptions[ id = 1 ]-description,
                                         exp = 'This is a sample description with sample words.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_descriptions[ id = 2 ]-description,
                                         exp = 'Another sample with multiple sample words.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion zur String-Manipulation. In Kombination mit einer `LOOP AT` Schleife und der Verwendung von Feldsymbolen (`ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL`) ermöglicht sie eine effiziente In-Place-Modifikation von String-Feldern in internen Tabellen. Die Änderungen am Feldsymbol werden automatisch in die Tabelle übernommen, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, String Replace, LOOP AT, Field Symbol

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle und fügen Sie dann einen neuen Flugdatensatz mit dem `VALUE`-Operator hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE itab WHERE ...` und `INSERT VALUE #( ... ) INTO TABLE itab`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_insert_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS manage_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_to_delete TYPE sflight-carrid
        is_new_flight       TYPE ty_sflight
      CHANGING
        ct_flights          TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_insert_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manage_flights.
    " Delete flights for a specific airline
    DELETE ct_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid_to_delete.

    " Insert a new flight using VALUE operator
    INSERT VALUE #( is_new_flight ) INTO TABLE ct_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_insert_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_insert_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_insert_itab=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_insert_itab( ).

    " Initial data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE zcl_delete_insert_itab=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'BA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '300.00' currency = 'GBP' ).

    lo_cut->manage_flights( EXPORTING iv_carrid_to_delete = 'AA'
                                      is_new_flight       = ls_new_flight
                            CHANGING  ct_flights          = lt_flights ).

    " Assertions
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ), exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid, exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid, exp = 'BA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE` Anweisung mit `WHERE`-Klausel ist die moderne und effiziente Art, Zeilen aus internen Tabellen zu entfernen. Der `VALUE`-Operator in der `INSERT` Anweisung ermöglicht das deklarative Erstellen und Einfügen neuer Zeilen, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als die traditionelle `CLEAR wa` und `APPEND wa` Methode.
keywords: DELETE, INSERT, Internal Table, VALUE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (Tabelle SFLIGHTS) nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Geben Sie die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und GROUP SIZE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_carrid( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Should not be initial if SFLIGHTS has data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ). " Assuming at least 2 distinct CARRID in SFLIGHTS
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung ermöglicht eine einfache und performante Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Aggregation, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und Währung. Sammeln Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtanzahl der Buchungen (BOOKID) und den Gesamtpreis (PRICE) aller Flüge in dieser Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             total_bookings TYPE i,
             total_price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_grouped_data.
    TYPES tt_grouped_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_grouped_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                                        currency = ls_sflight-currency ) INTO DATA(ls_group).
      DATA(lv_total_bookings) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_group WHERE ( bookid IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT sum = sum + 1 ).
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_data( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                    currency = ls_group-currency
                                    total_bookings = lv_total_bookings
                                    total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_aggregated_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_value_for_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_group_value_for_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_grouped_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights
                           GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                           WHERE ( ls_group-price > 1000 )
                           ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                             flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                             max_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT mx = 0 FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_group NEXT mx = nmax( mx, <fs_sflight>-price ) ) ) ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_filter_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_grouped_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE seatsmax > 500 ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_filtered_group_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                            filtered_flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_update_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_conditionally.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251203' price = 1000 currency = 'EUR' ) ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251203' price = 500 currency = 'USD' ) ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251203' price = 200 currency = 'USD' ) ) ).

    UPDATE sflights SET price = CASE carrid
                                  WHEN 'LH' THEN price * '1.05'
                                  WHEN 'AA' THEN price * '1.10'
                                  ELSE price * '1.02'
                                END.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel im `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrid,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrid.
    TYPES tt_avg_price_by_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_prices IMPORTING iv_currency TYPE s_currcode
                               RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_by_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                            FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_group
                                            WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
                                            NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                        FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_group
                                        WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
                                        NEXT count = count + 1 ).

      IF lv_flight_count > 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_avg_price_by_carrid( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                              average_price = lv_total_price / lv_flight_count ) TO rt_avg_prices.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_max_price_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_connid_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_connids,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             max_price TYPE s_price,
             connids_at_max_price TYPE ty_connid_list,
           END OF ty_max_price_connids.
    TYPES tt_max_price_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_at_max_price RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_max_price_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_max_price_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_at_max_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights
                           GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                           LET lv_max_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT mx = 0 FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_group NEXT mx = nmax( mx, <fs_sflight>-price ) ) IN
                           ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                             max_price = lv_max_price
                             connids_at_max_price = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_group WHERE ( price = lv_max_price ) ( <fs_sflight>-connid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_complex_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_update_complex_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_recent_flights.
    DATA(lv_30_days_ago) = sy-datum - 30.

    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0410' fldate = sy-datum - 5 price = 1000 seatsocc = 5 currency = 'EUR' ) ) ).

    UPDATE sflights SET price = CASE WHEN seatsocc < 10 THEN 0 ELSE price * '1.05' END
                      WHERE fldate BETWEEN @lv_30_days_ago AND @sy-datum.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_revenue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_revenue,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_revenue TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_revenue.
    TYPES tt_flight_revenue TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_revenue WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_revenue
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_revenue) TYPE tt_flight_revenue.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_revenue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_revenue.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    rt_revenue = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                          ( carrid        = ls_sflight-carrid
                            connid        = ls_sflight-connid
                            total_revenue = ls_sflight-price * ls_sflight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller `PRICE`-Werte für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    SELECT price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                               FOR ls_price IN lt_prices
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_price-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_total_price
      msg = 'Total price for LH should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price
      exp = '0.00'
      msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum_price`) und iteriert über die Tabelle, wobei er in jedem Schritt die Variable aktualisiert. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr ausdrucksstarke Art, Summen, Minima, Maxima oder andere aggregierte Werte zu berechnen.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, sflight, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als Eingabe akzeptiert und eine Liste der Komponentennamen und deren ABAP-Typen zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_components.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_table ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    IF lo_line_descr IS INSTANCE OF cl_abap_structdescr.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_line_descr ).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
          name = ls_component-name
          type = ls_component-type_descr->get_type_kind_as_string( )
        ) TO rt_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
