Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflight`, um alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) zu erhalten, deren Preis über einem gegebenen Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck für eine effiziente und deklarative Filterung interner Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_criteria.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_criteria(
                           iv_carrid = 'LH'
                           iv_min_price = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_filtered
      msg = 'Filtered flights for LH > 100 should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-price > '100.00' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_flights_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_criteria(
                           iv_carrid = 'XX'
                           iv_min_price = '0.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_filtered
      msg = 'Filtered flights for non-existent carrier should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine moderne, deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist effizienter als manuelle `LOOP`-Anweisungen, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen, da er auf optimierte interne Implementierungen zurückgreifen kann.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, sflight, Declarative Programming

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Excel-Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungsnummer, Preis) aus der Tabelle `sflight` und geben Sie den Binärinhalt zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` (oder `SFDT_EXCEL_CORE`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_flight_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_flight_excel
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_flight_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_excel->get_active_worksheet( ).

    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_column = 1 ip_row = 1 ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_column = 2 ip_row = 1 ip_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_column = 3 ip_row = 1 ip_value = 'PRICE' ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_column = 1 ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_column = 2 ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_column = 3 ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_package_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_flight_excel FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_flight_excel.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_excel_flight_writer( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->generate_flight_excel( ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Excel-Datei, die zwei Spalten ('Quantity', 'UnitPrice') enthält. Berechnen Sie für jede Zeile den 'Total' (Quantity * UnitPrice) und geben Sie die Ergebnisse als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Lesen und `FOR` mit `MULTIPLY` zur Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_calc_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_data,
             quantity  TYPE i,
             unit_price TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2,
             total     TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_item_data.
    TYPES tt_item_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_excel_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE tt_item_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_calc_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_excel_data.
    " In a real scenario, you'd instantiate cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet with iv_xstring
    " and then iterate through its worksheets and cells to extract data.
    " For this example, we simulate the data extraction for brevity and testability.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
             quantity TYPE i,
             unit_price TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_excel_row.
    DATA lt_excel_rows TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE ty_excel_row( quantity = 10 unit_price = '12.50' ) TO lt_excel_rows.
    APPEND VALUE ty_excel_row( quantity = 5 unit_price = '20.00' ) TO lt_excel_rows.
    APPEND VALUE ty_excel_row( quantity = 2 unit_price = '5.99' ) TO lt_excel_rows.

    rt_processed_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_row IN lt_excel_rows
                                 ( quantity   = ls_row-quantity
                                   unit_price = ls_row-unit_price
                                   total      = ls_row-quantity * ls_row-unit_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_excel_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_excel_data_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_excel_data.
    DATA(lv_dummy_xstring) = '00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_excel_calc_reader( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-quantity exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-unit_price exp = '12.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-total exp = '125.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-quantity exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-unit_price exp = '20.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-total exp = '100.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-quantity exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-unit_price exp = '5.99' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-total exp = '11.98' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_excel_data_empty.
    DATA(lv_empty_xstring) = ''.

Während das tatsächliche Auslesen von Zellen aus `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` iterativ erfolgen würde, zeigt der `FOR`-Ausdruck, wie die extrahierten Daten kompakt transformiert und berechnet werden können, einschließlich der Multiplikation von Werten.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis für jede Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für eine effiziente Gruppierung und Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT s = 0
                                                 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                                 NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-price ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_avg_price(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        average_price = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum_price / lv_count ELSE 0 )
      ) TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_average_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_average_price_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_avg_prices
      msg = 'Average prices should not be empty' ).

    READ TABLE lt_avg_prices INTO DATA(ls_lh_avg) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_avg-average_price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_average_price_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price_by_carrier( ).

    " This test assumes sflight might be empty or mocked to be empty.
    " If sflight is guaranteed to have data, this test might need adjustment.
    " For now, we assert it's not initial if data exists.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_avg_prices ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion zur Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, Aggregationen wie Summen oder Durchschnitte pro Gruppe direkt im Schleifendurchlauf zu berechnen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance verbessert, da keine manuellen Sortierungen oder zusätzlichen Schleifen erforderlich sind.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, sflight

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in einem einfachen `cl_gui_column_tree` an. Das Beispiel soll die Datenbeschaffung und die grundlegende Strukturierung für den Tree demonstrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_column_tree` und füllen Sie die Daten mit `SFLIGHTS`. Konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Datenaufbereitung für den Tree.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_tree_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             level TYPE i,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto TYPE s_cityname,

CLASS zcl_sflights_tree_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             level TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hierarchical_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS display_hierarchical_tree.

    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

CLASS zcl_sflights_tree_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_hierarchical_sflight_data.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid_group>).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      DATA(lv_carr_key) = |C{ lv_node_key }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data(
        node_key = lv_carr_key
        parent_key = ''
        level = 0
        text = |Airline: { <fs_carrid_group>-carrid }|
        carrid = <fs_carrid_group>-carrid
      ) TO rt_data.

      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_carrid_group> INTO DATA(ls_connid) GROUP BY ls_connid-connid ASCENDING ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid_group>).
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        DATA(lv_conn_key) = |F{ lv_node_key }|.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data(
          node_key = lv_conn_key
          parent_key = lv_carr_key
          level = 1
          text = |Flight: { <fs_connid_group>-connid }|
          carrid = <fs_connid_group>-carrid
          connid = <fs_connid_group>-connid
        ) TO rt_data.

        LOOP AT GROUP <fs_connid_group> INTO DATA(ls_fldate).
          lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
          APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data(
            node_key = |D{ lv_node_key }|
            parent_key = lv_conn_key
            level = 2
            text = |Date: { ls_fldate-fldate }|
            carrid = ls_fldate-carrid
            connid = ls_fldate-connid
            fldate = ls_fldate-fldate
          ) TO rt_data.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_hierarchical_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
        node_layout_enabled = abap_true.

    DATA(lt_data) = get_hierarchical_sflight_data( ).

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'TEXT' text = 'Description' )
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flight No.' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' )
    ).

    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_FLIGHT_DATA'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab = lt_data
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
    ).

    mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_column_tree`, der eine Hierarchie von Paketen und deren direkten Unterpaketen anzeigt, basierend auf `cl_pak_package_queries`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_sub_packages` rekursiv und füllen Sie den `cl_gui_column_tree` dynamisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_tree_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             level TYPE i,
             packname TYPE devclass,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_package_node.
    TYPES tt_package_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_package_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_package_hierarchy
      IMPORTING
        iv_root_package TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_package_nodes.

    METHODS display_package_tree
      IMPORTING
        iv_root_package TYPE devclass.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mv_node_counter TYPE i.

    METHODS add_sub_packages_to_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_package TYPE devclass
        iv_level TYPE i
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes TYPE tt_package_nodes.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_tree_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_package_hierarchy.
    mv_node_counter = 0.
    add_sub_packages_to_nodes(
      iv_parent_key = ''
      iv_package = iv_root_package
      iv_level = 0
      CHANGING
        ct_nodes = rt_nodes
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_sub_packages_to_nodes.
    DATA(lt_sub_packages) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_sub_packages(
      i_package = iv_package
      i_active_only = abap_true
    ).

    " Add current package as a node if it's the root or a sub-package
    IF iv_parent_key IS INITIAL.
      mv_node_counter = mv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_current_key) = |P{ mv_node_counter }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_package_node(
        node_key = lv_current_key
        parent_key = iv_parent_key
        level = iv_level
        packname = iv_package
        description = |Package: { iv_package }|
      ) TO ct_nodes.
    ELSE.
      lv_current_key = iv_parent_key.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sub_packages INTO DATA(ls_sub_package).
      mv_node_counter = mv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_sub_package_key) = |P{ mv_node_counter }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_package_node(
        node_key = lv_sub_package_key
        parent_key = lv_current_key
        level = iv_level + 1
        packname = ls_sub_package-devclass
        description = |Sub-Package: { ls_sub_package-devclass }|
      ) TO ct_nodes.

      " Recursively add sub-packages
      add_sub_packages_to_nodes(
        iv_parent_key = lv_sub_package_key
        iv_package = ls_sub_package-devclass
        iv_level = iv_level + 1
        CHANGING
          ct_nodes = ct_nodes
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_package_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
        node_layout_enabled = abap_true.

    DATA(lt_nodes) = get_package_hierarchy( iv_root_package ).

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'DESCRIPTION' text = 'Description' )
      ( fieldname = 'PACKNAME' text = 'Package Name' )
    ).

    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_PACKAGE_NODE'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab = lt_nodes
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
    ).

    mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_sflight_nodes TYPE tt_sflight_nodes.

    METHODS handle_node_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_column_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.

CLASS zcl_sflights_tree_events IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflight_nodes = get_sflight_nodes( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_node(
        node_key = |{ lv_node_key }|
        parent_key = ''
        level = 0
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom
        cityto = ls_sflight-cityto
      ) TO rt_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
        node_layout_enabled = abap_true.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_node_double_click FOR mo_column_tree.

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flight No.' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' )
      ( fieldname = 'CITYFROM' text = 'From' )
      ( fieldname = 'CITYTO' text = 'To' )
    ).

    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab = mt_sflight_nodes
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
    ).

    mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    READ TABLE mt_sflight_nodes INTO DATA(ls_selected_node) WITH KEY node_key = node_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_demo_output=>display_data(
        EXPORTING
          value = VALUE string_table(
            ( |Airline: { ls_selected_node-carrid }| )
            ( |Flight No.: { ls_selected_node-connid }| )
            ( |Flight Date: { ls_selected_node-fldate }| )
            ( |From: { ls_selected_node-cityfrom }| )
            ( |To: { ls_selected_node-cityto }| )
          )
          name = |Flight Details for Node { node_key }|
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

category: UI, ALV Tree, Grouping, Internal Tables
Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` an, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und dann nach Flugnummer (`CONNID`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `LOOP AT` Anweisung, um die hierarchischen Daten vorzubereiten, ähnlich wie in `tree_002`, aber mit Fokus auf die Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_tree_groupby DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             level TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_flight_nodes.

    METHODS display_grouped_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_tree_groupby IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_grouped_sflight_data.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid_group>).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      DATA(lv_carr_key) = |C{ lv_node_key }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
        node_key = lv_carr_key
        parent_key = ''
        level = 0
        text = |Airline: { <fs_carrid_group>-carrid }|
        carrid = <fs_carrid_group>-carrid
      ) TO rt_nodes.

      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_carrid_group> INTO DATA(ls_connid) GROUP BY ls_connid-connid ASCENDING ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid_group>).
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        DATA(lv_conn_key) = |F{ lv_node_key }|.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
          node_key = lv_conn_key
          parent_key = lv_carr_key
          level = 1
          text = |Flight: { <fs_connid_group>-connid }|
          carrid = <fs_connid_group>-carrid
          connid = <fs_connid_group>-connid
        ) TO rt_nodes.

        LOOP AT GROUP <fs_connid_group> INTO DATA(ls_fldate).
          lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
          APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
            node_key = |D{ lv_node_key }|
            parent_key = lv_conn_key
            level = 2
            text = |Date: { ls_fldate-fldate }|
            carrid = ls_fldate-carrid
            connid = ls_fldate-connid
            fldate = ls_fldate-fldate
          ) TO rt_nodes.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_grouped_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
        node_layout_enabled = abap_true.

    DATA(lt_nodes) = get_grouped_sflight_data( ).

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'TEXT' text = 'Description' )
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flight No.' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' )
    ).

    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_FLIGHT_NODE'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab = lt_nodes
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
    ).

    mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_grouped_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_grouped_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_tree_groupby( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->get_grouped_sflight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'SFLIGHTS table is empty, cannot test' act = lines( lt_nodes ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_warn ).
    IF lines( lt_nodes ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_nodes[ 1 ]-node_key ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_nodes[ 1 ]-level exp = 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_nodes[ 1 ]-carrid ).

      " Check for at least one child node if a parent exists
      DATA(lv_parent_key) = lt_nodes[ 1 ]-node_key.
      DATA(lv_child_exists) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
        IF ls_node-parent_key = lv_parent_key.
          lv_child_exists = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'No child nodes found for first parent' act = lv_child_exists ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Gruppierungsfunktion von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in ABAP 7.50+, um hierarchische Daten für ein `cl_gui_column_tree` vorzubereiten. Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` werden zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Flugnummer gruppiert. Dies erzeugt eine dreistufige Hierarchie, die direkt in den Tree geladen werden kann. Die Verwendung von `GROUP BY` ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um komplexe Datenstrukturen für die UI-Darstellung zu aggregieren.
keywords: cl_gui_column_tree, GROUP BY, Hierarchy, SFLIGHTS, UI, Datenaggregation

CLASS zcl_pak_check_existence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS check_package_active
      IMPORTING
        iv_package TYPE devclass

CLASS zcl_pak_check_existence IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_package_active.
    DATA(ls_attributes) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_attributes( iv_package ).

    rv_is_active = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN ls_attributes IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_attributes-devclass IS NOT INITIAL
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle aktiven globalen Klassen (Objekttyp `CLAS`) in einem Paket und verwenden Sie RTTI, um deren öffentliche Methoden zu listen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_objects_in_package` mit `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und `get_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_rtti_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             class_name TYPE trobj_name,
             method_name TYPE seocmpname,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_methods_in_package
      IMPORTING
        iv_package TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_rtti_methods IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_public_methods_in_package.
    DATA(lt_classes) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_objects_in_package(
      i_package = iv_package
      i_object_type = 'CLAS'
      i_active_only = abap_true
    ).

    rt_methods = VALUE tt_method_info(
      FOR ls_class IN lt_classes
      LET lo_class_descr = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_class-obj_name ) )
          lt_methods = lo_class_descr->get_methods( )
      IN
      ( FOR ls_method IN lt_methods
        WHERE ( ls_method-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public )
        ( class_name = ls_class-obj_name,
          method_name = ls_method-name ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,

CLASS zcl_sflights_tree_string_fmt IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_formatted_sflight_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_nodes = VALUE tt_sflight_nodes(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( node_key = |{ CONV string( lv_node_key + 1 ) }|
        parent_key = ''
        level = 0
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate

      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flight No.' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' )
      ( fieldname = 'CITY_FORMATTED' text = 'Route' )
    ).

    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab = lt_nodes
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
    ).

    mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_tree_cond_fmt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,

             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto TYPE s_cityname,
             cell_color TYPE lvc_t_scol,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.
    TYPES tt_sflight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_conditional_formatted_nodes
      IMPORTING
        iv_highlight_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_sflight_nodes.

      IMPORTING
        iv_highlight_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_tree_cond_fmt IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_conditional_formatted_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_nodes = VALUE tt_sflight_nodes(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( node_key = |{ CONV string( lv_node_key + 1 ) }|
        parent_key = ''
        level = 0
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom
        cityto = ls_sflight-cityto
        cell_color = COND lvc_t_scol(
          WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = iv_highlight_carrid
          THEN VALUE lvc_t_scol( ( fname = 'CARRID' color = '3' int = '0' ) )
          ELSE VALUE lvc_t_scol( ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_conditional_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
        node_layout_enabled = abap_true.

    DATA(lt_nodes) = get_conditional_formatted_nodes( iv_highlight_carrid ).

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flight No.' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' )
      ( fieldname = 'CITYFROM' text = 'From' )
      ( fieldname = 'CITYTO' text = 'To' )
    ).

    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_NODE'
        i_tabname_layout = 'CELL_COLOR'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab = lt_nodes
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
    ).

    mo_column_tree->expand_tree( ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_conditional_formatted_nodes FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_conditional_formatted_nodes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_tree_cond_fmt( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->get_conditional_formatted_nodes( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'SFLIGHTS table is empty, cannot test' act = lines( lt_nodes ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_warn ).
    IF lines( lt_nodes ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
      DATA(lv_other_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
        IF ls_node-carrid = 'LH'.
          lv_lh_found = abap_true.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_node-cell_color ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_node-cell_color[ 1 ]-color exp = '3' ).
        ELSE.
          lv_other_found = abap_true.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_node-cell_color ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'No LH flights found for highlighting' act = lv_lh_found ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'No other flights found for comparison' act = lv_other_found ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man bedingte Formatierung in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` implementiert. Mithilfe des `COND`-Operators wird die `CELL_COLOR`-Struktur dynamisch gefüllt: Wenn die Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) mit dem Highlight-Kriterium übereinstimmt, wird eine Farbe zugewiesen; andernfalls bleibt sie leer. Dies ermöglicht eine visuelle Hervorhebung von Daten basierend auf bestimmten Bedingungen, was die Benutzerfreundlichkeit verbessert und eine moderne Art der Datenpräsentation darstellt.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei ABAP-Timestamps in Sekunden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `SUBTRACT_TSTMP` der Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_diff_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_difference_in_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_diff_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_difference_in_seconds.
    cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract_tstmp(
      EXPORTING
        tstmp1 = iv_timestamp1
        tstmp2 = iv_timestamp2
      IMPORTING
        seconds = rv_seconds
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_difference.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_tstmp_diff_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp_start) = '20231026100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_end)   = '20231026100130.0000000'. " 90 seconds later

    DATA(lv_difference) = lo_calculator->get_difference_in_seconds(
      iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp_end,
      iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp_start
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_difference exp = 90 msg = 'Timestamp difference calculation failed' ).

    lv_difference = lo_calculator->get_difference_in_seconds(
      iv_timestamp1 = lv_tstmp_start,
      iv_timestamp2 = lv_tstmp_end
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_difference exp = -90 msg = 'Timestamp difference calculation failed for negative result' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach dem Flugdatum und ermitteln Sie für jedes Datum den frühesten und spätesten Abflug-Timestamp. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tstmp_analysis DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_tstmp_summary,
             fldate       TYPE sflight-fldate,
             earliest_tstmp TYPE timestampl,
             latest_tstmp   TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_date_tstmp_summary,
           tt_date_tstmp_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_tstmp_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_flight_timestamps
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_date_tstmp_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tstmp_analysis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_flight_timestamps.
    DATA: lv_earliest_tstmp TYPE timestampl,
          lv_latest_tstmp   TYPE timestampl.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-fldate.
      CLEAR: lv_earliest_tstmp, lv_latest_tstmp.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp(
                                   date = ls_grouped_flight-fldate
                                   time = ls_grouped_flight-deptime ).

        IF lv_earliest_tstmp IS INITIAL OR lv_current_tstmp < lv_earliest_tstmp.
          lv_earliest_tstmp = lv_current_tstmp.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_latest_tstmp IS INITIAL OR lv_current_tstmp > lv_latest_tstmp.
          lv_latest_tstmp = lv_current_tstmp.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_date_tstmp_summary(
        fldate       = ls_flight-fldate
        earliest_tstmp = lv_earliest_tstmp
        latest_tstmp   = lv_latest_tstmp
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_flight_analysis.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_tstmp_analysis( ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Timestamp in der Zukunft liegt, unter Berücksichtigung der aktuellen Systemzeit.
hint: Vergleichen Sie den Timestamp mit dem aktuellen UTC-Timestamp, der mit `GET TIME STAMP FIELD` ermittelt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_future_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_future_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_future_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_future_timestamp.
    DATA(lv_current_utc_tstmp) TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_current_utc_tstmp.

    IF iv_timestamp > lv_current_utc_tstmp.
      rv_is_future = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_future = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_check.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_tstmp_future_check( ).
    DATA(lv_current_utc_tstmp) TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_current_utc_tstmp.

    " Test with a future timestamp (current + 1 minute)
    DATA(lv_future_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add_seconds_to_tstmp(
                               tstmp = lv_current_utc_tstmp
                               seconds = 60 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_checker->is_future_timestamp( lv_future_tstmp ) msg = 'Future timestamp not recognized' ).

    " Test with a past timestamp (current - 1 minute)
    DATA(lv_past_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add_seconds_to_tstmp(
                             tstmp = lv_current_utc_tstmp
                             seconds = -60 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_checker->is_future_timestamp( lv_past_tstmp ) msg = 'Past timestamp incorrectly recognized as future' ).

    " Test with current timestamp (should be false or very close to false)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_checker->is_future_timestamp( lv_current_utc_tstmp ) msg = 'Current timestamp incorrectly recognized as future' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Überprüfung, ob ein Timestamp in der Zukunft liegt, indem er mit dem aktuellen System-Timestamp verglichen wird. Die Verwendung von `GET TIME STAMP FIELD` für die aktuelle Zeit und der direkte Vergleich von Timestamps sind effizient und präzise für solche Zeitprüfungen.
keywords: TIMESTAMP, ZUKUNFT, BEDINGUNG, GET TIME STAMP, VERGLEICH

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen Timestamp kapselt und Methoden zum Abrufen des Datums, der Uhrzeit und zum Hinzufügen von Sekunden bereitstellt, wobei intern `cl_abap_tstmp` verwendet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` Methoden innerhalb der Kapselungsklasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timestamp_wrapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl.

    METHODS get_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date) TYPE dats.

    METHODS get_time
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_time) TYPE tims.

    METHODS add_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_seconds TYPE i.

    METHODS get_timestamp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_timestamp TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_wrapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_timestamp = iv_timestamp.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_date.
    DATA(lv_dummy_time) TYPE tims.
    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_system_time(
      EXPORTING
        tstmp    = mv_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        date     = rv_date
        time     = lv_dummy_time
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_time.
    DATA(lv_dummy_date) TYPE dats.
    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_system_time(
      EXPORTING
        tstmp    = mv_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        date     = lv_dummy_date
        time     = rv_time
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_seconds.
    cl_abap_tstmp=>add_seconds_to_tstmp(
      EXPORTING
        tstmp   = mv_timestamp
        seconds = iv_seconds
      IMPORTING
        new_tstmp = mv_timestamp
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_timestamp.
    rv_timestamp = mv_timestamp.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timestamp_wrapper FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timestamp_wrapper.
    DATA(lv_initial_tstmp) = '20231203100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lo_tstmp_wrapper) = NEW zcl_timestamp_wrapper( iv_timestamp = lv_initial_tstmp ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_tstmp_wrapper->get_date( ) exp = '20231203' msg = 'Wrapped date incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_tstmp_wrapper->get_time( ) exp = '110000' msg = 'Wrapped time incorrect (assuming CET+1)' ).

    lo_tstmp_wrapper->add_seconds( 3600 ). " Add 1 hour
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_tstmp_wrapper->get_timestamp( ) exp = '20231203110000.0000000' msg = 'Adding seconds failed' ).

    lo_tstmp_wrapper->add_seconds( -1800 ). " Subtract 30 minutes
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_tstmp_wrapper->get_timestamp( ) exp = '20231203103000.0000000' msg = 'Subtracting seconds failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kapselung der `cl_abap_tstmp`-Funktionalität in einer eigenen Klasse. Dies fördert die Objektorientierung, indem der interne Zustand (der Timestamp) geschützt und der Zugriff über definierte Methoden erfolgt. Es verbessert die Wartbarkeit und Lesbarkeit des Codes, da die Details der Timestamp-Manipulation abstrahiert werden.
keywords: TIMESTAMP, OBJEKTORIENTIERUNG, KAPSELUNG, cl_abap_tstmp, DATUM, UHRZEIT

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String mit verschachtelten Objekten und extrahieren Sie einen Wert aus einer tief verschachtelten Eigenschaft. Der JSON-String enthält eine 'order' mit 'customer' und darin 'address' mit 'city'.
hint: Parsen Sie in eine tiefe ABAP-Struktur und greifen Sie dann über die Komponenten auf den Wert zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_nested_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_address,
             city TYPE string,
           END OF ty_address,
           BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             name    TYPE string,
             address TYPE ty_address,
           END OF ty_customer,
           BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id TYPE string,
             customer TYPE ty_customer,
           END OF ty_order.

    METHODS get_city_from_order
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_city) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_nested_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_from_order.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    DATA(lr_json_data) = lo_parser->parse( iv_json_string = iv_json_string ).

    DATA ls_order TYPE ty_order.
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE json_data = lr_json_data
      RESULT abap_data = ls_order.

    rv_city = ls_order-customer-address-city.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).

CLASS zcl_json_filter_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_active_items
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_json_filter_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_active_items.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    DATA(lr_json_data) = lo_parser->parse( iv_json_string = iv_json_string ).

    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE json_data = lr_json_data
      RESULT abap_data = lt_all_items.

    " Modern ABAP filtering
    rt_active_items = FILTER #( lt_all_items WHERE status = 'active' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_ui2_number_rounder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_value          TYPE decfloat16
        iv_decimals       TYPE i

CLASS zcl_ui2_number_rounder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD round_decimal.
    DATA(lo_number) = /ui2/cl_number=>get_instance( ).
    " /ui2/cl_number does not have a direct 'round' method like standard ABAP functions.
    " We can achieve rounding by formatting to a string with desired decimals
    " and then parsing it back. This demonstrates its use for precision control.
    DATA(l_formatted_string) = lo_number->format_number(
                                  iv_value = iv_value
                                  iv_decimals = iv_decimals
                                  iv_round_mode = /ui2/cl_number=>co_round_half_up ). " Example round mode
    rv_rounded_value = lo_number->parse_number( iv_value = l_formatted_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Ermitteln Sie die Benutzereinstellungen (z.B. über `GET PARAMETER ID`) und übergeben Sie diese an die Instanz von `/ui2/cl_number`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui2_dynamic_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_number_with_user_settings
      IMPORTING
        iv_value   TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui2_dynamic_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_number_with_user_settings.
    DATA l_decimal_char TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    DATA l_thousands_char TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    DATA l_date_format TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    " Get user settings for number format
    CALL FUNCTION 'GET_USER_DEFAULTS'
      EXPORTING
        username = sy-uname
      IMPORTING
        decimal_char   = l_decimal_char
        thousands_char = l_thousands_char
        date_format    = l_date_format " Not directly used for number, but often retrieved together
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.

    DATA(lo_number) = /ui2/cl_number=>get_instance( ).
    " /ui2/cl_number automatically uses current user settings if no locale is provided.
    " However, for explicit control or testing, one might set parameters.
    " For this example, we rely on its default behavior to pick up SY-LANGE and user settings.
    rv_formatted_string = lo_number->format_number( iv_value = iv_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Objekten enthält, und verwenden Sie dann moderne ABAP-Syntax (z.B. `FOR` und `VALUE`), um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur bestimmte Felder der geparsten Daten enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` mit `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_transform_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_item,
             id     TYPE string,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_item,
           tt_raw_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_item WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_processed_item,
             product_name TYPE string,
             price        TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_processed_item,
           tt_processed_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_json_to_new_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE tt_processed_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_transform_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_json_to_new_table.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    DATA(lr_json_data) = lo_parser->parse( iv_json_string = iv_json_string ).

    DATA lt_raw_items TYPE tt_raw_items.
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE json_data = lr_json_data
      RESULT abap_data = lt_raw_items.

    " Use VALUE and FOR to transform and select fields
    rt_processed_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_items
                                  ( product_name = ls_raw-name,
                                    price        = ls_raw-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Objekten enthält, und berechnen Sie die Summe eines numerischen Feldes (`value`) für alle 'active' Objekte, unter Verwendung von `cl_clb_parse_json` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` mit `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_reduce_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id     TYPE string,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_active_value_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_reduce_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_active_value_sum.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    DATA(lr_json_data) = lo_parser->parse( iv_json_string = iv_json_string ).

    DATA lt_all_items TYPE tt_items.
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id
      SOURCE json_data = lr_json_data
      RESULT abap_data = lt_all_items.

    " Filter and then Reduce to sum values
    rv_sum = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0 ##DECFLOAT16
                                FOR ls_item IN FILTER #( lt_all_items WHERE status = 'active' )
                                  NEXT s = s + ls_item-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen numerischen Wert (DECFLOAT16) in eine komprimierte String-Darstellung und wieder zurück, unter Verwendung von `/ui2/cl_number` (oder einer ähnlichen Funktionalität, die die Klasse bietet).
hint: Suchen Sie nach Methoden in `/ui2/cl_number`, die eine interne, komprimierte Darstellung von Zahlen ermöglichen, oder nutzen Sie die Formatierungs- und Parsing-Methoden für eine 'Standard'-Darstellung.

CLASS zcl_ui2_number_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_and_decompress
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_value TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decompressed_value) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui2_number_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress.
    DATA(lo_number) = /ui2/cl_number=>get_instance( ).

    " /ui2/cl_number itself does not directly offer 'compressed string representation'
    " in the sense of a generic serialization class like /UI2/BASIS_TINY_DATA.
    " However, its format_number and parse_number methods can be used to convert
    " to a canonical string representation and back, which is a form of serialization.
    " For a truly 'compressed' representation, one would typically use a dedicated
    " serialization class or custom logic.
    " This example demonstrates a canonical string conversion using /ui2/cl_number.

    DATA(l_canonical_string) = lo_number->format_number( iv_value = iv_original_value iv_decimals = 10 iv_round_mode = /ui2/cl_number=>co_round_none ).
    rv_decompressed_value = lo_number->parse_number( iv_value = l_canonical_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei `DECFLOAT16`-Werte auf Gleichheit unter Berücksichtigung einer Toleranzschwelle, um Rundungsfehler zu vermeiden, unter Verwendung von `/ui2/cl_number` (oder einer ähnlichen Funktionalität, die die Klasse bietet).
hint: Nutzen Sie die Formatierungs- und Parsing-Methoden von `/ui2/cl_number` in Kombination mit einer Rundung, um eine Vergleichsbasis zu schaffen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui2_number_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_with_tolerance
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1   TYPE decfloat16
        iv_value2   TYPE decfloat16
        iv_tolerance TYPE decfloat16 OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui2_number_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_with_tolerance.
    DATA(l_tolerance) TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '0.00000001' ##DECFLOAT16.
    IF iv_tolerance IS SUPPLIED AND iv_tolerance > 0.
      l_tolerance = iv_tolerance.
    ENDIF.

    " /ui2/cl_number does not provide a direct 'compare with tolerance' method.
    " However, we can leverage its formatting capabilities to round numbers
    " to a certain precision before comparison, effectively introducing tolerance.
    " Alternatively, direct subtraction and comparison with tolerance is standard.
    " This example uses direct subtraction as it's more robust for tolerance.
    " If /ui2/cl_number had a specific 'is_equal_with_tolerance' method, it would be used.

    IF abs( iv_value1 - iv_value2 ) < l_tolerance.
      rv_are_equal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_are_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui2_decimal_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_decimals_from_formatted
      IMPORTING
        iv_value   TYPE decfloat16
        iv_locale  TYPE sy-langu OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decimal_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui2_decimal_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_decimals_from_formatted.
    DATA(lo_number) = /ui2/cl_number=>get_instance( iv_locale = iv_locale ).
    DATA(l_formatted_string) = lo_number->format_number( iv_value = iv_value ).

    DATA(l_decimal_separator) = lo_number->get_decimal_separator( ).

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF l_decimal_separator IN l_formatted_string MATCH OFFSET DATA(l_offset).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_decimal_count = strlen( l_formatted_string ) - l_offset - 1.
    ELSE.
      rv_decimal_count = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.

      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für 'AA' in SFLIGHT mit SEATSOCC > 0
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 0 msg = 'Sollte eine Summe > 0 für AA liefern' ).

    " Test für eine nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft oder ohne belegte Sitze
    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( 'XX' ).

explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine funktionale Programmiertechnik, die den Code kompakter und ausdrucksstärker macht als traditionelle `LOOP`- und `SUM`-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in der `sflights`-Tabelle, der eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und Flugnummer (`CONNID`) hat, und geben Sie dessen Flugdatum (`FLDATE`) zurück. Wenn kein solcher Flug gefunden wird, geben Sie das Initialdatum zurück.

CLASS zcl_flight_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen aus einem String und konvertieren Sie ihn in Großbuchstaben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_manipulation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `FINAL` für Methoden und Klassen, um die Vererbung und Überschreibung zu kontrollieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FINAL` in der Klassendefinition und bei Methoden, die nicht überschrieben werden sollen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_class DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_info ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_fixed_info FINAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fixed_info.
    rv_info = 'This info cannot be overridden.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_derived_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_base_class.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_info REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_derived_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_info.
    rv_info = 'Info from derived class.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_final_methods FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_final_class FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_final_methods.
    DATA(lo_derived) = NEW zcl_derived_class( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_derived->get_info( ) exp = 'Info from derived class.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_derived->get_fixed_info( ) exp = 'This info cannot be overridden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_final_class.
    " Eine Klasse, die FINAL ist, kann nicht beerbt werden.
    " Dies kann hier nicht direkt im Unit Test geprüft werden, da es ein Syntaxfehler wäre.
    " Der Test bestätigt lediglich die Funktionalität der FINAL-Methode.
    DATA(lo_derived) = NEW zcl_derived_class( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_derived ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Schlüsselwort `FINAL` kann für Klassen und Methoden verwendet werden. Eine `FINAL` Klasse kann nicht beerbt werden, was die Architektur stabilisiert. Eine `FINAL` Methode kann in Unterklassen nicht überschrieben werden, was die Implementierung einer bestimmten Logik garantiert. Dies fördert die Kapselung und Kontrolle in der Objektorientierung.
keywords: Object Orientation, FINAL, Inheritance, Methods, Classes, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation einer internen Tabelle durch, indem Sie nur bestimmte Felder auswählen und umbenennen, und dabei eine neue interne Tabelle erstellen.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                          ( carrier_id  = ls_flight-carrid,
                            flight_num  = ls_flight-connid,
                            flight_date = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lt_summary ).
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_summary-carrier_id ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_summary-flight_num ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_summary-flight_date ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` und `VALUE` ermöglicht nicht nur das Filtern, sondern auch das Transformieren von internen Tabellen. Durch die explizite Zuweisung von Feldern im Konstruktor-Ausdruck kann eine neue Tabelle mit einer anderen Struktur und umbenannten Feldern erstellt werden, was den Code sehr flexibel und lesbar macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, Transformation, FOR, VALUE, Field Mapping, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` oder eine Schleife mit `DATA()` und arithmetischen Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupied_seats.
    SELECT seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_seats).

    IF lines( lt_seats ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                      FOR ls_seat IN lt_seats
                                        NEXT sum = sum + ls_seat-seatsocc ).
      rv_average = lv_total_seats / lines( lt_seats ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_average_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_average_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_seats( ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für 'LH' in SFLIGHT
    DATA(lv_avg_lh) = lo_cut->get_average_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_avg_lh exp = 0 msg = 'Sollte einen Durchschnitt > 0 liefern' ).

    DATA(lv_avg_xx) = lo_cut->get_average_occupied_seats( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_xx exp = 0 msg = 'Sollte 0 für XX liefern' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung des Durchschnitts wird durch die Kombination von `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung und `lines()` zur Bestimmung der Anzahl der Elemente sehr effizient. Die Verwendung von `DATA()` für die Inline-Deklaration von Variablen und `decfloat16` für präzise Dezimalberechnungen sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.
keywords: Math, Average, REDUCE, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp und Daten befüllt. Dies demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr`.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_table_type TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        et_dynamic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type ).
        CREATE DATA lo_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        et_dynamic_table = lo_data->*.

        LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source_line>).
          APPEND <fs_source_line> TO et_dynamic_table.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fill_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 2 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_source_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_fill( ).
    lo_cut->fill_dynamic_table( EXPORTING it_data = lt_source_data
                                          iv_table_type = 'SFLIGHT_T'
                                IMPORTING et_dynamic_table = lt_target_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target_data ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_data[ 1 ]-carrid exp = lt_source_data[ 1 ]-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Tabellenbefüllung unter Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik. Sie erlaubt es, zur Laufzeit Tabellen beliebigen Typs zu erstellen und zu manipulieren, was in generischen Frameworks oder bei der Verarbeitung unbekannter Datenstrukturen nützlich ist. Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Zugriff auf die Daten ist hierbei effizient.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, Field Symbols, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Struktur einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) und geben Sie die Namen der Felder sowie deren Typen aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data()` um das Typobjekt zu erhalten, und `cl_abap_structdescr` um die Komponenten zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ts_sflight_key.
    METHODS get_table_structure_info
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_structure_info.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND |Feld: { ls_component-name }, Typ: { ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) }| TO rt_field_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_structure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_structure.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight. " Need at least one line for RTTI to work on data reference

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_table_structure( ).
    DATA(lt_field_info) = lo_cut->get_table_structure_info( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_field_info[ 1 ]-table_line IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_field_info ), exp = 16 ). " SFLIGHT has 16 fields
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_field_info[ 1 ], exp = 'CARRID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von RTTI (Run Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, die Struktur von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit dynamisch zu analysieren. `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data()` liefert ein Typobjekt, das dann in `cl_abap_structdescr` gecastet wird, um auf die Komponenten einer Tabellenzeile zuzugreifen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Programme oder Tools.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_structdescr, get_table_line_type, get_components, dynamische Typanalyse

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zur Laufzeit eine interne Tabelle, die die gleiche Struktur wie `sflight` hat, und fügen Sie eine dynamisch erzeugte Zeile hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabellenerzeugung. Für den Zeilenzugriff verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight. " Template for structure

    " 1. Describe the type of sflight
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflight ) ).

    " 2. Create a table type description based on sflight structure
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                            p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
                            p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                            p_unique     = abap_false ).

    " 3. Create dynamic internal table
    DATA dref_table TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA dref_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN dref_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 4. Create dynamic work area (line)
    DATA dref_line TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA dref_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE ANY.
    ASSIGN dref_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

    " 5. Fill dynamic line components
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_component> TYPE ANY.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_component> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_component> = '0400'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_component> = sy-datum. ENDIF.

    " 6. Append dynamic line to dynamic table
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Check if table has one entry
    IF lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) = 1.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine gegebene Variable eine interne Tabelle ist und ob sie leer ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref()` und die Methode `is_table_type()` sowie `lines()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_empty_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_empty_table) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_empty_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    IF lo_typedescr->is_table_type( ) = abap_true.
      ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_table>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lines( <fs_table> ) = 0.
        rv_is_empty_table = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflight` und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, wobei die Fluggesellschaft in Kleinbuchstaben umgewandelt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor, um über die Quelltabelle zu iterieren und die Daten zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ts_flight_summary.
    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                          ( carrid = to_lower( ls_flight-carrid )
                            connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDIF.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation über die interne Tabelle durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine spezifische Zeile aus der Tabelle `sflight` basierend auf einem Schlüssel (`carrid`, `connid`) und geben Sie den Flugzeugtyp (`planetype`) zurück. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass die Zeile nicht gefunden wird.

solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_planetype
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_planetype.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_planetype = lt_sflight[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-planetype DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Nachricht, die den Status eines Fluges anzeigt. Wenn die Anzahl der belegten Sitze über einem Schwellenwert liegt, soll 'Ausgebucht' angezeigt werden, ansonsten 'Verfügbar'.

CLASS zcl_string_cond_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_bar_flight_barcodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_bar_flight_barcodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_barcodes.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL.

    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    rt_flight_barcodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_barcode_text = |{ <fs_flight>-carrid }{ <fs_flight>-connid }{ <fs_flight>-fldate DATE = ISO }| IN
      ( carrid   = <fs_flight>-carrid
        connid   = <fs_flight>-connid
        fldate   = <fs_flight>-fldate
        barcode  = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode(
                     i_symbology = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_code128
                     i_text      = lv_barcode_text
                   )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen Barcode, dessen Typ (z.B. Code-128 oder QR-Code) dynamisch zur Laufzeit basierend auf einem Eingabestring bestimmt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH` Operator für die dynamische Typauswahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bar_dynamic_symbology DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_barcode
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_symbology_name TYPE string " z.B. 'CODE128', 'QRCODE'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_barcode_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_dynamic_symbology IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_barcode.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).
    DATA(lv_symbology) TYPE cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>ty_symbology.

    lv_symbology = SWITCH #( iv_symbology_name
      WHEN 'CODE128' THEN cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_code128
      WHEN 'QRCODE'  THEN cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_qrcode
      WHEN 'EAN13'   THEN cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_ean13
      ELSE THROW cx_rstx_barcode_error( textid = cx_rstx_barcode_error=>invalid_symbology )
    ).

    rv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode(
      i_symbology = lv_symbology
      i_text      = iv_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_filtered_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
