Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine sehr große Menge von Flugdaten aus `sflight` effizient mit einem expliziten Cursor, um Speicherüberläufe zu vermeiden. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Cursor immer geschlossen wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` in einem `TRY...FINALLY` Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_large_data_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_large_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_large_data_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_large_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight.

    TRY.
        DO iv_max_rows TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          " Simulieren der Verarbeitung
          APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                          connid = ls_sflight-connid
                          fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) TO rt_processed_keys.
        ENDDO.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `TRY...FINALLY` Block stellt sicher, dass der Cursor auch bei Fehlern immer geschlossen wird, was eine kritische Best Practice für die Ressourcenverwaltung ist.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die Daten über einen Cursor liest und sicherstellt, dass der Cursor auch bei einem Fehler während des Lesens geschlossen wird. Demonstrieren Sie dies durch das Auslösen einer künstlichen Ausnahme.
hint: Kapseln Sie die Cursor-Operationen in einer Methode und verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_error_safe DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_flights_with_cursor
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_raise_error_after_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 0 " Nach X Zeilen Fehler auslösen
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_error_safe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flights_with_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight,
          lv_count TYPE i.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight.

    TRY.
        DO iv_max_rows TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          lv_count = lv_count + 1.
          IF iv_raise_error_after_rows > 0 AND lv_count = iv_raise_error_after_rows.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Künstlicher Fehler ausgelöst'.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                          connid = ls_sflight-connid ) TO rt_flights.
        ENDDO.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_sql_error.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_static_check.
      FINALLY.
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cursor_normal_close.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_cursor_error_safe( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->read_flights_with_cursor( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 msg = 'Sollte 5 Zeilen normal lesen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cursor_error_close.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_cursor_error_safe( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->read_flights_with_cursor( iv_max_rows = 10 iv_raise_error_after_rows = 3 ).
    " Der Test erwartet, dass eine Ausnahme ausgelöst wird und der Cursor geschlossen ist.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verdeutlicht die Wichtigkeit des `FINALLY`-Blocks in `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY` für die sichere Ressourcenfreigabe. Selbst wenn eine Ausnahme (hier eine künstliche `cx_static_check`) während der Cursor-Verarbeitung auftritt, wird der `CLOSE CURSOR`-Befehl im `FINALLY`-Block garantiert ausgeführt, um Ressourcenlecks zu verhindern.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten mit einem Cursor (für große Datenmengen) und generieren Sie für jede gelesene Flugbuchung einen Barcode, der die Buchungsnummer enthält. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Cursor geschlossen wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie Cursor-Operationen mit der Barcode-Generierung innerhalb der Schleife und nutzen Sie `TRY...FINALLY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bar_db_integration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_barcode,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             barcode  TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_booking_barcode.
    TYPES: tt_booking_barcodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_barcode WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_barcodes_from_cursor
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_booking_barcodes) TYPE tt_booking_barcodes
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_db_integration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_barcodes_from_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight.

    TRY.
        DO iv_max_rows TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.

          DATA(lv_barcode_text) = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }{ ls_sflight-connid }{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
          DATA(lv_barcode_xstring) = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode(
                                       i_symbology = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_code128
                                       i_text      = lv_barcode_text
                                     ).

          APPEND VALUE #( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                          connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                          fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                          barcode  = lv_barcode_xstring ) TO rt_booking_barcodes.
        ENDDO.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_sql_error.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Buchungen pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflight` und generieren Sie einen Barcode, der die Fluggesellschaft und die aggregierte Anzahl darstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bar_reduce_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_booking,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             booking_count TYPE i,
             barcode TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_carrier_booking.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_and_barcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_barcodes) TYPE tt_carrier_bookings
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_reduce_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_barcode.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    rt_aggregated_barcodes = REDUCE tt_carrier_bookings(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_bookings( )
      FOR GROUPS <fs_group> OF carrid IN lt_sflights GROUP BY carrid
      LET lv_count = lines( <fs_group> ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( result
                              ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
                                booking_count = lv_count
                                barcode = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode(
                                            i_symbology = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_code128
                                            i_text      = |{ <fs_group>-carrid }:{ lv_count }|
                                          )
                              ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_aggregated ) msg = 'Sollte aggregierte Daten finden' ).
    LOOP AT lt_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_agg).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_agg-carrid msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte nicht initial sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = ls_agg-booking_count exp = 0 msg = 'Buchungsanzahl sollte größer 0 sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_agg-barcode msg = 'Barcode sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator mit `FOR GROUPS` ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Anzahl der Buchungen pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln und direkt im Reduktionsschritt einen Barcode für die aggregierten Daten zu generieren.

CLASS zcl_bar_datetime_barcode DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_barcode_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.

CLASS zcl_bar_datetime_barcode IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_datetime_barcode.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD DATA(lv_timestamp).

    DATA(lv_date) TYPE d.
    DATA(lv_time) TYPE t.
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_timestamp INTO DATE lv_date TIME lv_time.

    DATA(lv_barcode_text) = |Datum: { lv_date DATE = USER } Uhrzeit: { lv_time TIME = USER }|.

    rv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode(
      i_symbology = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_code128
      i_text      = lv_barcode_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine einfache Enumeration für den Status eines Auftrags und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode, um den Status zu verarbeiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM ... END OF ENUM` und `CASE` für die Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_order_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM order_status,
             NEW_ORDER,
             IN_PROCESS,
             COMPLETED,
             CANCELLED,
           END OF ENUM order_status.

    METHODS process_order_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE order_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_order_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_order_status.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN order_status-NEW_ORDER.
        rv_message = |Order is new and awaiting processing. (Status: { iv_status })|.
      WHEN order_status-IN_PROCESS.
        rv_message = |Order is currently being processed. (Status: { iv_status })|.
      WHEN order_status-COMPLETED.
        rv_message = |Order has been successfully completed. (Status: { iv_status })|.
      WHEN order_status-CANCELLED.
        rv_message = |Order has been cancelled. (Status: { iv_status })|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = |Unknown order status. (Status: { iv_status })|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM task_status,
             OPEN,
             IN_PROGRESS,
             CLOSED,
             ON_HOLD,
           END OF ENUM task_status.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_task,
             id      TYPE i,
             title   TYPE string,
             status  TYPE task_status,
           END OF ty_task.
    TYPES: ty_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_task WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_tasks_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_all_tasks TYPE ty_tasks
        iv_status    TYPE task_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_tasks) TYPE ty_tasks.

CLASS zcl_enum_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_tasks_by_status.

    DATA(lt_all_tasks) = VALUE zcl_enum_table_filter=>ty_tasks(
      ( id = 1 title = 'Task A' status = zcl_enum_table_filter=>task_status-OPEN )
      ( id = 2 title = 'Task B' status = zcl_enum_table_filter=>task_status-IN_PROCESS )
      ( id = 3 title = 'Task C' status = zcl_enum_table_filter=>task_status-OPEN )
      ( id = 4 title = 'Task D' status = zcl_enum_table_filter=>task_status-CLOSED )

solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_conditional_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM action_type,
             CREATE,
             UPDATE,
             DELETE,
             READ,
           END OF ENUM action_type.

    METHODS execute_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_action TYPE action_type
        iv_object TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_conditional_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_action.
    IF iv_action = action_type-CREATE.
      rv_result_message = |Object '{ iv_object }' created successfully.|.
    ELSEIF iv_action = action_type-UPDATE.
      rv_result_message = |Object '{ iv_object }' updated.|.
    ELSEIF iv_action = action_type-DELETE.
      rv_result_message = |Object '{ iv_object }' deleted.|.
    ELSEIF iv_action = action_type-READ.
      rv_result_message = |Object '{ iv_object }' read.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_result_message = |Unknown action for object '{ iv_object }'.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Dekomprimieren Sie einen XSTRING, der eine komprimierte interne Tabelle (im JSON-Format) enthält, und deserialisieren Sie ihn zurück in die ursprüngliche Tabelle.
hint: Dekomprimieren Sie den XSTRING mit `cl_abap_gzip` und deserialisieren Sie dann den resultierenden JSON-String mit `cl_abap_conv_obj_json=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_decompress_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_and_decompress_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_decompressed_table) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_decompress_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_table.
    DATA lv_json_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_compressed_data TYPE xstring.
    DATA lv_decompressed_json TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " 1. Serialize to JSON
        cl_abap_conv_obj_json=>create(
          EXPORTING
            data = it_original_table
          RECEIVING
            json = lv_json_string
        ).

        " 2. Compress JSON string
        lv_compressed_data = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text_to_xstring( lv_json_string ).

        " 3. Decompress XSTRING
        lv_decompressed_json = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring_to_text( lv_compressed_data ).

        " 4. Deserialize JSON to table
        cl_abap_conv_obj_json=>create(
          EXPORTING
            json = lv_decompressed_json
          RECEIVING
            data = rt_decompressed_table
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_conv_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        CLEAR rt_decompressed_table.
      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error INTO DATA(lx_gzip_error).
        MESSAGE lx_gzip_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        CLEAR rt_decompressed_table.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).
        MESSAGE lx_codepage_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        CLEAR rt_decompressed_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Komprimierung und Dekomprimierung eines Strings und fangen Sie mögliche Fehler ab, die während des Prozesses auftreten können, insbesondere `CX_ABAP_GZIP_ERROR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um Ausnahmen wie `CX_ABAP_GZIP_ERROR` und `CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE` zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_compress_and_decompress
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_gzip_error
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage.

    METHODS attempt_decompress_invalid
      IMPORTING
        iv_invalid_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_caught) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_compress_and_decompress.
    DATA lv_compressed_data TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lv_compressed_data = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text_to_xstring( iv_input_text ).
        rv_result_text = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring_to_text( lv_compressed_data ).
      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error INTO DATA(lx_gzip_error).
        " Fehler bei GZIP-Operation (z.B. ungültige Daten)
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_gzip_error EXPORTING previous = lx_gzip_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).
        " Fehler bei Codepage-Konvertierung
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_codepage EXPORTING previous = lx_codepage_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD attempt_decompress_invalid.
    rv_error_caught = abap_false.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring_to_text( iv_invalid_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error.
        rv_error_caught = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
        rv_error_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Größe eines Strings vor und nach der GZIP-Komprimierung, um die Effizienz der Komprimierung zu demonstrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xstrlen` für die Größe des XSTRINGs und `cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_xstring` um die UTF-8-Größe des Originalstrings zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_compression_ratio DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_compression_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_compression_info) TYPE REF TO data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_compression_result,
             original_size_bytes TYPE i,
             compressed_size_bytes TYPE i,
             compression_ratio   TYPE f,
           END OF ty_compression_result.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_compression_ratio IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_compression_info.
    DATA lv_original_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA lv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA ls_result TYPE ty_compression_result.

    TRY.
        " Get original size in bytes (UTF-8 representation)
        lv_original_xstring = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_xstring( iv_input_text ).
        ls_result-original_size_bytes = xstrlen( lv_original_xstring ).

        " Compress
        lv_compressed_xstring = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text_to_xstring( iv_input_text ).
        ls_result-compressed_size_bytes = xstrlen( lv_compressed_xstring ).

        IF ls_result-original_size_bytes > 0.
          ls_result-compression_ratio = ( 1 - ( ls_result-compressed_size_bytes / ls_result-original_size_bytes ) ) * 100.
        ELSE.
          ls_result-compression_ratio = 0.
        ENDIF.

        CREATE DATA rs_compression_info LIKE ls_result.
        ASSIGN ls_result TO CAST #( rs_compression_info ).

      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error INTO DATA(lx_gzip_error).
        MESSAGE lx_gzip_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        CLEAR rs_compression_info.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).
        MESSAGE lx_codepage_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        CLEAR rs_compression_info.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Enumeration für verschiedene Arten von Benachrichtigungen und eine Methode, die eine Liste von Benachrichtigungen basierend auf ihrem Typ generiert und zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit Benachrichtigungsobjekten zu erstellen, die die Enumeration verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_notification DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM notification_type,
             INFO,
             WARNING,
             ERROR,
             SUCCESS,
           END OF ENUM notification_type.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_notification,
             id      TYPE i,
             type    TYPE notification_type,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_notification.
    TYPES: ty_notifications TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_notification WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_notifications
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_notifications) TYPE ty_notifications.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_notification IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_notifications.
    DATA(lt_all_types) = VALUE string_table(
      ( zcl_enum_notification=>notification_type-INFO )
      ( zcl_enum_notification=>notification_type-WARNING )
      ( zcl_enum_notification=>notification_type-ERROR )
      ( zcl_enum_notification=>notification_type-SUCCESS )
    ).

    rt_notifications = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
      LET lv_type_index = ( i - 1 ) MOD lines( lt_all_types ) + 1 IN
      ( id = i
        type = CAST zcl_enum_notification=>notification_type( lt_all_types[ lv_type_index ] )
        message = |Notification { i } of type { lt_all_types[ lv_type_index ] }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_string_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM color_enum,

      RETURNING

      RAISING

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_enum_string_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).

        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD enum_to_string.

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle und speichern Sie den resultierenden XSTRING in einer temporären Datei. Lesen Sie die Datei dann wieder ein und dekomprimieren Sie den Inhalt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_gzip` für Komprimierung/Dekomprimierung und `cl_gui_frontend_services` oder `cl_abap_file_utilities` für die Dateihandhabung (hier simuliert).
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_file_io DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message   TYPE string,
             severity  TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES: ty_log_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_store_logs
      IMPORTING
        it_logs TYPE ty_log_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS read_and_decompress_logs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_logs) TYPE ty_log_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gv_temp_xstring TYPE xstring. " Simulate file storage
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_file_io IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_store_logs.
    DATA lv_json_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_compressed_data TYPE xstring.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        " 1. Serialize to JSON
        cl_abap_conv_obj_json=>create(
          EXPORTING
            data = it_logs
          RECEIVING
            json = lv_json_string
        ).

        " 2. Compress JSON string
        lv_compressed_data = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text_to_xstring( lv_json_string ).

        " 3. Simulate saving to file (store in static attribute)
        gv_temp_xstring = lv_compressed_data.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_abap_conv_json_error cx_abap_gzip_error cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
        " Error handling
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_and_decompress_logs.
    DATA lv_decompressed_json TYPE string.

    IF gv_temp_xstring IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        " 1. Decompress XSTRING
        lv_decompressed_json = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring_to_text( gv_temp_xstring ).

        " 2. Deserialize JSON to table
        cl_abap_conv_obj_json=>create(
          EXPORTING
            json = lv_decompressed_json
          RECEIVING
            data = rt_logs
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_conv_json_error cx_abap_gzip_error cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
        " Error handling
        CLEAR rt_logs.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( timestamp = '20251204101015' message = 'Error: Database connection lost.' severity = 'E' )
    ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert einen vollständigen Workflow: Komprimierung einer internen Tabelle, 'Speicherung' in einem XSTRING (simuliert eine Datei) und anschließendes 'Lesen' und Dekomprimieren. Dies ist ein häufiges Szenario, wenn große Datenmengen in Dateien abgelegt oder über Schnittstellen ausgetauscht werden müssen, um Speicherplatz oder Bandbreite zu sparen. Die Kombination von JSON-Serialisierung (`cl_abap_conv_obj_json`) und GZIP-Komprimierung (`cl_abap_gzip`) ist ein robuster und effizienter Ansatz.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen beschreibenden Status-Text ('Active', 'Inactive', 'Blocked', 'Unknown') basierend auf einem einstelligen Status-Code ('A', 'I', 'B', jeder andere) zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck für eine prägnante bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(

INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
  METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
    rv_desc = |Circle with radius { mv_radius }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
    rv_desc = |Square with side { mv_side }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
        rv_info = |{ lo_circle->zif_shape~get_description() }: Area = { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_area() }|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_square INTO DATA(lo_square).
        rv_info = |{ lo_square->zif_shape~get_description() }: Area = { lo_square->zif_shape~get_area() }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_info = 'Unknown shape type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Flugbuchungen (SFLIGHT). Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Buchungen mit einer bestimmten Verbindungs-ID enthält, und markieren Sie diese als 'Confirmed', wenn die Auslastung über 80% liegt, andernfalls als 'Pending'. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` zum Filtern und `VALUE` mit `COND` zur Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    TYPES tt_flight_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_bookings) TYPE tt_flight_bookings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_processed_bookings = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( connid = iv_connid )
        LET lv_occupancy_percent = ( ls_sflight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_sflight-seatsmax IN
          ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
            connid   = ls_sflight-connid
            fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
            seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc
            seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax
            status   = COND string( WHEN lv_occupancy_percent > 80 THEN 'Confirmed' ELSE 'Pending' ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    " Prepare test data (assuming SFLIGHT table has data)
    " For a real unit test, you might mock SFLIGHT or insert test data.
    " Here, we rely on existing SFLIGHT data.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->process_flights( '0001' ). " Assuming '0001' is a valid connid

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result should not be initial for connid 0001' ).
    " Check if all entries have the correct connid
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_booking).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_booking-connid exp = '0001' msg = 'Connection ID mismatch' ).
      DATA(lv_occupancy_percent) = ( ls_booking-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_booking-seatsmax.
      IF lv_occupancy_percent > 80.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_booking-status exp = 'Confirmed' msg = 'Status should be Confirmed' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_booking-status exp = 'Pending' msg = 'Status should be Pending' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es ermöglicht das Filtern und Transformieren von Tabellendaten in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung, wodurch die Notwendigkeit expliziter `LOOP`s und `APPEND`s erheblich reduziert wird, was zu lesbarerem und funktionalerem Code führt.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, COND, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Liste von Flugbuchungen (SFLIGHT). Gruppieren Sie diese nach ihrer Verbindungs-ID und zählen Sie die Anzahl der 'Confirmed' und 'Pending' Buchungen für jede Verbindung. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `CASE` (oder `COND`)-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` und `COND` innerhalb der Schleife, um zu kategorisieren und zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             confirmed_count TYPE i,
             pending_count TYPE i,
             other_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_status.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    rt_grouped_status = REDUCE tt_flight_status(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_status( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( connid = ls_sflight-connid )
      LET lv_confirmed_inc = COND i( WHEN ( ls_sflight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_sflight-seatsmax > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
          lv_pending_inc   = COND i( WHEN ( ls_sflight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_sflight-seatsmax <= 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
      IN
        result = VALUE #( result
                          ( connid = ls_sflight-connid
                            confirmed_count = SUM( lv_confirmed_inc )
                            pending_count = SUM( lv_pending_inc )
                            other_count = SUM( COND i( WHEN lv_confirmed_inc = 0 AND lv_pending_inc = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = ls_grouped_status-pending_count exp = 0 msg = 'Pending count should be > 0' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.50) mit `FOR GROUPS OF`, um komplexe Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Der `COND`-Ausdruck wird innerhalb der `LET`-Klausel verwendet, um Buchungen zu kategorisieren, und `SUM` wird verwendet, um sie pro Gruppe zu zählen. Dieser funktionale Ansatz vereinfacht die Gruppierungs- und Aggregationslogik im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... AT NEW/END OF`-Konstrukten erheblich, wodurch der Code deklarativer und leichter verständlich wird.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren einfachen Methoden (z.B. `add`, `subtract`). Erstellen Sie eine weitere Methode, die einen String, der einen Methodennamen darstellt, und zwei Zahlen akzeptiert, dann die angegebene Methode dynamisch auf der Klasseninstanz aufruft und das Ergebnis zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie `CASE`, um den String der Methode zuzuordnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS subtract
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS perform_operation_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_operation_name TYPE string
        iv_num1           TYPE i
        iv_num2           TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    rv_result = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    rv_result = iv_num1 * iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_operation_dynamic.
    DATA lv_method_name TYPE string.
    CASE iv_operation_name.
      WHEN 'ADD'.
        lv_method_name = 'ADD'.
      WHEN 'SUBTRACT'.
        lv_method_name = 'SUBTRACT'.
      WHEN 'MULTIPLY'.
        lv_method_name = 'MULTIPLY'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unknown operation: { iv_operation_name }|.
    ENDCASE.

    CALL METHOD me->(lv_method_name)
      EXPORTING
        iv_num1 = iv_num1
        iv_num2 = iv_num2
      RECEIVING
        rv_result = rv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Ganzzahlen. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, in der jede Zahl transformiert wird: Wenn sie kleiner als 10 ist, multiplizieren Sie sie mit 2; wenn sie zwischen 10 und 20 (einschließlich) liegt, addieren Sie 5; andernfalls subtrahieren Sie 1. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` zum Iterieren und `COND` mit `WHEN OTHERS` für die Transformationslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_input_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_numbers.
    rt_transformed_numbers = VALUE #( 
      FOR lv_number IN it_input_numbers
        ( COND i(
            WHEN lv_number < 10 THEN lv_number * 2
            WHEN lv_number >= 10 AND lv_number <= 20 THEN lv_number + 5
            ELSE lv_number - 1
          ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_number_transformer=>tt_numbers( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 24 ) ( 18 ) ( 20 ) ( 15 ) ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die effektive Berechtigungsstufe eines Benutzers ('Admin', 'Manager', 'User', 'Guest') basierend auf einer Liste der ihm zugewiesenen Rollen bestimmt. Priorisieren Sie 'Admin' vor 'Manager' und 'Manager' vor 'User'. Wenn keine erkannten Rollen gefunden werden, weisen Sie 'Guest' zu. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck mit `WHEN`-Bedingungen, die auf die Existenz von Rollen prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_auth_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_roles TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_authorization_level
      IMPORTING
        it_user_roles TYPE tt_roles
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_auth_level) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_auth_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_authorization_level.
    rv_auth_level = SWITCH string(
                      WHEN line_exists( it_user_roles[ table_line = 'Z_ADMIN_ROLE' ] ) THEN 'Admin'
                      WHEN line_exists( it_user_roles[ table_line = 'Z_MANAGER_ROLE' ] ) THEN 'Manager'
                      WHEN line_exists( it_user_roles[ table_line = 'Z_USER_ROLE' ] ) THEN 'User'
                      ELSE 'Guest' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer internen Tabelle alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Wertes in einer Spalte durch einen neuen Wert. Verwenden Sie hierfür eine funktionale Methode.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` in einer Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_replace_table_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_old_carr TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_new_carr TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_table_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_carrier.
    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                             ( COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = iv_old_carr
                                       THEN CORRESPONDING ty_sflight( ls_sflight EXCEPT carrid ) WITH carrid = iv_new_carr
                                       ELSE ls_sflight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_replace_table_value=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_replace_table_value=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0401'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_replace_table_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights
                                                iv_old_carr = 'LH'
                                                iv_new_carr = 'UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'First entry should be UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second entry should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'Third entry should be UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne Tabellenkonstruktion mit `VALUE #(` und `FOR`, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen. Innerhalb der Schleife wird `COND #(` verwendet, um bedingt Zeilen zu modifizieren. `CORRESPONDING` hilft, alle Felder außer dem zu ändernden zu kopieren, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie in einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) den Wert einer Spalte nur, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung in einer anderen Spalte erfüllt ist. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den Änderungen.

CLASS zcl_conditional_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_price_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
        iv_new_currency TYPE s_currcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price_conditionally.
    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                             ( COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-price > iv_min_price
                                       THEN CORRESPONDING ty_sflight( ls_sflight EXCEPT currency ) WITH currency = iv_new_currency
                                       ELSE ls_sflight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_multi_replace IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_result_string = iv_input_string.
    LOOP AT it_mapping ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mapping>).
      rv_result_string = replace( val = rv_result_string
                                   sub = <fs_mapping>-old_val
                                   with = <fs_mapping>-new_val
                                   occ = 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) Werte in einer Spalte und aggregieren Sie gleichzeitig die Anzahl der vorgenommenen Änderungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Tabelle zu transformieren und einen Zähler zu führen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             modified_flights TYPE tt_sflight,
             change_count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_result.

    METHODS replace_and_count
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_old_carr TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_new_carr TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_and_count.
    rs_result = REDUCE ty_result( INIT modified_flights = VALUE tt_sflight( )
                                        change_count = 0
                                  FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                  NEXT modified_flights = VALUE #( modified_flights
                                                                   ( COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = iv_old_carr
                                                                             THEN CORRESPONDING ty_sflight( ls_sflight EXCEPT carrid ) WITH carrid = iv_new_carr
                                                                             ELSE ls_sflight ) ) )
                                       change_count = change_count + COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = iv_old_carr THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_replace FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_replace.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_replace=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_reduce_replace=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0401'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0001'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_replace( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->replace_and_count( it_sflights = lt_sflights
                                                  iv_old_carr = 'LH'
                                                  iv_new_carr = 'BA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-change_count exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 changes' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-modified_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' msg = 'First entry should be BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-modified_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second entry should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-modified_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' msg = 'Third entry should be BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-modified_flights[ 4 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'Fourth entry should be UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP, das es erlaubt, eine interne Tabelle zu iterieren und dabei sowohl eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren als auch einen aggregierten Wert (hier: `change_count`) zu berechnen. Die Kombination mit `VALUE #(` und `COND #(` macht den Code sehr ausdrucksstark und effizient.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, REPLACE, REDUCE, FOR, VALUE, COND, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_replace_in_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem String alle Vorkommen eines Musters, das mit einem regulären Ausdruck definiert ist, durch einen dynamisch generierten Ersatzstring, der auf den gefundenen Gruppen des Musters basiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `REPLACE` Funktion mit `REGEX` und einer `REPLACE_WITH` Callback-Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_replace_callback DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_with_callback
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_match FOR REPLACE_WITH_HANDLER
      IMPORTING
        match_result TYPE cl_abap_regex=>match_result_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_replacement) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_replace_callback IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_with_callback.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '(\w+)-(\d+)' ). " Example: Word-Number
    rv_result_string = lo_regex->replace_with_handler( text = iv_input_string
                                                         handler = me->handle_match ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_match.
    DATA(lv_word)   = match_result[ 1 ]-submatch.
    DATA(lv_number) = match_result[ 2 ]-submatch.
    rv_replacement = |{ lv_word }_NEW_{ lv_number }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_regex_callback FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_regex_callback.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_replace_callback( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_with_callback( 'Item-123, Product-456' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Item_NEW_123, Product_NEW_456' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->replace_with_callback( 'NoMatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'NoMatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) den Wert einer Spalte basierend auf einem Lookup in einer anderen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `TABLE_LINE` oder `LINE_EXISTS` für den Lookup.
solution:
CLASS zcl_replace_with_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_mapping,
             old_carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             new_carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier_mapping.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_mapping TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_mapping WITH UNIQUE KEY old_carrid.

    METHODS replace_carrier_from_map
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_mapping  TYPE tt_carrier_mapping
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_with_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_carrier_from_map.
    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                             LET ls_map_entry = VALUE ty_carrier_mapping( it_mapping[ KEY old_carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ] OPTIONAL )
                             IN
                             ( COND #( WHEN ls_map_entry IS NOT INITIAL
                                       THEN CORRESPONDING ty_sflight( ls_sflight EXCEPT carrid ) WITH carrid = ls_map_entry-new_carrid
                                       ELSE ls_sflight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_lookup FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_lookup.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_replace_with_lookup=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_replace_with_lookup=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'SQ'. ls_sflight-connid = '0401'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA: lt_mapping TYPE zcl_replace_with_lookup=>tt_carrier_mapping,
          ls_mapping TYPE zcl_replace_with_lookup=>ty_carrier_mapping.

    ls_mapping-old_carrid = 'LH'. ls_mapping-new_carrid = 'UA'. APPEND ls_mapping TO lt_mapping.
    ls_mapping-old_carrid = 'SQ'. ls_mapping-new_carrid = 'BA'. APPEND ls_mapping TO lt_mapping.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_replace_with_lookup( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->replace_carrier_from_map( it_sflights = lt_sflights
                                                         it_mapping = lt_mapping ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'LH should be UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'AA should remain AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' msg = 'SQ should be BA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine leistungsstarke Kombination aus `FOR`, `VALUE`, `LET` und `TABLE_LINE` (mit `OPTIONAL`) für Lookups in internen Tabellen. Es ermöglicht das Ersetzen von Werten in einer Tabelle basierend auf einem Mapping in einer anderen Tabelle in einem einzigen, funktionalen Ausdruck, was den Code sehr kompakt und effizient macht.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie zufällige Flugverspätungen (in Stunden, als Float) für Flüge aus der `sflights` Tabelle und speichern Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Die Verspätungen sollen zwischen 0 und 5 Stunden liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT` und `FOR` Schleifen mit `sflights`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_delay_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_delay,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             delay_hours TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_delay.
    TYPES: tt_flight_delays TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_delay WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS simulate_delays RETURNING VALUE(rt_delays) TYPE tt_flight_delays.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_delay_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_delays.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_min_delay TYPE f VALUE 0.0,
               lc_max_delay TYPE f VALUE 5.0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_delays = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                         ( carrid      = flight-carrid
                           connid      = flight-connid
                           fldate      = flight-fldate
                           delay_hours = lc_min_delay + ( lo_random->get_next( ) * ( lc_max_delay - lc_min_delay ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_delay_sim( ).
    DATA(lt_delays) = lo_cut->simulate_delays( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_delays ) msg = 'Should generate some flight delays' ).
    LOOP AT lt_delays INTO DATA(ls_delay).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = ls_delay-delay_hours low = 0.0 high = 5.0 msg = 'Delay should be between 0 and 5 hours' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_sel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_sel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

      DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Zeichenkodierungskonvertierung durch, bei der die Quell- und Zielkodierung dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` mit variablen Kodierungsnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_dynamic_enc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_source_encoding TYPE string
        iv_target_encoding TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_dynamic_enc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_dynamic.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv_out_src) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = iv_source_encoding ).
        lo_conv_out_src->write( EXPORTING data = iv_input_string ).
        DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_conv_out_src->get_buffer( ).

        DATA(lo_conv_in_tgt) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = iv_target_encoding input = lv_xstring ).
        lo_conv_in_tgt->read( IMPORTING data = rv_converted_string ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_converted_string = 'ERROR: ' && lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_ranges_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_sql_ranges_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrid.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA: lt_carrids TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id,
          ls_range_line LIKE LINE OF lt_carrids.

    ls_range_line-sign   = 'I'.
    ls_range_line-option = 'EQ'.
    ls_range_line-low    = 'LH'.
    APPEND ls_range_line TO lt_carrids.

    ls_range_line-low    = 'AA'.
    APPEND ls_range_line TO lt_carrids.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_ranges_select( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrid( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights ). " sflights might be empty in test system
    " To make it more robust, check if any flights are returned if data exists.
    " For a real test, you'd insert test data into sflights or mock the SELECT.
    " Here, we assume sflights might be empty or contain LH/AA.
    " A better assert would be to check if all returned flights have CARRID 'LH' or 'AA'.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          cond = ( <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH' OR <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA' )
          msg = |Unexpected CARRID: { <fs_flight>-carrid }|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, dynamische Selektionskriterien zu implementieren, ohne dynamische SQL-Strings bauen zu müssen. Die `@`-Escape-Zeichen kennzeichnen Host-Variablen.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_ranges DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flüge aus `sflights` aus, bei denen `CARRID` 'LH' oder 'AA' ist und `CONNID` zwischen '0001' und '0100' liegt, aber den Wert '0050' ausschließt.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine `RANGES`-Tabelle mit mehreren Einträgen für `CARRID` und `CONNID` und verwenden Sie `IN @itab`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_complex_ranges DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_complex_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_complex_ranges IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_complex_flights.
    DATA: lt_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id,
          lt_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF s_conn_id.

    " CARRID IN ('LH', 'AA')
    lt_carrid_range = VALUE #( 
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
    ).

    " CONNID BETWEEN '0001' AND '0100' AND CONNID NE '0050'
    lt_connid_range = VALUE #( 
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0001' high = '0100' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = '0050' )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid IN @lt_carrid_range
        AND connid IN @lt_connid_range
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_keys.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_complex_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_complex_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_complex_ranges( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->get_complex_flights( ).

    " Assertions depend on actual data in sflights.
    " For a robust test, mock sflights or insert specific test data.
    " Here, we'll just check if the result is not initial and contains expected CARRIDs.
    IF lines( lt_flight_keys ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_flight_keys ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_key>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          cond = ( <fs_key>-carrid = 'LH' OR <fs_key>-carrid = 'AA' )
          msg = |Unexpected CARRID: { <fs_key>-carrid }|
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          cond = ( <fs_key>-connid >= '0001' AND <fs_key>-connid <= '0100' AND <fs_key>-connid <> '0050' )
          msg = |Unexpected CONNID: { <fs_key>-connid }|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man komplexe Selektionskriterien mit mehreren `RANGES`-Tabellen in einer `WHERE`-Klausel von Open SQL kombiniert. Die Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators zur Erstellung der `RANGES`-Tabellen und die direkte Einbindung in die `WHERE`-Klausel (`IN @itab`) sind moderne und leistungsstarke ABAP-Features ab Version 7.40/7.50.
keywords: RANGES, Open SQL, Complex Selection, VALUE, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze für Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, deren `CARRID` in einer gegebenen `RANGES`-Tabelle liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `IN RANGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        it_carrid_filter TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid IN it_carrid_filter )
      NEXT total = total + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seats.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_ranges_reduce_agg=>tt_flight_data,
          ls_flight LIKE LINE OF lt_flights.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0001'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 100. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0002'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 150. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0003'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 200. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_flight-connid = '0004'. ls_flight-seatsmax = 50. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA: lt_carrid_filter TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id,
          ls_range_line LIKE LINE OF lt_carrid_filter.

    ls_range_line-sign   = 'I'.
    ls_range_line-option = 'EQ'.
    ls_range_line-low    = 'LH'.
    APPEND ls_range_line TO lt_carrid_filter.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ranges_reduce_agg( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats(
      it_flights       = lt_flights
      it_carrid_filter = lt_carrid_filter
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 300 ). " 100 (LH) + 200 (LH)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature ab ABAP 7.50, um Aggregationen über interne Tabellen durchzuführen. In Kombination mit dem `FOR`-Ausdruck und der `WHERE`-Klausel, die eine `RANGES`-Tabelle verwendet, ermöglicht dies eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Berechnung von Summen oder anderen Aggregaten basierend auf komplexen Filterkriterien.
keywords: RANGES, REDUCE, FOR, Aggregation, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

      iv_msgv2 = 'UA 100'
      iv_msgv3 = 'nicht'

    ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_message_collection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_basic_collection( ).
    DATA(lo_message_list) = lo_cut->collect_messages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = lo_message_list->has_error_messages( )

CLASS zcl_val_ranges_msglist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids_to_validate TYPE tt_carrids
        it_allowed_carrids     TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_ranges_msglist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_carrids.
    ro_message_list = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list_factory( )->create_message_list( ).

    LOOP AT it_carrids_to_validate ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
      IF NOT <fs_carrid> IN it_allowed_carrids.
        ro_message_list->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          iv_msgno = '003' " Example message number
          iv_msgv1 = <fs_carrid>
          iv_msgv2 = 'ist'
          iv_msgv3 = 'nicht'
          iv_msgv4 = 'erlaubt'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_combined_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_combined_message_string
      IMPORTING
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_combined_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_combined_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_message_string.
    DATA(lt_messages) = io_message_list->get_messages( ).

    rv_combined_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_message IN lt_messages
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
                   |{ ls_message-msgty }| && |: { ls_message-msgid } { ls_message-msgno } - { ls_message-msgv1 } { ls_message-msgv2 } { ls_message-msgv3 } { ls_message-msgv4 }|
                 ELSE
                   s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                   |{ ls_message-msgty }| && |: { ls_message-msgid } { ls_message-msgno } - { ls_message-msgv1 } { ls_message-msgv2 } { ls_message-msgv3 } { ls_message-msgv4 }|
               )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und die `REDUCE` Expression für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES ty_carrier_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE ty_carrier_summary_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                       FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                       NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_summary( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                       total_seats = lv_total_seats ) TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result,
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'
    ).

    DATA(ls_summary_lh) = VALUE zcl_itab_group_sflights=>ty_carrier_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_summary_lh WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_summary_lh-total_seats > 0 ),
        msg = 'Total seats for LH should be greater than 0'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'LH carrier not found in summary' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen direkt in der Schleife. Die `REDUCE` Expression wird hier verwendet, um die belegten Sitze innerhalb jeder Gruppe effizient zu summieren, was eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation darstellt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_future_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_future_flight.
    TYPES ty_future_flight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_future_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_itab_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) für alle Flüge in `sflights` mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`).
hint: Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ausgewählte Felder von `sflights` in einen JSON-String, parsen Sie diesen zurück in eine interne Tabelle und filtern Sie diese dann nach einem Kriterium (z.B. Fluggesellschaft 'LH').
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_fdt_json` für Serialisierung/Deserialisierung und `FILTER` für die Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_process_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES ty_flight_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_flight_data_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_process_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_filter_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    " 1. Serialize selected fields to JSON
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_writer( ).
    lo_writer->write_data( lt_sflights_raw ).
    DATA(lv_json_string) = lo_writer->get_json_string( ).

    " 2. Deserialize JSON back into an internal table of the specific type
    DATA lt_flights_from_json TYPE ty_flight_data_tab.
    DATA(lo_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_reader( lv_json_string ).
    lo_reader->read_data( CHANGING c_data = lt_flights_from_json ).

    " 3. Filter the deserialized table
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_flights_from_json WHERE carrid = iv_filter_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_process_and_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_and_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_process_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_filter_carrid) = 'LH'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result,

    ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-carrid,

      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst werden Daten aus der Datenbank in JSON konvertiert, dann zurück in eine spezifische ABAP-Tabelle geparst und anschließend mit der `FILTER` Expression effizient gefiltert. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights` und verwenden Sie dann eine `FOR` Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`, um die durchschnittliche Auslastung (`SEATSOCC` / `SEATSMAX`) pro Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`, `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_occupancy,
             carrid          TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_occupancy.
    TYPES ty_carrier_avg_occupancy_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_occupancy) TYPE ty_carrier_avg_occupancy_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_avg_occupancy = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        avg_occupancy = REDUCE f( INIT total_occupancy = 0.0
                                   total_flights = 0
                                   FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                   NEXT total_occupancy = total_occupancy + ( <fs_group_flight>-seatsocc / <fs_group_flight>-seatsmax ),
                                        total_flights = total_flights + 1
                                   FINALLY = total_occupancy / total_flights ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_group_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result,
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'
    ).

    DATA(ls_avg_lh) = VALUE zcl_itab_for_group_reduce=>ty_carrier_avg_occupancy( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_avg_lh WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_avg_lh-avg_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_avg_lh-avg_occupancy <= 1 ),
        msg = 'Average occupancy for LH should be between 0 and 1'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'LH carrier not found in average occupancy summary' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` für die Gruppierung, gefolgt von einer `REDUCE` Expression innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen wie die Berechnung von Durchschnitten auf sehr deklarative und funktionale Weise, was den Code extrem kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation, Average

CLASS zcl_itab_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_flight_strings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flight_strings.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| TO rt_formatted_strings.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      act = lt_result,
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,

             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #(

CLASS zcl_max_price_per_airline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             distance TYPE sflight-distance,
             distid   TYPE sflight-distid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_per_carrid,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_max_price_per_carrid.
    TYPES tt_max_price_per_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price_per_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_per_airline
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE tt_max_price_per_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_per_airline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_airline.
    rt_max_prices = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key) 
      ( carrid    = group_key 
        max_price = REDUCE #( 
                      INIT max_p TYPE sflight-price = 0 
                      FOR member IN GROUP group_key 
                      NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = member-price ) 
                    ) 
      ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den maximalen Wert in einer dynamisch angegebenen Spalte einer internen Tabelle.
