    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_itab_running_total=>ty_t_items.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_input ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).
    <fs_item>-id = 1. <fs_item>-value = 10.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_input ASSIGNING <fs_item>.
    <fs_item>-id = 2. <fs_item>-value = 20.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_input ASSIGNING <fs_item>.
    <fs_item>-id = 3. <fs_item>-value = 5.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_running_total( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_running_total( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-total exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-total exp = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-total exp = 35 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_running_total_empty.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_itab_running_total=>ty_t_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_running_total( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_running_total( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle. Eine lokale Variable (`lv_running_sum`) wird verwendet, um den laufenden Summenwert zu akkumulieren, was eine elegante und moderne Lösung für dieses Problem darstellt.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die einen Startwert nimmt und nacheinander einen Rabatt anwendet, dann eine Steuer hinzufügt und das Endergebnis zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie einen funktionalen Stil.
hint: Verwenden Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Methodenaufrufe zu verketten (Method Chaining).
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_chained_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.

    METHODS apply_discount
      IMPORTING
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_chained_calc.

    METHODS add_tax
      IMPORTING
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_chained_calc.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_chained_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD apply_discount.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * ( 1 - iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_tax.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chained_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_discount_no_tax FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_calculation.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_oo_chained_calc( '100.00' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->apply_discount( '10.00' ) " 100 - 10% = 90
                                 ->add_tax( '20.00' )      " 90 + 20% = 108
                                 ->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '108.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_discount_no_tax.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_oo_chained_calc( '50.00' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '50.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch das Zurückgeben der Instanz (`ME`) in den Methoden `apply_discount` und `add_tax` wird Method Chaining ermöglicht. Dies führt zu einem flüssigen, funktionalen Programmierstil, bei dem Operationen nacheinander auf dasselbe Objekt angewendet werden können, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Functional Style, Calculation

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_unique_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_unique_carrier_ids( ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS has at least 'AA' and 'LH'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_carrids ).

    " Check for specific carriers if known to exist
    READ TABLE lt_carrids WITH KEY table_line = 'AA' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_carrids WITH KEY table_line = 'LH' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.

    " Ensure no duplicates (implicitly handled by DISTINCT, but good to verify logic)

    SORT lt_carrids.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_carrids.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrids ) exp = lv_lines_before_sort ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SELECT DISTINCT` ist die Standard-SQL-Anweisung, um nur eindeutige Werte für die ausgewählten Spalten zurückzugeben. Die Inline-Deklaration (`@DATA(rt_carrids)`) ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das die Deklaration der Zieltabelle direkt im `SELECT`-Statement ermöglicht, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.

      BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_s_flight_key,
      ty_t_flight_keys TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_s_flight_key
                         WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

      RETURNING

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_flight_keys FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_flight_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_unique_conn( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->get_unique_flight_keys( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_keys ).

    " Check for a known combination (e.g., AA 0017)
    READ TABLE lt_flight_keys WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).

    " Verify that the table is indeed hashed and unique
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( lt_flight_keys ).
    " Attempt to insert a duplicate (should fail or raise exception if not unique key)
    " This is implicitly tested by the HASHED TABLE with UNIQUE KEY definition.
    " A direct check for duplicates would involve copying to a standard table and then sorting/deleting.
    " For a HASHED TABLE with UNIQUE KEY, the DB SELECT INTO TABLE will handle duplicates by only inserting unique ones.
    " So, just checking if it's not empty and contains expected values is sufficient.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `SELECT DISTINCT` mit der Zuweisung zu einer `HASHED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um eindeutige Datensätze aus der Datenbank abzurufen und gleichzeitig eine schnelle Zugriffszeit auf diese Daten im ABAP-Programm zu gewährleisten. Die Inline-Deklaration (`@rt_flight_keys`) vereinfacht die Syntax.
keywords: SELECT DISTINCT, HASHED TABLE, Database Access, Internal Tables, Unique Key

    DATA(lt_fldates) = lo_cut->get_unique_flight_dates_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_fldates ).
    " Assuming '19950228' is a known flight date for LH in SFLIGHTS
    READ TABLE lt_fldates WITH KEY table_line = '19950228' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).

    " Check for uniqueness (implicitly handled by DISTINCT and VALUE # FOR)
    DATA(lv_lines_before_sort) = lines( lt_fldates ).
    SORT lt_fldates.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_fldates.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_fldates ) exp = lv_lines_before_sort ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flight_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_for_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_fldates) = lo_cut->get_unique_flight_dates_for_carrier( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_fldates ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression kann direkt mit einem `SELECT`-Statement kombiniert werden, um die Ergebnisse einer Datenbankabfrage zu verarbeiten. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und leistungsstarkes Feature, das die Notwendigkeit einer separaten `LOOP`-Anweisung über die Ergebnisse eliminiert und den Code extrem kompakt macht. `SELECT DISTINCT` stellt sicher, dass nur eindeutige Flugdaten berücksichtigt werden.
keywords: FOR, SELECT DISTINCT, Database Access, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle eindeutigen Abflugorte (CITYFROM) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und speichern Sie diese in einer Sorted Table.

solution:
CLASS zcl_db_unique_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_t_cities TYPE SORTED TABLE OF s_city WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_unique_departure_cities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cities) TYPE ty_t_cities.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_unique_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_departure_cities.
    SELECT DISTINCT cityfrom
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_cities.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_cities FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_cities.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_unique_cities( ).
    DATA(lt_cities) = lo_cut->get_unique_departure_cities( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_cities ).

    " Assuming 'FRANKFURT' and 'NEW YORK' are known departure cities in SFLIGHTS
    READ TABLE lt_cities WITH KEY table_line = 'FRANKFURT' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    READ TABLE lt_cities WITH KEY table_line = 'NEW YORK' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).

    " Verify that the table is sorted and unique (implicitly by SORTED TABLE with UNIQUE KEY)
    DATA(lv_prev_city) TYPE s_city.
    LOOP AT lt_cities INTO DATA(lv_city).
      IF lv_prev_city IS NOT INITIAL.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_city > lv_prev_city ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_city = lv_city.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Abrufen von Daten mit `SELECT DISTINCT` direkt in eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass die Ergebnisse nicht nur eindeutig sind, sondern auch bereits sortiert vorliegen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Daten später sortiert oder mit binärer Suche zugegriffen werden sollen, da keine nachträgliche Sortierung erforderlich ist.
keywords: SELECT DISTINCT, SORTED TABLE, Database Access, Internal Tables, CITYFROM

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine lokale, geschachtelte Struktur, die eine Kopfzeile für eine Flugbuchung (Buchungsnummer, Datum) und eine interne Tabelle mit Flugsegmenten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Abflug, Ziel) enthält. Füllen Sie diese Struktur mit Beispielwerten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie Struktur- und Tabellentypen innerhalb einer übergeordneten Strukturdefinition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_type_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight_segment.
    TYPES: tt_flight_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_header,
             booking_id TYPE s_booking_id,
             booking_date TYPE dats,
           END OF ty_booking_header.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             header   TYPE ty_booking_header,
             segments TYPE tt_flight_segments,

CLASS zcl_type_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_booking.
    rs_booking = VALUE #( header = VALUE #( booking_id = '0000000001' booking_date = '20251231' )
                          segments = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
                                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LONDON' ) ) ).

Instructions: Berechne den SHA256-Hash eines gegebenen Strings und gib ihn als Hexadezimalstring zurück.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_message_digest` mit dem Algorithmus `cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256` und konvertiere das Ergebnis in einen Hexadezimalstring.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sha256_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sha256_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sha256_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha256_hash.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_hasher->calculate_hash_for_string( iv_string = iv_input_string ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_hash_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_hasher->calculate_sha256_hash( lv_test_string ).

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) und Flugnummern (CONNID) aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, aber nur für Flüge, deren Preis über 500 liegt, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators und `VALUE`.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR` mit `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_comprehension DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ts_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_comprehension IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights WHERE ( price > 500 )
                                   ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                     connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-price = 450.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_sflight>-price = 600.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_sflight>-price = 750.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_table_comprehension( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->get_filtered_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should return 2 filtered flights' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = sy-tabix msg = 'Flight AA 0017 should be present' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt explizite Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen zu verwenden, kann man die neue Tabelle deklarativ definieren. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `FOR`-Operators filtert die Zeilen direkt, was zu effizienterem und wartungsfreundlicherem Code führt.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Table Comprehension, Filter, Transformation

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Quadrate aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle von Integern unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Initialisiere `REDUCE` mit 0 und addiere das Quadrat jeder Zahl im Iterationsschritt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_of_squares.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR number IN it_numbers
                       NEXT sum = sum + ( number ** 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->sum_of_squares( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 14 msg = 'Sum of squares should be 1*1 + 2*2 + 3*3 = 1 + 4 + 9 = 14' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_result) = lo_calculator->sum_of_squares( lt_empty_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_empty_result exp = 0 msg = 'Sum of squares for empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen für Aggregationen und Transformationen, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht. Die `INIT`-Klausel definiert den Startwert, und `NEXT` beschreibt die Iterationslogik.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Summe

Instructions: Weise einer Variable einen Status-Text basierend auf einem numerischen Statuscode zu, unter Verwendung des `SWITCH`-Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_status_code
                                WHEN 1 THEN 'Erfolgreich'
                                WHEN 2 THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
                                WHEN 3 THEN 'Fehlerhaft'
                                ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status_resolver->get_status_text( 1 ) exp = 'Erfolgreich' msg = 'Status 1 should be Erfolgreich' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status_resolver->get_status_text( 2 ) exp = 'In Bearbeitung' msg = 'Status 2 should be In Bearbeitung' ).

Er ist deutlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `IF`-`ELSE IF`-Kaskaden oder `CASE`-Anweisungen, insbesondere wenn es darum geht, einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zu bestimmen. Dies verbessert die Code-Qualität und reduziert die Komplexität.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Klasse `zcl_flight_service`, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Datenzugriffsdienst) über den Konstruktor injiziert und diese Abhängigkeit als `READ-ONLY` Attribut speichert.
hint: Nutze `FINAL` für die Klasse und `READ-ONLY` für Attribute, die im Konstruktor gesetzt werden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_access_service PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_flight_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight.
ENDINTERFACE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_access_service.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_data_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_data_access_service~get_flight_data.
    rs_sflight-carrid = iv_carrid.
    rs_sflight-connid = '0001'.
    rs_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    rs_sflight-price = 1000.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_access_service.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_data_access_service TYPE REF TO zif_data_access_service.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_data_access_service = io_data_access_service.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_data_access_service~get_flight_data.
    rs_sflight = mo_data_access_service->get_flight_data( iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_injection.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechne die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` in einer `LOOP`.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und den `GROUP`-Schlüsselwort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_count,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ts_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'BA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0100'.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should return 3 distinct carriers' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'LH should have 2 flights' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'AA should have 1 flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Erweiterung der `LOOP AT`-Anweisung in ABAP 7.50 ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Anstatt manuelle Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen für die Aggregation zu verwenden, kann man direkt über Gruppen iterieren. Dies vereinfacht den Code für komplexe Aggregationen erheblich und verbessert die Performance, da die Gruppierung vom ABAP-Laufzeitsystem optimiert wird.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, LOOP, Aggregation, Gruppierung, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Struktur (z.B. `sflight`) und fülle sie mit Daten, ohne den Tabellentyp zur Kompilierzeit zu kennen.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Datenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    " Fill with some data
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = '0400'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_price>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_price> = 550. ENDIF.

    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

    " Add another line
    CREATE DATA lr_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_connid>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = '0017'. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_fldate>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_price>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_price> = 700. ENDIF.

    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_sflight_table( ).

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Dynamic table should contain 2 entries' ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->get_name( ) exp = 'SFLIGHT' msg = 'Line type should be SFLIGHT' ).

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_carrid> msg = 'CARRID should not be initial' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Programmierung in ABAP, insbesondere die Erstellung und Manipulation von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit, ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_typedescr` (und seinen Unterklassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`) in Verbindung mit `CREATE DATA` und Field-Symbolen ermöglicht es, flexible Lösungen zu entwickeln, bei denen die genaue Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Frameworks oder Tools, die mit beliebigen Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Field-Symbols, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Führe eine Filterung einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) basierend auf einer Bedingung durch und speichere die gefilterten Zeilen in einer neuen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Nutze den `FILTER`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um Zeilen zu selektieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ts_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_result_lh) = lo_filter->get_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_lh ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should return 2 flights for LH' ).

    DATA(lt_result_aa) = lo_filter->get_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_aa ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should return 1 flight for AA' ).

    DATA(lt_result_ua) = lo_filter->get_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_ua ) exp = 0 msg = 'Should return 0 flights for UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine moderne und hochperformante Methode, um interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ermöglicht eine deklarative Definition der Filterkriterien, was den Code deutlich lesbarer und kürzer macht als traditionelle `LOOP`- und `DELETE`-Anweisungen. Die Verwendung von Schlüsseln (`USING KEY primary_key`) optimiert die Filterung zusätzlich, da das ABAP-Laufzeitsystem die effizienteste Zugriffsstrategie wählen kann.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Functional Programming, Filterung, WHERE, Schlüssel

Instructions: Füge eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, wobei die Werte direkt im `VALUE`-Operator zugewiesen werden.
hint: Nutze `VALUE #( ... )` direkt in der `INSERT`-Anweisung.

CLASS zcl_value_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ts_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_new_entry
      IMPORTING
        io_table TYPE REF TO tt_data
        iv_id    TYPE i
        iv_text  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_new_entry.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_inserter) = NEW zcl_value_insert( ).

Instructions: Eine gegebene Zeichenkette um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Positionen nach links verschieben und das Ergebnis in einem String-Template ausgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SHIFT` Befehl und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_shift_amount TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_shifted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_string.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    SHIFT lv_temp_string BY iv_shift_amount PLACES LEFT.
    rv_shifted_string = |Original: { iv_input_string }, Verschoben: { lv_temp_string }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shift_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shift_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_basic( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->shift_string( iv_input_string = 'ABCDEFG' iv_shift_amount = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'Original: ABCDEFG, Verschoben: DEF G'
    ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->shift_string( iv_input_string = '12345' iv_shift_amount = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'Original: 12345, Verschoben: 345  '
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Obwohl `SHIFT` ein älteres Statement ist, ist es weiterhin gültig und effizient für einfache Zeichenverschiebungen. String-Templates (`|...|`) sind eine moderne Art der String-Formatierung.

Instructions: Eine interne Tabelle von Strings soll zirkulär um eine variable Anzahl von Positionen verschoben werden. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife für die Iteration.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SHIFT ... CIRCULAR` und eine `FOR` Schleife mit `IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_circular DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_table_circular
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_shift_amount  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shifted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_circular IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_table_circular.
    rt_shifted_strings = VALUE #( FOR <lv_string> IN it_input_strings
                                  LET lv_temp = <lv_string> IN
                                  ( SHIFT lv_temp BY iv_shift_amount PLACES CIRCULAR. lv_temp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shift_table_circular FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shift_table_circular.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_circular( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'ABCDE' ) ( 'FGHIJ' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->shift_table_circular( it_input_strings = lt_input iv_shift_amount = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ],
      exp = 'CDEAB'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ],
      exp = 'HIJFG'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `SHIFT ... CIRCULAR` Befehl mit einer modernen `FOR`-Schleife für interne Tabellen. Die `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Syntax ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Transformation der Tabelle, was als moderner ABAP-Stil gilt.
keywords: SHIFT, CIRCULAR, FOR, Internal Tables, String Processing

Instructions: Eine Zeichenkette soll so bearbeitet werden, dass die ersten N Zeichen an das Ende der Zeichenkette verschoben werden. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einer modernen String-Funktion anstelle von `SHIFT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Operationen wie `substring` Syntax `string+offset(length)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_string_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_shift_amount TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_shifted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_string_modern.
    IF iv_shift_amount >= STRLEN( iv_input_string ).
      rv_shifted_string = iv_input_string.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    rv_shifted_string = |{ iv_input_string+iv_shift_amount(STRLEN(iv_input_string) - iv_shift_amount) }{ iv_input_string(iv_shift_amount) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shift_string_modern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shift_string_modern.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shift_replace( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->shift_string_modern( iv_input_string = 'ABCDEFG' iv_shift_amount = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'DEFGABC'
    ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->shift_string_modern( iv_input_string = '12345' iv_shift_amount = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = '34512'
    ).
    lv_result = lo_cut->shift_string_modern( iv_input_string = 'SHORT' iv_shift_amount = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'SHORT'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine 'zirkuläre Verschiebung' (ähnlich `SHIFT ... CIRCULAR` aber mit anderen Füllzeichen) mit modernen String-Operationen (`substring` Syntax `string+offset(length)`) und String-Templates erreichen kann. Dies ist oft flexibler und lesbarer als der traditionelle `SHIFT` Befehl, insbesondere wenn keine Leerzeichen als Füllzeichen gewünscht sind.
keywords: String Functions, String Templates, String Processing

Instructions: Eine Liste von Produktcodes soll bereinigt werden. Wenn ein Code mit Leerzeichen beginnt, sollen diese entfernt werden, und der Code soll auf eine feste Länge gekürzt werden. Verwenden Sie `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING` und `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING` mit `COND` für bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_cleansing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_product_codes
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_codes TYPE string_table
        iv_max_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cleaned_codes) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_cleansing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_product_codes.
    rt_cleaned_codes = VALUE #( FOR <lv_raw_code> IN it_raw_codes
                                LET lv_temp_code = <lv_raw_code> IN
                                ( COND string( WHEN lv_temp_code IS INITIAL THEN ''
                                               ELSE
                                                 SHIFT lv_temp_code LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE.
                                                 IF STRLEN( lv_temp_code ) > iv_max_length.
                                                   lv_temp_code = lv_temp_code(iv_max_length).
                                                 ENDIF.
                                                 lv_temp_code ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Eine lange Zeichenkette, die aus aneinandergereihten, festen 5-stelligen IDs besteht, soll in eine interne Tabelle von IDs zerlegt werden. Verwenden Sie `SHIFT` in Kombination mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`, um iterativ Teile des Strings zu extrahieren und `SHIFT`, um den Reststring zu kürzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_fixed_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_fixed_length_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_segment_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_segments) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_fixed_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_fixed_length_string.
    DATA(lv_remaining_string) = iv_input_string.
    rt_segments = REDUCE string_table(
      INIT segments = VALUE string_table( )
           lv_current_string = lv_remaining_string
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE STRLEN( lv_current_string ) >= iv_segment_length
      NEXT
        segments = VALUE #( segments ( lv_current_string(iv_segment_length) ) )
        lv_current_string = SHIFT lv_current_string BY iv_segment_length PLACES LEFT.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_input) = 'ID001ID002ID003SHORT'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_fixed_length_string( iv_input_string = lv_input iv_segment_length = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'ID001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'ID002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = 'ID003' ).

    lv_input = '1234567890'.
    lt_result = lo_cut->parse_fixed_length_string( iv_input_string = lv_input iv_segment_length = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 5 ] exp = '90' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel nutzt `SHIFT` innerhalb eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks, um eine Zeichenkette in Segmente fester Länge zu zerlegen. `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiges funktionales Konstrukt in modernem ABAP, das hier für eine iterative Transformation verwendet wird. Die Kombination zeigt, wie auch ältere Befehle in modernen Kontexten sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei mit formatierten Zellen. Die Kopfzeile soll fett und zentriert sein, und bestimmte Datenzellen sollen eine Hintergrundfarbe erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Formatierungsfunktionen der `if_fdt_xl_sheet` Schnittstelle, z.B. `set_cell_format`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_formatting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_formatted_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string

CLASS zcl_excel_formatting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_formatted_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight,
          lo_excel    TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_sheet    TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet,
          lo_format   TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_format.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    lo_sheet = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Formatierte Daten' ).

    " Create a format for header
    lo_format = lo_excel->create_format( ).
    lo_format->set_bold( abap_true ).
    lo_format->set_horizontal_alignment( if_fdt_xl_format=>c_align_center ).

    " Header with format
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 1 iv_value = 'Fluggesellschaft' iv_format = lo_format ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 2 iv_value = 'Flugnummer' iv_format = lo_format ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 3 iv_value = 'Datum' iv_format = lo_format ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 4 iv_value = 'Preis' iv_format = lo_format ).

    " Create a format for highlighted cells (e.g., price > 500)
    DATA(lo_highlight_format) = lo_excel->create_format( ).
    lo_highlight_format->set_background_color( if_fdt_xl_format=>c_color_yellow ).

    " Data with conditional formatting
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 iv_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 2 iv_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 3 iv_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).

      IF ls_sflight-price > 500.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 4 iv_value = ls_sflight-price iv_format = lo_highlight_format ).
      ELSE.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 4 iv_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_excel->save_document( iv_filename = iv_file_path ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei, deren Spalten dynamisch aus den Feldern einer internen Tabelle generiert werden. Die Daten stammen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) um die Feldnamen der internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_dynamic_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_excel.

CLASS zcl_excel_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_dynamic_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight,
          lo_excel    TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_sheet    TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    lo_sheet = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Dynamische Daten' ).

    " Get structure description using RTTI
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights[ 1 ] ).

    " Write header dynamically
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = sy-tabix iv_value = ls_component-name ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Write data dynamically
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      DATA(lv_column) = 1.
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_value> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_column iv_value = CONV string( <lv_value> ) ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_column = lv_column + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_excel->save_document( iv_filename = iv_file_path ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_param_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_from_url.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_url_encoded_param TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP client creation failed'.
        ENDIF.

        IF iv_param_name IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_param_value IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_url_encoded_param = cl_http_utility=>url_encode( iv_param_value ).
          lo_http_client->request->set_query_parameter( name = iv_param_name value = lv_url_encoded_param ).
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP send failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP receive failed'.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_http_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` transformieren. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Syntax wie `FOR` und `VALUE`. Zeigen Sie, wie `sy-subrc` in solchen Szenarien vermieden wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` und `sflights`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                             connid = flight-connid,
                             cityfrom = flight-cityfrom,
                             cityto = flight-cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    " Check if all entries are 'LH'
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR` und `VALUE` ermöglichen eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite `LOOP AT` Schleife mit `APPEND` zu verwenden, wird die neue Tabelle direkt aus der Quelltabelle konstruiert. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und vermeidet die Notwendigkeit, `sy-subrc` nach jedem `APPEND` zu prüfen, da Fehler bei der Konstruktion direkt als Ausnahmen behandelt werden würden.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, sflights, Declarative, sy-subrc

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Nachricht unter Verwendung von String-Templates und dem `COND`-Operator, basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `|...{ COND ... }...|`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_greeting_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_age  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_greeting_message.
    rv_message = |Hello { iv_name }, you are { COND string(
                                                WHEN iv_age < 18 THEN 'young'
                                                WHEN iv_age >= 18 AND iv_age < 65 THEN 'an adult'
                                                ELSE 'a senior' ) }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

explanation: String-Templates bieten eine lesbare und effiziente Methode zur String-Konkatenation, die die alte `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung ersetzt. `COND` ermöglicht die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten inline, was `IF`-Anweisungen in vielen Fällen ersetzt und den Code kompakter macht. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu komplexen `IF`-Blöcken, die oft mit `sy-subrc` für Fehlerprüfungen kombiniert wurden.
keywords: String Templates, COND, Dynamic String, Readability, sy-subrc

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der `sflights`-Tabelle, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i_total = 0
                          FOR flight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                          NEXT i_total = i_total + flight-seatsocc.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_passengers_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_passengers_aa FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_total_passengers_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_passengers_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( 'LH' ).
    " Assuming some data in sflights for LH
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
    " A more precise test would involve knowing the exact sum for 'LH'
    " For example, if you know LH has 2 flights with 100 and 150 seatsocc:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 250 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_passengers_aa.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_passengers_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiger Operator für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Er ersetzt manuelle Schleifen (`LOOP AT`) und Akkumulatoren, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht. Die Notwendigkeit, `sy-subrc` nach jeder Iteration zu prüfen, entfällt, da `REDUCE` eine funktionale Herangehensweise bietet.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Table, sflights, Functional Programming, sy-subrc

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und nach 'NEW YORK' fliegen, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Populate lt_sflights for demonstration, in real scenario it would be read from DB
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND cityto = 'NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " Assuming there might be such flights in sflights
    IF lines( lt_filtered ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      " If no such flights exist in sflights, this test will pass if the result is empty
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FILTER` bietet eine prägnante und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. Es ersetzt die Notwendigkeit, eine `LOOP AT` Schleife zu schreiben und manuell Zeilen in eine neue Tabelle zu `APPEND` oder zu `DELETE`. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und wartbarerem Code und macht `sy-subrc` Prüfungen für Filteroperationen überflüssig.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, sflights, Declarative, sy-subrc

Instructions: Entwerfen Sie eine Klasse mit einer fließenden Schnittstelle (Fluent Interface), um eine Kette von Operationen auf einem Objekt auszuführen.
hint: Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, ermöglichen das Chaining.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.

    METHODS subtract
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.

    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_result = mv_result - iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_fluent_chain FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_chain.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_fluent_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 10 )->subtract( 3 )->multiply( 2 )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 14 ). " (10 - 3) * 2 = 14
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Fluent Interfaces verbessern die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes, indem sie eine kaskadierende Aufrufsyntax ermöglichen. Jede Methode, die eine Operation ausführt, gibt eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurück, wodurch weitere Methoden direkt auf dem Ergebnis des vorherigen Aufrufs aufgerufen werden können. Dies ist ein modernes Designmuster, das die Notwendigkeit von temporären Variablen und `sy-subrc` Prüfungen zwischen den Schritten eliminiert.
keywords: Fluent Interface, Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Design Pattern, ME, sy-subrc

CLASS zcl_modern_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    " sy-subrc is still available after SELECT, but modern ABAP often prefers
    " checking the table content directly or using exceptions for critical errors.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error or raise exception if no data found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Obwohl `sy-subrc` nach `SELECT` weiterhin verfügbar ist, wird in modernem ABAP oft empfohlen, die Ergebnisse direkt zu prüfen oder Ausnahmen für kritische Datenbankfehler zu verwenden, um eine klarere Fehlerbehandlung zu gewährleisten.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme und demonstrieren Sie deren Verwendung mit `TRY...CATCH` anstelle von `sy-subrc`-Prüfungen für eine Fehlerbedingung.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_static_check=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_positive_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.

    METHODS caller_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_positive_number.
    IF iv_number <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_number * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD caller_method.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_doubled_number) = process_positive_number( iv_input ).
        rv_status_message = |Number { iv_input } doubled is { lv_doubled_number }.|.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        rv_status_message = |Error: { lx_invalid_input->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_positive_number_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_positive_number_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_number_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->caller_method( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Number 5 doubled is 10.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_positive_number_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->caller_method( -1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Error: Input number must be positive.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne ABAP-Fehlerbehandlung basiert auf Ausnahmen, die eine strukturierte und klarere Fehlerbehandlung ermöglichen als die Prüfung von `sy-subrc`. Durch das Erben von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` wird eine prüfbare Ausnahme definiert. `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke kapseln den Code, der eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte, und ermöglichen eine spezifische Reaktion auf verschiedene Fehlertypen. Dies ist der bevorzugte Weg gegenüber der manuellen Prüfung von `sy-subrc` nach jedem Funktionsaufruf.
keywords: Exceptions, TRY, CATCH, CX_STATIC_CHECK, Error Handling, sy-subrc

CLASS zcl_itab_line_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itab_line_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_get_index.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_key.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid CP 'L*' )

solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_capacity
                                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 150 )

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` alle Flüge, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden und deren Flugnummer größer als '0400' ist. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `FILTER` Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND connid > '0400' )
        ( carrid = flight-carrid
          connid = flight-connid
          fldate = flight-fldate
          price  = flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " Assert that all filtered flights meet the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-carrid
        exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'Carrier ID is not LH'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-connid > '0400' )
        msg = 'Connection ID is not greater than 0400'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that there are some results (assuming SFLIGHTS has such data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'No flights found, check SFLIGHTS data or filter logic'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Iteration mit `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Ausdrucks ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `APPEND`-Konstrukte.
keywords: FOR, FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights, Open SQL

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine komplexe Datenstruktur (interne Tabelle von Strukturen) in ein komprimiertes Format und deserialisieren Sie es zurück. Nutzen Sie hierfür die Klasse `/ui2/basis_tiny_data`.
hint: Die Klasse `/ui2/basis_tiny_data` bietet Methoden zur Komprimierung und Dekomprimierung von Daten, oft im JSON-Format.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_compressor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_entry,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_entry.
    TYPES tt_data_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data           TYPE tt_data_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_data) TYPE xstring. " Assuming xstring for compressed binary data

    METHODS decompress_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_compressed_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_decompressed_data) TYPE tt_data_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_compressor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_data.
    DATA(lo_tiny_data) = NEW /ui2/basis_tiny_data( ).
    DATA(lv_json_string) = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = it_data pretty_print = abap_false ). " Serialize to JSON first

    " Assuming /ui2/basis_tiny_data has a compress method for string/xstring
    " This is a plausible assumption for a "Generic compressed serialization class"
    rv_compressed_data = lo_tiny_data->compress( lv_json_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_data.
    DATA(lo_tiny_data) = NEW /ui2/basis_tiny_data( ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = lo_tiny_data->decompress( iv_compressed_data ).

    " Deserialize from JSON back to internal table
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_decompressed_string
                               CHANGING  data = rt_decompressed_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compress_decompress.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_compressor( ).
    DATA(lt_original_data) = VALUE zcl_data_compressor=>tt_data_entries(
      ( id = 1 text = 'First entry' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Second entry with more text' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Third' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_compressed) = lo_cut->compress_data( lt_original_data ).
    DATA(lt_decompressed) = lo_cut->decompress_data( lv_compressed ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_decompressed )
      exp = lines( lt_original_data )
      msg = 'Number of entries mismatch after compression/decompression'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_original_data INTO DATA(ls_original).
      READ TABLE lt_decompressed INTO DATA(ls_decompressed) WITH KEY id = ls_original-id.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc(
        act = sy-subrc
        exp = 0
        msg = 'Entry not found after decompression'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_decompressed-text
        exp = ls_original-text
        msg = 'Text mismatch for entry'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Kombination mit `/ui2/cl_json` für die JSON-Serialisierung/Deserialisierung ist ein gängiges Muster in modernen ABAP-Anwendungen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Initialisieren Sie eine Variable für die Summe und addieren Sie in jedem Schritt den Preis hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( 0 ) )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( price = '100.00' )
      ( price = '250.50' )
      ( price = '50.00' )

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = '400.50'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die jeweils die Instanz der Klasse zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen. Demonstrieren Sie dies, indem Sie eine Kette von Operationen auf einem Objekt ausführen.
hint: Jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, muss `ME` als `RETURNING VALUE` zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor.
    METHODS multiply_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_factor TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor.
    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_value.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_value.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_factor.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_chainable_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->add_value( 5 )->multiply_value( 2 )->add_value( 3 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 13 " (0 + 5) * 2 + 3 = 13
      msg = 'Method chaining result incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten, was den Code flüssiger und lesbarer macht. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um den Typ eines beliebigen Objekts zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und Informationen über seine Attribute auszugeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr` und seine Unterklassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr` oder `cl_abap_datadescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_object_type
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_type_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_object_type.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    APPEND |Object Type: { lo_descr->get_name( ) }| TO rt_type_info.

    IF lo_descr->is_structure( ) = abap_true.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).
      APPEND |  Is Structure: Yes| TO rt_type_info.
      APPEND |  Components:| TO rt_type_info.
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND |    - { ls_component-name } (Type: { ls_component-type_descr->get_name( ) })| TO rt_type_info.
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSEIF lo_descr->is_table( ) = abap_true.
      APPEND |  Is Table: Yes| TO rt_type_info.
      DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr ).
      APPEND |  Table Type: { lo_table_descr->get_table_kind_as_string( ) }| TO rt_type_info.
      APPEND |  Line Type: { lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )->get_name( ) }| TO rt_type_info.
    ELSE.
      APPEND |  Is Elementary Type: { COND string( WHEN lo_descr->is_elementary( ) = abap_true THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' ) }| TO rt_type_info.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_analyze_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_analyze_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_analyze_elementary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_analyze_structure.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_test_struct,
            field1 TYPE string,
            field2 TYPE i,
          END OF ls_test_struct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_info) = lo_cut->analyze_object_type( REF #( ls_test_struct ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_info ) exp = 0 reverse = abap_true msg = 'No RTTI info generated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 1 ] exp = 'Object Type: LS_TEST_STRUCT' msg = 'Incorrect object type' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 2 ] exp = 'Is Structure: Yes' msg = 'Not recognized as structure' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 3 ] exp = 'Components:' msg = 'Components header missing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 4 ] exp = 'field1' msg = 'Field1 info missing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 5 ] exp = 'field2' msg = 'Field2 info missing' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_analyze_table.
    DATA: lt_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_info) = lo_cut->analyze_object_type( REF #( lt_test_table ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_info ) exp = 0 reverse = abap_true msg = 'No RTTI info generated for table' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 1 ] exp = 'Object Type: LT_TEST_TABLE' msg = 'Incorrect object type for table' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 2 ] exp = 'Is Table: Yes' msg = 'Not recognized as table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_analyze_elementary.
    DATA: lv_test_char TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'Hello'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_info) = lo_cut->analyze_object_type( REF #( lv_test_char ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_info ) exp = 0 reverse = abap_true msg = 'No RTTI info generated for elementary' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 1 ] exp = 'Object Type: C' msg = 'Incorrect object type for elementary' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_info[ 2 ] exp = 'Is Elementary Type: Yes' msg = 'Not recognized as elementary' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Frameworks, Serialisierungsmechanismen oder Debugging-Tools, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen.
keywords: RTTI, Reflection, Dynamic Programming, cl_abap_typedescr

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Tagen zwischen zwei Datumsangaben und formatieren Sie ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit in einem String. Nutzen Sie die modernen Datums-/Zeit-Typen und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` für Zeitstempeloperationen und direkte Subtraktion für DATS-Typen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_time_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_difference_in_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_date1 TYPE dats
        iv_date2 TYPE dats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days_diff) TYPE i.

    METHODS format_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_time_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_difference_in_days.
    rv_days_diff = iv_date2 - iv_date1. " Direct subtraction for DATS
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_timestamp.
    DATA(lv_date) = CONV dats( iv_timestamp ).
    DATA(lv_time) = CONV tims( iv_timestamp ).
    rv_formatted_string = |Datum: { lv_date DATE = USER } Uhrzeit: { lv_time TIME = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_date_difference FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_format_timestamp FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_time_utils( ).
    DATA(lv_date1) = '20251201'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_time_utils( ).
