Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die von 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer einfachen `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_lh DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_lh IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights_lh( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und prägnante Filterung von internen Tabellen. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die der angegebenen `WHERE` Bedingung entsprechen, ohne explizite Schleifen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, WHERE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die von 'AA' (American Airlines) oder 'UA' (United Airlines) durchgeführt werden und deren Flugdatum nach dem 01.01.2000 liegt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie mehrere Bedingungen im `WHERE` Teil des `FILTER` Operators.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights
                           WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' OR carrid = 'UA' )
                             AND fldate > '20000101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights_multi( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carrier should be AA or UA'
        act = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'UA' ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date should be after 20000101'
        act = ( ls_flight-fldate > '20000101' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Beispiel zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit des `FILTER` Operators, um komplexe Filterbedingungen mit logischen Operatoren (`AND`, `OR`) direkt in der Tabellenexpression zu formulieren. Dies führt zu sehr lesbarem und wartbarem Code.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Multiple Conditions, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die eine bestimmte Flugnummer (connid) haben, und projizieren Sie nur die Felder `carrid` und `fldate` in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `FOR` um die Struktur der Zieltabelle zu definieren und die Felder zu projizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_project_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_project_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE connid = iv_connid )
                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                            fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_project_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( '0017' ). " Assuming '0017' exists in SFLIGHT

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' act = ls_summary-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flight date should not be initial' act = ls_summary-fldate ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FILTER` mit `VALUE` und `FOR` Schleifen. Zuerst wird die Tabelle gefiltert, und dann werden die gefilterten Zeilen in eine neue Tabelle mit einer reduzierten Struktur projiziert. Dies ist ein sehr effizientes und ausdrucksstarkes Muster in modernem ABAP.
keywords: FILTER, VALUE, FOR, Projection, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, deren Flugnummern in einer separaten Liste von 'relevanten' Flugnummern enthalten sind. Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einer `LINE_EXISTS` Bedingung, um die Existenz in einer anderen internen Tabelle zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_relevant_flights
      IMPORTING it_relevant_connids TYPE tt_connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_relevant_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights
                           WHERE LINE_EXISTS( it_relevant_connids[ table_line = connid ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_relevant_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_relevant_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_line_exists( ).
    DATA lt_connids TYPE zcl_filter_line_exists=>tt_connid.
    APPEND '0017' TO lt_connids.
    APPEND '0400' TO lt_connids.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_relevant_flights( lt_connids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Connid should be in relevant list'
        act = LINE_EXISTS( lt_connids[ table_line = ls_flight-connid ] ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die in den letzten 30 Tagen stattgefunden haben, und sortieren Sie das Ergebnis absteigend nach Flugdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit Datumsberechnungen und anschließend `SORT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_date_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_recent_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_filter_date_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_recent_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lv_30_days_ago) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ) - 30.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fldate >= lv_30_days_ago ).
    SORT rt_flights BY fldate DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_recent_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_recent_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_date_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_recent_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    DATA(lv_30_days_ago) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ) - 30.
    DATA lv_prev_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date should be recent' act = ( ls_flight-fldate >= lv_30_days_ago ) ).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should be sorted descending by fldate' act = ( ls_flight-fldate <= lv_prev_fldate ) ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `FILTER` Operator für die Datumsfilterung mit der `SORT` Anweisung, um das Ergebnis zu ordnen. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date()` ist eine moderne Art, das aktuelle Systemdatum zu erhalten.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) haben und deren Flugnummer (`connid`) nicht in einer Blacklist enthalten ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_blacklist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid_blacklist TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_not_in_blacklist
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                it_blacklist_connids TYPE tt_connid_blacklist
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_blacklist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_not_in_blacklist.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights
                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                             AND NOT LINE_EXISTS( it_blacklist_connids[ table_line = connid ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_not_in_blacklist FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_not_in_blacklist.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_blacklist( ).
    DATA lt_blacklist TYPE zcl_filter_blacklist=>tt_connid_blacklist.
    APPEND '0017' TO lt_blacklist. " Assuming 0017 exists for LH
    APPEND '0400' TO lt_blacklist.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_not_in_blacklist( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_blacklist_connids = lt_blacklist ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Connid should not be in blacklist'
        act = LINE_EXISTS( lt_blacklist[ table_line = ls_flight-connid ] ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `FILTER` in Verbindung mit `NOT LINE_EXISTS`, um Zeilen aus einer Tabelle auszuschließen, deren Schlüssel in einer anderen 'Blacklist'-Tabelle vorhanden sind. Dies ist eine elegante und performante Methode, um 'Anti-Joins' auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights_to_json.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = lt_flights
            pretty_print = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            json        = rv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_json_string = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS ein und sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse absteigend nach dem Flugdatum (FLDATE) und aufsteigend nach der Flugnummer (CONNID).
hint: Verwenden Sie die ORDER BY-Klausel mit ASCENDING und DESCENDING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_order_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sorted_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_order_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    SELECT *
      FROM sflights
      ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING, connid ASCENDING
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_order_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( iv_act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    DATA(lv_prev_fldate) TYPE sflights-fldate.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) TYPE sflights-connid.
    DATA(lv_first_entry) TYPE sflights.

    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX 1 INTO lv_first_entry.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_prev_fldate = lv_first_entry-fldate.
      lv_prev_connid = lv_first_entry-connid.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) STARTING AT 2.
      IF ls_flight-fldate > lv_prev_fldate.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Sorting by FLDATE DESCENDING failed.' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight-fldate = lv_prev_fldate.
        IF ls_flight-connid < lv_prev_connid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Sorting by CONNID ASCENDING failed for same FLDATE.' ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ORDER BY`-Klausel sortiert die Ergebnisse direkt auf der Datenbank. Dies ist in der Regel performanter, als die Sortierung der internen Tabelle in ABAP, besonders bei großen Datenmengen.
keywords: SELECT, ORDER BY, DESCENDING, ASCENDING, Sorting, INTO TABLE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, deren Fluggesellschaften in einer zuvor gefüllten internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften (z.B. 'LH', 'AA') enthalten sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie FOR ALL ENTRIES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fae DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT *
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_for_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_for_empty_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) TYPE zcl_sflight_fae=>tt_carrids.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_carrids.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' ) TO lt_carrids.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( iv_act = lines( lt_flights ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_for_empty_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) TYPE zcl_sflight_fae=>tt_carrids.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( iv_act = lines( lt_flights ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR ALL ENTRIES` ist eine leistungsstarke Klausel, um eine `WHERE`-Bedingung dynamisch mit Werten aus einer internen Tabelle zu füllen. Es ist eine performante Alternative zu vielen einzelnen `SELECT`-Statements oder `IN`-Operatoren bei großen Datenmengen. Wichtig ist die Prüfung auf eine nicht-initiale interne Tabelle vor dem `SELECT`.
keywords: SELECT, FOR ALL ENTRIES, INTO TABLE, Performance, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = lo_cut->get_total_capacity( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_capacity >= 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code sehr prägnant macht.

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle `sflight` alle Flüge heraus, die nach 'NEW YORK' fliegen, und speichern Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD get_ny_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).

             field1 TYPE string,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_s_target.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug (Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) in der Tabelle `sflight` existiert.

CLASS zcl_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      rb_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des nächsten Montags ausgehend vom aktuellen Systemdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder `CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_next_monday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_monday RETURNING VALUE(rv_next_monday) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_next_monday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_monday.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).

    " 1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday
    IF lv_day_of_week = 1. " If today is Monday, next Monday is in 7 days
      rv_next_monday = lv_current_date + 7.
    ELSE.
      rv_next_monday = lv_current_date + ( 8 - lv_day_of_week ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_next_monday FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_next_monday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_next_monday( ).
    DATA(lv_next_monday) = lo_cut->get_next_monday( ).

    " Assert that the calculated date is indeed a Monday
    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( lv_next_monday ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_day_of_week exp = 1 ).

    " Further checks could involve mocking sy-datum for deterministic results
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_flight_count.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_t_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   count  = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    " This test is hard to make deterministic without mocking sflight.
    " For a real test, one would insert test data into a local temporary table.
    " Assert that the result table is not empty if sflight has data.
    IF lines( lt_flight_counts ) > 0.
      " Example: Check if 'LH' exists and has a count > 0
      READ TABLE lt_flight_counts WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_count).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_count-count > 0 ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `GROUP BY` Ausdruck innerhalb einer `FOR` Schleife ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen, was Aggregationen und Analysen vereinfacht.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, FOR GROUPS

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Fluggesellschaftscode (CARRID) für alle Flüge mit der Flugnummer '0017' in einer internen Tabelle auf 'AZ'.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_carrid.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_sflights TRANSPORTING carrid = iv_new_carrid
      WHERE connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_itb_modify_where=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum price = '300' currency = 'GBP' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_where( ).
    lo_cut->update_carrid(
      EXPORTING
        iv_connid     = '0017'
        iv_new_carrid = 'AZ'
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights   = lt_sflights
    ).

    DATA(lv_count_az) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE connid = '0017'.
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'AZ'.
        lv_count_az = lv_count_az + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_count_az
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 flights with CARRID AZ for CONNID 0017'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-carrid
      exp = 'UA'
      msg = 'Expected third flight CARRID to remain UA'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE`-Anweisung ermöglicht die direkte Aktualisierung spezifischer Felder in einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung, ohne explizites `LOOP` und `READ TABLE`. Dies ist eine effiziente und lesbare Methode in modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Durchlaufen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen. Wenn der Fluggesellschaftscode 'LH' ist und der Preis unter 120 liegt, erhöhen Sie den Preis um 10%. Nutzen Sie `COND` für die Preisberechnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `MODIFY` innerhalb der Schleife. Die Preisberechnung kann mit `COND` erfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_prices_cond
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_prices_cond.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-price = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH' AND <fs_flight>-price < 120
                                  THEN <fs_flight>-price * 1.1
                                  ELSE <fs_flight>-price ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights. "Should be 110
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights. "Should remain 150
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = sy-datum price = '110' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights. "Should remain 110

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_cond( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price
      exp = '110.00'
      msg = 'Expected first flight price to be 110'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-price
      exp = '150.00'
      msg = 'Expected second flight price to remain 150'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-price
      exp = '110.00'
      msg = 'Expected third flight price to remain 110'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    lo_cut->upsert_flight(

    ).

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge mit dem Fluggesellschaftscode 'SQ' um 5%, indem Sie eine `FOR`-Expression verwenden, um die zu modifizierenden Zeilen zu identifizieren und zu aktualisieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um eine neue Tabelle mit den aktualisierten Werten zu erstellen, und dann `MODIFY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_modify_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS increase_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_modify_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_flight IN ct_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( VALUE #( ls_flight EXCEPT price ) price = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ) )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_modified_flights INTO DATA(ls_modified_flight).
      MODIFY TABLE ct_sflights FROM ls_modified_flight.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_price_for_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_itb_modify_for=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100' currency = 'SGD' ) TO lt_sflights. "Should be 105
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200' currency = 'SGD' ) TO lt_sflights. "Should be 210
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights. "Should remain 150

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_modify_for( ).
    lo_cut->increase_price_for_carrier(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid     = 'SQ'
        iv_percentage = '5'
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights   = lt_sflights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ]-price
      exp = '105.00'
      msg = 'Expected first SQ flight price to be 105'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum ]-price
      exp = '210.00'
      msg = 'Expected second SQ flight price to be 210'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum ]-price
      exp = '150.00'
      msg = 'Expected LH flight price to remain 150'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung neuer interner Tabellen oder Strukturen basierend auf vorhandenen Daten. Hier wird sie verwendet, um eine temporäre Tabelle mit den aktualisierten Flügen zu erstellen, die dann mittels `MODIFY` in die ursprüngliche Tabelle zurückgeschrieben werden. Dies ist eine funktionale und lesbare Art der Datenmanipulation.
keywords: MODIFY, FOR, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, VALUE #( ... EXCEPT ... )

    rv_is_image = abap_false.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Map (Hash-Tabelle) von Dateierweiterungen zu ihren MIME-Typen aus einer Liste von Erweiterungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine Hash-Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_extension_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_mime_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line. " Extension -> MIME Type

    METHODS create_extension_mime_map
      IMPORTING
        it_extensions TYPE ty_extension_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mime_map) TYPE ty_mime_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_extension_mime_map.
    rt_mime_map = REDUCE ty_mime_map(
      INIT map = VALUE ty_mime_map( )
      FOR extension IN it_extensions
      LET mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>get_mime_type_for_extension( extension ) IN
      map = COND #( WHEN mime_type IS NOT INITIAL THEN VALUE #( map ( key = extension value = mime_type ) ) ELSE map )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für eine bestimmte Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fae DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-table_line.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fae_single_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae=>tt_carrids( ( 'LH' ) ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights ),
      msg = 'Should find flights for LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid,
      exp = 'LH',
      msg = 'First flight should be for LH'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_fae_multiple_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae=>tt_carrids( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights ),
      msg = 'Should find flights for LH and AA'
    ).
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_aa) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_count_aa = lv_count_aa + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_count_lh > 0 AND lv_count_aa > 0 ),
      msg = 'Should contain flights for both LH and AA'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights ),

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft für eine gegebene Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen in Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @rt_summary
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-table_line
        GROUP BY carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_date_range
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
        iv_date_from TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_date_to   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_date_range.
    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-table_line
          AND fldate BETWEEN @iv_date_from AND @iv_date_to.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_price_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-table_line.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften alle Flüge ab und erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern enthält, die tatsächlich Flüge in der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle haben.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_existing_flight_keys
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_existing_flight_keys.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-table_line.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT ls_flight_key IN lt_all_flights ( ls_flight_key ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_distinct_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae_distinct=>tt_carrids( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->get_existing_flight_keys( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flight_keys ),
      msg = 'Should find distinct flight keys'
    ).
    " Check for uniqueness (implicit due to SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY)
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_aa) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
      IF ls_key-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_key-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_count_aa = lv_count_aa + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_count_lh > 0 AND lv_count_aa > 0 ),
      msg = 'Should contain distinct flights for both LH and AA'

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae_distinct=>tt_carrids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Dateierweiterungen akzeptiert und für jede Erweiterung den MIME-Typ ermittelt. Wenn der MIME-Typ `application/vnd.sap.xsf+xml` ist, soll ein spezieller Hinweis zurückgegeben werden, ansonsten der ermittelte MIME-Typ.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` Konstanten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_special_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_extension_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mime_result,
             extension TYPE string,
             mime_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mime_result.
    TYPES tt_mime_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mime_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_mime_info_with_special_case
      IMPORTING
        it_extensions TYPE ty_extension_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_mime_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_special_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_info_with_special_case.
    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR extension IN it_extensions
                           LET lv_mime = cl_fxs_mime_types=>get_mime_type_for_extension( extension ) IN
                           ( extension = extension,
                             mime_info = COND string(
                                           WHEN lv_mime = cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_xslfo_supplementary
                                           THEN 'Spezialfall: XSLFO-Ergänzung'
                                           ELSE lv_mime
                                         )
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften die Anzahl der Flüge, die in den letzten 30 Tagen stattgefunden haben, und geben Sie diese als Map (Fluggesellschaft -> Anzahl) zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einer Datumsberechnung und anschließend `REDUCE` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_recent DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_flight_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_recent_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_flight_count_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_recent IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_recent_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_recent_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_date_30_days_ago) = sy-datum - 30.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_recent_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-table_line
          AND fldate >= @lv_date_30_days_ago.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE ty_flight_count_map(
      INIT map = VALUE ty_flight_count_map( )
      FOR carrid_line IN lt_recent_flights
      LET current_count = map[ carrid_line ] IN
      map = VALUE #( map ( key = carrid_line value = current_count + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_valid_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Rufen Sie für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften die Flugdaten ab und berechnen Sie den Gesamtumsatz für jede Fluggesellschaft, die Flüge in der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle hat. Geben Sie eine Map (Fluggesellschaft -> Gesamtumsatz) zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für die Abfrage und anschließend `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_revenue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_revenue_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-price WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_carrier_revenue
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_revenue_map) TYPE ty_revenue_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_revenue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_revenue.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-table_line.
    ENDIF.

    rt_revenue_map = REDUCE ty_revenue_map(
      INIT map = VALUE ty_revenue_map( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      LET current_revenue = map[ ls_flight-carrid ] IN
      map = VALUE #( map ( key = ls_flight-carrid value = current_revenue + ls_flight-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_revenue FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_carrier_revenue_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_revenue.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae_revenue( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae_revenue=>tt_carrids( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_revenue_map) = lo_cut->get_carrier_revenue( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_revenue_map ),
      msg = 'Should return revenue for carriers'
    ).
    IF lt_revenue_map IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( lt_revenue_map[ 'LH' ] >= 0 ),
        msg = 'LH revenue should be non-negative'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( lt_revenue_map[ 'AA' ] >= 0 ),
        msg = 'AA revenue should be non-negative'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_carrier_revenue_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae_revenue( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae_revenue=>tt_carrids( ).
    DATA(lt_revenue_map) = lo_cut->get_carrier_revenue( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_revenue_map ),
      msg = 'Empty input table should result in empty map'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein gegebener MIME-Typ ein Textdokument ist (z.B. `text/plain`, `text/html`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `STARTS WITH` in einer `IF`-Bedingung oder `CASE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_is_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_text_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_text) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_is_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_text_mime_type.
    rv_is_text = abap_false.
    IF iv_mime_type STARTS WITH 'text/'.
      rv_is_text = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_is_text_plain.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mime_type_is_text( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->is_text_mime_type( cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_text_plain ),

  METHOD test_is_text_html.

Instructions: Rufen Sie für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften die Flugdaten ab und fügen Sie eine Spalte hinzu, die angibt, ob der Flug teuer ist (Preis > 1000).
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND` um die neue Spalte zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_enrich DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_enriched,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             is_expensive TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_sflight_enriched.
    TYPES tt_sflight_enriched TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_enriched WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_enriched_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_enriched.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_enrich IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enriched_flights.
    DATA lt_raw_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_enriched WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_raw_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = @it_carrids-table_line.
    ENDIF.

    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_raw_flights
                                   ( ls_flight-carrid,
                                     ls_flight-connid,
                                     ls_flight-fldate,
                                     ls_flight-price,
                                     is_expensive = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_flight-price > 1000 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
                                 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_enrich_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_enrich_flights_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_enrich_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae_enrich( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae_enrich=>tt_carrids( ( 'LH' ) ).
    DATA(lt_enriched_flights) = lo_cut->get_enriched_flights( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_enriched_flights ),
      msg = 'Should return enriched flights for LH'
    ).
    DATA(lv_expensive_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_cheap_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_enriched_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price > 1000.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ls_flight-is_expensive,
          msg = 'Expensive flight should be marked as expensive'
        ).
        lv_expensive_found = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
          act = ls_flight-is_expensive,
          msg = 'Cheap flight should not be marked as expensive'
        ).
        lv_cheap_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_expensive_found AND lv_cheap_found ),
      msg = 'Should find both expensive and cheap flights'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_enrich_flights_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae_enrich( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae_enrich=>tt_carrids( ).
    DATA(lt_enriched_flights) = lo_cut->get_enriched_flights( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_enriched_flights ),
      msg = 'Empty input table should result in empty enriched flight table'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FOR ALL ENTRIES` für die Datenbankabfrage mit der `FOR`-Iteration und `VALUE`-Konstrukt, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen und dabei eine zusätzliche Spalte (`is_expensive`) basierend auf einer Bedingung (`COND`) zu füllen. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art der Datenanreicherung.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, Open SQL, FOR, VALUE, COND, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, Data Enrichment
